title_en: Wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument, comprising a life information processing part, a control part, a communication part and a display part for sound, pictures and texts. A digital body temperature sensor 101, a pulse detection amplifying circuit 102 and a storage 103 are respectively connected with an input/output port of a microprocessor 120; a red rescue key 123, an orange rescue key 124, a yellow rescue key 125, a green safe key 126 and a start key 127 are respectively connected with the input port of the microprocessor 120; a wireless communication module 121 and a USB interface 122 are respectively connected with the input/output port of the microprocessor 120; and a loudspeaker and a driving circuit 110 thereof, a liquid crystal display 111 and a calendar clock chip 112 are respectively connected with the input/output port of the microprocessor 120. The wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument of the invention is mainly used for carrying out emergency rescue on victims who suffer natural disasters such as earthquake and the like, and emergent accidents of mine disasters, traffic accidents and the like, can receive 'finding' signals and can automatically send 'distress call' messages of vital signs and the like.

title_en: Doppler's through-wall radar localization method based on LASSO feature extractions
abstract_en: The invention belongs to target following technical field, discloses a kind of Doppler's through-wall radar localization method based on LASSO feature extractions.Wherein, LASSO frequency estimation algorithms separate the component for demodulating back echo signal and estimate the frequecy characteristic of interesting target component；According to target instantaneous frequency, real-time estimation target position information, synthesizes target trajectory, realizes the tracking to target locating and tracking algorithm.The present invention can not only be on the basis of Doppler's Through-Wall Radar System terseness (only needing a transmitter and two receivers) and detection real-time (arithmetic speed is fast) be ensured, effectively improve the positioning accuracy to target, it can also solve the problems, such as " frequency ambiguity ", be realized at the same time for the track and localization of multiple target at the same time.In addition, the present invention, without lengthy and tedious calculating process such as multi-channel data fusions, arithmetic speed is fast, is with a wide range of applications in the target tracking domain of Doppler's through-wall radar.

title_en: A kind of human body detection imaging method through walls based on kurtosis assessment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of human body detection imaging methods through walls based on kurtosis assessment, in this method, establish the constraint relationship between wall parameter；To three-dimensional data matrix Focusedimage is obtained using the self-focusing imaging algorithm based on kurtosis assessed value；During step 5 obtains focal imaging, human body target has been detected whether using the maximum value of kurtosis value sequence.Method of the invention uses the self-focusing imaging algorithm based on kurtosis assessed value, traditional MIMO radar BP imaging model is modified in conjunction with wall parameter, then enhancing amendment has been carried out to Human Physiology micro-tremor signal in self-focusing imaging process, revised algorithm can obtain the higher-quality self-focusing image of Human Physiology micro-tremor signal.

title_en: Crab apartment device with monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crab apartment device with monitor function, includes crab apartment, automatic monitoring device, track, support, power cord, coaster device, backup pad, controller, first servo motor, has first belt pulley device, first assembly pulley, second belt assembly pulley, second servo motor, shell, automatic telescoping device, third servo motor, screw rod, nut, telescopic link, camera device, radar life detection appearance, alarm and infrared induction remote controller. The invention has the advantages that the occupied space is small, and the occupied area of every hundred swimming crabs is less than 1 square meter on average, thereby saving resources; the camera captures the picture of each swimming crab in the crab apartment, so that the workload of managers is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor is saved; the life state of the portunids is detected in real time through a radar life detector, so that the death of the portunids is avoided, and the accurate positioning treatment is realized; the operation of the monitoring device can be controlled by the infrared of the remote controller, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based HRV signal extraction method and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave radar-based HRV signal extraction method and equipment, which are used for solving the technical problem that the conventional HRV signal extraction method cannot carry out non-contact long-term monitoring on a user. The method comprises the following steps: collecting radar echo data of a human body in a sleep state, and processing the radar echo data to obtain vital sign signals of the human body; the radar echo data are obtained by acting a millimeter wave radar on the human body; filtering the vital sign signal based on a first preset filter to obtain a first filtered signal, and filtering the vital sign signal based on a second preset filter to obtain a second filtered signal; carrying out heartbeat cycle division on the first filtering signal through a first preset algorithm to obtain a heartbeat cycle signal; and screening the heartbeat periodic signal by using the second filtering signal through a second preset algorithm to obtain an HRV signal.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a heartbeat detection method and a heartbeat detection device, relates to the technical field of radar detection, and is used for improving the accuracy of heartbeat detection. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target space and acquiring echo signals; processing the echo signal to obtain a heartbeat time domain signal of the target human body; determining the number of effective peak-valley pairs in the heartbeat time domain signal according to the heartbeat time domain signal, and determining a frequency selection range according to the number of the effective peak-valley pairs; carrying out fast Fourier transformation on the heartbeat time domain signal to obtain a heartbeat frequency domain signal; finding a target spectrum peak of the heartbeat frequency domain signal in the frequency selection range; and determining the heartbeat frequency of the target human body according to the frequency corresponding to the peak value of the target spectrum peak.
assignees: QINGDAO HISENSE HITACHI AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method for bedridden patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring method for bedridden patients, which comprises monitoring equipment, wherein the monitoring equipment comprises a bed body, a radar transceiver, a processing center and an alarm, wherein the radar transceiver, the processing center and the alarm are arranged on the bed body; the weighing device comprises a weighing piece, a plurality of weighing devices, a processing center and a control unit, wherein the weighing devices are arranged in the weighing piece at intervals, the weighing devices are used for measuring stress conditions of all parts of the weighing piece, and the weighing devices are electrically connected with the processing center. The weighing piece is used for weighing, measuring stress conditions of each point on the mattress, effectively judging the position of a patient, and judging whether an interference source is positioned on the bed.

title_en: Respiration detection method, device and equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breath detection method, a device and equipment based on millimeter wave radar in the technical field of intelligent detection, comprising the following steps: determining acquisition sensor parameters according to first user data and environment data acquired by the millimeter wave radar according to a preset detection time interval for a user object; adjusting sensor parameters of the millimeter wave radar by taking the acquired sensor parameters as targets, and acquiring second user data of the user object again through the millimeter wave radar after adjusting the sensor parameters; generating a breathing characteristic of the user object based at least on the environmental data and the second user data; according to the preset key length, a random encryption key is randomly generated by adopting a random number generator, and a target key is derived according to the random encryption key and the fixed key; and according to the target key and the random encryption key, converting the breathing characteristics into a target system format, encrypting the breathing characteristics of the target system format through the target key, and generating a breathing detection result of the user object.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on principal component analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring method based on principal component analysis, which comprises the following steps: sending radar microwave signals to a target human body, receiving one path of radar microwave echo signals, and extracting frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave echo signals; judging whether the human body is in bed or not according to the frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave echo signals, and if so, extracting abdomen breathing characteristics according to the frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave echo signals; analyzing radar microwave echo signals according to the abdominal respiratory characteristics to obtain thoracic phase data, and reconstructing the thoracic phase data to obtain reconstructed thoracic phase data; and calculating the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the human body according to the reconstructed thoracic phase data.

title_en: FMCW-based vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign monitoring method, device and equipment based on FMCW and a storage medium, relating to the field of vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of receiving multi-frame FMCW radar echo signals, respectively executing processing steps on the multi-frame FMCW radar echo signals to obtain a plurality of third signals and a plurality of target motion phases corresponding to the third signals, determining a plurality of second signals according to the plurality of third signals and the plurality of target motion phases, further determining respiration and heartbeat frequencies and sending the respiration and heartbeat frequencies to an upper computer to monitor vital signs of a human body, and determining target motion phases and target distance gates according to the plurality of first signals, and determining third signals and phase values of the third signals according to the plurality of first signals and the target distance gates, wherein the third signals are average signals of the first signals located in the target distance gates. The problem that the accuracy of monitoring vital signs is not high when the RBM of faster speed appears in the human body in the prior art can be solved to this disclosure, improves the accuracy of monitoring vital signs.

title_en: Heart rate estimating method and device based on millimeter wave radar multichannel combination
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar non-contact vital sign monitoring, and particularly relates to a heart rate estimation method and device based on millimeter wave radar multichannel combination, which comprises the following steps that firstly, a chest echo signal is synchronously acquired by a millimeter wave radar based on multichannel frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW, a distance bin containing a vital signal is extracted from the echo signal through a distance FFT, and a multichannel phase signal is obtained by preprocessing; secondly, constructing a multichannel signal joint optimization objective function, combining a multichannel phase signal to perform modal decomposition, adaptively determining an initial center frequency of modal decomposition according to peak values fused by multichannel signal spectrums and peak values with large energy, performing iterative update based on the objective function to obtain an optimal heart rate modal sequence, and finally screening a final heart rate modal from the heart rate modal sequence according to an energy maximum principle, and outputting the center frequency of the screened heart rate modal as a heart rate value to realize heart rate estimation.

title_en: Sailing control method of mine-sweeper using radar image tracking
title_ko: 레이더 영상 추적 기법을 활용한 소해함 운항 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sailing control method of mine-sweeper using radar image tracking is provided to effectively eliminate mines buried in the swept area by controlling the operation of mine-sweepers by correcting a moving route and speed of mine-sweepers. CONSTITUTION: A swept area is set(S10). A route for a mine-sweeper is determined(S20). A mine-sweeper operates(S30). A towing type mine eliminating device is towed(S40). A radar image tracking starts(S100). A result of a radar image tracking is displayed on the electronic navigation chart(S150). It is determined if mine-sweepers are maintained in a designed swept area(S200).
abstract_ko: 레이더 영상 추적 기법을 활용한 소해함 운항 제어방법이 개시된다. 보다 상세하게는 본 발명은, (a) 미리 설정된 소해 구역에서 소해함을 이용하여 소해구를 예인하는 단계와, (b) 소해구의 실시간 위치에 대한 레이더 영상 추적을 시행하여 레이더 영상 추적에 의한 결과를 전자 해도에 전시하는 단계와, (c) 전자 해도를 판독하여 상기 소해구가 미리 설정된 소해 구역에 유지되고 있는지 판정하는 단계와, (d) (c)단계의 판정결과 소해구가 미리 설정된 소해 구역에서 벗어난 경우, 소해구가 상기 미리 설정된 소해구로 복귀되기 위한 소해함의 이동 속도 및 이동 경로를 산출하는 단계 및 (e) 산출된 소해함의 이동 속도 및 이동 경로에 따라 소해함을 운용하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Wearable device having an attachable and detachable sensor for detecting a biological signal and method of controlling wearable device
title_ko: 생체 신호를 검출하는 센서를 착탈할 수 있는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable device capable of easily attaching/detaching a sensor for detecting a biological signal, and a method for controlling the wearable device. The wearable device comprises: a wearing part configured to assist a user in wearing the wearable device on a body part of the user; a first interface part configured to receive a biological signal from a sensor installed in the wearable device; a control unit configured to generate biological information based on the received biological signal; and an output unit configured to output the generated biological information.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 검출하는 센서를 쉽게 착탈할 수 있는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Driver Personalized Negative Emotion Discrimination System using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 운전자 개인 맞춤형 부정적 감정 판별 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a driver personalized negative emotion discrimination system using radar. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a driver emotion discrimination system comprises: radar installed in a driver seat and obtaining a biological signal in a non-contact method; and a terminal determining a negative emotion of a driver by analyzing the biological signal obtained from the radar. Accordingly, a service which reduces probabilities of violent driving, legal violations and the like having a high correlation when the emotion of the driver is discriminated as the negative emotion is provided, thereby increasing user satisfaction.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 운전자 개인 맞춤형 부정적 감정 판별 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 운전자 감정 판별 시스템은, 운전석에 설치되어 생체신호를 비접촉식으로 획득하는 레이더 및 레이더에서 획득된 생체신호를 분석하여, 운전자의 부정적 감정을 판별하는 단말을 포함한다. 이에 의해, 부정적 감정으로 판별시 높은 상관관계를 갖는 난폭운전과 법규위반 등의 확률을 줄이는 서비스를 제공함으로써 사용자의 만족도를 향상시킬 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Apparatus for guiding exit in fire
title_ko: 화재상황에서도 식별이 용이한 피난구 유도 장치
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides an evacuation exit guiding device, which comprises: a detection sensor which is installed at a position of a certain height of an inner wall of a building and detects smoke caused by a fire; and an evacuation exit guiding projection unit which is buried and installed on the floor of the building, and controls a direction irradiating an evacuation exit guidance image recognizable with naked eyes by an evacuee toward the evacuation exit door in a different direction than usual without the fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 형태는 건물 내벽의 일정 높이의 위치에 설치되며 화재로 인한 연기를 감지하는 감지센서; 및 건물 바닥에 매립되어 설치되되, 감지센서를 통해 연기 감지될 경우 대피자가 육안으로 인식가능한 피난구 유도 이미지를 피난구 대피문을 향해 조사하는 방향을 화재 발생되지 않은 평상시와 다르게 하여 제어하는 피난구 유도 영사부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, one of the RF tags being turned on and generating an incident RF signal with a predetermined frequency, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one radio-frequency identification (RFID) radar that turns on one of the RF tags, demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital signal of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to the turned-on RF tag.

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject. A radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of arrays of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A phase vaue is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing phase changes over time for each voxel is generated. Voxels indicating an oscillating signal are selected and life sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: Wearable sensing device and bio signal data monitoring/emergency situation detection method using same
title_ko: 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 데이터 모니터링/응급 상황 감지 방법
abstract_en: A wearable sensing device may comprise: a bio sensor sheet covering a part of the front of a chest and a part of the back of the chest around an axillar (armpit) at a center therebetween; and a bio sensor control unit connected to the bio sensor sheet and located at the lower end of the rear surface of the chest, wherein the bio sensor sheet is configured to measure one or more bio signals among an electrocardiogram, a heart rate, a body temperature, a pulse, an electromyogram, a blood pressure, and a respiration volume. A wearable sensing device and a bio data management and emergency situation detection method using the same according to the present invention enable a small number of staffs to rapidly determine whether there is any problem in the health of invalids who are being cared for in a nursing/protective facility and whether an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스는 액와(겨드랑이)를 중심으로 흉부 정면의 일부와 흉부 배면의 일부를 덮는 바이오센서 시트, 및 바이오센서 시트에 접속되고 상기 흉부 배면의 하단에 위치한 바이오센서 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 바이오센서 시트는 심전도, 심박율, 체온, 맥박, 근전도, 혈압, 근전도, 및 호흡량 중 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호를 측정하도록 구성될 수 있다. 본 발명에 따른 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 생체 데이터 관리 및 응급 상황 감지 방법은 요양/보호 시설에 있는 보호대상약자들의 건강 이상 유무 및 응급 상황 발생 여부를 적은 인원으로 빠르게 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Methods, computer programs, radar systems, antenna systems and flying platforms for detecting a horizontally buried linear object
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for detecting a horizontally buried linear object, the horizontally buried linear object having a longitudinal extension. The method comprises moving(S10), with a flying platform comprising a radar for synthetic aperture radar, SAR, vertical imaging, along a trajectory corresponding to a synthetic aperture. The method further comprises transmitting (S20) and receiving radar signals while moving along the trajectory corresponding to the synthetic aperture. The method also comprises forming (S30) a SAR image based on collected data representing radar signal reflections received from the ground. The method additionally comprises detecting (S40) one or more features in the formed SAR image relating to the horizontally buried linear object. Said trajectory is oriented in a direction substantially perpendicular to an expected orientation of the longitudinal extension of the horizontally buried object and traversing the horizontally buried object. The present disclosure further relates to corresponding computer programs, radar systems, flying platforms and antenna systems.

title_en: Implantable cardioverter defibrillator designed for use in a magnetic resonance imaging environment
abstract_en: An implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) includes a communication interface operable to receive a communication signal from an external programmer. With the ICD not being in the presence of an MRI field generated by an MRI scanner, a communication signal is sent precharging a high energy storage capacitor before the patient undergoes the MRI scan. The signal also switches the ICD into an MRI mode which turns off the ICD's sensing functions detecting a dangerous ventricular arrhythmia. An operator monitors the patient's vital signs with sensors connected to the patient. If the patient does require the defibrillation shock, the operator sends a second communication signal delivering the defibrillation shock from the precharged high energy storage capacitor of the ICD. The patient can then be removed from the MRI scanner and the RF and gradient fields of the MRI scanner turned off.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Buried object detector
abstract_en: A sensor device designed to detect buried objects by measuring the anisotropy of the electromagnetic properties of ground. This anisotropy is distinguished from the main reflection by modulating the signal using either a mechanically rotated antenna or an electronically switched antenna array after the in-phase and quadrature components are isolated from the main reflection using an electronic filter.

title_en: Non-contact self-injection locking sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact self-injection locking sensor transmits a signal to a living body by a self-injection locking integrated oscillation antenna, and the signal reflected by the living body is injection-locked, and the signal is modulated by the phase of the vital sign of the living body, so that the physiological sign signal of the living body can be obtained by demodulating the injection locking signal of the self-injection locking integrated oscillation antenna by a demodulator.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 방 내부의 등에 설치된 내장형 생체 신호 수집기 기반 고독사 방지 방법에 있어서, 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기를 기반으로 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 상기 생체 신호에서 클러터(Clutter) 신호를 억제하고 고독사 방지 대상자의 생체 신호만을 추출하는 DSP(digital signal processing) 처리를 수행하는 단계; 상기 DSP 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 중요 신호만 추출하는 신호 처리를 수행하는 단계; 상기 신호 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 특징 파라미터를 추출하는 단계; 상기 생체 신호 및 상기 특징 파라미터를 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버로 전송하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버는 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 상기 생체 신호 및 특징 파라미터를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하고,  상기 생체 신호 수집 서버는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 고독사 방지 대상자에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 신호를 추출한다.

title_en: Negative Pressure Clothing having portable negative pressure apparatus
title_ko: 휴대용 음압기가 구비된 음압복
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 음압기가 구비된 음압복에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 실내에는 공기 오염도와 미세먼지를 검출하기 위한 센서부와 전면에는 투시부가 형성되며, 얼굴 부분을 감싸도록 하는 머리부와 상기 머리부와 하향으로 연결되며, 분리 가능하게 결합되어 몸을 감싸는 몸통부와 상기 머리부에는 스마트폰과 무선 연결되도록 하기 위해 결합, 구비되는 이어폰과 상기 머리부의 하부의 내부공간에 일단이 삽입되고 외부에 타단이 노출되어 산소가 유입되는 산소공급라인과 상기 산소공급라인의 타단에 설치되어 산소를 발생시키는 산소발생기와 실내의 공기 압력을 실외의 공기 압력보다 낮게 하여 내부의 오염된 공기를 실외로 배출시키는 웨어러블 형태의 휴대용 음압기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Bed with bio-signal measurement function and bio-signal monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 기능을 갖는 침대 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 기능을 갖는 침대는 침대의 매트리스에서 수면을 취하는 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 생체 신호의 변화 추이 정보를 생성하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의해 생성된 상기 변화 추이 정보를 이용하여 사용자 단말기에 상기 사용자의 수면 상태와 관련한 위험성을 알람으로 경보하는 알람 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for extracting images of vascular structure and blood flow from image sequences
abstract_en: Periodic biological functions and their related anatomy that cannot be seen in image sequences using typical means, can nonetheless be made visible by demodulating the image sequence according to the timing of that biological function using the described method. In particular, vascular structure and the function of that structure becomes observable when demodulated according to the patient's heart beat. This method suppresses the effects of thermal variations across the anatomy, and of severe scattering loss from buried tissues, that limit current thermographic (heat imaging) methods. It also measures localized changes in the wave front amplitude, shape, and phase, which are expected to prove useful for disease diagnosis and biometry.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Data pre-processing method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A data pre-processing method is provided. By using an energy distribution parameter set obtained through beamforming scanning, a signal-to-noise ratio of a signal can be improved and a detection range region can be automatically generated, thereby improving an object tracking effect. An exercise vital sign detection radar is also provided.

title_en: Life detection robot is equipped based on multisensor information
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a life detection robot is equipped based on multisensor information, the running gear unit is installed to the bilateral symmetry of box, cloud platform unit is installed on the box, have the rotary joint arm of realizing rotational degree of freedom and install on the rotary joint arm, realize the every single move articulated arm of the every single move degree of freedom, video load unit is installed on the every single move articulated arm, along with every single move articulated arm every single move swing with along with the rotary joint rotation of arm, sound load unit, radar life detection load unit is installed respectively on the rotary joint arm, along with the rotary joint rotation of arm, cloud platform unit, video load unit, sound load unit, radar life detection load unit link to each other with the the control unit who installs in the box respectively, and the control unit is connected with fast leaflet unit and rear control cabinet through the wireless communication who installs on the box. The utility model discloses can replace first -aid staff to get into the on -the -spot search and rescue task of carrying out in ruins, reduce the first -aid staff injures and deaths, the survivor that provides who is showing searches for efficiency.

title_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system
abstract_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system, life detection car includes vehicle main body, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly, at least four cameras and processor, vehicle main body is provided with the running assembly of driving life detection car traveling, and processor is connected with running assembly, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly and all cameras.The surrounding environment image that can be shot due to the application by the range information and camera for sign of life, the life detection car that sensor assembly detects and the surrounding objects that life-detection instrument detects, under the control of a processor, so that direction automatic running of the life detection car towards sign of life, search person in distress and its accurate location, rescue personnel is allowed in the place away from hazardous environment, the information that life detection car is passed back can be received by wearable device, understand site environment as on the spot in person, the decision of next step action is precisely made, reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Rock soil seepage real-time measuring instrument device based on heat conduction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground seepage flow real-time measuring instrument device based on heat-conduction. The device is buried underground, each seepage measurement sensor is connected with a seepage information collection transmitter through a respective seepage measurement processing terminal, and the seepage information collection transmitter is connected with a transmitting end antenna; among the seepage flow measurement sensor, tubule and two funnels of connection at the tubule both ends in the middle of the tubule funnel structure, the tip of tubule and communicate with each other with the tubule are connected to the tip of funnel admittedly, and the main aspects terminal surface of funnel is equipped with porous potsherd, and the inside central authorities of tubule have arranged controllable heating rod, and a temperature sensor has been put to the inside both ends equipartition of tubule, and the inside middle part cartridge of tubule has the water probe. The utility model discloses carry out its direction of accurate measurement and seepage flow volume size to the ground seepage flow that causes by various reasons in the ground, for the new instrument of seepage flow volume in the real-time observation ground, provide the precursor information for the emergence of calamity such as landslide, mud-rock flow.

title_en: Through-wall radar equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a through-wall radar device, which comprises a through-wall radar host, wherein two sides of the through-wall radar host are provided with hand handles, the rear side surface of the through-wall radar host is provided with an adsorption mechanism, the adsorption mechanism comprises an installation block and an adsorption unit, the installation block is fixedly arranged on the rear side surface of the through-wall radar host, the installation block is connected with the adsorption unit, the adsorption unit comprises a cylindrical tube, a lifting rod, a rubber plug and a sucker, the upper end of the cylindrical tube is fixedly arranged on the installation block, a cavity is arranged in the installation block, a sliding plate is arranged in the cavity, the upper end of the sliding plate is connected with a driving piece of the sliding plate, the other end of the driving piece of the sliding plate is connected with the upper end of the inner wall of the installation block, the lower end of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with the lifting rod, the lifting, the support is connected with the rough surface adhesive plate. The utility model has the advantages of place light, adsorption effect is good, improve imaging quality.
assignees: CHENGDU IANKE HUIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Health monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of health detection, in particular to health monitoring equipment, which comprises a monitor and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the monitoring mechanism is arranged in the monitor, the monitoring mechanism comprises a physical sign detector, a camera, an infrared transmitting tube, an infrared receiving tube and an infrared temperature measuring probe, the infrared transmitting tube and the infrared receiving tube are used for detecting the distance between a user and the monitoring equipment, the infrared transmitting tube is used for transmitting infrared rays in a specific wavelength range, the infrared receiving tube is used for receiving the reflected infrared rays and converting the infrared rays into electric signals to measure the distance, and the infrared temperature measuring probe is used for measuring the temperature of the surface of the user or an object in a non-contact mode. According to the utility model, through infrared ranging, infrared temperature measurement, UWB radar vital sign monitoring and camera real-time monitoring technologies, the health condition and working state of a user can be comprehensively monitored, and the accuracy and stability of a measurement result are ensured by adopting infrared rays and UWB radar technologies with specific wavelengths.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network, it includes vital sign module (1), gyro module (2), microprocessor module (6) and ad hoc network transmission module (7), vital sign module (1) is located at the inside of the helmet, vital sign module (1) includes photoelectric sensor (4) and temperature sensor (5), the photoelectric sensor (4) is through epidermis for detecting heart rate, and temperature sensor (5) is for measuring head skin temperature；Gyro module (2) is used to detect movement, the attitude data information of people；Vital sign module (1), the information conveyance of gyro module (2) detection are given microprocessor module (6), and microprocessor module (6) sends the data received by ad hoc network transmission module (7)；The invention enables the states that Fire Command Center more accurately understands fire fighter, and can make the decision to rescue and relief work faster.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU ZHONGLI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle environment detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle environment detection system and a method, wherein a life information detection module of the system detects whether life information exists in a vehicle through millimeter radar signals, a life information confirmation module confirms a detection result according to current image information, an information acquisition module acquires environment information in the vehicle when the life information exists, an environment information judgment module judges whether the environment information in the vehicle meets preset environment conditions, and an alarm module generates alarm information when the environment information in the vehicle does not meet the preset environment conditions. The invention determines whether to give an alarm or not by detecting the life information in the vehicle, confirming the detection result and judging the environmental information, thereby more accurately realizing the alarm of the life detection.

title_en: Nuclear magnetic imaging detection equipment and method based on increased biological radar detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear magnetic resonance, and discloses a nuclear magnetic imaging detection device based on increased biological radar detection. This nuclear magnetic imaging check out test set and method based on increase biological radar detects, can acquire the patient through biological radar and be carrying out the detailed respiratory wave and the pulse shock wave information of nuclear magnetic resonance inspection in-process, and can remove along with patient's removal, avoid appearing data loss or data detection deviation, be favorable to the vital sign change of real time monitoring person being examined, grasp the real-time vital sign change of patient when carrying out nuclear magnetic resonance, the doctor can further formulate the scheme according to patient's health, provide sufficient treatment judgement basis.

title_en: Human body vital sign detection method of millimeter wave radar in complex indoor scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and discloses a human body vital sign detection method of a millimeter wave radar under a complex indoor scene, which comprises the following steps: training the classifier according to the sample data; performing ADC data acquisition on the millimeter wave radar echo signal to obtain sampled data, and performing FFT processing, static clutter filtering and CFAR and DOA estimation to obtain point cloud data; performing Doppler transformation and feature extraction on point cloud data, and filtering moving points with large motion amplitude; extracting phase information from the signals of continuous N frames of the point cloud, and estimating breathing and heartbeat frequencies; extracting the characteristics of the point cloud signals of continuous N frames; inputting the extracted features into a classifier for prediction; and outputting the human target respiration heartbeat data detected in the scene. The method classifies the clutter and the scattering interference, and outputs the vital sign detection result of the human target; the method can eliminate large motion amplitude and static interference items in the scene, and ensure stable detection.
assignees: CHANGSHA MICROBRAIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Augmented reality search and rescue glasses suitable for complicated environmental conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses augmented reality search and rescue glasses suitable for complex environmental conditions, which comprise UWB ultra-wideband radar, RGB cameras, infrared cameras, IMU, eyeball trackers, calculation modules, display modules and the like. Wherein: UWB ultra-wideband radar, RGB camera, infrared camera adopt different technical means to detect the life in the environment respectively, realize shielding, life detection under multiple complex environment such as low illumination. The eye tracker is used for monitoring eye movements of the wearer, and the IMU is used for monitoring head movements of the wearer. The calculation module fuses the real-time life detection result, the eyeball movement of the wearer and the head movement data, and then presents the life detection result on the display module, thereby providing guidance for the search and rescue work of the rescue workers. Under complex environmental conditions, the invention has higher life detection capability, can greatly reduce the workload of rescue workers, and is very beneficial to life detection under complex environmental conditions.

title_en: Indoor static personnel detection method for millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting indoor static personnel of a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: reconstructing data, detecting categories of indoor personnel and the like, wherein the targets are in a scene with low movement speed, and then performing subsequent signal processing after the reconstruction data are needed; step S2: signal processing; step S3: implementing an algorithm, and implementing a cluster tracking algorithm according to the point cloud data in the step S2; step S4: confirming a target; step S5: and outputting a result. The method can realize the detection of indoor dynamic personnel and static personnel targets. The dynamic target detection is mainly realized through radar signal processing and a cluster tracking algorithm, and the static target detection is based on the detection of the respiratory heartbeat intensity, standard deviation and spatial correlation of the vital signals by using a vital sign detection algorithm, so that the effective detection of the static target is realized.

title_en: Biological magnetic field signal self-adaptive adjustment system based on giant magneto-resistance sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological magnetic field signal self-adaptive adjustment system based on a giant magneto-resistance sensor, which comprises an external programmable magnet module and a programmable external magnetic field, wherein the external programmable magnet module is composed of a permanent magnet and an electromagnet; the analog front-end module collects a biological induction magnetic field generated by an external programmable magnet module and charged particles in blood vessels by using a giant magneto-resistance sensor, and processes the collected signals through an amplifier and a filter; the digital back-end module simulates the biological induction magnetic field processed by the front-end module to carry out self-adaptive adjustment on the external programmable magnet module through peak-to-peak average ratio, and carries out vital sign detection on the biological induction magnetic field obtained after electromagnetic field adjustment. The invention combines the permanent magnet and the electromagnet to avoid the limitation under the interference of external environment, and the problem that the permanent magnet alone cannot be self-adaptively used for detecting individuals and external environment is solved by detecting the IBF magnetic field signal in real time and then self-adaptively adjusting the magnetic field of the electromagnet.

title_en: Biological signal processing device and biological signal processing program
abstract_en: To acquire more accurate vital information from a reflection wave obtained by transmitting an electric wave to a living body.SOLUTION: In a biological signal processing device, vital signals in which a body motion component is removed are taken out by using the ratio of complex signals of two reflection waves by a reflection wave from a region R1 where the motion is large because it includes a vital component in a person to be measured (living body) 7 and a reflection wave from a region R2 where the motion is small because it does not include a vital component by a beamforming and a null beam of a reception signal using one radar module using an array antenna (23 and 25) as indicated in Fig. 1. As a method of the present invention for acquiring a reflection wave by designating a specific site such as the region R2 (shoulder) which does not include a vital component and whose motion is small, the reflection wave is multiplied by weighting information w1 and w2 obtained by beamforming beforehand.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Digital device and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A wearable device includes a bio signal sensor unit which senses a bio signal; a storage unit which stores data; and a processor which controls the bio signal sensor unit and the storage unit. The processor unit generates first reference data which includes the weight of the first reference object and the first bio signal in case of directing a first bio signal generated when a first reference object is held, generates measurement data which includes a second bio signal in case of directing the second bio signal generated when the measurement object is held, compares the measurement data with the first reference data, and obtains the weight of the measurement object.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스에 있어서, 생체 신호를 센싱하는 생체 신호 센서 유닛; 데이터를 저장하는 스토리지 유닛; 및 상기 생체 신호 센서 유닛 및 상기 스토리지 유닛을 제어하는 프로세서; 를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 제 1 레퍼런스 오브젝트가 홀딩됨에 따라 발생된 제 1 생체 신호를 디텍트한 경우, 상기 제 1 생체 신호 및 상기 제 1 레퍼런스 오브젝트의 무게를 포함하는 제 1 레퍼런스 데이터를 생성하고, 측정 오브젝트가 홀딩됨에 따라 발생된 제 2 생체 신호를 디텍트한 경우, 상기 제 2 생체 신호를 포함하는 측정 데이터를 생성하고, 상기 측정 데이터를 상기 제 1 레퍼런스 데이터와 비교하여, 상기 측정 오브젝트의 무게를 획득하는, 웨어러블 디바이스를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: workers healthcare method using smartphone application
title_ko: 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method of managing the health of employees by using a smartphone application comprises: a screen output step in which an application is executed in a smartphone to output a main screen on a display under the control of a control part; a converting step in which the control part of the smartphone makes a request to a web service (210) of a server (200) through network communication and then receives and converts a biometric signal stored in a Hadoop distributed file system (HDFS)(230) of the server (200) into data able to be outputted on the display; and a data output step in which the control part matches the converted biometric signal data with each position of the main screen outputted on the display. As such, the employee health management method is capable of preventing accidents in industrial sites by identifying health condition based on a biometric signal of an employee in a safety management suit measuring the biometric signal; preventing accidents by analyzing the health state of an employee including stress level, exercise strength, movement, and behavior patterns through a bigdata-based server using a biometric signal such as electrocardiogram, accelerometer, or temperature sensed through a biometric signal sensor of the safety management suit; and preventing an industrial accident, improving productivity, and enhancing health by providing a continuous personalized health management service through a smartphone application.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법은 스마트폰에 어플리케이션이 실행되어 제어부의 제어하에 메인화면을 디스플레이에 출력하는 화면출력단계; 상기 스마트폰의 제어부가 네트워크통신을 통해 서버(200)의 웹 서비스(210)에 요청을 한 후, 서버(200)의 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)(HDFS, Hadoop Distributed File System)에 저장된 생체신호 데이터를 수신하여 디스플레이에 출력할 수 있도록 변환하는 변환단계; 상기 제어부는 변환된 생체신호 데이터를 디스플레이에 출력되는 메인화면의 각 위치에 매칭하여 표시하는 데이터출력단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통해 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Apparatus for determining the emergency situation of the old and the infirm
title_ko: 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm which senses a bio-signal of the elderly and infirm and whether the elderly and infirm enters a specific space through a contactless method by being arranged in a living space of the elderly and infirm, determines whether an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs by sensing the bio-signal of the elderly and infirm, determines whether the emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs as the elderly and infirm pushes a button, and determines whether the emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs through a movement of a body of the apparatus. To this end, the apparatus comprises: a bio-radar; a warning sound occurring button; a gyro sensor; and a control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 노약자의 주거 공간 내에 배치되어 노약자의 특정 공간 진입 여부와 노약자의 생체신호를 비접촉 방식으로 감지하고, 노약자의 생체신호 감지를 통해 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하고, 노약자의 버튼 누름을 통해서도 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하며, 장치 몸체의 움직임을 통해서도 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring bio signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for measuring bio signals. The device for measuring bio signals according to one embodiment comprises: an optical sensor for irradiating light to a subject and receiving a light signal returned from the subject; and a bio impedance sensor for measuring a bio impedance by depth with respect to the same area as the measurement area of the optical sensor. According to the present invention, precise signals can be obtained.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 피검체에 광을 조사하고 상기 피검체로부터 되돌아오는 광 신호를 수신하는 광 센서와, 상기 광 센서의 측정 영역과 동일한 영역에 대한 깊이별 생체 임피던스를 측정하는 생체 임피던스 센서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Home Occupant Detection And Monitoring System
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Reservoir landslide array type underwater deformation monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application provides a reservoir landslide array type underwater deformation monitoring device and a monitoring method, wherein an anchorage is buried at an underwater monitoring point of a sliding body, and a floating shell is used for floating on the water surface; the GPS sensor is used for receiving and transmitting GPS signals to obtain the real-time position of the floating shell, the water temperature sensor is used for obtaining a water temperature time sequence, and the gravity wave meter is used for obtaining a water surface wave height time sequence; the upper end of the pull rope is fixedly connected with the floating shell through a displacement compensation mechanism, the lower end of the pull rope is fixedly connected with the anchorage, the displacement compensation mechanism is used for carrying out displacement compensation after the floating shell floats along with the wave, and the coding type displacement meter is used for measuring the real-time distance between the displacement meter and the anchorage. The technical scheme provided by the application has the beneficial effects that: the real-time three-dimensional coordinates of the underwater monitoring points are monitored by the buoy type monitor, so that the change of the underwater three-dimensional space coordinates of the landslide body can be accurately positioned. And recording related environmental factors in real time, and integrating functions of real-time information acquisition, storage, processing analysis, transmission and the like.

title_en: Human body activity state detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of human body detection of electromagnetic waves, and provides a human body activity state detection method, a human body activity state detection device, human body activity state detection equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signals generated in continuous frames, analyzing to obtain voltage values of the echo signals, and determining a state decision weight corresponding to a signal wave of each frame according to the voltage values of the echo signals and the voltage value of the spatial noise; calculating a state value corresponding to each frame according to the state decision weight and the voltage value of the echo signal, comparing the state value corresponding to each frame with a standard value of a preset human body state, and determining the human body state corresponding to each frame according to a comparison result; and detecting the activity state of the human body according to the human body state corresponding to the continuous frames in the preset time and a preset decision rule. The method and the device can realize the recognition of the human body state based on the microwave signal, thereby accurately judging the activity state of the human body and improving the application range of detecting the vital signs of the human body by utilizing the microwave.

title_en: Detachable living body signal complex sensor and method for detecting information of the living body using the same
title_ko: 착탈 가능한 생체 신호 복합 센서 및 이를 이용한 생체 정보 검출 방법
abstract_ko: 착탈식 생체 신호 복합 센서는 피검체에 대한 생체 신호 센싱 및 신호 처리를 위한 회로 모듈이 내장된 것으로, 제 1 평판과, 상기 제 1 평판과 일측이 연결되어 한 쌍의 집게발 형태를 형성하는 제 2 평판을 포함하는 클립형 구조물; 상기 클립형 구조물의 외측면에 배치된 혈압 센서 및 복수의 전극;을 포함한다.

title_ko: 생체 신호 계측 장치
abstract_ko:
생체 신호 계측기(웨어러블 생체 센서)에 내장되어 있는 이차 전지를 전용 충전 단자에 의하지 않고 충전할 수 있도록 한다. 
내부 전원으로서의 전지 및 그 충전 회로(200)와, 생체 신호 계측 시에 인체의 피부면과 접촉하고 전지의 충전 시에는 소정의 급전기(2)에 접속되는 전극(10a, 10b)과, 전극(10a, 10b)에서 검출되는 생체 신호를 소정 처리하는 생체 신호 처리 회로(100)와, 생체 신호·급전 전력 분배 수단(300)을 구비하며, 전극(10a, 10b)에 대하여 생체 신호 처리 회로(100)와 충전 회로(200)가 생체 신호·급전 전력 분배 수단(300)을 통하여 전환 가능하게 접속되어 있고, 전지의 충전 시에는 전극(10a, 10b)을 충전용 단자로서 이용한다.

title_en: System for monitoring safety of living using sound waves and radio waves
title_ko: 음파 및 전파를 이용한 생활안전 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환경오류에 의한 오탐이나 해킹 등의 사생활 침해 걱정없이, 레이더 센서를 이용하여 관리 대상자의 생체신호(심장박동, 호흡, 움직임 등)를 감지하고 딥러닝 기술에 기반한 음향분석을 통해 관리 대상자를 실시간으로 정확하게 모니터링 및 이상발생 시 원격지의 관리자에게 신속히 알릴 수 있는 음파 및 전파를 이용한 생활안전 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent search and rescue system based on wireless networking and location technology
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of intelligent search and rescue system based on wireless networking and location technology, wherein system includes search and rescue robot, and the search and rescue robot includes the first car body, the first Power Component, first microprocessor, locating module, life detection module, the first power module and the first wireless communication module；Communication robot；Host computer, the host computer is communicated with first wireless communication module and/or second wireless communication module.Using this kind of system, arm processor is combined with ZigBee wireless sensor network technologies, utilize the intelligent search and rescue robot control core of ARM platform buildings, and aligned environment detection sensor system and vital signs detecting system, robot system is more effectively applied to search and rescue field, greatly improve the automaticity, concertedness and controllability of search and rescue robot, increase search efficiency, the search and rescue time is reduced, the requirement searched and rescued on a large scale is met.

title_en: Heartbeat detection radar system
abstract_en: A kind of heartbeat detection radar system is the utility model is related to, radar system includes：Radar transmitter, for launching the signal of predetermined waveform；The transmitting antenna being connected with radar transmitter, the signal for radar transmitter to be launched are radiated to default security region；Reception antenna, the echo-signal of human heartbeat's signal is included for receiving；The signal to noise ratio regulation circuit being connected with reception antenna, for improving the signal to noise ratio of low frequency signal in echo-signal；The frequency mixer being connected with signal to noise ratio regulation circuit, for the echo-signal of signal to noise ratio regulation circuit input to be carried out into Frequency mixing processing with default input signal；The A/D converter being connected with frequency mixer, the mixed frequency signal for frequency mixer to be inputted are converted to data signal；The terminal processor being connected with A/D converter, for detecting the heartbeat signal included in data signal.The utility model determines whether invader by detecting the heartbeat signal of human body, can strengthen security safety.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief, including guard box, horizontal pole, first-aid kit, storing chamber, chamber door, first support column, sole, radar life detection instrument, push pedal, support, searchlight, camera, first fixed block, baffle, round bar, second fixed block, solar cell panel, second support column, spring, warning light and screw. The radar life detection instrument can analyze and judge whether life bodies exist in ruins and obtain specific position information of the life bodies based on the time domain Doppler effect generated by human body telecontrol on radar echoes, is more accurate than a common thermal infrared detection instrument, and can transmit information through the outside of a warning lamp box when detecting life, so that the rescue efficiency is improved; the utility model discloses install the first-aid kit in the bottom of protective case, the inside of first-aid kit is equipped with the storing chamber, can carry some emergent medicines, has increased the stability of transporting, and the mode through the air transportation send first-aid products to the disaster area inside, has better emergent effect.

title_en: Detection ball for reconnaissance of life signs after earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a post-earthquake life sign reconnaissance detection ball, which comprises a circular ball shell, wherein a group of miniature cameras and a group of pyroelectric sensors are symmetrically arranged in the shell, and the heads of the miniature cameras and the pyroelectric sensors are embedded on the surface of the shell and are in the same plane with the shell and are integrated into a whole; a main control chip and a power supply are also arranged in the shell, a wireless transceiver and a positioner are arranged on the main control chip, a rotating shaft and a fixing device are arranged right below the main control chip, and the bottoms of the rotating shaft and the fixing device are connected with a single pendulum instrument; the micro camera, the pyroelectric sensor, the wireless transceiver, the positioner, the rotating shaft and the fixing device are all electrically connected with the main control chip; the detection ball is remotely controlled by a remote controller, and the main control chip is used for controlling the rotating shaft and the fixing device, so that the simple pendulum instrument swings left and right to control the forward and backward of the detection ball; and the information is transmitted to a remote place through the wireless transceiver after the micro camera and the pyroelectric sensor detect the vital signs.

title_en: Outdoor infrared ray makes a video recording and surveys multi-legged running gear
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an outdoor detection equipment especially relates to an outdoor infrared ray makes a video recording and surveys multi-legged running gear of observation. Comprises a rolling multi-foot walking device, a flat ground walking device, a camera, an infrared sensor and a controller; the rolling multi-foot walking device comprises a rolling motor, a hemispherical shell and a plurality of telescopic stabbing feet, wherein the plurality of telescopic stabbing feet are fixedly connected to the outer part of the hemispherical shell, and the rolling motor is connected with the hemispherical shell; the flat ground walking device comprises an annular shell, supporting legs, walking wheels and a walking motor, wherein the supporting legs are fixedly connected outside the annular shell, the walking wheels are arranged on the supporting legs, and the walking motor is connected with the walking wheels; the two hemispherical shells are arranged on two sides of the annular shell through bearings, the camera, the infrared sensor, the walking motor and the rolling motor are electrically connected with a controller, and the controller is powered by a battery. The camera helps people to take a picture or view in an outdoor complex environment; after disasters such as earthquakes occur, life signs are searched for through infrared detection in a complex and severe environment.

title_en: Method for melting snow and ice based on carbon fiber-glass fiber composite braiding net
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow-ice melting method based on carbon-glass fiber composite woven nets, which belongs to the field of transportation and disaster prevention. The method is characterized in that a thermal insulating layer, a heat conducting layer, a carbon-glass fiber composite woven net subjected to electric insulation and sand sticking treatment, and another heat conducting layer are laid in turn on a base layer of a to-be-heated body; a temperature measurement element is buried in a surface layer of the to-be-heated body; a carbon fiber bundle heating element is connected to a controllable power source with protection function in a series parallel connection mode by use of electric conducting silver colloid and a conductor; and according to surface layer temperature of the to-be-heated body, surface wind speed, the thickness of snow cover and ice, air temperature and the expected time for melting snow and ice, a digital PID temperature control system optimizes and adjusts the control parameters of the system and regulates heating power. The method has the advantages of high construction speed, uniform fast heating, stable performance, long life span, low cost and the like, plays a role in preventing cracking and reinforcing, and is an ideal snow-ice melting method for pavement, bridges and other facilities.

title_en: UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation method and a UWB Bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation system, and belongs to the technical field of bio-radar biological life detection. According to the UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation method of the invention, echo data obtained through collection are processed through the following manners that: a breath detection algorithm, an adaptive cancellation method and a target recognition algorithm are adopted to process the echo data in each channel; correlation processing is performed among each channel according to processing results; and finally, threshold values are set such that clutter left in the channels after processing can be removed, and at the same time, target classification and number estimation are realized. With the UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation of the invention adopted, a technological base can be provided for further implementation of bio-radar detection and positioning of multiple human body objects, and the improvement of the level and ability of bio-radar technique to obtain information of human bodies can be facilitated.

title_en: Automatic locking expansion device applied to distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic locking expansion device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection instruments. The sliding plate is pushed, so that the transition inclined surface jacks up the positioning column, the positioning column is separated from the positioning hole in the guide positioning strip, the first telescopic shell can slide along the inner pipe, the length of the telescopic device is adjusted, when the switch is loosened, the switch can be restored to the original position under the reverse action of the spring, when the switch is adjusted to the other positioning hole, the positioning column is matched with the positioning hole under the action of the spring, and the telescopic device is automatically locked and fixed at the extension position or the telescopic position, and the sliding plate is extremely convenient.

title_en: Accurate detection method for underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground pipeline detection, in particular to an accurate detection method for an underground pipeline, which comprises the following steps: obtaining corresponding construction position information and pipeline distribution diagrams in a construction position range, wherein the pipeline distribution diagrams comprise position information and buried depths of different pipelines, and step two: establishing a pipeline distribution model according to the construction position information and the pipeline distribution diagram, and step three: pipeline point location information within a pipeline database is retrieved and added to the pipeline distribution model. According to the invention, the depth information and the position information of the pipeline to be detected are determined by detecting the aluminum foil and the vertical origin on the ground twice and combining the radar model of the detector by a direct connection method, and the radar information of the two times are combined and compared, so that accurate positioning is realized, the parameter information is imported into the GNSS handbook after measurement, a pipeline distribution model is established, measurement and check are performed, and the pipeline detection precision is improved.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL CIVIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Personnel safety monitoring method and system based on data driving and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel safety monitoring method and system based on data driving, and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: s100, measuring heart rate data of a target person located in a preset monitoring area according to a first monitoring period by using a millimeter wave radar arranged at a preset position; s200, acquiring an infrared thermal imaging image of a preset monitoring area according to a first monitoring period by using an infrared thermal imaging device arranged at the adjacent position of the millimeter wave radar, calculating the barycenter coordinates of a target person in the infrared thermal imaging image, and calculating the moving speed of the target person according to the barycenter coordinates of the target person; and S300, judging whether vital signs of the target personnel are normal according to heart rate data and moving speed of the target personnel. The heart rate abnormality monitoring of personnel in the movement process of different intensity degrees can be realized by only utilizing the millimeter wave radar and the infrared thermal imaging device, and the intelligent degree, the heart rate monitoring reliability and the application scene of the invention are improved to a great extent.

title_en: High-resolution three-dimensional through-wall imaging device and rapid imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-resolution three-dimensional through-wall imaging device and a rapid imaging method, and particularly relates to the technical field of microwave through-wall imaging. The invention further provides a high-resolution three-dimensional through-wall imaging device which comprises a multi-port vector network analyzer, an ultra-wideband directional antenna area array and a control terminal.
assignees: THE 41ST INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Method and system for identifying life detection signals based on MIMO digital array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection signal identification method and a system based on MIMO digital arrays, which relate to the technical field of life detection and comprise the steps of constructing a life detection signal feature library; the method comprises the steps of transmitting electromagnetic waves by a plurality of radar antennas based on a MIMO digital array, receiving reflected target echo signals, judging whether living body life signals exist or not based on the target echo signals of the plurality of radar antennas, analyzing the physiological states of the living body life if the living body life signals exist, evaluating rescue priority emergency degree of each living body life based on the physiological states of all living body life detected by the MIMO digital array, and determining and generating a rescue overall scheme of all living body life based on the rescue priority emergency degree of all living body life. The invention has the advantages of effectively realizing the target precision detection of the human body in a static state and providing a more efficient and accurate non-contact life detection solution for the fields of disaster rescue, medical monitoring and the like.

title_en: Fire-retardant high temperature resistant fire control respirator with life monitoring function
abstract_en: The application provides a flame-retardant high-temperature-resistant fire-fighting respirator with a life monitoring function, which comprises a heat-insulating hood and a breathing mask connected with the heat-insulating hood, wherein the heat-insulating hood comprises a flame-retardant reflecting layer, a polyimide fiber sponge heat-insulating filling layer, a phase-change material temperature-regulating layer and a moisture-absorbing quick-drying cotton layer which are sequentially arranged from outside to inside, a transparent window is arranged in the middle of the breathing mask, an air inlet hole and an air outlet valve are arranged at the lower part of the breathing mask, the air inlet hole is communicated with a filtering and life signal monitoring device, a friction layer and an electrode layer are arranged in the filtering and life signal monitoring device, and the fire-fighting respirator further comprises a signal collecting and transmitting device connected with the filtering and life signal monitoring device through signals. The application has high-efficiency filtering effect, low respiratory resistance, excellent air permeability, flame retardant property and high temperature resistance, and can dynamically monitor the respiratory rate, strength and position information of a wearer through a high-efficiency friction electric sensor structure, thereby improving the safety guarantee of personnel in a fire scene.

title_en: Lead fish cableway radar wave current meter
abstract_en: The invention is used in the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, and particularly discloses a lead fish cableway radar wave current meter which comprises ground surfaces, wherein the ground surfaces are respectively poured and buried on two sides of a river channel, a second vertical rod is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from a first vertical rod, of the ground surfaces, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the first vertical rod, traction ropes are respectively arranged on the outer surfaces of the first vertical rod and the second vertical rod, and a relay moving end is arranged between the moving ropes. This lead fish cableway radar wave current meter only needs to start motor roller subassembly and rotates when needs monitor and gather the hydrological data of river surface, makes motor roller subassembly can drive the relay and removes the end that removes, makes the relay remove the end and can take radar monitoring component to remove on the removal rope, makes radar monitoring component monitor and gather data in the position of difference on the river surface, makes the monitoring can obtain the hydrological data of river course different points, can be more accurate obtain the hydrological data of river course.

title_en: Pseudo data creation system, pseudo data creation method, and program
abstract_en: To create pseudo underground radar data at a low calculation cost.SOLUTION: A pseudo data generation system for generating pseudo data of a pseudo buried pipe includes: a reflection profile point calculation unit that calculates a reflection profile point which is a foot of a perpendicular dropped from a pseudo survey point to a profile line; a reference reflection profile point calculation unit that calculates a reference reflection profile point which is a foot of a perpendicular dropped from a reference survey point to a reference profile line; a reference pseudo survey point calculation unit that calculates a reference pseudo survey point which is a point at which a minute line segment of the profile line at the reflection profile point and a minute line segment of the pseudo profile line at the reference reflection profile point are matched; and a buried pipe signal calculation unit that calculates a buried pipe signal at the reference pseudo survey point and calculates pseudo data by associating the buried pipe signal with the pseudo survey point.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Contents valuation system and contents valuating method using the system
title_ko: 콘텐츠 평가 시스템 및 이를 이용한 콘텐츠 평가 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a content evaluation system capable of evaluating content more objectively and reliably and a content evaluation method using the same. The content evaluation system includes: a brainwave measurement unit, a biometric signal measurement unit, a sensor control unit, and a main control unit. The brainwave measurement unit measures brainwaves from a subject who receives content and outputs the measured brainwaves. The biometric signal measurement unit measures a biometric signal from the subject and outputs the measured biometric signal. The sensor control unit controls the brainwave measurement unit and the biometric signal measurement unit, and receives and transmits the brainwaves and the biometric signal. The main control unit senses changes in the brainwaves and the biometric signal, which occur before the content is provided and while the content is provided by analyzing the brainwaves and the biometric signal transmitted from the sensor control unit. The main control unit also draws at least one of the immersion of the subject in the content and a direction of the emotion of the subject using the changes in the brainwaves and the biometric signal, and evaluates the content using the drawn at least one. Thus, the content may be evaluated more reliably.
abstract_ko: 보다 객관적이고 신뢰도가 높게 콘텐츠를 평가할 수 있는 콘텐츠 평가 시스템 및 이를 이용한 콘텐츠 평가 방법이 개시된다.  이러한 콘텐츠 평가 시스템은 뇌파 측정부, 생체신호 측정부, 센서 제어부 및 메인 제어부를 포함한다.  상기 뇌파 측정부는 콘텐츠를 제공받는 피험자로부터 뇌파를 측정하여 출력하고, 상기 생체신호 측정부는 상기 피험자로부터 생체 신호를 측정하여 출력한다.  상기 센서 제어부는 상기 뇌파 측정부 및 상기 생체신호 측정부를 제어하고, 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호를 제공받아 전달한다.  상기 메인 제어부는 상기 센서 제어부로부터 전달된 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 콘텐츠를 제공하기 전과 제공하는 동안 발생되는 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호의 변화를 감지하고, 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호의 변화에 이용하여 상기 피험자의 상기 콘텐츠에 대한 몰입도 및 정서의 방향 중 적어도 하나를 도출하며, 상기 도출된 적어도 하나의 결과를 이용하여 상기 콘텐츠를 평가한다.  이로써, 상기 콘텐츠를 신뢰도 높게 평가할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi radar sendor-based biosignal measurement system and method
title_ko: 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A multi-radar sensor-based biological signal measurement system and method are disclosed. The multi-radar sensor-based biological signal measurement system according to the present invention includes: a multi-sensor unit consisting of first and second radar sensors and detecting biological signals of a subject using the first and second radar sensors; and a signal analysis unit selecting one of the first and second radar sensors and receiving and analyzing the biological signal detected by the selected radar sensor.
abstract_ko: 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템은 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서로 구성되고 상기 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서를 이용하여 피검체의 생체 신호를 감지하는 멀티 센서부, 및 상기 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서 중 어느 하나의 레이더 센서를 선택하고 상기 선택된 레이더 센서에 의해 감지된 생체 신호를 수신하여 분석하는 신호 분석부를 포함한다.

title_en: Artificial intelligence smart wear Helmet
title_ko: 인공지능 스마트웨어 헬멧
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart helmet having a black box function, and more specifically, to a smart helmet having a black box function comprising: a helmet body having an opening on a lower part thereof so as to be worn on an outside of a head, and having a see-through window on a front surface thereof so as to enable a user to see a front side; a helmet support part connected to the opening of the helmet body and worn to surround a neck and shoulders of a user; an airbag device formed on an inner rear of the helmet body and including an airbag expanded to protect an occipital part and a temporal part, and a sensor for sensing impact and operating the airbag; a black box part including a camera mounted on an outer side of the helmet body to capture the outside, and a storage connected to the camera to store information; a headset embedded inside the helmet body and including an earphone part and a voice recognition part corresponding to ears and mouth, respectively; and a wireless communication part connected to an external wireless terminal; and an information display part connected to the wireless communication part and displaying road guide, time, and temperature information on the see-through window. According to the present invention, the helmet can be distributed to be used for the protection of an environment other than a special purpose and for the convenience of life, and additionally provides a function of minimum coping with fires and emergencies as an additional function, thereby helping the safety of the user and minimizing inconvenience of daily life by distributing the weight of the helmet over the entire shoulder.
abstract_ko:
