본 발명은 블랙박스 기능을 갖는 스마트 헬멧에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는, 머리의 외부에 착용되도록 하부에 개구부가 형성되고, 전면에는 앞을 볼 수 있도록 투시창이 형성된 헬멧본체; 상기 헬멧본체의 개구부에 연결되며 사용자의 목과 어깨까지 감싸도록 착용되는 헬멧지지부;를 포함하고, 상기 헬멧본체의 내측 후방에 형성되며, 후두부 및 측두부를 보호하도록 팽창되는 에어백과, 충격을 감지하여 에어백을 작동시키는 센서로 구성된 에어백 장치; 상기 헬멧본체의 외측에 장착되어 외부를 촬영하는 카메라와, 상기 카메라에 연결되어 정보를 저장하는 저장소로 구성된 블랙박스부; 상기 헬멧본체의 내부에 매립되며 귀와 입에 각기 대응되는 이어폰부와 음성인식부를 구비한 헤드셋; 외부 무선단말과 연결되는 무선통신부와, 상기 무선통신부에 연결되며 투시창에 길안내와 시간, 온도 정보를 표시해주는 정보표시부;를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 특수목적이 아닌 환경에 대한 보호 및 생활편의를 위해 사용되도록 보급될 수 있고, 추가적인 기능으로 화재, 긴급상황 등에도 최소한의 대처가 될 수 있는 기능을 추가적으로 제공하여, 사용자의 안전에 도움을 줄 수 있도록 하며, 헬멧의 무게를 어깨 전체에 무게를 분산시켜 일상생활을 하는데 불편함을 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Autonomous driving mobility for detecting buried objects and method for detecting buried objects using the same
title_ko: 매설물 탐지를 위한 자율 주행 모빌리티 및 이를 이용한 매설물 탐지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous driving mobility for detecting a buried object and a method for detecting a buried object using the same. The autonomous driving mobility for detecting a buried object comprises: a driving control unit for switching to a tracking driving mode to control driving according to a position where a magnetic field signal is detected when the magnetic field signal is detected by a magnetic field sensor while driving in a designated range in the autonomous driving mode; a data collection unit for collecting reception position data, intensity data, and time data required for signal transmission and reception of the magnetic field signal received while driving in the tracking driving mode; an information analysis unit for analyzing buried object information including the position, type, and depth of the buried object using the collected data; and a map generation unit for storing a driving route driven in the tracking driving mode and generating a buried object map in which the buried object information is reflected in the stored driving route. Accordingly, a position of an underground buried object can be detected by using a magnetic field sensor provided in the mobility, thereby preventing an accident caused by the buried object.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 매설물 탐지를 위한 자율 주행 모빌리티 및 이를 이용한 매설물 탐지 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 자율 주행 모드로 지정 범위를 주행하는 도중 자기장 센서에 의해 자기장 신호가 감지되면, 상기 추적 주행 모드로 전환시켜 상기 자기장 신호가 감지되는 위치를 따라 주행하도록 제어하는 주행 제어부; 상기 추적 주행 모드로 주행하면서 수신되는 자기장 신호의 수신 위치 데이터, 세기 데이터 및 신호 송수신 시 소요되는 시간 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 수집한 데이터를 이용하여 매설물의 위치, 종류 및 깊이를 포함하는 매설물 정보를 분석하는 정보 분석부; 및 상기 추적 주행 모드로 주행한 주행 경로를 저장하고, 저장된 주행 경로에 상기 매설물 정보가 반영된 매설물 지도를 생성하는 지도 생성부를 포함한다. 
이를 통해 모빌리티에 구비되는 자기장 센서를 이용하여 지하 매설물의 위치를 탐지할 수 있어 매설물로 인한 안전 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar-based non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring system and method. The monitoring system comprises: a millimeter wave transceiving module (1), a real-time signal acquisition module (2), a real-time signal processing module (3), and a visualization module (4). The millimeter wave transceiving module (1) is used for transmitting millimeter waves and receiving echo signals thereof; the real-time signal processing module (3) is used for extracting respiratory signals and heart rate signals by means of clutter suppression; and the visualization module (4) is used for performing waveform fitting on the respiratory signals and heart rate signals, and displaying, by means of a visual interface, the position, respiration, and heart rate of a subject in real time. The clutter suppression effectively overcomes the effect of environmental noise, such that the accuracy of the monitoring system is improved. In addition, the respiratory signals and heart rate signals are fitted by means of an iterative algorithm to visually display relevant waveforms and monitoring results.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content
abstract_en: A microwave stethoscope measurement method and sensor design employ a microwave transmission sensor and a microwave reception sensor placed on a patient's chest in spaced-apart side-by-side configuration for monitoring patient vital signs, lung water content and other critical measurements. The side-by-side sensors are spaced apart a separation distance of about 1-3 cm in lateral chest orientation. The sensors may be formed with a textile fabric for wearer comfort and to improve contact with the patient's skin. The microwave sensor measurements are digitally processed using a modified short time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrum windowed-averaged algorithm. Output data extracted from the microwave sensor measurements may be transmitted wirelessly to a mobile device such as a smartphone for remote monitoring of the patient's medical condition.
assignees: ISKANDER MAGDY F;CELIK NURI;GAGARIN RUTHSENNE;HUANG GUI CHAO;BIBB DARCY ALAN;UNIV HAWAII

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Matching Vital sign Information to a Concurrently Recorded Data Set
abstract_en: An approach is provided for matching vital sign information to a concurrently recorded data set according to a time domain. The approach involves determining sensor information collected from one or more sensors configured to monitor one or more vital signs of one or more objects within a monitored area. The approach also involves processing and/or facilitating a processing of the sensor information to detect the one or more objects and to track the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects over a time domain. The approach further involves matching the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects to a concurrently recorded data set based on the time domain. The approach further involves storing at least one record of the one or more vital signs matched to the concurrently recorded data set.

title_en: Contactless sensor-driven device, system, and method enabling ambient health monitoring and predictive assessment
abstract_en: An ambient monitoring device includes a housing, contactless sensors coupled to the housing, and a processing device disposed in the housing. The processing device is coupled to the contactless sensors. The processing device is to receive, from one or more contactless sensors of the plurality of contactless sensors, historical sensor data. The processing device is further to determine baseline vital signs based on the historical sensor data. The processing device is further to receive, from the one or more contactless sensors, current sensor data associated with a user that is within a threshold distance of the ambient monitoring device without contacting the ambient monitoring device. The processing device is further to determine, based on the current sensor data, current vital signs of the user. Responsive to determining the current vital signs do not meet the baseline vital signs, the processing device is to provide an alert.

title_en: Vital Sign Sensing Device
abstract_en: Vital sign sensing device includes a housing adapted to support a hand of a user and sensors adapted to detect vital signs of the user. The sensor device includes an arithmetic processor adapted to receive the electrical signal, manipulate the signal, and generate an electrical signal representative of the vital signs. The vital sign sensing device can be incorporated into various structures and equipment, such as, an armrest or seating device, a stretcher, or a kiosk.

title_en: Two-stage wall parameter estimation method based on ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage wall parameter estimation method based on an ultra-wideband through-wall radar, which is applied to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and aims at solving the problem of difficult wall parameter estimation in the prior art; the method comprises two stages of estimating wall parameters, wherein the first stage is an electromagnetic propagation path calculation stage, namely, a search interval of unknown parameters such as a radar wall-separating distance R, wall thickness d, wall dielectric constant epsilon and the like is firstly determined, and then, the time delay of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall is calculated by adopting a specular reflection and refraction point approximation method; the second stage is a wall parameter estimation stage, and projection imaging is carried out on each parameter in the parameter searching region; only when the candidate parameter is equal to the true value, the echo is coherently accumulated, and the intensity of the image after the back projection is the maximum, so that the candidate parameter is searched through the back projection image to obtain the true value.

title_en: Non-contact sleep stage method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep stage method and device, which comprises the steps of placing radar equipment at a designated position and powering on, processing echo signals of the radar equipment to obtain vital sign data, sending the vital sign data to a cloud server for storage, deriving and processing the vital sign data into time sequence features and frequency domain features, constructing a sleep stage prediction model, inputting the time sequence features and the frequency domain features into the sleep stage prediction model, carrying out feature learning and outputting sleep stage prediction values, simultaneously modeling the time sequence features and the frequency domain features through a double-branch structure, capturing a time sequence dependency relationship by utilizing BiLSTM, and enhancing the attention of the model to the time sequence information and the frequency domain information in the sequence by utilizing a attention mechanism.

title_en: Moving multi-polarization multi-transmitter/receiver ground penetrating radar system and signal processing for buried target detection
abstract_en: A moving ground penetrating radar is comprised of multiple transmitters and receivers with multiple, e.g., Horizontal and Vertical, polarizations to detect buried targets with standoff capability. Novel signal and imaging techniques are used to form high quality radar imagery with low artifacts that are due to various sources of self-induced resonances, e.g., transmitter-receiver coupling, calibration errors, and motion errors in the multi transmitter/receiver channels of the radar system. The irradiated target area image is formed via exploiting both the spatial diversity of the physical multi-transmitter and multi-receiver array and synthetic aperture/array that is generated by the motion of the platform that carries the radar system. The images that are formed from the multiple polarizations are combined to remove surface targets/clutter and, thus, enhance signatures of buried targets.

title_en: Registered multi-layer underground and surface images in land surveys
abstract_en: A method of land surveying that electronically registers together multi-layer underground and surface images of a surface volume with buried utilities and other infrastructures. Such method further comprises assembling and presenting the combination to a device in the field that visually guides crews in their safe digging of the ground nearby. The orienting, scaling, and registering of a first image layer is to a standardized orientation and scaling on a map of a photograph of a land surface from a zenith point in space above. Then the orienting, scaling, and registering of a second image layer is made to the standardized orientation and scaling on the map. This layer is a result of a ground penetrating radar investigation of buried objects point-by-point in an immediate search area of a corresponding ground surface. Underground buried objects and utilities are thereby located to make safe digging nearby.

title_en: Elevator wireless intercommunication warning device
abstract_en: The utility model is related to elevator safety technical fields, disclose elevator wireless intercommunication warning device, including the wireless talkback alarm terminal being arranged in elevator and the emergency rescue device being located at below wireless talkback alarm terminal；Wireless talkback alarm terminal includes central controller, the wireless telecommunications intercommunication module being connected with central controller, the data acquisition module being connected with central controller, the automatic alarm module being connected with central controller；Data acquisition module includes elevator data acquisition module and video acquisition module and the infrared vital sign inductor being integrated on wireless talkback alarm terminal；Compared with prior art, the elevator wireless intercommunication warning device of the utility model passes through design data acquisition module, wireless telecommunications intercommunication module, automatic alarm module, emergency rescue device extends rescue time in all its bearings when being elevator faults, reduce the mortality caused by accident, while improve the work efficiency of rescuer.

title_en: Popular earthquake alarm for civil use
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a popular earthquake alarm for civil use, which comprises a life detection device in wireless connection with a wireless receiving unit. The wireless receiving unit and anearthquake wave detection unit are embedded into a microprocessor; and the microprocessor is respectively connected with an alarming unit, a wireless SOS (Save Our Souls) unit, an emergency indicatorlamp control unit, a voice prompt unit, a voice SOS unit and a main/stand-by power supply. A three-way vibration acceleration sensor is used for detecting P waves (longitudinal waves) and S waves (transversal waves) of the earthquake waves. Emergency lighting is automatically switched on upon detecting an earthquake; and the infrared life detection device provides the life information at the periphery before and after the earthquake, which helps to judge whether people are trapped under collapsed buildings, and then sends out wireless distress calls and voice distress calls, thereby providinghelp for rescue personnel to rapidly position and salvage the trapped people. Moreover, as the main/stand-by power supply is provided, the alarm works as usual even under the circumstance of current failure.

title_en: Destructive earthquake automatic voice countdown alarm system and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm system which can automatically send a voice prompt and voice countdown before ground destructive power of an earthquake occurs. In the system, a pressure sensor is buried in a stratum to transmit data to a management computer; related calculation programs and voice prompt contents exist in the management computer; and the management computer is connected with an alarm speaker. A female voice prompt of an earthquake escape method and a countdown background male voice prompt of destructive power occurrence are automatically sent according to a calculation result of pressure change data transmitted by the pressure sensor arranged on an upper stratum on the back airspace side of a free earthquake center block when the free earthquake center block is determined to be unbalanced and starts to move.

title_en: Anti-interference vital sign information extraction and separation method based on millimeter wave biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-interference method for extracting and separating vital sign information based on a millimeter wave biological radar; the method comprises the following steps: s1: performing time domain interference detection on the signals, and traversing and detecting whether all frequency modulation signals are interfered; s2: carrying out interference position detection on the interfered signals; s3: interference suppression and signal restoration, wherein an interference section in the interfered frequency modulation signal is suppressed and the section of signal is reconstructed; s4: detecting target vital sign information, namely detecting the position of a target and the vital sign information of the target; s5: and (4) extracting and separating vital sign information, and extracting and separating heartbeat and respiratory signals of the target. The invention can accurately find the interference position and accurately repair the interfered signal, reduces the phase noise caused by the interference, ensures that a radar system can be used in the environment with multiple interferences, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the life signal and more accurately separates the respiration heartbeat signal.

title_en: Multi-radar association control method and control device in health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-radar association control method and a multi-radar association control device in a health monitoring system. The health monitoring system comprises a first fall monitoring radar and a first human presence monitoring radar which monitor a first area, and a first vital sign monitoring radar which monitors respiration and heartbeat of a sub-area in the first area. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring personnel presence information monitored by a first human presence monitoring radar; and controlling the working modes of the first vital sign monitoring radar and the first fall monitoring radar according to the existence information of the personnel in the first area and whether the personnel are in the sub-area. The invention can reduce the false alarm rate of the monitoring radar of the health monitoring system, improve the reliability of the monitoring result and reduce the average power consumption of the health monitoring system.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on a millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the steps of emitting linear frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW, obtaining original data after frequency mixing is carried out on echo signals, and forming the original data into a first matrix comprising a fast time dimension and a slow time dimension; performing one-dimensional fast Fourier transform on the first matrix to obtain a corresponding second matrix; then, carrying out static filtering operation on the second matrix to obtain a fourth matrix; performing unwrapping operation on the distance unit for judging the existence of the human body target in the fourth matrix; judging the vital sign of the human body target from the unwrapped phase signal; extracting corresponding chest wall displacement signals from the distance units of the human body targets with vital signs; and reconstructing the chest wall displacement-time signal to acquire accurate vital signs of the human target. Compared with the prior art, the invention improves the monitoring accuracy of the human heart rate respiration, and well reduces the calculated amount in the detection process so as to improve the capability of quick response.

title_en: Geophysical soil pollutant migration and early warning simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil pollutant migration and early warning, and particularly discloses a geophysical soil pollutant migration and early warning simulation method which comprises the steps of S1, installing a geophysical detection equipment assembly, S2, data acquisition, S3, data processing, S4 and data imaging, wherein an induction electromagnetic method is generally used for rapid bottoming investigation, rapid acquisition of stratum conductivity distribution, finding out of a conductivity abnormal region and providing assistance for subsequent construction of a geophysical method, and a ground penetrating radar is mainly suitable for stratum, underground pipeline position, underground storage tank position, shallow waste buried thickness and distribution, underground tank leakage, shallow DNAPL/LNAPL pollution and heavy metal pollution. In the underground pollution investigation project, the ground penetrating radar method is mainly used for finding out the positions of underground metal, pipelines and electromagnetic wave attenuation, and is convenient for laying and constructing the measuring lines by the high-density electric method, and the application range of the high-density electric method comprises hydrogeology detection, large-scale underground structure detection, underground tank body leakage detection and the like.
assignees: GEOLOGICAL INFORMATION EXPLOR BRANCH OF SINOPEC PETROLEUM ENGINEERING GEOPHYSICS CO LTD

title_en: Vertical rescue probe radar life detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vertical rescue probe radar life detection system and method, which belong to the technical field of radars and comprise a radar probe, wherein the radar probe is used for detecting trapped personnel in a down-hole roadway and comprises a vertical rescue radar and a cylindrical metal probe, a cable tray is used for placing the radar probe in a vertical shaft, the cable tray is connected with the radar probe through a cable, a ground processing display terminal is used for processing and displaying data and results detected by the radar probe, and the radar probe is connected with the ground processing display terminal through wireless communication.
assignees: ZHONGAN GUOTAI BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;SHANXI COAL GEOLOGY 115 EXPLORATION INST CO LTD

title_en: Patch attached to human body for amplifying bioelectric signals
title_ko: 인체 부착형 생체 신호 증폭 패치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biometric signal amplifying patch attached to a human body, and more particularly, to a patch attached to a human body capable of more accurately measuring a biometric signal by amplifying the biometric signal reflected by a user or an object to be measured. The patch attached to a human body according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a protection member made of at least one selected among woven fabric, non-woven fabric, and pelt, an adhesion member, and a radio signal reflecting member. The radio signal is an impulse radio ultra wide band (IR-UWB).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체 부착형 생체 신호 증폭 패치에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는 사용자 또는 측정 대상에 의해 반사된 생체 신호를 증폭시킴으로써 보다 정확한 생체 신호 측정을 가능하게 하는 인체 부착형 패치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: In-vehicle life detection method and apparatus, device, and storage medium
abstract_en: Provided are an in-vehicle life detection method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a computer readable storage medium, which are applicable to to the technical field of intelligent vehicles. The method comprises: obtaining an xth radar frame signal acquired by a preset millimeter wave radar in a vehicle (S110); performing demodulating sampling and time-frequency transformation on the xth radar frame signal, so as to obtain a first distance dimensional signal array (S120); filtering the first distance dimensional signal array, so as to obtain a second distance dimensional signal array (S130); extracting a phase and confidence of a preset detection point from the second distance dimensional signal array (S140); according to a phase and confidence of the preset detection point of an (x-1)th radar frame signal extracted in advance, iteratively filtering the phase and the confidence of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal, so as to obtain a filtering result of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal (S150); and when the filtering result is greater than a preset threshold, determining that a life exists at the preset detection point (S160). The present method is suitable for in-vehicle life detection in a variety of scenarios, and the detection effect is good.

title_en: Method and system for pairing physiological signal
abstract_en: A method disclosed in the present invention utilizes an image captured by an image capture device to assist physiological signal paring. Multiple vital signs in the physiological signal detected by a radar are able to be paired with multiple subjects in the image one on one accurately to realize continuous tracking of vital signs of multiple subjects.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring via remote sensing on stationary exercise equipment
abstract_en: Vital sign monitoring via remote sensing on stationary exercise equipment is provided. A new non-contact approach described herein uses radio frequency (RF) radar (e.g., ultra-wide band (UWB) radar) to remotely monitor vital sign information (such as heartbeat and breathing) and human activity information of subjects using stationary exercise equipment. In some embodiments, a radar sensor captures micro-scale chest motions (corresponding to the vital sign information) as well as macro-scale body motions (corresponding to movements from exercise). A signal processor receives radar signals from the radar sensor and processes the radar signals to reconstruct vital sign information from the micro-scale chest motions and/or human activity information from the macro-scale body motions using a joint vital sign-motion model, which can be trained using machine learning and other approaches.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to techniques for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection in analog domain. Proposed methods and apparatus are able to measure an impedance of human body based on sub-Nyquist sampling of signals. The proposed techniques can be particularly beneficial for reducing overall sensor power when an actuation signal generates electrical signals corresponding to vital signs in humans.
assignees: QUALCOMM INC;GARUDADRI HARINATH;BAHETI PAWAN KUMAR;MAJUMDAR SOMDEB

title_en: Implementation method towards the wireless sensor network emergency communication system of earthquake disaster
abstract_en: A kind of implementation method based on the wireless sensor network emergency communication system towards earthquake disaster, this system is by multifunctional sensing node, wireless sensor network gateway, systems soft ware and terminal software four part are constituted, multifunctional sensing node passes through blood oxygen probe, pulse is popped one's head in, the multiple probe such as probe for detecting temperature gathers the blood oxygen of human body, pulse, the specifying informations such as body temperature and relative geographical location information, then wireless sense network gateway device is transferred data to by wireless sensing module, gateway device is by realizing wireless sense network and Ethernet, the seamless switching of WLAN, concrete data are passed on terminal unit by infrastructure network, Surveillance center can use associated mobile device easily, such as PDA, the vital sign of smart mobile phone monitoring trapped personnel and geographical location information.This system can be applied practically under earthquake disaster environment, the life of people, the loss of property brought due to earthquake disaster can be reduced in each side such as manpower, financial resources, material resources, for the process towards earthquake disaster, the monitoring of outburst surroundings provides a real-time monitoring platform.

title_en: Highway soft soil foundation prefabricated friction type pile and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a friction type pile and a method for prefabricating a soft soil foundation on a highway, which comprises the following steps: the pile body, dynamometer and spacing pipe connected with the pile body; the limiting pipe is internally used for placing a limiting sheet, the dynamometer passes through the limiting pipe to enable a force measuring point to be in a region to be measured, and the dynamometer is limited or opened by adjusting the position of the limiting sheet; piles need to be buried in an danger zone, but whether the piles provide required stress cannot be determined, the precast piles can be monitored and repaired in time, and the safety factor of a foundation pit is greatly improved; compared with the traditional method for measuring the pile body stress, the method has the advantages that the measuring depth can be greatly deepened by arranging the sensor inside, and the installation is convenient without the guidance of technicians on workers; whether the pile body is broken or not can be analyzed in advance through data so as to prevent engineering disasters.

title_en: Method for separating UWB radar sensor receiving signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for separating a UWB radar sensor receiving signal, namely a method for carrying out signal decomposition on the UWB radar sensor receiving signal based on a zero-space tracking extraction single-component signal algorithm and confidence coefficient of a recursive integral operator, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signal frequencies of a human body, which can be applied to monitoring vital signs such as heart rate of infectious patients and can also be used for detecting the human body signs in earthquake. The method has short operation time, can accurately extract the breathing signal and the heartbeat signal frequency in the UWB ground penetrating radar signal, and provides an important basis for non-contact human body feature extraction.

title_en: Method and system for positioning trapped person based on four-dimensional biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning trapped people based on four-dimensional biological radar. The method comprises the following steps: s1, rearranging echo data acquired by a four-dimensional biological radar to form a three-dimensional complex matrix; s2, obtaining a three-dimensional complex radar image after filtering, and splicing the three-dimensional complex radar image obtained by continuous measurement into a four-dimensional radar image sequence according to time sequence; s3, calculating the energy entropy ratio of the four-dimensional radar image sequence; s4, weighting energy entropy ratio of the four-dimensional radar image sequence along a time dimension; s5, detecting a plurality of targets in each frame of three-dimensional image of the four-dimensional radar image sequence, and clustering, wherein a clustering center is used as the three-dimensional position coordinates of each human body target; s6, respectively extracting vital sign signals corresponding to each human body from voxels at the three-dimensional position coordinates along the time dimension. The invention greatly improves the signal-to-noise ratio after processing, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the buried human body detection by more than 30dB, and can realize human body detection and three-dimensional positioning of the buried human body with the depth of tens of meters.

title_en: Method and system for identifying life detection signals based on MIMO digital array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection signal identification method and a system based on MIMO digital arrays, which relate to the technical field of life detection and comprise the steps of constructing a life detection signal feature library; the method comprises the steps of transmitting electromagnetic waves by a plurality of radar antennas based on a MIMO digital array, receiving reflected target echo signals, judging whether living body life signals exist or not based on the target echo signals of the plurality of radar antennas, analyzing the physiological states of the living body life if the living body life signals exist, evaluating rescue priority emergency degree of each living body life based on the physiological states of all living body life detected by the MIMO digital array, and determining and generating a rescue overall scheme of all living body life based on the rescue priority emergency degree of all living body life. The invention has the advantages of effectively realizing the target precision detection of the human body in a static state and providing a more efficient and accurate non-contact life detection solution for the fields of disaster rescue, medical monitoring and the like.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method and system based on radar signals
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of life detection and discloses a multi-target life detection method based on radar signals, which comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting multi-target mixed signals received by a radar and preprocessing the signals; the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase space reconstruction on a preprocessed signal to obtain Gao Weixiang space tracks, constructing a self-adaptive dictionary, carrying out sparse representation on the signal, and separating primary vital sign signals of all targets from a mixed signal through a sparse optimization algorithm. The application adopts the technical scheme of fusion of the multi-band radar signals and the deep learning, and achieves the technical effect of high-precision separation of multi-target vital sign signals in a complex electromagnetic environment. Compared with the technical scheme of relying on single frequency band or fixed threshold classification in the prior art, the method solves the defects of serious signal aliasing and low separation precision in dense barriers or multi-target mixed scenes.

title_en: Apparatus for handling emergency situation based on internet of things smartware
title_ko: IoT 스마트웨어 기반의 긴급 상황 대응 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IoT 스마트웨어 기반의 긴급 상황 대응 장치에 관한 것으로, (1) 위치데이터, 충격데이터 및 생체신호데이터 중 적어도 하나를 센싱하여 상황정보를 생성하는 상황감지센서, (2) 사고발생이 감지되면 에어백의 팽창을 제어하는 ACU(AirBag Control Unit) 및 (3) 상기 에어백의 팽창이 결정되면 상기 상황정보를 긴급 상황정보로서 송신하는 통신부를 포함하는 스마트웨어; 및 
상기 스마트웨어로부터 수신된 긴급 상황정보를 분석하여 사고발생 가능성을 산출하고, 상기 산출된 사고발생 가능성이 기준 값 이상이면 관제 서버에 상기 긴급 상황정보 및 사고발생 가능성을 전송하고 긴급 구난의 진행을 요청하는 긴급 상황 모니터링 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Sensor, system and method for detecting radar biosignal
title_ko: 생체신호 검출을 위한 low-IF 레이더 센서, 시스템 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 레이더 생체신호 검출을 위한 센서, 시스템 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 신호원에 의한 잡음 영향을 상세하면서도 널 감지 지점(Null detection point)이 없는 간단한 구조의 레이더 구조를 갖는 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 생체신호 검출 센서는 생명체를 향해 신호를 송신하는 송신부; 상기 생명체로부터 반사되는 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 및 상기 수신부에 직접 연결되어 스위칭 신호를 인가하는 스위칭 신호 인가부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for emitting sonic sound for rescuing maritime distress
title_ko: 해상조난 구조용 음파발생장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 사용자의 특정 신체에 감겨 고정되는 밴드부(110), 하우징 프레임(121)과, 진동을 전달하는 보빈(122)과, 보빈(122)의 상단에 결합되어 가청주파수범위의 음파신호를 수중으로 전달하는 수밀구조의 진동판(123)과, 보이스 코일로의 전류 인가를 제어하는 제어모듈(125)로 이루어진, 음파발생부(120), 생체신호를 감지하는 생체 인식 센서(130), 진동판(123)의 테두리 영역에 일정거리 이격 배치되는 3개 이상의 해수유입홀(141)과, 해수유입홀(141)의 입구에 형성된 용해성 차단막(142)과, 차단막(142)의 용해로 노출된 해수유입홀(141)로 유입된 해수를 각각 감지하는 침수 센서(143)로 이루어진, 침수감지부(140), 및 수압을 감지하는 수압 센서(150)를 포함하여, 제어모듈(125)은, 생체신호를 분석하여 사용자의 정상상황과 위급상황을 판단하여 생체정보를 생성하고, 침수 센서(143)의 3개 이상의 해수유입홀(141)로 해수가 유입되어 일정시간이상 지속되고, 수압 센서(150)에 의해 일정 수압이 감지되면, 음파발생부(120)가 침수된 것으로 판단하여, 생체정보를 포함하는 음파신호를 수중으로 송출하도록 하는, 해상조난 구조용 음파발생장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Vital sign detection system with random body movement cancellation
abstract_en: A vital sign detection system includes a radar device, a nonreciprocal network, a first antenna and a second antenna. An output signal from the radar device is delivered to the first antenna via the nonreciprocal network and then transmitted to a first side of a biological subject via the first antenna. A first reflection signal from the first side of the biological subject is received by the first antenna and then delivered to the second antenna via the nonreciprocal network and then transmitted to a second side of the biological subject via the second antenna. A second reflection signal from the second side of the biological subject is received by the second antenna and then delivered to the radar device via the nonreciprocal network for vital sign detection with random body movement cancellation.

title_en: Unpiloted scout car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unpiloted scout car comprising a driver camera video antenna, a driver head sensing camera, an environmental voice sensor, a life detection instrument, an environmental smoke concentration sensor, an environmental temperature sensor, a viewer camera video antenna, a viewer remote control holder camera, a car control sensor receiving antenna, a headlamp, a caterpillar band and a car body, wherein the caterpillar band is arranged under a car body; the environmental voice sensor, the life detection instrument, the environmental smoke concentration sensor, the environmental temperature sensor and the headlamp are arranged on the front side of the car body; and the driver head sensing camera, the driver camera video antenna, the viewer camera video antenna, the viewer remote control holder camera and the car control sensor receiving antenna are arranged on the top of the car body. The unpiloted scout car is suitable for earthquakes, fire and military, and capable of scouting situations in a spot in stead of people in accidents and events and then transmitting information to a central headquarter, thus conveniently determining a specific solution so as to reduce casualties.

title_en: A kind of underground criminal case material evidence detection device based on geological radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of underground criminal case material evidence detection device based on geological radar, its radar detection apparatus used includes controller, radar transmitter, transmitting antenna, reception antenna, radar receiver and power module；Controller works for control radar detection device；Radar transmitter is connected with controller, for producing radar wave；Transmitting antenna is connected with radar transmitter, for launching the radar wave produced；Reception antenna is used to receive reflected radar wave；Radar receiver is connected with reception antenna, for handling the radar wave that reception antenna is received, and the radar wave after processing is sent into controller；Controller is connected by wireless communication mode with background master system；Power module is used to provide working power for radar detection apparatus.The utility model can not only quick detection to the hidden material evidence for being buried in underground, and the hidden material evidence for being buried in underground can be accurately positioned, contribute to criminal offense investigation.

title_en: The processing method of through-wall radar echo data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of processing methods of through-wall radar echo data, including obtain radar return signal sequence；It carries out difference by column and obtains difference sequence；Calculating energy, which is tieed up, in direction obtains energy sequence；Difference sequence after being normalized line by line to difference sequence；Accumulation summation, which is tieed up, in direction obtains sequence；The point more than differential threshold is obtained, determines target interval, guard interval and reference interval；Whether judgement target interval there is target and determines the initial position of target；Sequence is filtered to obtain pretreated data；Target location and display target track are obtained, the processing of through-wall radar echo data is completed.The present invention is not necessarily to additional hsrdware requirements, and applicability is high, and calculating speed is fast, and clutter recognition effect is good, can be applied to the real-time positioning of through-wall radar moving target, in the data prediction of the moving-targets acquisition radar system such as unmanned plane.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses the through-wall radar imaging methods based on deep learning, first acquisition artificial echo data；BP imaging is carried out to echo data, input picture when as neural metwork training；Then simulation training generates reference picture, reference picture when as neural metwork training；Neural network is built using tensorflow tool to be trained training data, neural network is trained with input picture and reference picture, and generate network model；Trained network model is finally applied to measured data.Method provided by the invention improves the resolution ratio of through-wall radar imaging；Reduce the secondary lobe in through-wall radar image.

title_en: Life detection and positioning method for full-polarization radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection and positioning method of a full-polarization radar, which comprises the steps of emitting electromagnetic waves to detect a detected area in a full-polarization antenna mode, and then receiving a scattering waveform of a target in the full-polarization antenna mode; and then, preprocessing the received signal, solving a polarization scattering matrix, inverting and estimating time delay, and finally obtaining target information. The invention has the advantages of simple operation, wide application range, adoption of various antenna polarization modes, enhancement of the echo intensity of a detection target, improvement of the detection probability of the life detection radar and the like.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method and system based on millimeter wave signals
abstract_en: According to the heartbeat detection method and system based on the millimeter wave signals, the millimeter wave sensor is used for transmitting continuous frequency modulation wave signals to a target user and receiving echo signals to obtain intermediate frequency signals, phase signals are extracted from the intermediate frequency signals, and the phase signals are used for capturing chest cavity micro-vibration of the target user caused by heartbeat movement. The method and the system can perform modal decomposition on the phase signal at least once based on the hierarchical variation modal decomposition model so as to remove the influence of the interference signal on the heartbeat signal, thereby obtaining fine-grained heartbeat information. The input signal of each variational modal decomposition is the output signal of the last variational modal decomposition. In each variational modal decomposition process, the method and the system calculate corresponding initial parameters based on input signals of the current variational modal decomposition, so that the optimization result is more accurate, the convergence rate is higher, the precision of the variational modal decomposition is improved, and the precision of heart rate detection is further improved.

title_en: Compressed air displacement prevents soil frost heaving disaster system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compressed air displacement system for preventing soil frost heaving disasters, which integrally comprises a detection control system and a gas displacement system. The detection control system respectively detects the temperature, the humidity and the acting force among the soil of the freeze thawing soil above the protection object through the temperature sensor, the humidity sensor and the force sensor, and the detection result is analyzed by the controller and then regulates and controls the electromagnetic control valve of the gas displacement system. The gas displacement system is used for realizing the start and stop of the air compressor and the dryer under the control of the detection control system, pressurized dry gas is transmitted to the gas spray head through the displacement gas pipeline, and the displacement gas is used for uniformly displacing moisture and wet air in freeze thawing soil through the gas spray head, so that frost heaving of soil nearby a protection object is prevented. The invention effectively prevents frost heaving damage of the protected object in the frost thawing soil area, and is applicable to the scenes of preventing the facilities such as buried pipelines, bridge foundations, roadbeds and the like from frost heaving damage.

title_en: Human health data measuring and calculating method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human health data measuring and calculating method and a system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a transmitting end array and a receiving end array of the FMCW radar, configuring a transmitting signal, and mixing an echo signal with the transmitting signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal; s2: sampling and rearranging the intermediate frequency signals to obtain a data matrix and signal data after direct current bias filtering; s3: determining the position of a human body target according to the signal data; s4: extracting vital sign phase signals according to the position of a human body target; s5: from the phase signal, wavelet decomposition and reconstruction, and heart rate estimation are performed. The heart rate estimation method and the heart rate estimation device can effectively improve the accuracy rate of heart rate estimation.
assignees: SICHUAN JINGCHENG DIANKE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent household anti-interference human body presence detection method and system based on 24GHz radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent home and discloses an intelligent home anti-interference human body presence detection method and system based on a 24GHz radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an intermediate frequency signal in a front space of an intelligent home based on a 24GHz FMCW radar front-end module integrated inside the intelligent home, and filtering the intermediate frequency signal; the method comprises the steps of extracting a distance-speed matrix of a filtering signal in a motion detection channel to generate a motion mark in a front space through the motion detection channel and the distance-speed matrix, outputting respiratory harmonic energy in the front space through a vital sign channel, sampling a noise spectrum baseline in the front space, converting the noise spectrum baseline into a noise interference mark through a frequency domain mutual exclusion verifier, and detecting whether a human body exists in the front space according to the motion mark, the respiratory harmonic energy and the noise interference mark to obtain a human body existence detection result. The invention can achieve both static human body detection reliability and anti-interference performance.
assignees: SHENZHEN HI LINK ELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Mountain apple frost prevention device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain apple frost prevention device, which relates to the field of disaster protection devices and comprises a base, an upright post, a reciprocating rotating assembly, a wind power assembly, heat release filling bins and a temperature sensor, wherein the base is buried below the ground for fruit tree planting and is used as a mounting base for stabilizing, the upright post is arranged at the top of the base, the reciprocating rotating assembly is arranged at the top of the upright post, the wind power assembly is arranged at the rotating end of the reciprocating rotating assembly, the temperature sensor is arranged at the middle lower part of the upright post, frost prevention main bodies formed by the base, the upright post, the reciprocating rotating assembly, the wind power assembly and the temperature sensor are distributed on the fruit tree planting at intervals, and a plurality of heat release filling bins are placed on the ground for fruit tree planting at intervals and release heat in low-temperature frost weather. The invention can realize turbulence without dead angle in a large range to destroy the near-ground reverse temperature layer, and simultaneously provides a long-acting low-cost auxiliary heat source which does not depend on external energy, and the whole device is convenient for quick installation, flexible adjustment and seasonal storage.
assignees: GANSU CONGLI AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Life-saving robot prepared for avalanches and snow storms
title_ko: 눈사태와 폭설에 대비한 재난 방제 및 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow is provided to identify the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, to send a signal to rescue workers, and then to rescue people buried in snow. CONSTITUTION: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow inhales snow through a snow sucking unit (10), converts snow into water by a heating plate (20), and converts the water into vapor by an ultrasonic generator (50) for removing snow. The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow identifies the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera and rescues people buried in snow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 눈사태와 폭설 시 재난 방제 및 인명을 구조하는 로봇에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 눈을 수증기로 바꿈으로써 눈을 제거하고, 눈에 갇힌 사람의 위치를 파악함과 더불어, 구조 신호를 보내 구조대원들이 조난자를 구조할 수 있도록 메커니즘을 제공할 수 있는 눈 제거 및 인명 구조에 관한 로봇이다.

title_en: In-home wireless broadcasting terminal with body activity and fire detection, living body signal reception function and the control method thereof
title_ko: 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a home wireless broadcasting terminal having body activity, fire detection, and biometric signal receiving functions and a control method therefor. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a home wireless broadcasting terminal having body activity, fire detection, and biometric signal receiving functions, which adds body activity, fire detection, and biometric signal receiving functions to a wireless broadcasting receiver installed in each family home within a predetermined area to receive and output predetermined announcements transmitted from a main broadcasting device installed in a specific place, and then transmits corresponding information to the main broadcasting device, thereby quickly responding to the occurrence of an emergency situation, and a control method therefor. To this end, the home wireless broadcasting terminal comprises: a wireless communication module; a digital clock unit; a button unit; an I/O control unit; a voice control unit; and a control unit (CPU). The wireless broadcasting receiver further includes an infrared array sensor for detecting body activities and sensing fires in a corresponding family home and a communication module for receiving a biometric signal. The wireless communication module is composed of a bidirectional data communication module and is configured to transmit a measured value from the infrared array sensor and a received measured value of a biometric signal measuring device to the main broadcasting device under the control of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 특정 장소에 설치된 메인방송장치로부터 송출되는 소정 안내방송을 전달받아 출력시키도록 일정 지역 내의 각 가정집에 설치되는 무선방송수신기에 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능을 추가로 구성한 후 해당 정보를 메인방송장치 측으로 전송하도록 하여 긴급상황 발생에 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 한 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명에 따른 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기는, 무선통신모듈과, 디지털시계부와, 버튼부와, I/O 제어부와, 음성 제어부 및, 제어부(CPU)를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 무선방송수신기에는 해당 가정집의 동체활동 및 화재감지를 위한 적외선 배열센서, 생체신호수신용 통신모듈이 더 구비되며, 상기 무선통신모듈은 양방향 데이터 통신모듈로 이루어져 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 상기 적외선 배열센서로부터의 측정값 및 수신된 생체신호측정기의 측정값을 상기 메인방송장치 측으로 전송하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Wireless tag, apparatus and method for measuring biological signal using the tag
title_ko: 무선 태그와 이를 이용한 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for measuring a biological signal of an occupant received from a wireless tag that can be mounted to a seat belt in a vehicle includes: a radar unit transmitting a pre-set radar signal to the wireless tag and receiving a radar reflection signal as a reflection signal for the radar signal converted from a frequency signal of an electromagnetic wave into a harmonic wave signal according to a biological change of the occupant; and a signal processing unit for detecting a heartbeat signal and breathing signal of the occupant through analysis on a frequency area for the radar reflection signal received from the radar unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 차량 내 좌석벨트에 장착 가능한 무선 태그로부터 수신되는 탑승자의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 생체신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 기설정된 레이더 신호를 상기 무선 태그로 송신하고, 상기 레이더 신호에 대한 반사 신호로서 탑승자의 생체변화에 따른 전파의 주파수 신호가 고조파 신호로 변조된 레이더 반사 신호를 상기 무선 태그로부터 수신하는 레이더부 및 상기 레이더부로부터 수신된 상기 레이더 반사 신호에 대하여 주파수 영역 분석을 통해 탑승자의 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호를 검출하기 위한 신호 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Underground base facilities protection system using DAS system and drone
title_ko: Ｄａｓ 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템
abstract_en: A system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system and a drone is disclosed. The system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a DAS system and a drone comprises: an integrated control server linked with an underground buried infrastructure management system including pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines, and a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system using an optical communication cable; and a drone. When the distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system detects excavation work related to the underground buried infrastructure (pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines), the drone is urgently dispatched to arrive at the excavation site of the construction work, transmits camera image data captured by the drone to the integrated control server, and performs a remote warning broadcast to workers using a speaker of the drone to alert them to excavation caution during the construction work, thereby preventing damage to the underground buried infrastructure in advance. The drone includes a GPS receiver, a camera, a directional speaker, and a 13.56 MHz RFID tag. Accordingly, by performing a warning broadcast for construction excavation caution using the speaker of the drone, damage to the underground buried infrastructure can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko:
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템이 개시된다. 
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템은 배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 및 송유관이 포함된 지하매설물 관리 시스템과 광통신 케이블을 이용한 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템과 연동된 통합관제 서버; 및 상기 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템이 지중매설 기반 시설(배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 송유관)에 관련된 굴착 공사가 감지되면, 드론을 긴급 출동시켜 건설 공사 굴착 현장에 도착하여 드론의 카메라 영상 촬영 데이터를 통합관제 서버로 전송하고, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 작업자들에게 건설 공사 굴착 주의 원격 경고 방송을 하여 상기 지중매설 기반 시설의 손상을 사전에 방지되도록 하며, GPS 수신기와 카메라와 지향성 스피커 및 13.56MHz RFID 태그가 부착된 드론을 포함한다. 따라서, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 건설 공사 굴착 주의 경고 방송을 함으로써 지중매설 기반시설 손상을 사전에 방지한다.

title_en: Hybrid fmcw-intererometry radar for positioning and monitoring and methods of using same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for a hybrid radar system that integrates frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) mode and interferometry mode. The radar works as a time division system that continuously switches between the FMCW mode and interferometry mode. The FMCW mode is responsible for absolute range detection and the interferometry mode takes cares of the weak physiological movement monitoring. The respective accuracies in range detection and displacement measurement complements the advantages of the two radar modes, providing versatile performance. By steering the antenna beam, the proposed radar system becomes an ideal solution for indoor health care, human localization, and human-computer interaction. Objects or human targets with or without stationary clutters can be precisely located. At the same time, the targets' vital signs and gestures can be monitored.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring signal processing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal processing system for non-contact vital sign monitoring, which comprises: the I/Q channel signal processing module: for combining the I/Q channel signals I (t) and Q (t) into a complex signal s (t); a respiratory frequency estimation module: defining frequency rotation operator according to the characteristics of the baseband signal mathematical model A reaction of S (t) with After multiplication, Fourier transform is carried out, the parameter P is optimized and estimated through frequency spectrum concentration indexes, and the respiratory frequency f is firstly estimated r (ii) a A modulation component removing module for operating S (t) and the frequency rotation operator estimated in step 2 Multiplying, removing the modulation component caused by respiration in S (t); a heartbeat frequency estimation module: for estimating the frequency f of the heartbeat h . The method is based on a radar baseband signal model, constructs a matched frequency rotation operator to carry out parametric optimization estimation, and can obtain high-precision f by using shorter sampling length data r And f h And the value is estimated, the test sensitivity is high, and the noise resistance is strong.

title_en: A kind of object detection method suitable for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of object detection methods suitable for through-wall radar to obtain raw radar data by radar to objective emission signal wave, and pre-processes to raw radar data；Pulse compression is carried out by matched filter, static target is inhibited by mti filter, obtains moving target indication data；By Doppler filter group, Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target is obtained；Three-dimensional CFAR detection is first carried out to Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target, then testing result is clustered, identifies quantity and the position of aobvious moving-target；Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target is condensed, determines quantity and the position of target, three-dimensional CFAR detection then is carried out to the quantity that cohesion comes out, identifies fine motion target.The present invention separates aobvious moving-target and the testing process of fine motion target, provides different detection methods to improve the detection probability of target.

title_en: Quantitative simulation method for contribution of sandstone overpressure causes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quantitative simulation method of sandstone overpressure contribution, which comprises the steps of collecting data such as finishing analysis test, well logging, geology, earthquake and the like, analyzing stratum pressure characteristics of sandstone at a target horizon, reconstructing buried history and thermal history of sandstone at the target horizon, quantitatively simulating pore pressure evolution history of uncompacted pressure and hydrocarbon generation pressurization, quantitatively simulating total pore pressure evolution history, quantitatively analyzing overpressure contribution, quantitatively analyzing contribution of uncompacted pressure, hydrocarbon generation pressurization and other factors to overpressure according to P  total ＝P underc +P hydrog  and P  total ＝P underc +P hydrog +P other , obtaining three overpressure mechanisms of the causes, quantitatively simulating the overpressure contribution of sandstone, and determining geological exploration areas of oil and gas reservoirs. The invention meets the requirements of the current geological exploration of the oil and gas reservoir, and has guiding significance for the quantitative analysis of the contribution of the overpressure causes of sandstone and the exploration work of the oil and gas reservoir.

title_en: Medical treatment device for search and rescue type aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical treatment device for a search and rescue type aircraft, which comprises a rewarming device, a vital sign monitoring device, an emergency treatment device and an onboard power supply, wherein the rewarming device comprises a thermal blanket and a far infrared rewarming bag and is used for rewarming a user, the vital sign monitoring device is respectively connected with the rewarming device and the emergency treatment device and comprises a sphygmomanometer, a heart rate measuring module, a body temperature measuring module, an oxygen saturation measuring module, a carbon dioxide sensor, an electrocardiograph and a vital sign evaluation module and is used for carrying out vital sign monitoring on the user, and the emergency treatment device comprises an automatic external defibrillator, a cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument, a simple breathing machine, an airborne oxygen supply device, an injection pump and a quantitative infusion pump and is used for carrying out emergency treatment on the user.

title_en: Through-wall radar respiratory signal detection method based on PCA and VMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar respiratory signal detection method based on PCA and VMD, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out characteristic decomposition on an ultra-wideband radar echo data matrix after direct current component removal, then carrying out modal decomposition on a dynamic signal matrix after impurity removal in a slow time dimension, screening relevant modal components in a respiratory frequency range, reconstructing the screened modal components, carrying out Fourier transformation in the slow time dimension to construct a distance-frequency spectrogram, finally constructing a two-dimensional Gaussian template which accords with human respiratory spectrum characteristics and matching, and calculating the distance and frequency estimated value of human respiratory signals. The invention solves the problems of weak anti-interference capability and high false alarm probability of a single clutter suppression method, thereby realizing accurate respiratory signal detection in a strong clutter environment.

title_en: Sewage pipe flushing system
title_ko: 하수도용 관거 세척장치
abstract_en: A washer of a sewerage conduit is provided to prevent the inundation of the downstream and improve sewage purification capacity by controlling and discharging excessively introduced sewage. A washer of a sewerage conduit includes a manhole type buried portion, sensors(31,33,35), and a vacuum device(40). The manhole type buried portion includes a first water tub and a second water tub. The first water tub stores sewage. The second water tub communicates with the first water tube through a lower communication hole. The sensors are installed at the first water tub and the second water tub, and sense a water level. The vacuum device is installed at an upper portion of the second water tub, and is electrically connected to the sensors. The vacuum device opens air in the second water tub according to signals of the sensors.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the Abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Vital sign detection apparatus and system and data processing method
abstract_en: The vital sign detection device of the present invention includes one or more sensors, which can detect a plurality of vital sign signals of a test subject in a non-contact manner, and output corresponding a plurality of vital sign information, thereby achieving fast and accurate vital sign detection. The invention also relates to a combined multi-functional detection device, which includes a camera, a radar sensor, an infrared sensor and a sensor driving unit, used for measuring vital signs. The invention also provides a non-contact blood pressure measurement method and device. The method includes receiving radar echoes and video signal streams at first and second parts, extracting first and second pulse wave signals therefrom, obtaining a measured pulse wave transit time, matching the measured pulse wave transit time with a reference pulse wave transit time, and obtaining a blood pressure value.
assignees: NAT UNIV SINGAPORE;NATIONAL UNIV OF SINGAPORE SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: System and method for mitigation of random body movement and interference effects in radar-based vital signs monitoring systems in medical applications
abstract_en: A radar system for vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing and a method for mitigating random body movement and external interference effects in vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing by employing a radar system that is configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external interference affecting vital signs monitoring is at least mitigated by decomposing and filtering a reconstructed displacement signal using a time and frequency analysis technique such as Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. This decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency basis components containing the random body movement interference. Hence, the filtered signal can be reconstructed after removing the random body movement components, thus enabling reliable and robust vital-signs parameter estimation.

title_en: Earthquake-resistant support for building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake-resistant support for building, which comprises a base, the skeleton is installed through four connecting pieces in the bottom of base, the inside of skeleton is inlayed and is equipped with a plurality of sound cottons of inhaling, the bottom fixedly connected with acoustic celotex board of skeleton, a plurality of gypsum boards of bottom fixedly connected with of acoustic celotex board, the connecting piece includes pre-buried seat and bumper shock absorber, the bumper shock absorber joint is in the bottom of pre-buried seat, pre-buried seat includes the mount, the draw-in groove has been seted up to the bottom of mount, the bumper shock absorber includes the support, the top of support is provided with the cardboard, the bottom of cardboard is provided with the clamp plate, there are rubber pad and lower rubber pad at the top of support inside wall and bottom difference fixed mounting, the utility model relates to a construction technical field. This antidetonation support for building through being provided with the connecting piece, utilizes the mode of pre-buried seat and bumper shock absorber joint to replace traditional self-tapping screw, greatly reduced operating personnel's intensity of labour.

title_en: Underground pipeline detection robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an underground pipeline detection robot, include the frame and be used for surveying the detection radar of burying buried pipeline, on the detection radar located the frame through fixed establishment, still be equipped with electric drive mechanism and encoder on the frame, electric drive mechanism passes through transmission shaft output power to frame, and the encoder is connected with the transmission shaft to fix a position according to the rotation of transmission shaft. The underground pipeline detection robot can realize the forward and backward movement of the underground pipeline detection robot through the electric driving mechanism, and compared with the existing mode of manually pushing the pipeline detection trolley, the underground pipeline detection robot has the advantages that the working strength of workers is reduced; through setting up the encoder, can carry out digital location, the record of being convenient for to buried pipeline's position.

title_en: TER radar detection transceiver for urban underground buried pipeline detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a TER radar detection transceiver for urban underground buried pipeline detection, which comprises a constant voltage clamping module and a bracket; the constant voltage clamping module is simultaneously connected between the transmitting control module and the transmitting coil and between the receiving control module and the receiving coil, and is used for performing constant voltage control on the transmitting signal and clamping control on the receiving induction signal; the support is frame-shaped, the bottom is equipped with the universal wheel, and the side direction is equipped with the layer board, transmitting coil and receiving coil all wind into annular and place on the layer board, and constant voltage clamp module, emission control module, receiving control module, data and instruction interface are all installed on the support. The utility model is stable and firm in structure and convenient to install, improves the detection precision and efficiency, increases the constant voltage clamp module in composition, improves the detection stability and reliability, is suitable for urban underground pipeline detection engineering, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Multi-target detecting method used for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-path illusion suppression method suitable for enclosed space multi-target detection on the basis of the principle that the multi-path echo distance corresponding to one target is certainly larger than the echo distance of the target itself. According to the method, binaryzation is conducted on an original image through threshold detection, the binaryzation image is marked on the basis of a 4-connected method to obtain a group of connected domains, and all the connected domains are sorted in an ascending mode from small to large according to the distances between the mean values of the coordinates of the connected domains to the central point a radar to form a connected domain sequence; then whether each connected domain is a target or a multi-path illusion region is analyzed and judged according to the ascending order of the distances between the mean values of the coordinates of the connected domains to the central point the radar from small to large, the connected domains which are judged to be the targets are remained, zero setting is conducted on the connected domains which are judged to be the multi-path illusion regions, and therefore it is guaranteed that target images in the multi-path illusion regions cannot be lost while suppression of multi-path illusion is achieved.

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar based single-side double-point squint imaging method of building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MIMO through-wall radar based single-side double-point squint imaging method of a building. An MIMO through-wall radar carries out real-aperture squint detection at two detection points selected in the single side of the building, and collected real aperture echoes of the two points from two squint images which include part corners of the building and static objects in the building via a backward projection imaging algorithm. Overlapped fusion and 2D constant false alarm detection are carried out on the two squint images, the integrity of all corner images of the building is ensured, the layout of all walls can be determined, corner image sidelobe and multipath phantom interference are inhibited, distribution of static objects therein can be determined, and a panorama image of the building including clear corner images and static object images is obtained finally. The corner image and the static object image can be used to determine the wall layer out and the static object distribution respectively, and imaging detection for the wall layout and the internal static objects of the building is realized.

title_en: A kind of life-detection system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of life-detection system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, method, the system includes multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and the life detection radar device being mounted in multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, it further include the motion compensation unit being connect with life detection radar device, multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is in region to be measured when flight, life entity target acquisition is carried out by life detection radar device, in life detection radar device detection process, motion compensation is carried out to radar detection signal according to the real-time position information of multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle by motion compensation unit, to compensate the offset deviation that multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle shake generates.The present invention have many advantages, such as structure it is simple, it is at low cost, can be realized dynamic life detection, and detection efficient and precision is high, detection mode is flexible.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Protection device and method for X80 buried pipeline to penetrate through earthquake fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of petrochemical industry and natural gas, and particularly relates to a protection device and a protection method for an X80 buried pipeline to pass through an earthquake fracture zone; the protection device comprises an X80 buried pipeline, a protection pipeline, an end cone pipeline, a flange structure, a displacement sensor, an air pressure sensor, a pneumatic booster pump, an air storage tank, an air inlet pipe, an air outlet pipe, a signal transmission and receiving device, a microcontroller and an electromagnetic valve. When the X80 buried pipeline passes through the earthquake fracture zone, the fault displacement can cause buckling deformation and even damage of the X80 buried pipeline. The invention can determine the area of X80 buried pipeline affected by fault displacement, and adds protective pipeline in the area, and fills nitrogen into the cavity between the protective pipelines, and can adjust the air pressure between the pipelines according to the strain of X80 buried pipeline to protect the buried pipeline. The invention can effectively reduce the influence of fault displacement on the buried X80 pipeline, prevent the pipeline strain from further increasing, and timely send out warning under the condition of pipeline danger.

title_en: Life detection system and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on life detection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on a life detection function, wherein the life detection system comprises a radar imaging module, a thermal imaging module, a video recording module, a feedback module, a control module, a power supply module and a throwing component for throwing a positioning instrument; the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module are all electrically connected with the feedback module; the feedback module, the releasing assembly and the power supply module are all electrically connected with the control module. The control module is used for controlling the power supply module to supply power to the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module, the video recording module and the putting component, and simultaneously controlling the feedback module to receive information fed back by the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module, analyze the received information and transmit the information back to the control center; by the scheme of the invention, the life of the flight area can be effectively detected and recorded in real time.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for monitoring vital movement and physical sign
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for monitoring vital movements and physical signs, and belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radars. The method comprises the following steps: compounding the continuous sine millimeter waves and the linear frequency modulation millimeter waves to obtain composite waveform millimeter waves; indoor vital movement and sign information detection is carried out by a millimeter wave radar by utilizing composite waveform millimeter waves; and extracting the indoor vital movement and sign information by using the echo baseband signal comprising the vital movement and sign information. The invention can optimize the application scene of the millimeter wave radar, can monitor the indoor vital movement information and the indoor vital sign information, realizes that one radar can carry out various monitoring functions of indoor vital movement, vital signs and the like, and reduces the cost.
