title_en: System and method for mitigating random body movement and interference effects in radar-based vital sign monitoring systems in medical applications
abstract_en: A radar system (10) for vital sign monitoring such as at least heart rate or respiration and a method for mitigating random body movement and external disturbance effects in vital sign monitoring such as at least heart rate or respiration by employing a radar system (10) configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected radar waves and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external disturbances affecting vital sign monitoring is alleviated at least by decomposing and filtering the reconstructed displacement signal x (t) using time and frequency analysis techniques such as Short Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a non-Negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. The decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency base components that contain random body movement disturbances. Thus, the filtered signal may be reconstructed after removal of the random body movement component, thereby enabling a reliable and robust vital sign parameter estimation.

title_en: Probe radar antenna
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enhance a resolution of a probe image in probing a relatively shallow region.  <P>SOLUTION: A probe radar antenna 10 provided for a buried object detector 1 has: circular antennas comprising two each of circular element conductors arranged on a substrate 17; and a circular antenna being a reception antenna B arranged in parallel with a transmission antenna A. A pulser 23 generates a pulsed radar wave, and the pulsed radar wave is sent to the two circular element conductors (11, 12) forming the transmission antenna A and radiated to a floor or a wall surface. The reflected wave from the wall or the floor is received by the circular element conductors (13, 14), and the buried object detector 1 discriminates a state of a buried object, based on a time between radiation of the radar wave and reception of the reflected wave, and a phase of a reception signal.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Electronic device generating health information based on a plurality of biometric signal and method of operating the same
title_ko: 복수의 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 생성하는 전자 장치 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device comprises: a battery; a display; at least one sensor; an interface; at least one memory; and at least one processor electrically connected to the display, the at least one sensor, the interface, and the at least one memory. The at least one processor uses the at least one sensor to determine whether a user wears the electronic device, uses the at least one sensor to measure a first biosignal of the user while the user wears the electronic device, drives an RF sensor included in a charging device to measure a second biosignal of the user generated by an RF signal oscillated from the RF sensor while the electronic device is connected to the charging device via the interface, receives at least one among power for charging the battery and the second biosignal from the charging device via the interface, generates health information of the user based at least on the first and the second biosignal, and displays the generated health information on the display. Other embodiments of the present invention are possible.

title_en: Rear seat entertainment system, rear seat entertainment remote controlling apparatus and method thereof
title_ko: 후석 엔터테인먼트 시스템, 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rear seat entertainment controlling apparatus, and a method thereof. The rear seat entertainment remote controlling apparatus may include a sensing module that is provided with a sensing surface including a biometric sensor and senses a biometric signal and a finger gesture of a user, a main controller that supplies AC current to the sensing module, and a short-range wireless communication module that transmits one of the sensed biometric signal or the sensed finger gesture to a rear seat monitor through short-range wireless communication depending on an operation mode. Accordingly, the present invention can provide a rear seat entertainment remote controlling appparatus capable of remote control of a rear seat monitor as well as health care information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치는 생체 센서를 포함한 센싱면이 형성되어 사용자의 생체 신호 및 손가락 제스처(Gesture)를 감지하는 센싱 모듈과 상기 센싱 모듈로 교류 전류를 제공하는 주제어기와 동작 모드에 따라 상기 감지된 생체 신호 및 손가락 제스처 중 어느 하나를 근거리 무선 통신을 통해 후석 모니터로 전송하는 근거리 무선통신 모듈을 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 헬스 케어 정보뿐만 아니라 후석 모니터의 원격 제어가 가능한 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치를 제공하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mask device and a control method thereof. According to the present invention, the mask device comprises: a mask body closely attached to a user's face and including an inner surface covering the user's nose and mouth and an outer surface exposed to an external space; an air cleaner connected to the mask body and having an inlet through which external air is introduced and an air flow hole through which the air introduced through the inlet flows into the inner surface of the mask body; and a breathing sensor disposed in a flow path between the inner and outer surfaces of the mask body and sensing the amount of respiration flowing through the air cleaner. Accordingly, the flow of air can be adjusted according to a user's breathing state through the breathing sensor disposed in the flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body, and the user's breathing can be more comfortable than that of a constant pressure type by performing an automatic breathing detection-based fan operation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치된 호흡 센서를 통해 사용자의 호흡 상태에 맞게 공기의 유동을 조절할 수 있으며,자동식 호흡 감지 기반 FAN 동작으로써 정압식 방식에 비해 고객의 호흡을 편안하게 해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Alarm system to prevent safety accidents caused by flooding of underpasses
title_ko: 지하차도 침수로 인한 안전사고 방지를 위한 경보시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present document is an alarm system that can effectively deliver a danger of entering an underpass during heavy rainfall to a driver to prevent the driver from recklessly entering the underpass. The alarm system according to an embodiment comprises: a water level sensor provided inside an underpass; a drainage pump provided inside the underpass; a drainage pipe having one end connected to the drainage pump and the other end located outside the underpass; a spray nozzle buried in the ground at an entrance of the underpass; a branch pipe connecting the drainage pipe with the spray nozzle; an electronic valve provided in the branch pipe and opening and closing the branch pipe; and a control unit controlling the drainage pump and the electronic valve based on information obtained by the water level sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 문건은 집중호우시 지하차도 진입의 위험성을 운전자에게 효과적으로 전달하여, 운전자의 무모한 지하차도 진입을 막을 수 있는 경보시스템을 개시한다. 
실시예에 따른 경보시스템은, 지하차도 내부에 구비되는 수위센서; 지하차도 내부에 구비되는 배수펌프; 일단이 상기 배수펌프와 연결되고, 타단의 상기 지하차도의 외부에 위치되는 배수파이프; 지하차도의 입구 지면에 매설되는 분사노즐; 상기 배수파이프와 상기 분사노즐를 연결하는 분기파이프; 상기 분기파이프에 구비되어, 상기 분기파이프를 개폐하는 전자밸브; 및 상기 수위센서로 획득된 정보를 바탕으로, 상기 배수펌프와 상기 전자밸브를 제어하는 제어유닛;을 포함한다.

title_en: A device for outputting simulated vital signs and a method for operating the same
title_ko: 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호를 출력하는 디바이스 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a device for outputting a simulated vital signal to prevent an unauthorized external user from leaking personal information like a user's vital signal and to reinforce security. The device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may: detect a UWB scanning pulse transmitted by an external device to measure a user's vital signal in a non-contact manner; if the UWB scanning pulse is detected, simulate a virtual person's vital signal to generate a virtual vital sign; and output simulated vital signal data including the vital signal and the virtual vital signal by using a UWB antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 허가되지 않은 외부 사용자에 의해 사용자의 생체 신호와 같은 개인 정보가 유출되는 것을 방지하고, 보안을 강화하기 위하여 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호를 출력하는 디바이스를 제공한다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 디바이스는 비접촉 방식(non-contact)으로 사용자의 생체 신호(vital sign)를 측정하기 위하여 외부 디바이스에 의해 송신된 UWB 스캐닝 펄스를 검출(detect)하고, UWB 스캐닝 펄스가 검출된 경우 가상 인물(virtual person)의 생체 신호를 시뮬레이션함으로써 가상 생체 신호(virtual vital sign)를 생성하고, UWB 안테나를 이용하여 생체 신호 및 가상 생체 신호를 포함하는 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호 데이터를 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Firefighting rescue equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to firefighting rescue equipment that consists of a helmet that adjusts to the head in order to protect the rescuer's face from smoke in the event of a fire, and it also integrates a self-contained breathing mask to supply oxygen in order to minimise risk related to a low concentration of oxygen in areas with a fire. Another feature of the present invention is a camera for transmitting real time video as a support, in addition to installed lights for improving visibility in areas with low lighting. The firefighting rescue equipment also has a communication system to establish contact with support personnel, and it is important to note that said equipment has mechanisms that supply air therein to keep the rescuer cool when they are in a high temperature environment. Another feature of the present invention is a vital sign sensor that monitors the critical systems of a person in risk situations.

title_en: Systems and methods for subject monitoring
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for collecting and analyzing vital sign information to predict a likelihood of a subject having a disease or disorder. In an aspect, a system for monitoring a subject may comprise: sensors comprising an electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor, which sensors are configured to acquire health data comprising vital sign measurements of the subject over a period of time; and a mobile electronic device, comprising: an electronic display; a wireless transceiver; and one or more computer processors configured to (i) receive the health data from the sensors through the wireless transceiver, (ii) process the health data using a trained algorithm to generate an output indicative of a progression or regression of a health condition of the subject over the period of time at a sensitivity of at least about 80%, and (iii) provide the output for display to the subject on the electronic display.

title_en: Target detection method for ground-penetrating radar and associated radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting at least one target buried in an area of the ground, using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a measurement of a signal transmitted by each transmitting antenna and reflected in the area of the ground, converting an estimate, into the frequency domain, of the propagation channel for each pair consisting of a transmitting antenna and of a receiving antenna, defining a first hypothesis H0 corresponding to an absence of target in the area of the ground, defining a second hypothesis H1 corresponding to the presence of at least one target in the area of the ground, performing a test of the likelihood ratio between the likelihood of the channel matrix under the second hypothesis H1 and the likelihood of the channel matrix under the first hypothesis H0, in order to conclude whether a target is present at a given position in the area of the ground.
assignees: COMMISSARIAT A L’ENERGIE ATOMIQUE ET AUX ENERGIES ALTERNATIVES

title_en: Method for monitoring stability and predicting destabilization of side slope based on change of state of strain of soil-rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the stability and predicting the destabilization of a side slope based on the change of the state of strain of soil-rock mass, which is used for monitoring strain sensitivity and strain acceleration condition along a sensor distribution direction in the side slope to fulfill the aims of pre-warning and prediction under the condition that buried monitoring sensors do not change the stable state of the side slope by arranging a plurality of parallel or slightly inclined multi-point strain gauges or distributed strain gauges in a slope body of the side slope, judging the plastic zone and potential destabilization range of the side slope according to the strain sensitivity change of the multi-point strain gauges or the distributed strain gauges and evaluating the stability of the side slope. Specifically for the slope bodies which are not obviously deformed before the side slopes are destabilized, a conventional displacement monitoring method cannot monitor and pre-warn the destabilization. Compared with the conventional method, the method has inimitable advantages, and compared with the conventional method for monitoring the stability of the side slope and a landslide disaster, is more direct and more rational monitoring means.

title_en: Video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless positioning and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides a video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless positioning, which comprises a ZigBee coordinator, zigBee blind nodes and more than three ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms, wherein the ZigBee blind nodes are arranged on the search and rescue robot, a controller, a communication module, an infrared monitoring module and a video monitoring module are further arranged on the search and rescue robot, and the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms are arranged at the vertex positions of the smallest regular polygon surrounding a search and rescue area. According to the invention, the search and rescue robot searches for life signals by utilizing the pyroelectric infrared sensor, the cradle head camera is utilized to capture surrounding environment images and videos, the environment images and videos are transmitted to the intelligent terminal by utilizing a Wi-Fi network built by the search and rescue robot or outside, the ZigBee blind node module is arranged on the search and rescue robot, the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanism and the ZigBee coordinator module which are arranged on the periphery of a disaster scene are matched to calculate the real-time position coordinates of the search and rescue robot, and the real-time position coordinates are displayed on an electronic map of the search and rescue intelligent terminal, so that the search and rescue work of wounded persons in disaster ruins is realized.

title_en: Dynamic and static human body target self-adaptive detection method and system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for self-adaptive detection of moving and static human body targets based on a through-wall radar, and relates to the technical field of radar detection. The invention comprises the following steps: SS01 obtains baseband signals after frequency mixing and amplification of the through-wall radar and the radio frequency module; SS02 collects 32 groups of data, and after distance Fourier transform and Doppler Fourier transform, accumulation of Doppler direction on corresponding distance units is carried out after modulus taking; SS03 judgment of moving human body; SS04 conversion of stationary human body distance units; SS05 judgment of static human body; SS06 location determination. According to the invention, the moving human body target and the static human body target can be respectively detected through the moving target detection algorithm and the static target detection algorithm, so that on one hand, the detection accuracy is improved, on the other hand, the interference of the moving target on the detection of the static human body target is effectively inhibited, and the problem that the moving target and the static target cannot be simultaneously detected by the conventional detection method is solved by utilizing the characteristic that the breathing heartbeat frequency of the static human body target is low.

title_en: Non-contact human vital sign sensing method and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based non-contact human vital sign sensing method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting radar echo signals comprising targets, processing intermediate frequency signals obtained through a low-pass filter to obtain signal spectrums, selecting a distance domain with the largest dynamic energy as a distance domain of a sensing target, determining the dynamic and static states of the detected targets according to the signal spectrums, re-collecting signals if the dynamic state is dynamic, performing distance beam forming on the signals in the distance domain of the sensing target if the dynamic state is static, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio of the target signals, performing fast Fourier transform on the target signals to obtain frequency spectrums of complex signals, calculating the respiratory rate, sequentially performing first-order difference and fast Fourier transform on the target signals to obtain frequency spectrums of differential complex signals, and calculating the heart rate of the targets according to the frequency spectrums and the respiratory rate of the differential complex signals. The invention can expand the range of breath and heartbeat detection, improve the accuracy of heartbeat detection, and can be widely applied to the field of non-contact human vital sign sensing.

title_en: Method and system for detecting through-wall radar target
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar target detection method, which comprises the steps of detecting by adopting a through-wall radar and acquiring an original echo signal; pulse compression is carried out to obtain compressed echo data; performing clutter suppression; performing coherent imaging to obtain an imaging result; constructing a robust principal component analysis optimization model based on the imaging result; and solving the model to obtain a final target detection result, and finishing the through-wall radar target detection. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the through-wall radar target detection method. The method for analyzing the robust principal component is applied to the target detection of the through-wall radar, and not only realizes the target detection of the through-wall radar through the technical scheme of pulse compression, clutter suppression, coherent imaging and robust principal component analysis, but also is suitable for the simultaneous detection of multiple moving and static targets under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, and has the advantages of higher detection accuracy and reliability, better robustness, higher detection speed and higher efficiency.

title_en: Non-contact sleep stage classification system and classification method based on visual view
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact sleep stage classification system and a classification method based on visual views. The system comprises a non-contact physiological information acquisition module, a visual network construction module and a sleep stage multi-element classification module. The visual network construction module is used for training network features extracted by the visual network construction module by using a machine learning method, firstly carrying out normalization processing on the extracted network features, then dividing sleep stages into a awake stage and a sleep stage, then carrying out fine classification on the sleep stage, dividing the sleep stage into a rapid eye movement stage, a sleep stage I, a sleep stage II and a sleep stage III, and finally completing the division of five sleep stages. The visual network is applied to the respiration and heartbeat signals extracted by the non-contact vital sign monitoring radar, so that the two branch networks of respiration and heartbeat are built, deep information of the respiration and heartbeat signals is further mined, and the accuracy rate of sleep stage classification is improved.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection with elimination of signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system that is configured to determine range and velocity information from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior of a vehicle for vital sign detection. The method includes steps to decompose reflected and received signals into range and velocity information, to measure the movement over time in specified range gates and to evaluate the similarities between them. Based on the characteristics of similar behaving range bins, it can be decided whether any detected movement is related to an internal or external disturbance or by vital signs.

title_en: System and method for ground penetrating radar communication using antenna crosstalk
abstract_en: An object detection system (24) is disclosed having a transducer (40, 40') for detecting buried objects (26). The transducer is encapsulated within a robust, electromagnetically transparent construction (42).
assignees: DEERE & CO;LOUISIANA TECH UNIVERSITY RES FOUNDATION

title_en: Focusing delay calculation method for known multilayer non-uniform walls
abstract_en: The invented discloses a focusing delay calculation method for known multilayer non-uniform walls, belongs to the technical field of through-wall radar target imaging, and specially relates to through-wall radar multilayer non-uniform wall compensation. Firstly, a range profile, namely, echo information of a target, is acquired; secondly, a wall is subdivided into enough small layers, each small layer is uniform, and a propagation delay expression of electromagnetic waves from a transmitting antenna to a receiving antenna is written according to the law of refraction; thirdly, the angle of incidence is calculated according to the geometric relationship, and thus, the focusing delay is obtained; and finally, BP imaging is carried out. To sum up, by adopting the method, a wall of which the dielectric constant changes in the thickness direction of the wall can be compensated precisely, and the delay of electromagnetic waves in penetrating the wall can be calculated accurately.

title_en: Indoor object echo extraction method and system based on acoustic-electromagnetic intermodulation
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor object echo extraction method and system based on acoustic-electromagnetic intermodulation, which comprises the steps of transmitting acoustic wave excitation from an electromagnetic wave transmitting and receiving end so as to trigger an object to vibrate and generate a corresponding acoustic wave signal; selecting an electromagnetic signal capable of modulating the sound wave signal according to a required frequency band, transmitting the electromagnetic signal, and performing sound-electromagnetic mutual modulation on the sound wave signal by using the electromagnetic signal to obtain sound-electromagnetic echo of an object; the electromagnetic wave receiving and transmitting end receives the acoustic electromagnetic echo, and the Fourier transform is carried out on the acoustic electromagnetic echo to obtain a corresponding frequency spectrum; and filtering the frequency spectrum according to the phase shift and amplitude modulation generated by the acoustic electromagnetic echo, thereby filtering the signal of the frequency band where the acoustic wave is excited and the symmetrical sideband signal, and further obtaining the characteristic frequency spectrum containing the characteristics of the object. Compared with the traditional mode of modulating weak vibration signals based on electromagnetic waves, the method increases the information amount carried by sound wave excitation and improves the stability of through-wall detection.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves; the system comprises a control module, wherein a first driving module is electrically connected to the control module, a millimeter wave radar module is electrically connected to the first driving module, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are electrically connected to the millimeter wave radar module, a data information processing module is electrically connected to the millimeter wave radar module, a phase measurement module is electrically connected to the data information processing module, and the phase measurement module is electrically connected to the control module; the invention realizes the detection of the vital signs of the human body through the millimeter wave radar module, the reflected signals are phase-modulated due to the motion of the chest, the receiving signals and the sending signals are combined through the frequency mixer to generate an Intermediate Frequency (IF) signal, the phase is calculated, the subsequent data information is calculated and processed, the information accuracy of the data is improved, and the detection result is calibrated through the phase measurement module.

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method based on wireless radar signal and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vital sign detection device and method based on a wireless radar signal. The method comprises the following steps: determining an initial position of a living body according to the wireless radar signal; determining a target position corresponding to a characteristic signal conforming to the physiological characteristic of the living body according to the frequency domain characteristic of the characteristic signal for detecting the vital sign parameter in a neighborhood range containing the initial position; and detecting vital sign parameters from the characteristic signal at the target location. Thus, clutter interference can be reduced, and detection accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement effect, which comprises the following steps: extracting phase data containing vital sign information from the radar signal, then carrying out multichannel average processing, and extracting a heartbeat signal by using a high-pass filter; detecting body movement of a heartbeat signal by using a double-energy threshold detection method, judging a body movement mode, and selecting initial distribution parameters of a maximum expected algorithm; filtering out motion artifacts using a maximum expected algorithm; and acquiring the heart rate of the tested target by using a fast Fourier transform spectrum analysis method. The non-contact heart rate detection framework of the MCA treatment, the APSEM method and the FFT spectrum analysis method provided by the invention realizes the inhibition of strong interference caused by body movement in the detection process, and is beneficial to obtaining accurate heart rate measurement results in the detection environment of the body movement of a detected person.

title_en: System for detecting a person's course of motion and/or vital sign parameters
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for detecting a person's course of motion. The method comprises detecting a plurality of images of a person during movement by a non-contact sensor, wherein the plurality of images depict movement of a body element of the person, creating at least one skeletal model with limb positions for at least some of the plurality of images, and calculating a movement process from movement of the body element of the person by comparing changes in limb positions in the at least one created skeletal model. At the same time vital sign parameters and/or signal processing parameters about the person may be detected and analyzed.

title_en: Wearable sensor to monitor bio signal and method to monitor bio signal using wearable device
title_ko: 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 센서 및 웨어러블 장치를 이용하여 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a wearable device for monitoring a biometric signal of a user. According to an embodiment, the wearable device is formed of a wearable sensor and an interaction unit which are attached/detached to/from each other. When the wearable sensor is connected to the interaction unit each other, the wearable sensor can use resources of the interaction unit while receiving power from the interaction unit.
abstract_ko: 사용자의 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 장치가 제공된다.  일 실시예에 따르면, 웨어러블 장치는 서로 착탈 가능한 웨어러블 센서 및 인터랙션부로 구성되고, 웨어러블 센서 및 인터랙션부가 서로 연결되어 있는 경우 웨어러블 센서는 인터랙션부로부터 전력을 공급 받으면서 인터랙션부의 자원을 이용할 수 있다.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection with elimination of signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system (100) that is configured to determine range and velocity information from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior (116) of a vehicle (114) for vital sign detection comprises steps to decompose reflected and received signals into range and velocity information, to measure the movement over time in specified range gates and to evaluate the similarities between them. Based on the characteristics of similar behaving range bins, it can be decided whether any detected movement is related to an internal or external disturbance or by vital signs.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of utilizing the millimeter wave radar to emit frequency modulation continuous wave signals to a human body, extracting intermediate frequency signals, estimating the azimuth angle of the human body relative to the radar, adopting digital wave beam formation, generating a distance-azimuth thermal map, estimating the elevation angle of the human body relative to the radar, extracting a distance-azimuth thermal map corresponding to the obtained elevation angle, determining detection points of different human bodies, extracting the intermediate frequency signals of different human bodies according to the distance-azimuth-elevation angle, and estimating heart rate and respiratory rate. The invention realizes non-contact multi-person vital sign monitoring, can effectively separate echo signals of different human bodies in a radar monitoring scene through the joint estimation of distance, azimuth and elevation, removes interference signals in the monitoring scene, and utilizes various algorithms to jointly estimate heart rate and respiratory rate, thereby improving the monitoring precision and ensuring good monitoring effect.

title_en: Expansive soil slope seepage instability prediction method, system and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method, a system and terminal equipment for predicting osmotic instability of an expansive soil slope, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining key factors of the instability of the expansive soil slope; based on the key factors, an expansive soil slope instability model is established; calculating to obtain a critical state value of the instability of the expansive soil slope based on the instability model of the expansive soil slope; obtaining the displacement change rate of the expansive soil through a sensor pre-buried in the expansive soil; judging a target instability risk interval and a target expansion displacement grade of the expansion soil side slope according to the expansion soil displacement change rate and the critical state value; and obtaining a prediction result of the osmotic instability of the expansive soil slope according to the target instability risk interval and the target expansion displacement level. And the target risk interval and the target expansion displacement level are combined, the stability of the expansive soil slope is judged, and the judgment result is more accurate.

title_en: Non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring method, device, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring method, a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring device, a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring system, equipment, media and products, and relates to the technical field of emotion recognition. The method comprises the steps of starting a human-computer interaction program to conduct interview with target personnel, receiving human vital sign signals and audio-video signals collected by a millimeter wave biological radar module and an audio-video collection module for the target personnel in the interview process, then sequentially carrying out pretreatment, signal separation treatment and frequency estimation treatment on the human vital sign signals to obtain respiratory rate and heartbeat frequency, carrying out feature extraction treatment on the audio-video signals to obtain audio features and video features, and finally comprehensively analyzing the audio features and the video features to obtain the emotion state of the target personnel according to the respiratory rate, the heartbeat frequency, the audio features and the video features, thereby providing high-quality data support for the establishment of a follow-up artificial intelligent emotion early warning and assessment model and realizing emotion state analysis with higher accuracy and higher reliability.

title_en: Bioinstrumentation to evaluate blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function
title_ko: 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 양손만을 이용하여, 단일 파라미터가 아닌, 심전도(ECG), 산소포화도(SpO 2 ), 혈압(NIBP), 체임피던스(Bio-Impedance)를 측정하고, 체지방율(Body Fat Rate, BFR), 비관혈식 혈압(NIBP), 혈관탄성도(BVSI), 심박출량(ICG), 폐기능 검사(IPFT)의 다차원의 생체 파라미터의 분석을 행하여, 비용과 시간의 제약이 적게 들며, 지속적인 혈관 및 심폐기능 모니터링이 가능한, 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은, 손목에 혈압측정용 커프를 장착하고, 좌측단과 우측단을 손으로 잡도록 이루어지되, 좌측단과 우측단의 손접촉부에는 생체신호 검출전극이 장착되어 있는 생체 계측 시스템에 있어서, 심전도, 체임피던스, 심박출량(ICG), 임피던스 폐기능검사(IPFT)를 측정하는 수단으로, 심전도 센서부과 체임피던스 센서부을 구비하여, 심전도신호와 체임피던스 신호를 검출하여, RR간격을 포함하는 심전도 파라미터, FEV1/FVC 비율, 심박출량, 체지방량을 측정하는 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈; 산소포화도 센서부를 구비하여 산소포화도를 검출하는 산소포화도 검출모듈; NIBP 센서부 및 압력센서부를 구비하여, NIBP센서부로부터의 혈압신호 및 압력센서부로부터의 코르트코프음신호를 검출하여, 혈압 신호로부터 오실로메트릭법에 따른 혈압을 검출하고, 코르트코프음신호로부터 코로토코프음에 따른 혈압을 검출하는 혈압측정모듈; 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈, 산소포화도 검출모듈, 혈압측정모듈의 구동을 제어하고, 사용자의 생체측정신호를 통계처리하여 결과를 디스플레이부로 출력하는 메인 모듈를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명은 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈 및 산소포화도 검출모듈을 이용하여 혈관탄성도(BVSI)를 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: An earthquake-resistant manhole srtucture
title_ko: 내진 성능을 구비한 단지내 배수로 구조를 갖는 맨홀 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention provides a manhole structure with an in-site drain structure having seismic performance which prevents damage to a manhole body. The manhole structure with an in-site drain structure having seismic performance comprises: a base unit which is installed in the ground, is made of concrete, and has a reinforcing member of a grid shape buried therein; a manhole body arranged on the base unit to be moved; a roller unit which is installed on a corner portion of the lower end of the manhole body, and rolls along a curved surface formed on a corner of a seating groove formed on the upper end of the base unit to move the manhole body; an impact sensor which is installed on the manhole body, and senses an external impact force; a level sensor installed on the manhole body to sense whether manhole body is level; and a control unit which controls driving of the roller unit to allow the manhole body to become level by driving the roller unit if the sensed impact force is higher than or equal to a preset impact force.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중에 설치되며, 콘크리트로 형성되며, 내부에 격자 형상의 보강 부재가 매설되는 베이스 부; 상기 베이스 부 상에 유동 가능하게 배치되는 맨홀 본체; 상기 맨홀 본체의 하단 모서리부에 설치되며, 상기 베이스 부의 상단에 형성되는 안착홈의 모서리에 형성되는 곡면을 따라 굴러 상기 맨홀 본체를 유동 시키는 롤러부; 상기 맨홀 본체에 설치되며, 외부 충격력을 감지하는 충격 센서; 상기 맨홀 본체에 설치되어 수평 여부를 감지하는 수평 센서; 및, 감지되는 상기 충격력이 기설정된 이상 충격력 이상을 이루는 경우, 상기 롤러부를 구동시켜 상기 맨홀 본체가 상기 수평을 이루도록 상기 롤러부의 구동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 내진 성능을 구비한 단지내 배수로 구조를 갖는 맨홀 구조물을 제공한다.

title_en: Microseism life detection system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a microseism life detection system, which comprises a control host capable of carrying out wireless communication, a plurality of wireless detection terminals and a plurality of wired detection terminals, wherein the plurality of wireless detection terminals and the plurality of wired detection terminals are integrated on the control host and can be disassembled; each wireless detection terminal and each wired detection terminal are internally provided with a vibration acceleration sensor, a millimeter wave radar module and an information processing module, the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module detect information in the vehicle, and the information processing module processes the information detected by the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module into sound waves with the frequency not more than 500Hz and transmits the sound waves to a control host through wireless communication and wired communication; each wireless detection terminal is also internally provided with a rechargeable battery; and an alarm device is also arranged on the control host. The utility model is convenient for detecting whether the life body exists in the vehicle body, can effectively avoid environmental interference, is convenient for use, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Life surviving device
abstract_en: The invention provides a life surviving device which belongs to rescuing equipment for assisting life detection and indicating the position of a trapped person. The life-surviving device comprises a pot body and air inflation bags arranged on the two sides of the pot body, wherein the pot body is provided with a valve which is used for blocking inflation openings of the air inflation bags; the valve is provided with a pulse sensor and a wireless transmitter; the pulse sensor is connected with a data input end of a first processor; the wireless transmitter is connected with a data output end of the first processor; each air inflation bag is provided with a wireless receiver and an LED (Light Emitting Diode) indication lamp; each wireless receiver is connected with a data input end of a second processor; each LED indication lamp is connected to a data output end of the second processor. According to the life surviving device, the positions of the trapped people can be indicated and vital signs of the trapped people can be monitored so that rescuing personnel not only can find the trapped people rapidly, but also can judge rescuing priorities according to the vital signs of the trapped people.
assignees: WUXI XRES PRODUCT DES & RES CO

title_en: It is positioned in a kind of ship personnel cabin based on UWB and health management system arranged
abstract_en: The invention belongs to UWB technology fields, and in particular to position in a kind of ship personnel cabin based on UWB and health management system arranged.The system includes positioning label, locating base station, isochronous controller and the location-server with vital sign sensors；Wherein, positioning label issues pulse data packet repeatedly；Locating base station receives the pulse data packet that positioning label is sent out, and measures the precise time that each pulse data packet reaches locating base station antenna；Isochronous controller is used to complete the coordinated control of network, guarantees the positioning timing of each locating base station, and the pulse data packet for collecting each locating base station is sent to location-server；Location-server reaches time difference and the multi-path algorithm of each locating base station according to pulse data packet, determines the position of positioning label and the health status of personnel.The present invention can effectively solve the problem that due to cabin inner shield and the problem of position inaccurate.

title_en: Intelligent window-breaking escape protection device for automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent automobile window breaking and escaping protection device, which belongs to the technical field of emergency escaping equipment and comprises a control processing module, an emergency alarm module, a fire alarm module, a vital sign alarm module, a button module, a communication module, a voice synthesis module, a window breaking device and a GPS module. The intelligent window breaking device has the advantages that automatic window breaking is achieved through the cooperation of the sensors of the alarm modules and the control processing module, manual window breaking is achieved through the button module, remote window breaking is achieved through the communication between the communication module and the rear-end equipment, and the window breaking device is driven to act in three intelligent window breaking modes, so that the personal safety of people in the vehicle is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Positioning method for distributed optical fiber sensing system
abstract_en: The method is used for carrying out phase correction on signals acquired by an optical fiber sensor array, so that the influence of the scale of an optical fiber sensing channel is eliminated, and the corrected signals can be directly used for obtaining high-precision target source position information by using an array signal processing method. The method is not dependent on a specially designed optical fiber winding structure, and is suitable for the conventional buried communication optical cable. The invention has the advantages of simple implementation, low cost, large range, high precision and the like, can further improve the positioning capability of the existing sensing system on the target signal in the actual application scene, is suitable for the fields of railway safety, perimeter security, earthquake rapid reporting and the like, and has great significance.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST OPTICS & FINE MECH CAS

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar system and identification method for both sides of friend and foe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall-penetrating radar system and a method for identifying enemy, comprising a wall-penetrating radar host and a positioning tag, wherein the wall-penetrating radar host is used for acquiring the position information of all human targets; the wall-penetrating radar host is in communication connection with the positioning tag and is used for acquiring distance information between the wall-penetrating radar host and the positioning tag on the own human body target; and the through-wall radar host identifies the two sides of the friend and foe in each human target according to the position information and the distance information. According to the invention, UWB base stations are not required to be arranged in advance, the indoor positioning of the target is realized through the multi-transmission multi-reception MIMO architecture of the through-wall radar host, the problem that nodes need to be erected in UWB positioning is solved, and the method has the characteristics of convenience and flexibility in use and the like.

title_en: Vital sign extraction and classification method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign extraction and classification method and device based on machine learning, which are characterized in that an intermediate frequency signal is extracted through a millimeter wave radar device, the influence of an interference signal is reduced under the condition of higher accuracy through a normalized least mean square algorithm NLMS, accurate respiratory signals and heartbeat signals are separated, the characteristics extracted from a radar echo on a time domain and a frequency domain are used as labels of training data, and the labels are input into MBSVM multiple classifiers for training test and verification, so that the accurate classification of human sleep signs is obtained. The invention is combined with a non-contact physiological signal sensing system, can keep the stability of the system while improving the accuracy and the reliability, monitors information such as respiratory heartbeat and the like of a user in real time, and has high practical value.

title_en: Non-contact heart rate variability detection method based on improved variational modal decomposition and modal selection criteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses an HRV estimation method of a millimeter wave radar. Firstly, the human body is positioned by utilizing the distance resolution characteristic of the FMCW radar, and noise and interference existing in echo signals are preprocessed. Secondly, a gray wolf optimization algorithm is introduced, and a traditional variation modal decomposition method is optimized by taking the maximum mutual information coefficient and the minimum reconstruction error as fitness functions, so that the self-adaptive separation of vital sign signals is realized. And simultaneously, a mode selection criterion based on the correlation coefficient is provided to select the optimal heartbeat component from the decomposed modes. Finally, extracting a time parameter corresponding to the heartbeat peak, further obtaining IBI, and calculating the time-frequency domain characteristics of the HRV through the IBI. The invention effectively extracts the heartbeat signal through an improved mode decomposition method and a mode selection criterion, thereby realizing high-precision estimation of heart rate variability.

title_en: System for observing carbon dioxide gas in earthquake precursor fault gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon dioxide gas observation system for earthquake precursor fault gas, which comprises a solar vertical rod, a storage battery buried box, a comprehensive weather station, an observation well and an observation host, wherein the solar vertical rod is arranged on the ground, a solar panel is arranged on the solar vertical rod, the storage battery buried box is buried underground, a storage battery is arranged in the storage battery buried box and is connected with the solar panel, the comprehensive weather station is arranged on the solar vertical rod, a carbon dioxide sensor and a ground temperature and humidity sensor are arranged in the observation well, the observation host is arranged on the solar vertical rod and is connected with the storage battery, the comprehensive weather station, the carbon dioxide sensor and the ground temperature and humidity sensor, and the device can be used for evaluating the influence of environmental factors on the observation of carbon dioxide concentration by arranging the observation well and the comprehensive weather station on the ground so as to finish the measurement of carbon dioxide concentration, air temperature, humidity, air pressure, rainfall and ground temperature, and the observation accuracy is improved.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF BEIJING HUAYUN ANALYTICAL INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Buried object display device, buried object detection device, and program
abstract_en: To use an AI detection function and a MG detection function in combination in an underground radar survey to improve accuracy of survey.SOLUTION: An AI detection unit 12 performs an AI detection function that represents processing for detecting an underground range in which a buried object exists by using survey data acquired from a radar survey device 10 and using machine learning related to a shape of the buried object in the survey data. A MG detection unit 13 performs a MG detection function that represents processing for performing migration processing of a reflection signal from the buried object by using the survey data acquired from the radar survey device 10 to detect a position of the buried object. An integration processing unit 14 superimposes the detection result by the AI detection unit 12 and the detection result by the MG detection unit 13 together on one screen so as to display the position of the buried object as the respective detection results.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Slope measuring apparatus and system using for the same
title_ko: 사면계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 사면계측시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A slope measuring apparatus and a system with the same are provided to prevent physical damage by falling rocks and a slope collapse. CONSTITUTION: A slope measuring apparatus comprises a main body, a displacement measuring sensor and a sinkage meter(50). The main body is equipped in a pile among several piles buried under the slop. The displacement measuring sensor is built in the main body and measures the displacement of the slop. The sinkage meter is installed in the main body and measures the sinkage of the slop.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사면의 거동을 계측하여 사면 붕괴로 인한 재해를 예방하기 위한 사면계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 사면계측시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히 본 발명은 사면에 매설되는 복수의 파일 중 어느 하나와 결합되는 본체; 상기 사면의 변위를 계측하도록 상기 본체에 설치되는 변위계측센서; 상기 복수의 파일 간 상대변위에 의해 상기 사면의 침하량을 계측하도록 상기 본체에 설치된 침하량 계측계;를 포함하는 사면계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 사면계측시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사면의 이상징후 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency situation detection system in private space based on lidar sensor
title_ko: 라이더 센서 기반 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensor-based emergency detection system in a private space, which accurately detects dangerous situations while minimizing privacy exposure. According to the present invention, the LiDAR sensor-based emergency detection system comprises: a LiDAR sensor detecting an object in a detection area requiring privacy protection; a vibration sensor detecting the magnitude of vibration in the detection area; a breath sensor detecting a breathing pattern of the object when the object detected by the LiDAR sensor is a person; a smart hub relaying data among the LiDAR sensor, the vibration sensor, the breath sensor, and an analysis server; and an analysis server receiving and applying detection data of the vibration sensor, detection data of the breath sensor, and an image taken by the LiDAR sensor to a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to detect a predetermined movement pattern of the object. Therefore, the present invention determines an emergency.
abstract_ko: 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 라이더 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 라이더 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 라이더 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 라이더 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND;TLBIZ CO LTD

title_en: Radar System for Detection of Human Trapped in Deep Subsurface and Control Method thereof
title_ko: 고심도 매몰자 탐지용 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar system for detecting a high-depth buried person and a control method thereof. According to the present invention, a pipe-type radar system for detecting a high-depth buried person comprises: a radar device including a pulse radar and a doppler radar; a winch device for raising or lowering the radar device in a borehole; a ground control device for driving the winch device to raise or lower the radar device in the borehole, and collecting pulse reflection wave signal data obtained from the pulse radar and frequency shift detection data obtained from the doppler radar; and a computing device for checking the depth of an underground cavity from the pulse reflection wave signal data collected while lowering the radar device in a pulse radar mode state, and monitoring a requester in the underground cavity through the frequency shift detection data obtained from the doppler radar after switching the radar device to the doppler radar mode state in a state where the radar device is raised and positioned at the depth of the underground cavity. According to the present invention, even if the buried people do not penetrate the through-hole through drilling into the space where the buried people will survive, radar equipment is inserted into the borehole around the buried person space to check whether the buried people survive.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고심도 매몰자 탐지용 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 고심도 매몰자 탐지용 파이프형 레이더 시스템은 펄스 레이더와 도플러 레이더를 포함하는 레이더 장치, 레이더 장치를 시추공에서 상승 또는 하강시키는 윈치 장치, 윈치 장치를 구동하여 레이더 장치를 시추공에서 상승 또는 하강시키고, 펄스 레이더에서 획득되는 펄스 반사파 신호 데이터와 도플러 레이더에서 획득되는 주파수 변이 감지 데이터를 수집하는 지상 통제 장치, 및 펄스 레이더 모드 상태에서 상기 레이더 장치를 하강시키면서 수집되는 펄스 반사파 신호 데이터로부터 지하공동의 심도를 확인하고, 레이더 장치를 상승시켜 지하공동의 심도에 위치시킨 상태에서 레이더 장치를 도플러 레이더 모드 상태로 전환한 후 도플러 레이더에서 획득되는 주파수 변이 감지 데이터를 통해 지하공동에서 요구조자를 모니터링하는 컴퓨팅 장치를 포함한다. 본 발명에 매몰자들이 생존해 있을 공간으로 시추를 통해 관통공을 관통하지 않더라도 매몰자 공간 주변의 시추공에 레이더 장비를 투입하여 생존여부를 확인할 수 있다.

title_en: Rf coil with integrated vital signs detector
abstract_en: It is an object of the invention to provide a radio frequency (RF) transmit- receive coil (1) for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system with an integrated vital signs detector (3) for the detection of vital signs of a patient within the magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, whereby contact sensors directly attached to the body of the patient, are replaced by a contactless system for monitoring vital signs, which makes it much easier to measure vital signs of the patient. The object is achieved by a RF transmit-receive coil (1) comprising a vital signs detector (3) wherein the vital signs detector (3) is integrated in the RF transmit-receive coil (1), wherein a pair of electrically conducting coil elements (4) of the RF transmit-receive coil (1) forms the vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is a capacitive vital signs detector (3), the capacitive vital signs detector (3) being adapted for receiving capacitive vital signs signals. The present invention also concerns a system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a method for operating the system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a software package for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system and a software package for upgrading a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system.

title_en: Non-contact sensing of vital signs
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed for non-contact sensing of vital signs. An example electronic device to measure vital signs includes a camera to capture an image; a radar antenna to transmit and receive radar signals; and processing circuitry to: identify a subject in the image; identify a location of the subject in an environment; control the radar antenna to steer the radar signals toward the location; and determine a vital sign of the subject based on a reflected radar signal.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining defects in dielectric materials and detecting subsurface objects
abstract_en: An apparatus travels within a 3-dimensional space collecting data that may be used to expose defects in structures and objects beneath the ground surface. In a preferred embodiment, the apparatus includes an unmanned aerial vehicle controlled by a user. The apparatus carries LIDAR and ground penetrating radar and correlates data received from both to facilitate displaying a map with data superimposed on it representing locations of defects in structures and buried objects.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Automated health check device and methods
abstract_en: An automated health check device and methods, the device comprising: at least one imaging sensor configured for capturing at least one image of at least an area confined by a window of the vehicle; at least one vital signs sensor configured for measuring a health parameter of a passenger at the area confined by the window; and at least one processor configured for: acquiring and analyzing the at least one image to determine location of the window; determining based on the determined location of the window a location of the passenger; determining the at least one vital signs sensor being oriented to a predetermined point of view in relation to the location of the passenger determined; and obtaining a measurement of the health parameter of the passenger from the at least one vital signs sensor.

title_en: Fmcw radar target detection method for vital signal detection
abstract_en: There is provided an FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection. A method for detecting vital signals by using radar selects a range bin where there are accurate vital signals by using a correlation between a phase change profile of an IF signal caused by a minute motion, and a target signal intensity change profile, so that accuracy of estimation of vital signals can be enhanced through exact tracking of a person (target). In addition, clutter may be exactly removed by utilizing a phase unwrapping technique which is adaptive to an upper body motion change compared to a 180-degree fixed phase unwrapping technique.

title_en: Method and system for validating optimal body sensor placement
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system comprising a monitoring patch configured to be adhesively attached to skin of an associated patient, the monitoring patch including at least one vital sign sensor arranged to measure vital sign data of the associated patient when the monitoring patch is adhesively attached to the skin of the associated patient. The monitoring patch includes a wireless transceiver or transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit the vital sign data, a monitoring device configured to receive the wirelessly transmitted vital sign data and to store, retransmit, or both store and retransmit the vital sign data, a skin condition sensor configured to measure skin measurement data on the skin of the associated patient, and at least one hardware processor configured to analyze the skin measurement data to determine advice on adhesive attachment of the monitoring patch to the skin and output the advice on the monitoring patch or the monitoring device.

title_en: Device and method for assessing, predicting and operating user's health in real time
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards a medical device for assessing, and predicting and operating the user's health by capturing the user's vital signs in real time. The medical device comprises a plurality of electrodes and a plurality of sensors positioned on various finger sheaths, wrist portions, and hand portions. The various finger sheaths, the wrist portions, and the hand portions are configured to allow the plurality of electrodes to detect a plurality of electrical potentials on different surfaces of a user's body parts and the plurality of sensors to collect vital signs on different surfaces of a user's body parts, at least one processing device configured to contact with the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors, the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors configured to transmit the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs from the different surfaces of the user's body parts to the processing device. The processing device configured to store the plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs and process the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs to assess a user's health and an end user device configured to receive the plurality of processed electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs form the processing device through a network.

title_en: Vital sign sensing device
abstract_en: Vital sign sensing device includes a housing adapted to support a hand of a user and sensors adapted to detect vital signs of the user. The sensor device includes an arithmetic processor adapted to receive the electrical signal, manipulate the signal, and generate an electrical signal representative of the vital signs. The vital sign sensing device can be incorporated into various structures and equipment, such as, an armrest or seating device, a stretcher, or a kiosk.

title_en: A buried object locating and tracing method and system employing principal components analysis for blind signal detection
abstract_en: A blind locating system for finding and tracing buried objects such as utility lines, conductive pipes and sondes. A sensor array is coupled to a signal processor, which determines a field vector for one or more buried objects by producing a data signal representing a covariance matrix corresponding to the covariances of the time-varying sensor array signals over a selected frequency band and accumulation interval. The covariance matrix is characterized by eigenvalues and associated eigenvectors and a user interface (UI) indicates the field vector associated with the eigenvector having the largest eigenvalue. Using several different frequency bands, a plurality of underground objects may be simultaneously detected and indicated in the UI without foreknowledge of their existence or characteristics.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign detection method based on improved robust adaptive beam forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign detection method based on improved robust self-adaptive beam forming, which comprises the following steps: acquiring radar receiving signals, and estimating the angles of the human bodies and the angle intervals occupied by the human bodies by adopting a direction-of-arrival estimation algorithm; one human body echo is made to be a desired signal, the other human bodies are made to be interference signals, and an improved epsilon constraint value-based method is adopted to reconstruct a covariance matrix; reconstructing a steering vector of the expected signal direction by adopting an improved method based on a zeta constraint value; obtaining a weight value by utilizing an adaptive beam forming algorithm; the method of the maximum signal-to-noise ratio search is adopted to obtain ideal weight and respiratory signals; repeating the steps to obtain all human respiratory signals. The method improves the robust beam forming algorithm from the scene of vital sign detection, and the improved robust self-adaptive beam forming method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance and can accurately extract vital sign signals of each human body.

title_en: Buried ground disaster monitoring device capable of guaranteeing timely response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried type ground disaster monitoring device capable of guaranteeing timely reaction, which comprises a mounting plate, a storage battery body, a data receiving and sending device, a central processing unit and a double-shaft driving device, wherein a buried pipe is welded on the lower side of an opening in the middle of the mounting plate, a supporting pipe is mounted on the upper side of the opening in the middle of the mounting plate through a bolt, a photovoltaic plate body is mounted on the inner side of the mounting frame, the storage battery body is arranged on the inner side wall of the lower end of the supporting pipe, a microseismic sensor is arranged below the central processing unit, the double-shaft driving device is mounted inside the upper end of the mounting frame through a bolt, and a movable frame is connected to the outer side of the upper end of the mounting frame in a clamping manner. This can guarantee to react bury formula ground disaster monitoring device in time has solved the photovoltaic board clearance problem, guarantees the cleanliness factor of photovoltaic board, makes the photovoltaic board be in good operating condition, guarantees battery power storage, ensures that equipment is in charged state all the time, can real-time supervision.

title_en: Gully type debris flow monitoring and early warning method based on multiple sensors
abstract_en: The invention provides a gully-type debris flow monitoring and early warning method based on a multi-element sensor, which comprises a debris flow monitoring station, wherein the debris flow monitoring station consists of a sensor sensing system, a data acquisition and transmission system and a power supply and energy storage system, the debris flow monitoring station is arranged in a debris flow monitoring area, the debris flow monitoring station is provided with an upright post, the bottom end of the upright post is provided with a debris flow detection station foundation, the debris flow detection station foundation is buried in the debris flow monitoring area, the rear side middle part of the upright post is provided with a back water surface fluid viscometer, the upper left part of the upright post is provided with a data acquisition and transmission system, and the debris flow area monitored by the upright post is internally provided with a warning water level and a perennial water level. According to the invention, the sensor data and the camera shooting data information connected with the debris flow monitoring station are synchronously transmitted back to the background database, so that the data accumulation and the mastering of the site situation are realized, the dynamic monitoring and early warning of the occurrence of the debris flow can be realized, and the monitoring reliability is improved.

title_en: Small emergency first-aid machine with remote video consultation function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a small emergency first-aid machine with a remote video consultation function. The system comprises a pavement detection unit, an information acquisition unit, a vital sign monitoring unit, a video consultation unit, a remote video module and a response scheduling unit, wherein the pavement detection unit is used for monitoring pavement conditions in real time based on a pavement detection sensor module and ensuring that a patient obtains emergency rescue in the shortest time, the information acquisition unit is used for recording and managing personal information and symptom description of the patient based on an information management module, the vital sign monitoring unit is used for monitoring and analyzing vital signs of the patient by applying an anomaly detection algorithm based on data acquired by the information acquisition unit, the video consultation unit is used for establishing video connection with a remote doctor by the remote video module based on the analysis result of the vital sign monitoring unit and performing consultation on the patient, and the response scheduling unit is used for performing emergency treatment on the patient based on the consultation result of the video consultation unit and planning subsequent medical treatment. The professional guidance of a remote doctor is obtained through video consultation, and the emergency treatment quality is improved.

title_en: Non-contact self-injection-locked vital sign sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact self-injection-locked vital sign sensor is disclosed, which includes transmitting antenna, receiving antenna, self-injection-locked integrated circuit and demodulator. The self-injection-locked integrated circuit includes voltage-controlled oscillator, mixer, two amplifiers and harmonic-frequency power combiner. A frequency-multiplied signal is produced by amplifiers and harmonic-frequency power combiner then transmitted to a living body by transmitting antenna. A frequency-divided signal is produced by voltage-controlled oscillator and mixer then transmitted to voltage-controlled oscillator, then a frequency- and amplitude-modulated signal is produced by the voltage-controlled oscillator then transmitted to demodulator to produce a vital sign. So as to detect vital sign with a higher frequency to increase measurement sensitivity by using a low-cost integrated circuit process. A centrifugal compressor includes a volute base block, a volute cover plate, an impeller, a diffuser-adjusting assembly, a radial constraint assembly, an axial constraint assembly and a driving assembly.

title_en: Target detection method for ground-penetrating radar and associated radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting at least one target buried in an area of the ground, using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a measurement of a signal transmitted by each transmitting antenna and reflected in the area of the ground, converting an estimate, into the frequency domain, of the propagation channel for each pair consisting of a transmitting antenna and of a receiving antenna, defining a first hypothesis H0 corresponding to an absence of target in the area of the ground, defining a second hypothesis H1 corresponding to the presence of at least one target in the area of the ground, performing a test of the likelihood ratio between the likelihood of the channel matrix under the second hypothesis H1 and the likelihood of the channel matrix under the first hypothesis H0, in order to conclude whether a target is present at a given position in the area of the ground.

title_en: Ultra-wideband through-wall radar detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra wide band through-wall radar detection system belongs to radar detection technical field for solve present radar detection result and show technical problem such as disguised inadequately, this detection system specifically includes the ultra wide band through-wall radar, still include with the glasses terminal that the ultra wide band through-wall radar communication links to each other, be used for right the detection result of ultra wide band through-wall radar shows. The utility model discloses an ultra wide band through-wall radar detection system has advantages such as simple structure, flexibility height, disguise are strong.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal gas stratum landslide body monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a monitoring device for a landslide body of a coal gas stratum, which comprises the following components: the device comprises an inclinometer catheter, a sensor probe, a bearing cable, a reader and a probe pulley block; the inclinometer is characterized in that the inclinometer conduit is buried in a coal gas stratum landslide body, the top of the inclinometer conduit is provided with a fixed pulley block, one end of a bearing cable is connected with the top end of the sensor probe, and the other end of the bearing cable is connected with the reader; the bearing cable is fixed at the top of the inclinometry conduit through a fixed pulley block. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the monitoring data is transmitted and stored to the reader through the bearing cable, the data is tidied and analyzed in time, the deep displacement and deformation trend of the landslide can be intuitively and accurately judged, reliable and real basic data is provided for engineering design and construction, the monitoring effect on the landslide body of the coal gas stratum is good, and the monitoring device is simple to operate and convenient to use.
assignees: HANGZHOU INSTITUTE OF TRANSP PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Non-excavation detection electromagnetic device of direct-buried heat supply pipeline based on geomagnetic feedback data collection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a direct-buried heat supply pipeline non-excavation detection electromagnetic device based on geomagnetic feedback data collection, which comprises a shell, a cover plate, a fixing ring, a mounting block, a movable rod, a limiting block and a cesium magnetic sensor matrix, wherein a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the front end of the shell, the fixing plate is connected with the front end of the shell, the movable handle is connected with the upper side of the inner part of the shell, the cover plate is arranged on the inner side of a disassembly structure, the right side of the rear end of the cover plate is provided with the 64-bit heat sensor, the fixing ring is arranged on the left side of the rear end of the cover plate, the mounting block is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the fixing ring, the outer side of the middle part of the mounting block is connected with the movable rod, the inner side of the movable rod is connected with the limiting block, and the inner side of the limiting block is connected with the cesium magnetic sensor matrix. This non-excavation of direct-burried heat supply pipeline detects electromagnetic means based on earth magnetism feedback data collection conveniently carries detection electromagnetic means, conveniently changes phased array scanning radar cesium magnetic sensor, and conveniently collects earth magnetism feedback data.
assignees: TIANJIN HENGTAI PERCEPTION PRECISION MEASUREMENT TECH CO LTD;TIANJIN JINAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multidimensional radar life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-dimensional radar life detection device, which belongs to the field of multi-dimensional radar life detection and comprises a detection equipment protection box body, wherein a radar life detection equipment placing plate is embedded in the detection equipment protection box body, a first accommodating groove, a second accommodating groove and a handheld detection equipment placing groove are formed in the radar life detection equipment placing plate, and a group of detection equipment limiting assemblies are arranged in the handheld detection equipment placing groove. According to the multi-dimensional radar life detection device, the limit plate can be matched with the rubber ring to elastically clamp the handheld radar detection equipment body through elastic reset of the compression spring, so that the limit plate is stably positioned in the handheld detection equipment placing groove, the risk of moving or collision in the transportation and transportation process is reduced, and the handheld radar detection equipment body can be surrounded and protected through the sponge arranged in the handheld detection equipment placing groove and the foam ball head positioned in the protection box cover.

title_en: Emergency communication system based on intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication system based on an intelligent terminal. The emergency communication system based on the intelligent terminal comprises the intelligent terminal which supports wireless transmission technology such as Bluetooth, wireless fidelity (WIFI), Zigbee or amateur radio, and software which runs on the terminals and supports an offline end-to-end communication mode, so that certain communication capacity can be kept under the condition that cellular mobile communication network infrastructure is seriously damaged, and rescue and relief work is convenient. By the adoption of the scheme, when traditional communication network does not work due to various natural disasters such as an earthquake, an end-to-end communication direct connection mode can be adopted, and a certain distance communication can be conducted when the network infrastructure is removed, so that a trapped person who is buried under ruins knows a position and a state by making a call and rescue and relief work is quite beneficial. Therefore, the emergency communication system based on the intelligent terminal has high economic value and social benefits.

title_en: Multi-target tracking method after through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multi-target tracking method after through-wall radar imaging, the rapid imaging can be achieved in a certain error, and a high quality imaging result can be obtained. According to the target targeting algorithm based on two-dimensional low-pass filtering and image etching, measurement position information and amplitude information can be effectively extracted, and finally a nearest area data association algorithm is used to carry out target tracking. At the same time, according to an interacting multiple model tracking algorithm, the high mobility of the target is fully considered, and the target tracking accuracy is high.

title_en: Beidou positioning system-based monitoring system and monitoring method for deep foundation pit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and a monitoring method for a deep foundation pit based on a Beidou positioning system, wherein the monitoring system comprises displacement sensors, a Beidou navigation positioning base station, a monitoring controller, terminal data processing equipment, data storage equipment and Internet of things transmission equipment, the displacement sensors are pre-buried in monitoring positions of the foundation pit through grid layout, and are interconnected and intercommunicated, crossed and fused, so that the distance change among the displacement sensors is measured in real time; the detection distance change is transmitted to a monitoring controller in real time through a base station, and the deformation condition of the deep foundation pit is judged after the detection distance change is analyzed by the monitoring controller; the data terminal processing equipment can correct errors of the monitored data through a differential technology, real-time monitoring of the deep foundation pit is achieved, the phenomenon of deformation of the deep foundation pit can be truly reflected through data processing and error correction, monitoring precision is improved, whether the displacement deformation of the deep foundation pit is within a safety range or not is judged, accidents can be effectively prevented through advanced early warning, and casualties, equipment damage and influences on safety of surrounding buildings due to sudden collapse and instability of the foundation pit are avoided.
