title_en: Reservoir landslide array type underwater deformation monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir landslide array type underwater deformation monitoring device and a monitoring method.A anchorage is buried at an underwater monitoring point of a sliding body, and a floating shell is used for floating on the water surface; the GPS sensor is used for receiving and transmitting GPS signals to obtain the real-time position of the floating shell, the water temperature sensor is used for obtaining a water temperature time sequence, and the gravity wave meter is used for obtaining a water surface wave height time sequence; the upper end of the pull rope is fixedly connected with the floating shell through the displacement compensation mechanism, the lower end of the pull rope is fixedly connected with the anchorage, the displacement compensation mechanism is used for displacement compensation after the floating shell floats with waves, and the coding type displacement meter is used for measuring the real-time distance between the coding type displacement meter and the anchorage. The technical scheme provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the real-time three-dimensional coordinates of the underwater monitoring points are monitored by the buoy type monitor, and the underwater three-dimensional space coordinate change of the landslide body can be accurately positioned. Recording relevant environmental factors in real time, and integrating the functions of real-time information acquisition, storage, processing analysis, transmission and the like.

title_en: Device and method for bio-signal measurement
title_ko: 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 생체신호 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio-signal measuring device using glasses. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal measuring device comprises: at least one mounting unit which can be mounted in glasses; a sensor unit including a bio-signal sensor unit which measures a bio-signal of a user wearing the glasses; a signal processing unit configured to convert at least the bio-signal to output the bio-information; and a communication unit configured to transmit the bio-information to the outside. Therefore, the bio-signal measuring device is conveniently mounted in various types of glasses to be universally used.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안경을 이용한 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시예에 의한 생체신호 측정장치는 안경에 장착될 수 있는 하나 이상의 장착부를 포함하며, 상기 안경을 착용한 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서부를 포함한 센서부와, 적어도 상기 생체신호를 변환하여 생체정보를 출력하는 신호 처리부와, 상기 생체정보를 외부로 전송하는 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Meditation chair and booth being individually optimized according to user mental and physical condition
title_ko: 사용자의 정신적, 신체적 상태에 따라 개인 최적화되는 명상 의자 및 부스
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to enable anyone to easily meditate by transforming a chair or creating a meditation environment according to a user's mental and physical state. The weight and pressure sensor, bio-signal detection sensor, air bag cushion, drive unit are set up in the pelvis, buttocks, thigh, knee supporting part and the optimized meditation posture is provided according to the state of the user, and the bio-signal can be measured and the size and position of the supporting part can be controlled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 사용자의 정신적, 신체적 상태에 따라 개인 최적화되는 명상 의자에 있어서, 상기 사용자의 골반을 지지하도록 구성된 골반 지지부; 상기 사용자의 둔부를 지지하도록 구성된 둔부 지지부; 상기 사용자의 허벅지를 지지하도록 구성된 허벅지 지지부; 상기 사용자의 무릎을 지지하도록 구성된 무릎 지지부; 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 설치된 위치에서 상기 사용자의 무게 및 압력을 측정하도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 무게 감지 센서 및 압력 센서; 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 설치된 위치에서 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 생체 신호 감지 센서 - 상기 적어도 하나의 생체 신호 감지 센서는 심전도를 측정하도록 구성된 ECG 센서, 광용적맥파를 측정하도록 구성된 PPG 센서 및 피부 전도율을 측정하도록 구성된 GSR 센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함함 -; 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나의 크기를 조절하기 위해 에어 펌프에 의해 수축 또는 팽창하도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 에어백 쿠션; 및 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나의 위치를 이동시키도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 구동 장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Target detection method for ground-penetrating radar and associated radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting at least one target buried in an area of the ground, using ground-penetrating radar, the method comprising the steps of: - acquiring (201) a measurement of a signal transmitted by each transmission antenna and reflected in the area of the ground; - determining (202) an estimate, in the frequency domain, of the propagation channel for each pair consisting of a transmission antenna and a reception antenna; - defining a first hypothesis H0 corresponding to the absence of a target in the area of the ground; - defining a second hypothesis H1 corresponding to the presence of at least one target in the area of the ground; - performing (203) a test of the likelihood ratio between the likelihood of the channel matrix under the second hypothesis H1 and the likelihood of the channel matrix under the first hypothesis H0, in order to conclude that a target is present at a given position in the area of the ground.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Method for detecting adjacent multi-target vital sign of millimeter wave MIMO radar under clutter background
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting adjacent multi-target vital signs of a millimeter wave MIMO radar under clutter background, which belongs to the field of vital sign detection and comprises the following steps of: transmitting a plurality of chirp signals modulated with space-time block codes; the receiving end: a. mixing echo signals of all receiving antennas with reference modulation signals, extracting recombination and space-time decoupling to obtain arrayed signals; performing distance azimuth two-dimensional smoothing and spatial spectrum estimation on the arrayed signals to locate adjacent human targets; b. extracting phase difference value sequences corresponding to the human body target and the clutter scattering points to construct vital sign signals and clutter scattering point phase signals corresponding to the human body target; c. and carrying out variation constraint multi-mode decomposition on the detected vital sign signals and clutter scattering point phase signals to obtain vital sign parameters. The invention can separate adjacent human targets under clutter background, and the separated vital sign signals have obvious periodicity, smooth waveform and high parameter estimation precision.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the steps of transmitting a linear frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW, mixing echo signals to obtain original data, forming the original data into a first matrix containing a fast time dimension and a slow time dimension, carrying out one-dimensional fast Fourier transform on the first matrix to obtain a corresponding second matrix, carrying out stationary filtering operation on the second matrix to obtain a fourth matrix, carrying out unwrapping operation on a distance unit for judging the existence of a human body target on the fourth matrix, judging vital signs of the human body target from unwrapped phase signals, extracting corresponding chest wall displacement signals from the distance unit of the human body target with the vital signs, and reconstructing chest wall displacement-time signals to obtain accurate vital signs of the human body target. Compared with the prior art, the invention improves the accuracy of monitoring the heart rate and the respiration of the human body, and well reduces the calculated amount in the detection process so as to improve the capability of quick response.

title_en: Vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distance angle energy array based on a radar data frame of a region to be detected received by a radar receiving antenna and a guiding vector of the radar receiving antenna; the method comprises the steps of acquiring an accumulated radar frame set corresponding to a radar receiving antenna, wherein a plurality of radar data frames which are accumulated and received by the radar receiving antenna are stored in the accumulated radar frame set; performing peak characteristic analysis on the distance angle energy array to obtain a micro-motion analysis result corresponding to the region to be detected; trend analysis is carried out on the accumulated radar frame set to obtain a trend analysis result corresponding to the region to be detected; and determining a vital sign detection result corresponding to the region to be detected by combining the micro-motion analysis result and the trend analysis result. The method can effectively save storage resources and computing resources, and simultaneously accurately sense vital sign information in the region to be detected by combining micro analysis and trend analysis.

title_en: Telemetry apparatus, system, and method for animal experiment
title_ko: 실험용 동물의 생체 신호 획득 장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 자기장을 이용하여 무선 전력을 전달하여 실험용 동물에 장착된 센서를 동작시키고, 센서에 의해 검출된 신호를 자기장 통신을 통해 데이터 분석 시스템으로 전달한다. 본 발명에 따른 실험용 동물로부터 생체 신호를 획득하는 장치는, 송수신 안테나; 외부의 무선 전력전송 장치로부터 상기 송수신 안테나를 통해 전달되는 전력을 변환하는 전력 제어부; 상기 전력 제어부로부터 공급되는 전력을 이용하여 동작하며 실험용 동물의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서; 상기 센서와 연결되어 있으며, 상기 센서에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 송수신 안테나를 이용하여 외부 장치와 통신을 수행하는 무선 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Human rescue control system using radar human body detection sensor installed in a building
title_ko: 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 특히 건물의 각 방에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용하여, 화재발생시 각 방에 사람이 있는 지를 검출하여 응급구조센터로 발송하고, 응급구조센터에서 현장의 소방관에게 정보를 송출하여 효과적인 인물구출이 가능하도록 구현된 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지 센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.   종래에는 다급한 화재현장에서 어디에 구조할 인명이 있는 지 확인할 수 있는 방법이 없었는데, 본 발명은 건물의 룸 넘버(room number)와 룸 내부에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서에서 감지되는 생체신호를 포함하는 현장데이터를 전달받는 서버와, 서버의 통신모듈을 통해 현장데이터를 수신하는 응급구조센터를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 서버는 화재감지장치를 통해 실제 화재가 발생한 것으로 비상신호가 전달된 경우 레이더 인체감지센서를 작동시키고, 이용자DB에서 룸 거주자의 인적사항을 포함하는 인명정보를 획득하며, 건물DB에서 건물의 룸 및 통로의 배치도를 포함하는 진입정보를 획득하여 응급구조센터를 통해 현장지휘센터를 전달하며, 상기 현장지휘센터에서는 현장데이터와, 룸 거주자의 인명정보와, 룸 및 통로의 배치도를 포함하는 진입정보에 의해 화재현장 진입통로를 결정하고 소방관을 지휘하여 인명구출을 위한 구출동선을 확보하는 것을 특징으로 하는 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템을 제안한다. 따라서 본 발명에 의한 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지 센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템은 건물의 각 방에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용하여, 각 방에 사람이 있는 지를 명확하게 확인할 수 있으므로, 화재시 효율적인 인명 구출이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 이용자DB 또는 건물DB를 적용하여, 소방관이 구출하고자 하는 인명의 성별 및 나이를 확인하고, 구출 동선을 효율적으로 기획할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring vital sign based on coherency between magnitude and phase
title_ko: 크기와 위상 사이의 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 크기와 위상 사이의 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 방법에 있어서, 레이더를 통해 반사된 신호를 수신하는 단계; 반사된 신호에 기초하여 크기 신호와 위상 신호를 결정하는 단계; 크기 신호와 위상 신호 사이의 코히어런시를 결정하는 단계; 및 코히어런시에 기초하여 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후가 존재하는 범위 빈에서는 크기 및 위상의 변동이 높은 상관 관계가 있다는 수학적 모델과 실험적 관찰을 기반으로 각 범위 빈에서 크기와 위상 간의 코히어런시를 정량화하는 크기 위상 코히어런시 지수를 활용함으로써, 가장 높은 지수 값을 가지는 범위 빈이 선택된다면, 종래의 방법들에 비하여 더욱 정확한 활력 징후가 측정될 수 있다.

title_en: Method and System for GPR Investigating on the basis of LiDAR and Positioning Information
title_ko: 라이다 센서와 위치정보에 기반한 ｇｐｒ 지중탐사장치 및 그 지중탐사방법
abstract_en: A GPR underground surveying apparatus based on LiDAR and location information and an underground surveying method thereof are disclosed. The GPR underground surveying apparatus of the present invention displays the location of a measurement point where an underground image was taken using GPS coordinates generated by a GPS sensor, and when accurate map coordinates are calculated using a LiDAR module, correct the GPS coordinates to map coordinates. In addition, the GPR underground surveying apparatus can create a map of buried objects by displaying discovered underground objects in the form of nodes and branches on a digital map. To achieve the above, the GPR underground surveying apparatus comprises a GPS sensor, a GPR sensor, a warning lamp, an underground search module, a data processing module, and a map generation module.
abstract_ko: 라이다(LiDAR)와 위치정보에 기반한 GPR 지중탐사장치 및 그 지중탐사방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 GPR 지중탐사장치는 지중영상을 촬영한 측정점의 위치를 GPS 센서가 생성하는 GPS 좌표를 이용하여 표시하되, 라이다 모듈을 이용해 정확한 지도상 좌표가 계산되면 GPS 좌표를 지도상 좌표로 보정할 수 있다. 또한, GPR 지중탐사장치는 탐색한 지중매설물을 디지털 지도상에 노드와 가지의 형태로 표시하여 매설물 지도를 만들 수 있다.

title_en: Life detection intelligent carriage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of life detection intelligent carriage.Life detection intelligent carriage of the present utility model includes：One-chip computer module, motor drive module, independent current source module, infrared obstacle avoidance module, human body induction module, GPS module and gsm module.The utility model has the advantages that the intelligent carriage with life detection function, it is contemplated that the complexity of application environment, configure various types of sensors and communication module etc. and be used to monitor car body local environment in real time, obtain effective information, it is very big to lift rescue efficiency；Dolly, which can enter in narrow and small complex environment, searches for survivor, unnecessary injury caused by avoiding the non-intellectual of environment possible to rescuer；Vehicle body is light simultaneously, small volume, and motion is flexible, and power consumption is low, can be used for a long time in complex environment, solves the problems, such as that mankind's activity is limited.

title_en: Printing solvent storage room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printing solvent storage room, which is divided into a storage area and a filling area by a fire-fighting roller shutter door, wherein a solvent taking platform of the filling area is provided with an electromagnetic explosion-proof valve, and a solvent storage tank of the storage area supplies solvent to the electromagnetic explosion-proof valve through a buried conduit and a solvent pump; a lifting fire-fighting hood is arranged above the solvent taking platform, sealing grooves which are correspondingly nested with hood openings at the bottom of the fire-fighting hood are arranged around the solvent taking platform, a hood body of the fire-fighting hood is of a hollow interlayer structure, and a dry powder automatic fire extinguisher and a temperature sensor are hung at the top of an inner cavity of the fire-fighting hood; the filling area is provided with a combustible gas concentration detection alarm device and a fire automatic alarm system, and a fire alarm controller is in communication connection with a lifting mechanism of the fire control cover; the explosion-proof ventilation mechanism is in communication connection with the combustible gas concentration detection alarm device. Effectively improves the safety of the storage and the matching of the printing solvent, thoroughly avoids the occurrence of casualty accidents, and effectively reduces the accident loss.
assignees: LIUYANG YUANYOU PRINTING PACKING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting safety helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control intelligent safety helmet, including the cap body, extension subassembly and monitoring subassembly, the downside the place ahead external fixation of the cap body has the brim of a hat, and the upside of the brim of a hat installs and is used for monitoring subassembly for the extension cap body protects the position extension unit mount in the rear side below of the cap body, and the extension subassembly includes equipment board, locking bolt and backplate, equipment board and the cap body are fixed connection, and the backplate is installed to the below of equipment board, and is connected through the locking bolt between backplate and the equipment board for monitor vital sign the monitoring subassembly sets up in the rear side below of equipment board. This fire control intelligent security cap is convenient for carry out video acquisition to user's route through the camera to can carry out network video transmission through 4G 5G, can also carry out personnel's location to the user through gps orientation module, can pass through blood oxygen sensor real-time supervision user's rhythm of the heart and oxyhemoglobin saturation moreover, functional preferred.
assignees: BEIJING WEIYIN ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method. According to the life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method, a life detection radar is adopted to perform detection on a plurality of detection points; the position of a live body is solved based on multiple-detection point criterions; the position of the live body is determined repeatedly through adopting the K-nearest neighbor principle; and therefore, the locating accuracy and detection probability of the spatial position of the live body can be improved. The life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method has the advantages of large detection area, low hardware cost and easiness in implementation in practical application.

title_en: In-vehicle vital sign monitoring and protecting system and method and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for monitoring and protecting vital signs in a vehicle, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the monitoring unit is used for monitoring the environment in the vehicle and the characteristics of the left living body; the vehicle-mounted host is used for calculating signals identified by the relevant sensors and sending out relevant instructions; a communication unit for transmitting MSD information; the alarm unit is used for reminding people around the vehicle; the active rescue unit is used for relieving adverse conditions of people in the vehicle; the recognition speed is ensured, and meanwhile, the recognition precision is increased; meanwhile, the active rescue function is equipped, when the temperature in the vehicle does not reach the dangerous degree, the safety of the vital signs in the vehicle can be guaranteed without extra rescuers arriving at the site, when the temperature in the vehicle is too high, the safety of the vital signs in the vehicle can be guaranteed through the third-party rescue mode, the boarding rate of the third-party rescue mode is reduced, and the rescue cost is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHONGRUN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted multichannel biological radar respiratory signal measurement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted multichannel biological radar respiratory signal measurement method which comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional radar image sequence of respiratory signals, carrying out threshold detection on each frame of three-dimensional radar image sequence, converting voxel data in each frame of three-dimensional radar image sequence into a three-dimensional radar point cloud sequence, registering the three-dimensional radar point cloud sequence, carrying out continuous radar imaging on the registered three-dimensional radar point cloud sequence to obtain a human body target area, extracting phase values in the voxel data of the human body target area to obtain physiological micro-motion signals, and carrying out signal separation on the physiological micro-motion signals to obtain respiratory signal waveforms. The invention solves the problem of inaccurate detection of the non-contact respiratory vital sign signal measurement technology under the condition of platform movement interference in the prior art.

title_en: Hemodialysis patient intelligent monitoring system, method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring system, an intelligent monitoring method and electronic equipment based on hemodialysis patients, which are suitable for a hospital and community dialysis center scene. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, an AI analysis module and a feedback and decision module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring vital sign evaluation anxiety/pain grades, the data processing module is used for receiving sensor data and triggering real-time early warning on key indexes, the AI analysis module is used for establishing a patient individuation baseline model, dynamically identifying abnormal modes, carrying out emotion analysis, combining dialysis parameters with real-time data and predicting risks, and the feedback and decision module is used for pushing three-level alarms and providing a visual interface, displaying patient history data and AI inference logic and assisting clinical decisions. According to the invention, vital sign and emotion data of a hemodialysis patient are collected in real time through the wearable equipment, and graded alarm and solution are provided after AI analysis.
assignees: RENMIN HOSPITAL WUHAN UNIV HUBEI GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Biological sign parameter acquisition method, electronic scale and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data processing, and provides a method for acquiring biological sign parameters, an electronic scale and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an infrared imaging image of a user through an infrared camera module and acquiring a corresponding airflow value when the user measures through an airflow sensor; the method comprises the steps of determining output current parameters corresponding to all electrodes on an electronic scale through an infrared imaging image, determining the acquisition frequency of a pressure sensor on the electronic scale through an airflow value, controlling electronic equipment to acquire at least one group of vital sign data of a user based on the output current parameters and the acquisition frequency, and obtaining a vital sign measurement report corresponding to the user according to a plurality of groups of vital sign data. By adopting the method, the accuracy of measuring the biological sign data can be improved.

title_en: Multi-parameter vital sign monitoring and rehabilitation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health care devices, in particular to a multi-parameter vital sign monitoring and health care device. The intelligent radar system comprises a plurality of bearing seats, square shells and at least two negative pressure components, wherein the bearing seats are distributed on different areas of a living room wall body, the square shells are provided with a health care radar body, the at least two negative pressure components are respectively arranged on two sides of adjacent sides of the square shells, and the square shells can be adsorbed on the wall body through the negative pressure components. According to the invention, the health care radar body can monitor the movement of the monitored old people, and when the health care radar body moves towards the monitoring dead angles in the functional areas, the health care radar body can move to the other bearing seat through the matching operation of the two negative pressure assemblies and the walking assembly, so that the monitored old people are positioned in the monitoring range of the health care radar body.
assignees: JIANGSU JIANLAIBANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_ko: 생체 신호 계측 장치
abstract_ko:
생체 신호 계측기(웨어러블 생체 센서)에 내장되어 있는 이차 전지를 전용 충전 단자에 의하지 않고 충전할 수 있도록 한다. 
내부 전원으로서의 전지 및 그 충전 회로(200)와, 생체 신호 계측 시에 인체의 피부면과 접촉하고 전지의 충전 시에는 소정의 급전기(2)에 접속되는 전극(10a, 10b)과, 전극(10a, 10b)에서 검출되는 생체 신호를 소정 처리하는 생체 신호 처리 회로(100)와, 생체 신호·급전 전력 분배 수단(300)을 구비하며, 전극(10a, 10b)에 대하여 생체 신호 처리 회로(100)와 충전 회로(200)가 생체 신호·급전 전력 분배 수단(300)을 통하여 전환 가능하게 접속되어 있고, 전지의 충전 시에는 전극(10a, 10b)을 충전용 단자로서 이용한다.

title_en: Bio-signal measurement system and method using terahertz wave
title_ko: 테라헤르츠파를 이용한 생체신호 측정 시스템 및 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a terahertz wave detection sensor; an imaging unit converting a terahertz wave incident to the terahertz wave detection sensor into an electrical signal and generating an image using the electrical signal; and a bio-signal detection unit detecting a movement of a lung part of a human body in the image generated by the imaging unit to detect a respiration rate of the human body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 테라헤르츠파 검출 센서; 상기 테라헤르츠파 검출 센서로 입사된 테라헤르츠파를 전기 신호로 변환하고, 상기 전기 신호를 이용하여 이미지를 생성하는 이미징부; 및 상기 이미징부가 생성한 이미지에서 인체의 폐 부분의 움직임을 검출하여 인체의 호흡수를 검출하는 생체신호 검출부;를 포함하는 것을 일 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Stress and burn-out analysis and diagnostic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an analysis and diagnostic device (1) for detecting stress and/or burn-out syndrome in a test person. According to the invention, the device comprises at least one sensor (2) detecting vital signs of the test person and transferring said vital signs to a memory unit, a voltage supply, and an evaluating unit connected to a memory unit. By means of the evaluating unit a time-resolved course of the vital signs detected by the at least one sensor (2) can be evaluated, and a comparator diagnosing stress and/or burn-out syndrome by means of a comparison of the time-resolved course of the detected vital signs with time-resolved stress and burn-out vital patterns stored in a data base is provided in the evaluating unit.

title_en: Data analysis device, search system, data analysis method, and program
abstract_en: An objective of the present disclosure is to grasp the accurate state of a buried object or a hollow and identify the position thereof without limitation on location.　Accordingly, a data analysis device 9 performs image data matching between first image data A1, which pertains to a first specified surface associated with radar search data A2 related to the first specified surface, and second image data B1, which pertains to a second specified surface adjacent to the first specified surface and associated with radar search data B2 related to the second specified surface, and composites the two pieces of radar search data to generate composite search data AB2. The data analysis device 9 performs image data matching between each of third image data pertaining to a specific surface 51 and fourth image data pertaining to a specific surface 52, the third image data and the fourth image data being acquired from a ground control-point measurement device 6, and specific image data that is at least one of the first image data or the second image data and includes the specific surface 51 and the specific surface 52, and performs calibration of an absolute position pertaining to the composite search data AB2 on the basis of individual absolute positions associated with the third image data and the fourth image data.

title_en: All-Direction High-Resolution Subsurface Imaging Using Distributed Moving Transceivers
abstract_en: A subsurface imaging technique using distributed sensors is introduced. Instead of monostatic transceivers employed in conventional ground penetrating radars, the proposed technique utilizes bi-static transceivers to sample the reflected signals from the ground at different positions and create a large two-dimensional aperture for high resolution subsurface imaging. The coherent processing of the samples in the proposed imaging method eliminates the need for large antenna arrays for obtaining high lateral resolution images. In addition, it eliminates the need for sampling on a grid which is a time-consuming task in imaging using ground penetration radar. Imaging results show that the method can provide high-resolution images of the buried targets using only samples of the reflected signals on a circle with the center at the transmitter location.

title_en: A kind of multipaths restraint method of multiple target side wall after through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of multipaths restraint method of multiple target side wall suitable for through-wall radar imaging, and all connected domains are extracted from the original radar image of binary first with 4 connection area detecting methods；Then connected domain vector is obtained to all connection Field Numbers and according to Euclidean distance ascending sort of their average coordinates from radar array center；Then connected domain vector element is reassembled into two subvectors, the two subvectors is extended according to the multi-path transmission paths to radar and direct echo transmission path respectively；Then the similarity matrix of two subvectors is calculated using similarity function；Finally judge all elements of similarity matrix using the method for similarity thresholding and decision rule, obtain the connected domain where real goal and curb multipath decoy.The present invention can be detected hidden multiple target after wall, can effectively be rejected multipath while target is retained.

title_en: Radar-camera fusion disaster tracking system and method for scanning invisible space
title_ko: 비가시공간 투시 레이더-카메라 융합형 재난 추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an invisible space perspective radar-camera fused type disaster tracking system, which comprises: a radar sensor configured to set a plurality of regions of interest having a center angle of 180 degrees to transmit a signal in all directions, and to detect an object to be tracked within the regions of interest based on the signal to set an event zone; a camera unit configured to receive an event zone set by the radar sensor and to track a movement of the object to be tracked located in the event zone based on the event zone; an information processing unit configured to coordinate the detected position of the object to be tracked and to calculate tracking information combining coordinate information of the coordinated object to be tracked and movement information of the object to be tracked collected through the camera unit; and a communication unit configured to share the tracking information calculated by the information processing unit by relaying wired/wireless communication with an external device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 비가시공간 투시 레이더-카메라 융합형 재난 추적 시스템은 중심각이 180도로 형성된 복수의 관심영역을 설정하여 전방위에 신호를 송출하고, 신호를 기초로 관심영역 내부의 추적대상을 감지하여 이벤트 존을 설정하는 레이더 센서; 레이더 센서에서 설정된 이벤트 존을 수신하고, 이를 기초로 이벤트 존에 위치한 추적대상의 움직임을 추적하는 카메라부; 감지된 추적대상의 위치를 좌표화 하여, 좌표화된 추적대상의 좌표 정보와 카메라부를 통해 수집된 추적대상의 움직임 정보를 종합한 트래킹 정보를 산출하는 정보 처리부; 및 외부 장치와 유무선 통신을 중계하여 정보 처리부에서 산출된 트래킹 정보를 공유하는 통신부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for Reduction Random Noise of Radar Gathering Signals in Radar for Measurement of Bio-Signals and Apparatus thereof
title_ko: 생체신호 측정용 레이더에서 레이더 수집신호의 랜덤노이즈 제거방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for reducing random noise from radar-gathering signals in a biometric measurement radar to increase biometric sensing correctness in a noncontact method and a device thereof. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: (a) receiving a signal reflected from a dynamic target and various kinds of n signals generated from the circumference of the dynamic target through n reception antennas; (b) generating Doppler intermediate frequency (IF) signals from the received n signals, respectively; (c) converting a plurality of doppler IF signals into digital data, respectively; (d) forming a digital signal into a data set having symbols at sampling time intervals and converting the data set into a frequency component symbol set of a plurality of indexes; (e) summing the index symbols converted into the frequency component symbol set by each index set to calculate a value divided by the number of n reception antennas; and (f) filtering only a periodical signal generated in common with respect to a value calculated in a calculation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본 발명은 마이크로웨이브 도플러레이더를 이용하여 인체의 생체신호를 획득하는 동안 외부에서 유입되는 각종의 진동노이즈를 효과적으로 감쇄시키고 제거하기 위한 방법과 그 장치에 관한 것으로, (a) IF 신호생성기의 전압제어발진부(VCO)에서 외부에서 인가된 전압(V(t))으로 일정 주기의 발진 주파수를 생성하여 단일의 송신안테나를 통해 동적 타깃의 주요 부위로 송출하고, 상기 동적 타깃에서 반사된 신호와 동적 타깃 주변에서 발생된 각종 신호를 n개의 수신안테나에서 수신하는 단계; (b) 상기 IF 신호생성기는 수신된 n개의 신호에서 각각 도플러 IF 신호를 생성하는 단계; (c) 아날로그/디지털변환기는 상기 IF 신호생성기에서 입력된 복수의 도플러 IF 신호를 각각의 디지털데이터로 변환하는 단계; (d) 상기 아날로그/디지털변환기(20)에서 단위 시간동안 수집된 디지털신호를 고속푸리에변환기에서 샘플링 시간 간격으로 심벌을 갖는 데이터 열로 구성하고, 이 데이터 열을 복수의 인덱스(Index)의 주파수 성분 심벌 열(symbol set)로 전환하는 단계; (e) 상기 신호연산기의 연산부에서 주파수 성분 심벌 열로 전환된 인덱스 심벌들을 각 인덱스 열로 합하여 n개의 수신안테나 수로 나눈 값으로 연산하는 단계; (f) 상기 연산부에서 연산된 값에 대하여 공통적으로 발생하는 주기적인 신호와 공통적이지 않은 비주기적인 신호의 스펙트럼 성분의 편차를 일정 기준의 문턱(Threshold) 값으로 분류하여 주기적인 신호만 필터링하는 단계를 포함하여 이루어진 것이다. 본 발명은 단일의 송신부와 복수의 수신부로 이루어진 생체신호 측정용 도플러레이더를 이용하여 생체신호 영역에 포함되어 있는 랜덤노이즈를 효과적으로 제거함으로써 비접촉식 방식에서 생체신호를 센싱하는 정확도를 개선한 것이다.

title_en: Modularized detection module integrated on fire rescue helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized detection module integrated in a fire-fighting and rescue helmet, in particular to the technical field of fire-fighting and rescue helmets, which comprises a helmet main body and a cape, wherein the cape is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the helmet main body, the top of the helmet main body is provided with the detection module, the detection module comprises a control host, two connecting belts, a thermal imaging detection module, a high-definition camera module, a gas detection module, a vital sign detection module and a positioning module, wherein a protective component is arranged inside the helmet main body. According to the utility model, the self-locking motor works to drive the pair of eye protection glasses to rotate, the position of the pair of eye protection glasses is regulated according to the requirement, the air pump inflates the two piston boxes and the hard tube, and the two piston connecting rods start to move oppositely, so that the two bone conduction type earphones are driven to move into the ears of a user oppositely, the operation is simple, and the use effect is good.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;WUXI CHANGKAICHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detection device, method and system for vital signs
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a device, a method and a system for detecting vital signs, wherein the device comprises: the first calculation unit is used for calculating the phase distribution of the distance FFT signal of the position of the living body along with the change of time according to the reflected signal of the microwave radar in a first preset time range; an unwrapping unit for phase unwrapping the phase distribution; a first determining unit configured to determine all local extreme points of the phase distribution subjected to the phase unwrapping according to a preset time window, the time window being determined according to a cycle range of respiration or heartbeat of a living body; the uniformization unit is used for performing amplitude uniformization processing on the phase distribution between each pair of adjacent local extreme points; and a second calculation unit for calculating the frequency of breathing or heartbeat of the living body based on the phase distribution subjected to the uniformization processing of the amplitude.

title_en: Through-wall perspective method based on neural network associated radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall perspective method based on a neural network associated radar, which comprises the following steps of: the partition wall collects radar detection information of a sample space, converts the radar detection information into a two-dimensional array, and stores the two-dimensional array as sample data; collecting image information of a sample space, converting the image information into binary picture data, and storing the binary picture data as label data; bringing the sample data and the label data into a convolutional neural network to obtain a trained data model; and detecting the space to be detected by using the radar partition wall, obtaining real-time radar detection data of the space to be detected, bringing the real-time radar detection data into a data model, and obtaining an indoor binary image through the data model. And (3) recognizing weak differences among received signals by utilizing the self-learning training capability of the convolutional neural network. So as to distinguish the action postures of the human body after the wall are standing, walking and lying; the placement position of large furniture such as sofas, beds and the like.
assignees: CHENGDU WEIZHI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention provides a MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on a two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor, which comprises the steps of recording echo signals of K frequency points corresponding to an m-th transmitting array element and an n-th receiving array element through an MIMO antenna array element parallel to a wall body, removing background clutter signals in the echo signals by adopting a background cancellation method, calculating a phase coherence factor PCF and a range phase coherence factor RPCF according to phase diversity at a pixel point, calculating a two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor according to the phase coherence factor and the range phase coherence factor, and weighting an FDBP imaging result to obtain a final imaging result; the MIMO through-the-wall radar imaging method provided by the invention can better integrate the advantages of PCF and RPCF, not only can effectively inhibit clutter interference, but also can further improve the resolution of an imaging reconstruction result, and is more beneficial to the detection and imaging of a hidden target behind a wall.

title_en: UWB vital sign signal detection method based on NGO-VMD algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a UWB vital sign signal detection method based on an NGO-VMD algorithm, and relates to the technical field of signal detection. The method comprises the steps of transmitting Gaussian pulse signals through an ultra-wideband radar module and receiving UWB radar echo signals reflected by a target human body so as to monitor vital signs of the target human body, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the UWB radar echo signals to obtain echo signals containing vital signs; processing echo signals containing vital signs through an NGO-VMD algorithm, and decomposing the echo signals to obtain a plurality of modal components; dividing the modal components according to a pre-acquired reference respiratory signal frequency range and a reference heartbeat signal frequency range to obtain a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal. The method realizes the detection of the vital sign signals, overcomes the unsafe of contact detection, can also reduce signal noise interference, and effectively improves the accuracy and timeliness of the extraction of the vital sign signals.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on human factor intelligence and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health medical detection, in particular to a vital sign detection method based on artificial intelligence and related equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring radio frequency reflected signals related to a target object and continuous multi-frame image data; obtaining first characteristic data based on the radio frequency reflection signal; and obtaining second feature data based on the multi-frame image data; performing feature fusion on the first feature data and the second feature data to obtain fusion features; and obtaining vital sign signals of the target object based on the fusion characteristics. In the embodiment of the invention, the vital sign is detected by mixing the millimeter wave radar and the remote photoplethysmography, so that the defect of inaccurate detection result caused by larger environmental factors of the millimeter wave radar in the prior art is overcome.

title_en: Fall alarm method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter radar
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a fall alarm method, a device, equipment and a medium based on millimeter radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving an environment laser point cloud of a preset detection area, receiving a second vital sign detection signal sent by a vital monitoring device, continuously sending millimeter radar to the preset detection area, receiving a first laser point cloud set fed back by human vital signs in the preset detection area within a preset time range, performing human target object point cloud segmentation on the laser point cloud of the human vital signs, determining a motion point cloud track of the human vital signs in the preset detection area, performing motion distortion compensation on the motion point cloud track according to preset motion compensation parameters of the human vital signs, generating a target motion point cloud track, determining vertical acceleration of the human vital signs in the vertical direction, and sending a falling alarm signal if the vertical acceleration is larger than an acceleration threshold. Thereby improving the accuracy of falling alarm and guaranteeing the safety of users.

title_en: Multi-view distributed through-wall radar system based on same-frequency orthogonal signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-view distributed through-wall radar system based on same-frequency orthogonal signals, and relates to the technical field of distributed radar systems. The invention provides a multi-view distributed through-wall radar system based on same-frequency orthogonal signals, which comprises a distributed radar module, a receiving end and a moving target detection module, wherein the distributed radar module comprises a first radar and a second radar, the first radar and the second Lei Dabu are arranged at different view angles, radar detection is carried out on a target scene behind a wall by adopting the same-frequency orthogonal signals, the receiving end comprises an orthogonal mixing signal filter for filtering the orthogonal mixing signals, the self mixing signals are respectively obtained by the first radar and the second radar, and the moving target detection module is used for extracting target information according to the obtained self mixing signals of the first radar and the second radar. Therefore, by adopting the method, the blind area detection capability of the through-wall radar can be improved, false target interference is restrained, meanwhile, the problem of channel interference of a distributed through-wall radar system is avoided, and the detection precision of the through-wall radar is improved.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE JIAXING

title_en: Nondestructive survey instrument, method therefor, and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a nondestructive survey instrument capable of detecting a position and a shape of a buried object buried in a shallow position, precisely compared with a conventional example, and capable of estimating a material of the buried object impossible to be estimated in the prior art.  <P>SOLUTION: This nondestructive survey instrument of the present invention has a microwave radar part for transmitting a transmission wave to receive a reflected wave thereof, a difference calculation part for subtracting a transmission waveform from a reflection waveform to find a differential waveform, a mutual correlation Hilbert transform part for Hilbert-transforming a crosscorrelation between the differential waveform and the transmission waveform to obtain a model fitness function of an absolute value of a complex reflection coefficient, a boundary model fitness computing part for holding the maximum value of a time difference of the model fitness function and a time difference of the maximum value, for conducting conversion into a prescribed time difference width of boundary model fitness function, a reverse projection image generating part for generating a reverse projection image by a histogram of the boundary model fitness function of a reflected wave, using the boundary model fitness function of the reflected wave in every measured point as a degree of reliability of a consideration point, and a phase detecting part for finding a phase of the transmission wave bringing the maximum value of the histogram in the reverse projection image.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Excavation assistance system for work machine and excavation assistance method for work machine
abstract_en: To enhance the accuracy and efficiency of excavation by a work machine.SOLUTION: An excavation assistance system for a work machine includes: a work machine having: an underground search device with a radar capable of searching for a buried object; a machine body; and a work device provided on the machine body and performing an excavation work; a first display device that displays information; a first acquisition unit that acquires an allowable depth, which is a depth enabling the radar to perform a search from a ground surface with predetermined accuracy; and a second acquisition unit that acquires a search position at which a radar has performed a search. The first display device has a first display unit that, based on the allowable depth acquired by the first acquisition unit and the search position acquired by the second acquisition unit, displays on a map the allowable depth and an excavation position where the work device is allowed to perform an excavation work.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Exit flee t0 leading light
title_ko: 피난구 유도등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency exit sign which makes it possible to secure a clear view from dust and smoke in case of a fire, and changes the angle of the sign to another safe exit, not a guide indication direction in case there is a fire in the guide indication direction indicated by the emergency exit sign, in order for persons to be always guided to a safe exit without a fire. The emergency exit including a body (10), a fixing plate (20), a light penetration part (30), a direction guide display part (31), a power source part (40), and an LED and LED driving part (50), additionally comprises: a control part (60), a first and a second heat sensor (70, 71), a laser generator (80), a laser ray passage hole (85), an angle change part (90) and a subsidiary accommodation part (100). Thus, the emergency exit sign has the distinguished effect of being able to guide persons to take refuge safely and more accurately under darkness where it is difficult to secure a clear view because of smoke. In ordinary times, the laser ray is irradiated to an original exit sign or another exit sign installed adjacently thereto and at the same time, the laser ray irradiated from the adjacent emergency exit sign is irradiated to other exit direction refractively, not to the ordinary exit sign. Thus, the emergency exit sign can be used in case of a bidirectional exit. The laser generator can be installed in the left, right side or the front of the body, and thus, the emergency exit sign can be installed regardless of an evacuation passage structure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재시 먼지, 연기 등으로부터 시야 확보를 가능하게 하고, 피난구 유도등이 지시하는 안내표시 방향에서 화재가 발생된 경우에도 안내표시 방향이 아닌 다른 안전한 출구측 방향으로 변각하여 항상 화재가 없는 안전한 출구로만 안내되도록 표시하는 피난구 유도등에 관한 것으로, 이는 몸체(10), 고정판(20), 광투시부(30), 방향안내표시부(31), 전원부(40), LED 및 LED구동부(50)를 구비한 피난구 유도등에 제어부(60)와, 제1 및 제2 열감지기(70)(71)와, 레이저발생기(80)와, 레이저 광선 통로구(85)와, 변각부(90) 및 보조수납부(100)를 구비하여서, 연기로 인한 시야확보가 어려운 상황속에서도 보다 정확하게 안전 대피하도록 유도할 수 있는 현저한 효과가 잇고, 또한 평상시에 본래의 피난구 또는 인접설치된 다른 피난구유도등으로 레이저 광선을 조사하는 동시에 인접 설치된 피난구 유도등에서 조사되는 레이저 광선을 평상시의 피난구측이 아닌 다른 피난구측 방향으로도 굴절 조사되도록 피난구가 양방향인 곳에서도 유용하게 사용할 수 있는 장점과, 레이저 발생기를 몸체의 좌, 우측면 또는 전방에 설치가 가능하여 피난통로구조에 관계없이 모두 설치 적용이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Non-contact Biosignal and Activity State Detection System
title_ko: 비접촉 생체신호 및 활동 상태 탐지 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탐지 정확도가 향상될 수 있는 비접촉 생체신호 및 활동 상태 탐지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 대상의 위치 및 상기 대상의 바이탈 신호를 탐지하는 레이더 모듈; 상기 레이더 모듈의 복수의 레이더들을 병렬로 연결하여 상기 레이더 모듈의 탐지 각도와 범위를 확장하는 레이더 병렬 연결 시스템; 상기 대상의 크기, 상기 대상의 위치 및 상기 대상의 활동 상태를 탐지하는 TOF 모듈; 상기 레이더 모듈과 상기 TOF 모듈로부터 수집된 데이터를 통합 분석하여 탐지 정확도를 향상시키는 인공지능 데이터 분석 유닛; 및 통합된 데이터를 실시간으로 출력하는 데이터 통합/출력 시스템을 포함한다.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using ground penetrating radar
Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Non-contact pulse transit time measurement system and non-contact vital sign sensing device thereof
abstract_en: In non-contact pulse transit time measurement system of the present invention, two continuous-wave radars are provided to detect movements at two positions on a subject for use in measuring pulse transit time. The measurement of the pulse transit time can be continuous and last for a long time because there is no contact to skin necessary.

title_en: Machine vision and artificial intelligence-based bracelet for real-time monitoring of patients' vital signs under emergency and critical situations
abstract_en: An advanced biometric bracelet has been designed that can monitor vital signs in emergencies and critical situations. Thanks to facial recognition technology, this bracelet records, displays, and sends the patient's data to the doctor. In situations where the number of patients or clients to hospitals and medical centers is high, or in case of natural disasters, this bracelet can alleviate probable risks by shortening the waiting time of patients. Equipped with biometric sensors, this bracelet can record vital signs including blood oxygen level, heart rate, and body temperature. In emergencies, the bracelet will alert and store the data for a while so that the doctor can check for fluctuations. The camera mounted on the bracelet helps to save the changes in the patient's face in the memory of the device and transmit it to the doctor via Wi-Fi.

title_en: Multi-sending and multi-receiving through-wall thunder imaging back-front-back wall oscillation once multi-path restraining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sending and multi-receiving through-wall mine imaging back-front-back-wall oscillation one-time multi-path restraining method. After obtaining an original radar image, binarizing the original radar image, extracting central values of all targets in the original image, calculating direct propagation distance and multipath propagation distance of target electromagnetic waves, calculating a normalized multipath error coefficient and an error threshold value, thereby judging the target of the original image, finally rejecting the multipath false target, realizing multipath inhibition, effectively identifying the real target in the radar image and the two front and back wall oscillation one-time multipath false targets, the loss of a real target can not be caused while the multipath false target is inhibited, two different multipath forms in one-way multipath can be perfectly considered, the method has the advantages of comprehensively and completely inhibiting the multipath, avoiding omission, ensuring the practical effect of the through-wall radar in the detection environment of the closed building and providing powerful guarantee for operators to make correct decisions.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method, device and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring method, a non-contact vital sign monitoring device and a non-contact vital sign monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting echo signals reflected after the emission signals meet the target to be detected; mixing the transmitting signal and the echo signal to generate a mixing signal; performing AD sampling on the mixing signal to generate a time domain sampling signal; carrying out distance transformation on the time domain sampling signal to obtain a one-dimensional range profile of the radar; acquiring a maximum peak value in the one-dimensional range profile to obtain a target range unit, and calculating a phase on the target range unit; repeating the distance conversion and phase calculation steps according to the radar frame refreshing frequency to obtain a phase set which is respectively calculated on the same distance unit every time, and performing phase difference processing to obtain a phase difference set; and filtering the phase difference set to obtain a vital sign signal of the target to be detected, and converting to obtain the vital sign. The invention solves the problems of inconvenience and infection caused by contact detection in the prior art, realizes non-contact measurement, has high practicability and convenience and avoids contact infection.

title_en: Multi-radar association control method and control device in health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-radar association control method and a multi-radar association control device in a health monitoring system. The health monitoring system comprises a first fall monitoring radar and a first human presence monitoring radar which monitor a first area, and a first vital sign monitoring radar which monitors respiration and heartbeat of a sub-area in the first area. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring personnel presence information monitored by a first human presence monitoring radar; and controlling the working modes of the first vital sign monitoring radar and the first fall monitoring radar according to the existence information of the personnel in the first area and whether the personnel are in the sub-area. The invention can reduce the false alarm rate of the monitoring radar of the health monitoring system, improve the reliability of the monitoring result and reduce the average power consumption of the health monitoring system.

title_en: Three-dimensional imaging method and device for through-wall radar based on priori information
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional imaging method and device of a through-wall radar based on priori information, which belong to the technical field of radars, consider three-dimensional characteristics of a wall structure, characterize local similarity of images through 3D-TV constraint, inhibit influence of wall artifacts and random half-points by using group sparse constraint, and can keep global coherence of the wall structure under the influence of noise by combining tensor Tucker decomposition constraint, so that perspective three-dimensional imaging quality is improved. According to the invention, the three-dimensional characteristics of the wall structure are considered in the solving process, so that the solving result is more consistent with the real wall structure.

title_en: Contents valuation system and contents valuating method using the system
title_ko: 콘텐츠 평가 시스템 및 이를 이용한 콘텐츠 평가 방법
abstract_ko: 보다 객관적이고 신뢰도가 높게 콘텐츠를 평가할 수 있는 콘텐츠 평가 시스템 및 이를 이용한 콘텐츠 평가 방법이 개시된다.  이러한 콘텐츠 평가 시스템은 뇌파 측정부, 생체신호 측정부, 센서 제어부 및 메인 제어부를 포함한다.  상기 뇌파 측정부는 콘텐츠를 제공받는 피험자로부터 뇌파를 측정하여 출력하고, 상기 생체신호 측정부는 상기 피험자로부터 생체 신호를 측정하여 출력한다.  상기 센서 제어부는 상기 뇌파 측정부 및 상기 생체신호 측정부를 제어하고, 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호를 제공받아 전달한다.  상기 메인 제어부는 상기 센서 제어부로부터 전달된 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 콘텐츠를 제공하기 전과 제공하는 동안 발생되는 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호의 변화를 감지하고, 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호의 변화에 이용하여 상기 피험자의 상기 콘텐츠에 대한 몰입도 및 정서의 방향 중 적어도 하나를 도출하며, 상기 도출된 적어도 하나의 결과를 이용하여 상기 콘텐츠를 평가한다.  이로써, 상기 콘텐츠를 신뢰도 높게 평가할 수 있다.

title_en: Personalized alarm provision system using Doppler signal-based biometric and motion information
title_ko: 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personalized alarm providing system using bio-information and motion information based on a doppler signal, comprising an apparatus for obtaining bio-signal and motion signal information using a doppler signal, a server, and a guardian terminal. The apparatus for obtaining bio-signal and motion signal information using a doppler signal includes: a doppler signal obtaining unit configured to emit a radar signal to a subject, obtain a doppler signal by obtaining a signal returning after the radar signal is reflected, and obtain a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit configured to obtain first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a signal information output unit configured to obtain the first signal information and the second signal information, and obtain bio-signal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information, respectively, using a preset algorithm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체 신호 및 움직임신호 정보 획득 장치, 서버 및 보호자 단말을 포함하는 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템이다. 상기 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체 신호 및 움직임신호 정보 획득 장치는  대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임신호 정보를 획득하는 신호 정보 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: fire protection shutter for disaster evacuation
title_ko: 재난 대피 겸용 방화셔터
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fireproof shutter capable of protecting a safe evacuation space in case of a disaster such as a fire, an earthquake, a flood, etc., and quickly grasping a location of an evacuee through a see-through window and a directional noise sensor. A fireproof shutter with a disaster evacuation function includes a shutter box. The shutter box includes a slat assembly and a guide rail, a see-through window, a temperature sensor, and an evacuation direction display unit formed on a slat, and in the event of a fire, cools the slat by a fire extinguishing water injection nozzle, and efficiently supports disaster rescue and evacuation by grasping the location of an evacuee based on a noise sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 재난 대피 겸용 방화셔터는: 후술할 슬랫 어셈블리가 권취 또는 권취 풀림 되도록 하는 회전 구동력을 제공하는 구동부가 내부에 구비되는 셔터박스; 상기 셔터박스의 좌우 양단 하부에서 지면으로 연장되어 상기 셔터박스가 지면에 대해 지지 되도록 구비된 가이드레일; 및, 상기 구동부에 의해 상하로 권취 또는 권취 풀림 되며 승강 개폐 가능하게 구비되고, 다수개의 슬랫들이 서로 상하로 결속되어 구비되며, 좌우 양단은 상기 가이드레일에 의해 상하 승강 이동이 안내되도록 구비된 슬랫 어셈블리;를 포함하고, 
상기 슬랫 어셈블리를 이루는 슬랫의 판면에는 슬랫 어셈블리를 기준으로 내외 어느 일측에서 반대편을 향한 시야가 확보될 수 있도록 투시공이 천공 형성되며, 상기 투시공은 투명재질로 마련된 투시창으로 덮이도록 구비되고, 상기 가이드레일의 전후 상단에는 상기 슬랫 어셈블리를 기준으로 내외 영역의 온도를 각각 감지하는 온도센서가 구비되며, 상기 가이드레일의 전후 양측에는 상기 온도센서에서 감지된 결과에 따라 램프의 색이 가변 되며 표시되도록 하는 대피방향 표시부가 구비되고, 
상기 온도센서에서 감지된 결과에 기초하여 상기 슬랫 어셈블리를 기준으로 한 내외 영역 중 어느 일측의 온도가 반대편의 온도와 비교해 기준 온도차보다 더욱 높은 경우 상기 대피방향 표시부를 통해 반대편에서 이를 알리도록 상기 대피방향 표시부를 제어하는 제어부를 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
이에 의하여, 화재 발생시뿐만 아니라 지진이나 홍수 등의 각종 재난 발생시에도 외부로부터 내부의 피난 공간이 안전하게 보호되도록 하며, 외부에서 구조를 위한 내부의 상황 파악 또는 내부에서 외부의 재난 상황 등을 파악하는 것이 투시창을 통해 모두 용이 해지도록 할 수 있고, 방화셔터를 기준으로 외부와 내부 중 화재가 발생 된 위치가 반대편에서 미리 알 수 있도록 화재 대피 방향이 표시되도록 함으로써 화재로 인한 인명 피해가 최소화되도록 할 수 있으며, 투시창이 오염되거나 파손되어 잘 보이지 않게 되더라도 지향성 노이즈 센서의 감지를 통해 방화셔터를 기준으로 외부와 내부 중 대피자가 생존해 있는 영역을 용이하게 파악할 수 있게 됨으로써 재난 대피자의 구조가 골든타임 안에 신속하게 이뤄지도록 할 수 있는 재난 대피 겸용 방화셔터를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar-based vital sign estimation
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating range data based on the received radar signals; detecting a target based on the range data; performing ellipse fitting on in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals associated with the detected target to generate compensated I and Q signals associated with the detected target; classifying the compensated I and Q signals; when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a first class, determining a displacement signal based on the compensated I and Q signals, and determining a vital sign based on the displacement signal; and when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a second class, discarding the compensated I and Q signals.

title_en: System and method for sensing with millimeter waves for sleep position detection, vital signs monitoring and/or driver detection
abstract_en: A sensor and method for sleep position detection including: a transmitter configured to transmit electromagnetic waves between 30 GHz and 300 GHz; a receiver configured to receive the electromagnetic waves from the transmitter, wherein the transmitter and receiver are positioned in relation to person sleeping such that the receiver receives reflected electromagnetic waves; and a control station configured to analyze the transmitted and received electromagnetic waves to determine a position of the person sleeping. In some cases, the method may include: forming a radar cube of results; performing a fast fourier transform (FFT) on the radar cube; applying a constant false alarm rate (CFAR) processor to the FFT data; determining a capon gradient; forming a 5-dimensional feature space based on the capon gradient; and conducting an optimization of SVM.

title_en: Non-contact fatigue detection method and system
abstract_en: Disclosed are a non-contact fatigue detection method and system. The method comprises: sending a millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar signal to a person being detected, receiving an echo signal reflected from the person, and determining a time-frequency domain feature, a non-linear feature and a time-series feature of a vital sign signal; acquiring a facial video image of the person, and performing facial detection and alignment on the basis of the facial video image, for extracting a time domain feature and a spatial domain feature of the person's face; fusing the determined vital sign signal with the time domain feature and the spatial domain feature of the person's face, for obtaining a fused feature; inputting the fused feature into a classifier to perform fatigue state recognition of said person, and determining whether the person is in a fatigued state by the fused feature. By fusing the two detection techniques, the method effectively suppressing the interference of subjective and objective factors, and improving the accuracy of fatigue detection.

title_en: System and methods for detection of subjects vitals and physiological symptoms via non-contact methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring which properly detect subject's vital signs by correcting the measured signals for reflectance and variations in distance between measurements. The present invention provides for adequate sensor numbers and types to properly monitor a subject's vitals and physiological signals. Certain aspects of the invention include the use of signal scoring methods. In such embodiments, acquired data and/or information is used for scoring a signal acquired from non-contact vital monitoring assisting in the accurate measurement of various vitals of a subject, including, without limit, a subjects temperature, cardiovascular and respiratory information. The present invention provides a viable solution for at-a-distance non-contact vital sign monitoring that overcomes the shortcomings of existing solutions known in the art.

title_en: Radar detection device and method
abstract_en: A radar detection device is provided. The radar detection device may include a radar device and a signal processing device. The radar device may include a plurality of antennas to transmit and receive radar signals. The signal processing device is coupled to the radar device, and the signal processing device determines that a target object is in a first area of a detection area or in a second area of the detection area according to the radar signals received by the radar device to determine to perform an activity detection or a vital-sign detection on the target object.

title_en: Portable radar life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable radar life detection device, comprising: the radar detection device comprises a storage box, a mounting shell, a radar detection module and a display module. The containing box realizes the placement and protection of parts of the device in an unassembled state; the installation shell consists of a handshake, a telescopic machine and a rotary machine, and an assembly state is formed by threaded connection, so that the height adjustment of the device in a use state and the vertical rotary scanning function of the radar module are realized; the display module is used for guiding the direction of the user in the use state; the radar module is used for searching the life body in the use state. The device disclosed by the utility model is simply assembled when in use, and disassembled after the use, and is stored in the storage box, so that the problems of heavy weight, difficult transportation and complex operation of the conventional radar life detection device are solved.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system for landslide disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring and early warning system for a landslide disaster. The system comprises piezoelectric cables, a front-end signal processor, a system host, a field alarm device, a wireless transmission device, and a monitoring center and the like. A plurality of piezoelectric cables are buried inside a side slope soil body and are used as sensors to carry out processing and analyzing on obtained signals; the field alarm device emits early warning prompting information in real time at field; the wireless transmission device sends the information to a monitoring center in real time by a GSM wireless network and processing, analyzing and displaying are carried out. According to the invention, the invention is mainly applied to monitoring of landslide stability; and functions of field real-time early warning, remote wireless disaster information transmission, and remote data displaying and the like can be realized. Moreover, the system having the characteristics of simple arrangement, low cost, and high practicability and the like can be effectively applied to large-area slide slope deformation monitoring and disaster forecasting.
assignees: TIANJIN SATCOM IOT APPLIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST CO LTD;BEIJING SATCOM ITS TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Sound object detection method and system based on multi-functional ultra-broadband wall-through radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses the sound object detection method based on multi-functional ultra-broadband wall-through radar and system.This method includes the pattern for determining through-wall radar detection target；The signal of receiver is gathered, gathers M*N groups altogether；M is effective impulse length, represents distance to data；N is pulse group number, and representation speed is to data；When the pattern of through-wall radar detection target is moving-target detection pattern, M>N；When the pattern of through-wall radar detection target is quiet target detection mode, M=N；Seeking the distance of M*N group data, the points of Fourier transformation are 2k times, obtain 2k*N frequency domain data to Fourier transformation；Wherein 2k>M；Speed is asked for Fourier transformation to Fourier transformation result to the distance of M*N group data again, the points of Fourier transformation are n times, obtain 2k*N frequency domain data；The data of coverage in 2k*N frequency domain data are intercepted, are added up according to Doppler to the data of interception；Object detection process is carried out to the result after cumulative, calculates target location coordinate.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES INST AUTOMATION

title_en: Non-contact respiration monitoring method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, and provides a non-contact respiration monitoring method, equipment, a system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of controlling a radar sensor to emit signals to an object to be detected, receiving echo signals through reflection, identifying frequency characteristics of first interference information in the echo signals and time sequence information of the frequency characteristics, wherein the first interference information is used for representing random motion interference of the object to be detected, and eliminating the first interference information in the echo signals according to the frequency characteristics of the first interference information and the time sequence information of the frequency characteristics to obtain target respiration monitoring signals, and the target respiration monitoring signals are used for representing respiratory frequency. By implementing the scheme, more reliable and accurate monitoring results can be obtained.
assignees: WUHAN UNITED IMAGING ZHIRONG MED TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human heart rate detection method based on multi-harmonic weighting reconstruction
abstract_en: A human heart rate detection method based on multi-harmonic weighting reconstruction is characterized in that a millimeter wave radar experiment system is built to collect human chest echo intermediate frequency signals, a frequency modulation continuous wave radar is used for non-contact and non-invasive vital sign signal collection, fast Fourier transformation is applied to the intermediate frequency signals of radar four-antenna receiving signals, chest positions of people are effectively obtained through inter-frame sliding difference and incoherent accumulation, and phase information about the measurement positions is collected. Then, the extracted phases are subjected to phase unwrapping and phase difference, decomposed into IMF components, and a heartbeat signal is reconstructed by using a method based on CEEMDAN multiple harmonic addition weight construction. According to the invention, higher detection precision is realized, and meanwhile, the threshold parameter is not required to be set manually, so that the heartbeat frequency detection robustness in a complex dynamic environment is remarkably improved.

title_en: In-vehicle vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-vehicle vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and data fusion, which relates to the technical field of automobile safety monitoring and comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode environment data through an arranged sensor and preprocessing to obtain a processed vital sign signal, a carbon dioxide concentration change rate and an environment temperature value; the method comprises the steps of inputting a processed vital sign signal into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model, outputting the existence probability of a living body, fusing the existence probability of the living body, the change rate of carbon dioxide concentration and the environmental temperature value by adopting a multi-sensor information fusion algorithm, judging the risk level, and respectively executing a grading early warning strategy and an active intervention strategy according to the risk level judgment result. The invention can improve the detection accuracy, enhance the environmental adaptability, realize timely rescue response and have engineering application value in the field of passenger safety monitoring of intelligent network-connected automobiles.

title_en: Survey device
abstract_en: To provide a survey device capable of acquiring information on a pavement multilayer structure layer in which a buried pipe is installed.SOLUTION: A survey device using an underground radar comprises: a reflected signal processing unit 41 that generates two-dimensional image data representing a cross section of a pavement multilayer structure layer on the basis of reflected signals of an emitted radar beam from the pavement multilayer structure layer; a first image processing unit 42 that generates first image processing data by performing suppression processing to suppress ground surface reflection signals on the two-dimensional image data; a second image processing unit 43 that generates second image processing data by performing sharpening processing to sharpen boundaries between layers of the pavement multilayer structure layer on the first image processing data; and a thickness calculation unit 44a that calculates the pavement thickness and the base course thickness from the second image processing data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Radar sensor for remote vital signal detection using two frequency
title_ko: 두 개의 주파수를 사용하는 원격 생체 신호 측정 레이더센서
abstract_en: A remote bio-signal measuring radar sensor using two frequencies is provided to facilitate heart beat measurement, remote voice acquisition, and survivor checking by sensing motions of internal organs in a remote place. A transmitting stage inputs a signal with a frequency f1 and a signal with a frequency f2 into a body(125) at the same time, wherein f2 is greater than f1. A receiving stage receives the reflected radio waves, which are inputted into the body in the transmitting stage, and divides the received radio waves into the signals with the frequencies f1 and f2 to amplify the divided signals. A primary frequency mixer(416) multiplies the signals with the frequencies f1 and f2. A band pass filter(417) passes only a signal with a frequency f2-f1 among the signals multiplied by the primary frequency mixer. A second frequency mixer(419) multiplies the signal passing through the band pass filter by a sine wave with the frequency f2-f1. A low band pass filter(420) filters the signal passing through the secondary frequency mixer. A digital signal processing unit(421) digitally processes the signal filtered through the low band pass filter.
abstract_ko:

title_en: System and method for ground penetrating radar communication using antenna crosstalk
abstract_en: An object detection system (24) is disclosed having a transducer (40, 40') for detecting buried objects (26). The transducer is encapsulated within a robust, electromagnetically transparent construction (42).
assignees: DEERE & CO;LOUISIANA TECH UNIVERSITY RES FOUNDATION;SIMICEVIC NEVEN;JAGANATHAN ARUN;MONTGOMERY JAMES L;OLSON JAY H
