title_en: A method and system for monitoring vital signs of an infant
abstract_en: An infant monitoring system combines an infant soother having a sensor for detecting the location or sucking motion of the soother and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. The vital signs sensor output is interpreted taking account of the sensing of the soother. In this way, it can be prevented that a soother sucking motion is incorrectly interpreted as a different vital signs measurement (such as heart rate or respiration rate) or otherwise corrupts the vital signs measurement.

title_en: Intuitively and rapidly applicable tourniquets
abstract_en: The Retrofit Tourniquet System is a portable, non-invasive diagnostic device designed to assess and monitor vital signs for early detection of hypovolemic shock and other trauma-related medical conditions. Utilizing integrated sensors, the system continuously tracks critical metrics such as heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, pulse pressure, and blood oxygen levels, comparing them against individualized baseline values stored in lookup tables. The system's diagnostic algorithms identify deviations in vital signs, calculate estimated blood loss stages, and provide recommended treatment options. Built to function seamlessly on or off a tourniquet, the Retrofit Tourniquet System enables first responders and military personnel to assess a patient's condition in real-time, even in field conditions. Enhanced by secure data encryption and compatibility with healthcare interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR and HL7), the system also supports remote monitoring by medical professionals when integrated with remote databases. This tailored, AI-assisted device improves patient survivability by allowing for timely interventions, particularly in cases of internal bleeding where traditional diagnostics are insufficient.
assignees: DIMINO MICHAEL J;DIMINO MICHAEL C;DIMINO ALFONSE

title_en: Automatic alarm system for vehicle casualties and traffic accidents
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic alarm system for vehicle casualties and traffic accidents. The automatic alarm system is characterized in that an infrared life detection instrument is installed on a vehicle and respectively acquires the life information below a vehicle chassis and the life information within a vehicle peripheral setting range; the life information below the vehicle chassis is obtained through covering an area right below the vehicle chassis via the infrared light which is sent out by the infrared life detection instrument, and the life information within the setting range is collected in real time, so that life images are generated and are transmitted to an alarm information control center via a public wireless communication network through utilizing global system for mobile communication (GSM); and the life information within the vehicle peripheral setting range is obtained in the way that for a traveling vehicle, when the infrared life detection instrument detects the vehicle body peripheral life information, and the vehicle is judge to hit pedestrians during brake acceleration, as a result, the image information is instantly sent to the alarm information control center. The automatic alarm system can be used for effectively solving the problems of runaway drivers or delayed and inaccurate alarming and difficult control when traffic accidents are happened, so that patients can be rescued in time.

title_en: A kind of imaging method suppressed suitable for through-wall radar multipath mirage
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of imaging method suppressed suitable for through-wall radar multipath mirage, including sub-aperture image step：Full aperture is divided into N number of without the sub-aperture occured simultaneously；To each sub-aperture, respectively by rear orientation projection's imaging algorithm, N number of independent subgraph is obtained；Subgraph fusion steps：N number of independent subgraph is normalized respectively, obtains N number of normalization subgraph I ' i ；Carry out joining the multiplied image I to after fusion for N normalized subgraph f ；Finally to the image I after fusion f Carry out Threshold detection and obtain final radar image I with binary conversion treatment.It is of the invention effectively to inhibit multipath mirage to disturb, improve the signal to noise ratio of image and the detection performance of concealed target after wall.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign data monitoring method, a system and a computer readable storage medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving echo signals in a radar detection space, and screening static detected personnel from the radar detection space according to the echo signals to serve as target objects; calculating the space position information of the target object in the radar detection space according to the echo signal of the target object; judging the number of target objects equidistant to the radar according to the space position information; if at least two target objects equidistant to the radar exist in the radar detection space, calculating phase information according to azimuth angle information and pitch angle information of the target objects; and calculating vital sign data of the target object according to the phase information. The non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on the millimeter wave radar has the advantages of non-contact monitoring, strong monitoring reliability, low cost and the like.

title_en: In-home wireless broadcasting terminal with body activity and fire detection, living body signal reception function and the control method thereof
title_ko: 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 특정 장소에 설치된 메인방송장치로부터 송출되는 소정 안내방송을 전달받아 출력시키도록 일정 지역 내의 각 가정집에 설치되는 무선방송수신기에 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능을 추가로 구성한 후 해당 정보를 메인방송장치 측으로 전송하도록 하여 긴급상황 발생에 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 한 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명에 따른 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기는, 무선통신모듈과, 디지털시계부와, 버튼부와, I/O 제어부와, 음성 제어부 및, 제어부(CPU)를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 무선방송수신기에는 해당 가정집의 동체활동 및 화재감지를 위한 적외선 배열센서, 생체신호수신용 통신모듈이 더 구비되며, 상기 무선통신모듈은 양방향 데이터 통신모듈로 이루어져 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 상기 적외선 배열센서로부터의 측정값 및 수신된 생체신호측정기의 측정값을 상기 메인방송장치 측으로 전송하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Emergency exit guide device for firefighting using electric device of building
title_ko: 건축물의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 비상구 유도장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency exit guide device for firefighting using an electric device of a building, which is buried to expose one surface to a side wall or a ceiling to indicate an emergency exit direction by LED lighting and accurately and stably perform the direction indication to an escapeable emergency exit in an emergency such as a fire. The emergency exit guide device for firefighting comprises a main installation box (10), a direction indication panel (20), a control box (30), a panel drive motor (40), a ventilation means (50), a power supply unit (60), and a controller (70).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 비상구 유도장치에 관한 것으로서, 벽면(W)에서 사람의 눈높이 또는 천정면의 폭 중간에 소정의 깊이가 요입되도록 하면서 실내측으로는 개방되게 형성한 설치홈(T)에 맞춤 삽입되도록 하는 메인 설치함(10); 상기 메인 설치함(10)의 개방된 일측면에 접하는 길이 방향의 상호 마주하는 상하부면 또는 양측면의 길이 중간에 길이 중간 부위가 회전 가능하게 축지지되도록 하며, 개방된 일측면으로는 복수의 엘이디들의 배열로 이루어지는 표시부(21)를 형성하는 방향 지시패널(20); 상기 메인 설치함(10)과 동일 수직선상의 상측 벽면(W)에 소정의 깊이로 요입되도록 하는 박스홈(BT)에 맞춤 삽입되도록 하면서 실내측으로 개방된 일측면은 도어(31)에 의해 개폐되도록 하는 콘트롤 박스(30); 상기 콘트롤 박스(30)의 내부에서 상기 방향 지시패널(20)의 길이 중간과 동일 수직선상에 축고정되도록 하여 상기 방향 지시패널(20)을 소정의 각도로 회전시키도록 하는 패널 구동모터(40); 상기 메인 설치함(10)의 개방된 단면에 대응되는 벽체측 판면(W)에 형성되는 휀(51)과 그릴(52)을 통해 외부로부터 외기가 소정의 압력으로 유입되도록 하여 화재 시 발생되는 연기를 희석시키거나 실내에 신선한 공기가 유입되도록 하는 환기 수단(50); 상기 콘트롤 박스(30)의 내부에서 상기 패널 구동모터(40)의 일측에 구비되어 상기 패널 구동모터(40)와 상기 방향 지시패널(20) 및 휀(51)에 전원이 공급되도록 하는 동시에 필요한 양의 전원이 충전되도록 하는 전원 공급 수단(60); 상기 콘트롤 박스(30)의 내부에서 상기 전원 공급 수단(60)과 반대측에 형성되어 화재 발생 시 화재 감지 센서로부터 감지되는 신호에 의해 화재 발생 위치를 체크하여 상기 방향 지시패널(20)을 설정한 각도로 회전시켜 대피할 방향으로 방향 지시패널(20)의 일부가 상기 메인 설치함(10)으로부터 돌출되도록 하여 표시부(21)에 표시되는 화살표에 의해 비상구를 찾아 대피할 수 있도록 하는 콘트롤러(70)의 결합으로 이루어진다.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: Systems and methods for using radio frequency signals and sensors to monitor environments
abstract_en: Systems and methods for using radio frequency signals and sensors to monitor environments (e.g., indoor building, industrial environments) are disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a system for providing a wireless asymmetric network comprises a hub having one or more processing units and at least one antenna for transmitting and receiving radio frequency (RF) communications in the wireless asymmetric network and a plurality of sensor nodes each having a wireless device with a transmitter and a receiver to enable bi-directional RF communications with the hub in the wireless asymmetric network. The one or more processing units of the hub are configured to determine localization of the plurality of sensor nodes within the wireless asymmetric network, to monitor regions within an environment for human presence and location of at least one robot, to determine human presence information to indicate whether a human is present within the monitored regions, and to determine a location for the human based on the human presence information when a human is present within the monitored regions.

title_en: System and method for continous and real-time locating and tracking scraper using UAV
abstract_en: A method includes: launching an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) parallel to a buried pipeline; sending a plurality of transmitted ground penetrating radar (GPR) waves to the buried pipeline using a GPR antenna of the UAV; receiving a received GPR wave from the buried pipeline such that the received GPR wave is a combination of a reflected GPR wave with a ringing noise signal from the one or more scrapers; measuring one or more parameters of the received GPR wave and determining if values of the one or more parameters are within a predefined threshold region; recording location coordinates and a time stamp of the one or more scrapers by analyzing the received GPR wave; and sending the location coordinates and the time stamp of the one or more scrapers to a controller unit for continuous and real-time locating and tracking movement of the one or more scrapers.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radar life detection instrument relates to the field of radar detection instrument, including the detection instrument body, detection instrument body below is provided with the base, the base is provided with the bracing piece, fixed surface is connected with the fixed plate under the detection instrument body, the fixed plate lower surface rotates to be connected in the upper end of the support bar, one side that the base is located the bracing piece is provided with the regulation pole, it is provided with the angle adjustment mechanism who is used for adjusting detection instrument body detection angle to adjust the pole, angle adjustment mechanism connects in the fixed plate. The application has the effect of shortening the rescue time.
assignees: SHENZHEN DASANTI SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A sight glass structure for a roller type fire shutter
title_ko: 롤러 타입 방화셔터용 투시창 구조
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 롤러 타입 방화셔터용 투시창 구조는, 저장박스의 내부에 감속모터에 연결된 차단판 롤러가 포함되고, 양측 가이드 레일 사이에 다수의 철판단위체로 구성된 차단판이 결합되어 화재감시센서의 화재신호에 의해 통로가 차단되도록 구성된 롤러 타입 방화셔터에 있어서, 상기 철판단위체의 철판을 관통하는 투시구멍; 철판이 절곡되어 상하좌우 네개의 변을 이루고, 일측 네개의 변이 안쪽으로 절곡되어 전면에 투시구를 이루어 상기 투시구멍에 결합되는 투시창 하우징; 철판이 "ㄷ"자 형상으로 절곡되고, 상부의 양측판이 일정한 깊이로 절삭되어 가운데 부분이 돌출된 돌출판이 형성되고, 상기 돌출판에 축홀이 형성된 한쌍의 브라켓; 상기 한쌍의 브라켓에 삽입되는 석영유리; 상기 양측 브라켓 돌출판의 축홀에 삽입되어 구르도록 구성된 굴대; 상기 석영유리의 하부를 감싸는 하부커버 난연천; 상기 석영유리의 앞뒤와 굴대를 감싸는 덮게 난연천; 및 상기 덮게 난연천의 단부가 외부로 돌출되어 형성된 손잡이;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things, including：Information terminal, it includes image collection assembly, voice talk module, intelligence sensor；For gathering information；Information receives and Transmission system, for sending and receiving information by communication；And floor manager terminal, for receiving, transmitting and display data.The present invention provides a kind of fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things, the Real-time Feedback of the information such as accident site environment, personnel positions and vital sign is realized, the safety of science decision commander and live emergency management and rescue personnel for accident floor manager provide technological means.
assignees: SUZHOU TEAMAY NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of for monitor hydrodynamic force type landslide device and its application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of for monitoring the device on hydrodynamic force type landslide, including several end to end monitoring pipes, measuring staff is provided in monitoring pipe, strain inductor is provided on measuring staff, the two sides of strain inductor are connected with one end of foil gauge respectively, the other end of foil gauge is connected with one end of compressed spring, compressed spring is vertical with measuring staff, the other end of compressed spring is fixedly connected with the rotation axis of pulley, the sliding slot for pulley rolling is offered in monitoring pipe, the upper end of measuring staff is provided with data line, the lower end of measuring staff is provided with water level sensor, one end of data line is connect with strain inductor and water level sensor, monitoring pipe positioned at the top is provided with hole in outer wall, pore pressure gauge is buried in hole.The invention also discloses the application methods of the device.A kind of device and its working method, structure for monitoring the landslide of the hydrodynamic force type due to caused by rainfall or Reservoir Water Level provided by the invention is simple and convenient to operate and integrates earth horizontal displacement, level of ground water and pore water pressure.

title_en: Remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs, and belongs to the technical field of personnel search and rescue and identification. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a basic vital sign data set of the individual soldiers in a preset time sequence before the current moment, and judging the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment and the reliability of the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment according to the data set; and (4) integrating the current individual physiological state and the current individual physiological state reliability, and determining and marking the current individual state. The invention solves the problems of accuracy and reliability in the existing remote identification technology of the individual wounded person, improves the remote identification accuracy and reliability of the individual wounded person by utilizing a multi-sensor fusion technology and a time sequence analysis technology according to the real-time vital sign information of the individual wounded person, and provides information support for the effective treatment of the wounded person.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF SYSTEM ENGINEERING ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SUPPORT TECH

title_en: Physiological parameter monitoring system and method and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a physiological parameter monitoring system and method and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises a first measuring part, a second measuring part and a processor. On the one hand, the technical scheme uses one measuring part to mainly measure vital signs and the other measuring part to mainly measure actions, so that interference conditions can be comprehensively judged in an information correction mode, and the condition that vital sign measurement is inaccurate due to a single measuring part is avoided; on the other hand, the problem of poor anti-interference performance when the radar equipment is singly used for carrying out non-contact vital sign measurement can be solved by adding the second measuring part in the technical scheme, and the reliability of the system can be enhanced by selecting, fusing or correcting the information measured by different measuring parts and participating in the processing process of the vital sign information, so that a more accurate vital sign measurement result is obtained.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINDRAY BIOMEDICAL ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Wounded rescue life detection and positioning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based wounded rescue life detection and positioning method which comprises the steps of S1, collecting and time synchronizing a plurality of RGB-D images, laser radar point clouds, millimeter wave vital sign radar data and infrared thermal image data, S2, outputting a pixel-level semantic mask, S3, generating wounded semantic point clouds, S4, forming a measurement-semantic dual map data set, S5, generating vital sign scores and writing the measurement-semantic dual map data set, S6, updating the wounded dynamic anchor attribute in the measurement-semantic dual map data set, S7, calculating the three-dimensional coordinates and rescue priority ordering of each wounded dynamic anchor based on the updated measurement-semantic dual map data set, and generating a obstacle avoidance optimization navigation path avoiding a risk semantic area. The invention effectively improves rescue efficiency and safety.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Smart home systems that apply to indoor and outdoor environment changes
title_ko: 실,내외 환경 변화에 따른 스마트홈 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart home system, which comprises: an outdoor environment detection unit for generally detecting an outdoor environment condition; an indoor environment detection unit for generally detecting an indoor environment condition; a database in which a preset S/W algorithm is stored while collecting and storing the detected environment conditions by the outdoor environment detection unit and the indoor environment detection unit; and a control unit for setting an optimal indoor environment condition.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트홈 시스템에 관한 것으로, 온도감지센서, 습도감지센서, 조도감지센서, 연기감지센서 등의 각종 센서 및 RFID(radio frequency identification), 직비(ZigBee), 와이파이(Wi-Fi), 블루투스(Bluetooth) 등의 무선 센서 네트워크(WSN; Wireless Sensor Network)를 포함하여 실외 환경 조건을 총괄적으로 감지하는 외부환경감지부와; 상기 외부환경감지부와 동일하게 이루어져 실내 환경 조건을 총괄적으로 감지하는 내부환경감지부와; 상기 외부환경감지부와 내부환경감지부에 의해 감지된 환경조건을 취합하여 저장함과 아울러, 미리 설정된 S/W 알고리즘이 저장된 데이타베이스와; 상기 외부환경감지부와 내부환경감지부에 의해 감지된 환경조건과 데이타베이스에 저장된 S/W 알고리즘을 종합적으로 비교, 분석하여 내부 환경조건의 설정 기준치를 가변 시키고, 가변 된 설정 기준치를 통해 난방설비, 냉방설비, 공조설비, 조명설비, 방범설비, 통신설비, 가전제품 등의 부대시설을 자동적으로 제어하여 최적의 내부 환경조건을 설정하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 내부환경감지부에는 비접촉으로 실내 거주자의 건강, 부상, 실신 등의 위급상항이나 실내 화재, 침입, 도난 등의 비상상황을 감지하여 상기 제어부에 전달하는 적외선감지센서, 심박감지센서, 음향감지센서 등의 비상감지부가 더 구비되고, 상기 제어부에는 상기 비상감지부의 신호에 따라 데이타베이스에 미리 저장된 비상연락처로 연락하여 비상 상황을 알리는 비상통신부를 더 포함하고, 태양전지, 풍력발전기 등의 발전전원으로 상시 또는 비상시 상기 부대시설에 전원을 공급하는 전력공급부를 더 포함하며, 제어부에는 상기 내부환경감지부에 의해 감지된 전기, 도시가스, 수도 등의 에너지 사용량을 사용자의 스마트폰으로 전송하는 데이타전송부를 더 포함하는 실,내외 환경 변화에 따른 스마트홈 시스템을 제공함으로써, 실외환경과 실내환경의 변화에 따라 사용자의 조작 없이 부대시설을 자동적으로 제어하여 실내환경을 쾌적하게 조성할 수 있으며, 실내 위급 또는 비상 상황에 신속하게 대처할 수 있고, 실내 에너지 사용량을 한눈에 알아보는 것은 물론, 상용전원의 사용량을 최소화 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Appratus for controlling integrated supervisory of pilots status and method for guiding task performance ability of pilots using the same
title_ko: 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치 및 이를 이용한 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a method of deriving a pilot′s mission performance capability performed by an integrated supervisory and control apparatus of a pilot state for evaluating a mission performance capability necessary for piloting a piloted object based on state information of the pilot comprises: a signal measuring step of measuring surrounding environment information in conjunction with a control apparatus of the piloted object and measuring at least one biological signals including an electroencephalography signal, an eye movement signal, a skin electrical activity signal, and a respiration measurement signal through a sensor device mounted on the pilot; an information calculating step of reflecting the pilot′s environment information in real time into an arousal state evaluation model for evaluation of the pilot′s state, analyzing the at least one biological signals to extract individual feature information, inputting the extracted individual feature information into the arousal state evaluation model and calculating convergence feature information through a correlation analysis with the pilot′s arousal state; and an arousal state evaluation and feedback providing step of evaluating the pilot′s real-time arousal state level using the convergence feature information, and providing an arousal deriving feedback signal in accordance with the evaluated arousal state level.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치 및 이를 이용한 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법은 조종사의 상태 정보에 기반하여 조종 대상체의 조정에 필요한 임무 수행 능력을 평가하는 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치에 의해 수행되는 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법에 있어서, 상기 조종 대상체의 제어 장치와 연계하여 주변 환경 정보를 측정하고, 조종사에 장착되는 센서 장치를 통해 뇌파 신호, 안구 움직임 신호, 피부 전기활동 신호, 호흡 측정 신호를 포함한 적어도 하나 이상의 생체신호를 측정하는 신호 측정 단계; 상기 조종 환경 정보를 조종사의 상태 평가를 위한 각성 상태 평가 모델에 실시간 반영하고, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호를 분석하여 개별 특징 정보를 추출한 후 상기 추출된 개별 특징 정보를 상기 각성 상태 평가 모델에 입력하여 조종사의 각성 상태와의 상관 관계 분석을 통해 융합 특징 정보를 산출하는 정보 산출 단계; 및 상기 융합 특징 정보를 이용하여 실시간 조종사의 각성 상태 수준을 평가하고, 상기 평가된 각성 상태 수준에 따라 각성 유도 피드백 신호를 제공하는 각성 상태 평가 및 피드백 제공 단계를 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: pre-acknowledge mask system of synapse
title_ko: 천식발작 조기감지 마스크 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an asthma attack early detection mask system. According to the present invention, a bio-signal detection sensor is mounted on a mask to detect symptoms before asthma coughing by a sensor and transmit the same to a control unit installed on the mask, and the control unit generates an alarm by an alarm means to allow a mask wearer to detect asthma attack in advance so that the mask wearer can be prepared quickly. The present invention has a remarkable effect of relieving pain by asthma and relieving asthma attack by detecting symptoms before asthma attack by the sensor in advance and allowing a mask wearer to quickly take action by taking medicine beforehand or the like.
abstract_ko:
본발명은 천식발작 조기감지 마스크 시스템에 관한 것으로, 생체신호감지센서가 마스크에 장착되어 천식 기침전 증후를 미리 센서로 감지하여 이를 마스크에 설치된 제어부에 전송하고 제어부에서는 경보수단에 의해 경보를 발생하여 마스크 착용자가 천식발작을 미리 감지하게 하여 신속히 대비토록 하는 것으로, 
본발명은 천식발작 증후를 센서에 의해 미리 감지하여 약을 미연에 복용하는 등 조치를 신속히 취함으로써 천식에 의한 고통을 덜고 천식발작을 진정시키는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring bio signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A bio signal measurement apparatus for measuring a bio signal comprises: a battery cover for covering an area in which a battery of a terminal device is enabled to be attached or detached; a sensor unit, included in the battery cover, for sensing a bio signal; and a controller for controlling the sensor unit to sense a bio signal, wherein the bio signal measurement apparatus can be attached to or detached from the terminal device by attaching or detaching the battery cover to/from the terminal device.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 생체 신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 단말 장치의 배터리를 탈부착할 수 있는 영역을 커버하기 위한 배터리 커버; 배터리 커버에 포함된 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 센서부가 생체 신호를 감지하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 배터리 커버가 단말 장치와 탈부착됨으로써 단말 장치와 탈부착될 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체 신호 측정 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Electronic device and method for determining sleep-related information
title_ko: 수면과 관련된 정보를 결정하기 위한 전자 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments comprises: a bio-signal detection sensor configured to acquire first and second biometric information on an object outside the electronic device; and a processor, wherein the processor can be configured to: acquire the first and second biometric information by using the bio-signal detection sensor; confirm a first variance, in which the first biometric information is changed, and a second variance, in which the second biometric information is changed; determine a state of the object related to the sleep on the basis of at least a part of the first variance and the second variance; and estimate a sleep latency related to the object on the basis of at least a part of the state.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예들에 따른 전자 장치(electronic device)는, 상기 전자 장치 외부의 오브젝트에 대한 제1 생체 정보 및 제2 생체 정보를 획득하도록 설정된 생체 신호 감지 센서와, 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 제1 생체 정보 및 상기 제2 생체 정보를 상기 생체 신호 감지 센서를 이용하여 획득하고, 상기 제1 생체 정보가 변화된 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 생체 정보가 변화된 제2 변화량을 확인하고, 상기 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 변화량에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 수면과 관련된 상기 오브젝트의 상태를 결정하고, 상기 상태에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 상기 오브젝트와 관련된 수면 잠복기를 추정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Sleep tracking and vital sign monitoring using low power radio waves
abstract_en: Various arrangements for performing radar-based measurement of vital signs. Waveform data may be received then filtered of data indicative of static objects to obtain motion-indicative waveform data. The motion-indicative waveform data may be analyzed to determine one or more frequencies of movement present within the motion-indicative waveform data. A spectral analysis may be performed on the motion-indicative waveform data to determine a spectral-analysis state of a monitored region. The spectral-analysis state of the monitored region may be determined to match a predefined spectral-analysis state during which vital sign monitoring is permitted. One or more vital signs of a monitored user present within the monitored region may be determined and output based on analyzing the motion-indicative waveform data.

title_en: Optical sensor device and image processing unit for measuring chemical concentrations, chemical saturations and biophysical parameters
abstract_en: Optical sensor devices, image processing devices, methods and computer readable code computer-readable storage media for detecting biophysical parameters, chemical concentrations, chemical saturations, vital signs and physiological information such as a malignant condition are provided. In some embodiments, the optical sensor includes an array of photodetectors, where each photodetector is configured to detect a spectrum of light. In some embodiments, the image processing device receives a live still or video electronic image, or alternatively, the electronic image is provided from an electronic storage media. Exemplary physiological parameters include but are not limited to a pulse rate, a biophysical or physiological property of skin, a cardiovascular property, a property related to an organ such as the liver or the kidneys, and a temperature fluctuation. In some embodiments, the physiological parameter is indicative of a malady including but not limited to an autoimmune disease, a cancer, a nutritional deficiency, a malignant condition of bone marrow, a present of an infectious microbe such as a fungus, a present of hepatitis, and a cardiovascular disorder a pulmonary disorder. Exemplary chemical concentrations include but are not limited to a chemical saturation, a pH level, a pH level in blood vessels such as capillarys or in skin, a glucose level such as a blood glucose level, a urea nitrogen level such as a blood urea nitrogen level, a CO2 level such as a blood CO2 level or a CO2 saturation level, and an oxygen level such as a blood oxygen level or a blood oxygen saturation level. In some embodiments, the biophysical parameter, physiological parameter or chemical concentration is obtained from reflecting light from tissue from a mammalian subject. Alternatively one or more of these parameters are detected from a food item such as food tissue, a consumable beverage such as an alcoholic beverage, a dairy product, wine, a baked good, a fruit and a vegetable. Exemplary parameters related to food items include but are not limited to a parameter indicative of cooking or spoilage, a pH, a concentration of an antioxidant, and a concentration of an anti-inflammatory agent.

title_en: Sound object detection method and system based on multi-functional ultra-broadband wall-through radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses sound object detection methods and system based on multi-functional ultra-broadband wall-through radar.This method includes the mode of determining through-wall radar detection target；The signal of receiver is acquired, acquires M*N group altogether；M is effective impulse length, represents length of the distance to data；N is pulse group number, length of the representation speed to data；When the mode of through-wall radar detection target is moving-target detection pattern, M > N；When the mode of through-wall radar detection target is quiet target detection mode, M=N；Ask the distance of M*N group data to Fourier transformation, the points of Fourier transformation are 2k times, obtain the frequency domain data of 2k*N length；Wherein 2k > M；Speed is sought to Fourier transformation to Fourier transformation result to the distance of M*N group data again, the points of Fourier transformation are n times, obtain the frequency domain data of 2k*N length；The data for intercepting effective distance in the frequency domain data of 2k*N length, add up according to speed to the data of interception；Object detection process is carried out to the result after cumulative, calculates target location coordinate.

title_en: Early warning and help seeking system based on external sensor and used for emergency condition of autonomous vehicle passenger
abstract_en: The invention relates to an external sensor-based early warning and help seeking system for an emergency situation of an autonomous vehicle passenger, which is characterized by comprising a vehicle door opening and closing recording module, an in-vehicle people number detection module, a background database module, a vital sign data acquisition module, a data processing module, an early warning module, a voice vibration reminding module, an emergency rescue module and a self-contained power supply module. The invention can monitor the health condition of passengers in real time in the running process of the autonomous vehicle, and can early warn and ask for help and take emergency rescue measures in time when passengers in the vehicle face danger and sudden emergency conditions, thereby saving lives in time.

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, an environment sensing unit, a through-wall radar, a holder and a control unit; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the environment sensing unit, the through-wall radar and the holder are all connected with the control unit; the through-wall radar is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for detecting the external structure, the internal structure and the internal personnel of the building to be detected; the environment sensing unit is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for sensing the flight environment information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the flight environment information to the control unit; the control unit controls the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the flight environment information so as to keep the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the outer wall body within a certain range; the cloud platform is located unmanned aerial vehicle, and the receiving and dispatching antenna of through-wall radar is located the cloud platform, and the control unit is according to flight environment information control cloud platform's action so that the array face of receiving and dispatching antenna keeps parallel with outer wall body. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, good detection performance and the like.

title_en: Electrical cable construction system for apartment houses using artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 공동주택 건축물의 전기 케이블 벽체 시공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric cable wall construction system of an apartment building using artificial intelligence that enables an inspection robot equipped with a current sensor, a flame sensor, and a camera to be movably installed within a main horizontal pipe, a branch horizontal pipe, and a vertical pipe buried in a wall and a ceiling, wherein an electric heat wiring and an electric lamp wiring are laid, so that a terminal and an electric wire are connected among the electric systems of an apartment building, detects, in real time, whether there is an abnormality in an outlet part into which a plug of a home appliance and the like is inserted and an electric lamp switch part that is frequently turned on/off, enables a fire to be prevented in advance by responding quickly by notifying a relevant person and enables quality electricity to be supplied to a user, sets a standard value by being equipped with an integrated management server, enables to be managed in conjunction with artificial intelligence by enabling the same to be databased, and enables construction of an integrated management system through test operations during construction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능을 이용한 공동주택 건축물의 전기 케이블 벽체 시공 시스템에 관한 것으로, 벽체와 천장에 매설되어 전열배선과 전등배선이 포설되는 메인수평관과 분기수평관 및 수직관 내에 전류센서, 불꽃센서 및 카메라가 구비된 점검로봇을 이동 가능하게 설치하여 공동주택의 전기계통 중 단자와 전선이 접속되며 가전제품 등의 플러그가 삽입되는 콘센트 부분과 자주 온/오프 되는 전등스위치 부분에서의 이상여부를 실시간으로 감지하여, 관계자에게 알림으로써 신속히 대처하여 화재발생을 사전에 예방할 수 있고 사용자에게 양질의 전기를 공급할 수 있도록 하며, 통합관리서버를 구비하여 표준값을 설정하고, 이를 데이터베이스화하여 인공지능과 연계하여 운용 관리할 수 있으며, 시공시 시운전을 통한 통합관리시스템을 구축할 수 있게 한 것이다.

title_en: Multi-Channel Radar Apparatus and Control Method for Detecting Humans Trapped in the Subsurface
title_ko: 매몰자 탐지용 다채널 레이다 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매몰자 탐지용 다채널 레이다 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 다채널 레이다 장치는, 지하 매질로 펄스 신호를 방사하기 위한 펄스 발생기, 지하 매질로 연속파(CW) 신호를 방사하기 위한 연속파 발생기, 및 펄스 신호 또는 연속파 신호 중 선택된 신호가 공급되어 지하로 방사되는 광대역 송신 안테나를 포함하는 송신부, 지하 매질에서 반사되어 수신된 펄스 반사신호를 샘플링 및 양자화하는 펄스 샘플러, 지하 매질에서 반사되어 수신된 연속파 반사신호의 주파수 변이를 감지하는 도플러 감지기, 및 펄스 반사신호 또는 연속파 반사신호 중 선택된 신호가 공급되는 광대역 수신 안테나를 포함하는 수신부 및 지하 공동 탐지를 위한 펄스 레이다 모드와 생명 신호 탐지를 위한 연속파 레이다 모드 사이의 전환을 제어하고, 펄스 레이다 모드에서 획득된 펄스 반사신호를 이용하여 정해진 지하 공동의 상부 위치에서 연속파 레이다 모드를 실행하여 연속파 반사신호를 수집하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of automation deviational survey warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of automation deviational survey warning devices, by in the pre-buried inclinometer pipe of pit foundation side wall to be measured, inclination sensor is set in inclinometer pipe, it is connect using detection module with inclination sensor, pass through inclination sensor and the deformation situation of inclinometer pipe synchro measure pit foundation to be measured in the construction process, the change shape in pit foundation work progress is obtained using detection module, and the data and preset threshold obtained by detection module by inclination sensor compare, so as to quickly see if fall out slant range, early warning can be carried out in time, the present apparatus can carry out real-time monitoring to the case where foundation pit side-wall horizontal displacement, it is again easy to use, save manpower, the problem of overcoming cumbersome traditional measurement method and serious lag, accurate data can be provided for guiding construction, early warning can be carried out to foundation pit disaster, to improve base pit engineering The mechanization of construction, the level of IT application.

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a debris flow disaster monitoring device, which comprises: the bottom of the main body is provided with a fixed steel column which is inserted into the ground; the tension sensors are fixedly connected to the main body, and the number of the tension sensors is a plurality; the inner end of the underground pipeline is connected with the main body and is buried underground, and the outer end of the underground pipeline extends outwards; the detection column is arranged at the outer end of the underground pipeline and is vertical to the ground upwards; the pull wire is arranged in the underground pipeline, one end of the pull wire is fixedly connected with the detection column, and the other end of the pull wire penetrates through the underground pipeline and the main body to be connected to the pull sensor; and the humidity detector is arranged on one side of the main body. When landslide and debris flow occur, the surface soil can slide downwards, so that the detection column in the soil is brought to topple, the pull wire is pulled, the pull sensor receives a pull signal, and the possibility of landslide and debris flow in the place is judged.
assignees: WUHU TIANKE ENVIRONMENT TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Rotatable distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable distributed radar life detection instrument, which comprises two radar units with rotating devices, wherein a telescopic rod is connected between the two rotating devices, and each rotating device comprises an upper base, an upper rotating shaft, a bearing, a lower base, a lower rotating shaft, a damping rotating shaft, a rotating shaft cover plate and a contact switch; the upper base and the lower base clamp the shell of the radar unit; the upper rotating shaft is arranged in the upper base, and a bearing is sleeved outside the upper rotating shaft; the lower rotating shaft is arranged in the lower base and is fixedly connected with the upper rotating shaft; the tail end of the lower rotating shaft is provided with a damping rotating shaft and a rotating shaft cover plate; the electric shock switches are arranged on the periphery of the lower rotating shaft; the upper rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the telescopic rod.

title_en: Smart terminal system for highland tourist rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart terminal system for highland tourist rescue, and relates to the technical field of smart rescue. The system comprises a smart rescue box and a smart terminal based on a mobile platform. The smart rescue box comprises a sign sensor, a master control module, a Bluetooth module, a wifi module, a Beidou location communication module and a power supply module. The sign sensor transmits detected signals to the master control module through the Bluetooth module. The master control module transmits location information and sign information of a person in distress to a rear end server through a Beidou short message communication module. According to the system, the life sign information is obtained through the front end sign sensor; stable and reliable short message communication is established by use of a Beidou navigation communication module; the transmission problem of search and rescue signals in an area without coverage of a public network is solved; finally connection is carried out with the rear end server; and the smart terminal system for highland tourist rescue based on the mobile platform is established.

title_en: The method positioned simultaneously for life detection radar array multiple target
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of methods positioned simultaneously for life detection radar array multiple target, including：At least four is arranged into a face battle array for the radar detection unit of life detection, determines its position coordinates；Obtain the signal of each radar detection unit；Therefrom extract the life entity number detected and corresponding range information；Random combine mathematically is carried out to all radar detection units, and combinations of pairs is carried out to the range information in each radar complex and calculates a possible target location, and a reliability index is distributed to each position, determines whether it retains；And the position of reservation is clustered, one probability of pro rate of all possible position points is accounted for according to element number in each class, the highest m class of probability is chosen as the class where objective body actual position, it is weighted averagely, while obtaining the specific location of more life entities.The above method has effectively removed wrong solution and false solution, realizes multiple target while positioning.

title_en: A kind of earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to air vehicle technique fields, especially a kind of earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned plane, including six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, the top of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles is equipped with GPS instrument, six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles are fixedly connected with GPS instrument, the lower end of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles is fixedly connected with fixed disk, sliding slot is offered in fixed disk, sliding block is equipped in sliding slot, sliding slot and sliding block are slidably connected, the inner wall of sliding slot and the outer surface of sliding block match, the lower end of sliding block is equipped with holder, sliding block is fixedly connected with holder, the lower end of holder offers cavity, positioning device is equipped in cavity, positioning device includes shockproof box, extension spring, placement plate, GPS module and combined aural and visual alarm, placement plate is located in shockproof box, sponge is fixedly connected on the inner roof wall of shockproof box, life is detected by radar life-detection instrument, repositioning is thrown Locator facilitates and searches and rescues team member's accurate positionin to the position of trapped person, and the time is searched and rescued in shortening, and convenient, efficient, accurate.

title_en: Life monitoring and rescuing device for cooperative robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative robot which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a cooperative robot arranged on a mobile robot, a vital sign monitoring device, an alarm rescue device and a main control device, wherein the vital sign monitoring device comprises a biological radar, the alarm rescue device and the main control device are arranged on the mobile robot, the mobile robot monitors that a target falls into the coverage range of the vital sign monitoring device through the vital sign monitoring device, the main control device makes a decision according to a signal uploaded by the vital sign monitoring device, positions the target according to a visual positioning device and starts the alarm rescue device to act, the alarm rescue device comprises a height adjusting component, a transverse moving mounting seat and a rescue bed component, the height of the cooperative robot is controlled through the height adjusting component, the extending length of the cooperative robot is controlled through the transverse moving adjusting component, and the cooperative robot is matched with the visual positioning device to control a grabbing piece to move the target to the rescue bed component.
assignees: CHUANGKE TIANXIA BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Respiration detection method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar signals
abstract_en: The invention designs a respiration detection method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar signals. The method mainly comprises three modules: a quick screening module based on cosine similarity, an optimal channel screening module based on distance dimension total energy and a breathing rate estimation module based on WOA-VMD. The rapid screening module can primarily screen a group of channels with larger difference from a plurality of channels of the MIMO millimeter wave radar. The optimal channel screening module further selects a channel with the largest distance dimension total energy from the group of channels. And finally, the respiratory rate estimation module sequentially performs phase unwrapping, phase difference calculation and self-adaptive optimal modal decomposition on the radar signals in the optimal channel, so that the respiratory rate is extracted. The method solves the problem that the target is far away from the radar and has larger breath detection error when deviating from the radar, and improves the breath detection accuracy based on radar signals.

title_en: Portable life detection radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of life detection radar equipment, and discloses a portable life detection radar which comprises a device shell, wherein the device shell is hollow, communication grooves are uniformly formed in the bottom end of the device shell, a cover plate is arranged at the top end of the device shell, and a linkage mechanism is arranged between the cover plate and the device shell; the detection equipment is arranged in the device shell, and a buffer mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the detection equipment. The invention reduces the weight of the total equipment by eliminating unnecessary equipment, realizes more convenient carrying, can realize quick linkage starting and locking closing of the equipment under the action of the linkage mechanism in the equipment, effectively improves the starting efficiency of the equipment, can quickly enter a rescue state, and can realize automatic cleaning operation on the bottom end of the inner wall of the shell of the device when the equipment is closed and locked under the linkage of the transmission mechanism and the cleaning mechanism, thereby being more convenient to maintain.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Multi-target vital sign detection method of TDM-MIMO millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target vital sign detection method of a TDM-MIMO millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of firstly controlling a transmitting antenna to transmit signals to a target area under a TDM-MIMO mode of the millimeter wave MIMO radar, simultaneously controlling a receiving antenna to receive echo signals reflected by the target area, extracting and recombining the echo signals to form array signals, then carrying out distance FFT, carrying out static clutter filtering by using a phasor mean value cancellation algorithm, carrying out forward and backward spatial smoothing and spatial spectrum estimation, carrying out two-dimensional constant false alarm rate detection and clustering to realize two-dimensional plane positioning of a human body target, then carrying out phase unwrapping and smoothing treatment to obtain a phase difference value sequence, finally carrying out iterative optimization on parameters of a variational modal decomposition algorithm by using an improved sinusoidal algorithm to guide a dung beetle optimization algorithm, and carrying out variational modal decomposition on the phase difference value sequence by using the parameters after iterative optimization to obtain vital sign parameters of each human body target. The method has stronger environmental adaptability and improves the reliability and the automation degree of detection.

title_en: Multi-person heartbeat and respiration information monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person heartbeat and respiration information monitoring method and system, which comprise the steps of adopting 1-transmission N-reception mode to emit wide beams by a radar antenna, enabling N receiving antennas to receive echo signals, utilizing a digital beam forming algorithm to conduct multi-target identification, obtaining initial azimuth angles of all targets, utilizing a sum-difference angle measuring algorithm to correct the initial azimuth angles of all targets to obtain final azimuth angles of all targets, mixing echo signals of all target azimuth angles with local oscillation signals to obtain intermediate frequency signals, taking the intermediate frequency signals as input of discrete wavelet transformation to obtain frequency spectrums of all targets, locking distance unit information of all targets, meanwhile dynamically adjusting discrete wavelet transformation coefficients to adapt to signal change by combining an adaptive filtering algorithm based on minimum mean square error, and conducting signal processing on the distance unit information of all targets to obtain multi-target vital sign information. The invention can realize the monitoring of the heartbeat and respiratory information of multiple people and simultaneously ensure the real-time performance and the accuracy of a monitoring system.

title_en: Fire escape room fire door
title_ko: 화재 대피실용 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology for a fire door for a fire shelter, which enables evacuees to temporarily escape from a fire which occurs in a high-rise structure such as an apartment or a building, and more particularly, to technology for a fire door for a fire shelter, which prevents personal injuries such as suffocation and burns caused by a toxic gas inside a fire shelter by blocking heat and the toxic gas transferred to the inside of the fire shelter and preventing thermal deformation of the fire door. The fire door installed at the entrance of a fire shelter in an apartment or a building comprises: a heat shielding interior material embedded in the fire door; heat shielding boards attached to the front and rear of the heat shielding interior material; and see-through holes installed to check the interior of the fire shelter, in which an exterior panel surrounds the outsides of the heat shielding interior material and the heat shielding boards.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 아파트 또는 빌딩 등의 고층 건물에서 화재가 발생할 경우 일시적으로 대피하는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술로서, 대피실의 내부로 전달되는 고온의 열과 유독가스를 차단하고, 방화문의 열변형을 방지하므로, 대피실의 내부에서 유독가스로 인한 질식사고와 화상 등의 인명피해를 방지하는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술이다. 
이러한 본 발명의 주요 구성은, 아파트 또는 빌딩 등의 공동 주택에서 화재 대피실의 입구에 설치되는 방화문에 있어서, 상기 방화문의 내부에 내장되는 차열내장재; 상기 차열내장재의 전면부와 후면부에 부착되는 차열보드; 및 상기 차열내장재와 차열보드의 외부를 외장패널이 감싸 구성되고, 대피실의 내부를 확인하기 위하여 설치된 투시홀;을 포함하여 구현된다.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Target search and localization method based on the more sensing points of life detection radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of target search and localization method based on the more sensing points of life detection radar, detected on multiple sensing points using life detection radar, life body position is solved based on more sensing point criterions, and constantly repeat to determine position using closest principle, positioning precision and detection probability, the search coverage for improving life entity locus are big, hardware cost is relatively low, is easy to realize in actual applications.

title_en: False alarm eliminating method for handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: A false alarm eliminating method for a handheld through-wall radar comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring strong reflection point distance information; detecting the internal area of the building through a handheld one-dimensional through-wall radar detection system, acquiring a strong reflection point signal in the building, and solving the distance information of the strong reflection point; step S2: acquiring target point distance information; simultaneously acquiring target signals of an internal area of a building through a through-wall radar, and solving target point distance information; step S3: matching the characteristics; matching the obtained distance information of the target point signal of the internal area of the building with the obtained distance information of the strong reflection point of the internal area of the building to obtain a target signal with matched characteristics, filtering false alarms and counting; step S4: matching results; and matching the real-time target detection result with the false alarm statistical result to further eliminate the false alarm. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, good real-time performance and high efficiency, and can effectively inhibit false alarms caused by the distribution of the internal structure of the building.

title_en: Sign contactless intelligent monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based physical sign contactless intelligent monitoring system, wherein a millimeter wave radar front-end module transmits and receives millimeter wave radar signals and is connected with a signal processing module; the signal processing module is connected with the communication interface module, analyzes the sampled and quantized echo signals to obtain vital sign data of a tested person, including frequency parameters of respiration and heartbeat, and transmits the processed information result to the upper computer through the communication interface module; and the upper computer compares the received vital sign data with preset data, uploads the data and comparison results to the background server, and gives an alarm to the mobile terminal if the comparison results are abnormal, and automatically gives an alarm when the comparison results exceed a preset maximum value. The intelligent monitoring system and the intelligent monitoring method realize real-time intelligent monitoring of vital signs of the old in the room, including monitoring of breathing and heartbeat parameters, and realize real-time alarm when abnormality occurs so as to prevent accidents.

title_en: Target imaging method and system based on multipath echo suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of through-wall radar target imaging, in particular to a target imaging method and system based on multipath echo suppression, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original echo of a through-wall radar; determining pixel point amplitude and multipath echo peak values in a target amplitude image according to original echoes and multipath propagation coefficients by using a delay and sum wave beam forming algorithm, carrying out echo cancellation according to the pixel point amplitude and the multipath echo peak values to obtain a plurality of wall body cancellation echoes, fusing the plurality of wall body cancellation echoes to determine a fused image, imaging the original echoes by using a BP algorithm to obtain echo images, sequentially carrying out region division and sequencing on the echo images to obtain a pixel point set, carrying out overlapping target screening according to the pixel point set, an amplitude threshold value and a region limiting proportion to obtain an overlapping target image, and carrying out superposition according to the fused image and the overlapping target image to determine the target image. The invention improves the accuracy of target imaging by eliminating part of echo.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and labeling method thereof
title_ko: 전자 장치 및 그의 레이블링 방법
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 전자 장치는 버튼을 포함하는 사용자 입력부, 사용자의 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 사용자에게 청각 자극을 제공하기 위한 오디오를 출력하는 오디오 출력부 및 센서를 통해 상기 사용자의 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 측정하는 동안 오디오 출력부를 통해 오디오를 출력하고, 버튼을 통해 입력된 출력된 오디오에 대한 사용자의 반응에 기초하여 사용자의 의식 상태를 판단하고, 측정된 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 판단된 의식 상태별로 구분하여 레이블링하는 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Indicator light equipement for a fire shelter
title_ko: 화재대피를 위한 소방피난유도기구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire evacuation guide device for evacuation from fire, the fire evacuation guide device comprising: a case (10) buried to be exposed on a wall body; a guide plate (20) installed to be foldable on the case(10); an LED electronic display (30) which is installed on the guide plate (20) and visually displays characters or a design; a linear actuator (40) which folds the guide plate (20); a fire sensor (50) which senses an emergency situation and outputs the same; a control unit (60) which receives transmission of a signal from the fire sensor (50) and controls operation of the LED electronic display (30) and the linear actuator (40); and a battery (70) which supplies power to the LED electronic display (30), the linear actuator (40), the fire sensor (50), and the control unit (60). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fire evacuation guide device displays a location of an emergency exit while not interrupting pedestrian′s passage since the guide plate is inserted in a wall body in a common situation. When a fire occurs, the guide plate and the LED electronic display are folded and protrude from the wall body. Consequently, visibility of displaying a location of the emergency exit is significantly increased, and the fire evacuation device can guide people to escape in a rapid manner.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재대피를 위한 소방피난유도기구에 관한 것으로서, 벽체 노출되게 매설되는 케이스(10); 케이스(10)에 접철가능하게 설치되는 안내판(20); 안내판(20)에 설치되어 문자나 도안을 시각적으로 표시하는 LED전광판(30); 안내판(20)을 절첩하는 리니어액추에이터(40); 비상상황을 감지해 출력하는 화재감지센서(50); 화재감지센서(50)로부터 신호를 전달받아 LED전광판(30) 및 리니어액추에이터(40)를 동작제어하는 제어부(60); LED전광판(30), 리니어액추에이터(40), 화재감지센서(50), 제어부(60)로 전원을 공급하는 축전지(70)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면, 평상시에는 안내판이 벽체에 인입되어 있기 때문에 보행자의 통행을 방해하지 않으면서 비상구의 위치를 표시하고, 화재발생시에는 안내판과 LED전광판이 접히면서 벽체로부터 돌출됨에 따라 비상구의 위치 표시에 대한 시인성을 획기적으로 높여주어 화재의 위험으로부터 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있다.

title_en: Air-coupled type ground penetrating radar antenna
title_ko: 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 안테나
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground-spaced type bistatic ground penetrating radar (GPR) antenna and, more specifically, to a ground-spaced type GPR antenna which reduces a direct wave that is a factor limiting imaging performance of a system when receiving in a receiving party of the GPR antenna by placing a loop antenna to be vertical to an antenna plane at a receiver point and allowing a feeding direction to be orthogonal to a feeding direction of a transmitter and the ground. The ground-spaced type GPR antenna spaced apart from the ground comprises: a transmitting antenna directed to the ground and penetrating a radio wave into the ground; and a receiving antenna receiving a radio wave which is radiated from the transmitting antenna and reflected from the ground, and fed to be perpendicular to the ground surface and the feeding direction of the transmitting antenna. The transmitting antenna uses a horn antenna having directivity and the receiving antenna uses a loop antenna in which a physical plane of the antenna is positioned to be perpendicular to the ground surface, thereby improving radar detection performance of the ground-spaced type GPR system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지면 이격형 바이스태틱 지표투과레이다 안테나에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 수신기 지점에 루프 안테나를 안테나 평면에 수직이 되게 놓고 급전방향을 송신기의 급전방향 및 지표면과 직교가 되게 구성하여 지표투과레이다 안테나(Ground Penetrating Radar, 이하 GPR이라 칭함)의 수신측에서 수신하는 경우 시스템의 영상화 성능을 제한하는 요소인 직접파를 감소시킨 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 안테나에 관한 것으로서, 지면에서 이격하여 구성된 지면 이격형 GPR 안테나에 있어서, 지면으로 지향시키고 내부로 전파를 침투시키도록 구성되는 송신안테나; 상기 송신안테나로부터 방사되어 상기 지중으로부터 반사되어 돌아오는 전파를 수신하고 상기 송신안테나의 급전 방향 및 지표면과 직각을 이루도록 급전받는 수신안테나;를 포함하고, 상기 송신안테나는 지향성을 갖는 혼 안테나를, 상기 수신안테나는 안테나의 물리적 평면이 지표면에 대해 수직을 이루도록 위치시킨 루프 안테나를 사용하도록 구성되어 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 시스템의 레이다 탐지 성능을 향상시키는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KOREA INST GEOSCIENCE & MINERAL RESOURCES KIGAM

title_en: FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection
title_ko: 생체 신호 감지를 위한 fmcw 레이다 목표물 탐지 측정 방법
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 감지를 위한 FMCW 레이다 목표물 탐지 측정 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 레이다를 이용한 생체 신호 감지 방법은, 미세 움직임으로 인한 IF 신호의 위상 변화 프로파일과 표적 신호 세기 변화 프로파일 간의 상관관계를 이용하여 정확한 생체 신호가 존재하는 거리 빈을 선택함으로써, 사람(표적)에 대한 정확한 추적을 통해 생체 신호의 추정 정확성을 높이고, 180도 고정형 위상 언래핑 기술 대비 상체 움직임 변화량에 적응형인 위상 언래핑 기술을 활용하여 클러터를 정확하게 제거할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for the detection, recording and reporting of hazardous materials and illegal activity
abstract_en: A system and method for the detection, recording, and reporting of matter and energy related to hazardous and illegal substances in enclosed and semi-enclosed spaces The system and method relate to the early detection of hazardous materials and illegal actions commonly associated with criminal and terrorist activities This 'around-the-clock' security shield integrates audio, video and sensor detection (passive deterrence) with real-time monitoring, communications, and data recording (active deterrence) The system can function as a stationary or mobile recording-reporting device(2) for the detection of biological agents, toxic chemicals, dirty bombs, electromagnetic radiation, human presence, drugs associated with volatile organic chemicals (VOCs). and occasions of negligent oversight The primary component of the system is a solid-state detection unit(2) housed in a compact case which ma) be mounted for mobile or stationary applications The detection unit(2) includes a variety of detectors( 18,22.24) and sensors(20), power supply(10a I Ob), and communication interfaces

title_en: FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection
abstract_en: There is provided an FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection. A method for detecting vital signals by using radar selects a range bin where there are accurate vital signals by using a correlation between a phase change profile of an IF signal caused by a minute motion, and a target signal intensity change profile, so that accuracy of estimation of vital signals can be enhanced through exact tracking of a person (target). In addition, clutter may be exactly removed by utilizing a phase unwrapping technique which is adaptive to an upper body motion change compared to a 180-degree fixed phase unwrapping technique.

title_en: Personnel search for and rescue and environmental monitoring system based on zigBee
abstract_en: Personnel search for and rescue and environmental monitoring system based on zigBee, this system involve internet of things field and intelligent control, search and rescue field. This system includes host computer terminal, zigBee gateway, location basis of reference point, search and rescue mobile terminal, sensor group. Sensor network keeps away the barrier module including infrared life detection module, environment monitor sensor, ultrasonic wave to and MSP430 microcontroller. This system adopts the microprocessor and the wireless transmission module of low -power consumption, very big reduction system power dissipation, overcome patrolling of current search and rescue system short between flight time, search for and rescue the problem that the success rate is low, adopt the trilateral location algorithm based on RSSI, further improved stranded personnel's coordinate positioning accuracy to implement effective rescue, simultaneously multiple environment monitor sensor has been carried on in this system, also can exert very big effect to in the aspect of calamity prevention and the processing, this very big promotion the practicality of this system.

title_en: Novel gardens are with sign of taking router device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel gardens are with sign of taking router device, including base, lifter and device body, the base on be provided with the device body through the lifter, be provided with the plant basin on the base, the lifter adopts the cavity design, the bottom is provided with pre -buried signal cable in the base. The utility model discloses can utilize ordinary electric wire transmission network signal, the wireless router of rethread on it carries out WIFI data transmission and surfs the net, as long as at the appropriate within range of device body, can all receive WIFI data resources, makes people's operation of also can surfing the net in park, gardens, and life and the work given people bring the facility, it carries out cartographic information show and emergency information respectively and demonstrates to give people and bring information acquisition convenient and fast more to set up simultaneously cartographic information panel and emergency information screen on the device body, it to provide the function of charging to link to each other with the battery through the power supply USB interface.

title_en: Robot for detecting and positioning fire scene and life
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene and life detection positioning robot, which comprises a base, wherein a cooling system is arranged in the base, a detection device is arranged on the base, and a moving device is arranged at the bottom of the base; the detection device comprises a shell arranged on the base, a fireproof infrared camera arranged on the shell, a temperature detector arranged on the shell, a wireless data transmitter arranged in the shell and a microcontroller arranged in the base and connected with the wireless data transmitter; the cooling system comprises a cavity arranged in the base, a group of through holes arranged at the top of the base, a cooling pipe arranged on the inner side surfaces of the cavity and the shell, and a micro circulating pump arranged in the cavity, wherein the through holes are connected with the cavity and positioned at the bottom of the shell, and two ends of the micro circulating pump are respectively connected with two ends of the cooling pipe.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system which comprises a UWB (Ultra-Wide Bandwidth) radar front end and a signal processing display unit. The system can realize real-time and non-contact monitoring on physiological parameters of a human body, such as respiration, body movement signals, respiratory rate, and the like under the condition of penetrating through a thicker nonmetal obstacle. The ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system is mainly used for the physiological parameter monitoring of patients which are not suitable for being connected with electrodes and a sensor in a ward, such as large-area burn patients, and the like, can be also used for carrying out non-contact real-time monitoring on buried wounded people (who can not be rescued in short time) in the disasters, such as earthquake, and the like and provides necessary reference for search and rescue staffs applying medical rescue to learn the vital sign condition of a rescued object at any time.

title_en: Moving body location and error correction method for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving body location and error correction method for through-wall radar. Target distance sums under two receiving channels are used for obtaining the virtual position of a target through direct oval cross location, the virtual distance sums of a virtual target are obtained on the basis of known wall parameters, distance sum correction quantities are obtained by subtracting the target distance sums from the virtual distance sums, finally, the correction quantities are subtracted from the distance sums of the real target, oval cross location is conducted, and target location and error correction are finished. The position deviation caused by wall electromagnetism penetration to target location is corrected, the moving target location accuracy of the through-wall radar is improved, and the robustness of follow-up tracking processing is guaranteed. Compared with existing method, the moving body location and error correction method for the through-wall radar has the advantages that computation is simple and convenient, and the real-time performance and practicability are high.

title_en: Device for carrying out early warning on geological disasters by applying sensors and wireless network
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for carrying out early warning on geological disasters by applying sensors and a wireless network, and belongs to the fields of sensors, electronics and wireless communication. The device comprises sensor modules, a wireless transmitting module, a wireless receiving module, a signal processing module and an information publishing module, wherein the sensor modules are arranged in places such as a detected mountain, a steep slope and a dam where the disasters occur easily, and the wireless receiving module is installed at an information center. Natural disasters such as heavy rain, flood and small variations in geological structure cause mountain slope or landslide, and thus severe threats are imposed on the public property and the life and property of people. The device provided by the invention aims to prevent the disasters timely. A stress sensor is buried in the detected mountain or the steep slope, once the stress change exceeds a certain limit, a network alarm can inform a command monitoring center through a 3G wireless network, and passing vehicles, pedestrians, and surrounding residents and organizations can be informed to take preventive measures quickly.

title_en: Water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system, which is characterized in that a water condition monitoring device, a soil monitoring device and an early warning notification terminal are arranged to notify flood condition information of villagers in real time, and if flood disasters are predicted to occur, the villagers can be notified to evacuate at the first time, so that the problem of low efficiency caused by the combination of the existing broadcast and artificial notification is solved, and the notification timeliness of villages influenced by flood periods is improved. Simultaneously through be provided with the monitoring subassembly on the soil monitoring devices and bore the integrated structure of native subassembly and flexible subassembly for at the in-process of installation or maintenance, drive the mode that bores native subassembly and monitoring subassembly and remove through its flexible subassembly of electric control, with the sensor is buried underground or pulled out to the quick realization, thereby installation or the maintenance progress of monitoring devices are in order to ensure during the quickening flood season the monitoring of water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system is ageing.
assignees: GEOVIS SHENZHEN DIGITAL TECH INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with a vital sign monitoring system, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a reinforcing ring is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the equipment main body, a fixing strip is arranged on one side of the equipment main body, a display screen and a buzzer are arranged on the front side of the fixing strip, a water storage tank is embedded in the bottom of the equipment main body, the water storage tank consists of a water diversion mechanism, a water absorption layer and a pull buckle, the water absorption layer is inserted into the bottom of the water storage tank, the water diversion mechanism is arranged on the upper part of the water absorption layer, the pull buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the water absorption layer, an inner cavity is arranged on the inner side of the equipment main body, a sweat detection sensor and a liquid collection rod are arranged on the side surface of the inner cavity, a monitoring system is arranged in the equipment main body, and the individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with the vital sign monitoring system is characterized, Blood pressure detection module and heart rate detection module carry out comprehensive control to temperature, blood pressure and heart rate.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Radar-based single-target life sensing
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to radar-based single-target life sensing. In one embodiment, a method includes: generating a target displacement signal indicative of motion of a human target based on raw digital data generated by the millimeter wave radar sensor; and estimating a vital sign of the human target based on the target displacement signal, wherein generating the target displacement signal comprises: generating target in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) (I/Q) data associated with the human target based on the raw digital data, classifying the target I/Q data as either high quality data or low quality data using a first neural network, discarding the target I/Q data when the target I/Q data is classified as low quality data, performing an elliptic fit on the target I/Q data when the target I/Q data is classified as high quality data to generate compensated I/Q data, and generating a target displacement signal based on the compensated I/Q data.

title_en: Emergency rescue personnel health state research and judgment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for studying and judging the health state of emergency rescue workers, and relates to the technical field of human body protection. The intelligent fire extinguishing protective clothing comprises a fire extinguishing protective clothing body, a flexible sensing system, a communication system, a performance evaluation and safety early warning system and an individual soldier display system, wherein the performance evaluation and safety early warning system comprises a wide-temperature-range human body thermal reaction module, a skin burn module and a multi-source information fusion module, and the multi-source information fusion module comprises a feature extraction sub-module, a prediction sub-module, a conversion sub-module and a combination sub-module. The invention introduces an active protection technology, and through the comprehensive application of the wide-temperature-range human thermal reaction module, the skin burn module and the multi-source information fusion module, the space-time distribution of the toxic gas concentration in the rescue operation environment, the operation track and vital sign state of rescue workers can be displayed in real time, and the dangerous area classification, the accurate evaluation of the operation efficiency and the intelligent early warning of the health state can be performed based on the acquired data.

title_en: Using environmental friendly materials so thick, Thermal and noncombustible fire door
title_ko: 친환경소재 이용한 방음, 단열, 불연성 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention provides a noncombustible fireproof door manufactured only using environmentally friendly materials such as earth, straw, sawdust, charcoal and corn to prevent the shortcoming and weakness of a traditional fireproof door, as described above. The present invention can reduce casualties and property damages in the case of a fire as the present invention is never burned by any strong fire. The present invention can be separated and recycled when discarded and the waste is separated without being incinerated or buried so that metallic materials can be returned to a steel mill and environmentally friendly materials can be returned to nature. Therefore, environmental problems together with global warming can be solved simultaneously. Also, once the noncombustible fireproof door is installed, soundproofing and insulation can also be provided in addition to fireproofing. Moreover, the present invention gives a large profit to industries and societies and will be greatly influential in preventing global warming and conserving nature as the present invention can give social and economic benefits to consumers owing to long life and environmental friendliness.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위에서 서술한바와 같이 종래의 방화문의 단점과 취약점을 방지하고자 그야말로 친환경소재인 흙과 짚, 톱밥과 숯,옥수수를 100% 이용하여 불연성방화문을 만들어 졌기때문에 그 어떤 강력한 화재에도 전혀 불에 타지 않아 화재시 인명피해와 재산피해를 크게 줄일수 있으며 , 
폐기처리시 분리하여 다시 재활용할수도 있고, 폐기물이 소각되거나 매립되는 일이 없이 분리되어 금속자재는 제강소로 , 친환경소재들은 자연으로 다시 돌아갈수 있어 지구온난화와 함께 환경문제도 동시에 해결해줄수 있는 그야말로 일석오조의 금상첨화를 얻을수 있다. 
또한 방화뿐만 아니라 이 불연성방화문이 설치시공완료되면 방음과 단열 도 동시에 해결할수 있고 긴수명과 환경친화성을 띠어 소비자들에게 사회적, 경제적이익을 줄수있기때문에 나아가서는 산업과 사회에 막대한 이익을 가져오며 , 
지구온난화를 방지하고 환경을 보전하는데 크나큰 영향력을 발휘할것이다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting status of vehicle occupant
title_ko: 차량 탑승자 상태 감지방법 및 차량 탑승자 상태 감지장치
