abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for detecting a state of a vehicle occupant, which can control operation of a vehicle internal device or vehicle driving to respond to a change in a body of an occupant estimated in communication with the vehicle internal device in a 5G communication environment after executing an on-board artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm to acquire a biosignal of the occupant getting in the vehicle, and measuring a change in a body of the occupant through a movement signal, a breathing signal, and a heart rate signal in the acquired biosignal of the occupant. According to the present invention, after extracting movement, breathing, and heart rate signals of the occupant getting in the vehicle through an RF sensor mounted in the vehicle, based on the extracted biosignal of the occupant, a state of an occupant body is estimated to inform the occupant that the state of the body is estimated to be a biosignal deviant from a normal state.
abstract_ko: 탑재된 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI) 알고리즘 및/또는 기계학습(machine learning) 알고리즘을 실행하여 차량에 탑승한 탑승자의 생체신호를 취득하고, 취득한 탑승자 생체신호에서 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호 및 심박수 신호를 통해 탑승자의 신체 변화를 측정한 뒤, 5G 통신 환경에서 차량 내부 기기와 통신하여 추정된 탑승자의 신체 변화에 대응할 수 있도록 차량 내부 기기의 구동을 제어하거나 차량 운행을 제어할 수 있는 차량 탑승자 상태 감지방법 및 차량 탑승자 상태 감지장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 의하여 차량 내 탑재된 RF 센서를 통해 차량에 탑승한 탑승자의 움직임, 호흡, 심박수 신호를 추출한 뒤, 추출된 탑승자의 생체신호를 기초로 탑승자의 신체 상태를 추정하여 신체 상태가 정상상태를 벗어난 생체신호로 추정되면, 이를 탑승자에 알릴 수 있다.

title_en: Fire protection water tank type electric vehicle fire protection device with firewall
title_ko: 방화벽 겸용 방화수조형 전기자동차 방화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire water tank type electric vehicle firefighting apparatus functioning as a firewall. The fire water tank type electric vehicle firefighting apparatus includes: a fire floor formed in a size including a lower area of a vehicle to function as a vehicle parking space floor; fire airbags buried and installed consecutively in the periphery of the fire floor; a fire detection sensor installed on the fire floor to detect a fire on a parked electric vehicle; an inflator embedded in the fire airbags to actuate the airbags; and a control circuit part installed in the fire floor, and sensing a signal of the fire detection sensor to output an operation control signal of the inflator. Therefore, in case of a fire on the electric vehicle parked on the fire floor, the airbags are actuated to form a slope firewall. In accordance with the present invention, the fire water tank type electric vehicle firefighting apparatus functioning as a firewall can be conveniently installed in a parking lot, and can be installed one by one on each parking position with a minimized parking space invasion issue.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방화벽 겸용 방화수조형 전기자동차 방화장치에 관한 것으로서, 자동차 하부 면적을 포함하는 크기로 형성되어 자동차 주차 공간 바닥이 되는 방화바닥; 상기 방화바닥 외주변에 연속하여 매몰 설치되는 방화 에어백; 상기 방화바닥에 설치되어 주차된 전기자동차의 화재를 감지하는 화재 감지센서; 상기 방화 에어백에 내장되어 에어백을 작동시키는 인플레이터; 상기 방화바닥 내부에 설치되며, 화재 감지센서의 신호를 감지하여 상기 인플레이터의 작동 제어신호를 출력시키는 제어 회로부;를 포함하여 구성되어 상기 방화바닥에 주차된 전기자동차의 화재 발생시 상기 에어백이 작동하여 사면 방화벽을 형성시키는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의하여, 주차장 내 설치가 간편하고, 주차 공간의 침해 문제가 최소화되어 각 주차 위치당 하나씩 설치 가능한 방화벽 겸용 방화수조형 전기자동차 방화장치를 제공되는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Contactless detection and monitoring system of vital signs of vehicle occupants
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and systems for detecting vital signs of occupants in vehicles, for example, the vehicle cabin. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receiving the radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to vibration data of the vehicle, to produce a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine the vital signs of the occupant.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Vital-sign radar sensor using wireless internet signals
abstract_en: A vital-sign radar sensor uses wireless internet signals to detect vital signs. It includes a first and second demodulation unit to demodulate an incident and reflected wireless internet signal with an injection-locked oscillator into a first and second demodulated signal, respectively. The combined use of the first and second demodulated signals can eliminate the influence of communication modulation on the extraction process of a Doppler shift due to vital signs. Moreover, the vital-sign radar sensor is a receive-only device so that it won't cause interference to ambient wireless communication networks.

title_en: System and method for continous and real-time locating and tracking scraper using uav
abstract_en: A method includes: launching an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) parallel to a buried pipeline; sending a plurality of transmitted ground penetrating radar (GPR) waves to the buried pipeline using a GPR antenna of the UAV; receiving a received GPR wave from the buried pipeline such that the received GPR wave is a combination of a reflected GPR wave with a ringing noise signal from the one or more scrapers; measuring one or more parameters of the received GPR wave and determining if values of the one or more parameters are within a predefined threshold region; recording location coordinates and a time stamp of the one or more scrapers by analyzing the received GPR wave; and sending the location coordinates and the time stamp of the one or more scrapers to a controller unit for continuous and real-time locating and tracking movement of the one or more scrapers.

title_en: Detection city landslide causes fuel gas conduit to bury the packaged type device for squeezing off leakage
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of detection city landslide and fuel gas conduit is caused to bury the packaged type device for squeezing off leakage, belongs to Urban Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and hazards control field.The device collects the infrasound signal at the gas pipeline fracture leakage of burial by infrasound sensor measuring system to detect the degree of injury of gas pipeline.The leakage degree of injury for the city gas pipeline buried by burst landslide can be precisely detected using the present apparatus; buried pipes combustible gas leakage information can be detected with real-time early warning; mobile system is welded on the bottom end of full guard support cover by the present apparatus simultaneously; pass through several rotating pulleys and annular scraper set up; it can guarantee that the packaged type in the planarization and arbitrary region of present apparatus detecting location flexibly detects; several probe energy close contact Rock And Soils for ensuring to set up guarantee the accuracy of detection.

title_en: Three-dimensional rendering method and system for underground buried object based on three-dimensional ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional rendering method and a three-dimensional rendering system for an underground buried object based on a three-dimensional ground penetrating radar, wherein the three-dimensional rendering method for the underground buried object comprises the following steps: step S1, extracting target radar data according to a designated position; s2, preprocessing the extracted radar data, including removing direct waves of the extracted target radar data, eliminating background transverse waves of data of each channel, applying reverse amplitude attenuation gain to the data of each channel and removing low-frequency noise of the channel; step S3, calculating and projecting the processed radar data to obtain a full-channel data slice set; s4, processing data of the full-channel data slice set by utilizing an edge detection algorithm to obtain a slice set for separating a target waveform from background clutter; and S5, performing three-dimensional rendering on the targets separated in the slice set. The invention combines various filtering and data preprocessing, thereby being capable of effectively separating underground buried objects and effectively performing three-dimensional rendering.

title_en: Method for operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection, which eliminates signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system (100), the radar sensor system (100) being configured to determine range and speed information for vital sign detection from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior (116) of a vehicle (114), the method comprising the steps of: the reflected and received signals are decomposed into range and velocity information to measure movement over time in a designated range gate and evaluate similarity between them. Based on the characteristics of the similar behavior range bin, it may be decided whether any detected movements are related to internal or external disturbances or vital signs.

title_en: Method and device for identifying human body behaviors of through-wall radar based on multilink information decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar human body behavior recognition method and device based on multi-link information decision, which comprise the steps of obtaining an original image of through-wall radar human body behavior echo, preprocessing the original image, carrying out Bayesian statistical decision on micro Doppler signal characteristics by a first link to obtain a first link recognition result, obtaining visual layer local characteristics from the processed image by a second link to obtain a second link recognition result, obtaining visual layer global characteristics from the processed image by a third link, namely classifying the processed image by a residual neural network introducing an attention mechanism to obtain a third link recognition result, and fusing the first link recognition result, the second link recognition result and the third link recognition result to obtain a final recognition result. The invention realizes the identification of high accuracy and high information utilization rate under severe conditions such as fuzzy radar imaging, low signal-to-noise ratio and the like.

title_en: Frequency estimation method, storage medium and device based on rootMUSIC and signal dimension conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological signal processing, in particular to a frequency estimation method, a storage medium and equipment based on rootMUSIC and signal dimension conversion. The method comprises the steps of modeling chest displacement signals extracted from radar echoes into the sum of sine waves with integral multiple frequencies of basic respiration and heart rate, generating corresponding single-channel analysis signals through Hilbert transformation, converting the single-channel analysis signals into multi-channel data through a signal rearrangement method, enabling chest wall signal models to be equivalent to uniform linear array multi-snapshot receiving signal models, enabling vital sign frequencies to be in one-to-one correspondence with the arrival directions of signal sources, processing the receiving data of the multi-snapshot receiving signal models through an alternate direction multiplier method frame, solving denoised signal matrixes, and carrying out frequency estimation on the denoised signal matrixes by using rootMUSIC algorithm to calculate roots. The invention converts the signal model, so that the frequency estimation range is equivalent to the angle estimation range, and the frequency estimation precision is improved.

title_en: Wireless tag, apparatus and method for measuring biological signal using the tag
title_ko: 무선 태그와 이를 이용한 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 차량 내 좌석벨트에 장착 가능한 무선 태그로부터 수신되는 탑승자의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 생체신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 기설정된 레이더 신호를 상기 무선 태그로 송신하고, 상기 레이더 신호에 대한 반사 신호로서 탑승자의 생체변화에 따른 전파의 주파수 신호가 고조파 신호로 변조된 레이더 반사 신호를 상기 무선 태그로부터 수신하는 레이더부 및 상기 레이더부로부터 수신된 상기 레이더 반사 신호에 대하여 주파수 영역 분석을 통해 탑승자의 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호를 검출하기 위한 신호 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Near field subwavelength focusing synthetic aperture radar with chemical detection mode
abstract_en: Detection of objects such as a buried explosive device while operating from a moving platform using a radio frequency emission system having two modes. An electromagnetic wave emission and detection system operates in a first mode to locate objects of interest and in a second mode to determine if an object contains explosive materials. In the first mode, the emission and detection system preferably operates as a subwavelength focusing, wideband, superlens using a near field super gain synthetic aperture continuous wave (CW) swept radar. In the second mode the system preferably enabled after detection of an object in the first mode, uses chemical detection methods such as Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance (NQR).

title_en: A kind of breathing mask of the traceable sign of life based on baroceptor
abstract_en: The breathing mask for the traceable sign of life based on baroceptor that the utility model discloses a kind of, including mask bodies and main control module, the front end installation settings of mask bodies has filter poison cover, the two sides of mask bodies front end, which are respectively mounted, is provided with oral area respirator, the rear end of mask bodies is provided with the headband for wearing, oxygen concentration sensor and alarm indicator are installed, the inside of mask bodies is also equipped with main control module, baroceptor, blood oxygen transducer, power supply and wireless transport module at the top of mask bodies.Baroceptor and blood oxygen transducer are provided in the utility model, the vital sign of detectable mask wearer, and it prompts to withdraw before user's asphyxia or anoxic, or pass through wireless transport module automatic alarm when asphyxia or anoxic are alarmed, and it is positioned by GPS, to implement treatment and transfer in time, convenient for the progress of security protection work.

title_en: Telescopic distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic distributing type radar life detection location is equipped, including the radar unit more than two, adjacent two link to each other through a telescopic machanism between the radar unit, telescopic machanism is used for drawing big or reducing adjacent two distance between the radar unit. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, easy and simple to handle, application scope are wide, can realize multi-mode detection etc.

title_en: Earthquake wave underground construction space observation system and method based on random arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake wave underground construction space observation system and method based on random arrangement, and belongs to a geological survey method of underground construction. The system comprises an earthquake wave trigger and an earthquake wave receiver, the earthquake wave trigger and the earthquake wave receiver are both connected into a data acquisition instrument, and the data acquisition instrument is further connected into a computer. The earthquake wave trigger comprises a plurality of kinds of earthquake wave excitation devices, and respective starting switches are arranged on the earthquake wave excitation devices. The earthquake wave receiver comprises detector strings which are used for being buried underground and on the ground to detect different earthquake waves. Each earthquake wave sensor in the earthquake wave receivers is used as a basic unit, position description and direction description are carried out, ray tracing and homing imaging are carried out on received transmission waves and reflection waves through position offset and angle offset, and earthquake data correction, processing and standard wave spectrum display are achieved.

title_en: Life detection intelligent carriage
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of life detection intelligent carriage.The life detection intelligent carriage of the present invention includes：One-chip computer module, motor drive module, independent current source module, infrared obstacle avoidance module, human body induction module, GPS module and gsm module.It is an advantage of the invention that the intelligent carriage with life detection function, it is contemplated that the complexity of application environment, configuring various types of sensors and communication module etc. is used to monitor car body local environment in real time, obtains effective information, very big to lift rescue efficiency；Dolly, which can enter in narrow and small complex environment, searches for survivor, it is to avoid the unnecessary injury that the non-intellectual of environment is likely to result in rescuer；Vehicle body is light simultaneously, small volume, and motion is flexible, consumes energy low, can for a long time be used in complex environment, solves the problem of mankind's activity is limited.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar multi-Target Image domain robust tracking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar multi-Target Image domain robust tracking methods, are related to through-wall radar technology, in particular to the multi-target detection tracking technique of through-wall radar.The present invention provides the image area track algorithm of the multiple target after being suitable for through-wall radar imaging.The fast imaging in certain allowable error obtains better quality imaging results；Algorithm for image enhancement based on PCF weighting processing can effectively inhibit the influence of graing lobe, enhance target；Target template creation algorithm based on twin shaft projection can efficiently extract clarification of objective information, prepare for tracking；Image area track algorithm based on average drifting and Kalman filtering can effectively cope with the problem of target image extension and deformation, also can easily cope with target occlusion problem, and tracking accuracy is high.Therefore, the present invention has real-time good, the high advantage of tracking accuracy, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: A kind of false alarm rejection method, apparatus for through-wall radar detection
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of false alarm rejection method, apparatus for through-wall radar detection, this method step includes: that S1. detects purpose interior of building region using through-wall radar detection system, acquires the first echo signal comprising interior of building strong reflection spot characteristic information respectively and comprising the second echo signal of target signature information；S2. first echo signal is detected, obtains interior of building strong reflection spot characteristic signal, and detect to second echo signal, obtain interior of building target signature signal；S3. interior of building strong reflection spot characteristic signal, interior of building target signature signal are subjected to characteristic matching, the echo signal after being matched is exported as final target detection signal to filter out false-alarm.The present invention is able to suppress the false-alarm generated by structure feature in building, and has many advantages, such as simple implementation method, at low cost, strong real-time, inhibition precision and high-efficient.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large robot burying rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale robot burying rescue method and a system, which relate to the technical field of robots and comprise the following steps: the rescue robot dynamically scans a scene and constructs a three-dimensional model to obtain point cloud data; acquiring a target image to perform target detection; acquiring vital sign data of trapped people through a living body detection radar; evaluating the health state of the trapped person based on vital sign data of the trapped person; making a rescue decision, planning a local path of the rescue robot by using an artificial potential field method, and simultaneously sending a control instruction according to the rescue decision to enable the rescue robot to carry out rescue operation; the invention can integrate the functions of detecting life signs, positioning the positions of a plurality of trapped persons, researching rescue strategies, automatically planning paths, realizing automatic obstacle avoidance and assisting rescue workers to rescue, thereby making rescue path decisions according to the life strengths and the positions of the trapped persons.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on phase encoding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign detection, and discloses a vital sign detection method based on phase coding, which is characterized in that a vital sign detection signal is coded in a random coding mode, so that the transmitted signal has certain randomness, interference between adjacent carriers can be avoided, and after correct decoding, the phase of a false target generated by coherent interference can be randomized, thereby detecting a real target and avoiding the influence of coherent interference; the phase noise caused by interference is reduced through phase encoding and traversal decoding, vital signs are obtained from signals subjected to serious incoherent interference, and the capability of the radar system for detecting the vital signs is enhanced; static clutter and false targets are distinguished through variance of phase signals, so that human targets can be accurately detected, and difference operation is carried out on heartbeat signals, so that heartbeat signal components are enhanced, and accuracy of heartbeat frequency detection is improved.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method based on maximum echo energy selection back projection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on maximum echo energy selection backward projection, which comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-channel original echo signal through a through-wall radar; performing pulse compression processing on the acquired original echo signals; performing clutter suppression processing on the echo signals obtained after the processing; performing compensation processing on the extra time delay through a refraction angle approximation wall time delay compensation algorithm; dividing an imaging area by adopting the echo signals obtained after processing and the compensation processing result, and establishing a mapping relation between a distance-direction pixel point and an azimuth-direction pixel point; based on the established mapping relation, obtaining a final imaging result through coherent superposition processing, and completing imaging processing; according to the method, the echo signal with larger energy is selected as a scattering echo of a target, a mapping relation of a distance direction and a direction is constructed, and coherent imaging is carried out; the method has the advantages of reduced redundant calculation, increased imaging speed and improved imaging precision.

title_en: In-vehicle cabin living body detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted cabin in-vivo detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1, after a flameout door of a vehicle falls down to be locked, activating in-cabin living body detection, opening an in-cabin millimeter wave radar, and performing target detection; s2, preprocessing echo signals of the millimeter wave radar; s3, decomposing vital sign signals according to echo signals of the millimeter wave radar; and S4, extracting a living body signal and judging whether a living body exists in the cabin. The invention provides a vehicle-mounted cabin in-vivo detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which is characterized in that dynamic and static detection of human bodies in a vehicle is advanced, then breath and heartbeat signal detection is carried out, and the detection process is decomposed, so that the movable human bodies can be detected preferentially and rapidly and alarm, and the operation efficiency of an algorithm is improved.
assignees: CHANGZHOU XINGYU AUTOMOTIVE LIGHTING SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Method for Service of Driver Identfy and Bio Signal Information of Driver
title_ko: 생체정보를 통한 운전자 개인인식 및 운전상태 변화정보 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for recognizing a driver, using biometric information, and for providing changes in driving conditions. The present invention is disclosed to recognize a driver by producing characteristics from biometric information on a driver through a biometric information sensor installed in the steering wheel of a vehicle; to produce a physical condition of the driver from the biometric information equipped in the steering wheel during driving; to provide information on changes in biological signals in real time during driving to provide information on changes in biological signals according to drowsiness of a driver, a driving habit, and a driving situation; and to detect a steering angle of the steering wheel by a gyro sensor installed in the steering wheel, thereby analyzing driving habits of the driver and helping the driver to safely drive. The method of the present invention comprises the following steps of: recognizing a driver by comparing characteristics of the stored biological signals with biological signals obtained by biometric information sensors including an ECG sensor, a skin electric resistance sensor, a skin temperature sensor, a body fat sensor, and an arterial elasticity sensor; producing basic health information from the biological signals obtained by each sensor and providing the information to the driver; producing information on changes in the biological signals obtained by each sensor according to the mileage and the travel time of the vehicle and providing the information to the driver; and generating a guide to improve the physical condition of the driver and a guide on driving habits by obtaining and analyzing the changes in the biological signals for a predetermined time period.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체정보를 통한 운전자 개인인식 및 운전상태 변화정보 제공방법에 관한 것으로, 차량의 핸들에 장착된 생체정보센서를 통해 운전자의 생체정보로부터 특징을 산출하여 운전자를 인식하며, 운전 중 핸들에 장착된 생체정보로부터 운전자의 건강상태를 산출하고, 운전 중 실시간으로 생체신호 변화정보를 제공하여 운전자의 졸음, 운전습관 및 운전상황에 따른 생체신호변화 정보를 제공하고, 핸들에 장착된 자이로센서를 통해 핸들의 조향각도를 감지하여 운전자의 운전습관 등을 분석 및 안전운전을 가이드 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 차량의 핸들에 장착된 심전도센서, 피부전기저항센서, 피부온도센서, 체지방센서, 동맥탄성도센서를 포함한 생체정보센서를 통해 획득된 생체신호의 특징과 기 저장된 생체신호 특징과의 비교를 통해 운전자를 식별하는 과정; 각 센서를 통해 획득된 생체신호에서 기초 건강정보를 산출하여 운전자에게 제공하는 과정; 차량의 주행거리 및 시간에 따라 상기 각 센서를 통해 획득된 생체신호의 변화상태정보를 산출하여 운전자에게 제공하는 과정; 및 생체신호의 변화상태정보를 일정 기간획득 및 분석하여 운전자의 개인건강 향상 및 운전습관에 대한 가이드를 생성하는 과정;을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Blood pressure waveform measuring sensor and blood pressure measuring device
title_ko: 혈압 파형 측정센서 및 그의 혈압 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a sensor which measures biological signals such as blood pressure waveforms, and a blood pressure measuring device equipped with such a sensor to measure blood pressure. In the present invention, the measuring sensor comprises: a first metal sheet which acts as a ground and has a hole in the center; a first insulator located below the first metal sheet and having a hole formed in the center; a second metal sheet located below the first insulator and functioning as a patch; a second insulator located below the second metal sheet; and a signal pin which penetrates the hole and has an end in contact with the second metal sheet. And when an electromagnetic field is supplied through the signal pin, the impedance formed in the second metal sheet is measured to sense the blood pressure waveform.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혈압 파형과 같은 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 그리고 이러한 센서가 구비되어 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정장치를 제안한다. 본 발명에서 측정 센서는, 그라운드(Ground)로 작용하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 메탈 시트, 상기 제1 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 절연체, 상기 제1 절연체 하부에 위치하며 패치로 작용하는 제2 메탈 시트, 상기 제2 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하는 제2 절연체, 및 상기 홀을 관통하며 끝 단은 상기 제2 메탈 시트와 접촉하는 신호 핀을 포함하여 구성된다. 그리고 상기 신호 핀을 통해 전자기장이 급전되면 상기 제2 메탈 시트에 형성되는 임피던스를 측정하여 혈압 파형을 센싱한다.

title_en: System and method for the detection, recording and reporting of hazardous materials and illegal activity
abstract_en: A system and method for the detection, recording, and reporting of matter and energy related to hazardous and illegal substances in enclosed and semi-enclosed spaces The system and method relate to the early detection of hazardous materials and illegal actions commonly associated with criminal and terrorist activities This 'around-the-clock' security shield integrates audio, video and sensor detection (passive deterrence) with real-time monitoring, communications, and data recording (active deterrence) The system can function as a stationary or mobile recording-reporting device(2) for the detection of biological agents, toxic chemicals, dirty bombs, electromagnetic radiation, human presence, drugs associated with volatile organic chemicals (VOCs). and occasions of negligent oversight The primary component of the system is a solid-state detection unit(2) housed in a compact case which ma) be mounted for mobile or stationary applications The detection unit(2) includes a variety of detectors( 18,22.24) and sensors(20), power supply(10a I Ob), and communication interfaces

title_en: Autonomous cardiac resuscitation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of cardiac resuscitation devices for resuscitating the heart, which enables an emergency physician or paramedic to perform cardiac resuscitation automatically and very professionally, saving the paramedic time and effort and ensuring patient comfort. The device of the invention is easy to use and is installed as a single piece that the user can easily place and secure to the patient's chest, which is desirable in such devices because saving time is paramount in emergency situations. In addition to saving time, the device does not require installation tools or preparation time. The device is formed by an adhesive silicone piece (1) comprising detectors (2) surrounded by compression massage sensors (3) that perform movements like the movement of a hand pressing on the heart during resuscitation, wherein the silicone piece is attached over the heart, directly on the patient's chest, and works using an AI feature together with the receipt of messages sent by detectors attached to the surface of the sensors to measure the patient's vital signs, the sensors massaging the area by pressing, contracting and vibrating.

title_en: Life detection method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: at a certain distance from the earth's surface, the airborne life detection radar transmits detection signals and receives echoes, such as echoes of subsurface life signals, the earth's surface and other interference signals; preprocessing an echo signal received by an airborne radar; carrying out Fourier transform on the preprocessed signals and constructing a neural network data set; preprocessing the constructed neural network data set; and (3) building a neural network and training a test neural network model, and effectively distinguishing life signals, strong earth surface echoes and other interference signals so as to detect whether life signs exist under the earth surface. The method provided by the invention can be used for detecting the vital signals more effectively and has stronger environmental adaptability.

title_en: Life monitoring method and device based on intelligent vehicle-mounted box
abstract_en: The application provides a life monitoring method and device based on an intelligent vehicle-mounted box, which specifically comprise the following steps: the millimeter wave radar sends a signal to scan an area in a vehicle, receives an echo signal of the radar, and mixes the sending signal with the echo signal to obtain a beat frequency signal; acquiring N frames of beat frequency signals, transmitting the N frames of beat frequency signals to an intelligent vehicle-mounted box for first data processing, and judging whether a target exists or not; filtering the signal with the target obtains a heart rate signal and a respiration rate signal respectively. The intelligent vehicle-mounted box provided by the application can monitor vital signs of targets in a vehicle in real time, and can give an alarm and ask for help in time when abnormal vital signs are found.

title_en: Urban buried pipeline ground penetrating radar calibration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calibrating a ground penetrating radar of an urban buried pipeline, which comprises the following steps of S1 designing and manufacturing various standard blocks, forming various standard sample blocks by combining the standard blocks into different layering models, wherein the standard sample blocks are used for simulating layering of a real urban road and a buried pipeline of the real urban road, S2 continuously sweeping the calibrated ground penetrating radar from left to right above the standard sample blocks to generate a visual picture, S3 calculating thickness of different layering, pipeline burial depth, pipeline spacing, pipeline trend and pipeline medium attribute according to the generated picture, S4 comparing, calculating metering performance errors of the calibrated radar to calibrate the metering performance of the calibrated radar, meanwhile checking whether the calibrated radar is accurate or not, S5 judging whether the radar performance is qualified according to the result of the step S4, and solving the problem that the measuring result is biased due to factors such as different dielectric constants, different material compositions and noise interference.

title_en: Underground excavation deformation monitoring method based on ultra-shallow buried high-flow stratum subway channel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground excavation deformation monitoring of subway channels, and particularly discloses an underground excavation deformation monitoring method based on an ultra-shallow buried high-flow stratum, which generates a geological risk distribution map by carrying out geological radar detection on a construction influence range in the early stage of construction, further carries out differential arrangement of monitoring points by carrying out risk grading on the construction influence region by utilizing the geological risk distribution map, improves the deformation capturing capability of a key region on the premise of ensuring the monitoring effect, the monitoring redundancy of the low-risk area is reduced, the jump modification and stability characteristics of deformation are identified by dynamically analyzing deformation data collected by monitoring points in each sub-area in the construction process, whether a monitoring blind area or a redundant area exists is judged, encryption or migration operation of the monitoring points is triggered according to the jump modification and stability characteristics, the transition from static layout to dynamic evolution of the monitoring system is realized, and the real-time matching performance between the layout of the monitoring points and deformation evolution of the stratum is effectively ensured.

title_en: Electronic device and method for determining information associated with sleep
title_ko: 수면과 관련된 정보를 결정하기 위한 전자 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예들에 따른 전자 장치(electronic device)는, 상기 전자 장치 외부의 오브젝트에 대한 제1 생체 정보 및 제2 생체 정보를 획득하도록 설정된 생체 신호 감지 센서와, 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 제1 생체 정보 및 상기 제2 생체 정보를 상기 생체 신호 감지 센서를 이용하여 획득하고, 상기 제1 생체 정보가 변화된 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 생체 정보가 변화된 제2 변화량을 확인하고, 상기 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 변화량에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 수면과 관련된 상기 오브젝트의 상태를 결정하고, 상기 상태에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 상기 오브젝트와 관련된 수면 잠복기를 추정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Plant frost-proof system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plant frost-proof system, and belongs to the field of agro-meteorological disaster regulation and control. According to an existing frost-proof technique, a lot of resources are consumed, and environment is severely polluted in certain frost-proof methods. Heat in soil is absorbed through a parallel-connection soil heat exchanger with vertical buried pipes, arrives at a heat pump unit through a circulating medium and then is transmitted to a ground heat exchanger on the ground; eventually, heat transferring is carried out between the ground heat exchanger and air, heat is transmitted to the air, and accordingly the temperature of small climate of a plant growth area is increased, and the frost-proof effect is achieved during last frost of the early spring. Meanwhile, the frost-proof effect of a soil source geo-thermal heat pump system is further improved through solar heating.

title_en: A kind of protected working Integration Equipment for fireman
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of protected working Integration Equipments for fireman, it is equipped including protective helmet and ectoskeleton, ectoskeleton equipment includes the close-fitting protective garment with biosensor, upper body protective gear, lower part of the body protective gear and Protective Boots are worn from top to bottom on the surface of close-fitting protective garment, the gas cylinder mounting box for grafting respirator is being also set up on human body back, Yu Suoshu upper body protective gear, and the open and close type storage box for placing axe, safety rope is being also set up at thigh two sides, on Yu Suoshu lower part of the body protective gear.The utility model can provide extra power by each force aid system, ensure that the harmony between human action and machinery.It acquires fireman chest heartbeat data in time by biosensor, monitors the vital sign of fireman, the arrangement of infrared ray life detectors can judge different targets by temperature difference, detect victim's body heat.

title_en: Pipeline carrier radar damage detection system
abstract_en: Pipeline carrier radar damage detection system relates to buried pipeline damage detection technical field. The pipeline damage detector comprises a radar station used for sending radar wave signals to a metal pipeline, a distributed radar receiver used for receiving the radar wave signals on the metal pipeline, a processor used for receiving data sent by the radar receiver and analyzing and finding out the damage position of an outer anticorrosive coating of the pipeline, and a pipeline damage detector used for detecting and scanning the metal pipeline at the damage position of the anticorrosive coating and determining the damage position, type and degree of the metal layer of the metal pipeline. The utility model discloses a radar station and distributed radar receiver cooperation find the damage position of outer anticorrosive coating of metal pipeline, and the scanning is surveyed to the metal pipeline that rethread pipeline damage detector anticorrosive coating damaged the position, confirms the type of the damage of metal level and the position of damage and the degree of damage, reaches and prevents suffering from in unprecedented purpose.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDUN XUNDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent earthquake information detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent earthquake information detector which is composed of a seeker 1, earthquake sensors 2, universal connectors 3, connection cables 4 and an earthquake information processor 5; wherein, the numbers of the earthquake sensors 2, the universal couplings 3 and the connection cables 4 are determined according to a plurality of units as required to meet the requirements of detection depth and distance. The seeker 1 is made of hard materials to facilitate the detector to be put into a proper place in a drill hole or a crack under the coordination of the universal connectors. The connection cables are used for transmitting the earthquake information collected by all the earthquake sensors to the earthquake information processor 5 which sends out earthquake forecast after carrying out the analysis and judgment or sends the earthquake information to other devices through a network interface. In earthquake-prone areas, the intelligent earthquake information detector can be buried into foundation together with ground piles to detect and forecast the occurrence of earthquake at any moment, and thereby further reducing the loss of people lives and properties.

title_en: End of service life indicator for organic vapor respirator cartridges
abstract_en: Embodiments are generally directed to detection of end of service life of a respirator cartridge for one or more organic vapors. In general, end-of-life detection may use a competitive UV light absorption-fluorescence method. Thus, a sensor that emits light when UV is applied may be placed within the cartridge with the UV lamp and photodetector directed at the sensor. In some embodiments, multiple corresponding sensors and UV lamps and light detectors may be used. Generally, the light level emitted by one or more sensors can be used to estimate the effective end of life.

title_en: Marine vital signs detecting module based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of marine vital signs detecting module based on Bluetooth technology, includes water-proof sensor (1), low frequency filtering and amplifying circuit (2), Bluetooth transmission circuit (3), and totally 3 parts combine and constitute an one integral piece.The analogue signal that water-proof sensor is exported, after 2 grades are amplified filtering, the gain that can make 1Hz low frequency respiratory frequency signal reaches 10dB, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters bluetooth module ADC, after bluetooth module kernel algorithm processes, it is converted into frequency of respiration, gives closely lifesaving appliance by Bluetooth transmission.In a word, water-proof sensor and bluetooth module are combined by the present invention, can be emitted by bluetooth wireless mode by the vital sign of maritime peril personnel, greatly improve efficiency and the specific aim of maritime search and rescue work.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGYUAN MOBILCOM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Performance detection system and method of UWB radar life detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance detection system and a method of a UWB radar life detection device, wherein the detection system consists of a field simulation device, a position moving device, a vital sign simulation device and a movable interference device; placing equipment to be tested on one side of the post-disaster field simulation device, wherein one side is a life signal detection area; the position moving device is arranged in a life signal detection area of the post-disaster field simulation device; the vital sign simulation device is arranged on the position moving device; the movable interference devices are arranged in the buried vital signal detection area according to actual random. When the UWB radar life detection device is detected, the life sign simulation device moves in a life signal detection area, and detection of detection distance, field angle, angle and distance information resolution, multi-target anti-interference capability and dynamic target detection capability is completed. The invention can simulate the actual conditions of different burying depths, burying materials, a plurality of living bodies and micro-moving living bodies, thereby carrying out target two-dimensional detection on the device, having high detection precision and good applicability.

title_en: Cognitive biological radar method and device for detecting human body posture and vital signs
abstract_en: The invention provides a cognitive biological radar method and a cognitive biological radar device for detecting human body postures and vital signs, and is applied to detecting the human body postures and the vital signs. The method is based on a perception and action cycle mechanism; the radar transmits waveforms of a certain group of parameters to a detection area, a receiving end collects reflected radar signals, the sensing target and the environment are calculated, the waveform parameters focusing more on the target to be detected in the environment are selected according to the optimization rule by minimizing the information entropy, and the transmitting end adjusts the waveform attribute of the next radar transmission in real time based on the sensing of the target and the environment. Taking the application to human body postures (fall, gesture recognition) and vital signs (respiration, heart shake, skin surface vibration caused by blood vessel pulse and the like) as an example, after the cognitive biological radar acquires radar echo data of a high-precision target and environment, the characteristic information of the acquired data is extracted through a data characteristic extraction module; and the data are transmitted into a deep learning classification module for classification; and transmitting the result to a result display module. The invention realizes the implementation and application of the cognitive biological radar technology, combines a deep learning model and realizes the high-precision detection of human body gestures, vital signs and the like.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based sports multi-person vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based method for monitoring vital signs of multiple persons moving, which comprises the steps of emitting linear frequency modulation continuous waves through a millimeter wave radar, detecting the multiple persons moving, receiving echoes through a receiving antenna, obtaining intermediate frequency signals after frequency mixing, storing the radar signals into a fast time-slow time format, and carrying out FFT (fast Fourier transform) processing in the fast time direction to carry out ranging so as to obtain echo data in a distance-slow time form. According to the invention, the influence of human body translation on the phase is removed in a time-frequency domain through wavelet transformation, the phase sequence of each target echo is respectively extracted, phase unwrapping is carried out, heartbeat signals and respiratory signals with different frequency bands are separated through an intermediate frequency filter, the heartbeat frequency and the respiratory frequency are respectively calculated through FFT (fast Fourier transform), the phenomenon that the motion of a human body can generate extra phase change on radar echoes is prevented, and the millimeter wave radar can accurately detect the heartbeat and the respiration of the human body is caused.
assignees: NANJING LIUJI OPTOELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;JIANGSU YUNHEFENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heart beat and respiratory frequency joint estimation method based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heartbeat respiratory frequency joint estimation method based on an MIMO radar, belongs to the technical field of radars, and particularly belongs to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring. By adopting the ML estimation method, the estimation of the heartbeat and the respiratory frequency is realized, and compared with the traditional method based on time-frequency analysis, the ML estimation method has more stable performance, smaller error and smaller dependence on data duration; in addition, the invention provides an estimation performance evaluation method with more theoretical basis for the field by calculating the CRB estimated by the heartbeat respiratory frequency; based on the CRB obtained by derivation, the invention provides a system parameter optimization design method which can assist technicians to find out the optimal radar parameters, thereby improving the performance of heartbeat and respiratory frequency estimation.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar vital sign signal denoising algorithm based on PE and TVF-EMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband radar vital sign signal denoising algorithm based on PE and TVF-EMD, and belongs to the technical field of radar vital detection. Firstly, preprocessing clutter and noise signals in original radar echo signals by adopting methods such as channel signal subtraction, average subtraction, linear trend suppression, automatic gain control, fast time filtering, slow time filtering and the like; then, the position of a human body target is detected by adopting a PE algorithm through analyzing statistical characteristics such as kurtosis, standard deviation, variance and the like of data in a slow time direction. The optimization algorithm can conveniently and accurately locate the time when the signal is suddenly changed, and can amplify the fine change of the signal. And decomposing the extracted vital sign signals by adopting a TVF-EMD algorithm, calculating the respective energy duty ratio of each IMF component in the respiratory frequency band and the heartbeat frequency band after decomposition, selecting a proper signal for reconstruction, and finally carrying out spectrum analysis on the reconstructed signal by utilizing FFT (fast Fourier transform). The radar vital signal denoising method provided by the invention can accurately locate the target and extract the vital information, and the denoising result is quite considerable.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring system and a vital sign monitoring method. The intelligent monitoring system has the advantages that technologies such as RFID, radar and cloud computing are combined together, full-automatic monitoring and early warning of vital signs are achieved, the intelligent monitoring system is powerful in function, high in precision, wide in application range, free of privacy risks, friendly to the elderly, and suitable for being used in a multi-person environment.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar, belonging to the technical field of radar signal processing, comprising the following steps: performing fast Fourier transform on radar echo intermediate frequency signal data to obtain a frequency spectrum and a phase spectrum of an intermediate frequency signal; suppressing interference in the frequency spectrum using a phasor mean cancellation algorithm; performing incoherent accumulation on multi-frame data; searching the maximum value in the range of the human body target distance to obtain a distance unit corresponding to the target; extracting phases at the corresponding distance units of the target from the phase spectrum, unfolding the phases, and calculating a target body surface displacement curve; separating the respiratory and heartbeat signals; and respectively carrying out spectrum estimation on the respiration and heartbeat signals obtained by separation, and obtaining corresponding respiration and heartbeat times per minute according to a spectrum estimation result. By adopting the vital sign detection method and device based on the millimeter wave radar, the frequency estimation with high resolution can be carried out on the vital sign signals with limited length, so that more accurate vital sign detection results can be obtained.

title_en: Sensor for detecting buried object
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sensor for detecting a buried object of complex-type enhancing detection sensitivity of a magnetic sensor.  <P>SOLUTION: The sensor 10 includes a magnetic sensor 12 and a radio-frequency sensor 14, consisting of a receiving section 16 and a transmitting section 18, preparing a plurality of antenna elements constituting the radio frequency sensor 14 on the periphery of the receiving section 16 and moreover, preparing the transmitting section 18 on a periphery of the radio-frequency sensor 14 centered on the receiving section 16.
