title_en: Patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple bio signals
title_ko: 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple biosignals which operates wirelessly to provide a remote health care service. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple biosignals comprises: an electrode patch module having electrodes arranged on a first surface to collect multiple biosignals and connectors arranged on both ends of a second surface facing the first surface, wherein a middle portion connecting both ends of the second surface has a shape becoming narrower as a symmetric arch shape; a circuit unit main body which is detachable and attachable to a first area of the patch module, is electrically connected to a connector arranged on the first area, and includes one or more circuit parts for processing, storage, and short-range wireless communication for the collected multiple biosignals; and a power supply unit main body which is detachable and attachable to a second area of the patch module and is electrically connected to a connector arranged on the second area to supply power to the circuit parts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선으로 동작하는 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스에 관한 것으로서, 일실시예에 따른 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스는 제1 면에 다중생체신호 수집을 위한 전극들이 배치되고, 상기 제1 면에 대향하는 제2 면의 양끝 단에 커넥터가 배치되며, 상기 양끝 단을 잇는 가운데 부분이 서로 대칭되는 아치형태로써 좁아지는 형태를 갖는 전극패치 모듈, 상기 패치 모듈의 제1 영역에 탈부착이 가능하되, 상기 제1 영역에 배치된 커넥터와 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 수집된 다중생체신호에 대한 처리, 저장, 및 근거리 무선통신을 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 회로부품들을 포함하는 회로부 본체, 및 상기 패치 모듈의 제2 영역에 탈부착이 가능하되, 상기 제2 영역에 배치된 커넥터와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 회로부품들에 전원을 공급하기 위한 전원부 본체를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: According to one disclosure, provided is a method for determining a dangerous situation of a user through first danger determination which has analyzed a bio-signal of a user and second danger determination which has analyzed surrounding environment information, and managing the safety. The method comprises the steps of: sensing a bio-signal of a user by using at least one sensor every predetermined period; matching a surrounding environment of the user with any one of a plurality of state groups classified in accordance with the activity attribute of the user, when the change in the bio-signal of the user exceeds a threshold value; determining a danger level for the surrounding environment based on setting information of the matched state group and the bio-signal of the user; and transmitting a notification message to a terminal of a guardian in accordance with the determined danger level.
abstract_ko: 일 개시에 의하여, 사용자의 생체 신호를 분석한 1차 위험 판단, 주변 환경 정보를 분석한 2차 위험 판단을 통해 사용자의 위험 상황을 판단하고 안전을 관리하는 방법을 제공하며, 본 방법은 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 사용자의 주변 환경을 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하는 단계, 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 정하는 단계 및 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mask apparatus and a control method therefor. The present invention relates to a mask apparatus and a control method for controlling the same, wherein the mask apparatus comprises: a mask body which is in close contact with the face of a user, and has an inner surface covering the nose and mouth of the user and an outer surface exposed to an external space; an air cleaner which is connected to the mask body and is formed with an inlet port for introducing external air and an air flow hole for allowing the air introduced through the inlet port to flow into the inner surface of the mask body; and a respiration sensor which is arranged on a flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body and senses the amount of respiration that flows through the air cleaner. According to the present invention, a flow of air can be adjusted to be suitable for the user′s respiration condition through the respiration sensor arranged in the flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body, and an automatic respiration sensing-based fan operation allows the user′s respiration to be more comfortable compared to a static pressure-type operation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치된 호흡 센서를 통해 사용자의 호흡 상태에 맞게 공기의 유동을 조절할 수 있으며,자동식 호흡 감지 기반 FAN 동작으로써 정압식 방식에 비해 고객의 호흡을 편안하게 해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Water barrier system for river level monitoring
title_ko: 하천 수위 모니터링을 위한 차수벽 시스템
abstract_en: A water barrier system for river level monitoring is disclosed. The water barrier system for river level monitoring includes: a water barrier buried in the ground of a river bank that rises or falls to block overflowing water from the river; a cylinder module that raises or lowers the water barrier; a water level sensor that measures the water level of the river; a broadcaster that outputs an evacuation guidance broadcast; and a controller that determines whether the river is expected to overflow beyond the river bank using the water level of the river measured by the water level sensor, controls the broadcaster to broadcast an evacuation guidance broadcast if the river is expected to overflow as a result of the determination, operates the cylinder module to raise the water barrier buried in the ground of the river bank if the measured water level of the river reaches a preset dangerous water level, and controls the height of the water barrier to rise corresponding to the measured water level.
abstract_ko: 하천 수위 모니터링을 위한 차수벽 시스템이 개시된다. 하천 수위 모니터링을 위한 차수벽 시스템은, 하천의 강둑의 지중에 매립되어 있다가 상승 또는 하강하여 하천에서 범람하는 물을 차단하는 차수벽, 차수벽을 상승 또는 하강시키는 실린더 모듈, 하천의 수위를 측정하는 수위센서, 대피 안내 방송을 출력하는 방송기 및 수위센서에 의하여 측정된 하천의 수위를 이용하여 하천이 강둑을 넘어 범람할 것으로 예상되는지 여부를 판단하고, 판단 결과 하천이 범람할 것으로 예상되면, 방송기가 대피 안내 방송을 하도록 제어하고, 측정된 하천의 수위가 미리 설정된 위험 수위에 도달하면, 강둑의 지중에 매립되어 있던 차수벽이 상승하도록 실린더 모듈을 동작시키고, 측정된 수위에 상응하게 차수벽의 상승 높이를 제어하는 제어기를 포함한다.
assignees: DAEJIN UNIV CENTER FOR EDUCATIONAL INDUSTRIAL COOPERATION

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, the RF tags respectively generating incident RF signals with different predetermined frequencies, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one RF radar that demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital sign of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to associated frequency of the reflected RF signal.

title_en: Radar detection systems and methods for detecting permanence of slow targets
abstract_en: A method and a system for radar detection system include, after cyclically generating a detection profile representing signal intensity as a function of position, cyclically analyzing the detection profile by alternating two modes of analysis. The first mode is suitable to detect a target entering the field of view, but may have poor sensitivity to targets that move at a low speed for a long time, such as a person entering a hazardous area and stopping. When this mode detects a target, a second mode is entered, which is more sensitive and suitable to detect the permanence of the target in the field of view, and in particular small movements connected to the vital signs of the target. The second mode may be based, for example, on complex signal deviations for each position with respect to a long-term complex mean value for that position. Only if the second mode does not detect any target for a certain restart time, the field of view is deemed to be clear and the first mode is used again.

title_en: Life detection system and method for mine drilling rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection system and a life detection method for mine drilling rescue, wherein the system comprises a ground terminal and a multifunctional life detection device, the ground terminal is in communication connection with the multifunctional life detection device in a wireless transmission or network transmission mode, the ground terminal comprises a central processing unit and an interaction module, the central processing unit is used for sending control instructions to the multifunctional life detection device, the multifunctional life detection device comprises a controller, a video/infrared image detection module, an audio detection module and a radar detection module, and the controller is used for receiving the control instructions and controlling the video/infrared image detection module, the audio detection module and/or the radar detection module based on the control instructions. The technical scheme provided by the application can be suitable for various conditions of drilling rescue, improves the success rate and accuracy of life information detection, and simultaneously improves the rescue efficiency by a full-automatic detection process.

title_en: Leakage detection apparatus for underground hot water pipe
title_ko: 지중 온수 배관 누수감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground hot water pipe leakage detection device, which comprises: a case provided on an upper side of a hot water pipe embedded in the ground and having an inner accommodating portion with an opened upper portion; an opening/closing cover disposed on an upper side of the accommodation portion of the case; a sensing unit comprising a temperature sensor disposed adjacent to the hot water pipe and a test coupon disposed adjacent to the hot water pipe and buried, and detecting the leakage of the hot water pipe according to the temperature change by the temperature sensor and the potential change of the test coupon; a processing unit for converting an analog signal input from the sensing unit into a digital signal to check an error, and performing conversion into a predetermined data transmission format; a communication unit for transmitting data of the processing unit through wireless communication; a storage unit for storing the data of the processing unit; a situation room server for monitoring the state of the hot water pipe through the data wirelessly transmitted by the communication unit, and notifying those outside of the danger; and a cylindrical enclosure having the sensing unit, the processing unit, the communication unit, and the storage unit embedded therein, and disposed in the accommodation portion of the case. The underground hot water pipe leakage detection device can measure the degree of leakage or corrosion of underground facilities, determine the time of replacement and repair of the underground facilities, and establish a situation room server based on the Internet of Things (IoT) combined with wireless communication to perform monitoring for 24 hours in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중에 매설된 온수 배관의 상부 측에 설치되고 상방 개구(開口)형 내부 수용부를 갖는 케이스;  상기 케이스의 수용부 상부 측에 배치되는 개폐커버;  상기 온수 배관에 인접하게 배치되어 매설되는 온도센서와, 상기 온수 배관에 인접하게 배치되어 매설되는 테스트쿠폰(test coupon)으로 이루어져, 상기 온도센서에 의한 온도 변화와 상기 테스트쿠폰의 전위 변화에 따라 온수 배관의 누수를 감지하기 위한 감지부;  상기 감지부에서 입력되는 아날로그 신호를 디지털 신호로 전환하여 오류를 검사하고 기설정된 데이터 전송 형식으로 변환하는 처리부;  상기 처리부의 데이터를 무선 통신으로 전송하기 위한 통신부;  상기 처리부의 데이터를 보관하기 위한 저장부;  상기 통신부에 의해 무선 전송된 데이터를 통해 상기 온수 배관의 상태를 모니터링하고, 사전 위험 정보를 외부로 알리기 위한 상황실 서버; 및  상기 감지부, 처리부, 통신부 및 저장부가 내장되고 상기 케이스의 수용부에 배치되는 원통형의 외함체;로 이루어지도록 구현함으로써, 지중시설물의 누수나 부식 정도를 측정할 수 있고, 또 이를 통해 지중시설물에 대한 교체 및 보수시기를 판단할 수 있으며, 무선통신을 결합한 사물인터넷(IoT) 기반으로 상황실 서버를 구축하여 실시간으로 24시간 모니터링 할 수 있는 지중 온수 배관 누수감지장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Movable fire extinguishing parking station for electric vehicle
title_ko: 전기 자동차용 이동식 소화 주차장
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile fire extinguishing parking lot for electric vehicles which can quickly extinguish a fire by immersing an electric vehicle in fire water and isolating the electric vehicle to prevent the fire from spreading if the fire breaks out in the corresponding electric vehicle by a battery defect, a battery impact, and overcharging. To this end, the mobile fire extinguishing parking lot for electric vehicles comprises: a parking base having a towing ring; wall tubes embedded at four positions of the edge of the parking base to be expanded to the upper surface of the parking base when a fire breaks out to form a temporary wall; a plurality of fire detection sensors exposed to the upper surface of the parking base to detect a fire of an electric vehicle; a plurality of injection nozzles exposed to the upper surface of the parking base to inject fire water to a lower portion of the electric vehicle; and a fire-extinguishing tank supplying fire water to the injection nozzles. The parking base also has compartments formed at four positions of the edge to embed the wall tubes. A hinge pin for maintaining the embedded wall tubes in a buried state is connected to an upper portion of the compartments. The wall tubes hold fire water to extinguish a fire of an electric vehicle by immersion or partial immersion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기 자동차용 이동식 소화 주차장에 관한 것으로, 이를 위해 견인고리가 구비된 주차대;와, 상기 주차대의 가장자리 4개소에 내장되어 화재시 주차대의 상부면으로 팽창되어 가벽체를 이루는 팽창식 벽체튜브;와, 상기 주차대에 상부면에 다수 노출되어 전기차의 화재를 감지하는 다수의 화재감지센서;와, 전기차의 하부로 소화수를 분사될 수 있도록 상기 주차대의 상부면에 노출되는 다수의 분사노즐; 및 상기 각 분사노즐로 소화수를 공급하는 소화탱크;를 포함하되, 상기 주차대는 벽체튜브를 내장시키기 위해 가장자리 4개소에 격실이 더 형성되고, 상기 격실의 상부에는 내장된 벽체튜브를 매립된 상태로 유지하기 위한 힌지판이 연결되고, 상기 벽체튜브는 소화수를 담수시켜 전기차를 수장 또는 부분 수장에 의해 소화시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Precise infrastructure mapping using full-waveform inversion of ground penetrating radar signals
abstract_en: A new system and method for FWI of common-offset GPR data, particularly targeting the dimensions and infilling material of buried objects. The method is useful in situations where clear isolated diffraction hyperbolas indicate the presence of an underground object, but the object's dimensions and filling may be unknown. The present invention acquires GPR data and applies advanced numerical methods to get the depth and size of the underground object in a very accurate manner. An embodiment of the invention includes five main steps: GPR data processing, ray-based analysis to set a good initial model, 3D to 2D transformation of data, effective SW estimation, and FWI.

title_en: System and method for discrimination of central and obstructive disordered breathing events
abstract_en: Disordered breathing events may be classified as central, obstructive or a combination of central an obstructive in origin based on patient motion associated with respiratory effort. Central disordered breathing is associated with disrupted respiration with reduced respiratory effort. Obstructive disordered breathing is associated with disrupted respiration accompanied by respiratory effort. A disordered breathing classification system includes a disordered breathing detector and a respiratory effort motion sensor. Components of the disordered breathing classification system may be fully or partially implantable.
assignees: LEE KENT;HATLESTAD JOHN D;ZHU QINGSHENG;STAHMANN JEFFREY E;HARTLEY JESSE W;NI QUAN;CARDIAC PACEMAKERS INC

title_en: Rescue unmanned plane, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle group and its regulation and control fire-fighting system
abstract_en: The utility model is related to rescue unmanned plane, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle group and its regulation and control fire-fighting system, and it is included with unmanned planes more than three axles driven respectively by corresponding motor, the performing module being arranged on unmanned plane, the control terminal by wirelessly controlling unmanned plane and performing module respectively and the battery for providing electric energy to performing module；Performing module includes illuminator, radar life-detection instrument, GPS positioning system and/or high-definition camera.Rescue the broken unmanned plane of detection, the water spray unmanned plane and the fire extinguishing ball unmanned plane of more than ten of more than ten more than a group of planes, including ten；The utility model is reasonable in design, compact conformation and easy to use.
assignees: RUNTAI RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: One kind is used for fire control security protection mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind to be used for fire control security protection mask, including main body and filter core, the upper end of the main body is equipped with thermal infrared life-detection instrument, and the inner surface of main body is equipped with wireless intercom, the top of the filter core is equipped with isolation type air respiratorresuscitator, and the lower end of filter core is installed with sealing reinforcer, the lower end of the sealing reinforcer is equipped with smoke filter, and the sealing reinforcer is fixedly connected with main body.It is described in the utility model a kind of for fire control security protection mask, equipped with smoke filter, wireless intercom and thermal-infrared sensing instrument, the pernicious gas generated after object burning can be filtered out so as to ensure safety of the fireman in fire fighting, and fireman can be facilitated to receive the instruction that higher level sends out in fire fighting, prevent fireman from can not find to be trapped in the people in shelter in fire fighting so as to cannot timely sue and labour, different operating situation is applicable in, brings better prospect of the application.
assignees: XINCHANG COUNTY WAIPOKENG ORGANIC TEA PROFESSIONAL COOP

title_en: Container house
abstract_en: The application relates to a container room is applied to container technical field, include: this container body, wind and rain inductor, ground anchor device, air cushion device, controller. When the wind speed monitored by the wind and rain sensor exceeds a preset wind speed threshold value, the wind and rain sensor can trigger the connected controller to send a first control signal to the ground anchor device, and the ground anchor device can be buried into a placing surface for a preset depth, so that the container body can be more firmly fixed on the placing surface to prevent the container body from being blown down by typhoon; the container body is provided with groove structure in order to hold the air cushion device, and when the rainfall that sets up the monitoring of the rain sensor at container body top exceeded predetermined rainfall threshold value, the rain sensor can trigger the controller of connecting and send second control signal for the air cushion device, and the air cushion device is aerifyd to support container body rebound, break away from ponding.

title_en: Emergency SOS device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency SOS device. Infrared lights (6) are arranged on a shell (1) in various directions; a chargeable battery (2), a switch (7) and a control device (3) are arranged in the shell (1); the chargeable battery (2), the switch (7), infrared lights (6) are connected with the control device (3). The utility model provides a small device for overcoming the deficiency that buried people cannot communicate with the outside; after being buried, since the emergency SOS device can illuminate, people can ask for help by blowing the whistle and acquire information from the outside through the radio, thus increasing the probability of being detected by an external life detecting instrument through infrared information and the opportunity of people to be saved; and the emergency SOS device can be used in the earthquake-prone area.

title_en: In-vehicle life detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of intelligent automobiles, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting life in an automobile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an x-th radar frame signal acquired by a preset millimeter wave radar in the vehicle; demodulating and sampling and time-frequency conversion are carried out on the xth radar frame signal to obtain a first distance dimension signal array; filtering the first distance dimension signal array to obtain a second distance dimension signal array; extracting the phase and confidence of a preset detection point in the second distance dimensional signal array; performing iterative filtering on the phase and the confidence coefficient of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal according to the phase and the confidence coefficient of the preset detection point of the pre-extracted xth-1 radar frame signal to obtain a filtering result of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal; and determining that the preset detection point has life under the condition that the filtering result is greater than a preset threshold value. The invention can be suitable for life detection in vehicles in various scenes and has better detection effect.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar human vital sign monitoring method and system based on diversity mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar human vital sign monitoring method and system based on a diversity mechanism, comprising the following steps: the millimeter wave radar is provided with a plurality of transmitting antennas for transmitting millimeter wave signals to the environment and a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving the signals reflected by human bodies and objects; the signal processing module is used for carrying out frequency mixing on the reflected signals received by the receiving antenna, carrying out space diversity on the positions of the human body to obtain reflected components of the positions of the human body, carrying out dynamic signal extraction by estimating echo static components to obtain dynamic components, carrying out time diversity on the echo dynamic components at a plurality of moments to improve the signal to noise ratio, carrying out phase extraction and unwrapping on the signals after the time diversity, and carrying out band-pass filtering and period estimation on the time domain to obtain the target respiration rate and heart rate. The invention utilizes a diversity method to improve the accuracy of monitoring the vital signs of the human body in a complex environment and a long distance by integrating multi-antenna and multi-pulse data.

title_en: Roadbed construction method for crossing V-shaped valley area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a roadbed construction method for crossing a V-shaped valley area, and belongs to the technical fields of foundation engineering and foundation treatment. The method solves the problems of low foundation drainage efficiency, unstability of the filled side slope and differential settlement control in the construction of the V-shaped valley roadbed. The technical scheme includes that a ditch is dug along the bottom of a valley, a broken stone drainage blind ditch wrapped by permeable geotextile is paved to form a foundation drainage system, a vibratory roller with a piezoelectric sensor embedded into a steel wheel is adopted in layered filling, a unidirectional geogrid is paved along a side slope after each two layers of filling and is vertically anchored into a compaction layer through a U-shaped anchoring piece, a transverse drainage pipe is pre-buried when filling is carried out to a threshold value of a bearing capacity abrupt change point of a foundation, and a sedimentation monitoring array is paved after filling is completed. The method is used for remarkably improving the bearing stability of the roadbed filled under complex terrains through the optimization of the foundation drainage structure and the system integration of intelligent compaction and differential settlement dynamic treatment of the filling body, and is suitable for foundation construction and disaster prevention and control of V-shaped canyon sections of mountain roads.
assignees: XINGTAI ROAD & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily display a burial position of a buried object on a road surface or the like in an underground radar for detecting the underground buried object.SOLUTION: An underground radar 1 includes a radar body 2 having an electromagnetic transmission section 5 for transmitting an electromagnetic wave, and an electromagnetic receiving section 6 for receiving a reflection wave of the electromagnetic wave; and detects a buried object by receiving wave data A from the electromagnetic wave receiving section 5. The underground radar 1 further includes: a position measuring section 3 for measuring a moving position of the radar body 2; a storage section 8 for storing burial position data C of the buried object determined based on the receiving wave data A when moving the radar body 2 and detecting the buried object, and position data B of the radar body 2 acquired by the position measuring section 3 when acquiring the receiving wave data A; and a display section 4 displaying the burial position of the buried object 11 based on the position data B of the radar body 2, when radar body 2 is moved again, acquired by the position measuring section 3 by the moving, and the burial position data C already stored in the storage section 8.

title_en: Method and system for estimating vital sign of vehicle occupant using ultra-wideband
abstract_en: To provide a method and system for estimating vital signs of a vehicle occupant using ultra-wideband communication.SOLUTION: A UWB signal is transmitted from one UWB system node to another UWB system node. Channel impulse responses (CIRs) associated with the UWB signals are determined. On the basis of the CIRs, in some embodiments, velocities associated with the UWB signals are specified, and activities of vehicle occupants are classified on the basis of the CIRs along with vital signs such as breathing rates. In other embodiments, on the basis of the CIRs, phase unwrapping of phase features associated with the CIRs is performed, and principle component analysis (PCA) transforms the CIRs, allowing estimated vital signs such as breathing rates to be identified.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Information detection method and apparatus for indoor object, and storage medium and processor
abstract_en: An information detection method and apparatus for an indoor object, and a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises: collecting target data information of an indoor target object by means of a target detection device (S101), wherein the target data information at least comprises vital sign information and behavior information of the target object, and the target detection device comprises a radar monitoring device, which does not need to be worn by the target object, and a vital sign monitoring device, which is worn by the target object; analyzing behavioral state information of the target object on the basis of the target data information (S102); and displaying the behavioral state information of the target object on a display interface (S103). The problem in the related art of an information detection effect for an indoor person being poor is solved.

title_en: A method for human only activity detection based on radar signals
abstract_en: A method of detecting human presence includes using a radar sensor to monitor a space, and receiving an output signal from the radar sensor. A Fourier transform is performed on the output signal to produce a signal spectrum. It is decided whether the output signal is indicative of human activity dependent upon at least one acoustic feature of the signal spectrum and at least one spectral feature of the signal spectrum.

title_en: Pre-seizure detection device incorporating electronic nose technology
abstract_en: In one aspect, the disclosure relates to a sensor for predicting epileptic seizures in a subject. In an aspect, the sensor includes carbon nanotubes (CNTs) functionalized with organic molecules that can reversibly bind pre-seizure volatile organic compounds (VOCs) by IT-IT bonding, polar bonding, van der Waals interactions, and the like. The sensor can detect the pre-seizure VOCs from biological fluids including sweat, saliva, and breath, thus allowing the prediction of a seizure from 10 to 45 minutes before the seizure occurs, allowing a subject wearing the sensor to take actions to ensure safety and/or to alert caregivers. In an aspect, the sensor can be incorporated into a wearable device that also monitors vital signs such as heart rate, body temperature, skin impedance, and/or body movements in order to predict the type of epileptic seizure. Also disclosed are methods of making the sensors and methods for predicting epileptic seizures.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring vital body signs of a seated person
abstract_en: A method comprising the step of using a plurality of doppler radars disposed on the seat belt or integrated into the seat belt for monitoring vital body signs of a person seated in a seat of a motor vehicle is disclosed. The disclosed method unobtrusively monitors vital body signs like heart rate and respiration of the person seated in the motor vehicle. A number of safety applications as well as wellness applications can be enabled. Examples are detection of momentary sleep of the driver, vital sign monitoring in case of an accident as well as relaxation exercise using biofeedback to reduce stress for drivers.
assignees: KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV;PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

title_en: A kind of unilateral 2 points of strabismus imaging method of building based on MIMO through-wall radars
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unilateral 2 points of strabismus imaging method of building based on MIMO through-wall radars, real aperture strabismus detection is carried out in two detecting location points of the unilateral selection of building using MIMO through-wall radars successively, two point reality aperture echoes of collection form oblique-view image of two width comprising partial building corner and internal stationary target by rear orientation projection's imaging algorithm.And for two width oblique-view images, the present invention utilizes additive fusion and two-dimentional CFAR detection, both the integrality of building whole corner image had been ensure that, beneficial to the layout for determining whole walls, corner image secondary lobe and multipath mirage is inhibited to disturb simultaneously, beneficial to the distribution for judging internal stationary target, the building panoramic picture comprising clear corner image and static target image is finally obtained.Wall layout and static target distribution can be judged respectively by corner image and static target image, realized to the wall layout of building and the imaging detection of internal stationary target.

title_en: Multi-target back wall one-time multipath suppression method after three-dimensional imaging of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target rear wall one-time multipath inhibition method after through-wall radar three-dimensional imaging, which comprises the steps of firstly extracting objects in all images from an original radar three-dimensional image after binarization; then extracting barycentric coordinates of all objects, and sequencing the objects in an ascending order according to Euclidean distances from the barycentric coordinates to the center of the radar array; secondly, calculating the direct path propagation distance and the multipath path propagation distance from all objects to each antenna array element; then defining correlation matching coefficients, and calculating correlation matching coefficients of direct path propagation distance and multipath path propagation distance of the object two by two; and finally, defining a decision threshold and a rule, judging whether the two objects have a target-multipath relation according to the correlation matching coefficients of the two objects, and removing all multipaths in the image after finding out the multipaths. The method can effectively remove the back wall multipath in the through-wall radar three-dimensional image once.

title_en: Landmine detection system and the method thereof
title_ko: 지뢰 탐지 시스템 및 탐지 방법
abstract_en: A mine detection system and detection method utilizing a ground penetrating-synthetic aperture radar (GP-SAR) mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone) to measure the vertical position of buried objects through time-series profiling of ultra-wideband (0.6 to 6 GHz) high-resolution radio signals, and to measure the horizontal position of buried objects through spatial profiling, interpreting the measured vertical and horizontal position data to visualize the location and size of buried landmines, thereby selecting priorities for detecting and removing metallic and non-metallic landmines, and proactively eliminating accident factors that may arise from landmine loss due to typhoons and floods.
abstract_ko: 무인비행체(드론)에 탑재된 Ground Penetrating-Synthetic Aperture Radar (GP-SAR)로 측정한 초광대역 밴드(0.6 ~ 6 GHz) 고해상도 전파신호의 시계열 프로파일링을 통해 매설물의 수직적 위치를 측정하고, 공간적 프로파일링을 통해 매설물의 수평적 위치를 측정하여, 측정된 수직 및 수평 위치 데이터를 해석하여 매설된 지뢰의 위치와 크기를 가시화함으로써, 금속성 및 비금속성 지뢰 탐지 및 제거 우선순위를 선정할 수 있고, 이에 따라, 태풍 및 홍수에 의한 지뢰 유실 등 지뢰로 인해 발생할 수 있는 안전사고 요인을 선제적으로 제거할 수 있는 무인비행체에 탑재된 GPR-SAR 센서를 활용한 지뢰 탐지 시스템 및 탐지 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Method and device for detecting buried metal using synchronous detection method
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for detecting buried metal, whereby it is possible to radio (wirelessly) transmit a synchronizing signal, and, when the frequency band of the transmission signal is restricted, to problem synchronous detection using a reference signal having a frequency equal to or greater than the frequency band. A method for detecting buried metal using synchronous detection method having a transmitting side device that transmits a transmitting signal (alternating current) to a buried metal for detection and transmits a synchronizing signal for synchronous detection, and a receiving side device for measuring the position and burial depth of the buried metal by detecting a magnetic field generated by the transmitting signal flowing in the buried metal with a magnetic sensor and processing amplitude and phase of the magnetic field, the method including: generating a standard signal of frequency f in the transmitting side device, and n dividing this standard signal to convert it to a transmitting signal of frequency f/n, transmitting this transmitting signal to the buried metal, m dividing the standard signal to convert it to a synchronizing signal of frequency f/m, transmitting this synchronizing signal from the transmitting side device by radio. Receiving the synchronizing signal by the receiving side device, m multiplying this received synchronizing signal to convert it to the standard signal. N dividing this converted standard signal to convert it to a reference signal of frequency f/n. Detecting a magnetic field generated by the transmitting signal flowing in the buried metal and synchronously detecting with the reference signal.

title_en: Through-wall radar signal processing and imaging display system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a through-wall radar signal processing and imaging display system, which comprises a radio frequency module, an STM data acquisition and imaging processing module and a liquid crystal imaging module which are connected in sequence, and also comprises a power supply module for supplying power to the radio frequency module, the STM data acquisition and imaging processing module and the liquid crystal imaging module; the radio frequency module is used for transmitting and receiving signals; the STM data acquisition and imaging processing module is used for acquiring a data stream signal from the radio frequency module and processing the acquired data stream signal to obtain point target data which can be displayed on a liquid crystal display; and the liquid crystal imaging module is used for carrying out imaging display operation on the point target data obtained by the STM data acquisition and imaging processing module. The utility model discloses a many hardware module framework realize signal processing system's design, can realize finally having the imaging system of the expanded communication interface of standard, high-speed data processing function, data transmission and memory function.

title_en: Magnetic resonance imaging system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a magnetic resonance imaging system. The magnetic resonance imaging system comprises: the system comprises a scanning bed, a magnetic resonance scanner, a non-contact motion monitoring unit and computer equipment; a magnetic resonance scanner is formed with a scan bore having a scan field of view; the scanning bed is used for carrying a subject and moving the subject into a scanning visual field; the magnetic resonance scanner and the scanning bed are respectively connected with the computer equipment; the computer equipment is used for controlling the movement of the scanning bed, controlling the magnetic resonance scanner to acquire the magnetic resonance data of the examinee and reconstructing a magnetic resonance image according to the magnetic resonance data; the non-contact motion monitoring unit comprises a frequency modulation continuous wave sensor, and the frequency modulation continuous wave sensor is connected with computer equipment. Through the method and the device, the problem that a motion monitoring system in the related technology cannot monitor the posture change information of the examinee and the physiological motion generated due to the vital signs at the same time is solved, and the posture change information of the examinee and the physiological motion generated due to the vital signs can be monitored at the same time.
assignees: SHANGHAI UNITED IMAGING MEDICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: For the equipment, system and method for detection and the processing of heartbeat signal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the detection for heartbeat signal and the equipment, system and method for processing.A kind of heartbeat detection apparatus, including at least one optical reflection sensor (10 or 10a and 10b) that will be positioned on the skin of people.The sensor unit is provided with optical transmitting set (11) and the corresponding optical receiver (12) that electric signal is converted by the light of skin reflex, and including the electrically tuneable optical filter (16,17) for being connected to transmitter, receiver or both of which, to select desired optical wavelength in operation, and the processing of signal that so obtains is performed to enhance heartbeat signal.Also illustrate system and detection method with the equipment.

title_en: Intelligent alarm method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent alarm method and an intelligent alarm device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining target vital sign data of a target object, determining a body state of the target object based on the target vital sign data, determining alarm parameters based on the body state of the target object, determining the position of the target object through the UWB module when the body state of the target object is in an abnormal state, sending alarm information to target equipment when the duration of the abnormal state of the body state of the target object is longer than or equal to a preset duration, and controlling an alarm module to alarm based on the alarm parameters, wherein the alarm information carries the target vital sign data and the position. The method can realize the positioning and alarming of the target object when the body state of the target object is abnormal, thereby reducing the loss and casualties caused by accidents.
assignees: OPPO GUANGDONG MOBILE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: System for detecting a course of motion and/or vital sign parameters of a person
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for detecting a course of motion of a person. The method comprises the following steps: detecting, by a non-contact sensor, a plurality of images of a person during motion, wherein the plurality of images depict motion of a body element of the person; at least one skeletal model having a limb position is created for at least some of the plurality of images, and a course of motion is calculated from the motion of the body element of the person by comparing changes in the limb position in the at least one created skeletal model. At the same time vital sign parameters and/or signal processing parameters relating to the person can be detected and analyzed.
assignees: METRA LABS NEW TECH AND SYSTEMS INC

title_en: System and method for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring uses a radar unit positioned in the center of the cabin to acquire image data of the vehicle cabin and uses a processor to generate detection of occupancy of a seat within the vehicle cabin, classification of an occupant, detection of a gesture, determination of a seat belt state, and monitoring of vital signs of the occupant. The output unit may perform a response adapted to the state of an occupant of the vehicle cabin.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of vital sign detection, and discloses a non-contact vital sign detection system which comprises a host, a slave and a terminal display device, wherein the slave comprises a slave processor, a millimeter wave radar chip and a slave communication module; the millimeter wave radar chip is used for receiving the millimeter wave radar parameters sent by the host, generating frequency modulation continuous waves according to the millimeter wave radar parameters and transmitting the frequency modulation continuous waves; receiving an echo signal of a user to be tested and sending the echo signal to a slave processor; the slave processor is used for obtaining the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the user to be detected through a preset respiratory heartbeat algorithm according to the echo signal of the user to be detected, and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to the master through the slave communication module; the host is used for receiving the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the user to be detected and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to the terminal display equipment; and the terminal display equipment is used for receiving and displaying the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the user to be detected. The method has the advantages of realizing non-contact detection, being convenient to use and user-friendly, and being capable of remotely detecting the vital sign information under the condition of no contact.
assignees: FUJIAN HUAHAI TRANSSION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human presence detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body presence detection system and method. The human body presence detection system includes a plurality of radar modules each configured to detect a human body presence within a detection range thereof, generate human body presence detection information indicating the detected human body presence, and transmit the generated human body presence detection information to the information processing device, and the information processing device is configured to receive the human body presence detection information from the plurality of radar modules and determine a human body presence in a detection space in which the plurality of radar modules are disposed based on the human body presence detection information from the plurality of radar modules.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ON BRIGHT ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Electronic deviece, and method for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 전자장치 및 생체정보 추정방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect, an electronic device may comprise: a main body; a sensor part disposed on one surface of the main body to detect a biological signal of a subject; a first output part comprising a light emitting part disposed on one surface of the main body, and guiding a measurement step to a user by adjusting the light emitting method of the light emitting part; and a processor that controls the first output part according to the measurement step, and estimating the biometric information of the user based on a biosignal detection result of the sensor part. Therefore, the present invention enables each measurement step to be efficiently guided to the user.
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 전자장치는, 본체, 상기 본체의 일면에 배치되어 피검체의 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 상기 본체의 일면에 배치되는 발광부를 포함하며, 상기 발광부의 발광 방식을 조절하여 사용자에게 측정 단계를 안내하는 제 1출력부, 및 상기 측정 단계에 따라 상기 제 1출력부를 제어하고, 센서부의 생체신호 검출결과를 기초로 사용자의 생체정보를 추정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for radio-frequency imaging sensors for advanced fingterprint biometrics and medical imaging
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, systems, and implementations of an ultra-compact RF (30 GHz-10 THz) imaging sensor topology that provides a new insight into the human skin are disclosed. The skin tissue is the largest organ in the body—both in weight and surface area—and stores valuable information that can revolutionize security biometrics and mobile health monitoring. The proposed compact sensor enables, for the first time, portable and wearable devices to perform superior biometric authentication compared to current fingerprint methods. Additionally, these devices could probe into the skin to monitor vital signs in real-time and enable mobile health monitoring.
assignees: TRICHOPOULOS GEORGIOS;THEOFANOPOULOS PANAGIOTIS;ARIZONA BOARD OF REGENTS FOR AND ON BEHALF OF ARIZONA STATE UNIV

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Through-wall radar remote assisting system based on WiFi secure communications
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of through-wall radar remote assisting system based on WiFi secure communications, including：Through-wall radar device, wireless network module and remote assisting system center；Through-wall radar device includes transmitting antenna and reception antenna；Transmitting antenna can emit ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave, penetrate in the personnel targets after wall is mapped to wall, while the ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave that reception antenna reception reflects；Wireless network module is attached with through-wall radar device, wireless network module and remote assisting system center to center communications；By wireless network module, the personnel targets information of detection is uploaded to remote assisting system center by through-wall radar device.The utility model advantageous effect：It solves under complicated operational environment, through-wall radar device needs remotely to carry out the problem of assistance judges, due to being the wireless communication based on WPA between remote assisting system and through-wall radar device, so safe, transmission range is long, and versatility is high.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES INST AUTOMATION

title_en: Human life detection device in car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a human life detection device in car, which comprises a roof, the roof lower surface passes through installation screw fixed connection's device shell, the movable hole has been seted up to the left surface of device shell, the multi-angle turn trough has been seted up to the inner wall in movable hole, the ball ejector pin has been cup jointed to the inner wall in multi-angle turn trough, the inside of device shell is equipped with information processing apparatus and fine-tuning respectively, the side of device shell is equipped with signal acquisition device. The human body life detection device in the automobile has the advantages that the detection head, the information processing box and the ultra-wide spectrum radar type life detection instrument connected with the information processing box are arranged inside the automobile body, so that the detection of the life characteristics of a driver is realized, and the human body life detection device in the automobile has the effects of detecting the life characteristics of the driver and automatically alarming when a traffic accident is sent by controlling the main board and the infinite signal transmitter connected with the front surface of the main board.

title_en: Fire control photoelectric smoke detector with life detection function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting equipment technical field specifically is a fire control photoelectric smoke detector with life detects function, including installation box, photoelectric smoke detector, infrared ray image probe and protection device, installation box lower surface is equipped with photoelectric smoke detector and infrared ray image probe, and infrared ray image probe's lower extreme is equipped with protection device, and protection device includes protection base, glass cover and scrapes the hawk, and beneficial effect is: servo motor drives the axostylus axostyle that is equipped with driving pulley through the belt to control the scraping board and come the flyback in the below of glass cover and move, the medial surface that the scraping board is close to the glass cover bonds and has the brush, and the outer wall of glass cover is hugged closely to the brush, and when the scraping board comes the flyback and moves, the brush cleans the smog that the glass cover outer wall is infected with, prevents to be infected with and causes the influence at the surperficial smog of glass cover to the detection of glass cover.
assignees: HEBEI SHANGBO MINING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Infant monitoring system and infant pacifier
abstract_en: Various embodiments of the present disclosure relate to infant monitoring systems, and infant pacifiers. The infant monitoring system combines an infant pacifier having a sensor for detecting a position or sucking action of the pacifier and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. Vital signs sensor output is interpreted in view of the sensing of the pacifier. In this way, nipple sucking action may be prevented from being misinterpreted as or otherwise corrupting different vital sign measurements (such as heart rate or breathing rate).

title_en: A kind of non-contact vital sign monitoring method based on millimetre-wave radar, apparatus and system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of non-contact vital sign monitoring method based on millimetre-wave radar, apparatus and system, this method comprises: extracting the echo-signal for encountering object to be measured back reflection based on transmitting signal；Transmitting signal be mixed with echo-signal and generates mixed frequency signal；AD sampling is carried out to mixed frequency signal, generates time-domain sampling signal；Range conversion is carried out to time domain sampled signal, obtains the one-dimensional range profile of radar；It obtains peak-peak in one-dimensional range profile and obtains target range unit, and calculate the phase on target range unit；Above-mentioned range conversion and phase calculation step are repeated according to radar frame refreshing frequency, acquisition calculates separately the phase sets in same distance unit every time and carries out phase difference processing, obtains phase difference set；Phase difference set is filtered, the vital sign parameter signals of object to be measured are obtained and is converted, vital sign is obtained.The present invention solves the problems, such as contact measurement bring inconvenience in the prior art and infects, and realizes non-cpntact measurement, practical convenient is high and avoids contact with infection.
assignees: CHANGSHA MICROBRAIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Breath detection sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiration detection sensor. Relates to the medical field. The sensor comprises a sensor shell, an elastic component, a first coil, a second coil and a conversion module, wherein the first coil, the second coil and the conversion module are arranged in the sensor shell; one side of the sensor shell is provided with an opening, and the elastic component is arranged at the opening of the sensor shell; the second coil is arranged on the elastic component, and one side of the second coil, which is far away from the elastic component, is arranged in the first coil; the second coil moves in the first coil along with the deformation of the elastic component. The processing module determines the respiratory state of the patient according to the first direct current signal converted by the conversion module, directly senses according to the abdominal state of the patient, reduces or even eliminates the influence of limb movement of the patient, improves the anti-interference capability, is not influenced by the environment of a ward where the patient is located, improves the reliability, can continuously monitor the respiratory state of the patient for many times, and reduces the treatment cost of the patient.
assignees: HENAN XIANGYU MEDICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact sleep vital sign detection method based on sector distributed radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep vital sign detection method based on a sector distributed radar. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a baseband signal output by a distributed radar, and identifying and eliminating a turning body movement signal; carrying out unbalance calibration and demodulation on baseband signals output by the distributed radar to obtain N paths of demodulation signals; separating the respiratory signal from the heartbeat signal of the N paths of demodulation signals, detecting and obtaining N respiratory rates and N heart rates; and respectively carrying out weighted fusion on the detection results of the respiration rate and the heart rate to obtain a fused respiration rate and a fused heart rate. The invention can detect the respiratory rate and the heart rate under different sleeping postures in a mode of combining a plurality of radars, and improve the accuracy of detecting the respiratory rate and the heart rate in the sleeping process. The invention provides a non-contact detection means for sleep health detection.

title_en: Method and program for exploring underground buried pipe
abstract_en: To provide a method and a program for exploring an underground buried pipe capable of detecting the underground buried pipe with high accuracy.SOLUTION: A method for exploring an underground buried pipe includes: a reflected wave acquisition step of acquiring reflected waves of radio waves of an underground radar transmitted toward a ground at a plurality of measurement points by scanning the underground radar along a survey line; an underground buried pipe detection step of detecting the reflected waves from the underground buried pipe appearing in a hyperbolic shape from an image created by arranging waveforms of the reflected waves for each scanning distance of the underground radar; and a reflection coefficient sign estimation step of estimating a sign of a reflection coefficient of the underground buried pipe.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for monitoring a bio-signal on the basis of a wireless network. A system for monitoring a bio-signal on the basis of a wireless network comprise: a bio-sensor for sensing a bio-signal generated by a sensing object; a bio-signal monitoring device for monitoring the bio-signal, determining whether the bio-signal is in a normal range or in an abnormal range on the basis of a set value, and transmitting state information of the sensing object to an emergency situation management device when the bio-signal is in the abnormal range; and the emergency situation management device for transferring the state information to a user terminal of a guardian of the sensing object. The sensing signal includes a cardiac impulse signal, a movement signal, and a respiration signal. The bio-sensor is an ultrahigh sensitive microwave sensor, and the bio-signal monitoring device extracts bio-signal feature information by collecting the bio-signal of the sensing object. The bio-signal monitoring device extracts a signal of the sensing object from a plurality of bio-signals generated by a plurality of sensing objects in the same place on the basis of the bio-signal feature information.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템은, 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 생체 신호를 센싱하도록 구현되는 생체 센서; 상기 생체 신호를 모니터링하고, 설정된 값을 기반으로 상기 생체 신호가 정상 범위인지 비정상 범위인지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 생체 신호가 상기 비정상 범위인 경우, 응급 상황 관리 장치로 상기 센싱 대상의 상태 정보를 전송하도록 구현되는 생체 신호 모니터링 장치; 및 상기 센싱 대상의 보호자의 사용자 장치로 상기 상태 정보를 전달하도록 구현되는 응급 상황 관리 장치를 포함하고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 생체 센서는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 모니터링 장치는 상기 센싱 대상의 상기 생체 신호를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하도록 구현되고, 상기 생체 신호 모니터링 장치는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 센싱 대상의 신호를 추출하도록 구현된다.

title_en: Electronic device including sensor module
title_ko: 센서 모듈을 포함하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present disclosure, an electronic device may include: a housing; a battery disposed in the housing; and a sensor module of which at least a part is disposed inside the housing. The sensor module may include: a substrate; a biometric recognition sensor disposed on the substrate; a sealing member covering at least a part of the substrate and the biometric recognition sensor; and a biometric signal detection electrode which covers at least a part of the sealing member, which is electrically connected with the substrate, and of which at least a part is exposed outwards. In addition, various embodiments may be possible.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 다양한 실시예들에 따르는 전자 장치는, 하우징, 상기 하우징 내에 배치된 배터리 및 적어도 일부가 상기 하우징 내에 배치된 센서 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 센서 모듈은, 기판, 상기 기판 상에 배치된 생체 인식 센서, 상기 기판 및 상기 생체 인식 센서의 적어도 일부를 둘러싸는 밀봉 부재, 및 상기 밀봉 부재의 적어도 일부를 둘러싸고, 상기 기판과 전기적으로 연결된 생체 신호 감지 전극으로서, 적어도 일부가 상기 하우징의 외부로 노출된 생체 신호 감지 전극을 포함할 수 있다. 그 외에도 다양한 실시예들이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: A method for human only activity detection based on radar signals
abstract_en: A method of detecting human presence includes using a radar sensor to monitor a space, and receiving an output signal from the radar sensor. A Fourier transform is performed on the output signal to produce a signal spectrum. It is decided whether the output signal is indicative of human activity dependent upon at least one acoustic feature of the signal spectrum and at least one spectral feature of the signal spectrum.

title_en: Through Wall Sensing System Using WiFi/Cellular Radar
abstract_en: A handheld through-wall sensing system comprising a transmitter/receiving operating at wireless data or cellular transmission frequencies. The system is operated in a monostatic radar mode with transmission occurring on frequency f o  and reception on a predetermined bandwidth centered on f o . The system may be operated on a pulsed or pseudo “half duplex” mode and have a transmit/receive pattern that is a function of the desired minimum stand-off distance.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Pet monitoring
abstract_en: A system to monitor a pet includes a wearable device with: sensor(s) to monitor vital sign; a wireless transceiver to determine a geolocation of the pet; a processor coupled to the sensor and the wireless transceiver, the processor capturing pet parameters for the pet's caregiver or owner.

title_en: Method and radar of life detection
abstract_en: In a life detection method of the present invention, a signal transceiver is configured to transmit a transmission signal to an area and receive a reflected signal from the area as a detection signal, a demodulator coupled to the signal transceiver is configured to receive and demodulate the detection signal to output a demodulated signal, a compute element coupled to the demodulator is configured to receive the demodulated signal and compute a RMS value of the demodulated signal, and a determination element coupled to the compute element is configured to receive the RMS value of the demodulated signal and determine whether having a living body within the area according to the RMS value and a RMS threshold value.

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced maximum permissible exposure (mpe) compliance based on vital signs detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflection signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflection signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on the reflection signals, the device can measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain a heart rate and/or breathing rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflection signals indicate human vital signs, such as a heart rate or breathing. The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether human vital signs are detected at the target object, and transmit the adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Non-invasive vibration-based material identification and leakage detection for underground pipelines
abstract_en: A nondestructive evaluation system and method are provided for detecting the material type and leakage of an underground service line. An impactor applies a controlled impact to an instrumented rod in contact or proximity with the service line, inducing stress waves that propagate into the service line and surrounding soil. Sensors on the rod and/or on the ground surface detect the resulting waveforms. A processing unit analyzes time and frequency domain characteristics such as wave speed, attenuation, and vibration response to determine service line material and identify anomalies associated with leakage. The system enables accurate, real-time diagnostics of buried pipelines without excavation or fluid interruption.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content

title_ko: 생체 신호 처리 장치 및 생체 신호 처리 방법
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 처리 장치가 개시된다.  일 실시예는 복수의 센서들로부터 서로 다른 전기적 물리량을 갖는 생체 신호를 수신하고, 생체 신호를 전압 입력부 및 전류 입력부 중 어느 하나를 통해 수신하여 처리한다.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the Abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Remote diagnosis system for faults of freight train on road
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of train transportations and provides a remote diagnosis system for faults of a freight train on road. The system mainly comprises a portable detector connected by network, a special railway management system and a fault diagnosis module; the portable detector comprises an intelligent processing unit, an infrared temperature detecting unit, an image shooting unit, an audio recording unit, a network transmission unit, a locating unit, an interface and a power supply unit; and the special railway management system comprises a data server, a management platform and an emergency commanding repeating terminal. Pictures and data of the faults are collected by the portable detector and are transmitted to a remote database for experts to diagnose, then the diagnosis result is transmitted back to the portable detector; and the field train operation personnel can timely repair the faults according to the diagnosis result; in this way, the hidden safety troubles buried by the field operating personnel due to error operations caused by limited professional knowledge can be shot; meanwhile, the lines are guaranteed to be opened timely, and the transmission efficiency is improved.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane device that can launch fire service inventory to captive in building fire
abstract_en: A kind of unmanned plane device that can launch fire service inventory to captive in building fire, including unmanned plane and connected ground control centre, wherein, unmanned plane includes a cabin, rotor is connected with cabin gusset, and an airborne laser radar and fire alarm bell are provided with cabin, and the fire service inventory delivery device is drum, inside there is the chamber of multiple storage fire service inventories, the fire service inventory bottom plate of each chamber is inclined-plane；The fire service inventory delivery device side is opening surface, and each chamber has a side door, and side door controls folding by rotary electric switch；The detection device is installed at the center of fire service inventory delivery device lower surface, has spinfunction, can scan the environment of large area around the unmanned plane.In rescue operations, unmanned plane is using camera and airborne laser radar record site environment and obstacle information and sends picture to ground control centre, is searched and rescued by radar life-detection instrument, fire service inventory is dispensed into trapped personnel hand in time.

title_en: Radar life detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of life detection and provides a radar life detector which comprises a remote control car, wherein a scanning imaging assembly is arranged in the top end of the remote control car and used for scanning and imaging the surrounding environment, a surrounding detection assembly is arranged on the outer side of the scanning imaging assembly and used for detecting surrounding vital signs, information acquisition assemblies are arranged on the left side and the right side of the remote control car and used for acquiring information of a rescuer, a storage battery is arranged in the bottom end of the remote control car, the surrounding detection assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging scanner fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the top end of the remote control car, radar detectors are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the top end of the remote control car and used for scanning living bodies in the left direction and the right direction, and the infrared thermal imaging scanner is used for carrying out infrared scanning on living bodies in the front direction and the rear direction, so that the detection range of the device is improved and the detection efficiency of the device is improved.
