title_en: A kind of Precise Position System for having the function of to monitor vital signs
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Precise Position System for having the function of to monitor vital signs,Silicone band both sides position distribution for being fixed on user's wrist location has velcro,Two side positions of one side end face of silicone band are equipped with air bag,Position between described two air bags is equipped with flexible PCB,Heart rate sensor for monitor heart rate is installed on the rearward position of air bag,Body temperature transducer for monitoring user's body temperature is distributed in the forward position of air bag,Vital signs is monitored by adding heart rate sensor realization,The design greatly facilitates conceptual design and the deployment of emergency management and rescue,And body temperature transducer then realizes the real-time monitoring to user's body temperature,Wireless communication module is coordinated to transfer data in the receiving device in the external world,And identification card uses the design of low-power consumption,And then improve its cruising time,And card reader one,The work of card reader two and identification card influences from working environment,And then greatly improve registration,It is simple and reliable for structure.

title_en: Through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal
abstract_en: The through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal that the invention discloses a kind of.Through-wall imaging method hardware device cost proposed by the invention is extremely low, WiFi signal caused by wireless universal router can be used as the transmitting signal of imaging system, and wireless router has been distributed widely in family, bank, market, office building and hotels and other places at present, substantial amounts provide signal source abundant for through-wall imaging system；The WiFi signal that the wireless router utilized generates has wider bandwidth, theoretically ensure that the high-resolution of imaging；The WiFi signal frequency range that the wireless router utilized generates meets ieee standard, and the whole world is general, and the frequency range is free frequency range, without paying frequency range usage charges；The hardware device small volume needed, compares traditional through-wall radar, it is only necessary to which configuration is with reference to receiving antenna and detection receiving antenna；Suitable for any through-wall radar imaging method；Through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal proposed by the invention can realize through-wall imaging to low-cost high-efficiency, lay a good foundation effectively quickly to solve indoor emergency event.

title_en: A kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization, including radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, the electromagnetic signal for modulating generation low-frequency ultra-wideband, and receive and demodulate target echo signal；MIMO imaging antenna array elements include the transmitting antenna array being made of multiple transmission antenna units, are used for outside electromagnetic radiation signal；And the receiving antenna array being made of multiple reception antenna units, it is used for receives echo-signal；Radio-frequency receiving-transmitting switch matrix unit, between radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement and MIMO imaging antenna array elements, for realizing the switching for the unlike signal interchannel that transmitting signal and echo-signal are constituted in different antennae unit；Data acquire and signal processing unit, generate transmitting signal for controlling radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, and for receiving target echo signal, carry out analysis imaging and target detection identification.The life detection radar of the three-dimensional localization of the present invention has many advantages, such as that positioning accuracy is high, penetration capacity is strong and high sensitivity.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional ground penetrating radar quantitative imaging method based on improved backward projection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional ground penetrating radar quantitative imaging method based on improved back projection, and relates to the technical field of ground penetrating radar imaging. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signal data of the three-dimensional ground penetrating radar in the survey area; preprocessing the echo signal data to obtain a three-dimensional data matrix, wherein the preprocessing comprises direct wave removal and gain control; segmenting the three-dimensional data matrix into two-dimensional profile data, and performing visual imaging on the two-dimensional profile data through improved back projection imaging; and extracting single channel wave A-scan data of the abnormal region, and quantifying the geometric dimension, the horizontal position and the buried depth of the underground buried target body corresponding to the amplitude abrupt change position of the single channel wave A-scan data. The method effectively solves the problem of misjudgment of directly judging target echo data in engineering practice, realizes the visualization of the underground target, simplifies the identification of the underground target, and provides technical support for the decision of subsequent related workers.

title_en: Moving target tracking method based on overcomplete angle dictionary optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moving target tracking method based on an overcomplete angle dictionary optimization technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining echo signals of a moving target by adopting a Doppler through-wall radar module; estimating and processing the echo signal by adopting a windowing time-frequency analysis method to obtain an instantaneous frequency value; fitting the instantaneous frequency value by adopting a high-order polynomial model to obtain a fitting curve; solving an instantaneous frequency inclination angle through a fitting curve, and further constructing an overcomplete instantaneous frequency inclination angle dictionary; performing time-frequency analysis processing on the echo signals by adopting an inclination angle dictionary to obtain optimal parameter domain distribution; processing the optimal parameter domain distribution by adopting a signal demodulation technology, extracting and processing the demodulated signal by adopting a characteristic value classification technology, and constructing an instantaneous frequency component set of the echo signal; and synthesizing the track of the moving target through the instantaneous frequency component set to finish the tracking processing of the moving target. The invention has high target positioning precision and good tracking effect.

title_en: Sleep sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of firstly presetting acquisition parameters of the millimeter wave radar, transmitting signals by the millimeter wave radar, capturing reflected signals by a receiving antenna, obtaining intermediate frequency digital signals after sampling, and sending sampling results to back-end computing equipment; and identifying the sleeping posture of the user by utilizing the point cloud characteristics and the breathing characteristics obtained after the characteristic extraction. Then, effective reflection points are extracted, and the breathing frequency is accurately estimated by a weighted average method by using the reflection points. The invention aims to realize an accurate and reliable vital sign monitoring system by using low-cost and easy-to-deploy commercial millimeter wave radar equipment, stably identify 6 sleep postures and accurately measure respiratory rate, acquire rich and stable point cloud information, enhance the characterization of the point cloud on the sleep postures and acquire more accurate respiratory rate estimation results.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV HEFEI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Multichannel through-wall radar micro Doppler characteristic enhancement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel through-wall radar micro Doppler characteristic enhancement method. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining Doppler images corresponding to optimal channels and Doppler images of optimal channels, secondly carrying out two-layer wavelet decomposition and low-rank decomposition on the Doppler images of each optimal channel, averaging low-frequency and low-rank components of the Doppler images to realize multi-channel Doppler feature fusion to obtain a fusion Doppler spectrum, carrying out human body movement direction angle estimation by using a BFGS optimization algorithm, carrying out stretching transformation on a frequency axis of the fusion Doppler spectrum by using the movement direction angle obtained by estimation, and carrying out linear smoothing technology complementation on data points missing after transformation, thereby obtaining a micro Doppler feature enhancement result. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through numerical simulation and actual measurement.

title_en: Portable urodynamics monitoring system using mobile device
title_ko: 모바일 장치를 이용한 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법
abstract_en: A portable bladder monitoring method using a mobile device is provided to monitor a patient's bladder function in a remote place by using the mobile device such as a PDA(Personal Digital Assistant) or a mobile phone. A portable bladder monitoring method using a mobile device includes the steps of: collecting bio-signals generated during urine collection and urination of a bladder by a sensor unit; measuring data required for a bladder function test from the collected bio-signals by a signal pre-processing unit(20); allowing a user to monitor the measured data through the mobile device by a control unit(40) remotely; and storing and managing the measured data by a server unit(50). The bio-signals are a bladder pressure signal, an abdominal electromyogram signal, and an impedance signal inside the urethral canal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법에 관한 것으로서, 자세하게는 모바일 장치와 중앙서버를 이용하여 방광기능을 검사하기 위한 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 방광의 축뇨와 배뇨 중 발생하는 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 상기 수집된 생체신호로부터 방광기능 검사에 필요한 데이터를 측정하는 단계; 상기 측정된 데이터를 모바일 장치를 이용하여 사용자가 원격 모니터링하는 단계; 상기 측정된 데이터를 수집하여 저장 및 관리하는 단계; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 휴대용 하드웨어를 제공하여 가정이나 병상에서 간단하게 방광기능 검사를 수행할 수 있으며, 자동으로 배뇨 시점을 정확하게 판정할 수 있고, 복압 측정을 위해 사용되는 항문 카테터를 사용할 필요가 없으며, 모바일 장치를 이용하여 방광기능 검사 과정에 대한 원격 관리할 수 있다는 장점이 있다. 
       
     방광기능 검사, 모바일 장치, 서버유닛, 복압, 휴대용
assignees: KIM KEO SIK;AN YANG SOO;SONG CHUL GUY

title_en: Antenna system for ultra-wideband radar applications
abstract_en: Antenna systems suitable for ultra-wideband radar applications, e.g. ground penetrating radar, through-wall radar systems, are disclosed in which backward electromagnetic radiation leakage, which is detrimental to antenna performance, is eliminated, and thereby enhancing the forward radiation performance of the antenna system. This necessarily results in insignificant electromagnetic interference to proximate antenna systems. Accordingly, an antenna array may be provided in which multiple antenna systems may be juxtaposed to one another even without a gap between adjacent antenna systems.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Wavelength division sensing method and apparatus for doppler radar vital sign monitoring and mechanical vibration monitoring
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and a radar system incorporating multiple carrier wavelengths. A multi-carrier radar method and system according to the present invention can be used to realize sensing of complex pattern vibrations using a wavelength division sensing technique.

title_en: Portable penetrating radar
abstract_en: Method and apparatus is a handheld ground penetrating radar which transmits radar pulses and acquires and processes received data for presentation on a display allowing a user to identify buried targets. Novel low cost approach to portable high-resolution light weight penetrating imaging. Method and apparatus for a portable penetrating radar incorporating a display depicting permittivity variation versus distance and time as the medium is scanned.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring radar equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign guards radar equipment includes radar radio frequency equipment, connector, ARM treater and signal transmission equipment, radar radio frequency equipment passes through the connector with the ARM treater is connected, signal transmission equipment with the ARM treater is connected, radar radio frequency equipment includes radar crystal oscillator, receiving antenna, transmitting antenna and radar chip, receiving antenna reaches transmitting antenna all with the radar chip is connected, the signal that radar crystal oscillator produced makes the inside broadband microwave signal that produces of radar chip, and pass through the transmitting antenna transmission, receiving antenna receives the return signal. The utility model discloses can realize human vital sign monitoring function, monitor human from multiple human signs such as the distance of equipment, respiratory rate, rhythm of the heart, equipment return signal intensity size contactlessly.
assignees: SENSEWORLD TECH CO LIMITED DONGSHENG NANXIANG

title_en: Apparatus for feedback according to emotional state
title_ko: 감정 상태에 따른 피드백 장치
abstract_ko:
감정 상태에 따른 피드백 장치가 개시된다. 
     본 고안은 사용자가 소정의 스포츠 경기를 진행하여 점수를 획득할 때마다 상기 사용자에 부착된 복수의 센서로부터 생체 신호를 측정하는 신호 측정부, 상기 측정된 생체 신호를 사용자별로 분류하여 저장하는 제1 데이터 베이스부, 소정의 평균 생체 신호 및 상기 평균 생체 신호에 대응하는 감정 정보를 저장하는 제2 데이터 베이스부, 상기 평균 생체 신호를 참조하여 상기 제1 데이터 베이스부에 저장된 생체 신호에 대응하는 감정 정보를 제2 데이터 베이스부에서 검색하는 감정 검색부, 상기 감정 검색부에 의해 검색된 감정 정보를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 감정 상태 정보를 생성하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 사용자에게 상기 감정 상태 정보에 대응하는 피드백을 수행하는 감정 피드백부를 포함하는 감정 상태에 따른 피드백 장치를 제공한다. 
     본 고안에 의하면, 스포츠 경기 중 생체 신호를 측정하여 실시간으로 감정 상태를 분류하고, 기 저장된 데이터 베이스(DB) 정보를 이용하여 선수의 감정 상태에 따른 피드백을 제공함으로써, 인간의 감정 상태를 세부적으로 분류할 수 있고, 감정 상태 판단의 정확성을 향상시키고, 특정 선수에게 존재하는 심리적인 문제점을 용이하게 개선하게 할 수 있고, 스포츠 선수에게 자기조절을 통한 피드백 학습을 제공하여 집중력과 내적으로 초점적 주의 상태와 관련된 생체패턴에 도달시킬 수 있으며, 양궁이나 골프 퍼팅과 같은 집중력과 주의를 요하는 스포츠 분야의 훈 련과정을 촉진시키고 수행 능력을 증진시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Three-dimensional through-wall target imaging radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional through-wall target imaging radar system. The system is a target radar imaging system, a wave source frequency is 4GHz, and transmitting power is 2W. An antenna is arranged on a moving platform, and the moving platform is driven by rotation of a rotating plate to reciprocate in uniform motion so as to scan a tested organism in a reciprocated manner to obtain echo signals. The acquired signals are subjected to amplifying, filtering and down conversion and then subjected to imaging algorithm processing by an FPGA (field programmable gate array) pulse signals to obtain image data, and the image data are finally displayed through a display.

title_en: Flood early warning grade division and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood early warning grade division and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, dividing flood forecast grades into four grades of extra large, medium and small according to a recurrence period; step 2, corresponding early warning is divided into four levels of extreme danger, high danger, danger and low danger for early warning; the method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, sensors are buried in a water system drainage basin, a remote sensing station is built to collect rainfall and hydrological data, the data are transmitted back to a central station through a communication system to be analyzed and processed, and flood forecasting is carried out according to an analysis result, such as large investment, difficult maintenance, incomplete data, short forecasting period and the like, and timeliness, stability and accuracy of the rainfall forecasting, the flood forecasting and mountain flood disaster forecasting are seriously affected.
assignees: GUIZHOU EAST CENTURY TECH CO LTD;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HYDROGRAPHIC BUREAU ZHAOQING HYDROLOGY BRANCH

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar wall type intelligent identification method based on yolov5
abstract_en: A wall-penetrating radar wall type intelligent identification method based on yolov comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring wall data by using an ultra-wideband single-channel through-wall radar, and preprocessing the acquired data to obtain available data; step 2, intercepting an image with a wall object for each data; marking each image to obtain a final data set and a label; step 4, sending the marked data set into a yolov model for feature training; and step 5, training a model to obtain model weights for target detection and classification. The method disclosed by the invention can improve the accuracy of target detection.
assignees: CHINA INSTITUTE OF RADIO WAVE PROPAGATION CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION NO 22 RESEARCH IN

title_en: Intelligent emergency marker light display system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency marker lamp display system, wherein a language identification system, a temperature sensor and a smoke detector are electrically connected with an emergency lighting controller, the emergency lighting controller is electrically connected with an escape emergency lighting lamp and a life detection and positioning module, the life detection and positioning module and the escape emergency lighting lamp are electrically connected with the display system, the smoke detector detects fire smoke, meanwhile, the temperature sensor can monitor the temperature of a fire place in real time, so that the situation of false triggering of the fire is prevented, the voice identification system can identify the voice of a person in the case of the fire, then the emergency lighting controller can simultaneously receive a detection signal of the smoke detector, a detection signal of the temperature sensor and a disaster signal identified by the voice identification system, then the escape emergency lighting lamp is controlled to be lightened, meanwhile, the escape lamp is displayed in a matched animation mode through the display system, and the direction of the person far away from a fire source is reminded.

title_en: Human body perception detection method based on FMCW millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body perception detection method based on an FMCW millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of acquiring and processing data of an environment by adopting the FMCW millimeter wave radar to obtain a plurality of frames of original intermediate frequency signal data, carrying out frame processing to obtain an adaptive speed amplitude threshold value and a target speed energy amplitude of a corresponding frame, then detecting by using different strategies according to the human body perception detection result of the previous frame, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or a stationary human body target if the human body perception detection result of the previous frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion if the current frame is larger than the adaptive speed amplitude threshold value, otherwise, carrying out human vital sign detection to obtain a target breathing signal and a heartbeat signal, analyzing and judging whether the current frame is a human body target or not, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not if the human body perception detection result of the previous frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not. The invention can detect the static human body target and the human body target with large-amplitude action, and realize more accurate human body perception detection in different scenes.

title_en: Indoor vital sign sensing device and sensing method based on SLAM technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor vital sign sensing device and an indoor vital sign sensing method based on SLAM technology, wherein the indoor vital sign sensing device comprises an SLAM mobile detection vehicle placed on the ground and a positioning radar structure arranged on a wall, the positioning radar structure is communicated with the SLAM mobile detection vehicle, and the SLAM mobile detection vehicle is provided with a laser radar for scanning the surrounding environment, an odometer for acquiring distance and direction information of an object and an inertial measurement unit for measuring acceleration and angular velocity of the vehicle. Through SLAM simultaneous localization and mapping technique, automatic calculation route, automatic obstacle avoidance and travel to the monitoring target nearby region, the millimeter wave radar on the car starts the vital sign of monitoring object, realizes the accurate control of vital sign, in time sends the alarm to the dangerous emergence in the ward to guarantee monitoring object's safety.

title_en: Search and rescue device for radar detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a search and rescue device for radar detection. The life detector comprises a life detector body, wherein a mobile platform which is used for driving a search and rescue equipment body to move is installed on the life detector body. According to the invention, the life detector is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle through the arrangement of the mobile platform, so that the life detector can be used in different rescue scenes, the mobility and the search range of the search and rescue device are obviously improved, trapped people can be found out in time, the rescue success rate of the trapped people is improved, and the flexibility and the efficiency of rescue work are improved. Through the setting of dehumidification subassembly, the drying cabinet absorbs the moisture in the life detection appearance through the drier to reduce the humidity in the life detection appearance, make the moisture in the life detection appearance be difficult to too high, make the life detection appearance be difficult to receive the influence of moisture and produce the damage, improve the security and the life of life detection appearance.

title_en: Disaster safety robot
title_ko: 재난 안전로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is an amphibious disaster safety robot that can be operated in narrow spaces such as overhead sewer pipes, as well as on general roads, sand, and water. The disclosed disaster safety robot comprises: a driving wheel unit capable of being independently driven and including a pair of driving wheels spaced apart from each other to form a spherical body; an environment detection unit including a first sensor module formed on an outer side of each of the pair of driving wheels; and a human life detection unit including a second sensor module formed on an upper portion of a spaced area between the pair of driving wheels, wherein the environment detection unit and the human life detection unit can maintain a posture while rotating in a direction opposite to a rotation direction of the pair of driving wheels.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Biological signal processing device and biological signal processing program
abstract_en: [Problem] To acquire vital information having enhanced accuracy from reflected waves obtained by transmitting radio waves to a living body. [Solution] As shown in Fig. 1, a biological signal processing device according to the present embodiment uses one radar module employing array antennas (23, 25), and by subjecting a reception signal to beam forming or using null beams, the ratio of complex signals of two reflected waves, one from a region R1 exhibiting large motion due to inclusion of vitals and the other from a region R2 exhibiting small motion due to absence of vitals, is used to extract a vital signal with body motion components removed. In the present embodiment, as a method for acquiring the reflected wave by designating a specific site, such as the region R2 (shoulder) having small motion due to absence of vitals, the reflected wave is multiplied by weight information w1, w2 obtained in advance by beamforming.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Anomalous phase detection based ground penetrating radars
abstract_en: A method of buried metal object detection is described, which includes generating RF signal in a radio frequency module, supplying RF signal to a ground penetrating radar, scanning the ground penetrating radar over an area comprising buried metal objects, and detecting a buried metal object using anomalous phase response measured in the reflected signals.
assignees: PRINCE SATTAM BIN ABDULAZIZ UNIV PSAU

title_en: A kind of method of through-wall radar to multiple mobile object real-time detection, separation
abstract_en: A kind of through-wall radar rejects complicated background signal to the method for multiple mobile object real-time detection, separation by a kind of Clutter suppression algorithm based on exponential smoothing filter, and the information of movement human target is retained more rapidly, exactly；By a kind of envelope detected algorithm based on Hilbert transform, so as to realize the crest that each moving target is placed in different envelopes；By a kind of based on the algorithm for being combined fixed threshold and adaptive threshold, so as to realize the separation of each moving target more quickly in different regions；The inventive method is simple, execution efficiency is high, it is adaptable to detection of the portable through-wall radar partition wall to human body target of doing more physical exercises, and is that through-wall radar is accurately positioned there is provided sound assurance to each moving target, can effectively improve the operating efficiency of through-wall radar.

title_en: Device to cut the underground line for the distributing board
title_ko: 특고압 전용 지상배전반 접속용 지중배전선 차단장치
abstract_en: An underground line interruption device for connecting a distribution board for a high voltage is provided to prevent the fire from being spread to the distribution board. A distribution board case(10) is installed on the ground. A distribution board(20) is embed in the distribution board case. An underground tube(30) made of an insulation material is buried under the ground and is connected to the bottom of the distribution board case. A distribution board power supply line(40) is composed of an active line and a neutral line and is arranged inside the underground tube. An external power supply line(50) is composed of the active line and the neutral line and is embedded in the underground tube. A conductive connection bar(60) is embedded in the underground tube through a support stand and connects the active line of the distribution board power supply line and the active line of the external power supply line mutually or connects the neutral line of the distribution board power supply line and the neutral line of the external power supply line mutually. An interruption device is installed in an outer portion of the underground tube and includes a case, a piston reciprocating linearly at right angles to the axial direction of the underground tube, a hitting part with a fire-retardant sealing the underground tube, a spring elastically supporting the piston, and a solenoid controlling the operation of the piston. A fire sensor(80) is installed in the distribution board case, and senses the fire of the distribution board. A control unit(90) receives a fire signal from the fire sensor is and control the operation of the solenoid. An alarm device(100) is controlled by the control unit and outputs the firing state to the outside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 특고압 전용 지상배전반 접속용 지중배전선 차단장치에 관한 것으로, 지면에 설치되는 배전반케이스(10)와; 배전반케이스(10)에 내설되는 배전반(20)과; 지중에 매설되어 배전반케이스(10)의 저면에 연통되는 절연재질의 지중배관(30)과; 활선(41)과 중성선(42)으로 구성되어, 지중배관(30) 내부에 배치되는 배전반전력공급선(40)과; 활선(51)과 중성선(52)으로 구성되어, 지중배관(30)에 내설되는 외부전력공급선(50)과; 'W' 자 형상의 절단부(63)와 절단부(63)의 양쪽 선단에 각각 구비되는 제1·2연결부(61,62)를 갖추고서, 지지대(S)를 매개로 지중배관(30)에 내설되어, 배전반전력공급선(40)의 활선(41)과 외부전력공급선(50)의 활선(51)을 상호 연결하거나, 배전반전력공급선(40)의 중성선(42)과 외부전력공급선(50)의 중성선(52)을 상호 연결하는 전도체 재질의 연결대(60)와; 지중배관(30)의 외면에 설치되어, 지중에 매설되는 케이스(71)와, 지중배관(30)의 축 방향과 90도로 교차하는 방향으로 직선왕복이동가능하게 내설되는 피스톤(72)과, 피스톤(72)에 설치되어 연결대(60)를 절단하면서 지중배관(30)을 밀폐하는 난연재의 타격부(73)와, 케이스(71)에 내설되어 피스톤(72)을 일방향으로 탄발지지하는 스프링(74)과, 케이스(71)에 설치되어 피스톤(72)의 동작을 제어하는 솔레노이드(75)를 갖춘 차단기구(70)와; 배전반케이스(10)에 설치되어, 배전반(20)의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서(80)와; 화재감지센서(80)로부터의 화재신호를 입력받아 차단기구(70)의 솔레노이드(75)를 작동제어하는 제어유닛(90)과; 제어유닛(90)에 의해 작동제어되어 화재상태를 외부로 출력하는 경보장치(100)로 이루어져, 지중배관을 따라 불길이 번져가지 않으며, 화재의 발생을 관리자가 즉각 알 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Biological signal measuring device based on electric stimulation for each part
title_ko: 부위별 전기자극 기반의 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 부위별 전기자극 기반의 생체신호 측정장치는, 사용자의 신체 일부에 대한 생체신호를 측정하는 복수의 생체신호 측정센서; 상기 사용자의 신체 일부에 복수의 전기자극 신호를 동시에 전달하거나 시간차를 두고 순차적으로 전달하는 복수의 전기자극 센서; 상기 복수의 생체신호 측정센서로부터 측정되는 복수의 생체신호를 모니터링하기 위한 모니터링부; 상기 모니터링부에서 모니터링된 상기 복수의 생체신호에 대한 정보가 저장되는 데이터베이스; 상기 데이터베이스에 저장되는 상기 생체신호에 대한 정보를 분석하여 상기 복수의 생체신호 중 미측정 값 또는 결측 값이 가장 적거나 없는 최적의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 최적의 생체신호 측정센서를 판단하는 제1 분석 알고리즘과, 상기 최적의 생체신호에 따라 미세전류의 양, 주기 및 미세전류에 의한 전기자극의 반복 주기에 따른 파형이 달라지는 전기자극 신호를 연산하는 제2 분석 알고리즘이 기저장되는 분석부; 및 상기 생체신호 측정센서로부터 상기 최적의 생체신호가 측정되도록 제어하며, 상기 전기자극 센서로부터 상기 전기자극 신호가 생성되도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System for the detection and classification of buried unexploded ordnance
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting buried metal objects such as unexploded ordnance and the collection of data for the classification of the detected objects based on parameters extracted from the collected data includes a wheeled cart, positioned on which is an array of transmitter coils for transmitting a series of excitation signals onto the area of interest and a sensor array of receiver coils and preamplifiers for receiving back the resultant eddy current decays emitted by the buried objects, a computer, and data acquisition electronics for acquiring and storing the received decays as decay data within the computer. The incoming EMI data are digitized and a data fitting process is performed to extract fit location and shape parameters. These data can be transferred to other data analysis systems for comparison to previously recorded signatures to determine whether the received decay data from the area of interest is attributable to buried metal objects or conversely to an object constituting an anomaly.

title_en: Contactless sensor-driven device, system, and method enabling ambient health monitoring and predictive assessment
abstract_en: An ambient monitoring device includes a housing, contactless sensors coupled to the housing, and a processing device disposed in the housing. The processing device is coupled to the contactless sensors. The processing device is to receive, from one or more contactless sensors of the plurality of contactless sensors, historical sensor data. The processing device is further to determine baseline vital signs based on the historical sensor data. The processing device is further to receive, from the one or more contactless sensors, current sensor data associated with a user that is within a threshold distance of the ambient monitoring device without contacting the ambient monitoring device. The processing device is further to determine, based on the current sensor data, current vital signs of the user. Responsive to determining the current vital signs do not meet the baseline vital signs, the processing device is to provide an alert.

title_en: Intelligent slope geological disaster monitoring and pre-warning device based on wireless sensor networks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent slope geological disaster monitoring and pre-warning device based on wireless sensor networks. The device comprises wireless sensor networks, the wireless sensor networks are connected with a data transmitter, the data transmitter is connected with a backbone network, the backbone network is connected with a receiving and analyzing system, and a pre-warning display screen is connected to the receiving and analyzing system. According to the utility model, the wireless sensor networks are buried inside a slope body; a wireless sensor network cluster head is used to acquire sound transmission signals at the initial catastrophe stage of a slope and the signals are transmitted to the data transmitter arranged at a safe position in a wireless way through a multi-hop path; the data transmitter transmits gathered information to the indoor receiving and analyzing system in a customized data format through the backbone network and transmits received signals to a computer of the receiving and analyzing system; the computer analyzes and processes the received signals and takes a pre-warning measure of a corresponding level according to a processing result; and the pre-warning information is transmitted to the pre-warning display screen at a section where a disaster occurs through a communication cable to remind passing vehicles, pedestrians or residential areas and the like to take corresponding disaster reduction and prevention measures.

title_en: Fire hydrant capable of preventing water resources from being stolen
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire hydrant for preventing water resources from being stolen, which relates to the field of fire hydrants and comprises a fire hydrant main body; the fire hydrant is characterized in that the lower end of the fire hydrant body is connected with a water supply pipeline buried underground, a water pressure sensor is installed on the water supply pipeline, a protective shell is fixedly installed outside the fire hydrant body, and the right side of the protective shell is rotatably connected with a 匚 -shaped protective shutter through a rotating shaft. The screwing piece, the W-shaped driving piece, the W-shaped slot, the fixing bolt, the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece are matched, and the screwing piece is carried by a firefighter, so that the phenomenon that an illegal person steals a water source in the hydrant main body is avoided; the outdoor fire hydrant is characterized in that a protection box type protection structure is arranged outside the outdoor fire hydrant, and a door lock structure is arranged on a baffle door on the protection box type protection structure, but the common door lock structure is easy to be opened by illegal personnel, so that the phenomenon of stealing water source inside the outdoor fire hydrant is caused.
assignees: HEBEI XINZHENGYE FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot for path planning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue equipment, in particular to a search and rescue robot for path planning, which comprises a bottom plate and a search and rescue assembly, wherein the search and rescue assembly comprises a head part, a main body, a battery compartment, a cover plate, a locking block and legs, the robot is started to detect the surrounding environment through the head part and transmit detected pictures to monitoring pictures of workers through a network, meanwhile, the legs start to operate to drive the robot to integrally start to move, the head part and the legs are connected stably on the main body, after entering a narrow space, a target with vital signs is detected through a thermal imaging instrument arranged on the head part, and the search and rescue task is completed through the joint of all execution mechanisms, so that the problems that when the existing crawler type search and rescue robot is used for searching and rescue, the flexibility of the crawler robot in the narrow space is limited, the running speed of the crawler robot is slow, and the search and rescue efficiency is influenced are solved.

title_en: Printing solvent storage room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing solvent storage room which is divided into a storage area and a filling area by a fire-fighting roller shutter door, wherein a solvent taking platform of the filling area is provided with an electromagnetic explosion-proof valve, and a solvent storage tank of the storage area supplies solvent to the electromagnetic explosion-proof valve through a buried conduit and a solvent pump; a lifting fire-fighting hood is arranged above the solvent taking platform, sealing grooves which are correspondingly nested with hood openings at the bottom of the fire-fighting hood are arranged around the solvent taking platform, a hood body of the fire-fighting hood is of a hollow interlayer structure, and a dry powder automatic fire extinguisher and a temperature sensor are hung at the top of an inner cavity of the fire-fighting hood; the filling area is provided with a combustible gas concentration detection alarm device and a fire automatic alarm system, and a fire alarm controller is in communication connection with a lifting mechanism of the fire control cover; the explosion-proof ventilation mechanism is in communication connection with the combustible gas concentration detection alarm device. Effectively improves the safety of the storage and the matching of the printing solvent, thoroughly avoids the occurrence of casualty accidents, and effectively reduces the accident loss.
assignees: LIUYANG YUANYOU PRINTING PACKING CO LTD

title_en: Smoke alarm device and method capable of sensing vital signs
abstract_en: A can perceive the smog alarm device and method of the vital sign, when the smog sensory module detects that there is smog in the environment, the smog sensory module sends the alarm signal to the microcontroller; the radar sensing module is used for judging whether personnel exist in the environment with smoke by using the human body micro-motion signal; the networking module is used for transmitting the processing information of the controller to a cloud or a control center; when smoke exists in the environment, the sound-light alarm prompting module carries out sound-light alarm prompting; when smoke exists in the environment and people exist in the environment, smoke alarm is carried out in a first acousto-optic prompt mode; when the fact that only smoke exists in the environment and no people exist is detected, smoke alarm is carried out in a second acousto-optic prompting mode. The invention can enable the rescue workers to know whether the trapped people exist in the fire search and rescue field at the first time, avoid missing the gold rescue time of the trapped people, more accurately find the search and rescue targets during search and rescue, and is beneficial to ensuring the life safety of the trapped people.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINGHUA PHASE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Feature extraction method and device for vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature extraction method and device of vital sign signals, comprising the following steps: modeling vital sign signals caused by chest movement; mixing echo signals of a continuous wave radar system to obtain beat frequency signals for modeling; obtaining a phase gradient of the obtained beat frequency signal, and estimating a second-order delay product; estimating a second-order cyclic time-varying torque using the second-order delay product; root of Chinese characterEnhancement spectrum based on second order cyclic time-varying moment structure Extracting the strongest respiratory harmonic frequency in the enhancement spectrum; estimating the strongest respiratory harmonic order to extract the target respiratory rate Constructing harmonic suppression enhancement spectra from respiratory frequencies Extracting target heart beat frequency And iteratively optimizing and estimating the target respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency. The invention can realize accurate extraction of non-contact target respiration and heartbeat frequency under strong harmonic interference.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;PURPLE MOUNTAIN LABORATORIES FOR NETWORK COMMUNICATION & SECURITY

title_en: Vital sign detection method, device, equipment and medium in indoor scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection and discloses a vital sign detection method, device, equipment and medium in an indoor scene. According to the invention, the vital sign detection and snore detection are carried out on the scene to be detected by combining various detection data of the pressure-sensitive sensor, the millimeter wave radar and the microphone, so that the final target vital sign detection result is obtained, and the accuracy and the instantaneity of the vital sign detection are improved. Therefore, by implementing the invention, vital signs can be monitored more comprehensively, so that the requirements of users can be better met and the market competitiveness is improved.
assignees: WONLY SECURITY & PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for detecting vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting vital sign signals, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar mixed signals with target vital sign information; the method comprises the steps of adopting a sliding-moving target display method to eliminate static noise to radar mixed signals, obtaining target enhanced radar mixed signals, carrying out coherent accumulation to the target enhanced radar mixed signals, obtaining human body target position information, obtaining phase information according to the human body target position information, sequentially carrying out phase unwrapping and phase difference to obtain vital sign phase information, adopting an internal noise self-elimination method to the vital sign phase information, extracting initial heartbeat signals, adopting a sliding average filtering method to extract initial respiratory signals, and carrying out band-pass filtering to the initial heartbeat signals and the initial respiratory signals to obtain heartbeat signals and respiratory signals. The invention can effectively solve the problem of serious interference caused by environmental noise when the FMCW radar is used for monitoring the respiration and the heart rate.

title_en: System for monitoring living body signal
title_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A system for monitoring a biometric signal is disclosed. The system for monitoring a biometric signal according to the present invention is provided on a movable device in an indoor space, and comprises: a radar unit which uses an impulse radar to track a location of a monitoring target to determine a coordinate of the monitoring target, and gives directivity to the impulse radar according to the coordinate of the corresponding monitoring target to receive a biometric signal of the monitoring target; and a first control unit which refers to the coordinate of the monitoring target to move the movable device to a location for acquiring the biometric signal of the monitoring target, and determines the breathing rate and the heart rate from the biometric signal received by the radar unit to determine an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 시스템은, 실내에서 이동가능한 장치에 제공되며, 임펄스 레이더를 이용하여 모니터링 대상의 위치를 추적하여, 모니터링 대상의 좌표를 결정하고, 해당 모니터링 대상의 좌표에 따라 임펄스 레이더에 지향성을 부여하여, 모니터링 대상의 생체신호를 수신하는 레이더부와, 모니터링 대상의 좌표를 참조로, 모니터링 대상의 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 위치로 상기 이동가능한 장치가 이동하도록 구동하고, 상기 레이더부가 수신한 생체신호로부터 호흡수 및 심박수를 결정하여, 응급상황을 판단하는 제1제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Driver Vital Detecting System using Impulse UWB RADAR
title_ko: 임펄스 초광대역 레이더를 이용한 차량 운전자 생체 신호 측정 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alarm system (100) for measuring a bio-signal of a vehicle driver using an impulse ultra wide band (UWB) radar, which comprises: an impulse UWB radar module (110) for receiving a wireless signal reflected by emitting a UWB impulse signal toward a heart (H) and a lung (L) of a driver; a conversion module (120) for converting the received wireless signal for the driver into heartbeat and respiration signals; a bio-abnormality analysis module (130) for comparing the converted heartbeat and respiration signals with the range of predetermined normal heartbeat and respiration values to determine a bio-abnormality; and an alarm module (160) for generating an alarm by receiving information on the bio-abnormality through a communications module (150) when the bio-abnormality analysis module (130) determines the bio-signal as the bio-abnormality that the heartbeat or respiration signals are out of the range of the predetermined normal heartbeat and respiration values.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 임펄스 초광대역 레이더를 이용한 차량 운전자 생체 신호 측정 경보 시스템(100)에 관한 것으로, UWB 임펄스 신호를 운전자의 심장(H) 및 폐(L)를 향하여 조사시켜 반사되는 무선신호를 수신하는 임펄스 초광대역 레이더 모듈(110);과, 상기 수신된 운전자에 대한 무선신호를 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호로 변환시키는 변환모듈(120);과, 변환된 상기 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호를 소정의 정상 심박값 범위 및 소정의 정상 호흡값 범위와 비교하여 생체이상을 판단하는 생체이상 분석모듈(130);과, 상기 생체이상 분석모듈(130)에 의해 상기 심박 신호 또는 상기 호흡 신호가 상기 소정의 정상 심박값 범위 및 소정의 정상 호흡값 범위를 벗어나는 생체 이상인 것으로 판단되는 경우, 상기 생체 이상에 대한 정보를 통신 모듈(150)을 통하여 전달받아 경보를 발생시키는 경보 모듈(160); 을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 임펄스 초광대역 레이더를 이용한 차량 운전자 생체 신호 측정 경보 시스템(100)에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and method for customized addiction therapy based on bio signal
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a patient-customized disintoxication system based on a biosignal, and a method therefor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the patient-customized disintoxication system comprises: a sensor measuring the biosignal from a user; a condition determination part determining condition of the user based on the measured biosignal; a cognitive behavior treatment image determination part determining images of cognitive behavior treatment based on the determined condition of the user; and an image providing part providing the user with the determined images of cognitive behavior treatment.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 사용자로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서, 측정된 생체신호를 기초로 사용자 상태를 결정하는 상태 결정부, 결정된 사용자 상태를 기초로 인지행동치료 영상을 결정하는 인지행동치료 영상 결정부, 및 결정된 인지행동치료 영상을 사용자에게 제공하는 영상 제공부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 그 방법에 관련된다.

title_en: System for the detection and classification of buried unexploded ordnance
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting buried metal objects such as unexploded ordnance and the collection of data for the classification of the detected objects based on parameters extracted from the collected data includes a wheeled cart, positioned on which is an array of transmitter coils for transmitting a series of excitation signals onto the area of interest and a sensor array of receiver coils and preamplifiers for receiving back the resultant eddy current decays emitted by the buried objects, a computer, and data acquisition electronics for acquiring and storing the received decays as decay data within the computer. The incoming EMI data are digitized and a data fitting process is performed to extract fit location and shape parameters. These data can be transferred to other data analysis systems for comparison to previously recorded signatures to determine whether the received decay data from the area of interest is attributable to buried metal objects or conversely to an object constituting an anomaly.
assignees: NELSON HERBERT H;US GOV SEC NAVY

title_en: Ground Penetrating Radar with Multiple Correlators
abstract_en: A subsurface detection system may be capable of sensing a buried feature and providing an estimate of the feature's depth. Such a subsurface detection system may comprise a signal generator transmitting at least one signal toward a buried feature and at least one signal along a plurality of various length paths. Each of a plurality of correlators may be associated with one of the various length paths and receive both a signal reflected by the feature and a signal transmitted along one of the various length paths. Each of the correlators may correspond to a distance to the buried feature. As the reflected signal reaches each correlator it may identify a time offset between the arrival of the reflected signal and the signal transmitted along one of the various length paths. By so doing, a distance to the buried feature may be estimated by detecting the correlator with the shortest time offset.

title_en: Portable touchless vital sign acquisition device
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a non-contact MCG is anticipated as one embodiment. Additionally, a non-contact stethoscope, thermal sensor, or MCG could be utilized singly or in combination with each other, or included singly or together in other medical devices such as a fluoroscope, For example, a handheld, portable instrument comprising a non- contact stethoscope without a magnetometer or thermal sensor can provide a measure of acoustic signals without contacting a subject, while a non-contact thermal sensor as a single device can provide a rapid contactless temperature of a subject
assignees: UNIV FLORIDA;SKIDMORE FRANK M;DAVIDSON MARK;DONDA RUSSELL S

title_en: Audio life detection equipment for earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an audio frequency life detection device for earthquake disaster, which mainly comprises: the detection device is transmitted with the main control equipment through a wireless network; the method comprises the following steps that a special microelectronic processor is adopted, micro vibration transmitted in air or solid can be identified, after a main control device is placed in a safe area, a detection device is controlled to enter a rescue area through a direction control touch screen, a camera shoots and transmits topographic images in real time, a micro vibration sensor probe and a voice sensor probe transmit information to a micro vibration signal display screen and a sound wave display screen, the micro vibration sensor probe senses weak seismic wave signals transmitted from the surface layer of the ground, and the voice sensor probe can be in voice communication with a rescuer; the main control equipment directly transmits the voice signal to the detection personnel; approaching the rescuers infinitely according to the signal intensity, and then rapidly making a detailed rescue plan.

title_en: Through-wall radar signal optimization processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar signal optimization processing method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, performing target detection on a region to be detected by using a through-wall radar, and receiving multi-channel echo signals corresponding to a plurality of apertures; s2, respectively acquiring aperture domain data of different apertures from multi-channel echo signals to form a plurality of sub-aperture data groups, respectively performing weighted imaging on full aperture data corresponding to the multi-channel echo signals and each sub-aperture data group, then comparing weighted imaging results, and obtaining optimized imaging data signals from similar parts in each weighted imaging result; the device comprises a radar detection module and a signal optimization processing module; the invention has the advantages of simple implementation method, low cost, good optimization performance, high efficiency and the like, and can realize real-time signal processing and simultaneously inhibit clutter.

title_en: Ultra-wideband through-wall radar human respiration and heartbeat detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting respiration and heartbeat of an ultra-wideband through-wall radar life body, belonging to the technical field of radar detection and comprising the following steps: s1: receiving a through-wall echo signal; s2: partitioning the echo signals; s3: accumulating the correlation pulses; s4: suppressing wall echo; s5: denoising the wavelet; s6: decomposing the signal; s7: performing Fourier transform; s8: screening a frequency domain mode; s9: detecting a constant false alarm; s10: and identifying a plurality of life body targets. Wall clutter is removed through singular value decomposition, weak breathing heartbeat signals are enhanced, high-frequency noise is removed through wavelet transformation, breathing and heartbeat signals are separated through intrinsic mode decomposition, and breathing and heartbeat signals of a living body can be extracted at the same time; finally, identifying a plurality of life body targets according to the difference of breathing and heartbeat frequencies and position information of different life bodies; the signal-to-noise ratio is effectively improved in a certain mode, and the calculation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Array type electrode based on magnetic-induced method to detecting biosignal
title_ko: 어레이형 유도용량성 생체신호 전극 및 이를 구비한 생체신호 검출키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an array type inductance biosignal fabric electrode and a biosignal detection kit having the same. The inductance biosignal fabric electrode is formed by positioning a conductive thread or a conductive fabric-based coil type magnetic sensor for detecting a change in the volume of a biological tissue by using a change in inductance, on a fabric in a planar or three-dimensional structure. Buffer members are positioned between the inductance biosignal fabric electrode and the skin while being separated from each other to have a predetermined space to reduce motion. The inductance biosignal fabric electrode is configured as a single electrode or an array type electrode, and a fabric-based connector unit is provided to connect the inductance biosignal fabric electrode to power. The biosignal detection kit of the present invention comprises: an array electrode unit formed by stacking two or more electrode units including a fabric electrode which has a spiral coil, receives an oscillating signal from an oscillating circuit, and outputs the oscillating signal including a biosignal; buffer members positioned under the array electrode unit; and a bottom fabric positioned on the bottom of the buffer members, wherein the buffer members are installed to be spaced apart from each other and have a space therebetween.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유도용량(Inductance)변화를 이용한 생체조직의 체적변화를 검출하는 전도성 실 또는 전도성 직물 기반 코일 형 자계 센서를 직물 위에 평면 혹은 입체 구조로 위치시켜 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극을 형성하며, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극과 피부의 사이에, 완충부재들이 위치되되, 완충부재들이 소정의 공간을 구비하도록 이격되어 위치함에 의해 동잡음이 저감되도록 이루어지며, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극이 단일 전극으로 구성되거나 어레이형 전극으로 구성되며, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극에 전원을 연결하기 위한 직물기반 코넥터부를 포함하는, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극 및 이를 구비한 생체신호 검출키트에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 생체신호 검출키트는, 나선형 코일을 구비하며 발진회로로부터 발진신호를 수신하고 생체신호를 포함한 발진신호를 출력하는 직물전극을 포함하는 전극부를 2개 이상 적층하여 이루어진, 어레이 전극부; 상기 어레이 전극부의 아래에 위치되는, 완충부재; 상기 완충부재 밑에 위치되는, 밑면 직물지;를 포함하여 이루어지며, 상기 완충부재는, 다수개의 완충부재가 서로 이격되어 설치되되, 완충부재들 사이에는 공간이 구비되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Removable underground exploration radar device using the properties of the mediators
title_ko: 매개물질의 물성을 이용한 착탈식 지하 레이다 탐사장치
abstract_en: The removable radar underground exploration device comprises: a detector which detects an underground cavity or an underground buried object by transmitting and receiving signals to and from an earth surface while mitigating a property difference at the earth surface by using a mediator; and a transfer unit which provides a driving force and moves the detector along the earth surface, wherein the detector is mounted at a lower portion of the transfer unit; and a coupling member which couples the detector with the transfer unit such that they can be separated from each other. Since the detector can be removably mounted on a vehicle or a cart by way of the coupling member, it is easy to carry and transfer the detector. Also, since the detector is manufactured in a caterpillar type and a detecting sensor is installed inside a caterpillar, it is possible to bring the detecting sensor to be close to an uneven earth surface, which results in a stable exploration. Furthermore, it is possible to protect the detecting sensor and prevent transmission and reception signals from being scattered by mitigating a property difference at the earth surface by forming the caterpillar of a matching member such as rubber, etc., which increases an exploration depth.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 매개물질을 이용하여 지표면과 물성차이를 완화시키면서 지표면을 향하여 신호를 송수신하여 지하의 공동이나 매설물을 탐지하는 탐지기; 상기 탐지기가 하부에 장착되어 구동력을 제공하면서 상기 탐지기를 지표면을 따라 이송시키는 이송유닛; 및 상기 탐지기와 상기 이송유닛을 분리가능하게 결합시키는 결합부재;를 포함하여 구성되어, 
결합부재를 이용하여 탐지기가 차량이나 카트에 탈착이 가능하도록 제작하여 휴대가 편리하고 운반이 간편하고, 탐지기를 캐터필러 방식으로 제작하여 캐터필러 내부에 탐지센서를 설치하므로서, 탐지센서를 고르지 못한 지표면에 근접시키면서 안정적으로 탐사가 가능하며, 탐지센서를 보호하며 캐터필러의 소재를 고무 등의 매칭부재로 제작하여 탐지센서와 탐사대상 지표면과의 물성의 차이를 완화시켜 송수신신호의 산란을 방지하여 탐사심도를 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Physiological signal measurement apparatus
title_ko: 생체신호측정기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a physiological signal measurement apparatus, comprising: two pairs of electrodes to measure a physiological signal of at least a portion of a body of a user; a measurement unit to measure at least one among the impedance, the electrocardiogram, and the pulse transit time (PTT) of a human body from the two pairs of electrodes; a triaxial acceleration sensor to triaxially sense a sensing value related to a change in the measured posture of the user; and a control unit to determine the measured posture of the physiological signal by using the sensing value detected by the triaxial acceleration sensor, to determine at least one among the impedance, electrocardiogram, and PTT of the human body through the measurement unit by using a first condition when the measured posture is in a first mode, and to determine at least one among the impedance, electrocardiogram, and PTT by using a second condition which is different from the first condition when the measured posture is in a second mode. Therefore, according to the present invention, when a physiological signal cannot be precisely measured in a state in which a band type physiological signal measurement apparatus is worn, a physiological signal measurement mode is changed from a wearing mode to a non-wearing mode to measure the physiological signal in a condition corresponding to the non-wearing mode. Resultantly, the physiological signal can be precisely measured even at low temperatures and in environments with low humidity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호측정기에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 신체의 적어도 일부분의 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 두 쌍의 전극, 상기 두 쌍의 전극으로부터 인체의 임피던스, 심전도, PTT(Pulse Transmit Time) 중 적어도 하나를 측정하는 측정부, 상기 사용자의 측정 자세 변화와 관련된 센싱값을 3축으로 감지하는 3축 가속도센서, 및 상기 3축 가속도센서에서 감지된 센싱값을 이용하여 상기 생체 신호의 측정 자세를 판단하고, 상기 측정 자세가 제1 모드인 경우, 상기 측정부를 통해 인체의 임피던스, 심전도, PTT 중 적어도 하나를 제1 조건을 이용하여 결정하고, 상기 측정 자세가 제2 모드인 경우, 상기 임피던스, 상기 심전도, 상기 PTT 중 적어도 하나를 상기 제1 조건과 상이한 제2 조건을 이용하여 결정하는 제어부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 밴드형 생체신호측정기를 착용한 상태로 정확한 생체신호 측정이 어려운 경우, 생체신호 측정 모드를 착용 모드에서 비착용 모드로 측정모드로 변환하여 비착용 모드에 대응하는 조건으로 생체 신호를 측정함으로써, 낮은 온도와 낮은 습도 환경에서도 정확한 생체 신호를 측정할 수 있다.

title_en: Reconfigurable portable locator employing multiple sensor array having flexible nested orthogonal antennas
abstract_en: A portable locator for detecting a buried object characterized by an electromagnetic (EM) field emission employing three-dimensional (3D) sensor arrays each having three substantially-identical EM field sensors disposed on a flexible annular wall having a radial centroid defining a sensing axis. The flexible annular sensors are retained in substantial concentricity with the corresponding sensing axes disposed in substantial mutual orthogonality. A pair of 3D sensor arrays disposed on a first axis substantially orthogonal to a second axis defined by another pair of EM field sensors each having a sensing axis disposed along the second axis. The locator introduces a user-reconfigurable user interface (UI) employing a “sticky” ratcheting audio UI and a hollow hinge assembly for redisposing the sensor assembly from an operating to a storage disposition.

title_en: Color image rendering for ground-penetrating radar systems
abstract_en: Devices, methods and techniques related to image rendering for ground-penetrating radar (GPR) systems are disclosed. In one example aspect, a method for producing one or more images associated with a GPR includes receiving information representative of signals received by the GPR, determining at least three frequency bands associated with the received information, assigning color values to the received information corresponding to the at least three frequency bands, and generating a color image for the one or more objects by combining the received information in all of the at least three frequency bands together such that the color values in the color image indicate a size of the one or more objects, a depth at which the one or more objects is buried underground, or an electrical permittivity of the one or more objects.
assignees: L LIVERMORE NAT SECURITY LLC;TERES TECH INC

title_en: Mine geological environment monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine geological environment monitoring devices. In the monitoring device, a soil pressure monitoring device, a vibration sensor and a camera are all positioned on the same monitoring section in a monitoring area; the soil pressure monitoring device is buried below the ground surface to a set depth, the vibration sensor is fixed at the ground surface, the lower end of the fixing device is buried below the ground surface, the upper end of the fixing device is located above the ground surface, and the camera is fixed at the top end of the fixing device; the data output end of the soil pressure monitoring device, the data output end of the vibration sensor and the data output end of the camera are connected to the lower computer; the lower computer transmits data to the upper computer of the monitoring center through the data transceiver; and the upper computer of the monitoring center is used for determining geological environment data of a monitoring area according to the monitoring data of the soil pressure monitoring device, the monitoring data of the vibration sensor and the monitoring data of the camera. The utility model discloses can the geological environment in real-time supervision mine, avoid causing personnel's damage because the geological disasters in mine.

title_en: Loess landslide formation mechanism physical model test device under environment of undermining
abstract_en: A physical model test device of a loess landslide forming mechanism in a subsurface erosion environment comprises a water supply system, a test system, a collection system and a high-definition real-time camera system; the water supply system comprises a water supply barrel and a flowmeter, and the water supply barrel and the flowmeter are connected by a water supply pipe; the testing system comprises a model box, a slope model is buried in the model box, a porous latex tube communicated with a water supply barrel is buried in the slope model, a sensor is buried in the slope model according to conditions, and the change of a stress field and a seepage field in the slope body in the testing process is monitored through the sensor; the collection system collects accumulated water of the experiment system, the high-definition real-time camera system comprises a top camera, a left camera, a right camera and a front camera, and the change condition of the slope model in the experiment process can be recorded in real time; the utility model discloses considered the undermining to the influence of soil slope stability, especially be applicable to under the undermining environment loess landslide and form mechanism experimental study, easy operation, durable reliable, economic environmental protection, circulated repetitious usage.

title_en: Multifunctional solar heat collection and dissipation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional solar energy collection cooling system. The system mainly comprises a non-pressure-bearing solar heat-collecting and heat-dissipating water bag, a heat-insulating and heat-storing water tank buried under a north wall, a submersible pump for circulation, a high-pressure submersible pump for fire fighting, an automatic temperature difference controller, a temperature and time controller and the like, wherein the solar heat-collecting and heat-dissipating water bag is fixedly suspended on the north wall in the sunlight greenhouse, and the heat-insulating and heat-storing water tank made of composite rubber and plastic is buried in an underground foundation groove of a truss of the north wall of the greenhouse. The utility model has the advantages of low in construction cost, mend warm effectual, the operation is stable with low costs, does not occupy the cultivation soil in the canopy, has solved china's northern regional assembled sunlight greenhouse because there is not thermal-arrest temperature compensation measure, only is applicable to and plants low temperature crops such as leafy vegetables, strawberry, can't plant the problem of solanberry class thermophilic nature crop through winter, has eliminated the fire control hidden danger that greenhouse material is flammable simultaneously.
assignees: BEIJING HUAMEI WOLONG AGRICULTURE TECH CO LTD;HUAMEI ENERGY SAVING TECH GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING WOLONG AGRICULTURE & FORESTRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact respiration and heartbeat detection lamp based on UWB radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the space perception, concretely relates to contactless heartbeat detection lamp of breathing based on UWB radar technique, a serial communication port, include: the device comprises a power management module, a lighting module, a voltage processing module, a wireless communication module, a radar measuring module, a storage module, a display module and a transceiving module. This contactless heartbeat detecting lamp of breathing based on UWB radar technique sends the signal through two way TX board-mounted antennas of radar detection module, and rethread four way RX board-mounted antennas carry out the analysis to received signal, isolate breathing, heartbeat life information, has got rid of temperature and illumination to the interference of information acquisition with the transmission, has promoted the accuracy of detected information.

title_en: The remote supervision system of mankind's activity
abstract_en: According in a first aspect, including for the system for remotely monitoring the object in predefined space：Sonar module and radar module, it mutually couples so as to while obtains the data in relation to object；Processing subsystem, it is configured to：Control sonar module and radar module；Handle data；With communication with external apparatus information and instruction.According to second aspect, the system for nearby monitoring object includes：The noncontacting proximity sensor array of data is obtained at the same time, and wherein data include vital sign and the position of object；Processing subsystem, it is configured to：Control array；Handle data；With communication with external apparatus information and instruction.According to the third aspect, monitoring system includes：One remote system；One nearby system；SONDAR servers；An and console.According to fourth aspect, for being included by sonar module and radar module come the long-range method for monitoring object：The predefined space of selection is monitored for user using console；Determine the one group of event classified to alarm；And monitoring object.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar life detection instrument, and relates to the technical field of radar detection. This radar life detection instrument, including the guard box, the top of guard box is rotated and is connected with sealed lid, the equal fixedly connected with metal safe edge of each edge of guard box and sealed lid, the top of guard box is provided with the waterproofing mechanism corresponding with sealed lid, one side at guard box center is provided with radar life detection device body, one side of radar life detection device body is provided with handheld terminal fixed establishment, week side of radar life detection device body outer wall all is provided with avris protection mechanism, the bottom of radar life detection device body is provided with bottom damper. Through design waterproof sealing mechanism, terminal protection mechanism, detection device avris protection mechanism and bottom damper, can play fine guard action to radar life detection device, effectually prevented to lead to the damage of detection instrument because of bumping under adverse circumstances.

title_en: Ground buried pipe backfilling and compactness detection processing method for rock-soil thermal response testing hole
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for backfilling a buried pipe of a rock-soil thermal response test hole and detecting and processing compactness, and belongs to the field of new energy. The method comprises the following steps: after a plurality of test holes are finished, the buried pipe is put into the bottom of the hole, and the grouting pipe which has the slightly thicker pipe diameter and the same length as the buried pipe is also put into the hole together with the buried pipe; the prepared backfill slurry is injected into the bottom of the hole through the grouting pipe and returns to the ground through the annular space between the grouting pipe and the hole wall; jacking the backfill slurry in the grouting pipe into the annulus by using clear water to finish primary backfill; a radar is inserted into the hole from the lower part of the grouting pipe, a radar detection section of the test hole is generated in the process from bottom to top, and the depth of the cavity or the honeycomb section and the direction in the test hole are determined; perforating at a preset depth and a preset direction by putting a perforating gun under the grouting pipe, wherein the perforating gun emitting hole faces to the cavity or the honeycomb section; and finally, injecting the backfill slurry into the grouting pipe again, wherein the backfill slurry enters the cavity or the honeycomb section through the perforation channel.
assignees: SHANDONG FANGNENG NEW KINETIC ENERGY SCIENCE INST CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave mapping system and method for generating point clouds and determining vital signs to define human mental states
abstract_en: Millimeter wave (mmWave) mapping systems and methods are disclosed for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs to define a human mental state. A point cloud is generated that includes point cloud data defining a person or object detected within a physical space based on one or more mmWave waveforms of a mmWave sensor. Determining a pose of the person within the portion of the physical space from the point cloud data. One or more vital signs of the person are determined based on the mmWave waveform. Electronic feedback is provided that represents a human mental state of the person defined by the point cloud data and the one or more vital signs of the person.

title_en: Life detection device, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a life detection device, a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a use method thereof, aiming at the problems that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle has complicated operation when being provided with a life detection radar, the detection range of the life detection radar is small, and the life detection radar is exposed outside and is easily damaged by complex terrains when descending, the invention provides the following scheme, which comprises a detection shell, wherein the bottom of the detection shell is provided with an opening, both sides of the detection shell are provided with first threaded holes, the inner wall of one side of the detection shell is rotatably connected with a second rotating shaft, one end of the second rotating shaft is fixedly sleeved with a first semi-gear, in the invention, a swinging component can be used for driving the life detection radar to swing, so that the life detection radar can search in a large range, the search efficiency is improved, the installation is simple, and the height can be adjusted, when descending, the life detection radar is retracted to the inside of the detection shell, the safety of the life detection radar can be guaranteed, and the service life of the device is prolonged.
assignees: HUNAN HAOTIANYI AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, in particular to a vital sign monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: the method comprises the steps that a millimeter wave radar is adopted to transmit millimeter waves to a target direction pointing to a target area and receive echo signals, and at least one target to be detected in the target direction is separated from the echo signals; step S2: acquiring a breathing signal and a heartbeat signal of a target to be detected by adopting a processing device associated with the millimeter wave radar according to the echo signal; and step S3: and generating the respiratory frequency of the target to be detected according to the respiratory signal by adopting a processing device, and generating the heartbeat frequency of the target to be detected according to the heartbeat signal. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the targets in the target direction are detected through millimeter waves, the targets are separated in two dimensions of distance and direction angle, the targets which actually need to monitor vital signs are accurately obtained, and therefore good separation degree among multiple targets is achieved, and the multiple targets can be monitored simultaneously.

title_en: Respiratory heartbeat detection method and device based on signal self-adaptive standard comparison
abstract_en: The application provides a breath and heartbeat detection method and device based on signal self-adaptive standard comparison, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting microwave signals to a living body in a target range by adopting a millimeter wave radar meeting requirements; receiving echo signals formed by the reflection of a living body, filtering the echo signals to obtain a respiration original signal sequence and a heartbeat original signal sequence, and processing the respiration original signal sequence and the heartbeat original signal sequence to obtain possible respiration detection data and possible heartbeat detection data; comparing the respiration original signal sequence with the possible respiration detection signal sequence self-adaptive standard signal to obtain a respiration frequency value, and comparing the heartbeat original signal sequence with the possible heartbeat detection signal sequence self-adaptive standard signal in a preset time period to obtain a heartbeat frequency value; the respiratory rate value and the heartbeat rate value are displayed. The scheme can detect the respiratory rate value and the heartbeat rate value in a contactless, efficient and accurate way.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method based on improvement RPSEMD
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved RPSEMD-based millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method, which comprises the steps of performing signal preprocessing on echo signals of a target captured by a frequency modulation continuous wave radar module, performing fast Fourier transform on the captured signals in a distance dimension, positioning a distance unit where the target object is located by a distance door locking technology, performing phase extraction on the signals, performing phase unwrapping processing, enhancing the stability of the signals through differential operation, improving the signal quality through a median filtering technology, and separating and extracting vital sign signals through an improved RPSEMD algorithm model to realize millimeter wave radar vital sign detection. And taking the square sum of the cross-correlation coefficients as an objective function, optimizing the parameters of the traditional RPSEMD algorithm by using Bayesian optimization, and finding out an optimal group of parameters in a given parameter range. The result of the algorithm verification on the actually measured signals shows that the modal aliasing problem of the traditional algorithm in the process of decomposing the signals is reduced.

title_en: A readout circuit for multi-sensing
title_ko: 멀티 센싱 리드아웃 회로
