abstract_en: According to the present invention, in a multi sensor system, a readout circuit capable of creating a variety of signals inputted from TSP based on a touch or various environmental sensor signals inputted from an environment sensor as sensing information corresponding to the signals, and bio signals and environmental sensor signals may be sensed by including a touch signal without separate additional devices using one TSP so that corresponding signals are processed through a readout circuit corresponding to characteristics of signals when various signals are inputted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, 멀티 센서 시스템에 있어서, TSP로부터 터치를 기반으로 입력되는 다양한 신호 또는 환경 센서로부터 입력되는 다양한 환경 센서 신호를 해당 신호에 대응되는 센싱 정보로 생성할 수 있는 리드아웃 회로를 통합하여 구현하고, 다양한 신호가 입력되는 경우 신호의 특성에 대응되는 리드아웃 회로를 통해 해당 신호가 처리되도록 하여 하나의 TSP를 이용하여 별도의 추가적인 장치 없이 터치 신호를 포함하여 생체 신호 및 환경센서 신호도 센싱할 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: System for Emergency Notification of Solitude Oldster
title_ko: 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for notifying an emergency situation of the elderly living alone. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system for notifying an emergency situation of the elderly living alone, which is able to detect and analyze the status of the elderly living alone through bio signals, detect information on an emergency situation in real time, transmit the information to a management server, and allow the rapid response to the emergency situation. Therefore, the present invention provides a system for notifying an emergency situation of the elderly living alone, which comprises: a terminal including a sensor worn on the wrist of an elderly living alone and detecting bio signals periodically, and a communication unit transmitting the signal received from the sensor along with location information to a management server; and the management server analyzing the bio signals received from the terminal, and comparing the bio signals with pre-saved data, and, if it is determined that there is an emergency situation, transmitting the emergency situation information to the emergency rescue institution which is the closest to the location of the terminal transmitted from the terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 독거노인의 상태를 생체신호를 통해 감지하고 분석하여 실시간으로 응급상황에 대한 정보를 감지하여 관리서버에 관리전송함으로 신속하게 응급상황에 대처할 수 있도록 된 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명은 독거노인의 손목에 착용하여 생체신호를 주기적으로 감지하는 센서와 이 센서로부터 전달받은 신호를 위치정보와 함께 관리서버에 전송하는 통신부로 이루어지는 단말기; 상기 단말기로부터 전달 받은 생체신호를 분석하여 미리 저장된 데이터와 비교하여 응급상황이라고 판단될 경우 상기 단말기로부터 송신된 단말기의 위치와 가장 가까운 응급구조기관으로 응급상황 정보를 송신하는 관리서버;를 포함하는 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Localized triggering of human activity analysis
abstract_en: The present description relates to determining human activity in an environment (ENV) in which at least one sensor is configured to measure a parameter relating to human activity. This process comprises: - providing a device for detecting a human presence in the environment (GW, TV, BB1, PRN, BB2), and - activating the sensor (C11, C12, C13) if a human presence has been detected in the environment (RO1).

title_en: Mm-wave radar vital signs detection apparatus and method of operation
abstract_en: The present invention discloses mm-wave radar sensor to be applied for detection of the vital signs of humans, particularly babies, as well as animals, in clinical and daily life environments. The key system relevant elements are the utilization of mm-wave integrated radar system, with specific planar high-gain antenna radiation pattern, with separate receive and transmit antennas, and detection of the following biomarkers: heartbeat and respiratory dynamics. The method of operation calculates the probability of a number of possible events. In case that probability is above a predefined threshold, the interaction with end user or end system is initiated, typically by using arbitrary wireless communication. Corresponding event related predefined actions are performed in that case. Preferably, the system is using 60 GHz integrated radar front end working in Doppler operation mode, with 4 x 4 TX and RX planar radiation elements, with physical size typically in the range 4 x 2 x 1 cm, or smaller.

title_en: A vibration-based human detection system using piezoelectric sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vibration-based human detection system using a piezoelectric sensor (1 ) for search and rescue applications, by focusing on detecting human presence in disaster areas such as collapsed buildings. The microcontroller (2) in the system distinguishes between human and non-human vibrations by filtering noise and interference caused by environmental factors, using signal processing techniques and deep learning algorithms.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Radar-Based Vital Sign Estimation
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating range data based on the received radar signals; detecting a target based on the range data; performing ellipse fitting on in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals associated with the detected target to generate compensated I and Q signals associated with the detected target; classifying the compensated I and Q signals; when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a first class, determining a displacement signal based on the compensated I and Q signals, and determining a vital sign based on the displacement signal; and when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a second class, discarding the compensated I and Q signals.

title_en: Detection, location, and characterization of buried explosive devices and weapons caches
abstract_en: Embodiments of this invention utilize Fraunhofer diffraction to detect, locate, and characterize buried objects, and, in particular, weapons caches and/or potentially dangerous explosive devices, are to be detected and characterized according to rough size, shape, and reflectivity with respect to the probe energy (ultrasound, microwave, milliwave, etc.). Size is obtained by measuring the spatial pattern and/or width of the Fraunhofer diffraction wave. Reflectivity is obtained by normalizing the reflected energy with respect to the energy reaching the target object and the size of the reflective area of the target object.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, sway cancellation, patient identification, and subject monitoring sensors
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler- shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or to provide apnea therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.
assignees: KAI MEDICAL INC;DROITCOUR AMY;VERGARA ALEXANDER;SHING TOMMY;EL HOURANI CHARLES;NAKATA ROBERT;MOSTAFANEZHAD ISAR;MIYASATO SCOTT

title_en: Life detection system and method based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system and method based on a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, a life detection radar device carried on the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a motion compensation device connected with the life detection radar device, when the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flies in a region to be detected, the life detection radar device is used for detecting a life object, and in the detection process of the life detection radar device, the motion compensation device is used for compensating a radar detection signal according to real-time position information of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle so as to compensate displacement deviation generated by shaking of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, high detection efficiency and precision, flexible detection mode and the like, and can realize dynamic life detection.

title_en: Method and system for determining thickness of effective soil layer of soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining the thickness of an effective soil layer of soil, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a ground penetrating radar image of a target place; determining the calibration depth of a calibration object buried in soil; determining the depth of a calibration object in the ground penetrating radar image and the time of transmission of electromagnetic waves to the calibration object based on the ground penetrating radar image of the target place; determining the propagation speed of the electromagnetic wave in the soil based on the calibration depth and the time for transmitting the electromagnetic wave to the calibration object; determining a dielectric constant based on the propagation velocity; determining a soil moisture content based on the dielectric constant; and determining the thickness of a soil layer according to the depth of the calibration object in the ground penetrating radar image, the propagation speed, the dielectric constant and the soil moisture content. The method can improve the measurement precision of the soil layer thickness.

title_en: Method and system for processing sign data based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a sign data processing method and a system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly adopting the frequency modulation continuous wave radar to transmit electromagnetic wave signals to a human body to be detected so as to detect the mechanical motion signals of the chest wall of the human body to be detected and receive returned echo signals; then sampling the echo signals, processing the sampled echo signals by using a multiple signal classification algorithm to obtain a high-resolution range profile, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals according to the high-resolution range profile; finally, physical sign data of the human body to be detected are determined according to the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals, wherein the physical sign data comprise respiration rate, real-time respiration rate variability, heart rate and real-time heart rate variability; the invention can detect the vital signs of the human body to be detected more conveniently and more efficiently, realizes the high-precision real-time extraction of the respiration rate, the heart rate, the variability of the respiration rate and the variability of the heart rate, and provides accurate and clear sign data.

title_en: Vital sign supervision is breathed and air purification healthy and is supported device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring and air purifying health-care device, and in particular relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, which comprises a monitoring shell, a driving motor, a rotating block and a transverse extension deflection adjusting mechanism; the transverse extension deflection adjusting mechanism comprises a rotating frame, an adjusting screw rod, an adjusting motor, a sleeve block, a linkage bar, a sleeve and a vertical motor, wherein the output end of the vertical motor is fixedly provided with the vertical frame, and the vertical deflection adjusting mechanism is arranged in the vertical frame. According to the invention, the displacement adjusting mechanism is transversely prolonged, so that the monitoring biological radar can automatically carry out displacement adjustment according to the signal intensity, thus the monitoring operation is carried out under the stronger signal intensity range, the monitoring effect of respiration and heartbeat is greatly improved, and the problem that the monitoring operation is difficult to be carried out under the stronger signal intensity range, and the monitoring effect of vital signs is poor is solved.

title_en: measurement module for bio signal and healthcare underwear for bio signal monitoring
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 모듈 및 생체 신호 모니터링을 위한 기능성 속옷
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기능성 속옷에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 심전도 센서, 온도 센서 및 혈류 센서를 포함하여 구성되고, 속옷에 부착되어 실시간으로 착용자의 생체 신호를 측정하는 생체 신호 측정 모듈을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 생체 신호 측정 모듈 및 생체 신호 모니터링을 위한 기능성 속옷에 따르면, 심전도 센서, 온도 센서 및 혈류 센서를 포함하여 구성되어, 기능성 속옷 착용자의 생체 신호를 실시간으로 측정하는 생체 신호 측정 모듈을 속옷의 특정 부위에 구비시킴으로써, 신체에 지속적으로 고정 유지되는 것이 용이하고, 복수 종류의 측정 센서를 함께 구비하여 다양한 생체 신호 획득이 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 분리형 저장 모듈 또는 통신 모듈을 더 포함함으로써, 외부 단말기에 측정 정보를 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring biometric data
title_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안경테와 안경알로 구성되며, 식별수단이 부여되는 안경; 상기 안경과 네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 상기 안경으로부터 수신하는 데이터를 저장 및 관리하는 서버를 포함하고, 상기 안경은, 사용자의 생체신호를 생성하는 바이오센서; 상기 생체신호를 상기 서버로 송신하는 통신부; 사용자가 상기 안경테를 펼치는 동작을 감지하는 동작감지센서; 사용자의 안경착용을 감지하는 생체감지센서; 및 상기 생체신호를 분석하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Leak detection system and method based on intelligent smart metering
title_ko: 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수탐지시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an intelligent smart metering based water leak detection device and a driving method thereof, remote management of water supply through a backbone network can be performed by linking an intelligent smart metering based water leakage sensor and a locking device with a wireless communication terminal system. In addition, without opening an index, a micro-electro mechanical system (MEMS) is used so that users can check whether there is an abnormal behavior of a pipe due to a leak signal in a specific area of a buried pipe, ground deformation around the pipe, water pressure imbalance in the pipe, external damage, etc. By linking the intelligent smart metering based water leakage sensor and locking device with the wireless communication terminal system, remote management of water supply through the backbone network can be performed. The intelligent smart metering based water leak detection system includes multiple meters, a corrosion detection module, a monitoring module, and a wireless communication terminal.
abstract_ko: 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수탐지장치 및 그 구동방법은 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수센서 및 잠금장치와 무선통신 단말 시스템을 연동함으로써, 기간망을 통한 상수도 원격 관리를 가능하게 한다. 또한, 지표를 개복하지 않고 MEMS(Micro-Electro Mechanical System)을 이용하여 지중에 매립된 관거의 특정 지역에서의 누수신호, 관로 주변의 지반 변형, 관로 내 수압 불균형, 외부 손상 등에 의한 관의 이상거동 여부를 확인할 수 있도록 하고, 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수센서 및 잠금장치와 무선통신 단말 시스템을 연동함으로써, 기간망을 통한 상수도 원격 관리를 가능하게 한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Portable infrared pyroelectric life detection instrument for earthquakes
abstract_en: A portable infrared pyroelectric life detection instrument for earthquakes adopts the structure that an infrared sensor is connected with an infrared signal acquisition circuit, the infrared signal acquisition circuit is connected with a signal amplification circuit, the signal amplification circuit is connected with a time control circuit, and the time control circuit is connected with an executive circuit. The utility model has the technical effects that the instrument is simple in structure and small in volume, and can be popularized due to low cost; and as trapped victims can be found to the maximum extent, more rescue time can be gained.

title_en: Railway bridge dynamic deflection wireless detection system device based on microwave radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway bridge dynamic deflection wireless detection system device based on microwave radar technology, which comprises a deflection measuring radar; the bottom of the deflection measuring radar is fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting legs; the bottom of the supporting leg is provided with a reinforcing embedded part; the reinforcing embedded part comprises a top seat plate assembled on the supporting legs, and the bottom of the top seat plate is fixedly connected with an I-shaped plate; the I-shaped plate comprises vertical steel plate parts which are arranged at intervals in the front and back, and horizontal steel plate parts are fixedly connected between the vertical steel plate parts; a plurality of pairs of embedded rod bodies which are arranged at intervals up and down are fixedly connected between the vertical steel plate parts; each pair of the buried rod bodies comprises two symmetrically arranged U-shaped buried rods, and a plurality of wrapping columns are fixedly connected to the U-shaped buried rods; the gripping column penetrates through the U-shaped embedded rod, and the device further comprises an assembling portion fixedly connected to the bottom of the vertical steel plate portion. Adopt the design of above-mentioned device part can realize firm will detect the deflection measurement thunder of railway bridge and erect.
assignees: BEIJING PUBLIC WORKS SECTION CHINA RAILWAY BEIJING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar subassembly for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a millimeter wave radar component for monitoring vital signs, which comprises a bottom plate, a fixed plate and a workbench, wherein a group of fixed plates are installed in the middle of the top of the bottom plate, a plurality of threaded holes are formed in the middle of one side of each fixed plate, bolts are connected with the threads in the threaded holes, a group of connecting plates penetrate through the surfaces of the bolts, the workbench is arranged at the top of each connecting plate, a group of supporting plates are installed in the middle of the top of the workbench, a rotating shaft penetrates through the through holes, a fixed lantern ring is sleeved on the surface of the rotating shaft, a connecting column is installed on the surface of the fixed lantern ring, and a camera body is arranged at the bottom end of the connecting column. Through the setting of backup pad, pivot, the fixed lantern ring, camera body, millimeter wave radar body, lead screw, arc clamp splice and transmitting antenna, through the collocation use of pivot, camera body, lead screw and arc clamp splice, be convenient for fix and adjust the position of camera body, simple structure, convenient monitoring simultaneously.
assignees: JIANGSU YUNHAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;NANJING SIX SEASON PHOTOELECTRIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot being convenient for carrying goods and materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake rescue robots for being convenient for carrying goods and materials, including car body, the car body both ends are respectively mounted searchlight, the searchlight side is installed by colored video camera, goods and materials storeroom is arranged in the vehicle body, cover board is set at the top of the goods and materials storeroom, the first in command is set at the top of the cover board, pedestal is arranged in the car body top, shield is arranged in the base top, the shield side wall installs two thermal imaging systems and two life-detection instruments, the first protecting tube is arranged in the shield side, hydraulic stem is installed at the top of first protecting tube, one end of described hydraulic stem installs the first link block.The beneficial effects obtained by the present invention are as follows being: structure of the invention is compact, it is easy to use, by extending hydraulic stem, and then hydraulic stem is made to drive the first link block mobile, and then make connecting rod that the second protecting tube be driven to rotate down, and then the length of earthquake rescue robot is shortened, and then earthquake rescue robot is facilitated to move in narrow rescue channel.
assignees: GUANGDONG HAIXUEYUN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life signal Enhancement Method based on segmentation classification enhancing processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life signal Enhancement Methods based on segmentation classification enhancing processing, remove ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo-signal background clutter, echo signal registration block is selected using simulated scenario emulation data, judge whether survey window matches with registration block using sliding window, classification segmentation denoising, enhancing are carried out to radar signal matrix, multiframe weighting processing is being carried out to treated result, finally enhance distant signal with local normalization method, the signal matrix finally enhanced is used for coordinate detection life entity.The present invention realizes the enhancing to life signal, by doing different processing to different types of signal matrix block, effectively is denoised, enhanced for the type of signal, it is modified using consecutive frame, and the amplitude of distant signal is enhanced, become apparent the position of echo signal all accurately, to provide guarantee for subsequent detection in time domain and frequency domain.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;SUZHOU TIANBIYOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote vital sign detection method and device based on phased array radar technology
abstract_en: The method and the device for detecting the remote vital signs based on the phased array radar technology acquire the position information of a target human body under a preset coordinate system of a space to be detected to form a position coordinate data set of the target human body; configuring a millimeter wave radar transmitter, and respectively performing radar beam forming on a transmitting radio frequency channel and a receiving radio frequency channel according to the position direction of a target human body in a space to be detected; receiving an echo signal reflected by a target human body through a radar receiver, performing one-dimensional Fourier transform on distance dimensional information of the echo signal, then performing maximum value search, extracting data near the maximum value and forming a new echo sequence for performing two-dimensional Fourier transform; and (3) obtaining a respiration characteristic signal and a heart rate characteristic signal from the echo sequence through a digital filter, and carrying out noise reduction and fast Fourier transform to restore the respiration and heartbeat motion waveforms of the target human body. The invention has the advantages of long testing distance, high precision, no loss of the testing target and capability of testing multiple targets.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINGHUA PHASE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent elderly accompanying system based on computer vision technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent nursing system for the elderly based on a computer vision technology. The system mainly comprises an indoor monitoring system, a robot system and a mobile equipment display terminal. The indoor monitoring system is provided with a plurality of integrated cameras according to indoor space layout, and dynamic tracking of real-time information of the aged day and night is realized in a video and infrared combined mode; the robot system consists of a built-in intelligent analysis and control system, a voice interaction system, an indoor navigation system, a vital sign detection system and the like; the accompanying robot consists of an integrated camera, a motion system, an imitation human arm system, a partition storage box (medicine, nutrient and the like) and a sensor module; the mobile device display terminal comprises a mobile phone, an intelligent watch, a computer and the like and is used for displaying video information according to task call, and simple gesture interaction can be achieved. The accompanying and nursing system meets the demands that children care about the health and psychological factors of the old and reduce the consumption of manpower and material resources, and improves the timeliness and accuracy of emergency rescue.

title_en: Personnel safety intelligent management system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel safety intelligent management system based on big data, relates to the technical field of personnel safety intelligent management, and solves the technical problems of low-efficiency safety management means and false alarm or missing report caused by inaccurate risk assessment in the prior art; according to the invention, the identification model is used for identifying and verifying the identity of the staff to be identified, so that the safety of the construction site is improved; the invention collects the working environment image of staff through the camera, the vital sign detector collects vital sign information of staff, and the ultrasonic sensor collects the working height of staff; based on the collected information, analyzing vital sign risk coefficients, operational height risk coefficients, and operational environment risk coefficients; based on various dangerous coefficients, comprehensively analyzing to obtain personal dangerous coefficients of staff, and early warning is carried out on the time when the personal dangerous coefficients exceed a preset threshold value; the accurate evaluation of personal safety coefficients is realized, and casualties and property loss are effectively reduced.
assignees: SHANXI DATANG INT LINFEN CO GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A multi-target vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar includes the steps of sending linear frequency modulation electromagnetic wave signals through the millimeter wave radar, constructing a three-dimensional data matrix according to reflected signals, carrying out Fourier transformation and data processing on different dimensions of the data matrix, obtaining distance, speed and angle information of targets, manufacturing a three-dimensional point cloud data set, clustering the generated point cloud data to obtain related information of a plurality of targets, generating a two-dimensional movement state scatter diagram based on clustered information, inputting the scatter diagram into a movement state classifier network model to identify movement states, extracting signals of targets in a movement interval period, and monitoring respiration rate and heartbeat rate of the targets. The invention has the characteristics of good privacy protection, low time delay, non-contact performance and the like, and can realize the monitoring of multi-target vital signs.

title_en: Vital sign detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection system which comprises a power supply part and a detection part, wherein the power supply part is configured to provide energy, the detection part is used for detecting vital signs of a user and is electrically connected with the power supply part, the detection part comprises a circuit board and a millimeter wave radar sensor, the circuit board is arranged in the detection part, the millimeter wave radar sensor is arranged on the circuit board, and the millimeter wave radar sensor can emit millimeter-level electromagnetic waves to detect the vital signs. Because the detection portion is suitable for including circuit board and millimeter wave radar sensor, millimeter wave radar sensor integration sets up on the circuit board to let the structure that uses above-mentioned detection portion more simple reliable, can realize the portable use of vital sign detecting system, and can integrate and have multiple performance in order to let the diversified function of vital sign detecting system use.

title_en: Geological operation-oriented real-time monitoring method and device for mental fatigue of operators
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring method and device for mental fatigue of operators facing geological operations, comprising the steps of S1, determining layout of a measured target and a millimeter wave radar, S2, acquiring a millimeter wave radar intermediate frequency echo, extracting complex phases of corresponding distance information after the measured target is positioned by a distance domain, performing phase expansion and steady state correction to obtain a continuous phase sequence representing chest micro-displacement, S3, applying IIR digital band-pass filtering to the continuous phase sequence and decoupling the continuous phase sequence to form a respiratory channel and a heartbeat channel, S4, extracting time domain and frequency domain features of heart rate variability HRV and respiratory rhythm from the respiratory channel and the heartbeat channel in a sliding time window to form a multidimensional vital sign feature vector set, S5, performing incremental learning by using an OS-ELM and judging and outputting mental fatigue grade in real time, S6, implementing hierarchical risk management, triggering early warning and intervention measures, and S7, performing local storage and visual display on fatigue grade and event log and synchronizing to a remote management platform.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR CIVIL ENG CO LTD;UNIV HONG KONG POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Ultrasound treatment apparatus and driving method thereof
title_ko: 초음파 치료 장치 및 이의 구동 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an ultrasound treatment apparatus comprising: a respiration sensor unit sensing a daily respiration cycle of an object and generating a respiration sensing signal; an information processing unit extracting a synchronizing signal corresponding to any one time section of the daily respiration cycle using the respiration sensing signal; a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) generating unit including a hole in which a magnetic field for doing an MRI is applied and generating an MRI in an interested area of the object according to the synchronizing signal; an ultrasonic image generating unit including an ultrasound probe irradiating an imaging ultrasound wave to the interested area of the object, arranged on one side of the MRI generating unit and generating an ultrasound image in the interested area; and an ultrasound treatment unit arranged on one side of the MRI generating unit and irradiating a focused ultrasound wave to the interested area using the MRI. According to the present invention, by doing an MRI according to a synchronizing signal, an ultrasound image and an MRI can be provided in real time. In addition, it is possible to precisely track a position of an interested area and measure the temperature of the interested area so stable ultrasound treatment is possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 대상체의 일 호흡주기를 감지하여 호흡감지신호를 생성하는 호흡센서부; 상기 호흡감지신호를 이용하여 상기 일 호흡주기 중 어느 하나의 시구간에 대응되는 동기화 신호를 추출하는 정보처리부; 자기공명영상 촬영을 위한 자기장이 인가되는 중공을 포함하고, 상기 동기화 신호에 따라 상기 대상체의 관심영역의 자기공명영상을 생성하는 자기공명영상 생성부; 상기 대상체의 관심영역에 촬상용 초음파를 조사시키는 초음파 프로브(probe)를 포함하며, 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되어 상기 관심영역의 초음파 영상을 생성하는 초음파영상 생성부; 및 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되며, 상기 초음파영상 및 상기 자기공명영상을 이용하여 상기 관심영역에 집속(focused) 초음파를 조사하는 초음파 치료부;를 포함하는, 초음파 치료 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Seismic isolation rubber pad for micro-pile and construction method of micro-pile using the same
title_ko: 마이크로파일 면진 고무패드 및 이를 이용한 내진과 면진 기능을 갖는 마이크로파일의 시공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic isolation rubber pad, coupled to a head of a micro-pile (a pile with a small diameter) buried in a concrete layer to absorb and attenuate a shock, and a method for constructing a micro-pile with a function of earthquake proofing and seismic isolation using the same, and, more specifically, to a seismic isolation rubber pad and a method for constructing a micro-pile with a function of earthquake proofing and seismic isolation using the same, wherein the rubber pad includes: a first seismic isolation pad coupled to encompass a side surface and an upper part of a plate based on the plate (a ground pressing plate) coupled to the head of the micro-pile, an upper fixation unit of the plate and the micro-pile exposed to a set length at an upper part of the plate; a second seismic isolation pad coupled to encompass a lower surface of the plate and a lower fixation unit of the plate; and a third seismic isolation pad which is coupled to a lower part of the second seismic isolation pad while encompassing an exposed part of the micro-pile installed at an upper part of a weak layer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 콘크리트층에 매설되는 마이크로파일(소구경말뚝)의 두부(Head)에 결합되어 충격을 흡수 및 감쇄시키는 마이크로파일 면진 고무패드 및 이를 이용한 내진과 면진 기능을 갖는 마이크로파일의 시공방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 마이크로파일의 두부에 결합되는 플레이트(지압판)를 기준으로 플레이트의 측면과 상부, 플레이트의 상부 고정부 및 플레이트의 상부에 소정 길이 노출된 마이크로파일을 감싸면서 결합되는 제1면진패드; 플레이트의 하부면과 플레이트의 하부 고정부를 감싸면서 결합되는 제2면진패드; 및 제2면진패드의 하부로 연약층 상부에 설치된 마이크로파일의 노출부를 감싸면서 결합되는 제3면진패드;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 마이크로파일 면진 고무패드 및 이를 이용한 내진과 면진 기능을 갖는 마이크로파일의 시공방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Baby Monitoring System
title_ko: 베이비 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a baby monitoring system, and the baby monitoring system of the present invention installs an arm capable of pan-tilt-zooming, monitors the baby's movements in a pre-sleep mode to determine whether the baby is sleeping, and in the sleep mode, a camera, a gas detection sensor, a respiration detection sensor, etc. installed in the head of the arm are moved in all x, y, and z directions on a rectangular coordinate system by the pan-tilt-zooming, so that sound, humidity, body temperature, etc. are accurately detected at an accurate detection location, and fecal gas and respiration are accurately detected, so that the baby's safety can be easily and accurately monitored remotely.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 베이비 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 베이비 모니터링 시스템은, 팬틸트 줌이 가능한 아암(arm)을 설치하여, 취침 전 모드에서 베이비 움직임을 모니터링하여 취침 여부를 판단하고, 취침 모드에서 상기 아암의 헤드에 설치된 카메라, 가스감지센서, 호흡감지센서 등을 상기 팬틸트 줌으로 직각좌표계 상의 x,y,z 모든 방향으로 이동해 정확한 감지 위치에서 소리, 습도, 체온 등 뿐만아니라 분변 가스의 감지 및 호흡의 감지가 정확하여, 베이비의 안전 여부가 원격에서도 용이하고 정확히 모니터링 가능한 베이비 모니터링 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method of monitoring a user's condition and electronic device performing the same
title_ko: 사용자의 상태 모니터링 방법 및 이를 수행하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for monitoring a state of a user of an electronic device comprises: an operation of generating a first biometric signal of a user; an operation of determining a first value for the first biometric signal based on the first biometric signal; an operation of determining whether the state of the user corresponds to a first state based on the first value; an operation of generating a second biometric signal of the user through a second sensor when the state of the user corresponds to the first state; an operation of determining a second value for the second biometric signal based on the second biometric signal; an operation of determining whether the state of the user corresponds to a second state based on the second value; and an operation of performing a preset first action when the state of the user corresponds to the second state.
abstract_ko: 일 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치의 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하는 방법은,   사용자의 제1 생체 신호를 생성하는 동작, 제1 생체 신호에 기초하여 제1 생체 신호에 대한 제1 값을 결정하는 동작, 제1 값에 기초하여 사용자의 상태가 제1 상태에 대응하는지 여부를 결정하는 동작, 사용자의 상태가 제1 상태에 대응하는 경우, 제2 센서를 통해 사용자의 제2 생체 신호를 생성하는 동작, 제2 생체 신호에 기초하여 제2 생체 신호에 대한 제2 값을 결정하는 동작, 제2 값에 기초하여 사용자의 상태가 제2 상태에 대응하는지 여부를 결정하는 동작, 및 사용자의 상태가 제2 상태에 대응하는 경우, 미리 설정된 제1 액션을 수행하는 동작을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Sleep monitoring and intervention system and method
abstract_en: A sleep monitoring and intervention system comprises an elevated indoor electrical appliance (100) with a sensor module (310) for continuous detecting individuals in a room to acquire information of human presence, physical state and sleep-related activities, a loudspeaker (300) for a playback of audio data, and a control unit (320) programmed for analyzing and processing said information, communicating control signals and/or audio data through a communication link, and triggering a playback of the audio data from the loudspeaker (300) based on the analyzed and processed information. The system aims to elevate sleep quality across age groups by harnessing advanced detection technology for personalized interventions, fostering a serene sleeping ambiance and promoting overall well-being.
assignees: AI SPARK INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Providing energy efficient features using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in an energy efficient manner using a plurality of sensors such as those of a battery-powered device such as a television remote, and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from an initial television WiFi radio scan, or an initial low-powered detection scan from the television remote, may be analyzed by the processor to determine a potential presence of one or more humans are present proximate to the device. If there is such a potential presence, the device remote can enter a full-powered detection mode to accurately determine the presence or absence of one or more humans, and take further actions.

title_en: Vital sign measurement system and vital sign measurement method thereof
abstract_en: A vital sign measurement system includes an excitation signal source, a vital sign sensor, an environmental sensor, an analog front-end sensor electrically connected with the vital sign sensor, and a processor module electrically connected with the excitation signal source, the environmental sensor and the analog front-end sensor. The excitation signal source generates excitation signals. The excitation signals are transmitted to a human body, and then the excitation signals are reflected to generate sensing signals. The vital sign sensor receives the sensing signals, and the sensing signals are converted into a plurality of analog synthetic signals. The environmental sensor receives environmental light. The analog front-end sensor receives and amplifies the analog synthetic signals. The processor module calculates an intensity of the environmental light. And the processor module sends an adjustment instruction to the analog front-end sensor to adjust a sampling frequency of the analog front-end sensor.
assignees: CHENG UEI PREC IND CO LTD

title_en: Animal Caloric Output Tracking Methods
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring the health of an animal using multiple sensors is described. The wearable device may include one or more sensors whose resultant signal levels may be analyzed in the wearable device or uploaded to a data management server for additional analysis. One or more embodiments include variations of the sensor system to accommodate differences in animals, including tracking vital signs over a period of time and comparing recorded values with an individual or species-based trendline. A deviation from the trendline may be signaled by alerting a user associated with the device about the deviation.

title_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using ultra wideband
abstract_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using Ultra-Wideband communication. UWB signals are transmitted from one UWB system node (110B) to another UWB system node (110A). Channel impulse responses (CIRs) associated with the UWB signals are determined. Based on the CIRs, in some embodiments velocities associated with the UWB signals are determined, and activities of vehicle occupants are classified based on the CIRs along with vital signs such as breathing rates. In other embodiments, based on the CIRs, phase unwrapping of phase features associated with the CIRs is performed, and principle component analysis (PCA) transforms the CIRs, allowing estimated vital signs such as breathing rates to be determined.

title_en: Life searching method and system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life searching method and a life searching system based on multi-sensor fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: arranging a plurality of sensor modules to acquire a sensor data sequence group acquired by each sensor module at a set frequency; preprocessing the sensor data sequence group based on a neural network to form life detection preliminary probability output corresponding to the sensor module; and taking each preliminary probability output as one path of input of a deep neural network, splicing and fusing a plurality of preliminary probability outputs of the sensor modules through the deep neural network, and outputting a final probability value of life existence. The life searching method and the life searching system collect various environmental information based on the plurality of sensor modules, and fuse and splice life detection data under different environmental information by using the deep neural network, so that the robustness and the accuracy of life detection are improved in a stage manner.

title_en: Vital sign parameter estimation method and performance evaluation based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign parameter estimation method and performance estimation based on MIMO radar, relates to the technical field of MIMO radar application, and provides a technical scheme for improving the performance of parameter estimation by further applying the MIMO radar to vital sign parameter estimation. The application includes placing MIMO radar in an observation area; acquiring MIMO radar position information and observation area position information; acquiring received acquisition sample information of the MIMO radar, wherein the acquisition sample information is a transmitting signal of an MIMO radar transmitting antenna passing through an observation area; inputting the position information and the sample information into a signal model, outputting unknown parameters of the input information through maximum likelihood estimation by the signal model, and outputting a Kramer boundary value for estimating the unknown parameters by the signal model; and outputting vital sign parameter information and performance of parameter estimation thereof. The application realizes that the MIMO radar adopts Bayesian estimation to obtain the estimation value of the heartbeat frequency, and the Clarituxan boundary value of the parameter is utilized to evaluate the estimation performance.

title_en: Flight life detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flight life detector. The flight life detector comprises a quadcopter, a core circuit board and a sensor device. The core circuit board is arranged on the lower side of the quadcopter. The sensor device is arranged on the lower side of the core circuit board. The sensor device is a human body infrared thermal sensor. The sensor device can also be an optical life detector or an acoustic wave life detector. The quadcopter is controlled through a control handheld terminal. The control handheld terminal comprises a flight control handle and a color screen. According to the utility model, by installing the sensor device and the core circuit board on the lower side of the quadcopter, signs of life are detected through the flight of the quadcopter in the air, so the disaster relief work is more safe, convenient and fast, and the purpose of long-distance life detection can be realized.

title_en: Survival device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a survival device, and belongs to auxiliary life detection and trapped person position indication equipment. The survival device comprises a tank and inflatable bags arranged on the two sides of the tank, wherein a valve is arranged on the tank, and is used for blocking inflation inlets of the inflatable bags; a pulse sensor and a wireless transmitter are arranged on the valve; the pulse sensor is connected to the data input end of a first processor; the wireless transmitter is connected to the data output end of the first processor; wireless receivers and LED (light-emitting diode) indicator lamps are arranged on the inflatable bags; the wireless receivers are connected to the data input end of a second processor; the LED indicator lamps are connected to the data output end of the second processor. According to the survival device, not only can be the position of a trapped person indicated, but also vital signs of the trapped person can be monitored, so that a rescuer can rapidly find the trapped person, and can also determine rescue priority according to the vital signs of the trapped person.
assignees: WUXI XRES PRODUCT DES & RES CO

title_en: Wall-hanging smog gas sensor is used in wisdom fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting, which comprises a wall body, wherein a pre-buried box is arranged in an inner cavity of the wall body, a control box is arranged in the inner cavity of the pre-buried box, the right side of the control box penetrates through the outer side of the pre-buried box and is fixedly connected with a mounting box, the top and the bottom of the inner cavity of the pre-buried box are fixedly connected with fixed boxes, limiting plates are arranged in the inner cavity of the fixed boxes, the opposite sides of the two limiting plates are fixedly connected with first springs, and the opposite sides of the two limiting plates are fixedly connected with clamping rods. According to the wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting, the limiting plate, the first spring, the clamping rod, the adjusting shell, the pushing block, the partition plate, the sliding rod, the sliding sleeve, the pressing plate, the second spring and the pushing rod are arranged, so that the problems that an existing wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting is troublesome in installation and disassembly processes, time-consuming and labor-consuming are solved, the wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting has the advantages of being rapid and convenient to disassemble and assemble, and the wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting is worth popularizing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG MIDDLE INDUSTRY FIRE FIGHTING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Solar energy buried type geomagnetic radar and RFID induction all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar buried geomagnetic radar and RFID induction integrated machine which comprises a base, wherein an installation barrel is arranged in the base, a heat dissipation cavity is formed between the base and the installation barrel, a cleaning cover is arranged at the top end of the heat dissipation cavity, and a filter frame is arranged at the bottom end of the cleaning cover. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the heat dissipation cavity, the cleaning cover, the filter screen, the external thread, the internal thread and the holding rod, the heat generated inside the installation cylinder is convenient to dissipate, so that when the equipment works, the heat generated inside the equipment is transmitted to the inside of the heat dissipation cavity through the heat dissipation holes and the heat dissipation fins, and then the heat is discharged through the cleaning cover at the top end of the heat dissipation cavity to dissipate the heat.
assignees: YUNNAN INTER FLYING SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Colliery is personnel positioning device in pit based on 5G technique
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underground safety, in particular to coal mine underground personnel positioning equipment based on a 5G technology, and aims to solve the problems that the existing coal mine underground personnel positioning equipment is inaccurate in positioning and lacks a vital sign detection function. The coal mine underground personnel positioning equipment based on the 5G technology is used for positioning underground personnel based on the 5G technology, has extremely high positioning precision, and greatly improves the positioning accuracy of the underground personnel; the built-in body temperature rhythm of heart blood pressure sensor of wearing equipment I, body temperature rhythm of heart blood pressure sensor's detection data send for 5G chip I after signal processor handles, and 5G chip I sends real-time vital sign of staff in the pit to ground controlgear, provides important basis for the formulation of rescue scheme when the mine disaster takes place.
assignees: DAGUANG WISHONG INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method and device for monitoring and dynamically positioning vital signs in real time
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for monitoring and dynamically positioning vital signs in real time. The device comprises a part for detecting, processing and sending vital sign information of a monitored person and a part for positioning the vital sign information; the vital signs of a person are detected and acquired by a pulse sensor, a temperature sensor and a body movement sensor, is processed by an A/D conversion module, and then is sent out by a wireless sending module; and the part for positioning the vital sign information is provided with a wireless receiving module for receiving the vital sign information, a remote data communication module, a GPS global positioning information receiving module, a mobile communication GSM/3G module and a wireless local area network (WLAN) module to form a comprehensively-positioning system, and a control unit controls a positioning calculation unit to calculate the positioning. The method and the device have the following steps: (1) the position and the vital sign information of the monitored person can be acquired at the same time for the benefit of nursing, monitoring, searching and rescuing special crowds; and (2) the device has modularized design for the convenience of carrying.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency system capable of life detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency system capable of life detection. The system comprises a main controller. The main controller is connected with at least one sub-controller in communication. The sub-controller is electrically connected with a fire-fighting emergency lamp; and the fire-fighting emergency lamp is internally provided with a life detection sensor. The invention provides the fire-fighting emergency system capable of the life detection. The fire-fighting emergency system can perform concentration management, reduces maintenance difficulty, can be normally used in case of an emergency, can carry out life sign detection, facilitates the operation of rescue work, shortens life rescuing time, increases life rescuing probability, enhances disaster rescue efficiency, and besides, can also effectively reduce loss and casualties.

title_en: Earthquake early warning alarm for converter station and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an alarm for earthquake early warning of a converter station and a monitoring method thereof, belonging to the technical field of earthquake early warning. The earthquake early warning alarm for the converter station comprises a box body, a moving mechanism, a driving mechanism and an earthquake warning mechanism. The moving mechanism comprises a first hollow pipe and a second hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe penetrates through the box body in a sliding mode, a conical head is installed at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe, and a through hole is formed in the surface of the first hollow pipe. The first hollow pipe, the second hollow pipe, the micro motor, the screw rod, the clamping plate and the elastic piece are matched, so that the seismic sensor can be buried in the soil, a pit does not need to be dug on the surface of the soil, the seismic sensor can be buried, the burying of the seismic sensor is facilitated, in addition, the conical head is additionally arranged at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe is favorably driven into the soil, and the subsequent burying of the seismic sensor is facilitated.

title_en: Millimeter wave-based device and method for positioning personnel and detecting vital signs in fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave-based device and a millimeter wave-based method for locating personnel and detecting vital signs in a fire scene, wherein the device comprises a central control and processing module, and a DAC (digital-to-analog converter), an ADC (analog-to-digital converter), an optional data storage module, a millimeter wave radar module, a camera module, a WIFI module and an intermediate frequency signal processing module which are connected with the central control and processing module; according to the method, the DAC, the ADC and the central processing and controller module are used for processing and identifying the positions of personnel in the fire and vital sign key data, FMCW millimeter wave data collection is achieved, the MCU processes and analyzes the data, the SD card caches the data, the positions and vital sign states of the personnel in the fire are given, the SCCB communication protocol is used for controlling the camera to give specific position information, and the data are transmitted to the local terminal device in cooperation with the WIFI module based on the SPI.

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent real-time monitoring, and provides an intelligent vital sign monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: modeling human body vital signs; the monitoring radar transmits a transmitting signal of linear frequency modulation continuous waves to a monitoring area, and simultaneously captures echo signals reflected by a human body uninterruptedly; analyzing a transmitting signal, an echo signal and a beat signal of the radar, and extracting human body vital sign data; checking vital sign information in real time; and separating the heartbeat signal and the respiration signal, and respectively carrying out frequency calculation on the heartbeat signal and the respiration signal. The invention measures the human body vital sign signal by measuring the relative frequency relation between the received signal and the transmitted signal, thereby improving the real-time performance and the accuracy of the human body vital sign signal detection; the data of the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal are extracted through the confidence parameters of spectral estimation based on FFT, autocorrelation and peak value interval, and the calculation accuracy of separating the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal is greatly improved.
assignees: JIUZHOU YUNHE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Living body detection method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a life detection method and device. The life detection method comprises the following steps: calculating the signal fluctuation and intensity ratio of the current position according to the current position radar signal fluctuation, the current position radar signal intensity and the current position radar signal intensity in a certain range; determining candidate positions according to the signal fluctuation and intensity ratio; and determining the position of the living body according to the candidate position. Wherein the starting point of the current position with a certain range is in the direction of the position of the radar towards the current position; the end point of the certain range of the current position is in the direction of the current position far away from the position where the radar is located. According to the embodiment of the application, the detection rate of a person in lying is improved, and false detection is reduced.

title_en: Multi-radar fusion vital sign monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-radar fusion vital sign monitoring device and a monitoring method, comprising a mounting frame, a bottom plate, a first shell, a second shell, a 3D laser radar, an infrared array sensor, a rotating structure and a millimeter wave radar, wherein the bottom plate is connected with the mounting frame, the rotating structure is arranged on the bottom plate, the first shell is connected to the rotating structure, the 3D laser radar and the infrared array sensor are arranged in the first shell, the second shell is connected with the bottom plate and located below the first shell, and the millimeter wave radar is arranged in the second shell. Through the cooperation of multiple different radars, judge whether the old person in the room is in the state of tumbleing, and then in time report to the police, under the condition of guaranteeing old man's privacy, both increased the monitoring area, improved monitoring accuracy again, reached the purpose of full-range monitoring.

title_en: Life perception monitoring analysis system for whole house of solitary old man
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent home and discloses a living old people whole house life perception monitoring analysis system which comprises a user terminal and a monitoring platform, wherein the monitoring platform comprises a life perception monitoring module, an abnormality evaluation module and an alarm module, the life perception monitoring module comprises a distribution control unit, a behavior monitoring unit, a position monitoring unit and a body monitoring unit, the distribution control unit is connected with a plurality of groups of sensors through a network to distribute and control an area, the behavior monitoring unit is used for acquiring a behavior data set, the position monitoring unit is used for acquiring a position data set, the body monitoring unit is used for acquiring a body data set, the abnormality evaluation module carries out abnormality evaluation according to received data, and sends a signal to the alarm module when the abnormality exists in the evaluation, and the alarm module receives the signal and gives an alarm. The comprehensive and refined monitoring and intelligent response to living environment, vital signs, daily behaviors and health management of the solitary old people are realized through multiple cross judgment.

title_en: Wearable underwater vital sign and environment monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign measurement, in particular to a wearable underwater vital sign and environment monitoring system which comprises a physiological signal acquisition module, a photoelectric volume pulse wave sensor, a bioelectrical impedance electrode, a piezoelectric sensor and a neck piezoelectric signal, wherein the photoelectric volume pulse wave sensor is fixed at a wrist position, the bioelectrical impedance electrode is attached to the chest, the piezoelectric sensor is placed at the neck position, and the photoelectric volume pulse wave signal, the bioelectrical impedance signal and the neck piezoelectric signal of the wrist position are acquired. In the invention, signal reconstruction is carried out based on energy proportion calculation, the position of an electrocardio R wave crest value point and an R-R interval time sequence are extracted, variability indexes are generated through frequency domain decomposition and frequency band energy statistics, time domain and frequency domain index values are calculated, and weight distribution is carried out, so that the overall monitoring of the underwater physical sign state is realized. The signal acquisition precision is improved by means of a multi-source signal acquisition mode, noise interference is eliminated through signal track matrix decomposition operation, and the reconstruction quality of signals is ensured by adopting characteristic vector energy specific gravity calculation.
assignees: QINGDAO CHENGLANG MARINE UNMANNED EQUIPMENT CO LTD;SHANGHAI DIVING EQUIPMENT FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Wearable monitoring bracelet of preeclampsia early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable monitoring bracelet for early warning of preeclampsia, which relates to the technical field of wearable monitoring bracelets and comprises a monitoring bracelet main body, wherein a touch round screen is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the monitoring bracelet main body, two ends of the monitoring bracelet main body are fixedly connected with splicing end blocks, the end parts of the two splicing end blocks are respectively provided with an expanding splicing box, the tail end of the monitoring bracelet main body is internally filled with an elastic glue box, one side of the inside of the elastic glue box is provided with a gas pressure sensor, the monitoring precision and the monitoring efficiency of the monitoring bracelet are effectively improved, and meanwhile, the sensor in the expanding splicing box can be replaced according to the requirement by utilizing a general splicing structure at the splicing position of the expanding splicing box and the splicing end blocks, so that the monitoring bracelet can also carry out special accurate detection on other vital signs while detecting epilepsy symptoms, and the use safety and smoothness of the monitoring bracelet are further improved.

title_en: Land mine locating device and land mine locating system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a land mine locating system for quickly locating a land mine while preventing erroneous detection and oversight.  <P>SOLUTION: The land mine locating system 1 includes a land mine locating device 10 for performing location by scanning a land mine locating area 30 with land mines likely to be buried therein in an A direction and in a B direction, and a personal computer PC 20 for receiving, analyzing, and displaying information transmitted from the locating device 10. A land mine locating part 100 of the locating device 10 includes a metal locator, an underground radar, a smell sensor, an infrared camera, a communication part connected to an antenna to radio-communicate with the PC 20, a control part for controlling operation of respective parts, a wheel drive part driving wheels 110 while being driven by the control part, and a guide drive part for driving the locating part 100 so as to move it on a guide 120 while being controlled by the control part.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Data transmission method and buried object detection device
abstract_en: To provide a data transmission method that has certainty in data transmission even for UDP that has no acknowledgment function and high real-time properties.SOLUTION: A buried object detection device includes a search device body that radiates a medium with radar waves and searches for a buried object in the medium, and a display device that receives data from the search device body and displays a search result, and when the latest data is transmitted from the search device body to the display device by using UDP having no acknowledgment function and having high real-time properties, retransmission data which is predetermined data transmitted in the past is simultaneously transmitted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: System and method for sensing high-resolution distance, and application thereof
abstract_en: To conduct a non-contact and non-invasive type sending of a vital sign or other health signal using radar or other high-resolution distance sensing.SOLUTION: A sensing system 11 includes a first radar sensing assembly and an analysis system 18. The first radar sensing assembly uses a radar to measure a plurality of distances to a first target position 16 at different times. The analysis system 18 receives the plurality of distances from the first radar sensing assembly and calculates a difference of the plurality of distances measured by the first radar sensing assembly, thereby quantifying a movement of a target 14 at the first target position 16 at different times. The sensing system 11 uses the calculated difference of the plurality of distances to generate one or more first quantitative action level value that represents the movement of the target 14 at the first target position 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hollow snake robot for topographical detection of a urial and collapse and control method thereof
title_ko: 붕괴지형 매몰자 탐지를 위한 뱀 로봇 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a hollow snake robot for detecting a buried person in a flat and narrow space, and a control method thereof. According to an aspect of the present invention, the hollow snake robot comprises: a hollow body unit constructed by connecting a plurality of modules having drive shafts perpendicular to each other in a universal joint scheme; a supply unit connected to one end of the body unit; and a robot hand which is connected to at least a portion of the supply unit, and performs a task by gripping or liberating an object. The supply unit includes: a tube inserted into the hollow space of the other end of the body unit to move a first material associated with survival of a rescue request person to the outside through the one end; a camera to photograph an area around the hollow snake robot; a temperature sensor to measure the temperature of the area around the hollow snake robot; a gas sensor to measure a gas amount and the present of gas in the area around the hollow snake robot; a microphone to receive a voice of the rescue request person and a sound in the area around the hollow snake robot; a speaker to output information inputted from the outside; and a projector to use light to output an image to the area around the hollow snake robot. The hollow snake robot may further comprise a communication unit to transfer information acquired through at least one among the camera, the temperature sensor, the gas sensor, and the microphone to the outside via wired communication or wireless communication.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상인 중공형 뱀 로봇은, 유니버설 조인트(universal joint) 방식의 서로 직교하는 구동축을 가진 복수의 모듈을 연결하여 구성된 중공형의 몸통부; 상기 몸통부의 일단에 연결되는 공급부; 및 상기 공급부의 적어도 일부에 연결되고, 객체를 파지 또는 해방하여 태스크(task)를 수행하는 로봇 핸드; 를 포함하고, 상기 공급부는, 상기 몸통부의 타단의 중공으로 삽입되고, 상기 일단을 통해 외부로 구조요청자의 생존과 관련된 제 1 물질을 이동시키기 위한 튜브; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역을 촬영하는 카메라; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 가스 유무 및 가스량을 측정하는 가스 센서; 상기 구조요청자의 음성 및 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 소리를 입력 받는 마이크로폰; 상기 외부로부터 입력된 정보를 출력하기 위한 스피커; 및 빛을 이용하여 영상을 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역으로 출력하는 프로젝터;를 더 포함하며, 상기 카메라, 온도 센서, 가스 센서 및 마이크로폰 중 적어도 하나를 통해 획득한 정보를, 유선 통신 또는 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전달하기 위한 통신부;를 더 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Biological signal measurement apparatus and system
title_ko: 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a biological signal measurement device and a system thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the biosignal measurement device includes: at least one EEG sensor for measuring an EEG signal of a user in contact with a user′s head; and a Bluetooth module for receiving the EEG signal measured by the EEG sensor, transmitting the EEG signal to a preset terminal, and receiving a sound source transmitted from the terminal. The Bluetooth module consists of a first means for processing the measured EEG signal and providing the measured EEG signal to the Bluetooth module, a second means for processing the received sound source, and a one-chip, wherein the Bluetooth module may receive the EEG signal through a receiving terminal connected to a microphone and transmit the EEG signal to the terminal. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide a user′s electroencephalogram signal (EEG signal) measured using the single Bluetooth module, and to provide a customized sound source according to a measurement result, as well as interpretation information on the measurement result to the user.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정 장치는 사용자의 두상에 접촉하여 상기 사용자의 뇌파 신호를 측정하기 위한 적어도 하나의 뇌파 측정 센서; 및 상기 뇌파 측정 센서에서 측정한 뇌파 신호를 수신하여 미리 설정된 단말기로 전송하고, 상기 단말기로부터 전송된 음원을 수신하는 블루투스 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 블루투스 모듈은 상기 측정된 뇌파 신호를 처리하여 상기 블루투스 모듈로 제공하기 위한 제1 수단 및 상기 수신된 음원을 처리하기 위한 제2 수단과 원칩으로 구성되며, 상기 블루투스 모듈은 마이크와 연결되는 수신 단자를 통해 상기 뇌파 신호를 수신하여 상기 단말기로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Smart UWB Sleep Apnea Monitoring System using Deep Learning
title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 비접촉 수면 무호흡 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A non-contact sleep apnea monitoring system using deep learning comprises: a non-contact motion detection sensor that detects motion of an observer; a non-contact breathing detection sensor that detects breathing of the observer; and an apnea monitoring unit that determines a sleep state of the observer based on detection data of the non-contact motion detection sensor by using a preset deep learning algorithm in individually receiving and processing the detection data of the non-contact motion detection sensor and the non-contact breathing detection sensor and determines an apnea state during a sleep state of the observer based on the detection data of the non-contact breathing detection sensor.
abstract_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 비접촉 수면 무호흡 모니터링 시스템은 관측자의 동작을 감지하는 비접촉 동작감지센서와, 관측자의 호흡을 감지하는 비접촉 호흡감지센서와, 비접촉 동작감지센서 및 비접촉 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터를 각각 수신하여 처리함에 있어서, 미리 설정된 딥러닝 알고리즘을 이용하여 비접촉 동작감지센서의 감지 데이터를 토대로 관측자의 수면상태를 판단하고, 비접촉 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터를 토대로 관측자의 수면상태 중의 무호흡 상태를 판단하는 무호흡 모니터링부를 포함한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Detection device for vital signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device (1) for vital signs, comprising a sensor (2) and an energy supply module (3), wherein the sensor (2) has at least one detection means (5, 6, 7, 8), which is designed to detect a vital sign from the group consisting of the oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, and pulse, and furthermore comprises a first (10) communication module, wherein the energy supply module (3) has a second communication module (20) and an energy source (21), and wherein a wireless communication connection (4) exists between the first (10) and second communication module (20), wherein the sensor (2) is configured as an elastically restorably deformable thin-film sensor, and the communication connection (4) is configured for transmitting energy and measured values, or measurement data.

title_en: Computerized method and system for global health, personal safety and emergency response
abstract_en: A computerized system and method for intuitively detecting a user's need for emergency help, preventive care and medical interventions and also for coordinating care for user's loved ones and pets when user experiences an emergency or has passed away. Detection is done via labs and life signs equipment and sensors, self-initiated request for monitoring or the system's periodically polling user through an alert, a telephone call, a notification, a text message or other appropriate means to find out if they are in danger. Polling and automated monitoring may also be triggered by real-time medical data electronically or wirelessly transmitted to the system. If user fails to respond, the system automatedly calls either user's contacts (by listed priority) to notify them of a potential emergency, or emergency responders directly depending on severity of the emergency and communicates to them critical information as well as a code to access user's medical record(s).

title_en: Smart device-based radar system detecting human vital signs using a compact circularly-polarized antenna
abstract_en: Techniques and apparatuses are described that implement a smart device-based radar system capable of detecting human vital signs using a compact circularly-polarized antenna. A radar system includes at least one compact circularly-polarized antenna with a patch antenna and a quadrature hybrid coupler. The quadrature hybrid coupler is on a separate plane that is above or below the patch antenna. By vertically stacking the patch antenna with the quadrature hybrid coupler, lateral dimensions of the radar system can be reduced relative to other antenna configurations or designs. The quadrature hybrid coupler can also have a ring-shape design to improve isolation and polarization purity of the compact circularly-polarized antenna relative to a rectangular design. The compact circularly-polarized antenna enables a radar system operating at frequencies between approximately 1 gigahertz (GHz) and 24 GHz to be implemented within a variety of small smart devices.

title_en: Smart home device using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring for contactless human interactions and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. Radar chirps may be output by a radar sensor operating in a burst mode. The burst mode radar data stream may be monitored for a contactless human interaction performed by an active user. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. Health monitoring of an inactive user may be performed using the virtual continuous mode radar data stream.

title_en: Vital-sign radar sensor using a wireless frequency-locked loop
abstract_en: A vital-sign radar sensor using wireless frequency-locked loop includes a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO), an antenna component, a mixer, a loop filter and a frequency demodulation component. The VCO outputs an oscillation signal to the antenna component via a output port, the antenna component transmits the oscillation signal to a subject as a transmitted signal and receives a reflected signal from the subject as a received signal, the mixer receives and mix the oscillation signal and the received signal into a mixed signal, the loop filter receives and filter the mixed signal to output a filtered signal, the filtered signal is delivered to the VCO via a tuning port, the frequency demodulation component receives and demodulates the oscillation signal to output a vital-sign signal.

title_en: Device for outputting simulated vital sign and operation method thereof
abstract_en: A device for outputting a simulated vital sign, includes: an ultra-wideband (UWB) communication interface including a UWB radar and a UWB antenna, and configured to detect a UWB scanning pulse transmitted by an external device to measure a vital sign of a user in a non-contact manner; memory storing at least one instruction; and at least one processor configured to execute the at least one instruction, wherein the at least one instruction, when executed the at least one processor individually or collectively, cause the device to: based on the UWB scanning pulse being detected by the UWB communication interface, generate a virtual vital sign by simulating a vital sign of a virtual person, obtain simulated vital sign data by combining the vital sign with the generated virtual vital sign, and output, through the UWB antenna, a UWB signal component including the vital sign data toward the external device.

title_en: Device for predicting earthquakes and volcanic eruptions, and for locating epicentres and magnitudes by measuring the radon in the soil
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for predicting earthquakes and volcanic eruptions, and for locating epicentres and magnitudes using an array (200) of device for detecting and analyzing radon anomalies in the soil (100). The device for detecting and analyzing radon anomalies in the soil (100) consists of two modules: a buried module (110), itself consisting of a radon sensor (111) and of a housing (112) and a surface module (120), itself consisting of a wireless communication system (121), of environmental sensors, of an electronic card, of a foot (125) and of a power supply (124). The multitude of device for detecting and analyzing radon anomalies in the soil (100) forms a measurement array (200) which dispatches the data to a server (210) which are processed by an earthquake prediction algorithm (220). The device according to the invention is particularly intended for monitoring radon anomaly in the soil for predicting earthquakes and volcanic eruptions, and locating epicentres and magnitudes.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a heartbeat detection method and device, relates to the technical field of radar detection, and is used for improving the accuracy of heartbeat detection. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target space and acquiring echo signals; processing the echo signals to obtain heartbeat time domain signals of the target human body; determining the number of effective peak-valley pairs in the heartbeat time domain signal according to the heartbeat time domain signal, and determining a frequency selection range according to the number of the effective peak-valley pairs; performing fast Fourier change on the heartbeat time domain signal to obtain a heartbeat frequency domain signal; searching a target spectrum peak of the heartbeat frequency domain signal in a frequency selection range; and determining the heartbeat frequency of the target human body according to the frequency corresponding to the peak point value of the target frequency spectrum peak.

title_en: Moving target tracking method based on overcomplete angle dictionary optimization technology
