abstract_en: The invention discloses a moving target tracking method based on an overcomplete angle dictionary optimization technology, which comprises the steps of adopting a Doppler through-wall radar module to acquire echo signals of a moving target, adopting a windowing time-frequency analysis method to carry out estimation processing on the echo signals to acquire instantaneous frequency values, adopting a high-order polynomial model to carry out fitting processing on the instantaneous frequency values to acquire a fitting curve, solving an instantaneous frequency tilt angle through the fitting curve so as to construct an overcomplete instantaneous frequency tilt angle dictionary, adopting the tilt angle dictionary to carry out time-frequency analysis processing on the echo signals to acquire optimal parameter domain distribution, adopting a signal demodulation technology to carry out extraction processing on the optimal parameter domain distribution, adopting a characteristic value classification technology to carry out extraction processing on the demodulated signals to construct an instantaneous frequency component set of the echo signals, and synthesizing a track of the moving target through the instantaneous frequency component set to finish tracking processing on the moving target. The invention has high target positioning precision and good tracking effect.

title_en: Oxygen generator breathing optimization system and method, oxygen generator and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to oxygen generation control, and particularly relates to an oxygen generator breathing optimization system, an oxygen generator, a storage medium, a breathing detection pressure sensor for detecting the breathing frequency of a wearer, an oxygen storage container for storing oxygen generated by an oxygen generation module, an electromagnetic valve arranged on an oxygen delivery pipe communicated with the oxygen storage container, a blood oxygen saturation and heart rate detection sensor for detecting blood oxygen saturation and heart rate data of the wearer, and a control module electrically connected with the breathing detection pressure sensor, the electromagnetic valve and the blood oxygen saturation and heart rate detection sensor, wherein the control module is configured to be suitable for controlling the valve opening time and the valve opening frequency of the electromagnetic valve according to the detected breathing frequency and the detected blood oxygen saturation and heart rate data. The invention can be used to adapt the oxygen output or shut down to the breathing rhythm of the wearer.

title_en: Contactless sensor circuit
title_ko: 비접촉식 센서 회로
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉식 센서 회로를 제공한다. 이 센서 회로는 측정 대상과 전기적, 물리적으로 비접촉하여 측정 대상의 전위를 측정할 수 있다. 이 센서 회로는  측정 대상과 축전 결합하는 측정 전극, 측정 전극과 직렬 연결되는 결합 축전기, 제1 음의 입력단 및 결합 축전기에 연결된 제1 양의 입력단을 포함하고 측정 신호를 제1 양의 입력단으로 입력받아 측정 신호를 증폭하여 제1 출력단으로 출력하는 제1 증폭기, 및 제1 노드와 상기 제1 출력단 사이에 연결되어 입력 임피던스를 증가시키는 임피던스 회로부를 포함하되, 제1 증폭기는 자체 입력 저항(Ri) 및 자체 정전용량(Ci)를 포함하고, 결합 축전기의 결합 정전용량은 측정 대상과 측정 전극에 의하여 형성된 등가 정전 용량보다 작을 수 있다. 
       
     비접촉 센서, 전위 센서, 생체 신호 증폭기, 고입력 임피던스, 저입력 커패시턴스

title_en: Remote Vital signs Detection Sensor
title_ko: 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서에 관한 것이다. 종래 기술은 사람의 위치를 확인하고 해당 방향으로 신호를 보내어 생체 신호를 감지하는 방식이다. 따라서, 연속적으로 공간을 이동하는 사람의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위해서는 연속적으로 신호의 방향을 변경해야 하며 특정 방향에 지속적으로 위치하지 않고 이동하여 벗어난 사람의 생체 신호는 감지가 어려울 수 있다. 이에 의해 감지된 생체 신호는 정확성이 떨어질 수 있는 문제점이 있다. 본 발명은 사람의 생체 신호를 정확하게 감지할 수 있는 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서는 주파 신호를 외부로 방사하고, 대상물에 반사되어 되돌아온 반사 고주파 신호를 수신하는 안테나부; 및 수신된 상기 반사 고주파 신호의 변화 패턴을 기반으로 생체 신호를 분석하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다. 본 발명은 감지된 생체 신호를 정확하게 추출할 수 있다. 또한 정확한 생체 신호 정보는 심근경색 등의 위급 상황을 신속하고 정확하게 알 수 있으며 독거노인 고독사와 같은 신변 이상에 대하여 빠르게 조치를 취할 수 있다.

title_en: All-direction high-resolution subsurface imaging using distributed moving transceivers
abstract_en: A subsurface imaging technique using distributed sensors is introduced. Instead of monostatic transceivers employed in conventional ground penetrating radars, the proposed technique utilizes bi-static transceivers to sample the reflected signals from the ground at different positions and create a large two-dimensional aperture for high resolution subsurface imaging. The coherent processing of the samples in the proposed imaging method eliminates the need for large antenna arrays for obtaining high lateral resolution images. In addition, it eliminates the need for sampling on a grid which is a time-consuming task in imaging using ground penetration radar. Imaging results show that the method can provide high-resolution images of the buried targets using only samples of the reflected signals on a circle with the center at the transmitter location.

title_en: Firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology. The firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology is composed of an acquisition module, a processing module, a Bluetooth forwarding module and a monitoring end. The acquisition module is connected with the processing module. The Bluetooth forwarding module comprises a Bluetooth transceiver chip and a wireless module, and the wireless module is a WIFI module and/or a mobile communication module. The monitoring end is a device supporting Bluetooth and WIFI. Firefighter vital sign data are acquired and transmitted to the processing module by the acquisition module, the data are packaged and then transmitted to the Bluetooth forwarding module through Bluetooth signals by the processing module, and the firefighter vital sign data are transmitted to the monitoring end by the Bluetooth forwarding module through the WIFI or a communication network. The firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology can be separated from a PC, is high in portability and can expand the range of motion of a monitored firefighter. Through the firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology, the vital sign conditions of firefighters in firefighting rescue and service training can be monitored in real time, and vital sign abnormality warning signs can be given out in time.

title_en: Mountain landslide monitoring sensor installation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mountain landslide monitoring sensor installation mechanism, include: the mounting plate is provided with a rotating rod in a penetrating way; the driving motor is connected with one end of the rotating rod, which penetrates out of the mounting plate; the bevel gear box is arranged on the mounting plate; the bevel gear group is arranged in the bevel gear box; the sliding box is arranged at the bottom side of the bevel gear box; the screw rod is vertically and rotatably connected in the sliding box, and one end of the screw rod is in transmission connection with the bevel gear group; the sliding block can be arranged in the sliding box in a vertically sliding manner and is sleeved outside the screw rod in a threaded manner; the mounting column is arranged at the bottom side of the sliding block and penetrates through the bottom of the sliding box; the sensor shell is detachably arranged on the mounting column, and one end of the sensor shell is a conical tip; the bevel gear boxes are multiple; the rotating rod is in transmission connection with the bevel gear set. The utility model relates to a rationally, easy operation is easy, can accomplish the buried installation or the adjustment landfill degree of depth or the dismantlement of a plurality of massif landslide monitoring sensors through a dwang, effectively improves the adjustment efficiency of corresponding installation effectiveness, landfill degree of depth, dismantlement efficiency.
assignees: SICHUAN YATONG ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and system for learning and imaging ultra-wideband through-wall radar and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method, a device and a system for learning and imaging of an ultra-wideband through-wall radar and a readable storage medium, wherein the method is used for acquiring echo scattering data of a hidden target; removing wall echoes and noise of the echo scattering data; constructing a fast operator of Fourier transform according to a diffraction tomography algorithm; constructing a compressed sensing sparse reconstruction model based on the echo scattering data and the fast Fourier transform operator; and a sparse reconstruction iterative algorithm is expanded into a multilayer neural network structure, and the hyper-parameters in the network model are trained through a training data set. According to the invention, by randomly down-sampling the echo data, the frequency domain data acquisition amount of the system is greatly reduced, and the data acquisition time of the system is reduced; reducing the memory required by the operation of the algorithm by constructing a fast operator of Fourier transform; by driving the hyper-parameters of the intelligent learning network model through data, the calculation complexity is reduced, the limitation of iteration time consumption of a sparse reconstruction method is avoided, and the imaging quality is improved.

title_en: Fire control extinguishing device based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things fire fighting, and discloses a fire fighting device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a pre-buried base, wherein the top of the pre-buried base is connected with a box cover through a bolt, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected inside the box cover, an automatic fire fighting mechanism is arranged inside the pre-buried base, the surface of a connecting arm is fixedly connected with an alarm through a bolt, the bottom of the connecting arm is fixedly connected with a small infrared induction camera through a bolt, and the bottom end of the automatic fire fighting mechanism is provided with a protection mechanism. This fire control extinguishing device based on thing networking utilizes automatic fire extinguishing mechanism and protection machanism, reaches the effect that the shower nozzle was automatic to be looked for the ignition and carries out the pertinence to put out a fire, sprays the different thing of putting out a fire to different sources of a fire simultaneously and reaches the effect of putting out a fire, improves the efficiency of putting out a fire, has ensured the security when putting out a fire simultaneously, further reaches avoiding the inside effect of mosquito dust entering shower nozzle.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BINGWU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of medical care and health monitoring, in particular to a non-contact vital sign monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: 1) Respectively carrying out data acquisition on the I/O two paths of signals of the radar module at a set sampling frequency to obtain a data frame signal group of the I/O two paths of signals; wherein, the signal buffered every second is used as a frame of data; 2) Respectively carrying out time domain analysis on the data frame signal groups of the I/O two-path signals, and judging the implantation state and the body movement state of the user; and respectively carrying out frequency domain analysis on the data frame signal groups of the I/O two paths of signals to obtain the breathing times and the heart rate times of the user. The invention provides a method for carrying out vital body detection by fusing various vital sign information, which realizes implantation/separation judgment, body movement intensity judgment, breath count (breath holding) calculation and heart rate count calculation under the same equipment, can effectively monitor four vital sign information of an implantation person, and is also suitable for scenes of other vital body detection such as post-disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based fire fighting search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based fire protection search and rescue system and method, when a fire disaster occurs in a fire protection monitoring area, a smoke sensing module of the invention sends a smoke sensing signal to a signal trigger switch to trigger a millimeter wave radar to operate, the millimeter wave radar is used for detecting the position information and the vital sign information of trapped personnel in the monitoring area, an NB wireless transmission unit transmits the position information and the vital sign information to a search and rescue management platform for analysis and processing, and the search and rescue management platform obtains a fire protection search and rescue scheme and sends specific work task instructions to each execution end. Compared with the traditional carpet type search and rescue, the invention can rapidly make a correct rescue strategy, and the fire fighting search and rescue personnel can accurately capture the position information and the vital sign information of the trapped personnel, thereby being beneficial to rapidly and accurately rescuing the fire fighting search and rescue personnel, greatly shortening the rescue time, reducing the rescue difficulty and improving the survival rate of the trapped personnel.
assignees: GUIZHOU VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER

title_en: Module cascade millimeter wave vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a module cascading millimeter wave vital sign detection radar, which comprises a power supply data board and a medium substrate, wherein an antenna array, a data processing chip and a peripheral circuit module are arranged on the medium substrate, the antenna array comprises a transmitting antenna area and a receiving antenna area, a plurality of transmitting antenna arrays are uniformly distributed in the transmitting antenna area at intervals, a plurality of receiving antenna arrays are uniformly distributed in the receiving antenna area at intervals, two sides of the receiving antenna area are respectively provided with an isolation virtual free area, and a plurality of isolation virtual free arrays are uniformly distributed in each isolation virtual free area at intervals; the data processing chip is connected with the transmitting antenna array and the receiving antenna array, and the isolation virtual array is grounded; the power supply data board is electrically connected with the medium substrate. The antenna array with high isolation and low side lobe performance is arranged, so that the information receiving and transmitting are not aliased, the radar performance is good, and the vital sign monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: TEACHING HOSPITAL CHENGDU UNIV TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Underground space vehicle-mounted through-wall radar path optimization method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of an underground space vehicle-mounted through-wall radar path based on an improved ant colony algorithm, firstly, considering the specificity of an underground space, according to the distance of the unmanned vehicle motion path and the imaging quality of the three-dimensional through-wall radar, the self-adaptive rule of the heuristic function is designed, and the global searching performance and the convergence speed of the algorithm are balanced. Secondly, by solving the non-convex optimization problem under the multi-constraint conditions including path length, imaging quality, non-purity of the kene and the like, the environment perception, accurate imaging and path planning are ensured to be efficiently and accurately completed in a complex underground environment. The method can be applied to unmanned detection and target search and rescue in underground space, and has strong adaptability and high efficiency.

title_en: Full-flow management method and system for non-contact microwave monitoring physiological parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-flow management method and a full-flow management system for non-contact microwave monitoring physiological parameters, which are characterized in that microwave signals of physiological parameters of a user are collected, and the microwave signals are preprocessed and subjected to feature extraction processing to obtain vital sign parameters of a human body; the method comprises the steps of wirelessly transmitting human vital sign parameters to a terminal of a user or a nurse station to evaluate the human vital sign parameters, comparing an evaluation result with a health rule base to generate corresponding health suggestions and pushing the health suggestions to the user terminal, analyzing the human vital sign parameters in the terminal through a pre-training model when the user is in a night sleep state, judging whether the user is in an abnormal breathing state according to an analysis result, if so, sending a control instruction to a sickbed corresponding to the user to control the sickbed to execute angle adjustment operation, and particularly, realizing real-time response and intervention on the health state of the patient through a complete flow management method of collecting the vital sign, judging the state and performing linkage intervention.

title_en: Polyaniline-based multi-mode thermoelectric sensor for environmental hazard and vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyaniline multi-mode thermoelectric sensor for monitoring environmental hazard and vital signs. The sensor comprises a composite thermoelectric functional layer formed by polyaniline and a carbon material, wherein the carbon material is used as a flexible conductive substrate, and polyaniline grows on the carbon material in situ in an electrochemical deposition mode to form a stable polyaniline/carbon composite structure. The self-powered temperature sensing of the environmental temperature difference is realized based on the Seebeck effect of the composite material, meanwhile, the pressure sensing function is realized by utilizing the high specific surface area of the carbon material and the resistance change characteristic caused by stress of the carbon material, and the detection of the gas and the pH environment is realized by further combining the reversible doping/dedoping behavior of polyaniline. The sensor realizes multi-parameter collaborative monitoring of temperature, pressure, chemical environment and the like in a single material system, has the characteristics of simple structure, good flexibility and self-power supply, and is suitable for the fields of complex environment monitoring and vital sign sensing.

title_en: Emergency rescue system in the ship using biological signal
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 선박 내 응급구조구난 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호를 이용한 선박 내 응급구조구난 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 해상 및 선박 내에서 승객에게서 발생할 수 있는 응급상황을 실시간으로 판단하고, 신속한 대처를 할 수 있어 귀중한 인명의 피해를 줄일 수 있게 된다. 또한, 재난상황이 발생한 경우, 위치기반 센서(140)에 의해 환자의 정확한 위치를 알아낼 수 있어, 바다에 빠져 조난을 당하거나, 다수의 층과 객실로 이루어지거나 위락 시설이 설치되어 있는 복잡한 구조를 갖는 대형 여객선과 같은 곳에서 즉각적인 응급 구조 조치를 할 수 있게 된다.
assignees: MOKPO NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Mobile sensor platform
title_ko: 모바일 센서 플랫폼
abstract_en: Disclosed is a mobile sensor platform including a variety of hardware and software to perform sensing operations of various passengers in a mobile sensor platform. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method includes: a step of using one or more sensors in a vehicle to continuously monitor a biosignal of a passenger in the vehicle; a step of generating data results from data fusing of different sensor signals received from at least one among one or more first electronic devices in the vehicle and one or more second electronic devices outside the vehicle and the biosignal; a step of using the data results to determine one or more operations to be performed on behalf of the passenger independently of the passenger; and a step where the vehicle performs the one or more operations independently of the passenger.
abstract_ko:
모바일 센서 플랫폼 내의 다양한 탑승자들의 센싱 동작을 수행하기 위한 다양한 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어를 포함하는 모바일 센서 플랫폼이 개시된다. 개시된 일 실시 예에 따른 방법은 차량 내의 하나 이상의 센서를 사용하여 차량 내의 탑승자의 생체 신호를 지속적으로 모니터링하는 단계, 차량 내의 하나 이상의 제1전자 장치, 및 차량 외부의 하나 이상의 제2전자 장치 중 하나 이상으로부터 수신된 다른 센서 신호들과 생체 신호의 데이터 융합으로부터 데이터 결과를 생성하는 단계, 데이터 결과를 사용하여, 탑승자와 독립적으로 탑승자를 대신하여 수행할 하나 이상의 동작을 결정하는 단계, 및
차량이 탑승자와 독립적으로 하나 이상의 동작을 수행하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Vehicle and control method for the same
title_ko: 차량 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: Provided are a vehicle and a control method thereof, wherein the vehicle determines a positive level of a user in the vehicle and accumulates a positive index of the user when the determined positive level is greater than or equal to a predetermined value. The vehicle according to an exemplary embodiment includes: a bio-signal sensor for measuring the user′s bio-signal; a display for displaying an image; and a control unit that determines at least one of a positive level and a change amount of the positive level of the user based on the measured bio-signal, accumulates the user′s positive index if at least one of the determined positive level and the change amount of the positive level is greater than or equal to a predetermined value, and transmits a control signal so that the display can display the accumulated positive index.
abstract_ko:
차량 내 사용자의 긍정도를 결정하고, 결정된 긍정도가 미리 정해진 값 이상이면 사용자의 긍정 지수를 누적시키는 차량 및 그 제어방법을 제공한다. 
일 실시예에 따른 차량은, 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서, 영상을 표시하는 디스플레이, 및 상기 측정된 생체신호에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 긍정도 및 긍정도의 변화량 중 적어도 하나를 결정하고, 상기 결정된 긍정도 및 긍정도의 변화량 중 적어도 하나가 미리 정해진 값 이상이면 상기 사용자의 긍정 지수를 누적 시키고, 상기 디스플레이가 상기 누적된 긍정 지수를 표시하도록 제어 신호를 송출하는 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: Wearable device, electronic device and operation method thereof for monitoring body water change
title_ko: 체수분 변화를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 장치, 전자 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a wearable device for monitoring a change in body water, an electronic device, and an operating method thereof. The wearable device (200; 101) includes: a communication circuit (220; 190) configured to transmit or receive data or a signal to or from an external electronic device (E); an output module (260); an electrical sensor (230) configured to measure a first bio-signal related to electrical characteristics; an optical sensor (240) configured to measure a second bio-signal related to optical characteristics; a temperature sensor (250) configured to measure the temperature of skin; and at least one processor (210; 120) operatively connected to the communication circuit (220; 190), the output module (260), the electrical sensor (230), the optical sensor (240), and the temperature sensor (250).
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 웨어러블 장치는, 외부 전자 장치와 데이터 또는 신호를 송신하거나 또는 수신하도록 설정된 통신 회로, 출력 모듈, 전기적 특성과 관련한 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 전기 센서, 광학적 특성과 관련한 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 광학 센서, 피부의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서, 및 상기 통신 회로, 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서와 동작적으로 연결된 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서로부터, 상기 제1 생체 신호, 상기 제2 생체 신호, 및 상기 온도와 관련한 제3 생체 신호를 각각 획득하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 획득한 제1 생체 신호와 관련한 제1 데이터, 상기 획득한 제2 생체 신호와 관련한 제2 데이터, 및 상기 제3 생체 신호와 관련한 제3 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로 전송하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 제3 데이터에 의해 각각 보정된 상기 제1 데이터 및 상기 제2 데이터의 변화에 기반하여 산출된 신체의 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로부터 수신하고, 상기 수신한 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터에 기반하여, 상기 출력 모듈에 상기 체수분 변화에 관련한 피드백을 출력하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidance method, computer program product and system
abstract_en: A hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) guidance method (40) for a system including a head-mountable computing device (100) comprising a processor (110) and at least one display module (106, 106') arranged to be viewed by the wearer (20) of the head-mountable computing device when wearing the device is disclosed that allows a rescuer to receive CPR guidance without losing sight of the victim. The method comprises receiving (420), on said processor, a first signal conveying vital signs information from at least one sensor (200, 210) for monitoring vital signs of a patient (10), wherein a sensor (210) of the at least one sensor is integrated in the head-mountable computing device (100); processing said first signal on said processor to obtain the vital signs information; and displaying (422) CPR guidance on said at least one display module in response to the processed vital signs information. A computer program product and a CPR guidance system are also disclosed. The system may be created in situ using ubiquitous devices, e.g. smart devices including usable sensors, thus facilitating rapid response to an SCA event, which improves the chances of survival of a SCA victim.

title_en: Ambient-light seal with integrated dry electrodes for electrical vital signs measurements
abstract_en: A wearable device (10) for individual health assessment measurement of vital signs comprises a housing (16), an optical sensor/emitter assembly (18), a controller (20), and a light seal (12). The optical sensor/emitter assembly emits optical signals from a bottom surface (22) of the housing through skin of a subject and receives reflected optical signals. The controller (20) controls a physiological measurement modality of the wearable device in the measurement of the vital signs and is coupled to the optical sensor/emitter assembly (18) for controlling the optical sensor/emitter assembly. The light seal (12) is configured to be removably coupled with the skin of the subject and to prevent ambient light interference with the optical sensor/emitter assembly when coupled. The light seal (12) comprises at least one integrated dry electrode (14) for transmitting and/or receiving electrical signals to/from the skin of the subject. Each integrated dry electrode (14) is electrically coupled to the controller (20) for obtaining electrical measurements according to the physiological measurement modality.

title_en: Plurisensorial system adapted for the prevention of professional diseases in the working environment, and method for the use of the system
abstract_en: A multi-sense system adapted for prevention of occupational diseases in a working environment is described, which comprises: - a protective facial mask, adapted for application in the front zone of a person's face, comprising nose and mouth areas, and comprising: - a temperature and humidity sensor (5, 6) adapted to be activated when the mask is worn, and adapted to provide time-related data concerning said activation as well as temperature and humidity values; - removable air filter elements (3, 4) applied to the front side parts of the mask; - inhalation (8) and exhalation (7) valves applied to the front zone of the mask, in front of the mouth, when the mask is worn; - elements for securing the mask to the face (2, 9, 10, 11, 12); - an electronic nose device (3) adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the quality of the air in said working environment; - a breathing detection device, adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the respiratory rate; - a data processing and displaying device, adapted to receive and store the data outputted by said protective facial mask, electronic nose device and breathing detection device, also adapted to process and display said data in order to determine a condition wherein said rotective facial mask needs to be worn.

title_en: Moving Multi-Polarization Multi-Transmitter/Receiver Ground Penetrating Radar System and Signal Processing for Buried Target Detection
abstract_en: A moving ground penetrating radar is comprised of multiple transmitters and receivers with multiple, e.g., Horizontal and Vertical, polarizations to detect buried targets with standoff capability. Novel signal and imaging techniques are used to form high quality radar imagery with low artifacts that are due to various sources of self-induced resonances, e.g., transmitter-receiver coupling, calibration errors, and motion errors in the multi transmitter/receiver channels of the radar system. The irradiated target area image is formed via exploiting both the spatial diversity of the physical multi-transmitter and multi-receiver array and synthetic aperture/array that is generated by the motion of the platform that carries the radar system. The images that are formed from the multiple polarizations are combined to remove surface targets/clutter and, thus, enhance signatures of buried targets.

title_en: Tunnel engineering safety construction excavation method
abstract_en: A tunnel engineering safe construction excavation method is characterized in that the excavation process of two opposite tunneling working faces of a deep-buried tunnel is continuously monitored through a micro-seismic sensor, the condition of a fault in front of the working face is detected in real time, and the working face of the tunnel excavated and penetrated through the fault is determined according to the distribution condition of the fault in front of the working face, so that the rockburst disaster caused when the working face of the tunnel penetrates through the fault can be effectively reduced, the construction safety of the tunnel is ensured, and the engineering construction progress is accelerated.

title_en: Heart rate and respiratory rate millimeter wave radar detection method based on CNN fusion characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a heart rate and respiration rate millimeter wave radar detection method based on CNN fusion characteristics, which comprises the steps of obtaining a one-dimensional radar signal of a target person in real time, wherein the one-dimensional radar signal is obtained by monitoring vital signs of the target person through a millimeter wave radar sensor, carrying out time-frequency analysis based on the one-dimensional radar signal to obtain a two-dimensional time-frequency signal, carrying out human heart rate and respiration rate detection on the target person based on the one-dimensional radar signal and the two-dimensional time-frequency signal to obtain the heart rate and respiration rate of the target person, overcoming the problems of inconvenience and discomfort caused by long-term monitoring and limitation of application of the traditional contact detection method, realizing comprehensive and accurate detection of the heart rate and the respiration rate of the human body through a non-invasive monitoring means, being particularly beneficial to old people, chronic disease patients and individuals needing long-term rehabilitation monitoring, and providing support for home medical treatment and remote health monitoring.

title_en: emergency situation determination method using glasses with measuring module
title_ko: 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 측정모듈이 구비된 안경은 안경 몸체(110)와; 뇌전도를 측정하기 위한 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120)과; 심전도를 측정하기 위한 맥박 측정모듈(130)과; 운동량을 측정하기 위한 자이로 센서(140)와; 상기 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120), 맥박 측정모듈(130), 자이로 센서(140)에서 신호를 수신받은 후, 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 파악하고, 상기 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 통해 사용자의 생체신호를 파악한 후, 생체신호에 따라 보청 장치(170) 또는 골전도 보청 장치(160)를 통해 착용자에게 알려주거나, 무선통신부(180)를 통해 외부로 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부(150)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 소리를 출력하여 착용자에게 들리도록 하는 보청 장치(170)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 골전도를 통해 착용자의 내이에 소리를 전달하는 골전도 보청 장치(160)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 별도로 구비된 외부의 서버(200)로 신호를 전송하는 무선통신부(180)와; 배터리(190); 로 이루어지는 것이며,  본 발명 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법은 측정모듈이 구비된 안경(100)의 안경 몸체(110)에 구비된 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120), 맥박 측정모듈(130), 자이로 센서(140)에서의 신호가 제어부(150)로 전달되는 신호 전달단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 신호를 통해 착용자의 생체신호를 파악하는 생체신호 판단단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 생체신호를 통해 착용자의 위급상황을 판단하는 위급상황 판단단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 생체신호를 파악한 착용자의 위급상황이면 보청 장치(170) 또는 골전도 보청 장치(160)를 통해 착용자에게 위급상황임을 알려주거나, 또는 무선통신부(180)를 통해 별도로 구비된 외부의 서버(200)로 신호를 전송하여 서버(200)에서 위급상황을 확인이 필요한 보호자에게 위급상황임을 알려주는 위급상황 알림단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 따라서 본 발명 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법은 안경에 스트레스 지수 측정모듈, 맥박 측정 모듈, 자이로 센서 등의 센서들을 구비하여 검사기를 일일이 붙이지 않아 일상생활에 지장이 없으며, 내장된 센서들의 무게도 사람이 느끼지 못할 정도로 가볍기에 사용에 불편하지 않고, 안경에 구비된 스트레스 지수 측정모듈, 맥박 측정 모듈, 자이로 센서를 통해 측정된 데이터를 통해 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 파악하여 심신이 약한 노인 등의 착용자의 상태를 파악하고, 상기 착용자의 상태가 좋지 않다고 판단되면 보청 장치 또는 골전도 보청 장치를 통해 사용자에 알려주어 휴식 등으로 대처할 수 있도록 하며, 착용자의 상태가 위급하다고 판단되면 무선통신부를 통해 가족, 119안전신고센터, 사회복지기관, 기타보호자 등에 신호를 전송하여 알려줌으로써 가족, 119안전신고센터, 사회복지기관, 기타보호자 등에서 착용자의 후속조치가 빠르게 될 수 있도록 하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of maintenance component with thermal-insulating waterproof function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to building maintenance applied technical field, specifically discloses a kind of maintenance component with thermal-insulating waterproof function, including exterior wall production board, interior wall production board, insulating layer, snap-gauge, connection card slot, hole for injecting glue and waterproof gasket cement.A kind of beneficial effect of maintenance component with thermal-insulating waterproof function of the utility model is: 1, having good waterproof performance, common building Pack the outer wall, it is not arranged to stay between steel tie, wall column by regulation and sets straight stubble, simultaneously in building wall construction, scaffold eye clogs the positions ash plug imprecisions such as pipeline not firm, through walls, penetrating passage is all easily left, which has substantially prevented inducement caused by leaking；2, since wall is on-site assembly, the construction time is greatly saved；3, anti-seismic performance improves, simultaneously because exterior wall is light material, the secondary injury for the generation that can collapse to avoid wall in earthquake.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCIAL BUILDING MATERIALS RES & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Six sufficient search and rescue type robots
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a six-foot search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue of robots and comprises a six-foot robot, a main control module, a material area, an infrared temperature measurement module, an ultrasonic sensor, a camera, a cardiotachometer pulse measurement module, a voice recording and playing module, a satellite mobile communication module, a temperature and humidity measurement module and a radar life detection instrument, and is suitable for complex terrains, so that convenience is brought to search and rescue work, trapped persons can be rescued more quickly and safely by rescuers after disasters, and casualties of rescuers can be reduced; the radar life detection instrument is more accurate, and trapped people can be more accurately found in a complex environment after an earthquake disaster; the body temperature and the pulse of the trapped person can be measured, a water bag and nutrient solution can be sent to the trapped person, and the trapped person can be helped to insist for a longer time; the carried satellite mobile communication module and the voice recording and playing module can enable trapped people to carry out voice communication with rescue workers or family people outside a disaster area.

title_en: Heating system of direct-buried fire-fighting water tank for photovoltaic power plant
abstract_en: A heating system of a direct-buried fire water tank for a photovoltaic power plant comprises a direct-buried fire water tank, an electric heater, a temperature sensor, a control cabinet, a municipal power supply, a power plant self-use power supply, a circulating water pump, heat dissipation equipment and a water dirt remover; the electric heater is used for heating water in the directly buried fire-fighting water tank; the temperature sensor feeds the water temperature of the directly buried fire water tank back to the control cabinet, and the control cabinet controls the operation of the electric heater; the control cabinet is selectively connected with a municipal power supply or a power plant self-use power supply, and the municipal power supply or the power plant self-use power supply supplies power to the heating system; the water at the water intake of the heating water of the direct-buried fire-fighting water tank flows back to the direct-buried fire-fighting water tank sequentially through the circulating water pump, the heat radiation equipment and the water dirt remover; the heat dissipation device is used for supplying heat for external equipment by utilizing the heat of hot water of the direct-buried fire-fighting water tank. The utility model can be applied to the range of the booster station of the photovoltaic power plant, the system stores heat for electricity generated by the photovoltaic power plant, the heating cost in the booster station is reduced, and the problem of freezing of water in the directly buried fire water tank is solved.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA ENERGY CONSTRUCTION GROUP;NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA POWER ENGINEERING CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Multi-target beef cattle respiration heart rate monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-target beef cattle respiration and heart rate monitoring device, and relates to the technical field of agricultural information. The method effectively solves the problems of inconvenient installation of contact equipment, interference to beef cattle and the like by utilizing a non-contact measurement technology of the radar, effectively solves the problem of insufficient efficiency of a single-target measurement method by utilizing a multi-target echo decoupling method, can monitor respiration and heart rate of multi-target beef cattle more accurately by fusing visual data and radar data, distinguish non-beef cattle targets, improve monitoring accuracy and automation level, can rapidly process multi-target echo information by utilizing a data processing module, realize simultaneous monitoring of the multiple beef cattle targets, improve monitoring efficiency, realize positioning and vital sign monitoring of the targets by fusing the visual information and the radar data, and can also perform identity recognition, provide data support for refined breeding management and also provide powerful technical support for health management of modern animal husbandry.

title_en: Non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the following steps: s1, scanning the upper body of a tester through an integrated radar sensor to obtain radar original data; s2, carrying out data preprocessing on the radar original data to obtain heartbeat data, breathing data and breathing heartbeat rate parameters of each window time; s3, positioning abnormal events according to the waveform change condition of the radar data, extracting relevant features, and judging respiratory obstruction and classifying and judging body movement events. The invention combines the monitoring of vital signs and the detection of apnea and falling events in body movement in the whole night with an alarm mechanism, is more suitable for sleep monitoring in household scenes, can generate more reliable sleep reports and reflects real sleep conditions.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on space-time equivalent virtual array technology
abstract_en: A vital sign detection method based on space-time equivalent virtual array technology obtains equivalent multi-channel virtual array signals through signal recombination according to phase information obtained by demodulating received single-channel continuous wave radar signals; then, carrying out frequency domain estimation on the multichannel virtual array signal by utilizing a subspace method to obtain incoming wave angle information; and accurately acquiring vital sign information of the target by a coarse-to-fine frequency estimation method according to the target frequency obtained by converting the angle information of the incoming wave. The invention synthesizes an equivalent virtual array by utilizing the similarity of a single-input single-output (SISO) CW radar single-channel phase signal and a single-input multiple-output (SIMO) radar multi-channel array signal, and completes the conversion from time to space, thereby realizing the accurate and stable estimation of the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a human body with super-resolution.

title_en: Small emergency first-aid machine with remote video consultation function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a small emergency first-aid machine with a remote video consultation function. The system comprises a pavement detection unit, an information acquisition unit, a vital sign monitoring unit, a video consultation unit, a remote video module and a response scheduling unit, wherein the pavement detection unit is used for monitoring pavement conditions in real time based on a pavement detection sensor module and ensuring that a patient obtains emergency rescue in the shortest time, the information acquisition unit is used for recording and managing personal information and symptom description of the patient based on an information management module, the vital sign monitoring unit is used for monitoring and analyzing vital signs of the patient by applying an anomaly detection algorithm based on data acquired by the information acquisition unit, the video consultation unit is used for establishing video connection with a remote doctor by the remote video module based on the analysis result of the vital sign monitoring unit and performing consultation on the patient, and the response scheduling unit is used for performing emergency treatment on the patient based on the consultation result of the video consultation unit and planning subsequent medical treatment. The professional guidance of a remote doctor is obtained through video consultation, and the emergency treatment quality is improved.
assignees: YANTAI XINFEI INTELLIGENT SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Radar heart rate detection method, and system thereof
abstract_en: To detect a heart rate by detection based on non-contact type 'Vital Signs' of a radar.SOLUTION: In a radar heart rate detection method and its system, raw signals are collected by facing a radar sensor to at least one object, and according to a concept for visualizing an image, after converting the raw signals into two-dimensional image information, a network is allowed to learn automatically by deep learning, which in the two-dimensional image information is a notable heart rate frequency, or which is a heart rate frequency to be filtered, to thereby take out the heart rate frequency effectively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Steering wheel cover of insensible detection type
title_ko: 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An unstimulating signal detection type steering wheel cover is provided to measure bio signal of a driver accurately by detecting the error range of meridian points in hands. CONSTITUTION: An unstimulating signal detection type steering wheel cover comprises a primary piezoelectric sensor portion and a secondary piezoelectric sensor portion. The primary piezoelectric sensor portion measures heart rate, skin conduction, and pulsation and is widely distributed in a steering wheel cover gripped by the hands of a driver. A plurality of piezoelectric sensors is installed in the primary piezoelectric sensor portion. The secondary piezoelectric sensor portion measures heart rate, skin conduction, and pulsation and outputs warning message at the determined set value at the same time. The secondary piezoelectric sensor portion is installed in the center portion of the primary piezoelectric sensor portion. The secondary piezoelectric sensor portion is projected from a steering wheel to a driver.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량의 스티어링 휠에 결합되는 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버에 있어서, 운전 시, 운전자의 양 손이 상기 스티어링 휠을 파지하는 부분에 복수개의 패턴으로 형성되어 심박수, 피부전도도 및 맥동을 측정하는 제1피에조센서부 및 상기 제1피에조센서부의 중앙에 배치되고, 운전자의 양 손바닥에 형성된 경혈부위에 위치하도록 형성되며, 심박수, 피부전도도 및 맥동을 측정함과 동시에 설정된 수치에서 경고진동을 발생시키는 한 쌍의 제2피에조센서부를 포함하며, 상기 제1피에조센서부는 상기 제2피에조센서부를 중심으로 하여 상기 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버의 원주방향으로 감싸도록 형성될 수 있다. 
본 발명에 의한 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버는 첫째, 피에조센서를 사용하여 심박수, 피부전도도 및 맥동을 측정할 수 있고, 둘째, 측정된 전기적 신호에 의해 운전자의 경혈을 자극하여 전기자극 치료 또는 경고 메세지를 전달할 수 있으며, 셋째, 운전자의 지속적인 생체신호 모니터링이 가능하고, 넷째, 저렴한 가격으로 설치 및 보급이 용이한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and Device for Measuring Biometric Data using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for measuring biometric signals using radar. The method for measuring biometric signals using the radar comprises: a step (a) of receiving multiple biometric signals from the radar; a step (b) of calculating distance information of the received multiple biometric signals and calculating the multiple biometric signals according to each distance; a step (c) of selecting a signal with the largest distribution in accordance with time among the multiple biometric signals for each distance classified in the step (b); a step (d) of further selecting a plurality of signals among signals of which distance to the signals selected in the step (c) among the multiple biometric signals for each distance classified in the step (b) is less than an arbitrary distance; a step (e) of converting all the signals selected in the step (c) and the step (d) from time domain to frequency domain; a step (f) of calculating reliability for each biometric signal from the signals for each distance converted in the step (e); and a step (g) of selecting the signals for each distance with the highest reliability calculated in the step (f) for each biometric signal to detect corresponding biometric signals. The disclosed method can accurately detect each biometric signal from the multiple biometric signals.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 레이더를 이용하여 다중 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법에 있어서, (a) 상기 레이더로부터 상기 다중 생체 신호를 입력받는 단계; (b) 상기 입력받은 다중 생체 신호의 거리 정보를 계산하고 거리별로 분류하는 단계; (c) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 시간에 따른 분산이 가장 큰 신호를 선택하는 단계; (d) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 상기 (c)단계에서 선택된 신호와의 거리가 임의의 거리보다 작은 신호들 중에서 다수의 신호들을 더 선택하는 단계; (e) 상기 (c)단계 및 (d)단계에서 선택된 모든 신호들을 시간 도메인에서 주파수 도메인으로 변환하는 단계; (f) 상기 (e)단계에서 변환된 거리별 신호들에서 각 생체 신호별로 신뢰도를 산출하는 단계; 및 (g) 각 생체 신호 별로 상기 (f)단계에서 산출된 신뢰도가 가장 높은 거리별 신호를 선택하여 해당 생체 신호를 검출하는 단계를 포함한다. 개시된 방법에 따르면, 다중 생체 신호에서 각 생체 신호를 정확하게 검출해 낼 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring biological signal and operating method thereof
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a biological signal measuring apparatus can include: an optical sensor which includes a photo detector and a light source array disposed to surround the photo detector; a first electrode which is disposed between the photo detector and the light source array; a second electrode which is disposed at an outer side of the light source array; an impedance measuring unit which measures impedance of a subject through the first electrode and the second electrode; and a processing unit which determines contact state of the subject and the optical sensor based on the impedance of the subject. According to the present invention, it is possible to improve accuracy of measuring a biological signal.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 광 검출기 및 상기 광 검출기 주위를 둘러싸도록 배치된 광원 어레이를 포함하는 광학 센서와, 상기 광 검출기와 상기 광원 어레이 사이에 배치된 제1 전극와, 상기 광원 어레이의 외곽에 배치된 제2 전극와, 상기 제1 전극 및 상기 제2 전극을 통해 피검체의 임피던스를 측정하는 임피던스 측정부와, 상기 피검체의 임피던스를 기반으로 상기 피검체와 상기 광학 센서의 접촉 상태를 판단하는 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Health care monitoring and smart home convergence system based on ceiling-embedded built-in IoT radar sensor
title_ko: 천장 빌트인 IoT 레이더 센서 기반 건강관리 모니터링 및 스마트홈 융합 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 천장 빌트인 IoT 레이더 센서 기반 건강관리 모니터링 및 스마트홈 융합 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 건강관리 모니터링 및 스마트홈 융합 시스템은, 침실 내 천장에 설치되며, 레이더 신호의 ToF(Time of Flight)를 기반으로 사용자의 심박수 또는 호흡수를 측정하여 생체신호 데이터를 생성하는 천장 빌트인 IoT 레이더 센서; 및 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 수면패턴을 분석하고, 상기 수면패턴을 이용하여 상기 사용자의 건강상태에 대한 건강예측정보를 생성하는 건강분석부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: POSCO E&C CO LTD;POSCO DX COMPANY LTD;CHEIL ELECTRIC WIRING DEVICES CO LTD

title_en: Method, apparatus and terminal for life detection processing
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a life detection processing method, device and terminal. The method includes that: a WiFi electromagnetic wave is emitted; coherent waves of a reflected wave of the WiFi electromagnetic wave and the WiFi electromagnetic wave are received; and life information is determined according to the received coherent waves. The method solves the problems about the life detection in related art that it is not convenient for users to operate, the penetration is low and the general feature is poor, while offering portability, usability and timeliness of use.

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluation of a subject's emotional, physiological and/or physical state with the subject's physiological and/or acoustic data
abstract_en: Embodiments of the subject invention relate to a method and apparatus for remote evaluation of a subject's emotive and/or physiological state. Embodiments can utilize a device that can be used to determine the emotional and/or physiological state of a subject through the measurement and analysis of vital signs and/or speech. A specific embodiment relates to a device capable of remotely acquiring a subject's physiological and/or acoustic data, and then correlating and analyzing the data to provide an assessment of a subject's emotional and/or physiological state. In a further specific embodiment, the device can acquire such data, correlate and analyze the data, and provide the assessment of the subject's emotional state and/or physiological in real time.
assignees: SHRIVASTAV RAHUL;LIN JENSHAN;ZAWOY KARL R;PATEL SONA;UNIV FLORIDA

title_en: Ultra-wideband radios for time-of-flight ranging and network position estimation
abstract_en: This invention provides a novel high-accuracy indoor ranging device that uses ultra-wideband (UWB) RF pulsing with low-power and low- cost electronics. A unique of the present invention is that it exploits multiple measurements in time and space for very accurate ranging. The wideband radio signals utilized herein are particularly suited to ranging in harsh RF environments because they allow signal reconstruction in spite of multipath propagation distortion. Furthermore, the ranging and positioning techniques discussed herein directly address many of the known technical challenges encountered in UWB localization regarding synchronization and sampling. In the method developed, noisy, corrupted signals can be recovered by repeating range measurements across a channel, and the distance measurements are combined from many locations surrounding the target in a way that minimizes the range biases associated to indirect flight paths and through-wall propagation delays.
assignees: UNIV CALIFORNIA;HERTZOG CLAUDIA A;DOWLA FARID U;DALLUM GREGORY E;ROMERO CARLOS E

title_en: Human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming. The human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming comprises the following steps: extracting a distance-angle unit of the measured object; acquiring Doppler frequency spectrum; and estimating the heart rate value and the respiration value of the tested object, and detecting the vital signs of the human body of the tested object. According to the invention, each distance-angle unit of a measured object is extracted through preprocessing the received initial echo signals, then the corresponding phase signals are extracted, the Doppler frequency spectrum is obtained through unwrapping and differential processing, then the Doppler frequency spectrum is analyzed, a respiratory pseudo spectrum is constructed in a preset respiratory frequency range to obtain the respiratory value of the measured object, finally a heart rate pseudo spectrum is constructed in a preset heart rate range, and the heart rate value of the measured object is obtained by combining the heart rate harmonic product spectrum, so that the improvement of the detection accuracy of the vital signs of the human body is achieved, and the problem of low detection accuracy of the vital signs of the human body in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Intelligent household anti-interference human body presence detection method and system based on 24GHz radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent home and discloses an intelligent home anti-interference human body presence detection method and system based on a 24GHz radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an intermediate frequency signal in a front space of an intelligent home based on a 24GHz FMCW radar front-end module integrated inside the intelligent home, and filtering the intermediate frequency signal; the method comprises the steps of extracting a distance-speed matrix of a filtering signal in a motion detection channel to generate a motion mark in a front space through the motion detection channel and the distance-speed matrix, outputting respiratory harmonic energy in the front space through a vital sign channel, sampling a noise spectrum baseline in the front space, converting the noise spectrum baseline into a noise interference mark through a frequency domain mutual exclusion verifier, and detecting whether a human body exists in the front space according to the motion mark, the respiratory harmonic energy and the noise interference mark to obtain a human body existence detection result. The invention can achieve both static human body detection reliability and anti-interference performance.

title_en: Portable optical cable buries degree of depth intellectual detection system appearance
abstract_en: The invention provides a portable optical cable burial depth intelligent detector, which belongs to the technical field of underground pipeline detection and comprises a shell, a multi-mode sensing unit, a main control and data processing unit, a man-machine interaction unit and a power supply unit, wherein the multi-mode sensing unit, the main control and data processing unit, the man-machine interaction unit and the power supply unit are integrated in the shell. The multi-mode sensing unit comprises an electromagnetic induction sensor, a ground penetrating radar sensor and an inertial measurement unit IMU. The main control and data processing unit runs a data fusion algorithm, fusion processing is carried out on the multi-source sensing data, and parameters of the electromagnetic induction model are dynamically corrected according to the dielectric constant of soil detected by the radar through the self-adaptive calibration module. The invention effectively overcomes the defects that a single detection principle is easy to be interfered and depends on experience through multi-mode sensing complementation and intelligent information fusion, obviously improves the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of measuring the buried depth of the metal and nonmetal optical cables under different soil conditions, and realizes continuous acquisition, intelligent interpretation and informationized management of buried depth data.

title_en: Multifunctional distributed multi-vital sign non-contact detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional distributed multi-vital sign non-contact detection radar system which comprises a central processing module, a line distribution module and a front-end detection module. The front-end detection module is composed of a plurality of vital sign sensing access modules, transmits optical signals or microwave signals to a detection area and receives echoes to obtain original detection signals. The central processing module comprises a signal generation and processing unit, a pulse condition extraction unit, a blood pressure estimation unit and a dynamic tracking and fall-preventing early warning unit, and realizes the functions of generating and processing detection signals, pulse condition extraction, blood pressure estimation, fall-preventing monitoring and early warning processing based on range profile and micro Doppler analysis and the like. The circuit distribution module is connected with the sensing access module and the central processing module, adds delay in each link and consists of a plurality of optical splitters and optical delays. The invention realizes the continuous measurement functions of non-contact, respiration and pulse detection, acquisition of human body pulse condition information, rapid estimation of human body systolic pressure, falling prevention and dynamic tracking.

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced maximum permissible exposure (MPE) compliance based on vital signs detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflection signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflection signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on the reflection signals, the device can measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain a heart rate and/or breathing rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflection signals indicate human vital signs, such as a heart rate or breathing. The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether human vital signs are detected at the target object, and transmit the adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Disaster site information intelligent collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster site information intelligent collecting device which comprises a communication module, a temperature pressure sensor, a tender moving sensor, a radio frequency identification device (RFID) reading instrument, a gyroscope, a vital sign detector and the like and is enabled to have innovation functions including individual positioning inside a building, wireless telecommunication, movement state detection, air breathing apparatus pressure monitoring, external environment (temperature, pressure) detection, vital sign monitoring and the like. All the detection parameters can be transmitted to a site command rescue platform in real time. The disaster site information intelligent collecting device is reasonable in design, and capable of improving efficiency of fire fighting and rescue, lowering loss of lives and fortune to the lowest point and improving life safety guarantee level.
assignees: XINJIANG ZHONGJU ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: GNSS and gyroscope fused high-precision geological disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-precision geological disaster monitoring system with GNSS and gyroscope integrated, which comprises a plurality of monitoring stations arranged at monitoring points, wherein each monitoring station comprises a positioning monitoring pile and a plurality of sensors buried underground, the positioning monitoring pile comprises a positioning component, a pile body and a control component, the positioning component comprises a gyroscope, a GNSS antenna and a circuit board, the circuit board comprises an OEM board and an MEMS accelerometer, the GNSS antenna is connected with the OEM board to receive positioning information of a satellite navigation system, the control component comprises a storage battery, a data acquisition front end, a data conversion circuit, an MCU data processing circuit and a communication module, the data acquisition front end acquires the positioning information of the sensors buried underground, the gyroscope, the MEMS accelerometer and the satellite navigation system, data is transmitted to an operation center through the communication module, the operation center calculates monitoring results, and the monitoring large screen displays field monitoring results, and sending the early warning alarm information and the early warning place geographic coordinate information to terminal equipment of related management personnel.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: A radar life detection instrument comprises a detection machine main body and a Bluetooth device, wherein the Bluetooth device 1 comprises a Bluetooth module and a display module. The detection machine main body comprises transmitting/receiving antennas (2 and 3), a low noise amplifier 4, a power amplifier 5, a modulator-demodulator 6 and a signal processing device 7, wherein the transmitting antenna 2 is arranged on the power amplifier 5, the receiving antenna 3 is arranged on the low noise amplifier 4, and the low noise amplifier 4 and the power amplifier 5 are connected with the signal processing device 7 through the modulator-demodulator 6.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY AUTOMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Mine rescue floats alignment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine rescue floating alignment system and method, the system includes ground monitoring platform, the fiber optic cables being connected with ground monitoring platform, it is arranged on fiber optic cables and stretches to the rescue positioning subsystem in Underwell permeable area, rescuing positioning subsystem includes multiple wireless rescue terminals, wireless rescue terminal includes the internal Storage jar that nutrient solution is housed, control module and communication interface, floating layer is set with outside Storage jar, control module includes processor, power supply, memory, EGC sensor, weighing sensor and data transmission unit, ground monitoring platform includes industrial computer and wireless data transceiver module；The method comprising the steps of：First, initialization rescue positioning subsystem；2nd, drill and deliver and wirelessly rescue terminal；3rd, position trapped personnel position and obtain trapped personnel vital sign parameter.The present invention is using floatability Storage jar positioning trapped personnel position, while the nutriment sustained life of being taken for trapped personnel, help is provided for rescue trapped personnel.
assignees: XI'AN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY;XI'AN TIANHE MINING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable handheld radar life detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable handheld radar life detection device, which comprises: the mobile mechanism is arranged in the shell; the moving mechanism comprises a U-shaped plate, the U-shaped plate is slidably mounted in the shell, and a radar life detection head is mounted in the U-shaped plate through a support column; when the radar life detection head is used, life signs are detected through the radar life detection head on the spot after a disaster, when the device is used for a long time, the condition of high temperature load is easily generated, the use temperature of the radar life detection head is detected through a temperature sensor in a U-shaped plate, when the temperature is too high, a motor is started through a DSP controller to drive the gear to rotate on a rack, the U-shaped plate is driven to move downwards to the inside of a shell through the meshing of a gear and the rack, the radar life detection head is closed, the storage is rapidly completed, a heat dissipation fan is started to blow the radar life detection head, and the temperature of the probe is reduced.

title_en: Old man's robot system of accompanying and attending to based on interaction of multidimension degree intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional intelligent interaction-based elderly accompanying robot accompanying system, which relates to the technical field of accompanying robots, wherein heart rate, respiratory rate and body temperature can be monitored in real time by utilizing a vital sign radar without contacting a user, the health state of the user is comprehensively estimated by combining the monitoring of the heart rate, the respiratory rate and the body temperature, the multi-dimensional health monitoring and the evaluation are beneficial to finding potential health problems as soon as possible, in addition, the user can interact with the robot through voice instructions to carry out video call, inquire calendar and weather information, the user experience of the elderly is improved, the technical use threshold is reduced, the system is internally provided with an image processing unit, dangerous situations such as falling or abnormal behaviors can be identified, medical staff and family contacts are automatically contacted, timely emergency rescue is provided, daily chatting and psychological guiding with the elderly are realized by utilizing a large language model, and possible autism and depression symptoms are relieved.

title_en: Emergency patient triage decision-making method and system based on intelligent grading of illness states
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hospital emergency systems, and discloses an emergency patient triage decision method and system based on intelligent grading of conditions. According to the invention, by setting the triage score, automatically and objectively acquiring multidimensional physiological data including vital sign data, nerve functions and autonomic nerve states through equipment such as a multiparameter monitor, an electroencephalograph and a skin electric sensor on an emergency ambulance, generating a quantized triage score based on a fusion weight algorithm, and additionally introducing delta wave duty ratio, GSR and HRV, the triage score can discover hidden crisis such as intracranial pressure increase and cerebral hernia more rapidly and earlier, and the scoring precision is improved from the fuzzy grade of mild, moderate and severe to continuous numerical quantization, so that an extremely reliable and refined basis is provided for subsequent decision.
assignees: HUNAN SHOUCHEN HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring system using hospital room patient's bio information and environment information
title_ko: 병실 환자 생체 정보 및 환경정보를 이용한 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system using bio information and environment information of a patient in a hospital room, which comprises: an antenna unit installed in a hospital room, using a time difference between an impulse signal and a reflected signal from a patient to measure the patient's presence and a distance from the patient to measure the patient's heart rate and respiration status, which are vital signs, and, at the same time, receiving the patient's moving status; a sensor unit installed on the lower part of a bed to continuously measure the patient's moving status and presence; a gateway unit transmitting the patient's bio-signals and status information measured by the antenna unit and the sensor unit; and a control unit modulating an impulse signal value received from the antenna unit into a digital signal, separating a noise signal and a target signal of the patient from the acquired signal, extracting the bio-signals through the patient's motion to monitor the patient's bio-signals and status information, and notifying the outside in case of emergency. According to the present invention, the patient's bio-signals are measured in a non-contact manner, the patient's movement and position are continuously measured through a pressure difference applied to the bed, the patient's condition is analyzed by receiving the measured values, an analyzed result is monitored, and an emergency is notified to the outside so, on the basis of collected data, falls, bedsores, contamination of a hospital room, and the like can be prevented and the emergency can be immediately managed, thereby providing an effect of effectively managing the patient.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 병실 환자 생체 정보 및 환경정보를 이용한 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 병실에 설치되어 발생하는 임펄스 신호가 환자로부터 반사되어 되돌아오는 신호의 시간차를 이용하여 환자 유무와 환자의 탐지 및 거리를 측정하여 환자의 생체신호인 심박과 호흡 상태를 측정하는 동시에 환자의 모션 상태를 수신하는 안테나부와, 상기 침대의 하부에 설치되어 환자의 모션 상태 및 유무를 지속적으로 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 안테나부와 센서부에서 측정된 환자의 생체신호 및 상태 정보를 송신하는 게이트웨이부와, 상기 안테나부로부터 수신된 임펄스 신호값을 디지털 신호로 변조하고 취득한 신호에서 잡음신호와 환자의 대상 신호를 구분한 다음 환자의 모션을 통한 생체신호를 추출하여 환자의 생체신호 및 상태 정보를 모니터링 및 위급상황시 외부로 알려주도록 하는 제어부를 포함한다. 
이를 통해, 환자의 생체신호를 비접촉으로 측정하며 침대에 가해지는 압력차를 통해 환자의 움직임과 위치를 지속적으로 측정하고, 측정된 값을 수신받아 환자의 상태를 분석하며, 분석된 결과를 모니터링 및 위급상황시 외부로 알려주어, 수집된 데이터를 기반으로 낙상, 욕창, 병실 오염 등을 사전에 예방하고 응급상황 발생시 즉각적인 대처가 가능하여 환자를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: WEBS TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHOSUN IACF

title_en: Personalized alarm provision system using Doppler signal-based biometric and motion information
title_ko: 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personalized alarm providing system using bio-information and motion information based on a doppler signal, comprising an apparatus for obtaining bio-signal and motion signal information using a doppler signal, a server, and a guardian terminal. The apparatus for obtaining bio-signal and motion signal information using a doppler signal includes: a doppler signal obtaining unit configured to emit a radar signal to a subject, obtain a doppler signal by obtaining a signal returning after the radar signal is reflected, and obtain a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit configured to obtain first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a signal information output unit configured to obtain the first signal information and the second signal information, and obtain bio-signal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information, respectively, using a preset algorithm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체 신호 및 움직임신호 정보 획득 장치, 서버 및 보호자 단말을 포함하는 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템이다. 상기 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체 신호 및 움직임신호 정보 획득 장치는  대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임신호 정보를 획득하는 신호 정보 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrostatic field sensor and a security system in interior spaces, which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna (1). Said probe is connected to an electronic circuit (2, 3, 4, 31, 32) which is able to decode said changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor, and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field, by means of a processor (7), enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding said antenna (1) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Position estimation device, position estimation method, and position estimation program
abstract_en: This invention is capable of estimating the three-dimensional position of a buried object using a set of two-dimensional ground penetrating radar data.　In this position estimation device, a candidate point extraction unit extracts buried object position candidate points from ground penetrating radar data that is two-dimensional data obtained through measurement of a buried object that is buried in the ground. A two-dimensional processing unit inputs the ground penetrating radar data into a recognition device that has been trained in advance to output a recognition score representing buried object likeness and outputs recognition scores representing the buried object likenesses corresponding to the candidate points. A three-dimensional integration unit integrates the ground penetrating radar data using a graph structure on the basis of the recognition scores and relative position information for the ground penetrating radar data and estimates the three-dimensional position of the buried object.

title_en: Vital sign detection apparatus and system and data processing method
abstract_en: The vital sign detection apparatus of the present invention, which comprises one or more sensors which may detect, by using a non-contact means, multiple vital sign signals of a subject to be tested, and output a plurality of pieces of corresponding vital sign information, thereby achieving fast and accurate vital sign detection. The present invention also relates to a multifunctional fusion detection apparatus, which comprises a camera, a radar sensor, an infrared sensor and a sensor driver, and which is used for vital sign measurement. The present invention also provides a non-contact type blood pressure measurement method and apparatus. The method comprises: first and second parts receive radar echoes and video signal streams, extract first and second pulse wave signals therefrom, obtain measured pulse wave transmission time, match the measured pulse wave transmission time with reference pulse wave transmission time, and obtain a blood pressure value.
assignees: NAT UNIV SINGAPORE;NATIONAL UNIV OF SINGAPORE SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Moving body location and error correction method for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving body location and error correction method for through-wall radar. Target distance sums under two receiving channels are used for obtaining the virtual position of a target through direct oval cross location, the virtual distance sums of a virtual target are obtained on the basis of known wall parameters, distance sum correction quantities are obtained by subtracting the target distance sums from the virtual distance sums, finally, the correction quantities are subtracted from the distance sums of the real target, oval cross location is conducted, and target location and error correction are finished. The position deviation caused by wall electromagnetism penetration to target location is corrected, the moving target location accuracy of the through-wall radar is improved, and the robustness of follow-up tracking processing is guaranteed. Compared with existing method, the moving body location and error correction method for the through-wall radar has the advantages that computation is simple and convenient, and the real-time performance and practicability are high.

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for sectional overhead line type slope earth surface deformation
abstract_en: The invention provides a segmented overhead line type slope earth surface deformation automatic monitoring system, a plurality of overhead line piles are sequentially arranged, a head end overhead line pile is defined as a control pile, and the control pile is positioned at a relatively stable position on the periphery of a slope earth surface potential landslide body; the lower end of the wire-lifting pile is buried in the ground surface of the side slope, the wire-lifting pile is rotationally connected with a rotating body, the upper end of the rotating body is provided with a fixed pulley support, the fixed pulley support is rotationally connected with a fixed pulley, a rotary displacement sensor is arranged on the rotating body and below the fixed pulley, the fixed pulley is movably connected with a steel wire rope, one end of the steel wire rope is connected with a steel wire rope tensioning device, a part between one end of the steel wire rope and the fixed pulley passes through the rotary displacement sensor, and the other end of the steel wire rope is fixedly connected with the adjacent wire-lifting pile; the power supply device is electrically connected with the data communication device, and the rotary displacement sensor is connected with the data processing device through the data communication device signal. The invention has the beneficial effects that: realize the long-term automatic monitoring of the slope surface deformation in a large scale, and the cost is low, the operation is convenient, simple and effective.

title_en: Individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual emergency rescue equipment with a vital sign monitoring system, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a reinforcing ring is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the equipment main body, a fixing strip is arranged on one side of the equipment main body, a display screen and a buzzer are arranged on the front surface of the fixing strip, a water storage tank is embedded in the bottom of the equipment main body, the water storage tank consists of a water diversion mechanism, a water absorption layer and a pull buckle, the water absorption layer is inserted into the bottom of the water storage tank, the water diversion mechanism is arranged on the upper part of the water absorption layer, the pull buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the water absorption layer, an inner cavity is arranged on the inner side of the equipment main body, a sweat detection sensor and a liquid collecting rod are arranged on the side surface of the inner cavity, a monitoring system is arranged in the equipment main body, and the individual emergency rescue equipment with the vital sign monitoring system is comprehensively monitored by the sweat detection sensor in cooperation with a temperature detection module, a blood pressure detection module and a heart rate detection module in a control system.

title_en: Non-excavation accurate positioning method and device for deeply buried underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-excavation accurate positioning method and device for underground pipelines, comprising the following steps of arranging a movable detection trolley on the ground, carrying out positioning detection by a ground penetrating radar and an adjustable induction coil type accurate positioner on the detection trolley, regulating the ground penetrating radar to be close to the ground to be detected in a rotating mode, inquiring the distribution condition of underground metal or nonmetal pipelines, analyzing the strength of signals between induction coils to judge the moving direction through regulating the interval between the induction coils, and carrying out pitching regulation and storage when in idle through the ground penetrating radar mechanism.

title_en: Bio-signals based automatic sleep-stage identification system
title_ko: 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템에 관한 것으로, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용하여 수면 단계를 예측하기 위한 것이다.
