이를 위하여 본 발명은 EEG, EOG, EMG, PPG, SKT, GSR 센서를 이용하여 서로 다른 채널을 통해 다양한 생체 신호를 획득하는 생체신호 검출부, 생체신호 검출부에서 각 채널을 통해 획득된 다양한 생체신호를 각 생체신호의 특징 추출에 적합한 방법으로 신호 처리를 실시하여 각각의 생체신호로부터 각 생체신호의 특징을 나타내는 특징점을 추출하는 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부, 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부의 각 생체신호에 대한 특징점을 기준으로 생체신호 조합을 생성하는 서브셋 발생부, 및 서브셋 발생부에서 조합된 생체신호 조합을 통하여 수면단계(REM,LS,DS)를 분류하고, 각 단계에 따른 조합의 성능 평가를 분석하는 성능 평가부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템을 제공하여, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용한 수면 단계 분석시 측정의 정확도와 편리성을 고려한 최적의 생체신호 조합으로 수면 단계를 정확하고 편리하게 예측할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: A low power biological signal measuring instrument and a amplification rate control method of measured signal
title_ko: 저전력 생체신호 측정기 및 측정 신호 증폭율 제어 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 저전력 생체신호 측정기 및 측정 신호 증폭율 제어 방법을 공개한다. 이 장치는 생체신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 감지된 생체신호를 인가받아 필터링하는 필터부; 상기 감지된 생체신호의 직류 기저선(DC baseline)을 비교하여 증폭율 제어 신호를 출력하는 증폭율 제어부; 상기 필터링된 생체신호를 인가받아 상기 증폭율 제어 신호에 응답하여 증폭하는 증폭부; 상기 증폭된 생체신호를 인가받아 진단 알고리즘을 이용하여 생체신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 센서부 내 제1 및 제2 접촉단자 쌍의 접촉여부 또는 침수 여부에 따라 측정기에 전원을 공급 또는 차단하는 전원부;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의할 경우, 측정되는 생체신호 파형의 듀티 싸이클을 현격하게 감소시키고, 생체신호 측정시 전체의 소모되는 전력을 현저하게 절감시킴으로써, 생체신호 측정기의 사용 시간을 획기적으로 증가시킬 수 있게 된다. 또한, 생체신호 비측정시에도 지속되는 전력소모를 방지하고, 생체신호 측정기 침수시 고장을 미연에 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: System for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템
abstract_ko: 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하고, 센싱된 정보를 서버로 전송하는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 상기 웨어러블 디바이스로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하되, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 상기 사용자의 주변 환경을 상기 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하고, 상기 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 상기 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 서버를 포함하는, 위험 상황을 판단하고 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Passenger's bording poistion and biometric information detection radar system and radar signal processing method thereof
title_ko: 탑승객의 탑승 위치 및 생체 정보 감지 레이더 시스템 및 그의 레이더 신호 처리 방법
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a radar system for detecting passenger seating positions and biometric information, which can stably detect seating positions and biometric information of passengers, such as adults or children, in an interior space while a vehicle is in motion, using a radar sensor, and a radar signal processing method thereof. The system includes: a moving target data signal processing unit that receives ADC data received through a plurality of receiving channels to detect biometric data of passengers while the vehicle is in motion, and processes the data to detect moving targets; a distance and angle data signal processing unit that distinguishes biometric signals from vibration signals by signal processing 3D data including distance and angle data of the detected moving target data; a frequency data signal processing unit that detects frequency components for biometric signals based on periodicity detected from the 3D data; and a biometric data signal processing unit that determines biometric information based on the detected frequency values and analyzes fluctuation characteristics of the determined frequency values to track biometric signals. According to the present invention, a radar system for detecting a passenger's boarding position and bio-information and a radar signal processing method thereof can obtain the effect of accurately distinguishing and determining random noise components and target signals generated by vibrations during vehicle driving, and stably detecting a passenger's boarding position and bio-signals.
abstract_ko: 탑승객의 탑승 위치 및 생체 정보 감지 레이더 시스템 및 그의 레이더 신호 처리 방법에 관한 것으로,탐지 대상을 향해 레이더 신호를 송신하고 탐지 대상으로부터 반사되는 수신신호를 수신해서 탑승객을 감지하며, 차량 주행 중 탑승객의 생체 데이터를 검출하도록, 복수의 수신 채널을 통해 수신된 ADC 데이터를 수신해서 신호처리해서 이동 표적을 검출하는 이동 표적 데이터 신호처리부, 검출된 이동 표적 데이터의 거리와 각도 데이터를 포함하는 3D 데이터를 신호처리해서 생체 신호와 진동 신호를 구분하는 거리 각도 데이터 신호처리부, 상기 3D 데이터에서 검출된 주기성에 기반하여 생체 신호에 대한 주파수 성분을 검출하는 주파수 데이터 신호처리부 및 검출된 주파수 값을 기반으로 생체 정보를 판별하고 판별된 주파수 값의 변동 특성을 분석하여 생체 신호를 추적하는 생체 데이터 신호처리부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 차량 주행 중 진동으로 발생하는 랜덤한 잡음 성분과 표적 신호를 정확하게 구분 및 판별해서 탑승객의 생체 신호 및 탑승 위치를 안정적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: Wireless intelligent ward nursing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless intelligent ward nursing system, the system includes: hospital server, ward computer, medical staff mobile terminal, patient terminal, control signal transmitter, wireless sensing signal collector, threshold value alarm, remove the bar code scanner, hospital server and ward computer, medical staff mobile terminal, patient terminal interconnect, the ward computer is connected with control signal transmitter, wireless sensing signal collector, threshold value alarm, remove the bar code scanner, a plurality of wireless devices are connected to the control signal transmitter output, the wireless transmitter of a plurality of integrated sensors is connected to wireless sensing signal collector input. The utility model discloses accessible medical staff mobile terminal or patient terminal are long-range to look over the patient vital sign parameter condition through the sensor monitoring, but also the work of remote control wireless device, and the doctor's advice is perhaps looked over in the adjustment, and convenient operation can satisfy the treatment and the nursing needs under the emergency situation.
assignees: UNION HOSPITAL TONGJI MEDICAL COLLEGE HUAZHONG UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: Auxiliary rescue machine vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary rescue machine vehicle which comprises an upper chassis and a lower chassis, wherein a hydraulic jack is fixed in the middle of the lower chassis, a rotation driving device is arranged between the lower chassis and the hydraulic jack, a traveling device is fixed on the upper chassis, a camera and an LED lamp are arranged on the upper chassis, and an infrared sensor, a singlechip control system and a life detector are also arranged on the upper chassis. The utility model realizes the omnibearing steering of the trolley by the rotation between the upper chassis and the lower chassis. The camera is used for comprehensively visually identifying objects and barriers of the robot car and returning specific pictures of an accident scene, the infrared sensor can detect the ambient temperature and realize infrared imaging, and the camera can be used for detecting the barriers and can also serve as a flame detector to assist rescue workers in detecting the environmental safety of the disaster scene. The vital sign near the car can be detected to the vital detector, assists the rescue personnel to search and rescue, can improve the rescue efficiency after the disaster by a wide margin, reduces the casualties.

title_en: Sedimentation monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sedimentation monitoring device, comprising: and the sedimentation cylinder is buried in the tunnel ground and used for presenting the sedimentation quantity of the tunnel ground. The buckle component is arranged on the sedimentation cylinder and is rotationally connected with the top wall of the sedimentation cylinder. The corner reflector is arranged on the buckle assembly, fixedly connected with the buckle assembly and in communication connection with the radar system and used for reflecting echo signals to the radar system and assisting the radar system in detecting the settlement of the tunnel ground. The buckle component is screwed out of the sedimentation cylinder and is buried in the ground of a tunnel by means of the driving force of the electric drill after being connected with the common electric drill, and then the buckle component is transferred into the sedimentation cylinder and extends into the ground, so that the sedimentation cylinder is supported in the sedimentation cylinder, and the work of monitoring the sedimentation quantity simultaneously with the control monitoring system on a construction site is realized. And only need rotatory two processes of burying in ground and rotatory installation buckle subassembly, simple easy operation, time saving and labor saving have improved work efficiency.
assignees: SHAANXI PUBLIC STAR SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-human body vital sign ultra-wideband radar monitor based on eye-shaped differential antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses an eye-shaped differential antenna-based multi-human body vital sign ultra-wideband radar monitor, which comprises an XETHRU X4 ultra-wideband radar chip, an ultra-wideband differential transmitting antenna, an ultra-wideband differential receiving antenna and a microprocessor with a QSPI interface, wherein the XETHRU X4 ultra-wideband radar chip is positioned on the front surface of a multilayer PCB, and the ultra-wideband differential transmitting antenna and the ultra-wideband differential receiving antenna are printed on the plane of the same multilayer PCB and are respectively positioned on the left side and the right side of the XETHRU X4 ultra-wideband radar chip. The invention has the advantages of high detection sensitivity, strong anti-interference performance and capability of distinguishing multi-target human body vital signs.
assignees: SHANDONG PUTAI INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Underground pipeline buried depth estimation method based on ground penetrating radar and three-dimensional velocity spectrum
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground pipeline buried depth estimation method based on a ground penetrating radar and a three-dimensional velocity spectrum. The invention solves the problem that the traditional special pipeline exploring instrument can only detect metal pipelines when detecting the urban underground pipelines.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring device, which comprises: a radar transmission system; the first input end of the radar receiving system is connected with the output end of the radar transmitting system; the input end of the digital signal processing system is connected with the output end of the radar receiving system, the first output end of the digital signal processing system is connected with the input end of the radar transmitting system, the second output end of the digital signal processing system is connected with the second input end of the radar receiving system, and the digital signal processing system is used for digitally processing and regulating and controlling the radar transmitting system and the radar receiving system in real time; and the input end of the upper computer is connected with the third output end of the digital signal processing system, algorithm processing is carried out, vital sign information is extracted, and vital sign monitoring is completed. The invention solves the problem that the speed measurement and distance measurement resolution ratio of the traditional CW radar and UWB radar is limited, adopts the FMCW radar with the distance measurement and speed measurement capability, has the bandwidth of 4GHz, greatly improves the accuracy of physical sign monitoring, and realizes the high integration of hardware and the miniaturization of equipment through the antenna-radio frequency-digital mixed pressure integration.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating landslide erosion-collapse-reviving evolution process
abstract_en: The test device for simulating the landslide 'erosion-landslide-reviving' evolution process comprises a landslide model arranged in a test box, wherein a wave making device and a wave absorbing device are respectively arranged at two ends of the model, the wave making device is arranged at the front end of the landslide model, the wave absorbing device is arranged at the rear end of the model, shooting devices are arranged at the top and two sides of the outside of the test box, the shooting devices at the top are arranged at the front end of the landslide model, a water body monitoring device is arranged side by side, the landslide model comprises a multistage bedrock plate and a bedrock plate lifting device, during test, bedrock, a sliding belt and a sliding body material are sequentially paved on the bedrock plate, a sensor is buried in the sliding body material, the test box is a transparent box with an opening at the top, double-layer glass is arranged in the box of a wave making device area, water injection and drainage devices are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the box on the sides of the wave making device and the wave absorbing device, and a sponge is arranged at the wave absorbing device end in the box; the utility model realizes the simulation of the erosion-collapse-reviving linkage process.

title_en: Collaborative vital sign monitoring system based on fixed radar and mobile unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign monitoring system with a fixed radar and an unmanned aerial vehicle, which realizes large-scale basic monitoring through a millimeter wave radar array, and a specific unmanned aerial vehicle performs accurate rechecking after receiving an abnormal signal. The system adopts a multistage response mechanism, when the fixed radar detects sign abnormality, the unmanned aerial vehicle is scheduled to lock a target through millimeter wave echo feature matching, identity binding is carried out by utilizing a binocular camera, body temperature data is supplemented by combining an infrared sensor, and finally an early warning decision is generated through a multi-mode fusion algorithm. The hardware layer defines the minimum configuration requirement (including millimeter wave radar module, visual identification unit, infrared temperature measuring component and obstacle avoidance system) of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the software layer designs a cross-equipment data space-time alignment model and a dynamic task scheduling protocol. The application scene covers the sudden night monitoring of the nursing home, the health monitoring of the gym group and the non-contact patrol of the hospital isolation ward, and the problems of loss of tracking of moving targets, unhooking of identity information and the like in the traditional scheme are effectively solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: UWB-based contactless biometric signals Tester
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 생체신호진단기
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for remote health care using UWB radar. According to the present invention, a training set is configured by grouping values, which can be analyzed from a first UWB radar Doppler signal, by class using a pattern recognition method. A central center diagnoses a health state by analyzing a second UWB radar Doppler signal measured by a mobile terminal based on the training set and transmits class information to the mobile terminal as diagnostic results. As the result of the diagnosis, when the class information is classified as dangerous and an emergency has occurred, the central center requests emergency rescue based on a position signal transmitted from the mobile terminal.
abstract_ko: UWB 레이더를 이용한 원격 건강관리 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 제1 UWB 레이더 도플러 신호에서 분석할 수 있는 값들을 패턴인식 기법을 이용해 클래스별로 그룹화하여 트레이닝 셋을 구성한다. 중앙 센터는 트레이닝 셋을 바탕으로 휴대 단말기에서 측정된 제2 UWB 레이더UWB 레이더 신호를 분석하여 건강상태를 진단하고, 진단결과로서 클래스 정보를 휴대 단말기로 전송한다. 진단 결과, 클래스 정보가 위험으로 분류되어 응급 상황이 발생한 경우에, 중앙 센터는 휴대 단말기로부터 전송된 위치 신호에 기반하여 응급 구조를 요청한다.

title_en: touch panel apparatus for measuring biosignals and method for measuring pulse transit time using thereof
title_ko: 생체신호를 측정하는 터치 패널 장치 및 이를 이용한 맥파 전달 시간을 측정하는 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a touch panel apparatus for measuring a pulse transit time with a simple method and a method for measuring the pulse transit time using the same. The touch panel apparatus includes a touch panel unit which senses a signal according to a heart beat, a pulse sensor unit which senses a pulse signal, and a processor which obtains the pulse transit time based on the pulse signal and the signal according to the heart rate, which are sensed.
abstract_ko: 간편한 방식으로 맥파 전달 시간을 측정할 수 있는 터치 패널 장치 및 이를 이용한 맥파 전달 시간을 측정하는 방법을 개시한다.

title_en: workers healthcare monitoring method using biological signals based safety menagement woking clothes
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for monitoring health care of a worker using safety management working clothes based on a bio-signal, which promotes disaster prevention, increase of productivity, and health enhancement. According to the present invention, the method comprises the steps of: transmitting a signal sensed by a bio-signal sensor (130) to a web service (210) of a server (200); requesting the web service (210) to insert or delete an algorithm; storing the algorithm when a hadoop distributed file system (230) requests storage of the algorithm; transmitting the algorithm to the web service (210) by the hadoop distributed file system (230); transmitting a simple object access protocol (SOAP) message to an output device by searching for data applied with the web service (210) having received the algorithm; and outputting a screen through the output device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 모니터링 방법은 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)에 구비된 생체신호용 센서(130)를 통해 감지된 신호를 서버(200)의 웹 서비스(210)에 전송하는 단계; 상기 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 삽입 또는 삭제를 서버(200)의 데이터베이스(220)에 요청하거나, 또는 알고리즘 저장을 서버의 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)(HDFS, Hadoop Distributed File System)에 요청하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 알고리즘 저장 요청시 알고리즘을 저장하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 저장된 알고리즘을 실행하기 위해 알고리즘을 웹 서비스(210)로 전송하는 단계; 상기 알고리즘을 수신한 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 검색 및 적용한 후, 적용된 데이터를 검색하여 SOAP(Simple Object Access Protocol) 메시지를 출력장치에 보내는 단계; 상기 출력장치를 통해 화면을 출력하는 단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 모니터링 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for acquiring bio-signal, and apparatus for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 생체신호 획득 장치 및 방법과, 생체정보 추정 장치
abstract_en: A biosignal acquisition apparatus is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a biosignal acquisition apparatus may comprise: a sensor unit including a biosignal sensor which measures a biosignal according to the contact of an object, a load sensor which detects a contact load of the object, and an ultrasonic sensor array which detects a contact load distribution of the object; and a signal processing unit which acquires an actual contact load of a region of interest based on the contact load and the contact load distribution and outputs the actual contact load and biosignal of the region of interest.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 획득 장치가 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면 생체신호 획득 장치는 대상체의 접촉에 따라 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서, 대상체의 접촉 하중을 검출하는 하중 센서 및 대상체의 접촉 하중 분포를 검출하는 초음파 센서 어레이를 포함하는 센서부와, 접촉 하중 및 접촉 하중 분포를 기초로 관심영역의 실제 접촉 하중을 획득하고, 관심영역의 실제 접촉 하중 및 생체신호를 출력하는 신호 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: fire suppression system for electric vehicles in charging
title_ko: 충전중 전기자동차 화재진압 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing system for an electric vehicle in charging which can effectively extinguish a fire by preventing thermal runaway to prevent the fire from being transferred to other cells of a battery. The fire extinguishing system for an electric vehicle in charging comprises: fire water injection parts separated from each other, buried and installed on a floor surface on which an electric vehicle in charging connected to a charger is positioned, and provided with a fine spray nozzle with a head installed to face the bottom surface of the electric vehicle; a sensing part having temperature sensors separated from each other and arranged on the floor surface to sense the battery temperature of the electric vehicle; and a control part having a controller opening and closing a valve of a fire water supply pipe connected to the fine spray nozzle based on information generated by the temperature sensors to regulate the supply of fire water to the fine spray nozzle. The fine spray nozzle finely sprays the fire water toward the battery by projecting the head above the floor surface by the water pressure of the fire water supplied as the controller opens the valve of the fire water supply pipe when the temperature of the battery sensed by the temperature sensors exceeds a preset temperature.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 충전기에 연결된 충전중의 전기자동차가 위치하는 바닥면에 간격을 두고 매립 설치되되, 헤드가 상기 전기자동차 저면을 마주하게 설치되는 미세분무 노즐을 구비하는 소화수분사부; 상기 바닥면에 간격을 두고 배치되어 상기 전기자동차의 배터리 온도를 감지하는 온도센서를 구비하는 감지부; 및 상기 온도센서가 생성하는 정보를 기반으로 상기 미세분무 노즐에 연결되는 소화수공급관의 밸브를 개폐하여 상기 미세분무 노즐로의 소화수 공급을 단속하는 제어기를 구비하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 미세분무 노즐은 상기 온도센서가 감지한 상기 배터리의 온도가 사전 설정된 온도를 초과할 때 상기 제어기가 상기 소화수공급관의 상기 밸브를 개방함에 따라 공급되는 상기 소화수의 수압에 의해 상기 헤드가 상기 바닥면 상부로 돌출되어 상기 배터리를 향해 상기 소화수를 미세분무하는 것을 특징으로 하는 충전중 전기자동차 화재진압 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Non-Contact Patient Monitoring Medical Bed System
title_ko: 비접촉식 환자 감시용 메디컬 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 비접촉식 환자 감시용 메디컬 시스템은, 초광대역 임펄스(IR UWB) 레이더 센서 및 체압센서를 이용하여 환자의 생체 신호, 체압 신호를 비접촉 방식으로 측정함으로써 심장 이상, 욕창 발생, 낙상 발생 등을 예방하고 즉각 조치하는 데 목적이 있다. 
이에 따라, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 비접촉식 환자 감시용 메디컬 시스템은, 초광대역 임펄스(IR UWB) 레이더 센서를 이용하여 침대 위 환자의 심박수 및 호흡수를 포함한 생체신호를 측정하고 모니터링하는 바이탈감지부; 압전(Piezo) 센서를 이용하여 침대 위 환자의 부위별 체압을 측정하여 욕창 여부 및 낙상 가능성을 모니터링하는 체압감지부; 바이탈감지부, 체압감지부에서 측정한 생체 신호 및 체압 신호를 화면 출력하는 디스플레이부; 및 바이탈감지부, 체압감지부에서 측정한 생체 신호 및 체압 신호를 해석하고 데이터를 학습하여 환자의 심장 상태, 욕창 가능성 및 낙상 여부를 판단하고 간호시스템에 전송하는 제어처리부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Biosignal measuring device
title_ko: 생체신호측정기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biosignal measuring device comprising: two pairs of electrodes for measuring a biosignal of at least a portion of a user's body; a measuring unit for measuring at least one of body composition, electrocardiogram, and Pulse Transmit Time (PTT) of a human body from the two pairs of electrodes; a three-axis acceleration sensor for sensing a sensing value associated with a change in a user's measurement posture in three axes; and a control unit for determining a measurement posture of the biosignal using the sensing value sensed by the three-axis acceleration sensor, wherein the measurement unit determines the at least one of the body composition, the electrocardiogram, and the PTT of the human body using a first condition, if the measurement posture is in a first mode, and determines the at least one of the body composition, the electrocardiogram, and the PTT using a second condition different from the first condition if the measurement posture is in a second mode. According to the present invention, when it is difficult to accurately measure the biosignal while wearing a band-type biosignal measuring device, the biosignal can be measured accurately even in a low temperature and low humidity environment by converting a biosignal measurement mode from a wear mode to a non-wear mode and measuring the biosignal under conditions corresponding to the non-wear mode.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호측정기에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 신체의 적어도 일부분의 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 두 쌍의 전극, 상기 두 쌍의 전극으로부터 인체의 체성분, 심전도, PTT(Pulse Transmit Time) 중 적어도 하나를 측정하는 측정부, 상기 사용자의 측정 자세 변화와 관련된 센싱값을 3축으로 감지하는 3축 가속도센서, 및 상기 3축 가속도센서에서 감지된 센싱값을 이용하여 상기 생체 신호의 측정 자세를 판단하고, 상기 측정 자세가 제1 모드인 경우, 상기 측정부를 통해 인체의 체성분, 심전도, PTT 중 적어도 하나를 제1 조건을 이용하여 결정하고, 상기 측정 자세가 제2 모드인 경우, 상기 체성분, 상기 심전도, 상기 PTT 중 적어도 하나를 상기 제1 조건과 상이한 제2 조건을 이용하여 결정하는 제어부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 밴드형 생체신호측정기를 착용한 상태로 정확한 생체신호 측정이 어려운 경우, 생체신호 측정 모드를 착용 모드에서 비착용 모드로 측정모드로 변환하여 비착용 모드에 대응하는 조건으로 생체 신호를 측정함으로써, 낮은 온도와 낮은 습도 환경에서도 정확한 생체 신호를 측정할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for removing random noise of radar collection signal in biometric signal measurement radar, and apparatus for same
title_ko: 생체신호 측정용 레이더에서 레이더 수집신호의 랜덤노이즈 제거방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for effectively reducing and removing, by using microwave Doppler radar, various types of vibration noise introduced from the outside while a human biometric signal is being acquired, and an apparatus for same. The method comprises the steps of: (a) generating, by a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) of an IF signal generator, an oscillation frequency having a predetermined period by using a voltage (V(t)) applied from the outside, transmitting the generated oscillation frequency to a major portion of a dynamic target through a single transmission antenna, and receiving, by n reception antennas, a signal reflected from the dynamic target and various types of signals generated around the dynamic target; (b) generating, by the IF signal generator, a Doppler IF signal from each of n received signals; (c) converting, by an analog/digital converter, each of multiple Doppler IF signals input by the IF signal generator into digital data; (d) configuring, into a data set having symbols at sampling time intervals by a fast Fourier transformer, digital signals collected by the analog/digital converter (20) during a unit time, and converting the data set into a frequency component symbol set having multiple indices; (e) calculating a value by adding, for each index set, index symbols converted into a frequency component symbol set and then dividing same by the n reception antennas by a calculation unit of a signal calculator; and (f) with respect to the value calculated by the calculation unit, classifying the deviation between spectrum components of a commonly-generated periodic signal and an uncommon aperiodic signal according to a threshold value of a predetermined standard, and obtaining only the periodic signal through filtering. The present invention can effectively remove random noise included in a biometric signal area by using biometric signal measurement Doppler radar including a single transmission unit and multiple reception units, thereby improving the accuracy of sensing a biometric signal in a contactless manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본 발명은 마이크로웨이브 도플러레이더를 이용하여 인체의 생체신호를 획득하는 동안 외부에서 유입되는 각종의 진동노이즈를 효과적으로 감쇄시키고 제거하기 위한 방법과 그 장치에 관한 것으로, (a) IF 신호생성기의 전압제어발진부(VCO)에서 외부에서 인가된 전압(V(t))으로 일정 주기의 발진 주파수를 생성하여 단일의 송신안테나를 통해 동적 타깃의 주요 부위로 송출하고, 상기 동적 타깃에서 반사된 신호와 동적 타깃 주변에서 발생된 각종 신호를 n개의 수신안테나에서 수신하는 단계; (b) 상기 IF 신호생성기는 수신된 n개의 신호에서 각각 도플러 IF 신호를 생성하는 단계; (c) 아날로그/디지털변환기는 상기 IF 신호생성기에서 입력된 복수의 도플러 IF 신호를 각각의 디지털데이터로 변환하는 단계; (d) 상기 아날로그/디지털변환기(20)에서 단위 시간동안 수집된 디지털신호를 고속푸리에변환기에서 샘플링 시간 간격으로 심벌을 갖는 데이터 열로 구성하고, 이 데이터 열을 복수의 인덱스(Index)의 주파수 성분 심벌 열(symbol set)로 전환하는 단계; (e) 상기 신호연산기의 연산부에서 주파수 성분 심벌 열로 전환된 인덱스 심벌들을 각 인덱스 열로 합하여 n개의 수신안테나 수로 나눈 값으로 연산하는 단계; (f) 상기 연산부에서 연산된 값에 대하여 공통적으로 발생하는 주기적인 신호와 공통적이지 않은 비주기적인 신호의 스펙트럼 성분의 편차를 일정 기준의 문턱(Threshold) 값으로 분류하여 주기적인 신호만 필터링하는 단계를 포함하여 이루어진 것이다. 본 발명은 단일의 송신부와 복수의 수신부로 이루어진 생체신호 측정용 도플러레이더를 이용하여 생체신호 영역에 포함되어 있는 랜덤노이즈를 효과적으로 제거함으로써 비접촉식 방식에서 생체신호를 센싱하는 정확도를 개선한 것이다.

title_en: Method for detecting biometric information, and electronic device supporting same
title_ko: 생체 정보 검출 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments comprises: an output module; a communication module configured to communicate with at least one external device; a first sensor for detecting a bio-signal of the body; a second sensor configured to detect an inertial signal; and a processor operatively coupled to the output module, the communication module, the first sensor, and the second sensor, wherein the processor may be configured to: determine the position of the electronic device on the basis of signals transmitted and received to/from the at least one external device in response to detecting the bio-signal through the first sensor; determine the posture of the electronic device on the basis of information obtained through the second sensor; determine a measured posture on the basis of the position of the electronic device and the posture of the electronic device; and guide the measured posture to correspond to a pre-specified reference posture.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 출력 모듈, 적어도 하나의 외부 장치와 통신하도록 설정된 통신 모듈, 신체에 대한 생체 신호를 감지하는 제 1 센서, 관성 신호를 감지하도록 설정된 제 2 센서 및 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 통신 모듈, 상기 제 1 센서 및 상기 제 2 센서와 동작 가능하게 연결된 프로세서를 포함하며, 상기 프로세서는 상기 제 1 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 것에 응답하여 상기 적어도 하나의 외부 장치와 송수신하는 신호에 기초하여 신체에 대한 상기 전자 장치의 위치를 결정하고, 상기 제 2 센서를 통해 획득되는 정보에 기초하여 상기 전자 장치의 자세를 결정하고, 상기 전자 장치의 위치 및 상기 전자 장치의 자세에 기초하여, 측정 자세를 결정하고, 상기 측정 자세가 미리 지정된 기준 자세에 대응되도록 가이드 하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The patch sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Non-contact vital-sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A non-contact vital-sign monitoring system having a radar disposed in vicinity of a monitored subject includes a data buffer storing output signals of the radar sampled in sequence during a predetermined period; a status classifier determining status of the monitored subject; and a vital-sign detector determining a vital sign of the monitored subject according to the output signals of stationary status.

title_en: System And Method For Discrimination Of Central And Obstructive Disordered Breathing Events
abstract_en: Disordered breathing events may be classified as central, obstructive or a combination of central an obstructive in origin based on patient motion associated with respiratory effort. Central disordered breathing is associated with disrupted respiration with reduced respiratory effort. Obstructive disordered breathing is associated with disrupted respiration accompanied by respiratory effort. A disordered breathing classification system includes a disordered breathing detector and a respiratory effort motion sensor. Components of the disordered breathing classification system may be fully or partially implantable.
assignees: LEE KENT;HATLESTAD JOHN D;ZHU QINGSHENG;STAHMANN JEFFREY;HARTLEY JESSE W;NI QUAN

title_en: Complex tunnel-type agricultural facility and storeroom
title_ko: 복합 터널형 농업시설 및 저장고
abstract_en: To form a complex tunnel-type agricultural facility and storeroom, a foundation is formed on a base selected as a location for the installation of an arched roof structure formed of a foamed polystyrene panel with a thickness of 0.175 M (175 mm) and a width of 2 M, a concrete base, of an L shape and in which a rebar having a diameter of 10 mm is buried in an inner central portion thereof, is formed on an outer side of the foundation, and a panel base part, having a bottom formed of foamed polystyrene above the concrete base and an L and panel-shaped base part, is buried in the concrete base part to reinforce the installed strength of the arched roof structure through the deposition of concrete, and thereby minimize damage generated by typhoons or other natural disasters. Also, in the concrete base part of the bottom surface of the agricultural facility, heating pipes having carbon nanotubes built therein that emit heat derived from electric power are buried at certain intervals so as to be connected to a power source, the growing temperature for crops in the agricultural facility formed in the arched roof structure is controlled by a controller controlled by a temperature sensor installed indoors, a condensing unit formed of carbonate for condensing sunlight is formed on a top surface of the agricultural facility, sunlight is supplied to shaded portions by using a reflector mounted on the panel forming an arched roof to be angle-adjustable, sunlight can be directly received through windows on side surfaces of the structure to allow the agricultural products to grow and photosynthesize, a product loading unit and unloading unit are installed between the agricultural facility and the storeroom to reduce transferring distance in order to avoid having to transport agricultural products produced in the agricultural facility out from the arched roof structure, to thereby effectively minimize a moving line for workers, and the storeroom is maintained at a temperature of 4℃ by using a well-known and common type of refrigerating air-conditioner, so as to maintain the freshness of stored agricultural products and enable appropriate shipping dates of agricultural products to be adjusted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 복합 터널형 농업시설 및 저장고를 형성하기 위하여, 패널소재의 두께가 0.175M(175㎜)이고, 폭은 2M인 발포 폴리스틸렌에 의한 패널로 이루어지는 원형지붕 구조물의 설치위치가 선정된 바닥기초에 토대를 형성하고, 상기 토대위의 외측부에는 ┗자 형태로 콘크리트 기초를 형성하되, 내부중심부에는 직경10㎜의 철근이 매설되는 콘크리트기초, 상기 콘크리트기초 위에 하부에는 발포 폴리스틸렌으로 형성되며, 패널형태의 기초부가 L자 형태의 패널 기초부를 콘크리트 기초부에 매설하여 원형지붕 구조물의 설치강도를 콘크리트타설로 보강하므로 태풍 및 기타 자연재해로 발생되는 피해를 최소화할 수 있다. 또한, 농업 시설부의 바닥면의 콘크리트 기초부에는 전력에 의거 발열되는 탄소 나노 튜뷰가 내부에 구비된 히팅 파이프를 일정간격으로 매설하여 전원에 연결하고, 실내에 설치된 온도센서에 의거 제어되는 콘트롤러에 의거 원형지붕 구조물의 내부에 형성된 농업시설부의 농산물의 성장온도를 제어하며, 또한, 농업시설부의 상부면에서 햇빛을 집광하기 위하여 카보네이트로 이루어지는 집광부를 형성하고, 원형지붕을 형성하는 패널에는 각도 조절이 가능하게 장착된 반사경에 의거 그늘진 부분에 햇빛을 공급하고, 측면의 창문에서는 태양광을 직접 받아들이에 농산물의 성장의 광합성을 도우며, 물품 상, 하차부는 농업 시설부와 저장고의 사이에 설치하여, 농업 시설부에서 생산된 농산물 등을 원형지붕 구조물의 밖으로 출하할 때보다 그 이송거리를 단축하여 작업자의 동선을 효율적으로 최소화시키고, 저장고에는 공지공용의 냉동 공조시설에 의거 4℃를 유지하여 생산된 보관중인 농작물의 신선도를 유지하고, 농작물의 적정한 출하시기를 조절가능하게 할 수 있다.

title_en: Multichannel multi-human body target two-dimensional positioning method based on UWB (Ultra Wide Band) radar type life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel multi-human body target two-dimensional positioning method based on a UWB (Ultra Wide Band) radar type life detector. The life detector comprises a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas which respectively form three radar echo signal channels. The two-dimensional positioning method comprises the following steps of: A1. enhancing a weak life signal of a static human body by all channels and integrating a radar echo signal in distance by all the channels through adopting a method for integrating eight points at an interval of four points; scattering the integrated signal for decomposing, reconstructing and synthesizing a target echo signal and a distance signal; carrying out digital filtration and digital differentiation on the target echo signal and realizing the enhancement of the weak available signal; A2. distinguishing one-dimensional distance, carrying out space frequency analysis according to the target echo signal obtained afterdigital filtration and digital differentiation and the distance signal by all the channels and respectively obtaining three projecting signals of a target in the three channels; and A3. confirming the two-dimensional position information of the target according to the three projecting signals and forming a display image.

title_en: Weak-breathing-signal enhancement method used for life detection radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a breathing signal enhancement method used for a life detection radar. In the breathing signal enhancement method, an echo signal matrix of an ultra-wide-band life detection radar is modeled into a zero mean stationary random process, and through a background removal method and a linear jitter removal method, a signal matrix which includes weak breathing signals is obtained preliminarily. Different degrees of enhancement processing, fast time FIR band-pass filter and a slow time moving average filter enable the weak breathing signals to be enhanced and more obvious in an output signal matrix so that guarantee is provided to follow-up detection of weak human body characteristics.

title_en: Portable audio and video life detection instrument based on wireless transmission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable audio and video life detector based on wireless transmission, which belongs to the technical field of security rescue and comprises a life detector main body, a signal acquisition and output module, a signal processing and control module, a wireless equipment sending module, a wireless equipment receiving module and a remote control driving module; utilize infrared camera and digital adapter to carry out image and audio acquisition respectively, again respectively through video signal processing circuit and audio signal processing circuit after handling, audio and video transmission to handheld terminal after will handling by transmitting antenna, if confirm that there is the trapped person, then accessible remote control drive module opens quantum wave transceiver, utilizes to transmit quantum wave and receives the quantum wave signal that returns to it carries out processing analysis, judges the health condition of trapped person. In a word, the invention has the advantages of high transmission efficiency, convenient operation and flexible realization.

title_en: Polarized through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides a polarized through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method, and relates to the technical field. The method converts the polarized through-the-wall radar imaging problem into a sparse group basis tracking denoising problem by utilizing the joint sparsity of scene reflectivity vectors corresponding to all polarized channels, solves the sparse group basis tracking denoising problem by adopting a spectral projection gradient L1 norm minimization algorithm to realize imaging reconstruction, realizes the calculation of forward functions and adjoint function operators by adopting a non-uniform fast Fourier transform technology in the imaging process, and avoids the calculation and storage of each element of a dictionary matrix. The polarized through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method provided by the invention obviously reduces the requirement on the memory of a computer in the imaging process, can ensure the quality of imaging reconstruction, and is suitable for large-scale high-resolution polarized through-wall radar imaging occasions.

title_en: Performance detection system and method of UWB radar life detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance detection system and a method of a UWB radar life detection device, wherein the detection system consists of a field simulation device, a position moving device, a life sign simulation device and a movable interference device; placing equipment to be tested on one side of the post-disaster field simulation device, wherein one side is a life signal detection area; the position moving device is arranged in a life signal detection area of the post-disaster field simulation device; the vital sign simulation device is arranged on the position moving device; the movable interference means are arranged in the buried vital signal detection area at random according to reality. When the UWB radar life detection device is detected, the life sign simulation device moves in a life signal detection area, and detection of detection distance, field angle, angle and distance information resolution, multi-target anti-interference capability and dynamic target detection capability is completed. The invention can simulate the actual conditions of different burying depths, burying materials, a plurality of living bodies and micro-moving living bodies, thereby carrying out target two-dimensional detection on the device, having high detection precision and good applicability.

title_en: Doppler radar heartbeat detection method based on multi-scale residual error shrinkage network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Doppler radar heartbeat detection method based on a multi-scale residual error shrinkage network, which considers that continuous wave radar signals in a time domain are different in performance on different time scales, provides a multi-scale time domain feature extraction module, and places the multi-scale time domain feature extraction module in a residual error shrinkage network structure to form a multi-scale residual error shrinkage module, wherein the residual error shrinkage network uses a soft threshold value as a nonlinear conversion layer, so that related noise interfering with heartbeat detection can be effectively eliminated; performing Hilbert-Huang transform on radar signals under different scales, wherein the obtained result reflects time-frequency characteristics of the signals, and further extracting the characteristics of the transformed signals, so that heartbeat related characteristics are separated from complex mixed signals; and the output of the multi-scale residual error contraction module and the output of the Hilbert-Huang Lvbo module are subjected to feature fusion, so that noise interference in an original radar signal is effectively reduced. The method can reconstruct high-quality radar signals and improve the accuracy of heartbeat detection.

title_en: Floating Dam and Controlling Method of Water Level using such Floating Dam
title_ko: 수위계측 센서에 의한 보 직하수위 측정을 이용한 부력식 가동보 구조물 및 이를 이용한 하천 저류수위조절 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a buoyancy-type movable weir structure and a method for controlling a water level of reserved river water using the same. The buoyancy-type movable weir structure blocks the flow of water and stores a considerable quantity of the water flowing down from the upper reaches of a river, as a main body of a weir rises by buoyancy and a weir part is exposed above the water in the case of an ordinary water level, In the case of a flood water level, the buoyancy-type movable weir structure introduces the water into the main body and causes the main body of the weir to sink and the weir part not to be exposed above the water, thereby allowing the flow of water to smoothly flow downstream. The present invention includes a buried container (20) and a movable weir (10) moving up and down by buoyancy, wherein the movable weir (10) includes a vertical body (16) and a lower body (17), and has an internal space (14). The buried container (20) includes a water level sensor (202) for measuring a water level of water directly under a weir, and a passage control valve (201). If a measured water level directly down the weir is less than a lower bound value, the passage control valve (201) is closed to elevate the movable weir (10) with the buoyancy of the water stored in the buried container (20) so that the vertical body (16) blocks the flow of water. If the measured water level directly down the weir is greater than an upper bound value, the internal space (14) of the movable weir (10) is filled with the water and the movable weir (10) descends. If the measured water level directly down the weir is less than the upper bound value, the movable weir (10) is elevated again.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 평수위의 경우에는, 보의 본체가 부력에 의해 상승하여 보 부분이 하상으로부터 돌출됨으로써 수류의 흐름을 막아 상류로부터 흘러오는 물의 상당량을 저류하게 되지만, 홍수위의 경우에는 보의 본체 내부로 물을 유입시켜 본체가 가라앉도록 하여 하상으로부터 보 부분이 하상으로부터 돌출되지 않도록 함으로써, 수류가 하류로 원활하게 흘러갈 수 있도록 하는 부력식 가동보 구조물에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에서는 매립함(20)과, 부력에 의해 승하강하는 가동보(10)를 포함하며; 가동보(10)는 연직체(16)와 하부체(17)로 이루어져 있으며; 가동보(10)에는 내부공간(14)이 존재하며; 매립함(20)에는 보 직하수위를 측정하는 수위계측 센서(202)와 통로제어밸브(201)가 구비되어 있고; 측정된 보 직하수위가 하한 값 미만이면 통로제어밸브(201)를 폐쇄하여 매립함(20)에 채워진 물의 부력으로 인하여 가동보(10)가 상승하여 연직체(16)가 물의 흐름을 막아 가두게 되고; 측정된 보 직하수위가 상한 값 이상이면 가동보(10)의 내부공간(14)에 물이 채워지면서 가동보(10)가 하강하고, 측정된 보 직하수위가 상한 값 미만이 되면 내부공간(14)의 물을 배수하여 가동보(10)가 다시 상승하는 구성을 구성을 가지는 것을 특징으로 하는 부력식 가동보 구조물과, 이를 이용하여 하천의 저류수위를 조절하는 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Method and appratus for measuring biometric data using radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and a device to measure a biometric signal by using radar. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the biometric signal measuring device includes: a first signal obtaining part obtaining a first signal, measuring a first biometric signal of a subject, from first radar; a second signal obtaining part obtaining a second signal, measuring both the first and second biometric signals of the subject, from second radar; a signal synchronizing part synchronizing the first and second signals; and a biometric signal detecting part removing the first biometric signal from the second signal and detecting the second biometric signal by calculating a difference between the first and second signals synchronized. The first radar is placed at a set distance to measure the first biometric signal from the subject, and the second radar is placed at a set distance to measure both the first and second biometric signals from the subject.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 장치는 제1 레이더로부터 측정 대상자의 제1 생체 신호가 측정된 제1 신호를 획득하는 제1 신호 획득부, 제2 레이더로부터 상기 측정 대상자의 제2 생체 신호와 상기 제1 생체 신호가 모두 측정된 제2 신호를 획득하는 제2 신호 획득부, 상기 제1 신호와 제2 신호를 동기화하는 신호 동기화부 및 상기 동기화된 제1 신호와 제2 신호의 차이를 계산하여 상기 제2 신호에서 상기 제1 생체 신호를 제거하고 상기 제2 생체 신호를 검출하는 생체 신호 검출부를 포함하되, 상기 제1 레이더는 상기 측정 대상자로부터 상기 제1 생체 신호가 측정되도록 설정된 거리에 배치되고, 상기 제2 레이더는 상기 측정 대상자로부터 상기 제1 생체 신호 및 제2 생체 신호가 모두 측정되도록 설정된 거리에 배치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Active phase switchable array
abstract_en: An active phase switchable array includes a plurality of antenna elements and a bias circuit. Each of the radar elements includes an antenna, a power coupling network and an injection-locked oscillator (ILO), and each of the antenna elements is coupled with each other through the power coupling networks for operating the ILO of each of the antenna elements in self- and mutual-injection-locked states. The antenna elements in self-injection-locked state are utilized to detect the vital signs of subjects, and the antenna elements in mutual-injection-locked state are utilized to produce phase difference between the radiating signals of the antenna elements for forming a beam. As a result, the active phase switchable array can simultaneously detect the vital signs of multiple subjects.

title_en: Radio frequency life detection radar system
abstract_en: Trapped or confined individuals may be located and rescued by detecting their vital signs (e.g., chest movement or heart beat) using reflected, radio frequency signals over a range of multiple antenna polarities.
assignees: GHAFFARI NIK HOSSEIN;FRASER DESMOND A;PEIXOTO NATHALIA

title_en: Portable software robot for life detection for earthquake relief
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a life detection is with portable software robot for earthquake relief, load the body and the center through groove that resets including the center, settle the upper end of center dress carrier has robot main drive mechanism, and the lower extreme of center dress carrier installs the vice drive mechanism of robot, the middle part of center dress carrier is provided with the detection room, and the front end of detecting the room settles and have sealed top cap, all install the set screw all around of sealed top cap, and the inside of sealed top cap is provided with the cable through hole, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: this portable software robot is used in life detection for earthquake relief is provided with center dress carrier, robot main drive mechanism, the vice drive mechanism of robot and detection room, through the center and the detection room that are located the device body center, can let the device body can keep better equilibrium through the center with behind the detection room linking installation circuit and the detection sensor, make things convenient for the device body to carry out better function.

title_en: A kind of explorer vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of explorer vehicles for search and rescue, including flying control module and to the power module of each module for power supply, fly control module respectively with GPS positioning module, drive the motor drive module of propeller and raspberry pie module for sending aircraft motion command and data processing to be connected, raspberry pie module is connected with life detection module, environment detection module, communication module and SD card；Life detection module includes camera and sound acquisition module, and environment detection module includes Temperature and Humidity module, detection of air quality module and dust detection module, and communication module includes WIFI module and LORA module.After aircraft provided by the utility model flies to devastated, it acquires the environmental information of devastated and indicator of trapped personnel is unfolded to search operation, the location information of trapped person is locked by GPS positioning module, collected information back is converged to ground data and is stood, the rapid deployment of rescue work can be accelerated.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUREN COLLEGE ZHEJIANG SHUREN UNIV

title_en: Oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention overcomes serious environment condition limit in rescue processes of firefighters and defects in physiology monitoring technology of the firefighters and provides an oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system capable of monitoring vital signs of oxyhemoglobin saturation and the like of firefighters. The oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system is characterized by comprising an oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal arranged on a user and an intelligent cell phone which is arranged at the position of a monitor and provided with a Bluetooth wireless data communication module or a Zigbee wireless data communication module. An oxyhemoglobin sensor is arranged on the oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal. The oxyhemoglobin sensor can detect oxyhemoglobin saturation of the user in real time mode and feeds results back to the oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal to judge whether the oxyhemoglobin saturation is out of limit and then weather alarm can be given out by an acousto-optic alarm circuit. The oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system can accurately detect oxyhemoglobin saturation information of the firefighters in real time mode and feed information back to the intelligent cell phone of a firefighter command monitoring end. The monitoring terminal has the advantages of being small in volume and convenient to wear.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method, system and terminal based on biological radar
abstract_en: In order to overcome the defects in the prior art, the application provides a vital sign monitoring method, a system and a terminal based on a biological radar, which comprise the following steps: setting at least 2 biological radars; alternately adjusting the direction angle of the biological radar according to a preset period so as to alternately acquire echo data of a person to be monitored through the biological radar; according to the echo data, obtaining the face orientation of the person to be monitored, taking the biological radar of the face orientation of the person to be monitored as a biological radar close to the person to be monitored, and taking the biological radar as a monitoring radar; and monitoring vital signs of the person to be monitored by using the monitoring radar. The monitoring method can monitor the vital signs continuously in the sleeping process of the person to be monitored, and can monitor the respiratory rate and the heartbeat rate more accurately even if the person to be monitored turns over in the sleeping process.
assignees: SHENZHEN YICHENG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign data health analysis method and system based on wearable finger ring monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of health monitoring, and particularly relates to a vital sign data health analysis method and system based on wearable ring monitoring, which comprises a sensor module, a fall detection module, an alarm module, a GPS module, a wearable ring, an application terminal and a monitoring cloud platform, wherein the health data of a user are analyzed in real time, the health data of the user are synchronized to the application terminal in real time, under abnormal conditions, the position information of the user is synchronized in real time, a plurality of health indexes of the user can be monitored in real time, continuously and for a long time, the fall detection function is provided, and more importantly, when the abnormality occurs, the family members and medical personnel of the user receive the alarm information, the position of the user can be tracked in real time, emergency rescue or health guidance is provided for the user according to the situation, and the health monitoring management of the user forms a closed loop.
assignees: SHENZHEN KANGHENG MEDICAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wearable vital sign monitoring and early warning equipment and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses wearable vital sign monitoring and early warning equipment and application, and belongs to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. The utility model provides a wearable vital sign monitoring early warning equipment, includes the electrocardio monitoring clothing, the electrocardio monitoring clothing includes cuff and collarband, wherein, the outside of cuff is provided with the radar arm area, and one side of collarband below is provided with the electrocardio monitor, the electrocardio monitor is through mounting hole groove and electrocardio monitoring clothing combination, wherein, the surface in mounting hole groove is provided with the colloid magnetic ring. For solving the problem that most of existing portable vital sign monitoring equipment is wrist-worn, the detection accuracy that this kind of wrist-worn structure can realize is limited, and can also receive wearing environment influence, the electrocardio monitoring clothing adopts the design of wearing next to the skin, and the user needs the electrocardio monitor in guarantee chest region and skin direct contact when wearing, can carry out real-time supervision through electrocardio monitor to pulse and blood pressure concentration and other numerical values in daily life in-process.
assignees: THE FIFTH MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Multi-radar vital sign monitoring system applied to fixed crowd place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-radar vital sign monitoring system applied to fixed crowd places, which comprises a horizontal layer 24GHz radar network, a vertical layer 60GHz radar array and an auxiliary sensor module. Through three-dimensional collaborative deployment of the heterogeneous radars, the improved variational modal decomposition algorithm and the joint probability data association tracking technology are combined, and multi-target respiration, heart rate and behavior feature separation in dense scenes is achieved. The system adopts a space-time diagram convolution network to extract individual gait cycle characteristics, and establishes a unique biological characteristic coding file through dynamic gesture track matching to complete non-contact identity binding. The hardware design integrates a multi-band radar chip and a dual-mode communication interface, and the software architecture deploys a lightweight AI model to realize localized real-time analysis. The embodiment covers the fields of fall monitoring in the nursing home, postoperative monitoring in the hospital and safety control in the kindergarten, radar spacing and beam pointing can be dynamically adjusted, and the problems of privacy leakage and target confusion existing in the traditional monitoring system are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign collaborative monitoring system based on multi-band reconfigurable radar array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign collaborative monitoring system based on a multi-band reconfigurable radar array, which breaks through the limitation of fixed frequency bands, adopts a 20-80GHz adjustable radar module on a horizontal layer, integrates a rotatable waveguide structure and an MEMS phase array, deploys 45-300GHz photon radar on a vertical layer, and combines an optical comb generator to realize continuous frequency modulation. The system automatically matches a penetration mode (24 GHz), a high-precision mode (60 GHz) and a multi-target mode (77 GHz) through a dynamic spectrum sensing and beam forming algorithm. Innovative definition of frequency band combination mathematical constraint conditions (fV/fH is more than or equal to 1.5) covers existing and future potential frequency band combinations. The application scene covers the metal environment penetration monitoring of hospitals, the dense target separation of the aged communities and the safety monitoring of the industrial high-humidity environment.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for positioning moving object based on millimeter wave radar and binocular camera, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for positioning a moving object based on millimeter wave radar and a binocular camera, which are used for acquiring different point cloud data and visual image data by utilizing millimeter wave radar and binocular visual technology, respectively processing the point cloud data and the visual image data, and fusing the point cloud data by adopting a fusion strategy to obtain fused point cloud data, and simultaneously, identifying the fused point cloud data to acquire the motion track and behavior characteristic information of the living object in the fused point cloud data, so as to further determine the information of the living object, and combining clustering and fusion algorithm to process the data, so that the vital sign can be monitored in real time and accurately without direct contact with a patient, the defect of manual monitoring is effectively compensated, and more comprehensive and efficient health guarantee is provided for the patient.
assignees: UNIV PEKING 3RD HOSPITAL PEKING UNIV 3RD CLINICAL MEDICAL COLLEGE;BEIJING XINGYING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating forest-healing program
title_ko: 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법 및 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a forest healing program evaluation method and a forest healing program evaluation system capable of maximizing a forest healing effect. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the forest healing program evaluation method comprises the steps of: measuring multiple biological signals by a sensor attached to a patient in accordance with a forest healing program; analyzing measured values of the multiple biological signals to calculate a score for each function for each function related to a health state of the patient; comparing the score for each function with a prior score for each function in accordance with the multiple biological signals measured before execution of the forest healing program to select a first function with improved health state; and using the selected first function to provide an evaluation result for the forest healing program.
abstract_ko: 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법 및 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법은, 산림 치유 프로그램의 실시에 따라, 환자에 부착된 센서에 의해 다중 생체신호를 측정하는 단계와, 상기 다중 생체신호의 측정값을 분석하여, 상기 환자의 건강상태와 관련한 기능 별로 기능 별 점수를 산출하는 단계와, 상기 기능 별 점수를, 상기 산림 치유 프로그램의 실시 전에 측정된 다중 생체신호에 따른 기능 별 사전 점수와 비교하여, 건강상태가 호전된 제1 기능을 선별하는 단계, 및 상기 선별한 제1 기능을 이용하여, 상기 산림 치유 프로그램에 대한 평가 결과를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for calibrating bio-information estimation model and, apparatus for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 장치 및 방법과, 생체정보 추정 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a calibration device of a biometric information estimation model. According to one embodiment, the calibration device comprises: a sensor unit measuring a bio-signal from a subject; and a processor extracting a first characteristic and a second characteristic from each of a plurality of points of the bio-signal, and determining a calibration point of the biometric information estimation model from the plurality of points based on a degree of change of the first characteristic of each point compared to the first characteristic of the reference point and a degree of change of the second characteristic of each point compared to the second characteristic of the reference point.
abstract_ko: 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 장치가 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면, 캘리브레이션 장치는 피검체로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서부와, 생체신호의 복수 지점 각각에서 제1 특징 및 제2 특징을 추출하고, 기준 지점의 제1 특징 대비 각 지점의 제1 특징의 변화 정도 및 상기 기준 지점의 제2 특징 대비 각 지점의 제2 특징의 변화 정도를 기초로 복수 지점 중에서 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 지점을 결정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for providing health information based on bio-signal measured by non-contact manner
title_ko: 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for providing health information based on biometric signals obtained by measurement in a non-contact manner. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: collecting non-contact biometric signals through a non-contact biometric sensor spaced apart from a subject; using a previously trained conversion model to convert the collected non-contact biometric signals such that they correspond to contact biometric signals, thereby generating virtual biometric signals; and analyzing the health conditions based on the generated virtual biometric signals to provide health information on the subject. According to the present invention, health conditions can be diagnosed by converting the biometric signals obtained in a non-contact manner into virtual biometric signals that correspond to biometric signals obtained in a contact manner. Accordingly, without the development of a separate diagnostic technique (or a diagnostic method or a diagnostic algorithm) to analyze biometric signals in a non-contact manner, health conditions such as cardiovascular diseases can be easily diagnosed based on the biometrical signals obtained in the non-contact manner to provide health information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 상기 방법은 피검자와 이격되어 위치하는 비접촉 생체 센서를 통해, 비접촉 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 기 학습된 변환 모델을 이용하여, 상기 수집된 비접촉 생체 신호를 접촉 방식의 생체 신호에 상응하도록 변환하여 가상의 생체 신호를 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 생성된 가상의 생체 신호를 기반으로 건강 상태를 분석하여 상기 피검자에 대한 건강 정보를 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 이러한 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호를 접촉 방식으로 측정되는 생체 신호에 상응하는 가상의 생체 신호로 변환하여 건강 상태를 진단할 수 있다. 이로 인하여, 본 발명은 비접촉 방식의 생체 신호를 분석하기 위한 별도의 진단 기법(또는 진단 방법 또는 진단 알고리즘)을 개발하지 않고도, 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호를 기반으로 건강 상태(예: 심혈관 질환)를 용이하게 진단하여 건강 정보를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF YEUNGNAM UNIV

title_en: Detection device for vital signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device (1) for vital signs, comprising a sensor (2) and an energy supply module (3), wherein the sensor (2) has at least one detection means (5, 6, 7, 8), which is designed to detect a vital sign from the group consisting of the oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, and pulse, and furthermore comprises a first (10) communication module, wherein the energy supply module (3) has a second communication module (20) and an energy source (21), and wherein a wireless communication connection (4) exists between the first (10) and second communication module (20), wherein the sensor (2) is configured as an elastically restorably deformable thin-film sensor, and the communication connection (4) is configured for transmitting energy and measured values, or measurement data.

title_en: Vital sign detection system with random body movement cancellation
abstract_en: A vital sign detection system includes a radar device, a nonreciprocal network, a first antenna and a second antenna. An output signal from the radar device is delivered to the first antenna via the nonreciprocal network and then transmitted to a first side of a biological subject via the first antenna. A first reflection signal from the first side of the biological subject is received by the first antenna and then delivered to the second antenna via the nonreciprocal network and then transmitted to a second side of the biological subject via the second antenna. A second reflection signal from the second side of the biological subject is received by the second antenna and then delivered to the radar device via the nonreciprocal network for vital sign detection with random body movement cancellation.

title_en: Electronic device for measuring biometric signal and method for operating same
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 전자 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device comprising a sensor module, a communication circuit, and at least one processor is disclosed. The at least one processor may be configured to: determine the mounting state of the electronic device on the basis of sensor data received from the sensor module; select, on the basis of the mounting state, at least one antenna combination comprising at least one transmission antenna and at least one reception antenna among one or more antennas; acquire a radar signal related to a measurement target from the communication circuit through the at least one antenna combination; acquire a biometric signal from the acquired radar signal; evaluate the quality of the biometric signal; and adjust control parameters regarding an antenna combination selected from among the at least one antenna combination on the basis of the sensor data, the radar signal, and the quality of the biometric signal.
abstract_ko: 센서 모듈, 통신 회로, 및 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하는 전자 장치를 개시한다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 상기 센서 모듈로부터 수신된 센서 데이터를 기반으로 전자 장치의 거치 상태를 확인하고, 상기 거치 상태에 따라, 상기 하나 이상의 안테나들 중 적어도 하나의 송신 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신 안테나를 포함하는 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합을 선택하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합을 통해 상기 통신 회로로부터 측정 대상과 관련된 레이더 신호를 획득하고, 상기 획득된 레이더 신호로부터 생체 신호를 획득하고, 상기 생체 신호의 신호 품질을 평가하고, 상기 센서 데이터, 상기 레이더 신호, 및 상기 생체 신호의 신호 품질에 따라 상기 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합 중 선택된 안테나 조합에 대한 제어 파라미터들을 조정하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: One is applicable to through-wall radar multiaspect body of wall aligning formation method
abstract_en: The invention provides one and be applicable to through-wall radar multiaspect body of wall aligning formation method, utilize the existing conversion of the Radon for detection of straight line in image to carry out body of wall position probing, penetrate compensation of delay and imaging by each face wall rear region is carried out respectively to body of wall, realized the focal imaging of each imaging region and each face wall body. Further, before splicing subimage, first subimage is carried out the contrast of body of wall and background in the linear change process enhancer of gray scale image. The present invention has corrected body of wall position effectively, has improved image quality.

title_en: Ultra-wideband Doppler radar life detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband Doppler radar life detection system, and belongs to the technical field of radars. The device comprises a transmitting module, a receiving module and a data processing module; the transmitting module and the receiving module keep signal synchronization; the transmitting module is used for transmitting electromagnetic radio frequency signals, the electromagnetic radio frequency signals are modulated by the tested life electromagnetic information to form echo signals, the receiving module is used for completing pretreatment of the received signals, the data processing module is used for carrying out data analysis on the pretreated received signals, and a weak signal detection mode based on stochastic resonance is adopted for realizing spectrum analysis and extraction of the signals, so that detection and capture of the weak life electromagnetic information are realized. And a bistable stochastic resonance detection mode of subsampling and parameter compensation is adopted for the received weak physiological characteristic signals, and frequency spectrum migration and enhancement processing of signals to be detected are realized by utilizing the difference of gain characteristics of bistable stochastic resonance on different frequency components.

title_en: Through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on phase non-uniform quantization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on phase non-uniform quantization, which comprises the steps of firstly calculating the phase of radar imaging at grating lobe or side lobe positions; and then, aiming at radar receiving signals, calculating imaging results of all channels and radar original imaging results by using a back projection algorithm, and quantifying the phases of all channels by means of the phases of grating lobes or side lobe positions according to the operation results. And then calculating standard deviation of phase quantization results of different channels at the same pixel point position, thereby forming a weight image. And finally, weighting the radar original imaging result to obtain radar images after grating lobes and side lobe suppression. The effectiveness and the robustness to noise of the disclosed method are proved through a plurality of simulation and actual measurement embodiments. The method is not only suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging detection, but also can be applied to the fields of synthetic aperture radar imaging, microwave imaging and the like, and is a universal image grating lobe and sidelobe suppression method.

title_en: Radar sensor for remote vital signal detection using two frequency
title_ko: 두 개의 주파수를 사용하는 원격 생체 신호 측정 레이더센서
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 몸에 대한 투과도가 다른 서로 다른 두 개의 주파수를 사용하여 체내의 생체 정보를 얻는 원격 생체 신호 측정 레이더 센서에 관한 것으로서, 주파수 f1을 가지는 신호와 주파수 f2(f2>f1)을 가지는 신호를 생체에 동시에 입사시키는 송신단과, 상기 송신단에서 생체에 입사된 전파가 반사되어 오는 것을 입력받아 f1과 f2 주파수로 분리 후 증폭하는 수신단과, 상기 수신단에서 분리되어 출력되는 f1과 f2의 주파수를 가지는 두 신호를 서로 곱하는 1차 주파수 혼합기와, 상기 1차 주파수 혼합기를 통해 서로 곱해진 신호 중 f2-f1 주파수를 가지는 신호만을 골라서 통과시키는 대역통과필터와, 상기 대역통과필터를 통과한 신호에 f2-f1의 주파수를 가지는 정현파를 곱하는 2차 주파수 혼합기와, 상기 2차 주파수 혼합기를 통과한 신호를 필터링하는 저대역통과필터와, 상기 저대역통과필터를 거쳐서 필터링된 신호를 디지털 처리하는 디지털 신호처리부를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     레이더 센서, 도플러, 주파수 혼합기, 대역통과필터, 생체신호

title_en: Mobile terminal and method for processing the car accident usgin mobile terminal
title_ko: 이동 단말기 및 이를 이용한 차량의 사고 발생 처리 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a mobile terminal and a method for processing an accident of a vehicle by using the same. According to the present invention, a main body, formed to be worn on a certain portion of a body of a user, is connected to an e-call system of the vehicle and receives information related to a state of the vehicle; if a state that the main body is worn is sensed, a biosignal of the user, a wearer, is detected by using at least one sensor arranged on the main body. Afterwards, state information of the wearer is sequentially obtained by analyzing the detected biosignal to correspond to a state that an accident occurrence event of the vehicle is sensed based on the received information; and then, if a predetermined condition is satisfied, state information of the wearer and information, related to a state of the vehicle, are transmitted to a predetermined call center in cooperation with the e-call system.
abstract_ko: 이동 단말기 및 이를 이용한 차량의 사고 발생 처리 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은, 신체의 특정부위에 착용가능하도록 이루어진 본체가 차량의 이콜(e-Call) 시스템과 연결되어, 차량의 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신한다. 그리고, 본체의 착용이 감지되면, 본체에 구비된 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 착용자의 생체신호를 검출한다. 그리고, 수신된 정보에 기초하여 차량의 사고 발생 이벤트가 감지된 것에 응답하여, 상기 검출된 생체신호를 분석하여 착용자의 상태 정보를 단계적으로 획득한다. 그런 다음, 기설정된 조건을 만족하면, 이콜(e-Call) 시스템과 연동하여, 착용자의 상태 정보와 차량의 상태와 관련된 정보를 기설정된 콜센터로 전송한다.

title_en: Safety management work clothes based on biological signals
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 작업복(110)과; 상기 작업복의 내부면에 부착되되 생체신호용 센서 및 모듈의 인체 접지 최소화를 위해 신축성 있는 합성수지 원단으로 제조된 밴드(120)와; 상기 밴드에 부착되는 생체신호용 센서(130)와; 상기 생체신호용 센서로부터 신호를 전달받아 처리하는 모듈(140)과; 배터리(150)와; 상기 생체신호용 센서와 모듈 또는 모듈과 배터리 간에 신호를 전달할 수 있는 디지털실(160); 로 이루어지는 것으로, 본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복은 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Device and method for non-contact detection of galvanic skin response based on imaging
title_ko: 영상 기반 갈바닉 피부 반응 비접촉 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 생체 신호를 검출하는 기술에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 갈바닉 피부 반응(GSR, Galvanic Skin Response)을 비접촉식 적외선 영상에서 피부의 밝기 값으로  추출하는 영상 기반 갈바닉 피부 반응 비접촉 감지 장치 및 방법에 대한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따르면, 적외선 피부 영상의 밝기 값과 갈바닉 피부 반응 값의 상관 관계를 이용해 비 접촉식으로 생체 신호를 대체 감지할 수 있다.

title_en: Contactless type apparatus for measuring biological signal and Method thereof
title_ko: 비접촉식 생체신호 측정기 및 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact biosignal measuring device and a measuring method, and more specifically to the measuring device and measuring method capable of determining a location and movement of a subject to be measured using a radar sensor after detecting the movement of the subject to be measured or shaking of the subject to be measured using a 3-axis acceleration sensor, and measuring a respiratory rate or heart rate per unit time by extracting only biological signals. The biosignal measuring device of the present invention includes a 3-axis acceleration sensor; a radar sensor; a micro controller unit (MCU); and a display.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉식 생체신호 측정기 및 측정방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 3축 가속도 센서를 이용하여 측정자의 움직임 또는 측정기의 흔들림 여부를 파악한 후, 레이더 센서를 이용하여 측정 대상자의 위치와 움직임 여부를 파악하고, 생체신호만을 추출하여 단위 시간당 호흡수 또는 심박수를 측정하는 측정기 및 측정방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization, including radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, for modulating the electromagnetic signal for generating low-frequency ultra-wideband, and receives and demodulate target echo signal；MIMO imaging antenna array element, including be made of multiple transmission antenna units transmitting antenna array, for outside electromagnetic radiation signal；And the receiving antenna array being made of multiple receiving antenna units, it is used for receives echo-signal；Radio-frequency receiving-transmitting switch matrix unit, between radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement and MIMO imaging antenna array element, for realizing the switching for the unlike signal interchannel that transmitting signal and echo-signal are constituted in different antennae unit；Data acquisition and signal processing unit generate transmitting signal for controlling radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, and for receiving target echo signal, carry out analysis imaging and target detection identification.The life detection radar of the three-dimensional localization of the utility model has many advantages, such as that positioning accuracy is high, penetration capacity is strong and high sensitivity.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide deep position displacement monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide deep position displacement monitoring system which comprises a pull wire, a displacement measurement device arranged on the ground and a measurement pipe arranged underground. One end of the pull wire is connected with the displacement measurement device, the other end of the pull wire is fixedly arranged in the measurement pipe, the measurement pipe is arranged to be inclined to a horizontal plane and penetrates through a sliding face of a landslide to enable the bottom of the measurement pipe to be fixed to a sliding bed, and the measurement pipe is a flexible pipe capable of being deformed along with the sliding of a sliding body. The measurement pipe is the flexible pipe inclined to the horizontal plane, the bottom of the measurement pipe stretches into the sliding bed, the pull wire in the measurement pipe can respond to displacement changes under the condition of small sliding displacement, displacement enough for detection is generated, and displacement monitoring accuracy is guaranteed. The landslide deep position displacement monitoring system is simple in structure and convenient to use, a drilling dip angle sensor and other micro-displacement measurement devices do not need to be buried, the micro displacement of the landslide can be monitored by only mounting the displacement measurement device on the ground surface, the instrument environment is good, damage is not prone to happening, maintenance is facilitated, operation cost is greatly lowered, and high popularization and application value is achieved.
assignees: CHONGQING GAOXIN ENGINEERING SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;WANG SEN

title_en: A kind of rescue system and its rescue mode at earthquake relief work scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rescue system at earthquake relief work scene, including user equipment, signal transferring system and disaster area rear decision-making and directing system, the information of the user equipment is sent to disaster area rear decision-making and directing system by signal transferring system, user's vital sign data is detected and obtained with sensor, user data to high in the clouds is sent with network or radio, wherein the RI radio intelligence of user is forwarded to high in the clouds with radio transferring equipment, user data is analyzed beyond the clouds, when earthquake disaster occurs, the formulation rescue plan of the data science sent out according to user, and quick accurate rescue is carried out according to specific user's rescue information.Simple structure of the present invention, it is simple to operate；Real-time Transmission, cost of implementation is low, and using effect is good, is easy to promote the use of, and user number is more, and it is just more accurate that the condition of a disaster judges.

title_en: A kind of directing self-extinguishing module
