abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of directing self-extinguishing module, including vision sensor, foamite container, extinguishing chemical jet module, head, extinguishing chemical flexible pipe and processor, vision sensor is integrated in same head with extinguishing chemical jet module, vision sensor includes visible image capturing module and infrared thermal imaging module, it is seen that light photographing module and the camera lens of infrared thermal imaging module is identical with the nozzle direction of extinguishing chemical jet module and centerline parallel.The features such as fire suppression module of the present invention has high working efficiency, fire extinguishing accuracy rate is high, the fire suppression module of the present invention is equipped on mobile robot or other platforms, it is possible to increase the fire disaster emergency processing rapidity and accuracy in buried cable tunnel.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: A kind of robot for the detection of colliery tunnel safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of robot for the detection of colliery tunnel safety, safety detection device and safety device for life-saving including crawler type walking mechanism and for colliery tunnel, be provided with the crawler type walking mechanism for install safety detection device and safety device for life-saving from steady head；The safety detection device includes the sensor cluster for being sealingly disposed in rear in crawler type walking mechanism, and the sensor cluster includes infrared thermography and gas detector；The safety device for life-saving includes the life-detection instrument of sealed set and is operated in the wireless tranceiver communication system of ultrashort wave frequency band.The operating efficiency that the robot detected provided by the present invention for colliery tunnel safety improves gas in the tunnel of colliery, the potential safety hazard of electric wiring is investigated, when solving colliery tunnel generation cave-in accident, it is excessive because searching and rescuing scope to being buried survivor's search-and-rescue work, search and rescue team member and search and rescue that direction is indefinite to cause to search and rescue the problem of being wasted time.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system for moving target
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system for a moving target, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting chirp signals with different slope frequencies based on an MIMO technology to obtain a plurality of groups of signal data with different distance resolutions; acquiring target distance information and extracting a target phase signal; and decomposing the target phase signal to obtain a heartbeat signal and a respiration signal of the target based on a modal decomposition algorithm, and estimating the heart rate and the respiration rate of the target. The invention uses the non-contact millimeter wave radar for detection, realizes the detection of the respiration rate and the heart rate of the moving target, and brings pleasant experience to users while ensuring privacy compared with wearable and contact devices; compared with other traditional non-contact vital sign monitoring methods, the method does not need the monitored person to sit on a chair or lie on a bed to enable the chest to face the radar equipment, supports the target to normally move in the monitoring area, and realizes the monitoring of the vital signs.
assignees: WUHAN BEACON FIRE KEANDROID SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY;UNIV SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Three-dimensional positioning life detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radars and discloses a three-dimensional positioning life detection radar system which comprises a phased array antenna unit, a signal receiving unit, a Doppler frequency shift analysis module, a target motion analysis module, a three-dimensional reconstruction module and a deep learning module, wherein the phased array antenna unit is used for transmitting radar waves and dynamically adjusting the beam direction according to the position of a target, the signal receiving unit is used for receiving radar signals reflected by the target, the Doppler frequency shift analysis module is used for analyzing the frequency change of the received radar signals and extracting micro-motion signals of the target, the target motion analysis module is used for tracking the motion of the target through a Kalman filtering technology, the three-dimensional reconstruction module is used for reconstructing the three-dimensional position of the target through an electromagnetic field integral equation and multi-source sensor information fusion according to the received signals, and the deep learning module is used for identifying the micro-motion signals and optimizing target classification. By adopting the phased array antenna unit and the beam forming technology, the technical effects of accurately three-dimensionally scanning the target and quickly adjusting the dynamic beam are achieved.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a distance frequency domain signal based on a radar echo signal; the method comprises the steps of carrying out frequency spectrum analysis on distance frequency domain signals, positioning the position of an object to be detected, extracting phase information at the position, filtering through a band-pass filter to obtain a respiratory frequency band interval signal and an initial heartbeat frequency band interval signal, carrying out real-time respiratory rate estimation on the basis of the respiratory frequency band interval signal to obtain respiratory frequency, eliminating respiratory harmonics in the initial heartbeat frequency band interval signal by using an adaptive trap based on the respiratory frequency to obtain a heartbeat frequency band interval signal, decomposing the heartbeat frequency band interval signal by using a variation modal decomposition algorithm with minimum fuzzy entropy as an optimization target to obtain a heartbeat signal, and carrying out real-time heart rate estimation on the basis of the heartbeat signal to obtain a real-time heart rate. The method, the device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium provided by the invention can improve the accuracy of heart rate measurement.
assignees: SUZHOU LEIJIADA HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: GPR target detection method integrating proxy model and dimension reduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a GPR (general purpose computing) target detection method integrating a proxy model and dimension reduction, which comprises the steps of adopting a B spline to draw the outline of a target body and define the minimum dimension, adopting the number of points, relative dielectric constant and conductivity of the B spline as model parameters, simulating target scattering echo data by using FDTD-based method simulation software GprMax, adopting a forward modeling part to perform dimension reduction processing on the GPR data to obtain a corresponding main component weight coefficient and serve as the output of the proxy model, constructing a network circulation proxy model based on a radial basis RBF, replacing complex target function calculation by constructing an approximate model, accelerating population convergence and improving optimization efficiency, realizing rapid forward modeling of the GPR scattering echo data, integrating a proxy model strategy by a particle swarm algorithm, solving nonlinear microwave backscattering problem and realizing precise inversion of the shape and position of a buried target.

title_en: Distributed sensing using ultra-wide-band radio
abstract_en: To disclose a distributed ultra-wide-band (UWB) radar system, and an operating method thereof.SOLUTION: A distributed radar system uses a plurality of separate UWB radios or nodes without using a centralized clock or timing source. However, a distributed UWB system operates to provide radar-like functionality and high-resolution sensing capability through synchronization based on line-of-sight (LOS) signal processing and noise estimation. Synchronized channel impulse response (CIR) can be processed for general object detection and tracking, gesture recognition, or micro motion such as vital sign monitoring.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mask device and a method for controlling the same. According to the present invention, the mask device includes: a mask body coming into close contact with a user′s face and having an inner surface covering the user′s nose and mouth and an outer surface exposed to an outer space; an air cleaner connected to the mask body, and having a suction port for the outside air to flow in and an air flow hole allowing the air flown in through the suction port to flow to the inner surface of the mask body; and a respiration sensor disposed on a flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body and detecting the amount of respiration flowing through the air cleaner. According to the present invention, the air flow can be adjusted in accordance with the state of respiration of the user using the respiration sensor disposed on the flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body. In addition, a customer′s respiration can become comfortable, as compared with a static pressure method, by the fan operation based on automatic respiration detection.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치된 호흡 센서를 통해 사용자의 호흡 상태에 맞게 공기의 유동을 조절할 수 있으며,자동식 호흡 감지 기반 FAN 동작으로써 정압식 방식에 비해 고객의 호흡을 편안하게 해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: A non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and system based on a millimeter-wave radar, and a computer-readable storage medium. The method comprises: receiving echo signals in a radar detection space, and on the basis of the echo signals, selecting static detected persons from the radar detection space to serve as target objects (S10, S110); on the basis of echo signals of the target objects, calculating spatial position information of the target objects in the radar detection space (S20, S120); on the basis of the spatial position information, determining the number of target objects equidistant from the radar (S30, S130); if there are at least two target objects equidistant from the radar in the radar detection space, calculating phase information on the basis of azimuth angle information and elevation angle information of the target objects (S40, S150); and calculating vital sign data of the target objects on the basis of the phase information (S50, S160).

title_en: Device, system and method for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: In order to provide means for measuring vital signs such as heart rate, breathing rate, pulse forms, that allow accurate and unobtrusive signal acquisition and that are automatically adjusted to varying positions of an area of interest within a predetermined area, a device, a system and a method for measuring vital signs are provided, wherein electromagnetic signals such as microwave or radar are emitted and reflected electromagnetic signals are sensed with directional sensitivity by a transceiving unit and wherein a direction of interest is determined based on the sensed reflected signals and a primary direction of sensitivity (300) of the transceiving unit is adjusted to the direction of interest by a control unit. Thus, vital signs can be monitored in an unobtrusive and simple way.
assignees: KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV;PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Detection apparatus of vital parameters on steering wheel
abstract_en: A detection apparatus of vital parameters on a steering wheel is provided. The apparatus includes a horn switch, remote control switches configured to operate devices within a vehicle and a vital signal detector configured to detect a vital signal of an operator. The vital signal detector includes a detection sensor that is configured to detect the vital signal of the operator and a photo sensor that is mounted on the remote control switch. Accordingly, the separate space for the assembling portion of the vital signal detector is not required and the volume of the apparatus and the number of components are reduced. The mountability and the aesthetics are improved.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;DAESUNG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Vital Signs Monitoring System
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Sensor for detecting the passing of a pulse wave from a subject´s arterial system
abstract_en: In order to provide an easy-to-use technique for measuring blood pressure and/or other vital signs of a subject, a sensor for detecting the passing of a pulse wave from a subject's arterial system is suggested, the sensor being adapted to be located at a sensing position on the exterior of the subject's body, characterized in that the sensor comprises a number of electrical coils for generating an inductive coupling to the subject's body in a way that the properties of said inductive coupling change if a pulse wave passes a screened volume underneath the sensing position, and a circuit connected to the number of electrical coils, said circuit being adapted to detect said property changes of the inductive coupling.
assignees: PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV

title_en: Buried object detector
abstract_en: A sensor device designed to detect buried objects by measuring the anisotropy of the electromagnetic properties of ground. This anisotropy is distinguished from the main reflection by modulating the signal using either a mechanically rotated antenna or an electronically switched antenna array after the in-phase and quadrature components are isolated from the main reflection using an electronic filter.

title_en: Multi-target vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A multi-target vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar includes the steps of sending linear frequency modulation electromagnetic wave signals through the millimeter wave radar, constructing a three-dimensional data matrix according to reflected signals, carrying out Fourier transformation and data processing on different dimensions of the data matrix, obtaining distance, speed and angle information of targets, manufacturing a three-dimensional point cloud data set, clustering the generated point cloud data to obtain related information of a plurality of targets, generating a two-dimensional movement state scatter diagram based on clustered information, inputting the scatter diagram into a movement state classifier network model to identify movement states, extracting signals of targets in a movement interval period, and monitoring respiration rate and heartbeat rate of the targets. The invention has the characteristics of good privacy protection, low time delay, non-contact performance and the like, and can realize the monitoring of multi-target vital signs.

title_en: System for sensing collapse of the slope
title_ko: 비탈면 붕괴 사전 감지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting collapse of slope in advance, more particularly, to a system for detecting collapse of slope in advance to prevent disaster due to the collapse of slope by detecting the collapse of natural slope. For the purpose, the present invention includes: inclination sensors which are installed in a plurality of piles buried in a slope to detect the inclination of the slope; infrared sensors which are installed in at least one of the piles to detect the displacement of the slope by receiving infrared light after irradiating the infrared light to an adjacent pile; a control unit which is installed in one side of the slope to receive and store detected information from the inclination sensors and infrared sensors, and to deliver the detected information to an administrator server; and the administrator server for storing the detected information received from each control unit installed in slopes of many locations, determining whether the stored detected information is out of the preset reference value, and notifying the result to an administrator if the detected information is out of the reference range.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비탈면 붕괴 사전 감지시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 자연사면의 붕괴를 감지하여 사면붕괴로 인한 재해를 예방하도록 한 비탈면 붕괴 사전 감지시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은 사면에 매설되는 복수 개의 파일에 각각 설치되어 사면의 기울기를 감지하는 기울기센서; 상기 복수 개의 파일 중 어느 하나 이상에 설치되어 인접된 파일에 적외선 조사 후 수광여부로 사면의 변위를 감지하는 적외선센서; 사면의 일측에 설치되어 상기 기울기센서와 적외선센서로부터 감지정보를 전달받아 저장하고, 관리자서버에 그 감지정보를 전달하는 제어부; 여러 장소의 사면에 설치되는 각각의 제어부로부터 전달받은 감지정보를 저장하고, 그 저장된 감지정보가 설정된 기준값을 초과하는지를 판별한 후 기준값을 초과하는 경우 해당 사면의 관리자에게 이를 알려주는 관리자서버;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground penetrating radar analogue test device, the device sets up in the cross section is for falling trapezoidal ground recess, and the characteristic target is buried the both sides of ground recess, the device includes: the cross section of the vehicle body is in an inverted trapezoid shape, first mounting positions are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the vehicle body and used for mounting a ground penetrating radar, second mounting positions are arranged on the left side and the right side of the vehicle body and used for mounting the ground penetrating radar, and the ground penetrating radars on the first mounting positions and the second mounting positions face the left side and the right side of the vehicle body; side wheels arranged on the left side and the right side of the vehicle body; a drive device; a controller electrically connected to the drive device; and a computer. The utility model has the advantages that the device has a plurality of ground penetrating radar mounting positions on the head part, the tail part and two sides; and a lateral detection simulation mode is adopted, so that a feasible way is provided for realizing convenient replacement of the tested buried target and simulation test of the large-depth target.
assignees: SHANGHAI YUNYI ELECTROMAGNETIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forward direction mixing match tracing method and system towards multipolarization through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of forward direction mixing match tracing method and system towards multipolarization through-wall radar imaging, the method includes: obtain the radar return under multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL；Multiple radar returns are carried out vectorization process, calculates base signal matrix according to multiple radar returns of vectorization, and degree of rarefication K is set；Utilizing orthogonal matching pursuit method to solve the local solution of multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL, merge all local solutions, find out the position corresponding to K maximum in fusion results, initialize Ji Xinhaoji, the signal calculating multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL is remaining；It is iterated calculating to the local solution of multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL, whether stops iteration according to default iteration stopping conditional judgment；Calculate according to the iteration result meeting iteration stopping condition and merge and obtain being ultimately imaged result.Present invention have the advantage that in forward direction mixing matching pursuit algorithm, selected base signal is evaluated and selects the base signal of optimum, image quality is better than other greedy algorithms.

title_en: A kind of life detection radar breathing of FMCW broadbands and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of breathing of FMCW broadbands life detection radar and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm, and compared with prior art, the present invention has following beneficial effect：Breathing and the heartbeat signal of many people can simultaneously be obtained,By using Coiflets small echos,Compared to traditional frequency domain filtering,The small echo can well keep reconstructing border and the energy of breath signal,Treatment especially to short time signal is particularly evident,Using the higher hamonic wave for filtering based on double coefficient LMS adaptive filter algorithms breath signal,And the adaptive filter algorithm does not need extra reference signal,Due to employing the step-size in search factor successively decreased in algorithm,Heartbeat signal can preferably be retained while breath signal harmonic wave is filtered,By selecting the suitable initial step length factor,Heartbeat signal can be rapidly converged to based on double coefficient LMS adaptive filter methods,And less steady output rate is kept in longer time,So that be finally recovered heartbeat signal frequency content is more accurate in a long time.

title_en: A kind of underground mine disaster sign of life detection and alignment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of detection of underground mine disaster sign of life and alignment system, including Transmission Fibers, positioned at generating laser L face to face, optical splitter P, circulator C, phase detectors D, data collecting card Q, signal transacting main frame N, and the optical fiber acoustic detection probe A positioned at mine passage, when mine disaster occurs, by the sign of life for calling for help voice signal acquisition trapped personnel caused by the activity such as sound and walking for gathering and monitoring the personnel for being confined in underground.Meanwhile optical fiber sound wave sensing probe A equidistantly distributes according to certain, it can realize and the position for being stranded personnel in the pit is positioned by information such as the different optical fiber sound wave sensing probe A intensities of sound collected.The positional information of trapped personnel is provided for rescue personnel.The present invention use transmission line of the optical fiber as signal, due to light weight, it is corrosion-resistant the advantages that, be hardly damaged when mine disaster occurs, it is ensured that the validity in signals transmission.

title_en: Detection city landslide causes Gas Pipe to bury the packaged type device for squeezing off leakage
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of detection city landslide and Gas Pipe is caused to bury the packaged type device for squeezing off leakage, belongs to Urban Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and hazards control field.The device collects the infrasound signal for burying gas pipeline fracture leak to detect the degree of injury of gas pipeline by infrasound sensor measuring system.The leakage degree of injury for the city gas pipeline buried by burst landslide can be precisely detected using apparatus of the present invention; buried pipes combustible gas leakage information can be detected with real-time early warning; mobile system is welded on the bottom end of full guard support cover by apparatus of the present invention simultaneously; pass through several rotating pulleys set up and annular scraper; it can ensure that the packaged type in the planarization and arbitrary region of apparatus of the present invention detecting location flexibly detects; ensure several probe energy close contact Rock And Soils set up, ensures the accuracy of detection.

title_en: Radar-based vital sign estimation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to radar-based vital sign estimation. In one embodiment, a method comprises: receiving radar signals by using a millimeter wave radar; generating range data based on the received radar signal; detecting a target based on the range data; performing an ellipse fitting on in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals associated with a detected object to generate compensated I and Q signals associated with the detected object; classifying the compensated I and Q signals; when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals corresponds to the first class, determining a displacement signal based on the compensated I and Q signals and determining a vital sign based on the displacement signal; and discarding the compensated I and Q signals when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals corresponds to the second class.

title_en: Robot-based autonomous interaction millimeter wave radar respiration heart rate detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot-based autonomous interaction millimeter wave radar respiration heart rate detection system, which comprises: the device comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a robot control module, a man-machine interaction module, an AI system module, a memory module and an equipment main control module, wherein the robot control module is configured to control the millimeter wave radar and collect millimeter wave radar application data, and the millimeter wave radar module is configured to process original echo data received by the radio frequency transceiver unit, so that vital sign information of a living body is formed, and the vital sign information of the living body is analyzed and predicted. The advantage of endowment service robot millimeter wave radar detection breathing rhythm of the heart inspection in the set not only this application still compensaties prior art's service robot and lacks the function of autonomic service interaction service detection rhythm of the heart. The method is convenient, simple and rapid, is non-contact, finds the state of an illness and prevents the state of the illness in advance, and makes a pre-diagnosis conclusion.
assignees: FUNING PIPAYU TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method for measuring walking safety sense of streets at night in city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the walking safety of streets at night in cities, which comprises the following steps: selecting a measure street; organizing a testee to perceive walking on the spot on the street at night; the testee carries a wearable dynamic vital sign monitor and a GPS positioning system; deriving a skin conductance response SCR value of the tested person during walking at night by wearing the dynamic vital sign monitor; calculating the peak value incidence rate of the SCR wake-up period of the testee, and then carrying out nonparametric inspection to judge whether the sensing data is effective or not; after the test is passed, calculating the SCR awakening peak value incidence rate of the unit period of the tested person; fusing GPS signals synchronously acquired by walking of a testee to generate an awakening hot spot map; performing emotion valence on the awakening hotspot to form a night fear hotspot map of the testee; and finally, performing nuclear density analysis on the hot spot map to obtain a night fear feeling thermal force distribution result, and realizing real-time measurement of the night safety feeling of the urban street.

title_en: Remote monitoring method for converter station based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote monitoring method for a converter station based on image recognition. The invention comprises the following steps: setting a camera to shoot images of all physical assets in the converter station, and marking the position information of the physical assets; extracting images shot by a camera from a database to a data center for image recognition of the real assets needing to be checked; setting vital signs of millimeter wave radar detection personnel; carrying out image identification to judge whether smoke appears; if smoke exists, judging whether the smoke has vital signs of personnel by using a millimeter wave radar; and constructing an electronic fence for the set working area of the converter station, then carrying out image recognition, and recognizing personnel and vehicles entering and exiting the set working area. The invention can remotely check the real assets in the converter station and improve the checking efficiency and timeliness.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Target tracking method and related device based on low-frequency ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target tracking method and a related device based on a low-frequency ultra-wideband through-wall radar, which mainly solve the problems of high dependence on a complex multi-antenna imaging system and low algorithm instantaneity of the existing through-wall target tracking technology. The implementation scheme is as follows: firstly, removing wall clutter direct current components in an original time-distance graph by using an RPCA algorithm; then constructing an echo data matrix, detecting a target in the RD spectrum by using a region maximum detection method, and extracting distance and speed information; then estimating the target distance by using a two-way receiving channel, and positioning the target by combining the geometric relation of the antenna base line; and finally, tracking by using a Kalman filter. The invention realizes real-time tracking of human body targets behind the wall through the one-shot two-shot low-cost and low-complexity wall-penetrating radar, and the verification result shows that the RPCA algorithm can be used for removing wall clutter components in a wall-penetrating scene, the tracking track is matched with the actual track, the target positioning error is smaller, the performance is better, and the method can be used for anti-terrorism and disaster rescue.

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar hidden target imaging method based on multipath virtual image positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO through-wall radar hidden target imaging method based on multipath virtual image positioning, which mainly solves the problem that the existing MIMO through-wall radar images a hidden target in a building, and the positioning effect of a real target is poor due to too many multipath virtual images. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring MIMO array echo data, calculating a one-dimensional range profile of an imaging area, and estimating wall parameters according to the range profile; compensating the refraction error of the wall body by adopting a refraction point approximation method, and establishing an improved BP algorithm of the through-wall scene; constructing a MIMO radar multipath virtual image positioning model, selecting a virtual image ectopic sub-aperture, and imaging sub-aperture echo data by using an improved BP algorithm; and carrying out gamma correction-based sub-image fusion on the sub-aperture images to obtain the built-in hidden target radar image after multipath virtual image suppression. The invention can effectively inhibit multipath virtual images generated by wall reflection, improves the imaging effect of hidden targets in buildings, and can be used for rescue activities, public safety and military investigation.

title_en: Through-wall human body posture estimation method based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of MIMO radar and neural network, and discloses a through-wall human body posture estimation method based on the MIMO radar, which adopts a MIMO radar system to capture the signals, processes the obtained signals by analyzing the original radar signals generated by human body reflection in a scene and utilizing Fourier transformation to extract Doppler information, combining the original signals and Doppler signals, a horizontal feature matrix and a vertical feature matrix of the human body posture are constructed, and the feature matrices are then input into a transducer network for training and learning to realize human body posture estimation. The invention can improve the generalization capability of the system under the conditions of light-weight data and light-weight network, and has the characteristics of strong robustness, high stability, real-time performance and high efficiency.

title_en: Bed with bio-signal measurement function and bio-signal monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 기능을 갖는 침대 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bed having a bio-signal measurement function and a bio-signal monitoring system using the same. The bed having the bio-signal measurement function according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit sensing a bio-signal of a user sleeping on a mattress of the bed; a signal analyzing unit analyzing the bio-signal sensed by the sensor unit and generating change trend information of the bio-signal; and an alarm warning unit alerting a user terminal of a danger related to a user's sleeping status by using the change trend information generated by the signal analyzing unit. Provided are the bed having the bio-signal measurement function capable of informing the danger, the bio-signal monitoring system using the same, and a method thereof.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 기능을 갖는 침대는 침대의 매트리스에서 수면을 취하는 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 생체 신호의 변화 추이 정보를 생성하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의해 생성된 상기 변화 추이 정보를 이용하여 사용자 단말기에 상기 사용자의 수면 상태와 관련한 위험성을 알람으로 경보하는 알람 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: Biometric system using both hands for evaluation of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function
title_ko: 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biometric system using both hands for the evaluation of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function, the system being capable of measuring an electrocardiogram, oxygen saturation, blood pressure, body impedance and performing tests on body fat percentage, non-invasive blood pressure (NIBP), vascular compliance, cardiac output and pulmonary function, in order to perform multi-dimensional analysis on the bio parameters rather than using a single parameter, and using just two hands, thus reducing cost and time restrictions and allowing continuous monitoring of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function. A biometric system of the present invention is configured in that a blood pressure measuring cuff is placed around the wrist of a user, and a left end and a right end of the system can be held by the hand of the user, respectively, the left right ends having respective hand contact portions in which the respective bio signal detection electrodes are embedded, the system comprising: an electrocardiogram and body impedance measurement module serving as a means for measuring an electrocardiogram, body impedance, cardiac output and impedance pulmonary function and having an electrocardiogram sensor unit and a body impedance sensor unit for detecting an electrocardiogram signal and a body impedance signal in order to thus measure an electrocardiogram parameter including RR interval, FEV1/FVC ratio, cardiac output, body fat and vascular compliance; an oxygen saturation detection module having an oxygen saturation sensor unit for detecting oxygen saturation; a blood pressure measurement module having an NIBP sensor unit and a pressure sensor unit for detecting a blood pressure signal from the NIBP sensor unit and a Korotkoff sound signal from the pressure sensor unit in order to detect blood pressure from the blood pressure signal by means of an oscillometric method and detect blood pressure based on the Korotkoff sound from the Korotkoff sound signal; and a main module for controlling operations of the electrocardiogram and body impedance measurement module, the oxygen saturation detection module and the blood pressure measurement module, collecting statistics on the bio measurement signals of a user and outputting the result on a display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 양손만을 이용하여, 단일 파라미터가 아닌, 심전도, 산소포화도, 혈압, 체임피던스를 측정하고, 체지방율, 비관혈식 혈압(NIBP), 혈관탄성도, 심박출량, 폐기능 검사의 다차원의 생체 파라미터의 분석을 행하여, 비용과 시간의 제약이 적게 들며, 지속적인 혈관 및 심폐기능 모니터링이 가능한, 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 손목에 혈압측정용 커프를 장착하고, 좌측단과 우측단을 손으로 잡도록 이루어지되, 좌측단과 우측단의 손접촉부에는 생체신호 검출전극이 장착되어 있는 생체 계측 시스템에 있어서, 심전도, 체임피던스, 심박출량, 임피던스 폐기능검사를 측정하는 수단으로, 심전도 센서부과 체임피던스 센서부을 구비하여, 심전도신호와 체임피던스 신호를 검출하여, RR간격을 포함하는 심전도 파라미터, FEV1/FVC 비율, 심박출량, 체지방량, 혈관탄성도을 측정하는 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈; 산소포화도 센서부를 구비하여 산소포화도를 검출하는 산소포화도 검출모듈; NIBP 센서부 및 압력센서부를 구비하여, NIBP센서부로부터의 혈압신호 및 압력센서부로부터의 코르트코프음신호를 검출하여, 혈압 신호로부터 오실로메트릭법에 따른 혈압을 검출하고, 코르트코프음신호로부터 코로토코프음에 따른 혈압을 검출하는 혈압측정모듈; 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈, 산소포화도 검출모듈, 혈압측정모듈의 구동을 제어하고, 사용자의 생체측정신호를 통계처리하여 결과를 디스플레이부로 출력하는 메인 모듈를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: CNN-Based Remote Locating and Tracking of Individuals Through Walls
abstract_en: A system and method is provided to quantize a plurality of search bins within a structure with a label corresponding to whether an UWB radar sensor has detected an individual within the search bin to produce a labeled image of plurality of search bins. A convolutional neural network classifies the labeled image regarding how many individuals are shown in the labeled image.

title_en: A kind of focusing time delay computational methods for the non-homogeneous wall of known multilayer
abstract_en: A kind of focusing time delay computational methods for the non-homogeneous wall of known multilayer of the disclosure of the invention, belong to through-wall radar target imaging technical field, are related specifically to the non-homogeneous wall compensation of through-wall radar multilayer.The echo information of Range Profile, i.e. target is obtained first；Secondly wall is subdivided into enough substratums, so each substratum can be regarded as uniformly, the propagation delay expression formula that electromagnetic wave reaches reception antenna from transmitting antenna being write out according to the law of refraction；Incidence angle is then calculated according to geometrical relationship, you can obtain focusing time delay；Last BP imagings.In summary, the wall that this method can change for dielectric constant on thickness of wall body direction is accurately compensated, and is accurately calculated electromagnetic wave and is penetrated delay produced by wall.

title_en: System for detecting a person's course of motion and/or vital sign parameters
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for detecting a person's course of motion. The method comprises detecting a plurality of images of a person during movement by a non-contact sensor, wherein the plurality of images depict movement of a body element of the person, creating at least one skeletal model with limb positions for at least some of the plurality of images, and calculating a movement process from movement of the body element of the person by comparing changes in limb positions in the at least one created skeletal model. At the same time vital sign parameters and/or signal processing parameters about the person may be detected and analyzed.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning calling integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses mountain torrent disaster early warning and calling integrated equipment, which comprises a monitoring station point arranged beside a river course, wherein the monitoring station point comprises a mounting frame which is pre-buried and arranged beside the river course, a rain gauge arranged on the mounting frame and a plurality of ultrasonic velocimeters for measuring water flow rate, the side surface of the rain gauge is fixedly connected with an ultrasonic water level gauge for measuring water level height, the side surface of the ultrasonic water level gauge is fixedly connected with a monitoring device, and the top of the ultrasonic water level gauge is fixedly connected with a water drop sensor. This mountain torrent calamity early warning calls integration equipment through set up the edulcoration cover at the rain gauge top, and its partly comprises fixed rack, and partly comprises a plurality of rotatable edulcoration poles to a plurality of edulcoration poles can link to rotate, can directly outwards release impurity such as the leaf that falls on the edulcoration cover in the rotation in-process, has realized automatic clearance, can avoid the leaf to cover the problem that influences the collection rain and cause the jam.

title_en: Closed Compact Panel with Voltage Detector
title_ko: 전압 감지 기능을 갖춘 격벽 격실 축소형 고?저압 폐쇄배전반
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A compact type enclosed switchgear with a voltage detector is provided to prevent the generation of visual corona and partial discharging in the state of use by choosing a high voltage through wall busing and a low voltage through wall busing on the switchgear. CONSTITUTION: High voltage switchgear(110) includes a high voltage through wall busing(111). The high voltage through wall busing includes a voltage detecting sensor. A voltage indicator displays the voltage of electricity flowing through a high voltage supply cable. A voltage display controller(113) controls the voltage. A transformer for instrument supplies a primary high voltage and low voltage to a multifunctional digital protective relay(118). A vacuum interrupter is a main circuit breaker for switching a high voltage power circuit. A surge absorber removes surge due to the switching of the vacuum interrupter.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전압 감지 기능을 갖춘 격벽 격실 축소형 고?저압 폐쇄배전반에 관한 것으로서, 고압 벽관통 부싱, 고압 공급 케이블을 통해 유입된 전기의 전압을 표시하는 전압표시기, 전압을 감지제어하는 전압표시제어기, 계기용 변압기, 진공차단기, 계기용 변류기, 다기능 디지털 보호계전기, 서어지 흡수기, 제어 스위치를 포함하는 고압 배전반 및 저압 벽관통 부싱, 기중 차단기, 배선용 차단기, 계기용 변압기, 계기용 변류기, 영상 변류기, 다기능 디지털 시계, 누전 화재 경보기, 제어 스위치를 포함하는 저압 배전반으로 이루어지고, 상기 저압 배전반과 고압 배전반은 금속판에 의해 구획된 다수 개의 격벽으로 격실을 갖춘 격벽 격실 축소형 고?저압 폐쇄배전반에 있어서, 상기 고압 벽관통 부싱은 24kV 특고압에 적용되도록 내부에 도체가 삽입 배치되고, 상기 도체의 주변에 절연체로 이루어진 절연애관이 배치되며, 상기 절연애관의 중앙에 패널 걸림부가 설치되고, 상기 패널 걸림부의 내부에 상기 도체와 평행 방향으로 전압감지 기능 센서가 내장되는 동시에 외주면에 상기 전압감지 기능 센서와의 접속 단자를 형성하며, 상기 패널 걸림부를 중심으로 하여 양쪽 가장자리를 따라 점진적으로 적어지면서 상기 절연애관의 표면에 반경방향으로 돌출된 다수개의 방열절연돌기가 일정한 간격을 두고 방사상으로 형성되고, 상기 절연애관의 양쪽 끝단에 상기 다수 개의 방열절연돌기보다 더 큰 직경을 갖는 돌출턱이 형성되고, 상기 돌출턱의 가장자리 선단면에 상기 도체와 연결된 접속판이 설치되고, 상기 저압 벽관통 부싱은 7.2kV 이하 고압 및 저압에 적용되도록 내부에 도체가 삽입 배치되고, 중앙에 패널 걸림부가 설치되며, 상기 패널 걸림부의 내부에 상기 도체와 평행 방향으로 전압감지 기능 센서가 내장되는 동시에 외주면에 상기 전압감지 기능 센서와의 접속 단자를 형성하고, 상기 패널 걸림부의 양쪽 끝단에 상기 도체와 연결된 접속판이 설치되는 것을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
따라서 본 발명은 전압감지 기능 센서가 내장된 고압 벽관통 부싱 및 저압 벽관통 부싱을 배전반에 채택하여 전기적 및 기계적 성능과 내구성이 우수할 뿐만 아니라 구조적으로 안전성이 향상될 뿐만 아니라 설치가 간편하고 원재료비가 절감될 수 있고, 금속 격벽으로 격실을 갖춘 폐쇄형 구조로 인해 독립된 모선실, 차단기실, 저압실 등 격실을 구획하여 불의의 사고시 주변 기기로의 사고 파급을 최대한 억제하여 구조적으로 전력계통의 안정된 시스템을 구축할 수 있다.

title_en: Integrated terahertz sensor
title_ko: 통합 테라헤르츠 센서
abstract_ko: 시스템 및 방법은 전자기 스펙트럼의 테라헤르츠 영역에서 동작하는 통합 소형 센서를 제공할 수 있다.  통합 소형 센서는 원격 표적을 검출하고, 비접촉, 비외과적 방식으로 동작할 수 있다.  통합 소형 센서가 생체 신호의 장기간 기록이 필요한 생명 의학, 생리학 및 기타 환경에서 사용될 때, 도플러 레이더 기술, 흡수 분광학 등과 같은 다양한 신호 분석 기술이 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency determination device
title_ko: 위급 상황 판단 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is an emergency situation determining apparatus. The emergency situation determining apparatus comprises: a sensor detecting a bio-signal of a person and a motion of a hand of the person within a predetermined range; and a determination unit analyzing the bio-signal recognized by the sensor and additionally analyzing the motion of the hand in accordance with a result of analyzing the bio-signal to determine whether an emergency situation has occurred.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 위급 상황 판단 장치를 제공한다. 위급 상황 판단 장치는 일정 범위 내에서 사람의 생체 신호 및 사람의 손의 동작을 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 생체신호를 분석하고, 상기 생체신호를 분석한 결과에 따라 추가적으로 손의 동작을 분석하여 위급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 판단하는 판단부를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for detecting vital signs using imaging-assisted radar
title_ko: 촬영 보조형 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 촬영 보조형 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 검출 시스템은, 대상을 촬영하기 위한 촬영부; 상기 대상을 향해 레이더 신호를 송신하기 위한 적어도 하나의 레이더 송신부; 상기 대상의 서로 다른 신체부위에서 반사된 레이더 신호를 각각 수신하기 위한 적어도 두 개의 레이더 수신부; 및 대상의 신체부위별 가중치와 서로 다른 신체부위에서 반사된 레이더 신호를 이용하여, 상기 대상의 움직임에 의한 노이즈가 제거된 생체 신호를 검출하는 처리부를 포함한다. 실시예에 따르면 촬영장치의 보조를 통해 대상의 움직임에 의한 노이즈를 능동적으로 제거함으로써 생체 신호의 검출 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling smart health care mattress
title_ko: 환자 특정이 가능한 스마트 병실용 침대 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환자 특정이 가능한 스마트 병실용 침대 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 환자가 누울 수 있도록 구비되는 병실용 침대와, 해당 환자가 소지할 수 있도록 구비되며, 기 설정된 고유한 태그식별정보를 저장하는 RFID 태그와, 병실용 침대의 일측에 장착되며, RFID 태그의 정보를 RFID 방식으로 인식하고, 인식된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보를 전송하는 복수개의 RFID 리더기들과, 병실용 침대의 일측에 장착되며, 적어도 하나의 레이더를 이용하여 병실용 침대 상에 존재하는 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 비접촉식으로 검출하는 적어도 하나의 레이더 센서장치와, 복수개의 RFID 리더기들 중 전파가 수신되고 있는 RFID 리더기의 방향으로 빔포밍 방식을 이용하여 레이더 신호가 송출되도록 레이더 센서장치의 동작을 제어하고, 전파가 수신되고 있는 RFID 리더기로부터 인식된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보와 함께 레이더 센서장치로부터 검출된 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 수집 및 전송하는 레이더 제어장치와, 레이더 제어장치와 통신망을 통해 연결되며, 레이더 제어장치로부터 전송된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보와 함께 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 해당 환자의 재실/부재, 수면, 체위, 호흡, 심박, 움직임, 또는 거리 상태 중 적어도 하나의 환자 상태정보를 실시간 분석 및 환자 상태 통합 모니터링을 수행하는 환자 관리서버를 포함함으로써, 불필요한 생체신호 데이터가 섞이는 경우를 최소화할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 환자를 특정하여 해당 환자의 생체신호 데이터만을 효율적으로 수집 및 모니터링 할 수 있다.

title_en: Electrical equipment protection system for apartment houses using IoT
title_ko: IoT를 이용한 공동주택 전기 설비 보호 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrical facility protection system for apartment houses using IoT. The electrical facility protection system for apartment houses using IoT can manage power consumption of a plurality of outlets through the IoT, groups a plurality of outlets corresponding to a plurality of IoT devices, and blocks standby power for each group by comparing the amount of used power and the amount of standby power for the corresponding group, thereby effectively managing electricity of apartment houses. In addition, the electrical facility protection system for apartment houses using IoT includes: a main horizontal buried pipe in which wiring is installed; and an in-pipe inspection robot that detects current and flame in the buried pipe while moving inside a branch horizontal buried pipe and photographs the inside of the buried pipe as a thermal image. When a situation inside the buried pipe and a buried wiring conduit installed in the buried pipe buried in a wall or ceiling and connected to the outlet is in an emergency situation, power can be cut off, and the situation in the pipe can be monitored to respond quickly. An electric shock accident and a fire accident caused by a short circuit can be prevented, thereby providing high-quality electricity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT를 이용한 공동주택 전기 설비 보호 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사물인터넷을 통해 다수의 콘센트들의 소비전력을 관리할 수 있으며, 다수의 IoT 디바이스 대응되는 다수의 콘센트들을 그룹화하고, 해당 그룹에 대한 사용전력량과 대기 전력량을 비교함에 따라 그룹별로 대기 전력을 차단함으로써 공동주택 전기를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있도록 함과 아울러, 배선이 포설되는 메인수평매설관과 분기수평매설관 내부를 이동하면서 매설관 내의 전류와 불꽃을 감지하고 매설관 내부를 열화상으로 촬영하는 관내점검로봇을 구비하여, 벽체나 천장에 매설된 매설관 내에 포설되어 콘센트에 연결되는 매설배관과 매설관 내부의 상황이 비상 상황이면 전원을 차단함과 아울러 관내 상황을 모니터링하여 신속히 대처할 수 있으며, 누전에 따른 감전사고와 화재사고를 예방할 수 있어 양질의 전기를 제공할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Search for and rescue humanoid robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search for and rescue humanoid robot, including running gear and organism, organism upper portion rear end and upper portion front end are equipped with broken respectively that the dismouting is put and extinguishing device, are equipped with the water tank on the organism between extinguishing device and broken dismouting are put, are equipped with the loading case on the water tank, are equipped with camera, fan and life detection appearance above loading the case, and the loading incasement is equipped with aspiration pump, oxygen system, and four sides of loading case all are equipped with ultrasonic distance sensor and flame sensor, and the front portion of organism is connected with the shovel board through hydraulic means. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: put and shovel the board through broken dismouting, can quick break tearing and clear away the roadblock open, and then can rescue the personnel of stranding with the shortest time, the utility model discloses the stranded personnel of ability automatic search can judge concrete position moreover when using, adopt track type running gear to strengthen the stability when moving, will load the case setting and on the water tank, can increase the accommodation space who loads the case like this.

title_en: A kind of fire helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire helmets, including helmet shell, helmet inner casing and wind shield, wind shield is connect by buckle structure with helmet shell, helmet shell is equipped with thermal insulation layer, noise control layer, anticollision layer and buffer layer successively from outside to inside, helmet inner casing is equipped with mounting box, and controller, positioning device, wireless communication module, power module, heartbeat detection device and apparatus for testing body temperature are equipped in mounting box.The utility model is provided simultaneously with heat-insulated, noise control, anticollision and the function of damping, feature-rich various, and thermal insulation layer is set to the outermost layer of helmet shell, and the helmet integrally will not easily be deformed because of high temperature, and service life is long；In addition, the utility model can monitor the physiology sign of fire fighter in real time and be accurately positioned, to make quick response to emergency episode, practicability is high, can be widely applied to fire-fighting equipment technical field.

title_en: Method for avoiding an accident or for mitigating the consequences of an accident
abstract_en: A method for avoiding accidents a biometric sensor system is used to ascertain vital signs of a vehicle occupant, and in the event that the vital signs lie outside a normal range, preparatory emergency measures are carried out in a safety system in the vehicle.

title_en: Method and device for enhancing human behavior characteristics of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for enhancing human body behavior characteristics of a through-wall radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the input data into a plurality of areas based on information relationship, and giving corresponding weight to each divided area, wherein the output of the attention weighting module is a feature map; the convolutional layer module is used for generating a two-dimensional image for downscaling the input data; inputting a characteristic diagram into a super-resolution module comprising a plurality of LISTA models; the two-dimensional image is input into a self-adaptive weight module to generate enhanced information of each region; and fusing the enhanced information of each region to obtain a fusion characteristic vector, and performing scale conversion on the fusion characteristic vector to obtain output. The method combines the specific complex multipath effect of through-wall radar imaging and the physical background under the low signal-to-noise-ratio scene, so that the method achieves a better data enhancement effect by using less cost.

title_en: Multi-target behavior perception multipath elimination method for millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar multi-target behavior perception multipath elimination method relates to the technical field of radar multipath elimination, and aims at the problems that in the prior art, under the condition of multi-target human body detection, due to the fact that targets are too many, interference exists between targets and detection accuracy is affected, the characteristics of ordered statistics are utilized, multipath interference and clutter are effectively restrained and eliminated, and the problem that under the condition of multi-target human body life detection, interference exists between targets and detection accuracy is affected due to the fact that targets are too many is solved. Meanwhile, multipath elimination is further verified through the coherence coefficient, and the robustness of the method is improved. The method can effectively improve the target detection and tracking performance of the radar system, and has higher practical value for applications such as behavior perception and the like.
assignees: ZHONGYI ZHILIAN WUXI INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Method and system for monitoring continuous biomedical signal
title_ko: 연속적인 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 모니터링 하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  본 개시의 예시적 실시예에 따른 센서 시스템은, 생체 신호를 감지함으로써 연속적인 전기적 신호를 출력하는 센서 모듈, 기준 데이터를 저장하는 메모리, 무선 채널을 통해서 출력 데이터를 전송하는 트랜스미터, 및 연속적인 전기적 신호로부터 생성된 입력 데이터 및 기준 데이터에 기초하여, 입력 데이터를 출력 데이터로서 트랜스미터를 통해서 전송할지 여부를 결정하는 데이터 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject a radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of frames of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A processor may collate a series of complex values for each voxel representing reflected radiation for the associated voxel in multiple frames and generate therefrom a real signal sample for each voxel. Neural networks may be used to select the voxel with the best waveform.

title_en: Lateral wave radar system for forward detection
abstract_en: A forward-looking radar system adapted to detect and identify buried or near surface objects from a moving ground vehicle has been developed. The system incorporates a radar detection system and in one embodiment is mounted on a ground vehicle. The system is adapted to differentiate common roadway clutter from objects of interest.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Methods, computer programs, radar systems, antenna systems, and flying platforms for detecting a horizontally buried linear object
abstract_en: A method for detecting a horizontally buried linear object is provided, the horizontally buried linear object having a longitudinal extension. The method comprises moving, with a flying platform comprising a radar for synthetic aperture radar, SAR, vertical imaging, along a trajectory corresponding to a synthetic aperture. The method further comprises transmitting and receiving radar signals while moving along the trajectory corresponding to the synthetic aperture. The method also comprises forming a SAR image based on collected data representing radar signal reflections received from the ground. The method additionally comprises detecting one or more features in the formed SAR image relating to the horizontally buried linear object. Said trajectory is oriented in a direction substantially perpendicular to an expected orientation of the longitudinal extension of the horizontally buried object and traversing the horizontally buried object.

title_en: Non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and device based on IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and device based on an IR-UWB radar, which are characterized in that IR-UWB radar equipment is deployed at the bedside to collect vital sign data of a tested object in an environment where the device is positioned during the bed at night; automatically positioning the position range of the bed, and extracting vital sign signals representing the tested object in the range of the bed from echo signals reflected by the radar; respectively identifying five states of the human body in the whole night process based on a signal processing algorithm; estimating the sleeping period of the tested object according to the state change condition of the human body overnight; monitoring the respiration rate change condition of a tested object in a sleep period; and identifying respiratory events occurring in the sleep period of the tested object by using a deep learning method based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism. The invention improves the accuracy of the calculation of the breathing frequency overnight and can obtain more accurate sleep apnea low-ventilation index AHI data.

title_en: Communication security and protection integrated routing system, method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a communication security and protection integrated routing system, a method, equipment and a storage medium suitable for a fire scene, which comprise the following steps: the fire scene far-end MCU selects a target area to be detected according to the SSID provided by the WiFi routing module carrying the fire scene near-end MCU, and connects the fire scene far-end MCU with the SSID of the selected target area in a frequency band of 5 GHzWiFi; the WiFi routing module collects the CSI data and uploads the CSI data to the communication cloud module; the Tencel cloud module sends the CSI data to an edge computing power PC end, human existence state judgment is carried out through filtering processing of the edge computing power PC end and by utilizing a sliding window function algorithm, and a judgment result is fed back to the mobile end APP module. According to the application, information feedback is provided by utilizing the physical layer characteristics of human body activities on disturbance of WiFi 5GHz electromagnetic waves, so that the function of monitoring the human body existence state in a fire scene is realized, and a firefighter can rapidly judge whether the human body vital signs to be rescued exist in the fire scene.

title_en: AI-based monitoring method of driver's state of stress by use of look and biomedical signal
title_ko: 운전자 표정 및 생체신호를 활용한 신경망 기반의 운전자 스트레스 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology that constructs a neural network model for outputting a driver stress evaluation value based on facial expressions, biometric signals, and driving patterns, as well as an RNN-based neural network model for predicting future changes in stress levels, thereby providing driver stress monitoring and stress change prediction through the models. More specifically, the present invention inputs driver facial information and driving pattern information, obtained during vehicle operation, into a brain neural mapping model and a sympathetic nervous system mapping model to derive, in real time, the activation states of brain neural networks (sensor network, action network, and default mode network) and the sympathetic nervous system. Based on this, the driver's stress state is monitored in real time and visualized through radar charts and gauge charts. In addition, the present invention predicts future changes in stress states using an RNN-based neural network model and visually represents the changes in the driver's sympathetic nervous system (SNR) and parasympathetic nervous system (PNR) activation through accumulated area charts, divided into past records and future predictions. The present invention enables the driver to intuitively understand the driver's stress response state and respond in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 표정, 생체 신호, 주행 패턴에 의해 운전자 스트레스 평가치를 출력하는 신경망 모델 및 향후 스트레스 상태 변화를 예측하는 RNN 기반 신경망 모델을 구성하고 이들 신경망 모델에 의해 운전자 스트레스 모니터링과 스트레스 변화 예측을 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 구체적으로, 본 발명은 차량 주행 중에 운전자 표정 정보와 주행 패턴 정보를 뇌신경 매핑 모델과 교감신경 매핑 모델에 입력하여 뇌신경 네트워크(센서 네트워크, 액션 네트워크, 디폴트 모드 네트워크)와 교감신경의 활성화 상태를 실시간으로 도출하고 이를 통해 운전자 스트레스 상태를 실시간으로 모니터링하고 레이더 차트 및 게이지 차트를 통해 운전자 스트레스 상태를 시각화 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 또한, 본 발명은 RNN 기반 신경망 모델에 의해 향후의 스트레스 상태 변화를 예측하고 누적 영역 차트를 통해 운전자의 교감신경(SNR)과 부교감신경(PNR) 활성화 변화를 과거 기록과 미래 예측으로 나누어 시각적으로 표현함으로써 운전자가 자신의 스트레스 반응 상태를 직관적으로 이해하고 미리 대응할 수 있도록 지원하는 기술에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The patch sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using a Kalman filter
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving reflected radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating a displacement signal indicative of a displacement of a target based on the reflected radar signals; filtering the displacement signal using a bandpass filter to generate a filtered displacement signal; determining a first rate indicative of a heartbeat rate of the target based on the filtered displacement signal; tracking a second rate indicative of the heartbeat rate of the target with a track using a Kalman filter; updating the track based on the first rate; and updating a setting of the bandpass filter based on the updated track.

title_en: A kind of Zai Hou detection and rescues robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Zai Hou detection and rescues robot, including micromachine, wheel stand, wheel and axletree, the main shaft of the micromachine is connected by shaft coupling with the axletree, the axletree is connected with the wheel, the both ends of the axletree are connected by bearing with the wheel stand, the wheel stand is arranged on secondary stent, the secondary stent is connected with one-level support, the upper end of the one-level support is connected with frame, illuminating lamp is provided with the frame, the illuminating lamp is arranged on lighting lamp bracket, temperature sensor is installed in the frame of the side of the illuminating lamp.Detection and rescue robot architecture is simple after the calamity, it is readily transported, suitable for scene after the complicated calamity of various environment, life-detection instrument and security protection camera are provided with device, can in time find and feedback signal, detecting location are accurate, ensure the accuracy of search and rescue position, meanwhile illuminating lamp is provided with device, it is easy to night to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Mountain area geology removes monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mountain area geology mobile monitoring system, include: the lower end of the first supporting rod is fixedly buried underground, and the upper end of the first supporting rod is provided with a pull rope sensor, a wireless transmission module and a solar cell module; the lower end of the second supporting rod is fixedly buried underground, and the upper end of the second supporting rod is provided with a wire holder; a signal receiver; the pull rope sensor comprises a hub and a sensing element, wherein a stretchable stainless steel rope is wound on the hub, and the sensing element is connected with the hub; the wire holder is connected with the stainless steel cable; the wireless transmission module is electrically connected with the sensing element; the solar cell module is connected with the stay wire sensor and the wireless transmission module to provide electric energy; the signal receiver is adapted to the wireless transmission module and is used for remotely receiving the monitoring signal sent by the wireless transmission module. The system does not need manual measurement, can quickly acquire monitoring data in real time, is accurate and reliable in data, can effectively improve monitoring efficiency, guarantees timely and reliable ground disaster early warning, and is suitable for large-scale monitoring and early warning.
assignees: SICHUAN SHUDU GEOLOGICAL ENG SURVEY CO LTD

title_en: Waveform-audio-fused ultra-wideband radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel waveform parameter-audio-fused ultra-wideband radar life detector. A radar echo is divided into two paths: one path is processed and extracted into a respiratory signal, and then whether the respiratory signal is a life parameter of a human being is intelligently identified; and the other path is processed into an audio signal through amplitude modulation or frequency modulation, and through multi-channel and noise masking characteristics of a human ear, information carried by the radar echo is monitored in real time in a listening way to obtain information which is difficultly expressed by waveform of an ultra-wideband biological radar echo so as to identify whether a biological radar echo signal carries life information artificially. Through the two processing and identifying ways, the life detection accuracy is greatly improved; and the novel waveform parameter-audio-fused ultra-wideband radar life detector breaks through a limitation that the conventional radar life detector relies on a single waveform parameter for identification, improves the practicality of the radar life detector and has a good application prospect.

title_en: A kind of disaster relief unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster relief unmanned planes, comprising: disc shaped shell, machine top rotor, side Zhou Xuanyi, diving cabin, shutter, goods and materials frame, infrared detection system and solar panel；Machine top rotor is mounted on disc shaped shell upper surface center；Side Zhou Xuanyi is uniformly arranged on disc shaped shell edge by connecting rod；Diving cabin is arranged in disc shaped shell bottom concave side；Shutter and solar panel include multiple, and are arranged at disc shaped shell surface；Shutter is disposed adjacent with solar panel；Goods and materials frame is detachably connected with disc shaped shell；Infrared detection system is arranged at disc shaped shell bottom concave side edge.The present invention both can be used for air transport disaster relief supplies, and accurately detect human life sign, and can snorkeling in water.
assignees: FOSHAN SHENFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Two-stage wall parameter estimation method based on ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage wall parameter estimation method based on an ultra-wideband through-wall radar, which is applied to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and aims at solving the problem of difficulty in wall parameter estimation in the prior art; the method comprises the steps of estimating wall parameters in two stages, wherein the first stage is an electromagnetic propagation path calculation stage, firstly determining search intervals of unknown parameters such as distance R between a radar and a wall, thickness d of the wall, dielectric constant epsilon of the wall and the like, and then calculating time delay of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall by adopting a mirror reflection and refraction point approximation method; the second stage is a wall parameter estimation stage, and projection imaging is carried out on each parameter in the parameter search area; only when the candidate parameter is equal to the true value, the echo can be subjected to coherent accumulation, and the intensity of the image after back projection is the maximum, so that the candidate parameter is searched through the back projection image to obtain the true value.

title_en: Vibration subsidence in-situ dynamic test bed for foundation soil and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration sinking in-situ dynamic test bed of foundation soil and a test method thereof. In the in-situ test field, a horizontal vibration load is applied to the soil body of the lower foundation through a vibration table, and dynamic response of the foundation soil is measured by sensors buried at different positions to reflect the seismic subsidence deformation of the soil body. At present, the vibration sinking test of soil comprises a dynamic single shear, dynamic triaxial and dynamic torsional shear indoor test method, but no mature method exists for the field in-situ vibration sinking test of foundation soil. A method for testing dynamic response and vibration subsidence deformation of foundation soil is provided by the vibration effect of a vibrator on an in-situ soil column on site, and a soil dynamics test method is filled. The method for measuring the acceleration response and the seismic subsidence deformation of the foundation soil under the in-situ condition has good practical significance for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: FMCW radar human vital sign detection method based on CEEMDAN combined wavelet threshold
abstract_en: A FMCW radar human vital sign detection method based on CEEMDAN united wavelet threshold is characterized by constructing a millimeter wave radar experiment system, wherein a human body is positioned in front of the radar, and intermediate frequency signals of human body echoes are collected; data preprocessing is carried out on the received intermediate frequency signals, and the influence of noise is reduced through distance dimension FFT and incoherent accumulation, so that the distance between the chest of the human body and the radar is determined; recovering the phase of the vital sign signal from the incoherently accumulated FFT result by using the linear characteristic of arctangent demodulation, and performing phase unwrapping and phase difference to obtain optimized phase information; the processed phase signals are combined with a wavelet threshold method through CEEMDAN algorithm, decomposed into IMF components, and heartbeat and respiratory signals are reconstructed; and carrying out FFT (fast Fourier transform) on the obtained heartbeat and respiration signals to estimate the heart rate and the respiration rate. The invention remarkably reduces the parameter quantity and the calculated quantity while maintaining higher detection precision.

title_en: Microwave radar vital sign detection method and system based on infrared temperature sensing detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for detecting vital signs of a microwave radar based on infrared temperature sensing detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, rotating infrared temperature sensing detection to detect whether a human body exists, if yes, transmitting and receiving radar signals through a microwave radar, searching the position of the human body, S2, searching a region of a micro-motion state corresponding to the position of the human body, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, respectively searching vital sign detection regions of each human body from the region of the micro-motion state, and S3, respectively receiving the radar signals returned by the vital sign detection regions, and respectively extracting vital signs from the radar signals.

title_en: Localized triggering of human activity analysis
abstract_en: The present description relates to determining human activity in an environment (ENV) in which at least one sensor is configured to measure a parameter relating to human activity. This process comprises: - providing a device for detecting a human presence in the environment (GW, TV, BB1, PRN, BB2), and - activating the sensor (C11, C12, C13) if a human presence has been detected in the environment (RO1).

title_en: Portable contactless biosignal detection device, driver monitor device, visitor screening system, and household healthcare system
abstract_en:
The present invention provides a vital signal detection device of a portable and non-contact type that can independently acquire vital information such as body temperature, respiratory rate, and heart rate simultaneously.
