     The present invention includes: an antenna unit provided with a planar antenna of a MIMO radar on a front surface; and a display unit including a display panel on the front surface. The antenna unit is combined with the display unit or the display unit is combined with the antenna unit in a rotatable manner so that, from a state where the planar antenna and the display panel face in a direction ahead of the front surface, the planar antenna is turned to be directed to a direction of a back surface of the display unit opposite from the display panel. The portable non-contact vital signal detection device detects a vital signal on a side ahead of the front surface and a vital signal on a side in the direction of the back surface opposite from the front surface.

title_en: System and Method for Vital Signal Sensing Using a Millimeter-Wave Radar Sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: Radar-based human presence monitoring system with edge filtering and cloud-based feedback
abstract_en: A human presence monitoring system includes a radar-based sensing device configured for installation in a residential environment and a cloud-based server configured to receive and analyze sensing data. The device emits frequency-modulated continuous-wave radar signals and performs on-device signal processing using distance, energy, and motion gating to detect and classify human presence. A visual indicator provides real-time feedback to the user. The device aggregates radar data into a compressed two-dimensional histogram and transmits periodic reports via a cellular or Wi-Fi connection. The server applies machine learning classifiers trained on historical activity and client-specific circadian patterns to assess reported data and determine alert conditions. Updated classification parameters may be transmitted back to the device without user intervention, allowing the system to adapt over time. A companion application enables authorized contacts to receive daily reports, view activity history, configure alert preferences, and manage support circle communications.

title_en: A kind of more people based on variation mode decomposition time-varying breath signal detection method through walls
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of more people time-varying breath signal detection methods through walls for being based on variation mode decomposition (VMD), steps are as follows: ultra wide band transmitting antenna emits the vibration that burst pulse passes through torso model micro-doppler, echo is received by receiving antenna, and ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo samples to obtain human body echo-signal matrix through walls when passing through slow；The variance of each range gate is calculated by range gate selection algorithm, and finds out range gate existing for the maximum i.e. more people's targets of variance and High-frequency Interference and extra frequency components are eliminated using low-pass filter；Mode decomposition is carried out using VMD algorithm to filtered signal, iteration subsignal obtains the effective respiration information for meeting breathing number and frequency range；It carries out Hilbert transform and carries out time frequency processing, obtain the dynamic prompting message comprising smooth respiratory characteristic.The present invention can effectively eliminate the interference harmonic wave of different respiratory components, and removal metope interference enhances feeble respiration signal, have common-path interference, and accurate time-varying tracks characteristic.

title_en: False alarm suppression method and device for through-wall radar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a false alarm suppression method and a false alarm suppression device for through-wall radar detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, detecting an internal area of a target building by using a through-wall radar detection system, and respectively obtaining a first echo signal containing characteristic information of a strong reflection point in the building and a second echo signal containing target characteristic information; s2, detecting the first echo signal to obtain a characteristic signal of a strong reflection point in the building, and detecting the second echo signal to obtain a characteristic signal of a target in the building; and S3, carrying out feature matching on the building internal strong reflection point feature signal and the building internal target feature signal to obtain a matched target signal, and outputting the matched target signal as a final target detection signal to filter false alarms. The method can inhibit false alarms generated by structural features in the building, and has the advantages of simple implementation method, low cost, strong real-time performance, high inhibition precision and efficiency and the like.

title_en: Heartbeat and respiratory frequency joint estimation method based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heartbeat and respiratory frequency joint estimation method based on MIMO radar, which belongs to the technical field of radar, in particular to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring. By adopting the ML estimation method, the estimation of the heart beat and the respiratory frequency is realized, compared with the traditional method based on time-frequency analysis, the ML estimation method has more stable performance, smaller error and smaller dependence on the time length, the invention provides an estimation performance evaluation method with more theoretical basis for the field by calculating the CRB of heart beat respiratory frequency estimation, and the invention provides a system parameter optimization design method based on the derived CRB, which can assist technicians to find out the optimal radar parameter so as to improve the performance of heart beat respiratory frequency estimation.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection with elimination of signals excited by interfering movements
Apparatus and method of integratedly processing a plurality of bio signals
title_ko: 통합적인 생체신호 처리장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 통합적인 생체신호 처리장치 및 방법을 개시한다.   제1 신호처리모듈은  제어신호에 대응하여 각 센서를 구동하기 위한 신호를 생성하고, 각 센서로부터 제공되는 생체신호를 처리한다.  제2 신호처리모듈은 처리하고자 하는 생체신호에 대응하여 제어신호를 생성하는 한편 처리조건을 자동으로 설정하고, 제1 신호처리모듈로부터 제공되는 생체신호를 설정된 처리조건에 따라서 처리하고, 처리결과를 출력한다.

title_en: Emergency Notification System
title_ko: 응급 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency notification system which measures a biometric signal (130) of a protection target person (100) to send a notification to a designated output unit (500) corresponding to a designated contact (120) corresponding to an emergency situation and a set dangerous body situation. The emergency notification system comprises a biometric sensor unit (200), a target person terminal unit (300), a management server unit (400), and the designated output unit (500).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보호대상자(100)의 생체신호(130)을 측정하여 응급 상황 및 정해진 신체적 위험 상황에 해당하는 지정연락처(120)에 대응하는 지정출력부(500)에 알림을 보내기 위한 응급 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 생체센서부(200)와 대상자단말기부(300)와 관리서버부(400) 및 지정출력부(500)를 구비한다.

title_en: System for monitoring elderly people living alone and method performing the same
title_ko: 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템 및 이를 실행하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 게이트웨이, 레이더 센서 및 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함하는 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템은 게이트웨이로부터 수신된 영상 이미지를 미리 생성된 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델에 적용한 후 상기 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델로부터 추출된 영상 이미지에 대한 독거노인 자세에 따른 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급을 상기 게이트웨이를 통해 상기 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치에 제공하고, 상기 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 관리자 단말에 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 알림 메시지를 제공하는 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 독거노인의 거주지에 설치되며 임펄스 신호를 생성하여 송신 안테나를 통해 방사하고, 상기 방사된 신호에 대한 반사 신호에 따라 생체 신호 값을 생성하여 상기 게이트웨이에 제공하는 레이더 센서, 상기 레이더 센서로부터 생체 신호 값을 수신하면 상기 생체 신호 값에 따라 응급 위험 상황이 발생한 순간의 영상 이미지를 생성하여 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 제공하고, 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버로부터 수신된 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 독거노임 응급 위험 상황 여부를 판단하는 게이트웨이 및 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 등록된 독거노인에 대한 모니터링 결과를 수신하여 저장하는 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Foundation structure of fume pipe with buried structure
title_ko: 내진성을 가지는 지중 흄관 기초구조물
abstract_en: Provided by the present invention is an underground hume pipe foundation structure with earthquake resistance. The underground hume pipe foundation structure with earthquake resistance comprises: a concrete support part positioned underground; hume pipes positioned on an upper portion of the concrete support part, disposed adjacently to drain sewage, and forming a hollow; a connection part which connects the hume pipes; an impact sensor installed on each of the hume pipes and configured to measure the impact force applied to the hume pipes; a support part installed on the concrete support part and configured to support lower end portions of the hume pipes; and a posture control part provided on the support part, and configured to guide the rotation and distortion of each of the hume pipes when the impact force exceeds a predetermined abnormal impact force and correct the forcible rotation and distortion of each of the hume pipes when the impact force is less than the predetermined abnormal impact force such that the hume pipes are arranged in the original positions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내진성을 가지는 지중 흄관 기초구조물을 제공한다. 상기 내진성을 가지는 지중 흄관 기초구조물은 지중에 위치되는 콘크리트 지지부; 상기 콘크리트 지지부의 상부에 위치되며, 오수를 배수시키도록 서로 이웃하여 배치되고, 중공을 이루는 흄관들; 상기 흄관들의 사이를 연결하는 연결부; 상기 흄관들 각각에 설치되며, 상기 흄관들로 가해지는 충격력을 측정하는 충격 센서; 상기 콘크리트 지지부 상에 설치되고, 상기 흄관들의 하단부를 지지하는 지지부; 및, 상기 지지부에 구비되어, 상기 충격력이 기설정되는 이상충격력 이상을 이루면 상기 흄관들 각각이 회전 및 틀어짐을 안내하고, 상기 충격력이 기설정되는 이상충격력 미만을 이루면 상기 흄관들 각각을 강제 회전 및 강제 틀어짐을 교정하여 원위치로 배치시키는 자세 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Colliery is many information sensing devices of environment in pit based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colliery is environmental multi-information perception device in pit based on thing networking belongs to communication and environmental monitoring field. The device uses an FPGA as a main control chip and transmits real-time voice video and environmental parameter information under a coal mine to a ground control center through connection with a camera, a microphone, a temperature and humidity sensor, a gas concentration sensor and a dust concentration sensor; the optical fiber transmission is realized by connecting the photoelectric conversion module, and meanwhile, the transmission efficiency is improved by compressing the image acquired by the camera; the detection of the life body can be carried out by connecting with the life detection radar; by connecting to NB-loT, emergency communication may be available. The device greatly improves the underground coal mine environment detection elements, the communication quality and the efficiency through a multi-sensor fusion technology and an optical fiber communication technology, timely discovers and pre-warns the monitored environment information and the position with problems, and ensures the safety production of a coal mine.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring wearable system based on electrical impedance imaging
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent monitoring wearable system based on electrical impedance imaging, which relates to the technical field of bioelectrical impedance monitoring, and comprises wearable equipment and a cloud server which are in communication connection; wearable equipment includes wearable overcoat, sensor module, control module, power module, and sensor module, control module and power module all are connected with the wearable shell, and sensor module and control module all are connected with the power module electricity, and sensor module is connected with the control module electricity, and control module is connected with cloud service communication. The system has the functions of noninvasive and remote monitoring of vital signs of patients with infectious diseases and critical diseases, uploading data to a cloud platform by using the internet technology, and providing remote interpretation and guidance for a doctor.

title_en: Wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless remote life monitoring pager which comprises a life information processing part, a control part, a communication part and a sound and image display part. A digital body temperature sensor 101, a pulse detection amplifying module 102 and a memory 103 are respectively connected with an input interface and an output interface of a microprocessor 120; a red SOS key 123, an orange SOS key 124, a yellow SOS key 125, a green safe key 126 and a starting key 127 are respectively connected with an input port of the microprocessor 120; a wireless communication module 121 and a USB interface 122 are respectively connected with the input interface and the output interface of the microprocessor 120; and a loudspeaker, a driving circuit 110, a liquid crystal display 111 and a calendar clock chip 112 are respectively connected with the input interface and the output interface of the microprocessor 120. The utility model is mainly used for the emergency relief of survivors in natural disasters such as earthquake and the like and emergency accidents such as mine disasters, traffic accidents and the like. The wireless remote life monitoring pager can receive ''finding'' signals, and can automatically send ''SOS'' information of physical life sign and the like.

title_en: Vital signs display methods and system
abstract_en: A kind of vital signs display methods and system that the present invention is provided, are related to field of radar.Detect whether there is the vital signs of human body by the signal of radar transmissions, and show that position relationship between radar and human body, human life characteristic signal be strong and weak in the display interface of terminal device and human body surrounding enviroment these three views, the situation of target body is specifically shown in display interface；Respond handover operation, the indication range in display interface to three views of human body situation is adjusted, the specifying information of target body, the particular location and surrounding enviroment of accurate master goal human body so that can successfully deploy for the search-and-rescue work of target body can pointedly be understood.

title_en: Signal monitoring method, device, storage medium and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal monitoring method, a device, a computer readable storage medium and a system, firstly, collecting vital sign signals of a monitored object in a non-contact mode through a millimeter wave radar chip; performing microwave signal processing on the acquired vital sign signals to obtain a monitoring result comprising vital sign frequencies; and sending the monitoring result to a cloud platform so that the cloud platform manages the monitoring result.

title_en: Joint estimation of respiratory rate and heart rate using ultra wideband radar
abstract_en: A method for contactless vital sign monitoring comprising: radar signals for object detection are transmitted via the transceiver. The method further comprises the steps of: a clutter-removed channel impulse response is generated from a reflection of a received radar signal, wherein a portion of the reflection of the radar signal is reflected from a living subject. The method further comprises the steps of: a set of range groupings corresponding to locations of the living object is identified. In addition, the method comprises: a first set of signal components representative of a respiration rate of the living subject and a second set of signal components representative of a heart rate of the living subject are identified.

title_en: Non-contact sleep monitoring method and monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact sleep monitoring method and a monitoring device, comprising the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic wave signals to a test target through a millimeter wave radar, collecting human chest micro-motion echoes, obtaining intermediate frequency signals, and separating respiration signals and heartbeat signals in the intermediate frequency signals; processing the respiration and heartbeat phase signals, and accurately estimating respiration and heartbeat and body micro-motion information; generating variability data by utilizing the results acquired in real time by breathing, heartbeat and body micro-motion, extracting characteristics, and obtaining awake duration, sleep duration, body movement times and bed leaving times according to an algorithm; the millimeter wave radar simultaneously detects the unmanned object, abnormal respiration, abnormal heartbeat and abnormal condition to a large extent in the monitoring process, and carries out red light warning and buzzer warning when abnormal conditions occur; the non-contact sleep monitoring method and the monitoring device can simultaneously monitor the non-contact vital signs and the sleep, and have great significance for sleep monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU KANGHUDA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact detection system and method for soil moisture content based on antenna sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact detection system and method for the moisture content of soil based on an antenna sensor, and belongs to the technical field of soil property measurement. Comprises 5 steps: step S1, selecting proper antenna sensor frequency and ground penetrating radar center frequency according to the detected water content range and depth of the soil body; step S2, detecting the frequency spectrum response of an antenna sensor in the air by adopting a ground penetrating radar to obtain a minimum value f  a  of a frequency spectrum signal; step S3, detecting the frequency spectrum response of an antenna sensor buried in the stratum by adopting a ground penetrating radar to obtain a frequency spectrum signal minimum f  d ; s4, calculating the dielectric constant of the stratum to be tested according to a formula epsilon  r =(f a /f d ) 2 ; and S5, calculating the water content of the stratum to be tested by adopting a Topp formula. The method has the advantage of non-contact detection of the water content, and reduces the difficulty of signal processing on the basis of the traditional ground penetrating radar-based water content detection method.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar and camera fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and provides a vital sign detection method based on fusion of a millimeter wave radar and a camera, which comprises the steps of detecting the gesture based on a human body image of a target person to obtain a chest area of the target person, and performing frequency analysis on a millimeter wave radar signal to obtain a distance angle heat map; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a chest area, carrying out human body positioning based on the chest area and a distance angle heat map to obtain a human body position, carrying out phase extraction on millimeter wave radar signals based on the human body position to obtain vital sign signals of target personnel, carrying out variation modal decomposition on the vital sign signals to obtain vital sign parameters of the target personnel, overcoming the defects that the current detection is easily influenced by the skin state of the human body, the detection result is inaccurate, and limitations exist on special crowd, continuous monitoring and remote monitoring, realizing non-invasive detection, ensuring that the detection result is more accurate and reliable, being more beneficial to the special crowd, and providing support for home medical treatment and remote health monitoring.

title_en: Sensor module for biological signal detection using conductive wire
title_ko: 전도성 실을 이용한 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method capable of reducing a manufacturing processes and of improving productivity by utilizing an electrode as an electrode of a bio-signal sensing device and by simplifying a construction of the electrode and an electrical connection structure. The present invention discloses the sensor module to detect a bio-signal by using a conductive-wire as an electrode. The sensor module to detect the bio-signal according to the present invention comprises: an array electrode including a plurality of electrode patterns formed on both surfaces of a nonconductive basic material by using the conductive wire; a substrate including a plurality of connecting terminals corresponding to the plurality of electrode patterns and a plurality of wire patterns individually connected to the plurality of connecting terminals; and a fixing means to fixate the substrate on the array electrode to always connect the plurality of electrode patterns to the plurality of connecting terminals. According to the present invention, the sensor module may give smooth and comfortable wearing sensation to a user by utilizing the conductive wire as the electrode to detect the bio-signal and more accurately detect a bio-signal by obtaining an enough connecting surface when the flection is existed on a skin contact surface. In addition, the method may simply form an array electrode by using the conductive wire in the non-conductive base material and may remarkably improve the productivity of the array electrode with a simple electric connecting configuration. In addition, the electrode pattern formed by the conductive wire provides a flexible skin contact surface, minimizes the electrode pattern, and compactly forms the sensor module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전도성 실을 전극으로 이용하는 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈은, 전도성 실을 이용하여 비전도성 모재의 양면에 걸쳐 형성된 다수의 전극패턴을 포함하는 어레이 전극; 상기 다수의 전극패턴에 각각 대응하는 다수의 접촉단자와 상기 다수의 접촉단자와 각각 연결되는 다수의 배선패턴을 포함하는 기판; 상기 다수의 전극패턴이 상기 다수의 접촉단자에 항상 접촉되도록 상기 기판을 상기 어레이 전극에 대해 고정시키는 고정수단을 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면 전도성 실을 생체신호 감지용 전극으로 활용하므로 사용자에게 부드럽고 편안한 착용감을 줄 수 있고 피부접촉면에 굴곡이 있는 경우에도 충분한 접촉면을 확보함으로써 보다 정확한 생체신호를 검출할 수 있다. 또한 비전도성 모재에 전도성 실을 이용하여 간편하게 어레이 전극을 구성할 수 있고, 전기적 연결 구성이 매우 간단하므로 어레이 전극의 생산성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있다. 또한 전도성 실로 이루어진 전극패턴은 유연한 피부접촉면을 제공하고 전극패턴의 소형화가 가능하므로 센서모듈을 컴팩트하게 제조하는 것이 가능해진다.

title_en: Contactless biosignal detection devices and systems for multiple targets
title_ko: 다중 타겟용 비접촉식 생체신호 검출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a non-contact biosignal detection apparatus for a plurality of targets using a radar sensor to overcome the limitations of the non-contact biosignal detection apparatus for a single target. The bio-signal detecting apparatus for the plurality of targets comprises: a plurality of transmission antennas transmitting a chirp signal; a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving a reflective signal resulting from the chirp signal; a chirp signal generator for generating the chirp signal and transmitting the same to the plurality of transmitting antennas; a low noise amplifier which is positioned to be corresponded to a plurality of receiving antennas; an intermediate frequency signal generator for signal-converting having the intermediate frequency (IF); an analog to digital converter for converting the intermediate frequency signal into the digital signal; a digital front-end packetizing the transformed signal; an ADC buffer storing the packetized digital signal; a control unit performing the processing for determining the heart rate and respiratory rate of the plurality of subjects; and a communication unit for transmitting the data to the manager side through a communication network. According to the present invention, it is possible to overcome the limitations of conventional non-contact biometric signal detection apparatus for a single target, and to provide an efficient management service for a plurality of subjects.
abstract_ko: 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 장치 및 시스템이 개시된다. 상기 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 장치는, 소정의 공간 내에 위치하는 복수의 대상자들 측으로 처프(chirp) 신호를 송출하는 복수 개의 송신 안테나들과, 복수의 대상자들로부터 처프 신호에 기인한 반사 신호를 수신하는 복수 개의 수신 안테나들과, 처프 신호를 생성하여 복수 개의 송신 안테나들로 보내기 위한 처프 신호 발생부와, 복수 개의 수신 안테나들 각각에서 수신한 반사 신호에서 잡음을 제거하기 위해, 복수 개의 수신 안테나들 각각에 대응되게 위치한 저잡음 증폭기와, 저잡음 증폭기를 통과한 신호를 중간 주파수(IF)를 갖는 신호 변환하기 위한 중간 주파수 신호 생성부와, 중간 주파수 신호 생성부에 의해 변환된 중간 주파 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하기 위한 아날로그 디지털 컨버터와 디지털 신호를 저장하는 ADC 버퍼와, 처프 신호 발생부에서 연속적으로 주파수를 변화시키도록 제어하고, ADC 버퍼에 저장된 데이터를 수신하여 복수의 대상자들의 심박수 및 호흡수를 결정하기 위한 처리를 수행하는, 제어부와, 제어부에 의해 결정된 심박수 및 호흡수를 포함하는 데이터를 통신망을 통해 관리자 측으로 전송하기 위한 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Radar-based vital sign estimation
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating range data based on the received radar signals; detecting a target based on the range data; performing ellipse fitting on in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals associated with the detected target to generate compensated I and Q signals associated with the detected target; classifying the compensated I and Q signals; when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a first class, determining a displacement signal based on the compensated I and Q signals, and determining a vital sign based on the displacement signal; and when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a second class, discarding the compensated I and Q signals.

title_en: Systems and methods for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring using a radar unit centrally positioned within the cabint to obtain image data of the vehicle cabin and a processor to generate detect occupancy of seats within the vehicle cabin, categorize occupants, detect posture, determine seatbelt status and monitor life signs of the occupants. An output unit may execute responses appropriate to the status of occupants of the vehicle cabin.

title_en: Biological information acquisition device and biological information acquisition method
abstract_en: A biological information acquisition device (5) comprises a detected value acquisition unit (11) for acquiring a value detected by a noncontact biological sensor (3), a vital sign measurement unit (12) for measuring a vital sign of a subject (TP) by using the detected value, an image data acquisition unit (13) for acquiring image data on images captured by a camera (4), an image processing unit (14) for performing image processing on captured images including the subject (TP) to perform at least one of state estimation for estimating the state of the subject (TP), attribute estimation for estimating the attribute of the subject (TP), and personal identification for identifying the subject (TP), and a parameter setting unit (15) for setting a parameter in the measurement of the vital sign according to the result of the image processing.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Apparatus for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for battery-free measuring vital signs of a user from a single position near the user influenced by an alternating electric field provided by an electronic device. The apparatus includes a first electronic circuitry, a second electronic circuitry stacked to the first electronic circuitry, an instrumentation amplifier for amplifying the signals, an analog/digital converting logic circuit for generating digitized information, and a communication unit for communicating the digitized information. The first electronic circuitry includes a first electrode for receiving vital signals (acoustic, mechanical, electrical signals) from the user's body, a first shield unit for shielding the first electrode from electrical influences and influenced by the alternating electric field provided by the electronic device, a first rectifier for harvesting and rectifying the received alternating electric field from the first shield unit, further the first rectifier provides DC energy, a first buffer stores the DC energy and provides differential voltages, a first programmable operational amplifier amplifies the amplitude of the received vital signs powered by the received differential voltage from the first buffer.

title_en: System and method for rescuing a person buried alive
abstract_en: A system and method for rescuing a person buried alive, the system including a life sensor disposed inside a burial space for detecting presence of a living human person in the burial space, an oxygen container having an outlet into the burial space, an alarm to be activated upon detecting by the life sensor a living person, and a control unit adapted to perform, upon detection of human living by the life sensor, one or more of enabling the oxygen container to release oxygen into the burial space, and activating the alarm.

title_en: Apparatus, sensor system, electronic device and method
abstract_en: In accordance with an embodiment, a method includes receiving data indicating a receive signal of a sensor; processing the data by isolating a locally stationary signal component of the receive signal from at least one of a stochastic or a deterministic signal component of the receive signal; and determining a vital sign of a living being based on the isolated locally stationary signal component of the receive signal.

title_en: Antidetonation steel mesh thermal insulation wall body convenient to fitment is reformed transform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake-resistant steel mesh heat-insulating wall body convenient to decorate and reform, which relates to the technical field of building wall bodies and comprises a wall plate frame body, wherein a steel net rack b is arranged inside the wall plate frame body, the steel net rack b is fixedly connected with a steel net rack a through assembling bolts, heat-insulating layers are fixedly arranged on two side walls inside the wall plate frame body, a concrete layer is poured between the steel net rack a and the steel net rack b, fastening grooves are arranged on the surfaces of the heat-insulating layers at intervals, and fastening strips are fixedly connected on the outer side surfaces of the steel net rack a and the steel net rack b at intervals. According to the invention, the fastening strips are embedded in the fastening grooves in a matching manner, the steel mesh frame a and the steel mesh frame b are stably and tightly assembled in the wall plate frame body, and the concrete layer is poured between the steel mesh frame a and the steel mesh frame b, so that the anti-seismic performance and the anti-cracking performance of the wall body are improved, the safety and the reliability of the wall body are favorably improved, and the pre-buried arrangement of the wire pipes is facilitated.

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar imaging method, device, equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar imaging method, a device, equipment and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring through-wall radar echo signal sets acquired by a transmitting-receiving co-located antenna at a plurality of observation position points; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a through-wall radar echo signal set to remove echo signals of a fixed wall static background in the through-wall radar echo signal set, inputting the preprocessed through-wall radar echo signal set and preset tuning parameters into a preset low-rank sparse optimization algorithm to solve so as to extract echo signals of a target to be detected, and constructing an image of the target to be detected according to the echo signals of the target to be detected. The method effectively removes strong reflection of foreign matters such as pipelines or steel bars in the wall, enhances the through-wall radar image of the target behind the wall, and improves the imaging quality of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system based on data transmission
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire prevention monitoring system based on data transmission, which belongs to the technical field of data monitoring, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data transmission module, a warning module and a real environment assessment monitoring effect, wherein the data acquisition module is used for configuring a sensor to a target forest monitoring area and carrying out real-time monitoring to acquire original forest parameter data, the data processing module is used for preprocessing the original forest parameter data and then storing the preprocessed original forest parameter data into a first database, the data transmission module is used for detecting whether the edge equipment is connected with a receiver of a data transmission terminal on line or not by adopting a heartbeat detection mechanism and regularly transmitting the data, if yes, the first parameter data of the first database received by the receiver are standardized to acquire standard parameter data, and the warning module is used for predicting fire risk of the target forest monitoring area according to the historical parameter data and the standard parameter data and configuring the fire risk to the real environment assessment monitoring effect. The system improves monitoring, early warning and response efficiency, optimizes resource allocation and efficiently processes disaster conditions.

title_en: Insulation type distributing box layed underground
title_ko: 지중 매설용 절연형 배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an insulative distributing board to be buried underground. According to the present invention, a ceramic heater capable of dissipating heat is included in a closure part, which constitutes the distributing board. At the same time, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are installed in parallel in the closure part. An interspace between both sides of a door part is sealed by a sealing cover; a structure of a distributing hole is improved to arrange a ventilation hole. Therefore, water is prevented from permeating into the distributing board; electric leakage and short-circuit are prevented. According to the present invention, the inside of the insulative distributing board is maintained to be at a constant temperature and the humidity. Therefore, electric leakage or short-circuit caused by humidity and moisture, which permeates into the distributing board when it rains, are prevented in advance; accidents are prevented; and an electric shock accident is prevented when the short-circuit occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중 매설용 절연형 배전반에 관한 것으로, 배전반을 구성하는 함체부 내부에 발열기능을 하는 세라믹히터를 내장함과 동시에 온도센서 및 습도센서를 병행설치하고, 도어부의 양측 도어 경계면을 밀폐커버로 밀봉하며, 배전공 구조를 개선하여 통풍구를 마련함에 의해 침수를 막고, 누전이나 단락을 예방할 수 있게 된다. 
이와 같은 본 발명은 내부를 항상 일정한 온도와 습도를 유지하도록 건조시키기 때문에 수분이나 습기, 우천시 스며든 물기에 의한 누전이나 합선을 미연에 방지할 수 있게 되어 안전사고를 예방하고, 단락시에도 감전사고를 예방한다.

title_en: Robotic sense-through-wall sensor with simplified control interface
abstract_en: A system includes a self-propelled robotic vehicle carrying an UWB sensor. The UWB sensor responds to binary transitions of a mode control signal to select for its modes of operation.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Low-cost electromagnetic wave life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-cost electromagnetic wave life detection instrument which comprises a front-end radar system part and a back-end signal processor part. The front end radar system part is a small-sized handheld radar device. A transceiver module is arranged in the radar device and is provided with an emission antenna and two receiving antennas. The back-end signal processor part comprises a single chip microcomputer, a power circuit, a clock circuit, a reset circuit, a keyboard circuit and a display circuit. According to a signal processor of the electromagnetic wave life detection instrument, the single chip microcomputer is adopted to replace a DSP and an FPGA chip and is used as a main processing module, so that the production cost of the electromagnetic wave life detection instrument is greatly reduced. The signal processor of the electromagnetic wave life detection instrument is simple, feasible, low in cost, easy to popularize, capable of meeting common life rescue requirements. The electromagnetic wave life detection instrument can be popularized and utilized in the whole society through reduction of the production cost, so that Chinese disaster relief capacity can be improved.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection device
abstract_en: A non-contact vital sign detection device comprises an antenna module, a radar module, a control module, a display module and a power supply module; the radar module is connected with the antenna module and the control module, the display module is connected with the control module, and the power supply module is connected with the radar module, the control module and the display module. This novel life detection to stranded personnel in the calamity accident has accuracy, reliability scheduling problem, provides a novel non-contact vital sign detection device, and the device is through acquireing the radar data who carries stranded personnel heartbeat, breathing and micro-motion signal, can be accurate, effectual discernment stranded personnel vital sign condition to reach the purpose that stranded personnel vital sign detected accuracy and reliability in improving the calamity accident.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar, which belongs to the technical field of health monitoring, and particularly comprises an MCU module, a speaker module, a millimeter wave radar antenna board, a power supply module and a display screen, wherein the MCU module, the speaker module, the millimeter wave radar antenna board and the power supply module are arranged in a shell, and the display screen is arranged on the shell; the utility model adopts non-contact monitoring, has wide application range and simple and quick monitoring.
assignees: SHANXI GERUAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mechanical telescopic locking device applied to distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical telescopic locking device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection instruments, which comprises a telescopic device, wherein the telescopic device is of a U-shaped structure, two end parts of the telescopic device are respectively provided with a rotating device, the rotating devices are connected with the telescopic device through screws, the periphery of the bottom end of one rotating device is provided with a first radar unit, the periphery of the bottom end of the other rotating device is provided with a second radar unit, and the first radar unit and the second radar unit are connected with the rotating device through screws. According to the telescopic device, the three-section ball slide rail is arranged between the telescopic inner tube and the telescopic shell I and used for providing telescopic guidance for the telescopic inner tube and the telescopic shell I, the flexibility of telescopic is greatly improved, the adjustment is labor-saving and convenient, the telescopic device is extremely practical, and the locking switch is only required to be rotated to enable the locking switch to stretch into the clamping groove, so that the fixing operation of the telescopic device can be realized, and the telescopic device is extremely convenient and fast.

title_en: Post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system. The post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system includes ZigBee node detection devices, ZigBee routers, a ZigBee coordinator, a server and mobile terminals; the ZigBee nodes build a network; the ZigBee nodes are provided with the node detection devices; the node detection devices transmit acquired data to the local server; the local server marks the geographical locations of the ZigBee node detection devices on a map; the mobile terminals visit the server; and the mobile terminals obtain the geographical locations of ZigBee node detection devices which display life signs. According to the post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system, the ZigBee ad-hoc network is adopted as a core; the ZigBee nodes are scattered in the air; life signs are detected through infrared thermal release human body detection sensors and audio signal detection sensors on the nodes. The post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system has the advantages of low cost and high detection efficiency, and can assist in saving precious rescue time.

title_en: A kind of through-wall imaging radar target tracking method of dimension self-adaption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall imaging radar target tracking methods of dimension self-adaption, are related to through-wall radar technology, in particular to the target following technology of through-wall radar.This method uses time domain back projection imaging method, quickly obtains the radar image of better quality；Algorithm for image enhancement based on CF weighting processing can inhibit secondary lobe and noise, improve signal noise ratio (snr) of image；After obtaining target area using twin shaft projection algorithm, the track algorithm based on average drifting can effectively cope with the stronger human body target tracking of randomness；Target scale and angle estimating method based on image moment can accurately calculate target image scale and angle, and tracking accuracy and robustness can be improved.The present invention has real-time good, adaptable, the high advantage of tracking robustness.

title_en: Non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring system and a non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar; the monitoring system includes: the system comprises a millimeter wave transceiver module, a real-time signal acquisition module, a real-time signal processing module and a visualization module; the real-time signal processing module is used for extracting a respiratory signal and a heart rate signal through clutter suppression; the visualization module is used for carrying out waveform fitting on the respiration signal and the heart rate signal and displaying the position, the respiration and the heart rate of the testee in real time through a visualization interface. The invention effectively overcomes the influence of environmental noise through clutter suppression, and improves the precision of a monitoring system; in addition, fitting is carried out on the respiration signal and the heart rate signal through an iterative algorithm, and related waveforms and monitoring results are visually displayed.

title_en: Life monitoring intelligent bracelet capable of being worn by personnel independently through mobile mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a life monitoring intelligent bracelet, which is worn by a mobile mechanical arm by personnel independently and comprises a clamping mechanism and a detection mechanism, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a shell, a clamping jaw, a push rod and a reset piece, the clamping jaw and the push rod are arranged on the shell, the push rod is used for loosening the clamping jaw, the reset piece is used for keeping the clamping jaw in a clamping state, the detection mechanism comprises a fixing piece and a vital sign information sensor, the fixing piece is arranged on the lower side of the shell, and the vital sign information sensor is arranged on one side of the fixing piece, which is far away from the shell, and is arranged in the middle of the clamping jaw. According to the life monitoring intelligent bracelet, the bracelet is automatically worn on the wrist of a patient by the mobile mechanical arm, and the vital sign information of the patient is collected by the bracelet to perform diagnosis and classification, so that the accuracy of triage can be improved, the treatment rate of the patient can be improved, and the requirements on professional medical staff in emergency situations can be reduced.

title_en: A portable medical eqiupment for measuring physiological signal
title_ko: 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비
abstract_en: A portable medical device for measuring a physiological signal is provided to perform medial treatment by measuring the physiological signal quickly in an emergency situation. A portable medical device(100) includes a measuring device(20), a display device(40), and a mounting device(60). The measuring device includes a measuring module(22) and a communication module(24). The measuring module is composed of a sensor for measuring the physiological signal. The communication module transmits the physiological signal measured in the measuring module. The display device includes the communication module and a monitor. The communication module transmits and receives the physiological signal information and medical information from and to the communication module and a medical center in a remote place. The monitor displays the physiological signal information and the medical information. The measuring device and the display device are detachably mounted in the mounting device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급처치를 요하는 환자의 현재 신체상태를 측정하기 위한 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비를 제공한다. 이와 같은 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비는 신체의 각종 생체신호를 측정하는 측정기구와, 이를 모니터링하는 디스플레이기구들이 휴대용으로 이루어져 구급차량이나 휴대용 가방 등에 간편하게 탈부착될 수 있도록 함으로써 긴급한 상황이나 일반적인 의료장비의 설치 및 사용이 어려운 장소에서도 신속하게 생체신호를 측정하여 효과적인 의료 조치를 행할 수 있게 된다. 본 발명에 따른 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비는 신체의 생체신호가 측정되는 센서로 이루어진 측정모듈과, 상기 측정모듈로부터 생체신호를 전달받아 이를 송신하는 통신모듈이 케이싱에 설치되어 이루어지는 측정기구와; 측정기구의 통신모듈 및 원격지의 의료기관과 유무선으로 연결되어 생체신호 정보 및 의료정보를 송수신하는 통신모듈과, 통신모듈과 연결되어 생체신호 정보 및 의료정보를 표시하게 되는 모니터가 케이싱에 설치되어 이루어지는 디스플레이기구 및; 일측이 개방된 공간부가 측정기구의 케이싱과 디스플레이기구의 케이싱에 대응되게 각각 형성되어  측정기구 및 상기 디스플레이기구가 각각 탈부착이 가능하게 장착되는 장착기구를; 포함하여 이루어진다. 이와 같은 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비에서 장착기구의 공간부 측면을 이루는 고정면과, 장착기구의 고정면에 대응되는 측정기구의 케이싱 외측면 및 디스플레이기구의 케이싱 외측면에는 서로 요철관계를 이루며 착탈되는 고정구가 각 각 설치되어 고정구에 의해 측정기구와 디스플레이기구가 장착기구에 고정되게 된다.

title_en: Smart Respirator Protective Equipment
title_ko: 스마트 호흡기 보호구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart device for protecting a respiratory organ and, more specifically, to a smart device for protecting a respiratory organ capable of comprising a filter module for blocking fine particles and harmful gas, a light source module for improving identification of a wearer, a measuring module for measuring a state of the wearer, and quality of air, and a confirming module for confirming biological information and position information of the wearer; and providing high reliability. The smart device for protecting the respiratory organ comprises: the filter module; a biological signal sensor module; an acceleration sensor module; a position tracking module; the light source module; a speaker module; a wireless mobile communication module; and a detachable charging battery module. The filter module blocks inflow of the fine particles and the harmful gas to the inside of a human body through a mouth and a nose of the wearer. The biological signal sensor module senses and obtains a biological signal of the wearer. The acceleration sensor module senses a moving state or falling of the wearer. The position tracking module obtains moving position information of the wearer. The light source module is provided in one side of a front surface of the smart device for protecting the respiratory organ, is composed of a bundle of high-brightness LEDs, and identifies the wearer at a long distance. The speaker module is provided on one side of a side surface of the smart device for protecting the respiratory organ and generates an emergency warning sound. The wireless mobile communication module is provided on the one side of the side surface of the smart device for protecting the respiratory organ; and is connected to a commercial mobile communication network to transmit the biological signal of the wearer, a position change, and a position moving signal. The detachable charging battery module supplies power to the biological signal sensor module, the acceleration sensor module, the position tracking module, the light source module, the speaker module, and the wireless mobile communication module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트 호흡기 보호구에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 미세입자 및 유해가스를 차단하는 필터 모듈, 착용자의 식별성을 증대시키는 광원 모듈, 착용자 상태 및 공기의 질을 측정하는 모듈, 착용자의 생체정보 및 위치정보를 파악하는 모듈이 구비되는 고신뢰성의 스마트 호흡기 보호구를 구현하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 

본 발명에 따른 스마트 호흡기 보호구는 미세입자 및 유해가스가 착용자의 입과 코를 통해 인체 내부로 유입되는 것을 방지하기 위한 필터모듈; 상기 착용자의 생체신호를 감지하고 획득하는 생체신호 센서모듈; 상기 착용자의 이동상태 또는 낙상을 감지하는 가속도 센서모듈; 상기 착용자의 이동 위치정보를 획득하는 위치추적모듈; 상기 스마트 호흡기 보호구 전면부의 일측에 구비되며 다발 형태의 고휘도 발광 다이오드로 구성되어 원거리에서 상기 착용자를 식별하기 위한 광원모듈; 상기 스마트 호흡기 보호구 측면부의 일측에 구비되며, 긴급 경고음을 발생시키는 스피커모듈; 상기 스마트 호흡기 보호구 측면부의 일측에 구비되며, 상기 착용자의 생체신호와 위치변화 및 위치이동신호를 전송하기 위해서 상용 이동 통신망에 접속하는 무선이동통신모듈; 상기 생체신호 센서모듈, 상기 가속도 센서모듈, 위치추적모듈, 상기 광원모듈, 상기 스피커모듈 및 상기 무선이동통신모듈에 전원을 공급하기 위한 착탈식 충전 배터리모듈;로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Device for outputting simulated vital sign and operation method thereof
title_ko: 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호를 출력하는 디바이스 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a device for outputting a simulated vital sign to prevent an unauthorized external user from leaking personal information, such as a user's vital sign, and to reinforce security. The device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may: detect a UWB scanning pulse transmitted by an external device to measure a user's vital sign in a non-contact manner; if the UWB scanning pulse is detected, simulate a virtual person's vital sign to generate a virtual vital sign; and output simulated vital sign data including the vital sign and the virtual vital sign by using a UWB antenna.
abstract_ko: 허가되지 않은 외부 사용자에 의해 사용자의 생체 신호와 같은 개인 정보가 유출되는 것을 방지하고, 보안을 강화하기 위하여 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호를 출력하는 디바이스를 제공한다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 디바이스는 비접촉 방식(non-contact)으로 사용자의 생체 신호(vital sign)를 측정하기 위하여 외부 디바이스에 의해 송신된 UWB 스캐닝 펄스를 검출(detect)하고, UWB 스캐닝 펄스가 검출된 경우 가상 인물(virtual person)의 생체 신호를 시뮬레이션함으로써 가상 생체 신호(virtual vital sign)를 생성하고, UWB 안테나를 이용하여 생체 신호 및 가상 생체 신호를 포함하는 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호 데이터를 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content
abstract_en: A microwave stethoscope measurement method and sensor design employ a microwave transmission sensor and a microwave reception sensor placed on a patient's chest in spaced-apart side-by-side configuration for monitoring patient vital signs, lung water content and other critical measurements. The side-by- side sensors are spaced apart a separation distance of about 1-3 cm in lateral chest orientation. The sensors may be formed with a textile fabric for wearer comfort and to improve contact with the patient's skin. The microwave sensor measurements are digitally processed using a modified short time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrum windowed-averaged algorithm. Output data extracted from the microwave sensor measurements may be transmitted wirelessly to a mobile device such as a smartphone for remote monitoring of the patient's medical condition.

title_en: The automatic Fast measurement system of emission source Ground Penetrating Radar multiple offset distance data altogether
abstract_en: The automatic Fast measurement system of emission source Ground Penetrating Radar multiple offset distance data altogether, is related to Ground Penetrating Radar.Equipped with the automatic rapid measurement device of common emission source Coherent Noise in GPR Record, computer, radar host computer, measuring device is equipped with screw rod, fixing buckle, transmission nut, Ground Penetrating Radar transmitting antenna, Ground Penetrating Radar reception antenna and stepper motor；Transmitting antenna is fixed on screw rod both ends with stepper motor；Reception antenna is fixed on screw rod；Computer is connected by data cable with stepper motor and radar host computer, and stepper motor controls the position of Ground Penetrating Radar reception antenna by drving sprial bar；Radar host computer control transmitting antenna records reflection echo to underground medium radiated electromagnetic wave, and by reception antenna；Transmission nut is used for the position for being driven reception antenna；Screw rod is used for the movement for carrying reception antenna；Fixed transmitting antenna is used to radiate high-frequency electromagnetic wave pulse signal to underground medium；Reception antenna is used to receiving and gathering the echo-signal from buried target.

title_en: Non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the following steps: s1, scanning the upper body of a tester through an integrated radar sensor to obtain radar original data; s2, carrying out data preprocessing on the radar original data to obtain heartbeat data, breathing data and breathing heartbeat rate parameters of each window time; s3, positioning abnormal events according to the waveform change condition of the radar data, extracting relevant features, and judging respiratory obstruction and classifying and judging body movement events. The invention combines the monitoring of vital signs and the detection of apnea and falling events in body movement in the whole night with an alarm mechanism, is more suitable for sleep monitoring in household scenes, can generate more reliable sleep reports and reflects real sleep conditions.

title_en: Information transfer control method and equipment
title_ko: 정보 표시 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are an information display method and a device. According to the present invention, the information display method includes the steps of: measuring a current bio-signal using a sensor; determining stress signal information based on a comparison result of the current bio-signal measured by the sensor and a reference bio-signal used for detecting a stress signal; determining an information display setting according to the stress signal information; and outputting visual information and/or auditory information according to the information display setting. Accordingly, it is possible to determine tendency of a user's health state and a risk of the health state early by converting the bio-signals into a database.
abstract_ko: 정보 표시 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 개시에 따른 정보 표시 방법은, 센서를 이용하여 현재 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 상기 센서에 의하여 측정된 상기 현재 생체 신호와 스트레스 신호 감지에 사용되는 참조 생체 신호의 비교 결과에 기초하여, 스트레스 신호 정보를 결정하는 단계, 상기 스트레스 신호 정보에 따라 정보 표시 설정을 결정하는 단계, 및 상기 정보 표시 설정에 따라 시각 정보 및/또는 청각 정보를 출력하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Life detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a life detection radar which comprises at least three support rods with adjustable lengths, a support plate, a mounting seat, a life detection radar body, a first angle adjusting mechanism and a second angle adjusting mechanism, wherein the support rods are vertically arranged and surround to form a polygon; the supporting plates are horizontally fixed on the tops of the supporting rods; the mounting seat is arranged below the supporting plate, and the upper end of the mounting seat is rotatably arranged on the supporting plate; the life detection radar body is rotatably mounted at the lower end of the mounting seat, and the life detection radar body is provided with a scanning surface facing the ground. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the scanning range of the scanning surface when the life detection radar body is placed once can be enlarged, so that the detection blind area is reduced, the times of placing the life detection radar body are reduced, the labor intensity of search and rescue personnel is reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: A kind of object detection method suitable for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of object detection methods suitable for through-wall radar to obtain raw radar data by radar to objective emission signal wave, and pre-processes to raw radar data；Pulse compression is carried out by matched filter, static target is inhibited by mti filter, obtains moving target indication data；By Doppler filter group, Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target is obtained；Three-dimensional CFAR detection is first carried out to Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target, then testing result is clustered, identifies quantity and the position of aobvious moving-target；Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target is condensed, determines quantity and the position of target, three-dimensional CFAR detection then is carried out to the quantity that cohesion comes out, identifies fine motion target.The present invention separates aobvious moving-target and the testing process of fine motion target, provides different detection methods to improve the detection probability of target.
assignees: CHANGSHA SHENZHITONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic forest fire prevention warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fireproof warning devices, and discloses a telescopic forest fireproof warning device which comprises a rack, a telescopic device and a hydraulic system, wherein the telescopic device is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the rack, the hydraulic system is fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the rack, the rack is made of stainless steel, all frames are welded and connected, and the rack is integrally buried in soil. When the pedestrian passes through, the sensor receives pulse signal, make hydraulic system and telescoping device work, the warning sign rises and exceeds ground, the pedestrian just can see forest fire prevention warning sign, and disappear as pulse signal, under the effect of gravity, the warning sign can slowly descend back to the original position, can avoid the bad weather of strong wind and rainy, reduce the personal safety accident that probably takes place, the overall process does not need artifical the participation, can make the reaction fast when someone gets into the forest zone time, thereby time saving and labor saving, safe and reliable's effect has been reached.
assignees: FUZHOU YANGQING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel multi-functional intelligent fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel multifunctional intelligent fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle air-drop equipment part utilizes two motors to control the switching of the storing interlayer in the medical box and the opening and closing of the electrically operated gate respectively, and realizes the air-drop function. The medical detection device utilizes the health detection thermal infrared imager capable of self-adapting to the environment to find trapped people and detect sign information of the trapped people, and effective information is timely provided for medical staff rescue. The life detection device utilizes the change of the respiratory thorax of a human body to form a Doppler effect and feeds back the Doppler effect to the detector. The gas detection sensor utilizes a catalyst to perform flameless combustion, converts a heat signal into a differential pressure signal and sends the differential pressure signal to the singlechip. The high-temperature-resistant structure of the lithium battery is composed of a C/Ph composite heat-insulating material. Unmanned aerial vehicle buffer utilizes step motor to change the inertia of rotor, and the drive pulley is rotatory, realizes that low-power unmanned aerial vehicle ground traveles. The multi-functional fire control unmanned aerial vehicle that this patent provided can provide reliable helping hand for the fire control cause.

title_en: Health management intelligent system and human cardiopulmonary function signal monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health management, in particular to an intelligent health management system, which structurally comprises: a 24GHz CFK101A millimeter wave radar sensor, a waveform generator and an AD acquisition card are adopted to form a human body vital sign real-time monitoring system platform, wherein the human body vital sign real-time monitoring system is embedded with MATLAB script in a LabVIEW real-time data acquisition program for processing phase signals and real-time filtering radar signals, and the result obtained by the MATLAB script is returned to the LabVIEW; the intelligent terminal for health management of the elderly further comprises a control circuit board and a display screen, wherein a processor and a voltage stabilizing single-way unit are integrated on the control circuit board; the CFK101A millimeter wave radar sensor is internally provided with a CFK101A1T1R Kband radar chip and a VCO oscillator. The invention provides a health management intelligent system which can realize household intelligent monitoring of daily breathing and heart rate of the elderly, and achieves heart and lung function health management.
assignees: YIHUIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Wall clutter suppression method based on DPSS dictionary and block self-adaptive subspace tracking
abstract_en: The invention provides a wall clutter suppression method based on a DPSS dictionary and a block self-adaptive subspace tracking. Aiming at the problems that the through-wall clutter suppression method needs more priori and is suitable for single radar system, the invention firstly utilizes the characteristics of time-frequency truncation and strong energy aggregation capability of the DPSS dictionary to effectively characterize the expansion target of the wall body, and avoids the priori requirement on the relevant parameters of the wall body. And then, the backtracking characteristic of the subspace tracking algorithm and the characteristic of simultaneously iterating a plurality of atoms are utilized to realize the accurate reconstruction of wall clutter, avoid the prior limitation of the wall clutter range and realize single-channel processing to be popularized to multiple radar systems such as SAR, MIMO and the like. And the efficiency of the reconstruction algorithm is improved by utilizing the blocking characteristic of the DPSS dictionary, and the sparseness prior required by the reconstruction algorithm is avoided by combining with the self-adaptive iteration. And finally, accurately reconstructing the wall clutter, and subtracting the original echo to complete wall clutter suppression.

title_en: Reverse pushing method simulated submarine landslide impact pipeline model test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a reverse pushing method for simulating submarine landslide impact pipeline model test device and a test method. The size of the model device is effectively controlled by reversely pushing the pipeline impact slope through a reverse pushing method, unexpected sliding impact force errors are avoided, and the difficulty that the shape and sliding trend of the traditional sliding surface are difficult to quantitatively control is overcome; the thrust magnitude, deflection and bending moment distribution rules of the pipeline can be obtained by measuring the values of the axial force sensor between the jack and the push rod and the strain gage at different positions on the pipeline, so that the feedback of the effect of the submarine landslide impact on the buried pipeline is determined, and a reference basis is provided for the design of submarine pipelines.

title_en: Non-contact respiration detection method based on CSI dynamic component rapid alignment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of respiration monitoring, and discloses a non-contact respiration detection method based on rapid alignment of a CSI dynamic component, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting wireless signal data transmitted by a WiFi transmitter in an indoor environment, and extracting CSI original data from the WiFi signal; secondly, carrying out data preprocessing on the original CSI data to obtain a CSI ratio signal, removing static components and reducing noise; then, calculating a covariance matrix of the preprocessed data, obtaining a main direction by using a characteristic value decomposition method, and then calculating an included angle between the main direction and the positive direction of the I axis; then, calculating the angle of the alignment CSI ratio signal to be rotated according to the polarity of the CSI ratio signal sample sum; finally, all CSI ratio signal enhancement dynamic components are combined to extract breathing patterns. The method solves the problem that the target is far away from the WiFi equipment, so that the breath cannot be detected, and improves the sensing range of the WiFi signal for detecting the breath.

title_en: Full-period electrocardiogram acquisition and diagnosis auxiliary system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health monitoring and management, and discloses a full-period electrocardiogram acquisition and diagnosis auxiliary system based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises a hardware acquisition and real-time signal processing module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the hardware acquisition and real-time signal processing module is used for acquiring vital sign data of a user through the millimeter wave radar and a multi-mode sensor and preprocessing an acquired original signal; the system comprises a crowd classification and feature modeling module, an edge calculation and real-time monitoring module and a monitoring module, wherein the crowd classification and feature modeling module classifies according to information and acquired data input by a user and builds personalized health portraits, and the edge calculation and real-time monitoring module is used for extracting electrocardiosignals and other vital sign data in real time and monitoring abnormal events. The hardware acquisition and real-time signal processing module for acquiring vital sign data by the millimeter wave radar and the multi-mode sensor and the technical scheme for dynamically updating the health portrait by combining the user classification realize high-precision and multi-dimensional acquisition and personalized management of the user health data.

title_en: an assembly system for fire-insulation materials
title_ko: 내화 충전재 결합구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a structure for installation of fireproof filling materials, which are buried in a penetrating-hole formed in an inter-floor slab or a wall between adjacent rooms in a building to prevent flames and smoke from quickly spreading to the next floor or room in case of fire. Especially, pipes installed in a high-rise building in Korea are connected through penetrating-holes of each floor. However, it is practically impossible to place a pipe in the dead center of a penetrating-hole such that the pipe is placed eccentrically with respect to the penetrating-hole and a space formed by the pipe and the penetrating-hole has an indeterminate shape. A fireproof filling material installed to fill the indeterminate space has a sponge function to be easily applicable to the indeterminate space and has characteristics to suppress the heat of flames and the passage of smoke in case of fire. An existing fireproof foam pad (11), having the characteristics and usage as a fireproof filling material (1), is used since it is a conventional concept of a prior art product. The products high density and specific gravity, and lack of elasticity make product prone to breakage when applied to the penetrating-hole, a distinctive feature of a Korean building. When reducing the density and specific gravity to resolve the issue, the product shows structural weakness in sealing and thermal conduction performance. To solve these issues, the present invention provides a high-performance fireproof filling material having a composite structure in which a thermally expanding curtain with good thermal expansion is added to a fireproof foam pad, which can be conveniently applied to distinctive Korean buildings and remarkably improve the performance of the existing product.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물에 있어 층간 슬래브층 혹은 인접실 간의 벽체에 형성하는 관통구에 매설되어 화재 발생시 화염과 연기가 층간 또는 인접실로 급속히 퍼지는 것을 방지하기 위해 설치하는 내화충전재 설치구조에 관한 것이다. 
특히 국내 고층 건물에 설치하는 배관은 각층별 관통구를 통하여 연결되는데 이때 파이프가 관통구의 정중앙에 위치하는 것이 현실적으로 불가하여 관통구에 배관의 위치는 편심을 이루고 이로 인하여 이들이 이루는 공간은 부정형이므로 이를 메우도록 설치하는 내화 충전재는 부정형의 공간에 적응이 용이하도록 스펀지 기능을 가지도록 하고 화재 발생시 화염의 높은 열과 연기가 통과하는 것을 억제 지연하도록 하는 성질을 가지고 있다. 
이와 같은 성질을 가지고 내화 충진재(1)로 사용되는 방화 폼 패드(11)가 종래의 것이 외국의 선행 제품의 개념을 차용한 제품을 사용하다 보니 밀도와 비중이 높고 보다 경질의 특성으로 인하여 국내의 건축 특성인 관통구에 적용하기에는 탄력성이 부족하고 쪼개지는 현상이 많으며 이를 극복하고자 밀도와 비중이 낮으면 결국 밀폐성과 열전도성에 구조적인 문제를 보이는 점이 있어 이를 개선하고자 방화 폼 패드에 열팽창성이 우수한 열팽창 커튼을 첨부하는 복합 구조를 이루어 성능이 상승한 내화 충진재로 국내 건축 특성에 편리하게 적용하고 동시에 기존의 제품의 성능을 획기적으로 개선할 수 있도록 하려는 것이다.

title_en: Implantable device based on smartphone control
title_ko: 스마트폰 제어 기반의 임플랜터블 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an implantable device based on smartphone control which comprises: a bio-signal collecting unit which collects a bio-signal related to a user's disease through an implant bio-sensor inserted into a living body, performs pre-processing according to the type of the bio-signal, and receives the bio-signal which is pre-processed an emergency disease response unit; primarily analyzing the pre-processing bio-signal to determine the necessity of emergency response of the user disease, and if so, providing an emergency disease response module instructing the implant bio-sensor to respond to an emergency disease to a user terminal; and a chronic disease corresponding part which secondarily analyzes the pre-processing performance bio-signal and determines the chronic response necessity of the user disease and if so, provides the chronic disease corresponding module directing the chronic disease correspondence to the implant biosensor to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰 제어 기반의 임플랜터블 장치에 관한 것으로, 생체 내에 삽입된 임플란트 생체 센서를 통해 사용자 질환과 연관된 생체신호를 수집하고 상기 생체신호의 유형에 따른 전처리를 수행하여, 전처리 수행 생체신호를 수신하는 생체신호 수집부; 상기 전처리 수행 생체신호를 1차적으로 분석하여 상기 사용자 질환의 긴급대응 필요성을 결정하고 그렇다면 상기 임플란트 생체 센서에 긴급 질환대응을 지시하는 긴급 질환대응 모듈을 사용자 단말에 제공하는 긴급질환 대응부; 및 상기 전처리 수행 생체신호를 2차적으로 분석하여 상기 사용자 질환의 만성대응 필요성을 결정하고 그렇다면 상기 임플란트 생체 센서에 만성 질환대응을 지시하는 만성 질환대응 모듈을 상기 사용자 단말에 제공하는 만성질환 대응부;를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV KOOKMIN IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject. A radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of arrays of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A phase vaue is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing phase changes over time for each voxel is generated. Voxels indicating an oscillating signal are selected and life sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: Systems and methods for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring using a radar unit positioned within the cabin to obtain image data of the vehicle cabin, a beam deflector for deflecting electromagnetic waves into obstructed regions of the cabin and a processor to generate detect occupancy of seats within the vehicle cabin, categorize occupants, detect posture, determine seatbelt status and monitor life signs of the occupants.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and an operating method thereof. The search and rescue robot consists of three parts, namely a head part, a body part and a tail part, wherein the three parts are connected together through a connecting mechanism; the head part is provided with a life detection device, a driving device, a control device, a power device, a communication device, a camera and an infrared device; the body part and the tail part are provided with a driving device, a control device and a power device; each part consists of a plurality of joints; a deformation mechanism is a structure which is used for supporting in the joints; the joints are connected together through the driving device; and the outer surface of the entire robot is covered by a flexible fabric skin layer. The robot is suitable for executing detection tasks of living bodies under ruin environments of earthquake, coal mine disasters and the like; the robot can also enter a narrow space in ruins through deformation of the robot to detect life information; and thus, the search and rescue range of the robot is expanded, the rescue efficiency is increased, and valuable time is brought for rescuing more lives.

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar device
