abstract_en: The invention discloses a hand-held through-the-wall radar device, which belongs to the field of radars and comprises a radar host, a charger and a charging cable; the radar host comprises an antenna module, a radio frequency module, a signal processing and display control module, a charge-discharge module and a shell; after the radar host is powered on, the charging module provides required voltage for the radio frequency module and the signal processing and display control module through voltage conversion, when the signal processing and display control module receives the detection key information, the radio frequency module is controlled to generate radar signals, the radar signals are emitted through an antenna, the antenna module receives echo signals and sends the echo signals to the signal processing and display control module after being processed by the radio frequency module, and target information is displayed again after being processed by an algorithm; the handheld through-wall radar has the advantages of small volume, light weight, large effective detection range, high sensitivity and high precision, and meanwhile, the handheld through-wall radar has the advantages of multi-target detection and tracking and high anti-interference capability.

title_en: Underground hidden defect simulation detection system and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground hidden defect simulation detection system and a detection method thereof, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the sector ring tunnel comprises two shield tunnel segments; the ground penetrating radar assembly comprises a radar slide rail and a ground penetrating radar, the radar slide rail is arranged on the inner side of the sector ring tunnel, and the ground penetrating radar is arranged on the radar slide rail; the defect simulation assembly is positioned at the outer side of the fan-shaped annular tunnel and comprises a first side wall, a second side wall and a bottom surface, a cavity is formed among the first side wall, the second side wall, the bottom surface and the fan-shaped annular tunnel, quartz sand is filled in the cavity, a plurality of pipelines are buried in the quartz sand, mortar is laid on one side, far away from the cavity, of the first side wall, and a plurality of drilling holes are formed in the second side wall; and the signal processing component is used for processing radar echo signals received by the ground penetrating radar and determining radar signal characteristics. The method can accurately analyze the hidden defect type after shield tunnel segment through defect simulation and radar echo signal processing, and can be widely applied to the technical field of radar detection.

title_en: Identification sensor for works buried at great depth
User authentication method and system via the skin impedence recognition in the bio-electrical signal measurement environment using wearable sensors
title_ko: 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 (1) 피부 임피던스 측정부가 사용자의 피부 임피던스를 측정하는 단계; (2) 통신부가 상기 단계 (1)에서 측정된 피부 임피던스를 인증부로 전송하는 단계; 및 (3) 인증부가 상기 단계 (2)에서 전송된 피부 임피던스를 미리 저장된 사용자 데이터와 비교하여 사용자를 인증하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템에 따르면, 개인별로 차이가 나는 피부 임피던스를 전극 센서를 이용하여 측정하고, 이를 사용자 인증 도구로 사용함으로써, 웨어러블 센서로 생체 신호를 측정하는 환경에서 생체 신호 측정 대상이 되는 사용자를 간편하고 편리하며 정확하게 인증할 수 있다.

title_en: Blood pressure waveform measuring sensor and blood pressure measuring device
title_ko: 혈압 파형 측정센서 및 그의 혈압 측정장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혈압 파형과 같은 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 그리고 이러한 센서가 구비되어 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정장치를 제안한다. 본 발명에서 측정 센서는, 그라운드(Ground)로 작용하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 메탈 시트, 상기 제1 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 절연체, 상기 제1 절연체 하부에 위치하며 패치로 작용하는 제2 메탈 시트, 상기 제2 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하는 제2 절연체, 및 상기 홀을 관통하며 끝 단은 상기 제2 메탈 시트와 접촉하는 신호 핀을 포함하여 구성된다. 그리고 상기 신호 핀을 통해 전자기장이 급전되면 상기 제2 메탈 시트에 형성되는 임피던스를 측정하여 혈압 파형을 센싱한다.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior spaces and exterior spaces which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna ( 1 ). The antenna ( 1 ) is connected to an electronic circuit ( 2, 3, 4, 31, 32 ) which is able to decode the changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field by means of a processor ( 7 ) enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding the antenna ( 1 ) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: A kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot, including：The pedrail mechanism of left and right two, 4 DC speed-reducings, the chassis being connected between two pedrail mechanisms in left and right；The chassis and the junction of two crawler belts in the left and right are provided with downwardly projecting part；The DC speed-reducing is bolted and the downwardly projecting part；The chassis lower surface is provided with multiple sensors, microcontroller, image transmission system；The chassis upper surface is provided with double mechanical arms mechanism.The long-range execute-in-place of the utility model by more ensure rescue personnel safety and machinery flexibility ratio；The utility model manipulator realizes the various motion such as shearing, broken, cutting, expansion, crawl after replacing.The utility model also has life detection function.

title_en: Anti-deformation prefabricated direct-buried engineering pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prefabricated direct-burried engineering pipeline of preapring for an unfavorable turn of events shape, including the inner tube, the heat preservation has been cup jointed to the inner tube outer wall, the heat preservation outer wall has cup jointed the sleeve pipe, the sleeve pipe outer wall is equipped with the rubber tube, be equipped with a plurality of spring preforming between rubber tube and the sleeve pipe, spring preforming one side and sleeve pipe fixed connection, the first spring of fixedly connected with between spring preforming and the sleeve pipe. The utility model discloses a connecting pipe passes through the screw nail with the installed part and is connected with first screw hole, screw and second screw hole threaded connection, internal thread and external screw thread threaded connection combination use, wherein the spring preforming and the first spring combination of sheathed tube outer wall, the inner tube is made by stainless steel material, strengthen the firm and the corrosion resistance of pipeline, the heat preservation is made by polyurethane foam, the resistance to compression takes precautions against earthquakes, heat-resisting heat preservation, the cellucotton is made by inorganic fiber cotton, thermal insulation performance is good, stability is stronger, the resistance to compression of combatting earthquake prevents that liquid punching press from leading to the pipeline to break or the pipeline.
assignees: LIAONING HUAYANG PIPELINE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Small non-contact human body vital sign detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a small non-contact human body vital sign detection device, which comprises a signal processing and transmitting module, a binary power divider, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, an amplitude-phase comparator, a terminal module and a wireless module; the signal processing and transmitting module is used for transmitting a microwave signal with set frequency; the power divider is used for receiving microwave signals and dividing the microwave signals into two paths, one path is transmitted through a transmitting antenna, and the other path of signals is transmitted to the amplitude-phase comparator; the receiving antenna is used for receiving the reflected modulation signal and sending the modulation signal to the amplitude-phase comparator; the amplitude-phase comparator is used for comparing the amplitude difference and the phase difference of the two paths of signals and sending the signals to the signal processing and transmitting module, and the signal processing and transmitting module respectively sends the signals to the terminal module for displaying and sends the signals to the wireless module for uploading to the cloud. The device has the advantages of detecting the vital signs of the human body in a non-contact manner, extracting the respiration heartbeat signal, visualizing the data and reducing the complexity of the system and the data processing difficulty.

title_en: Three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar device, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall detection radar, and structurally comprises a shell, wherein a direction changing component is vertically arranged at the upper end of a cavity of the shell, a three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body is arranged on the top surface of the direction changing component, a plurality of sucker legs are obliquely arranged at four sides of the rear end of the shell, a controller and a battery are arranged in the cavity of the lower end of the shell, an operation panel is arranged on the front side of the shell, so that the three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body can directly pass through a wall to detect an object right in front of the rear side of the wall after being adsorbed and fixed on the wall by the four sucker legs, and a swinging component is driven by a rotator to rotate, so that the left and right visual angles of the three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body can be enlarged, the detection visual angles of the three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body after passing through the wall can be enlarged, and the through-wall detection area is promoted, and the practicability is strong.

title_en: Wireless sensing network system and method for searching and rescuing trapped persons
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a wireless sensing network system and a method for searching and rescuing the trapped persons. The wireless sensing network system is composed of a physical sign data acquisition sensor node, a wireless positioning device based on an RSSI value, a Sink node and a terminal display device. The physical sign data acquisition sensor node processes the acquired physical sign data and then transmits the data to the Sink node by a multi-hop routing, the Sink node then sends the data to a system terminal via other basic supporting networks, at the same time, a wireless positioning system calculates the relative position of a to-be-positioned node according to the position of a reference positioning node of the wireless positioning system and transmits the coordinate information of the relative position to the Sink node via a wireless coordinator, and the Sink node calculates the absolute position of a mobile node by combining the relative coordinate with the absolute position of the reference positioning node, and transmits the absolute position of the mobile node to the mobile terminals of the rescue personnel, so that the rescue personnel can determine the concrete position of the buried life accurately and rapidly.

title_en: Behind-wall human body target self-adaptive indication method of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a behind-wall human body target self-adaptive indication method of a through-wall radar. According to the invention, for the background of each data point of echo signals, the historical pulse data of the optical length is selected for estimation, and the SCR of each data point after clutter inhibition reach the maximum, so that the problem of a routine behind-wall human body target indication method fails to be adapted to targets different in moving types is successfully solved, and the adaptation of the through-wall radar to the human body target different in moving types is improved; in addition, the method is low in calculation amount, high in execution efficiency, suitable for the detection of the human body target different in moving types by the through-wall radar, and capable of effectively improving the working efficiency of the through-wall radar.
assignees: HUNAN TAIKANG ELECTRONIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Biont information is extracted to alarm switch control device and method using bioradar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to extract and utilize technical field to Biont information is contactless, disclose it is a kind of extract Biont information to alarm switch control device and method using bioradar, detected respectively by organism breathing that bioradar is extracted and restored simultaneously, heartbeat waveform；According to testing result, it provides a variety of logical combination level to export as alarm level, user selects the driving alarm switch movement of respective logic level as needed.The present invention is not required to object to be monitored in such a way that the vital sign for detecting organism carries out switch control by bioradar and issues the sound and move, it is not influenced by use environment temperature and thermal objects, and since bioradar wave energy effectively penetrates a variety of media (a variety of non-metal articles such as rain, mist, clothing, paper, plastics), so the problem that detection switch fails caused by stopping because of each type objects and rate of false alarm is high is also minimized.

title_en: Through-wall radar human behavior identification method and device based on multilink information decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying human body behaviors of a through-wall radar based on multilink information decision, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of a through-wall radar human behavior echo, and preprocessing the original image; the first link is used for carrying out Bayesian statistical judgment on the characteristics of the micro-Doppler signals to obtain a first link identification result; the second link is used for acquiring the local characteristics of the visual layer from the processed image to obtain a second link identification result; the third link is used for acquiring global features of a visual layer from the processed image, namely, the processed image is classified by a residual neural network introducing an attention mechanism to obtain a third link identification result; and fusing the first link identification result, the second link identification result and the third link identification result to obtain a final identification result. The invention realizes the identification of high accuracy and high information utilization rate under the severe conditions of fuzzy radar imaging, low signal-to-noise ratio and the like.

title_en: Human body breathing and heartbeat detection method based on improved BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of radar signal processing, in particular to a human breath and heartbeat detection method based on an improved BP neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out wavelet denoising treatment on an original vital signal acquired by a radar, then utilizing an improved self-adaptive fully integrated empirical mode decomposition (ICEEMDAN) algorithm to decompose the radar original thoracic signal to obtain a plurality of modal functions (IMFs) with different spatial scales, and then predicting and optimizing IMF components through the BP neural network improved by an immune Genetic Algorithm (GA); the invention has good noise robustness, can effectively separate noise and accurately extract respiratory and heartbeat signals, and improves the reconstruction accuracy and the signal-to-noise ratio of the sign signals.

title_en: FMCW radar non-contact vital sign extraction method based on MFO-SVMD algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an FMCW radar non-contact vital sign extraction method based on an MFO-SVMD algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1: an FMCW radar is arranged, a transmitting antenna continuously transmits continuous wave signals with continuously variable frequencies, and a receiving antenna receives echo signals reflected by a human body; s2: after receiving the echo signal, preprocessing the echo signal to obtain a phase differential signal containing vital sign information; s3: performing MFO-SVMD decomposition on the obtained phase difference signal to obtain a plurality of modal components including respiratory heartbeat signal components; s4: and calculating the variance contribution rate of each modal component obtained by decomposition, and carrying out signal screening according to the variance contribution rate of the respiratory heartbeat signal, so as to obtain the required respiratory and heartbeat signals. The method has the advantages of high precision and good real-time performance, overcomes the limitation that the traditional vital sign instrument needs to be worn, avoids the risk of cross infection, and has wider applicability.
assignees: SHENZHEN LIANRUI MAITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote Vital signs Detection Sensor
title_ko: 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote vital signs detection sensor. The prior art is a method of detecting a bio signal by confirming a position of a person and transmitting a signal in a corresponding direction. Therefore, in order to detect the bio signal of the person continuously moving in a space, the direction of the signal should be continuously changed, and it may be difficult to detect a bio signal of a person who is not continuously located in a specific direction and moves away. Accordingly, there is a problem in that accuracy of the detected bio signal can be reduced. The purpose of the present invention is to provide the remote bio signal detection sensor capable of accurately detecting the bio-signal of the person. A remote bio signal detection sensor according to a preferable embodiment of the present invention includes: an antenna unit for radiating a frequency signal to the outside and receiving a reflected high frequency signal which is reflected from an object; and a control unit which analyzes the bio signal based on a change pattern of the received reflected high frequency signal. The present invention can accurately extract the detected bio signal. In addition, accurate bio signal information enables quick and accurate identification of emergency situations such as myocardial infarction, and enables a quick action against personal abnormalities such as death of the elderly living alone.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서에 관한 것이다. 종래 기술은 사람의 위치를 확인하고 해당 방향으로 신호를 보내어 생체 신호를 감지하는 방식이다. 따라서, 연속적으로 공간을 이동하는 사람의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위해서는 연속적으로 신호의 방향을 변경해야 하며 특정 방향에 지속적으로 위치하지 않고 이동하여 벗어난 사람의 생체 신호는 감지가 어려울 수 있다. 이에 의해 감지된 생체 신호는 정확성이 떨어질 수 있는 문제점이 있다. 본 발명은 사람의 생체 신호를 정확하게 감지할 수 있는 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서는 주파 신호를 외부로 방사하고, 대상물에 반사되어 되돌아온 반사 고주파 신호를 수신하는 안테나부; 및 수신된 상기 반사 고주파 신호의 변화 패턴을 기반으로 생체 신호를 분석하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다. 본 발명은 감지된 생체 신호를 정확하게 추출할 수 있다. 또한 정확한 생체 신호 정보는 심근경색 등의 위급 상황을 신속하고 정확하게 알 수 있으며 독거노인 고독사와 같은 신변 이상에 대하여 빠르게 조치를 취할 수 있다.

title_en: Control method and system of electrical wheel-chair for autonomous moving
title_ko: 전동휠체어의 자율주행 제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An autonomous driving control system for an electric wheelchair comprises an electric wheelchair that is configured to autonomously drive to a first destination within or outside a certain space while monitoring the health status of an occupant through at least one bio-signal sensor and a central server that manages a CCTV installed inside and outside the space. The central server comprises: a detection unit that detects location-specific environmental information inside and outside the certain space from location-specific image information of the CCTV; a communication unit that transmits map information inside and outside the certain space and the environmental information to the electric wheelchair and receives emergency information of the occupant from the electric wheelchair when the health status of the occupant is an emergency; and an emergency processing unit that selects second destination information where emergency treatment can be performed based on the emergency information and transmits the second destination to the electric wheelchair. The electric wheelchair moves autonomously by setting a first route to the first destination based on the map information and the environmental information, and when the second destination information is received, the electric wheelchair moves autonomously by setting a second route from the current location to the second destination. Accordingly, the system enables immediate patient transfer.
abstract_ko: 상기한 본 발명의 목적을 실현하기 위한 일 실시예에 따른 전동휠체어의 자율주행 제어 시스템에 있어서, 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호 센서를 통해 탑승자의 건강 상태를 모니터링하면서, 일정 공간 내외부의 제1 목적지까지 자율주행하도록 구성된 전동휠체어, 및 상기 일정 공간 내외부에 설치된 CCTV를 관리하는 중앙 서버를 포함하고, 상기 중앙 서버는, 상기 CCTV의 위치별 영상 정보로부터 상기 일정 공간 내외부의 위치별 환경정보를 감지하는 감지부, 상기 전동휠체어에 상기 일정 공간 내외부의 맵(map) 정보와 상기 환경정보를 송신하고, 탑승자의 건강 상태가 응급 상황인 경우, 상기 전동휠체어로부터 탑승자의 응급 상황 정보를 수신하는 통신부, 및 상기 응급 상황 정보에 기초하여, 응급 처치가 이루어질 수 있는 제2 목적지 정보를 선정하여 상기 전동휠체어에 송신하는 응급상황 처리부를 포함하고, 상기 전동휠체어는 상기 맵 정보와 상기 환경정보에 기초하여 제1 목적지까지의 제1 경로를 설정하여 자율주행으로 이동되고, 상기 제2 목적지 정보가 수신되면, 현재 위치로부터 상기 제2 목적지까지의 제2 경로를 재설정하여 자율주행으로 이동된다.

title_en: Smart safety device system based on thermal sensor
title_ko: 열상센서기반 스마트안전 디바이스 시스템
abstract_en: The smart safety device system includes: a thermal imaging sensor for detecting an object in a detection area requiring privacy protection; a vibration detection sensor for detecting the vibration level in the detection area; a respiration detection sensor for detecting a breathing pattern of an object when the object detected by the thermal imaging sensor is a person; a smart hub for relaying data between the thermal imaging sensor, the vibration detection sensor, and the respiration detection sensor and an analysis server; and an analysis server for receiving detection data of the vibration detection sensor, detection data of the respiration detection sensor, and images captured by the thermal imaging sensor, respectively, and detecting a set movement pattern of a preset object by applying a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to determine an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 스마트안전 디바이스 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 열상감지 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 열상감지 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 열상감지 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 열상감지 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: Buried pipe detector using underground detection radar and wireless headphones
title_ko: 지중 탐지 레이더와 무선 헤드폰을 활용한 매립 배관 탐지기
abstract_en: The idea proposes a buried pipe detector developed to accurately detect pipes buried in the ground and prevent pipe damage. This idea is attached to the excavator bucket and integrates underground detection radar (gpr) and wireless headphones to deliver piping location information to the excavator pilot in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 아이디어는 지중에 매립된 배관을 정확하게 탐지하고 배관 훼손을 예방하기 위해 개발된 매립 배관 탐지기를 제안한다. 이 아이디어는 굴착기 버킷에 부착되며 지중 탐지 레이더(GPR)와 무선 헤드폰을 통합하여 배관 위치 정보를 실시간으로 굴착기 조종사에게 전달한다.

title_en: System for automatically classifying sleep stages on the basis of biosignals
title_ko: 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for automatically classifying sleep stages on the basis of biosignals for predicting sleep stages using mutually different biosignals. For this purpose, the present invention relates to a system for automatically classifying sleep stages on the basis of biosignals, comprising: a biosignal detection unit using EEG, EOG, EMG, PPG, SKT, and GSR sensors to acquire various biosignals through mutually different channels; a signal-processing and characteristic extraction unit using a method suitable for extracting the characteristics of each biosignal to process the various biosignals acquired through each channel by the biosignal detection unit, and extract a certain characteristic from each of the biosignals; a subset-generating unit for generating biosignal groups based on the certain characteristics of each biosignal extracted by the signal-processing and characteristic extraction unit; and a performance evaluation unit for classifying the biosignals into sleep stage categories (i.e. REM, LS, and DS) using the biosignal groups formed by the subset-generating unit, and analyzing a performance evaluation of the groups for each stage, wherein for the analysis of sleep stages using mutually different biosignals, sleep stages can be accurately and conveniently predicted through the combination of biosignals in order to enable accurate measurement and convenience.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템에 관한 것으로, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용하여 수면 단계를 예측하기 위한 것이다. 이를 위하여 본 발명은 EEG, EOG, EMG, PPG, SKT, GSR 센서를 이용하여 서로 다른 채널을 통해 다양한 생체 신호를 획득하는 생체신호 검출부, 생체신호 검출부에서 각 채널을 통해 획득된 다양한 생체신호를 각 생체신호의 특징 추출에 적합한 방법으로 신호 처리를 실시하여 각각의 생체신호로부터 각 생체신호의 특징을 나타내는 특징점을 추출하는 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부, 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부의 각 생체신호에 대한 특징점을 기준으로 생체신호 조합을 생성하는 서브셋 발생부, 및 서브셋 발생부에서 조합된 생체신호 조합을 통하여 수면단계(REM,LS,DS)를 분류하고, 각 단계에 따른 조합의 성능 평가를 분석하는 성능 평가부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템을 제공하여, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용한 수면 단계 분석시 측정의 정확도와 편리성을 고려한 최적의 생체신호 조합으로 수면 단계를 정확하고 편리하게 예측할 수 있게 한다.
assignees: UNIV YONSEI IACF;YOO SEON KOOK;LEE CHUNG KI

title_en: Apparatus for the detection and classification of buried unexploded ordnance
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting buried metal objects such as unexploded ordnance and the collection of data for the classification of the detected objects based on parameters extracted from the collected data includes a wheeled cart, positioned on which is an array of transmitter coils for transmitting a series of excitation signals onto the area of interest and a sensor array of receiver coils and preamplifiers for receiving back the resultant eddy current decays emitted by the buried objects, a computer, and data acquisition electronics for acquiring and storing the received decays as decay data within the computer. The incoming EMI data are digitized and a data fitting process is performed to extract fit location and shape parameters. These data can be transferred to other data analysis systems for comparison to previously recorded signatures to determine whether the received decay data from the area of interest is attributable to buried metal objects or conversely to an object constituting an anomaly.
assignees: US GOVERNMENT;NELSON HERBERT H;STEINHURST DANIEL A;HARBAUGH GLENN R;BELL THOMAS H

title_en: Method and system for monitoring vital body signs of a seated person
abstract_en: A method comprising the step of using a plurality of doppler radars disposed on the seat belt or integrated into the seat belt for monitoring vital body signs of a person seated in a seat of a motor vehicle is disclosed. The disclosed method unobtrusively monitors vital body signs like heart rate and respiration of the person seated in the motor vehicle. A number of safety applications as well as wellness applications can be enabled. Examples are detection of momentary sleep of the driver, vital sign monitoring in case of an accident as well as relaxation exercise using biofeedback to reduce stress for drivers.
assignees: KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV;PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;THIJS JEROEN ADRIANUS JOHANNES;MUEHLSTEFF JENS;PINTER ROBERT

title_en: Self-focusing sparse imaging method of through-wall radar and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging, and provides a through-wall radar self-focusing sparse imaging method and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signals of an expansion target, and constructing a parameterized dictionary signal model taking wall thickness and relative dielectric constant as parameters; taking the sparse characteristic of the expansion target as priori information, and constructing an objective function containing a parameterized dictionary based on maximum posterior probability estimation of total variation constraint and a parameterized dictionary signal model; alternately iterating and updating sparse reflection coefficients and wall parameters according to an objective function, wherein a hash table and linear convolution are used for replacing related operations of dictionary matrixes contained in an updating formula; when the iteration termination condition is reached, outputting the wall thickness and the relative dielectric constant corresponding to the termination of the outer loop as wall parameter estimation values, and using the corresponding sparse reflection coefficient for imaging. The invention effectively reserves the edge characteristic of the expansion target, eliminates the target position deviation caused by unknown wall parameters, simultaneously ensures that the imaging result is clearer, effectively reduces the operation time and improves the space complexity.

title_en: Vital sign signal monitoring method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign signal monitoring method and a related device, and belongs to the field of intelligent driving. The method comprises the steps of carrying out phase expansion on phases corresponding to each sample frequency point in a plurality of sample frequency points to obtain a plurality of target phases, subtracting every two adjacent target phases in the plurality of target phases according to time sequence corresponding to the plurality of sample frequency points to obtain a plurality of phase differences, determining radar vital signals based on the plurality of phase differences, and determining vital sign signals based on the radar vital signals. Because of heart fluctuations corresponding to adjacent times in the heartbeat waveform, or chest fluctuations corresponding to adjacent times in the respiration waveform, are both correlated with the phase difference between the two phases corresponding to adjacent times. Therefore, the radar vital signals determined based on the plurality of phase differences are accurate, so that vital sign signals can be accurately determined based on the radar vital signals, and the safety of vehicle driving is ensured.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wireless communication and provides a heartbeat detection method, a heartbeat detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a spatial channel between an edge computing gateway and each target equipment in a first target area to acquire first breathing information perceived by the spatial channel; the method comprises the steps of sensing first respiration information based on a spatial channel, determining a second target area where a first object is located, detecting second respiration information of the first object in the second target area by adopting a millimeter wave radar, determining the second object based on the first respiration information and the second respiration information, and detecting heartbeat information of the second object. According to the application, the rough position of the target in the static state is perceived through indoor space channel perception connection, and then the millimeter wave radar is controlled to perform heartbeat detection, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of heartbeat detection are improved.

title_en: Patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple bio signals
title_ko: 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선으로 동작하는 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스에 관한 것으로서, 일실시예에 따른 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스는 제1 면에 다중생체신호 수집을 위한 전극들이 배치되고, 상기 제1 면에 대향하는 제2 면의 양끝 단에 커넥터가 배치되며, 상기 양끝 단을 잇는 가운데 부분이 서로 대칭되는 아치형태로써 좁아지는 형태를 갖는 전극패치 모듈, 상기 패치 모듈의 제1 영역에 탈부착이 가능하되, 상기 제1 영역에 배치된 커넥터와 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 수집된 다중생체신호에 대한 처리, 저장, 및 근거리 무선통신을 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 회로부품들을 포함하는 회로부 본체, 및 상기 패치 모듈의 제2 영역에 탈부착이 가능하되, 상기 제2 영역에 배치된 커넥터와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 회로부품들에 전원을 공급하기 위한 전원부 본체를 포함한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for detecting buried objects
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method for detecting buried objects includes receiving ground penetrating radar (GPR) signals captured at discrete locations along a surface of a medium in which an object may be buried, computing parameters based on the received GPR signals that are indicative of the proximity of a buried object, plotting the computed parameters as a function of location, determining an apex of a hyperbola that results from the plotting of the computed parameters, and designating a location at which the apex occurs as an estimated location of the buried object.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH FLORIDA;UNIV OF THE SCIENCES IN PHILADELPHIA

title_en: Computerized method and system for global health, personal safety and emergency response
abstract_en: A computerized system and method for intuitively detecting a user's need for emergency help, preventive care and medical interventions and also for coordinating care for user's loved ones and pets when user experiences an emergency or has passed away. Detection is done via labs and life signs equipment and sensors, self-initiated request for monitoring or the system's periodically polling user through an alert, a telephone call, a notification, a text message or other appropriate means to find out if they are in danger. Polling and automated monitoring may also be triggered by real-time medical data electronically or wirelessly transmitted to the system. If user fails to respond, the system automatedly calls either user's contacts (by listed priority) to notify them of a potential emergency, or emergency responders directly depending on severity of the emergency and communicates to them critical information as well as a code to access user's medical record(s).

title_en: Detection apparatus of vital parameters on steering wheel
abstract_en: A detection apparatus of vital parameters on a steering wheel is provided. The apparatus includes a horn switch, remote control switches configured to operate devices within a vehicle and a vital signal detector configured to detect a vital signal of an operator. The vital signal detector includes a detection sensor that is configured to detect the vital signal of the operator and a photo sensor that is mounted on the remote control switch. Accordingly, the separate space for the assembling portion of the vital signal detector is not required and the volume of the apparatus and the number of components are reduced. The mountability and the aesthetics are improved.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;DAESUNG ELECTRIC CO LTD;LS AUTOMOTIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital-sign radar sensor using wireless internet signals
abstract_en: A vital-sign radar sensor uses wireless internet signals to detect vital signs. It includes a first and second demodulation unit to demodulate an incident and reflected wireless internet signal with an injection-locked oscillator into a first and second demodulated signal, respectively. The combined use of the first and second demodulated signals can eliminate the influence of communication modulation on the extraction process of a Doppler shift due to vital signs. Moreover, the vital-sign radar sensor is a receive-only device so that it won't cause interference to ambient wireless communication networks.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection crawler control device
abstract_en: A non-contact type vital sign detection crawler control device comprises a radar module, a control module, a power driving module, a wireless communication module, a power supply module and a program configuration module; the radar module, the power driving module, the wireless communication module and the program configuration module are all connected with the control module, the power supply module is connected with all other modules and supplies power to the other modules, the control module comprises a chip STM32F103C8, the power driving module comprises two motor driving chips and two motors, and the wireless communication module comprises a component HC-08. According to the utility model, the power driving module can intelligently drive the tracked vehicle to replace fire rescue personnel to enter a severe life detection environment, non-contact type life sign detection is realized through the radar module, instruction interaction and data transmission between the tracked vehicle and rear-end control personnel are realized through the wireless communication module, and the accuracy and reliability of life detection can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE PROTECTION RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT

title_en: Radar life detection system and method
abstract_en: A radar life detection system is composed of a radar acquisition and control processing module, a radar antenna unit module, and a radar power supply unit module. The radar acquisition and control processing module consists of a preprocessor and a signal processor, and processes received life signals. The radar life detection system is a system which is applied to coal mines or other dangerous places to sample and detect gases.

title_en: A kind of real-time mobile disaster emergency system model in before institute and scene
abstract_en: A kind of real-time mobile disaster emergency system model in before institute and scene, with electronics first aid glasses end, expert's remote assistance end, it is characterized in that at electronics first aid glasses end, expert's remote assistance is provided with application software in end, electronics first aid glasses end rescuer wears when suing and labouring, electronics first aid glasses end includes the physical aspect mirror body similar with common spectacles, electronic equipment is provided with mirror body, electronic equipment includes environment camera, full shot, microphone, light sensor, infrared positioning lamp, earphone, environment camera has more sets, electronics first aid glasses end also has medical treatment collection accessory kit and signal transmission component, medical treatment collection accessory kit can gather the physiological parameter data of reflection vital sign patient, signal transmission component can realize information exchange with expert's remote assistance end.The present invention realizes real-time communication between long-range first visual angle of various salvation scene experts and field first aid personnel, and being admitted to hospital for patient, offer is basic to be prepared, the application prospect having had.

title_en: System and method for monitoring vital signs of a person
abstract_en: A system (10) and method for monitoring a person (14) within a defined area by detecting breathing or lack of breathing. Respiration is detected using the radar signal (24), the camera signal (22), and/or the microphone signal (26). The radar signal (24), the camera signal (22) and/or the microphone signal (26) are analyzed to determine whether the subject person (14) is active and, if not, whether the person is breathing or not breathing. An alert is generated if the reflected radar signal (24), the camera signal (22) and the microphone signal (26) all simultaneously indicate that the subject person (14) has not moved and is not active for a selected period of time.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring action removing method based on deep learning and radio frequency perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring action removing method based on deep learning and radio frequency perception. By applying the method, the influence of motion on non-contact vital sign monitoring can be eliminated, the fine-grained vital sign waveform is correctly recovered, the robustness of the vital sign monitoring on the motion is improved, and the defect that the existing waveform separation technology is limited to linear signals is overcome. In addition, the method samples the sensing data captured by the radar on two time scales of fast and slow, converts the data captured by various radars into a uniform format, facilitates subsequent signal processing, and enables the vital sign monitoring method provided by the invention to be independent of bottom hardware.
assignees: CHINESE AND NEW INTERNATIONAL UNITED RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Method for quickly evaluating wall bushing of converter station after earthquake
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly evaluating a wall bushing of a converter station after an earthquake, which comprises the following steps: s1, before earthquake, establishing a valve hall-through wall sleeve system earthquake response equivalent substitution model through a finite element model and a mathematical approximation relation; in an S2 earthquake, three-direction earthquake acceleration, speed and displacement data of a site where the wall bushing is located are monitored; after the earthquake of S3, the data monitored in S2 are input into the equivalent substitution model of the valve hall-wall bushing system earthquake response of S1, so that the stress peak values of the inner and outer wall bushing roots are estimated. The method has higher objectivity; the data monitoring mode is simple, the sensors arranged on the wall bushing do not need to be responded and collected, and only the seismic data of the area where the wall bushing is located are monitored; the post-earthquake emergency rescue method is simple and quick in post-earthquake work, can provide the root stress condition of the inner casing and the outer casing in a short time by simply processing earthquake motion parameters and guiding in the equivalent substitution model, guides the post-earthquake emergency rescue work, and has good engineering application prospect.

title_en: Vital sign remote monitoring system for emergency rescue safety management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign remote monitoring system for emergency rescue safety management, which relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and comprises a vital sign acquisition end, a comprehensive processing module, a 5G data transmission module, a display module and a power supply module, wherein the vital sign acquisition end comprises an infrared body temperature monitoring module, a heart rate blood pressure monitoring module, an electrocardio monitoring module and a blood oxygen monitoring module, the output ends of the infrared body temperature monitoring module, the heart rate blood pressure monitoring module, the electrocardio monitoring module and the blood oxygen monitoring module are all connected with the comprehensive processing module through signal wires, and the output end of the comprehensive processing module is respectively connected with the input ends of the 5G data transmission module and the display module through the signal wires. According to the invention, a doctor diagnoses through observing the data or waveforms of blood pressure, electrocardio, blood oxygen, respiration and the like displayed on the system, so that the doctor can timely acquire vital sign data information of a patient, thereby facilitating remote rescue guidance and improving emergency efficiency.
assignees: HEFEI D E ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Microseism life detection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microseism life detection system, which comprises a control host capable of carrying out wireless communication, a plurality of wireless detection terminals and a plurality of wired detection terminals, wherein the plurality of wireless detection terminals and the plurality of wired detection terminals are integrated on the control host and can be disassembled; each wireless detection terminal and each wired detection terminal are internally provided with a vibration acceleration sensor, a millimeter wave radar module and an information processing module, the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module detect information in the vehicle, and the information processing module processes the information detected by the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module into sound waves with the frequency not more than 500Hz and transmits the sound waves to a control host through wireless communication and wired communication; each wireless detection terminal is also internally provided with a rechargeable battery; and an alarm device is also arranged on the control host. The invention is convenient for detecting whether the life body exists in the vehicle body, can effectively avoid environmental interference, is convenient for use, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Human vital sign radar signal processing method and device based on sliding singular spectrum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, and provides a human vital sign radar signal processing method and device based on a sliding singular spectrum, wherein the human vital sign radar signal processing method based on the sliding singular spectrum comprises the following steps: acquiring a physical sign vibration signal, and dividing the physical sign vibration signal into a plurality of signal segments based on a sliding window; carrying out singular spectrum analysis on each signal segment to obtain a reconstruction subsequence corresponding to each signal segment; and determining target sub-fragments of the signal fragments, and combining the reconstructed sub-sequences corresponding to the target sub-fragments to obtain the target sign vibration signal. The invention improves the efficiency of signal processing by reconstructing after segmentation, ensures the accuracy and reliability of analysis results, and is suitable for analyzing long-time sign monitoring data.

title_en: Health monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a health monitoring system and method, the system comprising an indoor device equipped with a sensor module, a processor communicatively connected to the sensor module, an alarm system, and a user interface. The embodiment of the invention discloses breakthrough integration of radar technology and artificial intelligence in common household equipment (ceiling fans). The system consists of a seamlessly integrated radar module and decorative radome, turning the fan into a discreet and unobtrusive health-monitoring device. The radar module remotely transmits signals to the monitoring area, captures signals reflected from the individual's body, and provides continuous real-time data regarding vital signs such as heart rate and respiratory rate. Such information, when processed by the artificial intelligence processor, enables the system to detect abnormal conditions, triggering an alert communicated to the user through the user interface. The novel system can adapt to different living environments and has deployment flexibility, and a new era of comprehensive, continuous and user-friendly health monitoring is created.
assignees: AIHUI INTELLIGENT TECH ZHONGSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster search and rescue motion control system based on multi-sensor robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster search and rescue motion control system based on a multi-sensor robot, which relates to the technical field of motion control of robots, and comprises the steps of determining a perception range threshold of the robot according to overall perception of a disaster scene environment, generating a preliminary search and rescue route of a clustered robot based on regional division of the disaster environment, predicting the change trend of obstacles in a region to be searched by the robot and the corresponding dangerous degree based on multi-sensor data, further adjusting the search and rescue route of the robot in real time to realize dynamic obstacle avoidance, determining vital signs of trapped people through a life recognition system of infrared detection, simultaneously recognizing the postures and rescue difficulties of the trapped people based on multi-sensor fusion, reporting the vital signs, the postures and the rescue difficulties of the trapped people, and dynamically adjusting the search and rescue route according to the current position and the state of the robot by utilizing position information of a decentralized network sharing robot. The disaster search and rescue of high-efficient accurate, safe dynamic has been realized, search and rescue efficiency and success rate have been greatly promoted.

title_en: Through-wall radar clutter suppression method based on space frequency diversity
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar clutter suppression method based on spatial frequency diversity, and aims to solve the problems of background clutter interference and difficult detection of low-speed moving targets of through-wall radars in complex indoor environments. The method mainly comprises the steps of solving the problem P1 (formula (1) in the specification), generating signal waveforms with low side lobes and good Doppler tolerance through multi-band radar signal waveform optimization design, solving the problem P2 (formula (2) in the specification), optimizing a beam array according to antenna patterns of signals with different frequencies by combining an antenna beam forming technology, and realizing effective differentiation of target signals and background clutter by comparing echo power ratios of signals with different frequencies in different directions based on bat bionic multi-band radar array signal processing.

title_en: Radar vital sign detection method, radar vital sign detection device, radar vital sign detection system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar vital sign detection method, a radar vital sign detection device, a radar vital sign detection system and a storage medium, wherein the radar vital sign detection method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signal; the method comprises the steps of separating respiration and heartbeat data from historical frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signals, training a neural network model according to the respiration and heartbeat data, acquiring the frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signals of a tested person in real time, inputting the frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signals of the tested person into the trained neural network model, obtaining a sleep quality report of the tested person, detecting sudden disease risk in real time, and carrying out human dynamic tracking according to environment data acquired in real time. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the high-precision detection of the respiratory rate and the heart rate is realized.

title_en: Deep complex space environment monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep complex space environment monitoring method which comprises the following steps of constructing a deep WiFi 6E+mesh ad hoc network communication and collection node network, cooperatively collecting multidimensional data, collecting environment parameters, vital sign data, communication state data and equipment power supply state data, carrying out relay transmission on Mesh ad hoc network data, and carrying out ground data processing and scheduling support. The method has the advantages that the WiFi 6E and Mesh ad hoc network architecture is adopted, a fixed wired link is not needed, or high-cost base stations are not needed to be deployed densely, the deep topology dynamic change can be dealt with through the bidirectional redundant link of the Mesh protocol, the electromagnetic interference resistance can be enhanced by means of the 6GHz frequency band of the WiFi 6E, meanwhile, access of mobile equipment such as rescue robots and portable terminals is supported, the problems that an existing wired scheme is slow in repair, the wireless scheme is high in cost and the low-power consumption scheme is insufficient in bandwidth are solved, and instantaneity and flexibility of deep emergency communication are considered.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY;UNIV XUZHOU MEDICAL

title_en: Display panel, display device and vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel, a display device and a vital sign monitoring method, wherein the display panel comprises an array substrate, a color film substrate and a millimeter wave radar antenna array positioned between the color film substrate and the array substrate, the millimeter wave radar antenna array is at least partially positioned in a black matrix area of the color film substrate, and is electrically connected with a radar circuit through a conductive connection structure arranged in a frame of the display panel and used for transmitting millimeter wave signals under the control of the radar circuit and receiving millimeter wave echo signals reflected by a user in a detection area of the millimeter wave radar antenna array, and the millimeter wave echo signals are used for determining vital sign parameters of the user. Therefore, under the condition that an additional independent radar module and a windowing structure are not needed, the display panel is enabled to integrate a non-contact vital sign monitoring function, and the integration level and the light weight level of the whole machine are improved while the display effect is kept.

title_en: Information acquisition device for reinforcing-bar in concrete by radar scan and operation method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a reinforcing-bar arrangement information acquisition device which can obtain an image that correctly and clearly displays the arrangement state of reinforcing-bars even if alignment of a scan start position for each radar scan is performed fuzzily when grasping positions of a plurality of reinforcing-bars arranged in parallel to each other in concrete by performing the radar scan by an electromagnetic radar device, and provide an operation method thereof.SOLUTION: A reinforcing-bar arrangement information acquisition device for acquiring arrangement information of a plurality of reinforcing-bars arranged in parallel to each other by being buried in concrete C, comprises: a hyperbola information holding part 0361 which holds hyperbola information acquired by performing plural times of radar scans that pass through different paths in the orthogonal directions over the plurality of reinforcing-bars; a hyperbola information synchronization unit 0362 which synchronizes the repetition period of the reflection intensity of the held hyperbola information by the plural times of radar scans that pass through different paths; and an arrangement information generation unit 0363 which generates arrangement information of the reinforcing-bars on the basis of the synchronized hyperbola information obtained for each of the different paths.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3D

title_en: Portable smart CPR device with AI algorithms
title_ko: Ai 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a portable smart cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) device applied with an AI algorithm that enables the implementation for cardiopulmonary resuscitation and additional functions to be easily progressed, and enables feedback for the cardiopulmonary resuscitation to be clearly delivered to the rescuer. Provided is a portable smart CPR device applied with the AI algorithm comprising: a body part; a feedback part embedded in the body part and partially exposed, wherein feedback information is confirmed by visual and auditory data; a defibrillator part embedded in the body part and formed in a detachable structure, wherein an electric shock is implemented to a user; an electrode sensor part embedded in the body part and partially exposed, wherein a vital sign of the user is obtained by being in contact with the user, and comprising a plurality of electrodes and sensors to which the electric shock of the defibrillator part is transmitted to the user; and a remote monitoring part located at a separate place and collecting and analyzing the vital sign.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 심폐소생술 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 환자에 대한 정보가 수집 및 분석되는 AI 알고리즘으로부터 환자에 대한 심폐소생술의 피드백 정보가 획득되고, 추가적으로 AI 알고리즘에서 분석된 정보를 바탕으로 전기충격이 진행되어 전문지식이 없는 구조자가 응급 환자에 대한 심폐소생술을 효율적이면서도 스마트하게 실시될 수 있는 AI 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치에 관한 것이다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 AI 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치에 있어서, 몸체부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 일부가 노출되되, 피드백 정보가 시각 및 청각데이터로 확인되는 피드백부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 분리가능 구조로 형성되되, 사용자에게 전기충격이 실시되는 제세동부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 일부가 노출되되, 사용자에게 접촉되어 사용자의 바이탈사인이 획득되고, 상기 제세동부의 전기 충격이 사용자에게 전달되는 복수개의 전극 및 센서가 포함되는 전극센서부; 및 별도의 장소에 위치되되, 상기 바이탈사인이 수집 및 분석되는 원격모니터링부;가 포함되는 것을 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Identification sensor for works buried at great depth
abstract_en: A transponder for a wireless communication and contactless identification system, of RFID type, intended to be affixed on (or in proximity) to buried works, said transponder comprising: - a set of antenna segments (200x) consisting of electrical conductors constituting at least one first and one second antenna element (203-1, 203-2), - a printed circuit comprising an RFID chip and at least one tuning capacitor (202x) as well as a connector (281) allowing electrical connecting of said antenna segments.
assignees: ELIOT INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS S A S;LE BASTARD LUDOVIC;NIVON THIERRY;PALOMARES MARC

title_en: Earthquake early warning alarm for converter station and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an alarm for earthquake early warning of a converter station and a monitoring method thereof, belonging to the technical field of earthquake early warning. The earthquake early warning alarm for the converter station comprises a box body, a moving mechanism, a driving mechanism and an earthquake warning mechanism. The moving mechanism comprises a first hollow pipe and a second hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe penetrates through the box body in a sliding mode, a conical head is installed at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe, and a through hole is formed in the surface of the first hollow pipe. The first hollow pipe, the second hollow pipe, the micro motor, the screw rod, the clamping plate and the elastic piece are matched, so that the seismic sensor can be buried in the soil, a pit does not need to be dug on the surface of the soil, the seismic sensor can be buried, the burying of the seismic sensor is facilitated, in addition, the conical head is additionally arranged at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe is favorably driven into the soil, and the subsequent burying of the seismic sensor is facilitated.

title_en: Method for detecting life information through non-contact wall
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for detecting life information by non-contact wall penetration, which comprises the following steps: denoising a target signal to be detected; processing the signal in the fast time dimension direction of the denoised target signal to be detected by adopting the EEMD to obtain a first IMFs set; locating characteristic time exponential sampling points in a first set of IMFs; processing the signal in the slow time dimension direction of the denoised target signal by adopting the EEMD to obtain a second IMFs set of characteristic time index sampling points in the slow time dimension direction, and constructing a second IMFs set matrix; and acquiring signals which meet the respiration rate characteristic and the heart rate characteristic in the second IMFs set matrix, and finding out corresponding respiration signals and heart rate signals. The method and the device can remove the fixed background noise in the radar receiving echo signal, can utilize the through-wall detection function of the radar receiving echo signal, and adopt non-contact detection to realize detection of the life information.

title_en: Multi-person heartbeat detection and positioning method and system based on SIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person heartbeat detection and positioning method and system based on a SIMO radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of correcting amplitude and phase of echo signals of each channel of the radar; weighting the corrected signals to obtain echo signals corresponding to the search angle, calculating a two-dimensional FFT of distance Doppler for the echo signals, reconstructing, imaging to obtain distance and angle information of a human body target, calculating an optimal direction diagram weight vector through a DBF principle, calculating a distance dimension FFT, obtaining vital sign signals of each human body target, estimating heart rate by utilizing PCA and ZASLMS algorithms, decomposing and extracting the vital sign signals according to the estimated heart rate by utilizing a tensor decomposition theoretical algorithm, obtaining a target heartbeat signal and recovering corresponding time domain waveforms. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, can accurately judge the distance and angle information of a plurality of human targets positioned in different or same distance doors, inhibit the interference of moving and static objects and extract the heartbeat signals of the corresponding targets.

title_en: Defibrillator for Ubiquitous healthcare
title_ko: 유비쿼터스 헬스케어용 환자 모니터링 기능을 갖는 심장제세동기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A heart defibrillator is provided to consecutively monitor biological signal data and to deliver a message in an emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: A heart defibrillator comprises a bio-signal sensor module(100), a defibrillator main body(200), a control unit(300), and a relay server(400). The bio-signal sensor module measures the electrocardiogram and blood oxygen saturation value of a user and transmits the measured information wirelessly. The defibrillator main body determines the amount of electric shock and applies electric shock through an electrode pad. The control unit stores and analyzes biological signal data and displays a message in an emergency situation. The relay server transmits user position information and biological signal data to administrator and medical team by wire. [Reference numerals] (100) Bio-signal sensor module; (200) Defibrillator main body; (300) Control unit; (400) Relay server; (AA) Manager; (BB) Medical staff
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자 신체에 부착하여 심전도, 혈중산소포화도 측정하는 생체신호센서모듈과 제세동기를 무선으로 연결하여 생체신호데이터를 분석 및 저장한 다음 긴급상황발생시에는 제세동기 본체를 동작하여 전기충격에 의한 응급처치를 할 수 있도록 함과 아울러 중계서버를 통해 관리자 및 의료진에게 생체신호데이터를 전송하여 환자관리를 할 수 있도록 한 유비쿼터스 헬스케어용 환자 모니터링 기능을 갖는 심장제세동기에 관한 것이다 
즉, 본 발명은 사용자 신체에 부착되어 사용자의 심전도 및 혈중산소포화도를 측정하고 측정된 정보를 무선으로 송출하는 생체신호센서모듈과; 사용자의 생체신호데이터 신호에 의해 전기충격여부 및 전기충격량을 판정하고 전극패드를 통하여 전기충격이 이루어지는 제세동기 본체와; 상기 생체신호센서모듈로부터 송신되는 측정정보를 수신하여 생체신호데이터를 분석 및 저장한 다음 긴급상황발생시 메시지를 표시하여 경보하는 수단으로 전기충격에 의한 응급처치를 할 수 있도록 하고. 통신망을 통해 생체신호데이터를 송신하는 제어장치부와; 상기 제어장치부와 상호 무선연결되어 사용자 위치정보 및 생체신호데이터를 관리자 및 의료진에게 유무선으로 전송하는 중계서버;를 포함하는 유비쿼터스 헬스케어용 환자 모니터링 기능을 갖는 심장제세동기를 특징으로 한다.

title_ko: 차량 탑승자의 생체 신호의 무접촉 검출 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 차량, 예를 들어, 차량 객실압의 탑승자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 신호 유닛은 레이더 신호를 탑승자에게 전송하고, 탑승자로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 수신한다. 반사된 레이더 신호는 차량의 진동 데이터에 관해 분석되어, 수정된 신호를 생성한다. 수정된 신호는 탑승자의 생체 신호를 결정하기 위해 분석된다.

title_en: A method for detecting vital signs based on a radar senor and a system for monitoring and improving state of sleeping
title_ko: 레이다 센서 기반 생체신호 검출 방법 및 이를 이용한 수면 모니터링 및 개선 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present specification, disclosed are a method for detecting a biosignal based on a radar sensor, and a system for monitoring and improving a sleep using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: a first device (100) including a radar sensor (130); and a second device (200) wirelessly communicating with the first device (100). The radar sensor (130) performs radar transmission/reception with respect to a subject to obtain a heartbeat signal and a breathing signal separated from each other from a received radar, and the second device (200) receives data on the heartbeat signal and the breathing signal from the first device (100) to monitor a sleep. Therefore, the precision on bio-signal detection can be further improved.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 레이다 센서 기반 생체신호 검출 방법 및 이를 이용한 수면 모니터링 및 개선 시스템을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수면 모니터링 및 개선 시스템은 레이다 센서(130)를 포함하는 제1 기기(100); 및 상기 제1 기기(100)와 무선통신하는 제2 기기(200);를 포함하며, 상기 레이다 센서(130)는 피검체에 대한 레이다 송수신을 수행하여 수신 레이다로부터 상호 분리된 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호를 획득하며, 상기 제2 기기(200)는 상기 제1 기기(100)로부터 상기 심박 신호 및 상기 호흡 신호에 대한 데이터를 전송받아 수면 모니터링을 수행한다.

title_en: Fire detection and fire handling system for electric vehicle charging station
title_ko: 전기차 충전소 화재 감지 및 화재 처리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection and handling system for an electric vehicle charging station, which is integrated to an electric vehicle charging and parking system to enable an early warning and an appropriate response in case of a fire, thereby causing an operator and a manager of an electric vehicle charging station to take quick and effective action for a fire risk, and guaranteeing the safety of a user. More specifically, the fire detection and handling system includes: a waterproofing device buried to be liftable in a lower part of the floor surface of a parking lot in which an electric vehicle is parked, and ascending while surrounding the electric vehicle parked in the parking lot; a water supply device supplying water into the waterproofing device when the waterproofing device ascends; a camera module photographing the electric vehicle parked in the parking lot; a sensor module detecting at least one of a sound, smoke and heat emanating from the electric vehicle parked in the parking lot; and a processing part connected to the waterproofing device, the water supply device, the camera module and the sensor module, and actuating the waterproofing device and the water supply device when detecting a fire on the electric vehicle through at least one of the camera module and the sensor module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차 충전 및 주차 시스템에 통합되어 화재 발생 시 조기 경보 및 적절한 대응을 가능하게 함으로써, 전기차 충전소의 운영자 및 관리자가 화재 위험에 대한 신속하고 효과적인 대응을 할 수 있으며, 사용자의 안전을 보장할 수 있도록 구성한 전기차 충전소 화재 감지 및 화재 처리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는, 전기차가 주차되는 주차장의 바닥면 하부에 승강되도록 매설되며, 상승시 상기 주차장에 주차된 전기차를 둘러싸면서 상승하는 방수장치; 상기 방수장치 상승시, 상기 방수장치의 내부로 물을 공급하는 급수장치; 상기 주차장에 주차된 전기차를 촬영하는 카메라 모듈; 상기 주차장에 주차된 전기차에서 발생하는 소리, 연기, 열 중 적어도 어느 하나를 감지하는 센서 모듈; 및 상기 방수장치, 상기 급수장치, 상기 카메라 모듈 및 상기 센서 모듈과 연결되며, 상기 카메라 모듈과 상기 센서 모듈 중 적어도 어느 하나를 통해 전기차의 화재 감지 시, 상기 방수장치와 상기 급수장치를 동작시키는 처리부를 포함하는 전기차 충전소 화재 감지 및 화재 처리 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Smart watch
abstract_en: Systems and methods include a cellular, WiFi, and Bluetooth transceiver coupled to a processor; an accelerometer or a motion sensor coupled to the processor; and a sensor coupled to the processor to sense mood or body vital sign; and a wearable device operating wirelessly with the processor, wherein the wearable device includes at least one sensor coupled to a back of the wearable device and wherein the wearable device recognizes and executes a speech command.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for detecting human presence in front of a plurality of sensors, such as speaker sensors, and a device with a processor, such as a television. An example method includes varying, during a collection routine, a respective signal strength of one or more of a plurality of transmitters. The example method further includes receiving results of the collection routine in a form of raw data from a plurality of sensors. The example method further includes determining, by at least one processor, a respective geographical position of one or more humans present within a predetermined geographical range of the at least one processor based on the raw data from the plurality of sensors. Subsequently, the example method includes executing an action based on the respective geographical position of the one or more humans.

title_en: Near-to-eye display life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nearly eye shows life detection device, include: the glasses part comprises an optical waveguide lens, a control module and a first wireless network module, wherein the control module and the first wireless network module are installed on the legs of the glasses; the probe part comprises an infrared focal plane detector, a microprocessor controller and a second wireless network module, wherein the infrared focal plane detector and the second wireless network module are both connected with the microprocessor controller, and the second wireless network module is connected with the first wireless network module of the glasses part. Through the optical waveguide lens with traditional thermal imaging life detection device's thermal imaging image display on the glasses part with probe part wireless connection for thermal imaging detection device is lighter-weighted more, and single can accomplish the life and survey, has improved search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Monitoring system for communication of wisdom ward and millimeter wave physical sign radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring system for communication between an intelligent ward and a millimeter wave vital sign radar, which comprises a client, a server, a data layer, an MQTT server and the millimeter wave vital sign radar, wherein the millimeter wave vital sign radar is arranged above a sickbed of a patient. According to the utility model, the millimeter wave vital sign radar is arranged above a sickbed of a patient, vital sign data and sleep data of the patient are monitored and reported in real time to the intelligent ward management platform and are pushed to the bedside machine, the nursing signboard and the management machine, so that the accuracy and timeliness of the data are ensured, medical staff can accurately judge the corresponding data, the medical staff can check the vital sign data and the sleep monitoring data of the patient in the nursing signboard and the management machine, in addition, the patient can be warned and prompted when the vital sign is abnormal, the abnormality of the patient can be timely found, corresponding measures are taken, and certain analysis can be carried out on the sleep data, so that the medical staff and the patient can be fed back.
assignees: XIAMEN WORLD LINKING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Microseismic-monitoring-sensor arrangement method for stratified excavation of deeply-buried hard-rock tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic-monitoring-sensor arrangement method for stratified excavation of a deeply-buried hard-rock tunnel. When a second layer to the last layer of the tunnel are excavated, a first group/second group of microseismic sensors are installed in rock mass of a tunnel inner wall at the front/back of a tunnel face; a line obtained through downward movement of a center line of a currently-excavated-layer bottom plate for 1 meter is used as a rotating center line and the first group of microseismics sensors and the second group of microseismic sensors are distributed in the rock mass of the tunnel inner wall, the rotating center line being a central axis; and with the advancement of the tunnel face, the first group of microseismic sensors and the second groups of microseismic sensors are redistributed until tunnel excavation is completed. In the method, through use of space supplied by excavated layers of a tunnel, microseismic sensors are arranged at the front and back of excavated tunnel faces and a tunnel face of higher risks and adjacent areas of the tunnel face are included in the two groups of microseismic sensor arrayed at the front and back of the tunnel face all the time so that acquisition of micro-fracture signals is facilitated, microseism positioning precision is ensured and a basis is laid for accurate prediction and forecast of a disaster.
assignees: INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Multi-person through-wall time varying breathing signal detection method based on VMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person through-wall time varying breathing signal detection method based on VMD, comprising the steps of: an ultra wide band emission antenna emitting narrow pulse, through human thoracic cavity micro-doppler vibration, echo being received by a receiving antenna, and performing slow time sampling on ultra wide band radar echo to obtain a through-wall human body echo signal matrix; calculating the variance of each distance door through a distance door selection algorithm, the one with a largest variance being a distance door where a multi-person target exists, and employing a low pass filter to eliminate high frequency interference and superfluous frequency components; utilizing a VMD algorithm to perform mode decomposition on filtered signals, and iterating sub-signals to obtain effective information meeting the number and frequency band of breathing; and performing Hilbert transformation and time frequency treatment to obtain dynamic instantaneous information including smooth breathing characteristics. The method can effectively eliminate interference harmonic wave of different breathing components, remove metope interference, and enhance weak breathing signals, and has the characteristics of strong interference immunity and accurate time varying tracking characteristics.

title_en: Physiological sign sensor capable of resisting clutter
abstract_en: A physiological symptom sensor capable of resisting clutter generates an oscillation signal by virtue of a SIL oscillator, the oscillation signal is transmitted to an object in a wireless signal mode through an antenna group, the antenna group receives a reflection signal reflected by the object, the SIL oscillator is injected and locked by the reflection signal, the wireless signal transmitted by the antenna group is transmitted to a demodulation unit for demodulation, so that a vital sign of the organism is obtained, wherein a separation part of the antenna group can prevent the clutter signal reflected by the demodulation unit and the environment where the demodulation unit is located from being transmitted to the SIL oscillator, so that the clutter signal is prevented from interfering the detection of the vital sign of the object.

title_en: Life detection positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection positioning system and a life detection positioning method, comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle, a life detection radar, a path planning module and an SLAM system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with the life detection radar, the path planning module and the SLAM system to detect a disaster area. The life detection radar can locate relative position information between a living body and the unmanned aerial vehicle in a disaster area. The path planning module can plan the next moving path of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the positioned relative position information, the unmanned aerial vehicle can plan the moving path according to the path planning module, the unmanned aerial vehicle goes to the position of the living body before and returns to the position of the rescue personnel from the position of the living body. After the unmanned aerial vehicle reaches the position of the living body, the carried SLAM system is started, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can start to return to the navigation, a three-dimensional map model corresponding to the return route is synchronously constructed by taking the position of the living body as a starting point, and the three-dimensional map model is provided for a rescuer to refer to, so that the rescuer can conveniently make a rescue route.
assignees: CHINESE PLA ARMY SPECIALIZED MEDICAL CT

title_en: Human body pose and physiological sign real-time monitoring and early warning system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body pose and physiological sign real-time monitoring and early warning system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the millimeter wave radar, a functional module and a data real-time monitoring and early warning module, wherein a signal output end of the millimeter wave radar is connected with a signal input end of the functional module, and a signal output end of the functional module is connected with a signal input end of the data real-time monitoring and early warning module; the functional module is configured to acquire signals of the millimeter wave radar, calculate physiological sign data through phase change based on the signals of the millimeter wave radar, acquire point cloud data based on the signals of the millimeter wave radar, and identify and detect the pose of the human body based on the point cloud data; the data real-time monitoring and early warning module is configured to process the pose and vital sign data of the human body, store the processed pose and vital sign data in the database, and perform visual display and accidental state early warning based on the processed data. The invention has the advantages of non-contact, all-weather, all-around, comprehensive functions, low cost and privacy protection.

title_en: Frequency estimation method, storage medium and device based on rootMUSIC and signal dimension conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological signal processing, in particular to a frequency estimation method, a storage medium and equipment based on rootMUSIC and signal dimension conversion.
