The method comprises the steps of modeling chest displacement signals extracted from radar echoes into the sum of sine waves with integral multiple frequencies of basic respiration and heart rate, generating corresponding single-channel analysis signals through Hilbert transformation, converting the single-channel analysis signals into multi-channel data through a signal rearrangement method, enabling chest wall signal models to be equivalent to uniform linear array multi-snapshot receiving signal models, enabling vital sign frequencies to be in one-to-one correspondence with the arrival directions of signal sources, processing the receiving data of the multi-snapshot receiving signal models through an alternate direction multiplier method frame, solving denoised signal matrixes, and carrying out frequency estimation on the denoised signal matrixes by using rootMUSIC algorithm to calculate roots. The invention converts the signal model, so that the frequency estimation range is equivalent to the angle estimation range, and the frequency estimation precision is improved.

title_en: High-resolution imaging method of forgetful through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution imaging method of a wall-penetrating radar with less forgetting. The method comprises the specific steps of training an optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network of a source domain to enable the optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network to recover the shape of a source domain target and take the optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network as a pre-training network, loading a pre-training model to initialize corresponding partial parameters of a target domain network LFHRNet with a multi-branch structure, training the target domain network on a target domain data set, learning a new knowledge of the target domain when one branch is trained, freezing the other branch to keep the source domain knowledge, and introducing a routing network to carry out accurate expert allocation. The invention effectively reduces forgetting of source domain knowledge, and enables the network to have the capability of high-resolution imaging of static targets in the source domain and the target domain.

title_en: Portable radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable radar life detector in the technical field of radar detection equipment, which comprises a machine case, a supporting table, a workbench and a working table, wherein the top of the machine case is hinged with an organic cover, the top of the machine cover is provided with a handle assembly, the supporting table is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the machine case, the circumferential inner wall of the supporting table is rotatably connected with a rotary table through a bearing, the bottom of the supporting table is provided with a rotating mechanism for driving the rotary table to rotate, the surface of the workbench is designed into a spherical shape, and the middle of the rotary table is provided with a spherical groove matched with the surface of the workbench. The invention can convert the detection radar body from a vertical state to an inclined state, and enables the detection radar body to break through the limitation of the traditional vertical downward detection, thereby realizing the scanning of different areas by changing the detection direction, covering wider areas, accurately detecting the life signs at different positions and greatly improving the accuracy and the effectiveness of life detection.
assignees: SICHUAN FENGBANG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence auxiliary multi-mode small animal anesthesia and consciousness research device and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of neurobiology and anesthesiology research, and discloses an artificial intelligence-assisted multi-mode small animal anesthesia and consciousness research device and system, wherein the system comprises an integrated monitoring cabin, a transparent experiment box and a sound insulation dark box; the brain electricity/myoelectricity recording module records brain cortex and muscle electricity activities, the optical fiber calcium imaging module, the optical fiber probe and the high-sensitivity photoelectric detector, the drug administration module, the program-controlled microinjection pump, the intravenous, intraperitoneal and inhalation drug administration support module, the vital sign monitoring module, the behavior capturing module, the infrared high-speed camera and the gesture analysis system, the AI operation and analysis platform and the data acquisition, processing and visualization function are integrated, wherein the vital sign monitoring module comprises a wireless infrared body temperature detector, a wireless millimeter wave radar detector and a high-precision pressure sensor. The invention realizes the full-flow automation from drug administration to data acquisition, does not need manual intervention, improves the multi-mode data synchronization precision by more than 90 percent and improves the experimental efficiency by more than 50 percent.

title_en: Buried object detection device, and buried object detection method
abstract_en: To provide a buried object detection device capable of detecting buried objects more accurately over a wider area, and a buried object detection method.SOLUTION: The buried object detection device includes: a radar data processing unit that converts multiple radar data measured by an underground measuring device into images: a buried object detection unit that detects buried objects from the images of the radar data; an underground feature detection unit that detects a characteristic portion that is different from the buried object in the images of the radar data; an alignment unit that calculates alignment information for multiple radar data alignment based on the detection results from the underground feature detection unit; and a result integration unit that integrates the buried object detection results based on the output result of the buried object detection unit and the output result of the alignment unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Realtime monitoring system for guard based on bio signal and etc
title_ko: 생체 신호 등을 기반으로 한 경계 근무 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: In one barrier service real time monitoring system is the remote the organism state of the guard including bio-signal etc, it on a real time basis monitors. The information about the organism state of the guard is grasped rapidly. CONSTITUTION: A sensor module(20) comprises the electrocardiogram sensor unit(21) and 3 shaft acceleration sensor part(22) in which the electrocardiogram of the guard is measured and which is created the electrocardiogram signal. It measures the movement of the guard and 3 shaft acceleration sensor part is created 3 shaft acceleration signal. The portable terminal apparatus(100) transmits the electrocardiogram signal received a message from the sensor module and the guard status signal including 3 shaft acceleration signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경계 근무 상황실에서 원격으로 경계 근무자를 모니터링하는 것에 관한 것이며, 특히 경계 근무자의 생존 여부, 생체 상태, 근무 태도 및 이동 경로 등을 모니터링하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명의 경계 근무 실시간 모니터링 시스템은, 경계 근무자의 심전도를 측정하여 심전도 신호를 생성하는 심전도 센서부(21)와, 상기 경계 근무자의 움직임을 측정하여 3축 가속도 신호를 생성하는 3축 가속도 센서부(22)를 포함하는 센서 모듈(20); 상기 센서 모듈(20)로부터 수신한 상기 심전도 신호 및 3축 가속도 신호를 포함하는 경계 근무자 상태 신호를 전송하는 휴대 단말 장치(100); 상기 휴대 단말 장치(100)로부터 상기 경계 근무자 상태 신호를 수신하여 분석하는 경계 근무 모니터링 서버(200)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

assignees: V I SOFT CO LTD;ICU RES & IND COOP GROUP

title_en: Remote controller for measuring bio-signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 원격 제어 장치
abstract_en: A remote controller recognizes a user by using a user recognizing module on the remote controller. Disclosed is a method. According to whether a user is a member or not, a bio signal sensor on the remote controller measures the bio signal of the user. The data of the measured bio signal is transmitted to a display device.
abstract_ko: 원격 제어 장치(remote controller)가, 원격 제어 장치 상의 사용자 인식 모듈을 이용하여 사용자를 인식하고, 사용자가 등록된 사용자인지 여부에 대한 판단에 따라, 사용자의 생체 신호를 원격 제어 장치 상의 생체 신호 센서를 이용하여 측정하고, 측정된 생체 신호의 데이터를 표시 장치에게 전송하는, 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Wearable Authentication Device Using Biological Signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 이용한 착용형 인증 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a wearable authentication device using a bio-signal. The wearable authentication device includes: a proximity sensor which distinguishes whether to be worn, and generates a signal for authentication when wearing and a signal for de- authentication when not wearing; a measurement signal which touches on a skin of a user so as to measure the bio-signal from the user; and a control unit which analyzes the bio-signal measured by the measurement unit and performs an authentication process to compare with the previously registered bio-signal so as to determine whether to use.
abstract_ko: 착용형 인증 장치가 제공된다. 이 착용형 인증 장치는 착용 여부를 구별하여, 착용시에는 인증 실시용 신호를, 그리고 미착용시에는 인증 해제용 신호를 생성하는 근접 센서, 사용자의 피부에 접촉하여 사용자로부터 생체 신호를 측정하는 측정부 및 측정부에 의해 측정된 생체 신호를 분석하여 미리 등록된 생체 신호와 비교하는 인증 절차를 수행하여 사용 여부를 결정하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Gesture-based disaster response device and method
title_ko: 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gesture-based disaster response device and a method. The device includes: a situation information collection unit for receiving an operation signal and a biosignal for disaster response from a wearable terminal including a plurality of sensors which are attached to a user's body and are operated; a gesture recognition unit for recognizing a user's gesture according to a change pattern of the operation signal based on a location characteristic according to a location of a user; a disaster occurrence detector configured to monitor the presence or absence of abnormalities in the biosignal according to the gesture to detect the occurrence of a disaster related to the user; and a disaster response processing unit which propagates disaster information including the user's location and requests a control server to proceed with emergency rescue, in case the occurrence of the disaster is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 사용자의 신체에 부착되어 동작하는 복수의 센서들을 포함하는 웨어러블 단말로부터 재난 대응을 위한 동작 신호 및 생체 신호를 수신하는 상황 정보 수집부, 상기 사용자의 위치에 따른 장소 특성을 기초로 상기 동작 신호의 변화 패턴에 따라 상기 사용자의 제스처를 인식하는 제스처 인식부, 상기 제스처에 따른 생체 신호의 이상 유무를 모니터링하여 상기 사용자에 관한 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부 및 상기 재난 발생이 검출된 경우 상기 사용자의 위치를 포함하는 재난 정보를 전파하고 관제 서버에 긴급 구조의 진행을 요청하는 재난 대응 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Health monitoring appliance
abstract_en: A heart monitoring system for a person includes one or more wireless nodes forming a wireless network; a wearable sensor having a wireless transceiver adapted to communicate with the one or more wireless nodes; and a software module receiving data from the wireless nodes to detect changes in patient vital signs.

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced maximum permissible exposure (mpe) compliance based on vital signs detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflection signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflection signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on the reflection signals, the device can measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain a heart rate and/or breathing rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflection signals indicate human vital signs, such as a heart rate or breathing. The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether human vital signs are detected at the target object, and transmit the adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar apparatus determining vital sign
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar apparatus determining a vital sign includes a microprocessor, a millimeter wave radar and an electrocardiogram machine. The millimeter wave radar is configured to detect a human body to obtain a plurality of wireless vital-sign signals. The microprocessor is configured to receive the wireless vital-sign signals. The electrocardiogram machine is configured to detect the human body to obtain a plurality of wired vital-sign signals. The microprocessor is configured to receive the wired vital-sign signals. After the microprocessor receives the wireless vital-sign signals and the wired vital-sign signals, the microprocessor is configured to output the wireless vital-sign signals and the wired vital-sign signals.

title_en: Respirator with end-of-service-life detection
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and apparatus for detecting when respiratory cartridges of a respirator have reached their end-of-service-life. In some instances, two or more respiratory cartridges are removably connectable to a respirator housing, where each of the two or more respiratory cartridges receives ambient air and deliver cleaned air to the respirator housing. One of the respiratory cartridges may be configured to have a lower adsorption capacity than the remaining respirator cartridges. A gas sensor may be situated downstream of the reduced capacity respirator cartridge, and may detect an increased concentration of the targeted gas in the cleaned air delivered by the reduced capacity respiratory cartridge. When detected, an end-of-service-life indication may be provided to the user.

title_en: Rescue system for a collapse
title_ko: 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue system for a collapse, in which a body detection unit is installed in order to detect the presence of people inside a building, and a tilt sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed in order to set changed tilt data and acceleration data as an event trigger signal, when an earthquake or external shock occurs. Moreover, by analyzing a signal measured in the body detection unit at a predetermined time before the event trigger signal occurs, if someone was in the building before a collapse accident, the place where people are buried is announced through a voice or Morse code via an alarm unit in order to perform a rescue operation quickly. As a result, accident mortality from a collapse may be drastically reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체 감지부를 설치하여 건축물 내부 사람의 유무를 감지하고 경사 센서와 가속도 센서를 설치하여 지진 또는 외부의 충격이 발생할 경우 변화되는 경사 데이터와 가속도 데이터를 이벤트 트리거 신호로 설정하여 이벤트 트리거 신호가 발생한 시점의 일정시간 전 인체 감지부에서 계측한 신호를 분석하여 건축물의 붕괴사고 발생 전 사람이 있을 경우 경보 알람부를 통해 사람이 매몰된 장소의 위치를 음성 또는 모스부호를 통해 경보하여 신속하게 구조 작업을 진행할 수 있도록 함으로써 붕괴에 의한 사고 사망률을 현저히 저감할 수 있는 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA MAINTENANCE CO LTD;CHOI JUN SEONG;SONG JEA HWAN;KANG SUNG MIN

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle carried life detection equipment and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses unmanned aerial vehicle carried life detection equipment and a detection method, wherein the detection equipment comprises sky end detection radar equipment and ground end display control equipment, and the sky end detection radar equipment comprises an antenna, a radio frequency module and a baseband processing module; the radio frequency module comprises a digital frequency synthesizer or a phase-locked loop, a power amplifier, a circulator, a low-noise amplifier, a combiner, a mixer, a band-pass filter, a gain-controllable amplifier, an amplitude limiter, an analog-digital converter and an antenna, wherein the digital frequency synthesizer or the phase-locked loop, the power amplifier, the circulator and the antenna form a transmitting channel; the antenna, the circulator, the low noise amplifier, the combiner, the mixer, the band-pass filter, the gain controllable amplifier, the amplitude limiter and the analog-digital converter form a receiving channel. The detection device is small in size and light in weight, is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle to realize large-area rapid detection of trapped people, and has stronger environmental adaptability and applicability.

title_en: Method and Device for Measuring Biometric Data using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 레이더를 이용하여 다중 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법에 있어서, (a) 상기 레이더로부터 상기 다중 생체 신호를 입력받는 단계; (b) 상기 입력받은 다중 생체 신호의 거리 정보를 계산하고 거리별로 분류하는 단계; (c) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 시간에 따른 분산이 가장 큰 신호를 선택하는 단계; (d) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 상기 (c)단계에서 선택된 신호와의 거리가 임의의 거리보다 작은 신호들 중에서 다수의 신호들을 더 선택하는 단계; (e) 상기 (c)단계 및 (d)단계에서 선택된 모든 신호들을 시간 도메인에서 주파수 도메인으로 변환하는 단계; (f) 상기 (e)단계에서 변환된 거리별 신호들에서 각 생체 신호별로 신뢰도를 산출하는 단계; 및 (g) 각 생체 신호 별로 상기 (f)단계에서 산출된 신뢰도가 가장 높은 거리별 신호를 선택하여 해당 생체 신호를 검출하는 단계를 포함한다. 개시된 방법에 따르면, 다중 생체 신호에서 각 생체 신호를 정확하게 검출해 낼 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: fire fighting building indoor fire hydrant
title_ko: 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting building indoor fire hydrant, which can easily extinguish a fire, comprising: a hose holder; a fire alarm; a hose sensor; a nozzle sensor; an alarm sensor; a firefighting water sensor; a sight glass; a pocket unit; an LED module; and a status checking controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물에 설치되어 화재를 진압하기 위한 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전은 벽체에 매립되는 소화전 함체, 상기 함체를 개폐하는 함체도어, 및 상기 함체의 내부에 설치되어 방화수를 공급하는 방화수전, 상기 함체의 내부에 수용되며 상기 방화수전과 연결되는 소방호스, 상기 소방호스의 끝단에 설치되어 방화수를 분사하는 관창노즐을 포함하는 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전에 있어서, 상기 함체의 내부에 설치되어 상기 소방호스를 거치하는 호스거치대, 상기 함체의 내부에 설치되어 상기 관창노즐을 거치하는 노즐거치대, 상기 함체에 설치되어 화재의 발생을 외부로 알리는 화재경보기, 상기 호스거치대에 설치되어 상기 소방호스의 거치여부를 감지하는 호스감지센서, 상기 노즐거치대에 설치되어 상기 관창노즐의 거치여부를 감지하는 노즐감지센서, 상기 화재경보기의 작동여부를 감지하는 경보기감지센서, 상기 방화수전에 방화수의 공급여부를 감지하는 방화수감지센서, 상기 함체도어에 형성되어 상기 함체의 내부를 투과하여 보는 투시창, 상기 함체도어의 내측에 상기 투시창의 둘레를 감싸 상부가 개방된 수용포켓을 형성하는 포켓부, 상기 포켓부의 내부에 복수 개가 삽입되어 상기 투시창을 통해 보여지며, 내부가 투과되는 투명한 소화액이 충전되고 투척 시 용이하게 깨지면서 충전된 소화액을 분출하여 화재를 진압하는 투척식 소화기, 상기 투척식 소화기를 통해 빛이 확산되어 상기 투시창을 통해 보이도록 상기 각 투척식 소화기와 대응되는 위치마다 빛을 조사하는 LED가 설치되는 LED모듈, 및 상기 함체의 내부 상태를 상기 함체의 외부에서 상기 투척식 소화기를 통해 확산되는 빛을 통해 파악하도록 상기 호스감지센서, 상기 노즐감지센서, 상기 경보기감지센서, 및 상기 방화수감지센서에서 감지되는 신호에 따라 서로 다른 위치의 LED을 점등하는 상태확인컨트롤러를 포함한다.
assignees: JI SUNG CONSULTING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject. A radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of arrays of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A phase value is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing phase changes over time for each voxel is generated. Voxels indicating an oscillating signal are selected and life sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: Sleep apnea monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep apnea monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a signal processing module, an MCU (microprogrammed control Unit) processor, a deep learning identification system and a rear-end display system, wherein the millimeter wave radar module is connected with the signal processing module; the method is characterized in that: the millimeter wave radar module is connected with the MUC processor, transmits a linear frequency modulation continuous wave signal in the working process according to the detection principle of the Doppler radar, receives a reflected echo signal and transmits the signal to the signal processing module; the signal processing module is connected with the MCU, obtains vital sign monitoring data of a user in the sleeping process by performing signal processing such as demodulation, amplification and the like on the echo signal, and transmits the signal to the deep learning identification system; the deep learning identification system filters a received signal, and filters noise and interference through a band-pass filter with a passband response of 2-50 Hz, which is generated by cascading a low-pass digital filter and a high-pass digital filter, according to the frequency of the signal.

title_en: Through-wall radar self-focusing sparse imaging method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging, and provides a through-wall radar self-focusing sparse imaging method and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signals of an extended target, and constructing a parameterized dictionary signal model with wall thickness and relative dielectric constant as parameters; constructing an objective function containing a parameterized dictionary by taking the sparse characteristic of an extended target as prior information and based on the maximum posterior probability estimation of full variational constraint and a parameterized dictionary signal model; alternately and iteratively updating the sparse reflection coefficient and the wall parameters according to the target function, wherein a hash table and a linear convolution are used for replacing the correlation operation of a dictionary matrix contained in the updating formula; and when the iteration termination condition is reached, outputting the wall thickness and the relative dielectric constant corresponding to the termination of the outer loop as estimated values of wall parameters, and using the corresponding sparse reflection coefficient for imaging. The invention effectively reserves the edge characteristic of the extended target, eliminates the target position offset caused by unknown wall parameters, simultaneously makes the imaging result clearer, effectively reduces the operation time and improves the space complexity.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue system for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent search and rescue system for fire fighting, which comprises intelligent fire fighting search and rescue equipment and a transmission communication system connected with the intelligent fire fighting search and rescue equipment; the intelligent fire fighting search and rescue equipment can collect and process the detected data and transmit the data to the command center in real time through the transmission communication system. The intelligent search and rescue system for fire fighting can assist the firemen to quickly finish rescue work on the premise of ensuring the self safety of the firemen in a disaster emergency rescue site; the equipment information of the individual soldier is transmitted to the vehicle-mounted control terminal in real time through the network, analysis and decision are carried out, and the analysis decision result is pushed to the individual soldier equipment so as to achieve accurate and rapid rescue and realize linkage of the individual soldier and a command center; the intelligent detection system achieves the purposes of accurate positioning of individual soldier personnel in fire rescue on site, infrared video return, intelligent identification of personnel to be rescued, voice talkback, vital signs and integrated detection of ventilator air pressure.
assignees: CHINA NAT AERO TECH HUADONG OPTOELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Oil pipe protection device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil exploitation equipment, and discloses an oil pipe protection device which comprises an oil pipeline, wherein a protective outer pipe sleeve is sleeved outside the oil pipeline, a puncture-resistant layer is embedded and installed on one side inside the protective outer pipe sleeve, a heat-insulating layer is embedded and installed on one side outside the puncture-resistant layer, a flame-retardant rubber ring is embedded and installed on one side outside the heat-insulating layer, a pressure sensor is uniformly clamped and installed at the edge position of the outer wall of the flame-retardant rubber ring, and a fixed inner side ring is fixedly installed on one side outside the flame-retardant rubber ring. According to the invention, through the electronic conducting wire and the puncture-resistant layer inside the protective outer sleeve, the functions of plant puncture prevention, heat preservation and water prevention can be provided when an oil pipeline is pre-buried, meanwhile, when a fire disaster occurs inside the oil pipeline, the flame-retardant rubber ring can be contracted towards the fixed inner side ring side under the action of high temperature, the fire source is closed to block air, the fire source is extinguished, and the function of flame-retardant protection of the oil pipeline is realized.

title_en: Driver safety monitoring method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver safety monitoring method, a device, a vehicle and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a driver in the target vehicle through at least one millimeter wave radar during the running process of the target vehicle; uploading vital sign data of the driver to a driver health management server through an internet of vehicles system; and generating a health management result matched with the driver according to the vital sign data of the driver through the driver health management server. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can provide an effective driver health and safety management mode, and improves the safety of drivers and target vehicles.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar human heart rate measurement method and system based on breath harmonic analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave radar human heart rate measurement method and system based on breath harmonic analysis. The method utilizes I/Q signals acquired by millimeter wave radar, and uses an extended DACM algorithm to acquire phase change information; then analyzing the time domain waveform of vital sign information, and calculating to obtain an asymmetry parameter of respiration and a pause parameter of a respiration gap, so that the bandwidth of a notch filter is dynamically adjusted by analysis, and the influence on a heartbeat frequency spectrum is reduced while respiratory harmonic waves are suppressed; finally, the heart rate estimation range is narrowed in a time domain peak counting mode, and the heart rate with higher precision is obtained by applying Chirp-Z transformation. Compared with the traditional respiratory harmonic elimination method, the heart rate measurement method is simple and convenient in flow, more effectively analyzes the intensity of respiratory harmonic and inhibits pertinence, and can effectively improve the measurement accuracy when the heart rate is overlapped with the respiratory harmonic frequency.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;GUANGANMEN HOSPITAL CHINA ACAD OF CHINESE MEDICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Detection method and positioning method for weak human body vital signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of weak human body life signals, which comprises the steps of adopting an ultra-wideband radar to transmit high-frequency high-repetition frequency sub-pulse signals to a target area and receiving sub-pulse echo signals; signal preprocessing is carried out on the sub-pulse echo signals; performing fast Fourier transform on the preprocessed signals to obtain frequency spectrums of sub-pulse signals; filtering and selecting the frequency spectrum of the sub-pulse signal to obtain a target frequency; and judging the target frequency to finish the detection of the weak human body vital signals. The invention also discloses a positioning method comprising the detection method of the weak human body vital signals. The invention is based on the repetition frequency, frequency agility and corresponding signal processing scheme, and improves the detection and positioning capability of the radar on weak human body vital signals after medium while reducing the coherent accumulation time; therefore, the invention not only can realize the detection and positioning of weak human body vital signals, but also has higher reliability and better accuracy.

title_en: Mobile scheduling management device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency dispatch management and discloses a mobile dispatch management device which comprises an information acquisition unit, an integration unit, a dispatch optimization unit, a decision-making auxiliary unit, a command unit and a communication unit, wherein the information acquisition unit comprises a field information acquisition module, an environment monitoring module and a vital sign detection sensor, the field situation can be rapidly, comprehensively and accurately mastered in an emergency scene through the information acquisition unit, the integration unit, the dispatch optimization unit, the decision-making auxiliary unit and the command unit, the accurate allocation and dynamic optimization of resources are realized based on scientific data analysis and intelligent algorithm, the scientificity and the efficiency of command decision are improved by means of an immersive virtual reality technology, and close fit and efficient cooperation among departments are ensured through a cross-department integrated cooperative communication system, so that the efficiency and effect of emergency rescue are remarkably improved, and casualties and property loss are furthest reduced.
assignees: BEIJING GREAT WALL HUA RUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign signal enhancement method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign signal enhancement method and a vital sign signal enhancement system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar echo signals, and recombining fast time sampling points into a subarray along a slow time direction; the method comprises the steps of screening subarrays according to a signal quality evaluation mechanism, removing low-quality subarrays to form sparse subarrays, performing digital beam forming of a distance dimension on the sparse subarrays, introducing asymmetric beam pattern constraint, and extracting vital sign phase information from a slow time signal output by beam forming. The invention can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the vital sign signal, enhance the signal detectability and ensure the detection accuracy and the robustness.

title_en: Sensor for acquiring physiological signals
title_ko: 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 센서
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 특히 센서(1)가 의복(7)에 포함되고 이러한 의복(7)을 착용한 사람이 고 레벨 활동을 하는 경우에, 개선된 실리콘 고무를 가지는, 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 센서(1)에 관한 것이고, 본 발명은 또한 이러한 센서를 포함하는 장치 및 이러한 장치를 포함하는 의복(7)에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus For Disaster Relief
title_ko: 재난 구조 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for disaster relief comprises: a driving unit which provides a driving force to move to a disaster scene in which a disastrous event happens in the case of the disastrous event; a sensor unit which detects victims belonging to the disaster scene and senses biological signals of the detected victims during the movement; a control unit which includes a victim status determination unit determining the present status of the victims based on the sensed biological signals, and a behavior determination unit differently determining a relief measure to be performed with respect to the victims in accordance with the perceived present status of the victims; and a screen unit marking a map showing the victims the way to evacuate.
abstract_ko: 상기 과제를 해결하기 위한 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 재난 구조 장치는 재난 이벤트가 발생한 경우 상기 재난 이벤트가 발생한 재난 현장으로 이동하기 위한 동력을 제공하는 구동부; 상기 이동 과정 중에 상기 재난 현장에 속하는 재난자를 탐색하고, 상기 탐색된 재난자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 감지된 생체 신호를 기초로 상기 탐색된 재난자의 현재 상태를 판단하는 재난자 상태 판단부 및 상기 판단된 현재 상태에 따라 상기 재난자에 대하여 수행할 구호조치를 상이하게 판단하는 동작 판단부를 포함하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 상기 재난자에게 대피 방법을 안내하는 지도를 표시하는 화면부를 포함한다.

title_en: Infant dectection system in vehicle based on ultra-wideband impluse-radio
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a UWB-based non-contact impulse radar-based vehicle infant occupancy detection system and, more specifically, to a UWB-based non-contact impulse radar-based vehicle infant occupancy detection system, in which a UWB sensor unit is installed on an upper end of a rear seat of a vehicle to measure a bio-signal of a passenger who is a monitoring target for monitoring an infant occupancy state of the vehicle in a non-contact manner, and an estimated distance between a guardian or a driver and the vehicle is measured through Bluetooth signal strength (RSSI) to monitor the occupancy state in a smartphone application through Bluetooth communication based on the measured bio-signal data and the measured estimated distance data between the guardian or the driver and the vehicle, and at the same time, a warning command signal is transmitted to a guardian terminal even if the guardian or the passenger (driver) deviates from the vehicle in the infant occupancy state to notify the guardian terminal audiovisually and immediately, thereby preventing an infant from being trapped in the vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 차량의 뒷 좌석 상단에 UWB 센서부가 설치되어, 비접촉식으로 차량의 유아 재실 상태를 모니터링하기 위한 모니터링 대상자인 탑승자의 생체 신호를 측정하고, 보호자 또는 운전자와 차량 사이의 추정 거리를 블루투스 신호 세기(RSSI)를 통해 측정하여 상기 측정된 생체 신호 데이터와 보호자 또는 운전자와 차량 사이의 측정된 추정 거리 데이터를 기초로 하여 블루투스 연통을 통해 스마트폰 앱에서 재실 상태를 모니터링함과 동시에, 유아 재실 상태에서 보호자 또는 탑승자(운전자)가 차량으로부터 이탈하더라도 보호자 단말로 경고 명령 신호를 전송하여 시청각적으로 즉각 통지할 수 있도록 하여 차량내 유아 갇힘 사고를 예방할 수 있는 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Three-dimensional through-wall radar system
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a three-dimensional through-wall radar system, comprising a frequency source (11), a transmitter (12), transmitting antennas (5), receiving antennas (4), a receiver (13), a signal processing board (2) and a power supply (3). The frequency source (11), the transmitter (12), and the receiver (13) are integrated on a same PCB to form a radio frequency integrated board (1); the signal processing board (2) and the radio frequency integrated board (1) are connected by means of an inter-board connector (14); the power supply (3) is fixed on the radio frequency integrated board (1), and is directly connected to the signal processing board (2) by means of a power supply interface; and the transmitting antennas (5) and the receiving antennas (4) are all located on the periphery of the radio frequency integrated board (1). The present invention has the advantages such as a simple and compact structure, light weight, and a simple and fast connection.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for contactless vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system (1), the radar sensor system (1) comprising a transmitter (2), a receiver (3) and processing device (5), wherein: the transmitter (2) irradiates (100) at least one body region (21) of a person (20) with radar radiation (30); the receiver (3) generates (110) a receiver signal from reflected radiation (11) from the at least one body region; the processing device (5) generates, for each of a plurality of processing windows, a displacement signal based on the receiver signal, which displacement signal characterizes a body motion comprising as oscillating motions a breathing motion and a heartbeat motion, and calculating an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillating motion. In order provide reliable and efficient means for life sign monitoring, the invention provides that the processing device (5), based on the displacement signal, applies an adaptive Nonlinear Least Squares method to calculate (250) a plurality of frequency estimates (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ), each of which corresponds to one of a plurality of harmonics of a first oscillating motion, wherein the processing device (5) uses an individual search region (A h1 , A h2 , A h3 ) for each frequency estimate (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ), adapts at least one search region (A h1 , A h2 , A h3 ) for at least one processing window, and calculates (300) a first estimated fundamental frequency (f h ) for the first oscillating motion based on the frequency estimates (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ).

title_en: Apparatus and method for evaluating cognitive load during driving by using driving performance and biomedical signals
title_ko: 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용한 운전 중 인지부하 평가장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent vehicle system for evaluating the cognitive load during driving by using driving performance and biomedical signals, and for performing security and preventative measures according to the evaluation. To this end, the present invention provides an apparatus and method for evaluating the cognitive load including: a lane detecting unit for receiving a vehicle image and calculating a lane position; an SLDP calculating unit for calculating the accumulated SDLP value for a predetermined time for lane position data received from the lane detecting unit; an SCL calculating unit for obtaining the average value of skin conductance input from a skin conductance sensor of the vehicle from the driver of the vehicle for the predetermined time; and a cognitive load determining unit for estimating the cognitive load state of the driver from the SDLP value and the average value of the skin conductance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용하여 운전자의 운전중 인지부하를 평가하고, 그 평가에 따른 안전 및 예방 조치를 행하는 지능형 자동차 시스템에 과한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은, 상기 차량의 이미지를 입력받아 차선의 위치를 계산하는 차선 검출부와, 상기 차선 검출부로부터 수신된 상기 차선의 위치 데이터에 대해 일정 시간 동안 누적된 SDLP 값을 구하는 SDLP 연산부와, 상기 차량의 스킨 컨덕턴스 센서로부터 일정시간 동안 입력된 상기 차량의 운전자에 대한 피부전도도의 평균값을 구하는 SCL 연산부와, 상기 SDLP값과 피부전도도 평균값을 통해 상기 운전자의 인지부하 상태를 추정하는 인지부하 판단부를 포함하는 인지부하 평가장치 및 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: DAEGU GYEONGBUK INST SCIENCE;SON JOON WOO;PARK MYOUNG-OUK

title_en: Device and method for monitoring compressions at a cardiac massage
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a device for and method of monitoring compressions in a cardiac massage on a person in a medical emergency situation. The device is equipped with a flow tube ( 2, 202 ), which exhibits a continuous flow channel for air, with at least one flow sensor ( 10 ) for determining mass or volumetric flow arranged in the flow channel of the flow tube ( 2, 202 ), and/or with a vital signs sensor arranged on the flow tube, by means of which a proportion of oxygen and carbon dioxide can be determined, with a processor that produces a characteristic output signal for penetration depth from the mass or volumetric flow determined and/or from the proportion of oxygen or carbon dioxide detected, and 
     with an output device ( 124, 224 ) that issues the output signal.

title_en: Seat occupation, vital signs and safety belt lock sensor system for rear vehicle seats without power supply
abstract_en: The present invention discloses seat occupation, vital signs and safety belt lock sensor for rear seats, which do not have power supply. The proposed system contains mm-wave radar sensor to be used for rear seat detection of seat occupancy and for vital sign detection, being placed on the vehicle ceiling or being integrated in the front seats, having radiation in the direction of the rear seat and detection if the human being is on the rear seat. The proposed system further contains hardware functionality being integrated in the safety belt environment. This functionality is communicating status if the safety belt is locked or not, in the case when the remote mm-wave sensor detected the human being on the rear seat, using arbitrary wireless communication means, and embedded arbitrary means for conserving energy, like battery. The proposed system is additionally detecting vital signs of the person using rear seats.

title_en: Wall parameter estimation method of through-wall radar
abstract_en: A wall parameter estimation method of a through-wall radar mainly solves the problem that the deviation of wall parameter estimation results is large due to the fact that the accuracy of time delay estimation results is poor in the conventional method. The method comprises the steps of estimating the time delay difference of the reflected waves of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall body through a seven-step orthogonal matching pursuit sparse reconstruction algorithm, constructing the time delay difference estimated values and the time delay difference theoretical values of M observation positions into an objective function, accurately estimating the thickness and the relative dielectric constant of the wall body through minimizing the objective function, and accurately estimating the conductivity of the wall body by combining the amplitude ratio of the reflected waves of the rear surface and the front surface of the wall body under the condition of single-base transceiving. In the wall parameter estimation process, an orthogonal matching pursuit sparse reconstruction algorithm is adopted to estimate the double-pass transmission delay difference of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall, so that the resolution and the accuracy of the delay difference estimation result under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio are improved, and the accuracy of wall parameter estimation is ensured. The method is particularly suitable for parameter estimation of the thin-layer wall body under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Through-wall perspective method based on neural network associated radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall perspective method based on a neural network associated radar, which comprises the following steps of: the partition wall collects radar detection information of a sample space, converts the radar detection information into a two-dimensional array, and stores the two-dimensional array as sample data; collecting image information of a sample space, converting the image information into binaryzation picture data, and storing the binaryzation picture data as label data; bringing the sample data and the label data into a convolutional neural network to obtain a trained data model; and detecting the space to be detected by using the radar partition wall, obtaining real-time radar detection data of the space to be detected, bringing the real-time radar detection data into a data model, and obtaining an indoor binary image through the data model. And (3) recognizing weak differences among received signals by utilizing the self-learning training capability of the convolutional neural network. Thereby distinguishing the action postures of the human body behind the wall as standing, walking and lying; the placement position of large furniture such as sofas, beds and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar track deviation estimation method based on image domain self-focusing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of through-wall radars, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar track deviation estimation method based on through-wall imaging image domain self-focusing. Firstly, realizing wall energy integration by using Radon transformation, realizing the estimation of the track deviation in the sight direction in a transformation domain by using an image self-focusing method, and secondly, carrying out maximum contrast self-focusing on a plurality of point target areas distributed behind the wall, and realizing the estimation of the track deviation along the course. The invention can reduce the dimension of the optimized variable, improve the estimation efficiency and fully utilize the space-variant pitch error information provided by targets with different distances and azimuth positions.

title_en: Radar for detecting object under the ground and method for detecting the same
title_ko: 매설물 탐지 레이더 및 탐지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar unit for detecting an object under the ground and a method for detecting the same, which minimizes the error rate in detecting an object buried under the ground. The radar unit of the embodiment of the present invention comprises: a transmission antenna for transmitting a detection signal to the ground surface; a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving reflected signals from an object buried under the ground by a detection signal; an environment analyzing unit for using the characteristics of each reflected signal received from the receiving antennas to identify the environmental characteristics where the detection of the object buried under the ground is conducted; and a signal processing control unit for processing the first reflected signal and second reflected signal according to the environmental characteristics to create a detection image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매설물 탐지 레이더 및 탐지 방법으로서, 지중에 매설된 매설물을 탐지하는데 있어서 오탐율을 최소화하는 매설물 탐지 레이더 및 탐지 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시 형태는 지표면에 탐지 신호를 송신하는 송신 안테나; 상기 탐지 신호에 의해 지중에 매설된 물체로부터 반사되는 반사 신호를 각각 수신하는 복수의 수신 안테나; 상기 복수의 수신 안테나로부터 수신하는 각각의 반사 신호의 특성을 이용하여, 매설물 탐지가 이루어지는 탐지 환경 특성을 파악하는 환경 분석부; 상기 탐지 환경 특성에 따라서 상기 제1반사 신호 및 제2반사 신호를 처리하여 탐지 영상을 생성하는 신호처리 제어부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Electronic acupuncture needle having heart rate sensor
title_ko: 심박센서가 구비된 전자침
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic acupuncture needle apparatus which adjusts electrical stimulation provided by an electronic acupuncture needle by using bio-signal information, and a method of controlling the electronic acupuncture needle apparatus. An objective of an embodiment of the present invention is to provide the electronic acupuncture needle apparatus which simultaneously stimulates a plurality of acupuncture points depending on the health state of a user by using the bio-signal information. The electronic acupuncture needle apparatus of the present invention comprises: an electronic acupuncture needle unit which applies electrical stimulation to the user; a sensor unit which senses the bio-signal information of the user; and a control unit which controls the sensor unit to sense a bio-signal at preset intervals and controls the electronic acupuncture needle unit so that an electrical stimulation amount is adjusted according to the bio-signal sensed by the sensor unit. The control unit controls the electrical stimulation amount after estimating if the user is in an emergency situation depending on whether a signal variation amount from a bio-signal sensed at the first set time to a bio-signal sensed at the second set time during a time change from a first set time to a second set time belongs to a predetermined range or not.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 정보를 이용하여 전자침이 제공하는 전기자극을 조절하는 전자침 장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로서, 사용자에게 전기자극을 가하는 전자침부, 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 센서부 및 미리 설정한 시간 간격으로 생체신호를 감지하도록 센서부를 제어하고, 센서부가 감지한 생체신호에 따라 전기자극량이 조절되도록 전자침부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하며, 제어부는 제1설정시간으로부터 제2설정시간까지의 시간변화 동안 제1설정시간에 감지된 생체신호로부터 제2설정시간에 감지된 생체신호까지의 신호변화량이 소정의 범위에 속하는지 여부에 따라 사용자가 응급상황에 있는지 여부를 추정한 후 전기자극량을 제어하는 것을 특징으로 하는 전자침 장치 및 그 제어방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Underground facility surveying and exploration system using GPR exploration equipment
title_ko: 지피알(gpr) 탐사장비를 이용한 지하시설물 측량 탐사 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility surveying and exploration system using ground penetrating radar (GPR) exploration equipment. More specifically, the present invention relates to an underground facility surveying and exploration system using GPR exploration equipment, which is improved to facilitate surrounding exploration based on underground facilities and improve the convenience of exploration when exploring the buried depth of underground facilities, structures around underground facilities and the distance to those structures, or the like.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지피알(GPR) 탐사장비를 이용한 지하시설물 측량 탐사 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 지하시설물의 매설 깊이, 지하시설물 주변의 구조물 및 그 구조물과의 거리 등을 탐사할 때 지하시설물을 기준으로 주변 탐사를 용이하게 하고, 탐사의 편의성을 향상시키도록 개선된 지피알(GPR) 탐사장비를 이용한 지하시설물 측량 탐사 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Sleep state determination system, method, and application using the same using Doppler signals
title_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션
abstract_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템은 관측 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임 신호 정보를 획득하고, 상기 생체 신호 및 움직임 정보를 이용하여 상기 관측 대상자의 수면 상태를 판단하는 수면 상태 판단부;를 포함하며, 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호를 통해 획득되는 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보는 제1-1 신호 정보 및 제1-2 신호 정보이며, 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 통해 획득되는 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보는 제2-1 신호 정보 및 제2-2 신호 정보를 포함한다.

title_en: Smoke alarm and smoke alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a smoke alarm and a smoke alarm system, wherein the smoke alarm comprises a shell, a mounting carrier, a chip and an alarm device, the shell is mounted on the mounting carrier, air inlets are circumferentially formed in the outer part of the shell, and the alarm device is mounted on the outer wall of the shell; a chip is arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the shell; it is characterized by also comprising: a dual smoke detection device and a life detection device; the dual smoke detection device is arranged on the outer wall of the shell. The smoke alarm provided by the utility model comprises the double smoke detection devices, can be used for respectively detecting the concentration of white smoke and black smoke in smoke, is more accurate in smoke concentration detection compared with the existing smoke alarm, and is provided with the life detection device, so that the privacy of a user in a space is protected, and meanwhile, the life activity signs in a millimeter wave radar monitoring range with strong penetrating fog, smoke and dust penetrating capability are depended.

title_en: Small animal vital sign monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a small animal vital sign monitoring device, which comprises a box body, an ultra-wideband radar monitoring system fixedly arranged at two ends of the inner bottom surface of the box body and a small animal fixing device, wherein the ultra-wideband radar monitoring system is arranged at the bottom surface of the box body; the radar monitoring system comprises a shell, an ultra-wideband radar module, a radar echo signal processing module and a safety power module, wherein the ultra-wideband radar module, the radar echo signal processing module and the safety power module are arranged in the shell; the fixing device comprises a support track plate, a base and an upper cover, wherein the base is in sliding connection with the support track plate, the upper cover is in rotary connection with the base, and the base and the upper cover can be matched to form a movable space which is more suitable for accommodating small animals. According to the utility model, non-contact type small animal vital sign monitoring is realized through the ultra-wideband radar monitoring system and the fixing device, the moving space of the small animal is effectively limited, the interference of body movement data on the vital sign is avoided, the respiratory frequency and heart rate data are more accurately obtained, meanwhile, the monitored small animal is isolated through the box body, and the risk of damaging the body health of an experimenter is reduced.

title_en: Protective clothing based on flexible sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses protective clothing based on a flexible sensor, which comprises a coat for protecting the upper body, trousers for protecting legs and a head cover for protecting the head and the neck, wherein the coat, the trousers and the head cover are integrally formed; still include the data acquisition subassembly, the data acquisition subassembly is including the flexible gas sensor that is used for gaseous composition to gather, the flexible humidity transducer that is used for air humidity to gather, the flexible temperature sensor that is used for the collection of regional interior temperature and the flexible inductance formula sensor that is used for vital sign to gather. The invention can realize data acquisition of the surrounding environment in a wearing mode, and can detect the vital signs of the firefighter, thereby facilitating the command center to know the conditions in the area where the firefighter is located and the command center to formulate a rescue scheme.

title_en: Rapid Gaussian gridding non-uniform FFT through-wall imaging radar BP method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid Gaussian gridding non-uniform FFT through-wall imaging radar BP method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a through-wall radar detection scene model, arranging antenna array elements parallel to a wall body, transmitting electromagnetic waves, and uniformly sampling an obtained target echo signal to obtain echo signal data e; gridding pixel points in the imaging area of the through-wall radar, projecting echo signal data onto each pixel point grid in the imaging area to obtain an amplitude value I (x) of a BP imaging pixel point of the through-wall radar p ,y p ) (ii) a Constructing an expression of the non-uniform FFT, and pre-calculating and storing each coefficient in the expression of the non-uniform FFT; transforming uniformly sampled data to non-uniformly sampled data, pair I (x) p ,y p ) And (4) performing fast Gaussian gridding non-uniform FFT calculation and accumulating to obtain a radar imaging graph. The invention can effectively reduce the calculation complexity while ensuring the imaging quality, and solves the problem that the calculation amount of the BP method is along with the working frequencyThe number of points, antennas and pixel points are increased.

title_en: Object recognition method, object recognition device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an object identification method, an object identification device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be recognized comprising the buried object to be recognized, inputting the image to be recognized into a target recognition model comprising a feature extraction submodel and an object recognition submodel, recognizing the buried object to be recognized in the image to be recognized through the feature extraction submodel and the object recognition submodel comprising a plurality of convolution layers, outputting a recognition result, and determining the type of the buried object to be recognized in the image to be recognized according to the recognition result output by the target recognition model. Compared with the traditional method for detecting the buried object in the ground penetrating radar image through Hough transform and the like, the method has the advantages that the buried object type in the image to be recognized is recognized by the aid of the characteristic extraction submodels and the object recognition submodels comprising the plurality of convolution layers, and accordingly the recognition accuracy of the buried object is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BUREAU EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE TRANSMISSION CO CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Human breath detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of signal processing, and relates to a human breath detection method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, radar echo data are read; s2, performing inverse fast Fourier transform on the radar echo data to obtain a fast-slow time plane; s3, detecting a moving target on the fast and slow time planes, eliminating background clutter, obtaining echo signals of a human body, and determining the target position of the human body; s4, performing fast Fourier transform on the fast and slow time planes subjected to moving object detection along slow time to determine the respiratory rate of the human body. The human body behind the obstacle (wall) can still be detected under the conditions of complex environments such as strong clutter and low signal to noise ratio to acquire the breathing frequency and one-dimensional distance of the human body target, so that whether the human body target exists or not and whether the vital sign of the human body is stable or not can be determined, and the method can be applied to scenes such as anti-terrorism and earthquake disaster rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN LAN YOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for positioning trapped person based on four-dimensional biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning trapped people based on four-dimensional biological radar. The method comprises the following steps: s1, rearranging echo data acquired by a four-dimensional biological radar to form a three-dimensional complex matrix; s2, obtaining a three-dimensional complex radar image after filtering, and splicing the three-dimensional complex radar image obtained by continuous measurement into a four-dimensional radar image sequence according to time sequence; s3, calculating the energy entropy ratio of the four-dimensional radar image sequence; s4, weighting energy entropy ratio of the four-dimensional radar image sequence along a time dimension; s5, detecting a plurality of targets in each frame of three-dimensional image of the four-dimensional radar image sequence, and clustering, wherein a clustering center is used as the three-dimensional position coordinates of each human body target; s6, respectively extracting vital sign signals corresponding to each human body from voxels at the three-dimensional position coordinates along the time dimension. The invention greatly improves the signal-to-noise ratio after processing, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the buried human body detection by more than 30dB, and can realize human body detection and three-dimensional positioning of the buried human body with the depth of tens of meters.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and provides a heartbeat detection method, a heartbeat detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a spatial channel between an edge computing gateway and each target device in a first target area to obtain first breathing information perceived by the spatial channel; determining a second target area where the first object is located based on the first respiratory information perceived by the spatial channel; detecting second breathing information of the first object in the second target area by adopting a millimeter wave radar; a second subject is determined based on the first respiration information and the second respiration information, and heartbeat information of the second subject is detected. According to the application, the rough position of the target in the static state is perceived through indoor space channel perception connection, and then the millimeter wave radar is controlled to perform heartbeat detection, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of heartbeat detection are improved.

title_en: Technique for treating surface air leakage of shallow-buried coal seam easy to naturally fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shallow-buried natural ignition-prone coal seam surface air leakage treatment technology, which comprises three parts of surface air leakage treatment, fire area gas detection and emergency rescue treatment. The earth surface air leakage monitoring and detecting device is used for carrying out qualitative and quantitative measurement, and plugging materials with bentonite as a substrate are used for filling cracks. And constructing a multi-jump infinite area network, arranging data acquisition nodes at the middle and lower parts of the hydraulic support along the working surface, and covering the outer sides of the nodes by large-block coal-losing to form a triangular protection area. Along with the pushing of the working face, the nodes are buried in the goaf, a data acquisition local area network is constructed, and gas and temperature signals are transmitted in a relay mode. The stepless air damper is provided with an air speed sensor and a rotating blade, so that the aperture of the variable air window is formed, the tunnel air quantity is sensed in real time, and remote intelligent regulation and control are realized. The wall surface spraying vehicle sprays and forms plugging foam on the rugged roadway wall surface. The technology has the remarkable characteristics of high systematic degree of treatment and strong application scene pertinence, and can be used for carrying out high-efficiency treatment on the coal seam which is shallow buried and easy to fire naturally.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a vital sign monitoring system and method, comprising: the respiratory airflow temperature data acquisition unit is used for acquiring the respiratory airflow temperature through the temperature sensor; a chest respiratory motion data acquisition unit for acquiring chest respiratory motion data by an acceleration sensor; the chest impedance imaging unit is used for acquiring chest impedance imaging results through a plurality of impedance electrodes; the processor unit is used for issuing a data acquisition command and processing acquired data, and specifically comprises the following components: based on the obtained respiratory airflow temperature data, chest respiratory motion data and chest impedance imaging results, vital sign monitoring is achieved, wherein when the respiratory airflow temperature data is abnormal, a data acquisition command is issued to the chest impedance imaging unit to obtain an imaging result, meanwhile, whether the chest respiratory motion data is normal or not is judged, if so, the occurrence of obstructive apnoea is judged, and if not, the occurrence of central apnoea is judged.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHONGKE ADVANCED TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target regional rapid through-wall imaging method under polar coordinate system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-target regional rapid through-wall imaging method under a polar coordinate system, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and comprises the following steps: preprocessing a target echo signal to remove wall echo and background clutter; carrying out one-dimensional constant false alarm detection on the central channel, and extracting the number of targets and the electric length corresponding to the positions of the targets; step 2, measuring that the electric length of the target position is larger than the real distance of the target due to the existence of the wall, and obtaining the relation between the real distance of the target and the electric length according to detailed mathematical deduction; calculating the difference between the electric length corresponding to the target position and the real distance and the width of the main echo lobe, and determining the width of the local imaging strip; the true distance at which each target is located is striped. The method shortens the time consumption of the algorithm, avoids the condition that strong targets mask weak targets due to energy attenuation, and corrects the deviation of the imaging positions of the targets due to the existence of the wall body by deducing the wall body compensation formula under the polar coordinate system.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Human body automatic focusing vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring method of human body automatic focusing, which comprises the steps of sending radar microwave signals to a target human body, receiving three paths of radar microwave echo signals, respectively extracting frequency domain characteristics of the three paths of radar microwave echo signals, generating human body three-dimensional point cloud data according to the frequency domain characteristics of the three paths of radar microwave echo signals, determining the lying position of the target human body according to the human body three-dimensional point cloud data, carrying out signal reconstruction on the three paths of human body radar microwave echo signals obtained according to the lying position of the target human body, obtaining three paths of reconstructed human body radar microwave signals, judging whether the target human body is in a resting state according to the three paths of reconstructed human body radar microwave signals, if so, searching for the chest of the target human body, and calculating the heart rate and respiratory frequency of the target human body.

title_en: Real-time through-wall human body posture estimation method based on WIFI equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of infinite perception and human body posture estimation, and discloses a real-time through-wall human body posture estimation method based on WIFI equipment, which comprises the following steps: the system is deployed, wherein an emitter and a receiver are carried with an inter5300 network card and a plurality of emitter antennas, an emitter and a receiver are respectively arranged on two sides of a wall body, the emitter is provided with a synchronous camera, the receiver receives reflected CSI passing through an indoor human body and surrounding wall bodies, the camera synchronously collects video data, and a data set is manufactured by aligning the CSI data frame and the video frame by utilizing time stamps of the CSI and the video frame according to the collected channel state information CSI signals and the video frames. Through arranging the WiFi transmitting end and the WiFi receiving end on two sides of the wall body and carrying corresponding artificial neural network models, non-contact human body posture estimation is achieved, and the effects of through-wall human body recognition and posture estimation through wireless signals are achieved.

title_en: Artificial object detection system, method of detecting artificial object used therein, and artificial object detection control program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an artificial object detection system, capable of efficiently and simultaneously detecting artificial objects existing at the bottom of the sea or water in a wide area, even when an artificial object is buried therein.  <P>SOLUTION: An artificial earthquake generating means (e.g., an artificial earthquake source 11) arranged at a bottom B of the sea or water generates an artificial earthquake. A vibration wave detection means (e.g., a vibration sensor 12) arranged in the sea or water detects the sound waves generated by the artificial earthquake and a vibration wave radiated in the sea or water from the bottom B of the sea or water, with the bottom B propagating an earthquake wave qw being faster than the sound waves. An artificial object presence determination means (e.g., a data processing device 13) detects the arrival orientation of the vibration waves when the level of the vibration waves detected by the vibration sensor 12 is relatively higher and determines that an artificial object HW exists at the bottom B of the sea or water in the arrival orientation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for sensing high-resolution distance, and application thereof
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To conduct a non-contact and non-invasive type sending of a vital sign or other health signal using radar or other high-resolution distance sensing.SOLUTION: A sensing system 11 includes a first radar sensing assembly and an analysis system 18. The first radar sensing assembly uses a radar to measure a plurality of distances to a first target position 16 at different times. The analysis system 18 receives the plurality of distances from the first radar sensing assembly and calculates a difference of the plurality of distances measured by the first radar sensing assembly, thereby quantifying a movement of a target 14 at the first target position 16 at different times. The sensing system 11 uses the calculated difference of the plurality of distances to generate one or more first quantitative action level value that represents the movement of the target 14 at the first target position 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Whole fabric radiating far-infrared ray and manufacturing process thereof
title_ko: 원적외선을 방사하는 섬유원단과 그의 제조방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a fiber fabric, from which far infrared rays are emitted, is manufactured by a method which comprises: a first process in which an appropriate amount of acid is added to an alkaline germanium solution of pH 9-10, prepared by dissolving germanium dioxide powder in an alkaline solution, to convert the germanium solution into a slightly acid germanium solution of pH 5-7, wherein undissolved solids are filtered out with a filter so as to prepare a pure slightly acid mixed solution; a second process in which 30-50% of the slightly acid mixed solution is mixed with 50-70% of an aqueous binder solution so as to prepare an undiluted adhesive germanium solution; a third step in which 3-10% of the undiluted germanium solution is diluted in clean water at a temperature of 40-50°C and added with 3-5% of an antistatic agent so as to prepare a germanium mixed diluted solution; and a fourth step in which a fiber fabric having the diluted solution infiltrated thereinto by immersion and coating processes is dried while being transferred through an electric heater thermal kiln set at a temperature of 80-130°C. The fiber fabric manufactured by the present invention is configured to maintain softness like an original fiber fabric. Unlike a conventional fiber fabric using powder type germanium, the fiber fabric of the present invention is not stiff caused by protruding concave-convex parts or coated films but soft, and is configured to emit far infrared rays having an emissivity of 0.9 or more.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 원적외선이 방출되는 섬유원단은 
이산화 게르마늄 분말을 알칼리 액으로 용해하여 만들어진 ph 9~10의 알카리성 게르마늄 용액이 ph 5~7 정도의 약산성으로 전환되도록 산을 적정량 혼합하고, 용해되지 아니한 고형물을 필터로 여과하여 순수한 약산성 혼합용액을 만드는 제 1공정, 
상기 약산성 혼합용액 30~50%에 수용성 바인더액 50~70%의 비율로 혼합한 후 접착성 게르마늄 원액을 완성하는 제2공정, 
상기 게르마늄 원액을 3~10%로 하여 40~50℃ 정도의 깨끗한 물에 희석하고, 정전기방지제 3~5%를 혼합하여 게르마늄 혼합 희석액을 완성하는 제3공정, 
희석액을 침수, 도포작업으로 내부로 침투시킨 섬유원단을 80~130℃로 설정된 전기히터 열가마를 경유하면서 건조되는 제4공정을 통하여 제조된다. 
본 발명으로 제조되는 섬유원단은 원래의 섬유원단과 같은 부드럼움을 유지한다. 기존의 분말형 게르마늄을 사용한 섬유원단과는 달리 요철 돌출이나 코팅피막으로 인한 뻣뻣함이 없이 부드러우며, 0.9이상의 원적외선을 방출한다.

title_en: Smart ring for extracting bio-signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정용 스마트 링
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정용 스마트 링은 착용자의 손가락에 착용되도록 반지형상을 가지고, 착용된 손가락이 맞닿는 내주면 및 내주면보다 크게 형성되는 외주면을 가지는 하우징, 하우징의 내주면으로부터 돌출형성되는 돌출부, 하우징의 내주면에 위치하고, 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부 및 센서부로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신하는 제어부 및 센서부 및 제어부로 전원을 공급하는 배터리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and device for searching through collapsed ground
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for determining whether a living person has been buried in collapsed ground. The device consists of a rod provided with a receiver unit and a signal processing unit. The receiver unit is intended to receive reflected radar signals transmitted form a radar transmitting antenna and transfer these signals to the signal processing unit. The signal processing unit which is provided with specific detection units determines whether the received signal have been Doppler shifted. By determining this the device can decide whether the Doppler shift depends on the moving chest of a breathing person buried alive.

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced maximum permissible exposure (mpe) compliance based on vital signs detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflection signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflection signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on the reflection signals, the device can measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain a heart rate and/or breathing rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflection signals indicate human vital signs, such as a heart rate or breathing. The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether human vital signs are detected at the target object, and transmit the adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Security surveillance microwave sensor having reduced false report rate by means of biological signal detection
title_ko: 생체신호 감지에 따른 오보율을 개선한 보안 감시용 마이크로웨이브 센서
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security surveillance microwave sensor having a reduced false report rate by means of biological signal detection, the security surveillance microwave sensor monitoring and determining a malfunction state or false alarm due to environmental factors by detecting humans, animals or objects approaching within a predetermined distance by means of a microwave signal. The present invention: has a first doppler radar and a second doppler radar, each of which detect humans and process security signals, provided in a pair so as to further extend the monitoring distance and perform security surveillance; can specifically set an IF frequency band which can be disturbed by humans; can simply amplify the IF frequency or use a change in the voltage level (peak to peak) by converting and outputting same into a displacement of a DC voltage in order to extend the monitoring distance (d); can precisely manage a monitoring state by double-checking such that the pair of sensors can transmit and receive security signals to and from each other by means of the extended monitoring distance; and has a reduced false report rate compared to an existing microwave sensor by distinguishing false alarms or a malfunction state of the sensors.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 마이크로웨이브(Microwave) 신호를 이용하여 일정 거리 이내에서 접근하는 인체나 동물 또는 사물을 감지하여 환경적 요인에 의한 오경보나 고장상태를 감시하고 판단하는 생체신호 감지에 따른 오보율을 개선한 보안 감시용 마이크로웨이브 센서에 관한 것으로, 인체감지 및 보안신호를 각각 처리하는 제1도플러레이더와 제2도플러레이더를 한 쌍으로 설치하여 감시거리를 더욱 확장하여 보안감시를 할 수 있도록 하고, 인체에 의해 교란되는 IF 주파수대역을 특정하여 설정할 수 있고, 감시거리(d)를 확장하기 위하여 단순히 IF 주파수를 증폭하거나 전압레벨(peak to peak)의 변화를 DC 전압의 변위로 변경 출력하여 사용할 수 있도록 하며, 감시거리의 확장으로 한 쌍의 센서에서 상호 보안신호를 송출하고 수신할 수 있도록 이중 체크함으로써 감시상태를 세밀하게 관리할 수 있고, 센서의 오경보나 고장상태를 더욱 구분할 수 있어 기존의 마이크로웨이브 센서에 비하여 더욱 향상된 오보율의 개선할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: System and method for monitoring patient risk by using bio-signal obtained in non-contact type
title_ko: 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for monitoring patient risks by using bio-signals obtained in a non-contact type. According to the present invention, an apparatus for automatically collecting bio-signals comprises the steps of: periodically emitting radar toward a patient; measuring the heart rate and the respiration rate of the patient by using radar signals reflected from the patient; measuring the body temperature of the patient by using an infrared body temperature measurement sensor; estimating the blood pressure of the patient by using the heart rate; estimating the electrocardiogram and the oxygen saturation of the patient by using the heart rate and the blood pressure value; and predicting the risk of a severe disease of the patient by using the heart rate, the respiration rate, the blood pressure, the body temperature, the electrocardiogram, and the oxygen saturation. The apparatus may further comprise a step of delivering an alarm signal to an external terminal if the predicted risk is greater than a reference value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 생체신호 자동 수집 장치는 환자를 향하여 레이더를 주기적으로 조사하는 단계, 환자로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 이용하여 환자의 심박수와 호흡수를 측정하는 단계, 적외선 체온 측정 센서를 이용하여 환자의 체온을 측정하는 단계, 심박수를 이용하여 환자의 혈압을 추정하는 단계, 심박수와 혈압 값을 이용하여 환자의 심전도와 산소포화도를 추정하는 단계, 그리고 상기 심박수, 호흡수, 혈압, 체온, 심전도 및 산소포화도를 이용하여 환자의 중증질환에 대한 위험도를 예측하는 단계를 포함하고, 예측된 위험도가 기준값보다 크면 외부 단말로 알람 신호를 전달하는 단계를 더 포함할 수 있다.
