title_en: Buried heat storage can
abstract_en: The present invention relates to heat energy technology apparatus field, more particularly to a kind of buried heat storage can, including top ends of cans (1), tank skin (2) and tank bottom (3), it is characterized in that, the top ends of cans (1) is provided with fused salt pumping hole (4), fused salt entrance (5), fused salt agitator mouth (6), electric heater mouth (7), liquid level gauge (8), thermometer (9), inspection manhole (10), heat-insulation layer A (11)；The inner side of the tank skin (2) sets electric heating layer (12) and temperature sensor (13), the outside of the tank skin (2) to be provided with heat-insulation layer B (14).The present invention is buried heat storage can, avoids heat-storing device from being placed in heat-energy losses excessive in atmospheric environment；Tank body can be made to be corroded from natural calamities such as dusts storm, extend the service life of heat storage can, reduce the cost and expense of replacing.

title_en: Water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system, which is characterized in that a water condition monitoring device, a soil monitoring device and an early warning notification terminal are arranged to notify flood condition information of villagers in real time, and if flood disasters are predicted to occur, the villagers can be notified to evacuate at the first time, so that the problem of low efficiency caused by the combination of the existing broadcast and artificial notification is solved, and the notification timeliness of villages influenced by flood periods is improved. Simultaneously through be provided with the monitoring subassembly on the soil monitoring devices and bore the integrated structure of native subassembly and flexible subassembly for at the in-process of installation or maintenance, drive the mode that bores native subassembly and monitoring subassembly and remove through its flexible subassembly of electric control, with the sensor is buried underground or pulled out to the quick realization, thereby installation or the maintenance progress of monitoring devices are in order to ensure during the quickening flood season the monitoring of water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system is ageing.

title_en: Landslide safety monitoring system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide safety monitoring system and an early warning method thereof, and relates to the technical field of safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of connecting a control end of a cloud server and landslide sensors buried in a soil slope to be monitored, wherein the landslide sensors are uniformly distributed on the soil slope to be monitored, soil layer tightness data and soil layer deviation data of different depths of installation points of the landslide sensors are obtained, the control end obtains the soil layer tightness data and the soil layer deviation data sent by the landslide sensors and combines a three-dimensional image of a region of the soil slope to be monitored, which is obtained in advance, to construct a three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model of the soil slope to be monitored, the control end obtains the data sent by the landslide sensors in real time and updates the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, if the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change exceeds a preset threshold value, the control end sends out landslide warning alarms, and the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change is a comparison value of the three-dimensional real-time soil layer monitoring model and an initial three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, and the three-dimensional soil layer deviation is obtained.

title_en: Equipment for protection transmission tower
title_ko: 송전탑 보호 시설물
abstract_en: Equipment for protecting a transmission tower is provided to prevent the approach of a fire in advance by storing rainwater and to spray water in all directions when sensing a fire. Equipment for protecting a transmission tower includes a water storing tower(110), a water collecting tool(120), a pump, a discharge pipe(140), a valve controller(150), a water spray nozzle(170), a fire sensing sensor(180), a large amount water spray nozzle(190) and a wind direction switch. The water storing tanks are buried in the ground around a transmission tower(10). The large amount water spray nozzles are installed in four directions around the transmission tower, and are opened and closed by the control of the valve controller. The wind direction switch sends instructions to open and close the large amount water spray nozzle in a direction of wind coming in.
abstract_ko: 빗물을 받아 저장해 놓고, 송전탑의 주변에서 산불을 감지하면 저장된 물을 사방으로 뿌려주도록 하여 산불의 접근을 미리 막을 수 있으며, 바람이 불어오는 방향으로 대량살수를 하도록 하여 산불을 진압할 수 있는 송전탑 보호 시설물이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 송전탑 보호 시설물은 송전탑주변 지중에 매립되는 저수조와, 저수조로 빗물을 받아 유입시키는 집수구와, 저수조의 물을 지면위로 퍼올리는 펌프 및 배출관과, 배출관이 연결되는 밸브제어기와, 송전탑주변에 다량으로 골고루 설치되면서 밸브제어기의 제어에 의해 개폐되는 살수노즐과, 송전탑의 주변에 설치되어 산불을 감지하여 밸브제어기를 작동시키는 화재감지센서를 포함한다. 그리고 송전탑주변 네방향에 설치되면서 밸브제어기의 제어에 의해 어느 하나가 개폐되는 대량살수노즐과, 풍향을 계산하여 바람이 불어오는 방향의 대량살수노즐을 개폐시키도록 지시하는 풍향스위치가 더 포함될 수 있다.

title_en: Ultrasound treatment apparatus and driving method thereof
title_ko: 초음파 치료 장치 및 이의 구동 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 대상체의 일 호흡주기를 감지하여 호흡감지신호를 생성하는 호흡센서부; 상기 호흡감지신호를 이용하여 상기 일 호흡주기 중 어느 하나의 시구간에 대응되는 동기화 신호를 추출하는 정보처리부; 자기공명영상 촬영을 위한 자기장이 인가되는 중공을 포함하고, 상기 동기화 신호에 따라 상기 대상체의 관심영역의 자기공명영상을 생성하는 자기공명영상 생성부; 상기 대상체의 관심영역에 촬상용 초음파를 조사시키는 초음파 프로브(probe)를 포함하며, 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되어 상기 관심영역의 초음파 영상을 생성하는 초음파영상 생성부; 및 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되며, 상기 초음파영상 및 상기 자기공명영상을 이용하여 상기 관심영역에 집속(focused) 초음파를 조사하는 초음파 치료부;를 포함하는, 초음파 치료 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: System for Sensing Landsilde
title_ko: 산사태 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a landslide detection system, wherein a plurality of foundation supports buried and installed in a mountainous terrain are connected by a sensing wire, a possibility of an occurrence of landslide can be determined in a simple manner without applying various sensors by measuring a change in a tensile force of the sensing wire to determine the possibility of an occurrence of landslide, in addition to a sensor for measuring the tensile force of the sensing wire, a separate sound detection sensor is mounted to detect a sound generated at the time of surface displacement, accordingly, the possibility of an occurrence of landslide can be determined more accurately, the sensing wire can be restored to its initial state through a tensile force holding means by providing the tensile force holding means capable of restoring the tensile force of the sensing wire to an initial set value state when the change in the tensile force of the sensing wire occurs due to an external factor, and accordingly, a stable and precise sensing state can be always maintained.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산사태 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 산악 지형에 매립 설치된 다수개의 기초 지지대를 감지 와이어로 연결하고, 감지 와이어의 인장력 변화를 측정하여 산사태 발생 가능성을 판단함으로써, 다양한 센서들을 적용하지 않고 단순한 방식으로 산사태 발생 가능성을 판단할 수 있고, 감지 와이어의 인장력을 측정하는 센서 이외에 별도의 소리 감지 센서를 장착하여 지표 변위 이동시 발생하는 소리를 감지함으로써, 산사태 발생 가능성을 더욱 정확하게 판단할 수 있으며, 감지 와이어의 인장력을 최초 설정값 상태로 복원시킬 수 있는 인장력 유지 수단을 구비함으로써, 외부 요인에 의해 감지 와이어의 인장력 변화가 발생한 경우에는 인장력 유지 수단을 통해 감지 와이어를 최초 상태로 복원시켜 항상 안정적이고 정확한 감지 상태를 유지할 수 있는 산사태 감지 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: face mask
title_ko: 페이스 마스크
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 수중 레저 또는 재난 환경에서 사용되는 페이스 마스크에서 전방을 투시하는 렌즈부에 센서를 통해 수집된 다양한 정보들을 디스플레이하여 착용자에게 표시하고, 경고하기 위한 페이스 마스크에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 페이스 마스크는 안면을 밀폐하는 프레임, 프레임의 전방에 배치되어 전방을 투시하는 렌즈부, 신체 정보 및 외부 정보를 수집하는 센서부, 센서부에 의해 수집된 정보를 렌즈부에 출력하는 출력부, 센서부로부터 수집된 신체 정보 및 외부 정보를 전달받아 출력부가 출력하도록 제어하고, 신체 정보 및 외부 정보를 통해 획득한 가공 정보를 출력부가 출력하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Magnetic sensing buried utility locator including a camera
abstract_en: Portable locators for detecting buried objects and determining information therefrom based on sensing electromagnetic emissions are disclosed. In one implementation, a portable locator may include a magnetic field sensor array and associated signal processing circuitry to detect and determine information associated with the buried object, as well as a camera and image or video processing circuitry to process images or video received from the camera in conjunction with the buried object detection.

title_en: Systems and methods for mapping manmade objects buried in subterranean surfaces using an unmanned aerial vehicle integrated with radar sensor equipment
abstract_en: A method for mapping an object buried in a subterranean surface includes receiving a first input data set. The first input data set is based on a GNSS signal, a SAR signal, and a GPR signal. The method further includes generating a raw image based on the first input data set, comparing the raw image to a calibration data set, identifying an object based on the raw image compared to the calibration data set, transmitting object data to a ground-based post-processing unit, and displaying the object data to a graphic user interface. The calibration data set may be based on material calibration data. The object data may be based on the object identified.

title_en: Real-time, two dimensional (2-D) tracking of first responders with identification inside premises
abstract_en: A combination of active reader tags and ultra wideband (UWB) radar systems provide real-time monitoring of first responders, with identification of each team member using active tags, and detection of victims or other subjects using motion or breathing detection, in a field of operations such as a building affected by fire or hazardous material or search and rescue mission area. Initially, a cluster of miniaturized radars (sensors) act in a static mode of operation, gathering static radar information used to depict a constructed layout of the premises. The cluster of radars then operate in a dynamic mode that detects motion or breathing of multiple subjects inside the field of operations. With dual mode operation the system can read the active tags identification, and by triangulation, display the position of each first responder with its identification and positions of subjects on a composite image of the constructed layout.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar with multiple correlators
abstract_en: A subsurface detection system may be capable of sensing a buried feature and providing an estimate of the feature's depth. Such a subsurface detection system may comprise a signal generator transmitting at least one signal toward a buried feature and at least one signal along a plurality of various length paths. Each of a plurality of correlators may be associated with one of the various length paths and receive both a signal reflected by the feature and a signal transmitted along one of the various length paths. Each of the correlators may correspond to a distance to the buried feature. As the reflected signal reaches each correlator it may identify a time offset between the arrival of the reflected signal and the signal transmitted along one of the various length paths. By so doing, a distance to the buried feature may be estimated by detecting the correlator with the shortest time offset.

title_en: A kind of robot guided for life detection after earthquake and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of robots guided for life detection after earthquake and rescue, including robot body, the bottom of the robot body is movably installed with traveling wheel, sliding slot is offered at the top of robot body, motion bar is slidably fitted in sliding slot, and the top of motion bar is extended to outside sliding slot, the side of motion bar is welded with rack, the side of sliding slot is installed with the first servo motor, first gear is welded on the output shaft of first servo motor, first gear is engaged with rack, the top of the motion bar is welded with the second servo motor, second gear is welded on the output shaft of second servo motor, the side of second servo motor is equipped with the groove for being opened in motion bar top.The utility model is easy to operate, easy to use, and very easily the height of infrared detector and detection angles can be adjusted, area of detection is considerably increased, substantially eliminate check frequency.

title_en: Fixed placer of human vital sign radar monitor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixed placement device of a radar monitor for human vital signs, which relates to the technical field of instrument fixed placement and comprises a base, wherein a fixing mechanism is arranged at the top end of the base, a monitor main body is arranged at the inner side of the fixing mechanism, the fixing mechanism comprises a support frame, arbitrary stop shafts are symmetrically arranged at the positions, close to the top end, of the left side and the right side of the inner part of the support frame, a bracket is rotationally connected between the two arbitrary stop shafts, the inner side of the support frame is matched with the arbitrary stop shafts through a rotary table, the monitor main body can be subjected to multi-angle adjustment, the use convenience is improved, the inserted rod is pushed inwards through a spring group, the monitor main body can be placed and fixed in a fixed block, the inserted rod is driven to be separated from the fixed block through pushing a push plate outwards, and the aim of rapid disassembly and assembly are achieved, and convenience and disassembly efficiency are greatly improved.

title_en: Multi-wall-body quick compensation method suitable for through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-wall-body quick compensation method suitable for through-wall radar imaging. Based on known or estimated wall body parameters, hidden target imaging in an antenna attaching wall and multi-parallel-wall-body building structure is considered, let us suppose that multiple wall bodies have the same relative dielectric constant and different widths, first, according to the refraction law, the multiple wall bodies are moved to the edge of a first wall body in parallel, the multiple wall bodies are combined to form an equivalent single wall body, and meanwhile the fact that imaging focusing delay is not changed is guaranteed. By the equivalent processing, the multi-refraction problem related to multi-wall-body electromagnetic propagation is converted to a traditional single wall body single-refraction problem equivalently, and problem difficulty is simplified. Then, based on a minimum-duration method, refraction point position searching on the equivalent wall body is carried out, and propagation path delay is computed. Finally, a back-projection imaging algorithm is used for obtaining a target focusing image after multi-wall-body compensating, the advantage of target position error accurate compensation is achieved, and high practicability is achieved.

title_en: A kind of polarization through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of polarization through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method, is related to technical field.This method converts group sparse basis for polarization through-wall radar imaging problem using the joint sparse that each POLARIZATION CHANNEL corresponds to scene reflectivity rate vector and tracks a Denoising Problems, imaging reconstruction is realized using spectrum Projected L1 norm minimum algorithm solution group sparse basis tracking Denoising Problems, the calculating for realizing positive function and adjoint function operator in imaging process using nonuniform fast Fourier transform technology, avoids the calculating and storage to each element of dictionary matrix.Polarization through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method provided by the invention, reduces the demand in imaging process to calculator memory, while can guarantee the quality of imaging reconstruction significantly, is suitable for extensive high-resolution polarization through-wall radar imaging occasion.

title_en: Automobile safety system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automobile safety system, which comprises a power supply, a control circuit and a power supply, wherein the power supply is used for supplying power to the whole safety system, and the power supply is triggered to start to supply power when a door is closed and locked by a key; the trigger module is used for controlling the on and off of the power supply; the life sensor is used for sensing life signs in the vehicle; the sound detector is used for detecting sound signals in the vehicle; the temperature sensor is used for sensing the temperature in the vehicle when the life signs in the vehicle are detected; the air conditioner controller is used for actively starting the vehicle-mounted air conditioner when the temperature sensor senses that the temperature in the vehicle exceeds a threshold range; the communication module is used for sending out help seeking information and making a help seeking call when the life signs in the vehicle are sensed. Whether life signs exist in the vehicle is sensed by the life sensor, if the life signs exist, emergency rescue information is sent to an emergency contact person or a rescue center, the temperature sensor and the air conditioner controller are matched to sense the temperature in the vehicle, the situation that accidents are caused by too high or too low temperature in the vehicle when rescue is not timely is avoided, and therefore the accident rate is reduced.

title_en: Ultra-wideband MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wide band radar signal processing, and discloses an ultra wide band MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method. The invention mainly comprises the following steps: (1) rearranging the echo data of a plurality of channels of the MIMO radar; (2) performing sequential inertial coherent imaging and compensation on the target area; (3) band-pass filtering along a time dimension; (4) calculating the position of the surface of the thorax of the living body; (5) removing clutter and direct current bias; (6) taking phases to obtain vital sign signals; (7) the respiratory and heartbeat signals are separated. (8) Detecting the peak values of the respiration and heartbeat signals, and calculating the instantaneous respiration rate and the heart rate; (9) sliding time window dynamic measurements. The invention can be used for carrying out three-dimensional positioning and vital sign measurement on trapped people in ruins and buildings, has high signal processing gain, high positioning precision and good real-time performance, and can realize instantaneous respiration rate and heart rate measurement.

title_en: Spontaneous flashlight-like layered pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-generating flashlight-shaped layered pressure sensor, which comprises a sensor shell, a sensor body and a sensor body, wherein the sensor shell comprises an inner shell which is buried in soil body, and an outer shell which is coaxially connected above the inner shell, is used for bearing the soil body pressure of landslide, and can generate axial relative movement with the inner shell; the sensor shell is internally provided with a magnetic field mechanism which can form an induction electric signal through the relative motion of the inner shell and the outer shell and the cutting of a magnetic induction wire; an inner shell electrode layer and an outer shell electrode layer which can output induction electric signals to the outside through the relative movement of the inner shell and the outer shell are respectively arranged on the outer surface of the inner shell and the inner surface of the outer shell. The invention effectively solves the problem that external power supply is needed in landslide monitoring, can be used for pressure measurement in landslide monitoring, reflects the pressure parameter when landslide occurs, and judges the landslide state through the pressure parameter.
assignees: HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Method and system for predicting survival space aperture of pressed human body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of prediction of living space of a buried human body, and discloses a method and a system for predicting aperture of living space of the buried human body based on ultra-wideband biological radar, according to prior information that medium in a living space hole is mostly air, and the propagation speed of electromagnetic waves is close to the propagation speed of the electromagnetic waves in vacuum, after a human body target is judged to exist and positioned, taking the human body target positioning position as the circle center, taking the distance from the sparse pulse sequence obtained by sparse pulse deconvolution to the circle center as the radius, making a series of concentric circles, if the concentric circles are overlapped to a certain extent, judging the position of the pulse sequence as the upper edge position of the human body living space hole, and estimating the aperture size. The method can effectively estimate the aperture size of the living space of the human body target under ruins, and the information is favorable for judging the surrounding condition of survivors.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF NORTHERN THEATER COMMAND OF PLA

title_en: End-to-end vital sign monitoring radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end vital sign monitoring radar system. The system comprises a radio frequency and buffer module and an analog demodulation module. The radio frequency and buffer module is used for completing the transmission, the reception and the signal buffering of millimeter wave signals and comprises a radio frequency module and an IQ two-way buffer. The analog demodulation module performs signal demodulation in the analog domain using a modified differential and cross multiplication algorithm (MDACM) method and outputs a target time-varying displacement signal. The analog demodulation module is composed of analog devices and comprises an IQ two-way direct current item extraction module, an IQ two-way differentiator, an IQ two-way multiplier, a first-stage subtracter, a second-stage subtracter, an adder and an integrator. The phase demodulation principle of the analog demodulation module follows MDACM algorithm, and the process is completely carried out in the analog domain. The whole radar system can realize end-to-end vital sign monitoring, has high real-time performance and low power consumption, and can reduce the sampling rate and the sampling channel.

title_en: Cavity identification system and cavity identification method
abstract_en: To suppress false detection of a cavity occurring in the vicinity of a stratum and buried structure to improve the reliability of the underground cavity identification process.SOLUTION: The cavity identification system is for detecting an underground cavity, includes a calculating device for performing a predetermined process and a computer having a storage device connected to the computing device, and equipped with an identification device that detects a cavity from an inputted ground radar reflection image; a primary determination unit for determining the candidate cavity which may be present in the underground radar reflected image using the detection result by the identification device; and a false detection verification unit for determining whether a cavity exists in the region or not using the image of the area of the cavity candidate determined, and the false detection verification unit has a shape verification unit for inspecting the relative positional relationship between a tip portion and, a left slope portion, and a right slope portion of the cavity for the image of the region of the determined candidate cavity, and a tip verification unit for inspecting the shape of the tip.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring vital sign based on spatial phase coherency
title_ko: 공간적 위상 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for determining a vital sign measurement distance based on spatial phase coherency. According to the present invention, the method for determining a distance for measuring vital signs comprises the steps of: receiving a reflected signal through radar; determining a phase signal based on the reflected signal; determining coherency between phase signals for a first distance and a second distance, which are a distance pair selected from among a plurality of distances, using the phase signals determined for each distance; and determining a distance for measuring vital signs based on the coherency. According to the present invention, by utilizing a spatial phase coherency index, which quantifies the inter-phase coherency in a pair of different range bins, the pair of range bins with the highest index value is selected as a distance for vital sign detection, so more accurate vital signs can be measured compared to conventional methods.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공간적 위상 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 방법에 있어서, 레이더를 통해 반사된 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 반사된 신호에 기초하여 위상 신호를 결정하는 단계; 복수의 거리 별 결정된 위상 신호를 이용하여 상기 복수의 거리 중에서 선택된 거리 쌍인 제1 거리 및 제2 거리에 대한 위상 신호 사이의 코히어런시를 결정하는 단계; 및 상기 코히어런시에 기초하여 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 한 쌍의 서로 다른 범위 빈에서의 위상 간 코히어런시를 정량화하는 공간적 위상 코히어런시 지수를 활용하여, 가장 높은 지수 값을 가지는 한 쌍의 범위 빈을 활력 징후 탐지를 위한 거리로 선택함으로써, 종래의 방법들에 비하여 더욱 정확한 활력 징후가 측정될 수 있다.

title_en: Utilization system for traffic infrastructure investigation data
abstract_en: In order to effectively utilize investigation data about the deterioration in or damage to traffic infrastructure and prevent accidents in advance, the present invention is provided with: an electromagnetic wave radar (12) mounted on a vehicle (13); a GNSS device (14) mounted on the vehicle (13); and a server (30) which is connected to the electromagnetic wave radar (12) and the GNSS device (14) through a communication line and which receives reflective wave data and current position data. The server (30) has: an analysis program (P1) which analyzes the reflective wave data to detect the deterioration and damage that has occurred on a target surface and under the target surface or detect the presence of a buried object; map data (D1); and a map data synchronization program (P2) which, on the basis of position data, specifies on the map data (D1), the place where the deterioration, damage, or buried object has been detected by the analysis program (P1). The server (30) discloses the map data (D1), on which the place is specified where the deterioration, damage, or buried object has been detected, only to specific access members on the Internet.
assignees: C E MAN INTEGRATED LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Life Detection Processing Method, Device and Terminal
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a life detection processing method, device and terminal. The method includes that: a WiFi electromagnetic wave is emitted; coherent waves of a reflected wave of the WiFi electromagnetic wave and the WiFi electromagnetic wave are received; and life information is determined according to the received coherent waves. The method solves the problems about the life detection in related art that it is not convenient for users to operate, the penetration is low and the general feature is poor, while offering portability, usability and timeliness of use.

title_en: Three-dimensional target imaging radar system through walls
abstract_en: The invention discloses three-dimensional target imaging radar system through walls, which is a kind of target radar imaging system, and wave source frequency used by this system is 4GHz, transmission power 2W.Antenna is placed on mobile platform, and mobile platform is driven by the rotation of turntable, is back and forth moved with uniform velocity, and carries out shuttle-scanning to tested life entity to obtain echo-signal.Then the signal of acquisition carries out imaging algorithm processing through FPGA pulse signal control processing unit and can obtain image data, show eventually by display by amplification filtering, down coversion.

title_en: Life detection system and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on life detection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on a life detection function, wherein the life detection system comprises a radar imaging module, a thermal imaging module, a video recording module, a feedback module, a control module, a power supply module and a throwing component for throwing a positioning instrument; the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module are all electrically connected with the feedback module; the feedback module, the releasing assembly and the power supply module are all electrically connected with the control module. The control module is used for controlling the power supply module to supply power to the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module, the video recording module and the putting component, and simultaneously controlling the feedback module to receive information fed back by the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module, analyze the received information and transmit the information back to the control center; by the scheme of the invention, the life of the flight area can be effectively detected and recorded in real time.

title_en: Underground nonmetallic pipeline positioning detection method
abstract_en: The application provides a positioning detection method of an underground nonmetallic pipeline, which comprises the steps of moving a multi-frequency microwave probe in a target area, marking a position designated by a target indicator on the ground as a first position when a microwave signal receiver receives microwave signals reflected by the underground nonmetallic pipeline, rotating the multi-frequency microwave probe to enable an included angle beta between the indication direction of the target indicator and the vertical direction to be 90 degrees and more than 0 degrees, moving the multi-frequency microwave probe along the first direction, marking the position designated by the target indicator on the ground as a second position when the microwave signal receiver receives the microwave signals, and obtaining the burial depth D of the underground nonmetallic pipeline according to the beta, the distance L between the first position and the second position and a first operation rule. By the technical scheme, the buried depth of the underground nonmetallic pipeline can be rapidly positioned, so that the later management and maintenance of the pipeline are facilitated.

title_en: Behind-wall hidden target tracking method suitable for low signal-to-noise ratio environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a behind-wall hidden target tracking method suitable for a low signal-to-noise ratio environment, which is applied to the technical field of radar tracking. The method aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, complex electromagnetic environment causes more clutter and noise in echo, the imaging quality is poor, and then the target is difficult to track. Firstly, reconstructing a scene by adopting a backward projection method, then, establishing a target template based on a ridge regression idea by extracting characteristics of a target area, establishing a scale pool with small distance scale change and large azimuth scale change based on a through-wall radar target imaging mechanism and imaged target characteristics, tracking a next frame of target based on a related filtering idea, updating the target template for each frame of change of the characteristics of the through-wall radar target, and finally dynamically estimating the target area and obtaining a tracking track; the invention can realize the accurate tracking of hidden targets behind the wall in a low signal-to-noise ratio scene.

title_en: Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on data driving and time-frequency analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on data-driven time-frequency analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining Doppler through-wall modulation echo signals of multi-target movement, analyzing and processing the obtained Doppler through-wall modulation echo signals of multi-target movement through STFT, constructing a time-frequency distribution matrix data set, constructing a neural network model, training the constructed neural network model by adopting the obtained time-frequency distribution data set to obtain an optimal time-frequency distribution prediction model, predicting and processing the constructed time-frequency distribution matrix data set by adopting the constructed optimal time-frequency distribution prediction model to obtain predicted time-frequency distribution, and completing positioning processing by adopting the obtained predicted time-frequency distribution to the Doppler through-wall modulation echo signals of multi-target movement. The method realizes real-time tracking and positioning processing of the target, can better solve the problem of time-frequency blurring, improves the time-frequency resolution, and has high accuracy, strong overfitting resistance and obviously improved identification capability.

title_en: Multipath echo identification and personnel detection method based on fingerprint characteristics of vital signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipath echo discrimination and personnel detection method based on fingerprint characteristics of a vital signal, which comprises the steps of separating echo signals of each target from radar received signals, and decomposing the echo intermediate frequency phase signal into a plurality of IMF modes by using a successive variation mode decomposition algorithm, and reconstructing a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal from the IMF modes. And further, based on the extraction of multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal fingerprint characteristics of the millimeter wave radar, the multi-target personnel are distinguished and detected and the multi-path false targets are identified according to the similarity of the fingerprint characteristics of the multi-path false targets and the corresponding real targets. The method does not need priori information of the environment or post measurement of the environment size, has small scene limitation, is applicable to complex indoor scenes, has strong practicability, is effective in multi-person vital sign detection, can remove multiple paths by only a single radar, simplifies the whole detection system, and does not need to change the configuration of radar arrays and other system layers.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting missing person in disaster scene using a drone and method by using the same
title_ko: 무인기를 이용한 재난현장에서의 실종자 탐지 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for detecting a missing person in a disaster site by using a drone and a method thereof which rapidly detect a missing person buried in a building or under the ground or escaping to an evacuation space by using a radar sensor mounted in a drone in a disaster site where earthquake, landslide, shipwreck and the like occur wherein detection equipment or a rescue team has difficulty to access the disaster site, which photograph an image of a corresponding region and check location information if a missing person is detected, and which provide the image data and the location information to the rescue team through a disaster control server of a remote place to rapidly rescue the person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탐지 장비나 구조대의 접근이 어려운 지진, 산사태, 조난사고 등이 발생한 재난현장에서 무인기(drone)에 탑재된 레이더 센서를 사용하여 건물이나 지하에 매몰되거나 대피공간으로 피신한 실종자를 신속하게 탐지하고, 실종자가 탐지되면 해당 지역의 영상 촬영 및 위치정보 확인을 수행하고, 영상 데이터 및 위치정보를 원격지의 재난관제서버를 통해 구조대에 제공하여 신속한 인명구조를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무인기를 이용한 재난현장에서의 실종자 탐지 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHONBUK IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Blood Pressure Meter And Method For Measuring Blood Pressure Using The Same
title_ko: 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서로 다른 2 부위에서 측정되는 생체 신호를 이용해서 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 혈압 측정 시스템은: 신체의 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터의 검출을 위한 제1센서부; 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터와 동맥압 측정의 검출을 위한 제2센서부; 그리고 상기 제1센서부에 의해 검출되는 제1 혈류 파라미터와 상기 제2센서부에 의해 검출되는 제2 혈류 파라미터 및 동맥압으로부터, 상기 제1 혈류 파라미터가 검출되는 부위의 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 산출부를 갖는 제어유닛을 포함한다. 
본 발명은 혈관 저항률과 혈압 파라미터의 변화를 이용해서 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정 시스템, 보다 구체적으로 신체의 일 부위에서 검출되는 혈류 파라미터와 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 검출되는 동맥압과 혈류 파라미터에 의한 혈관 저항률을 이용해서 혈압을 계산하는 혈압계이므로, 혈류 파라미터 변화량과 혈관 저항률을 기반으로 혈압 획득을 원하는 부위의 혈압을 보다 정확하게 측정할 수 있고, 혈압계의 신뢰도가 크게 향상될 수 있다.

title_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using ultra wideband
abstract_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using Ultra-Wideband communication. UWB signals are transmitted from one UWB system node to another UWB system node. Channel impulse responses (CIRs) associated with the UWB signals are determined. Based on the CIRs, in some embodiments velocities associated with the UWB signals are determined, and activities of vehicle occupants are classified based on the CIRs along with vital signs such as breathing rates. In other embodiments, based on the CIRs, phase unwrapping of phase features associated with the CIRs is performed, and principle component analysis (PCA) transforms the CIRs, allowing estimated vital signs such as breathing rates to be determined.

title_en: Providing energy-efficient features using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in an energy efficient manner using a plurality of sensors such as those of a battery-powered device such as a television remote, and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from an initial television WiFi radio scan, or an initial low-powered detection scan from the television remote, may be analyzed by the processor to determine a potential presence of one or more humans are present proximate to the device. If there is such a potential presence, the device remote can enter a full-powered detection mode to accurately determine the presence or absence of one or more humans, and take further actions.

title_en: Self-tracking non-contact vital sign monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-tracking non-contact vital sign monitoring device which comprises a CW radar system, a two-degree-of-freedom cradle head and a two-stage cross sliding track, wherein the CW radar system is arranged at the action end of the two-degree-of-freedom cradle head; the base of the two-degree-of-freedom cradle head is driven by a two-stage track motor to walk on a two-stage track of the two-stage cross-shaped sliding track, and the two-stage track is driven by a one-stage track motor to walk on a one-stage track of the cross-shaped sliding track; the CW radar system comprises a host and two antennas arranged on the end face of the host antenna, wherein the distance between the two antennas is an integral multiple of half wavelength of radar signals, the two antennas are always positioned on the same plane, and the host of the CW radar system controls the motion states of the two-degree-of-freedom cradle head, the primary track motor and the secondary track motor. The device can detect vital signs of a human body in real time according to the radar, and can realize real-time adjustment of the distance and the angle between the device and the target.

title_en: Method of suppressing timing jitter in ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method of suppressing timing jitter in an ultra-wideband through-wall radar, comprising the following steps: collecting multiple groups of echo receiving signals, performing Fourier transform in range dimension on the signals to get corresponding frequency domain data; calculating the modulus value of the frequency domain data, performing Fourier transform in speed dimension on the calculated modulus value, and solving the modulus value of the transformed frequency domain data again; coherently integrating the solved modulus value according to the range dimension; carrying out adaptive threshold processing and target feature extraction based on distance unit on the coherently-integrated data; and positioning the coordinate of a target location using an elliptical positioning method, and displaying the target location. Through the method, dynamic clutter caused by timing jitter can be suppressed effectively, the signal-to-noise ratio of signals can be improved, the complexity of target detection can be reduced, and the probability of false alarm can be reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG ACAD OF SCIENCES INST OF AUTOMATION

title_en: Intelligent imaging formula vital signs detecting instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent imaging formula vital signs detecting instrument, main control end, the scalable feeler lever containing signal transmssion line, the camera probe that feeler lever front end is arranged in, front end light source and front end signal processing unit including having main power source and display；Camera probe uses the double mode camera with infrared camera and colour imagery shot, the reflected light signal of body surface is received by the ccd image sensor inside camera probe, and reflected light signal is converted into picture signal, and signal processing is carried out by front end signal processing unit, obtain trapped person's vital sign parameter such as heart rate and respiratory rate；Picture signal also returns main control end by cable transmission in feeler lever；Front end light source is used to provide illumination for colour imagery shot.The present invention can effectively improve the reliability and accuracy for traditional optical formula vital signs detecting.

title_en: A kind of intelligent wearable device and help-asking system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a kind of intelligent wearable device and help-asking systems, and wherein intelligent wearable device includes: processor, acceleration transducer, bio-electrical impedance sensor, electrodermal reaction sensor, temperature sensor, baroceptor, Bluetooth antenna, flash memory；Acceleration transducer, for obtaining the step counting information of user；Bio-electrical impedance sensor, for obtaining heart rate, the respiratory rate of user；Electrodermal reaction sensor, for detecting the rate of perspiration of user；Temperature sensor, for detecting the skin temperature of user；Baroceptor is used for, and is detected the air pressure size of user position, is obtained height above sea level locating for user；Processor, for receiving each vital sign information；Each vital sign information stored in flash memory is sent to the application software of mobile terminal, so that application software issues warning information and distress signals when vital sign information meets preset condition.The present invention is realized sends distress signals in the case where user's body situation exception automatically.

title_en: A kind of multichannel error self-correcting method for impulse formula through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multichannel error self-correcting methods for impulse formula through-wall radar, the steps include: step S1: detecting straight coupling wave position in each channel；Step S2: reference instant in reference channel and reference channel is determined；Step S3: each channel time delay error is calculated；Step S4: adaptive compensation is made to the error obtained in step S3 by the method for zero padding or truncation；Step S5: conformance error compensation is done in all channels, compensates straight coupling wave propagated error.The present invention has many advantages, such as to can be improved debugging efficiency, applied widely.

title_en: Underground buried object three-dimensional rendering method and system based on three-dimensional ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional rendering method and a three-dimensional rendering system for underground buried objects based on a three-dimensional ground penetrating radar, wherein the three-dimensional rendering method for the underground buried objects comprises the following steps: step S1, extracting target radar data according to the designated position; step S2, preprocessing the extracted radar data, including removing direct waves of the extracted target radar data, eliminating background transverse waves of each channel data, applying reverse amplitude attenuation gain to the data of each channel, and removing channel low-frequency noise; step S3, calculating and projecting the processed radar data to obtain a full-channel data slice set; step S4, processing the data of the full-channel data slice set by using an edge detection algorithm to obtain a slice set for separating a target waveform from a background clutter; and step S5, performing three-dimensional rendering on the target separated from the slice set. The method can efficiently separate the underground buried objects through the combination of various filtering and data preprocessing, and effectively perform three-dimensional rendering.
assignees: SHENZHEN ANDE SPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for separating received signals of UWB radar sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for separating signals received by a UWB radar sensor, namely a method for decomposing the signals received by the UWB radar sensor based on a zero-space tracking and extracting single-component signal algorithm and confidence coefficient of a recursive integral operator and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signal frequency of a human body, which can be applied to monitoring vital signs such as heart rate of an infectious patient and the like and can also be used for detecting the human body signs in earthquake. The method is short in operation time, can accurately extract the frequency of the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal in the UWB ground penetrating radar signal, and provides an important basis for non-contact human body feature extraction.

title_en: Rotary locking telescopic device applied to distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary locking telescopic device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection. When the telescopic adjusting mechanism is in telescopic adjustment, the guide positioning groove slides in the outer guide groove, the stop block slides in the inner guide groove, the sliding copper sleeve slides in the inner hole of the shell of the telescopic device, and the sliding copper sleeve provides guide for the telescopic motion of the telescopic device, so that the stability of the telescopic motion process of the telescopic device can be greatly improved.

title_en: Radar-based in-vehicle vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based in-vehicle vital sign monitoring method which comprises the steps of S1, transmitting signals to an in-vehicle space by a vehicle-mounted radar to obtain intermediate frequency echo signals, S2, preprocessing the obtained intermediate frequency echo signals to obtain a fixed distance d  0  between a determined target and the radar, S3, extracting continuous multiframe vital sign signals p (t) from the target of the radar d  0 , and S4, carrying out frequency estimation on the vital sign signals p (t) obtained by the S3 to obtain the frequency of respiratory heartbeat.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHIHUI CHELIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed sensing with ultra wideband radio
abstract_en: A distributed Ultra Wideband (UWB) radar system and method for operating the same are disclosed. Distributed radar systems use multiple separate UWB radios or nodes that do not use a centralized clock or time source. However, distributed UWB systems operate to provide radar-like functionality and fine sensing capability through synchronization based on line-of-sight (LOS) signal processing and noise estimation. The synchronized Channel Impulse Response (CIR) may be processed for general object detection and tracking, gesture recognition, or even micro-motion, such as monitoring vital signs.

title_en: Anti-interference method for multi-band radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference method of a multi-band radar, which comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining an enhanced model in an offline state through offline dynamic countermeasure training, secondly obtaining an original echo signal in an online state to carry out self-adaptive filtering, carrying out space-time spectrum feature extraction by using the enhanced model, thirdly carrying out feature fusion and target separation according to the extracted space-time spectrum feature, fourthly carrying out optimization according to the separation result and judging whether a termination condition is achieved, if so, ending and outputting a multi-dimensional data packet, otherwise, returning to the step two. The method disclosed by the invention achieves the industry leading level on the anti-interference performance and vital sign monitoring precision through triple technical breakthroughs of hardware reconstruction, dynamic countermeasure training method and closed loop feedback, and is particularly suitable for extreme scenes such as firefighting rescue, battlefield search and rescue and the like. And the next step can focus on optimizing the light weight of the model, and further improve the deployment efficiency of the mobile platform.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Apparatus for measuring the physiological signal, method for providing emergency rescue service and system for emergency rescue using the same
title_ko: 생체신호 측정단말기, 이를 이용한 응급구호 서비스 제공방법 및 응급구호 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A biometric signal measurement terminal, an emergency service supplying method using the same and an emergency system for determining a cautious step and an emergency step are provided to supply an efficient emergency service by determining an emergency situation of the user. CONSTITUTION: A biometric signal measurement sensor(130) measures the biometric signal of a user. A controller(110) controls the measurement signal value is transmitted to a mobile communication terminal(200). A database(150) sets up the cautious step and the emergency step corresponding to a health standard value of the user. If the measurement signal value is less than the lowest limit, an emergency reader determines the cautious step and the emergency step.
abstract_ko:

title_en: glasses with measuring module and its emergency situation determination method
title_ko: 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation determining method using glasses having a measurement module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the emergency situation determining method using glasses having a measurement module comprises a signal transmission step, a bio-signal determination step, an emergency situation determination step, and an emergency situation notification step. According to the present invention, the emergency situation determining method using glasses having a measurement module can rapidly perform follow-up action of a wearer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 측정모듈이 구비된 안경은 안경 몸체(110)와; 뇌전도를 측정하기 위한 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120)과; 심전도를 측정하기 위한 맥박 측정모듈(130)과; 운동량을 측정하기 위한 자이로 센서(140)와; 상기 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120), 맥박 측정모듈(130), 자이로 센서(140)에서 신호를 수신받은 후, 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 파악하고, 상기 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 통해 사용자의 생체신호를 파악한 후, 생체신호에 따라 보청 장치(170) 또는 골전도 보청 장치(160)를 통해 착용자에게 알려주거나, 무선통신부(180)를 통해 외부로 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부(150)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 소리를 출력하여 착용자에게 들리도록 하는 보청 장치(170)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 골전도를 통해 착용자의 내이에 소리를 전달하는 골전도 보청 장치(160)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 별도로 구비된 외부의 서버(200)로 신호를 전송하는 무선통신부(180)와; 배터리(190); 로 이루어지는 것이며,  
본 발명 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법은 측정모듈이 구비된 안경(100)의 안경 몸체(110)에 구비된 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120), 맥박 측정모듈(130), 자이로 센서(140)에서의 신호가 제어부(150)로 전달되는 신호 전달단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 신호를 통해 착용자의 생체신호를 파악하는 생체신호 판단단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 생체신호를 통해 착용자의 위급상황을 판단하는 위급상황 판단단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 생체신호를 파악한 착용자의 위급상황이면 보청 장치(170) 또는 골전도 보청 장치(160)를 통해 착용자에게 위급상황임을 알려주거나, 또는 무선통신부(180)를 통해 별도로 구비된 외부의 서버(200)로 신호를 전송하여 서버(200)에서 위급상황을 확인이 필요한 보호자에게 위급상황임을 알려주는 위급상황 알림단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
따라서 본 발명 측정모듈이 구비된 안경 및 이를 이용한 위급상황판단 방법은 안경에 스트레스 지수 측정모듈, 맥박 측정 모듈, 자이로 센서 등의 센서들을 구비하여 검사기를 일일이 붙이지 않아 일상생활에 지장이 없으며, 내장된 센서들의 무게도 사람이 느끼지 못할 정도로 가볍기에 사용에 불편하지 않고, 안경에 구비된 스트레스 지수 측정모듈, 맥박 측정 모듈, 자이로 센서를 통해 측정된 데이터를 통해 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 파악하여 심신이 약한 노인 등의 착용자의 상태를 파악하고, 상기 착용자의 상태가 좋지 않다고 판단되면 보청 장치 또는 골전도 보청 장치를 통해 사용자에 알려주어 휴식 등으로 대처할 수 있도록 하며, 착용자의 상태가 위급하다고 판단되면 무선통신부를 통해 가족, 119안전신고센터, 사회복지기관, 기타보호자 등에 신호를 전송하여 알려줌으로써 가족, 119안전신고센터, 사회복지기관, 기타보호자 등에서 착용자의 후속조치가 빠르게 될 수 있도록 하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: PARK CHANG HOON;PARK SEONG BAE;KIM YOUN HO

title_en: Fine dust information collection system using multifunctional air cleaning headphone
title_ko: 다기능 공기청정 헤드폰을 이용한 미세먼지정보 수집 시스템
abstract_en: A fine dust information collection system using a multifunctional air cleaning headphone comprises: a headphone body which includes two earplugs emitting sound and purified air, a mask connected between the two earplugs, a headband rotatably coupled to the two earplugs, and a blindfold rotatably coupled between the two earplugs and the headband; a charging station on which the headphone body is held and which can emit purified air; a fine dust measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure fine dust concentration around a user and transmits information on the measured fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a biosignal measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure a biosignal of the user and transmits information on the measured biosignal to the mobile device of the user; and a central server which wirelessly communicates with the mobile device of the user and receives information on the fine dust concentration and information on the biosignal. Accordingly, the present invention enables users to breathe in fresh air anywhere through an air cleaning mode.

title_en: Method for detecting biometric information and electronic device supporting the same
title_ko: 생체 정보 검출 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments includes: an output module; a communication module configured to communicate with at least one external device; a first sensor configured to sense a biometric signal; a second sensor configured to sense an inertial signal; and a processor operatively connected to the output module, the communication module, the first sensor, and the second sensor. The processor may be configured: to determine a location of the electronic device for a human body based on a signal transmitted or received with the at least one external device through the communication module in response to sensing the biometric signal through the first sensor; to determine a posture of the electronic device based on information obtained through the second sensor; to determine a measurement posture based on the location and the posture of the electronic device; and to guide the measurement posture to correspond to a predetermined reference posture. Accordingly, the present invention can measure biometric information with high reliability.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 출력 모듈, 적어도 하나의 외부 장치와 통신하도록 설정된 통신 모듈, 신체에 대한 생체 신호를 감지하는 제 1 센서, 관성 신호를 감지하도록 설정된 제 2 센서 및 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 통신 모듈, 상기 제 1 센서 및 상기 제 2 센서와 동작 가능하게 연결된 프로세서를 포함하며, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 제 1 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 것에 응답하여, 상기 통신 모듈을 통해 상기 적어도 하나의 외부 장치와 송수신하는 신호에 기초하여 신체에 대한 상기 전자 장치의 위치를 결정하고, 상기 제 2 센서를 통해 획득되는 정보에 기초하여 상기 전자 장치의 자세를 결정하고, 상기 전자 장치의 위치 및 상기 전자 장치의 자세에 기초하여, 사용자에 대한 측정 자세를 결정하고, 상기 측정 자세가 미리 지정된 기준 자세에 대응되도록 가이드 하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Vital sign sensor capable of resisting clutter
abstract_en: In a vital sign sensor of the present invention, an antenna assembly radiates an oscillation signal generated by a SIL oscillator to an object in a form of a wireless signal and receives a reflected signal from the object, and the reflected signal can have the SIL oscillator injection-locked. The wireless signal radiated from the antenna assembly is transmitted to a demodulator for demodulation such that the vital signs of the object can be obtained. Additionally, an isolator of the antenna assembly is provided to prevent the SIL oscillator from receiving a clutter reflected from the demodulator and an environment where the demodulator is placed. As a result, the clutter can't influence the vital sign detection of the object.

title_en: Body composition, circulation, and vital signs monitor and method
abstract_en: The invented non-invasive vital signs monitor is in a flexible, nominally flat planar form having integral gel electrodes, a sticky-back rear surface, an internal flex circuit capable of sensing, recording and playing out several minutes of the most recently acquired ECG waveform data and a front surface that includes an outplay port. The invented non-invasive body composition ‘risk’ monitor includes a measurement device for monitoring one or more variables including body fluid mass, dehydration, respiratory rate, blood pressure, bio-impedance, cardiography such as cardiac output, and body conformation parameters. The risk monitor may be provided in a lightweight carrying case into which the vital signs monitor plugs. Finally, a lightweight portable probe or transducer containing a transmissive or reflective electro-optical emitter and receptor in the infrared spectrum is fitted on a subject's finger or toe. Associated electronics energize and monitor the probe, detect cardio-rhythmic fluctuations therefrom, and process digital data over a prescribed window to produce a non-invasive, qualitative or quantitative measure of the subject's circulation. In accordance with one embodiment of the invention, a simple tri-color LED array is used to indicate the subject's circulation as being normal, reduced, or borderline. Thus the vital signs, bio-impedance, and circulation monitors may be independent or they may be integrated into one portable, non-invasive device that can concurrently monitor and locally display or remotely convey important patient data including circulation data to a local subject or physician or to/from a remote patient medical data center via wireless telemetry for oversight, treatment and possible intervention by a remote physician.
assignees: SEMLER HERBERT J;BENZ PHILIP;MILLS GARY;MCNAMES JAMES

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection through vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system (10) and a method of operating a radar sensor system (10) for detecting occupancy of an interior (34) of a vehicle (32) and with vital signs monitoring are provided. The radar sensor system (10) comprises a radar transmitting unit (12), a radar receiving unit (18) and a signal processing and control unit (26). The method at least comprises the following steps: transmitting (60) radar waves to a scene within a vehicle interior (34), receiving (62) at least one radar wave generated by reflection of the transmitted radar waves (16), decomposing (64) the received at least one radar wave (22) into range, doppler and angle information, quantifying and tracking (68) movement in each region of interest (38, 40, 42) by angle gating and range gating, detecting (78) and monitoring vital signs of an occupant (28, 30) in each region of interest (38, 40, 42), and determining (84) whether the quantified and tracked movement in the scene relates to the occupant (28, 30) or to external or internal disturbances based on satisfaction of at least one predefined condition relating to the quantified and tracked movement and/or the detected and monitored vital signs.

title_en: Ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system and data acquisition and processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system and a data acquisition processing method, comprising earthquake sources uniformly or non-uniformly distributed on the ground, an earthquake source excitation signal detection instrument and a ground gravity measurement instrument; the seismic source excitation signal detection instrument is a wired detector and a wired seismic data recording instrument which are arranged on the ground, or a wireless node seismic instrument which is arranged on the ground, or a buried armored optical cable which is wound in a continuous spiral shape and a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing modulation-demodulation system. Microgravity data are acquired point by point in high density along the ground detector line and the ground source line. The buried depth and the velocity distribution of the whole measuring work area from the earth surface to the bedrock surface are obtained through the joint inversion of the direct wave, the reflected wave, the refraction wave first arrival time data and the ground microgravity data of the ground seismic data, and the method is used for accurately and reliably carrying out static correction processing on the ground seismic data and providing high-quality data after static correction processing for the subsequent further processing of the ground seismic data.

title_en: A interpolation method for vital signs using doppler radar sensing
title_ko: 도플러 레이더를 이용한 심박데이터에 대한 ｈｒｖ 보간법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마이크로파를 인체를 통해서 송수신하여 인체의 호흡, 심박신호를 도플러 효과를 이용하여 얻어진 심박신호에서 호흡의 영향을 제거하고 신체의 건강상태, 스트레스 지수 등의 인체의 순환계상태를 분석하는 도플러 레이더를 이용한 심박데이터에 대한 HRV(에이치알브이) 보간방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 마이크로파의 도플러 신호를 이용하여 비 접촉으로 인체의 심박신호와 호흡신호를 측정하되, 심장박동의 도플러 심박신호가 호흡신호에 의하여 변화하는 것을 보간하기 위한 것으로,  ECG를 이용한 표준 심박신호의 최대점에 대하여 도플러 심박신호가 호흡신호에 의하여 빠르거나 늦어지는 것을 보간하기 위하여 호흡신호 주기에 대해 일정구간을 설정하고, 호흡신호의 레벨을 다수개로 구분하며, 설정된 호흡주기 동안에 발생하는 도플러 심박신호사이의 주기를 각각 측정하고, 설정된 호흡주기 동안 호흡 신호의 레벨에 상관없이 전체의 주기를 합하여  도플러 평균 주기를  측정하고, 설정된 호흡주기 동안에 도플러 심박신호의 주기를 상기 다수개로 구분한 호흡신호의 레벨이 동일한 값을 가진 심박신호로 각각 구성하여 측정한 호흡 크기 구간별 심박주기와  상기의 도플러 평균 주기와 발생한 오차를 보간하도록 구성되어 있다. 
     본 발명은 마이크로파 도플러 심박신호와 ECG 표준 심박신호 주기를 대비하되, 다수개로 구분한 호흡신호의 레벨이 동일한 값을 갖는 심박신호를 사용하여 호흡신호에 의하여 발생한 오차를 보간 하므로 정확하고 신뢰성이 높은 HRV분석 결과 를 제공하는 작용효과가 있다. 
       
     마이크로파, 에이치알브이, 심박, 호흡, 보간법, 도플러

title_en: Apparatus and Method for measuring physiological signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 생체 신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 단말 장치의 배터리를 탈부착할 수 있는 영역을 커버하기 위한 배터리 커버; 배터리 커버에 포함된 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 센서부가 생체 신호를 감지하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 배터리 커버가 단말 장치와 탈부착됨으로써 단말 장치와 탈부착될 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체 신호 측정 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Fire door for apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택용 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire door for an apartment house, wherein the fire door can be safely operated. Moreover, the fire door comprises: a ceramic pipe buried along a wall surface; a door frame for forming a frame moving path; a fire door for allowing cold air to be sprayed to the door frame; a hinge axis; a door temperature sensor for checking a temperature; and a controller for controlling a temperature and intensity of the cold air.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택용 방화문에 관한 것으로서, 벽면을 따라 매설되면서 에어컨 냉기가 공급되도록 하는 세라믹 배관; 상부에는 세라믹 배관이 연결되고, 상부면과 양측면을 통해 하부면으로 내부에는 냉기가 순환하도록 틀 이동로를 형성하는 도어 틀; 일측에서 상기 도어 틀에 상단부와 하단부가 회전 가능하게 축지지되고, 일정 폭이 이격되도록 구비되는 내측 패널과 외측 패널, 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 안쪽면에 접합되는 내열판과, 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 사이에 구비되어 내외측 공간을 분리되게 하는 중앙 격판과, 상기 내열판과 상기 중앙 격판 사이의 공간을 수직의 방향으로 다단 분리되게 하면서 각 분리되는 공간은 상호 반대측 단부간 교번으로 연통되도록 하여 상부로부터 냉기가 지그재그 형상으로 하향 이동할 수 있도록 냉각 통로를 형성하는 가이드 격판으로 이루어지며, 상기 내열판과 중앙 격판과 가이드 격판은 상호 결합되는 불연 및 단열 소재로서 이루어지고, 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 주연부를 일정 폭으로 절곡시킨 사이드면에는 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 절곡 단부간 일정 폭 이격되도록 하면서 외측의 상기 가이드 격판에 의해 패널간 열 전달이 차단되도록 하며, 양측의 패널 단부간 일정 폭으로 노출되는 사이드면은 상기 가이드 격판에 의해 커버되도록 하면서 상기 가이드 격판의 사이드면을 따라 일정 간격으로 미세 분사홀이 형성되도록 하여 내부의 냉각 통로를 통해 유동하는 냉기가 상기 도어 틀에 분사되도록 하는 방화 도어; 상기 도어 틀에 대해서 상기 방화 도어가 회전 가능하게 축지지되도록 하면서 중앙은 수직 관통되도록 하며, 상부축은 상기 도어 틀의 상부면측 틀 이동로와 상기 방화 도어의 상부측 냉각 통로에 각각 일부가 삽입되고, 하부축은 상기 방화 도어의 하부측 냉각 통로와 상기 도어 틀의 하부면측 틀 이동로에 일부 삽입되면서 에어컨 냉기가 상기 방화 도어에 공급 및 배출되도록 하는 힌지축; 상기 방화 도어의 내측 패널과 외측 패널에 각각 설치되도록 하여 화재 발생 시 각각의 온도를 체크하는 도어 온도 센서; 상기 도어 온도 센서로부터 감지되는 온도에 따라 일정 온도 이상에서 에어컨이 자동으로 가동되게 하면서 감지되는 온도 변화에 따라 냉기의 온도와 세기가 조절되도록 하는 콘트롤러로서 이루어지는 구성이 특징이다.

title_en: Radar apparatus for detecting multiple life—signs of a subject, a method and a computer program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, comprising a transmitter system for emitting a transmission electromagnetic beam to the chest and/or the abdomen of a subject, a receiving system for receiving first reflected electromagnetic beam data from the chest and/or the abdomen, and a processor unit for processing the first received beam data retrieving breath activity information. The transmitter system, the receiving system and the processor are further arranged for performing a radar measurement of a superficial artery structure, such as a wrist artery, an ankle artery, a carotid artery and/or the fontanel artery for retrieving heart activity information. Thereto, the a second transmission electromagnetic beam is directed towards the superficial artery structure, the first and the second transmission electromagnetic beam being transmitted from a single radar unit.
assignees: NEDERLANDSE ORGANISATIE VOOR TOEGEPAST-NATUURWETENSCHAPPELIJK ONDERZOEK TNO

title_en: Life detection instrument on water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water life detecting instrument, which belongs to the technical field of water search and rescue, and particularly relates to a water life detecting instrument, which comprises a base, a four-chamber body shield is arranged above the outer side of a tripod head, an infrared thermal imager is arranged in a chamber body above the left side of the four-chamber body shield, a low-light-level camera is arranged in a chamber body below the left side of the four-chamber body shield, a high-definition automatic focusing camera is arranged in a chamber body above the right side of the four-chamber body shield, and the infrared thermal imager, the low-light-level camera, the high-definition automatic focusing camera and a laser module are arranged in the four-chamber body shield, thereby avoiding the influence of the humid environment on the service life of the infrared thermal imager, the low-light-level camera, the high-definition automatic focusing camera and the laser module, and the infrared thermal, thereby meeting the use requirements of different scenes.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HENGWEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system
abstract_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system, life detection car includes vehicle main body, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly, at least four cameras and processor, vehicle main body is provided with the running assembly of driving life detection car traveling, and processor is connected with running assembly, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly and all cameras.The surrounding environment image that sign of life, the life detection car of sensor assembly detection and the range information and camera of surrounding objects that can be detected due to the application by life-detection instrument are shot, under the control of a processor, so that direction automatic running of the life detection car towards sign of life, search person in distress and its accurate location, rescue personnel is allowed in the place away from hazardous environment, the information that life detection car is passed back can be received by wearable device, understand site environment as on the spot in person, the decision of next step action is precisely made, unnecessary casualties is reduced.

title_en: Heartbeat detection radar system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of heartbeat detection radar system, radar system includes：Radar transmitter, for launching the signal of predetermined waveform；The transmitting antenna being connected with radar transmitter, the signal for radar transmitter to be launched are radiated to default security region；Reception antenna, the echo-signal of human heartbeat's signal is included for receiving；The signal to noise ratio regulation circuit being connected with reception antenna, for improving the signal to noise ratio of low frequency signal in echo-signal；The frequency mixer being connected with signal to noise ratio regulation circuit, for the echo-signal of signal to noise ratio regulation circuit input to be carried out into Frequency mixing processing with default input signal；The A/D converter being connected with frequency mixer, the mixed frequency signal for frequency mixer to be inputted are converted to data signal；The terminal processor being connected with A/D converter, for detecting the heartbeat signal included in data signal.The present invention determines whether invader by detecting the heartbeat signal of human body, can strengthen security safety.

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent non-visual non-contact vital sign monitoring device, which comprises a front-end device, wherein the front-end device comprises: a radar sensor, the radar sensor comprising: a radar signal receiving and transmitting processing unit and a signal output unit; the radar signal transceiving processing unit includes: radar chip, receiving and transmitting antenna, program memory and clock crystal oscillator; the radar chip is used for collecting signals at the front end, the program memory is used for storing application program codes, and the clock crystal oscillator is used for providing clock signals; the radar signal receiving and transmitting processing unit is used for generating, amplifying, transmitting, receiving, mixing and collecting and processing radar signals, and real-time accurate measurement of vibration characteristics and displacement of equipment is realized through analyzing frequency, phase and amplitude characteristics of intermediate frequency signals. The invention adopts non-contact vital sign monitoring, which is helpful to reduce virus transmission caused by contact points and contacters to the maximum extent and better ensure the contact safety of personnel.
assignees: JIUZHOU YUNHE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device suitable for carbon dioxide pipeline leakage experimental test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon dioxide pipeline transportation, in particular to a method and a device suitable for experimental test of carbon dioxide pipeline leakage, wherein the method comprises the steps of experimental integrity check and device air tightness check; introducing carbon dioxide gas into the device for scavenging, checking the test pipeline, the temperature sensor, the pressure sensor and the safety protection device again, filling sand into the sand box, and performing carbon dioxide pipeline leakage experiment test on the test pipeline. The latter includes carbon dioxide gas cylinder, three-way valve, constant temperature water bath storage tank and sand box. According to the invention, the test pipeline is buried in the sand box, so that the acquisition, control and the like of pressure and temperature parameters of the buried multiphase carbon dioxide pipeline in the leakage process are realized, different leakage morphological characteristics and wall temperature changes in a leakage port area are obtained, the rapid qualitative judgment of leakage caliber, leakage position and the like after the pipeline leakage accident occurs is facilitated, and the development of subsequent emergency rescue work is facilitated.

title_en: Device and method for simulating mud bursting and sand bursting under high pressure and with adjustable mining crack width
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of burst sand disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a burst sand simulation device and method with adjustable mining crack width under high pressure. The simulation device includes: a cement sand material source cabin; the adjustable crack die at least comprises two crack plates which are oppositely arranged, the distance between the two crack plates is adjustable, and the mining cracks with different widths are simulated by adjusting the gap between the two crack plates; the cement sand material source cabin is positioned above the adjustable crack die, and the cement sand material source cabin is communicated with the adjustable crack die; the air pump is communicated with the cement sand source cabin through a pipeline; the data acquisition system at least comprises a plurality of water pressure sensors. The simulation device has a more practical accurate simulation result, and is favorable for providing more reliable basis for construction of a thick bedrock deep buried coal seam mining mud bursting disaster prevention and control technology system.

title_en: Underground radar apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar apparatus capable of surely surveying a buried object on a shallow layer by suppressing linking of direct waves.SOLUTION: A receiving signal obtained by receiving a reflected wave of an electromagnetic wave sent from a transmission antenna 12 to underground by a receiving antenna 21 is decomposed into a plurality of frequency component signals by a wavelet transformer 5. An STC processing part 6 performs STC processing by individually setting sensitivity adjustment quantity so that in a direct wave receiving period of an electromagnetic wave directly received from the transmission antenna 12 and a reflected wave from a ground surface, signal levels of respective frequency signal components generated by decomposition are equalized, and in the following receiving period, performs STC processing for emphasizing a signal component having strong reflected signal intensity from the buried object by setting the sensitivity adjustment quantity so that the sensitivity adjustment quantity of a low frequency signal component is increased with the lapse of time. Respective frequency signal component after the STC processing are combined by a reverse wavelet transformer 7 to generate a combined receiving signal, and the buried object is surveyed based on the combined receiving signal.

title_en: Apparatus and method for decision of psychological state using bio signals
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 심리상태 판단 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An apparatus for determining a psychological state according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a bio-signal acquisition unit for acquiring a first bio-signal and a second bio-signal of a user generated by a first stimulus; and a psychological state determination unit for extracting a first feature and a second feature by analyzing the first bio-signal and the second bio-signal and determining the psychological state of the user based on the first feature and the second feature. The first bio-signal and the second bio-signal are bio-signals indicating changes in autonomic nerves measured by different bio-sensors. For example, the first bio-signal is a PPG signal measured by a pulse wave sensor, and the second bio-signal is a GSR signal measured by a skin conductivity sensor. The apparatus of the present invention can accurately determine the psychological state of the user by using the bio-signals.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서의 일 실시예에 따른 심리상태 판단 장치는 제1 자극에 의해 발생된, 사용자의 제1 생체신호와 제2 생체신호를 획득하는 생체신호 획득부와, 제1 생체신호와 제2 생체신호를 각각 분석하여 제1 특징 및 제2 특징을 추출하고, 제1 특징 및 제2 특징에 기초하여 사용자의 심리상태를 판단하는 심리상태 판단부를 포함할 수 있다. 여기서, 제1 생체신호와 제2 생체신호는 각각 서로 상이한 바이오 센서로부터 측정되는 자율 신경의 변화를 나타내는 생체신호일 수 있다. 예를 들면, 제1 생체신호는 맥파 센서로부터 측정된 PPG 신호이고, 제2 생체신호는 피부전도 센서로부터 측정된 GSR 신호일 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for handling emergency situation based on internet of things smartware
title_ko: IoT 스마트웨어 기반의 긴급 상황 대응 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation countermeasure apparatus based on IoT smartware, comprising: the smartware including (1) a situation detection sensor sensing at least one among position data, shock data and biometric signal data to generate situation information, (2) an air bag control unit (ACU) controlling expansion of an air bag if an accident occurrence is detected, and (3) a communication unit transmitting the situation information as emergency situation information if the expansion of the air bag is determined; and an emergency situation monitoring server analyzing the emergency situation information received from the smartware to calculate an accident occurrence possibility, and, if the calculated accident occurrence possibility is a reference value or more, transmitting the emergency situation information and the accident occurrence possibility to a control server to request an emergency rescue. The present invention prevents indiscreet emergency rescue requests due to device malfunctions or minor injuries to reduce social costs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IoT 스마트웨어 기반의 긴급 상황 대응 장치에 관한 것으로, (1) 위치데이터, 충격데이터 및 생체신호데이터 중 적어도 하나를 센싱하여 상황정보를 생성하는 상황감지센서, (2) 사고발생이 감지되면 에어백의 팽창을 제어하는 ACU(AirBag Control Unit) 및 (3) 상기 에어백의 팽창이 결정되면 상기 상황정보를 긴급 상황정보로서 송신하는 통신부를 포함하는 스마트웨어; 및 
상기 스마트웨어로부터 수신된 긴급 상황정보를 분석하여 사고발생 가능성을 산출하고, 상기 산출된 사고발생 가능성이 기준 값 이상이면 관제 서버에 상기 긴급 상황정보 및 사고발생 가능성을 전송하고 긴급 구난의 진행을 요청하는 긴급 상황 모니터링 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Electronic device for determining vital sign of user and method for thereof
title_ko: 사용자의 생체 사인을 결정하는 전자 장치 및 그 동작 방법
