abstract_en: According to various embodiments, an electronic device for determining the vital sign of a user while the user activates comprises a first sensor for detecting the vital sign of the user, a second sensor for detecting the activity of the user, and at least one processor connected to the first sensor and the second sensor. The at least one processor is configured to check a vital sign determined through a first signal obtained through the first sensor, normalize the vital sign to correspond to an activity characteristic of the user based on the vital sign determined via the first signal and an activity level of the user determined via a second signal obtained via the second sensor, and determine a vital sign by merging the vital sign determined through the first signal and the normalized vital sign. Accordingly, the electronic device can accurately measure the vital sign of a wearer when the wearer of the electronic device engages in high-intensity exercise.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시예들에 따르면, 사용자가 활동하는 동안 생체 사인(vital sign)을 결정하는 전자 장치는, 사용자의 생체 사인을 감지하기 위한 제1 센서, 상기 사용자의 활동을 감지하기 위한 제2 센서, 및 상기 제1 센서 및 상기 제2 센서에 연결된 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함한다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 상기 제1 센서를 통해 획득한 제1 신호를 통해 결정되는 생체 사인을 확인하고, 상기 제1 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 생체 사인 및 상기 제2 센서를 통해 획득한 제2 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 사용자의 활동 레벨에 기반하여 상기 사용자의 활동 특성에 상응하도록 생체 사인을 정규화(normalization)하고, 상기 제1 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 생체 사인 및 상기 정규화된 생체 사인을 머징(merging)하여 생체 사인을 결정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Muzzle device for health care
title_ko: 건강관리용 입마개 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a muzzle device for health care. The muzzle device for health care comprises: a muzzle member provided to cover a face portion including the nose and mouth of a target animal; a binding member connected to a rear end of the muzzle member to bind the muzzle member to the face portion; a vital sensor unit provided in one area of the muzzle member to measure vital sign information of the target animal; and a device controller unit performing health risk analysis of the target animal based on the vital sign information measured by the vital sensor unit, generating risk alarm information when a health risk signal is detected as a result of the analysis, and transmitting the risk alarm information to a user terminal pre-registered in a storage unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건강관리용 입마개 디바이스에 관한 것이며, 건강관리용 입마개 디바이스는, 대상 동물의 코와 입을 포함한 안면부를 가리도록 마련되는 입마개 부재; 상기 입마개 부재를 상기 안면부에 결속시키기 위해 상기 입마개 부재의 후측단과 연결되는 결속 부재; 상기 입마개 부재의 일영역에 마련되어 상기 대상 동물의 바이탈 사인 정보를 측정하는 바이탈 센서부; 및 상기 바이탈 센서부에서 측정된 바이탈 사인 정보를 기반으로 상기 대상 동물의 건강 위험도 분석을 수행하고, 분석 결과 건강 위험 신호가 감지된 경우 위험 알람 정보를 생성하여 저장부에 기 등록된 사용자 단말로 전송하는 디바이스 컨트롤러부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Providing image units for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: According to an example aspect of the present invention, there is provided image units for vital sign monitoring by a multichannel radar scanning a field-of-view and a microwave imaging radiometer sounding the field-of- view. Presence of moving targets within the field-of- view of the radar is determined on the basis of phase and/or amplitude changes of the image units between scans. Thermal information or information determined based on the thermal information obtained by the sounding is combined with the image units of the moving targets. In this way vital signs may be monitored based on movement and thermal information of the image units.

title_en: System and method for non-contact people localization and vital signs monitoring via fmcw radar
abstract_en: A monitoring system (100) is presented for monitoring vital signs of subject(s). The monitoring system (100) includes a control system (12) configured for signal communication with a frequency modulated continuous wave FMCW radar system (10) to process measured data which is received from a single-channel limited to either the in-phase or the quadrature component of receiver of said FMCW radar and which is in the form of a data matrix (DM) indicative of consecutive beat signals. The control system comprises a data processing utility comprising: a localization module (30) configured and operable to process the measured data indicative of said data matrix (DM) and provide support recovery data indicative of the received signals originated at localized one or more subjects; and a vital signs extraction module (32) configured and operable to analyze the support recovery data and monitor vital signs, such as respiration rate RR and heart rate HR, of said localized one or more subjects.

title_en: Life detection device used in collapses and under debris
abstract_en: The present disclosure is a life detection device comprising an outer and inner ring (2, 3) containing sensor units (9), speaker (14), wireless communication module (15) and similar data sensors and transmitters in order to detect life much faster after a disaster or accident, to perform more accurate search/rescue operations by detecting the locations of living beings trapped under collapse/debris, and to prioritise rescue operations after life status determinations are made upon the search. It is a life detection device that does not require any training or expertise, is single-use, has an outer cage (1 ) that protects the important parts inside and the circuit board (5) and allows it to roll, has a round shape, a flexible structure that can be rolled, and can easily move in collapsed areas and under debris.
assignees: SUELEYMAN DEMIREL UENIVERSITESI IDARI VE MALI ISLER DAIRE BASKANLIGI GENEL SEKRETERLIK

title_en: Method and device for searching through collapsed ground
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for determining whether a living person has been buried in collapsed ground. The device consists of a rod provided with a receiver unit and a signal processing unit. The receiver unit is intended to receive reflected radar signals transmitted form a radar transmitting antenna and transfer these signals to the signal processing unit. The signal processing unit which is provided with specific detection units determines whether the received signal have been Doppler shifted. By determining this the device can decide whether the Doppler shift depends on the moving chest of a breathing person buried alive.

title_en: Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization method and system based on box spline wavelets frame
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization method and system based on box spline wavelets frame.The present invention obtains the echo image data of Ground Penetrating Radar first, and removes the direct wave image in the image, obtains pretreated Gpr Signal；Then pretreated Gpr Signal is decomposed using box spline wavelets, and carries out edge positioning to decomposition result；It is fitted the boundary curve of image, chooses vertex of the point that curve derivative is zero as radar image；Buried target curvilinear equation is finally established, two points in the Liang Ge branch on the radar image vertex on asymmetric selection edge are fitted buried target curve using 3 fitting process, to realize the positioning of buried target.Localization method of the invention improves the precision of target positioning, for metal pipe line and nonmetal pipe line shallow-layer detection all that may be present, is not likely to produce false-alarm；And algorithm is simple, runing time is short, improves the efficiency of target positioning.

title_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on spatial structure correlation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution wall-penetrating radar imaging method based on spatial structure relevance, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring an echo signal of an nth array element receiving observation scene in the N-dimensional uniform linear array; receiving echo signals of N array elements and M frequency points in a vectorization mode; electromagnetic wave multipath propagation is caused by reflection of an inner wall, and echo signals received by the N-dimensional array under the multipath propagation are obtained; performing down-sampling on the measurement signal to obtain an observation vector of sparse reconstruction; adding group sparse prior distribution to direct wave and K-1 multipath reflection coefficient vectors to simulate a group sparse structure of the vectors; and (4) iteratively solving each parameter by using a parameter estimation formula to obtain a high-resolution through-wall radar imaging result. The method fully utilizes a group sparse structure of multipath propagation and a spatial distribution structure of target continuity in the through-wall radar imaging process, and obtains a high-resolution radar image.

title_en: TRM-based through-wall radar detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TRM-based through-wall radar detector, and relates to the technical field of radar detection devices. The detector comprises a control module, wherein a control signal output end of the control module is connected with a control signal input end of a radar signal source and is used for outputting radar pulse signals under the control of the control module, a signal output end of the radar signal source is connected with a signal input end of a transmitter module, a signal output end of the transmitter module is connected with a signal input end of a transceiver module, a signal output end of the transceiver module is connected with a signal input end of a receiver module, and the transceiver module is used for transmitting detection signals to a wall and receiving reflected detection signals; the signal output end of the receiver module is connected with the signal input end of the control module. The detector has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, high resolution, good imaging effect and the like.

title_en: Working method of omnidirectional biological radar device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an omnidirectional biological radar device and a working method thereof, wherein an FMCW radar is arranged on a 360-degree rotating platform, and omnidirectional vital sign detection of a plurality of human targets is realized through a radar rotating at a high speed. The rotary radar platform not only can realize the identification of the existence of people in the surrounding environment, but also can estimate the relative angle between the radar initial position and the object by using the virtual SIMO (Simple Input Multiple Output, single input multiple output) method provided by the invention, and finally realizes the simultaneous detection of all-dimensional vital signs of a plurality of human targets. The implementation of the task may have important application value for future search and rescue and vital sign detection.

title_en: Human sleeping posture identification and vital sign monitoring method based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a human body sleeping posture recognition and vital sign monitoring method based on FMCW radars, which comprises the steps of obtaining gray level images corresponding to distance time matrixes formed by splicing two radars under each human body sleeping posture, training a sleeping posture recognition model by using the gray level image data, carrying out sleeping posture recognition classification on a human body to be monitored by using the trained sleeping posture recognition model, correspondingly selecting one of the two distance time matrixes according to the recognized sleeping posture result, precisely positioning a plurality of continuous distance doors where a human body thoracic cavity is located by using a thoracic cavity displacement signal correlation algorithm, jointly decomposing thoracic cavity displacement signals of the plurality of continuous distance doors occupied by the human body by using a GA-MVMD method to obtain a plurality of IMF components, and reconstructing a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal according to each IMF component. The method improves the accuracy of sleep posture recognition and can realize accurate measurement of vital signs of human bodies under different sleep postures.

title_en: Identification sensor for works buried at great depth
Vehicle mounted metal and mine detector
abstract_en: The invention is related to a vehicle mounted metal and mine detector, which is used in the operations with military or humanitarian purposes regarding the clearance or removal of landmines for detecting mines with high metal content and plastic mines with a minimum content of metal that are near the ground surface or buried underground, as well as any improvised explosive devices, ammunitions and explosives; in the archaeological researches for determining the location of the buried archaeological remains without damaging them; in the geophysical studies for the exploration of mineral deposits, industrial minerals and rock formations; and in the detection of infrastructure elements such as underground pipelines and cables. The system is comprised of a manned or unmanned ground vehicle ( 8 ), a lower arm ( 2 ) and an upper arm ( 3 ) that are connected to the lower shell ( 7 ) of the vehicle by means of rotating links, a search head ( 1 ) in which electromagnetic interference (EMI) sensor coils and ground penetrating radar (GPR) antennas are arranged to be nested inside one another, fore arms ( 9 ) that are fastened directly on the search head ( 1 ) or into the ribs ( 13 ) placed on the search head and that enable the search head ( 1 ) to be connected to the lower arm ( 2 ) and to the upper arm ( 3 ) by means of the quick-connect rotating connection components, a linear actuator ( 5 ) and a lever arm ( 4 ) that are connected to either one of the lower arm ( 2 ) and the upper arm ( 3 ) with rotating links for adjusting the height of the search head ( 1 ) from the ground, and an upper shell ( 6 ) covering the last-mentioned mechanisms for protecting them against external factors. While adjusting the height of the search head ( 1 ) from the ground, at the same time, it is kept parallel to the ground, and these two functions are carried out by using only one linear actuator ( 3 ). Through the arrangement of the sensors in the search head such that the sensors are arrayed in pairs nested one another, the dimensions of the search head are kept as small as possible, providing the ease of use in narrow areas where the detection operation is carried out. When the search head is damaged, the connection components are broken off by themselves and the search head is broken off from the vehicle due to the connection of the search head ( 1 ) to the lower arm ( 2 ) and the upper arm ( 3 ) by means of the quick-connect connection components, which prevents the rest of the vehicle from being damaged by protecting it against the damaging effects. Furthermore, the damaged search head can be replaced easily and quickly with a new one on site without the need for any special equipment, therefore the vehicle has the ability to operate for a long time.

title_en: Multifunctional life rescuing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional life rescuing system which is characterized in that: a life rescuing card (A) is communicated with a life signal receiving instrument (B) by wireless signals, the life rescuing card (A) is provided with a human body thermal infrared sensor module (A2), a heart detection sensor module (A3), a first low power-consumption singlechip module (A4) and a first wireless modulation-demodulation module (A5); the life signal receiving instrument (B) is provided with a second wireless modulation-demodulation module (B5), a second low power-consumption singlechip module (B4), a LCD driver module (B2), a LCD display module (B3), a D/A conversion module (B8), an audio filtering/amplification module (B9) and a loudspeaker (B10). The multifunction life rescuing system can overcome the environmental impact, has convenient operation and efficiently finishes the searching and rescuing of trapped persons.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING SHARING CULTURE DIFFUSION CO LTD

title_en: A kind of rescue UAS for fire of high-rise building
abstract_en: A kind of rescue UAS for fire of high-rise building；Vital signs is detected using radar life-detection instrument, it is automatic to launch escape wet towel, simple relief goods, extend rescue time；Take pictures by GPS positioning system and circular flight and obtain trapped personnel ambient condition information, these data are sent back into ground base station using Wireless data transmission equipment；While ground base station carries out data analysis and sends rescue personnel to stand by, unmanned plane continues to investigate, surrounding environmental gases are detected using smog Long Range Detecting and Ranging, above led the way by unmanned plane in evacuation process, once detect in the range of certain distance have endanger gas if send alarm signal.Rescue UAS described in the utility model for fire of high-rise building, substantially increases search rate and rescue is efficient.

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld through-wall radar device, belonging to the radar field, comprising a radar host, a charger and a charging cable; the radar host comprises an antenna module, a radio frequency module, a signal processing and display control module, a charging and discharging module and a shell; after the radar host is powered on to work, the charging module provides required voltage for the radio frequency module and the signal processing and display control module through voltage conversion, when the signal processing and display control module receives detection key information, the radio frequency module is controlled to generate radar signals and emit the radar signals through an antenna, the antenna module receives echo signals, the echo signals are processed by the radio frequency module and then are sent to the signal processing and display control module, and target information is displayed after algorithm processing; the utility model discloses hand-held type through-wall radar is small, light in weight, effective detection range is big, sensitivity is high, the precision is high, has the advantage that multi-target detection and tracking, interference killing feature are strong simultaneously.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Building site uses multi-functional life detection instrument after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building site uses multi-functional life detection instrument after earthquake, its structure includes that radar surveys dish, lithium cell group, detection instrument body, horizontal pole, gripping handle, infrared inductor, solar energy electroplax and display screen, the bottom of radar survey dish is equipped with infrared inductor, the top of radar survey dish is equipped with the solar energy electroplax, the right part welding of radar survey dish has the detection instrument body, the top front side of detection instrument body is equipped with lithium cell group, the rear portion of lithium cell group is equipped with the display screen, the bottom front side of detection instrument body is equipped with controlling means, controlling means's process connecting rod is connected with detection monitoring device, detection monitoring device's top left side is equipped with gas sensor, detection monitoring device's top right side is equipped with temperature monitor and humidity monitor. This multi-functional life detection instrument is used in building site after earthquake, the life sign after the high efficiency detected the earthquake, and detection efficiency is high, and the precision is high.
assignees: SHANNENG ENG SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributing type radar life detection location is equipped, it includes: the life detection module comprises more than two radar units to form a network, and each radar unit comprises a transmitting unit and a receiving unit and can work independently; and the GPS positioning time service module is used for receiving GPS communication, positioning the position of each radar unit in real time, and using the GPS signal as a time sequence trigger signal of each radar unit to realize time sequence synchronization of each radar unit. And the WIFI signal transmission module is used for performing wireless transmission of radar detection data and issuing a control instruction. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, wider coverage, wider detection range and the like.

title_en: Multichannel multi-human body target two-dimensional positioning method based on UWB (Ultra Wide Band) radar type life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel multi-human body target two-dimensional positioning method based on a UWB (Ultra Wide Band) radar type life detector. The life detector comprises a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas which respectively form three radar echo signal channels. The two-dimensional positioning method comprises the following steps of: A1. enhancing a weak life signal of a static human body by all channels and integrating a radar echo signal in distance by all the channels through adopting a method for integrating eight points at an interval of four points; scattering the integrated signal for decomposing, reconstructing and synthesizing a target echo signal and a distance signal; carrying out digital filtration and digital differentiation on the target echo signal and realizing the enhancement of the weak available signal; A2. distinguishing one-dimensional distance, carrying out space frequency analysis according to the target echo signal obtained after digital filtration and digital differentiation and the distance signal by all the channels and respectively obtaining three projecting signals of a target in the three channels; and A3. confirming the two-dimensional position information of the target according to the three projecting signals and forming a display image.

title_en: Moving target two-dimensional detecting and tracking method for ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving target two-dimensional detecting and tracking method for ultra-wideband through-wall radar. According to the method, through echo data of a linear array sensor, an area to be measured is subjected to two-dimensional imaging by beam-forming, and the position of a target in an imaging result is extracted in the coordinate point form according to the concept of relative gray; a point trajectory output by an image detector is matched and correlated with an existing track; the existing track is managed and operated by track initiation, track maintaining, track deletion and the like; the existing stable track is subjected to KF (Kalman filtering) on the basis of IMM (interacting multiple model); optimal estimated values of two-dimensional parameters of all targets in the area to be measured are acquired; the moving targets behind an obstacle are subjected to two-dimensional detecting and tracking through the data of the linear array sensor of the ultra-wideband through-wall radar.

title_en: Television anti-addiction method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a television anti-addiction method and a system based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein human body vital sign information of watching a television is collected through the millimeter wave radar, the current audience watching the television is judged, and different anti-addiction conditions and anti-addiction measures are set, so that the anti-addiction effect can be effectively realized, and the specific conditions can be flexibly processed; in another aspect, the present invention provides a system comprising: the system comprises a television, a television controller, a millimeter wave radar, a cloud system and an anti-addiction evaluation module. The method and the system provided by the invention can not collect image information and have good privacy; and the anti-addiction effect is good without being influenced by light rays and facial shielding.
assignees: SICHUAN HONGMEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and medium for detecting, extracting and classifying life signals based on millimeter wave FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal detection extraction and classification method and medium based on millimeter wave FMCW radar, comprising acquiring a static human body target by adopting the millimeter wave FMCW radar to obtain a radar echo signal; sampling the radar echo signal to obtain original ADC data; and filtering background noise and removing direct current components of the acquired original ADC data to obtain two-dimensional matrix data M x N to be processed, wherein M is a fast time sampling point, and N is a slow time sampling point. And carrying out Range FFT on the M-N two-dimensional matrix along a fast time axis to lock a target distance gate, and extracting a target position life signal according to the target distance gate. And performing time-frequency analysis or spectrum estimation on the extracted vital signals to perform vital sign estimation to obtain heart rate and respiratory rate parameters, and finally performing abnormal classification on the heart rate and respiratory rate to perform health monitoring.

title_en: Underground pipeline parameter detection method based on deep learning and ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The application provides an underground pipeline parameter detection method based on deep learning and ground penetrating radar, which comprises the following steps: according to the distribution diagram of the existing underground pipeline and the known actual excavation data, arranging the underground pipeline with known material parameters, buried depth parameters and pipe diameter parameters; scanning and detecting a known underground pipeline, acquiring an actual measurement radar profile image of the underground pipeline, preprocessing the actual measurement radar profile image, modeling the underground pipeline by using ground penetrating radar forward modeling software, acquiring and processing an emulation radar profile image, processing and labeling the material, the burial depth and the pipe diameter of the emulation radar profile image according to parameters of the underground pipeline, training a pre-trained target detection network by using the emulation radar profile image, generating an underground pipeline detection network, and carrying out parameter adjustment and optimization on the underground pipeline detection network; outputting parameter information of the underground pipeline through the optimized underground light detection network.

title_en: Buried electric network equipment detection device and detection method based on ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground grounding detection, in particular to a buried electric network equipment detection device and a detection method based on ground penetrating radar. In the ground penetrating radar-based ground penetrating network equipment detection device and the ground penetrating radar-based ground penetrating network equipment detection method, the three-dimensional and four-dimensional space image ground penetrating radar measuring instrument is realized by detecting the change generated when an earth electromagnetic field encounters different mediums. Therefore, underground grounding devices such as transformers, lightning arresters, towers and the like in the power grid structure are conveniently subjected to underground hidden engineering inspection and acceptance, daily inspection operation and maintenance inspection is performed for positioning, measuring and analyzing, positioning and measurement of the underground metal grounding body without excavation are realized, and power grid construction hidden engineering inspection and acceptance and daily operation and maintenance positioning, detection and flaw detection are assisted.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD QUJING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Positive pressure oxygen respirator capable of self-adaptively supplying oxygen and output adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of positive pressure oxygen respirators, in particular to a positive pressure oxygen respirator capable of self-adaptively supplying oxygen and an output adjusting method thereof, wherein the positive pressure oxygen respirator comprises an oxygen bottle, a pressure reducer, an air bag, an inflating mechanism, a gas sensor, a body state monitoring unit, a main controller, an electric control adjusting valve and an electric control exhaust valve, wherein the gas sensor monitors a gas detection value in a breathing circuit, the body state monitoring unit monitors vital sign parameters of a person, and the inflating mechanism firstly fills the air bag and a pipeline with air when the oxygen respirator is started initially; the invention forms feedback control by adding the inflation mechanism, the electronic monitoring and the electronic control valve, so that the whole proportion of oxygen and nitrogen in the loop is close to that of air, the invention is suitable for the normal physiological requirement of human body, improves the adaptability of using oxygen and self-adaptively adjusts the oxygen concentration according to the requirement of the human body, and can use the oxygen more safely and healthily.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method based on HHO-CEEMDAM algorithm
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method based on a HHO-CEEMDAM algorithm is characterized by comprising the steps of building a millimeter wave radar experiment system, collecting intermediate frequency signals of human echoes, carrying out data reading and recombination, extracting phase characteristics, determining the distance between a human chest and a radar through non-coherent accumulation enhancement target signals, recovering phases of vital sign signals from an FFT result of incoherent accumulation by utilizing linear characteristics of arctangent demodulation, carrying out phase unwrapping and phase difference to obtain optimized phase information, setting an initialization range of CEEMDAN parameters and designing an adaptation function, optimizing CEEMDAN parameters by utilizing the HHO algorithm, carrying out CEEMDAN decomposition by utilizing optimized parameters, screening breath and heartbeat IMF components, and obtaining estimated values of a respiratory frequency and a heart rate according to the IMF components. The method improves the accuracy of estimating the respiratory rate and the heart rate of the millimeter wave radar in fatigue driving detection.

title_en: Buried object survey device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily remove striped noise components included in a received signal of an underground radar device to improve visibility of an image.SOLUTION: For pieces of one-dimensional image data f(t) in all reflection time axis directions in two-dimensional image data, the pieces of data are transformed into time-frequency areas by one-dimensional wavelet analysis, time-frequency data is calculated, and frequency components of vertical striped noise are calculated, after that, first filtering processing for extracting the noise components is executed, and second filtering processing for removing vertical striped noise components extracted from the original two-dimensional image data is executed to remove the vertical striped noise, and similar noise removal processing is further executed for the pieces of one-dimensional image data f(t) in all moving distance axis directions in the two-dimensional image data to remove the horizontal striped noise.
assignees: NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD:THE;UNIV OF ELECTRO-COMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Electronic device for estimating physiological signal and method thereof
title_ko: 생체 신호를 추정하는 전자 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic device for estimating a biometric signal to increase accuracy and reliability of biometric information acquired by using a wearable device and to a method thereof. According to various embodiments of the present invention, the electronic device comprises: a first sensor measuring a biometric parameter of a user; a second sensor measuring characteristic of the user′s movement; at least one processor operatively connected to the first sensor or the second sensor; and a memory operatively connected to the at least one processor. The method stores instructions allowing the at least one processor, during execution, to monitor the user′s biometric signals based on the bio-parameters measured by the first sensor; check a first signal indicating a bioactivity trend on the basis of the user′s movement characteristics acquired from the second sensor when the user′s movement is detected by using at least one of the first sensor and the second sensor during monitoring; and correct the user′s biometric signals recorded during a first time period, in which the user′s movement is maintained, on the basis of the first signal. Various other embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른, 전자 장치는, 사용자에 대한 생체 파라미터를 측정하는 제1 센서, 상기 사용자의 움직임 특성을 측정하는 제2 센서, 상기 제1 센서 또는 상기 제2 센서와 작동적으로 연결된 적어도 하나의 프로세서, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서와 작동적으로 연결된 메모리를 포함하고, 상기 메모리는, 실행 시에, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가, 상기 제1 센서에 의해 측정된 생체 파라미터를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 모니터링 하고, 상기 모니터링 중 상기 제1 센서 또는 상기 제2 센서 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 움직임을 감지하면, 상기 제2 센서로부터 획득한 상기 사용자의 움직임 특성을 기반으로 생체 활동 추세를 나타내는 제1 신호를 확인하고, 상기 제1 신호를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 움직임이 유지되는 제1 시간 구간 동안 기록된 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 보정하도록 하는 인스트럭션들을 저장할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따라 다른 실시예들이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-purpose infant health status monitoring device and multi-purpose infant health status monitoring system including the same
title_ko: 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치 및 이를 포함하는 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of an embodiment of the present invention, a multipurpose infant and toddler health state monitoring device may be provided comprising: a head part having a grip part gripped by a hand formed on one surface, and having a contact part having a central groove concaved inward or an edge groove formed on an edge to be coupled to a nipple part so that the other surface is in direct contact with the body to measure a bio-signal; a sensor part provided on the head part to measure the bio-signal of an infant and toddler playing; and a control part for determining a health state of the infant and toddler based on the measured bio-signal. According to thereof, a health state of the infant and toddler may be determined through a multi-channel comprising body temperature, pulse wave, oxygen saturation, electrical conductivity of the skin, and pressure, and the health state of the infant and toddler may be transmitted to an external device to be monitored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예의 일 측면에 따르면, 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 직접 접촉되어 생체 신호를 측정하거나, 젖꼭지부에 결합할 수 있도록 내측으로 오목한 중앙 홈 또는 가장자리에 테두리 홈이 형성되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하는, 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치를 제공할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도, 피부의 전기전도도 및 압력을 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Color image rendering for ground-penetrating radar systems
abstract_en: Devices, methods and techniques related to image rendering for ground-penetrating radar (GPR) systems are disclosed. In one example aspect, a method for producing one or more images associated with a GPR includes receiving information representative of signals received by the GPR, determining at least three frequency bands associated with the received information, assigning color values to the received information corresponding to the at least three frequency bands, and generating a color image for the one or more objects by combining the received information in all of the at least three frequency bands together such that the color values in the color image indicate a size of the one or more objects, a depth at which the one or more objects is buried underground, or an electrical permittivity of the one or more objects.
assignees: L LIVERMORE NAT SECURITY LLC;TERES TECH INC

title_en: Method and device for identifying human behaviors of rapid multi-scale through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying human body behaviors of a rapid multi-scale through-wall radar, which are used for constructing a lightweight deep neural network with multi-scale characteristic information mining capability by combining a super-resolution Doppler estimation model based on a nuclear distance, a lightweight non-anchor single-stage target detection network model and a lightweight classification network model according to frequency stepping radar data, synchronously extracting translation information of a human body in a complex through-wall environment and generated mu-D characteristics, mixing the two scales of information to carry out decision recognition, and finally giving out a through-wall radar human body motion recognition result.

title_en: Wearable monitoring apparatus
title_ko: 착용형 모니터링 장치
abstract_ko:
실시예는 착용형 모니터링 장치에 관한 것이다. 
실시예에 따른 착용형 모니터링 장치는, 피부에 부착 가능하게 형성되고, 복수 개로 배열된 전극을 이용하여 인체로부터 신호 대 잡음비를 측정하고, 측정된 신호 대 잡음비에 기초하여 복수 개의 전극 중 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 전극들을 선택하고, 선택된 전극들을 이용하여 하나 이상의 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 및 피부에 부착 가능하게 형성되고, 센서부를 통해 검출된 생체신호를 수집하는 단말부를 포함하고, 센서부 및 단말부는, 인체 통신을 이용하여 데이터를 송수신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Electronic device including biometric sensor and electrode for acquiring biometric signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 획득을 위한 생체 센서 및 전극을 포함하는 전자 장치
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 문서에 개시되는 일 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 표면에 복수의 관통 홀이 형성되는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 상기 표면에 회전 가능하도록 결합되는 휠 부재, 상기 휠 부재는 도전성 부분을 포함함; 상기 하우징 내부에 배치되는 인쇄 회로 기판; 및 상기 휠 부재의 회전을 지지하기 위해, 적어도 일부가 상기 관통 홀의 내부에 배치되는 제1 베어링 구조, 상기 제1 베어링 구조는 상기 인쇄 회로 기판과 상기 도전성 부분을 전기적으로 연결함; 을 포함할 수 있다. 이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Precise infrastructure mapping using full-waveform inversion of ground penetrating radar signals
abstract_en: A new method for FWI of common-offset GPR data, particularly targeting the dimensions and infilling material of buried pipes. The method is useful in situation where clear isolated diffraction hyperbolas indicate the presence of a pipe, but pipe dimensions and filling may be unknown. The invention is a method of taking GPR data and applying advanced numerical methods to get the depth and size of an underground pipe in a very accurate manner. An embodiment of the method consists of five main steps: GPR data processing, ray-based analysis to set a good initial model, 3D to 2D transformation of data, effective SW estimation, and FWI.

title_en: Respiration detection using radar
abstract_en: One or more radar sensors can be used to monitor patients in a variety of different environments and embodiments. In one embodiment, radar sensors can be used to monitor a patient's breathing, including monitoring of tidal volume, chest expansion distance, breathing rate, etc. In another embodiment, a patient position can be monitored in a patient bed, which can be used as feedback for control of bladders of a patient bed. Additional embodiments are described herein.

title_en: Buried pipeline positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a buried pipeline positioning device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an ultrasonic pipeline detector and a controller are arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a probe of the ultrasonic pipeline detector penetrates through the bottom plate and extends to the lower surface of the bottom plate, a first obstacle sensor is arranged on the front side of the lower surface of the bottom plate, a second obstacle sensor is arranged on the rear side of the lower surface of the bottom plate, the heights of the probe and the second obstacle sensor relative to the ground are higher than those of the first obstacle sensor relative to the ground, telescopic units are arranged at four corners of the lower surface of the bottom plate, universal wheels are arranged on the telescopic units, a push handle is arranged on the rear side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, and the ultrasonic pipeline detector, the first obstacle sensor, the second obstacle sensor and the telescopic units are electrically connected with the controller; the utility model can effectively avoid the collision between the probe of the ultrasonic pipeline detector and the obstacle in the moving process, thereby protecting the probe.

title_en: Earthquake underground fluid inspection well and system and method used earthquake underground fluid inspection well to detect seismic precursor abnormal information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake underground fluid inspection well and a system and a method used the earthquake underground fluid inspection well to detect seismic precursor abnormal information of gap pressure diffusion coefficients, which relate to earth physics and quakeproof disaster reduction technology. The earthquake underground fluid inspection well is arranged vertical to the direction of strata, a corrosion resisting seal stainless steel sleeve is installed in the center of the inspection well in the middle, cement is used at the bottom and the top of the inspection well for fixing a sleeve, a stainless steel clamp is adopted to fix the sleeve at the position of the axial center of the stainless steel sleeve additionally, multimode fibers are buried in a gap between the sleeve and the well wall, ore particles are filled in the gap between the sleeve and the well wall, so that an even gap medium layer is formed. A special high-resolution-ratio fiber sensor collects gas pressure dynamic response signals stimulated by earthquake cutting waves, a data analyzing system is integrated through a maximum likelihood deconvolution space-time conservation method and a weight integral method chips, characteristic scale of the dynamic gap pressure diffusion coefficients related to the cutting waves is obtained through calculation, an earthquake source generated the earthquake cutting waves is  carried out high-precision earthquake location, scientific decision-making data with earthquake source physical significances are provided to seismic prediction. The obtaining method of the characteristic scale of the dynamic gap pressure diffusion coefficients can be used for well wall fracture monitor of oil exploitation wells and carbon dioxide geology seal injection wells.
assignees: INST OF CRUSTAL DYNAMICS CHINA SEISMOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: The signal processing system of non-contact vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides the signal processing system of a kind of non-contact vital sign monitoring, including: I/Q channel signal processing module: for I/Q channel signal I (t) and Q (t) is combined into complex signal S (t)；Respiratory frequency estimation module: according to baseband signal mathematical model feature, defines frequency rotation operator By S (t) with Carry out Fourier transformation after being multiplied, by spectrum concentration index, the optimizing of parameter P is estimated, first estimate to obtain respiratory frequency f r ；Modulation product removes module, by S (t) and the frequency rotation operator estimated by step 2 It is multiplied, removes the modulation product caused by breathing in S (t)；Palmic rate estimation module: for estimating frequency f of heart beating h .The present invention carries out parametrization optimizing estimation based on radar baseband signal model, the frequency rotation operator that structure matches, utilizes shorter sampling length data can obtain high-precision f r And f h Estimating numerical value, measurement sensitivity is high, and noise immunity is strong.

title_en: Safe and reliable Quick rescue device and rescue mode after a kind of tunnel cave
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Quick rescue devices and rescue mode safe and reliable after a kind of tunnel cave.Quick rescue device includes the push-bench of built-in belt conveyor, radar life-detection instrument, the steel push pipe and jack of internal illumination device, after tunnel cave, Rapid Excavation active well, the push-bench and radar life-detection instrument of built-in belt conveyor are installed in active well, the steel push pipe of internal illumination device, jack, then the push-bench of built-in belt conveyor rescued by excavating, radar life-detection instrument detects the sign of life in collapsing ruins, make fast and accurately to reach rescue position, then trapped person is transported by belt conveyor from the rescue channel that the push-bench of built-in belt conveyor and the steel push pipe of internal illumination device are formed.It, securely and reliably and being capable of Quick rescue after the present invention can collapse in constructing tunnel.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring Blood Pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2) and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters of a patient, characterized by a sensing portion having a flexible housing that can be worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, a wireless transmitter, and the sensing and electronics components of all sensors. The patch sensor measures Electrocardiogram (ECG), Impedance Plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and Phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these waveforms to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures the PPG waveform also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of the breast tissue.

title_en: Continuous wave life detection radar
abstract_en: The application provides a continuous wave life detection radar, this continuous wave life detection radar includes: the frequency synthesizer module is used for generating a linear frequency modulation radio frequency signal; an antenna for transmitting and receiving radio frequency signals; a circulator for connecting the transmitter, the receiver and the antenna; the antenna radiates amplified linear frequency modulation radio frequency signals outwards according to the fixed directivity of the circulator; and the radio frequency cancellation module is used for isolating the transmitter and the receiver. The ultra-wideband radar signal receiving and transmitting are realized by adopting a linear frequency modulation continuous wave system, the coherent processing of the radar is realized, and the detection distance and the resolution of the radar can be further improved. The single antenna is used for realizing the receiving and transmitting of the radar, and has the characteristics of small volume, light weight and the like. And the circulator is adopted to realize the isolation of the emitting electrode and the receiver, and a radio frequency cancellation scheme is further adopted to realize better receiving and transmitting isolation, thereby being more beneficial to improving the detection performance of the radar. The radar is provided with a plurality of devices for networking, and three-dimensional or higher-precision life detection is realized.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Omnidirectional biological radar device and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an omnidirectional biological radar device and a working method thereof, wherein an FMCW radar is arranged on a 360-degree rotating platform, and omnidirectional vital sign detection of a plurality of human targets is realized through a radar rotating at a high speed. The rotary radar platform not only can realize the identification of the existence of people in the surrounding environment, but also can estimate the relative angle between the radar initial position and the object by using the virtual SIMO (Simple Input Multiple Output, single input multiple output) method provided by the invention, and finally realizes the simultaneous detection of all-dimensional vital signs of a plurality of human targets. The implementation of the task may have important application value for future search and rescue and vital sign detection.

title_en: Vital sign simulation equipment and interference signal generation system
abstract_en: The invention provides vital sign simulation equipment and an interference signal generation system, wherein the equipment comprises a controller, a displacement generation unit and a displacement generation unit, wherein the controller is used for generating a control signal according to vital sign simulation parameters, the displacement generation unit is connected with the controller and is used for generating periodic displacement according to the control signal sent by the controller, the vital sign simulation parameters comprise heart beat parameters or/and breathing parameters, and the problem that the biological radar test equipment in the prior art lacks standard test equipment and cannot evaluate the accuracy of products in the quality inspection test process is solved.
assignees: JIAXING HUIHE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rapid vital sign analysis method and system based on millimeter wave radar time sequence data
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid vital sign analysis method and a rapid vital sign analysis system based on millimeter wave radar time sequence data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a two-dimensional image corresponding to target millimeter wave radar data, wherein the two-dimensional image comprises a distance dimension and a Doppler dimension, the target millimeter wave radar data is obtained by preprocessing noise data in the millimeter wave radar data, and the preprocessing comprises the following steps: static clutter filtering, average maximum energy range gate positioning and signal phase unwrapping; acquiring a data cube corresponding to the millimeter wave radar data of the target based on the two-dimensional image, wherein the data cube comprises a time dimension, a distance dimension and a Doppler dimension; projecting the data cube onto three orthogonal two-dimensional planes to obtain image data of the data cube on each two-dimensional plane, wherein the three orthogonal two-dimensional planes are a time distance plane, a time Doppler plane and a distance Doppler plane; and analyzing the image data to obtain a predicted value of vital sign data corresponding to the image data.

title_en: Bioinstrumentation to evaluate blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function
title_ko: 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A biometric system for evaluation of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary functions using both hands is provided to use a wrist blood pressure measurement module, thereby improving the accuracy of wrist blood pressure measurement. CONSTITUTION: A body impedance sensor unit (130) comprises a current electrode and a voltage electrode. The body impedance sensor unit detects a pulmonary volume signal. An impedance pulmonary function test (IPFT) pre-processor (160) removes noise. The IPFT pre-processor amplifies the pulmonary volume signal. An electrocardiogram and body impedance micro controller unit (MCU) (170) converts the pulmonary volume signal to a digital signal. [Reference numerals] (110) Electrocardiogram sensor unit; (120) Electrocardiogram preprocessing unit; (130) Body impedance sensor unit; (140) Body impedance preprocessing unit; (150) ICG preprocessing unit; (160) IPFT pre-processor; (170) Electrocardiogram and body impedance MCU; (210) Oxygen saturation sensor unit; (220) Oxygen saturation preprocessing unit; (230) Oxygen saturation MCU; (310) NIBP sensor unit; (320) NIBP preprocessing unit; (330) Pressure sensor unit; (340) Pressure preprocessing unit; (410) Main MCU; (420) Display unit; (430) Speaker unit; (440) Bluetooth unit
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 양손만을 이용하여, 단일 파라미터가 아닌, 심전도(ECG), 산소포화도(SpO 2 ), 혈압(NIBP), 체임피던스(Bio-Impedance)를 측정하고, 체지방율(Body Fat Rate, BFR), 비관혈식 혈압(NIBP), 혈관탄성도(BVSI), 심박출량(ICG), 폐기능 검사(IPFT)의 다차원의 생체 파라미터의 분석을 행하여, 비용과 시간의 제약이 적게 들며, 지속적인 혈관 및 심폐기능 모니터링이 가능한, 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은, 손목에 혈압측정용 커프를 장착하고, 좌측단과 우측단을 손으로 잡도록 이루어지되, 좌측단과 우측단의 손접촉부에는 생체신호 검출전극이 장착되어 있는 생체 계측 시스템에 있어서, 심전도, 체임피던스, 심박출량(ICG), 임피던스 폐기능검사(IPFT)를 측정하는 수단으로, 심전도 센서부과 체임피던스 센서부을 구비하여, 심전도신호와 체임피던스 신호를 검출하여, RR간격을 포함하는 심전도 파라미터, FEV1/FVC 비율, 심박출량, 체지방량을 측정하는 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈; 산소포화도 센서부를 구비하여 산소포화도를 검출하는 산소포화도 검출모듈; NIBP 센서부 및 압력센서부를 구비하여, NIBP센서부로부터의 혈압신호 및 압력센서부로부터의 코르트코프음신호를 검출하여, 혈압 신호로부터 오실로메트릭법에 따른 혈압을 검출하고, 코르트코프음신호로부터 코로토코프음에 따른 혈압을 검출하는 혈압측정모듈; 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈, 산소포화도 검출모듈, 혈압측정모듈의 구동을 제어하고, 사용자의 생체측정신호를 통계처리하여 결과를 디스플레이부로 출력하는 메인 모듈를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명은 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈 및 산소포화도 검출모듈을 이용하여 혈관탄성도(BVSI)를 검출할 수 있다.
assignees: NUGA MEDICAL CO LTD;UNIV YONSEI WONJU INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Human Body Change Measurement System And Method In Accordance With Stimulus Presentation To Classify The Sex Offense
title_ko: 성범죄 분류를 위한 자극 제시에 따른 신체 변화 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for measuring a body change according to presentation of stimulation for classification of sex crimes. According to the present invention, sensors of an apparatus for measuring a body change for classification of sexual crimes are attached to the body of a subject. A penis diameter change measuring unit, an electrocardiogram measuring unit, and various sensors (for example, skin conductivity detecting unit, skin conduction and visual deviation detecting unit, safety measuring circuit) for measuring psycho physiological reactions are attached, wherein the penis diameter change measuring unit uses a strain gauge which measures a change amount in the diameter of a penis of a subject according to auditory stimulation and visual stimulation of presenting pictures of children or adults by imitating a virtual sexual situation. Measured biosignals are transmitted to a computer, and the type and stimulation source database of sex offenders are constructed. In integrated operation and analysis software of a computer, which is a system for measuring a body change, combined with an autonomous nervous system analysis, patient information and a stimulation source category of a sex offender are inputted. It is possible to measure the autonomic nervous system reaction and physiological change of the sex offender according to auditory stimulation and visual stimulation of presenting pictures of children or adults by imitating a virtual sexual situation with respect to stimulation sources corresponding to the characteristics of the sex offender, and to determine whether the sex offender has child molestering paraphilias. Classification and treating effects are provided according to risk factors of the sex offender, and a sex offender treatment program is improved to guide the sex offender in the right direction. Thus, it is possible to reduce the recidivism rate of the sex offender.
abstract_ko:
성범죄 분류를 위한 자극제시에 따른 신체 변화 측정 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 신체 변화 측정 시스템은 대상자의 신체에 성범죄 분류를 위한 신체 변화 측정 장치의 센서들을 부착하고, 가상의 성적인 상황을 묘사하여 아동이나 성인 사진이 제시되는 시각 자극과 청각 자극에 따라 대상자의 성기에 음경의 직경의 변화량을 측정하는 스트레인 게이지를 사용한 음경 직경 변화 측정부와 심전도 측정부, 및 심리생리반응을 측정하는 여러 센서(ex. 피부전도도 검출부-피부전도반응, 시선이탈 감지부-안전도 계측 회로)들을 부착하여 측정된 생체 신호들을 컴퓨터로 전송하며,  
성범죄자의 유형과 자극원 데이터베이스를 구축하고, 자율신경계 분석이 결합된 신체 변화 측정 시스템인 컴퓨터의 통합 운영 및 분석 소프트웨어에서 성범죄자의 환자 정보와 자극원 카테고리를 입력하고, 성범죄자 특성에 맞게 자극원을 가상의 성적인 상황을 묘사하여 아동이나 성인 사진이 제시되는 시각 자극과 청각 자극에 따른 성범죄자의 자율신경계의 반응과 생리적인 변화를 측정하여 성범죄자의 아동 성애적 성도착증 여부를 판단하며, 성폭력 범죄자의 위험 요인에 따른 분류와 치료효과를 제공하여 올바른 방향으로 인도하도록 성범죄자 치료 프로그램을 개선하여 성범죄자의 재범률을 줄이는 효과가 있다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA NAT FORENSIC SERVICE DIRECTOR MINISTRY OF INTERIOR AND SAFETY

title_en: recessed solar LED road marker
title_ko: 매립형 태양광 엘이디 도로표지병
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road-buried road stud, and more specifically, to a buried solar LED road stud, which can send emergency situation information and location information by means of a wireless communication, and can make an accident circumstance to be clearly recognized, thereby preventing an accident. To this end, the present invention comprises: a main body housing to be buried in the road; a main body inserted and installed in the main body housing; and a main body housing cover fixated to the main body housing by means of a cover fixating pin to prevent the dislocation of the main body at the upper portion of the main body housing. The main body comprises: a solar panel converting sunlight introduced into the upper portion of the main body into electricity; a battery storing electricity converted in the solar panel; an LED outputting light by using the electricity stored in the battery; a beacon receiving an emergency situation signal from a smartphone, and linked with the smartphone to transmit a message notifying location information and an emergency circumstance; an illuminance sensor detecting illuminance; and a control board connected to the beacon and the illuminance sensor to control the operation of the LED. A lens is provided to be convex at the upper portion of the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 매립형 도로표지병에 있어서, 특히 무선통신을 통해 긴급 상황정보와 위치정보를 보낼 수 있고 또한 사고 상황에 대한 명확한 인지가 가능하게 하여 사고를 예방할 수 있도록 한 매립형 태양광 엘이디 도로표지병에 관한 것으로, 도로 매립을 위한 본체하우징; 상기 본체하우징의 내부에 삽입 설치되는 본체; 및 상기 본체하우징의 상부에서 상기 본체의 이탈을 방지하기 위하여 커버고정핀에 의해 상기 본체하우징에 고정되는 본체하우징커버로 구성되며, 상기 본체는 상기 본체의 상부로 유입되는 태양광을 전기로 변환하는 태양광 판넬과, 상기 태양광 판넬에서 변환된 전기를 저장하는 배터리와, 상기 배터리에 저장된 전기를 사용하여 빛을 출력하는 엘이디와, 스마트폰으로부터 위급 상황 신호를 수신하고 상기 스마트폰과 연동하여 위치정보와 위급 상황을 알리는 메시지를 전송하는 비콘과, 조도를 감지하는 조도센서와, 상기 비콘과 상기 조도센서와 연결되어 상기 엘이디의 동작을 제어하는 컨트롤보드를 구비하며, 상기 본체의 상부는 렌즈를 볼록하게 구비하는 것이 특징인 발명이다.

title_en: System and method for controlling the temperature of a chamber
title_ko: 챔버의 온도를 제어하기 위한 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a chamber control system for controlling a thermal chamber used for a thermal environment test on a satellite component. In accordance with the present disclosure, the chamber control system for controlling a thermal chamber includes: a human-machine interface receiving a biometric signal of a user from a wearable device, identifying whether a problem occurs to the user based on the biometric signal, and, when identifying that a problem has occurred to the user, transmitting a danger signal indicating the occurrence of the problem; a thermal chamber control part transmitting an emergency situation command signal in response to the danger signal; and a thermal chamber changing the internal temperature of the chamber to a room temperature in response to the emergency situation command signal. The present invention is capable of preventing a satellite component from being exposed to an extreme situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 위성체 부품의 열 환경 시험에 이용되는 열 챔버를 제어하기 위한 챔버 제어 시스템에 관련된 것이다. 본 개시에 따르면, 열 챔버를 제어하기 위한 챔버 제어 시스템은 웨어러블(wearable) 장치로부터 사용자의 생체 신호를 수신하고, 상기 생체 신호에 기반하여 상기 사용자에게 문제가 발생하였는지 여부를 식별하고, 상기 사용자에게 문제가 발생한 것으로 식별한 경우 상기 문제의 발생을 지시하는 위험 신호를 송신하는 휴먼-머신 인터페이스와, 상기 위험 신호에 응답하여, 비상 상황 명령 신호를 송신하는 열 챔버 제어부와, 상기 비상 상황 명령 신호에 응답하여 챔버의 내부 온도가 상온으로 변경되는 열 챔버를 포함한다.

title_en: A leak detection system for water and sewage pipes using 3D surface penetration radar and a leak verification system for water and sewage pipes
title_ko: 3차원 지표투과레이더를 이용한 상하수관의 누수탐사 시스템 및 상하수관의 누수검증 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a leak detection system for water and sewage pipes including a 3D ground penetrating radar (GPR) for checking a passing speed of fluid passing through a pipe network, a difference in reflection intensity through a phase change and a dielectric constant difference on a radar-gram, and a change in depth of a reflection boundary in order to check whether there is a water leak in the pipe network buried underground. Therefore, regardless of the buried depth of the water and sewage pipes, the size of the water and sewage pipes, the water and sewage pipe leaks, and the material of the water and sewage pipes, the signal reflected from an upper boundary of the pipe is used to detect water and sewage pipes buried underground to identify leakage parts.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하에 매설되어 있는 관망의 누수 여부를 확인하기 위하여, 관망을 통과하는 유체의 통과속도, 레이더 그램상의 위상변화 및 유전율 차이를 통한 반사강도의 차이 및 반사 경계면의 심도변화를 확인하는 3차원 지표투과레이더(GRP, Ground Penetrating Radar)를 포함하는, 상하수관의 누수탐사 시스템을 제공한다. 
따라서 상하수관의 매설깊이, 상하수관 크기, 상하수관 누수, 상하수관 재질에 상관없이 관로의 상부 경계면으로부터 반사된 신호를 이용하여 지하에 매설되어 있는 상ㅇ하수관을 탐지하여 누수부위를 파악할 수 있다.

title_en: Treating pathogenic infections
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range and bacterial or viral infection are targeted for death. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of an antibiotic and an antiviral. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: Computation processing device for identifying position of buried elongate object from gpr data from array-type ground penetrating radar device
abstract_en: The present invention accurately identifies a burial position and an elongation direction even when the vertex position in a hyperbolic reflection image is not positioned directly below a data acquisition point.　From GPR data acquired by an array-type ground penetrating radar device of a first analysis line, a second analysis line, and a third analysis line that extend in mutually different directions and are composed of data acquisition points, a first angle formed by the first analysis line and the second analysis line, and a second angle formed by the second analysis line and the third analysis line, the present invention calculates the vertex position of a hyperbola of the GPR data in the first analysis line, and a first virtual propagation speed, a second virtual propagation speed, and a third virtual propagation speed of radio waves in the substance that is below the first analysis line, the second analysis line, and the third analysis line. The present invention calculates the skew angle formed by the first analysis line and a fourth straight line obtained by projecting an elongate object onto the ground surface, the inclination angle formed by the elongate object and the ground surface, the burial depth from a first point positioned directly above the elongate object on the first analysis line to the elongate object directly therebelow, and the position of the first point, with which the present invention identifies the burial position and the elongation direction of the elongate object.

title_en: Sensor fusion framework using multiple sensors to assess buried structures
abstract_en: A method of surveying the condition of an underground conduit by positioning a propelled carriage assembly within the underground conduit. The carriage assembly includes (i) at least one transmitter/receiver unit capable of transmitting a pulsed signal toward at least a portion of an inner wall of the conduit, and (ii) a secondary sensor positioned on the carriage assembly. The data derived from the pulsed signal at a given lateral location within an underground conduit is read as is a secondary sensor condition derived from secondary sensor data taken at the given lateral location. Then it is determined whether the secondary sensor condition indicates a basis for a false void detection by the data derived from the pulsed signal and if the basis for false void detection exists, providing an indication of such basis.

title_en: Cardiac signal processing apparatus and cardiac signal processing method
abstract_en: A cardiac signal processing apparatus includes: a unit for acquiring, from a heartbeat sensor, cardiac signals relating to heartbeats of a subject; a low-pass filter for allowing passage of those cardiac signals having a first predetermined frequency or lower, among the cardiac signals; higher harmonic noise acquisition unit for acquiring harmonic signals of low-frequency noise by performing high frequency extrapolation on the signals output from the low-pass filter; a high-pass filter for allowing passage of those cardiac signals having a second predetermined frequency or higher, among the cardiac signals; and higher harmonic noise removal unit for removing the harmonic signals of low-frequency noise from the signals output from the high-pass filter. It is thus made possible to remove noise from the cardiac signals and to obtain desirable heartbeat detection characteristics.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Radar identification of persons via vital signs
abstract_en: A radar apparatus comprises: a processor; a radar; and a non-transitory memory storing instructions that, when executed by the processor, configure the apparatus to perform a method. The method comprises: emitting a radar signal with the radar; receiving backscattered radar signals with the radar; extracting reflection data from the backscattered radar signal; determining at least one vital sign of at least one person from the extracted reflection data; and identifying the at least one person by using a first machine learning model to provide a similarity score between the determined at least one vital sign and at least one vital sign from previously collected vital signs of the at least one person.

title_en: Life detecting device based on pseudocode phase-modulated continuous wave system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection device based on pseudocode phase modulation continuous wave system. The devices comprises the following steps: performing phase modulation on intermediate frequency signal by applying fake random encoded signal, then changing wave to microwave and amplify the microwave by power, radiated by transmitting antenna. Encoded signal entering into receiving antenna is amplified by low noise, two mixing and wave filtering and switched into stimulation baseband signal, translated into digital signal by high speed sampling, the digital signal is performed clutter cancellation, distance gate correlation, digital filtering by applying large-scale FPGA device, performs FFT switch in high speed DSP processor and adjudged, the result of judgment will be sent to terminal to display. The detection device can be used for discovering people located in the wall body or other barrier, and can measure the distance between people and detection device, provides convenience for search, rescue, thus the device has stronger anti-clutter and anti-background interference capability.

title_en: Based on multiple target location estimation method after the through-wall radar imaging for improving Dynamic Programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on multiple target location estimation method after the through-wall radar imaging for improving Dynamic Programming；It includes target area imaging, target image optimization, Dynamic Programming and the estimation of sliding window smooth position.The present invention has fully taken into account autgmentability of the target in imaging results, the target caused by scattering coefficient difference, target echo attenuation, target occlusion etc. between target is improved well loses problem, improve target detection probability, with the advantage that target detection probability is high, position estimation accuracy is higher, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Robot for coal mine tunnel safety detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot for safety detection of a coal mine tunnel, which comprises a crawler-type travelling mechanism, a safety detection device and a safety lifesaving device, wherein the crawler-type travelling mechanism is provided with a self-stabilizing cradle head for installing the safety detection device and the safety lifesaving device; the safety detection device comprises a sensor assembly which is arranged at the rear part in the crawler-type travelling mechanism in a sealing way, and the sensor assembly comprises an infrared thermal imager and a gas detector; the safety life-saving device comprises a life detector which is arranged in a sealing mode and a radio interphone communication system which works in an ultrashort wave frequency band. The robot for safety detection of the coal mine tunnel provided by the invention improves the working efficiency of potential safety hazard investigation of gas and electric circuits in the coal mine tunnel, and solves the problem that when a collapse accident occurs in the coal mine tunnel, the search and rescue work of a survivor to be buried is wasted due to the fact that the search and rescue range is too large and the search and rescue direction of a search and rescue team member is not clear.

title_en: Rock-soil seepage real-time measuring instrument system based on heat conduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock-soil seepage real-time measuring instrument system based on heat conduction. The system is buried underground, each seepage measurement sensor is connected with a seepage information collection transmitter through a seepage measurement processing terminal, and the seepage information collection transmitter is connected with a transmitting end antenna; in the seepage flow measuring sensor, a thin tube funnel structure is a middle thin tube and two funnels connected to two ends of the thin tube, the small end of the funnels is fixed to the end part of the thin tube and is communicated with the thin tube, a porous ceramic plate is arranged on the end face of the large end of the funnels, a controllable heating rod is arranged in the center of the inside of the thin tube, a temperature sensor is arranged at two end parts of the inside of the thin tube, and a water detection needle is inserted in the middle of the inside of the thin tube. The invention accurately measures the direction and the seepage flow of the rock and soil caused by various reasons in the rock and soil, is a novel instrument for observing the seepage flow in the rock and soil in real time, and provides precursor information for the occurrence of disasters such as landslide, debris flow and the like.

title_en: Radar-based respiration and heartbeat signal detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting respiration and heartbeat signals based on a radar. The method comprises the following steps: a, judging whether a target exists or not based on a transmitting signal and a receiving signal; b, processing the mixed vital sign signal of the target as follows: b1, carrying out high-pass filtering and FFT (fast Fourier transform) on the mixed vital sign signal to obtain first spectrum data; b2, if the frequency corresponding to the maximum amplitude value point is in the respiratory frequency range and an amplitude maximum value point exists at the Q frequency multiplication position and/or near the Q frequency multiplication position of the frequency, taking the frequency as a respiratory main frequency; b3, decomposing the mixed vital sign signals of the target based on empirical wavelet transform; and B4, if the maximum frequency of the third component or the fourth component is within a preset heartbeat frequency range, taking the maximum frequency as the heartbeat main frequency. Based on empirical wavelet transform, breath and heartbeat signals are separated in a self-adaptive mode, the frequency of the breath and heartbeat signals is extracted accurately, and the breath and heartbeat frequencies of a plurality of people can be extracted and separated simultaneously for a broadband/ultra-wideband radar.

title_en: Human body presence sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent induction, in particular to a human body presence sensor, which comprises a microwave sensor, an infrared sensor, a register unit, a control unit and a power supply unit, wherein the microwave sensor and the infrared sensor detect target environment information through a microwave sensing signal and an infrared temperature signal respectively, and detected data are transmitted into an operation unit to be processed by a statistical algorithm to classify the microwave sensing signal and the infrared temperature signal; judging according to the microwave sensing data and the temperature value, and when the data is stored in the high-temperature register, the control unit sends the human existence sensing to be true; when data is stored in the low Wen Jicun device, the control unit sends a human presence perception of no. The invention can sense the moving heat body and record the heat value, and the heat value can be used for judging whether the moving/static heat body exists or not and finally outputting whether the heat body exists in the closed space or not; based on the microwave sensor and the infrared sensor, it is jointly determined whether a person exists in the detected environment.

title_en: Indoor moving object detection method based on Doppler frequency modulation profile and range gating filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting an indoor moving target of an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar, which comprises the steps of providing a moving target detection method based on Doppler frequency modulation profile and distance gating filtering. The imaging result of the moving target is defocused and is easy to be submerged in strong static clutter, so that the detection rate of the moving target is reduced. To solve this problem, the present invention analyzes Doppler frequency characteristics of stationary clutter and moving targets. Then, the range migration of the target echo is corrected in the range-doppler domain by sinc interpolation. Then, the Doppler frequency of each range gate of the echo is estimated by fractional Fourier transform, the estimated value of the frequency modulation is compared with the theoretical value of the frequency modulation of the stationary target, and a range gating filter is designed to inhibit clutter generated by walls and stationary objects based on the difference of the Doppler frequency modulation. And finally, constructing an azimuth compression filter to realize focusing imaging of the moving target. Simulation and actual measurement experiments verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

title_en: quick search and rescue equipment for fire scene
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to an  kinds of rapid search and rescue equipment in fire scene, including the casing, thermal imaging subassembly, radar life detection subassembly, central processing unit, communication module and display module, thermal imaging subassembly, radar life detection subassembly, central processing unit, communication module all are located the casing, display module is located housing face, thermal imaging subassembly, radar life detection subassembly, communication module and display module connect central processing unit respectively.

title_en: Breathing protection device with breathing detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a respiratory protection device with respiratory detection function, which comprises a protective cover and a head-wearing bracket, wherein the head-wearing bracket is provided with an exhaust fan, the exhaust fan is connected with a vent pipe, the vent pipe is detachably connected with the protective cover, and a sensor is arranged in the vent pipe and can detect expiratory parameters, respiratory state and the like; the head-mounted bracket is provided with a controller which is electrically connected with the sensor. The controller comprises a driving circuit, a processor, a power supply, a control key and a Bluetooth module. The utility model discloses an air exhauster takes the waste gas in the protection casing out, is favorable to the protection casing to ventilate, makes the user keep breathing unobstructed, effectively reduces carbon dioxide and gathers, improves use comfort. And the sensor is used for detecting parameters of expiration and respiration states, and parameter data are wirelessly sent through the Bluetooth module, so that real-time health condition monitoring is conveniently carried out. And the diversified application scenes can be experienced through listening to music, news, making and receiving calls and the like through the Bluetooth headset.

title_en: A kind of ultra-broadband wall-through radar human body respiration and heartbeat detecting method and system
