abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of breathing of ultra-broadband wall-through radar life body and heartbeat detecting method and systems, belong to the radar exploration technique field, comprising the following steps: S1: receiving echo-signal through walls；S2: by echo-signal piecemeal；S3: accumulation coherent pulse；S4: wall echo is inhibited；S5: Wavelet Denoising Method；S6: decomposed signal；S7: Fourier transformation is carried out；S8: state simulation of frequency region screening；S9: CFAR detection；S10: multiple life entity target identifications.The present invention removes wall clutter by singular value decomposition, enhances feeble respiration heartbeat signal, then removes high-frequency noise with wavelet transformation, then decomposed with natural mode of vibration and separated breathing and heartbeat signal, can extract breathing and the heartbeat signal of life entity simultaneously；Finally according to the difference and location information of the breathing of different life entities and palmic rate, multiple life entity targets are identified；Signal-to-noise ratio is effectively improved by certain mode, and computational efficiency is made to be greatly enhanced.
assignees: CN ELECT TECH NO 38 RES INST

title_en: Multi-target vital sign radar detection system based on coding and phased array antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target vital sign radar detection system based on coding and a phased array antenna, which is characterized by comprising a transmitter and a receiver; the invention applies the coding technology and the phased array antenna technology to a vital sign detection system, and because the detection signal in each direction is modulated by the coded baseband signal, the direction and distance information of each echo signal can be determined by the correlation characteristic analysis of the random code in a receiver module, and then the vital sign information of each target can be distinguished.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using kalman filter
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to radar vital signal tracking using a kalman filter. In an embodiment, a method comprises: receiving the reflected radar signal by a millimeter wave radar; generating a displacement signal indicative of a displacement of the target based on the reflected radar signal; filtering the displacement signal using a band-pass filter to generate a filtered displacement signal; determining a first rate indicative of a heart rate of the target based on the filtered displacement signal; tracking, using a kalman filter, a second rate indicative of a heart rate of a target having a trajectory; updating the trajectory based on the first rate; and updating the settings of the band-pass filter based on the updated trajectory.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign detection method based on an IR-UWB radar, and belongs to the field of physiological information. The method comprises the following steps: deploying IR-UWB radar indoors to acquire human body characteristic data of a detected person in different activity states; preprocessing data based on an MTI algorithm; disclosed is a vital sign detection method with maximized spectrum sparsity. Aiming at the defects that the existing respiratory heartbeat signal monitoring mostly adopts contact equipment and the detection accuracy rate is low under the non-contact condition, the invention provides a method for acquiring human body characteristic data by utilizing an IR-UWB radar, preprocessing the data by an MTI algorithm and then extracting the respiratory heartbeat signal in the human body characteristic data from the preprocessed IR-UWB radar signal by utilizing a vital sign detection method with the spectrum sparse maximization.

title_en: Human body existence detection device, computer equipment and storage medium based on radio frequency sensor in home environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body existence detection device, computer equipment and storage medium based on a radio frequency sensor in a home environment, wherein the device comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module, a detection module and a detection module, wherein the signal acquisition and acquisition module is used for utilizing a vital sign monitoring radar to acquire radar echo signals of a tester in real time, and performing signal processing on the received echo signals containing vital signs to obtain distance gate quadrature I/Q signals; the signal preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the acquired signals, selecting a range gate, and demodulating the selected signals to obtain vital sign signals; the body movement detection module is used for processing the vital sign signals to obtain body movement information and detecting and judging the movement state target; the breath detection module is used for extracting breath information in vital sign signals and detecting and judging a static state target; and the feature extraction and verification module is used for extracting and classifying the features of the input signals and detecting and judging the transition state targets. The invention can monitor whether human bodies exist in the home environment in real time, and is effective and feasible and reliable in performance.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_ko: 차량 탑승자의 생체 신호의 무접촉 검출 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 차량, 예를 들어, 차량 객실압의 탑승자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 신호 유닛은 레이더 신호를 탑승자에게 전송하고, 탑승자로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 수신한다. 반사된 레이더 신호는 차량의 진동 데이터에 관해 분석되어, 수정된 신호를 생성한다. 수정된 신호는 탑승자의 생체 신호를 결정하기 위해 분석된다.

title_en: System and method for monitoring vital signs of animal in shelter
title_ko: 보호시설 내 동물의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for monitoring a biosignal of an animal in a shelter includes: a sensor unit installed in a shelter and detecting the biosignal of each animal accommodated in the shelter; a signal analyzer configured to analyze the biosignal detected by the sensor unit and generate change trend information of the biosignal; and an alarm unit for alerting at least one of a veterinarian terminal and an animal owner terminal with an alarm of a risk related to the health state of the animal by using the change trend information generated by the signal analyzer. Therefore, it is possible to efficiently manage the state of health of the animal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 보호시설 내 동물의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템은 보호시설 내에 설치되고, 상기 보호시설 내에 수용된 동물들 각각의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 생체 신호의 변화 추이 정보를 생성하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의해 생성된 상기 변화 추이 정보를 이용하여 수의사 단말기 및 동물 주인 단말기 중 적어도 하나에 상기 동물의 건강 상태와 관련한 위험성을 알람으로 경보하는 알람 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: Buried object detection in gpr images
abstract_en: A method and system for detecting the presence of subsurface objects within a medium is provided. In some embodiments, the imaging and detection system operates in a multistatic mode to collect radar return signals generated by an array of transceiver antenna pairs that is positioned across the surface and that travels down the surface. The imaging and detection system pre-processes the return signal to suppress certain undesirable effects. The imaging and detection system then generates synthetic aperture radar images from real aperture radar images generated from the pre-processed return signal. The imaging and detection system then post-processes the synthetic aperture radar images to improve detection of subsurface objects. The imaging and detection system identifies peaks in the energy levels of the post-processed image frame, which indicates the presence of a subsurface object.
assignees: PAGLIERONI DAVID W;CHAMBERS DAVID H;BOND STEVEN W;BEER N REGINALD

title_en: Providing energy-efficient features using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in an energy efficient manner using a plurality of sensors such as those of a battery-powered device such as a television remote, and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from an initial television WiFi radio scan, or an initial low-powered detection scan from the television remote, may be analyzed by the processor to determine a potential presence of one or more humans are present proximate to the device. If there is such a potential presence, the device remote can enter a full-powered detection mode to accurately determine the presence or absence of one or more humans, and take further actions.

title_en: Wavelength division sensing method and apparatus for doppler radar vital sign monitoring and mechanical vibration monitoring
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and a radar system incorporating multiple carrier wavelengths. A multi-carrier radar method and system according to the present invention can be used to realize sensing of complex pattern vibrations using a wavelength division sensing technique.

title_en: Respiration detection sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiration detection sensor. Relates to the medical field. The sensor comprises a sensor shell, an elastic component, a first coil, a second coil and a conversion module, wherein the first coil, the second coil and the conversion module are arranged in the sensor shell, the first coil is arranged in the sensor shell, one side of the sensor shell is an opening, the elastic component is arranged at the opening of the sensor shell, the second coil is arranged on the elastic component, one side, far away from the elastic component, of the second coil is arranged in the first coil, and the second coil moves in the first coil along with deformation of the elastic component. The processing module determines the breathing state of the patient according to the first direct current signal converted by the conversion module, directly senses according to the state of the abdomen of the patient, reduces or even eliminates the influence of limb movement of the patient, improves the anti-interference capability, is not influenced by the environment of a ward where the patient is located, improves the reliability, can continuously monitor the breathing state of the patient for many times, and reduces the treatment cost of the patient.

title_en: Prefabricated yellow soil wall-board as a building material
title_ko: 건축 구조물의 조립형 황토벽판
abstract_en: A prefabricated loess wall panel of a building structure is provided to assemble and install as a portion of a building structure of a multistoried building structure such as an apartment house by coupling a loess wall filled with loess materials to a space of a wall panel frame, to increase structural strength by forming a wall panel frame with steel beams, and to control humidity and to be beneficial to the human body sanitarily by forming a wall with loess materials. A prefabricated loess wall panel of a building structure is formed by coupling a wall panel frame(F), which comprises a top horizontal beam(1) made of an H-steel beam, vertical beams(2) made of H-steel beams arranged on two ends and the middle of the top horizontal beam at regular intervals, horizontal reinforcements(3) composed of plural square bars arranged on the vertical beams at regular intervals and diagonal reinforcements(4) arranged to cross the frame diagonally, with a loess wall(Y), which comprises a wire sieve(5) attached to front and rear sides of the wall plate frame and loess materials(y) filled in a space of the wall plate frame to make the wire sieve buried, wherein many holes(1h) are formed on a retreated part(1a) of the top horizontal beam to penetrate and support a reinforcing bar of a slab to install a slab and a loess wall(P) integrally, and veneer(6) is attached to the outside of the horizontal reinforcement to improve on appearance of a wall or to use effectively for driving a nail.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축 구조물의 조립형 황토벽판에 관한 것으로 H형 강철빔으로 된 상단 가로빔, 상기 상단 가로빔의 양단부와 중간부에 일정한 간격의 세로로 배치된 세로빔, 상기 세로빔의 전후 양측에서 세로빔에 걸쳐 상하 일정한 간격으로 배치된 복수개의 가로 보강대, 및 대각선으로 교차된 대각선 보강대로 형성된 벽판 프레임과, 상기 벽판 프레임의 양측면에 장착된 금속망체, 금속망체가 매입되게 벽판 프레임의 내부공간에 황토소재가 충전된 황토벽체가 결합되어 황토벽체로 구성되어 있다.  설정된 벽의 높이와 폭으로 된 상기 황토벽판을 건축물이 정위치에 수직으로 고정시키고 상단 프레임의 구멍을 이용하여 철근 슬라브를 황토벽판과 일체로 축조하여 건축물 구조체의 일부가 되게 한다. 황토 벽판의 조립시공이 간편하고 강도와 내구성이 매우 높으며, 실내의 습기조절기능이 있고 화재의 우려가 없으며 화재시 유해가스가 방출이 없고 황토에서 방출되는 원적외선과 음이온에 의해 위생에 유익하여 각종 건축 구조물의 벽판으로 유효하게 사용할 수 있게 제공한다.       
       
     상단 가로빔, 세로빔, 가로 보강대, 대각선 보강대, 망판, 황토소재.

title_en: System and methods for vital sign estimation from passive thermal video
abstract_en: A system for measuring a pulse and respiratory rate from passive thermal video includes contour segmentation and tracking, clustering of informative pixels of interests, and robust dominant frequency component estimation. Contour segmentation is used to locate a blood vessel region to measure, after which all pixels in the nearby region are aligned across frames based on the segmentation's position, and scale in each frame. Spatial filtering is then performed to remove noise not related to heart beat and then non-linear filtering is performed on the temporal signal corresponding to each aligned pixel. The signal spectrum of each pixel is then feed to a clustering algorithm for outlier removal. Pixels in the largest cluster are then used to vote for the dominant frequency, and the median of the dominant frequency is output as the pulse rate.
assignees: LIU QIONG;YANG MING;TURNER ALTHEA;FUJI XEROX CO LTD

title_en: Multi-stage detection of buried IEDs
abstract_en: A surveillance system includes a multi-propeller aircraft having a main propeller and a plurality of wing unit propellers; a housing that houses the main propeller and the wing unit propellers; an optical video camera; an ultra-wideband (UWB) radar imaging system; a control system for controlling flight of the multi-propeller aircraft from a remote location; and a telemetry system for providing information from the optical camera and the ultra-wideband (UWB) radar imaging system to a remote location.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Wireless sensor network system for rescue field
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless sensor network system for rescue field. The wireless sensor network system comprises information gatherers, a communicator and a wireless monitoring host, wherein the information gatherers are installed in various field rescue equipment, the communicator is carried by a rescue worker, the information gatherers are connected to the communicator by wireless network, and the communicator is interconnected with the wireless monitoring host by the wireless network; and each information gatherer comprises an environment condition acquisition module, a personnel positioning module, a vital signs information acquisition module and an equipment condition acquisition module. The wireless sensor network system is adapted to a complex rescue environment, acquired field environment information, equipment condition information, rescue worker positional information and vital signs information are transmitted to the wireless monitoring host by the information gatherers through the communicator, more field information is supplied for scientific decision and command of emergency field managers, and therefore rescue efficiency is improved, life and property losses are minimized, and safety guarantee level for field emergency rescue workers is raised.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring children target
abstract_en: The utility model provides a target object for monitoring vital signs of children, which comprises: the children model comprises a children model body, a children model skin and a motion mechanism, wherein the children model skin is attached to the children model body and is formed by multiple layers of cloth and used for generating the same millimeter wave radar RCS radar scattering sectional area, the same micro Doppler effect and the same laser radar attribute as those of real children; motion is located the abdominal cavity of children's model body, includes: the device comprises a moving motor, an eccentric wheel, a jacking sliding plate and a fixed shell, wherein vertical slideways are arranged on two walls of the inner side of the fixed shell, the jacking sliding plate is erected on the vertical slideways, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a central shaft of the eccentric wheel, an eccentric shaft of the eccentric wheel is rotatably connected with a driving end of the jacking sliding plate so as to drive the eccentric wheel to rotate by the moving motor, and therefore the eccentric wheel drags the jacking sliding plate to reciprocate up and down to simulate the fluctuation of the thoracic cavity during respiration.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar heartbeat and respiration detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of accessory devices of millimeter wave equipment, in particular to a heartbeat breath detection device of a millimeter wave radar, which can clamp a machine body through a clamping mechanism, in the process, a radiation position of the machine body is adjusted through a rotation adjusting device matched with a swinging device, and the radiation range of the equipment is diffused through a rotating mechanism, so that the application range of the equipment is improved, the working efficiency of the equipment is improved, and the practicability is improved.

title_en: Distributed reconfigurable through-wall radar detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributed reconfigurable through-wall radar detection system, which comprises a power supply module, a transceiver antenna unit module, a radio frequency module, a signal processing module and a display control module, wherein the power supply module is connected with the transceiver antenna unit module; the power supply module, the receiving and transmitting antenna unit module, the radio frequency module, the signal processing module and the display control module are all independent modules; the receiving and transmitting antenna unit module is detachably connected with the radio frequency module through a first connector; the signal processing module is detachably connected with the radio frequency module through a second connector; the power module is detachably connected with the radio frequency module and the signal processing module through a third connector respectively; the signal processing module is in communication connection with the display control module. The utility model can be carried by common knapsack, can be assembled quickly when in use on site, and can switch detection modes by adopting flexible distributed scheme.

title_en: Self-focusing compressed sensing imaging method of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-focusing compressed sensing imaging method of a through-wall radar. The method has the advantages that wall parameter estimation and behind-wall scene imaging are unified into the same processing frame, wall parameter estimation is achieved while a high-resolution target image is obtained, frequency band resources occupied by a system transmission end and the sampling number of a receiving end are reduced, operation complexity is lowered, and detecting efficiency is increased.

title_en: A kind of united through-wall radar object localization method of ellipse-hyperbolic
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of target location algorithm suitable for through-wall radar imaging, and first, target area after wall is detected using linear array antenna arrays more than two passages；Then offseted using adjacent periods pulse and extract activity concealed target and utilization Step Frequency radar feature acquisition target and transmitting-receiving array element spacing after wall；Then target location is determined by conventional elliptical Cross Location Method, recycles hyperbola Cross Location Method to determine coordinates of targets；The position of target is determined finally by the low coordinate of error-sensitivity in two methods of selection respectively.The present invention can be accurately positioned to concealed target after wall, and compare conventional mapping methods with higher positioning precision.

title_en: The measurement apparatus and measuring method of a kind of contactless buried pipe track forces cun
abstract_en: The measurement apparatus and measuring method of a kind of disclosure of the invention contactless buried pipe track forces cun, including electromagnetic wave saturating ground equipment, signal preprocessing device is connected with electromagnetic wave saturating ground equipment, buried depth locator is connected with signal preprocessing device, line size measuring appliance is connected with buried depth locator, imaging processor is connected with signal preprocessing device, buried depth locator and line size measuring appliance respectively, and aobvious control instrument is connected with imaging processor；The present invention solves the position that current ground penetrating radar detection technology can only position underground piping, the problem of being unable to accurate measurement underground piping size, the present invention can realize lossless non-contact measurement, to underground surrounding medium and underground piping without destruction, also the dimension information of different depth underground piping can under the antenna of different frequency, be detected.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign real-time millimeter wave radar monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign real-time millimeter wave radar monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars and comprises the following components: the positioning devices are provided with a plurality of groups, and each positioning device is respectively fixed at the joints of the limbs and the skull of the patient; the positioning device comprises a plurality of positioning ends which are respectively fixed in a use place to form a 3D positioning area, and the positioning ends transmit signals to the monitoring device; the auxiliary equipment is used for acquiring the image information of the patient and transmitting the image information to the monitoring equipment; and the monitoring equipment generates a signal set after receiving the signals and the image information of each positioning equipment, and generates the body information of the patient based on the signal set. According to the invention, the gesture of a patient can be detected by arranging the plurality of positioning devices, and the position and angle of each positioning device can be identified by the auxiliary device through the set signal frequency, the set light color and the set stroboscopic effect.

title_en: Calcareous sand grouting diffusion reinforcement simulation device and experimental method in seawater environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calcareous sand grouting diffusion reinforcement simulation device and an experimental method in a seawater environment, and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control of island reef engineering. It comprises the following steps: the system comprises a seawater environment simulation system, a calcareous sand layer simulation system, a data acquisition and monitoring system and a grouting and slurry storage system; the seawater environment simulation system forms a seepage loop; the calcareous sand layer simulation system is arranged in the seawater environment simulation system, and two ends of the calcareous sand layer simulation system are respectively connected with two groups of grouting pipes and one group of exhaust ports; the data acquisition and detection system comprises pressure sensors buried in different positions of the calcareous sand layer, wherein the sensors are connected with a signal collector and are fed back to the computer control platform through the signal collector; and the grouting and slurry storage system inputs the slurry into the calcareous sand layer simulation system from the slurry storage barrel. The first water storage tank, the second water storage tank and the flow speed control mechanism can control the inlet and outlet and the flow speed of seawater and form a seepage loop, so that the real seawater environment can be accurately simulated and restored, and the grouting test simulation research is conveniently carried out indoors.

title_en: Distributed biological radar system and monitoring system for home care
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed biological radar system and a monitoring system for home care, wherein the radar system comprises a first radar and a second radar which are arranged at a certain height of a monitoring area, and the first radar detects the distance measurement and/or the angle measurement of a moving object and vital sign signals; detecting ranging and/or angulation of a moving object when the second radar is in the first detection mode; the method comprises the steps of moving up and down in a second detection mode and detecting a monitoring area to obtain point cloud data; if the distance measurement and/or angle measurement signals detected by the two radars are not changed and the vital sign signals are detected by the first radar, the second radar moves up and down; the calculation module divides the point cloud data detected by the second radar into a plurality of layering spaces, determines a ground base line, judges whether the point cloud data conforming to the human body characteristics exist in a preset height range above the ground base line, and if so, performs data exception processing. The application can realize fall alarm monitoring in a larger range and more accurately.
assignees: APPLIED TECHNOLOGY COLLEGE OF SOOCHOW UNIV

title_en: Method and device for monitoring movement behavior of patient in magnetic resonance operation
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for monitoring movement behaviors of a patient in magnetic resonance surgery, which relate to the technical field of human body detection and comprise the following steps: acquiring individual vital sign information of a patient based on a plurality of monitoring devices worn on the patient during a magnetic resonance procedure; judging a first movement grade corresponding to the patient according to each vital sign information and the corresponding reference information; acquiring a first image of a patient in the operation process, and comparing the first image with a preset reference image to judge the corresponding movement range of the patient; determining a second movement grade corresponding to the movement range based on a preset mapping relation; judging a third movement level corresponding to the patient based on measurement information measured by an inertial sensor mounted on the patient; and judging whether the movement behavior of the patient has hidden danger or not according to the first movement grade, the second movement grade and the third movement grade. Therefore, the movement behavior of the patient can be timely, reliably and accurately detected, and whether hidden danger exists or not can be judged.
assignees: SHENSHAN CENTRAL HOSPITAL SUN YAT SEN UNIV

title_en: System of smart safeguard helmet for fireman and device thereof
title_ko: 소방관용 스마트 보호 헬멧 시스템 및 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a smart protective helmet for firefighters includes: a display unit which scans an area around the helmet and outputs a signal applied from the outside as an image; an infrared ray sensing thermal image camera which reads infrared emitting values from every object around the helmet in order to reset an image of the front side of the helmet; and a radar scanning unit which scans the front area as moving in a predetermined space where the helmet is located based on a radar sensor in order to sense objects and generate a signal regarding the sensed objects; and a control unit which reads the infrared emitting values from the objects around the helmet by driving the infrared ray sensing thermal image camera when the front scan rate of the display unit is equal to or less than a first scan rate and drives the radar scanning unit to transmit the signal regarding the sensed objects to the display unit in order to provide the image around the helmet when the front scan rate of the display unit is less than or equal to a first emitting value. According to the present invention, location and moving situation of firefighters are provided to a fire station and other firefighters, and thus help firefighting and lifesaving.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 소방관용 스마트 헬멧은 헬멧의 주변을 투시하고, 외부로부터 인가된 신호를 영상으로 출력하는 디스플레이부와, 상기 헬멧 주변의 모든 물체의 적외선 발산값을 읽어 상기 헬멧 전면의 영상을 재설정하는 적외선 센싱용 열상 카메라부와, 레이더 센서를 통하여 상기 헬멧이 위치하는 일정 공간에서 이동하면서 전방을 스캐닝하여 물체를 감지하고, 감지된 물체에 관한 신호를 발생하는 레이더 스캐닝부 및 상기 디스플레이부를 통한 전방의 투시율이 제1 투시율 이하일 경우, 상기 적외선 센싱용 열상 카메라부를 구동시켜 상기 헬멧 주변 물체의 적외선 발산값을 읽고, 제1 발산값 이하일 경우, 상기 레이더 스캐닝부를 구동시켜 이를 통해 감지된 물체에 관한 신호를 상기 디스플레이부로 전송하여 주변 영상을 제공하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Home care artificial intelligence fall detection system with emergency recognition function
title_ko: 위급상황 인지기능을 갖춘 가정용 홈케어 인공지능 낙상감지 시스템
abstract_en: A home care artificial intelligence fall detection system, which can accurately detect emergency situations while minimizing privacy exposure, comprises: a thermal imaging sensor for detecting an object in a detection area where privacy protection is required; a vibration detection sensor which detects a magnitude of vibration in the detection area; a breathing detection sensor which detects a breathing pattern of the object if the object detected by the thermal imaging sensor is a person; a smart hub which relays data between the thermal imaging sensor, the vibration detection sensor, the breathing detection sensor, and an analysis server; and an analysis server which receives detection data from the vibration detection sensor, detection data from the breathing detection sensor, and images taken from the thermal imaging sensor, respectively, and applies a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to detect set movement patterns of preset objects and determine emergency situations.
abstract_ko: 가정용 홈케어 인공지능 낙상감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 열상감지 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 열상감지 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 열상감지 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 열상감지 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Floor buried type evacuation guidance light and control system for evacuation guidance lamp using the same
title_ko: 바닥매립형 피난유도등 및 이를 이용한 피난유도등 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floor-embedded evacuation guide light which is embedded in the floor to guide an escape route in an emergency situation such as the event of a fire, and if there are multiple escape routes, can lead to a smooth escape by dispersing the number of evacuees rather than concentrating the evacuees in one direction, and an evacuation guide light control system using the same. The floor-embedded evacuation guide light according to the present invention is installed embedded in the floor to guide the escape route according to detection information of a fire detection sensor, and comprises: a housing installed to be embedded in the floor; a battery installed in the housing; a light emitting module portion installed in the housing and emitting light by the battery or an external power source; and a cover portion installed on an upper part of the housing. The light emitting module portion or the cover portion is formed to display a set escape direction to guide the escape route of the evacuees. Accordingly, a quick and safe escape route can be guided.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재발생과 같은 비상상황시 탈출 경로를 안내하기 위한 피난유도등이 바닥에 매립된 상태로 설치되며, 탈출경로가 다수일 경우 탈출인원이 일방향으로 집중되지 않고 분산되어 원활한 탈출이 이루어질 수 있도록 유도할 수 있는 바닥매립형 피난유도등 및 이를 이용한 피난유도등 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 바닥매립형 피난유도등은 화재감지센서의 감지정보에 따라 탈출경로를 안내하도록 바닥에 매립 설치되는 것으로, 바닥에 매립되도록 설치되는 하우징, 상기 하우징에 설치되는 배터리, 상기 하우징에 설치되며 상기 배터리 또는 외부 전원에 의해 발광하는 발광모듈부, 상기 하우징의 상부에 설치되는 커버부를 포함하고, 상기 발광모듈부 또는 커버부는 탈출인원의 탈출경로를 가이드할 수 있도록 설정된 탈출 방향을 표시할 수 있게 형성된다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION HONAM UNIV

title_en: Algorithmic approach for estimation of respiration and heart rates
abstract_en: One or more aspects of the disclosure relate to monitoring a resting subject's respiration and heart rate through an impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) radar in a noninvasive fashion, in order to infer the corresponding health status including heart rate and respiration rate. Any other reflectance technology may be used. These two cardiopulmonary vital signs are derived based on the processing of recorded waveforms that are collected by the IR-UWB radar or any other reflectance technology system, after getting reflected-off the resting subject's body or relevant body part. A novel algorithm that processes the recorded waveforms is proposed to extract these vitals' signals and, accordingly, estimate their rates. This algorithm includes at least three major stages: i) noise reduction, ii) respiration rate estimation, and iii) heart rate estimation. Furthermore, the algorithm addresses the effects of harmonics and intermodulation between the breathing and heartbeat signals without requiring the implementation of filters.

title_en: A method and system for monitoring vital signs of an infant
abstract_en: :An infant monitoring system combines an infant soother having a sensor for detecting the location or sucking motion of the soother and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. The vital signs sensor output is interpreted taking account of the sensing of the soother. In this way, it can be prevented that a soother sucking motion is incorrectly interpreted as a different vital signs measurement (such as heart rate or respiration rate) or otherwise corrupts the vital signs measurement.

title_en: Continuous Vital Sign Monitoring and Automatic Opioid Overdose Reversal Wearable Device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable health monitoring device designed to detect and respond to life-threatening emergencies, including opioid overdoses and respiratory failure. The device comprises a plurality of sensors to continuously monitor oxygen levels, heart rate, blood pressure, and respiration patterns. A microcontroller processes real-time sensor data to detect abnormalities and trigger alerts. If the user remains unresponsive, an automatic intervention system activates, which includes a mild electric shock mechanism to stimulate the nervous system and a built-in naloxone injector to administer an opioid antidote. Additionally, a wireless communication module transmits emergency notifications and GPS coordinates to emergency responders and pre-set contacts. The device prevents overdose-related deaths and improves emergency medical care.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system which comprises a UWB (Ultra-Wide Bandwidth) radar front end and a signal processing display unit. The system can realize real-time and non-contact monitoring on physiological parameters of a human body, such as respiration, body movement signals, respiratory rate, and the like under the condition of penetrating through a thicker nonmetal obstacle. The ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system is mainly used for the physiological parameter monitoring of patients which are not suitable for being connected with electrodes and a sensor in a ward, such as large-area burn patients, and the like, can be also used for carrying out non-contact real-time monitoring on buried wounded people (who can not be rescued in short time) in the disasters, such as earthquake, and the like and provides necessary reference for search and rescue staffs applying medical rescue to learn the vital sign condition of a rescued object at any time.

title_en: System with vital sign data sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system having an analysis unit 1 and sensors 2, 3, wherein the sensors 2, 3 are capable of measuring vital sign parameters of a living being 4 and the analysis unit 1 is capable of performing an analysis based on the measured vital sign parameters. The analysis unit 1 is provided such that the analysis unit 1 can send a command signal 8 to the external arrangement 5, 6, 7 depending on the result of the analysis, so that the external arrangement 5, 6, 7 performs an action in accordance with the command signal 8. The invention also relates to an application, a method and a computer program product. The user can thereby save time and achieve a particularly high level of operating comfort.

title_en: Rear interference suppression method for handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for suppressing rear interference of a handheld through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining the distance of a human body target behind the through-wall radar and the echo intensity; step S2: obtaining the distance of a human body target in front of the through-wall radar and the echo intensity; step S3: comparing the echo intensities corresponding to the human body target obtained in the steps S1 and S2, forming a preset threshold value by the difference between the two echo intensities, and using the threshold value as a basis for eliminating the rear interference. Step S4: when a target is detected within a certain distance, the echo intensity corresponding to the target is feature-matched with the threshold T obtained in step S3. And if the echo intensity corresponding to the target is greater than the threshold value T, judging as the target, otherwise, judging as a false alarm and filtering. The method has the advantages of simple principle, easy realization, effective suppression of rear interference, guarantee of the optimal detection performance of the radar and the like.

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method, wherein the detection system comprises a visual detection unit and an ultra-wideband radar, the visual detection unit is used for acquiring target information of a visual area, and the target information comprises wall information; the ultra-wideband radar is connected with the visual detection unit and used for filtering target information in front of the wall according to the wall information and detecting a target in a rear area of the wall to obtain a detection result. The invention has the advantages of long-distance omnibearing detection, high detection speed, high detection precision, flexibility and the like.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
Signal processing method and apparatus for ultra wide band ground penetrating radar based land mine detection
title_ko: 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for detecting a landmine based on ultra-wideband ground penetrating radar, and comprises: a training process for generating a background signal model by collecting data in an area where landmines are not buried and in an area where landmines are buried while recognizing the landmines; and a detecting process that detects the landmines by using the background signal model acquired through the training process without recognizing the landmines.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지뢰 매설을 인지한 상태에서 지뢰가 매설되지 않은 영역과 지뢰가 매설된 영역의 데이터를 수집하여 배경 신호 모델을 생성하는 훈련 과정과, 지뢰 매설을 인지하지 못한 상태에서 훈련 과정을 통해 획득한 배경 신호 모델을 이용하여 지뢰를 탐지하는 탐지 과정을 포함하는 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: Multi-purpose infant health status monitoring device and multi-purpose infant health status monitoring system including the same
title_ko: 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치 및 이를 포함하는 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예의 일 측면에 따르면, 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 직접 접촉되어 생체 신호를 측정하거나, 젖꼭지부에 결합할 수 있도록 내측으로 오목한 중앙 홈 또는 가장자리에 테두리 홈이 형성되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하는, 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치를 제공할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도, 피부의 전기전도도 및 압력을 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-contact fast vital sign acquisition based on radar signal
abstract_en: Various examples are provided for non-contact vital sign acquisition. Information can be provided regarding vibrations of a target using a radar signal such as, e.g., non-contact vital sign measurement. Examples include estimation of heart rate, change in heart rate, respiration rate, and/or change in respiration rate, for a human or other animal. Implementations can produce one or both rates of vibration and/or change in one or both rates of vibration for a target other than an animal or human experiencing two vibrations at the same time, such as a motor, a vehicle incorporating a motor, or another physical object. Some implementations can estimate the respiration movement in the radar baseband output signal. The estimated respiration signal can then be subtracted from radar signals in the time domain and, optionally, can be further enhanced using digital signal processing techniques, to produce an estimate of the heartbeat pulses.

title_en: Remote infrared positioning instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote infrared positioning instrument comprising a pyroelectric infrared sensor mounted on a leg part of a monitored person, a control circuit device, a GPS system carried around by the monitored person and a control center, wherein the control circuit device is linked to the pyroelectric infrared sensor, radio signals are emitted by the control circuit device for one time when detection is performed by the pyroelectric infrared sensor for one time, the GPS system receives the radio signals emitted by the control circuit device, and bidirectional signal transmission is carried out by the control center and the GPS system. The remote infrared positioning instrument is characterized in that human body signals can be detected through use of infrared rays emitted from a human body, the human body signals can be converted into the radio signals which are then sent to the GPS system through use of a wireless emitting device, bidirectional signal transmission is carried out by the GPS system and the control center, the position and life signs of the monitored person can be tracked and positioned in a real-time manner, and therefore an aim that search and rescue work can be carried out timely when an accident occurs can be attained.

title_en: A kind of life-detection system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to unmanned plane applied technical field; specifically provide a kind of life-detection system based on unmanned plane; life-information after calamity is detected by radar life-detection instrument of the carry on unmanned plane, is made of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, GPS module, protective cradle, radar life-detection instrument, antenna, unmanned controller, posture display, Minitype hand-held computer controller.Solve the problems, such as in rescue and relief work that artificial detection efficient is low, danger zone rescue personnel is unable to reach, it is convenient, efficient, accurate to have the advantages that.
assignees: MENGCHENG COUNTY YONGTENG MICRO PAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for monitoring stability and predicting destabilization of side slope based on change of state of strain of soil-rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the stability and predicting the destabilization of a side slope based on the change of the state of strain of soil-rock mass, which is used for monitoring strain sensitivity and strain acceleration condition along a sensor distribution direction in the side slope to fulfill the aims of pre-warning and prediction under the condition that buried monitoring sensors do not change the stable state of the side slope by arranging a plurality of parallel or slightly inclined multi-point strain gauges or distributed strain gauges in a slope body of the side slope, judging the plastic zone and potential destabilization range of the side slope according to the strain sensitivity change of the multi-point strain gauges or the distributed strain gauges and evaluating the stability of the side slope. Specifically for the slope bodies which are not obviously deformed before the side slopes are destabilized, a conventional displacement monitoring method cannot monitor and pre-warn the destabilization. Compared with the conventional method, the method has inimitable advantages, and compared with the conventional method for monitoring the stability of the side slope and a landslide disaster, is more direct and more rational monitoring means.

title_en: Ultra wide band radar life detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra wide band radar life detection system and an ultra wide band radar life detection method. The ultra wide band radar life detection system comprises a radar host and a control terminal. The radar host comprises a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a transmitter, a receiver, a main control unit and a communication unit. The control terminal transmits a detection command; the detection command enters the main control system through the communication unit; the main control system triggers the transmitter to generate an ultra wide band narrow pulse; then the ultra wide band narrow pulse is radiated to an observation region by the transmitting antenna; the receiving antenna receives a pulse echo; the pulse echo is transmitted into the receiver to be sampled; data obtained after sampling is transmitted into the main control system to be subjected to clutter rejection, detection and judgment; and the communication unit transmits a processing result of the main control system into the control terminal to display the processing result. Compared with a conventional life detector, the ultra wide band radar life detection system has the advantages that the control terminal can remotely control the radar host to work according to the required mode; and the ultra wide band radar life detection system not only has strong penetrating power, but also has high reliability and high detection accuracy.
assignees: WUXI JUNSHUAI ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Remote life micro-tremor signal detection method based on Terahertz Doppler radar
abstract_en: The remote life micro-tremor signal detection method based on Terahertz Doppler radar that the invention discloses a kind of, and in particular to life micro-tremor signal detection technique field.This method is digitized by four road life entity reflection echo signal of Terahertz Doppler radar real-time reception by tetra- road life entity reflection echo signal of multichannel digital Yi Dui；Inhibit the static clutter in four road life entity reflection echo signals；Linear trend item in the four road life entity reflection echo signals for filtering out static clutter is inhibited；Respectively to filtering out static clutter and tetra- road signal of linear trend Hou being inhibited to carry out the processing such as complex signal demodulation, the vital sign parameter signals after being reconstructed are handled result using set empirical mode decomposition；Fourier transformation is carried out to the vital sign parameter signals after reconstruct, obtains signal spectrum；Harmonic component is inhibited, the peak value in frequency spectrum after in-band harmonic is inhibited is as the estimated value of respiratory rate and heart rate.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRONIC TECH INSTRUMENTS CO LTD

title_en: Life detection radar weak target detection method based on state prediction accumulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection radar weak target detection method based on state prediction accumulation, which comprises the following steps: discretizing the received multi-frame echo signals; detecting each frame of discrete echo signals according to a first detection threshold; constructing a target motion model and a target measurement model; constructing a target accumulation function according to the target motion model and the target measurement model; updating the state transition set of each frame of echo detection signal according to the speed constraint threshold and the prediction constraint threshold; calculating a target accumulation function value for each frame of echo detection signals according to the updated state transition set and the target accumulation function; judging a target according to a second detection threshold and a target accumulation function value; and backtracking the target estimation track according to the target accumulation function value. The invention sets the first detection threshold to filter noise interference, and sets the speed constraint threshold and the forecast constraint threshold to filter state information with high conformity with the target state, thereby reducing the arithmetic operation amount and improving the target detection performance.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar antenna device for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar antenna device for vital sign monitoring, which comprises a base, wherein a monitoring equipment main body is rotatably connected to the base, an antenna assembly is arranged at the top end of the monitoring equipment main body, the monitoring equipment main body comprises a bottom plate, a housing and a locking rod, the antenna assembly comprises a casing, a top cover and an antenna plate, and the casing is connected with the housing through a pull plate. According to the invention, the antenna assembly which can be independently extended and the orientation angle can be adjusted on the monitoring equipment main body, so that the orientation of the antenna plate in the antenna assembly can be changed along with the change of the orientation of the antenna assembly, and the orientation angle of the antenna plate can be manually adjusted, so that the direction of sending and receiving signals by the antenna plate can be opposite to a patient needing vital sign monitoring, the monitoring error is reduced, and the accuracy of monitoring data is increased.
assignees: CHINESE PLA ARMY SPECIALIZED MEDICAL CT

title_en: System and method for detecting vital signs
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection system and a detection method for vital signs. The method includes transmitting a first radio frequency signal through a first radar and receiving a first radar signal corresponding to the first radio frequency signal, performing an in-phase quadrature demodulation on the first radar signal to obtain a first received in-phase component and a first received quadrature component, performing a first convolution operation on the first received in-phase component and a first symbol and a first product-shift accumulation operation on a first result of the first convolution operation to obtain a first accumulated value, performing a second convolution operation on the first received quadrature component and the first symbol and a second product-shift accumulation operation on a second result of the second convolution operation to obtain a second accumulated value, and generating a vital sign according to the first accumulated value and the second accumulated value.

title_en: Multi-unit radar cooperative motion state and vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unit radar cooperative motion state and vital sign monitoring system and method. The system comprises an edge sensing node and an upper computer which are in communication connection, wherein the edge sensing node is provided with complete vital sign wireless sensing, signal resolving and communication capability, the upper computer is used for receiving information such as a target ID, a target position, a target vital sign, a target abnormal state and the like sent by the edge sensing node, the edge sensing node is composed of a microcontroller module, a radar sensor module, a DSP module, an FPGA neural network reasoning module, a communication module and a power supply module, the microcontroller module is respectively in communication connection with the radar sensor module, the DSP module and the FPGA neural network reasoning module, the radar sensor module is in communication connection with the DSP module, the DSP module is in communication connection with the FPGA neural network reasoning module, and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the edge sensing node. The method carries out the accurate tracking of the vital signs and the positions of the multiple targets, and realizes the accurate tracking of the health states of the multiple targets.

title_en: Multi-sensing fusion property center 24-hour home health monitoring emergency system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 24-hour home health monitoring emergency system for a multi-sensing fusion property center, and relates to the technical fields of Internet of things, intelligent care and medical health monitoring. The system realizes 24-hour continuous vital sign monitoring, high-precision abnormal detection, rapid emergency response and personalized health service for the elderly and senior pregnant women in communities through the combination mode of intelligent bedding noninductive monitoring at night and intelligent wearing noninductive monitoring at daytime, and the integrated multi-sensor fusion technology is in deep linkage with a property center. The intelligent monitoring system comprises an intelligent monitoring terminal group, a property intelligent monitoring center, a property APP mobile terminal, a property community gateway and other core modules, adopts a dynamic weight fusion algorithm, a precursor trigger mechanism and a blockchain evidence storage technology, achieves early warning trigger within 3 seconds and response rescue information task dispatch within 30 seconds, effectively solves the problems of accuracy, response timeliness and data safety of home health monitoring, has the advantages of low cost, easiness in popularization and high practicability, and accords with the national intelligent care industry development policy.
assignees: HONGSEN ZHIKANG HAINAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign monitoring method and system based on VMD
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign monitoring method and system based on a VMD, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining sample data containing vital signs; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-feature fusion analysis to obtain a frequency band energy ratio, a frequency spectrum entropy, a signal to noise ratio estimation and a peak value concentration degree of vital signs, judging whether the frequency band energy ratio, the frequency spectrum entropy, the signal to noise ratio estimation and the peak value concentration degree of the vital signs meet preset conditions or not to match corresponding punishment factors and decomposition layers in a grading mode, decomposing the inching signals by a VMD algorithm to obtain a plurality of sample components, performing multi-feature weighted scoring on the sample components, screening the sample components by a bidirectional interference suppression strategy to obtain target signals, reconstructing the vital sign signals based on the target signals, and outputting monitoring results. The method has the effect of improving the monitoring precision and timeliness of vital signs in a real-time processing scene.

title_en: Airborne systems and detection methods localisation and production of images of buried objects and characterisation of the composition of the subsurface
abstract_en:
Airborne systems and methods for the detection, location and obtaining of images of buried objects and for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. The systems comprise at least one aerial module (1) with a radar unit (11) that emits and / or captures radar signals and a positioning and guidance system (13) with an accuracy equal to or less than 3 cm, and a ground station (2) with a flight control system (21) and a radar signal processing unit (23) where radar signal processing algorithms (25) are applied. The invention also comprises a method for the detection, localization and obtaining of images of buried objects and a method for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. 
     Applicable in sectors where it is necessary to perform the detection of buried objects, as for example in civil applications (detection of antipersonnel mines), pipeline inspection or in archaeology.

title_en: Smart infant stethoscope toy and infant health status monitoring system including same
title_ko: 스마트 영유아 청진기 장난감 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart infant stethoscope and an infant health status monitoring system including same, the smart infant stethoscope comprising: insertion portions that have rubber caps coupled to the outside thereof and are inserted into the ears; a head portion having, on one side thereof, a gripping portion that is held by the hand and, on the other side, a contact portion which comes into contact with the body; sensor units provided in the insertion portions and the head portion to measure biological signals of an infant at play; and a control unit that assesses the health condition of the infant on the basis of the measured biological signals. Accordingly, the health status of infants, including body temperature, pulse waves, oxygen saturation, and skin conductance, can be assessed through multiple channels and be transferred to an external device, so that the health status of infants can be monitored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 영유아 청진기 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 외부에 고무 캡이 결합되어 귀에 삽입되는 삽입부; 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 접촉되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 삽입부 및 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도 및 피부전도도를 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다. [대표도] 도 1

title_en: Onshore electromagnetic reservoir monitoring
abstract_en: Onshore electromagnetic (EM) reservoir monitoring systems and methods, including a system with a light source producing a light beam and an EM sensor array positioned above ground or buried underground over one or more regions of interest within a subterranean formation, the array coupled to the light source with an optical fiber. An EM sensor modulates the interrogation light beam in response to an EM signal induced into the subterranean formation by an EM source. The system further includes a processor controlling the light source, processing modulated light received from the array, and collecting data with the array to produce EM surveys, each EM survey based on data sets collected at different times. The EM sensor is physically isolated from a surrounding environment. The surveys are combined to produce a time lapse earth model of the regions of interest.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-contact fast vital sign acquisition based on radar signal
abstract_en: Various examples are provided for non-contact vital sign acquisition. Information can be provided regarding vibrations of a target using a radar signal such as, e.g., non-contact vital sign measurement. Examples include estimation of heart rate, change in heart rate, respiration rate, and/or change in respiration rate, for a human or other animal. Implementations can produce one or both rates of vibration and/or change in one or both rates of vibration for a target other than an animal or human experiencing two vibrations at the same time, such as a motor, a vehicle incorporating a motor, or another physical object. Some implementations can estimate the respiration movement in the radar baseband output signal. The estimated respiration signal can then be subtracted from radar signals in the time domain and, optionally, can be further enhanced using digital signal processing techniques, to produce an estimate of the heartbeat pulses.

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for detecting human presence in front of a plurality of sensors, such as speaker sensors, and a device with a processor, such as a television. An example method includes varying, during a collection routine, a respective signal strength of one or more of a plurality of transmitters. The example method further includes receiving results of the collection routine in a form of raw data from a plurality of sensors. The example method further includes determining, by at least one processor, a respective geographical position of one or more humans present within a predetermined geographical range of the at least one processor based on the raw data from the plurality of sensors. Subsequently, the example method includes executing an action based on the respective geographical position of the one or more humans.

title_en: System and method for ground penetrating radar communication using antenna crosstalk
abstract_en: An object detection system (24) having a transducer (40, 40') for detecting buried objects (26) is disclosed. The transducer is encapsulated in a robust electromagnetically permeable structure (42).

title_en: A kind of imaging preprocess method of the through-wall radar extracted based on target trajectory
abstract_en: A kind of imaging preprocess method of the through-wall radar extracted based on target trajectory, belongs to through-wall radar technical field.The present invention determines wall position on the basis of front distance picture in offseting for target echo first, utilizes wall position to divide detection zone；Secondly, the Range Profile in continuous two cycles is offseted into processing, target information is highlighted；Then, in the detection zone of division of Range Profile after offseting, Cycle by Cycle carries out adaptive thresholding, distinguishes target and background and then finds target position and limit target trajectory width；Finally, the data of target trajectory institute overlay area are imaged, so that institute is into only containing target information in radar image.The present invention is configured based on MIMO and the echo data of through-wall radar is pre-processed, wall position is determined, detection zone is divided, and then extract target trajectory, imaging effect is significantly increased, suppresses the target extension caused by closing scene and multi-path jamming in radar image.

title_en: Device, system and method for detection and processing of heartbeat signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device, a system and a method for detection and processing of heartbeat signals. A heartbeat detection device includes at least one optical reflection sensor (10 or 10a and 10b) to be positioned on a person's skin. The sensor unit is provided with a light emitter (11) and a corresponding light receiver (12) which converts light reflected by the skin into an electrical signal, and comprises an electrically tunable optical filter (16, 17) connected to the emitter, the receiver or both, in order to select, in operation, the desired light wavelength, and to perform processing of the signal thus obtained in order to enhance the heartbeat signal. Systems having the apparatus and detection methods are also described.

title_en: Method for calculating positions of trapped persons based on CFD (computational fluid dynamics) adjoint probability method
abstract_en: A trapped person position calculation method based on a CFD (computational fluid dynamics) adjoint probability method comprises the steps of 1, constructing a loose porous medium type ruin simplified physical model; step 2, obtaining a steady-state flow field through CFD forward simulation; step 3, collecting monitoring information of monitoring points of the sensor; step 4, solving an adjoint equation based on CFD for each monitoring alarm position to obtain a standard reverse position probability; step 5, solving a joint position probability equation to obtain a joint reverse position probability; step 6, solving a conditional reverse position probability equation and a multiple conditional reverse position probability equation to obtain a conditional reverse position probability; step 7 identifies the source location from the reverse location probability distribution. According to the method, the vital sign representative gas collected along the path of the monitoring point of the sensor by the instantaneous time sequence is combined, the collected data is analyzed by the cascaded large-scale monitoring point of the sensor, and the search and rescue workers track and trace the source by the gas inversion theory to judge the condition and the approximate position of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Detection method and positioning method for weak human body vital signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of a weak human body life signal, which comprises the steps of adopting an ultra-wideband radar to send a high-frequency high-repetition frequency sub-pulse signal to a target area and receive the sub-pulse echo signal, carrying out signal pretreatment on the sub-pulse echo signal, carrying out fast Fourier transform on the pretreated signal to obtain a frequency spectrum of the sub-pulse signal, carrying out filtering and frequency selection on the frequency spectrum of the sub-pulse signal to obtain a target frequency, and judging the target frequency to finish detection of the weak human body life signal. The invention also discloses a positioning method comprising the detection method of the weak human body vital signals. The invention is based on repetition frequency, frequency agility and corresponding signal processing schemes, reduces coherent accumulation time and improves the detection and positioning capability of the radar on weak human body vital signals after medium, so that the invention not only can realize the detection and positioning of the weak human body vital signals, but also has higher reliability and better accuracy.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, one of the RF tags being turned on and generating an incident RF signal with a predetermined frequency, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one radio-frequency identification (RFID) radar that turns on one of the RF tags, demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital signal of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to the turned-on RF tag.

title_en: A kind of multiple target physical examination survey and localization method based on constant false alarm rate detection
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of multiple target physical examination survey for life detection radar based on constant false alarm rate detection and localization methods, include the following steps：Step A：Original signal is inputted, and original signal is arranged in B-SCAN figure by road number, wherein the fast time, to comprising range information, the slow time is to including frequency information；Step B：Remove the static clutter and linear trend item in initial data；Step C：Fourier transformation is carried out to all road information that the same sampling instant obtains, obtains distance-Doppler hum pattern；Step D：The algorithm of target detection based on CFAR is used in distance-Doppler domain, objective body is marked on distance-Doppler domain；Step E：Judge that whether there is or not non-zero points in the image of CFAR output, the result of output is then carried out target identification by non-zero points if it exists, exports the location information and respiratory rate size of target.The present invention reduces because of the false target that the interference of local very noisy occurs.

title_en: Through-wall radar rapid imaging method based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar rapid imaging method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform. The invention adopts a receiving and transmitting separately-arranged mode, and the coordinates of the transmitter and the receiver are different, so that the signal models are different, and the green function of the layered medium from the transmitting antenna to the target and the green function of the layered medium from the target to the receiving antenna are different; and the unmanned aerial vehicle platform is adopted for data acquisition, and the azimuth sampling position is not straight and uniform, so that the imaging result is obtained by utilizing the conjugate linear process that the imaging result is equivalent to the echo generation process.

title_en: Termite detection method and termite detection system based on microwave radar through-wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a termite detection method and system based on microwave radar through-wall detection, and belongs to the technical field of microwave radar through-wall detection. The detection method comprises the steps of scanning a region to be detected by using a multi-output microwave radar detection device to obtain radar echo signals, performing signal receiving processing on the radar echo signals to obtain discrete time domain intermediate frequency signals, removing background clutter by band-pass filtering, reconstructing the signals to achieve DOA estimation of an information source, screening white ant targets in amplitude and measuring target distances, and sending termite detection results comprising the target distances and the DOA estimation to target users. The detection system comprises a microwave radar detection device and a user terminal, wherein the microwave radar detection device is used for scanning an area to be detected, performing signal processing and analysis on radar echo signals to obtain termite detection results, and sending the termite detection results to the user terminal. The invention adopts a non-invasive detection mode to realize rapid, convenient and low-cost accurate termite self-detection so as to obviously reduce the hazard of termite disasters.

title_en: Method for monitoring coastal water area geological disasters by utilizing optical cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring geological disasters in a coastal water area by utilizing an optical cable, which is characterized in that when geological disasters occur in the coastal water area in a jurisdiction, an optical cable sensing technology is utilized, an optical fiber is used as a sensing medium, sensitivity is provided for external environment changes, environmental parameter changes are monitored through scattering effects of optical signals in the optical cable, the optical cable is laid along the coast and buried on the ground surface or underground of the coastal water area to cover a potential geological disaster area, an optical fiber sensor system is deployed, change signals such as displacement, vibration and strain of the optical cable in the coastal water area are collected in real time, a background optical transmission management system is used for monitoring field optical fiber equipment in real time, meanwhile, the real-time monitoring of the geological disasters in the coastal water area is considered, the geological conditions in the jurisdiction are dynamically sensed, and the optical cable sensing technology is combined with big data, the Internet of things and artificial intelligent analysis, so that the monitoring efficiency and the early warning precision of the geological disasters in the coastal water area can be obviously improved, and powerful guarantee is provided for channel safety.

title_en: Trusted digital personal local secure storage system and cross-domain synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trusted digital personal local secure storage system, which comprises an anti-intrusion safe, a quantum optical storage body and a blockchain mapping engine. The safe adopts a five-layer composite protective structure (shape memory alloy and tungsten carbide armor), and triggers three-level self-destruction (flame retardant/laser ablation/aluminum thermal fusion destruction) when intrusion is detected. The quantum optical storage body is used for recording the nano grating in a quartz glass medium through femtosecond laser, so that the 1PB capacity and thousand year data are stored. The innovation points comprise 1) a biological dynamic key technology, a double-chain synchronous protocol, a public chain certificate transaction hash and 3) a federal disaster recovery mechanism, wherein the biological dynamic key technology fuses fingerprints, irises and real-time vital signs to generate encryption factors, 2) the double-chain synchronous protocol is used for storing local encryption data by a private chain, and 3) the data regeneration is realized through a Shamir algorithm and a multi-signature intelligent contract. The system achieves the IP68 protection Level and EMC Level 4 immunity, the data irrecoverable rate is 100%, and the system is suitable for protecting digital assets at home, enterprises and government Level.

title_en: Multifunctional sleep monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A multifunctional sleep monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the steps of reorganizing, dividing frames and removing clutter of collected original ADC data, obtaining a target distance spectrum through one-dimensional FFT and inter-frame difference, and determining a target distance unit through non-coherent accumulation. Extracting phase information of the unit signal, unwrapping and differentiating to obtain vital sign signals, separating respiratory and heartbeat components by utilizing multi-mode decomposition and reconstruction, and obtaining respiratory frequency and heart rate through Fourier transformation; the system can analyze vital signs and sleeping posture states in real time, and automatically output alarm information when detecting apnea, abnormal heart rate or dangerous sleeping posture continuously exceeding a preset time. The invention has the advantages of non-contact, high precision and real-time performance.

title_en: location recognition system used RFID for block transportation in shipyard
title_ko: Ｒｆｉｄ를 이용한 블록 위치 인식 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A location recognition system using an RFID for block transportation in a shipyard is provided to sense a shape and position of a target block by obtaining a coordinate through recognition of an RFID tag. CONSTITUTION: In a location recognition system using an RFID for block transportation in a shipyard, an RFID tag(10) is buried under the ground by a certain interval. An ID and latitude and longitude are stored in the RFID tag, and the RFID reader recognizes a coordinate of the RFID tag. A laser rangefinder and a direction angle sensor are built in a location and geometry-measuring apparatus(200). A location and geometry-measuring apparatus measure the distance from the coordinate of the RFID tag to the target block. A reception server(300) receive location and shape data of the target block from a location and geometry-measuring apparatus.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 지면에 소정 간격으로 삽입되어 있으며, 고유 식별번호와 위도 및 경도 좌표가 저장되는 RFID 태그; RFID 리더기가 내장되어 바닥에 소정 간격으로 삽입되어 있는 상기 RFID 태그의 좌표를 인식하고, 레이져 거리 측정기 및 방향각 센서가 내장되어 상기 RFID 태그의 좌표로부터 블록 부재까지의 거리 및 방향각을 측정하는 위치 및 형상 측정장치; 상기 위치 및 형상 측정장치로부터 블록 부재의 위치 및 형상 정보를 수신받는 위치 및 형상 수신서버; 및 상기 위치 및 형상 수신서버로부터 블록 부재의 위치 및 형상 정보를 수신받아 상기 위치 및 형상 측정장치로 블록 부재의 이동을 요청하는 운반관리 시스템을 포함하는 RFID를 이용한 블록 위치 인식 시스템을 제공한다. 
       
     선박, GPS, 블록 부재, 배치, RFID
assignees: HYUN DAI HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring systems and methods for the health and safety of infants/elderly people
title_ko: 유아/노약자의 건강 및 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a monitoring system and a monitoring method for health and safety of infants/the elderly.
