According to the present invention, a monitoring system for health and safety of infants/the elderly comprises: a sensor unit for sensing the health and indoor environment of infants or the elderly; a monitoring unit for monitoring the health state and sleep environment of infants or the elderly by analyzing sensing data on the health and indoor environment sensed through the sensor unit; and a communication unit for transmitting monitoring information on the health state and sleep environment to a guardian terminal. the sensor unit includes at least one of a general image CCD sensor for photographing a general image, a thermal image sensor for detecting body temperature, a radar sensor for detecting respiration, and a microphone for detecting voice.
abstract_ko: 유아/노약자의 건강 및 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  본 발명에 따른 유아/노약자의 건강 및 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템은 유아나 노약자의 건강 및 실내 환경을 감지하는 센서부, 상기 센서부를 통해 감지된 건강 및 실내 환경에 관한 센싱 데이터를 분석하여 유아나 노약자의 건강 상태 및 수면 환경을 모니터링하는 모니터링부, 및 상기 건강 상태 및 수면 환경에 관한 모니터링 정보를 보호자 단말기에 전송하는 통신부를 포함하고, 상기 센서부는 일반 영상을 촬영하는 일반 영상 CCD 센서, 체온 감지를 위한 열화상 센서, 호흡 감지를 위한 레이다 센서, 및 음성 감지를 위한 마이크 중 적어도 하나를 포함한다.

title_en: Stress and burn-out analysis and diagnostic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an analysis and diagnostic device (1) for detecting stress and/or burn-out syndrome in a test person. According to the invention, the device comprises at least one sensor (2) detecting vital signs of the test person and transferring said vital signs to a memory unit, a voltage supply, and an evaluating unit connected to a memory unit. By means of the evaluating unit a time-resolved course of the vital signs detected by the at least one sensor (2) can be evaluated, and a comparator diagnosing stress and/or burn-out syndrome by means of a comparison of the time-resolved course of the detected vital signs with time-resolved stress and burn-out vital patterns stored in a data base is provided in the evaluating unit.

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection with vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system (10) and a method of operating the radar sensor system (10) for detecting an occupancy in an interior (34) of a vehicle (32) and with vital sign monitoring is provided. The radar sensor system (10) comprises a radar transmitting unit (12), a radar receiving unit (18) and a signal processing and control unit (26). The method includes at least steps of transmitting (60) a radar wave towards a scene within the vehicle interior (34), receiving (62) at least one radar wave that has been generated by reflection of the transmitted radar wave (16), - decomposing (64) the received at least one radar wave (22) into range, Doppler and angular information, quantifying and tracking (68) a movement in each region of interest (38, 40, 42) by angular gating and range gating, detecting (78) and monitoring vital signs of occupants (28, 30) in each region of interest (38, 40, 42), and determining (84) whether quantified and tracked movements in the scene are related to an occupant (28, 30) or to external or internal disturbances, based on a fulfillment of at least one predefined condition concerning the quantified and tracked movements and/or the detected and monitored vital signs.

title_en: Buried object detection sensor
abstract_en: A combined type buried object detection sensor is provided, in which a MD and a GPR are integrated to improve a detectivity. A buried object detection sensor  10  has a constitution in which plural antenna elements composing a GPR  14  are disposed on a circumference, an inner coil  16  of a MD  12  is arranged at a center portion of the GPR  14  and an outer coil  18  of the MD  12  is arranged at a periphery of the GPR  14 , the GPR  14  has slits  20  separating the respective antenna elements, and the slits  20  between adjacent antenna elements are connected by a metal leaf  36.

title_en: Lateral wave radar system for forward detection
abstract_en: A forward-looking radar system adapted to detect and identify buried or near surface objects from a moving ground vehicle has been developed. The system incorporates a radar detection system and in one embodiment is mounted on a ground vehicle. The system is adapted to differentiate common roadway clutter from objects of interest.
assignees: UNIV OHIO STATE RES FOUND;CHEN CHI-CHIH

title_en: Landslide model test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide model test device which comprises a landslide model box, wherein a model slope body and a freezing and thawing unit are arranged in the landslide model box; the model slope body is piled on the bottom plate of the landslide model box, one side face of the model slope body is used for slope setting and is a free slope face, and the other side faces of the model slope body are limited by the side plates of the landslide model box so that the section of the model slope body vertical to the slope face is in a right trapezoid shape; the freeze-thaw simulation unit comprises a condensation pipe network which corresponds to the slope surface and is buried under the slope surface, and the condensation pipe network is connected with the heat exchange equipment main body outside the landslide model box; a plurality of temperature sensors are also embedded under the slope surface. According to the invention, through the freeze-thaw simulation unit, a test for simulating and researching the influence of seasonal freeze-thaw on landslide geological disasters can be effectively developed, and a test for simulating and researching the influence of freeze-thaw skid promotion on landslide geological disasters under the action of water can be effectively developed by combining the existing rainfall system and the like.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning equipment and system method for geological disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and provides intelligent geological disaster monitoring and early warning equipment and a system method thereof, comprising a buried rod, the surface internally mounted of buried pole has interior pole, the lower extreme fixedly connected with butt joint pole of interior pole, the surface of interior pole is provided with the arc hole, and the internally mounted of arc hole has the gasbag. According to the application, the inner rod is arranged in the buried rod, the air bag is arranged on the inner rod, the pressure sensor is arranged in the air bag, on one hand, the air bag is used for protecting the pressure sensor, the condition of pre-triggering is avoided, the monitoring accuracy is reduced, the air bag is arranged in the arc hole, after the inner rod penetrates into a stratum, the air bag is extruded through the compression ring, the expansion direction of the air bag is changed, a certain space is reserved between the stratum and the pressure sensor after the air bag is transversely expanded, and when the stratum changes in pressure, the air bag is pushed, and then the pressure plate is touched, so that the pressure plate is touched under the extrusion of the stratum.

title_en: Satellite SAR reflector for landfill monitoring
title_ko: 위성 sar 데이터를 이용한 매립시설 유지관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a buried facility maintenance system using satellite aperture radar (sar) data, wherein a satellite sar signal reflection device for receiving a satellite signal is installed in a buried facility to obtain sar data, and the obtained sar data and measurement data obtained from various measurement modules integrally installed in the satellite sar signal reflection device can be used to accurately monitor ground subsidence, leachate level, methane gas concentration, odor, fine dust state, and the like of the buried facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매립시설에 인공위성 신호를 수신하는 위성 SAR 신호 반사장치를 설치하여 합성개구레이더(SAR : Synthetic Aperture Radar) 데이터를 획득하고, 획득한 SAR 데이터와, 위성 SAR 신호 반사장치에 통합 설치되는 각종 측정모듈로부터 획득된 측정 데이터를 이용하여 매립시설의 지반 침하, 침출수 수위, 메탄 가스 농도, 냄새, 미세먼지 상태 등을 정확하게 모니터링할 수 있는 위성 SAR 데이터를 이용한 매립시설 유지관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the Abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: A life detection instrument based on an ultra wide band pulse radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a life detection instrument based on an ultra wide band pulse radar. According to the life detection instrument, a down converter does not need to be employed, and baseband signals are directly generated from carrier wave signals through equivalent sampling, so that restrictions of A/D data processing rates of existing life detection instruments are overcome; and equivalent sampling is carried out on radar echo pulse signals so as to broaden nanosecond or picosecond pulse signals along a time axis into millisecond-order or microsecond-order base-band pulse signals.

title_en: Detection robot based on machine vision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection robot based on machine vision, including round platform shape main part, the both ends of a certain diameter of lower surface of main part are provided with first drive wheel and second drive wheel, the lower surface edge of main part still is provided with 4 universal wheels, central angle between two adjacent wheels in first drive wheel, second drive wheel and the universal wheel is 60 degrees, every the wheel top all is provided with camera module, camera module distributes in the side of main part. The utility model discloses can be through many cameras in the machine vision application of space modeling in coordination with two mesh stereovision, let survey rescue robot system performance function bigger, and can carry on multiple sensor and detection instrument to carry out vital sign through host computer remote control system and survey, provide useful on-the-spot information for disaster accident scene rescue.

title_en: Human body existence sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent induction, in particular to a human body presence sensor which comprises a microwave sensor, an infrared sensor, a register unit, a control unit and a power supply unit, wherein the microwave sensor and the infrared sensor respectively detect target environment information through a microwave sensing signal and an infrared temperature signal, the detected data are transmitted into an operation unit to be processed by a statistical algorithm, and the microwave sensing signal and the infrared temperature signal are classified; judging according to the microwave sensing data and the temperature value, and when the data are stored in a high-temperature register, sending the human body presence sensing to be true by a control unit; when the data is stored in the low temperature register, the control unit sends a human presence sense as no. The invention can sense the moving heat body and record the heat value, and the heat value can be used for judging whether the moving/static heat body exists or not and finally outputting whether the heat body exists in the closed space or not; and jointly judging whether a person exists in the detected environment or not based on the microwave sensor and the infrared sensor.

title_en: Method, device, vehicle and medium for identifying target object
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, a vehicle and a medium for identifying a target object, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining, by the first sensor, whether vital sign data exists for the target subject; and determining the type of the target object according to the outline characteristics of the target object determined by the second sensor when vital sign data of the target object exist. According to the method and the device for identifying the type of the target object, the type of the target object can be accurately identified based on vital sign data, and therefore basis can be provided for subsequent operation.
assignees: WENZHOU GANGYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sleep assisting method and system for detecting sleep quality based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep assisting method and system based on microwave radar detection of sleep quality, comprising the following steps of S1, transmitting and receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching for the position of a human body, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching for a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving radar signals returned by the vital sign detection area, extracting vital signs from the radar signals, and S4, evaluating the sleep quality according to the vital signs, and controlling sleep assisting equipment to work according to the sleep quality.

title_en: Ocean carrier evaluation early warning method based on unmanned plane and geographic grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ocean carrier evaluation early warning method based on unmanned planes and geographic grids, which belongs to the technical field of ocean disaster bearing evaluation and comprises the following steps of S1, determining an evaluation area and establishing a monitoring network, wherein a plurality of first sensors are buried in the area of the carrier area, geographic grid division is carried out based on the positions of the first sensors, the first sensors and a preset data processing system are connected to form the monitoring network, real-time acquisition and transmission of data are realized, S2, receiving monitoring data and data preprocessing are carried out, namely, receiving and monitoring ocean disaster data, when the ocean disaster data reach a first preset threshold value, enabling the first sensors to acquire corresponding data of the carrier area according to preset frequency, and after the first sensor data are collected, carrying out data preprocessing. The invention improves the real-time performance and the accuracy of evaluation and enhances the monitoring and early warning capability of ocean disasters.

title_en: Method for nondestructive detection of farmland buried peat by radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geophysical exploration, in particular to a method for nondestructive detection of farmland buried peat by using a radar, which comprises the following steps that step 1, any point on a farmland to be detected is selected as a starting point; step 2, loading a ground penetrating radar by using a carrying device to detect a starting point, dynamically selecting the antenna frequency of the ground penetrating radar according to the formation type of a deposit in the detection process, dynamically adjusting the acquisition mode according to the gradient of the landform, acquiring the soil profile of the starting point position, and acquiring the peat layer thickness of the position according to the soil profile, step 3, selecting a plurality of test points according to the peat layer thickness, sequentially detecting the peat layer thickness of each test point position by using the ground penetrating radar, and step 4, connecting the peat layer thickness of the starting point and the numerical value of the peat layer thickness of the test point position into a smooth curved surface, thereby predicting the peat layer thicknesses of other positions of farmlands. The invention is used for reducing the influence of farmland grass roots and the like on data acquisition.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot convenient to carry materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic rescue robot convenient to carry materials, relates to the technical field of seismic rescue robots, and solves the problem that the existing seismic rescue robot can only detect trapped people and cannot convey materials to the trapped people. The utility model provides a conveniently carry earthquake rescue robot of goods and materials, includes the automobile body, the track wheel is all installed to preceding terminal surface and the rear end face of automobile body, one side movable mounting of automobile body up end has put the thing device, the opposite side of automobile body up end rotates and is connected with the roating seat, thermal imaging appearance and life detection appearance are installed to the up end of roating seat, the casing is still installed to the up end of automobile body, the camera is installed to the inboard of casing, feeding mechanism is installed through rotary mechanism to one side on automobile body surface. The invention can pass through the narrow gap, is convenient for conveying materials to trapped people, can increase the carrying amount of the materials, and improves the use effect.

title_en: Underground radar apparatus and method therefor
abstract_en: To provide an underground radar apparatus and a method therefor capable of searching a buried object by one scan without having to replace a transmitting/receiving antenna in accordance with a width of a road.SOLUTION: In an underground radar apparatus 100 having a transmitting array antenna 30 and a receiving array antenna 40, a position variable mechanism 20 in which each interval of either antenna elements of the transmitting array antenna 30 and the receiving array antenna 40 is variable while keeping all intervals equal is provided. title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting abnormal respiration
title_ko: 이상호흡 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for sensing abnormal breathing comprising: a sensor for sensing photoplethysmogram from optical signals received by being reflected from a user body; a bandpass filter for extracting signals of a necessary band from the photoplethysmogram received from the sensor; an analog-digital converter for performing a digital conversion for the filtered signal; and an abnormal breathing recognition unit which extracts a respiratory rate signal from the digital-converted photoplethysmogram signal, derives a plurality of respiratory rate feature values for the extracted respiratory rate signal through a time axis analysis, and senses abnormal breathing by using the derived plurality of respiratory rate feature values. The abnormal breathing sensing apparatus according to the present invention can be used in a survival monitoring for seniors living alone, soldiers separated during operations, and survivors isolated in a disaster/accident, and in a sleep quality diagnosis and monitoring thereof.
abstract_ko: 사용자 신체로부터 반사되어 수신되는 광신호로부터 광용적맥파를 센싱하는 센서, 상기 센서로부터 수신된 광용적맥파로부터 필요 대역의 신호를 추출하는 대역통과 필터, 상기 필터링된 신호에 대해 디지털 변환을 수행하는 아날로그-디지털 변환기, 및 디지털 변환된 광용적맥파 신호로부터 호흡률 신호를 추출하고, 추출된 호흡률 신호에 대해 시간 축 분석을 통해 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 도출하고, 도출된 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 이용해 이상 호흡을 감지하는 이상호흡 인지부를 포함하는 이상호흡 감지 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 이상호흡 감지 장치는 독거노인 및 군사 작전시 고립된 병사들, 재난/사고 현장에 고립된 사람들의 생존 여부 모니터링, 수면 질 진단 및 모니터링 등에 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: Automatic Emergency Report Bracelet
title_ko: 자동위급신고팔찌
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic emergency reporting bracelet. According to the present invention, the automatic emergency reporting bracelet is attached with an LED display lamp connected with a light-sensitive photodiode in pair to flicker an LED light hundreds per second so as to calculate a heart rate through measurement of the number of times of heartbeat per minute, that is, photoplethysmography. In addition, a blood pressure changed in real time is measured by attaching a flexible sensor capable of measuring a pressure of a large blood vessel below several centimeters through the skin, the muscle, and panniculus adiposus by a non-invasive method with an ultrasound. Also, a bracelet wall equipped with a digital temperature measuring function can measure a body temperature change of a user. Furthermore, data measured in the automatic emergency reporting bracelet is connected to a device through Bluetooth communication, and the device can be connected to an emergency management center in real time through an emergency management center application to construct a communication network with a medical institution or emergency center through the device. Therefore, a report is automatically accepted to the emergency management center from the device when the user pre-determines values of a bio-signal (heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature) to compare the same with a predetermined value, and the difference between a predetermined normal value and a current value occurs by exceeding a predetermined time.

title_en: Bio-metric signal measuring apparatus using sensors and method of performing there of
title_ko: 복수의 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a biometric signal measurement apparatus using a plurality of sensors to minimize power consumption and an execution method thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the biometric signal measurement apparatus comprises: a plurality of sensors sensing motion of a biometric signal measurement target and sensing whether the biometric signal measurement apparatus comes in contact with the skin of the biometric signal measurement target; a first ADC converting a sensing value of a second sensor or third sensor among the plurality of sensors into a skin contact signal to detect a first contact state and generating a first contact state detection result; a second ADC converting a sensing value of the second sensor or third sensor among the plurality of sensors into a skin contact signal to detect a second contact state and generating a second contact state detection result; a first control unit determining whether a predetermined pattern is detected by using a sensing value of a first sensor among the plurality of sensors, providing an activation command for changing the state of the first ADC to an active state to the first ADC according to a determination result, and providing an activation command for changing the state of the second ADC to an active state on the basis of a first contact state detection result to the second ADC when a contact state detection result is received from the first ADC; and a second controller measuring a biopotential difference through the second sensor or third sensor according to the second contact state detection result when a second contact state detection result is received from the second ADC.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 복수의 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 장치는 생체 신호 측정 대상의 모션을 센싱하고, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치가 상기 생체 신호 측정 대상의 피부에 접촉되었는지 여부를 센싱하는 복수의 센서, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서의 센싱 값을 피부 접촉 신호로 변환하여 제1 접촉 상태를 감지한 후 제1 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 생성하는 제1 ADC, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서의 센싱 값을 피부 접촉 신호로 변환하여 제2 접촉 상태를 감지한 후 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 생성하는 제2 ADC, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제1 센서의 센싱 값을 이용하여 특정 패턴이 감지되었는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 판단 결과에 따라 상기 제1 ADC의 상태를 활성화 상태로 변경하기 위한 활성화 명령을 제1 ADC에 제공하고, 상기 제1 ADC로부터 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 수신하면 상기 제1 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 기초로 상기 제2 ADC 상태를 활성화 상태로 변경하기 위한 활성화 명령을 상기 제2 ADC에 제공하는 제1 제어부 및 상기 제2 ADC로부터 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 수신하면 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과에 따라 상기 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서를 통해 생체 전위차를 측정하는 제2 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Animal caloric output tracking methods
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring the health of an animal using multiple sensors is described. The wearable device may include one or more sensors whose resultant signal levels may be analyzed in the wearable device or uploaded to a data management server for additional analysis. One or more embodiments include variations of the sensor system to accommodate differences in animals, including tracking vital signs over a period of time and comparing recorded values with an individual or species-based trendline. A deviation from the trendline may be signaled by alerting a user associated with the device about the deviation.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: The method of through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of method of through-wall radar imaging.The method is in Radar Imaging Processing process, be multiplied by body of wall compensating factor to frequency spectrum data, compensating factor employs accurate physical model, considers the interaction between electromagnetic wave and body of wall, thus eliminate the impact of body of wall on image space, ensure that imaging accuracy.In addition, because the elimination of wall influence is carried out at frequency domain, only relate to multiplying, and compensating factor calculates without the need to solving nonlinear equation, therefore calculated amount is less.

title_en: Non-contact sleep vital sign detection method based on sector distributed radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep vital sign detection method based on a fan-shaped distributed radar, which comprises the steps of, and obtaining detection results of a plurality of respiratory rates and heart rates, fusing the detection results, and improving the accuracy of respiratory rate and heart rate detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a baseband signal output by a distributed radar, identifying and eliminating a body turning signal, carrying out unbalance calibration and demodulation on the baseband signal output by the distributed radar to obtain N paths of demodulation signals, separating a respiratory signal from a heartbeat signal on the N paths of demodulation signals, detecting and obtaining N respiratory rates and N heart rates, and respectively carrying out weighted fusion on respiratory rate and heart rate detection results to obtain fused respiratory rate and fused heart rate. According to the invention, the respiration rate and the heart rate can be detected under different sleeping postures in a mode of combining a plurality of radars, and the accuracy of the respiration rate and the heart rate detection in the sleeping process is improved. The invention provides a non-contact detection means for sleep health detection.

title_en: Human body vital sign detection method of millimeter wave radar in complex indoor scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and discloses a human body vital sign detection method of a millimeter wave radar under a complex indoor scene, which comprises the following steps: training the classifier according to the sample data; performing ADC data acquisition on the millimeter wave radar echo signal to obtain sampled data, and performing FFT processing, static clutter filtering and CFAR and DOA estimation to obtain point cloud data; performing Doppler transformation and feature extraction on point cloud data, and filtering moving points with large motion amplitude; extracting phase information from the signals of the point cloud continuous N frames, and estimating respiratory and heartbeat frequencies; extracting the characteristics of the point cloud signals of continuous N frames; inputting the extracted features into a classifier for prediction; and outputting the human target respiration heartbeat data detected in the scene. The method classifies the clutter and the scattering interference, and outputs the vital sign detection result of the human target; the method can eliminate large motion amplitude and static interference items in the scene, and ensure stable detection.

title_en: Self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method for intelligent automobile cabin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method for an intelligent cabin of an automobile, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the vehicle millimeter wave radar detects a human body target in a vehicle; detecting the position of a human body target; extracting the echo phase of a human body target; separating a heartbeat signal and a respiratory signal in a human body target echo; directly estimating the frequency of the separated respiratory signals; and for the heartbeat signal, after the interference is eliminated by utilizing an adaptive cancellation method, frequency estimation is carried out. In a vehicle-mounted environment, the invention can realize non-contact monitoring of the health state of the driver, including measurement of respiratory and heartbeat frequency. The invention can eliminate the interference caused by vehicle body vibration and environmental noise and reduce the measurement error of respiratory and heartbeat frequency by the thought of self-adaptive filtering facing the application background of the intelligent cabin.

title_en: Non-contact biosignal analysis system for body condition determination
title_ko: 인체상태 판단을 위한 비접촉식 생체신호 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact biometric signal analysis system for determining body conditions to prevent accidents caused by drowsy driving. According to the present invention, the non-contact biometric signal analysis system comprises: a signal generation unit transmitting a ultrawide band (UWB) impulse radar signal in a space in which a person to be determined exists and receiving a reflected signal; a signal processing unit filtering the signals received after being transmitted from the signal generation unit to extract a respiration signal and a heart rate signal as biometric signals to be determined; and a signal analysis unit performing time domain analysis and frequency domain analysis on the basis of the respiration signal and heart rate signal extracted through the signal processing unit to measure and generate a plurality of parameter information related to heart rate variability (HRV) and generating state analysis information for determining a current body condition of the person to be determined on the basis of the generated plurality of parameter information and preset and stored human condition determination reference information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 인체상태 판단을 위한 비접촉식 생체신호 분석 시스템은, UWB(Ultra wideband) 임펄스(Impulse) 레이더 신호를 판단대상이 존재하는 공간 내에 송신 후 반사되어 오는 신호를 수신하는 신호발생유닛; 상기 신호발생유닛으로부터 송신 후 반사되어 수신되는 신호들을 필터링 처리하여 판단대상의 생체 신호로서 호흡 신호 및 심박 신호를 추출하는 신호처리유닛; 및 상기 신호처리유닛을 통해 추출된 호흡 신호 및 심박 신호를 기반으로 시간 영역(Time Domain) 분석 및 주파수 영역(Frequency Domain) 분석을 수행하여 심박변이도(HRV, Heart Rate Variability) 관련 다수의 파라미터 정보를 측정 생성하고, 생성된 다수의 파라미터 정보 및 기 설정 저장된 인체상태 판단기준 정보를 기반으로 판단대상의 현재 인체상태를 판단한 상태분석정보를 생성하는 신호분석유닛;을 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT HANBAT IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Comprehensive life monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a comprehensive life monitoring system, which comprises a sensor module, a microprocessor module, a power supply module, a wireless communication module and a comprehensive terminal monitoring module, wherein the comprehensive terminal monitoring module is located at an external platform; the sensor module comprises a passive type pyroelectric infrared probe and a gas sensor which are respectively connected with an input port of the microprocessor module; an output port of the microprocessor module is connected with the input port of the wireless communication module; the wireless communication module and the comprehensive terminal monitoring module are in wireless transmission; the wireless communication module adopts a Zigbee module with a wireless positioning function; and the Zigbee module comprises two Zigbee nodes, wherein one of the Zigbee nodes is an FFD (full function device) node, and is fixed in a mine, and the other one of the Zigbee nodes is a RFD (reduced function device) node, and is located on the body of a monitored person. The comprehensive life monitoring system can be used for detecting vital signs of a miner in real time in case of a mine disaster and accurately positioning the miner for effective and timely rescue.

title_en: Wireless detection device for slope safety
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of safety detection, and discloses a wireless side slope safety detection device, which comprises a detection assembly pre-embedded in the slope surface of a slope body, an installation seat fixed on the ground and positioned at one side of the slope body, and an external remote control terminal, wherein the detection assembly comprises a plurality of parallel steel stranded wires and a plurality of photosensitive sensors equidistantly arranged on the steel stranded wires; this wireless detection device of side slope safety, through set up a plurality of photosensitive sensor in the domatic inside of side slope, when domatic production landslide phenomenon soon, domatic at first can produce the crack, can give central processing unit with signal transmission when pre-buried photosensitive sensor perception in domatic inside light, central processing unit at first starts the on-the-spot warning subassembly and carries out the police dispatch newspaper to the scene, prevent that the side slope is gone into to the field personnel mistake, central processing unit is giving remote control terminal with information transfer through wireless communication module simultaneously, so that the professional in time handles the side slope.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGGU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Come down emergency escape device
abstract_en: Come down emergency escape device, it is related to civil engineering geo-hazard early-warning technical field, including power supply, switch, normally indicate green light, early warning instruction red light, early warning loudspeaker, obliquity sensor, it is easy to happen the region of landslide hazard in massif, slopes, it will be moved towards along mountain shape, slopes trend is vertically arranged multiple holes, the pre-buried obliquity sensor in hole, the variation of slopes angle is monitored using obliquity sensor, slopes angle change causes early warning circuit to be closed, start alarm activation, police instruction blinking red lamp, alarming horn report early warning sound.Not only at low cost the present invention is based on the emergency escape device on landslide, high sensitivity, monitoring are accurate, the accuracy of early warning is ensure that, but also very useful, when landslide occurs, it can quickly send out and withdraw information, people is promoted quickly to withdraw, to reduce casualties and property loss.
assignees: HANGZHOU LINPING VOCATIONAL SENIOR MIDDLE SCHOOL

title_en: Life signal monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises the millimeter wave radar, the millimeter wave radar transmits a frequency modulation signal, a human chest cavity reflects an echo signal, and data are finally transmitted to the data processing module through a mixer and a sampler which are integrated by the millimeter wave radar; the data processing module processes the intermediate frequency signals in the data sent by the data acquisition module through background noise filtering, phase extraction, respiration and heartbeat separation, respiration and heartbeat reconstruction, distance and frequency separation and calculation reduction methods to obtain the heart rate, the respiration and the displacement distance of the human thorax; the follow-up application module acquires data and processes the data in real time through multiple processes, uploads the data to the cloud server, and utilizes the GUI to visualize the heart rate, the respiration and the displacement distance of the human chest, so that a guardian can conveniently check the data at any time.

title_en: Antidetonation steel mesh thermal insulation wall body convenient to fitment is reformed transform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake-resistant steel mesh heat-insulating wall body convenient to decorate and reform, which relates to the technical field of building wall bodies and comprises a wall plate frame body, wherein a steel net rack b is arranged inside the wall plate frame body, the steel net rack b is fixedly connected with a steel net rack a through assembling bolts, heat-insulating layers are fixedly arranged on two side walls inside the wall plate frame body, a concrete layer is poured between the steel net rack a and the steel net rack b, fastening grooves are arranged on the surfaces of the heat-insulating layers at intervals, and fastening strips are fixedly connected on the outer side surfaces of the steel net rack a and the steel net rack b at intervals. According to the invention, the fastening strips are embedded in the fastening grooves in a matching manner, the steel mesh frame a and the steel mesh frame b are stably and tightly assembled in the wall plate frame body, and the concrete layer is poured between the steel mesh frame a and the steel mesh frame b, so that the anti-seismic performance and the anti-cracking performance of the wall body are improved, the safety and the reliability of the wall body are favorably improved, and the pre-buried arrangement of the wire pipes is facilitated.
assignees: ANHUI LIANGU TECH RESEARCH NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Display equipment control method based on human body recognition and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a display equipment control method based on human body recognition and related equipment; the method comprises the following steps: for the display equipment in a preset first working state, detecting whether a human body exists at a preset target position by using a preset millimeter wave radar; collecting postures of the human body by using a millimeter wave radar in response to the determination that the human body is detected at the target position, judging whether the postures are preset target postures by using a pre-trained neural network model, monitoring vibration of the human body by using the millimeter wave radar in response to the determination that the postures are the target postures, judging whether the human body is in a preset target state according to the vibration, and adjusting the display equipment to be in a preset second working state in response to the determination that the human body is in the target state, wherein the vibration of the human body comprises displacement changes of the thoracic cavity caused by heartbeat and respiration; in response to determining that no human presence is detected at the target location, the display device is adjusted to a second operating state.

title_en: Wearable through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wearable through-the-wall radar system, which comprises a radar host, a display control terminal and a body armor, wherein the radar host is connected with the display control terminal; the radar host comprises a receiving and transmitting antenna array, a radio frequency subsystem, a data processing subsystem and a power supply; the body armor comprises a cover, a bulletproof layer, a buffer layer and bulletproof plugboards, and the cover, the bulletproof layer, the buffer layer and the bulletproof plugboards are sequentially arranged from outside to inside; the receiving and transmitting antennas in the receiving and transmitting antenna array are arranged on the outer side of the bulletproof layer, and the radio frequency subsystem is arranged on the inner side of the bulletproof plugboard; the bulletproof layer and the buffer layer are provided with mounting holes, the data processing subsystem comprises a circuit board and a metal shell, the circuit board is arranged inside the metal shell, the metal shell is arranged in the mounting holes, and the transceiver antennas in the transceiver antenna array are arranged on the periphery of the mounting holes on the bulletproof layer and are connected with the circuit board through flexible flat cables. The utility model integrates the radar system and the body armor, and meets the wearable requirement of the radar system.

title_en: Through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on imaginary symbol coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall-penetrating radar grating lobe inhibition method based on imaginary symbol coherence factors, which comprises the following steps of, the phases of a centrally symmetrically arranged MIMO array at grating lobe positions are derived and demonstrated to be symmetrical. Based on this conclusion, the imaginary positive and negative of the imaging results for each channel are then quantified. Finally, weights are calculated based on the quantized results and the original image is weighted to suppress grating lobes and side lobes. The effectiveness of the disclosed method is demonstrated by a plurality of simulated and actually measured embodiments. The method is not only suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging detection, but also can be applied to the fields of synthetic aperture radar imaging, microwave imaging and the like, and is a universal image grating lobe and sidelobe suppression method.

title_en: Human rescue control system using radar human body detection sensor installed in a building
title_ko: 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life rescue control system using a radar human body detecting sensor installed in a building. According to the present invention, the life rescue control system comprises: a radar human body detecting sensor installed on one side of each room inside a building; a server for receiving scene data; an emergency rescue center; and a scene command center for providing command for life rescue. According to the present invention, efficient life rescue can be implemented in case of fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 특히 건물의 각 방에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용하여, 화재발생시 각 방에 사람이 있는 지를 검출하여 응급구조센터로 발송하고, 응급구조센터에서 현장의 소방관에게 정보를 송출하여 효과적인 인물구출이 가능하도록 구현된 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지 센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.   
종래에는 다급한 화재현장에서 어디에 구조할 인명이 있는 지 확인할 수 있는 방법이 없었는데, 본 발명은 건물 내부 각 룸(room)의 일측에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서와; 상기 레이더 인체감지센서에서 전달된 생체신호에 따라 룸 넘버와 인명의 존재여부를 포함하는 현장데이터를 전달받는 서버와; 상기 서버의 통신모듈을 통해 현장데이터를 수신하는 응급구조센터와; 상기 응급구조센터에서 송신된 현장데이터를 통해 화재현장에 실제 존재하고 있는 인명에 대한 정보를 파악하여 인명구조를 지휘하는 현장지휘센터를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템을 제안한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서가 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하고, 설정범위를 벗어나면 엘이디 점등과 진동 및 경보음을 발생할 수 있는 무선신호를 송출함으로써 사용자가 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 하여 긴박한 상황에서 더욱 안전하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써 생체신호의 감지가 더욱 용이하고, 휴대 및 사용이 더욱 편리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring vital sign based on coherency between magnitude and phase
title_ko: 크기와 위상 사이의 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring a vital sign based on coherency between magnitude and phase. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: receiving a signal reflected through a radar; determining a magnitude signal and a phase signal on the basis of the reflected signal; determining coherency between the magnitude and phase signals; and determining a distance for vital sign measurements on the basis of the coherency. Accordingly, since a magnitude-phase coherency index, which quantifies the coherency between magnitude and phase in each range bin, is utilized on the basis of mathematical models and experimental observations that magnitude and phase fluctuations are highly correlated in range bins where vital signs are present, accurate vital signs can be measured in comparison with conventional methods when the range bin with the highest index value is selected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 크기와 위상 사이의 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 방법에 있어서, 레이더를 통해 반사된 신호를 수신하는 단계; 반사된 신호에 기초하여 크기 신호와 위상 신호를 결정하는 단계; 크기 신호와 위상 신호 사이의 코히어런시를 결정하는 단계; 및 코히어런시에 기초하여 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후가 존재하는 범위 빈에서는 크기 및 위상의 변동이 높은 상관 관계가 있다는 수학적 모델과 실험적 관찰을 기반으로 각 범위 빈에서 크기와 위상 간의 코히어런시를 정량화하는 크기 위상 코히어런시 지수를 활용함으로써, 가장 높은 지수 값을 가지는 범위 빈이 선택된다면, 종래의 방법들에 비하여 더욱 정확한 활력 징후가 측정될 수 있다.

title_en: Metal detector and method therefor
title_ko: 금속탐지기 및 탐지방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a metal detector and a metal detection method capable of detecting a metal object, which can determine whether a metal object is buried by detecting a part where the temperature rise is different from the surrounding soil. According to the present invention, the metal detector may comprise: an emitting means for emitting microwaves to a sensing area; a sensing means for sensing a temperature change in the sensing area; and a conversion means for converting the temperature value detected by the sensing means into an electrical signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 금속탐지기는, 감지 영역에 마이크로웨이브를 방출하는 방출수단; 상기 감지 영역의 온도변화를 감지하는 감지수단; 및 상기 감지수단에서 검출된 온도값을 전기적 신호로 변환하는 변환수단을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Non-contact self-injection-locked vital sign sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact self-injection-locked vital sign sensor is disclosed, which includes transmitting antenna, receiving antenna, self-injection-locked integrated circuit and demodulator. The self-injection-locked integrated circuit includes voltage-controlled oscillator, mixer, two amplifiers and harmonic-frequency power combiner. A frequency-multiplied signal is produced by amplifiers and harmonic-frequency power combiner then transmitted to a living body by transmitting antenna. A frequency-divided signal is produced by voltage-controlled oscillator and mixer then transmitted to voltage-controlled oscillator, then a frequency- and amplitude-modulated signal is produced by the voltage-controlled oscillator then transmitted to demodulator to produce a vital sign. So as to detect vital sign with a higher frequency to increase measurement sensitivity by using a low-cost integrated circuit process. A centrifugal compressor includes a volute base block, a volute cover plate, an impeller, a diffuser-adjusting assembly, a radial constraint assembly, an axial constraint assembly and a driving assembly.

title_en: Non-contact sensing of vital signs
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed for non-contact sensing of vital signs. An example electronic device to measure vital signs includes a camera to capture an image; a radar antenna to transmit and receive radar signals; and processing circuitry to: identify a subject in the image; identify a location of the subject in an environment; control the radar antenna to steer the radar signals toward the location; and determine a vital sign of the subject based on a reflected radar signal.

title_en: Radar-based vital sign estimation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to radar-based vital sign estimation. In one embodiment, a method includes receiving radar signals with a millimeter wave radar, generating range data based on the received radar signals, detecting a target based on the range data, performing an elliptical fit on in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals associated with the detected target to generate compensated I and Q signals associated with the detected target, classifying the compensated I and Q signals, determining displacement signals based on the compensated I and Q signals when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals corresponds to a first class, and determining vital signs based on the displacement signals, and discarding the compensated I and Q signals when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals corresponds to a second class.

title_en: Breathing and heartbeat detection method based on ultra-wideband radar CIR
abstract_en: The invention provides a respiration and heartbeat detection method based on an ultra-wideband radar CIR, which comprises the steps of obtaining an original signal of respiration and heartbeat signals, preprocessing the first signal to obtain a second signal, performing fast Fourier transform on real part and imaginary part signals on a range gate in a buffer window of the first signal, performing time domain judgment when the signal-to-noise ratio of real parts or imaginary parts of continuous 3 range gates in a frequency domain is higher than a first threshold, performing time domain judgment when the frequency domain judgment is continuously performed for 3 times, considering that the time domain detection is passed when the value obtained by dividing the number of effective half cycles by the number of half cycles exceeds a preset threshold, and detecting the respiration signal, and performing time domain detection on the second signal to detect the heartbeat signal when the respiration signal is detected. According to the respiration and heartbeat detection method based on the ultra-wideband radar CIR, which is provided by the invention, the respiration and heartbeat signals can be accurately detected based on the fast Fourier transform and time signal characteristic statistics.

title_en: Building earthquake forecasting device based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a building earthquake forecasting device based on a wireless sensor network, which comprises a data storage server, a plurality of wireless sensor network nodes, a single chip microcomputer and an audible alarm, wherein the single chip microcomputer is in communication with the wireless sensor network nodes. The building earthquake forecasting device is characterized in that parts of the wireless sensor network nodes are connected with a temperature sensor and a shock sensor and buried under a building foundation, the other parts of the wireless sensor network nodes are connected with the shock sensor and arranged among floors, and the single chip microcomputer is connected with the data storage server and the audible alarm. The building earthquake forecasting device is capable of realizing forecasting of an earthquake for people living on low floors, gaining time for residents to escape from a building, and also assisting relevant departments in monitoring earthquakes.

title_en: Multi-mode composite type life-detection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of multi-mode composite type life-detection system, including mobile terminal and detecting terminal, and mobile terminal is wirelessly connected detecting terminal；Mobile terminal includes touch screen, signal analyzer and the first wireless telecom equipment；Detecting terminal includes shell, main control unit, radar detecting equipment, micro- vibration probe, audio-video probe, the second wireless telecom equipment, radar antenna and main battery.The multi-mode composite type life-detection system of the utility model, by the way that radar detection, micro- vibration detection and audio-video detection are combined, can more efficiently, accurately carry out life detection, simultaneously by the introducing of improvement and wireless communication technique to system structure, so that the operation of life detection is more simple and convenient.
assignees: BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Lifting or supporting machine for earthquake rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a lifting or supporting machine for earthquake rescue and relates to the field of rescue, engineering application and the like, in particular to a special lifting or supporting machine needed in natural disasters such as earthquakes and the like. The lifting or supporting machine consists of a spherical body and four telescopic type hydraulic cylinders, wherein the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are mutually connected in the spherical body by pipe joints, and four points where the four telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are contacted with the surface of the spherical body form four apex points of a regular hexahedron inscribed to the spherical body; the supporting palms on the top parts of the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are connected with the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders by sphere pairs; and the top part of each telescopic type hydraulic cylinder is provided with a supporting palm provided with a force sensor. Under a condition of lower load, the lifting or supporting machine is used as a lifting machine to rescue people buried beneath collapsed buildings, and under a condition of bigger load, the lifting or supporting machine is used as a supporting machine to protect trapped persons from the secondary extrusion when the large-scale machinery is used for moving buried objects; and the lifting or supporting machine also has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, easy maintenance, big lifting or supporting force and strong environmental adaptability.

title_en: Transmit-receive integrated ultra wide band flight radar timing sampling detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmit-receive integrated ultra wide band flight radar timing sampling detection method, and relates to the technical field of an aircraft and a life detection radar. A flight radar refers to an integral mechanical structure formed by carrying an ultra wide band life detection radar on a rotorcraft. The integrated ultra wide band radar is carried by the rotorcraft so as to perform low and medium-altitude flight and carries out life detection continuously on buried life in a flying process. In a detection process, a GPS positioning apparatus is used for positioning a three-dimensional coordinate position of the aircraft. Distance information between the three-dimensional coordinate position and a life object is continuously transmitted by the flight radar in the flying process, the data is stored in a database, and finally, according to the acquired life distance information and the three-dimensional coordinate position of the aircraft, after data processing is performed through three-sphere method, a real position of buried object life is obtained finally. The method provided by the invention can greatly reduce the workload of rescue personnel, shortens rescue time and improves the life rescue efficiency.

title_en: Through-wall radar remote assisting system and method based on WiFi secure communications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar remote assisting system and method based on WiFi secure communications, including：At least one through-wall radar device, the transmitting antenna of through-wall radar device can launch ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave, penetrate in the personnel targets after wall is mapped to wall, receive the ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave reflected by reception antenna, extract personnel targets information；At least one wireless network module, the wireless network module are attached with through-wall radar device, and by wireless network module, the personnel targets information of detection is uploaded to remote assisting system center by through-wall radar device；Beneficial effect of the present invention：Remote assisting system is solved under complicated operational environment, through-wall radar device needs long-range the problem of carrying out assisting to judge, due to being the wireless communication based on WPA between remote assisting system and through-wall radar device, so safe, transmission range is grown, and versatility is high.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES INST AUTOMATION

title_en: A kind of unmanned aerial vehicle group searching rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned aerial vehicle group searching rescue method and system, method includes：Multi rack searches for unmanned plane and forms unmanned aerial vehicle group, and carrying detection source is treated region of search and is scanned respectively, determines suspicious region, the detection source includes radio-frequency spectrum detection source and/or SAR imaging detection source and/or optical imagery detection source；Target area is determined from the suspicious region by data fusion；The target area is scanned by the ultra wide band life detection radar that search unmanned plane carries, obtains and returns the vital sign status information in the target area.The advantages that with searching rescue accurate positioning, precision is high, and flexibility is good, and stability is good, can greatly improve the efficiency of searching rescue.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact heart rate monitoring device based on FMCW radar, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact heart rate monitoring device based on an FMCW radar, computer equipment and a storage medium. The device comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module and is used for extracting vital sign signals from radar echo signals, and the flow is as follows: firstly, capturing an echo signal containing vital signs, selecting the echo signal through Fourier transformation and a target corresponding distance gate to obtain a quadrature I/Q signal, demodulating the I/Q signal by removing direct current and arctangent phases, and extracting the vital sign signal; the signal processing module is used for performing singular value decomposition on the vital sign signals and removing noise and interference; then, carrying out complementary aggregate empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD) on the denoised vital sign signals to obtain heartbeat signals; the heart rate abnormality alarm module is used for heart rate calculation and abnormality processing, and the flow is as follows: firstly, zero filling and windowing are carried out on the heartbeat signal, the signal frequency spectrum is calculated, the frequency corresponding to the maximum peak value is used as a heart rate result, and an alarm is given when the heart rate result is abnormal. The heart rate monitoring system can monitor heart rate in real time and provide an abnormality alarm function.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency rescue, disaster search and rescue and life detection positioning, and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system which comprises a sensor array module, a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method and a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system, wherein the sensor array module is composed of a plurality of sensors of different types and is used for collecting environment data in a target area, the multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-type sensor array in the target area to collect the environment data of the target area, S2, conducting noise filtering and signal enhancement processing on the original data collected by the sensors, and extracting key characteristics of a living body. According to the application, through self-adaptive multi-mode fusion, deep learning feature recognition, nonlinear TDOA optimization and reinforcement learning path planning, the problems of single sensor failure, low signal-to-noise ratio erroneous judgment, complex environment positioning error, static path planning hysteresis and the like are solved, the accuracy of life detection and rescue response efficiency are improved, and the method is suitable for extreme disaster environments.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar heartbeat signal extraction method based on variation modal decomposition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar heartbeat signal extraction method based on variation modal decomposition. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a reference signal of a heartbeat signal, S2, calculating the number of modal components and penalty factors of a variation modal decomposition (vmd) algorithm by using information entropy of a chest signal as an adaptability function of an Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (ABCA), S3, obtaining a plurality of imf (intrinsic modal function) signals by using the vmd algorithm for signal decomposition, screening and removing the imf signals, reconstructing the remaining imf signals to obtain a reconstructed signal, S4, setting a threshold, repeating the step S3 until imf signals with the largest correlation in all imf signals reach the set threshold, and stopping circulation. The imf signal is the required heartbeat signal. The method fully utilizes the characteristic that the vmd algorithm is good at processing the non-fixed frequency signals, better solves the optimal input parameters of the vmd algorithm by introducing the artificial bee colony algorithm, effectively removes respiratory signals and noise, and better retains the detailed characteristics of heartbeat signals.

title_en: Petrochemical site safety intelligent management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of petrochemical safety production management, in particular to a petrochemical site safety intelligent management platform which comprises a sensing layer, a transmission layer, a data layer, an application layer and a display layer, wherein all the layers are cooperated to realize the whole flow coverage of the petrochemical site safety management, the sensing layer is provided with a positioning terminal, health monitoring equipment, behavior identification equipment and environment monitoring equipment and is used for collecting personnel positions, health data, operation behaviors and environment parameters, and the transmission layer adopts a 5G private network, a WIFI local area network and ZigBeePlus wireless communication modules to realize the high-speed stable data transmission of the sensing layer and the data layer. According to the invention, through ZigBeePlus three-dimensional positioning technology, the positioning precision of personnel can reach the meter level, the specific position of personnel in an equipment area and a limited space can be accurately mastered, the vital sign watch is associated with position data in real time, when the personnel is in a health abnormality or in a dangerous area, the system can rapidly trigger early warning and lock the position, the rescue response time is shortened by more than 50%, and the casualties risk is greatly reduced.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGYAN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Pet house system with real-time pet health monitoring and care functions
title_ko: 실시간 반려동물 건강 모니터링 및 케어 기능이 포함된 펫하우스 시스템
abstract_en: A pet house system capable of real-time health monitoring and care for pets through the measurement of biosignals is provided. A pet house system including a real-time pet health monitoring and care function according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit embedded in the bottom of the pet house to acquire biosignals including a heartbeat signal of the pet and a microvascular vibration signal generated during heartbeat; and a processor that processes the biosignals acquired through a multi-channel piezoelectric sensor, measures the heart rate and respiratory rate based on the signal processing results, and analyzes the heart rate variability (HRV) included in the signal processing results to estimate the stress of the pet. By doing so, it is possible to contribute to the health management of pets by analyzing the pet's heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress, classifying sleep states, analyzing body water and body fat, automatically creating a comfortable environment using a temperature sensor, and detecting body temperature in real-time through epidermal temperature measurement.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정을 통해 반려동물의 실시간 건강 모니터링과 케어가 가능한 펫하우스 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 실시간 반려동물 건강 모니터링 및 케어 기능이 포함된 펫하우스 시스템은, 펫하우스 바닥에 내장되어, 반려동물의 심장 박동 신호 및 심장 박동시 발생하는 미세 혈관 진동 신호를 포함하는 생체 신호를 획득하는 센서부; 및 다채널 압전센서를 통해 획득된 생체 신호를 신호처리하고, 신호처리 결과를 기반으로 심박수(Heart rate) 및 호흡수(respiratory rate)를 측정하고, 신호처리 결과에 포함된 심박변이도(HRV)를 분석하여 반려동물의 스트레스를 추정하는 프로세서;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 반려동물의 심박수, 호흡수 및 스트레스 분석, 수면 상태 분류, 체수분과 체지방을 분석하고, 온도 센서를 이용한 쾌적한 환경 자동조성 및 표피온도 측정을 통한 실시간 체온감지를 수행하여 반려동물의 건강관리에 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Vehicle occupant detection
abstract_en: A vehicle occupant detection system and method for using the same.The vehicle occupant detection system includes: a controller; a plurality of life detection sensors, wherein the plurality of life detection sensors are installed within an interior cabin of a mass-transit vehicle and are each associated with a life detection zone; a local warning system having at least one human-machine interface (HMI) output device; and a vehicle interface that communicatively couples the controller to a vehicle electrical system of the mass-transit vehicle.The vehicle occupant detection system is configured to: (i) acquire sensor data by scanning the life detection zone using the plurality of life detection sensors; (ii) determine whether an occupant is present based on the sensor data; and (iii) provide an indication to a user that an occupant is present using the HMI output device when it is determined that an occupant is present.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-contact fast vital sign acquisition based on radar signal
abstract_en: Various examples are provided for non-contact vital sign acquisition. Information can be provided regarding vibrations of a target using a radar signal such as, e.g., non-contact vital sign measurement. Examples include estimation of heart rate, change in heart rate, respiration rate, and/or change in respiration rate, for a human or other animal. Implementations can produce one or both rates of vibration and/or change in one or both rates of vibration for a target other than an animal or human experiencing two vibrations at the same time, such as a motor, a vehicle incorporating a motor, or another physical object. Some implementations can estimate the respiration movement in the radar baseband output signal. The estimated respiration signal can then be subtracted from radar signals in the time domain and, optionally, can be further enhanced using digital signal processing techniques, to produce an estimate of the heartbeat pulses.
assignees: THE UNIV OF FLORIDA RESEARCH FOUNDATION INC

title_en: A system based on ai and crowd dynamics invented to improve safety and efficiency while traveling in groups or clusters during crowded events like hajj and umrah
abstract_en: A wearable electronic travel aid device is disclosed for monitoring and guiding pedestrians in crowds, including those with visual impairments. The device uses positioning sensors and Al to generate accurate location estimations within a twenty-cubic-centimetre frame. It also includes a guidance communication system, audio signals, 3D Haptic communication, and a human-machine interface. The system uses RSSI and CSI techniques to characterise human presence and activities, and uses Wi-Fi fingerprinting for active localization. It is designed for crowd dynamics management, particularly for crowded Islamic rituals like Hajj. The system is based on active particle dynamics principles. The system uses particle dynamics to model crowds with discrete sets of pseudo-particles, allowing for realistic dynamic behaviour and event change detection. It also includes pedestrian dynamics, integrating groups of different sizes for crowded situations like Al Kaaba, Masjid al- Haram, and the Holy City of Makkah during Hajj or Umrah pilgrimages. The system uses clustering algorithms and supports vector machines to process pedestrians and optimize their paths. It also includes a dashboard for managing simultaneous requests and positioning data, ensuring safety for individual travellers or pilgrims. The dashboard uses big-data analysis to detect and predict crowd congestion in real-time, enabling timely interventions in emergencies or potential security threats. This crowd motion summarization approach can benefit industries such as public safety, event management, and urban planning by accurately estimating crowd density, predicting precise crowd motions, and forecasting trajectories. The system is designed to guide individuals to services such as restrooms, food, and medical care stations. It uses real-time crowd data analysis to estimate occupancy levels and propose alternatives. The system also functions as an intelligent traveling guide and companion, with a multitude of chatbots providing services like accommodation reservations, purchase requests, and site seeing. The bots use crowd dynamics to provide comprehensive guidance, hints, and alerts. They can assist with Islamic rituals, travel, tourism, and evacuation. The Evacuation Bot uses crowd dynamics and real-time data to manage evacuation procedures and ensure safety during emergencies. The Near Services Bot assists in finding nearby amenities and provides real-time updates on wait times. The system uses deep neural networks to suggest shortest paths and cost functions to ensure efficient and cost-effective travel.

title_en: Mine rescue floating positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine rescue floating positioning system and a method, the system comprises a ground monitoring platform, an optical fiber cable connected with the ground monitoring platform, and a rescue positioning subsystem which is arranged on the optical fiber cable and extends into an underground water permeable area, wherein the rescue positioning subsystem comprises a plurality of wireless rescue terminals, each wireless rescue terminal comprises a storage bottle internally filled with nutrient solution, a control module and a communication interface, a floating layer is sleeved outside the storage bottle, the control module comprises a processor, a power supply, a memory, a electrocardio sensor, a weighing sensor and a data transmission unit, and the ground monitoring platform comprises an industrial personal computer and a wireless data transceiver module; the method comprises the following steps: 1. initializing a rescue positioning subsystem; 2. drilling holes and putting in a wireless rescue terminal; 3. and positioning the trapped person and acquiring vital sign parameters of the trapped person. The invention utilizes the floatable storage bottle to position trapped people, and simultaneously brings nutrition substances for life maintenance to the trapped people, thereby providing help for rescuing the trapped people.

title_en: Breath Measurement System based on X-Band Doppler Radar.
title_ko: 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 사람의 심장부에 RF 신호를 방사하여 생체 신호를 검출하여 원격으로 호흡을 측정하는 바이오 레이더 시스템으로 신체에 부착하지 않은 상태에서 호흡을 측정하며, 측정된 호흡 정보를 관제모니터링수단에서 실시간으로 저장하고 관리하여 미리 설정된 경고/위험수준에 도달하면 알람을 발생시키고, 해당 호흡값 정보를 환자이력관리부에 저장 관리하는 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통해 사람의 심장부에 RF 신호를 방사하여 생체 신호를 검출하여 원격으로 호흡을 측정하는 바이오 레이더 시스템으로 신체에 부착하지 않은 상태에서 호흡을 측정할 수 있게 되어 중환자 혹은 상시 호흡 측정이나 모니터링이 필요한 환자를 대상으로 실시간 호흡수 측정이 가능한 효과를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: First responder dispatch system and methods of operation thereof
abstract_en: A first responder dispatch system is disclosed comprising a sensing wearable configured to be worn by a first responder. The sensing wearable can comprise a wrist-worn electronic device, a power-generating garment, or a combination thereof. The sensing wearable can comprise a plurality of biometric sensors configured to measure a plurality of vital signs of the first responder. The system can comprise a server programmed to receive biometric data concerning a plurality of vital signs of the first responder measured by the sensing wearable. The server can also transmit alerts to a plurality of dispatch client devices over a plurality of secured real-time bidirectional connections concerning a status of the first responder. At least one dispatch client device can transmit a response to the server and the server can, in turn, transmit additional biometric data concerning the first responder to the dispatch client device.

title_en: Locator with current-measuring capability
abstract_en: A human-portable utility locator system for locating and tracing a buried utility line characterized by an electromagnetic field emission. The locator may include a horizontal spaced sensor pair for detecting the horizontal field asymmetry of the emitted field in one or more independent frequency bands, which is employed to assist in determining an accurate “virtual depth” measurement for producing detection events. An event detector may be disposed to detect events corresponding to extremum in the B-field gradient with respect to time and a user interface (UI) coupled to the event detector signals the detected event to a user. In a preferred embodiment, one pair of spaced-apart 3D magnetic sensor arrays is disposed substantially orthogonal to another intermediate spaced-apart pair of sensors.

title_en: Method and system of attachment and detection of attachment of a wearable sensor to clothing material
abstract_en: A method and system of universal, secure attachment with attachment detection mechanism, of a wearable sensor-unit to any article of clothing worn around the body in order to measure vital signals of a person, such as motion, movements and activity levels. The method and system permits: reliable attachment to any article of clothing; an attachment in any position to clothing or fabric worn by a person; and detection for the wearable sensor attachment to an article of clothing to minimize false alarms.

title_en: Earthquake help calling positioning watch
abstract_en: Provided is an earthquake help calling positioning watch which comprises a watchband, a watchcase and a watch surface which are connected in turn. The watch surface is provided with a time displayer and a liquid crystal screen. The internal part of the watch surface is provided with a battery and an integrated circuit board. The top part of the watchcase is provided with a GPS position indicator. The bottom part of the watchcase is provided with a loudspeaker and a switch. The right part of the watchcase is provided with a remote control receiving switch and a time adjusting button. The upper right part of the watchcase is provided with a microphone. The upper left part of the watchcase is provided with an LED help calling flashing lamp. The left part of the watchcase is provided with an infrared ray probe. The lower left part of the watchcase is provided with a microwave emitter. The lower right part of the watchcase is provided with an LED lighting lamp and a lighting button. The earthquake help calling positioning watch is worn on the hand at ordinary times without leaving the body. If the body is buried after earthquake or the switch is forgotten to start in panic, search and rescue personnel use a unified special remote controller to start the remote control receiving switch of the earthquake help calling positioning watch in a remote control way, and then the GPS position indicator, the microwave emitter, the LED help calling flashing lamp and the loudspeaker generate help calling signals so that the search and rescue personnel can easily find help calling people and perform lifesaving timely.
assignees: KUNSHAN CITY YUSHAN TOWN SHILONG DESIGN STUDIO

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based real-time monitoring method for vital signs of driver
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring method for vital signs of a driver based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the millimeter wave radar corresponding to the position of the chest of the driver is arranged in a vehicle and is accessed to an information entertainment domain controller; and, performing the steps of: the information entertainment domain controller receives the vital sign data information of the driver collected by the millimeter wave radar and receives the driving state information of the vehicle; and the infotainment domain controller superposes and processes the vital sign data information of the driver and the vehicle running state information into real-time vital sign information, and uploads the real-time vital sign information to a cloud server for calling. According to the invention, the heartbeat frequency information of the driver and/or the breathing frequency information of the driver are monitored in real time by arranging the millimeter wave radar, so that the driver can be ensured to be timely provided with danger warning, and the driver can be ensured to have enough time to carry out emergency treatment.

title_en: Chaotic MIMO through-wall radar imaging device and method based on 2D-SCF
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar imaging, in particular to a 2D-SCF-based chaotic MIMO through-wall radar imaging device and method, which mainly overcome the defects of the existing MIMO through-wall radar imaging technology in terms of detection signals and imaging quality.
