The device comprises a signal transmitting path and a signal receiving path, wherein the signal transmitting path comprises a signal generator, a power amplifier, a single-pole double-throw radio frequency switch and a transmitting antenna which are sequentially connected, the signal receiving path comprises a receiving antenna, a single-pole eight-throw radio frequency switch, a low-noise amplifier and a data acquisition processor which are sequentially connected, and the data acquisition processor is connected with a reference signal output end of the signal generator. The device generates chaotic modulation pulse width-position signals through the signal generator and is used as detection signals, has the advantages of high distance resolution, low autocorrelation sidelobes, strong anti-interference performance and the like, adopts a 2D-SCF algorithm to inhibit image grating sidelobes, and effectively improves the imaging capability and imaging quality of the MIMO through-wall radar.

title_en: Real time psychophysiology-health monitering system using eyeglass
title_ko: 안경을 이용한 실시간 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A real-time health and sensibility monitoring system is provided to measure blood oxygen concentration, skin conductance, and respiration by installing a sensor or a microphone to a nose pad member of glasses or a goggle. CONSTITUTION: A first bio-signal measurement part(110) is arranged in a nose pad member of glasses or goggle. The first bio-signal measurement part comprises a SpO2 electrode, a skin resistance electrode, and a microphone electrode. The SpO2 electrode measures the blood oxygen saturation value. The skin resistance electrode measures the skin conductance. The microphone electrode measures respiration. A wireless transceiver(130) wirelessly transmits a first bio-signal detected by the first body signal measurement part to an external device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안경을 이용한 생체신호 무선 측정장치 및 그것을 이용한 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안경이나 고글의 코 받침부재에 SpO 2     센서, GSR센서, 마이크로폰, EMG, EEG 등을 부착하여 혈중 산소농도, 피부전도도, 호흡, 뇌파, 근전도 등을 무선 측정하고 건강 및 감성상태를 모니터링하기 위한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 안경이나 고글의 코 받침부재에 설치되어 안경이나 고글 착용자의 혈중 산소농도, 피부 전도도, 호흡, 뇌파, 근전도에 관련된 하나 이상의 전기신호를 검출하는 생체신호 측정부; 생체신호 측정부로부터 검출된 생체신호를 수신하여 무선 신호로 변환한 후 외부 기기로 전송하는 무선 송수신부;를 포함하는 안경을 이용한 생체신호 무선 측정장치 및 그것을 이용한 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템을 제공하여, 시간과 장소에 구애받지 않고 간편하게 생체신호를 측정하고, 사용자의 건강 및 감성 상태를 지속적으로 실시간 모니터링할 수 있게 한다. 
       
     생체, 측정, 안경, 감성 및 건강상태, 모니터링 시스템, 무선전송

title_en: Movable vital sign monitor
abstract_en: A movable vital sign monitor. The movable vital sign monitor comprises a shell(1), a control panel(2), a body temperature probe(3), a finger insertion port(5), a plurality of electrode slices(7), a display screen(8), a battery(9) and a communication interface(10), wherein the finger insertion port(5) is formed with a finger insertion notch and is formed in a surface shell of a shell(1), an inner groove of the finger insertion notch is provided with a blood oxygen sensor(6), and the blood oxygen sensor(6) is electrically connected with a control panel(2). The movable vital sign monitor of the present invention is integrated with a plurality of sensing modules for detecting vital signs, so that the movable vital sign monitor can detect a plurality of vital signs, and is more diversified in function. Meanwhile, the movable vital sign monitor is internally provided with a battery(9) and a display screen(8), so that the movable vital sign monitor itself can be used singly and movably and can display detection results directly by means of the display screen(8), and therefore, the movable vital sign monitor is convenient to use. In addition, the movable vital sign monitor can be grasped by a single hand in the whole volume, so that it is further convenient for a user to detect by himself or herself.
assignees: XUZHOU YONGKANG ELECTRONIC SCIENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blood pressure measurement system and blood pressure measurement method using same
title_ko: 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a blood pressure measurement system for calculating a blood pressure value by using biometric signals measured at two different parts, and a blood pressure measurement method using same. A blood pressure measurement system according to the present invention comprises: a first sensor unit for detecting a hemorheological parameter at one part of a body; a second sensor unit for detecting arterial pressure and a hemorheological parameter measured at another part of the body; and a control unit including a blood pressure calculation unit for calculating, from a first hemorheological parameter detected by the first sensor unit and a second hemorheological parameter and the arterial pressure detected by the second sensor unit, a blood pressure value of a part at which the first hemorheological parameter is detected. The present invention relates to a blood pressure measurement system for measuring blood pressure by using a change in a blood pressure parameter and vascular resistivity and, more specifically, to a sphygmomanometer for calculating blood pressure by using vascular resistivity obtained by a hemorheological parameter detected at one part of a body and a hemorheological parameter and arterial pressure detected at another part of the body. Accordingly, the present invention can more accurately measure blood pressure of a desired blood pressure acquisition part on the basis of variance in a hemorheological parameter and vascular resistivity, thereby greatly enhancing reliability of a sphygmomanometer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 서로 다른 2 부위에서 측정되는 생체 신호를 이용해서 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 혈압 측정 시스템은: 신체의 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터의 검출을 위한 제1센서부; 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터와 동맥압 측정의 검출을 위한 제2센서부; 그리고 상기 제1센서부에 의해 검출되는 제1 혈류 파라미터와 상기 제2센서부에 의해 검출되는 제2 혈류 파라미터 및 동맥압으로부터, 상기 제1 혈류 파라미터가 검출되는 부위의 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 산출부를 갖는 제어유닛을 포함한다. 본 발명은 혈관 저항률과 혈압 파라미터의 변화를 이용해서 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정 시스템, 보다 구체적으로 신체의 일 부위에서 검출되는 혈류 파라미터와 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 검출되는 동맥압과 혈류 파라미터에 의한 혈관 저항률을 이용해서 혈압을 계산하는 혈압계이므로, 혈류 파라미터 변화량과 혈관 저항률을 기반으로 혈압 획득을 원하는 부위의 혈압을 보다 정확하게 측정할 수 있고, 혈압계의 신뢰도가 크게 향상될 수 있다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Providing Energy-Efficient Features Using Human Presence Detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in an energy efficient manner using a plurality of sensors such as those of a battery-powered device such as a television remote, and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from an initial television WiFi radio scan, or an initial low-powered detection scan from the television remote, may be analyzed by the processor to determine a potential presence of one or more humans are present proximate to the device. If there is such a potential presence, the device remote can enter a full-powered detection mode to accurately determine the presence or absence of one or more humans, and take further actions.

title_en: A kind of multiple human body target evaluation methods and system based on UWB bioradar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multiple human body target evaluation methods and system based on UWB bioradar, belong to bioradar human life detection field, the present invention is on to the processing of the echo data collecting, first in each passage, adopt breathing detection algorithm, adaptive cancellation method and Target Recognition Algorithms to process, then carry out relevant treatment according to this result at each interchannel, last setting threshold is removed in passage and is processed residual clutter, and realize target classification simultaneously and number are estimated. The evaluation method of human body target number of the present invention, in order further to realize, the bioradar of multiple human body targets is surveyed and technical foundation has been established in location, contributes to promote bioradar technology and obtain level and the ability of human body information.

title_en: The automatic Fast measurement system of CMP Coherent Noise in GPR Record
abstract_en: The automatic Fast measurement system of CMP Coherent Noise in GPR Record, relates to GPR.It is provided with CMP Coherent Noise in GPR Record self-operated measuring unit, computer, radar host computer；Measurement apparatus is provided with transmission nut, left-and-right spiral bar, pipe collar, GPR transmitting antenna, GPR reception antenna and stepper motor；One end of left-hand screw bar is located at by stepper motor, and left-and-right spiral bar is connected by pipe collar；Launch antenna to be fixed on left-and-right spiral bar by transmission nut with reception antenna；Computer is connected with stepper motor and radar host computer by data wire, the position that stepper motor and radar host computer launch antenna and reception antenna for Synchronization Control respectively is moved and radar data acquisition, and stepper motor controls launch antenna and the position of reception antenna and make transmitting antenna and reception antenna the most equidistantly move by transmission left-and-right spiral bar；Radar host computer controls to launch sky alignment underground medium radiation frequency electromagnetic waves, and by reception antenna record from the reflection echo of buried target.

title_en: Non-contact human body heartbeat waveform extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact human body heartbeat waveform extraction method, which belongs to the technical field of human body perception and heartbeat detection, and comprises the steps of obtaining a reflected signal of a heartbeat of a target person by utilizing IR-UWB equipment, constructing an autocorrelation matrix characteristic of the reflected signal, carrying out characteristic mapping with an autocorrelation matrix of a heartbeat waveform extracted by real heartbeat acquisition equipment, obtaining a value of a heartbeat rate by utilizing a period similarity characteristic of a heartbeat period signal, and constructing the heartbeat waveform. The invention solves the problem that the high-precision human heartbeat waveform is difficult to obtain under the conditions of real stability and motion state and is limited by the interference of different indoor environments, the postures of personnel, the surface coverings and other factors.

title_en: Biological signal measurement apparatus and system
title_ko: 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 시스템
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정 장치는 사용자의 두상에 접촉하여 상기 사용자의 뇌파 신호를 측정하기 위한 적어도 하나의 뇌파 측정 센서; 및 상기 뇌파 측정 센서에서 측정한 뇌파 신호를 수신하여 미리 설정된 단말기로 전송하고, 상기 단말기로부터 전송된 음원을 수신하는 블루투스 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 블루투스 모듈은 상기 측정된 뇌파 신호를 처리하여 상기 블루투스 모듈로 제공하기 위한 제1 수단 및 상기 수신된 음원을 처리하기 위한 제2 수단과 원칩으로 구성되며, 상기 블루투스 모듈은 마이크와 연결되는 수신 단자를 통해 상기 뇌파 신호를 수신하여 상기 단말기로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: User interfaces for utility locators
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to utility locator and user interfaces for use with such locators. Such utility locators may include multiple antennas and sensors for determining and displaying information associated with a buried or otherwise inaccessible utility.

title_en: Infrared laser alarm device of hoisting machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared laser alarm device of hoisting machinery, which comprises an area scanning module, a far infrared life detection sensing module, a micro control processing module (CPU), a reminding module and a control circuit connected with hoisting equipment, wherein the area scanning module is connected with a plurality of infrared photoelectric transmitting tubes, and the far infrared life detection sensing module is connected with a high-precision sign detector; the reminding module is respectively connected with the voice warning module, the image warning module and the vital sign display module. The device comprises a loudspeaker connected with a voice warning module, a dangerous area light beam illuminating lamp connected with an image warning module, and a vital sign temperature display instrument connected with a vital sign display module, wherein the vital sign temperature display instrument clearly displays a dangerous area of a lifted cargo, detects the position and distance of a human vital sign existing underground, and timely sends out a safety alarm signal, thereby effectively preventing accidental personal injury on construction or search and rescue sites.

title_en: Fire fighting protective clothing embedded with vital sign detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to fire fighting protective clothing embedded with a vital sign detection device, which comprises a fire fighting protective clothing body and is characterized in that the vital sign detection device is embedded in the fire fighting protective clothing body; the vital sign detection device comprises a data acquisition module, a wireless sensor network communication module and a power supply module; the data acquisition module is connected with the wireless sensor network communication module; the wireless sensor network communication module is connected with an antenna; and the power supply module is respectively connected with the data acquisition module and the wireless sensor network communication module. After the fire fighting protective clothing is adopted, vital signs of a fire fighter, which comprises pulse and breath, can be detected in real time, wherein the two parameters can represent the health condition and the physical consumption of the fire fighter; and data is transmitted to a control system of a fire engine through a wireless sensor network, so that a fire commander can make a correct decision according to the special body condition of the fire fighter on site, which is very beneficial to the life safety of the fire fighter.

title_en: Underground obstacle crossing life detection vehicle and emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underground obstacle crossing life detection vehicle and an emergency rescue system, wherein the underground obstacle crossing life detection vehicle comprises a chassis, a traveling mechanism and a vehicle body, the traveling mechanism adopts a wheel and crawler combined structure with a deformation function, the top of the vehicle body is provided with a liftable image pickup element, the front end of the vehicle body is provided with an infrared detector, an audio life detection instrument and a radar life detection instrument, and a storage box for placing articles is arranged in the vehicle body.

title_en: It is a kind of to search and rescue under water with the supersonic sounding device with life detection function
abstract_en: The supersonic sounding device with life detection function is used the invention discloses a kind of search and rescue under water, it mainly includes sensor, bottom plate, enclosing cover, location-plate and bolt and nut；There is fixed support on sensor, and be fastened together through bolt E with backing plate A, bottom plate；Damping rubber snare is equipped with sensor external and bottom plate side opening, and the endoporus of cable through the guard ring of sensor coordinates with enclosing cover to be installed；Enclosing cover is fastenedly connected on bottom plate through bolt G；Bottom plate is fixedly connected on location-plate through bolt F through enclosing cover, backing plate B；It is overcome in existing mine operation because causing mine visibility low using artificial moonlight, easily causes the hidden danger such as downhole safety Frequent Accidents；Mine locomotive is widely used in support the use.

title_en: A kind of life detecting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life detecting device, is related to human life detection field.The present invention includes main body, is provided with infrared thermography and radar life-detection instrument in main body, the Athey wheel mechanism that bottom part body is provided with chassis and is connected with chassis, and Liang Ge troubleshootings mechanism is provided with chassis.Troubleshooting mechanism can remove roadblock, and carry the metal object opened and influence radar life-detection instrument investigative range, improve the detection accuracy of radar life-detection instrument；Athey wheel mechanism can be searched and rescued with the function of realization device autonomous, ensured the personal safety of rescue worker in adverse circumstances instead of rescue worker.There is the present invention man-made environment to disturb less, result is stable accurately, search and rescue the characteristics of scope is big.
assignees: CHENGDU LINGGAN YUANSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of millimeter wave life detection bird-repeller system and bird repellent method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of millimeter wave life detection bird-repeller system and bird repellent methods, wherein bird-repeller system includes including vital signs detecting device, scarer, detection device controller, go up and down steering mechanism and power supply, the detection device controller is connect with the electric control part of lifting steering mechanism, the vital signs detecting device is mounted on the movable erecting bed of the lifting steering mechanism, the vital signs detecting device includes antenna assembly, millimetre-wave radar device, millimeter wave radiometer and signal processing module, the millimetre-wave radar device and the millimeter wave radiometer are connected respectively to the signal processing module, the signal processing module is for acquiring, it extracts to compare again after vital sign parameter signals and calculate comprising birds quantity, the bird repellent signal of position and distance, the scarer is electrically connected with the signal processing module.The present invention solves bird repellent unicity, and effect on driving birds is undesirable, and birds lead to the problem of adaptability for a long time.
assignees: WUHU BOGAO OPTOELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transmit-receive antenna and hand-held type through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transceiving antenna and a handheld through-wall radar system, wherein the transceiving antenna comprises a dielectric substrate, at least two antenna structures, a plurality of branches and a plurality of first gaps, wherein the antenna structures are arranged on the first side surface of the dielectric substrate in parallel; the plurality of first gaps are distributed on two sides of the antenna structure, and the first gaps are vertical to the radiation direction of the antenna structure; the branches are distributed on the surfaces of the two sides of the dielectric substrate in a one-to-one correspondence mode, and the branches are located in the radiation direction of the antenna structure. This receiving and dispatching antenna is through the first gap that distributes in antenna structure's both sides, realizes the miniaturization of antenna, distributes at antenna structure's radiation direction simultaneously and sets up the minor matters, improves the radiation gain of whole antenna to make the antenna can carry out the system integration with radio frequency circuit board and reduce the holistic size of through-wall radar system, improve the angle resolution ratio of the range separation of penetrating through-wall radar system and system, and then obtain the miniaturized through-wall radar system of high performance.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection eliminating signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system (100), the radar sensor system (100) being configured to determine range and speed information from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior (116) of a vehicle (114) for vital sign detection, the method comprising the steps of: the reflected and received signals are decomposed into range and velocity information to measure movement over time in the specified range gate and to evaluate the similarity between them. Based on the characteristics of the similar behavior range bins, it can be decided whether any detected movement is related to internal or external disturbances or vital signs.

title_en: Underground mining area safety monitoring system and monitoring method based on optical fiber sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a underground mining area safety monitoring system and a monitoring method based on an optical fiber sensing technology, wherein the monitoring system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an armored optical cable safety monitoring well distributed on the ground in a grid mode in a mining area, a three-component distributed acoustic wave sensing optical fiber fixed on a top plate of an underground mining roadway, a distributed strain or displacement sensing optical cable, a distributed temperature sensing optical fiber, a distributed chemical sensing optical fiber and a multi-channel DAS/DSS/DTS/DCS composite modem instrument. The underground mining area is monitored in real time by means of the well-ground combined distributed optical fiber sensing network, meanwhile, parameters such as temperature, strain or deformation, displacement, microseism events, groundwater level and groundwater component change and the like of the underground mining area are monitored in real time according to an armored monitoring optical cable which is arranged in the underground mining area and is buried underground and fixed on the top plate of the underground mining roadway, and a section where fracture and settlement of the top plate of the mining roadway are likely to happen is reinforced and processed in time, early warning information is issued, so that geological disasters and underground water source pollution are timely avoided.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and system based on edge calculation and millimeter wave band
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and discloses a vital sign monitoring method and system based on edge calculation and millimeter wave bands. The vital sign monitoring method specifically comprises the following steps: s101: sending an acquisition instruction to the millimeter wave radar, and acquiring a real-time target displacement signal and a reference target displacement signal when a human body holds breath in the same time period; s102: and acquiring a real-time target displacement signal, uploading the real-time target displacement signal to an edge computing system, defining an edge computing model for the received content by the edge computing system, and comparing the computing model with the real-time target displacement signal to separate out a real-time respiratory signal. The invention carries out non-contact measurement on key vital signs such as respiratory signals, heartbeat signals and the like of a real-time target, has small error fluctuation, simultaneously carries out conveying and definition comparison based on edge calculation and millimeter wave bands, has high measurement precision, and efficiently realizes rapid processing of data by the edge calculation and monitoring of vital signs by the millimeter wave bands.

title_en: Tailing pond sediment beach instability early warning system and method based on space-ground cooperation
abstract_en: A method and a system for early warning of sediment beach instability of a tailing pond based on air-ground cooperation comprise the steps that an air-ground monitoring module comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a satellite remote sensing unit, a ground sensing module comprises an array type saturation sensor and a micro-seismic sensor network, the array type saturation sensor is buried in a beach key area, the micro-seismic sensor network is buried in a beach substrate, an edge-cloud cooperation calculation module comprises an edge calculation module and a cloud processing module, the edge calculation module is used for fusing multisource monitoring data to obtain target fusion data, the cloud processing module is used for calculating dynamic instability indexes and classifying early warning, and a dynamic prevention and control execution module is used for executing early warning actions. The method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data, fusing the monitoring data by an edge computing module, computing a dynamic instability index by a cloud processing module based on target fusion monitoring data, and performing early warning classification. The system and the method can perform real-time accurate early warning on the dynamic deposition beach instability risk.
assignees: GUANGDONG SAFETY PRODUCTION AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Microwave radar-based vital sign detection method and device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a microwave radar-based vital sign detection method and device. The method comprises the following steps: S1, transmitting and receiving, by means of microwave radar, a radar signal to locate a position of a human body; S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate to search for a vital sign detection region; and S3, receiving a radar signal returned by the vital sign detection region, and extracting vital signs from the radar signal. According to the present application, the microwave radar can be controlled to rotate and/or translate to search for the vital sign detection region, such that the microwave radar used for detecting vital signs can be placed at a plurality of positions indoors. In addition, there is no need to manually adjust a scanning region of the microwave radar before use. The microwave radar can automatically search for a vital sign detection region and perform vital sign detection.

title_en: Radio Frequency Life Detection Radar System
abstract_en: Trapped or confined individuals may be located and rescued by detecting their movement using reflected, radio frequency signals over a range of multiple antenna polarities.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, sway cancellation, patient identification, and subject monitoring sensors
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler- shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or to provide apnea therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.
assignees: KAI MEDICAL INC;DROITCOUR AMY;VERGARA ALEXANDER;SHING TOMMY;EL HOURANI CHARLES;NAKATA ROBERT;MOSTAFANEZHAD ISAR;MIYASATO SCOTT

title_en: Non-contact fatigue detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact fatigue detection method and a non-contact fatigue detection system, which comprise the following steps: sending a millimeter wave radar signal to a person to be detected, and receiving an echo signal reflected from the person to be detected; to determine time-frequency domain characteristics, nonlinear characteristics and timing characteristics of the vital sign signals; acquiring a face video image of a person to be detected, and performing face detection and alignment based on the face video image to extract time domain characteristics and space domain characteristics of the face of the person to be detected; fusing the time-frequency domain characteristics, the nonlinear characteristics and the time sequence characteristics of the vital sign signals with the time domain characteristics and the space domain characteristics of the face of the person to be detected to obtain fused characteristics; and inputting the fused features into a classifier, identifying the fatigue state of the person to be detected, and judging whether the person to be detected is in the fatigue state. The invention combines the two technologies, thereby effectively inhibiting the interference of subjective and objective factors and improving the precision of fatigue detection.

title_en: Emergency disaster relief vehicle-mounted imaging system based on time-frequency transmission technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of microwave general induction, and discloses an emergency disaster relief vehicle-mounted imaging system based on a time-frequency transmission technology, in particular to an antenna communication system based on the time-frequency transmission technology, and an accuracy enhancement type vehicle-mounted radar imaging system for emergency disaster relief by combining the time-frequency transmission technology with a through-wall radar. The invention aims to provide an emergency disaster relief vehicle-mounted imaging system which can be connected in a multipoint mode and is more accurate in three-dimensional imaging, and the functions of providing quicker and more accurate detection data for emergency disaster relief and mutually communicating on time are achieved. Can provide support for operators to detect the environment and determine the human body orientation, and increase the safety coefficient and the operation efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating forest-healing program
title_ko: 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법 및 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 시스템
abstract_ko: 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법 및 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법은, 산림 치유 프로그램의 실시에 따라, 환자에 부착된 센서에 의해 다중 생체신호를 측정하는 단계와, 상기 다중 생체신호의 측정값을 분석하여, 상기 환자의 건강상태와 관련한 기능 별로 기능 별 점수를 산출하는 단계와, 상기 기능 별 점수를, 상기 산림 치유 프로그램의 실시 전에 측정된 다중 생체신호에 따른 기능 별 사전 점수와 비교하여, 건강상태가 호전된 제1 기능을 선별하는 단계, 및 상기 선별한 제1 기능을 이용하여, 상기 산림 치유 프로그램에 대한 평가 결과를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: RF coil with integrated vital signs detector
abstract_en: A radio frequency (RF) transmit—receive coil for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system includes an integrated vital signs detector for the detection of vital signs of a patient within the MR imaging system. The coil includes a contactless sensor system for monitoring vital signs, which makes it easier to measure vital signs of the patient.

title_en: Radar type life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radar formula life detection instrument, including the computational element: calculating the standard deviation of the radar echo signals; a judging unit: judging that radar echoes are interfered by RFI based on the standard deviation; a processing unit: and carrying out frequency domain amplitude limiting on the echo containing the RFI interference, and not processing the echo containing no RFI interference. Adopt the technical scheme of the utility model, can be when effectively restraining RFI better the integrality that has kept target information, have that the algorithm is simple, calculate high efficiency, effectual characteristics.
assignees: WUXI JUNSHUAI ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring and health conditioning instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of medical appliances, in particular to a non-contact vital sign monitoring and health conditioning instrument, which comprises an installation box, a sensor module, an artificial intelligent machine learning algorithm module, a communication module, a power module and a cloud server, wherein each group of modules are installed in the installation box, the sensor module consists of a millimeter wave/terahertz microstrip array antenna transceiver, a fundamental wave signal generator and a digital signal processor and is responsible for detecting vital sign data of heart rate and respiratory rate of a human body, and the body shape, the body state, the movement and the position of a monitored person; the cloud server receives the data of the artificial intelligent machine learning algorithm module, performs storage operation, and then utilizes a built-in algorithm model and a business model to combine the data condition to send state notification, early warning notification, alarm information and intelligent suggestion to the mobile terminal of the user.
assignees: CHENGDU LINGRUI AOCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water storage device with water quantity detection mechanism for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water storage device for forest fire prevention with a water quantity detection mechanism, which comprises a water storage tank and a cement pool, wherein the water storage tank and the cement pool are buried under the ground, a water outlet is arranged in the center of the inner wall of the bottom of the cement pool, the water outlet is communicated with the inside of the water storage tank through a water outlet pipe, a water quantity detection control mechanism is arranged on one side of the water storage tank, and a filtering water storage mechanism is arranged in the cement pool. According to the utility model, the water storage tank and the cement pool are buried under the ground, so that the occupied space of the water storage device can be saved, direct irradiation of sunlight is reduced, evaporation of a water source is greatly reduced, water resources are saved, the water level sensor monitors the water quantity in the water storage tank, the external rainfall is small, water can be supplemented through tap water for water storage, when rainfall is abundant, the cement pool can collect rainfall of forests, and water sources are provided for the water storage tank through filtering sediment, so that the consumption of surface water resources is reduced.

title_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on group structure and correlation study
abstract_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on group structure and correlation study, is related to the technical field of radar imagery.The present invention includes the following steps: the homogenous linear array for assuming N array element, emulates the through echo-signal of n-th of array element；M frequency point echo-signal of vectorization N number of array element simultaneously；Emulate N number of array element multipath echo signal；Obtain compressed observation data；It constructs a layering Bayes and generates model；Variable γ, x are optimized with c；Initialize γ, x and c；Calculate the upper bound that a nonzero element of γ is become to objective function reduction after neutral element Calculate the upper bound that a neutral element of γ is become to objective function reduction after nonzero element γ is converged into optimal value；Parameter c is learnt group interior element correlation.The present invention take full advantage of in signal group sparsity structure and organize correlation between interior element, the sparse reconstruct mean square error of signal can be effectively improved, observation number needed for reducing reconstruct original signal, and there is stronger noise resisting ability.
assignees: NANJING HUIJUN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: A method of it is rescued for snowfield
abstract_en: A kind of method for snowfield rescue disclosed by the invention, use a kind of unmanned plane snowfield rescue system, including unmanned machine detecting device and rescue center, unmanned machine detecting device and rescue center's wireless communication connect, unmanned machine detecting device includes fuselage, rotor is provided on fuselage, fuselage surface center is installed by MCU Main Processing Unit, MCU Main Processing Unit is separately connected radar life detector, sound acquisition module, delivery device, holder, signal transmitting and receiving module and GPS positioning module, delivery device is mounted on the bottom surface of fuselage, camera is installed on holder, MCU Main Processing Unit is also connected with the output end of electric power detection module, the input terminal of electric power detection module connects power module, power module is used to power to the unmanned machine detecting device.Rescue mode disclosed by the invention, so that being found as early as possible by the trapped person to snow is buried, and heat generating device provides thermal energy, the extending life time provides a possibility that bigger successfully to rescue.

title_en: A kind of wearable flexible biological monitoring sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to biological intelligence sensing technologies, and in particular to a kind of wearable flexible biological monitoring sensor.Its core group becomes using macromolecular elastomer as matrix, mixes the high flexibility composite membrane of micro nano structure conducting particles.The characteristic film substantially with piezoresistive effect of the film.In actual test, which carrys out the vital signs such as the accurate organism heartbeat of reflection in real time, pulse with the fluctuation of resistance, to realize effectively monitoring.

title_en: Multi-person positioning and vital sign detecting method and system based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning multiple persons and detecting vital signs based on an FMCW radar, comprising the following steps: amplitude and phase correction is carried out on the echo signals of each channel; weighting the corrected signals by using the guide vectors at each search angle to obtain echo signals of corresponding angles; calculating a distance dimension FFT (fast Fourier transform) for each echo signal, and suppressing the interference of a static object; processing the constant false alarm rate to obtain the distance and angle information of each human body target; solving the optimal directional diagram weight vector forming a main lobe at each expected human body target angle and forming a null in other interfering human body target angle intervals; weighting each channel signal respectively, and calculating distance dimension FFT; and extracting respiration and heartbeat signals of each human body target according to the phase information of the range gate where the target is located. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, can accurately judge the distance and angle information of a plurality of human body targets positioned in different or same distance gates and extract corresponding respiration and heartbeat signals.

title_en: Respiration and heartbeat monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiration and heartbeat monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises an FMCW millimeter wave radar, wherein the FMCW millimeter wave radar is adopted to transmit electromagnetic wave signals to a human body, receive reflected signals carrying vital signs, demodulate received radar echo signals, separate and extract respiration and heartbeat information from the received radar echo signals, and acquire and analyze data: after receiving echo data, the radar transmits the original echo data to a PC (personal computer) end through a network cable and analyzes the original echo data so as to obtain Range-FFT (fast Fourier transform-fast Fourier transform) data; and (3) judging whether a target exists or not: and calculating the echo signal energy of the current frame through single frame Range-FFT data. The invention receives the radar echo signal which is returned from the human body and carries the vital sign information of the human body through the FMCW millimeter wave radar, and then processes the echo signal by utilizing the signal processing technology to obtain the respiration and heartbeat values of the human body, thereby achieving the purpose of monitoring the vital sign.
assignees: DEXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CHANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Animal vital sign monitoring method and system based on microwave beam regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention provides an animal vital sign monitoring method and system based on microwave beam regulation, comprising the following steps: positioning: detecting and positioning sensitive parts of target respiration and heartbeat in a visual field range based on a band-pass filter bank; a phase shift control step: constructing a phase coding matrix, and performing phase shift control on the transmitting signals of the transmitting antennas so that the synthesized wave beams of the transmitting antennas face the sensitive part obtained by positioning; a signal receiving and transmitting step: acquiring a plurality of echo signals and performing signal processing to obtain a multichannel baseband signal; demodulation: and performing micro-motion phase demodulation on the multichannel baseband signal, and extracting vital sign information of a target. The invention can process the multichannel baseband signal through the band-pass filter group to realize the detection and the positioning of the respiratory heartbeat sensitive part of the animal; animal vital sign detection is carried out by a phase coding and beam focusing method, and the testing distance, the signal-to-noise ratio and the measuring precision are improved.

title_en: Vital sign detection radar signal processing method under low signal-to-noise ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing a vital sign detection radar signal under a low signal-to-noise ratio, which belongs to the technical field of electronic information and comprises the following steps: measuring the digital intermediate frequency signal amplitude of a plurality of groups of I/Q channels, dynamically tracking the DC offset and compensating; coherent accumulation of intra-frame signals; distance processing; detecting a moving target based on the history estimation and the current state; performing distance tracking based on the distance dimension CFAR and the auto-covariance function; phase demodulation; demodulating the real phase, and differentiating the phase to enhance the heartbeat signal; two paths of breathing and heartbeat are filtered by a band pass filter to obtain a phase component; respectively carrying out signal recombination on the two paths of band-pass filtering output signals; and outputting a frequency estimation result based on the spectrum estimation of the multiple signal classification algorithm. The invention adopts the method for processing the vital sign detection radar signal under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, realizes better random body dynamic interference resistance, and can realize high-precision detection under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Non-excavation detection electromagnetic device and method for direct-buried heat supply pipeline based on geomagnetic feedback data collection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-buried heat supply pipeline non-excavation detection electromagnetic device and method based on geomagnetic feedback data collection, comprising a shell, wherein a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the front end of the shell, the front end of the shell is connected with a permalloy plate shielding cover, and the upper side of the inner part of the shell is connected with a movable handle; the cover plate is arranged on the inner side of the disassembly structure, the right side of the rear end of the cover plate is provided with a 64-bit thermal sensor, the left side of the rear end of the cover plate is provided with a fixed ring, the rear end of the fixed ring is fixedly provided with an installation block, the outer side of the middle part of the installation block is connected with a movable rod, the inner side of the movable rod is connected with a limiting block, and the inner side of the limiting block is connected with a cesium magnetic sensor matrix. The non-excavation detection electromagnetic device and the method for the direct-buried heat supply pipeline based on geomagnetic feedback data collection are convenient to carry the detection electromagnetic device, convenient to replace a cesium magnetic sensor of a phased array scanning radar, and convenient to collect geomagnetic feedback data.
assignees: TIANJIN HENGTAI PERCEPTION PRECISION MEASUREMENT TECH CO LTD;TIANJIN JINAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus, system, and method for obtaining biosignals from laboratory animal
title_ko: 실험용 동물의 생체 신호 획득 장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: In the present invention, wireless power is delivered by using an electromagnetic field to operate a sensor mounted on a laboratory animal, and a signal detected by the sensor is delivered to a data analysis system through electromagnetic field communication. An apparatus for obtaining biosignals from a laboratory animal, according to the present invention, comprises: a transreceiving antenna; a power control unit for converting power which is delivered from an external wireless power transmission device through the transreceiving antenna; a sensor which is operated by using power supplied from the power control unit for detecting biosignals of the laboratory animal; a signal processing unit which is connected to the sensor for processing the biosignals detected by the sensor; and a wireless communication unit for communicating with the an external device by using the transreceiving antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 자기장을 이용하여 무선 전력을 전달하여 실험용 동물에 장착된 센서를 동작시키고, 센서에 의해 검출된 신호를 자기장 통신을 통해 데이터 분석 시스템으로 전달한다. 본 발명에 따른 실험용 동물로부터 생체 신호를 획득하는 장치는, 송수신 안테나; 외부의 무선 전력전송 장치로부터 상기 송수신 안테나를 통해 전달되는 전력을 변환하는 전력 제어부; 상기 전력 제어부로부터 공급되는 전력을 이용하여 동작하며 실험용 동물의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서; 상기 센서와 연결되어 있으며, 상기 센서에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 송수신 안테나를 이용하여 외부 장치와 통신을 수행하는 무선 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart ring for biosignal measurement
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정용 스마트 링
abstract_en: A smart ring for biosignal measurement, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a housing having a ring shape to be worn on a finger of a wearer and having an inner circumferential surface that contacts the finger on which the housing is worn and an outer circumferential surface formed to be larger than the inner circumferential surface; a protrusion unit protruding from the inner circumferential surface of the housing; a sensor unit which is positioned on the inner circumferential surface of the housing and measures biosignals; a control unit that receives the measured biosignals from the sensor unit; and a battery unit which supplies power to the sensor unit and the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정용 스마트 링은 착용자의 손가락에 착용되도록 반지형상을 가지고, 착용된 손가락이 맞닿는 내주면 및 내주면보다 크게 형성되는 외주면을 가지는 하우징, 하우징의 내주면으로부터 돌출형성되는 돌출부, 하우징의 내주면에 위치하고, 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부 및 센서부로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신하는 제어부 및 센서부 및 제어부로 전원을 공급하는 배터리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Cross-bore detection during horizontal directional drilling
abstract_en: An electromagnetic sensor is configured for deployment at or near a cutting tool connected to a drill string and moveable by a horizontal directional drilling machine. The sensor comprises a housing having an exterior surface which is exposed to soil when the drill string and cutting tool move through the soil. An antenna arrangement and a power source are supported by the housing. Circuitry is disposed in the housing and coupled to the power source and the antenna arrangement. The circuitry is configured to generate a signal for transmission by the antenna arrangement, measure a performance characteristic of the antenna arrangement using a power detector coupled to at least a transmit antenna of the antenna arrangement, and detect a change in the antenna performance characteristic relative to a threshold indicative of contact between the cutting tool and a buried utility.

title_en: Biopotential electrode body and biopotential sensor
abstract_en: Provided is a biopotential electrode body having high mechanical strength and suitable for acquiring more bioinformation. The biopotential electrode body includes multiple electrically conductive portions each having a contact surface contactable with a biological body, and one or more electrically insulating portions that electrically insulate the multiple electrically conductive portions from each other. The electrically conductive portions each include a first elastic resin and a plurality of first particles buried in the first elastic resin. The electrically insulating portions each include a second elastic resin and a plurality of second particles buried in the second elastic resin.

title_en: Life detection radar system based on multi-domain multi-feature and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection radar system based on multi-domain multi-feature and deep learning, wherein the signal output end of a receiving and transmitting channel is respectively connected with the signal input end of a pulse pressure pre-life body recognition module and the signal input end of a pulse pressure preprocessing module, the signal output end of the pulse pressure preprocessing module is respectively connected with the signal input end of a pulse pressure post-life body recognition module and the signal input end of an imaging-based life body detection position recognition module, and the pulse pressure pre-life body recognition module, the pulse pressure post-life body recognition module and the imaging-based life body detection position recognition module are all connected with a sparse self-coding network and a logistic regression classifier. The method is used for radar life detection, solves the outstanding problems of low recognition efficiency and low accuracy caused by adopting a manually designed feature extraction method and only using a time-frequency combined domain as a feature extraction domain in the existing life detection radar target recognition technology, and meets the practical requirement of quick search and rescue of trapped personnel in disaster ruins such as earthquakes, landslides and the like.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템은, 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 생체 신호를 센싱하도록 구현되는 생체 센서; 상기 생체 신호를 모니터링하고, 설정된 값을 기반으로 상기 생체 신호가 정상 범위인지 비정상 범위인지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 생체 신호가 상기 비정상 범위인 경우, 응급 상황 관리 장치로 상기 센싱 대상의 상태 정보를 전송하도록 구현되는 생체 신호 모니터링 장치; 및 상기 센싱 대상의 보호자의 사용자 장치로 상기 상태 정보를 전달하도록 구현되는 응급 상황 관리 장치를 포함하고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 생체 센서는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 모니터링 장치는 상기 센싱 대상의 상기 생체 신호를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하도록 구현되고, 상기 생체 신호 모니터링 장치는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 센싱 대상의 신호를 추출하도록 구현된다.

title_en: System for monitoring survival in danger zone
title_ko: 위험공간에서의 생존 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a survival detecting system in a dangerous space. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the survival detecting system in a dangerous space comprises: a radar unit; a terminal unit; and a lamp unit. The survival detecting system in the dangerous space effectively detects survival and a position of a monitored person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험공간에서의 생존 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 피감지자가 위치하는 공간인 위험공간에 배치되며, 초광대역(UWB : Ultra Wide Band) 주파수를 사용하는 레이더로 마련되어 상기 피감지자의 생체신호를 감지하는 레이더부; 상기 위험공간 외부에 배치되며, 상기 레이더부로부터 전달되는 상기 생체신호를 화면에 표시하며, 상기 생체신호를 기초로 상기 피감지자의 상태가 위험하다고 판단되는 경우 비상신호를 생성하는 단말부; 및 상기 위험공간에 배치되며, 상기 비상신호를 전달받는 경우 점등하는 램프부를 포함하되, 상기 위험공간은, 터널 내부 또는 가스탱크 내부 또는 지하실 내부 또는 하수구 내부 또는 엘리베이터 내부 또는 비상계단을 형성하는 공간 또는 복도를 형성하는 공간 중 어느 하나로 마련되며, 상기 램프부는, 복수개로 마련되며, 소정의 간격으로 이격되어 상기 위험공간을 형성하는 구조물의 천정에 각각 설치되며, 상기 레이더부는, 복수개로 마련되어 복수개의 상기 램프부 사이에 각각 설치되며, 상기 레이더부는, 제1전파를 상기 피감지자로 송신하는 송신부와, 상기 제1전파가 상기 피감지자에 송신된 이후 반사되는 제2전파를 수신하는 수신부와, 상기 제1전파와 상기 제2전파를 기초로 상기 피감지자의 생체신호를 생성하는 연산부와, 상기 생체신호를 상기 단말부로 전달하는 통신부와, 상기 송신부와 수신부와 연산부와 통신부에 전원을 공급하는 배터리부를 포함하며, 상기 배터리부는, 화재가 발생하는 경우, 화염에 의한 열에너지 및 빛에너지를 흡수하여 전원을 충전하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 외부에서 위험공간에 위치하는 피감지자의 생존 및 위치가 효과적으로 감지될 수 있다.

title_en: Radar sensing for vehicle occupancy
abstract_en: A method for sensing occupancy states within a motor vehicle using a radar sensor system, the radar sensor system comprising: an antenna system, at least one sensor (10), and processing circuitry (18). The method comprises the following steps: at least one occupiable location within the vehicle is illuminated with a continuous wave (CW signal) using an antenna system, the CW signal being frequency modulated in time. Receiving at least one sensor signal (a) reflected as a result of the CW signal using at least one sensor (10), the at least one sensor (10) defining a plurality of reception channels (1 … i), each channel having a different frequency (f) 1 …f i ). The processing circuitry (18) is operable to: for each receive channel (1 … i), applying DC offset removal to the respective sensor signal (a) to generate a modified signal (b); and generating one or more multiplication status signals (34, 38) based on the modified signal (b), the multiplication status signals indicating an attribute related to the at least one multiplicable position. A system for implementing the method is also disclosed. These technologies provide in-vehicle occupant detection and classification (airbag suppression), occupant presence detection and occupant vital sign monitoring, and seat belt reminder functionality (SBR). The radar system may include one or two (or four) outputs (I/Q) per channel. Can be used forThe received signal is mixed down into baseband using a single channel demodulator or I/Q demodulator. Advanced signal processing including auto-calibration routines and clutter removal may be used to detect occupants and their vital signs (breathing and heartbeat) and determine their distance from the radar system.

title_en: A kind of haze mouth mask
abstract_en: The invention belongs to student with protective articles technical field, discloses a kind of haze mouth mask, including：Mouth mask body, it is sleeved at human body mouth and nose；Breather valve, it is inlaid in mouth mask body, realizes the exchange of mouth mask inside and outside air；Filter, breather valve are connected, and inside is provided with disinfection filtering bag, realize absorption, sterilization, filtering to impurity in extraneous air；Breathing detection sensor, it is inlaid in mouth mask body on wall, combines updating formula for the pressure and temperature in acquisition port cover body, and using air pressure, temperature to obtain the air pressure change in mouth mask body, by the air pressure in mouth mask body and the change of temperature, to perceive the breathing situation of wearer；Controller, electrically connected with breathing detection sensor, the electric signal of reception is analyzed and handled.The haze mouth mask can effectively carry out absorption by filter and disinfection filtering bag to the haze in air and pernicious gas composition and close filtering, and pass through the breathing situation inside breathing detection sensor detection mouth cover body.

title_en: A kind of sealing detector of highly sensitive high anti-interference pipe and cable detector
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of sealing detector of highly sensitive high anti-interference pipe and cable detector, trend for Underground and/or underwater pipeline, plane distribution and buried depth, circuit unit including epoxy resin round tube and in the epoxy resin round tube, the circuit unit includes alternating magnetic field vector sensor and the low-noise preamplifier that is made of discrete component, the alternating magnetic field vector sensor and the low-noise preamplifier are connected with each other and are both secured to circuit board, sealing material filled with insulation between the inner wall and the circuit unit of the epoxy resin round tube, alternating magnetic field vector sensor multiple inductance coils having the same, multiple inductance coils are serially connected, and it all has in each inductance coil using magnetic core made of high permeability material.The present invention has many advantages, such as high sensitivity, strong antijamming capability, small in size and light-weight.
assignees: JINGMEN PINCHUANG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human body respiration and heartbeat detection method based on terahertz and recurrent neural network
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining a human physiological sensing signal through a terahertz radar signal, preprocessing the information in a noise reduction mode, marking the processed signal data, training through a constructed recurrent neural network model, and obtaining a relevant model after training; the technical scheme is that on the basis of carrying out noise reduction processing on the terahertz echo signal, an empirical mode decomposition method is adopted, an original signal is decomposed into inherent mode functions on different frequencies, data are learned through a designed multilayer cyclic neural network, a recognition model for human heartbeat and respiratory information is constructed, the influence of noise on the terahertz echo signal can be effectively removed, and the terahertz echo signal has good robustness; the detection accuracy of the signal is better improved by a mode of carrying out feature fusion on the high-frequency signal and the low-frequency signal.

title_en: Life detection system and method for mine drilling rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection system and a method for mine drilling rescue, wherein the system comprises the following components: the ground terminal is in communication connection with the multifunctional life detection device in a wireless transmission or network transmission mode; the ground terminal includes: a central processing unit and an interaction module; the central processing unit is used for sending a control instruction to the multifunctional life detection device; the multifunctional life detection device comprises: the system comprises a controller, a video/infrared image detection module, an audio detection module and a radar detection module; the controller is used for receiving the control instruction and controlling the video/infrared image detection module, the audio detection module and/or the radar detection module based on the control instruction. The technical scheme provided by the application can be suitable for various conditions of drilling rescue, improves the success rate and accuracy of life information detection, and simultaneously improves the rescue efficiency by a full-automatic detection process.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: OFDM radar vital sign signal separation method based on FGO-VMD and multi-feature clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OFDM radar vital sign signal separation method based on FGO-VMD and multi-feature clustering, and belongs to the technical field of radar communication integration. According to the method, OFDM signal radar is utilized for human body detection, multi-subcarrier phase difference linear regression is utilized for estimating displacement, chest micro-motion signals are extracted, a FGO-VMD combined optimization model is provided, the mode number and penalty factor parameters of a VMD decomposition algorithm are determined through minimum envelope entropy self-adaption, a multi-feature clustering and weighting construction strategy is designed, frequency band screening and related coefficient weighting are combined, robustness of separation of respiratory signals and heartbeat signals is enhanced, and high-precision separation of vital sign signals is achieved. The invention realizes non-contact vital sign detection based on the OFDM radar signal, solves the problems that the traditional algorithm needs to manually set parameters of the modal number and punishment factor, signal amplitude attenuation and modal aliasing under complex noise, and the like, remarkably improves the accuracy of vital sign monitoring, and realizes high-accuracy separation of vital sign signals.

title_en: Apparatus adjustable level of the manhole cover assembly and construction method of the same
title_ko: 높이조절용 맨홀뚜껑 조립체 및 그의 시공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A height-adjustable manhole cover assembly and a construction method thereof are provided to prevent differential settlement and secure superior evenness of a road. CONSTITUTION: A height-adjustable manhole cover assembly comprises a primary manhole cover support(2) and a secondary manhole cover support(4). The primary manhole cover support is buried in a sub base material of aggregate in order to prevent obstacles to compaction work. The primary manhole cover support has a height for leveling a manhole cover(1) to the sub base material. The secondary manhole cover support is coupled to the primary manhole cover support. The secondary manhole cover support has a height for leveling the manhole cover to the surface layer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 높이가 다른 1차 및 2차 맨홀뚜껑 받침대를 이용하여, 맨홀설치후 자갈의 보조기층재와 아스콘의 표층 포설시공시 1차 및 2차 맨홀뚜껑 받침대와 맨홀뚜껑이 보조기층 및 표층과 레벨을 같게 함으로써 맨홀뚜껑에 의한 지장물 발생을 제거하여 그레이더 및 다짐장비에 의한 1차 및 2차 포설 및 다짐을 견고하게 할 수 있어 부등침하를 방지하고 우수한 노면의 평탄성을 구현할 수 있으며, 다짐작업의 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있는 높이조절용 맨홀뚜껑 조립체 및 그의 시공방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 맨홀뚜껑을 수용하기 위한 제1 수용부와 상기 제1 수용부의 하단에 내측으로 연장되어 맨홀뚜껑을 지지하기 위한 받침연장판과 맨홀슬라브에 안착되기 위한 외부 플랜지를 구비하며, 원형단면의 회주철로 이루어져 다짐작업에 따른 지장물이 발생되지 않도록 자갈의 보조기층재에 매립되는 1차 맨홀뚜껑 받침수단; 및 상기 1차 맨홀뚜껑 받침수단의 제1 수용부에 끼워져 지지되는 원형의 직립면과, 상기 직립면의 상단에 맨홀뚜껑을 수용하기 위한 제2 수용부및 맨홀뚜껑을 받쳐 지지하기 위한 단턱을 구비하며, 원형단면의 회주철로 이루어져 표층재에 맨홀뚜껑의 레벨을 맞추기 위한 2차 맨홀뚜껑 받침수단을 포함하는 높이조절용 맨홀뚜껑 조립체 및 그의 시공방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Biological signal measuring device based on electric stimulation for each part
title_ko: 부위별 전기자극 기반의 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biometric signal measurement device based on electric stimulation for each part to maximally treat a part of a user's body. According to the present invention, the biometric signal measurement device comprises: a plurality of biometric signal sensors for measuring biometric signals of parts of a user's body; a plurality of electrical stimulation sensors transmitting a plurality of electrical stimulation signals for treatment to the user's body at the same time or sequentially with a time difference; a monitoring unit monitoring a biometric signal-based user bio-rhythm or a user bio-rhythm changed according to the electrical stimulation signals; a database storing information about the user's biorhythm monitored by the monitoring unit; an analysis unit storing a first analysis algorithm analyzing information on the user's biorhythm stored in the database to determine an optimal biometric signal sensor for measuring an optimal biometric signal best reflecting the user's biorhythm among the plurality of biometric signal sensors and a second analysis algorithm calculating an optimal electrical stimulation signal for maximally treating a part of the user's body on the basis of the optimal biometric signal; and a control unit performing control so that the optimal biometric signal is measured from the biometric signal sensor and performing control so that the optimal electrical stimulation signal is generated from the electrical stimulation sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 부위별 전기자극 기반의 생체신호 측정장치는, 사용자의 신체 일부에 대한 생체신호를 측정하는 복수의 생체신호 측정센서; 사용자의 신체 일부에 치료를 위한 복수의 전기자극 신호를 동시에 전달하거나 시간차를 두고 순차적으로 전달하는 복수의 전기자극 센서; 생체신호 기반의 사용자 바이오리듬 또는 전기자극 신호에 따라 변화되는 사용자 바이오리듬을 모니터링하는 모니터링부; 모니터링부에서 모니터링된 사용자 바이오리듬에 대한 정보가 저장되는 데이터베이스; 데이터베이스에 저장되는 사용자 바이오리듬에 대한 정보를 분석하여 복수의 생체신호 측정센서 중 사용자 바이오리듬을 최대로 반영하는 최적의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 최적의 생체신호 측정센서를 판단하는 제1 분석 알고리즘과, 최적의 생체신호를 기준으로 사용자의 신체 일부가 최대로 치료되도록 하기 위한 최적의 전기자극 신호를 연산하는 제2 분석 알고리즘이 기저장되는 분석부; 및 생체신호 측정센서로부터 최적의 생체신호가 측정되도록 제어하며, 전기자극 센서로부터 최적의 전기자극 신호가 생성되도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting body component
title_ko: 체내 성분 검출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: One embodiment of a device for detecting a body component includes: a sensor unit which contacts a subject and detects a biosignal; and a processor which determines a time point at which the influence of local blood pressure is minimized, including a time point at which the amplitude of an AC component is maximized or a time point at which the slope of a DC component is maximal, and detects body components based on the determined time point.
abstract_ko: 체내성분 검출장치의 일 실시예는 피검체와 접촉되어 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 생체신호에서, AC성분의 진폭이 최대가 되는 시점 또는 DC성분의 기울기가 최대가 되는 시점을 포함하는, 국부혈압의 영향이 최소가 되는 시점을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 시점을 기초로 체내성분을 검출하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A buried object locating and tracing method and system employing principal components analysis for blind signal detection
abstract_en: A blind locating system for finding and tracing buried objects such as utility lines, conductive pipes and sondes. A sensor array is coupled to a signal processor, which determines a field vector for one or more buried objects by producing a data signal representing a covariance matrix corresponding to the covariances of the time-varying sensor array signals over a selected frequency band and accumulation interval. The covariance matrix is characterized by eigenvalues and associated eigenvectors and a user interface (UI) indicates the field vector associated with the eigenvector having the largest eigenvalue. Using several different frequency bands, a plurality of underground objects may be simultaneously detected and indicated in the UI without foreknowledge of their existence or characteristics.

title_en: Method and Device for detecting Information of Object In Room, Storage Medium and Processor
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and device for detecting information of an object in a room, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: collecting target information of a target object in the room by target detection equipment, wherein the target information at least comprises vital sign information and behavior information of the target object, and the target detection equipment comprises radar monitoring equipment that the target object do not need to wear and vital sign monitoring equipment that the target object wears; analyzing behavior state information of the target object based on the target information; and displaying the behavior state information of the target object on a display interface. Through the application, the problem of poor information detection effect on indoor personnel in related technologies is solved.

title_en: For searching and rescuing the wireless sensing network system and method for trapped person
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of for searching and rescuing the wireless sensing network system and method for trapped person, is made of four sign data acquisition sensor node, the wireless localization apparatus based on RSSI value, Sink node and terminal presentation facility parts.Sign data acquires and is sent to Sink node by multi-hop routing after sensor node is handled the sign data of acquisition, data are sent to system terminal by other base support networks again by Sink node, wireless location system calculates the relative position of node to be positioned according to the position of its reference location node at the same time, and the coordinate information of relative position is transmitted to Sink node by wireless coordinator.The absolute position of this relative coordinate combination reference location node is calculated the absolute position of mobile node and is transmitted to the mobile terminal of rescue personnel by Sink node, and rescue personnel can be buried the specific location of life with the determination of accurate quick.

title_en: A kind of estimation method of underground metalliferous round tube radius and buried depth based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The estimation method of the invention discloses a kind of underground metalliferous round tube radius and buried depth based on BP neural network buries radar return data in different media using the metal circular tube that Ground Penetrating Radar forward simulation obtains different radii and buried depth；The backward energy value in A-Scan echo-peak, peak value arrival time and the preset time period right above metal circular tube is extracted, with this 3 parameter construction feature vectors, composition characteristic vector matrix, the data set as training sample importation.The data set of training sample output par, c is made of the relative dielectric constant of the radius of known metal round tube, buried depth and underground medium.The structure for designing BP neural network, is trained BP neural network with training sample data, and the characteristic parameter of Ground Penetrating Radar echo data to be measured is input to the BP neural network after training, is estimated the radius and buried depth of underground metal circular tube.The present invention can fast, accurately estimate the radius and buried depth of underground metalliferous round tube.

title_en: Human body through-wall detection imaging method based on kurtosis evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides a human body through-wall detection imaging method based on kurtosis evaluation, wherein in the method, a constraint relation between wall body parameters is established; for three-dimensional data matrix Obtaining a focused image by adopting a self-focusing imaging algorithm based on a kurtosis evaluation value; and in the process of obtaining the focusing imaging in the step five, detecting whether a human body target exists or not by adopting the maximum value of the kurtosis value sequence. The method adopts a self-focusing imaging algorithm based on the kurtosis evaluation value, corrects the traditional MIMO radar BP imaging model by combining with wall parameters, then carries out enhanced correction on the human physiological micromotion signals in the self-focusing imaging process, and the corrected algorithm can obtain a self-focusing image with higher quality of the human physiological micromotion signals.

title_en: Animal vital sign monitoring method and system based on microwave beam regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention provides an animal vital sign monitoring method and system based on microwave beam regulation, comprising a positioning step of detecting and positioning sensitive parts of target respiration and heartbeat in a visual field range based on a band-pass filter bank, a phase shift control step of constructing a phase encoding matrix and performing phase shift control on transmitting signals of transmitting antennas so that synthesized beams of the transmitting antennas face the sensitive parts obtained by positioning, a signal transceiving step of acquiring a plurality of echo signals and performing signal processing to obtain a multichannel baseband signal, and a demodulation step of performing micro-motion phase demodulation on the multichannel baseband signal to extract vital sign information of the target. The invention can process the multichannel baseband signals through the band-pass filter group to realize detection and positioning of the respiratory heartbeat sensitive part of the animal, and can detect the vital signs of the animal through the methods of phase coding and beam focusing to improve the testing distance, the signal-to-noise ratio and the measuring precision.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar baseband module and system for multi-target vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar baseband module and a system for multi-target vital sign monitoring, wherein the radar baseband module comprises a time domain processing sub-module, a frequency domain processing sub-module and an FFT sub-module, the time domain processing sub-module is used for filtering and preprocessing digital intermediate frequency signals of echo signals reflected by targets to obtain time domain sampling point sequences, the FFT sub-module is used for carrying out FFT conversion on the time domain sampling point sequences output by the time domain processing sub-module to obtain one-dimensional frequency domain signals, the frequency domain processing sub-module is used for extracting phase characteristics of a plurality of targets from the one-dimensional frequency domain signals, the FFT sub-module is also used for carrying out FFT conversion on the phase characteristics of the plurality of targets to obtain two-dimensional frequency domain signals so as to extract vital sign information of each target, and the frequency domain processing sub-module comprises a distance extraction unit, a phase extraction unit, a plurality of parallel unwrapping units, a parallel-serial conversion unit and a null filter. The invention has high integration, low power consumption, low cost and low time delay.

title_en: Electronic device for obtaining biometric signal and method of operating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호를 획득하는 전자 장치와 이의 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 센서 모듈, 상기 센서 모듈의 제1채널과 연결된 제1전극부, 상기 센서 모듈의 제2채널과 연결된 제2전극부, 및 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1전극부와 상기 제1전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제1부분 사이의 제1임피던스와, 상기 제2전극부와 상기 제2전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제2부분 사이의 제2임피던스를 측정하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1임피던스와 상기 제2임피던스에 기초하여 상기 제1임피던스 및 상기 제2임피던스의 차이가 지정된 범위를 만족하도록 상기 제1채널과 상기 제2채널 각각에 대응하는 임피던스를 조절하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1채널 및 상기 제2채널의 임피던스가 조절된 상태에서, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 획득하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Wearable device and sensor device
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 및 센서 디바이스
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 웨어러블 디바이스는, 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와, 웨어러블 디바이스를 착용한 사용자의 피부에 접촉하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부 사이에 형성되어 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부를 기구적으로 연결하며, 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부가 독립적으로 움직일 수 있도록 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부 사이의 움직임 전달을 차단하는 완충부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Interface between vital-signs sensors and patient monitor
abstract_en: An apparatus includes at least one sensor, a connector and a conversion unit. The sensor is coupled to a patient body so as to measure a physiological parameter of the body. The connector coupled to a patient monitor, which measures a value of the physiological parameter by applying a test signal via the connector and measuring a response signal on the connector in response to the test signal. The conversion unit is coupled between the at least one sensor and the connector, and is configured to determine a corrected value of the physiological parameter, to calculate an auxiliary signal that, in combination with the test signal produced by the patient monitor, causes the response signal on the connector to represent the corrected value of the physiological parameter, and to generate and output the auxiliary signal to the connector so as to cause the patient monitor to measure the corrected value.

title_en: Onshore electromagnetic reservoir monitoring
abstract_en: Onshore electromagnetic (EM) reservoir monitoring systems and methods, including a system with a light source producing a light beam and an EM sensor array positioned above ground or buried underground over one or more regions of interest within a subterranean formation, the array coupled to the light source with an optical fiber. An EM sensor modulates the interrogation light beam in response to an EM signal induced into the subterranean formation by an EM source. The system further includes a processor controlling the light source, processing modulated light received from the array, and collecting data with the array to produce EM surveys, each EM survey based on data sets collected at different times. The EM sensor is physically isolated from a surrounding environment. The surveys are combined to produce a time lapse earth model of the regions of interest.

title_en: It destroys analogue test device to contain upper portion defect dykes and dams infiltration
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an it destroys analogue test device to contain upper portion defect dykes and dams infiltration, the device include the model groove and set up the dykes and dams model in it that the upper portion of dykes and dams model is equipped with arched simulation ant way, the dykes and dams model is close to the simulation ant of low reaches dam slope department and says that near is equipped with a spheric region, and the upper portion in model groove is equipped with the artificial rainfall simulation ware, multiunit monitor sensor has been buried underground in near simulation ant way in the dykes and dams model. The device's construction method does: at first making the soil sample with the clay, burying arched tubule underground on dykes and dams model upper portion, fill the soil sample and tamp after exceeding the tubule, then excavate the peripheral soil sample of tubule for spherical, backfilling clay layer that the soil sample of excavating made the spheric region again, to be close to this tubule more loose more, fills to extract pre -buried tubule after the completion and give birth to moulding and plan the ant way, and the edge journey of saying the simulation ant sets up multiunit monitor sensor. The utility model discloses it flows the effect and brings out infiltration destruction and send calamity mechanism to can be used to study homogeneity dykes and dams upper portion defect advantage.

title_en: Monitoring alarm equipment for detecting geological disasters
