abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning equipment, in particular to a monitoring and alarming device for detecting geological disasters; including detecting box, support rack, protection box with a net, collection subassembly, solar cell panel, battery and pre-buried stake, be equipped with in the protection box with a net and detect the box and support the rack, protection box with a net bottom rigid coupling has if intervene the pile of burying, the support rack is put on the shelf and is equipped with the detection box, it is equipped with controller, alarm and battery to detect box inside, the collection subassembly includes air velocity transducer, wind direction sensor, earthquake wave sensor and soil salinity sensor, the equal rigid coupling of lateral wall all around of detection box has solar cell panel. The utility model discloses stable in structure can monitor multiple data, and powerful can in time discover geological disasters, and then early warning geological disasters.
assignees: XINJIANG VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF COMMUNICAITONS

title_en: Emergency SOS device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency SOS device. Infrared lights (6) are arranged on a shell (1) in various directions, and a chargeable battery (2) and a radio (9) are arranged inside the shell (1), and infrared lights (6) are arranged at one end of the shell (1), and a whistle is arranged at the other end thereof; the chargeable battery (2), the radio (9), a switch (7), infrared lights (6) and an external charging port (8) are connected with a control device (3). The utility model provides a small device for overcoming the deficiency that buried people cannot communicate with the outside; after being buried, since the emergency SOS device can illuminate, people can ask for help by blowing the whistle and acquire information from the outside through the radio, thus increasing the probability of being detected by an external life detecting instrument through infrared information and the opportunity to be saved; and the emergency SOS device can be used in the earthquake-prone area.

title_en: A kind of strong penetrability three-dimensional radar life detection positioning device of high-resolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of strong penetrability three-dimensional radar life detection positioning devices of high-resolution, main includes transmitting subsystem, receiving subsystem, multichannel data acquisition system, main control unit, wireless line traffic control terminal, power module, by by marx pulse-generating circuits, three avalanche transistors, the high amplitude pulses of the nanosecond of Resonant Mode Trigger Circuits composition emit subsystem, reception echo is carried out by receiving subsystem, by noise reduction unit, filter unit, signal amplification unit processing, incoming multi-channel data collection unit carries out sampling processing, the result of sampling processing comes in and goes out by DSP data processing units and WiFi communication module and the main control unit for running linux system, bidirectional data communication is carried out to wireless display and control terminal by 2.4GWiFi.In short, the present invention can realize three-dimensional localization life detection, the distortion of impulse wave is prevented, improve the clear of the image of three-dimensional simulation and receives the intensity of weak signal.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring under slow random motion based on biological radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vital sign detection, and provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring method based on a biological radar under slow random motion. Firstly, synchronously acquiring frequency modulation continuous wave radar and pulse ultra-wideband radar data; and then, based on the echo signals of the frequency modulation continuous wave radar, the target detection, the motion mode pre-classification and the body orientation classification are realized by utilizing machine learning. On the basis, the estimation of the position of the chest echo is realized based on the body orientation, the vital sign signals obtained by the detection of the pulse ultra-wideband radar are corrected in an auxiliary mode, and the vital sign extraction is further realized by adopting a heartbeat estimation and recovery algorithm. The detection method provided by the invention can accurately detect the target vital signs under the slow random motion, and provides possibility for further realizing long-term, robust and comprehensive vital sign monitoring under the motion state and exploring the influence of motion on the physiological health of a human body.

title_en: Doppler radar heartbeat detection method based on multi-scale residual shrinkage network
abstract_en: The invention is a Doppler radar heartbeat detection method based on a multi-scale residual shrinkage network, which considers that continuous wave radar signals in a time domain are different in performance on different time scales, provides a multi-scale time domain feature extraction module, and places the multi-scale time domain feature extraction module in a residual shrinkage network structure to form the multi-scale residual shrinkage module, wherein the residual shrinkage network uses a soft threshold value as a nonlinear conversion layer, so that related noise interfering heartbeat detection can be effectively eliminated; performing Hilbert-Huang transform on the radar signals under different scales, wherein the obtained result reflects the time-frequency characteristics of the signals, and further performing characteristic extraction on the transformed signals, which is favorable for separating heartbeat related characteristics from complex mixed signals; and the output of the multi-scale residual shrinkage module and the output of the Hilbert-Huang filtering module are subjected to feature fusion, so that the noise interference in the original radar signal is effectively reduced. The method can reconstruct high-quality radar signals and improve the heartbeat detection accuracy.

title_en: Life detection positioning method and system for mine drilling rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection and positioning method and system for mine drilling rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting an area to be detected by using back-to-back ultra-wideband radars placed in a borehole, obtaining radar echo matrixes in each preset direction of the area to be detected, and preprocessing each radar echo matrix; determining each initial direction in which the trapped person is located and the radar echo matrix preprocessed in each initial direction according to the preprocessed radar echo matrix in each preset direction; determining the distance between trapped personnel corresponding to each initial direction and the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar according to the radar echo matrix preprocessed in each initial direction; and determining the position of the trapped person based on the distance between the trapped person corresponding to each initial direction and the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar. According to the technical scheme, the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar is used for detecting the positions of trapped people, so that the calculated amount is small, and the three-dimensional positions of the trapped people can be rapidly and accurately determined.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life detection radar device
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection radar device, which comprises a base, a pulley assembly, a driving mechanism, a detection radar body, a pushing assembly, a pressing assembly and a rotation stopping assembly, wherein the pulley assembly is arranged on the base; the top surface of the base is provided with grooves, and the pulley assemblies are provided with a plurality of pulley assemblies and are uniformly distributed on the bottom surface of the base; the driving mechanism is rotatably arranged on the base, and the detection radar body is arranged on the driving mechanism; the pushing component and the pressing component are respectively and slidably arranged in the groove of the base, and the rotation of the driving mechanism can drive the pushing component to slide towards the pressing component, so that the pressing component slides towards the rotation stopping component; the bottom surface of the base component is provided with a plurality of strip holes, the rotation stopping component is slidably arranged in the groove of the base and can slide in the strip holes, and the sliding of the pressing component can simultaneously enable the rotation stopping components to slide towards the pulley component and be inserted into the pulley component to limit the rotation of the pulley component. The rotation of the life detection radar device does not need to continuously limit the base.
assignees: CHINESE PLA ARMY SPECIALIZED MEDICAL CT

title_en: Vital sign and consciousness condition monitoring system based on active and passive radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign and consciousness condition monitoring system based on an active and passive radar, which is characterized in that on the basis of monitoring vital signs by an existing millimeter wave radar, millimeter wave echo signals and brain wave signals can be received by adopting a low-side lobe high-gain high-sensitivity dual-frequency receiving antenna, meanwhile, an extremely low-frequency (brain wave band signal frequency range: 0-20 MHz) high-sensitivity receiver is added to a high-sensitivity receiver module for receiving and conditioning brain wave radiation signals, then sampling and analyzing are carried out in a signal processing module, the analyzed data result is compared with the analyzed data result of normal personnel stored in a data storage module, and when the difference is larger than a threshold value, the occurrence of abnormality of the vital signs or consciousness conditions of a patient is indicated, and an early warning signal is sent. The invention relates to a non-contact monitoring system based on active and passive radars, which is used for accurately collecting vital sign signals and brain electrical signals, and realizing real-time, continuous and dynamic monitoring of vital signs and consciousness conditions of patients, thereby being beneficial to rapid recovery of the patients under good resting conditions.

title_en: Portable wireless vital sign monitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable wireless vital sign monitor, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a monitor component, wherein the monitor component comprises a base, a shell is arranged above the base, a millimeter wave biological radar for monitoring vital signs of a monitored person is arranged in the shell, the inside of the base is provided with a mounting component, the top of the base is in sliding sleeve joint with the bottom wall of the shell so as to realize omnibearing angle adjustment of the shell, the bottom of the base is provided with a mounting component so as to realize quick assembly and disassembly of the monitor component, and an adjusting component is arranged in the base so as to realize unfolding and closing of the shell. According to the invention, the mounting assembly and the adjusting assembly are arranged, so that the monitor can be disassembled and assembled more conveniently, and the state of the monitor can be further adjusted, so that the portable monitor is convenient to carry.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCE HOSPITAL FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL WITH NANJING MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Multimode sensor vital sign monitoring method of high dynamic simulator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of vital sign monitoring algorithms, and particularly relates to a multi-mode sensor vital sign monitoring method of a high-dynamic simulator. The method integrates a millimeter wave radar, an IMU and an ECG sensor, phase information of a person to be tested is acquired through signals and positioned through targets, self-adaptive signal decomposition and signal screening are carried out on the phase information through phase unwrapping and signal extraction, and a novel method for realizing stable, real-time and non-contact vital sign monitoring in a high dynamic simulation environment can be realized. The method has the perception capability of motion state, and can dynamically adjust the signal processing strategy and the detection mechanism by combining the information of the multi-mode sensor, so that higher detection precision and robustness are maintained in a complex environment.
assignees: GUANGDONG RUIFAN PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pipeline leakage point detection method, device and equipment integrating thermal response and earthquake waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline leakage point detection method, device and equipment integrating thermal response and earthquake waves, and relates to the technical field of underground pipeline leakage detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining seismic wave signals and space-time thermal response data obtained by detecting an underground pipeline, inputting the space-time thermal response data into a space-time convolutional neural network to conduct space-time feature extraction to obtain a thermal field change mode of the underground pipeline, inputting the thermal field change mode into a physical information neural network to conduct inversion to obtain first leakage source information of the underground pipeline, wherein the physical information neural network uses a heat conduction equation as a hard constraint, conducting inversion on the seismic wave signals to obtain second leakage source information of the underground pipeline, and determining leakage point detection results of the underground pipeline based on the first leakage source information and the second leakage source information. The invention can realize the omnibearing accurate sensing of the deep buried leakage point from the space position to the leakage state, and improves the detection depth and the positioning precision.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY INTER CITY PLANNING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar having a wide survey range in a direction orthogonal to a radar movement direction, capable of acquiring easily the shape of a buried object and a burying position with excellent resolution in the radar movement direction.  <P>SOLUTION: This radar has a constitution equipped with an electromagnetic wave transmission part 20 capable of scanning in the radar width direction with an electromagnetic wave transmitted toward the underground from a transmission array antenna 24, an electromagnetic wave transmission direction control part 30 for controlling variably the electromagnetic wave transmission direction of the electromagnetic wave transmission part 20, an electromagnetic wave reception part 40 for receiving a reflected wave from the underground by a reception array antenna 41, a reflected wave incoming angle estimation part 50 for estimating the reflected wave incoming direction from a received signal by the electromagnetic wave reception part 40, a synthetic aperture processing part 60 for performing synthetic aperture processing from the received signal by the electromagnetic wave reception part 40, a transmission/reception time operation part 70 for operating a time from electromagnetic wave transmission until reflected wave reception, an image processing part 80 for calculating display data, and an image display part 90 for displaying the display data.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
assignees: NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD;NAT UNIV YOKOHAMA

title_en: Apparatus for measuring pulse wave, skin resistance and respiration
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device for measuring a pulse wave, skin resistance, and respiration.SOLUTION: The device for measuring the pulse wave, skin resistance, and respiration comprises: a grip-skin current measurement piece 80 held by a person to be measured; a probe-skin current measurement piece 90 brought into contact with a hand and foot of the person to be measured; a wrist pulse wave detecting sensor 100 in which a piezoelectric element sensor is incorporated; an index finger pulse wave detecting sensor 110 including a light emitting device and a light receiving device; a respiration detecting pad 120 to be attached to the abdominal part of the person to be measured; a main body 1 including a control unit, a capacitance touch input unit, a display unit 20, and a USB interface; and a personal computer 150 electrically connected to the control unit via the USB interface, and including an integrated control unit for analytically processing, by an input of the user, signals detected from the grip-skin current measurement piece, the probe-skin current measurement piece, the wrist pulse wave detecting sensor, the index finger pulse wave detecting sensor, and the respiration detecting pad.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Telemetry apparatus, system, and method for animal experiment
title_ko: 실험용 동물의 생체 신호 획득 장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: In the present invention, wireless power is delivered using an electromagnetic field to operate a sensor mounted on a laboratory animal, and a signal detected by the sensor is delivered to a data analysis system through electromagnetic field communication. According to the present invention, an apparatus to obtain biosignals from a laboratory animal comprises: a transceiving antenna; a power control unit to convert power delivered from an external wireless power transmission device through the transceiving antenna; a sensor operated using power supplied from the power control unit to detect biosignals of the laboratory animal; a signal processing unit connected to the sensor to process the biosignals detected by the sensor; and a wireless communication unit to communicate with an external device using the transceiving antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 자기장을 이용하여 무선 전력을 전달하여 실험용 동물에 장착된 센서를 동작시키고, 센서에 의해 검출된 신호를 자기장 통신을 통해 데이터 분석 시스템으로 전달한다. 본 발명에 따른 실험용 동물로부터 생체 신호를 획득하는 장치는, 송수신 안테나; 외부의 무선 전력전송 장치로부터 상기 송수신 안테나를 통해 전달되는 전력을 변환하는 전력 제어부; 상기 전력 제어부로부터 공급되는 전력을 이용하여 동작하며 실험용 동물의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서; 상기 센서와 연결되어 있으며, 상기 센서에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 송수신 안테나를 이용하여 외부 장치와 통신을 수행하는 무선 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Non-contact type monitoring device for monitoring infectious patient and non-contact type monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 감염병 환자 격리 감시를 위한 비접촉 방식 모니터링 장치 및 이를 이용한 비접촉 방식 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A non-contact monitoring device for quarantine monitoring of an infectious patient according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a radar sensor which measures a biosignal of a patient accommodated in an isolation facility in a non-contact manner; a data learning unit which learns a biosignal normal range of the patient through biosignal data measured by the radar sensor; and an abnormal state detection unit which detects the biosignal to be in an abnormal state when the biosignal measured by the radar sensor is out of the biosignal normal range learned by the data learning unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 감염병 환자 격리 감시를 위한 비접촉 방식 모니터링 장치는, 격리 시설에 수용된 환자의 생체 신호를 비접촉 방식으로 측정하는 레이다 센서; 상기 레이다 센서에 의해 측정된 생체 신호 데이터를 통해 환자의 생체 신호 정상 범위를 학습하는 데이터 학습부; 및 상기 레이다 센서에 의해 측정된 생체 신호가 상기 데이터 학습부에 의해 학습된 생체 신호 정상 범위를 벗어나는 경우, 생체 신호 비정상 상태임을 감지하는 비정상 상태 감지부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for detection of buried objects
abstract_en: A system for detecting buried objects or threats is described. Radiation is detected from a target area by at least two wavelength radiation band sensors. The radiation emitted by the target area is detected by suitable detectors and processed using suitable signal processing means together with statistical data processing methods such that an image of the target area is produced capable of showing buried objects in the target area.

title_en: Nuclear power plant, safety system with fuse element and gravity elevator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nuclear power plant and safety system with fuse element and gravity elevator, the buildings of the power plant subjected to contamination being buried below sea level and under borated water basins, and having a safety system free of electrical and electronic components to act in the event of possible accidents comprising, among others, means for flooding the buildings of the power plant with thermal fuses and gravity elevators for operator evacuation in the event of an emergency.
assignees: SERBEX TECNOLOGÍA Y VALORES S L

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection with vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system (10) and a method of operating the radar sensor system (10) for detecting an occupancy in an interior (34) of a vehicle (32) and with vital sign monitoring is provided. The radar sensor system (10) comprises a radar transmitting unit (12), a radar receiving unit (18) and a signal processing and control unit (26). The method includes at least steps of transmitting (60) a radar wave towards a scene within the vehicle interior (34), receiving (62) at least one radar wave that has been generated by reflection of the transmitted radar wave (16), - decomposing (64) the received at least one radar wave (22) into range, Doppler and angular information, quantifying and tracking (68) a movement in each region of interest (38, 40, 42) by angular gating and range gating, detecting (78) and monitoring vital signs of occupants (28, 30) in each region of interest (38, 40, 42), and determining (84) whether quantified and tracked movements in the scene are related to an occupant (28, 30) or to external or internal disturbances, based on a fulfillment of at least one predefined condition concerning the quantified and tracked movements and/or the detected and monitored vital signs.

title_en: System and method for ground penetrating radar communication using antenna crosstalk
abstract_en: An object detection system ( 24 ) is disclosed having a transducer ( 40, 40 ′) for detecting buried objects ( 26 ). The transducer is encapsulated within a robust, electromagnetically transparent construction ( 42 ).
assignees: SIMICEVIC NEVEN;JAGANATHAN ARUN;MONTGOMERY JAMES L;OLSON JAY H

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Detection, location, and characterization of buried explosive devices and weapons caches
abstract_en: Embodiments of this invention utilize Fraunhofer diffraction to detect, locate, and characterize buried objects, and, in particular, weapons caches and/or potentially dangerous explosive devices, are to be detected and characterized according to rough size, shape, and reflectivity with respect to the probe energy (ultrasound, microwave, milliwave, etc.). Size is obtained by measuring the spatial pattern and/or width of the Fraunhofer diffraction wave. Reflectivity is obtained by normalizing the reflected energy with respect to the energy reaching the target object and the size of the reflective area of the target object.

title_en: Identity recognition method based on pulse ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an identity recognition method based on a pulse ultra-wideband radar, belonging to the field of radar signal processing; after the pulse ultra-wideband radar acquires radar echo signals of a person to be tested, preprocessing is sequentially carried out, an energy concentration array and an energy concentration area are selected, sliding sections are carried out, and variation modal decomposition is carried out on each section to obtain heartbeat frequency and respiratory frequency information representing vital signs; and (3) forming the vital sign feature vectors of all the slices into an energy concentrated waveform, inputting the energy concentrated waveform into an identity recognition neural network, and respectively passing through an attention module, a convolution layer and a full connection layer of an encoder and a decoder to realize the identity recognition of the tested personnel. The invention can realize non-contact identity recognition, has no specific requirements on the behavior and action of detected personnel, uses various characteristics of heartbeat, respiration and posture, and has higher robustness.

title_en: MILITARY IoT WATCH AND PLATFORM CORRESPONDING TO THE SITUATION USING THE SAME AND METHOD THEREOF
title_ko: 군용 IoT 워치와 이를 이용한 상황 대응 플랫폼 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 군용 IoT 워치와 이를 이용한 상황 대응 플랫폼 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 군용 IoT 워치에 있어서, 시각을 디스플레이 하고, 무선통신으로 신호를 송출하는 본체; 상기 본체와 결합하여 사용자의 손목에 착용되는 밴드부; 및 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 측정하여 상기 본체로 측정결과를 전송하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 본체는 상기 측정결과가 미리 정해진 한계점을 넘어서는 경우, 상황실에 보고할 수 있다.

title_en: Device and method for generating highlight videos using biosignal-based emotion recognition
title_ko: 생체신호 기반 감정 인식을 통한 하이라이트 영상 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 생체신호 기반 감정 인식을 통한 하이라이트 영상 생성 장치 및 방법을 제공한다. 실시예에 따른 방법은, 전자장치에 의해, 센서 장치로부터 시간정보, 및 상기 시간정보에 따른 시간에서의 사용자의 생체신호를 포함하는 적어도 하나의 센싱데이터를 수집하고, 상기 센싱데이터를 기설정된 임계값과 비교하여 각 시간별 사용자의 감정상태를 인식하는 단계; 상기 전자장치에 의해, 상기 인식된 시간별 감정상태 각각에 대해 감정가중치를 산출하는 단계; 상기 전자장치에 의해, 원본영상데이터를 복수의 시간 구간으로 분할하고, 각 시간 구간에 대응하는 상기 감정가중치를 매핑하여 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 생성하는 단계; 상기 전자장치에 의해, 상기 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 기초로 하이라이트 최종영상을 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 전자장치에 의해, 상기 하이라이트 최종영상을 사용자 단말로 전송하는 단계;를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 감정가중치를 매핑하여 상기 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 생성하는 단계는, 상기 감정가중치가 기설정된 임계치 이상인 시간 구간의 프레임들을 하이라이트 후보 프레임으로 선정하는 단계와, 상기 감정가중치가 높은 순서대로 시간 구간을 정렬하여 상위 기설정된 비율의 구간을 선택하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Indoor and outdoor multi-person vital sign monitoring system based on multi-radar fusion internet of things
abstract_en: The scheme requires that the indoor and outdoor multi-target vital signs can be monitored based on the multi-radar fusion network. Under the environment that many people appear intensively indoor and outdoor, the problem of sheltering from and the aliasing of signal appears easily, thereby cause target vital sign monitoring inaccurate, undulant great scheduling problem, solitary ultra wide band radar network lacks the unable body state of discernment target of multidimension information and then influences vital sign monitoring, thereby solitary frequency modulation continuous wave radar can't realize accurate target location and lead to subsequent vital sign monitoring inaccurate, network deployment and the information fusion at different dimensions through ultra wide band radar and frequency modulation continuous wave radar, can reduce the influence of multi-target mutual interference effectively, simultaneously can also monitor the body state of multi-target, increase vital sign monitoring's accuracy and robustness.

title_en: Dynamic detection method for vital signs of millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign dynamic detection method based on a minimum mean square error criterion. The method comprises the steps of firstly, preprocessing human body information detected by a radar through intermediate frequency signals to reduce background noise and radar emission leakage interference; then carrying out speed prior detection on the target, determining that the human body belongs to a resting state or a moving state, and verifying and compensating the distance unit occupied by the human body through the obtained speed value after obtaining the moving state; after an accurate distance unit is obtained, positioning the random motion of the human body through continuous wavelet transformation and restraining through attenuation of a moving average filter to obtain an original thoracic cavity waveform; and finally, extracting the human respiration and heartbeat signals by adopting an optimization filter based on a mean square error criterion. The invention can accurately measure the vital signs of the human body in a resting state or a moving state in single detection, and can ensure that the human body freely moves in a non-contact state and simultaneously the radar can accurately acquire the vital sign information.

title_en: Non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and device based on IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and device based on an IR-UWB radar, which are characterized in that IR-UWB radar equipment is deployed at the bedside to collect vital sign data of a tested object in an environment where the device is positioned during the bed at night; automatically positioning the position range of the bed, and extracting vital sign signals representing the tested object in the range of the bed from echo signals reflected by the radar; respectively identifying five states of the human body in the whole night process based on a signal processing algorithm; estimating the sleeping period of the tested object according to the state change condition of the human body overnight; monitoring the respiration rate change condition of a tested object in a sleep period; and identifying respiratory events occurring in the sleep period of the tested object by using a deep learning method based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism. The invention improves the accuracy of the calculation of the breathing frequency overnight and can obtain more accurate sleep apnea low-ventilation index AHI data.

title_en: Vital sign supervision is breathed and air purification healthy and is supported device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring and air purifying health-care device, and in particular relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, which comprises a monitoring shell, a driving motor, a rotating block and a transverse extension deflection adjusting mechanism; the transverse extension deflection adjusting mechanism comprises a rotating frame, an adjusting screw rod, an adjusting motor, a sleeve block, a linkage bar, a sleeve and a vertical motor, wherein the output end of the vertical motor is fixedly provided with the vertical frame, and the vertical deflection adjusting mechanism is arranged in the vertical frame. According to the invention, the displacement adjusting mechanism is transversely prolonged, so that the monitoring biological radar can automatically carry out displacement adjustment according to the signal intensity, thus the monitoring operation is carried out under the stronger signal intensity range, the monitoring effect of respiration and heartbeat is greatly improved, and the problem that the monitoring operation is difficult to be carried out under the stronger signal intensity range, and the monitoring effect of vital signs is poor is solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN NINE TREE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Driver health monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning the health of a driver, which belong to the technical field of intelligent cabins of automobiles, wherein the method comprises the steps of calling camera data in a DMS (digital management system) in the intelligent cabin, positioning the chest of the driver and obtaining three-position coordinates of the chest part of the driver in a cabin space; the method comprises the steps of combining three-dimensional coordinates positioned on a thoracic cavity part, adjusting a millimeter wave radar integrated in a steering wheel to send radar signals, receiving echo signals of the radar signals after interference of movement of a fluctuation cavity of the thoracic cavity part, extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals in real time based on the echo signals to obtain vital sign signals, extracting features of the vital sign signals to obtain vital sign parameters, analyzing the vital sign parameters, and sending an abnormality processing request when the vital sign parameters exceed a threshold value. The method analyzes the cardiopulmonary data of the driver and judges the occurrence of crisis abnormal conditions such as the suppressed respiration and the heart beat pause in advance.

title_en: Underground radar device and construction machine
abstract_en: To ensure that the performance of detecting a buried object hardly decreases for even irregular ground surfaces such as uneven grounds.SOLUTION: An underground radar device 400 comprises a drum-shaped casing 410, a drum shaft 420 capable of rotating relatively to the casing 410, and a radar 430 suspended from the drum shaft 420 inside the casing 410. The radar 430 is disposed by being spaced apart from the inner surface of the casing 410 by a prescribed interval so that it can be displaced relatively to the inner surface of the casing 410. This ensures that the interval between the radar 430 and a ground surface is maintained almost constant as the casing 410 proceeds on an irregular ground surface while rolling thereupon, and it is possible to suppress a decrease in the performance of detecting a buried object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Buried structure position estimation system
abstract_en: To reduce the time required for estimation of a three-dimensional position of a buried structure to improve the accuracy of estimation.SOLUTION: A waveform image creation unit 41 creates, based on data observed by a buried structure survey system, a waveform image that takes the position of a radar survey device in a predetermined direction as a lateral direction, takes a delay time of a radio wave received by the radar survey device as a vertical direction, and takes the intensity of the radio wave received by the radar survey device as the brightness of pixels, for every position of the radar survey device in a second predetermined direction different from the predetermined direction. A two-dimensional position estimation unit 42 estimates a two-dimensional position of a buried structure by using a convolutional neural network based on the waveform image created by the waveform image creation unit 41. A three-dimensional position estimation unit 43 estimates a three-dimensional position of the buried structure based on the two-dimensional position of the buried structure estimated by the two-dimensional position estimation unit 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Wearable monitoring apparatus
title_ko: 착용형 모니터링 장치
abstract_ko:
실시예는 착용형 모니터링 장치에 관한 것이다. 
실시예에 따른 착용형 모니터링 장치는, 피부에 부착 가능하게 형성되고, 복수 개로 배열된 전극을 이용하여 인체로부터 신호 대 잡음비를 측정하고, 측정된 신호 대 잡음비에 기초하여 복수 개의 전극 중 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 전극들을 선택하고, 선택된 전극들을 이용하여 하나 이상의 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 및 피부에 부착 가능하게 형성되고, 센서부를 통해 검출된 생체신호를 수집하는 단말부를 포함하고, 센서부 및 단말부는, 인체 통신을 이용하여 데이터를 송수신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Electronic device and method for determining information associated with sleep
title_ko: 수면과 관련된 정보를 결정하기 위한 전자 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present invention includes a biometric signal detection sensor set to acquire first biometric information and second biometric information for an object outside the electronic device and a processor. The processor is set to acquire the first biometric information and the second biometric information using the biometric signal detection sensor, to conform a first change amount in which the first biometric information is changed and a second change amount in which the second biometric information is changed, to determine the state of the object associated with sleep based on at least a part of the first change amount and the second change amount, and to estimate sleep latency associated with the object based on at least a part of the state. Accordingly, the present invention can determine the sleep latency without the engagement or intervention of a user.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예들에 따른 전자 장치(electronic device)는, 상기 전자 장치 외부의 오브젝트에 대한 제1 생체 정보 및 제2 생체 정보를 획득하도록 설정된 생체 신호 감지 센서와, 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 제1 생체 정보 및 상기 제2 생체 정보를 상기 생체 신호 감지 센서를 이용하여 획득하고, 상기 제1 생체 정보가 변화된 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 생체 정보가 변화된 제2 변화량을 확인하고, 상기 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 변화량에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 수면과 관련된 상기 오브젝트의 상태를 결정하고, 상기 상태에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 상기 오브젝트와 관련된 수면 잠복기를 추정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and terminal for life detection processing
abstract_en: A method, apparatus and terminal for life-detection processing. The method comprises: emitting a WiFi electromagnetic wave; receiving a coherent wave of the reflected wave of the WiFi electromagnetic wave and the WiFi electromagnetic wave; and determining life information on the basis of the received coherent wave. The method solves problems in relevant technologies with respect to life-detection such as inconvenient user-operability, low availability rates and poor inter-operability, while offering easy portability, and ease and timeliness of use.

title_en: Vital sign detection apparatus and system and data processing method
abstract_en: The vital sign detection device of the present invention includes one or more sensors, which can detect a plurality of vital sign signals of a test subject in a non-contact manner, and output corresponding a plurality of vital sign information, thereby achieving fast and accurate vital sign detection. The invention also relates to a combined multi-functional detection device, which includes a camera, a radar sensor, an infrared sensor and a sensor driving unit, used for measuring vital signs. The invention also provides a non-contact blood pressure measurement method and device. The method includes receiving radar echoes and video signal streams at first and second parts, extracting first and second pulse wave signals therefrom, obtaining a measured pulse wave transit time, matching the measured pulse wave transit time with a reference pulse wave transit time, and obtaining a blood pressure value.
assignees: NAT UNIV SINGAPORE;NATIONAL UNIV OF SINGAPORE SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Vehicle mounted metal and mine detector
abstract_en: The invention is related to a vehicle mounted metal and mine detector, which is used in the operations with military or humanitarian purposes regarding the clearance or removal of landmines for detecting mines with high metal content and plastic mines with a minimum content of metal that are near the ground surface or buried underground, as well as any improvised explosive devices, ammunitions and explosives; in the archaeological researches for determining the location of the buried archaeological remains without damaging them; in the geophysical studies for the exploration of mineral deposits, industrial minerals and rock formations; and in the detection of infrastructure elements such as underground pipelines and cables. The system is comprised of a manned or unmanned ground vehicle (8), a lower arm (2) and an upper arm (3) that are connected to the lower shell (7) of the vehicle by means of rotating links, a search head (1) in which electromagnetic interference (EMI) sensor coils and ground penetrating radar (GPR) antennas are arranged to be nested inside one another, fore arms (9) that are fastened directly on the search head (1) or into the ribs (13) placed on the search head and that enable the search head (1) to be connected to the lower arm (2) and to the upper arm (3) by means of the quick-connect rotating connection components, a linear actuator (5) and a lever arm (4) that are connected to either one of the lower arm (2) and the upper arm (3) with rotating links for adjusting the height of the search head (1) from the ground, and an upper shell (6) covering the last-mentioned mechanisms for protecting them against external factors. While adjusting the height of the search head (1) from the ground, at the same time, it is kept parallel to the ground, and these two functions are carried out by using only one linear actuator (3). Through the arrangement of the sensors in the search head such that the sensors are arrayed in pairs nested one another, the dimensions of the search head are kept as small as possible, providing the ease of use in narrow areas where the detection operation is carried out. When the search head is damaged, the connection components are broken off by themselves and the search head is broken off from the vehicle due to the connection of the search head (1) to the lower arm (2) and the upper arm (3) by means of the quick-connect connection components, which prevents the rest of the vehicle from being damaged by protecting it against the damaging effects. Furthermore, the damaged search head can be replaced easily and quickly with a new one on site without the need for any special equipment, therefore the vehicle has the ability to operate for a long time.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Impulse radar device and method
abstract_en: A miniaturized impulse radar is provided. The radar uses a slight frequency difference between a local oscillator and an RF signal to generate high quality A- Scans using an inexpensive microcontroller's analog-to-digital converter. A DMA circuit is used to write analog-to-digital converter outputs to a buffer memory. The radar has applications in, for instance, ground penetrating radar for detecting buried utilities, automotive collision avoidance, autonomous robot navigation, and machine vision in general.

title_en: Human presence detector and human presence detection method thereof
abstract_en: A human presence detector includes a microwave generator, a microwave receiver, a frequency mixing wave detector and a signal processor. The microwave generator is configured to emit and transmit a detecting microwave in a detection space. The microwave receiver is configured to receive a corresponding echo of the detecting microwave. The frequency mixing wave detector, linked to the microwave generator and the microwave receiver, is configured to perform a frequency mixing wave detection on the detecting microwave and the corresponding echo of the detecting microwave to output a primary detecting signal. The signal processor linked to the frequency mixing wave detector is configured to select a fluctuation signal at a predetermined frequency range in the primary detecting signal to amplify and output a secondary detecting signal. Accordingly, in response to the detection of the motion at the predetermined frequency range, a human (living) body is detected and determined in the detection space.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Respiration detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a respiration detection method and device, relates to the technical field of radar detection, and is used for improving the accuracy of respiration detection. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target space, and acquiring echo signals of M channels; processing echo signals of the M channels to obtain respiration characteristic signals of a target human body of the M channels; processing the respiration characteristic signals of the target human bodies of the M channels to obtain cross-correlation entropy corresponding to the target human bodies; performing Fourier transform on the cross-correlation entropy to obtain a cross-power spectrum; and determining the respiratory frequency of the target human body according to the cross power spectrum.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar under motion disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar under motion disturbance, which comprises the following steps: performing down-conversion processing on original radar echo data; determining a region of interest according to the result of the down-conversion processing; preprocessing the data of the region of interest, and extracting an optimal respiratory signal by using a respiratory signal extraction algorithm based on an R square value; removing the background of the data of the region of interest, and simultaneously obtaining a start-stop frame of each random body movement through a movement detection algorithm; calculating to obtain the respiratory rate and the heart rate according to the region of interest data obtained after the Butterworth band-pass filtering, and optimizing the detection of the respiratory rate according to the optimal respiratory signal; and stopping detection when the random body movement is detected according to the start-stop frames of each random body movement obtained by the movement detection algorithm, and setting the respiration rate and the heart rate at the previous moment as the current detection result. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the continuous monitoring of vital signs of a human body under the condition of small random body movement is realized.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar underground pipeline parameter inversion method based on graphical user interface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ground penetrating radar data interpretation, and particularly relates to a ground penetrating radar underground pipeline parameter inversion method based on a graphical user interface. The method comprises the steps of designing a special graphic user interface, namely displaying a ground penetrating radar B-Scan signal, adjusting an interaction area and a threshold value, inputting basic parameters of the ground penetrating radar, starting a button and displaying a fitting result, marking key points of hyperbolic features in a ground penetrating radar B-Scan image through the graphic user interface, and realizing inversion of buried depth and radius parameters of an underground pipeline by combining a sampling time interval and a transverse inter-channel distance of an input ground penetrating radar system to obtain the buried depth and the radius parameters of the underground pipeline. Experimental results show that the method can accurately invert the buried depth and the radius of the underground pipeline of the ground penetrating radar, and solves the problems that the traditional method is not strong enough in universality, affected by noise, large in calculated amount, lack of radius inversion results and the like.

title_en: Vital sign detection signal denoising method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for denoising vital sign detection signals, which relate to the technical field of physiological sensing and signal processing and comprise the steps of acquiring an original phase signal containing physiological signals based on the Doppler technology of millimeter wave radar; the method comprises the steps of carrying out variational mode decomposition on an original phase signal based on a variational mode decomposition super-parameter search algorithm optimized by a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain vibration mode function information corresponding to the original phase signal, carrying out denoising treatment on the vibration mode function by using a substitution entropy and a fuzzy entropy as fitness functions, recombining the vibration mode function after denoising treatment to obtain a physiological signal after high-precision denoising treatment, and extracting respiratory and heartbeat physiological signals from the physiological signal after high-precision denoising treatment.

title_en: Roadbed construction method for crossing V-shaped valley area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a roadbed construction method for crossing a V-shaped valley area, and belongs to the technical fields of foundation engineering and foundation treatment. The method solves the problems of low foundation drainage efficiency, unstability of the filled side slope and differential settlement control in the construction of the V-shaped valley roadbed. The technical scheme includes that a ditch is dug along the bottom of a valley, a broken stone drainage blind ditch wrapped by permeable geotextile is paved to form a foundation drainage system, a vibratory roller with a piezoelectric sensor embedded into a steel wheel is adopted in layered filling, a unidirectional geogrid is paved along a side slope after each two layers of filling and is vertically anchored into a compaction layer through a U-shaped anchoring piece, a transverse drainage pipe is pre-buried when filling is carried out to a threshold value of a bearing capacity abrupt change point of a foundation, and a sedimentation monitoring array is paved after filling is completed. The method is used for remarkably improving the bearing stability of the roadbed filled under complex terrains through the optimization of the foundation drainage structure and the system integration of intelligent compaction and differential settlement dynamic treatment of the filling body, and is suitable for foundation construction and disaster prevention and control of V-shaped canyon sections of mountain roads.

title_en: Video life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a video life detection instrument, which acquires image and voice information of a trapped person under the ruins by a high definition video and a high sensitivity audio signal. The video life detection instrument has convenient use and small visual appearance, is firm and light, and is very suitable for the search and rescue operation of fallen buildings or narrow space. The front end of the video life detection instrument is provided with a micro motor which can control a micro camera at the front end of the video life detection instrument to rotate 360 degrees. And an infrared LED lamp is used to illuminate so as to see the image clearly in the dark place.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY CENTURY AUTOMATIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Conflagration rescue intelligent robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conflagration rescue intelligent robot, including control module, computer and main part, the computer passes through wireless transmission module and is connected with control module, the last the detection unit that is connected with of control module, the detection unit all sets up in the front of main part including camera, temperature sensor, humidity transducer, thermal imaging system and life detection ware, camera, thermal imaging system and life detection ware, and temperature sensor, humidity transducer set up the reverse side in the main part, last manipulator, fire extinguisher, apparatus of oxygen supply, buzzer and the pilot lamp of still being connected with of control module, the last drive arrangement that still is connected with of control module. The utility model discloses a computer remote control main part is tested the environment in the scene of a fire, with the real -time photo in the scene of a fire, temperature, humidity, have or not data transfer such as the personnel of surviving to the computer, can also put out a fire among a small circle, and cooperation search and rescue personnel, the injured personnel of discovery in time provide the warning for it.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a monitoring and early warning device of geological disasters belongs to geological disasters technical field, including pre-buried section of thick bamboo, dwang, bearing, protection casing, motor cover, servo motor, a protection section of thick bamboo, returning face plate, cage, main control board, battery, pressure sensor, rubber ring and monitoring facilities, the front and the back of pre-buried section of thick bamboo all imbed the welding and have the bearing, the centre of bearing runs through the welding and has the dwang, the front seamless welding of pre-buried section of thick bamboo is provided with the protection casing, and the dwang is located the protection casing. The utility model provides a pressure sensor can experience when the impact of earth, gives the control circuit on the main control board with data feedback, and control circuit control servo motor begins to operate, and servo motor drives a protection section of thick bamboo, returning face plate and cage rotation one hundred eighty degrees, makes monitoring facilities rotate the bottom of returning face plate, and a protection section of thick bamboo bears the impact of earth, avoids monitoring facilities to be destroyed by the washing, has and is difficult to damage, advantages such as long service life.

title_en: Mounting platform extension device of micro-variation monitoring radar system
abstract_en: An installation platform extension device of a micro-variation monitoring radar system comprises: the system comprises rail equipment, a rail equipment bracket, a wire groove bracket, a distribution box, a rod body, video monitoring equipment, wireless communication equipment and a lightning rod; the rail equipment is erected on the rail equipment support; the wire groove is horizontally arranged, one end of the wire groove is connected with the track support, and the other end of the wire groove is connected with the distribution box; the bottom of the wire groove is supported by a wire groove bracket, and the bottom of the wire groove bracket is buried underground; the rod body is vertically arranged, the bottom of the rod body is buried underground, the upper part of the rod body is respectively provided with a video monitoring device and a wireless communication device, and the top of the rod body is provided with a lightning rod; the wire groove arranged in the horizontal direction is connected with the rod body arranged in the vertical direction through a universal flange; the cable of the track equipment is connected to the distribution box through the wire groove, and the cables of the video monitoring equipment and the wireless communication equipment are also connected to the distribution box through the wire groove. The utility model has the advantages of convenient installation, light weight and convenient transportation.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA MYPATTERN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency assistance support vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency assistance support vehicle, which comprises an automotive chassis and a working device mounted on the automotive chassis, wherein the working device comprisesa crane, a hydraulic lifting platform, a communication device and a shelter; the crane is mounted at the front part of the automotive chassis; the hydraulic lifting platform is mounted at the middle part of the automotive chassis; the shelter is mounted at the back part of the automotive chassis; the communication device comprises a satellite antenna and a short wave antenna for communication in motion; a base is mounted at the upper end of the shelter; the satellite antenna is mounted on the base and can rotate; and the short wave antenna for communication in motion is mounted at the back part of the shelter. Since the utility model is provided with emergency equipment with the functions of hoisting, aerial work, communication and earthquake relief work; and earthquake relief work emergency equipment like life detection instruments, infrared scanners, generators, construction tools, cookers, tents and the like of the earthquake relief work device can be loaded in the shelter, so thatthe utility model has the characteristics that the device is complete, fast, flexible and engine-driven, and provides an all-around assistance support for earthquake relief work.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth microwave chaos life detection radar device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a life detection radar device, in particular to an ultra-wide bandwidth microwave chaos life detection radar device for detecting human body life feature information and distance information. The ultra-wide bandwidth microwave chaos life detection radar device can be used for disaster rescue and comprises a first signal generator, a first power splitter, a frequency mixer, a power amplifier, an ultra-wide bandwidth emitting antenna, an ultra-wide bandwidth receiving antenna, a low noise amplifier, an I/Q demodulator, a second signal generator, a second power splitter, a voltage-controlled phase shifter, an adjustable attenuator, a solid state microwave sensor, a third signal generator, a phase-locked amplifier and a signal collecting and processing module. The life feature information and the position information of trapped persons can be rapidly and accurately detected.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle carried life detection equipment and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses unmanned aerial vehicle carried life detection equipment and a detection method, wherein the detection equipment comprises sky end detection radar equipment and ground end display control equipment, and the sky end detection radar equipment comprises an antenna, a radio frequency module and a baseband processing module; the radio frequency module comprises a digital frequency synthesizer or a phase-locked loop, a power amplifier, a circulator, a low-noise amplifier, a combiner, a mixer, a band-pass filter, a gain-controllable amplifier, an amplitude limiter, an analog-digital converter and an antenna, wherein the digital frequency synthesizer or the phase-locked loop, the power amplifier, the circulator and the antenna form a transmitting channel; the antenna, the circulator, the low noise amplifier, the combiner, the mixer, the band-pass filter, the gain controllable amplifier, the amplitude limiter and the analog-digital converter form a receiving channel. The detection device is small in size and light in weight, is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle to realize large-area rapid detection of trapped people, and has stronger environmental adaptability and applicability.
assignees: NANJING MINZHIDA TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument which comprises a control terminal, wherein the control terminal is electrically connected with a detection handle through a connecting wire, the detection handle is fixedly connected with a detector through a flexible wire, the detector comprises a detection shell, a bioelectricity sensor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the detection shell, a vibration sensor is fixedly arranged in the detection shell and positioned on the right side of the bioelectricity sensor, a lateral optical camera is fixedly arranged in the detection shell and positioned on the right side of the vibration sensor, a video processor is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the lateral optical camera, and a vertical optical camera extending to the right side of the detection shell is fixedly arranged on the right side of the video processor. According to the multifunctional life detector, the bioelectricity sensor senses an electric field generated by ultralow frequency electric waves emitted by a human body, the vibration sensor identifies sound emitted by trapped persons, the optical camera shoots scenes in the ruins, and the trapped persons in the ruins can be detected to the greatest extent by three detection modes.
assignees: SHENZHEN DINGGUANHENGTONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to vital signs monitoring systems. The present invention relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system may include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system may be operable in one or more modes of operation such as, for example: a capacitance measurement mode, an electrical measurement mode, a piezoelectric measurement mode, a temperature measurement mode, an acceleration measurement mode, an impedance measurement mode, and a standby mode. Based on the measurements, the monitoring system may analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and advice to the user, and/or may adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system is also capable of analyzing the sleep of the user without directly contacting or attaching an uncomfortable probe to the user and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar uses a wavelet threshold denoising method based on an adaptive threshold function to denoise collected signals, so that pure vital sign signals can be obtained, and the method can adapt to different signals by adjusting the size of a control factor, so as to achieve a better denoising effect; when the vital sign frequency is estimated, a method of combining a Hamming window function and an MUSIC algorithm is used, the Hamming window function is used for processing sliding window data, a space spectrum is constructed by the MUSIC algorithm, and spectrum peak searching is carried out to obtain the frequency of heartbeat and respiration. The method has better stability, noise immunity and resolution, can eliminate the influence of clutter in a measuring environment on a result, can reduce the influence of respiratory harmonics on heart rate estimation, and further improves the accuracy of respiratory and heartbeat signal frequency estimation results.

title_en: Rescue site intelligent detection system and application
abstract_en: The application provides a rescue scene intelligent detection system and application, wherein a firefighter terminal device comprises a wireless communication module and an intelligent detection module, wherein the wireless communication module is used for receiving and sending voice, data and video information, and the intelligent detection module comprises an environment sensor, a vital sign detector, a data processing unit and a camera device; the base station equipment is used for receiving and processing voice, data and video signals from the firefighter terminal and comprises fixed base station equipment and mobile base station equipment, wherein the fixed base station equipment is positioned in a command part, and the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the mobile base station equipment, the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the appointed area can be rapidly deployed in a short time through the mobility and the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the communication requirements of different scenes are met, and the high-efficiency communication quality of the fire disaster and the command part is ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN HONGJIALI FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water amount detection device, vital sign detection device, and environment control system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To detect a water amount derived from a living body in a non-contact state.SOLUTION: A living body water amount detection unit 1 includes: a light source 11 that irradiates electromagnetic wave to a fabric part 231 as a detection target; at least one sensor 141 that detects a return amount of the electromagnetic wave reflected by the fabric part 231; and a calculation part 15 that calculates the return amount detected by the sensor 141 and converts it into the water amount.

title_en: Buried object survey device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object survey device allowing appropriate survey using an operation rod.SOLUTION: The buried object survey device includes: a device main body 2 that surveys a buried object in a medium by radiating a radar wave from a transmission antenna to the medium, receiving a reflected wave from the medium with a receiving antenna, and performing analysis processing; wheels 31 and 32 disposed before and after the device main body 2; an operation rod 4 that is a long body and whose one end is connected to the device main body 2; and angle regulating means 5 for regulating the device main body 2 so that the device main body 2 can swing longitudinally with respect to the operation rod 4 and does not swing by a predetermined angle or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Radar-invisible region estimation device and estimation method for reinforced concrete structure
abstract_en: To provide a radar-invisible region estimation device and estimation method for a reinforced concrete structure that can estimate a position of a reinforcing-bar near a wall even when a hyperbola waveform related to the reinforcing-bar buried near the wall of a floor is the waveform in which only a skirt portion of the base thereof is visible and an apex thereof is invisible in a case where the hyperbola waveform is acquired by performing radar scan on the floor being a reinforced concrete structure.SOLUTION: A radar-invisible region estimation device for a reinforced concrete structure includes: a radar survey result acquisition unit 0361 for a reinforced concrete structure; an apex-invisible waveform portion information acquisition unit 0362 which acquires waveform information on a waveform portion where an apex of a hyperbola waveform is invisible in the acquired radar survey result; an apex estimation means retention unit 0363 which holds apex estimation means to estimate an apex position of the apex-invisible waveform portion on the basis of the apex-invisible waveform portion information; and an apex estimation unit 0364 which estimates the apex position of the apex-invisible waveform portion on the basis of the apex-invisible waveform portion information and the apex estimation means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3C

title_en: Apparatus for monitoring physiology-health using mouse pad and method thereof
title_ko: 마우스 패드를 이용한 무자각 건강 모니터링 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A health monitoring apparatus and method thereof which uses a mouse pad are provided to prevent accident through alarm and to continuously monitor a health condition by monitoring a bio-signal through a mouse pad. CONSTITUTION: A health monitoring apparatus(100) includes a mouse pad unit and a health condition processing unit(200). The mouse pad unit includes a human body sensing unit(10) and a bio-signal processing unit. The body sensing unit is installed in the fixed region of a wrist supporting unit of the mouse pad. The body sensing unit includes a PPG sensor, a pressure sensor, a GSP sensor, and temperature sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 마우스 패드를 이용한 건강 모니터링 장치는, 마우스의 안착면을 갖는 판의 형상이며, 일측에는 사용자의 손목을 지지하는 손목 지지부가 마련된 마우스 패드와, 손목 지지부의 소정 영역에 내장되고, 사용자의 손목부분의 광혈류, 피부저항 및 온도를 포함하는 생체신호를 감지하는 인체 감지부와, 인체 감지부로부터 감지된 사용자의 생체신호들을 증폭 및 필터링한 후 상기 생체신호를 분석 및 가공하여 무선신호로 송출하는 생체신호 처리부를 포함하는 마우스 패드 장치; 및 마우스 패드 장치로부터 무선신호를 수신하여 모니터링 프로그램에 따라 사용자의 건강상태를 판정하는 건강상태 처리장치를 구비한다.

title_en: A sensor and a method of sensing thereof
title_ko: 센서 및 센싱방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sensor and a sensing method are provided to accurately measure a biological signal by detecting the size variation of the biological signal using the deviation degree of an oscillation frequency of an oscillator. CONSTITUTION: An oscillator(100) generates oscillation frequency deviation corresponded to a biological signal. A signal detector(200) detects the size variation of the biological signal using the deviation degree of an oscillation frequency. The signal detector includes a filter(210) and a power detector(220). The power detector is connected to the filter. The filter detects the size deviation of the biological signal using an SAW filter. [Reference numerals] (100) Oscillator; (110) Plate resonator; (200) Signal detector; (210) Filter; (220) Power detector; (300) Signal processor; (320) Filter; (400) Display unit
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 측정센서 및 측정방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정센서는 발진기, 신호검출부 및 신호처리부를 포함하며, 발진기의 발진주파수 편이량을 생체신호의 크기변화로 검출하고 검출된 생체신호로부터 맥박신호 및 호흡신호를 각각 검출한다.  
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정센서 및 측정방법은 생체신호 검출대상과 비접촉하여 이루어지며, 근거리에서 정확한 생체신호 검출이 가능하다.

title_en: Respiration detection using radar
abstract_en: One or more radar sensors can be used to monitor patients in a variety of different environments and embodiments. In one embodiment, radar sensors can be used to monitor a patient's breathing, including monitoring of tidal volume, chest expansion distance, breathing rate, etc. In another embodiment, a patient position can be monitored in a patient bed, which can be used as feedback for control of bladders of a patient bed. Additional embodiments are described herein.

title_en: Real-time, two dimensional (2-d) tracking of first responders with identification inside premises
abstract_en: A combination of active reader tags and ultra wideband (UWB) radar systems provide real-time monitoring of first responders, with identification of each team member using active tags, and detection of victims or other subjects using motion or breathing detection, in a field of operations such as a building affected by fire or hazardous material or search and rescue mission area. Initially, a cluster of miniaturized radars (sensors) act in a static mode of operation, gathering static radar information used to depict a constructed layout of the premises. The cluster of radars then operate in a dynamic mode that detects motion or breathing of multiple subjects inside the field of operations. With dual mode operation the system can read the active tags identification, and by triangulation, display the position of each first responder with its identification and positions of subjects on a composite image of the constructed layout.

title_en: Active phase switchable array
abstract_en: An active phase switchable array includes a plurality of antenna elements and a bias circuit. Each of the radar elements includes an antenna, a power coupling network and an injection-locked oscillator (ILO), and each of the antenna elements is coupled with each other through the power coupling networks for operating the ILO of each of the antenna elements in self- and mutual-injection-locked states. The antenna elements in self-injection-locked state are utilized to detect the vital signs of subjects, and the antenna elements in mutual-injection-locked state are utilized to produce phase difference between the radiating signals of the antenna elements for forming a beam. As a result, the active phase switchable array can simultaneously detect the vital signs of multiple subjects.

title_en: Providing Image Units for Vital Sign Monitoring
abstract_en: According to an example aspect of the present invention, there is provided image units for vital sign monitoring by a multichannel radar scanning a field-of-view and a microwave imaging radiometer sounding the field-of-view. Presence of moving targets within the field-of-view of the radar is determined on the basis of phase and/or amplitude changes of the image units between scans. Thermal information or information determined based on the thermal information obtained by the sounding is combined with the image units of the moving targets. In this way vital signs may be monitored based on movement and thermal information of the image units.

title_en: Autonomous cardiac resuscitation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of cardiac resuscitation devices for resuscitating the heart, which enables an emergency physician or paramedic to perform cardiac resuscitation automatically and very professionally, saving the paramedic time and effort and ensuring patient comfort. The device of the invention is easy to use and is installed as a single piece that the user can easily place and secure to the patient's chest, which is desirable in such devices because saving time is paramount in emergency situations. In addition to saving time, the device does not require installation tools or preparation time. The device is formed by an adhesive silicone piece (1) comprising detectors (2) surrounded by compression massage sensors (3) that perform movements like the movement of a hand pressing on the heart during resuscitation, wherein the silicone piece is attached over the heart, directly on the patient's chest, and works using an AI feature together with the receipt of messages sent by detectors attached to the surface of the sensors to measure the patient's vital signs, the sensors massaging the area by pressing, contracting and vibrating.

title_en: High-resolution high-penetrability three-dimensional radar life detection positioning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection and positioning device for a high-resolution high-penetrability three-dimensional radar, which mainly comprises a transmitting subsystem, a receiving subsystem, a multi-channel data acquisition system, a main control unit, a wireless line control terminal and a power supply module, wherein a nanosecond high-amplitude pulse transmitting subsystem consisting of a marx pulse generating circuit, three avalanche triodes and a resonant trigger circuit receives echoes through the receiving subsystem, the echoes are processed by a noise reduction unit, a filtering unit and a signal amplification unit and are transmitted into the multi-channel data acquisition system for sampling processing, the sampling processing result is input into the main control unit which is composed of a DSP data processing unit and a WiFi communication module and operates a Linux system, and the wireless display and control terminal is subjected to bidirectional data communication through 2.4 GWIFi. In a word, the invention can realize three-dimensional positioning life detection, prevent the distortion of pulse waves and improve the definition of three-dimensional simulated images and the strength of received weak signals.

title_en: Geogrid with Having a Function of Ground Sink Detection and Falling Accident Prevention
title_ko: 땅 꺼짐 탐지 및 추락 사고 방지 기능을 갖는 지오그리드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geogrid with a ground sink detecting function and a falling accident preventing function, which is able to detect sinking of the ground in accordance with changes in the terrain below a road, prevent a falling accident by notifying authorities of the position with a risk of sinking of the ground and prevent a vehicle and a person from falling into a space formed due to the ground sinking. When sinking of the ground (17) where a net mat (100) is buried proceeds, the current situation occurs directly before the sinking of the ground, or when sinking of the ground has occurred, a coordinate is formed on a power cable (150) of the net mat (100) to check the corresponding position by an arranged sensor (200). Thus, there is an effect to prevent an accident caused by the ground sinking.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 하부에서 지형의 변화에 따른 땅 꺼짐을 탐지하고, 땅 꺼짐 위험 위치를 통보해주어 추락 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있으며, 땅 꺼짐이 발생하더라도 이로 인해 생긴 공간으로 차량 및 인명이 추락하는 것을 방지할 수 있는 땅 꺼짐 탐지 및 추락 사고 방지 기능을 갖는 지오그리드에 관한 것으로, 그물 매트(100)가 매설된 지반(17)의 땅 꺼짐이 진행되고 있거나, 또는 땅 꺼짐이 발생하기 직전 상태에 있거나, 또는 땅 꺼짐이 발생했을 경우, 그물 매트(100)의 전원 케이블(150) 상에 좌표를 형성하여 배치된 탐지 센서(200)로 해당 위치를 확인할 수 있고, 땅 꺼짐으로 발생할 수 있는 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Signal processing method and apparatus for ultra wide band ground penetrating radar based land mine detection
title_ko: 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for detecting a landmine based on ultra-wideband ground penetrating radar, which comprises: a training process for generating a background signal model by collecting data in an area where landmines are not buried and in an area where landmines are buried while recognizing the landmines; and a detecting process that detects the landmines by using the background signal model acquired through the training process without recognizing the landmines.
