abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지뢰 매설을 인지한 상태에서 지뢰가 매설되지 않은 영역과 지뢰가 매설된 영역의 데이터를 수집하여 배경 신호 모델을 생성하는 훈련 과정과, 지뢰 매설을 인지하지 못한 상태에서 훈련 과정을 통해 획득한 배경 신호 모델을 이용하여 지뢰를 탐지하는 탐지 과정을 포함하는 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: Multi radar sendor-based biosignal measurement system
title_ko: 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템
abstract_ko: 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템은 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서로 구성되고 상기 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서를 이용하여 피검체의 생체 신호를 감지하는 멀티 센서부, 및 상기 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서 중 어느 하나의 레이더 센서를 선택하고 상기 선택된 레이더 센서에 의해 감지된 생체 신호를 수신하여 분석하는 신호 분석부를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart door lock with multi-factor authentication
title_ko: 다중 요소 인증을 적용한 스마트 도어락
abstract_ko: 다중 요소 인증(Multi-Factor-Authentication)을 적용한 스마트 도어락이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 다중 요소 인증을 적용한 스마트 도어락은, 사용자의 생체 신호를 추출하는 제1 센서부; 사용자의 지문 이미지를 추출하는 제2 센서부; 사용자의 얼굴 표면을 스캔하여 얼굴 이미지를 획득하는 제3 센서부; 및 생체 신호, 지문 이미지 및 얼굴 이미지를 심층신경망 기반의 생체신호 인증모델, 지문 인증모델 및 얼굴 인증모델에 각각 적용하여 사용자 인증을 수행하는 프로세서;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 다중 요소 인증 방식을 적용하여, 생체 신호, 지문 이미지 및 얼굴 이미지를 기반으로 사용자 인증을 수행함으로써, 기존의 단일 요소 인증의 보안 취약점을 보완할 수 있다. 더불어, 피부 습도에 따라서 상반된 인식률을 가진 두 생체요소(지문 및 생체 신호)를 대상으로 습도 수치에 따라 가중치를 적용하고, 조도를 기준으로 얼굴 이미지(안면 인식 요소)에 가중치를 적용하여 개인 인증의 정확도를 안정적으로 유지할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of Wearable air filtering purifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Wearable air filtering purifier, comprise main frame, USB discharge port, USB charge port, power supply and speed-regulating switch, power supply indicator, sensor signal interface, composite guide tracheae, respiration transducer and single-pass mouth mask; Described composite guide tracheae one end is inserted in main frame air outlet, and another end is connected with respiration transducer, and side, main frame bottom is provided with some air inlets; Described USB discharge port, USB charge port, power supply and speed-regulating switch, power supply indicator and sensor signal interface are successively set on main frame one side from the bottom to top, and are connected with the control circuit wire be arranged in main frame; It is in conjunction with breathing detection technology, air filtration technology and power management techniques, Miniaturization Design clarifier main frame and stealth composite guide tracheae and mouth mask or facial gas operated device, efficiently solve battery long continuation of the journey working time and air purifier at the volley or have the technical barrier used in wind environment.

title_en: Microseism monitoring equipment of semiconductor equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor device microseism monitoring device, and relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring devices. The utility model comprises the following steps: the top of pre-buried bucket is connected with coupling mechanism, and the bottom of pre-buried bucket inner wall is connected with the butt platform, and the top of butt platform is provided with the sensor, and the both sides of pre-buried bucket inner wall all are connected with fixed establishment, and the top of sensor is connected with the bracing piece, and the top activity of bracing piece runs through connection and mechanism and extends to coupling mechanism's outside. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the connecting ring, the fixing clamp, the slot and the fixing groove, when the embedded barrel needs to be sealed, the fixing ring is rotated by rotating the fixing ring to drive the fixing clamp to rotate, so that the fixing ring and the connecting ring are fixed, the embedded barrel can be sealed, and the problem that the bolt is blocked and cannot be opened due to rust fall of the top of the embedded barrel in a humid environment is avoided; through cooperation of the fixing semi-rings, the mounting groove plates, the positioning plates, the connecting rods and the like, stability of the sensor can be improved.

title_en: Cable digital display synchronous fixed point path instrument and fixed point method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable digital display synchronous fixed point path instrument and a fixed point method thereof, relates to the field of cable detection, and provides a detecting instrument for insulating fault points of a buried power cable. The detecting instrument comprises an electromagnetic wave sensor, a sound wave vibrating sensor, a data processor, a range display and an audio frequency amplifier, wherein the electromagnetic wave sensor and the sound wave vibrating sensor are connected with the data processor respectively; the electromagnetic wave sensor is used for sending the received electromagnetic waves transmitted from cable radiation to the data processor for processing; the sound wave vibrating sensor is used for sending the received fault point earthquake waves transmitted from the underground to the data processor for processing; the data processor is connected with the range display for information exchange; the electromagnetic wave sensor and a sound sensor are adopted to send received electromagnetic wave signals and earthquake waves to the data processor for processing; processed data information is displayed by the range display.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Space-ground-air integrated coordinated search and rescue system suitable for complex mountain scenic areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-ground-air integrated coordinated search and rescue system suitable for complex mountain scenic areas, and relates to the technical field of tourism safety. The three-dimensional rescue mode of multiple dimensions is erected, and a rescue auxiliary information system acts as a decision command hub so that integration and coordination of a search and rescue technology platform are facilitated, and a tourism safety guarantee technology integrated framework for the complex mountain scenic areas can be formed. Vital sign information is acquired through a front-end sign sensor, and a stable and reliable communication link is established by using the "space-air-ground" coordinated search and rescue communication system so that the problem of transmission of the search and rescue signals of the complex mountain scenic areas can be solved, finally the system is connected to a background server side to process and analyze emergency rescue decision information and thus the "space-air-ground" (integrated) coordinated search and rescue command mode for the complex mountain scenic areas is established.

title_en: One kind being suitable for tunnel-liner automatic checkout system and method
abstract_en: Present disclose provides one kind to be suitable for tunnel-liner automatic checkout system and method, automatic sweep apparatus is coupled including the pre-buried rail unit of segmented and radar antenna, the pre-buried rail unit of segmented includes multiple segmented guide rails and embedded bracket, each embedded bracket lifts a segmented guide rail, inside the pre-buried position to be measured in one end of embedded bracket, the pre-buried guide rail linear of segmented is arranged as coupling the mobile track of automatic sweep apparatus for radar antenna；It includes geological radar, elastic component and walking mechanism that radar antenna, which couples automatic sweep apparatus, the walking mechanism is parallel to the traffic direction of radar antenna, elastic component is laid between walking mechanism and radar antenna, and radar antenna progress lining quality detection on the track of the pre-buried rail unit composition of the segmented is lifted by walking mechanism.

title_en: Multi-mode composite detection system for sensing environment behind non-visual obstacle
abstract_en: A multimode composite detection system for non-visual obstacle rear environment perception, comprising: the sensor array comprises a through-wall radar sensor array and a partition listening sensor array, wherein the through-wall radar sensor array is used for generating and radiating electromagnetic wave signals and receiving, reducing frequency and filtering echo signals, and the partition listening sensor array is used for receiving sound signals in a detection area, filtering and amplifying; the sensor control and data acquisition and preprocessing platform is used for carrying out detection control on the front-end sensor array, acquiring and digitizing received data and carrying out filtering and matrix transformation on the digitized data; and the signal processing and fusion decision platform is used for processing the signals received by the sensor array, inputting the processing result of the sensor array into the fusion decision module for fusion decision, and giving out the final detection result of the system. The invention has the advantages of improving the detection probability and precision, improving the detection efficiency, improving the environment adaptability and the like.
assignees: ANTI-TERRORIST AND SWAT CORPS OF BEIJING MUNICIPAL PUBLIC SECURITY BUREAU;HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact heartbeat and respiration detection equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact heartbeat and respiration detection device based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises: helmet shells and helmet liners. The invention has the beneficial effects that: if the contact switch in the monitoring device is started for multiple times, the central processing unit starts the electronic gas generator to inflate the airbag, so that the impact force generated when the head of the riding person collides with the ground is reduced; when the riding personnel are collided and in a dangerous condition, the heart rate and the respiration intensity of the riding personnel can be judged by the millimeter wave radar, the starting times of the contact switch are obtained, the heart rate, the respiration intensity and the turning rough times of the riding personnel can be quickly transmitted and submitted to an emergency center, and meanwhile, the geographic position information is provided; the portable on-site first-aid equipment can be conveniently selected by the first-aid center according to the situation, the first-aid center can quickly arrive at the place where the accident happens and can be used for carrying out first-aid, and the survival rate of riding personnel when the riding personnel collide is improved; higher numbers of contact switch actuations indicate a greater risk to heart rate and respiration intensity.

title_en: Recuperation monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recuperation monitoring method and a system based on a millimeter wave radar, which relate to the technical field of recuperation monitoring and solve the technical problem that in the prior art, a recuperation patient cannot be timely analyzed according to vital sign parameters in a recuperation process in a recuperation period in real time; monitoring and analyzing the vital sign parameters of the rehabilitation process of the analysis object, and judging whether the rehabilitation state of the analysis object in the rehabilitation period is qualified or not, thereby carrying out rehabilitation monitoring on the analysis object in the rehabilitation period.
assignees: YIHUIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Error correction method for random body movement of target in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an error correction method for random body movement of targets in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection, which comprises the steps of separating signals of each target from radar echo signals; tracking echo signals in each target detection time; correcting respiratory heartbeat detection errors caused by random body movement of the target during detection based on a distance alignment and phase compensation algorithm; extracting a phase signal of a target, and decomposing the phase signal into N modes by using a successive variation mode decomposition algorithm; and identifying K modules corresponding to the vital signs, and reconstructing respiratory signals and heartbeat signals according to the K modules. The method can realize the simultaneous detection of the vital signs of a plurality of targets in the radar visual field range; the detection error caused by random movement of the target body in the radar detection process is corrected; the respiratory heartbeat signal of the target is extracted by adopting the successive variation modal decomposition algorithm, the number of modalities is not required to be set in advance, and the convergence speed is higher compared with that of the variation modal decomposition algorithm.

title_en: Omnibearing three-dimensional life monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an omnibearing three-dimensional life monitoring system, which aims to solve the technical problem that the current life monitoring system needs to be worn, and mainly comprises front-end acquisition equipment, edge computing equipment and a background server; the invention adopts a completely unconstrained and non-contact monitoring mode to monitor the change condition of each data of vital signs of a suspected person in real time, and simultaneously monitors the state and vital sign data of a target in real time by accessing audio and video data, radar data and optical fiber positioning data through an intelligent monitoring sensing device equipped for rooms and beds to infer the psychological condition of the target and discover abnormal timely automatic alarm. Once any sudden illness or sudden situation appears in personnel, the intelligent monitoring sensing device can monitor the change that the health produced in the first time to in time the police on duty is informed in the alarm, effectively promotes prevention and control factor of safety, reduces the nurse risk.

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vital sign detection device and method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining radar multi-antenna zero-speed distance FFT signals, selecting a first radar signal from the radar multi-antenna zero-speed distance FFT signals, generating amplitude characteristics and phase characteristics of the first radar signal, generating multi-segment candidate physiological signals by using a detection model based on a deep neural network according to the amplitude characteristics and the phase characteristics, selecting target physiological signals from the multi-segment candidate physiological signals, and detecting vital sign parameters according to the target physiological signals. Thereby, the accuracy of the vital sign detection result can be improved.

title_en: Electronic device for determining vital signs of a user and method of operating the same
abstract_en: An electronic device is provided that determines vital signs when a user is active. The electronic device includes: a first sensor for sensing vital signs of the user; a second sensor for sensing an activity of the user; and at least one processor connected to the first sensor and the second sensor. The at least one processor may be configured to: identifying a vital sign determined by a first signal, the first signal being acquired by a first sensor; normalizing the vital sign to correspond to the activity characteristic of the user based on the vital sign determined by the first signal and the activity level of the user determined using the second signal acquired by the second sensor; and combining the vital sign determined by the first signal with the normalized vital sign to determine a combined vital sign.

title_en: FMCW radar vital signal detection method based on ESOA-VMD algorithm and fuzzy logic reasoning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a FMCW radar vital signal detection method based on ESOA-VMD algorithm and fuzzy logic reasoning, comprising the following steps: s1: preprocessing an FMCW radar echo signal to extract a plurality of phase signals with vital signs in the echo signal; s2: extracting phase signals with vital signs in the echo signals in a reference range, and respectively processing the phase signals to obtain a plurality of corresponding modal components; s3: and screening out the modal components corresponding to the respiratory signal and the modal components corresponding to the heartbeat signal from the modal components to obtain the respiratory modal components and the heartbeat modal components, thereby obtaining the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal. The method realizes the detection of the vital sign signals, overcomes the inconvenience of contact detection, reduces the interference of respiratory harmonics and intermodulation waves on heartbeat signals, and effectively improves the accuracy of the extraction of the vital sign signals.
assignees: SHENZHEN LIANRUI MAITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection device, method and system
abstract_en: To provide a vital sign detection device, method and system.SOLUTION: The device comprises: a first calculation unit for calculating, on the basis of the reflected signal of a microwave radar within a first prescribed time range, the phase distribution of a distance FFT signal at the presence position of a living body that changes with the passage of time; an unwrapping unit for performing phase unwrapping on the phase distribution; a first determination unit for determining all local extremum points of the phase distribution after phase unwrapping on the basis of a prescribed time window, the time window being determined on the basis of the respiration or heartbeat cycle range of the living body; a uniformization unit for performing an amplitude uniformizing process on a phase distribution between each pair of adjacent local extremum points; and a second calculation unit for calculating the frequency of respiration or heartbeat of the living body on the basis of the phase distribution after the amplitude uniformizing process.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Emotion Interaction based on Bio-Signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 기반의 감성 인터랙션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emotion signal sensing device which includes a sensor unit which senses an environment signal and a bio-signal by the emotion change of a user, a signal processing unit which converts the sensed bio-signal and environment signal into digital signals and outputs the digital signals, and a control unit which generates emotion information by using the digital signals outputted from the signal processing unit and transmits the generated emotion information to an emotion service providing apparatus or an emotion signal sensing device of another user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감성 신호 감지 장치로, 사용자의 감성 변화에 의한 생체 신호와 환경 신호를 감지하는 센서부와, 상기 감지한 생체 신호와 환경 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하여 출력하는 신호 처리부와, 상기 신호 처리부로부터 출력되는 디지털 신호를 이용하여 감성 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 감성 정보를 다른 사용자의 감성 신호 감지 장치 또는 감성 서비스 제공 장치에 전달하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Detachable living body signal complex sensor and method for detecting information of the living body using the same
title_ko: 착탈 가능한 생체 신호 복합 센서 및 이를 이용한 생체 정보 검출 방법
abstract_en: A detachable biometric signal complex sensor has a circuit module for biometric signal sensing and signal processing with regard to a subject embedded therein. The detachable biometric signal complex sensor comprises: a clip type structure including a first plate and a second plate having one side thereof connected to the first plate to form a pair of claws; and a blood pressure sensor and a plurality of electrodes arranged on an external surface of the clip type structure.
abstract_ko: 착탈식 생체 신호 복합 센서는 피검체에 대한 생체 신호 센싱 및 신호 처리를 위한 회로 모듈이 내장된 것으로, 제 1 평판과, 상기 제 1 평판과 일측이 연결되어 한 쌍의 집게발 형태를 형성하는 제 2 평판을 포함하는 클립형 구조물; 상기 클립형 구조물의 외측면에 배치된 혈압 센서 및 복수의 전극;을 포함한다.

title_en: Devices and methods for noninvasive physiological analysis
title_ko: 비 침습 생체 신호 분석 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a physiological signal analysis device and method to detect physiological information of a subject. The physiological signal analysis device includes: a memory device configured to store a wrinkle pattern at a measurement position of the subject as a reference position; a measurement position sensor configured to periodically sense the reference position; and a physiological signal sensor configured to sense a physiological signal at the reference position if the stored reference position enters a range of the measurement position sensor; a signal processor configured to process signals of the measurement position sensor and the physiological signal sensor; and a display configured to display the physiological signal measured by the physiological signal sensor. The physiological signal analysis device of the present invention includes the measurement position sensor capable of sensing a measurement position to measure a physiological signal corresponding to a consistent measurement position, thereby performing a consistent and accurate analysis of health information.
abstract_ko: 피검체의 생체 정보를 검출하는 생체 신호 분석 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 생체 신호 분석 장치는 피검체의 측정 위치의 주름모양을 기준위치로 저장하는 기억장치; 기준위치를 주기적으로 감지하는 측정 위치 감지부; 저장된 기준위치가 측정 위치 감지부의 범위 내에 들어오면 기준위치의 생체신호를 감지하는 생체 신호 감지부; 상기 측정 위치 감지부와 상기 생체 신호 감지부의 신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 상기 생체 신호 감지부에 의해 측정된 생체 신호를 표시하는 표시부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Animal health monitor device, system and method
abstract_en: Animal health monitor device, system and method An animal health monitor device 1 for monitoring the health and/or one or more vital signs of an animal 10 comprises: an attachment means 2 for attaching the animal health monitor device 1 to the animal 10; a sensing means 3 configured to output raw sensor data; and a processing means 4 configured to produce processed output data from the raw sensor data. The sensing means 3 comprises a plurality of contact means for applying an alternating current to the skin of the animal 10 and measuring a voltage across the skin of the animal 10. Each contact means comprises at least one electrode configured for extending through hair or fur. The processed output data comprises at least one output signal indicative of the health and/or one or more vital signs of the animal 10.

title_en: Imaging system using infrared light
abstract_en: An imaging system is disclosed for imaging buried structure, typically vasculature, below the surface of an object which can be skin, fat deposits, or other material and for projecting an image of the buried structure onto the surface of the object. Scanning lasers are used both to illuminate the object and to project an image onto it. One or more photodiodes measure the intensity of scattered and reflected light to create an image in conjunction with one or more of the scanning lasers.
assignees: LUMINETX CORP;ZEMAN HERBERT D;LOVHOIDEN GUNNAR;BERRYHILL JEFF D

title_en: Human condition detecting device
abstract_en: A human condition detection device comprises a depth image-taking module for taking a depth image of a target area. A millimeter-wave radar module detects breaths or heartbeats in the target area to provide a signal. A thermal image-taking module takes a thermal image of the target area. A processor module determines whether a person is in the target area based on the depth image. The processor module determines whether there is any breath or heartbeat based on the signal if a person is in the target area. The processor module determines whether there is any abnormal vital sign of the person in the target area based on the signal and the thermal image if there is a breath or heartbeat in the target area. The processor module actuates the warning module to provide a warning if there is an abnormal vital sign of the person in the target area.

title_en: A kind of elevator faults security escape system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of elevator faults security escape systems, including car, multiple sensors and electric life controller, the fault detection module being connected on the connection between car and electric life controller；It is provided with the failure safe control module of fault-detection data interface, pattern switching control interface, communication network interface, life-information data-interface；With the operational mode handover module of pattern switching control interface communication connection；Connecting fault information sending module is communicated with communication network interface；With the vital signs detection module of life-information data-interface communication connection；The intercom module being connected with failure safe control module, above-mentioned elevator faults security escape system, can realize in Lift out of order, and trapped person is made to go out ladder safely in time, reduce passenger and occurred on the event among car.

title_en: Method, system and electronic equipment for removing static background and trend items of life detection radar echo signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and electronic equipment for removing static background and trend items of a life detection radar echo signal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring life detection radar echo data and acquiring an original echo matrix; taking the maximum value position of each column in the obtained original echo matrix as a segmentation marking point; segmenting each row of the original echo matrix; then, fitting by using a polynomial to obtain static background and trend item estimation; and subtracting the static background and the trend item estimation by using the original echo matrix to obtain an enhanced signal matrix. The method can accurately estimate the signal trend term introduced by the instability of radar hardware, and can effectively reduce the influence of non-stationary interference on the target signal.

title_en: Method and apparatus for matching vital sign information to a concurrently recorded data set
abstract_en: An approach is provided for matching vital sign information to a concurrently recorded data set according to a time domain. The approach involves determining sensor information collected from one or more sensors configured to monitor one or more vital signs of one or more objects within a monitored area. The approach also involves processing and/or facilitating a processing of the sensor information to detect the one or more objects and to track the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects over a time domain. The approach further involves matching the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects to a concurrently recorded data set based on the time domain. The approach further involves storing at least one record of the one or more vital signs matched to the concurrently recorded data set.

title_en: Radar-based single target vital sensing
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: generating a target displacement signal indicative of a movement of a human target based on raw digital data generated by a millimeter-wave radar sensor; and estimating a vital sign of the human target based on the target displacement signal, where generating the target displacement signal includes: generating target in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) (I/Q) data associated with the human target based on the raw digital data, classifying the target I/Q data as high quality data or as low quality data using a first neural network, when the target I/Q data is classified as low quality data, discarding the target I/Q data, when the target I/Q data is classified as high quality data, performing ellipse fitting on the target I/Q data to generate compensated I/Q data, and generating the target displacement signal based on the compensated I/Q data.
assignees: INFINEON TECHNOLOGIES AG;UNIV FRIEDRICH ALEXANDER ER

title_en: Plateau visitor succours intelligent terminal system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of plateau visitor and succour intelligent terminal system, relate to intelligence rescue technique field, including wisdom rescue box and intelligent terminal based on mobile platform, wisdom rescue box comprises condition sensor, main control module, bluetooth module, wifi module, Big Dipper positioning and communicating module and power module；Condition sensor passes to main control module by bluetooth module the signal detected, location information and the sign information of distress personnel are passed to back-end server by Big Dipper short message communication module by main control module again.This utility model obtains vital sign information by front end condition sensor, Beidou navigation communication module is utilized to set up reliable and stable short message communication, solve the transmission problem without public network area of coverage search and rescue signal, it is eventually connected to back-end server end, establishes a kind of plateau visitor based on mobile platform and succour intelligent terminal system.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network, it includes vital sign module (1), gyro module (2), microprocessor module (6) and ad hoc network transmission module (7), vital sign module (1) is located at the inside of the helmet, vital sign module (1) includes photoelectric sensor (4) and temperature sensor (5), the photoelectric sensor (4) is through epidermis for detecting heart rate, and temperature sensor (5) is for measuring head skin temperature；Gyro module (2) is used to detect movement, the attitude data information of people；Vital sign module (1), the information conveyance of gyro module (2) detection are given microprocessor module (6), and microprocessor module (6) sends the data received by ad hoc network transmission module (7)；The utility model makes Fire Command Center more accurately understand the state of fire fighter, and can make the decision to rescue and relief work faster.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU ZHONGLI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Minimize the life-detection instrument of visible light and the fusion of LONG WAVE INFRARED two-waveband video
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the life-detection instruments of a kind of miniaturization visible light and the fusion of LONG WAVE INFRARED two-waveband video, belong to life detection and rescue field.In the radiation of visible light to environment to be measured that the lighting source of the present invention is sent out, spectroscope is reflected by the object in environment；The infra-red radiation that object is sent out in environment simultaneously is irradiated at spectroscope；Visible light and infra-red radiation are split mirror reflection or transmission respectively, are then received respectively by miniature visual light imaging component and small-sized LONG WAVE INFRARED image-forming assembly；Miniature visual light imaging component and small-sized LONG WAVE INFRARED image-forming assembly give the Image Real-time Transmission of each self-forming to image co-registration component, are merged by image co-registration component, and the video of infrared and visible light fusion is formed.The present invention can generate the infrared colour merged with visible light or black and white video information in real time, can detect trapped person's vital sign and its local environment situation, have the mechanical-optical setup thus small volume of light path altogether.

title_en: Sign contactless intelligent monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sign non-contact intelligent monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein a millimeter wave radar front-end module transmits and receives millimeter wave radar signals and is connected with a signal processing module; the signal processing module is connected with the communication interface module, analyzes the sampled and quantized echo signals to obtain vital sign data of a tested person, including respiratory and heartbeat frequency parameters, and transmits a processed information result to an upper computer through the communication interface module; the upper computer compares the received vital sign data with preset data, uploads the data and a comparison result to the background server, sends an alarm to the mobile terminal if the comparison result is abnormal, and automatically alarms when the comparison result exceeds a preset maximum value. The invention realizes real-time intelligent monitoring of vital signs of the old people indoors, including monitoring of breathing and heartbeat parameters, and realizes real-time alarm when abnormality occurs so as to prevent accidents.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar signal motion noise removing method based on total variation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar signal motion noise removing method based on total variation, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a thoracic cavity signal containing motion noise by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, rearranging and converting the thoracic cavity signal into a gray level map; S2, after acquiring a chest image containing noise, respectively calculating second-order gradient information of the image in different directions, S3, according to the gradient information in different directions, obtaining sparse characteristics of noise and a bottom image structure, respectively designing a transverse second-order regularization constraint term and a longitudinal second-order regularization constraint term by introducing an Lp pseudo-norm, simultaneously designing a global sparse constraint term based on the priori characteristic of the noise, and S4, restoring the denoised image into a one-dimensional chest signal. According to the method, the sparse characteristics of the motion noise and the underlying image structure are fully utilized, the Lp pseudo-norms are introduced to better describe the sparse characteristics, the motion noise is effectively removed, and the detailed characteristics of the chest signals are better reserved.

title_en: Sickbed with intelligent monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a sickbed with an intelligent monitoring system, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances. The sickbed with the intelligent monitoring system comprises a sickbed body, an environmental field analysis module, a medical equipment signal multiplexing module, a multi-mode data fusion engine and a clinical decision module, wherein the environmental field analysis module comprises an electromagnetic field monitoring unit, a sound field imaging unit and a thermal field entropy change analysis unit. The technology adopts a non-contact type multi-physical-field monitoring technology, thoroughly avoids the skin injury risk caused by a contact type sensor, realizes omnibearing and accurate monitoring of vital signs such as respiration, heart rate, body temperature and the like by deeply mining the multi-source heterogeneous data value of medical equipment, and provides a more efficient monitoring mode for clinical monitoring.

title_en: face mask
title_ko: 페이스 마스크
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a face mask, which displays various information collected through a sensor on a lens part penetrating the front to display the same to a wearer in a face mask used in various water leisure or disaster environments and provides a warning. According to the present invention, the face mask includes: a frame sealing a face surface; a lens part arranged in front of the frame to penetrate the front; a sensor part collecting body information and outside information; an outputting part outputting the information collected by the sensor part to the lens part; and a control part receiving the body information and the outside information collected from the sensor part to control the outputting part to output the same and controlling the outputting part to output the processed information obtained through the body information and the outside information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각종 수중 레저 또는 재난 환경에서 사용되는 페이스 마스크에서 전방을 투시하는 렌즈부에 센서를 통해 수집된 다양한 정보들을 디스플레이하여 착용자에게 표시하고, 경고하기 위한 페이스 마스크에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 페이스 마스크는 안면을 밀폐하는 프레임, 프레임의 전방에 배치되어 전방을 투시하는 렌즈부, 신체 정보 및 외부 정보를 수집하는 센서부, 센서부에 의해 수집된 정보를 렌즈부에 출력하는 출력부, 센서부로부터 수집된 신체 정보 및 외부 정보를 전달받아 출력부가 출력하도록 제어하고, 신체 정보 및 외부 정보를 통해 획득한 가공 정보를 출력부가 출력하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Contactless detection and monitoring system of vital signs of vehicle occupants
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and systems for detecting vital signs of occupants in vehicles, for example, the vehicle cabin. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receiving the radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to vibration data of the vehicle, to produce a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine the vital signs of the occupant.

title_en: Through-wall radar sensors networked together to create 2d and 3d combined views of an area
abstract_en: Systems and methods for networking together through-wall radar sensors to generate a combined image based on signal data from the networked through-wall radar sensors. The system includes a first through-wall radar sensor and a second through-wall radar sensor. The second through-wall radar sensor is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor. The system includes a display of an area, wherein the display of the area is based on data from the first through-wall radar sensor combined with data from the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a first communication device connected to the first through-wall radar sensor and a second communication device connected to the second through-wall radar sensor. A controller is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor and the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a plurality of through-wall radar sensors networked together to provide a two-dimensional or a three-dimensional image of an area.

title_en: Terahertz wave plethysmography
abstract_en: Terahertz wave plethysmography provides a new principle of radar-based vital sign detection. This disclosure presents new applications at terahertz (THz) frequency band for non-contact cardiac sensing. For the first time, cardiac pulse information is shown to be simultaneously extracted based on two established principles using unique THz waves. A novel concept of Terahertz-Wave-Plethysmography (TPG) is introduced, which detects blood volume changes in the upper dermis tissue layer by measuring the reflectance of THz waves, similar to the existing remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) principle. A detailed analysis of pulse measurement using THz is provided. The TPG principle is justified by scientific deduction and carefully designed experimental demonstrations. Additionally, pulse measurements from various peripheral body regions of interest (ROIs), including palm, inner elbow, temple, fingertip, and forehead, are demonstrated using a novel ultra-wideband (UWB) THz sensing system.
assignees: RONG YU;THEOFANOPOULOS PANAGIOTIS;TRICHOPOULOS GEORGIOS;BLISS DANIEL W;UNIV ARIZONA STATE

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluation of a subject's emotional, physiological and/or physical state with the subject's physiological and/or acoustic data
abstract_en: Embodiments of the subject invention relate to a method and apparatus for remote evaluation of a subject's emotive and/or physiological state. Embodiments can utilize a device that can be used to determine the emotional and/or physiological state of a subject through the measurement and analysis of vital signs and/or speech. A specific embodiment relates to a device capable of remotely acquiring a subject's physiological and/or acoustic data, and then correlating and analyzing the data to provide an assessment of a subject's emotional and/or physiological state. In a further specific embodiment, the device can acquire such data, correlate and analyze the data, and provide the assessment of the subject's emotional state and/or physiological in real time.
assignees: UNIV FLORIDA;SHRIVASTAV RAHUL;LIN JENSHAN;ZAWOY KARL;PATEL SONA

title_en: Multi-object tracking method after a kind of through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The present invention provides multi-object tracking method after a kind of through-wall radar imaging, can in certain allowable error fast imaging, obtain better quality imaging results；The target location algorithm for involving Image erosion based on two-dimensional low pass can efficiently extract adjustment location information and amplitude information；Finally target is carried out using nearest FIELD Data association algorithm.Meanwhile, the track algorithm of interactive multi-model has fully taken into account the high maneuverability of target, and target tracking accuracy is high.

title_en: Graphene-based life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene-based life detector which comprises an infrared sensor, a telescopic mechanical arm, a signal processing unit and an alarm, wherein the infrared sensor is fixed at the front end of the telescopic mechanical arm, and the infrared sensor and the alarm are respectively connected with the signal processing unit. The infrared sensor is a regular icosahedron structure consisting of triangles, the surface of the regular icosahedron structure is a photoelectric device consisting of a semiconductor, a plurality of graphene films and an infrared filter layer, the semiconductor is used as a substrate, the graphene films are laid on the semiconductor, and finally the infrared filter layer is plated. By the regular icosahedron substrate structure, life signs in the ruins after a natural disaster are searched for with as large a specific surface area as possible exposed to the environment. The response distance of the life detector is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the sensitivity and the use convenience of infrared response are also improved.

title_en: Low-rank block sparse decomposition-based vital signal enhancement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital signal enhancement method based on low-rank block sparse decomposition, and belongs to the technical field of radar detection. According to the characteristics of the respiratory signal and the noise signal between different frames in the time domain echo, the method firstly divides the echo signal into two parts of low rank and block sparse signals in the time domain, fully utilizes the characteristics of the life signal between different frame data, then decomposes the signals by using an alternate direction method, minimizes the distortion of the life signal while suppressing the noise, extracts the required block sparse part from the preprocessed echo data, and further realizes the life signal enhancement. The method processes in the time domain, uses a projection scheme to perform acceleration operation in the solving process, enhances the respiratory signal while suppressing noise in the time domain echo signal, enables the extraction of the respiratory signal under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio to be possible, and can be cascaded with other frequency domain processing methods in the follow-up process, thereby remarkably improving the result.

title_en: Smart watch
abstract_en: Systems and methods include a cellular, WiFi, and Bluetooth transceiver coupled to a processor; an accelerometer or a motion sensor coupled to the processor; and a sensor coupled to the processor to sense mood or body vital sign; and a wearable device operating wirelessly with the processor, wherein the wearable device includes at least one sensor coupled to a back of the wearable device and wherein the wearable device recognizes and executes a speech command.

title_en: Airborne systems and detection methods localization and production of images of buried objects and characterization of the composition of the subsurface
abstract_en: Airborne systems and methods for the detection, location and obtaining of images of buried objects and for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. The systems comprise at least one aerial module with a radar unit that emits and/or captures radar signals and a positioning and guidance system with an accuracy equal to or less than 3 cm, and a ground station with a flight control system and a radar signal processing unit where radar signal processing algorithms are applied. The invention also comprises a method for the detection, localization and obtaining of images of buried objects and a method for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. Applicable in sectors where it is necessary to perform the detection of buried objects, as for example in civil applications (detection of antipersonnel mines), pipeline inspection or in archaeology.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted ultra-wideband radar systems and methods
abstract_en: Vehicle-mounted UWB systems and/or methods for detecting mines and other explosive devices are provided. In certain exemplary embodiments, a system for detecting non-buried mines and/or improvised explosive devices is provided. Distance measuring equipment may be configured to track movement of the system. Substantially forward-looking bistatic antenna transceivers may be capable of collecting range-magnitude radar data over two channels. A first transceiver may capture radar data for a first area, and a second transceiver may capture radar data for a second area. A processor may be configured to: derive range resolution data and cross-range resolution data from the range-magnitude radar data; focus the range resolution data and the cross-range resolution data, based at least on the distance data and an antenna beamwidth pattern associated with the antenna transceivers; and, “and” data for portions of the first area and the second area that overlap.

title_en: Swarm type ad hoc network slope inclination state monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a swarm type ad hoc network slope inclination state monitoring device; the method comprises the following steps: the shell is an engineering plastic cube; the inclination angle sensor chip is arranged in the shell and used for monitoring the inclination change of the side slope to obtain side slope inclination data; the wireless communication module is arranged in the shell, is connected with the tilt angle sensor chip and is used for forming a swarm type network by the ad hoc network; the slope inclination data is transmitted to the remote terminal; and the battery is arranged in the shell and is respectively connected with the tilt angle sensor chip and the wireless communication module. The utility model discloses the adoption that can solve the existence is monitored the side slope tilt state with pre-buried inclinometer, needs to spend longer engineering time, can not satisfy the technical problem of the anti-disaster requirement of speedily carrying out rescue work under the emergency.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Out-of-plane rigidity variable metal damper with earthquake monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an off-plate rigidity variable metal damper with earthquake monitoring function. The utility model discloses an energy consumption metal sheet, friction plate, the long support of first box type, the long support of second box type, the short support of box type, sensor, high strength bolt, nut, gasket, pre-buried steel sheet of connecting, connection bending resistance steel sheet, threaded bolt hole, anchor assembly, shear bolt, bending resistance bolt, pre-buried I shaped steel. The damper in the utility model is arranged in a structural member, does not bear the initial gravity load of the structure, and can provide the external rigidity for the energy-consuming metal plate; detecting the damage condition of the damper by using a sensor when the damper is subjected to vibration load; the damper is connected by adopting a full bolt, so that the replacement is convenient; the damper support and the embedded component are separately controlled by bending and shearing, so that the overall performance of the damper is improved.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Multifunctional post-disaster detection trolley
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional post-disaster detection trolley which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is connected with a crawler wheel assembly, the crawler wheel assembly is connected with an accelerating motor, the crawler wheel assembly is connected with a decelerating motor, the bottom plate is connected with a power supply, the bottom plate is connected with a detection assembly, the bottom plate is connected with a manipulator, the bottom plate is connected with a material assembly, the material assembly comprises a rotating motor, a screw rod and a material box, the material box is connected with a sealing assembly, and the sealing assembly comprises an electric telescopic rod and a sealing block. According to the utility model, a victim is prompted by the buzzer, the sound source of the victim is identified by the sound identification module, the position and the vital sign of the victim are detected by the radar life detector, the infrared equipment and the camera, the robot is used for cleaning the obstacle, the screw rod is driven to rotate by the rotating motor, so that the material box is driven to move, the material is conveniently sent to the front of the victim, and the electric telescopic rod drives the sealing block to move, so that the victim can drink water conveniently.

title_en: Be used to monitor the method and system of the vital sign of seated person
abstract_en: Disclose a kind of method, may further comprise the steps: used to be deployed on the seat belt or to be integrated into the vital sign that a plurality of Doppler radars in the seat belt come seated person in the seat of monitoring equipment motor vehicle.Disclosed method is monitored vital sign without being noticed, such as the heart rate and the breath state of seated person in the motor vehicles.Can realize a plurality of Secure Application and healthy the application.Each example is: detect driver's moment sleep, the monitoring of the vital sign under the vehicle accident situation and use biofeedback to loosen exercise, thereby reduce driver's pressure.

title_en: Imaging system using infrared light
abstract_en: An imaging system is disclosed for imaging a buried structure, typically a vascular structure, beneath the surface of a target, which may be skin, fatty deposits or other material, and for projecting an image of the buried structure onto the surface of the target. A scanning laser is used to illuminate the target and project an image onto the target. One or more photodiodes measure the intensity of scattered and reflected light to produce an image in conjunction with one or more scanning lasers.

title_en: Wireless sensor network-based maritime search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless sensor network-based maritime search and rescue system which comprises a wireless sensor network, a wireless communication sink node, a communication base station and a search and rescue network center, wherein the wireless sensor network transmits data to the wireless communication sink node, the wireless communication sink node transmits the data to the communication base station, and the communication base station transmits the data to the search and rescue network center; the system applies wireless sensor network technology into maritime search and rescue, changes conventional search and rescue method for searching only by search and rescue party, and realizes positioning on a falling target and real-time monitoring; and the data transmittedto the network by the wireless sensor network can help search and rescue people to fast position the target, and at the same time vital sign information of the target can be detected, so that the search and rescue efficiency can be greatly improved.

title_en: Quick wall compensation method suitable for MIMO through-wall radar imagings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of quick wall compensation methodes suitable for MIMO through-wall radar imagings, include the following steps：Setting radar establishes coordinate system, specified pixel point；MIMO through-wall radars carry out multiple-input multiple-output reality aperture and face detection, obtain echo-signal；The corresponding upper end of first pixel, lower end calculating abscissa are found, the propagation delay value that first pixel corresponds to all transceiver channels is calculated, finally obtains the propagation delay value that all pixels point corresponds to all transceiver channels；It is imaged to form final image according to rear orientation projection in conjunction with echo-signal and propagation delay value.The present invention is avoiding traditional wall compensation method due to iteration and is traversing the excessive problem of the operand brought simultaneously, it is good with correction target image position offset effect, the big superperformance in focal imaging region, finally obtained output image can be used for positioning, identify and extract target, have a good application prospect in the MIMO through-wall radar imagings application for needing to handle in real time.

title_en: Quantitative simulation method for contribution of sandstone overpressure causes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quantitative simulation method for sandstone overpressure cause contribution, which comprises the following steps: collecting, sorting, analyzing, testing, logging, geology, earthquake and other data; analyzing stratum pressure characteristics of the target horizon sandstone; reconstructing the buried history and the thermal history of the target horizon sandstone; quantitatively simulating the pore pressure evolution history of the undercompact; quantitatively simulating pore pressure evolution history of undercompact and hydrocarbon generation pressurization; quantitatively simulating the total pore pressure evolution history; quantitative analysis of contribution of overpressure causes is carried out according to P  total  ＝P  underc  +P  hydrog  And P  total  ＝P  underc  +P  hydrog  +P  other  Quantitative analysis of contributions of undercompact, hydrocarbon-producing pressurization and other causes to overpressureThree cause overpressure evolution mechanisms are obtained, the contribution of sandstone overpressure causes is quantitatively simulated, and the geological exploration area of the oil and gas reservoir is determined. The invention meets the requirements of the current geological exploration of the oil and gas reservoir, and has guiding significance for the quantitative analysis of the contribution of the overpressure causes of sandstone and the exploration work of the oil and gas reservoir.

title_en: Time domain through-wall radar sequential equivalent sampling receiver system based on SRD and integrated SoC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time domain through-wall radar sequential equivalent sampling receiver system based on SRD and integrated SoC, and belongs to the technical field of ultra-wideband time domain electromagnetics. The receiver system has a simple circuit structure, low cost and good circuit stability, can collect echo data and process signals simultaneously by using an integrated SoC of FPGA and ARM, reduces the complexity of the system, improves the efficiency of signal processing and increases the integration level of the system, ensures that the ADC cost is lower by using a sequential equivalent sampling method, can reach an equivalent sampling rate of more than 100GSPS by controlling sampling delay, effectively solves the problem of cost and meets the requirement of waveform precision, and the receiver system realizes accurate delay control by using a cascaded numerical control delay chip, ensures a larger range by using a coarse delay chip, simultaneously ensures a higher precision by using a fine delay chip, and effectively improves the sampling rate and the signal to noise ratio of the system.

title_en: Safe and efficient mining control method for shallow-buried close-range coal seam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal seam exploitation control, in particular to a safe and efficient exploitation control method for a shallow-buried close-range coal seam. According to the invention, through multi-mode data acquisition such as distributed optical fibers, laser spectrum sensors and unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging, a Cauchy distribution model is combined to comprehensively analyze temperature overflow values, CO anomaly monitoring ratio values, microseismic energy and oxygen concentration influence values to position a fire source, so that accurate guidance is provided for a target surface or the fire source is provided, the fire source positioning precision is improved, the fire extinguishing cost is low, and a spontaneous combustion risk assessment model is constructed by utilizing historical fire source information and real-time gas data, and through calculation of spontaneous combustion probability, low/medium/high risk grading response is realized, the safety of underground personnel is improved, and meanwhile, through support strengthening and disaster comprehensive early warning, disaster risks such as roof fall, gas overrun and the like are remarkably reduced, and the safe and efficient exploitation of a shallow buried short-distance coal seam is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL NO 3 CONSTR GROUP CO LTD

title_en: UWB and Beidou positioning-based converter station personnel tracking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a converter station personnel tracking method based on UWB and Beidou positioning, which comprises the steps of simulating a propagation path of a UWB base station and a Beidou signal by utilizing a three-dimensional digital twin model in combination with a ray tracking algorithm, analyzing multipath effect distribution, optimizing base station layout, generating personnel position samples by adopting a Monte Carlo method, judging signal shielding strength, dynamically adjusting base station positions, generating an optimized deployment map, generating personnel density heat map by expanding Kalman filtering fusion time difference data, dynamically adjusting personnel configuration by combining a weighted fusion algorithm, optimizing base station selection by utilizing a geometric dilution precision factor, obtaining high-precision path data, monitoring deviation conditions by utilizing a geofence technology, generating a position correction instruction, finally fusing vital sign sensor data, judging abnormal states in real time and triggering a rescue program. The invention obviously improves the positioning precision and the safety management efficiency and reduces the safety risk of the converter station.
assignees: ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: measurement module for bio signal and healthcare underwear for bio signal monitoring
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 모듈 및 생체 신호 모니터링을 위한 기능성 속옷
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a functional underwear and, more particularly, to the functional underwear which is configured to include an electrocardiogram sensor, a temperature sensor and a blood flow sensor and which includes a biosignal measuring module attached to an underwear to measure a biosignal of a wearer in real time. According to the biosignal measuring module and the functional underwear for monitoring a biosignal presented in the present invention, the functional underwear is configured to include an electrocardiogram sensor, a temperature sensor and a blood flow sensor and is provided with the biosignal measuring module which is attached to a specific region of an underwear and which is capable of measuring a biosignal of a functional underwear wearer in real time and thereby, it is easy to maintain the biosignal measuring module consistently by being secured to a human body and several types of measuring sensors are provided together therein and therefore, it is possible to obtain a variety of biosignals. In addition, according to the present invention, a removable storage module or a communications module is further added and thus, measurement information can be transferred to an external terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기능성 속옷에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 심전도 센서, 온도 센서 및 혈류 센서를 포함하여 구성되고, 속옷에 부착되어 실시간으로 착용자의 생체 신호를 측정하는 생체 신호 측정 모듈을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 생체 신호 측정 모듈 및 생체 신호 모니터링을 위한 기능성 속옷에 따르면, 심전도 센서, 온도 센서 및 혈류 센서를 포함하여 구성되어, 기능성 속옷 착용자의 생체 신호를 실시간으로 측정하는 생체 신호 측정 모듈을 속옷의 특정 부위에 구비시킴으로써, 신체에 지속적으로 고정 유지되는 것이 용이하고, 복수 종류의 측정 센서를 함께 구비하여 다양한 생체 신호 획득이 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 분리형 저장 모듈 또는 통신 모듈을 더 포함함으로써, 외부 단말기에 측정 정보를 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring biometric data
title_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring a bio-signal which monitors user data in real time. The system comprises: a pair of glasses composed of a glasses frame and glasses lenses, and having an identification means assigned thereto; and a server connected to the pair of glasses through a network, and storing and managing data received from the pair of glasses. The pair of glasses includes: a bio-sensor for generating a bio-signal of a user; a communication unit for transmitting the bio-signal to the server; an operation sensor for sensing an operation that the user stretches the glasses frame; a bio-sensor for sensing whether the user wears the pair of glasses; and a control unit for analyzing the bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안경테와 안경알로 구성되며, 식별수단이 부여되는 안경; 상기 안경과 네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 상기 안경으로부터 수신하는 데이터를 저장 및 관리하는 서버를 포함하고, 상기 안경은, 사용자의 생체신호를 생성하는 바이오센서; 상기 생체신호를 상기 서버로 송신하는 통신부; 사용자가 상기 안경테를 펼치는 동작을 감지하는 동작감지센서; 사용자의 안경착용을 감지하는 생체감지센서; 및 상기 생체신호를 분석하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for informing of ofobituary
title_ko: 사망 인지시점에 따른 부고정보 제공방법
abstract_en: Provided is a method for providing obituary information according to the time of death recognition, comprising: a terminal registration step in which a server registers a terminal in a database according to personal information entered from the terminal; a will information generation step in which the server generates a will according to a will information generation request from the terminal; a list generation step in which the server receives at least one selected from among contact information entered in the terminal and another contact information transmitted to the terminal from another terminal and generates a transmission list; a biometric information measurement step in which the server determines in real time whether the user's biometric information measured from the terminal is above or below a preset threshold; and a will information and emergency rescue request transmission step in which an emergency rescue request is transmitted to the police department when the user's biometric information measured from a biometric sensor is determined to be above a preset threshold value, and in which the will information and emergency request are transmitted to the input transmission list when the user's biometric information measured from the biometric signal sensor is determined to be below a preset threshold value. Accordingly, the present invention may automatically transmit obituary information to the list of bereaved family members stored in the terminal of the deceased at the time of death.
abstract_ko: 서버가 단말기로부터 입력된 개인정보에 따라 상기 단말기를 데이터베이스에 등록하는 단말기 등록단계, 상기 서버가 상기 단말기의 유언정보 생성요청에 따라 유언장을 생성하는 유언정보 생성단계, 상기 서버가 상기 단말기에 입력된 연락처 및 또 다른 단말기로부터 상기 단말기에 전송된 또 다른 연락처 중 선택된 적어도 하나를 수신 받아 전송리스트를 생성하는 리스트 생성단계, 상기 단말기로부터 측정되는 사용자의 생체인식정보가 기 설정된 임계값 이상 또는 이하인지 여부를 실시간으로 판단하는 생체정보 측정단계, 생체신호 센서로부터 측정되는 상기 사용자의 생체정보가 기 설정된 임계값 이상으로 판단되는 경우에 경찰청으로 긴급구조요청이 전송되는 구조요청 발송 단계가 진행되고, 상기 생체신호 센서로부터 측정되는 상기 사용자의 생체정보가 기 설정된 임계값 이하로 판단되는 경우에 상기 입력된 전송리스트로 상기 유언정보 및 긴급요청을 발송하는 유언정보와 긴급요청 발송단계;를 포함하는 사망 인지시점에 따른 부고정보 제공방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and device for detecting buried metal using synchronous detection method
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for detecting buried metal, whereby it is possible to radio (wirelessly) transmit a synchronizing signal, and, when the frequency band of the transmission signal is restricted, to problem synchronous detection using a reference signal having a frequency equal to or greater than the frequency band. A method for detecting buried metal using synchronous detection method having a transmitting side device that transmits a transmitting signal (alternating current) to a buried metal for detection and transmits a synchronizing signal for synchronous detection, and a receiving side device for measuring the position and burial depth of the buried metal by detecting a magnetic field generated by the transmitting signal flowing in the buried metal with a magnetic sensor and processing amplitude and phase of the magnetic field, the method including: generating a standard signal of frequency f in the transmitting side device, and n dividing this standard signal to convert it to a transmitting signal of frequency f/n, transmitting this transmitting signal to the buried metal, m dividing the standard signal to convert it to a synchronizing signal of frequency f/m, transmitting this synchronizing signal from the transmitting side device by radio. Receiving the synchronizing signal by the receiving side device, m multiplying this received synchronizing signal to convert it to the standard signal. N dividing this converted standard signal to convert it to a reference signal of frequency f/n. Detecting a magnetic field generated by the transmitting signal flowing in the buried metal and synchronously detecting with the reference signal.

title_en: Identification sensor for works buried at great depth
Monitoring Vital Sign of Occupant in a Vehicle Seat
abstract_en: A method for measuring vital signs of an occupant in a vehicle seat is provided. In an embodiment, a sensor includes a transmission circuitry, a reception circuitry, and a controller. The transmission circuitry is configured to transmit a radar beam to an occupant in a vehicle seat. The reception circuitry is configured to receive a reflected signal. The reflected signal being a reflection of the radar beam from the occupant. The controller is configured to determine data associated with a vital sign of the occupant based on the reflected signal.

title_en: System for Capturing Movement Patterns and/or Vital Signs of a Person
abstract_en: System and method for capturing a movement sequence of a person. The method comprises capturing a plurality of images of the person executing a movement sequence by means of a contactless sensor, the plurality of images representing the movements of the body elements of the person, generating at least one skeleton model having limb positions for at least some of the plurality of images, and calculating the movement pattern from the movements of the body elements of the person by comparing changes in the limb positions in the at least one skeleton model generated. In addition, vital signs and/or signal processing parameters of the person can be acquired and evaluated.
assignees: METRALABS GMBH NEUE TECH UND SYSTEME

title_en: Structure sparse imaging method and device of MIMO through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging, and provides a structure sparse imaging method and device of an MIMO through-wall radar. The method comprises the following steps: sparse transformation is carried out on echo signals of an extended target collected by the MIMO through-wall radar array, a pseudo-random measurement matrix based on a pseudo-random m sequence is constructed for compression sampling, and a perception matrix is further constructed; obtaining an initial value of a scattering coefficient of an extended target according to a back projection imaging algorithm, and estimating an index set for an orthogonal matching pursuit compressed sensing algorithm; fully considering the structure sparse prior information among pixels according to the one-by-one transfer process of the first-order neighborhood of the Markov random field to obtain a new index set; and then recalculating the scattering coefficient of the extended target until a convergence condition is met, and using the scattering coefficient of the extended target at the moment for two-dimensional imaging. The invention does not need to manually set the partitioning parameters, has small required storage space, reduces the computation amount and the system complexity and is easy to realize hardware.

title_en: Life signal enhancement method based on segmented classification enhancement processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal enhancement method based on segmented classification enhancement processing, which removes background clutter of an echo signal of an ultra-wideband radar, selects a target signal registration block by using simulation scene simulation data, judges whether an actual measurement window is matched with the registration block or not by using a sliding window, performs classification segmented denoising and enhancement on a radar signal matrix, performs multi-frame weighting processing on a processed result, and finally enhances a remote signal by using a local normalization method to obtain a final enhanced signal matrix for positioning and detecting a life body. The invention realizes the enhancement of the life signal, effectively carries out denoising and enhancement aiming at the type of the signal by carrying out different treatments on signal matrix blocks of different types, utilizes adjacent frames for correction, and enhances the amplitude of a remote signal, so that the position of a target signal is more obvious and accurate in both time domain and frequency domain, thereby providing guarantee for subsequent detection.

title_en: Deconvolution-based impulse type through-wall radar antenna ringing suppression method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deconvolution-based impulse type through-wall radar antenna ringing suppression method, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining an antenna impulse response function, converting the antenna impulse response function into a frequency domain form, and pre-storing the frequency domain form into a radar processor; step S2: if the radar is a multi-channel radar, carrying out channel correction on each channel error in the echo; if the radar is a single-channel radar, the step is omitted; step S3: FFT transforming the channel corrected echo to the frequency domain; step S4: the echo signal in the frequency domain is multiplied by the inverse function of the antenna impulse response function to realize deconvolution ringing suppression; step S5: the signal is converted into the time domain, where ringing effects in the signal have been removed. The invention has the advantages of wide application range, realization of suppression of signal ringing at the antenna end, improvement of radar range resolution, and the like.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based driver state point cloud detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a driver state point cloud detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radar, and comprises the steps of acquiring a target data matrix, wherein the target data matrix consists of target vital sign signals of a target driver, which are dynamically measured by a multi-transmission multi-reception MIMO-FMCW millimeter wave radar based on a preset measurement distance; determining a distance unit by combining the position of a target part and the radar distance resolution, performing Fourier transform on a target data matrix to obtain a target motion three-dimensional point cloud, analyzing and constructing a target space diagram, performing hidden space normal estimation between continuous frames on the target space diagram to obtain a target continuous frame point cloud, and performing state estimation on a target driver according to a target dense point cloud obtained by performing multi-frame fusion processing on the target continuous frame point cloud. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional driver state monitoring method often depends on vision or sensor data, and has the defects of limited vision, large environmental interference, large difficulty in complex scene recognition and the like.

title_en: Real time psychophysiology-health monitering system using eyeglass
title_ko: 안경을 이용한 실시간 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안경을 이용한 생체신호 무선 측정장치 및 그것을 이용한 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안경이나 고글의 코 받침부재에 SpO 2     센서, GSR센서, 마이크로폰, EMG, EEG 등을 부착하여 혈중 산소농도, 피부전도도, 호흡, 뇌파, 근전도 등을 무선 측정하고 건강 및 감성상태를 모니터링하기 위한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 안경이나 고글의 코 받침부재에 설치되어 안경이나 고글 착용자의 혈중 산소농도, 피부 전도도, 호흡, 뇌파, 근전도에 관련된 하나 이상의 전기신호를 검출하는 생체신호 측정부; 생체신호 측정부로부터 검출된 생체신호를 수신하여 무선 신호로 변환한 후 외부 기기로 전송하는 무선 송수신부;를 포함하는 안경을 이용한 생체신호 무선 측정장치 및 그것을 이용한 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템을 제공하여, 시간과 장소에 구애받지 않고 간편하게 생체신호를 측정하고, 사용자의 건강 및 감성 상태를 지속적으로 실시간 모니터링할 수 있게 한다. 
       
     생체, 측정, 안경, 감성 및 건강상태, 모니터링 시스템, 무선전송

title_en: Ai-based living sensor-linked care service provision system
title_ko: 인공지능 기반의 생활센서 연계 돌봄 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based care service providing system which comprises: a radar sensor installed in a specific space, detecting life signals including the user's presence, activity, respiration, and heartbeat information in the specific space without contact, and detecting user's body temperature information among the life signals; an artificial intelligence speaker linked to the radar sensor and uttering a speech message of conversation content for confirming an emergency situation to the user to confirm whether there is an emergency situation based on a detection result of the radar sensor, and uttering a speech message of conversation content for recommending a body temperature measurement behavior of the user at a designated time to make the user's body temperature measurement a habit; a monitoring server receiving the life signals collected by the radar sensor, analyzing the received life signals to perform monitoring of the specific space and detect the occurrence of an emergency situation for the user, and confirming the emergency situation detected by the artificial intelligence speaker to provide a notification regarding the emergency situation; and a user terminal linked to each of the radar sensor, the artificial intelligence speaker, and the monitoring server through a dedicated application. Therefore, according to the present invention, it is possible to effectively detect emergency situations by monitoring the health of elderly people living alone at home and situations which may occur in case of an emergency in an aging society.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반의 돌봄 서비스 제공 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특정 공간에 설치되고 상기 특정 공간에서 사용자의 재실, 활동, 호흡 및 심박 정보를 포함하는 생활신호를 비접촉 감지하고 상기 생활신호 중 사용자의 체온 정보를 접촉 감지하는 레이더 센서; 상기 레이더 센서와 연동하고 상기 레이더 센서의 감지결과를 토대로 상기 사용자에게 응급상황 확인을 위한 대화내용의 발화 메시지를 발화하여 응급상황 여부를 확인하고 지정된 시간에 상기 사용자의 체온측정 행동 추천을 위한 대화내용의 발화 메시지를 발화하여 상기 사용자의 체온측정을 습관화시키는 인공지능 스피커; 상기 레이더 센서에 의해 수집된 생활신호를 수신하고 수신된 생활신호를 분석하여 상기 특정 공간에 대한 모니터링을 수행하면서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하고 상기 인공지능 스피커에 의해 검출된 응급상황을 확인하여 상기 응급상황에 관한 알림을 제공하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 센서, 상기 인공지능 스피커 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다.  따라서, 본 발명은 고령화 사회에서 집에 홀로 있는 노인분들의 건강 체크 및 유사시 발생할 수 있는 상황을 모니터링하여 위급상황을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.
assignees: NURION LED CO LTD;HWIAN CO LTD;HAPPY CONNECT;SK TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Automated health check device and methods
abstract_en: An automated health check device and methods, the device comprising: at least one imaging sensor configured for capturing at least one image of at least an area confined by a window of the vehicle; at least one vital signs sensor configured for measuring a health parameter of a passenger at the area confined by the window; and at least one processor configured for: acquiring and analyzing the at least one image to determine location of the window; determining based on the determined location of the window a location of the passenger; determining the at least one vital signs sensor being oriented to a predetermined point of view in relation to the location of the passenger determined; and obtaining a measurement of the health parameter of the passenger from the at least one vital signs sensor.

title_en: Sleep tracking and vital sign monitoring using low power radio waves
abstract_en: Various arrangements for performing radar-based measurement of vital signs. Waveform data may be received then filtered of data indicative of static objects to obtain motion-indicative waveform data. The motion-indicative waveform data may be analyzed to determine one or more frequencies of movement present within the motion-indicative waveform data. A spectral analysis may be performed on the motion-indicative waveform data to determine a spectral-analysis state of a monitored region. The spectral-analysis state of the monitored region may be determined to match a predefined spectral-analysis state during which vital sign monitoring is permitted. One or more vital signs of a monitored user present within the monitored region may be determined and output based on analyzing the motion-indicative waveform data.

title_en: A kind of automatic detection and rescue robot of deep-well
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of automatic detection and rescue robots of deep-well, including No.1 body, No. two bodies, No.1 wheel, No. two wheels, crawler belt, No.1 operating room, No. two operating rooms, battery, control device, the positive and negative motor of No.1, laser radar, radar life-detection instrument, rotary shaft, No.1 gear, No. two gears, locating piece, compressed spring, winder, No.1 cylinder, No. two cylinders, No. two positive and negative motors, hemisphere wheel, servo motor and camera, by the way that winder is arranged in No. two operating rooms, and several locating pieces and compressed spring are set in the side of winder, locating piece is fixed in box body by compressed spring, and the line of winder is made to pass through all locating pieces, when radar life detector test is to life, locating piece is set to be depressed into ground downwards by No.1 cylinder, and then secure the wire in locating piece On ground, to facilitate rescue personnel's tripping in deep-well and be rescued along the direction finding wounded of line.

title_en: Gateway integrating vital sign and sleep monitoring
