abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gateway integrating vital signs and sleep monitoring, which comprises a charging base, a gateway main body, a control device and a control device, wherein the charging base is provided with a power supply area, a first charging contact is arranged in the power supply area, a UWB radar is arranged in the gateway main body and used for monitoring vital signs of a human body, a communication module is arranged in the gateway main body, the gateway main body is used for being placed on the power supply area, a second charging contact matched with the first charging contact is arranged on the gateway main body, the control device is arranged in the gateway main body, the control device is electrically connected with the UWB radar, and the control device is electrically connected with the communication module. The utility model can continuously monitor the health condition of the old or the patient.

title_en: A kind of Non-contact pediatric measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Non-contact pediatric measurement methods, the present invention carries out non-contact detection using vital sign parameter signals of the vital sign detections of radar instrument to tested children, it can also promote the shared exchange of the medical informations such as diagnosis correlation data, improve medical service level and working efficiency, malpractice is reduced, has the advantages that process easy to operate, easy-to-search, safe and efficient.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN WEST CHINA 2ND UNIV HOSPITAL

title_en: System and method for remotely tracking vital signs by millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring vital signs of a subject. The radar unit includes generating raw data, and the processor unit receives the raw data and identifies an oscillating signal in a series of complex-valued arrays representing radiation reflected from each voxel of the target region during a given time segment. A phase value is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing the change in phase over time is generated for each voxel. Voxels indicative of the oscillation signal are selected and vital sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: Fire trapped person positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and discloses a method and a system for positioning trapped fire personnel, wherein the method for positioning trapped fire personnel comprises the following steps of integrating a heart rate sensor, a body temperature sensor and a respiratory rate sensor into portable equipment, collecting vital sign data, sending the vital sign data to a central processing unit through a wireless transmission mechanism, and monitoring and analyzing the vital sign data to obtain the vital sign monitoring data; according to the invention, by integrating sensor data and carrying out real-time analysis, more accurate vital sign state identification and abnormal early warning are realized, the positioning precision of trapped people is further improved by combining the real-time acquisition of acoustic fluctuation and acoustic feature processing, the allocation of rescue resources is optimized by calculating sound source positioning coordinates, and the efficient and targeted rescue strategy and priority allocation can be formulated, so that the rescue efficiency is remarkably improved, the search time and resource waste are reduced, and the survival probability of the trapped people is improved.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom ward platform based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent ward platform based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of intelligent ward. The system comprises a patient room, a patient room monitoring system and a patient room, wherein the patient room is internally provided with a bedside interaction unit, an infusion unit, a nursing electronic whiteboard unit and a patient room display screen, the patient is worn with an electrocardiograph monitoring bracelet, the patient room monitoring system comprises a millimeter wave blood flow monitoring module and is used for acquiring vital sign data and electrocardiograph monitoring data, the patient room monitoring system further comprises a vital sign fusion monitoring module, an infusion optimization system comprises a piezoelectric film sensing array arranged in the infusion device, an identity authentication unit, an integrated near infrared structured light projection module, and a multi-data comparison thermodynamic diagram and a conflict report are generated based on a medical record similarity map recommendation execution scheme. The invention realizes personalized accurate regulation and control of the infusion rate, overcomes the defect of traditional infusion management, and improves the safety and effectiveness of the infusion link.
assignees: GUANGXI HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO SUN YAT SEN UNIV

title_en: Textile electrode kit, and the motion artifact-minimizing clothing installed with the kit
title_ko: 직물전극 키트 및 이를 장착한 동잡음 최소화 의복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a textile electrode kit and clothing for minimizing motion artifacts having the same includes; the textile electrode kit composed of a conductive textile based biological signal measurement sensor; and a clothing structure for indiscernibly and unconstrainedly minimizing the motion artifacts in your daily life and stably detecting a biological signal such as an electrocardiogram of a patient or the like. The present invention, which is the clothing to have an electrode detecting the biological signal, includes; an elastic member under an armpit positioned under a left side armpit and a right side armpit independently; a front center band positioned on a front plate of the clothing; an upper front center dart which is a dart perpendicularly extended from the center of an upper end of the front center band to the center of a neck circumference line of the front plate; a rear center band positioned on a rear plate of the clothing; and a lower rear center dart which is a dart perpendicularly extended from the center of a lower end of the rear center band to a waist portion.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전도성 직물기반 생체신호 측정 센서 등으로 이루어진 직물전극 키트와, 상기 직물전극 키트가 의류에 장착되어, 무구속적 및 무자각적으로, 피검자의 심전도 등 생체신호를 일상 동작 중에도 동잡음이 최소화하고 안정적으로 검출하도록 하는 의복 구조를 구비한, 직물전극 키트 및 이를 장착한 의복에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에서, 생체신호를 검출하는 전극을 장착하기 위한 의복은, 좌우측 겨드랑이 밑에 각각 위치되며, 탄성재질로 이루어진, 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재; 비신축성 소재를 포함하여 이루어지며, 띠형태를 이루며, 의복 앞판에 위치되되, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되는, 앞판중앙 띠;  앞판중앙 띠의 상단의 중앙에서 앞판의 목둘레선의 중앙까지 수직으로 이루어진 다트(dart)인, 앞판상부 중앙다트; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 띠형태를 이루며, 의복 뒷판에 위치되되, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착되는, 뒷판중앙 띠; 뒷판중앙 띠의 하단의 중앙에서 허리부까지 수직으로 이루어진 다트(dart)인, 뒷판하부 중앙다트;를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
앞판중앙 띠는, 중앙에 위치되며 탄성재질로 이루어진, 가슴중앙 탄성부재; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 가슴중앙 탄성부재의 일단에 장착된, 좌측 앞판중앙 띠; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 가슴중앙 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착된, 우측 앞판중앙 띠;를 포함하여 이루어진다.
assignees: UNIV YONSEI IACF;UNIV KONKUK IND COOP CORP

title_en: Smart door lock with multi-factor authentication
title_ko: 다중 요소 인증을 적용한 스마트 도어락
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a smart door lock and an authentication method using the same, which can complement the security vulnerabilities of existing single-factor authentication by performing user authentication based on biometric signals, fingerprint images, and facial images by applying a multi-factor authentication method. A smart door lock applying multi-factor authentication is provided, which includes: a first sensor unit for extracting a user's biometric signal; a second sensor unit for extracting a user's fingerprint image; a third sensor unit for scanning the user's face surface to obtain a facial image; and a processor for performing user authentication.
abstract_ko: 다중 요소 인증(Multi-Factor-Authentication)을 적용한 스마트 도어락이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 다중 요소 인증을 적용한 스마트 도어락은, 사용자의 생체 신호를 추출하는 제1 센서부; 사용자의 지문 이미지를 추출하는 제2 센서부; 사용자의 얼굴 표면을 스캔하여 얼굴 이미지를 획득하는 제3 센서부; 및 생체 신호, 지문 이미지 및 얼굴 이미지를 심층신경망 기반의 생체신호 인증모델, 지문 인증모델 및 얼굴 인증모델에 각각 적용하여 사용자 인증을 수행하는 프로세서;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 다중 요소 인증 방식을 적용하여, 생체 신호, 지문 이미지 및 얼굴 이미지를 기반으로 사용자 인증을 수행함으로써, 기존의 단일 요소 인증의 보안 취약점을 보완할 수 있다. 더불어, 피부 습도에 따라서 상반된 인식률을 가진 두 생체요소(지문 및 생체 신호)를 대상으로 습도 수치에 따라 가중치를 적용하고, 조도를 기준으로 얼굴 이미지(안면 인식 요소)에 가중치를 적용하여 개인 인증의 정확도를 안정적으로 유지할 수 있다.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Multichannel ultra wide band based (uwb-based) radar life detector and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: A multichannel ultra wide band based (UWB-based) radar type life detector and a two-dimensional positioning method thereof are provided. The life detector comprises a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas, which respectively form three radar echo signal channels. The two-dimensional positioning method comprises the following steps: A1, enhancing a weak vital sign signal of a static human body in each channels and integrating a radar echo signal in distance in each channels through adopting a method of integrating eight points at an interval of four points; scattering the integrated signal for decomposing, reconstructing and synthesizing a target echo signal and a distance signal; carrying out digital filtration and digital differentiation on the target echo signal and realizing the enhancement of the weak usable signal; A2, distinguishing one-dimensional distance, carrying out space frequency analysis in each channels according to the target echo signal obtained after digital filtration and digital differentiation and the distance signal, and respectively obtaining three projecting signals of the target in three channels; and A3, confirming the two-dimensional position information of the target according to the three projecting signals and displaying an image.
assignees: FOURTH MILITARY MEDICAL UNIV;WANG JIANQI;JING XIJING;ZHANG YANG;LU HAO;LI YANFENG;LI ZHAO;JIAO TENG;YU XIAO

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Lateral wave radar system for forward detection
abstract_en: A forward-looking radar system adapted to detect and identify buried or near surface objects from a moving ground vehicle has been developed. The system incorporates a radar detection system and in one embodiment is mounted on a ground vehicle. The system is adapted to differentiate common roadway clutter from objects of interest.
assignees: UNIV OHIO STATE RES FOUND;CHEN CHI-CHIH

title_en: The adaptive indicating means of human body target after a kind of through-wall radar wall
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of adaptive indicating means of human body target after through-wall radar wall.Pass through the background to each data point of echo-signal, the history pulse data for choosing optimization length is estimated, SCR reaches maximum after making each data point clutter recognition, the problem of human body Target indication method after conventional wall does not adapt to different motion type target is successfully solved, improves adaptability of the through-wall radar to different motion type human body target；The inventive method amount of calculation is low, and execution efficiency is high, suitable for detection of the through-wall radar to different motion type human body target, can effectively improve the operating efficiency of through-wall radar.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on space-time equivalent virtual array technology
abstract_en: A vital sign detection method based on space-time equivalent virtual array technology comprises the steps of obtaining equivalent multi-channel virtual array signals through signal recombination according to phase information obtained through demodulation of received single-channel continuous wave radar signals, then carrying out frequency domain estimation on the multi-channel virtual array signals through a subspace method to obtain incoming wave angle information, and accurately obtaining vital sign information of a target through a coarse-to-fine frequency estimation method according to target frequency obtained through conversion of the incoming wave angle information. The invention synthesizes an equivalent virtual array by utilizing the similarity of a single-input single-output (SISO) CW radar single-channel phase signal and a single-input multiple-output (SIMO) radar multi-channel array signal, and completes the conversion from time to space, thereby realizing the accurate and stable estimation of the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a human body with super-resolution.

title_en: Human health data measuring and calculating method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: S1, constructing a transmitting end array and a receiving end array of an FMCW radar, configuring a transmitting signal, and mixing an echo signal with the transmitting signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal; the method comprises the steps of S2, sampling and rearranging intermediate frequency signals to obtain a data matrix and signal data subjected to direct current bias filtering, S3, determining the position of a human body target according to the signal data, S4, extracting vital sign phase signals according to the position of the human body target, S5, carrying out wavelet decomposition and reconstruction according to the phase signals, and estimating heart rate. The heart rate estimation method and the heart rate estimation device can effectively improve the accuracy rate of heart rate estimation.

title_en: Apparatus and method for decision of psychological state using bio signals
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 심리상태 판단 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서의 일 실시예에 따른 심리상태 판단 장치는 제1 자극에 의해 발생된, 사용자의 제1 생체신호와 제2 생체신호를 획득하는 생체신호 획득부와, 제1 생체신호와 제2 생체신호를 각각 분석하여 제1 특징 및 제2 특징을 추출하고, 제1 특징 및 제2 특징에 기초하여 사용자의 심리상태를 판단하는 심리상태 판단부를 포함할 수 있다. 여기서, 제1 생체신호와 제2 생체신호는 각각 서로 상이한 바이오 센서로부터 측정되는 자율 신경의 변화를 나타내는 생체신호일 수 있다. 예를 들면, 제1 생체신호는 맥파 센서로부터 측정된 PPG 신호이고, 제2 생체신호는 피부전도 센서로부터 측정된 GSR 신호일 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 또 다른 측면에 따른 방 내부의 등에 설치된 내장형 생체 신호 수집기 기반 고독사 방지 시스템은 상기 고독사 방지 시스템은 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기를 포함하고, 상기 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 생체 신호를 수집하고, 상기 생체 신호에서 클러터(Clutter) 신호를 억제하고 고독사 방지 대상자의 생체 신호만을 추출하는 DSP(digital signal processing) 처리를 수행하고, 상기 DSP 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 중요 신호만 추출하는 신호 처리를 수행하고, 상기 신호 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 특징 파라미터를 추출하고, 상기 생체 신호 및 상기 특징 파라미터를 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버로 전송하도록 구현되고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버는 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 상기 생체 신호 및 특징 파라미터를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하도록 구현되고,  상기 생체 신호 수집 서버는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 고독사 방지 대상자에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 신호를 추출하도록 구현된다.

title_en: Health monitoring appliance
abstract_en: A heart monitoring system for a person includes one or more wireless nodes forming a wireless network; a wearable sensor having a wireless transceiver adapted to communicate with the one or more wireless nodes; and a software module receiving data from the wireless nodes to detect changes in patient vital signs.

title_en: Method and radar of life detection
abstract_en: In a life detection method of the present invention, a signal transceiver is configured to transmit a transmission signal to an area and receive a reflected signal from the area as a detection signal, a demodulator coupled to the signal transceiver is configured to receive and demodulate the detection signal to output a demodulated signal, a compute element coupled to the demodulator is configured to receive the demodulated signal and compute a RMS value of the demodulated signal, and a determination element coupled to the compute element is configured to receive the RMS value of the demodulated signal and determine whether having a living body within the area according to the RMS value and a RMS threshold value.

title_en: Human body physical sign monitoring system based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of physical sign monitoring, in particular to a human body physical sign monitoring system based on a microwave radar, which can monitor the information of human body vital signs in real time and send out an alarm in time, and can know monitoring data at any time through terminal equipment, and the system comprises: the monitoring device detects the vital sign state by the induction radar detector; the main controller processes the detection signals of the vital sign states by STM32 series chips and outputs data and alarm control signals; the relay output module outputs an alarm control signal sent by the STM32 series chip to peripheral alarm equipment; the peripheral alarm equipment realizes sound-light alarm; the power supply module is used for supplying power to the system as a whole; the local server receives data sent by the STM32 series chips, stores the data and uploads the data to the cloud platform server, and the cloud platform server can be accessed by the terminal equipment to obtain monitoring data in real time.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar respiration detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra-wideband radar breath detection device, which comprises a storage rack, wherein a detection device body is arranged in the storage rack, slots are fixedly formed in the inner wall surfaces of two sides of the interior of the storage rack, notches are formed in the two sides of the exterior of the detection device body, a plugboard is arranged on the inner top wall of the notch, fixed clamping boards are connected to two sides of the bottom end of the plugboard, movable clamping boards are further arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the plugboard, through sliding grooves are formed in the bottom end of the plugboard, clamping blocks are arranged on the inner wall surfaces of two sides of the interior of the slot, the storage rack and the detection device body are clamped in a plugging and clamping mode, the movable clamping boards, the fixed clamping boards and the clamping blocks are used for achieving the purposes of pressing and releasing the clamping by pressing again, so that the functions of storing and taking and placing the detection device body are achieved, the convenience of use is improved, the folding function is achieved by using a telescopic rod and a movable connecting seat, and the occupation of space is reduced.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Two-dimensional physical simulation test system and method for water inrush disaster of deep-buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional physical simulation test system for water inrush disasters of a deeply buried tunnel, which comprises a rigid test box, a water pressure servo control system, a vertical loading system, a pressure sensor and a permeation pressure sensor, wherein the rigid test box is of a cubic structure with an opening at the upper part, a high-strength glass plate is arranged on the front side surface of the rigid test box, a reserved tunnel portal is arranged on the high-strength glass plate, rock similar materials are paved inside the rigid test box, a karst cave cavity is buried at a preset position, the pressure stress sensor and the permeation pressure sensor are arranged on the periphery of the karst cave cavity and the tunnel, the karst cave cavity is communicated with the water pressure servo control system through a high-pressure water pipe, and the opening at the upper part of the rigid test box is loaded to a set load value through the. The two-dimensional model test system and the test method thereof have the advantages of simple structure, high strength, high rigidity and good water sealing performance, and can be used for more visually observing the surrounding rock fracture evolution characteristics in the water inrush process of the tunnel.

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument. The multifunctional life detection instrument comprises a control terminal, a life detection device carrying out data exchange with the control terminal, and a charging and discharging cell and a power source circuit which provide power for the control terminal and the life detection device, wherein the life detection device comprises a main control module carrying out data exchange with the control terminal, and a UWB electromagnetic detector, a micro vibration detector and an audio video detector which are respectively connected with the main control module to realize data interaction, and the control terminal controls switching among the three modes of the UWB electromagnetic detector, the micro vibration detector and the audio video detector. The multifunctional life detection instrument is advantaged in that high precision is realized, life rescue under various conditions can be adapted, powerful guarantee is provided for disaster rescuers, and the technological level and the equipment level in aspects of earthquake relief work and life saving of the country are effectively improved.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting robot that fire extinguishing strategy is formulated based on object
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting robot that fire extinguishing strategy is formulated based on object, including car body, water tank, fire water monitor, water cannon control device, running gear, drive device, processor and flame sensor for detecting burning things which may cause a fire disaster, the processor is connected with the drive device, flame sensor and water cannon control device, for being instructed when detecting burning things which may cause a fire disaster to drive device output driving, and to water cannon control device output open command while output driving is instructed；Drive device is connected with running gear, for driving running gear to be walked to fire location according to driving instruction；Water cannon control device is used to control fire water monitor water spray according to open command, it is arranged on the life-detection instrument being connected on car body with processor, metal detector and the route logging modle being connected with drive device, life-detection instrument is used to detect live body in the scene of a fire, metal detector is used to detect non-ferrous metal in the scene of a fire, and route logging modle is used to record the track route outside the scene of a fire to current location.
assignees: SUZHOU SHANGXINBAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heart beat respiration detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heartbeat respiration detection method and device and a processor. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: sending a detection signal to a detection object through a packaged antenna, and receiving a feedback signal returned by the detection object through a radar of the packaged antenna; and determining the heartbeat signal and the respiration signal of the detection object through an analysis algorithm according to the feedback signal. The invention solves the technical problems of lower efficiency, inconvenient use and complex operation of the related technology in the modes of respectively adopting the breathing machine and the electrocardiogram equipment to collect breath and heartbeat.

title_en: Wireless body area network MAC method based on priority scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless body area network MAC method based on priority scheduling, which can divide data into three types according to the characteristics of different data generated in the practical application of the wireless body area network: emergency data, periodic data, general data. Wherein the emergency data comprises random data, such data typically being associated with vital sign abnormality reports or medical emergency situations, such as arrhythmia emergency alert signals, or other medical conditions requiring immediate response. Periodic data includes periodic collection from sensors. The invention improves the superframe structure, simplifies the control difficulty, reduces the control overhead, makes the superframe more easily adapt to network changes, and ensures more flexible and reliable data transmission; optimizing the sensor node category and the sensor node priority setting strategy, and effectively relieving the collision problem during data transmission; by optimizing the time slot allocation strategy, the duty ratio of the sensor node is reduced, the energy loss is reduced, and the overall network performance and the system service quality of the wireless body area network are improved.

title_en: Through-wall radar target tracking method based on scale self-adaption-rotation kernel correlation filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar target tracking method based on scale self-adaption-rotation kernel correlation filtering. In the method, size and angle information of a target area are acquired by performing basic geometric feature estimation on a continuously changing target image, and are used for generating training samples and updating a correlation filter. Then the target candidate area of the current frame is defined according to the geometric information of the previous frame, and then the relevant filter is used for positioning the target position. Numerical simulation and experimentation verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title_en: Non-contact heartbeat signal extraction method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and particularly relates to a non-contact type heartbeat signal extraction method based on a millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the following steps of preprocessing radar original phase signals, extracting specific frequency components by using an elliptic filter, carrying out SSA singular spectrum analysis on the phase signals, constructing a track matrix and singular value decomposition to realize signal noise reduction reconstruction, and extracting intrinsic mode components related to vital signs in a self-adaptive mode decomposition algorithm by combining SVMD variation modes to extract a heartbeat envelope line for normalization. By adopting the method, the radar signal can be processed stably and accurately, and the information of the millimeter wave radar heartbeat can be extracted effectively.

title_en: Insert door
title_ko: 접이식 도어
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A folding door is provided to improve safety, prevent noise by the removal of a floor threshold, and make better use of a space. CONSTITUTION: A folding door comprises a door frame(1), a door housing(3), a seating projection, a detection sensor, an upper rail, a lower rail, and an incombustible soundproof material. The door frame is buried under a concrete wall. The door housing accepts a multi-stage door in a folder manner. The seating projection and the detection sensor are mounted in the seating groove. The upper rail and the lower rail guide the horizontal and linear reciprocating motion. The incombustible soundproof material is formed on both sides of the door.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 벽체에 매립시켜 수동 및 자동으로 열고 닫을 수 있는 다단의 접이식 도어에 관한 것이다. 
     사무실이나 주택의 현관. 방. 화장실. 등의 문 에는 일반적으로 사용되는 도어의 종류로는 금속류의 여닫이문을 사용하며 목재용 여닫이나 미닫이문 그리고 유리의 회전 및 여닫이 또는 미닫이의 수동 및 자동문이 등이 사용되고 있다. 
     그러나 현재 도어 사용의 여닫이문은 높이와 넓이의 원둘레 공간을 사용이 제한되고 또한 실내에서 화재발생시 뜨거운 공기의 팽창으로 인한 여닫이문을 개방하기 어려움으로 안전사고에 취약하며 화장실의 목재용 문틀 또는 문은 쉽게 썩어버려 고정 나사못이 이탈되고 변형되어 교체하는 시공비용이 발생하고 세면기 또는 양변기 사용 시에 사용자가 여닫이의 문에 걸려 문 주위를 벗어나야 열고 닫을 수 있는 불편함과 소음에 많이 노출되어 있으며 미닫이문 또한 문의 넓이가 벽체에 매립 또는 벽체에 겹치게 들어감으로 문 주위의 공간사용이 제한되며 레일에서 이탈되면 보수비용이 발생하고 하부 문틀이 없는 것은 흔들림으로 인한 소음이 발생하며 벽체는 기둥의 역할로서 협소한 공간에서는 시공 또한 불가하여 사용함에 불편함이 많고 자동문 역시 정기적으로 벨트 및 기타부품을 교체함으로 자재비 및 인건비가 발생하는 여러 가지의 문제점이 발생하고 있다.   
     따라서 여러 가지의 문제점을 효과적으로 해결하기 위하여 접이식 도어는 전동식과 수동식으로 구분하며 이에 도어의 전체 넓이에다 다단의 도어 중 어느 하나의 폭만 큼을 더한 도어 프레임을 설치함으로 협소한 벽체의 공간에 시공함에 용이하고 도어 수납부에 다단의 도어는 도어의 사이로 들어가 벽체에 매립됨으로 공간사용이 용이하며 화재발생시 압력에도 상. 하부의 레일을 구비하여 원활한 미닫이의 개폐가 용이하며 다단의 도어는 불연 방음재가 구비되며 바닥 문턱을 삭제함으로 상. 하부레일은 수평 및 직선왕복 운동을 유도한다. 
     전동용 접이식 도어는 제어부와 감속하는 구동모터는 클러치기어 그리고 구동 스크루에 볼 롤러를 구비하여 동력전달 부에 연결되며 안전한 개폐를 위하여 안착돌기와 감지센서가 구비되어 개폐스위치를 터치하면 접이식 도어는 자동개폐가 이루어지며 수동은 상기의 전동장치를 제외함으로 제작원가를 절감하고 손잡이를 이용하여 개폐하는 접이식 도어 이다.

title_en: Ground Penetrating Radar with Variable Dwell Time
abstract_en: An object detection system may be capable of sensing a buried object and providing an estimate of the object's depth. The object detection system may comprise a signal generator transmitting one or more signals. At least one of the signals may be directed toward the buried object and reflected off of the object back to the system. At least one of the signals may be transmitted along a variable length path. A correlator may then receive the signals and determine an offset between their arrival times at the correlator. The variable length path may then be adjusted over a range which includes a minimum offset indicating a distance to the object.
assignees: HALL DAVID R;WAHLQUIST DAVID C;LEFEVRE DON

title_en: Device and method for detecting position and orientation of underground elongated bodies
abstract_en: A method for defining a lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50), by means of GPR technique (Ground Penetrating Radar), comprises the steps of moving a first GPR sensor (110) along a first trajectory s consisting of a plurality of points P, and moving a second GPR sensor (110'), integral to the first GPR sensor (110), along a second trajectory s' consisting of a plurality of points P' and parallel to the first trajectory s. The method also comprises the steps of detecting a first and a second plurality of presence signals concerning possible buried objects by the first GPR sensor (110) and the second GPR sensor (120), acquisition of a first and a second set of spatial coordinates for each point P and P' at which a presence signal is detected, and receiving by a control unit (150) the presence signals and the set of spatial coordinates. The method provides then a step of computing the data concerning the presence of possible buried elongated objects (50) and the set of spatial coordinates, in order to determine, among all points P and P' at which a presence signal has been detected, points P 1  and P 1 ' at which the probability of presence of an elongated buried object (50) is higher. Then, a step of determining, at the end of said computing step, the lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50) is carried out responsive to the set of spatial coordinates corresponding to points P 1  and P 1 '.
assignees: I D S INGEGNERIA DEI SISTEMI S P A

title_en: Small-sensing-quantity large-range tipping bucket type rainfall sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-inductance large-range tipping bucket type rainfall sensor, which comprises a water outlet discharge spout, a water diversion channel with water outlets at two ends and a pair of tipping bucket components; the shaft of the water diversion channel is arranged on the central line of the bottom of the water outlet nozzle, and the tipping bucket assembly is symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the water diversion channel according to the central line of the water outlet nozzle. The invention relates to a rainfall sensor with 0.1mm sensing quantity, which consists of two pairs of single tipping bucket components with accurate weights, is supported by tipping bucket shafts, and is arranged in a jewel bearing support part on a bracket back to back and can sensitively rotate. The rain-bearing barrel is simple in structure, small in size, integrated with the rain-bearing barrel part, supported and installed by a single rod, firmly designed in a base and buried underground. The periphery is tensioned by a steel wire rope, and the device can normally work under 8-level typhoons, is convenient to use, expand and repair, is simple and convenient to detect dripping water, and has high precision; the method can be used as basic data of conventional rainfall in hydrology and meteorological departments, can also be used for 0.2 mm and 0.5mm, and can be used for telemetering, real-time report and wide application range.

title_en: A kind of buried pipeline detection device and method based on sound wave reflection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of buried pipeline detection devices based on sound wave reflection, it include: surface-based signal generator, power amplifier, vibration excitor, rake shake table, several three axis geophones, and the signal processor being mounted on host computer；Wherein, several three axis geophones constitute detector array, and the vibration excitor and detector array line constitute line direction；The signal generator is used to generate two kinds of modulated signals using waveform modulated；The modulated signal that the power amplifier is used to generate signal generator carries out power amplification；The signal that the vibration excitor is used to receive the power amplifier generates seismic wave；The rake shake table is used for the earthquake wave coupling that generates vibration excitor into soil；The three axis geophone is used to receive the reflected sonic signals in three directions；The signal processor obtains the position of buried pipeline by image for handling the received acoustic signals of three axis geophones and being imaged.

title_en: Sleep quality assessment method, equipment, system and medium based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep quality assessment method, equipment, a system and a medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the sleep quality assessment method comprises the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a tested person through millimeter wave radar monitoring equipment; according to the obtained vital sign data, one or more operations of body movement frequency analysis, respiratory disturbance degree analysis and bed duration determination of the tested person are executed; and carrying out sleep quality assessment of the tested person based on the obtained one or more information among the body movement frequency, the respiratory disturbance degree and the bed duration. In view of the advantages of non-contact detection of the millimeter wave radar, vital signs of a user can be detected without wearing the millimeter wave radar, the sleep quality of the detected person is estimated by utilizing various vital sign data with representative significance in the sleep process of the detected person acquired by the millimeter wave radar, and detailed and accurate estimated data is obtained on the premise of no perception detection, so that the method has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining defects in dielectric materials and detecting subsurface objects
abstract_en: An apparatus travels within a 3-dimensional space collecting data that may be used to expose defects in structures and objects beneath the ground surface. In a preferred embodiment, the apparatus includes an unmanned aerial vehicle controlled by a user. The apparatus carries LIDAR and ground penetrating radar and correlates data received from both to facilitate displaying a map with data superimposed on it representing locations of defects in structures and buried objects.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Thermal imaging intelligent interconnected fire-fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal imaging intelligent interconnected fire-fighting helmet, which comprises a helmet and an inductive interconnection component; the top of the helmet is provided with a heat dissipation ridge, and the surface of the heat dissipation ridge is provided with heat dissipation holes; the sensing interconnection assembly comprises a visible light camera, a thermal imaging camera, a display screen, a carbon monoxide sensor, a heart rate sensor, a temperature sensor, a pressure sensor, a data processing module and a data sending module. The utility model discloses the radiating effect is good, and is comfortable and easy to wear, can also real-time supervision fire fighter vital sign and the scene of a fire condition simultaneously to the outward appearance personnel carry out unified command dispatch according to the scene of a fire condition. The utility model discloses can effectively improve scene of a fire commander efficiency, protection fire fighter's life safety.
assignees: LI ZHI;FAN JIYING;LI JIANYONG;Zhai Xushuo;WU HAO;SU BOWEN;MA ZIMING;ZHANG BIN

title_en: Sliding connection type distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributed radar life detection positioning device in sliding connection, which comprises at least one radar unit and a sliding rail, wherein the radar unit is connected with the sliding rail and can slide along the sliding rail, and the sliding rail and the radar unit can rotate at any angle through a connecting device. The sliding rail is provided with the plurality of radar units, the base line of the antenna is increased, the detection resolution of the radar life detection positioning equipment can be effectively improved, and the performance of the radar life detection positioning equipment is improved; the number of the slide rails, the number of the radar units and the adjustable connecting devices among all the parts can change the antenna polarization direction of each independent unit, form multi-polarization or full-polarization antenna detection and improve the positioning performance; the number of the sliding rails, the number of the radar units and all the parts are matched through the adjustable connecting devices, and free arrangement of the independent radar units can be achieved.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene rescue fire-fighting equipment with high temperature resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene rescue fire-fighting equipment of high temperature resistance, including rescue module shell, rescue module door and window and jet, the bottom of rescue module shell all is provided with bearing structure, and the top of jet is provided with detection mechanism, and the display screen is installed to one side of mounting panel, and one side of display screen is provided with crashproof structure. The utility model discloses a high definition digtal camera feeds back the condition around the scene of the conflagration position in real time to controlling personnel, thermal infrared imager can simulate out the spatial distribution by scanning object surface temperature completely simultaneously, and be used for the line to dodge or puncture on electronic system handles the formation thermal image transmission display screen, then ultra-wide spectrum radar life detection instrument detects human life activity, be convenient for confirm stranded personnel position fast, the detection locate function of this device has been realized from this, the functionality of this device has been improved, improve the speed of location, be convenient for in time rescue stranded personnel, the casualty rate is reduced.
assignees: ZHONGZHEN KEJIAN GUANGDONG DISASTER PREVENTION AND MITIGATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method suitable for correcting and imaging positions of multiple faces of walls of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method suitable for correcting and imaging the positions of multiple faces of walls of a through-wall radar. The method includes the steps that existing Radon conversion used for detecting straight lines in an image is used for conducting wall position detection, and focusing imaging of all wall imaging areas and all the faces of walls is achieved by conducting wall penetrating delayed compensation and imaging processing on areas behind all the faces of walls. Furthermore, before sub-images are spliced, gray level linear variation processing is conducted on the sub-images, and the contrast ratio between the walls in the sub-images and the background is enhanced. According to the method, the positions of the walls are effectively corrected, and the quality of the imaged image is improved.

title_en: Multifunctional search and rescue detecting head used for disaster ruin crack search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional search and rescue detecting head used for disaster ruin crack search and rescue. The multifunctional search and rescue detecting head used for disaster ruin crack search and rescue comprises a detecting head housing, a search and rescue part mounting frame, an obstacle sensor, an attitude sensor, a human body infrared inductor, a video collector, a voice conversation device, life maintenance object conveying pipeline, a signal transmission cable and a switching port. The video collector comprises an image sensor, an LED light source, and a shooting control and image processing module. The voice conversation device comprises a miniature loudspeaker and a microphone. The miniature multifunctional detecting head with a plurality of built-in sensors can be used for the internal detection and the search and rescue work of ruin cracks, and especially, the detecting head is also provided with life detection, voice conversation and relief goods conveying functions when used for rescue.

title_en: The six-freedom motion track data processing method of drop test pre-buried sensor
abstract_en: The six-freedom motion track data processing method of drop test pre-buried sensor, comprises the following steps：The relative referential of object of which movement is set up based on ground, the relative coordinate system of object of which movement is set up based on drop test pre-buried sensor, when collecting object of which movement, monitoring point voltage data in a coordinate system on object；Step voltage data is converted into Mechanical Data, monitoring point on object is respectively converted into linear acceleration component of the monitoring point in each axle of referential on object in the linear acceleration of each axle of coordinate system, and the linear acceleration component to monitoring point on object in each axle of referential is sued for peace respectively, obtain linear acceleration of the monitoring point in each axle of referential on object, and it is converted into linear acceleration of the object mass center in each axle of referential, time is integrated, obtain barycenter linear velocity and displacement component of the object mass center in each axle of referential, draw out the time-histories function and displacement function of object of which movement.The present invention has scientific generality, can be widely used in falling rocks Disaster Study.

title_en: Front-back wall vibrates a multipaths restraint method after MIMO through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses front-back wall after a kind of MIMO through-wall radar imaging to vibrate a multipaths restraint method.It is included in after obtaining original radar image,Original radar image is subjected to binaryzation,Extract the central value of all targets in original image,Calculate the direct propagation distance and multipath transmisstion distance of target electromagnetic ripple,And calculate normalization multipath error coefficient and error threshold value,So as to judge the target of original image,Finally reject multipath decoy,Realize multipaths restraint,Realize that the real goal in effective Discrimination Radar image and their two kinds of front-back walls vibrate a multipath decoy,The loss of real goal will not be caused while multipath decoy is suppressed,Two kinds of different multipath forms in one way multipath can be considered perfectly simultaneously,Omission is completely occurred without comprehensively to multipaths restraint,It ensure that practical function of the through-wall radar in sealed building detects environment,Correct decision-making, which is made, for operating personnel provides sound assurance.

title_en: Detections of radar false alarm rejection method and device based on constructure inner structure feature
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of detections of radar false alarm rejection method based on constructure inner structure feature, step includes: that S1. detects interior of building region by through-wall radar detection system, obtains the first detectable signal containing constructure inner structure characteristic information and the second detectable signal containing target signature information respectively；S2. feature extraction is carried out to the first detectable signal respectively, obtains the structure feature signal of interior of building, and feature extraction is carried out to the second detectable signal, obtains target signature signal；S3. obtained target signature signal is matched with structure feature signal, the echo signal after obtaining characteristic matching is exported as final detectable signal to filter out false-alarm；The device includes radar detected module, characteristic extracting module and characteristic matching module.The present invention has many advantages, such as simple implementation method, required at low cost, real-time and realizes that effect is good and high-efficient.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue and disaster relief method based on unmanned aerial vehicle system and unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue and disaster relief method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle system and the unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof, comprising the following steps; the method comprises the following steps that firstly, corresponding unmanned aerial vehicles are dispatched according to the serious situation of the disaster; secondly, distributing unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue ranges through an unmanned aerial vehicle formation host according to disaster types, terrains and damage conditions; a third step of detecting the life signs by a thermal imaging camera and throwing a marker at the corresponding position; and fourthly, the search and rescue personnel perform search and rescue activities within the range of the marked positions. The invention can deal with post-disaster rescue activities of debris flow, flood, earthquake and other natural disasters, detect life signs from the air through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and enable search and rescue pairs to find search and rescue targets more easily through throwing the marker, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: CCCC REMOTE SENSING LOAD JIANGSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign extraction method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars, and particularly discloses a vital sign extraction method based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the vital sign extraction method comprises the following steps: acquiring an echo signal of a millimeter wave radar for a target human body, and extracting distance information in the echo signal; selecting an index corresponding to the strongest power point for phase analysis to obtain an analysis phase according to the distance information in the echo signal; judging whether the target human body is in a motion state or not and judging whether the respiratory signal of the target human body is weak or not according to the analytic phase; when the target human body is in a non-motion state and the respiratory signal of the target human body is weak, the vital sign value of the target human body is determined after the alternative distance gate is expanded; and when the target human body is in a non-motion state and the respiratory signal of the target human body is not weak, calculating the vital sign value of the target human body. The method for extracting the vital sign based on the millimeter wave radar can improve the accuracy of extracting the vital sign signal.
assignees: WEIFU HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Blood pressure detection method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood pressure detection method and a system based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the blood pressure detection method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the following steps: s1, designing a data acquisition system, and acquiring original data from a millimeter wave radar sensor through the data acquisition system; step S2, formulating a signal processing algorithm, and converting the original data into vital sign parameters related to blood pressure; and S3, correcting the individual difference through a personalized correction algorithm according to the physiological difference of each individual. The invention provides a blood pressure detection method and a blood pressure detection system based on millimeter wave radar, which are used for continuously measuring blood pressure without interruption and improving the accuracy of blood pressure measurement.
assignees: DEXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CHANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based physical sign rapid and accurate detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based physical sign rapid and accurate detection method. The invention can rapidly detect the vital sign signals, and has high detection precision and low complexity. Firstly, mixing echo signals and transmitting signals, and cross sampling to obtain complex signals; then, the variance of slow time energy based on complex signals is adopted, and the optimal distance unit is selected under the condition of not damaging the target phase signals, so that the optimal distance unit is ensured to simultaneously contain human respiration and heartbeat signals; meanwhile, the invention eliminates the higher harmonic wave of the respiratory signal before heart rate estimation, and outputs the final result of heart rate according to the amplitude value, so that the heart rate estimation has high accuracy. The method reduces the requirements of processing signals and estimating the time length of the signals under the condition of ensuring the detection precision, so that the method achieves the precision requirement of high-precision quick heart rate estimation and can be suitable for quick detection in various scenes.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE JIAXING;BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: RIS-assisted WIFI signal multi-target respiration detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WIFI signal multi-target respiration detection method and system based on RIS assistance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the WIFI intelligent device establishes connection with the WIFI access device; setting the number N of the quasi-structure antennas based on the number M of the multi-target to be detected, wherein N is more than or equal to M; changing the channel from the RIS to the WIFI intelligent device by switching the RIS reflection direction to obtain a new equivalent transmitting antenna; adjusting RIS emission gain to enable the WIFI intelligent equipment to receive a proper signal; the WIFI intelligent device reads the CSI data stream and acquires a new mixed signal; repeatedly switching the RIS reflection direction for N times to obtain sampling data of the N-dimensional mixed signal at a time point t  1 ; repeatedly sampling the N-dimensional mixed signal to obtain a time sequence of the N-dimensional mixed signal; and carrying out signal separation on the time sequence of the N-dimensional mixed signal based on a blind source classification technology to acquire the breathing information of a plurality of targets to be detected. The method can realize multi-target respiratory behavior detection under a large-scale user scene by only needing a small number of antenna pairs.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: Multi-target life detection method and system based on radar signals
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of life detection and discloses a multi-target life detection method based on radar signals, which comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting multi-target mixed signals received by a radar and preprocessing the signals; the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase space reconstruction on a preprocessed signal to obtain Gao Weixiang space tracks, constructing a self-adaptive dictionary, carrying out sparse representation on the signal, and separating primary vital sign signals of all targets from a mixed signal through a sparse optimization algorithm. The application adopts the technical scheme of fusion of the multi-band radar signals and the deep learning, and achieves the technical effect of high-precision separation of multi-target vital sign signals in a complex electromagnetic environment. Compared with the technical scheme of relying on single frequency band or fixed threshold classification in the prior art, the method solves the defects of serious signal aliasing and low separation precision in dense barriers or multi-target mixed scenes.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rehabilitation training system and method for gesture perception and proprioception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a posture sensing and proprioception rehabilitation training system, a quantitative evaluation method executed by the posture sensing and proprioception rehabilitation training system and a rehabilitation training method executed by the posture sensing and proprioception rehabilitation training system. The system comprises a multi-layer heterogeneous flexible sensor array mattress, a system control unit, a man-machine interaction module and an undisturbed physiological index detection unit. The mattress is laid on the surface of the sickbed and is used for collecting the body pressure distribution signals of the patient, outputting touch sense and warm stimulation and collecting vital sign signals in a non-contact mode. The system control unit processes the body pressure distribution and vital sign signals, runs intelligent recognition and control algorithms and generates stimulation control instructions. The man-machine interaction module displays the system state information and receives the user instruction. The undisturbed physiological index detection unit is integrated in the mattress and is used for collecting vital sign signals.

title_en: Apparatus for notifying emergency situation based on physiological signal and Watch using by the same
title_ko: 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 상황 알림 장치 및 그 시계
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for notifying an emergency situation based on a bio signal and a watch are provided to transmit position information of a user and peripheral situation in a specific situation using the bio signal of the user. CONSTITUTION: A bio sensor(110) senses a bio signal of a user. A microphone(130) receives a surrounding voice signal. An antenna(140) transmits a wireless signal to an access point. A microcontroller(120) receives the bio signal from the bio sensor. The microcontroller transmits the position signal and peripheral voice signal by wireless by operating the microphone and the antenna if the measurement value of the received bio signal exceeds the specific threshold value. A power supply unit is electrically connected to the microcontroller and supplies the power.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 상황 알림 장치 및 그 시계가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 상황 알림 장치는, 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 바이오 센서; 주위 음성 신호를 수신하는 마이크; 상기 사용자의 위치 신호 및 상기 마이크의 음성 신호를 전송하는 안테나부; 상기 바이오 센서로부터 생체 신호를 수신하고, 상기 수신된 생체 신호의 측정값이 미리 설정된 특정의 임계값을 초과하는 경우 상기 마이크 및 상기 안테나부를 동작시키는 마이크로 컨트롤러; 및 상기 마이크로 컨트롤러와 전기적으로 연결된 전원공급부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 알림 장치를 구비함으로써 특정 응급 상황이 발생시에 사용자의 신체에서 반응하는 생체 신호에 따라 응급 신호를 전송할 수 있어서 응급 상황 발생에 대한 신뢰도가 향상되고, 이와 동시에 응급 상황이 발생한 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 사고 발생시 이에 대한 추적이 용이하며, 다양한 센싱 기술들과 결합하여 유비쿼터스 서비스의 신경망적 역할을 수행할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Air breathing apparatus with safety alarm function
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air breathing apparatus provided with a safety alarm function, implemented in the air breathing apparatus to enable a user to easily check whether firefighting (life rescue) members or scuba divers survive and are in an abnormal state, and where they are. The apparatus comprises: a GPS module acquiring location information via a GPS satellite; an air breathing detection sensor detecting breath of a user; a residue sensing unit measuring an amount of air or oxygen stored in a high pressure tank of the air breathing apparatus; a control unit determining a state of the user according to breath detection signals detected by the breath detection sensor, controlling display of residue according to the remaining amount of air or oxygen sensed by the residue sensing unit, and controlling state signals of the user to be transmitted; a first and a second regulator regulating pressure of compressed air or oxygen according to control of the control unit; and a wireless transmitter wirelessly transmitting the state signals of the user according to control of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 호흡장치에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조) 대원 또는 스킨스쿠버 다이버들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치에 관한 것으로서, GPS 위성을 통해 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS모듈; 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서; 상기 호흡장치의 고압용기에 저장된 공기량 또는 산소량을 측정하는 잔량 감지부; 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량 또는 산소 잔량에 따라 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 압축 공기 또는 압축 산소의 압력을 조정하는 제1 및 제2 레귤레이터; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하여, 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Patient Monitoring Medical Bed
title_ko: 환자 모니터링 베드
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 환자 모니터링 베드는, 침대 프레임의 소정 위치에 장착되고 환자의 심장을 향하도록 각도 조절이 이뤄지는 거치대가 다수 구비되어, 바이탈감지부를 다수의 위치에서 선택적으로 임의로 장착되고 환자의 심장 부위를 향하도록 조절됨으로써 환자의 생체 신호를 비접촉 방식으로 측정할 수 있도록 하는 데 목적이 있다. 
이에 따라, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 환자 모니터링 베드는, 초광대역 임펄스(IR UWB) 레이더 센서를 이용하여 침대 위 환자의 심박수 및 호흡수를 포함한 생체신호를 측정하고 모니터링하는 바이탈감지부; 압전(Piezo) 센서를 이용하여 침대 위 환자의 부위별 체압을 측정하여 욕창 여부 및 낙상 가능성을 모니터링하는 체압감지부; 바이탈감지부, 체압감지부에서 측정한 생체 신호 및 체압 신호를 화면 출력하는 디스플레이부; 바이탈감지부, 체압감지부에서 측정한 생체 신호 및 체압 신호를 해석하고 데이터를 학습하여 환자의 심장 상태, 욕창 가능성 및 낙상 여부를 판단하고 간호시스템에 전송하는 제어처리부; 및 바이탈감지모듈이 수용 장착되고, 침대 프레임 소정 위치에 부착되어 환자를 향하도록 조절되는 적어도 하나 이상의 바이탈거치대;를 포함한다.

title_en: Blood pressure waveform measurement sensor and blood pressure measurement apparatus thereof
title_ko: 혈압 파형 측정센서 및 그의 혈압 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a sensor for measuring a biological signal such as a blood pressure waveform, and a blood pressure measurement apparatus provided with such a sensor to measure blood pressure. In the present invention, the measurement sensor comprises: a first metal sheet that acts as a ground and has a hole formed in the center thereof; a first insulator that is located under the first metal sheet and has a hole formed at the center thereof; a second metal sheet that is located under the first insulator and acts as a patch; a second insulator that is located under the second metal sheet; and a signal pin that passes through the hole and has an end in contact with the second metal sheet. In addition, when an electromagnetic field is supplied through the signal pin, a blood pressure waveform is sensed by measuring an impedance formed on the second metal sheet.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혈압 파형과 같은 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 그리고 이러한 센서가 구비되어 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정장치를 제안한다. 본 발명에서 측정 센서는, 그라운드(Ground)로 작용하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 메탈 시트, 상기 제1 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 절연체, 상기 제1 절연체 하부에 위치하며 패치로 작용하는 제2 메탈 시트, 상기 제2 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하는 제2 절연체, 및 상기 홀을 관통하며 끝 단은 상기 제2 메탈 시트와 접촉하는 신호 핀을 포함하여 구성된다. 그리고 상기 신호 핀을 통해 전자기장이 급전되면 상기 제2 메탈 시트에 형성되는 임피던스를 측정하여 혈압 파형을 센싱한다.

title_en: System and method for estimating vital signs
abstract_en: A system for estimating breathing frequency and heartbeat frequency of a subject, comprises at least one ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver, connected to at least one hardware processor, configured to: receive a plurality of readings from the UWB transceiver, each of the readings having a time and comprising a plurality of intensity values at the time, each of the intensity values having a corresponding distance value representing a distance between the UWB transceiver and the subject; determine a Range-Doppler map from the plurality of readings; analyze the Range-Doppler map to determine a breathing frequency value of the subject; perform null steering of a plurality of Doppler-map frequencies in the Range-Doppler map to nullify the breathing frequency value and integer multiples of the breathing frequency value to obtain a plurality of combined frequencies; and determine a heartbeat frequency value for which a plurality of computed frequencies corresponds with the plurality of combined frequencies.

title_en: System and method for the detection, recording and reporting of hazardous materials and illegal activity
abstract_en: A system and method for the detection, recording, and reporting of matter and energy related to hazardous and illegal substances in enclosed and semi-enclosed spaces The system and method relate to the early detection of hazardous materials and illegal actions commonly associated with criminal and terrorist activities This 'around-the-clock' security shield integrates audio, video and sensor detection (passive deterrence) with real-time monitoring, communications, and data recording (active deterrence) The system can function as a stationary or mobile recording-reporting device(2) for the detection of biological agents, toxic chemicals, dirty bombs, electromagnetic radiation, human presence, drugs associated with volatile organic chemicals (VOCs). and occasions of negligent oversight The primary component of the system is a solid-state detection unit(2) housed in a compact case which ma) be mounted for mobile or stationary applications The detection unit(2) includes a variety of detectors( 18,22.24) and sensors(20), power supply(10a I Ob), and communication interfaces
assignees: WBR INVESTMENTS L L C;TEMPLETON LARILLA;WAGNER THOMAS JAMES;BAGOT JR MICHAEL HARDIE;RAYER JR THOMAS ARNOULT

title_en: Device and method for detecting position and orientation of underground elongated bodies
abstract_en: A method for defining a lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50), by means of GPR technique (Ground Penetrating Radar), comprises the steps of moving a first GPR sensor (110) along a first trajectory s consisting of a plurality of points P, and moving a second GPR sensor (110'), integral to the first GPR sensor (110), along a second trajectory s' consisting of a plurality of points P' and parallel to the first trajectory s. The method also comprises the steps of detecting a first and a second plurality of presence signals concerning possible buried objects by the first GPR sensor (110) and the second GPR sensor (120), acquisition of a first and a second set of spatial coordinates for each point P and P' at which a presence signal is detected, and receiving by a control unit (150) the presence signals and the set of spatial coordinates. The method provides then a step of computing the data concerning the presence of possible buried elongated objects (50) and the set of spatial coordinates, in order to determine, among all points P and P' at which a presence signal has been detected, points P 1  and P 1 ' at which the probability of presence of an elongated buried object (50) is higher. Then, a step of determining, at the end of said computing step, the lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50) is carried out responsive to the set of spatial coordinates corresponding to points P 1  and P 1 '.
assignees: IDS INGEGNERIA DEI SISTEMI S P A

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention provides a MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on a two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor, which comprises the steps of recording echo signals of K frequency points corresponding to an mth transmitting array element and an nth receiving array element through an MIMO antenna array element parallel to a wall, removing background clutter signals in the echo signals by a background cancellation method, calculating a phase coherence factor PCF and a distance phase coherence factor RPCF according to phase diversity at pixel points, calculating a two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor according to the phase coherence factor and the distance phase coherence factor, and weighting FDBP imaging results to obtain final imaging results; the MIMO through-wall radar imaging method provided by the invention can better integrate the advantages of PCF and RPCF, not only can effectively inhibit clutter interference, but also can further improve the resolution of imaging reconstruction results, and is more beneficial to detection and imaging of hidden targets behind walls.

title_en: Ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for monitoring vital signs of an ultra-wideband biological radar, which relate to the technical field of monitoring vital signs of drivers and comprise the following steps of monitoring the drivers by transmitting short pulse signals by using the ultra-wideband biological radar; the method comprises the steps of filtering a monitoring signal to obtain a sign signal, extracting signal characteristics of the sign signal, grouping the signal characteristics based on different signal characteristics to obtain different characteristic groups, analyzing the relation between the signal characteristics and vital signs based on the different characteristic groups, and monitoring the vital signs of a driver based on the relation between the signal characteristics and the vital signs.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency rescue, disaster search and rescue and life detection positioning, and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system which comprises a sensor array module, a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method and a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system, wherein the sensor array module is composed of a plurality of sensors of different types and is used for collecting environment data in a target area, the multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-type sensor array in the target area to collect the environment data of the target area, S2, conducting noise filtering and signal enhancement processing on the original data collected by the sensors, and extracting key characteristics of a living body. According to the application, through self-adaptive multi-mode fusion, deep learning feature recognition, nonlinear TDOA optimization and reinforcement learning path planning, the problems of single sensor failure, low signal-to-noise ratio erroneous judgment, complex environment positioning error, static path planning hysteresis and the like are solved, the accuracy of life detection and rescue response efficiency are improved, and the method is suitable for extreme disaster environments.

title_en: Method of requesting rescue of emergent patient and portable terminal program for implementing the same
title_ko: 응급 환자 구조요청 방법 및 이를 구현하기 위한 휴대형 단말기용 프로그램
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency patient rescue request method and program of a portable terminal are provided to rapidly rescue emergency patents by rapidly transmitting emergency state information to a protector or an emergency rescue organization. CONSTITUTION: An abnormal state determination unit initializes a measurement time(200). In case the movement of a user is not detected, the abnormal state determination unit determines the range of electrocardiogram values and patterns based on measurement data stored in a data storage uni and a current electrocardiogram received from a sensor module(204). When the electrocardiogram data is not normality, an error determination unit determines the standard time of an error state(206). When a main control unit receives an emergency state determination signal is received, the main control unit transmits an emergency text message from the text message transmission unit to a protector terminal. The main control unit transmits a rescue request message from the rescue request unit to an emergency organization server(210). All rescue request activities are stopped when a user pushes the cancellation button of a terminal(212).
abstract_ko:
예컨대 심장병과 같은 질환을 가진 환자가 응급 상황에 처했을 때 환자의 생체 신호와 상기 환자의 움직임을 통해 응급상황임을 감지하고, 네트웍을 통해 구조 요청을 함과 아울러 주변에 있는 사람에게 구조 요청을 하여 신속히 구조될 수 있도록 해주기 위한 응급 환자 구조요청 방법. 
본 발명의 응급 환자 구조요청 방법은 적어도 하나의 센서 모듈과 인터페이스될 수 있고 가속도 센서를 구비하는 휴대형 단말기에서 구현된다.  단말기는 이를 휴대한 사용자의 신체상태를 감지하여 축적하고, 가속도 센서로부터의 가속도 데이터를 축적한다.  그리고, 단말기는 축적된 감지 데이터들과 가속도 데이터들을 토대로 사용자가 응급상황에 처했는지를 판단한다.  사용자가 응급상황에 처한 경우, 단말기는 네트웍을 통해 외부 장치에 구조요청을 함과 아울러, 음향으로 주변인에게 구조요청을 하고, 주변인이 단말기에 소정의 입력을 인가하는 경우 메모리에 저장된 구조방법 영상을 재생하게 된다. 
환자가 극단적인 상황에 처하지 않고 신속하게 구조될 수 있도록 해주는 효과가 있다.

title_en: apparatus for ultra-precision high-resolution bio-signal measuring and method using it
title_ko: 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치 및 측정방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 높은 측정 정밀도를 가지며 에너지 효율이 향상된 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치 및 측정방법에 관한 것으로, 
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치는, 
전기가 도통하는 다수의 전극과 상기 다수의 전극 간의 커패시턴스 변화를 측정하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및, 상기 센서부에 가변 전류를 공급하여 공급된 가변 전류에 의해 출력된 출력 전압과 기준 전압을 비교하여 상기 출력 전압이 상기 기준 전압 이상인 경우, 상기 가변 전류를 고정시켜서 상기 센서부로 재공급하는 구동 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency monitoring system based on vital sign sensor
title_ko: 바이탈 사인 센서 기반의 응급상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이탈 사인 센서 기반의 응급상황 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 실내 환경에서 사용자의 재실 여부, 활동 여부, 호흡수, 심박수, 체온 및 낙상 의심 여부를 포함하는 생체 신호를 비접촉 감지하는 레이더 측정기; 상기 레이더 측정기에 의해 수집된 생체 신호를 수신하여 상기 실내 환경 하에서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하고 상기 응급상황에 관한 알림을 제공하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 측정기 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다.  따라서, 본 발명은 가정, 사무실 등의 실내 환경에서 생체 신호를 감지하여 사용자의 위급상황 발생을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: Magnetic sensing buried object locator including a camera
abstract_en: Portable locators for detecting a buried object characterized by an electromagnetic (EM) field emission are disclosed. A locator may include a magnetic field sensor array and associated processing circuitry. A locator may further include a camera and image or video processing circuitry to process images or video received from the camera. A locator may further include a user-reconfigurable user interface (UI).
assignees: OLSSON MARK S;STUART PAUL G;COX DAVID A;MEREWETHER RAY;SHAFFER DAWN E;LEVIN RYAN B;MARTIN MICHAEL J;SEESCXIN INC

title_en: Fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system, and belongs to the field of fireman individual equipment. The fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system comprises vital sign information collection terminals and a monitoring command center, wherein each vital sign information collection terminal comprises a vital sign sensor, an information collection and transmission device and a helmet display device, data transmission is carried out between each information collection and transmission device and the corresponding vital sign sensor and between each information collection and transmission device and the monitoring command center in a wireless communication mode, an Android operating system is installed in each information collection and transmission device, a graphic display data interface is formed in each information collection and transmission device, and each helmet display device comprises a helmet, a rotatable connecting part, a metal hose and a small-sized display screen. The fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system has the advantages that each integrated vital sign sensor is comfortable in wear and convenient to wear, and the normal rescue combat cannot be influenced; firemen can check information more conveniently and more rapidly through the helmet display devices; the monitoring command center can monitor the state of a plurality of firemen at the same time and learn about the vital sign state of the firemen and information of harmful gas in a fire scene in real time.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INST OF MINISTRY PUBLIC SECURITY

title_en: It is a kind of that the fire-fighting automatic spraying device of exterior walls of buildings protrusion structurally is set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of, the fire-fighting automatic spraying device of exterior walls of buildings protrusion structurally is set, including the extinguishing pipe being connected in fire-fighting automatic spraying device ontology, the extinguishing pipe is respectively positioned on the lower section of external wall projective structure, and extinguishing pipe is supported by the multiple pre-buried bracing members being arranged below, the pre-buried bracing members are L shape, one end of pre-buried bracing members is embedded in external wall, and the other end of pre-buried bracing members is vertically upward；The side of the extinguishing pipe downward opens up multiple threaded holes, and the connection of threaded hole internal screw thread adjusts one end of pipeline, adjusts the other end connection applicator of pipeline；Originally practical to play the role of controlling external wall fire under the premise of having substantially no effect on facade effect, the flame retardant treatment of thermal insulation material, ornament materials, component by External Wall etc., when fire occurs, sprawling of the intensity of a fire by exterior wall can effectively be slowed down, gained time for fire-fighting and rescue.

title_en: Water-level monitoring system and method for early warning of landslide of rock slopes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-level monitoring system and method for early warning of landslide of rock slopes and belongs to the technical field of environment monitoring. The water-level monitoring system comprises a water pressure meter buried at a sliding surface and a water level meter arranged at the top part of a pull-apart crack of the rear edge. The water-level monitoring system also comprises a wireless remote system and an operation system, wherein the wireless remote system is connected with the water pressure meter and the water level meter by a data line; the operation system is used for receiving water-pressure monitoring data and water-level monitoring data of the wireless remote system. Site monitoring data is transmitted to the operation system by wireless signals, and an early-warning value and a site value can be given out simultaneously by monitoring software in the operation system, so that the subjectivity of the early-warning value artificially set is avoided and remote automatic monitoring and predicted early warning of landslide can be realized. The water-level monitoring system is mainly used for monitoring the water level and does not need to install a borehole clinometer and a stress sensor, so that the construction difficulty and the monitoring cost are reduced.
assignees: HONG DA GUO YUAN WUHU RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENTAL MAN CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact blood pressure monitoring method based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
