abstract_en: The invention provides a frequency-modulated continuous wave radar-based non-contact blood pressure monitoring method, which belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, an echo signal from a chest of a human body to be detected is collected by a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, then a heart rate value of a human body target is detected through variational modal decomposition, relocation is carried out in an interval by a pulse wave extraction method based on heart rate guidance to obtain a pulse wave signal with smaller interference, different modes are screened by taking the heart rate as a standard through VMD decomposition and then added, the interference of respiration and slight body movement on the pulse wave signal is removed, a relatively pure effective pulse wave signal waveform is obtained based on heart rate recovery, then time characteristics related to blood pressure are extracted from the waveform, a blood pressure estimation model is constructed, and the period of heart contraction and expansion is extracted for blood pressure prediction. The non-contact continuous blood pressure monitoring algorithm provided by the invention can accurately and robustly realize blood pressure estimation and provides possibility for realizing long-term real-time non-contact blood pressure monitoring.

title_en: Thermal cycle chemical industry reation kettle
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal cycle chemical reaction kettle, which relates to the field of chemical reaction kettles, and comprises: a base; the base is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the unloading pool, the unloading pool is buried underground in a workshop, and the upper end face of the unloading pool is level with the ground of the workshop; the chemical reaction kettle main body is fixedly arranged on the left side of the upper end surface of the base, and the thermal circulation box is fixedly arranged on the right side of the upper end surface of the base; an insulation layer is arranged outside the chemical reaction kettle main body; according to the invention, through the cooperation of the temperature sensor, the controller and the auxiliary discharging mechanism, the quick discharging work can be realized when the chemical reaction kettle encounters emergency situations such as continuous overhigh production temperature, and the like, so that the safety of the chemical reaction kettle is improved when the chemical reaction kettle encounters emergency situations; the problem of current chemical industry reation kettle when meetting the production temperature and last emergency such as too high is difficult to realize quick blowing work to the security when meetting the emergency has been reduced to chemical industry reation kettle.
assignees: NANTONG HUAXING MAGNETIC MAT CO LTD

title_en: Multipath echo identification and personnel detection method based on fingerprint characteristics of vital signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipath echo discrimination and personnel detection method based on fingerprint characteristics of a life signal. And further, based on the extraction of multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal fingerprint characteristics of the millimeter wave radar, the multi-target personnel are distinguished and detected and the multi-path false targets are identified according to the similarity of the fingerprint characteristics of the multi-path false targets and the corresponding real targets. The invention does not need priori information of the environment, does not need post measurement of the environment size, and has small scene limitation; the method is applicable to complex indoor scenes and has strong practicability; the method is effective in multi-person vital sign detection, and can remove multipath only by a single radar, so that the whole detection system is simplified; the method does not need to change the configuration of the radar array and other system layers.

title_en: Method and system for synchronously collecting multi-person gestures of through-wall radar and binocular camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for synchronously collecting Multi-person gestures of a through-wall radar and a binocular camera, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively acquiring an echo signal of the through-wall radar and an image of the binocular camera; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing echo signals to obtain a channel-distance matrix formed by stacking one-dimensional distance images of all receiving and transmitting channels of a radar, synthesizing binocular camera images to obtain a synthesized image, performing three-dimensional position calculation on the synthesized image to obtain three-dimensional point clouds of all pixel points in the synthesized image, performing time matching on the channel-distance matrix, the synthesized image and the three-dimensional point clouds to obtain an initial data frame, extracting YOLO gesture information based on the three-dimensional point clouds, estimating three-dimensional gestures from the images through a Multi-HMR algorithm, fusing the two gesture information to generate a final tag, and performing spatial registration on the gesture tag and radar data to form the final data frame. The invention realizes high-quality three-dimensional attitude information acquisition.
assignees: SUN YAT SEN UNIV SHENZHEN;UNIV SUN YAT SEN

title_en: A method of health functional dried fruit using jujube
title_ko: 건강 기능성 대추 건과 제조방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A producing method of health functional dried jujube is provided to offer the crunchy texture and the excellent nutrition of the jujube to eaters. CONSTITUTION: A producing method of health functional dried jujube comprises the following steps: dipping dried jujube in a medical herb extract for 1-1.5 minutes; separating the jujube from the extract, and coating the jujube with medical herb powder; and drying the coated jujube with low temperature air at 45-50 deg C using a microwave drier. A medical herb for the medical extract is selected from red ginseng, schisandra chinensis, schisandra chinensis, chaenomeles sinensis, and ginger.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 (a) 건대추를 한약재 추출물에 침수하여 한약재 추출물을 대추에 침투시키는 단계; (b) 한약재 추출물이 침투된 건대추를 수득하는 단계; (c) 상기 수득된 한약재 추출물이 침투된 건대추에 한약재 분말을 도포하여 코팅하는 단계; 및 (d) 상기 한약재 분말로 코팅된 건대추를 저온풍 건조하는 단계를 포함하는 건강 기능성 대추 건과(乾果) 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 제조방법은 (c)의 건대추를 마이크로웨이브를 이용하여 저온풍 건조함으로써 동결건조 방식보다 건조시간이 단축될 뿐만 아니라, 대추의 천연 감미와 약리성을 그대로 유지하면서 씹는 질감을 살릴 수 있어 바삭바삭하면서 영양이 풍부한 대추 건과 제조를 가능하게 한다. 또한 본 발명의 제조방법에 따라 제조된 대추 건과는 원재료가 대추 및 한약재 성분으로 이루어져 영양이 풍부하며 안전한 건강 기능성 건과이며, 대추를 주재료로 하되 대추에 첨가되는(추출물과 분말) 재료에 따라 그 맛이 달라지며, 또한 씹는 질감이 바삭바삭(스넥처럼)하기 때문에 남녀노소, 특히 대추 및 한약재를 일반적으로 섭취하는데 거부감을 보이는 어린아이들에게도 손쉽게 다가갈 수 있는 이상적인 천연 기호식품이다.

title_en: Emergency situation detection system in private space based on Thermal array sensor
title_ko: 열상감지 센서 기반 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency detection system in a private space, capable of accurately detecting emergency while minimizing exposure of privacy based on a thermal array sensor. The emergency detection system in the private space comprises: the thermal array sensor for detecting an object in a detection area in which privacy protection is required; a vibration sensor sensing the magnitude of vibration in the detection area; a respiration sensor detecting a respiration pattern of the object when the object sensed by the thermal array sensor is a person; a smart hub relaying data between the thermal array sensor, the vibration sensor, and the respiration sensor, and an analysis server; and the analysis server individually receiving sensing data of the vibration sensor, sensing data of the respiration sensor, and an image photographed by the thermal array sensor and determining the emergency while detecting a predetermined movement pattern of the predetermined object by being applied with a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm.
abstract_ko: 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 열상감지 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 열상감지 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 열상감지 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 열상감지 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for Monitoring Emergency Patients in an Ambulance Interio Using Vital Signs Response
title_ko: 활력징후 반응형 구급차 내부 응급환자 모니터링방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 적어도 구급차 내부에 하나 이상 설치된 카메라와 응급환자의 활력징후를 측정하기 위한 활력징후 측정부, 상기 카메라와 활력징후 측정부를 제어하고 카메라와 센서에 의해 측정된 정보를 무선통신을 이용해 전송하기 위한 컨트롤부, 상기 컨트롤부로 부터 전송된 정보를 모니터링할 수 있고 또 컨트롤부를 제어할 수 있는 관제서버로 이루어지는 구급차 내부 응급모니터링시스템을 통해 구현되도록 하되, 상기 활력징후 측정부에 의해 응급환자의 활력징후를 측정하는 단계와, 측정된 활력징후에 의한 정보를 바탕으로 응급환자의 처치가 필요한 부분을 향해 카메라가 포커싱하는 단계와, 상기 활력징후 측정부에 의해 측정된 활력징후 정보와 포커싱된 카메라로 부터 얻어진 영상정보가 관제서버로 전송되도록 하는 단계와, 상기 전송된 활력징후 정보와 응급환자의 처치가 필요한 부분이 촬영된 영상정보를 관제서버에 의해 모니터링 또는 저장될 수 있도록 하는 단계로 이루어지는 활력징후 반응형 구급차 내부 응급환자 모니터링방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로, 본 발명의 효과로는 구급차 내부에 설치되고 인공지능의 객체추적기술을 활용하는 카메라에 의해 응급환자의 활력징후에 따라 응급환자의 신체부위를 확대 및 집중촬영하여 환자의 상태에 대한 정확한 모니터링을 가능하게 하고, 또 고품질의 영상 데이터를 확보하여 환자의 응급조치에 만전을 기할 수 있으며, 의학적 분석 및 연구, 교육자료 등으로 활용가능할 뿐만 아니라 신속하고 정확한 데이터 분석 및 AI 기반 응급 가이드를 통해 응급 상황에서 환자의 상태를 효과적으로 관리하고 생존율을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있는 매우 유용한 발명인 것이다.

title_en: Millimeter wave (mmwave) mapping systems and methods for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs for defining a human psychological state
abstract_en: Millimeter (mmWave) mapping systems and methods are disclosed for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs for defining a human psychological state. A point cloud comprising point cloud data defining a person or an object detected within a physical space is generated based on one or more mmWave waveforms of an mmWave sensor. A posture of the person within the portion of the physical space is determined from the point cloud data. One or more vital signs of the person is determined based on the mmWave waveform(s). An electronic feedback is provided representing a human psychological state of the person as defined by the point cloud data and the one or more vital signs of the person.

title_en: Device, system and method for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: In order to provide means for measuring vital signs such as heart rate, breathing rate, pulse forms, that allow accurate and unobtrusive signal acquisition and that are automatically adjusted to varying positions of an area of interest within a predetermined area, a device, a system and a method for measuring vital signs are provided, wherein electromagnetic signals such as microwave or radar are emitted and reflected electromagnetic signals are sensed with directional sensitivity by a transceiving unit and wherein a direction of interest is determined based on the sensed reflected signals and a primary direction of sensitivity (300) of the transceiving unit is adjusted to the direction of interest by a control unit. Thus, vital signs can be monitored in an unobtrusive and simple way.
assignees: KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV;PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;MULDER BERNARDO ARNOLDUS;ANGELIS GEORGO ZORZ;DILLEN PAULUS HENRICUS ANTONIUS;VAN DALFSEN AGE JOCHEM;SEVO ALEKSANDAR;PINTER ROBERT;IGNEY CLAUDIA HANNELORE;GODLIEB ROBERT;VAN DEN BOOGAARD MAARTEN

title_en: Method of attaching sensor for sensing carbon dioxide to drone, searching for site where carbon dioxide concentration is high, and sending information thereof to mobile terminal such as smartphone
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a method that has few constraints in terms of use, makes it easy to ascertain location information for people who have been buried alive due to a disaster, and makes it possible to efficiently conduct rescue operations. [Solution] A method for discovering a place where a person (H) has been buried alive due to a landslide or a building collapse, wherein the method is characterized by comprising: a step for fixing, to a drone (10), a carbon dioxide sensor (13) that is a sensor provided for the purpose of detecting and measuring carbon dioxide; a step for flying the drone; a step for sensing, with the carbon dioxide sensor, a degree of carbon dioxide concentration consistent with a person breathing; a step for identifying location information for the sensed place; and a step for thereafter transmitting information to a mobile terminal (70).

title_en: Method for avoiding an accident or for mitigating the consequences of an accident
abstract_en: A method for avoiding accidents a biometric sensor system is used to ascertain vital signs of a vehicle occupant, and in the event that the vital signs lie outside a normal range, preparatory emergency measures are carried out in a safety system in the vehicle.

title_en: Wafer scale. ultra-wide band (uwb) radiometer with sensor probe for disaster victim rescue
abstract_en: A multi-sensor system is disclosed for detecting victims that may be trapped or buried (for example, earthquake survivors in collapsed buildings) and for accurately and safely locating such victims for safe and efficient rescue. An ultra wide band (UWB) radiometer sensor can detect and precisely calculate the position of the victim relative to a known position of a sensor probe or a monitoring unit of a sensor system. A sensing probe may be guided toward a victim and provide a combination of sensors and transducers (e.g., radiometer, optical and infrared camera, acoustic or sound transducers such as microphone and speaker) that may allow a probe operator remote from the subject (e.g., victim) to also determine the condition and status of the victim and communicate with the victim. With unique coding of the UWB signals, multiple units can be used together to triangulate a more exact position of each victim.

title_en: Systems and methods for vehicle occupant vital sign detection
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detection and/or estimation of a rate of an occupant vital sign from within a cabin of a vehicle. In some implementations, the method may comprise identifying a repeating pattern of Doppler spectrum peaks in RADAR signal using a plurality of different range bins. An estimated frequency distance between adjacent peaks of the repeating pattern may then be identified using the signal data. An estimated rate of a repeating vital sign of an occupant within the cabin of the vehicle may then be calculated using the estimated frequency distance.

title_en: Chest-based physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Earthquake wave underground construction space observation system and method based on random arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake wave underground construction space observation system and method based on random arrangement, and belongs to a geological survey method of underground construction. The system comprises an earthquake wave trigger and an earthquake wave receiver, the earthquake wave trigger and the earthquake wave receiver are both connected into a data acquisition instrument, and the data acquisition instrument is further connected into a computer. The earthquake wave trigger comprises a plurality of kinds of earthquake wave excitation devices, and respective starting switches are arranged on the earthquake wave excitation devices. The earthquake wave receiver comprises detector strings which are used for being buried underground and on the ground to detect different earthquake waves. Each earthquake wave sensor in the earthquake wave receivers is used as a basic unit, position description and direction description are carried out, ray tracing and homing imaging are carried out on received transmission waves and reflection waves through position offset and angle offset, and earthquake data correction, processing and standard wave spectrum display are achieved.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar self-focusing compressed sensing imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar self-focusing compressed sensing imaging methods, scene imaging after wall parameter Estimation and wall is unified into the same processing frame, high-resolution target picture is obtained while obtaining wall parameter Estimation, reduce the band resource of system transmitting terminal occupancy and the hits of receiving end, operation complexity is reduced, detection efficient is improved.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method based on radar signals and detection radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar signal-based multi-target life detection method and a detection radar, wherein time accumulation in a slow time direction is carried out on a preprocessed echo signal to obtain a first echo signal; carrying out inflection point envelope extraction on the first echo signal to obtain a second echo signal; calculating the average value of all amplitude signals except the M mark amplitude signals in the second echo signal; if the ratio of the marking amplitude signal to the average value is larger than a threshold value, a life target is arranged at the radar detection distance corresponding to the marking amplitude signal; the life detection method provided by the invention normalizes the amplitude of the radar signal on the dimension of fast time (distance) by adopting a normalization method, solves the problem of energy attenuation generated along with the increase of the distance in the transmission process of the radar signal, and effectively reduces the rate of missing judgment of a far-end target; and the method of twice inflection point envelope extraction is adopted, so that the multi-target axial identification accuracy is improved.

title_en: Multimode compound life detection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and discloses a multimode composite life detection system which comprises a radar detection module, an infrared sensor module, an acoustic detection module, a central processing unit and a data processing and signal fusion module, wherein the radar detection module is used for detecting surrounding environment through radar signals and identifying the position and existence of a target, the infrared sensor module is used for detecting the body temperature change of a life body through temperature difference, the acoustic detection module is used for detecting weak sound signals of the life body through sound collection and analysis, the central processing unit is used for coordinating the work of each module, receiving and processing signals from different detection modules and carrying out signal fusion and judging the existence of the life body, and the data processing and signal fusion module is used for receiving the signals of each detection module. According to the invention, through multi-mode composite detection, environment adaptability modeling, wireless communication optimization and intelligent man-machine interaction interface, high-precision life detection, stable data transmission and high-efficiency operation response in a complex environment are realized, and rescue efficiency and accuracy are greatly improved.

title_en: Portable radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable radar life detector in the technical field of radar detection equipment, which comprises a machine case, a supporting table, a workbench and a working table, wherein the top of the machine case is hinged with an organic cover, the top of the machine cover is provided with a handle assembly, the supporting table is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the machine case, the circumferential inner wall of the supporting table is rotatably connected with a rotary table through a bearing, the bottom of the supporting table is provided with a rotating mechanism for driving the rotary table to rotate, the surface of the workbench is designed into a spherical shape, and the middle of the rotary table is provided with a spherical groove matched with the surface of the workbench. The invention can convert the detection radar body from a vertical state to an inclined state, and enables the detection radar body to break through the limitation of the traditional vertical downward detection, thereby realizing the scanning of different areas by changing the detection direction, covering wider areas, accurately detecting the life signs at different positions and greatly improving the accuracy and the effectiveness of life detection.

title_en: Radar-based vital sign estimation
A sensor and a method of sensing thereof
title_ko: 센서 및 센싱방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 측정센서 및 측정방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정센서는 발진기, 신호검출부 및 신호처리부를 포함하며, 발진기의 발진주파수 편이량을 생체신호의 크기변화로 검출하고 검출된 생체신호로부터 맥박신호 및 호흡신호를 각각 검출한다.  
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정센서 및 측정방법은 생체신호 검출대상과 비접촉하여 이루어지며, 근거리에서 정확한 생체신호 검출이 가능하다.

title_en: System for detecting underground facilities by performing hybrid multi-exploration
title_ko: 하이브리드 멀티 탐사를 실시하여 탐사율을 향상시킬 수 있는 지하시설물 탐사시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility exploring system, which comprises: an underground facility probe for exploring the depth and position of a buried underground facility using a magnetic field; a high-power probe for exploring the depth and position of the buried underground facility using a magnetic field relatively higher than that of the underground facility probe; and a ground penetrating radar (GPR) device for exploring the depth and position of the underground facility by receiving a signal reflected from the underground facility after radiating a pulse. According to the present invention, hybrid multi-exploration capable of accurate exploration through fusion of different devices, such as an underground facility probe and a GPR device is performed, thereby improving an exploration rate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 탐사시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 자기장을 이용하여 매설된 지하시설물의 심도와 위치를 탐사하는 지하시설물탐사기, 지하시설물탐사기보다 상대적으로 높은 자기장을 이용하여 매설된 지하시설물의 심도와 위치를 탐사하는 고출력탐사기 및 펄스를 방사한 후 지하시설물에 반사된 신호를 수신하여 지하시설물의 심도와 위치를 탐사하는 지피알장비를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 지하시설물탐사기와 지피알장비 등 이기종 장비의 융합을 통하여 정확한 탐사가 가능한 하이브리드 멀티 탐사를 실시하여 탐사율을 향상시킬 수 있는 지하시설물 탐사시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Noncontact self-injection-locked sensor
abstract_en: In a noncontact self-injection-locked sensor, a self-injection-locked oscillating integrated antenna is designed to radiate a signal to a subject and be injection-locked by a reflect signal reflected from the subject. Owing to the reflect signal is phase-modulated by vital signs of the subject, a demodulator is provided to demodulate an injection-locked signal of the self-injection-locked oscillating integrated antenna to obtain a vital signal of the subject.
assignees: SIL RADAR TECH INC;UNIV NAT TAIWAN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Biological information acquisition device and biological information acquisition method
abstract_en: A biological information acquisition device includes a detection-value acquisition unit to acquire a detection value from a non-contact biometric sensor, a vital measurement unit to measure a vital sign of a target person (TP) using the detection value, an image-data acquisition unit to acquire image data indicating an image captured by a camera, an image processing unit to perform at least one of a state estimation process of estimating a state of the target person, an attribute estimation process of estimating an attribute of the target person, or a personal identification process of identifying the target person by performing image processing on the image captured including the target person, and a parameter setting unit to set a parameter in measuring the vital sign in accordance with a result of the image processing.

title_en: A sight glass structure for a roller type fire shutter
title_ko: 롤러 타입 방화셔터용 투시창 구조
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 롤러 타입 방화셔터용 투시창 구조는, 저장박스의 내부에 감속모터에 연결된 차단판 롤러가 포함되고, 양측 가이드 레일 사이에 다수의 철판단위체로 구성된 차단판이 결합되어 화재감시센서의 화재신호에 의해 통로가 차단되도록 구성된 롤러 타입 방화셔터에 있어서, 상기 철판단위체의 철판을 관통하는 투시구멍; 철판이 절곡되어 상하좌우 네개의 변을 이루고, 일측 네개의 변이 안쪽으로 절곡되어 전면에 투시구를 이루어 상기 투시구멍에 결합되는 투시창 하우징; 철판이 "ㄷ"자 형상으로 절곡되고, 상부의 양측판이 일정한 깊이로 절삭되어 가운데 부분이 돌출된 돌출판이 형성되고, 상기 돌출판에 축홀이 형성된 한쌍의 브라켓; 상기 한쌍의 브라켓에 삽입되는 석영유리; 상기 양측 브라켓 돌출판의 축홀에 삽입되어 구르도록 구성된 굴대; 상기 석영유리의 하부를 감싸는 하부커버 난연천; 상기 석영유리의 앞뒤와 굴대를 감싸는 덮게 난연천; 및 상기 덮게 난연천의 단부가 외부로 돌출되어 형성된 손잡이;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Phase-locked tracking loop-based through-wall detection wall body suppression method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase-locked tracking loop-based through-wall detection wall body suppression method. The method includes the following steps that: 1) original echo signals received by a receiving antenna are multiplied by the sine and cosine of local carriers respectively which are generated by a PLL (phase locked loop) module, after the carriers are removed, the signals are divided into two paths of signals; 2) the two paths of signals are transmitted to a first DLL module together, and after the delay phase tau of an M sequence is calculated, the M sequence is outputted, and is multiplied by the cosine of the carriers outputted by the PLL module, so that direct wave signals can be obtained; 3) subtraction is performed on the received original signals and the direct wave signals, so that direct wave-free signals can be obtained; 4) processing modes from the step 1) and the step 3) are repeated through a plurality of DLL modules sequentially, and target echo information can be obtained finally, and the method terminates. The method of the invention has the advantages of proper signal to noise ratio and accurate target detection when being applied to through-the-wall radars.

title_en: Life entity double station cooperative detection method based on single channel ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life entity double station cooperative detection method based on single channel ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR, pass through echo-signal in the radar receiving area of two different locations, form two two-dimentional echo-signal matrixes, motion filtering is carried out respectively to two matrixes, two matrixes are subjected to cross-correlation calculation along slow time dimension after the operation such as low-pass filtering, cross correlation matrix number is formed, calculates specific location and the imaging of target at a distance from two radars using target in cross-correlation matrix.This method can either realize effective detection to multiple and different strong and weak life entity targets, the range information relative to two radars of each life entity target can be disposably extracted again, the location information of life entity target can be resolved without pairing processing, it can be effectively reduced false-alarm and false dismissal probability under multi-target condition, the accuracy and robustness for improving human body target detection can satisfy the needs of the plural faint vital signs detection of name trapped person under the occasions such as disaster assistance.

title_en: Target imaging method and system based on multipath echo suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of through-wall radar target imaging, in particular to a target imaging method and a system based on multipath echo suppression, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original echo of a through-wall radar; determining pixel point amplitude and multipath echo peak value in the target amplitude image according to the original echo and multipath propagation coefficient by using a delay-sum beam forming algorithm; carrying out echo elimination according to the pixel point amplitude and the multipath echo peak value to obtain a plurality of wall body elimination echoes; fusing the plurality of wall echo elimination images to determine a fused image; imaging the original echo by using a BP algorithm to obtain an echo image; sequentially carrying out region division and sequencing on the echo images to obtain a pixel point set; screening overlapping targets according to the pixel point set, the amplitude threshold and the area limiting proportion to obtain overlapping target images; and superposing the fused image and the superposed target image to determine the target image. The invention improves the accuracy of target imaging by eliminating part of echoes.

title_en: Deep-buried tunnel surrounding rock dielectric property inversion and loosening ring range identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for inverting the dielectric property of surrounding rock of a deep-buried tunnel and identifying the scope of a loosening ring  Front side  Conductivity σ  Front part  And magnetic permeability mu  Front part  Obtaining a scan of the region of interest, and calculating the radar wave velocity v through a wave velocity model before excavation  Front side  (ii) a After the deep-buried tunnel is excavated, the high-precision dielectric constant epsilon and the conductivity sigma are output through dielectric property inversion, and the excavated deep-buried tunnel is solved through an excavated wave velocity modelThe wave velocity v; calculating the thickness of the loosening ring according to the wave velocity v; passing wave velocity v and radar wave velocity v  Front side  And (4) taking the square of the ratio as the quantitative evaluation of the integrity degree of the loose circle of the surrounding rock, and dividing a condition table according to the rock integrity index to obtain the grade of the loose circle of the surrounding rock. The method solves the problems of low measurement precision, unreliable measurement data, complex operation and the like in the conventional method for measuring the range of the loose coil after the deep-buried tunnel is blasted.
assignees: UNIV SHENYANG TECHNOLOGY;CHINA RAILWAY 19TH BUREAU GROUP 3RD CO LTD

title_en: Oxygen generator breathing optimization system and method, oxygen generator and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to oxygen generation control, and particularly relates to an oxygen generator breathing optimization system, an oxygen generator, a storage medium, a breathing detection pressure sensor for detecting the breathing frequency of a wearer, an oxygen storage container for storing oxygen generated by an oxygen generation module, an electromagnetic valve arranged on an oxygen delivery pipe communicated with the oxygen storage container, a blood oxygen saturation and heart rate detection sensor for detecting blood oxygen saturation and heart rate data of the wearer, and a control module electrically connected with the breathing detection pressure sensor, the electromagnetic valve and the blood oxygen saturation and heart rate detection sensor, wherein the control module is configured to be suitable for controlling the valve opening time and the valve opening frequency of the electromagnetic valve according to the detected breathing frequency and the detected blood oxygen saturation and heart rate data. The invention can be used to adapt the oxygen output or shut down to the breathing rhythm of the wearer.
assignees: XUZHOU YONGKANG ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir engineering safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a reservoir engineering safety management system and method, comprising the steps of acquiring a crack chromatographic image of a drainage gallery wall body through a through-wall type ground penetrating radar, and synchronously acquiring infiltration linear displacement dynamic data of a distributed optical fiber sensor; the method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on the two types of data, constructing a fracture space topological relation and a seepage conduction path model, generating a defect-seepage coupling map, utilizing a coupling map analysis module and a space-time convolution neural network module to identify the abrupt change trend of the displacement rate of a seepage line, triggering a gallery structure failure early warning signal, automatically generating a reinforcement work order after early warning, calling an unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out high-definition image rechecking task, and feeding back a rechecking result to correct the seepage conduction path model to realize dynamic self-correction. The invention has the capabilities of accurate modeling, intelligent early warning and real-time closed-loop regulation and control, and can remarkably improve the structural safety management level of reservoir engineering.
assignees: ANHUI JUNYUAN WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve efficiency in survey operation by an operator of an underground radar and quality of survey data in an underground radar system which detects an object buried under the ground.SOLUTION: An underground radar 1 has a radar body 2 equipped with an electromagnetic wave transmission part 5 for transmitting an electromagnetic wave towards the underground and an electromagnetic wave reception part 6 for receiving a reflection wave of the transmitted electromagnetic wave, and surveys a buried object 11 which is buried under the ground from reception wave data based on the electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 6. The underground radar 1 includes a location measurement part 3 for measuring a two-dimensional location of the radar body 2 at a survey area, a direction measurement part 4 for acquiring information on movement direction of the radar body 2 and a storage part 8 for unifying the reception wave data based on the electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 6 in surveying at the survey area, the two-dimensional location data acquired by the location measurement part 3 and the movement direction information acquired by the direction measurement part 4 as survey data of one unit and storing the survey data for each survey location.

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method based on wireless radar signal, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a vital sign detection device and method based on a wireless radar signal.SOLUTION: The method includes: determining an initial position of a living body based on a wireless radar signal; determining a target position corresponding to a characteristic signal matching with a physiological characteristic of the living body based on a frequence area feature of the characteristic signal for detecting a vital sign parameter within a range of an adjacent area including the initial position; and detecting the vital sign parameter based on the characteristic signal at the target position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Garment able to measure physical signal and the system using that
title_ko: 생체신호 수집이 가능한 의류 및 이를 이용한 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A garment able to measure physical signal and a system using the same are provided to help a user to manage an emergency situation by collecting a bio-signal and transmitting it to a management system in wireless. CONSTITUTION: In a garment able to measure physical signal and a system using the same, a fiber type sensor senses a bio-signal. The bio-signal transmission line transmits a detected bio-signal. A signal transmission unit(100) transmits the detected bio-signal to outside in wireless. The signal transmission unit transmits data in one of Zigbee communication and Bluetooth communication. The garment is comprised of a conductive fiber and a fiber sensor. A bio-information management server deciphers the bio-signal received from the garment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 의복 착용자의 착용감과 편리성을 최대화하면서도 생체신호를 정확하게 측정할 수 있도록 하는 생체신호 수집이 가능한 의류 및 이를 이용한 시스템에 관한 것으로, 생체신호를 감지하는 섬유형 센서, 전기 전도성을 가진 직물로 구현되며, 상기 섬유형 센서와 연결되어 감지된 상기 생체신호를 전송하는 생체신호 전송 선로 및 상기 생체신호 전송 선로와 연결되어 상기 감지된 생체신호를 수신하여 외부로 무선 송신하는 신호 송신부를 포함하며, 이에 따라 비침습, 무구속적으로 생체신호를 측정함에 따라 인체의 다양한 활동시에도 쾌적한 착의성을 도모할 수 있으며, 섬유형 센서 및 전도성 섬유를 이용하여 신호의 측정 및 전달이 이루어지도록 함으로써 인체의 다양한 동작에도 안정적인 생체정보 획득과 안정적인 생체정보 전달을 가능하게 할 수 있다.

title_en: System and control method for feedback of user emotion by robot
title_ko: 사용자의 생체정보 분석을 통한 감정상태 분석장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A feeling state analysis apparatus and method through bio-information analysis of a user are provided to analyze and determine a feeling state of the user by using a bio-signal including pulse waves, electric skin resistance, skin temperature, and external temperature etc. CONSTITUTION: A feeling analysis apparatus determines a feeling state of a user. A feeling reactor executes a fixed operation according to feeling condition information. A biosensor part measures each bio-information(S101). An analog to digital converter changes the bio-information into a digital signal. A main processor determines the feeling state of the user. The main processor transmits the feeling condition information to the feeling reactor. A feeling reaction control part drives feeling reactions. A music player reproduces and outputs sound data through a speaker.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 로봇을 통한 인간의 감정반응 시스템 및 그 제어방법은 사용자로부터 수집한 맥파(PPG), 피부전기전도도(GSR), 피부온도(SKT)등 생체신호를 이용하여 사용자의 감정상태를 인식 및 판단하고, 이를 로봇으로 전송하여 로봇이 사용자의 감정상태에 따라 설정된 반응을 하도록 로봇을 제어하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 다수의 바이오센서를 이용하여 추출된 사용자의 생체정보를 연산하여 사용자의 감정을 인식하는 감정분석장치와, 감정분석장치로부터 전송된 감정상태정보에 따라 로봇이 설정된 동작을 수행하도록 하는 로봇을 통한 사용자의 감정반응 시스템에 있어서, 감정분석장치는 맥파센서, 피부온도센서 및 피부전기저항센서로부터 각 생체정보를 측정하는 바이오센서부; 바이오센서부로부터 검지된 아날로그 생체정보를 디지털신호로 변환하는 아날로그/디지털변환부; 및 아날로그/디지털변환부를 통해 입력된 생체정보를 연산하여 사용자의 감정상태를 판단하고, 감정반응장치로 전송하는 메인프로세서;를 포함하여 구성되고, 감정반응장치는 감정분석장치로부터 전송된 사용자의 감정상태에 따라 설정된 감정반응을 구동하는 감정반응제어부; 로봇의 동작을 제어하는 로봇구동부; 설정된 음악을 재생하는 음악재생부;를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Flexible bio-signal measuring sensor
title_ko: 유연성 생체신호 측정센서
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flexibility biometric signal measuring sensor. According to the present invention, the sensor comprises: a flexibility body; a biometric signal sensing electrode formed on the body; and a biometric signal transmission unit electrically connected to the biometric signal sensing electrode. The present invention provides a flexibility biometric signal measuring sensor, which may maximize user convenience and a wearing sensation and improve biometric signal measurement accuracy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유연성 생체신호 측정센서에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 유연성 생체신호 측정센서는 유연성(flexible) 본체; 상기 본체 상에 형성된 생체신호 감지 전극; 및 상기 생체신호 감지 전극에 전기적으로 연결된 생체신호 전송부;를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA RES INST FOR FASHION INDUSTRY

title_en: Life-saving sensor for using of reconnaissance robot and operating method thereof
title_ko: 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a life detection sensor for utilizing a reconnaissance robot and an operating method thereof. An object of the present invention is to provide the life detection sensor capable of searching for human life on behalf of a firefighter in a space and an environment which are difficult to access. The life detection sensor for utilizing the reconnaissance robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a sensor unit mounted inside or outside the reconnaissance robot and detecting human life from a detection area; a plurality of antenna units mounted on front, rear, left, and right perpendicular surfaces of the reconnaissance robot and transmitting and receiving signals of the sensor unit; a signal processing unit which is mounted inside the reconnaissance robot, derives presence or absence and detection result of human life from the signal of the sensor unit received through the antenna units, and transmits the same to a server; and a control unit mounted inside the reconnaissance robot, and controlling the sensor unit, the antenna units, and the signal processing unit according to performance of the reconnaissance robot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서 및 그 운용방법을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서는. 정찰용로봇의 내부 또는 외부에 장착되며, 검출지역으로부터 인명을 탐지하는 센서부; 정찰용로봇의 전, 후, 좌, 우 수직면에 복수로 장착되며, 센서부의 신호를 송수신하는 안테나부; 정찰용로봇의 내부에 장착되며, 안테나부를 통해 수신한 센서부의 신호로부터 인명유무 및 탐지결과를 도출하여 서버로 송신하는 신호처리부; 및 정찰용로봇의 내부에 장착되며, 정찰용로봇의 임무 수행에 따라 센서부, 안테나부 및 신호처리부를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Bio-signal measuring device and bio-signal real-time monitoring system including the same
title_ko: 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 포함하는 생체신호 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A bio-signal measurement device and a bio-signal real-time monitoring system including the same are provided. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal measurement device comprises: a wearable sensor device which periodically measures bio-signal information of a user while attached to or worn on the body of the user and transmits the measured bio-signal information to the outside in real time; and a data collection transmitter which is worn by the user, receives the bio-signal information transmitted from the wearable sensor device, and transmits the user's bio-signal information received from the wearable sensor device to the outside, wherein the data collection transmitter may include an emergency alert signal generator that generates an emergency alert signal when operated by the user and transmits the generated emergency alert signal to the outside. According to the present invention, a user can send an emergency alert signal to a monitoring manager and thus can quickly and efficiently respond in the case of an emergency.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 포함하는 생체신호 실시간 모니터링 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정장치는 사용자의 신체에 부착 또는 착용된 상태에서 상기 사용자의 생체정보를 주기적으로 측정하고, 측정된 생체정보를 실시간으로 외부로 송출하는 웨어러블형 센서 디바이스; 및 사용자가 패용하고, 상기 웨어러블형 센서 디바이스에서 전송된 생체정보를 수신하며, 상기 웨어러블형 센서 디바이스로부터 수신된 사용자의 생체정보를 외부로 송출하는 데이터 수집 송신기;를 포함하고, 상기 데이터 수집 송신기는 사용자의 조작시 긴급알람신호를 생성하여 외부로 송출하는 긴급알람신호발생부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A system for detecting passengers who have not gotten off a school bus using radar sensors
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 미하차 탑승객 검출 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 미하차 탑승객 검출 시스템은 차량 내 좌석이 배치된 행마다 복수 개 설치되되, 통학 차량 내부의 일측 벽면에 좌석 시트에 상응하는 높이로 각 좌석 행마다 설치되어 타측 벽면 방향으로 사람의 생체 신호를 검출하는 복수의 레이더 센서 모듈과, 레이더 센서 모듈들로부터 생체 신호 검출 결과를 수신하여 미하차 탑승객을 검출한다. 이때, 본 발명은 설치된 레이더 센서 모듈의 레이더 신호가 간섭되지 않도록 시간을 분할하여 미하차 탑승객을 검출하도록 제어된다.

title_en: Wake-up sensing device
title_ko: 웨이크-업 감지 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a wake-up sensing device according to an embodiment of the present invention. The wake-up sensing device comprises: a sensor for sensing a person's movement and the person's biometric signal; and a control unit which analyzes the movement and biometric signal recognized by the sensor, and on the basis of the movement and biometric signal analysis result, determines whether or not the person wakes up, wherein the control unit determines the person's heart rate changed when a sleep state is switched to a non-sleep state, and the control unit outputs a first alarm when it is determined that the heart rate is changed, and the person's movement is increased.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 웨이크-업 감지 장치를 제공한다. 웨이크-업 감지 장치는 사람의 움직임 및 사람의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 움직임 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석하고, 상기 움직임 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석한 결과에 기초하여 사람이 잠에서 깨는지 여부를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 수면 상태에서 비수면 상태로 전환될 때의 사람의 심박수의 변화를 판단하고, 상기 제어부는 상기 심박수의 변화 및 사람의 움직임이 증가된 것으로 판단하는 경우 제1 알람을 출력한다.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Vehicle occupant detection
abstract_en: A vehicle occupant detection system and method for using the same. The vehicle occupant detection system includes: a controller; a plurality of life detection sensors, wherein the plurality of life detection sensors are installed within an interior cabin of a mass-transit vehicle and are each associated with a life detection zone; a local warning system having at least one human-machine interface (HMI) output device; and a vehicle interface that communicatively couples the controller to a vehicle electrical system of the mass-transit vehicle. The vehicle occupant detection system is configured to: (i) acquire sensor data by scanning the life detection zone using the plurality of life detection sensors; (ii) determine whether an occupant is present based on the sensor data; and (iii) provide an indication to a user that an occupant is present using the HMI output device when it is determined that an occupant is present.

title_en: Respiration detection using radar
abstract_en: One or more radar sensors may be used to monitor a patient in a variety of different environments and embodiments. In one embodiment, radar sensors may be used to monitor the patient's respiration, including monitoring tidal volume, chest expansion distance, respiration rate, and the like. In another embodiment, the position of the patient on the patient bed may be monitored, which position may be used as feedback for controlling the bladder of the patient bed. Additional embodiments are described herein.

title_en: Intelligent elderly accompanying system based on computer vision technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent nursing system for the elderly based on a computer vision technology. The system mainly comprises an indoor monitoring system, a robot system and a mobile equipment display terminal. The indoor monitoring system is provided with a plurality of integrated cameras according to indoor space layout, dynamic tracking of real-time information of the aged day and night is achieved through a video and infrared combination mode, the robot system comprises a built-in intelligent analysis and control system, a voice interaction system, an indoor navigation system, a vital sign detection system and the like, the accompanying robot comprises integrated cameras, a motion system, a humanoid robot arm system, a partition storage box (medicines, nutrients and the like) and a sensor module, the mobile equipment display terminal comprises a mobile phone, an intelligent watch, a computer and the like and is used for displaying video information according to task call, and simple gesture interaction can be achieved. The accompanying and nursing system meets the demands that children care about the health and psychological factors of the old and reduce the consumption of manpower and material resources, and improves the timeliness and accuracy of emergency rescue.

title_en: Respiration detection method, device and equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breath detection method, a device and equipment based on millimeter wave radar in the technical field of intelligent detection, comprising the following steps: determining acquisition sensor parameters according to first user data and environment data acquired by the millimeter wave radar according to a preset detection time interval for a user object; adjusting sensor parameters of the millimeter wave radar by taking the acquired sensor parameters as targets, and acquiring second user data of the user object again through the millimeter wave radar after adjusting the sensor parameters; generating a breathing characteristic of the user object based at least on the environmental data and the second user data; according to the preset key length, a random encryption key is randomly generated by adopting a random number generator, and a target key is derived according to the random encryption key and the fixed key; and according to the target key and the random encryption key, converting the breathing characteristics into a target system format, encrypting the breathing characteristics of the target system format through the target key, and generating a breathing detection result of the user object.

title_en: Underground space vehicle-mounted through-wall radar path optimization method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of an underground space vehicle-mounted through-wall radar path based on an improved ant colony algorithm, firstly, considering the specificity of an underground space, according to the distance of the unmanned vehicle motion path and the imaging quality of the three-dimensional through-wall radar, the self-adaptive rule of the heuristic function is designed, and the global searching performance and the convergence speed of the algorithm are balanced. Secondly, by solving the non-convex optimization problem under the multi-constraint conditions including path length, imaging quality, non-purity of the kene and the like, the environment perception, accurate imaging and path planning are ensured to be efficiently and accurately completed in a complex underground environment. The method can be applied to unmanned detection and target search and rescue in underground space, and has strong adaptability and high efficiency.

title_en: Precise rescue method for small earthquake space by utilizing miniature intelligent robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an earthquake narrow space accurate rescue method by utilizing a microminiature intelligent robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data and infrared thermal imager thermal imaging data based on a target area, drawing up a ruin environment three-dimensional model according to the data and generating a passing path map, deploying a self-adaptive networking for the micro-robot cluster, carrying out structural stability assessment and residual vibration risk prediction by combining the map, distributing detection partitions and rescue tasks of the micro-robot cluster in real time based on an assessment result, introducing vital sign information, optimizing balanced distribution of the detection partitions and the tasks, and outputting a parallel scheduling strategy. The application solves the technical problems of low rescue efficiency and low precision in a narrow space caused by complex environment and incomplete perception data, and achieves the technical effects of utilizing a microminiature robot cluster to perform life search and rescue and task allocation in the narrow space and improving the precision and efficiency of earthquake rescue in the narrow space.

title_en: Miniaturized card type human vital sign monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent health monitoring, in particular to miniaturized card type human vital sign monitoring equipment which comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a flexible substrate, an ADC (analog to digital converter) conversion unit and a signal processing unit, wherein the millimeter wave radar module comprises an antenna array unit and an antenna substrate, the antenna array unit is etched on the antenna substrate through a folding antenna technology, the flexible substrate is bonded with the antenna substrate, the ADC conversion unit is connected with the millimeter wave radar module, and the signal processing unit is connected with the ADC conversion unit and is used for extracting human vital sign signals and calculating medical parameters. The application adopts the flexible substrate and the folding antenna array technology, greatly reduces the area of a core module of the monitoring equipment, can reach the size and the dimension of a credit card, can adapt to various application scenes, is manufactured into the shape of a mobile phone shell, is coupled with the mobile phone, realizes monitoring closed loop, is simple to use and convenient to carry, does not need to be worn on the surface of a human body, and can realize non-contact medical grade health monitoring.

title_en: Bio-signal measurement device of mouse type
title_ko: 마우스형 다중 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 보다 정확한 심전도, 혈압을 측정하며, 사용하기 간편한 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는 상기 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 일측에 장착된 링형 측정부에서 커프압 및 산소포화도에 의해 정확한 혈압을 측정하며, 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 손바닥 접촉부에 위치된 심전도 전극 및 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 밑면에 위치된 가슴 심전도 전극을 통해 정확한 심전도를 측정하며, 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 손바닥 접촉부에 위치된 체임피던스 전극을 통해 체임피던스를 측정하는 마우스형 다중 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은, 반구(半球)형으로 이루어지며 손바닥을 거치(据置)하도록 이루어진 손바닥 거치부를 구비한 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치에 있어서, 상기 손바닥 거치부(100) 상의 일측에 위치되며, 손가락이 삽입되도록 이루어지고, 삽입된 손가락에서 혈압 및 산소포화도를 측정하는 링형 측정부; 를 적어도 구비하며, 상기 링형 측정부는, 내측에 삽입된 손가락을 감싸도록 이루어진 커프를 구비하며, 상기 커프에 공기를 가압한 후, 커프에서의 압력 변화로 부터 혈압신호를 검출하도록 이루어진 커프압력 측정부; 내측에 발광부와 수광부를 구비하여, 산소포화도를 검출하도록 이루어진 산소포화도 측정센서부;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명은, 손바닥 거치부 상에 위치되되, 손바닥이 닿는 부분에 장착되어지는 심전도 전극을 구비하는 손바닥 심전도 전극부; 상기 마우스형 생체신호  측정장치의 밑면의 일측에 심전도 전극이 구비되며, 상기 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치의 밑면을 가슴부위에 위치(부착)시킴에 의해 가슴 심전도를 측정하도록 이루어진 가슴 심전도 전극부; 손바닥 거치부(100) 상에 위치되되, 손바닥이 닿는 부분에 체임피던스 전극이 장착되는 손바닥 체임피던스 전극부;를 더 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     생체신호, 마우스, 심전도, 혈압, 체임피던스, 혈압, 산소포화도, 전극

title_en: System for drawing digital map
title_ko: 영상정보와 수치데이터를 이용한 공간영상 도화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fixed and spatial image drawing system using image information and numerical data, in which a plurality of GPS notification devices installed for each region where aerial imaging is performed, to be operated are maintained with the state of being buried in the ground during a normal time, and are exposed to the ground only when in use, emergency situations such as damage due to external impacts or a theft risk can be monitored in real time when in use on the ground, and a corresponding GPS notification device has a function of crime prevention through environmental design (CPTED) concept to improve cost effectiveness in accordance with the manufacturing, installation, and operation thereof. The fixed and spatial image drawing system using image information and numerical data comprises: a plurality of GPS notification devices; a GPS storage module; a lidar device; an elevation model storage module; a digital photographing module; an image storage module; a drawing module; and a numerical information synthesis module. Each of the GPS notification devices includes a housing, a solenoid actuator, a lift plate, a GPS receiver, a wireless transmitter, a forward and reverse rotation motor, a protection cover, a wireless communications module, an impact sensor, a tilt sensor, an infrared thermal image camera, a control unit, a storage unit, and a display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 항공촬영이 진행되는 지역 단위로 복수 개 설치되어 운용되는 GPS 알림장치가 평상 시에는 지중에 매입된 상태를 유지하고 사용 시에만 지상으로 노출되고 지상에서의 사용 중에는 외부의 충격에 의한 파손 내지 도난 위험 등의 비상 상황이 실시간 감시될 수 있도록 하며, 해당 GPS 알림장치가 셉테드 개념의   기능을 가져 그 제작, 설치 및 운용에 따른 비용 대비 효율성을 높일 수 있도록 하는 영상정보와 수치데이터를 이용한 고정과 공간영상 도화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 영상정보와 수치데이터를 이용한 고정과 공간영상 도화 시스템은 다수개의 GPS 알림장치, GPS 저장모듈, 라이다장치, 표고모델 저장모듈, 디지털 촬영모듈, 이미지 저장모듈, 도화모듈 및 수치정보 합성모듈을 포함하여 구성되고, GPS 알림장치 각각은 하우징, 솔레노이드 액츄에이터, 승하강 플레이트, GPS 수신기, 무선송신기, 정역회전모터, 보호커버, 무선통신모듈, 충격감지센서, 기울기 감지센서, 적외선 열화상 카메라, 제어부, 저장부 및 디스플레이부를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Mobile phone positioning type life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phone positioning type life detection device which comprises a fire rescue module (1), an earthquake rescue module (2), a field rescue module (3), a single chip microcomputer processing module (4), a terminal console (5) and a mobile phone signal transmitting and receiving device (6), wherein the fire rescue module (1), the earthquake rescue module (2) and the field rescue module (3) are independent mutually and commonly apply the mobile phone signal transmitting and receiving device (6) for performing life detection and positioning. The mobile phone positioning type life detection device is applicable to life detection and rescue under specific disasters, such as the mobile phone detection technology with low cost adopted in fire rescue, earthquake rescue and field rescue, and a plurality of sensors are used for coordination work, thereby making up for deficiency in precision and being applicable to being put into actual production.

title_en: An intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus. The intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus comprises a housing. A display screen is disposed on the front surface of the housing. An antenna is disposed on the top of the housing. A circuit supporting board is disposed in the housing and is equipped with a video server, a wireless communication card, a Bluetooth communication device, a RS485 communication device, and a power supply device. The power supply device provides electricity for various devices and elements. The Bluetooth communication device is wirelessly connected with a human vital sign sensor of a peripheral data device. The RS485 communication device is wirelessly connected with an environmental parameter sensor of the peripheral data device. The video server is connected with a camera device and a headset of the peripheral data device. The video server, the Bluetooth communication device, and the RS485 communication device transmit acquired signals to a repeater of the peripheral data device via the wireless communication card. The repeater transmits the acquired signals in a communication manner to a rear-end server in an external data management center to be processed. The intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus can be widely used in daily and emergency rescue in underground coal mines.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA COAL MINE ENG CO

title_en: Optical waveguide display assembly for breathing mask
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a respirator technical field provides a light guide display module for respirator, include: a support, its fixed mounting is on respirator's medial surface, just a standing groove has on the terminal surface of support, a connecting plate, connecting plate detachable fixed mounting in the standing groove, a casing, its joint is fixed in on a tip of support, just all be provided with a recess on the relative both ends face that sets up of casing, two lenses, every the equal holding of lens is fixed in and corresponds in the recess, and every the lens is made by transparent material, through this device of fixed mounting on respirator's medial surface, can be convenient for the staff when using, through the timely feedback signal to the staff of optical waveguide display screen, for example, ambient gas monitoring result, environment humiture, operation environment infrared image, oxygen cylinder pressure value, user vital sign monitoring result etc..
assignees: NANJING HANHAI XINGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Be applied to rotatory locking telescoping device of distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary locking telescopic device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection. When the telescopic adjusting mechanism is in telescopic adjustment, the guide positioning groove slides in the outer guide groove, the stop block slides in the inner guide groove, the sliding copper sleeve slides in the inner hole of the shell of the telescopic device, and the sliding copper sleeve provides guide for the telescopic motion of the telescopic device, so that the stability of the telescopic motion process of the telescopic device can be greatly improved.

title_en: Deeply buried underground pipeline detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pipeline surveys, especially, bury pipeline detection equipment deeply, which comprises a mounting bracket, the mounting bracket bottom is provided with lifting mechanism, and lifting mechanism including install on the mounting bracket inner wall electric telescopic handle, fixed connection in electric telescopic handle piston rod outer wall on the mount, install the detection radar on the mount inner wall. The utility model discloses an install on one can the equipment that slides together detection radar and display screen, just can accomplish the work that the underground pipeline surveyed alone, the labour has been saved, simultaneously through the brake mechanism who sets up, the security of equipment has been improved, and the operation is simple, high durability and convenient use, when there is higher barrier in the road surface, staff's accessible control electric telescopic handle drives the detection radar rebound, not only can avoid the barrier to influence the detection result who surveys the radar, can also increase the protective effect who surveys the radar.
assignees: SICHUAN QIAOJIAN ENG DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: High-temperature drought disaster-receiving device for field monitoring crops
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring devices, in particular to a high-temperature drought disaster-receiving device for field monitoring crops, which comprises a positioning tube, wherein a humidity sensor can be directly buried into soil through a ground drilling tube through the arrangement of an adjusting mechanism, meanwhile, the depth of the humidity sensor in the soil can be adjusted, the sensor is not required to be taken out and buried into the soil again, namely, the device is carried to a monitoring place, a support ring is held to vertically insert a ground drilling cone into the soil, a second motor is started to drive a second bevel gear to rotate, a second screw rod drives a transmission block to drive a humidity sensor part to move out of a through groove and enable the sensor to be in contact with the soil, the humidity of the soil can be monitored, in the detection process, a first motor is started, the first motor drives a first screw rod to rotate, and the screw rod drives a screw rod to descend continuously so as to adjust the depth of the ground drilling tube.
assignees: LANZHOU DROUGHT METEOROLOGY INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system. The system comprises a comprehensive processing server, a communication base station, an intelligent watch node, a positioning and monitoring node, a wind speed sensor node and a pressure sensor node. The comprehensive processing server can be in communication with the communication base station through connection of a cable. The communication base station is wirelessly connected with the intelligent watch node, the positioning and monitoring node, the wind speed sensor node and the pressure sensor node, and wireless mesh network communication is formed. According to the wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system, the positions of an underground miner can be positioned accurately, the vital signs of the miner and the safety information of the construction area environment of the miner can also be monitored, monitoring information can be transmitted to a ground monitoring center and the intelligent watch node on the hand of the underground miner in real time, operation and use are convenient, when the monitoring parameter exceeds the safety threshold value, the system can send out alarming information in time automatically, the positions of survived people can be determined after a mine disaster happens, the rescue efficiency can be improved, and the casualty loss can be reduced.

title_en: Based on multinuclear digital signal processor through-wall radar motion target tracking imaging method
abstract_en: One kind being based on multinuclear digital signal processor through-wall radar motion target tracking imaging method, is related to digital signal processing technique field, solves the problems, such as it is to meet ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR imaging requirement of real-time, is as follows：（1）Information data acquisition is carried out to mobile target and inputs the ends PC；（2）It carries out data encapsulation by information data and reaches multinuclear digital signal processor to handle；（3）8 parts are splitted data into, common storage area is stored in；（4）Using Core0 as main core, the initialization of control system notifies other to execute respective task from core；（5）Using Core1-7 as from core, the data of common storage area are accessed；（6）Each core reads information data and carries out time-delay calculation, and result is sent to original memory block；（7）The superposition that main core Core0 carries out last algorithm arranges, and former road returns to the ends PC.Operation efficiency of the present invention is high, meets the requirement of real-time of motion target tracking imaging.

title_en: Through-wall imaging method for inhibiting clutter interference of wall body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall imaging method for inhibiting wall clutter interference, which comprises echo modeling, antenna coupling interference inhibition, echo discretization, echo calculation, iterative clutter inhibition processing and a smoothed data entropy value, wherein the echo discretization comprises that a through-wall radar uses a multi-receiving multi-transmitting antenna, an equivalent antenna array element can be formed after the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are combined, and each antenna array element is subjected to discretization sampling in a time domain to form a sampling point. The detection of slow moving targets is influenced, and the problem that weak targets cannot be extracted correctly exists.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging correction method based on refracted wave static correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a through-wall radar imaging correction method based on refracted wave static correction, which comprises the steps of firstly reading echo data of each receiving antenna to determine refracted echo time of electromagnetic waves, and obtaining propagation delay of the electromagnetic waves in an outer wall body through a basic refraction equation; then estimating the propagation delay of the electromagnetic wave in the inner wall by using the delay time difference between the adjacent transmitting antenna and the adjacent receiving antenna; and finally, sequentially adding the propagation time delays in the channels, then imaging by using a back projection algorithm, correcting the electromagnetic wave propagation abnormity generated due to the existence of the wall body, and correcting the imaged target position to a correct position.

title_en: TRM-based through-wall radar detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detector based on TRM, and relates to the technical field of radar detection devices. The detector comprises a control module, a control signal output end of the control module is connected with a control signal input end of a radar signal source and used for outputting radar pulse signals under the control of the control module, a signal output end of the radar signal source is connected with a signal input end of a transmitter module, a signal output end of the transmitter module is connected with a signal input end of a receiving-transmitting integrated antenna module, a signal output end of the receiving-transmitting integrated antenna module is connected with a signal input end of a receiver module, and the receiving-transmitting integrated antenna is used for transmitting detection signals to a wall body and receiving reflected detection signals; and the signal output end of the receiver module is connected with the signal input end of the control module. The detector has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, high resolution, good imaging effect and the like.

title_en: Frequency spectrum estimation method based on Doppler radar heartbeat detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact type accurate heartbeat detection method based on a Doppler radar. Firstly, the frequency shift caused by weak chest displacement caused by the beating of the heart of a human body is captured by adopting the principle of continuous wave Doppler radar sign detection, namely, the radar transmits T (t) to a subject through a transmitting terminal. Then the phase of the signal T (t) is modulated by the chest wall movement x (t) of the subject, and the reflected signal is captured by a radar receiving end; secondly, after the reflected signal passes through a low noise amplifier at the front end, a baseband signal is obtained, a quadrature mixer is adopted to demodulate the baseband signal, and after the baseband signal passes through a gain amplifier, a chest wall signal can be obtained through arc tangent demodulation and joint winding calculation; and finally, the chest wall analog signal is processed by an analog-to-digital converter to obtain a digital signal x (t), the digital signal is separated and extracted by a Muller algorithm and a matched filtering algorithm at a PC end, and a heartbeat frequency spectrum result is obtained by an FTPR-TWV algorithm.

title_en: 4D heart positioning system and method based on MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a 4D heart positioning system and method based on MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave millimeter wave radar, and belongs to the technical field of radar detection. The system comprises an upper computer, a radio frequency module and a baseband module. The method of the invention detects the vital sign signals of the human body through the system, acquires the phase information of each channel under the condition of highly suppressing the interference signals by using the FMCW radar time domain anti-interference phase information extraction method, and then carries out MIMO heart beam forming and heart signal quality modeling evaluation so as to determine the position of the heart of the human body. The invention has the characteristics of wide applicability and high detection accuracy, can complete the positioning of the heart position of the human body without additional mechanical devices through a single radar, and can detect the vital sign parameters of the human body in a home vital sign monitoring scene more accurately.

title_en: Treadmill breath detection device based on forward scattering radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forward scattering radar-based treadmill respiration detection device, which relates to the field of respiration signal monitoring and comprises a treadmill transmitting device and a receiving monitoring device, wherein the treadmill transmitting device is provided with a transmitting antenna, a high-definition display screen, the receiving monitoring device comprises a receiving antenna, a Lime SDR, an edge computing device and a high-resolution camera, the edge computing device comprises a personal computer, a raspberry pie and other development boards, and the outer wall of the edge computing device is provided with the high-definition display screen. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the transmitting and receiving antenna and the high-resolution camera, the radar scattering cross section change (RCS) of abdominal change during human respiration is monitored, so that the signal amplitude change is transmitted to the edge computing equipment, the respiratory frequency during exercise is displayed, the defect that the existing running machine cannot monitor the respiratory frequency of a user in real time is overcome, the influence on the training effect or the exercise risk caused by the incapability of adjusting the exercise intensity in time is avoided, and the effective and accurate detection of the respiratory signal based on the chest and abdomen exercise signal is realized.

title_en: Method of attaching sensor, which detects carbon dioxide, to drone, finding point where concentration of carbon dioxide is high, and transmitting information to portable terminal such as smartphone
abstract_en: To provide a method that imposes limited restrictions on use, and makes it possible to readily grasp position information on a human being who is buried alive because of a disaster, and efficiently perform a rescue operation.SOLUTION: A method for finding a location of a human being who is buried alive because of a landslide or collapse of a building includes a process for using a system 1 to secure a carbon dioxide sensor 13, which detects and measures carbon dioxide, to a drone 10, a process for flying the drone, a process for detecting a concentration of carbon dioxide of a level, at which a human being can breathe, using the carbon dioxide sensor, a process for identifying position information on the detected place, and a process for transmitting information to a portable terminal 70.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Apparatus for measure of bio signal and method for analysis of rehabilitation training by suit type bio sensors
title_ko: 피복타입 무구속 생체신호 측정 및 이를 이용한 재활훈련 정도 판단방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for measuring coated type nonintrusive bio signals and a method for analyzing rehabilitation training using the same are provided to obtain various bio-information at a time by only wearing a bio signal measuring suit. CONSTITUTION: A bio signal measuring suit(101) includes a plurality of sensors(112,113,114) for measuring bio signals. The bio signal measuring suit is formed into large, middle, and small sizes for wearing convenience. Left and right electromyography sensors(111) measure electromyographic signals of the left and right shoulders and chest of a person to be tested. A control board(200) calculates all kinds of parameters for determining the health condition of the person and processing the signals. The control board comprises an analog to digital converter, an interface transformation unit, and a microcontroller.
abstract_ko:
따라서, 본 발명은 피복타입 무구속 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 재활훈련정도 분석방법에 관한 것으로서, 의류와 같이 피검자가 착용한 조끼타입의 생체신호측정슈트(suit)의 어깨 및 가슴 부위에 근전도(EMG), 심전도(ECG), 맥박, 호흡수 또는 피부온도 등을 획득하기 위한 다양한 생체센서를 장착하여 무구속, 무자각 상태에서 피검자의 생체신호를 획득하므로 피검자의 건강상태를 분석 및 관리하기 위한 기초 데이터를 제공하도록 하며, 측정된 근전도를 포함한 생체신호를 이용하여 재활훈련의 정도를 분석 및 판단하도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 근전도센서, 심전도센서, 피부저항센서 및 피부온도센서로부터 획득된 피검자의 각 생체신호를 채널별로 각각 입력받아 디지털신호로 변환 및 래치하는 AD변환기; AD변환기를 통해 입력된 각 채널별 생체데이터를 수집하고, 어떤 채널의 데이터인지 판단하고, 외부 인터페이스 매칭을 위해 변환 및 출력하는 인터페이스변환부; 및 인터페이스변환부로부터 입력된 생체데이터의 노이즈를 제거하고, 각 생체신호를 분석하여 피검자의 동작 및 건강상태와 감성인식 판단을 위한 파라미터를 산출하는 마이크로콘트롤러;를 포함하여 구성하되, 상기 생체센서부는 피검자가 착용 가능한 생체신호측정슈트의 내측에 부착된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Thermal Storage Pipe Filled with Paraffin Phase Change Materials and Temperature Management Method Thereby
title_ko: 파라핀계 상변화 물질로 충진된 축열재 파이프 및 이를 이용한 온도유지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of preventing a road from being frozen. According to the present invention, a pore of one or more porous particles selected from the group consisting of zeolite, perlite, or graphite is filled with a paraffin-based phase change material (PCM), and a heat storage material pipe filled with a heat resistant heat storage material, in which an outer surface of a porous particle filled with the phase change material is coated with one or more coating agents selected from the group consisting of a silica solidifier, cement, silica, a plaster, or loess, is buried below a sidewalk, a parking lot, or a mountain trail consisting of asphalt, cement, or loess. The present invention relates to a method for insulating a greenhouse by installing a heat storage material pipe filled with a heat resistant heat storage material below the greenhouse. In addition, the present invention relates to a cooling and heating system using a heat storage material, comprising: a heat circulation pipe for transferring heat from the heat storage material pipe; and a heat pump which is a heat exchanger connected to the heat circulation pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 파라핀계 상변화물질(PCM)이 제올라이트(Zeolite), 퍼라이트(Perlite) 또는 흑연(graphite)로 구성되는 군에서 선택되는 하나 이상의 다공성 입자의 세공경(pore)에 충진되고, 상기 상변화물질이 충진된 다공성 입자의 외부 표면이 실리카 고화재, 시멘트, 규사, 석고 또는 황토로 구성되는 군에서 선택되는 하나 이상의 코팅재로 코팅된 내열성 축열재가 충진된 축열재 파이프를 아스팔트, 시멘트 또는 황토로 이루어진 인도, 주차장 또는 등산로의 하부에 매설하는 도로의 결빙 방지 방법, 내열성 축열재가 충진된 축열재 파이프를 비닐하우스의 하부에 설치하여 비닐하우스를 보온하는 방법 및 상기 축열재 파이프로 부터 열을 전달할 수 있는 열순환 파이프; 및 상기 열순환 파이프와 연결되는 열교환기인 히트펌프;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 축열재를 이용한 냉난방 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: RASUNG ENERGY CO LTD;RYU EUN SANG

title_en: Device for Sensing Crack of Concrete Structure
title_ko: 콘크리트 구조물의 균열 감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus to sense a crack of a concrete structure which uses a same cement as the concrete structure as a basic material; and is able to monitor a position and a depth of a generated crack by burying a burial type sensor having an electroconductive network in the reinforced concrete structure. According to the present invention, the apparatus to sense the crack of the concrete structure comprises: a crack sensing sensor which has electroconductivity by being made by mixing a carbon type filling material and a super flowing material into a cement basic material, and is buried in the concrete structure; an electrode installed in both ends of the crack sensing sensor; and a monitoring part which senses the crack by measuring a resistance by applying electricity through an electric wire connected to the electrode.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 콘크리트 구조물과 동일한 시멘트를 모재로 사용하고, 전기전도성 네트워크를 가진 매립형 센서를 철근 콘크리트 구조물에 매립하여 발생된 균열의 위치와 깊이를 모니터링할 수 있는 콘크리트 구조물의 균열 감지장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 콘크리트 구조물의 균열 감지장치는, 시멘트 모재에 탄소계 충진재와 초유동화재가 혼입되어 만들어져 전기전도성을 가지며, 콘크리트 구조물에 매립되는 균열감지센서와; 상기 균열감지센서의 양단에 설치되는 전극과; 상기 전극에 연결되는 전선을 통해 전기를 인가하여 저항을 측정하여 균열 여부를 감지하는 모니터링부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
