title_en: Fire escape room fire door
title_ko: 화재 대피실용 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire door for a fire escape room, which is for temporarily evacuating when a fire occurs in a high-rise building such as an apartment, a building, etc. The fire door prevents high temperature heat and toxic gas from fire, and is prevented from thermal deformation, so that it is possible to not only protect people from suffocation, burns, etc. but also improve the fire resistance of the fire door. According to the present invention, a fire door installed at the entrance of a fire escape room includes: a heat insulating material installed inside the fire door; a heat insulating space disposed inside the fire door and disposed on the front surface of the heat insulating material; an external panel surrounding the outside of the heat insulating material and the heat insulating space; and a sight window installed through the heat insulating material, the heat insulating part and the external panel to inspect the inside of the fire escape room.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 아파트나 빌딩 등의 고층 건물에서 화재 발생시 일시적으로 대피하는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술로서, 화재로 인한 고온의 열과 유독가스를 차단하고, 방화문의 열변형을 방지하므로, 대피자들의 질식사고와 화상 등의 인명피해를 방지할 뿐만 아니라 방화문의 내화성을 높이는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술이다. 
이러한 본 발명의 주요 구성은, 화재 대피실의 입구에 설치되는 방화문에 있어서, 상기 방화문에 내장 설치되는 차열단열재; 상기 방화문의 내부에 설치되고, 차열단열재의 전면에 배치되는 차열공간부; 상기 차열단열재와 차열공간부의 외부로 감싸는 외장패널; 상기 차열단열재와 차열공간부 및 외장패널을 관통하여 설치되고, 대피실의 내부를 확인하기 위한 투시창;을 포함하여 구현된다.

title_en: Method for determining a relative dielectric constant and detection method for ground embedded objects
title_ko: 상대 유전 상수를 결정하기 위한 방법 및 지면 매립 물체를 검출하기 위한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to determine a relative dielectric constant, and a method to detect an object buried in the ground. According to the present invention, the method to determine a relative dielectric constant is to determine εR, a relative dielectric constant of the ground surface to be searched for a landmine by using a detector, which comprises a ground surface penetrating radar comprising: one or more detection coils; one or more transmitter antennas; and one or more receiver antennas. The method to detect an object buried in the ground is to detect a metallic or a nonmetallic object from the ground by using a landmine detector which comprises a metal detector and a ground penetrating radar. The metal detector comprises one or more detection coils having a coil plane to move in parallel to the ground surface during a detection process. The ground penetrating radar comprises an antenna arrangement which comprises: one or more transmitter antennas; and one or more receiver antennas. According to the present invention, the method to determine εR, which is a relative dielectric constant, is able to calibrate a detector by a fast and known method for properties of the ground surface to be searched. According to the present invention, the method to detect an object buried in the ground based on the determined relative dielectric constant is able to provide essential, necessary data for search and detection to a user. Accordingly, the present invention is able to make it easier for the user to handle the detector.
abstract_ko:
상대 유전 상수를 결정하기 위한 방법 및 지면 매립 물체를 검출하는 방법 
적어도 하나의 검출 코일 및 적어도 하나의 송신기 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신기 안테나를 포함하는 지면 투과 레이더를 포함하는 검출기를 이용해 지뢰가 탐색될 지면의 상대 유전 상수 ε R 를 결정하기 위한 방법 및 금속 검출기 및 지면 투과 레이더를 포함하는 지뢰 검출기를 이용해 지면에서 금속 및 비-금속 물체를 검출하기 위한 검출 방법으로서, 금속 검출기는 검출 동안 지면에 평행하게 이동하는 코일 평면을 갖는 적어도 하나의 검출 코일을 포함하고, 지면 투과 레이더는 적어도 하나의 송신기 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신기 안테나를 포함하는 안테나 배열을 포함한다. 상대 유전 상수 ε R 를 결정하기 위한 본 발명에 따르는 방법에 의해, 사용자는 탐색될 지면의 지면 속성에 대해 빠르고 알려진 방식으로 검출기를 교정할 수 있다. 결정된 상대 유전 상수를 기초로 하는 본 발명에 따르는 검출 방법은 사용자에게 탐색 및 검출을 위해 필수적이고 필요한 데이터를 제공한다. 다라서 검출기의 핸들링이 사용자에게 훨씬 더 쉬워진다.

title_en: Breathing Monitoring System for Detecting Biological Signals of Pets
title_ko: 반려동물 생체 신호감지를 위한 호흡 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 반려동물 생체 신호감지를 위한 호흡 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 반려동물 생체 신호감지를 센싱하는 호흡 센서, 상기 호흡센서를 통해 수집된 적어도 하나 이상의 신호를 변환 하여 데이터 처리하는 신호변환 장치, 상기 신호변환 장치를 통해 처리된 데이터를 전송하는 데이터 전송모듈, 상기 데이터 전송모듈을 통해 전송된 데이터를 저장 하고 분석하는 반려동물 데이터 서버 및 상기 반려동물 데이터 서버를 통해 반려 동물 호흡 데이터를 모니터링 해주는 사용자 단말기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 반려동물 호흡 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 특허는 부산광역시와 신라대학교 대학혁신연구단지(I-URP) 조성사업의 지원을 받아 수행된 결과이다.
assignees: SILLA UNIV INDUSTRY UNIV COOPERATION FOUNDATION;YPET

title_en: System, method and computer program product for remote measurement of vital signs
abstract_en: A system for measuring medical data characterizing a subject to be monitored, the system including radar sensor/s and/or electro-optical sensor/s. The medical data, which may include pulse and/or respiratory rate and/or temperature of the subject to be monitored, are measured remotely, thereby providing standoff detection and reducing risk of infection to medical personnel.

title_en: Multipurpose device for monitoring infant health condition, and multipurpose system comprising same for monitoring infant health condition
title_ko: 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치 및 이를 포함하는 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: One aspect of an embodiment of the present invention may provide a multipurpose device for monitoring an infant health condition, the device comprising: a head part having one surface on which a gripping part configured to be gripped by an infant's hand is formed, and the other surface on which a contact part is formed, the contact part being configured to be in direct contact with the infant's body to measure a biosignal or having an inwardly recessed central groove or an edge groove formed on the periphery thereof so as to be coupled to a nipple part; a sensor part provided on the head part to measure a biosignal of an infant at play; and a control part for determining the health condition of the infant on the basis of the measured biosignal. Accordingly, the health condition of an infant, including body temperature, pulse, oxygen saturation, electrical conductivity of the skin, and pressure, can be determined through multiple channels and can be transmitted to an external device, thereby monitoring the health condition of the infant.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예의 일 측면에 따르면, 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 직접 접촉되어 생체 신호를 측정하거나, 젖꼭지부에 결합할 수 있도록 내측으로 오목한 중앙 홈 또는 가장자리에 테두리 홈이 형성되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하는, 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치를 제공할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도, 피부의 전기전도도 및 압력을 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Vital sign extraction method based on dual-source IR-UWB biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign extraction method based on a dual-source IR-UWB biological radar, which is used for separating broadband signals and narrowband signals in radar echoes by combining a self-adaptive spectral line enhancement algorithm through a dual-channel cross-correlation signal enhancement technology of the dual-source UWB biological radar so as to realize the extraction of human respiratory signals in an unnatural state. The invention establishes a model for simulating an unnatural human body by tying a pneumatic tourniquet belt on the human body, and the model can quantitatively control and simulate human body targets with different pressed parts.

title_en: Test device and test method for researching influence of extreme rainfall on diversion channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test device and a test method for researching influence of extreme rainfall on a diversion channel, comprising a channel filling box, a drainage body and a water distribution device, wherein a channel model is filled in the channel filling box, the channel model comprises two side channel slopes and a channel lining plate positioned between the two side channel slopes, and one side of the channel model, which is close to a first drainage hole, is filled with the drainage body; the system comprises a channel model, a rainfall simulation component, a channel water supply component, a groundwater water supply component and a sensor component, wherein the rainfall simulation component simulates a channel rainfall scene, the channel water supply component simulates a channel water supply scene, the groundwater water supply component is positioned on one side of the simulation box and comprises a groundwater storage tank, water in the groundwater storage tank permeates into the channel model through a water permeable hole to simulate groundwater, and the sensor component is buried in the channel model to collect channel bottom, channel slope pore water pressure and channel slope displacement. The method considers the influence of water, ground water level and rainfall in the channel on the channel, and has important significance for further clarifying the catastrophe mechanism and disaster prevention of the channel slope under the extreme rainfall condition.

title_en: Method and device for enhancing through-wall radar signal of human body movement
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for enhancing a through-wall radar signal of human body movement, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a through-wall spectrogram to be enhanced; and inputting the through-wall spectrogram to be enhanced into a generator in a spectrogram processing-based network model to obtain an enhanced through-wall spectrogram so as to monitor human body movement. The training method of the network model comprises the steps of training a pre-training model through a free space spectrogram and a corresponding free space turning spectrogram in a data set, inputting a through-wall spectrogram into a generator to obtain a corresponding enhanced through-wall spectrogram, inputting the enhanced through-wall spectrogram and a non-paired free space spectrogram into the trained pre-training model to respectively obtain a corresponding channel dimension autocorrelation matrix, inputting the enhanced through-wall spectrogram and the non-paired free space spectrogram into a discriminator to obtain a discrimination result, constructing a loss function to optimize the generator and the discriminator, enabling the generator to carry out signal enhancement, and improving the accuracy of downstream semantic recognition.

title_en: Power cable connector
title_ko: 지중배전선의 단자연결 커넥터
abstract_en: A terminal connector for an underground power distribution wire is provided to repair the underground power distribution wire through a through hole by moving an upper base to one side and exposing the through hole of a lower base, and deal with a fire in the pipe line by transmitting a warning signal through a wireless transmitter. An underground power distribution wire(2) passes through a base(10) vertically and buried in a pipe line. A terminal connector(4) is connected with a power distribution unit(3a) of a power distributor(3). The base includes a lower base(11) which is formed with a through hole(11a) and with a rail(11b), and an upper base(12) in which a roller is placed at a lower side. The power distribution unit and a case(3b) are installed at an upper side. The terminal connector includes a bracket(40), a connector body(50), a connecting terminal(60), a solenoid device(70), an upper base transfer device, a controller, a fire sensor(100), a wireless transmitter, and an input device. The connector body is downward pressed by a spring(51). The connecting terminal has a connecting socket(61) which is detached from the power distribution unit. The upper base transfer device has a screw shaft, a driving motor, and a transfer block. The fire sensor is connected with the controller.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중에 매설된 배전선을 지속적으로 관리, 보수하여 합선이 발생되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 된 지중배전선의 단자연결 커넥터에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 지중배전선의 단자연결 커넥터는 관리자가 입력장치(120)를 이용하여 비밀번호 및 제어명령을 입력하면, 상기 솔레노이드장치(70)와 상부기대 이송장치(80)가 작동되어, 상기 접속단자(60)와 커넥터(50)의 연결을 해제함과 동시에 상부기대(12)를 일측으로 이동시켜 하부기대(11)의 관통공(11a)을 노출시키므로써, 관통공(11a)을 통해 관로(1) 내부의 배전선을 유지 보수할 수 있으며, 관로(1) 내부에 화제가 발생될 경우, 이를 감지하여 무선송신기(110)를 통해 경보신호를 무선송신하므로써, 관리자가 이를 수신하여 화재에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Healthcare system reflecting IoT and AI service design using data communication-based village broadcasting device
title_ko: 데이터 통신기반 마을방송장치를 이용한 IoT 및 AI서비스 설계반영의 헬스 케어 시스템
abstract_ko: Binary-CDMA 통신망을 기반으로 마을방송 장치 및 데이터 통신 서버와 적어도 하나의 홈 IoT 연동 장치 간에 데이터를 송수신하는 데이터 통신 기반 헬스 케어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 홈 IoT 연동 장치는 사용자의 생체 신호, 가스 및 화재 등의 위험 신호, 사용자의 고독사를 관리하기 위한 활동 신호를 감지하는 센서 모듈, 상기 Binary-CDMA 통신망을 이용하여 마을방송 장치로부터 마을방송 또는 재난방송을 수신하고, 사용자의 메시지 데이터 또는 상기 센서 모듈을 통해 감지된 센싱 데이터를 송신하기 위해 마련된 B-CDMA 모듈, 상기 마을방송 장치로부터 전송된 마을방송을 출력하기 위해 마련된 방송 출력 모듈을 포함하며, 각 가정에서 발생하는 위급 상황 및 사고 내용을 실시간으로 파악하여 각 가정의 위급 상황 및 재난사고에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Magnetic sensing buried object locator including a camera
abstract_en: Portable locators for detecting a buried object based on sensing electromagnetic emissions therefrom is disclosed. A portable locator may include a magnetic field sensor array and associated processing circuitry as well as a camera and image or video processing circuitry to process images or video received from the camera.

title_en: Disaster escape capsule
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster escape capsule which comprises a capsule body and a capsule door. An oxygen supply device and a storage bin are arranged in the capsule body. The disaster escape capsule is characterized in that the capsule wall of the capsule body is formed by a heat insulation anti-explosion coating, a compression resistant layer, a bulletproof anti-explosion layer and a buffer layer in sequence. The heat insulation anti-explosion coating is made of aluminum silicate heat-protection thermal-insulation plates. The outer layer of the compression resistant layer is a stainless steel outer shell. The inner layer of the compression resistant layer is made of alloy tile-type materials. The bulletproof anti-explosion layer is made of bulletproof polyester fabrics. The buffer layer is formed by a plurality of springs which are arranged on the layer surface in a regular mode. Sponge and rubber are filled in gaps between the springs. Through arrangement of the compression resistant layer, the disaster escape capsule can not structurally deform and break even if the disaster escape capsule drops down from a high altitude or is collided, pressed and buried by heavy objects. Through arrangement of the bulletproof anti-explosion layer, the disaster escape capsule can be effectively prevented from being damaged by bullets, shrapnels and explosion splashes. The buffer layer ensures that people in the disaster escape capsule can feel soft and buffering force is formed.

title_en: High safe type radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of radar detection instruments, in particular to a high-safety radar life detection instrument, which comprises a base and a detection instrument body, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with the bottom of the detection instrument body through a plurality of first telescopic rods, a plurality of first telescopic rods are all sleeved with damping springs, the two ends of each damping spring are respectively fixedly connected with the detection instrument body and the base, a plurality of cavities are arranged in the base, a screw rod is rotatably connected in each cavity, a first gear is fixedly sleeved on the screw rod, a second gear meshed with the first gear is arranged in each cavity, the second gear is rotatably connected to a transmission rod, one end of the transmission rod penetrates through the inner wall of each cavity and is fixedly connected with a knob, and the radar life detection instrument can be freely adjusted according to the use requirement through the arrangement of a plurality of adjusting mechanisms, therefore, the placing efficiency and the detection accuracy of the radar life detection instrument are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YIJIE SHANLIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detection device for vital signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device (1) for vital signs, comprising a sensor (2) and an energy supply module (3), wherein the sensor (2) has at least one detection means (5, 6, 7, 8), which is designed to detect a vital sign from the group consisting of the oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, and pulse, and furthermore comprises a first (10) communication module, wherein the energy supply module (3) has a second communication module (20) and an energy source (21), and wherein a wireless communication connection (4) exists between the first (10) and second communication module (20), wherein the sensor (2) is configured as an elastically restorably deformable thin-film sensor, and the communication connection (4) is configured for transmitting energy and measured values, or measurement data.

title_en: Multiple target location estimation method after through-wall radar imaging based on improvement dynamic programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses multiple target location estimation method after a kind of through-wall radar imaging based on improvement dynamic programming；It includes that target area imaging, target image optimization, dynamic programming and sliding window smooth position are estimated.The present invention has fully taken into account target autgmentability in imaging results, improve the track rejection problem caused because of scattering coefficient difference, target echo decay, target occlusion etc. between target well, improve target detection probability, there is the advantage that target detection probability is high, position estimation accuracy is higher, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Synthetic aperture through-wall radar multipath decoy elimination method based on more imaging dictionaries
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the synthetic aperture through-wall radar multipath decoy elimination method based on more imaging dictionaries, applied to multipaths restraint technical field of synthetic aperture through-wall radar, first, according to fabric structure feature, through-wall radar from preceding wall displacement and each reflection path echo, the direct echo dictionary of target and multipath decoy dictionary are established；Secondly, to echo data, rear orientation projection's imaging is carried out using the direct echo dictionary of target and multipath decoy dictionary respectively, obtains target aerial image and multipath decoy spatial image；Finally, target aerial image and multipath decoy spatial image are subjected to incoherent fusion, realize the suppression of a multipath decoy in building；Complexity is lower compared with prior art, and multipaths restraint effect is preferable.

title_en: Pile top indwelling pipe internal vibration pickup detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pile foundation detection, and particularly relates to a pile top indwelling pipe internal vibration pickup detection method, which comprises the following steps: s1, arranging an acceleration sensor; s2, data acquisition and pretreatment; s3, data processing and analysis; s4, evaluating and analyzing results, wherein the pile top indwelling pipe internal vibration pickup detection technology provided by the invention detects the problems of damage, defects and the like in the reinforced concrete pile foundation deeply buried and fixed underground through the pile top indwelling pipe, can improve detection accuracy, efficiency and reduce cost, plays a positive promoting role in ensuring the safety of the pile foundation, can be used for solving the monitoring problem of the pile foundation quality during the service period of a building and the evaluation problem of the damage degree of the building pile foundation after disaster, and has an important guiding role in reinforcing an old house and capping a house.

title_en: Human vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the vital sign measurement is carried out through an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a target human chest echo signal; clutter filtering processing is carried out on the target human chest echo signal to obtain an original chest micro-motion signal; reconstructing the original chest cavity micro-motion signal by utilizing an improved singular spectrum analysis SSA algorithm to obtain a reconstructed chest cavity micro-motion signal; and classifying and processing the reconstructed chest micro-motion signals through a variational modal decomposition VMD algorithm to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals. The method solves the problems that the center frequency hopping estimation accuracy is not high and the influence of respiration and noise is caused in the prior art.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The application relates to a vital sign detection method and equipment based on a microwave radar, which comprises the following steps of S1, transmitting and receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching the position of a human body, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving the radar signals returned by the vital sign detection area, and extracting vital signs from the radar signals. The application can control the rotation and/or translation of the microwave radar to find the vital sign detection area, so that the microwave radar for detecting vital signs can be placed at a plurality of indoor positions, manual adjustment of a scanning area of the microwave radar is not needed before the microwave radar is used, and the microwave radar can automatically find the vital sign detection area and detect the vital signs.

title_en: Method and system for verifying optimal body sensor placement
abstract_en: A system is disclosed comprising a monitoring patch configured to be adhered to skin of an associated patient, the monitoring patch comprising at least one vital sign sensor arranged to measure vital sign data of the associated patient when the monitoring patch is adhered to the skin of the associated patient. The monitoring patch includes a wireless transceiver or transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit vital sign data, a monitoring device configured to receive the wirelessly transmitted vital sign data and store, forward or both store and forward the vital sign data, a skin condition sensor configured to measure skin measurement data on skin of an associated patient, and at least one hardware processor configured to analyze the skin measurement data to determine a recommendation regarding adhesion of the monitoring patch to the skin, and output the recommendation on the monitoring patch or monitoring device.

title_en: Method and device for reconstructing circulatory generation countermeasure network based on non-contact electrocardiosignal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the field of electrocardiosignal monitoring, in particular to a method and a device for reconstructing a circulatory generation countermeasure network based on a non-contact electrocardiosignal. The method comprises the steps of carrying out component extraction processing on a pre-acquired non-contact electrocardio radar signal to obtain an electrocardio radar characteristic signal, carrying out coding processing on the electrocardio radar characteristic signal, respectively carrying out preprocessing on a pre-acquired sample radar signal set and a label electrocardio signal set, constructing an image reconstruction model based on a sample Lei Dage lambda angle difference field image set and a label electrocardio gram angle difference field image set, inputting an electrocardio Lei Dage lambda angle difference field image into the image reconstruction model, and carrying out conversion processing on the reconstructed electrocardio image to obtain a reconstructed electrocardio signal. The embodiment can effectively reconstruct ECG signals and provides a new idea for non-contact vital sign sensing.

title_en: Non-contact sleep stage method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep stage method and device, which comprises the steps of placing radar equipment at a designated position and powering on, processing echo signals of the radar equipment to obtain vital sign data, sending the vital sign data to a cloud server for storage, deriving and processing the vital sign data into time sequence features and frequency domain features, constructing a sleep stage prediction model, inputting the time sequence features and the frequency domain features into the sleep stage prediction model, carrying out feature learning and outputting sleep stage prediction values, simultaneously modeling the time sequence features and the frequency domain features through a double-branch structure, capturing a time sequence dependency relationship by utilizing BiLSTM, and enhancing the attention of the model to the time sequence information and the frequency domain information in the sequence by utilizing a attention mechanism.

title_en: Joint estimation of respiratory and heart rates using ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: A method for contactless vital sign monitoring includes transmitting, via a transceiver, radar signals for object detection. The method also includes generating a clutter removed channel impulse response from received reflections of the radar signals a portion of which are reflected off of a living object. The method further includes identifying a set of range bins corresponding to a position of the living object. Additionally, the method includes identifying a first set of signal components representing a respiration rate of the living object and a second set of signal components representing a heart rate of the living object.

title_en: Physiological sensor resembling a neck-worn collar
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The neck-worn sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: First responder dispatch system and methods of operation thereof
abstract_en: A first responder dispatch system is disclosed comprising a sensing wearable configured to be worn by a first responder. The sensing wearable can comprise a wrist-worn electronic device. The sensing wearable can comprise a plurality of biometric sensors configured to measure a plurality of vital signs of the first responder. The system can comprise a server programmed to receive biometric data concerning a plurality of vital signs of the first responder measured by the sensing wearable. The server can also transmit alerts to a plurality of dispatch client devices over a plurality of secured real-time bidirectional connections concerning a status of the first responder. At least one dispatch client device can transmit a response to the server and the server can, in turn, transmit additional biometric data concerning the first responder to the dispatch client device.

title_en: Radar detection false alarm suppression method and device based on building internal structure characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar detection false alarm suppression method based on building internal structure characteristics, which comprises the following steps: s1, detecting an internal area of a building through a through-wall radar detection system, and respectively obtaining a first detection signal containing internal structural feature information of the building and a second detection signal containing target feature information; s2, respectively carrying out feature extraction on the first detection signal to obtain a structural feature signal inside the building, and carrying out feature extraction on the second detection signal to obtain a target feature signal; s3, matching the obtained target characteristic signal with the structural characteristic signal to obtain a target signal with matched characteristics, and outputting the target signal serving as a final detection signal to filter false alarms; the device comprises a radar detection module, a feature extraction module and a feature matching module. The invention has the advantages of simple implementation method, low required cost, good real-time performance and implementation effect, high efficiency and the like.

title_en: Double-triaxial electromagnetic detection and route positioning method for submarine cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-triaxial electromagnetic detection and submarine cable routing positioning algorithm for a submarine electrified cable, wherein the submarine cable routing relative positioning algorithm comprises a magnetic deviation positioning algorithm, a transverse deviation positioning algorithm and a vertical deviation positioning algorithm, six real-time electromagnetic signals and sensor attitude angle signals provided for two orthogonal triaxial electromagnetic detection sensors are input into the algorithm, and the algorithm outputs submarine cable routing angle, submarine cable routing point transverse deviation, submarine cable routing point vertical deviation and submarine cable routing point burial depth. The submarine cable route absolute positioning algorithm comprises a submarine cable buried depth positioning algorithm, a submarine cable route angle positioning algorithm and a submarine cable route point absolute positioning algorithm, wherein the algorithm inputs are output of the submarine cable route relative positioning algorithm, a real-time ground altitude signal fed back by an altimeter, and a course angle and an absolute position (namely a longitude/latitude signal of a detection platform body) of a detection sensor under a geodetic coordinate system; the algorithm output is the absolute position of the submarine cable routing point (i.e., the longitude/latitude of the submarine cable routing point).

title_en: Human body respiration and heartbeat detection method based on terahertz and circulatory neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a human body respiration and heartbeat detection method based on terahertz and a circulating neural network, which comprises the steps of acquiring human body physiological sensing signals through terahertz radar signals, preprocessing information in a noise reduction mode, marking processed signal data, training through a constructed circulating neural network model, and obtaining a relevant model after training; the technical key point is that the technical scheme provided by the application adopts an empirical mode decomposition method to decompose an original signal into natural mode functions on different frequencies on the basis of noise reduction treatment of the terahertz echo signal, a designed multi-layer cyclic neural network is used for learning data and constructing an identification model for human heartbeat and respiratory information, the influence of noise on the terahertz echo signal can be effectively removed, the robustness is better, and the detection accuracy of the signal is better improved by means of feature fusion of a high-frequency signal and a low-frequency signal.

title_en: Radar data processing method and radar data acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar data processing method and a radar data acquisition system. The method is applied to the field of medical radars. The method comprises the steps of initializing radar parameters of a radar data transceiver, acquiring radar echo signals, extracting vital sign information and body movement information according to the radar echo signals, judging whether vital signs exist in a monitoring scene, continuously acquiring a judging result of whether the vital signs exist, adjusting the radar parameters to a low-power mode if the vital signs exist and the time exceeds a preset time, acquiring a bed Zhou Leida echo signal in the low-power mode, carrying out body movement detection and body target integration according to the radar echo signals around the bed, judging whether the vital signs exist around the bed, continuously acquiring a judging result of whether the vital signs exist around the bed, and adjusting the radar parameters to an initialized state if the vital signs exist and the time exceeds the preset time. The invention reduces the power consumption and optimizes the battery endurance, storage and data processing efficiency of the system.

title_en: Underground line stopper
title_ko: 지중매설형 배전 전선 스토퍼
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An underground installation power distribution electrical wire stopper is provided, which enables to stably prepare the earthquake by achieving supporting force and buffer force. CONSTITUTION: An underground installation power distribution electrical wire stopper includes an underground piping of the square pipe shape, a connector(100), and a supporting apparatus(200). The underground piping is formed as follows. The support stand receiving part is formed upward and downward along the inner surface. The penetration part connected to the support stand receiving part is opened to the lateral part. A support stand catching part is formed to face the support stand receiving part and buried under the ground. The upper part is connected to power-supplies installed on the ground. The connector is arranged on the top of the support stand receiving part of the underground piping. The supporting apparatus includes a case, a support stand, a spring, a solenoid, a detection sensor, and a control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중매설형 배전 전선 스토퍼에 관한 것으로, 지지대수용부(P1)가 내면을 따라 상하방으로 형성되고, 지지대수용부(P1)와 연통된 관통부(P2)가 측방으로 개구되며, 지지대걸림부(P3)가 지지대수용부(P1)와 대향되게 형성되어 지면에 매설되되, 상부가 지상에 설치된 배전함(C)과 연통되는 사각관 형상의 지중배관(P)과; 전력공급원으로부터 인입되는 인입전선(L)과 배전반(B)으로부터 인출되는 인출전선(L') 사이에 배치되도록 지중배관(P) 내부에 배치되는 절연재질인 패널(110)과, 패널(110)에 삽입되는 십자형상의 삽입부(121)와, 삽입부(121)로부터 하방으로 연장되며 패널(110)을 관통하여 인입전선(L)과 연결되는 제1연결부(122)와, 삽입부(121)로부터 상방으로 연장되며 패널(110)을 관통하여 인출전선(L')과 연결되는 제2연결부(123)로 구성된 도전재질인 연결대(120)와, 패널(110)의 측면에 고정되는 패널고정부(131)와, 지중배관(P) 내벽에 고정되는 지중배관고정부(132)로 구성되어, 패널(110)을 상방으로 탄발하는 적어도 두개 이상의 스프링(130)을 갖추고서, 지중배관(P)의 지지대수용부(P1)의 상부에 배치되는 커넥터(100)와; 측면에 지중배관(P)의 관통부(P2)와 연통되는 개구부(211)가 형성되어, 지중배관(P)과 이웃되게 배치되는 케이스(210)와, 지중배관(P)의 지지대수용부(P1)에 회전가능하게 설치되는 지지부(221)와, 관통홀(h)이 형성되며 지지부(221)로부터 연장되어 케이스(210) 내부로 인입되는 걸림부(222)와, 지지부(221)와 걸림부(222)에 형성되며 인입전선(L)이 통과하는 가이드부(223)를 갖춘 지지대(220)와, 지지대(220)가 지중배관(P)를 폐쇄하도록 탄발지지하는 스프링(230)과, 지지대(220)의 관통홀(h)에 삽탈가능하게 삽입되는 플런저(241)를 갖추고서, 케이스(210)에 내설되는 솔레노이드(240)와, 케이스(210) 보다 상부에 배치되도록 지중배관(P) 내면에 설치되어, 커넥터(100)의 낙하를 감지하는 감지센서(250)와, 케이스(210)에 내설되어, 감지센서(250)로부터 커넥터 낙하신호를 수신하면 솔레노이드(240)를 동작시키는 제어유닛(260)을 갖춘 지지장치(200)를 포함하여, 지진에 안정적으로 대처할 수 있으며, 커넥터로 흐르는 전기가 누전되지 않는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Electric concent box for laying wall of buinding
title_ko: 개선된 기능을 갖는 벽면 매설용 건축 전기 콘센트박스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wall-buried building electrical outlet box having an improved function. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the building electrical outlet box for wall-embedded use having an improved function includes a short-range communication unit (300), a display part (500), a fire occurrence sensing unit (600), and a micom control part (400). The risk of electric shock due to the curiosity of an infant can be fundamentally prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 콘센트박스에 있어서, 상기 콘센트박스 내부 및 외부에는 상기 콘센트박스의 현재 상태 정보를 사용자에게 송신하고, 송신된 상태 정보에 따른 사용자의 지령을 수신하여 상기 콘센트박스가 제어되도록 양방향 통신이 가능한 와이 파이, 지그비, NFC 내지 비콘을 포함하는 근거리 통신수단(300)이 하나 이상 마련되고, 상기 콘센트박스 외부에는 사용자에게 상기 콘센트박스의 상태 정보 메시지를 전달하는 LED 내지 OLED로 마련된 디스플레이부(500)가 마련되고, 상기 콘센트박스 내부 및 외부에는 온도센서(610) 및 연기센서(630)를 포함하는 화재 발생 감지수단(600)을 마련하여 상기 디스플레이부(500) 및 근거리 통신수단(300)을 통해 화재 발생 정보를 사용자에게 송신하고, 하나 이상의 알람 수단(700)을 상기 콘센트박스에 마련함으로써 화재 시 건물 내 또는 상기 콘센트박스 인근 지역에 화재에 관한 알람 기능을 수행하며, 상기 콘센트박스 내부에는 상기 근거리 통신수단(300), 디스플레이부(500), 화재 발생 감지수단(600), 알람수단(700) 및 콘센트박스를 제어하는 마이콤 제어부(400)가 마련되고, 외부의 우수나 해충의 침입으로 인해 발생하는 누수, 누전, 손상 방지를 위한 밀폐부재를 포함하는 케이싱이 마련되고, 상기 케이싱은 내화성, 내열성 및 내부식성을 확보하도록 아노다이징 표면처리 된 알루미늄과 스칸듐의 합금으로 형성되며, 상기 콘센트박스의 구성 중 적어도 하나 이상은 밀폐성능, 절연성, 내열성 및 내화학성을 확보하고 사용자의 그립감을 개선시키도록 실리콘 고무, 도자, ABS 및 PLA 중 어느 하나 이상을 사용하되, 정교한 형태를 확보하기 위해 3D 프린팅 가공을 통해 성형하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Rear seat entertainment system, rear seat entertainment remote controlling apparatus and method thereof
title_ko: 후석 엔터테인먼트 시스템, 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치는 생체 센서를 포함한 센싱면이 형성되어 사용자의 생체 신호 및 손가락 제스처(Gesture)를 감지하는 센싱 모듈과 상기 센싱 모듈로 교류 전류를 제공하는 주제어기와 동작 모드에 따라 상기 감지된 생체 신호 및 손가락 제스처 중 어느 하나를 근거리 무선 통신을 통해 후석 모니터로 전송하는 근거리 무선통신 모듈을 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 헬스 케어 정보뿐만 아니라 후석 모니터의 원격 제어가 가능한 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치를 제공하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring and controlling system based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vital sign intelligent monitoring control system based on microwave radar which characterized in that: the system comprises a Doppler human body life detection radar front end, an intelligent control end, a local control end and a remote end; the local control end comprises a controller and local hardware equipment, and the local hardware equipment comprises an intelligent home and a medical emergency system; and the intelligent control end identifies the original data acquired by the front end of the Doppler human body life detection radar and then generates human body life characteristic parameters and gesture commands. The utility model is based on the detection of gesture command, human respiration and heart rate by the continuous wave radar, the front end of the Doppler radar has simple structure, realizes the all-weather monitoring of the physiological state of the target human body under the condition of no contact, and the radar electromagnetic wave technology is not influenced by the environment; the intelligent household appliance can realize the control switch and emergency help seeking of the intelligent household appliance, and can carry out voice or manual remote control.

title_en: ARM-based non-contact sleep respiration monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring device based on ARM, which belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign monitoring and comprises a control board, an SD card and a millimeter wave radar unit, wherein the control board comprises an SD card holder, the SD card is inserted on the SD card holder, the millimeter wave radar unit is electrically connected with the control board, the control board comprises a first central processing unit, a first synchronous dynamic random memory, a second synchronous dynamic random memory, a flash memory chip, a memory card holder, a first serial communication interface, a buzzer and a buzzer control chip, the millimeter wave radar unit comprises a second central processing unit and a second serial communication interface, and the second serial communication interface is electrically connected with the second central processing unit. Adopt non-contact sleep respiration monitoring, there is foreign matter sense and low accuracy, and health monitoring effect is better, and equipment is owing to not receive weight, size factor's restriction, and its health detection function of realization that can be better improves detection precision, promotes user experience.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;HANGZHOU KUANGWEI JURUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of device and method of active In vivo detection
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of device and methods of active In vivo detection, it emits by radio-frequency module and receives radar radiofrequency signal, and radar rf echo signal is handled by signal processing control module to obtain the maximum peak amplitude of echo-signal, the maximum peak amplitude is compared with the threshold value set according to vital sign, and then judge whether address has living object, when there is living object, is notified and alarmed by communication module and alarm module.In vivo detection of the invention is not affected by temperature, and has stronger adaptive capacity to environment, to have better detection effect.

title_en: Dynamic and static human body target self-adaptive detection method and system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for self-adaptive detection of moving and static human body targets based on a through-wall radar, and relates to the technical field of radar detection. The invention comprises the following steps: SS01 obtains baseband signals after frequency mixing and amplification of the through-wall radar and the radio frequency module; SS02 collects 32 groups of data, and after distance Fourier transform and Doppler Fourier transform, the accumulation of Doppler direction on corresponding distance units is carried out after taking the module; SS03 judgment of moving human body; SS04 conversion of stationary human body distance units; SS05 judgment of static human body; SS06 location determination. According to the invention, the moving human body target and the static human body target can be respectively detected through the moving target detection algorithm and the static target detection algorithm, so that on one hand, the detection accuracy is improved, on the other hand, the interference of the moving target on the detection of the static human body target is effectively inhibited, and the problem that the existing detection method cannot realize the simultaneous detection of the moving target and the static target is solved by utilizing the characteristic that the breathing heartbeat frequency of the static human body target is low.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring Blood Pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital sign and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The patch sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, a wireless transmitter, and all of the sensing and electronic components of the sensor. The patch sensor measures and centrally processes Electrocardiogram (ECG), Impedance Plethysmogram (IPG), vascular plethysmogram (PPG), and Phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor measuring PPG waveforms also includes a heating element for increasing perfusion of tissue on the breast.
assignees: BAXTER INT;BAXTER HEALTHCARE SA;WELCH ALLYN INC

title_en: Ultra-wideband Doppler radar life detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system of an ultra-wideband Doppler radar, and belongs to the technical field of radars. The device comprises a transmitting module, a receiving module and a data processing module; the transmitting module and the receiving module keep signal synchronization; the transmitting module is used for transmitting electromagnetic radio frequency signals, the electromagnetic radio frequency signals form echo signals after being modulated by detected life electromagnetic information, the receiving module is used for completing preprocessing of received signals, the data processing module is used for carrying out data analysis on the preprocessed received signals, and spectrum analysis and extraction of the signals are achieved by adopting a weak signal detection mode based on stochastic resonance, so that detection and capture of the weak life electromagnetic information are achieved. For the received weak physiological characteristic signal, a bistable stochastic resonance detection mode of secondary sampling and parameter compensation is adopted, and the frequency spectrum migration and the enhancement processing of the signal to be detected are realized by utilizing the difference of gain characteristics of different frequency components by the bistable stochastic resonance.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign signal measuring device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign signal measuring device and a non-contact vital sign signal measuring method, wherein a target is directly selected through a camera, millimeter waves are sent through an antenna to realize the detection of the target, the vital sign signal detection can be accurately carried out on the moving target, the moving range of a patient is not limited, and discomfort or even secondary injury can not be brought to the patient, particularly a burn patient. Meanwhile, the non-contact detection can avoid the problems of poor contact of the sensor, inaccurate data acquisition, reduced service life of the equipment, even damage to equipment and the like caused by multiple plugging and unplugging of contact equipment; accurate and not fragile equipment.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar underground pipeline parameter inversion method based on graphical user interface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ground penetrating radar data interpretation, and particularly relates to a ground penetrating radar underground pipeline parameter inversion method based on a graphical user interface. The method comprises the steps of designing a special graphical user interface, and dividing the special graphical user interface into: displaying a B-Scan signal of the ground penetrating radar, adjusting an interaction area and a threshold value, inputting basic parameters of the ground penetrating radar, and displaying a start button and a fitting result; and marking key points of hyperbolic features in the B-Scan image of the ground penetrating radar through a graphic user interface, and realizing inversion of buried depth and radius parameters of the underground pipeline by combining the sampling time interval and the transverse inter-channel distance of the input ground penetrating radar system to obtain the buried depth and radius parameters of the underground pipeline. Experimental results show that the method can accurately invert the buried depth and the radius of the underground pipeline of the ground penetrating radar, and solves the problems that the traditional method is not strong enough in universality, affected by noise, large in calculated amount, lack of radius inversion results and the like.

title_en: Explosion-proof device and system that spouts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel slag treatment equipment, in particular to an anti-blowout device and an anti-blowout system. The explosion-proof spraying device comprises a silo, a cut-off valve group and a sensor, wherein the silo is provided with a containing cavity and an opening, the containing cavity is used for containing materials, the opening is opposite to an automobile trunk, the cut-off valve group is in movable fit with the silo and is used for closing or opening the opening, the sensor is arranged at the opening, and/or the sensor is arranged below the opening, the sensor is electrically connected with the cut-off valve group, and the sensor is used for detecting the moving speed of the materials. The explosion-proof spraying device can prevent materials from suddenly collapsing or spraying, and avoid safety accidents such as buried vehicles, casualties and the like.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUAXIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: FMamba neural network-based non-contact electrocardiogram generation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, in particular to a non-contact electrocardiogram generating method based on FMamba neural network, which comprises the steps of processing received radar data, extracting heart beat micro signals from the radar data, step S2, carrying out multi-level decomposition on the input heart beat micro signals by utilizing Maximum Overlapped Discrete Wavelet Transform (MODWT), step S3, respectively mapping the multi-level signals to a high-dimensional characteristic space by adopting an embedded network (Embedding), inputting the high-dimensional characteristic space into an independent FMamba neural network module for carrying out sequence characteristic extraction, step S4, carrying out self-adaptive variable-pitch scanning on Frequent SSM (FSSM) modules in the FMamba neural network module, carrying out self-adaptive variable-pitch scanning on different frequency bands of each level to obtain M  o , and carrying out non-contact electrocardiogram generation, thereby being suitable for remote medical monitoring, vehicle-mounted health systems, home care and other application scenes.

title_en: Front and sides simultaneous monitoring type underground radar device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform realtime detection of an obstacle buried in the ground or an obstacle visually concealed by vegetation, debris, and the like in front and side directions of a moving body such as a vehicle.SOLUTION: A microwave underground radar loaded on a vehicle that travels on a ground surface is provided with: a radar part 1 that can simultaneously perform monitoring and detection of presence/absence of an obstacle such as a land mine buried under a ground surface and in the ground of a road in a front direction and in shoulder side directions through an image by irradiating the ground surface with a microwave via an array antenna while being loaded on the vehicle and travelling; and a radar calibration part 2 that enables an operator to design a nonplanar array antenna that can easily detect an object when desired front and side direction detection regions are designated, and to stop the vehicle in order to configure the designed array antenna, and calibrate each element antenna so as to have a correct position and a correct orientation direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: COMMISSIONER OF ACQUISITION TECH & LOGISTICS AGENCY

title_en: MILITARY IoT WATCH AND PLATFORM CORRESPONDING TO THE SITUATION USING THE SAME AND METHOD THEREOF
title_ko: 군용 IoT 워치와 이를 이용한 상황 대응 플랫폼 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A military IoT watch, a platform which copes with a situation by using the same, and a method thereof are disclosed. The military IoT watch comprises: a main body configured to display a view and transmit a signal by wireless communication; a band unit coupled to the main body and worn on a wrist of a user; and a sensor unit configured to measure a biometric signal of the user and transmit a measurement result to the main body. When the measurement result exceeds a preset limit point, the main body reports the situation to a situation room.
abstract_ko: 군용 IoT 워치와 이를 이용한 상황 대응 플랫폼 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 군용 IoT 워치에 있어서, 시각을 디스플레이 하고, 무선통신으로 신호를 송출하는 본체; 상기 본체와 결합하여 사용자의 손목에 착용되는 밴드부; 및 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 측정하여 상기 본체로 측정결과를 전송하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 본체는 상기 측정결과가 미리 정해진 한계점을 넘어서는 경우, 상황실에 보고할 수 있다.

title_en: Safety system inside school bus using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 내부 안전 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 내부 안전 시스템은 차량 내 좌석이 배치된 행마다 복수 개 설치되되, 통학 차량 내부의 일측 벽면에 좌석 시트에 상응하는 높이로 각 좌석 행마다 설치되어 타측 벽면 방향으로 사람의 생체 신호를 검출하는 복수의 레이더 센서 모듈과, 레이더 센서 모듈들로부터 생체 신호 검출 결과를 수신하여 통학 차량 내부에서의 알람 발생 여부를 판단하고, 알람 발생 시 알람 제어 메시지를 생성하여 전송하는 알람 제어기와, 알람 제어기로부터 알람 제어 메시지를 수신하여 스피커를 통해 경고음을 출력하고 하나 이상의 엘이디를 점멸하여 표시하는 알람 제어기를 포함한다.

title_en: System and Method for Mitigation of Random Body Movement and Interference Effects in Radar-Based Vital Signs Monitoring Systems in Medical Applications
abstract_en: A radar system (10) for vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing and a method for mitigating random body movement and external interference effects in vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing by employing a radar system (10) that is configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external interference affecting vital signs monitoring is at least mitigated by decomposing and filtering a reconstructed displacement signal x(t) using a time and frequency analysis technique such as Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. This decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency basis components containing the random body movement interference. Hence, the filtered signal can be reconstructed after removing the random body movement components, thus enabling reliable and robust vital-signs parameter estimation.

title_en: Search device and search method
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a search device and a search method which can detect a buried object related to a social infrastructure facility in a space-saving manner and without interrupting work.　According to the search device and the search method, a transceiver for transmitting and receiving electromagnetic waves is mounted on a rotational shaft of a drilling device, the transceiver is rotated with the rotation axis, the electromagnetic waves are transmitted while drilling, reflected waves from a buried object are received, and the buried object is sensed on the basis of the principle of an underground radar. Thus, the search device and the search method do not require a work space such as required by a cart-type electromagnetic radar system, and can determine, from the state of the reflected waves, whether the buried object is a social infrastructure facility or just a stone without interrupting the drilling work.

title_en: Monitoring vital signs of multiple persons via single phased-mimo radar
abstract_en: System and method for sensing movement such as chest movement of each of a plurality of target test subjects by: transmitting, at each of N transmitting antennas (TXs) of a phased multiple-input multiple-output (phased-MIMO) radar, a common frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signal in each of a plurality of time division multiplex (TDM) slots, each TDM slot having associated with it a respective weight selected in accordance with a transmit steering vector configured to cause a coherent summation of transmitted signal in a desired direction θ0 toward at least one target; receiving target-reflected energy associated with the transmitted FMCW signals at a virtual array formed by stacking signal from P TDM slots received via M receiving antennas (RXs) of the phased-MIMO radar; and processing an output of the virtual array to extract therefrom signal received from the desired direction θ0 to determine thereby target movement in the desired direction θ0.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar detection and disease treatment method for deep-buried high-voltage tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground penetrating radar detection and disease treatment method for a deep buried high-voltage tunnel, wherein on-site survey lines are of a two-transverse two-longitudinal net structure, radar transmitting antennas continuously transmit pulse high-frequency electromagnetic waves to the underground, receiving antennas receive reflected waves and transmitted waves generated by interfaces with electrical differences or targets, and judging the properties of the targets according to the form, strength and change of radar spectrum reflected waves to form a forecast, wherein the forecast content comprises four aspects of forecasting whether rock formations are broken in front of a face, forecasting whether water-rich rock formations are formed in front of the face, forecasting whether water or mud burst exists in front of the face, forecasting fault fracture zones in front of the face and water content of the fault fracture zones in front of the face, and summarizing, surveying and constructing design files and construction specifications according to the forecast content.

title_en: Fall alarm method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter radar
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a fall alarm method, a device, equipment and a medium based on millimeter radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving an environment laser point cloud of a preset detection area, receiving a second vital sign detection signal sent by a vital monitoring device, continuously sending millimeter radar to the preset detection area, receiving a first laser point cloud set fed back by human vital signs in the preset detection area within a preset time range, performing human target object point cloud segmentation on the laser point cloud of the human vital signs, determining a motion point cloud track of the human vital signs in the preset detection area, performing motion distortion compensation on the motion point cloud track according to preset motion compensation parameters of the human vital signs, generating a target motion point cloud track, determining vertical acceleration of the human vital signs in the vertical direction, and sending a falling alarm signal if the vertical acceleration is larger than an acceleration threshold. Thereby improving the accuracy of falling alarm and guaranteeing the safety of users.

title_en: Vital sign and sleep monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign and sleep monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method utilizes the millimeter wave radar to realize non-contact sleep monitoring, firstly, the millimeter wave radar is used for collecting radar echo signals obtained by chest wall vibration in a sleep state, the position of a monitored object is determined, vital sign signals of the object are extracted, then, first amplitude body movements and second amplitude body movements of the object are accurately detected, whether an apnea event occurs in the object or not is detected in real time, alarm information is prompted under the condition that the event occurrence time is long, three sleeping positions of supine, lateral lying and prone lying are detected, finally, sleep state monitoring is formed, a user sleep quality analysis report is formed by combining the monitored information, and health advice is given. The method is simple, accurate, economical and efficient, is suitable for various application scenes such as families, hospitals, nursing homes and the like, and provides all-weather health monitoring services for users.

title_en: Safety helmet
title_ko: 안전 헬멧
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety helmet, wherein the safety helmet, which is worn on a user in an industrial site or a disaster site, senses a working environment of the user and displays the environment to the user in real time, and when a danger is sensed, the safety helmet apprises the danger of an external administrator through intercommunication, thereby transmitting, to an external administrator, the location, environment, and health state of the user. In the present invention, provide is a safety helmet, which is worn to protect the head of a user in an industrial site or a disaster site, and comprises an air suction port formed in one surface of the front side and a transmissive goggle part at the front side facing both eyes of the user, wherein a first sensor module is installed inside the suction port of the safety helmet and senses the temperature, brightness, humidity, gas, and shock around the user to generate a sensing signal; a signal processing module and a control module are installed inside the rear side of the helmet, wherein the signal processing module receives a measurement signal sensed by the first sensor module, amplifies and filters the measurement signal, and then converts the measurement signal into digital data, and the control module receives the measurement data through the signal processing module, displays the measurement data based on previously stored data display algorithm and analysis algorithm, and controls alarm and display through comparative analysis; a display part is provided on the goggle part, wherein the display part displays the measurement data and analysis data of the surrounding environment, which are analyzed by the control module such that the user can see the measurement data and the analysis data; an alarm part (6) is installed outside of the helmet, wherein the alarm part receives signals from a controller (3) to apprise the signals of the user through voice; and a power unit, for supplying necessary power to the first sensor module, the control module, the display part, and the alarm part, is installed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전 헬멧으로서 산업현장이나 재해현장에서 작업자가 착용하는 안전 헬멧이 사용자가 작업하는 환경을 감지하면서 작업자에게 실시간으로 표시하며, 위험이 감지되었을 때 외부의 관리자에게 상호 통신하여 위험성을 전달하여 사용자의 위치, 환경, 건강상태 등을 실시간으로 전달하는 것으로, 산업현장이나 재해현장에서 작업자의 머리를 보호하도록 착용하면서 전측 일면에 공기 흡입구가 형성되며, 작업자의 양 눈에 대면하는 전측에 투시형 고글부가 구비되는 안전 헬멧에 있어서, 상기 안전 헬멧의 흡입구 내측에 구비되어 작업자의 주변의 온도, 조도, 습도, 가스(gas), 충격을 감지하여 센싱신호를 생성시키는 제1센서모듈이 설치되고, 상기 제1센서모듈에서 감지한 측정신호를 받아 증폭하고 필터링한 후 디지털 데이터로 변환하는 신호처리모듈과 상기 신호처리모듈을 통해 측정데이터를 입력받고, 측정된 데이터에 대해 미리 저장되어있는 데이터 표시 알고리즘과 분석 알고리즘에 의해 측정 데이터를 표시함과 아울러 비교분석에 의해 알람 및 표시를 제어하는 제어모듈이 상기 헬멧의 후측 내부에 설치되고, 상기 제어모듈에 분석된 주변 환경의 측정 데이터와 분석 데이터를 작업자가 볼 수 있도록 고글부에 마련된 표시부에 표시하고, 상기 제어부(3)로부터 신호를 수신하여 음성으로 알리는 알림부(6)가 헬멧 외측에 마련되고, 상기 제1센서모듈, 제어모듈, 표시부 및 알림부에 필요한 전원을 공급하는 전원부가 포함되는 안전 헬멧을 제공한다.

title_en: Microwave signal generator of intermediate frequency
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of microwave signal generator of intermediate frequency, it is characterized in that: comprise PDRO module, AD9914 module, amplifier, filter, FPGA module, digital isolator; PDRO module and AD9914 model calling, AD9914 module is connected with amplifier, and amplifier is connected with filter simultaneously; Serial control data mouth is connected with FPGA module, and FPGA module realizes the connection with AD9914 module and digital isolator simultaneously.The utility model may be used on visiting in ground equipment and equipment through walls in some antidetonation rescue operations, improves Post disaster relief efficiency; Intermediate-freuqncy signal source as debug signal source in each electronic equipment, can produce various forms of intermediate-freuqncy signal as required; In intermediate-freuqncy signal source, UWB-LFM technology can be used in various advanced military radar, as the frequency synthesizer of radar, for advanced capabilities radar provides ultra broadband pumping signal; Intermediate-freuqncy signal source neutral line frequency modulation technology can be used in civilian radar for backing car, detects in order to high accuracy distance.

title_en: Search for and rescue humanoid robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search for and rescue humanoid robot, including running gear and organism, organism upper portion rear end and upper portion front end are equipped with broken respectively that the dismouting is put and extinguishing device, are equipped with the water tank on the organism between extinguishing device and broken dismouting are put, are equipped with the loading case on the water tank, are equipped with camera, fan and life detection appearance above loading the case, and the loading incasement is equipped with aspiration pump, oxygen system, and four sides of loading case all are equipped with ultrasonic distance sensor and flame sensor, and the front portion of organism is connected with the shovel board through hydraulic means. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: put and shovel the board through broken dismouting, can quick break tearing and clear away the roadblock open, and then can rescue the personnel of stranding with the shortest time, the utility model discloses the stranded personnel of ability automatic search can judge concrete position moreover when using, adopt track type running gear to strengthen the stability when moving, will load the case setting and on the water tank, can increase the accommodation space who loads the case like this.

title_en: A kind of three-dimensional radar life detection positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of three-dimensional radar life detection positioning devices, main includes transmitting subsystem, receiving subsystem, multichannel data acquisition system, main control unit, wireless line traffic control terminal, power module, by by marx pulse-generating circuits, three avalanche transistors, the high amplitude pulses of the nanosecond of Resonant Mode Trigger Circuits composition emit subsystem, reception echo is carried out by receiving subsystem, by noise reduction unit, filter unit, the processing of information amplifying unit, incoming multi-channel data collection unit carries out sampling processing, the result of sampling processing comes in and goes out by DSP data processing units and WiFi communication module and the main control unit for running linux system, bidirectional data communication is carried out to wireless line traffic control terminal by 2.4GWiFi.In short, the utility model can realize three-dimensional localization life detection, the distortion of impulse wave is prevented, improve the clear of the image of three-dimensional simulation and receives the intensity of weak signal.

title_en: Fire control cistern of photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting water reservoir for photovoltaic power generation, which belongs to the technical field of water storage and comprises a water reservoir body, a plurality of groups of photovoltaic power generation assemblies arranged above the water reservoir body, an electric cabinet connected with the photovoltaic power generation assemblies, a plurality of submerged electric heating pipes connected to the inside of the water reservoir body through the electric cabinet and a temperature sensor connected to the inside of the water reservoir body through the electric cabinet, wherein a top plate of the water reservoir body is arranged above a maximum frozen soil layer, a manhole is arranged on the top plate and is higher than the ground, the photovoltaic power generation assemblies are arranged on the top plate, and the submerged electric heating pipes are arranged above the maximum frozen soil line inside the water reservoir body. The utility model can obviously reduce the buried depth of the water tank, the excavation supporting engineering quantity, the reinforcement and thickness of the top plate of the water tank and the heating power consumption of the water reservoir.

title_en: Vital sign information extraction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a vital sign information extraction method, a vital sign information extraction device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo signal; determining signal energy corresponding to each slice signal in the slow time direction in the radar echo signal; extracting human body sign signals from the radar echo signals based on an energy window with a preset width and signal energy corresponding to each slice signal; and carrying out coherent accumulation processing on the human body sign signals, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals from the processed human body sign signals. Therefore, the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal can be accurately extracted from the radar echo signal according to the signal energy corresponding to each slice signal in the slow time direction in the radar echo signal and the energy window with the preset width.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter wave radar, which are characterized in that data acquired by the radar on a target area are firstly acquired, and intermediate frequency signal sampling is carried out on the data to generate ADC data; then, when the target person is judged to be in bed according to the ADC data and the body movement index is smaller than a preset value, extracting the chest position of the target person; then, extracting phase data of the chest position, and performing phase unwrapping on the phase data to generate unwrapped data; and finally, preprocessing the unwrapped data, performing FFT operation on the preprocessed unwrapped data to generate heart rate data and performing tracking processing on the heart rate data. The method solves the problem of misjudgment when vital signs are monitored based on millimeter wave radar.

title_en: Intelligent emergency rescue cabin with self-adjusting thermal environment and air quality and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency rescue cabin and a method for self-adjusting thermal environment and air quality, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue. The method is characterized by comprising the steps of firstly, establishing a standard loss rate by simulating the heat loss characteristics of an environment learning rescue cabin, then setting a target temperature interval, and dynamically selecting a grading temperature control mode such as dormancy, low-power consumption maintenance or dynamic balance based on comparison of the real-time monitored temperature loss rate and a standard value. The invention further discloses integrated vital sign monitoring, which can dynamically adjust the target temperature according to parameters such as core body temperature, blood oxygen, blood pressure and the like of a patient and start medical intervention modes such as active cooling, shock rewarming and the like, wherein the Hucken rewarming mode adopts a mode of heating a core area by directional radiation to realize safe rewarming. The system also incorporates a multi-rule priority arbitration mechanism. The cabin body comprises a sensor, an air conditioner, vital sign monitoring equipment and a directional heating plate. The invention realizes the unification of energy conservation, temperature stabilization and accurate medical intervention, and remarkably improves the intelligent level and the safety guarantee capability of emergency rescue.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for detecting vital sign
abstract_en: To provide a system and method for detecting a vital sign.SOLUTION: A method for detecting a vital sign comprises: transmitting a first radio frequency signal through a first radar to receive a first radar signal corresponding to the first radio frequency signal; performing in-phase quadrature demodulation to the first radar signal to acquire first received in-phase component and a first received quadrature component; performing a first convolution operation to the first received in-phase component and a first symbol and performing first product-sum operation to a first result of the first convolution operation to acquire a first cumulative value; performing second convolution operation to the first received in-phase component and the first symbol and performing second product-sum calculation to a second result of the second convolution operation to acquire a second cumulative value; and creating a vital sign on the basis of the first and second cumulative values.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6
