The method comprises the steps of processing and imaging an original echo signal, carrying out image enhancement on an obtained amplitude image, carrying out target detection through a deep learning model, carrying out time sequence optimization and track tracking on a detection result by combining a target state memory bank and a Kalman filter, outputting actual position information of a target with dynamic and static attributes, carrying out clustering and confidence assessment on a static target, carrying out track clustering and second-level behavior recognition on the dynamic target, and finally, synchronously presenting the information on a display control interface in a form of association of graphical marks and semantic text description. The invention solves the problems of single information presentation, insufficient analysis and non-traceability of the traditional life detection radar, and obviously improves the detection accuracy, the information reading depth and the system usability.

title_en: Superconducting coil apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a superconducting coil apparatus which has improved stability and insulation by reducing an influence of deterioration and strain stress in an edgewise direction which are caused by thermal distortion at the time of connection.  <P>SOLUTION: A first superconducting coil apparatus 10A includes a core 15 formed of an insulator, an electrode 13 buried into the core and fixed to the core 15 with a screw 16, and two superconducting tape wires 14a and 14b electrically connected to the electrode 13, and is constituted by disposing two superconducting coils 11a and 11b wherein two superconducting tape wires 14a and 14b are wound in opposite directions, coaxially adjacently to each other.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Gateway-based situation monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a gateway-based situation monitoring system capable of effectively observing an emergency situation that occurs in a house using non-contact, non-aware, and non-constrained IoT sensors.SOLUTION: A gateway-based situation monitoring system includes: a plurality of edge sensor terminals each installed in a specific space, connected by at least one wireless communication scheme, and collecting life signals generated in the specific space as monitoring information; a gateway terminal selectively connected to the plurality of edge sensor terminals by the at least one wireless communication scheme, receiving the life signal, and transmitting the signal to a cloud server; and a cloud server detecting the occurrence of an abnormal situation while monitoring the specific space by analyzing the life signal received from the gateway terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Underground structure detection apparatus and underground structure detection method
abstract_en: To accurately detect an underground buried object detected by a radar in an underground structure detection apparatus.SOLUTION: An underground structure detection apparatus detects information including a component constituting an underground structure, a type of the component, and position/posture information on the basis of a plurality of pieces of two-dimensional data indicating a cross section of ground and three-dimensional data indicating the underground structure. With respect to synthetic data obtained by synthesizing the two-dimensional data and the three-dimensional data, the position/posture information of a component represented by the synthetic data is corrected on the basis of an image feature grasped from the two-dimensional data. When a determination is made in a transverse direction with respect to a road, and the image feature is included in continuous images by a threshold or more, it is determined as a transverse pipe, and when a determination is mode in a longitudinal direction with respect to a road, and the image feature is included in continuous images by a threshold or less, it is determined as a longitudinal pipe, and the posture is corrected for each direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Wearable device and sensor device
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 및 센서 디바이스
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a wearable device capable of stably measuring a biosignal may comprise: a wearable device body; a sensor unit measuring a biosignal by contacting the skin of a user wearing the wearable device; and a buffer unit formed between the wearable device body and the sensor unit to mechanically connect the wearable device body and the sensor unit, and blocking transfer of movement between the wearable device body and the sensor unit so that the wearable device body and the sensor unit may independently move.
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 웨어러블 디바이스는, 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와, 웨어러블 디바이스를 착용한 사용자의 피부에 접촉하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부 사이에 형성되어 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부를 기구적으로 연결하며, 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부가 독립적으로 움직일 수 있도록 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부 사이의 움직임 전달을 차단하는 완충부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content
abstract_en: A microwave stethoscope measurement method and sensor design employ a microwave transmission sensor and a microwave reception sensor placed on a patient's chest in spaced-apart side-by-side configuration for monitoring patient vital signs, lung water content and other critical measurements. The side-by- side sensors are spaced apart a separation distance of about 1-3 cm in lateral chest orientation. The sensors may be formed with a textile fabric for wearer comfort and to improve contact with the patient's skin. The microwave sensor measurements are digitally processed using a modified short time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrum windowed-averaged algorithm. Output data extracted from the microwave sensor measurements may be transmitted wirelessly to a mobile device such as a smartphone for remote monitoring of the patient's medical condition.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A home occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event.

title_en: Providing energy efficient features using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in an energy efficient manner using a plurality of sensors such as those of a battery-powered device such as a television remote, and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from an initial television WiFi radio scan, or an initial low-powered detection scan from the television remote, may be analyzed by the processor to determine a potential presence of one or more humans are present proximate to the device. If there is such a potential presence, the device remote can enter a full-powered detection mode to accurately determine the presence or absence of one or more humans, and take further actions.

title_en: Targeting abnormal cell populations for apoptosis
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range abnormal cells including senescent and cancerous cells are targeted for apoptosis. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of a senolytic and chemotherapeutic. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: System and methods for detection of subjects vitals and physiological symptoms via non-contact methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring which properly detect subject' s vital signs by correcting the measured signals for reflectance and variations in distance between measurements. The present invention provides for adequate sensor numbers and types to properly monitor a subject's vitals and physiological signals. Certain aspects of the invention include the use of signal scoring methods. In such embodiments, acquired data and/or information is used for scoring a signal acquired from non-contact vital monitoring assisting in the accurate measurement of various vitals of a subject, including, without limit, a subjects temperature, cardiovascular and respiratory information. The present invention provides a viable solution for at-a-distance non- contact vital sign monitoring that overcomes the shortcomings of existing solutions known in the art.

title_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system in the cabin of crewman sea
abstract_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system in a kind of cabin of crewman sea, including：Command centre's server, fence transmitter, crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, crewman's Real Time Localizer, carrier-borne personnel positioning processor and persons falling in water locator, it is by being based on the modern information technologies such as AIS, UWB, big-dipper satellite positioning, single crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, carrier-borne and persons falling in water Real Time Localizer and wounded's vital sign and location data Transmission system are developed, realizes that marine wounded's vital sign monitoring automation, information storage electronization, information transmission network and the wounded give first aid to visualization.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting respirator glasses with multi-information fusion display function
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent fire-fighting respiratory mask glasses with multi-information fusion display, which are characterized in that: the breathing mask comprises a spectacle frame, an imaging module and a battery module, wherein the spectacle frame is arranged on a breathing mask, the imaging module is arranged on one side, close to eyes, of the top of the spectacle frame, and the battery module is integrated on one side of the tail end of the spectacle frame; the spectacle frame and the spectacle frame are integrated with a circuit board processor and a control module. The invention is installed in the fire-fighting breathing mask, can be connected with the pressure value of an oxygen cylinder of an air respirator, the gas concentration of a gas detector, the sign parameters of a vital sign bracelet and the imaging picture of a thermal imager, has compact structure, light weight and convenient use and interaction, does not influence the normal sight, really liberates the hands of a fireman, and improves the rescue and self-protection capability of the fireman.

title_en: Heartbeat respiration detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heartbeat respiration detection method and device and a processor. The method comprises the steps of sending detection signals to a detection object through a packaging antenna, receiving feedback signals returned by the detection object through a radar of the packaging antenna, and determining heartbeat signals and respiratory signals of the detection object through an analysis algorithm according to the feedback signals. The invention solves the technical problems of lower efficiency, inconvenient use and complex operation in the related art by adopting a breathing machine and an electrocardiogram device to collect breath and heart beat respectively.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method and system based on millimeter wave signals
abstract_en: According to the heartbeat detection method and system based on the millimeter wave signals, the millimeter wave sensor is used for transmitting continuous frequency modulation wave signals to the target user and receiving echo signals, intermediate frequency signals are obtained, phase signals are extracted from the intermediate frequency signals, and the phase signals are used for capturing chest micro-vibration of the target user caused by heartbeat motion. The method and the system can perform at least one modal decomposition on the phase signal based on the hierarchical variation modal decomposition model so as to remove the influence of the interference signal on the heartbeat signal, thereby obtaining fine-granularity heartbeat information. The input signal of each change mode decomposition is the output signal of the last change mode decomposition. In the process of decomposing the variation modes each time, the method and the system calculate corresponding initial parameters based on the input signals of the current variation mode decomposition, so that the optimization result is more accurate, the convergence speed is faster, the accuracy of the variation mode decomposition is improved, and the accuracy of heart rate detection is further improved.

title_en: Microwave Sensor for Security Monitoring Improved False Alarm Rate by Bio-Signal Detection
title_ko: 생체신호 감지에 따른 오보율을 개선한 보안 감시용 마이크로웨이브 센서
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a microwave sensor for security monitoring with a lowered false alarm rate by biosignal detection which uses a microwave signal to detect a human body, an animal, or an object approaching within a prescribed distance to monitor and determine a false alarm or a malfunction state by an environmental factor. First Doppler radar and second Doppler radar for detecting human bodies and processing security signals are installed in a pair to extend the monitoring distance to perform security monitoring. An IF frequency band disturbed by a human body can be specified and set. An IF frequency can be simply amplified or a change in the voltage level (peak to peak) can be changed to DC voltage displacement to be outputted and used to extend a monitoring distance (d). Mutual security signals are doubly checked to be transmitted and received by a pair of sensors by extending the monitoring distance to manage a monitoring state in detail. False alarms or malfunction states of the sensor can be further divided to lower a false alarm rate in comparison to a conventional microwave sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 마이크로웨이브(Microwave) 신호를 이용하여 일정 거리 이내에서 접근하는 인체나 동물 또는 사물을 감지하여 환경적 요인에 의한 오경보나 고장상태를 감시하고 판단하는 생체신호 감지에 따른 오보율을 개선한 보안 감시용 마이크로웨이브 센서에 관한 것으로, 인체감지 및 보안신호를 각각 처리하는 제1도플러레이더와 제2도플러레이더를 한 쌍으로 설치하여 감시거리를 더욱 확장하여 보안감시를 할 수 있도록 하고, 인체에 의해 교란되는 IF 주파수대역을 특정하여 설정할 수 있고, 감시거리(d)를 확장하기 위하여 단순히 IF 주파수를 증폭하거나 전압레벨(peak to peak)의 변화를 DC 전압의 변위로 변경 출력하여 사용할 수 있도록 하며, 감시거리의 확장으로 한 쌍의 센서에서 상호 보안신호를 송출하고 수신할 수 있도록 이중 체크함으로써 감시상태를 세밀하게 관리할 수 있고, 센서의 오경보나 고장상태를 더욱 구분할 수 있어 기존의 마이크로웨이브 센서에 비하여 더욱 향상된 오보율의 개선할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Cardiac signal processing apparatus and cardiac signal processing method
abstract_en: A cardiac signal processing apparatus includes: a unit for acquiring, from a heartbeat sensor, cardiac signals relating to heartbeats of a subject; a low-pass filter for allowing passage of those cardiac signals having a first predetermined frequency or lower, among the cardiac signals; higher harmonic noise acquisition unit for acquiring harmonic signals of low-frequency noise by performing high frequency extrapolation on the signals output from the low-pass filter; a high-pass filter for allowing passage of those cardiac signals having a second predetermined frequency or higher, among the cardiac signals; and higher harmonic noise removal unit for removing the harmonic signals of low-frequency noise from the signals output from the high-pass filter. It is thus made possible to remove noise from the cardiac signals and to obtain desirable heartbeat detection characteristics.
assignees: KISHI TAKAHIKO;TAKADA JUN-ICHI;SUZUKI SATOSHI;YASUE TOMOYOSHI;TOYOTA MOTOR CO LTD

title_en: Sensor system for explosive detection and removal
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting one of Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs), landmines or other buried explosives, the sensor system is mounted in place of a standard backhoe digging bucket of a backhoe vehicle. The sensor system includes a mounting portion having arc swing points for hanging the sensor system on a backhoe arm, and a holding pin opening for receiving a holding pin when positioned in a mounting position on the backhoe arm; and an electronic sensor wand arm assembly mounted to the mounting portion.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidance method, computer program product and system
abstract_en: A hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) guidance method ( 40 ) for a system including a head-mountable computing device ( 100 ) comprising a processor ( 110 ) and at least one display module ( 106, 106 ′) arranged to be viewed by the wearer ( 20 ) of the head-mountable computing device when wearing the device is disclosed that allows a rescuer to receive CPR guidance without losing sight of the victim. The method comprises receiving ( 420 ), on said processor, a first signal conveying vital signs information from at least one sensor ( 200, 210 ) for monitoring vital signs of a patient ( 10 ), wherein a sensor ( 210 ) of the at least one sensor is integrated in the head-mountable computing device ( 100 ); processing said first signal on said processor to obtain the vital signs information; and displaying ( 422 ) CPR guidance on said at least one display module in response to the processed vital signs information. A computer program product and a CPR guidance system are also disclosed. The system may be created in situ using ubiquitous devices, e.g. smart devices including usable sensors, thus facilitating rapid response to an SCA event, which improves the chances of survival of a SCA victim.
assignees: KONINKLIJKE PHILIPS NV;KONINKLIJKE PHILIPS N V V

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.

title_en: Human life detection mechanism applicable to S-shaped robot
abstract_en: A human life detection mechanism applicable to an S-shaped robot comprises pyroelectric infrared sensors. A power apparatus is fixed in the S-shaped robot body, a main bevel gear is mounted on an output shaft of the power apparatus, and rotary shafts are mounted on a casing of the S-shaped robot through bearings. Auxiliary bevel gears are mounted at one ends of the rotary shafts, and the other ends stretch out of the S-shaped robot. A plurality of the rotary shafts are distributed evenly on a longitudinal section of the S-shaped robot to form a group of the rotary shafts which are meshed with the main bevel gear through the auxiliary bevel gears. At least one group of the rotary shafts is arranged on the S-shaped robot, and the pyroelectric infrared sensors are installed at the ends of the rotary shafts stretching out of the S-shaped robot and connected with a receiving processing apparatus in the S-shaped robot through wires in the rotary shafts. According to the human life detection mechanism, the structure is simple and stable, the size is small, and the sensitivity is high; universal sensing apparatuses and processing circuits on the market can be used, so that a good practicality is provided; and trapped persons with vital signs can be detected in a rescue and disaster relief process, particularly in ruins.

title_en: Portable through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radar detection technical field, more specifically relates to a portable through-wall radar, including the casing, be used for signalling and can for casing pivoted detection module, be used for signal reception's signal module, be used for presenting the detection result and locate the outside display module of casing, be used for giving detection module signal module display module provides the electric energy respectively and rather than the power module of electricity connection, detection module with display module locates respectively the casing is outside, just detection module with the casing rotates to be connected, display module with the connection can be dismantled to the casing, signal module respectively with detection module display module electricity is connected, power module locates in the casing and with the connection can be dismantled to the casing. The utility model provides a realize enlarging the portable through-wall radar of detection scope through the rotation of detecting the module under the unchangeable condition in radar position.

title_en: Piezoelectric film sensor and wireless respiration detection circuit's MCP packaging form
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MCP packaging form of a piezoelectric film sensor and a wireless respiration detection circuit. The MCP packaging structure is as follows: the wireless respiration detection circuit chip is fixed on the piezoelectric film sensor through a fixing adhesive layer, a conductive pin of the chip is connected to the antenna and the piezoelectric film sensor, and the chip and the connection part of the conductive pin, the antenna and the piezoelectric film sensor are wrapped by a packaging filling body. The system has small size, low cost, simple manufacture and easy use by adopting the MCP packaging form.

title_en: Portable software robot for life detection for earthquake relief
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable soft robot for life detection for earthquake relief, which comprises a central loading body and a central resetting through groove, wherein the upper end of a central loading body is provided with a robot main transmission mechanism, the lower end of the central loading body is provided with a robot auxiliary transmission mechanism, the middle part of the central loading body is provided with a detection chamber, the front end of the detection chamber is provided with a sealing top cover, the periphery of the sealing top cover is provided with fixing screws, and the inside of the sealing top cover is provided with a cable through hole, the invention has the beneficial effects that: this portable software robot is used in life detection for earthquake relief is provided with center dress carrier, robot main drive mechanism, the vice drive mechanism of robot and detection room, through the center and the detection room that are located the device body center, can let the device body can keep better equilibrium through the center with behind the detection room linking installation circuit and the detection sensor, make things convenient for the device body to carry out better function.

title_en: Life monitoring method and device based on intelligent vehicle-mounted box
abstract_en: The invention provides a life monitoring method and a device based on an intelligent vehicle-mounted box, which specifically comprise the following steps: scanning an in-vehicle area by a millimeter wave radar sending signal, receiving an echo signal of the radar, and mixing the sending signal and the echo signal to obtain a beat frequency signal; acquiring N frames of beat frequency signals, sending the N frames of beat frequency signals to an intelligent vehicle-mounted box, and judging whether a target exists or not after first data processing is carried out on the N frames of beat frequency signals; and filtering the signal with the target to respectively obtain a heart rate signal and a respiration rate signal. Through the on-vehicle box of intelligence that this application provided, can carry out vital sign monitoring to the target in the car in real time, when discovering vital sign anomaly, can in time report to the police and seek help.
assignees: SHANGHAI HINGE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire fighter fire extinguishing protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective clothing identification, in particular to a fire-fighting protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence firefighters. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting body type data of a firefighter and protective clothing data of fire extinguishment equipment of the firefighter, S2, accessing a video monitoring module of a rescue place, then establishing a three-dimensional space model of the rescue place by combining the video monitoring module, collecting video recording data of the firefighter at the rescue place, and sending the video recording data to the three-dimensional space model for supplementing, accurately obtaining key vital sign data such as temperature, humidity and heart rate of the firefighter in the protective clothing through a built-in sensor by monitoring the performance parameters of the protective clothing in real time, and immediately giving an early warning once the data exceeds a safety threshold value, so that the firefighter can know own situation danger in the first time, withdraw replacement equipment in time or take corresponding protective measures, and life safety of the firefighter in fire extinguishment rescue actions is practically ensured.
assignees: U PROTEC SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried object survey device, method for controlling display of buried object survey device, and display control program
abstract_en: To provide a buried object survey device, a method for controlling the display of the buried object survey device, and a display control program, with which it is possible to eliminate the need for marking work and lighten the burdens of workers at buried object survey time.SOLUTION: A buried object survey device 10 comprises a capacitance sensor 13, a survey image conversion processing unit 25, a storage unit 22, a display unit 12, an operation input unit 15, and a display control unit 30. The capacitance sensor 13 detects the presence/absence of a buried object 51. The survey image conversion processing unit 25 converts the result of detection by the capacitance sensor 13 to a survey image. The storage unit 22 stores the survey image and a grid layer that includes grid lines corresponding to a prescribed reduction scale. The display unit 12 displays the survey image and the grid layer. The display control unit 30 controls the display unit 12 so as to display the survey image and the grid layer, and to display the survey image to be movable relatively to the grid layer in response to input to the operation input unit 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Apparatus for detect to vital signal from chair
title_ko: 의자를 이용한 생체정보 획득장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for acquiring bio information by using a chair. The purpose of the present invention is to acquire continuously the bio information by installing bio signal sensor at an armrest, a back and a seat of the chair mainly used in daily life or an office for acquiring the bio information and making compensations possible in spite of an error such as a contact degradation at a place, to calculate parameters for determining a health state, a stress state or an emotion state of a user, and to analyze a sitting posture state by distributing a plurality of pressure sensors to the back and the seat of the chair and acquiring data measured via each of the pressure sensors. The present invention comprises: an armrest bio signal measurement part for measuring the electrocardiogram (ECG), the GSR and the PPG from the arm or the palm of the user in contact with the armrest; a back ECG sensor installed on the back of the chair for measuring the ECG signal from the back of the user in contact with the back of the chair; a seat ECG sensor installed on the seat of the chair for measuring the ECG signal from the hips of the user in contact with the seat of the chair; and a bio information processor for receiving the bio signal measured from the armrest bio signal measurement part, the back ECG sensor and the seat ECG sensor and transmitting processed bio information or raw bio signal data to a personal computer or a smartphone. [Reference numerals] (110) Armrest bio signal measurement part;(111) Left and right ECG sensors;(112) GSR sensor;(113) PPG sensor;(114) Left and right CDS sensors;(121) Back ECG sensor;(122) Back pressure sensor;(131) Seat ECG sensor;(132) Sear pressure sensor;(210) Posture data calculator;(220) Micro controller

title_en: Rf coil with integrated vital signs detector
abstract_en: It is an object of the invention to provide a radio frequency (RF) transmit-receive coil (1) for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system with an integrated vital signs detector (3) for the detection of vital signs of a patient within the magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, whereby contact sensors directly attached to the body of the patient, are replaced by a contactless system for monitoring vital signs, which makes it much easier to measure vital signs of the patient. The object is achieved by a RF transmit-receive coil (1) comprising a vital signs detector (3) wherein the vital signs detector (3) is integrated in the RF transmit-receive coil (1), wherein a pair of electrically conducting coil elements (4) of the RF transmit-receive coil (1) forms the vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is a capacitive vital signs detector (3), the capacitive vital signs detector (3) being adapted for receiving capacitive vital signs signals. The present invention also concerns a system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a method for operating the system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a software package for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system and a software package for upgrading a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-contact fast vital sign acquisition based on radar signal
abstract_en: Various examples are provided for non-contact vital sign acquisition. Information can be provided regarding vibrations of a target using a radar signal such as, e.g., non-contact vital sign measurement. Examples include estimation of heart rate, change in heart rate, respiration rate, and/or change in respiration rate, for a human or other animal. Implementations can produce one or both rates of vibration and/or change in one or both rates of vibration for a target other than an animal or human experiencing two vibrations at the same time, such as a motor, a vehicle incorporating a motor, or another physical object. Some implementations can estimate the respiration movement in the radar baseband output signal. The estimated respiration signal can then be subtracted from radar signals in the time domain and, optionally, can be further enhanced using digital signal processing techniques, to produce an estimate of the heartbeat pulses.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

The object is achieved by a RF transmit-receive coil (1) comprising a vital signs detector (3) wherein the vital signs detector (3) is integrated in the RF transmit-receive coil (1), wherein a pair of electrically conducting coil elements (4) of the RF transmit-receive coil (1) forms the vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is a capacitive vital signs detector (3), the capacitive vital signs detector (3) being adapted for receiving capacitive vital signs signals. title_en: System and methods for detection of subjects vitals and physiological symptoms via non-contact methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring which properly detect subject's vital signs by correcting the measured signals for reflectance and variations in distance between measurements. The present invention provides for adequate sensor numbers and types to properly monitor a subject's vitals and physiological signals. Certain aspects of the invention include the use of signal scoring methods. In such embodiments, acquired data and/or information is used for scoring a signal acquired from non-contact vital monitoring assisting in the accurate measurement of various vitals of a subject, including, without limit, a subjects temperature, cardiovascular and respiratory information. The present invention provides a viable solution for at-a-distance non-contact vital sign monitoring that overcomes the shortcomings of existing solutions known in the art.

title_en: Double-frequency-band vital sign detection radar system based on superheterodyne and low-intermediate frequency structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-frequency-band vital sign detection radar system based on superheterodyne and a low-intermediate frequency structure, which comprises a receiving antenna and a transmitting antenna, wherein the receiving antenna is connected with a low-noise amplifier, a first frequency mixer and a band-pass filter in series; the transmitting antenna is connected with a power amplifier, the power amplifier is connected with a power synthesis structure, one path of the input end of the power synthesis structure is connected with a second phase-locked loop chip connected with the input end of the second mixer, and the other path of the input end of the power synthesis structure is connected with a power divider; the input end of the power divider is connected with a phase-locked loop chip, one path of the output end of the power divider is connected to the input end of the power synthesis structure, and the other path of the output end of the power divider is connected to the input end of the first frequency mixer. The invention can simultaneously solve the problems of direct current bias and image suppression and realize the detection effect of the vital sign signals with higher precision.

title_en: Breathing heartbeat detection method, system and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a breath and heartbeat detection method, a system and a device based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a radar echo signal, and acquiring object distance and phase information based on the mixture of the radar echo signal and a transmitting signal; enhancing the phase information to obtain enhanced phase information; performing wavelet packet decomposition on the enhanced phase information, reconstructing a respiratory signal based on the decomposed low-frequency component, and reconstructing a heartbeat signal based on the decomposed high-frequency component; reconstructing the physiological rate of the reconstructed respiratory signal and the reconstructed heartbeat signal; based on the reconstructed respiratory signal, the reconstructed heartbeat signal and the sensing matrix, constructing a loss function, and introducing a sparse penalty term and an adaptive factor into the loss function to realize physiological rate reconstruction. The scheme can effectively eliminate the influence caused by multipath effect in the environment, improves the signal to noise ratio, overcomes the interference caused by different intensity movements and realizes the accurate detection of respiratory heartbeat.

title_en: In-pipe robot positioning method and system suitable for non-excavation deep buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-pipe robot positioning method and system suitable for non-excavation deep buried pipelines, relates to the technical field of robot positioning, can be applied to the field of pipeline detection, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the existing in-pipe robot endurance and signal detection strength cannot be balanced, so that the applicability to different pipeline detection scenes is low. The method mainly comprises the steps that an in-pipe robot synchronously receives electromagnetic signals sent by an out-pipe auxiliary inspection robot through a transmitter array through a plurality of carried receivers, relative position coordinates of the in-pipe robot and the out-pipe auxiliary inspection robot are calculated according to receiving time of all the electromagnetic signals received by each receiver to obtain target relative position coordinates, in-pipe positioning coordinates are calculated according to each group of relative position coordinates, and weighted average calculation is conducted according to the in-pipe positioning coordinates and in-pipe positioning coordinates of a positioning sensor to obtain target in-pipe positioning coordinates. The method is mainly used for positioning the robot in the pipe.

title_en: Air breathing apparatus with safety alarm function
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치
abstract_ko: 호흡장치에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조) 대원 또는 스킨스쿠버 다이버들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치에 관한 것으로서, GPS 위성을 통해 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS모듈; 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서; 상기 호흡장치의 고압용기에 저장된 공기량 또는 산소량을 측정하는 잔량 감지부; 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량 또는 산소 잔량에 따라 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 압축 공기 또는 압축 산소의 압력을 조정하는 제1 및 제2 레귤레이터; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하여, 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 호흡장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for radar sensor-based personal recognition
title_ko: 레이더 센서 기반 개인 인식 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a personal recognition device and method based on a radar sensor, which use a radar sensor, which is a non-contact sensor, to measure a heartbeat signal, which is one of the biosignals, and recognize an individual based on the measured heartbeat signal. To achieve the purpose, according to the present invention, the personal recognition device based on a radar sensor comprises: a sensor unit which obtains an individual's biosignals in a non-contact manner; a feature extraction unit which extracts feature information from the obtained biosignals; and a personal recognition unit which recognizes an individual using the extracted feature information.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one
abstract_en: Receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one relates to life detection radar and rotor craft technical field. title_en: Coal mine underground disaster avoiding and self-rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colliery is calamity self-rescue device in pit of mine safety technical field, including refuge system and system of saving oneself, refuge system includes main storehouse and the supply storehouse that has the air purification system device, the supply storehouse is located the inner chamber lower part of main storehouse, the four corners fixedly connected with telescopic bracket of main storehouse, supply storehouse and main storehouse through among the system of saving refuge provide survival material and refuge place respectively, the small-size storehouse that can be in broken calamity scene through the motor-driven removal of water route amphibious running gear of recycling system of saving oneself shifts, and can search for and rescue the buried area through the ware of removing obstacles, the sensor group explores the place ahead of on-the-spot calamity, the device is not limited to the function of avoiding calamity, can also observe and transmit peripheral environment information; the small separation bin body is arranged, and the air purification burden is small when the air is switched on and off; the device has a plurality of independent bins, increases the survival probability, can search surrounding personnel and has rescue ability.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system utilizing solar energy
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy application, in particular to a forest fire prevention monitoring system using solar energy, which comprises a base, a pillar, an equipment cabin, a platform, a solar power generation panel, a telescopic rod, a storage battery, a controller, a signal transmitter, a storage battery and a smoke sensor; the base is buried, a pillar is arranged at the upper part of the base, an equipment cabin is arranged on the pillar, a platform is arranged on the equipment cabin, and a solar power generation panel is arranged on the platform; the storage battery and the signal transmitter are arranged in the equipment cabin, the storage battery is connected with the solar power generation panel, the signal transmitter is connected with the smoke sensor, and the smoke sensor is arranged at the bottom of the equipment cabin, so that the problem that the forest fire prevention modern sensor is difficult to use is solved.
assignees: YUNNAN YAOCHUANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a wearable device, and this wearable device is the loop configuration, is provided with on it: the system comprises at least two sensors, a signal processing unit and a signal processing unit, wherein the sensors are used for acquiring sign signals of a target user; the preprocessing module is used for obtaining at least two sign parameters with specified dimensionality according to the target user sign signal; the processing module is used for respectively matching at least two sign parameters with a preset threshold value on the designated dimension to obtain a characteristic value of the designated dimension; the processing module is further configured to perform operation based on at least two of the characterization values to obtain a sign state evaluation value of the target user; the display module is used for displaying the vital sign interface; and the vital sign interface displays the evaluation value of the state of the vital sign. The problem that the user cannot visually know the physical sign state of the user due to the fact that the user basic data are simply fed back by the current wearable intelligent device is solved.

title_en: Emergency window breaking device for automobile safety protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an urgent broken window device of car safety protection belongs to emergent escape apparatus technical field, an urgent broken window device of car safety protection include control processing module, alarm module, fire alarm module, vital sign alarm module, button module, communication module, speech synthesis module, broken window device in danger. The automatic window breaking is realized through the matching of the sensors of the alarm modules and the control processing module, the manual window breaking is realized through the button module, and the window breaking device is driven to act by the communication module and the rear-end equipment through three means of realizing remote window breaking, so that the personal safety of personnel in the vehicle is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: A kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane, including earth station and unmanned plane two parts, the earth station includes control computer, model generates interface, control interface, the base station UWBLOC and data transmission module, the unmanned plane includes drone body, flight control system, signal transmission device, indoor positioning module, data processing module, gas detection module, camera, fire behavior acquisition module and life detection module, fire behavior size and spatial distribution and variation tendency are judged by setting fire behavior acquisition module, life detection module is set simultaneously and detects the life entity to live, gas-detecting device is set again to judge the concentration of pernicious gas, and these detection results are generated interface display in model to come out for fireman's reference, the present invention can carry out scene of fire effectively and comprehensive Information is collected, and is referred to for fireman, is helped fireman to formulate rescue strategies, is reduced the difficulty and risk of rescue.
assignees: GUANGDONG RONGQE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning and protection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake disaster early warning and protection system which comprises a set of distributed earth-crust vibration monitoring sensor subsystem, a set of distributed data link radio station transmission subsystem, a set of family early warning terminal subsystem and a set of safety protection subsystem. The system utilizes the characteristics of low transmission speed and high transmission speed of electromagnetic waves of earthquake waves to early warn earthquake information for people additionally provided with the system, and provides a reliable earthquake disaster avoiding space for the people additionally provided with the system, the space can not only protect personnel in the house from being injured when the house collapses, but also provide necessary living conditions for the people, so that the people deeply buried underground can safely survive for 1 month, and sufficient rescue time is provided for rescue personnel. The system is suitable for residents nearby earthquake zones, is particularly suitable for large cities with high population density and people living in high buildings, can effectively protect the coming time of high-grade earthquakes, and ensures that people additionally provided with the system are not threatened by life safety.
assignees: SHENZHEN RONGLI AVIATION IND CO LTD;WANG ZHONGQIN

title_en: Double-triaxial electromagnetic detection and route positioning method for submarine cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-triaxial electromagnetic detection and submarine cable routing positioning algorithm for a submarine electrified cable, wherein the submarine cable routing relative positioning algorithm comprises a magnetic deviation positioning algorithm, a transverse deviation positioning algorithm and a vertical deviation positioning algorithm, six real-time electromagnetic signals and sensor attitude angle signals provided for two orthogonal triaxial electromagnetic detection sensors are input into the algorithm, and the algorithm outputs submarine cable routing angles, submarine cable routing point transverse deviation, submarine cable routing point vertical deviation and submarine cable routing point burial depth. The submarine cable routing absolute positioning algorithm comprises a submarine cable buried depth positioning algorithm, a submarine cable routing angle positioning algorithm and a submarine cable routing point absolute positioning algorithm, wherein the algorithm inputs are output of the submarine cable routing relative positioning algorithm, a real-time base height signal fed back by an altimeter, and a course angle and an absolute position (namely a longitude/latitude signal of a detection platform body) of a detection sensor under a geodetic coordinate system; the algorithm output is the absolute position of the submarine cable routing point (i.e., the longitude/latitude of the submarine cable routing point).

title_en: Test device for performance evaluation under action of dislocation load of buried pressurizing pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for performance evaluation under the action of a dislocation load of a buried pressurizing pipeline, which comprises a bracket, a separable box body, a pipeline, a loading assembly, an angle adjusting assembly, a pressurizing assembly and a data acquisition assembly, wherein the detachable box body is provided with a loading hole; the separable box body comprises a fixed end box body and a sliding end box body, the lower part of the bracket is fixed on the rigid floor, and the upper part of the bracket is fixedly connected with the fixed end box body of the separable box body; two ends of the pipeline are respectively and fixedly connected with two ends of the separable box body; the end part of the pipeline is connected with a pressurizing assembly, and the loading assembly is connected with a sliding end box body of the separable box body and is used for realizing axial and oblique dislocation loading of the box body; the data acquisition assembly comprises a pressure sensor, a DIC, an electromagnetic flowmeter, a dynamic acquisition instrument, a computer terminal and the like. The invention can realize accurate and convenient measurement of the three-dimensional space behavior of the pipeline under the action of the earthquake.

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign detection device and a method, wherein the vital sign detection device comprises: the equipment belt is internally provided with a direct current power supply; the radar mechanism comprises a shell, a support and a breathing radar, wherein the shell is fixed on the equipment belt, the support is fixed in the shell, the support is provided with an inclined plane which forms an included angle with the surface of the shell, the breathing radar is installed on the inclined plane of the support, and the direct-current power supply is electrically connected with the breathing radar; the vital sign detection device is embedded in the equipment belt, no extra construction stay wire is needed, and the vital sign detection device is powered by a direct-current power supply in the equipment belt; the structure of the vital sign detection device is inclined by a certain angle, so that the vital sign detection device effectively covers the whole sickbed and detects the vital sign condition of a patient in real time.
assignees: YIANDAI HEALTHY TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method for processing ultra-wideband UWB (ultra Wide band) vital signals
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for processing ultra-wideband UWB (ultra-wideband UWB) vital signals, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of echo signals corresponding to ultra-wideband UWB life signals to obtain a first echo signal matrix consisting of the echo signals, obtaining a second echo signal matrix after clutter preprocessing is carried out on the first echo signal matrix, carrying out singular value decomposition to obtain a plurality of singular values corresponding to the second echo signal matrix, screening the singular values and important items to obtain a plurality of main singular values, generating a third echo signal matrix corresponding to the main singular values, carrying out signal decomposition to obtain an inherent modal component matrix corresponding to the third echo signal matrix, and reconstructing a target ultra-wideband UWB life signal according to the inherent modal component matrix.

title_en: Vital sign detection method under ultra-wideband radar shielding environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new generation information, in particular to a vital sign detection method under an ultra-wideband radar shielding environment. Collecting echo signal data to construct an echo signal matrix; performing clutter removal pretreatment on the echo signal matrix, and performing singular value decomposition on the pretreated echo signal matrix to obtain a reconstruction signal; one-dimensional expansion is carried out on the reconstructed signal; obtaining an optimal bandwidth threshold value for empirical mode decomposition of a reconstructed signal and B spline orders to decompose the reconstructed signal which is one-dimensionally unfolded, so as to obtain a plurality of signal components; transforming each signal component into a frequency domain, and respectively calculating the frequency duty ratio of the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal in each signal component; acquiring a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal; and detecting vital signs according to the obtained respiratory signals and heartbeat signals. According to the method, the radar echo data are subjected to a series of processing, so that clutter in the data can be effectively removed, and the accuracy of identifying vital signs is improved.

title_en: OFDM-based radar communication integrated signal vital sign signal detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting vital sign signals of radar communication integrated signals based on OFDM. Belonging to the technical field of radar communication integration. According to the method, the micro-motion characteristic information of the human chest cavity carried in the echo is utilized more comprehensively, in the aspect of accurate signal extraction, the sensitive sub-carrier is screened by calculating the slow time variance of the sub-carrier, the signal corresponding to weak motion of the chest cavity is accurately captured, the separation precision of respiratory and heartbeat signals is greatly improved, the high-frequency noise is suppressed by combining wavelet transformation soft threshold denoising, effective low frequency is reserved, and the VMD decomposition nonstationary signal is taken as a modal function, so that the signal quality is optimized in all directions, and the vital sign monitoring is more accurate. The intelligent safety system has the advantages that the application advantages of the intelligent safety system in the cross-field are obvious, the safety of personnel in the vehicle is guaranteed in unmanned operation, the body of dangerous personnel is abnormal in the intelligent safety system in a long-distance insight, and the remote accurate diagnosis of assistance and medical care during remote medical treatment is really realized, so that the requirements of multiple fields are met.

title_en: Smart Mattress
abstract_en: To provide a smart mattress which can solve conventional technical problems that require contact measurement, instant monitoring, and long-time monitoring, when measuring biological data of a human body.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a smart mattress which is useful for performing a measurement or instant monitoring of long-term biological data of a user to establish an accurate care mode by: measuring biological data of a human body mainly using a non-contact sensor; tracing a rapid-eye-movement phase of a user through a detection method of measuring vital signs remotely; monitoring cardiac beat; sensing biological information such as respiration; detecting and recording biological information on getting up and sleeping posture and the like of the user; pairing and connecting a mobile device and computer via a control box; and then outputting and displaying, or uploading and storing, in a cloud database, all the acquiring information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Untact sleep apnea detection system
title_ko: 언택트 수면 무호흡 감지 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an untact sleep apnea detection system comprises: a non-contact respiration measurement sensor installed in a lower portion of a bed to detect respiration of a user; and a respiration determination unit classifying measurement data of the non-contact respiration measurement sensor into respiration, apnea, and movement by using a pre-learned deep learning model.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 언택트 수면 무호흡 감지 시스템은 침대 하부에 설치되어 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 비접촉 호흡측정센서와, 비접촉 호흡측정센서의 측정 데이터를 미리 학습된 딥러닝 모델을 이용하여 호흡, 무호흡, 움직임으로 분류하는 호흡 판별부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Non-contact respiration monitoring method based on doppler radar
abstract_en: A non-contact respiration monitoring method based on a Doppler radar. The method comprises: pre-processing a radar echo signal; extracting, from the radar echo signal, the position where the thorax of a monitored object is located; extracting motion information of the position where the thorax of the monitored object is located; extracting a respiration waveform component from the motion information of the thorax of the monitored object; and obtaining a respiration frequency of the monitored object on the basis of a corresponding spectrum estimation of the respiration waveform. The method for monitoring the thorax of an object has a higher positioning precision, and is a basis for accurately extracting a thoracic motion signal. A respiration signal is separated from a heartbeat signal by means of an improved CEEMD algorithm, such that a good separation effect is achieved on body motion interference, background noise and a vital sign signal, and the problem of an end effect in an original CEEMD algorithm is effectively ameliorated by means of an improvement, thereby increasing the decomposition speed.
assignees: NANJING ZHELI INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Targeting abnormal cell populations for apoptosis
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range abnormal cells including senescent and cancerous cells are targeted for apoptosis. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of a senolytic and chemotherapeutic. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: Radar detection of buried objects
abstract_en: An apparatus for detecting objects includes a transceiver configured to generate a radar signal, a transmit antenna coupled to the transceiver and configured to emit the radar signal, the radar signal comprising a first circular polarization, and a receive antenna coupled to the transceiver and configured to receive a return signal, the return signal comprising the first circular polarization.

title_en: Life signal synchronous measurement system and measurement method for biological radar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal synchronous measurement system and a measurement method for biological radar detection, and belongs to the technical field of biological radar and life signal measurement. The touch sensor group control system comprises a plurality of touch sensor groups and a control display end; each contact sensor group comprises a piezoelectric respiration sensor and a photosensitive pulse sensor; the control display end comprises a computer and a Bluetooth router, and the contact sensor group is communicated with the computer through the Bluetooth router; the computer is in communication with the biological radar system and is used for monitoring the working state of the biological radar system. A third-party software monitor is established by using a Hook technology in a Windows message mechanism, namely, a Hook is used for capturing event messages of starting/stopping measurement of the software of the biological radar system, and when the events of starting/stopping data storage of the biological radar are monitored, a synchronous measurement system is immediately triggered to start/stop data storage, so that the time synchronization of the data collected by the biological radar system and the data collected by the biological radar system is realized.

title_en: Multichannel error self-correction method for impulse type through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel error self-correction method for impulse type through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: detecting the position of the direct coupling wave in each channel; step S2: determining a reference channel and a reference moment in the reference channel; step S3: calculating the delay error of each channel; step S4: adaptively compensating the error obtained in the step S3 by a zero padding or cutting-off method; step S5: and performing consistency error compensation on all channels to compensate the propagation error of the direct coupling wave. The invention has the advantages of improving the debugging efficiency, being wide in application range and the like.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which belongs to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and comprises the steps of firstly processing echo data into a radar three-dimensional data matrix, executing FFT (fast Fourier transform) on each line of each channel data along a fast time dimension, and performing MVDR (mechanical vapor digital radiography) on data corresponding to Range-FFT points to obtain a data matrix containing distance angle information and a distance-angle diagram; and after preprocessing the distance-angle diagram, extracting connected domains by a connected domain analysis method, wherein the mass center of each connected domain is the target position, further extracting a corresponding phase sequence from a data matrix, and after phase unwrapping processing, first-order phase difference and band-pass filtering, realizing separation of a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, and respectively carrying out FFT processing and estimation to obtain a final monitoring result. According to the method, the number of the detected multi-person targets is not required to be known, the multi-targets at the same distance or the same angle can be distinguished, and vital sign estimation under the scene of the same distance is realized.

title_en: Multi -functional mine search and rescue robot based on zigBee technique
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi -functional mine search and rescue robot based on zigBee technique. The search and rescue efficiency that the robot was searched for andd rescue to the mine is significant. The utility model discloses a zigBee wireless transmission module is located the automobile body, the zigBee wireless transmission module of a plurality of automobile bodies passes through zigBee wireless sensor network system implementation location and network deployment, microprocessor control zigBee wireless transmission module, environment detection sensor system and vital sign detection system, environmental parameter in the environment detection sensor systematic survey mine, vital sign detection system surveys stranded personnel, the motion of driving system control automobile body, the power is driving system, microprocessor, vital sign detection system, zigBee wireless transmission module and environment detection sensor mains power supply. The utility model discloses build control core to supporting environment detection sensor system and vital sign detection system have reduced the search and rescue time, have improved search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Anti-irradiation multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-irradiation multifunctional life detector, wherein automatic leveling devices are arranged at four corners of the outer side of a radar box; a level bubble is fixed on the top surface of the radar box; a common handle switch is arranged between the two automatic leveling devices positioned on the same side of the radar box; the automatic leveling device comprises an outer sleeve and an inner sleeve, the outer sleeve is fixed on the radar box, and the inner sleeve is arranged inside the outer sleeve in a sliding manner; the inner wall of the outer sleeve is fixed with a downward inclined agnail scale; the outer wall of the inner sleeve is provided with a positive thorn scale which inclines upwards. The utility model can work on the ground which is approximately horizontal, and also can work on the rugged rubble, thereby ensuring the maximum range of the radar during one-time detection, reducing the detection times of the same place and saving the detection time. The structure is simple, no additional power source is needed, and the trouble of power connection is avoided during outdoor operation; convenient to use, swift, very big operating time that has saved makes the rescue more quick.
assignees: SHANDONG YINLING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of amphibious ship shape searching machine people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of amphibious ship shape searching machine people, detect liquid level information by level sensor and be sent to controller, then judging amphibious ship shape searching machine people's local environment by controller；If residing environment is land, then wheel work, propeller II does not works and passes through in expansion link II indentation hollow out nacelle, and amphibious ship shape searching machine people utilizes life-detection instrument and photographic head to start to search for trapped personnel；If residing environment is the water surface, then wheel quits work, and propeller I and propeller II all works.Propeller I rotates in atmosphere, filling channel and aerator is utilized to be full of air cushion by air, amphibious ship shape searching machine people is provided the buoyancy in water, propeller II stretches out hollow out nacelle through expansion link II and rotates in water simultaneously, the propulsive force that amphibious ship shape searching machine people travels at the water surface is provided, searches for trapped personnel also with life-detection instrument and photographic head.

title_en: Human presence detector and human presence detection method
abstract_en: A human body detector comprising a microwave generator (10), a microwave receiver (20), a mixer detector (30) and a signal processor (40), wherein the microwave generator (10) is arranged to emit probe microwaves for propagation in a probe space, wherein the microwave receiver (20) is arranged to receive respective echoes of the probe microwaves, wherein the mixer detector (30) is connected to the microwave generator (10) and the microwave receiver (20) and arranged to perform mixer detection of the probe microwaves and the respective echoes to output respective primary detection wave signals, wherein the signal processor (40) is connected to the mixer detector (30) and arranged to select and amplify the primary detection wave signals output by the mixer detector (30) to output secondary detection wave signals of a specific fluctuation frequency range, the response signal of the human body detector to the motion of which the motion frequency is in the specific frequency range is amplified, so that the presence of the human body can be judged in response to the motion of the specific frequency range.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for detecting living body in cabin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting a living body in a cabin. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current original data frame acquired by a millimeter wave radar, and determining current output data; determining the action amplitude detection result of the target object in the cockpit according to the current output data; and determining the vital sign of the target object according to the action amplitude detection result. By the method, data acquired by the millimeter wave radar are analyzed, the action amplitude detection result of the target object in the cabin is determined, the vital sign of the target object is determined according to the result, and detection of the living body in the cabin is achieved. The target objects with different action amplitudes in the cockpit can be accurately detected, the existence of the target object with vital signs is accurately judged, and the probability of missing report is effectively reduced. The living body in the cockpit is quickly and successfully sensed, and the relevant information of the living body target can be obtained.
assignees: HUIZHOU DESAY SV INTELLIGENT TRANSP TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multimode fusion living body vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of living body vital sign detection, and provides a multimode-fused living body vital sign detection system and method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises a signal acquisition module, a data alignment module, a position acquisition module and a vital sign calculation module. According to the invention, the signal detection device provided with the infrared imaging unit and the millimeter wave radar detection unit is arranged in the target scene, the primary position of the human body is positioned through the infrared detection image acquired by the infrared imaging unit, then the millimeter wave radar is driven to rotate to point to the direction corresponding to the primary position of the human body to execute accurate detection, and finally the accurate position and vital sign of the human body are generated based on the millimeter wave radar detection data acquired by the accurate detection, so that the problem that the traditional vital sign detection system cannot acquire the accurate position of the human body is solved.
assignees: SICHUAN YICHUANG KANGHUA HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underslung unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic vertical vector measurement system for detecting humanoid magnetic source object in emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a down-hanging unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic vertical vector measurement system for detecting a humanoid magnetic source object in emergency rescue, the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform module, a magnetic probe rod and driving module, a sensor module, a data acquisition processing module, a data transmission module and a ground terminal module. The invention has the beneficial effects that the probe of the high-sensitivity light pump atomic vector magnetometer is hung below the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting the actively telescopic magnetic probe rod, the probe can be lowered to the ground-near height for work, and the detection sensitivity of the shallow weak magnetic target is improved. Through the airborne computing platform based on the ROS, magnetometer data, unmanned aerial vehicle RTK positioning data and attitude data are synchronously acquired, and high-precision time alignment and fusion processing are carried out. The ground terminal provides various visual displays such as a real-time magnetic anomaly contour map, a magnetic anomaly profile map and the like. The technical problems that an existing unmanned aerial vehicle magnetic measurement system is insufficient in detection sensitivity of a shallow-buried small-scale humanoid magnetic source target, poor in low-altitude operation safety and insufficient in multi-source data fusion processing are solved.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RESEARCH INST OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Contactless sensor circuit
title_ko: 비접촉식 센서 회로
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A contactless sensor circuit is provided to be applicable for a bio and electric signal measurement process by measuring voltage signals from voltage signal source without electrical and physical contact. CONSTITUTION: A measuring electrode is capacitively coupled with a target(102). A coupling electric-condenser(112) is in serial connection with the measuring electrode. A first amplifier(106) includes a first negative inputting terminal(106b) and a first positive inputting terminal(106a). The first positive inputting terminal is in connection with the coupling electric-condenser. The first amplifier includes self inputted resistance(Ri) and self electrostatic capacitance. A bias circuit part secures the stable operation of the first amplifier.
