title_en: Sensor Fusion Framework Using Multiple Sensors to Assess Buried Structures
abstract_en: A method of surveying the condition of an underground conduit by positioning a propelled carriage assembly within the underground conduit. The carriage assembly includes (i) at least one transmitter/receiver unit capable of transmitting a pulsed signal toward at least a portion of an inner wall of the conduit, and (ii) a secondary sensor positioned on the carriage assembly. The data derived from the pulsed signal at a given lateral location within an underground conduit is read as is a secondary sensor condition derived from secondary sensor data taken at the given lateral location. Then it is determined whether the secondary sensor condition indicates a basis for a false void detection by the data derived from the pulsed signal and if the basis for false void detection exists, providing an indication of such basis.

title_en: Hybrid fmcw-intererometry radar for positioning and monitoring and methods of using the same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for a hybrid radar system that integrates frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) mode and interferometry mode. The radar works as a time division system that continuously switches between the FMCW mode and interferometry mode. The FMCW mode is responsible for absolute range detection and the interferometry mode takes cares of the weak physiological movement monitoring. The respective accuracies in range detection and displacement measurement complements the advantages of the two radar modes, providing versatile performance. By steering the antenna beam, the proposed radar system becomes an ideal solution for indoor health care, human localization, and human-computer interaction. Objects or human targets with or without stationary clutters can be precisely located. At the same time, the targets' vital signs and gestures can be monitored.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring via remote sensing on stationary exercise equipment
abstract_en: Vital sign monitoring via remote sensing on stationary exercise equipment is provided. A new non-contact approach described herein uses radio frequency (RF) radar (e.g., ultra-wide band (UWB) radar) to remotely monitor vital sign information (such as heartbeat and breathing) and human activity information of subjects using stationary exercise equipment. In some embodiments, a radar sensor captures micro-scale chest motions (corresponding to the vital sign information) as well as macro-scale body motions (corresponding to movements from exercise). A signal processor receives radar signals from the radar sensor and processes the radar signals to reconstruct vital sign information from the micro-scale chest motions and/or human activity information from the macro-scale body motions using a joint vital sign-motion model, which can be trained using machine learning and other approaches.

title_en: Radar identification of persons via vital signs
abstract_en: A radar apparatus comprises: a processor; a radar; and a non-transitory memory storing instructions that, when executed by the processor, configure the apparatus to perform a method. The method comprises: emitting a radar signal with the radar; receiving backscattered radar signals with the radar; extracting reflection data from the backscattered radar signal; determining at least one vital sign of at least one person from the extracted reflection data; and identifying the at least one person by using a first machine learning model to provide a similarity score between the determined at least one vital sign and at least one vital sign from previously collected vital signs of the at least one person.

title_en: Patient monitoring and surveillance system, methods, and devices
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods, devices and systems for the remote monitoring and/or surveillance of a patient's location, position, movement, vital signs, biopotentials, or a combination thereof using transmission of stepped-frequency radar signals, detecting reflections of the transmitted signals and processing the frequency and phase shifts.
assignees: LIFEFLOW TECHNOLOGIES INC;BROWN DAVID;NORDIN DAVID;TERAN MANUEL

title_en: Memory-based, real time feedback system using the processing of several pieces of bio-information into unified communication frames
title_ko: 메모리 기반 다중 생체정보의 통신 프레임 단일화 처리를 통한 실시간 피드백시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a memory-based, real time feedback system using the processing of several pieces of bio-information into unified communication frames, wherein the system is installed in a home or public facility, for detecting bio-signals emitted by a user, analyzing the bio-signals and providing various information to enable the user to autonomously manage the user's health, checking the condition of the user's body in real time so as to determine whether an emergency situation arises and allow a course of action to be taken that is required for said emergency situation. The real time feedback system comprises a bio-signal measuring terminal and a health management apparatus. The bio-signal measuring terminal comprises: a plurality of bio-signal detection sensors for detecting bio-signals of a user; and frame generating means for consolidating information on the bio-signals into one data frame, generating body information data from the data frame, and transmitting the body information data. The health management apparatus comprises: a receiving unit for receiving body information data from the bio-signal measuring terminal; data categorizing means for categorizing body information from the body information data received by the receiving unit; storage means for storing the body information; data analysis means for analyzing the body information stored in the storage means, when input or set analysis conditions for a user analysis request signal are satisfied; and a control unit including control means for receiving an input signal from an input unit and controlling the operation of the data analysis means, and for receiving the analysis results of the data analysis means and transmitting the analysis results via an output unit to an output terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일반 가정 또는 공공장소 등에 설치되어 사용자가 발산하는 생체신호를 감지하고 이를 분석해서 상기 사용자가 자발적으로 건강관리를 하기 위한 다양한 정보를 제공하고, 사용자의 몸 상태를 실시간으로 확인해서 응급상황 여부까지 판단해 처리할 수 있도록 한 메모리 기반 다중 생체정보의 통신 프레임 단일화 처리를 통한 실시간 피드백시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 다수의 셍체신호 감지센서와; 상기 생체신호에 대한 정보를 하나의 데이터 프레임으로 통합해 신체정보데이터로 생성해서 발신하는 프레임생성수단;이 구비된 생체신호 측정단말기, 생체신호 측정단말기로부터 신체정보데이터를 수신하는 수신부와; 수신부의 신체정보데이터로부터 신체정보를 분류하는 데이터분류수단과, 상기 신체정보를 저장하는 저장수단과, 사용자분석요청신호의 입력 또는 설정된 분석조건이 만족되면 저장수단에 저장된 신체정보를 분석하는 데이터분석수단과, 입력부의 입력신호를 수신해서 데이터분석수단의 동작을 제어하고 데이터분석수단의 분석결과를 받아 출력부를 통해 출력단말기로 전송하는 제어수단이 구비된 제어부;가 구비된 건강관리장치를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY;SON JAE GI;PARK CHANG WON;CHUNG HA JOONG;JEON KI MAN;KIM YOUNG HWAN;KIM HYUN WOO

title_en: UVB based multi-channel radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UVB based multi-channel radar life detection instrument for multi-target detection, which comprises a front end of a UWB biologic radar and a computing unit. The front end of the UWB biologic radar comprises a transmitting antenna, three receiving antennas, an impulse oscillator, an electromagnetic pulse generator and a sampling integrator. The transmitting antenna and each receiving antenna form a channel and therefore three channels are formed. The computing unit analyses and processes the collected three radar echo signals and finally extracts life information of multiple human body targets and the two dimensional position information of each target.

title_en: Out-of-plane stiffness variable metal damper with earthquake monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to an out-of-plane stiffness variable metal damper with an earthquake monitoring function. The invention comprises an energy consumption metal plate, a friction plate, a first box type long support, a second box type long support, a box type short support, a sensor, a high-strength bolt, a nut, a gasket, a pre-buried connecting steel plate, a connecting bending-resistant steel plate, a threaded bolt hole, an anchoring piece, a shearing-resistant bolt, a bending-resistant bolt and pre-buried I-shaped steel. The damper is arranged in a structural member, does not bear the initial gravity load of the structure, can provide out-of-plane rigidity for the energy-consuming metal plate, detects the damage condition of the damper by using a sensor when the damper is subjected to vibration load, is convenient to replace by adopting full-bolt connection, and improves the overall performance of the damper by adopting bending-shearing separation control of a damper support and an embedded member.

title_en: High-resolution imaging method of forgetful through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution imaging method of a wall-penetrating radar with less forgetting. The method comprises the specific steps of training an optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network of a source domain to enable the optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network to recover the shape of a source domain target and take the optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network as a pre-training network, loading a pre-training model to initialize corresponding partial parameters of a target domain network LFHRNet with a multi-branch structure, training the target domain network on a target domain data set, learning a new knowledge of the target domain when one branch is trained, freezing the other branch to keep the source domain knowledge, and introducing a routing network to carry out accurate expert allocation. The invention effectively reduces forgetting of source domain knowledge, and enables the network to have the capability of high-resolution imaging of static targets in the source domain and the target domain.

title_en: Stress and tension measuring apparatus with mouse pad and brain therapy system thereby
title_ko: 마우스패드를 이용한 심리상태와 신체의 긴장도 측정 및이를 활용한 두뇌 스트레칭 훈련시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마우스패드(mouse pad)에 GSR(Galvanic Skin Response)센서를 부착시켜 심리상태 및 신체의 긴장도를 측정하고 분석하여 스트레스 완화를 위한 훈련프로그램을 실행시키는 마우스패드를 이용한 심리상태와 신체의 긴장도 측정 및 이를 활용한 두뇌 스트레칭 훈련시스템에 관한 것으로,  
     2개의 GSR센서가 부착되며, 전기신호변환부와 디지털신호변환부 및 측정된 생체신호를 PC로 전송하기 위한 통신부를 포함하는 인체측정모듈; 및 상기 인체측정모듈로부터 측정된 생체신호 데이터를 전송받기 위한 통신부, 측정된 생체신호와 비교할 수 있는 기준 데이터 및 훈련 프로그램이 저장된 데이터베이스, 측정된 생체신호와 기준 데이터를 비교 분석하는 측정데이터처리부, 비교 분석 결과로 신체상태를 판단하는 신체상태분석부 및 상기 신체상태분석부의 판단 결과에 따라 훈련 프로그램을 실행시키는 효과연출부를 포함하여 구성되는 PC시스템; 및 인체측정모듈과 일체로 형성된 마우스패드를 포함하는 것을 구성적 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Biosignal interface device and method of operation of biosignal interface device
title_ko: 생체신호 인터페이스 장치 및 생체신호 인터페이스 장치의 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 생체신호 인터페이스 장치 및 생체신호 인터페이스 장치의 동작 방법을 제공한다.  일실시예에 따른 생체신호 인터페이스 장치는, 일반적으로 손목보다 팔뚝/팔꿈치쪽으로, 아래팔의 두께가 두꺼워지는 것을 이용하여, 센서부가 아래팔의 어떤 부위에 위치해 있는지 대략적으로 예측 함으로써, 인식할 수 있는 제스처의 개수 등의 모드를 변환하고 있다.

title_en: workers healthcare system using biological signals based safety menagement woking clothes
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템은 생체신호용 센서 및 모듈이 내장된 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)과; 상기 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)으로부터 사용자의 생체신호를 전달받아 분석하여 사용자의 패턴을 판단할 수 있는 데이터로 변환하는 서버(200)와; 상기 서버(200)에서 제공받은 데이터를 통해 건강상태를 모니터링 할 수 있도록 화면에 출력하는 출력장치; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Connector suppling of electric power
title_ko: 지중배전라인 분기가 가능한 안전성 향상 연결 커넥터
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connector with improved safety, capable of branching an underground distribution line, which comprises: a case (10) for forming an appearance; a clamp (20) buried in the case (10); a connection pipe (30) pressed and fixed by the clamp (20), and electrically connecting and fixing an underground distribution line (L) inserted into the case (10); a filling material (40) injected into the case (10) to be integrally formed with the case (10), the clamp (20), the connection pipe (30), and the underground distribution line (L); a fixed plate (50) fixed to the bottom; a lifting stand (60) movably installed on an upper surface of the fixed plate (50), and having the case (10) buried to be vertically moved; a sensor (70) for sensing the underground distribution line (L) fixed to the case (10) to output a sensing signal; a control unit (80) for receiving the sensing signal from the sensor (70), and outputting a submersion warning signal; and a transmitting device (90) for receiving a the submersion warning signal from the control unit (80), and transmitting the same to the outside. According to the present embodiment, the underground distribution line can be easily branched, and the impact applied to a connection part of the underground distribution line can be minimized to prevent damage thereby, by offsetting the force while the lifting stand moves along the upper surface of the fixed plate in a direction that external force is applied when the external force is applied to the underground distribution line.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중배전라인 분기가 가능한 안전성 향상 연결 커넥터에 관한 것으로서, 외관을 이루는 케이스(10)와; 케이스(10)에 내설되는 클램프(20)와; 클램프(20)에 의해 가압고정되며 케이스(10)의 내측으로 인입된 지중배전선(L)을 전기적으로 상호 연결 및 고정시키는 연결관(30)과; 케이스(10)에 주입되어 케이스(10)와 클램프(20), 연결관(30) 및 지중배전선(L)과 일체형을 이루는 충진재(40)와; 바닥에 고정되는 고정판(50)과; 고정판(50)의 상면에 이동가능하게 설치되며 케이스(10)가 상하이동가능하게 내설되는 승강대(60)와; 케이스(10)에 고정된 지중배전선(L)을 감지하여 감지신호를 출력하는 감지센서(70)와; 감지센서(70)로부터 감지신호를 전달받아 침수경고신호를 출력하는 제어부(80)와; 제어부(80)로부터 침수경고신호를 전달받아 외부로 송신하는 송신기(90);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면, 지중배전선을 손쉽게 분기할 수 있고, 특히 지중배전선에 외력이 작용하게 될 경우 외력이 작용하는 방향으로 고정판의 상면을 따라 승강대가 이동하면서 힘을 상쇄시켜 줌으로 지중배전선의 연결부위에 가해지는 충격을 최소화할 수 있어 이에 따른 손상을 방지할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Precise infrastructure mapping using full-waveform inversion of ground penetrating radar signals
abstract_en: A new system and method for FWI of common-offset GPR data, particularly targeting the dimensions and infilling material of buried objects. The method is useful in situations where clear isolated diffraction hyperbolas indicate the presence of an underground object, but the object's dimensions and filling may be unknown. The present invention acquires GPR data and applies advanced numerical methods to get the depth and size of the underground object in a very accurate manner. An embodiment of the invention includes five main steps: GPR data processing, ray-based analysis to set a good initial model, 3D to 2D transformation of data, effective SW estimation, and FWI.

title_en: Direction-sensitive radiation detector and radiation detection method
abstract_en: A radiation detection system and method suitable for use by a first responder to detect a radiological source. The system includes a container that encloses a chamber containing a pressurized inert gas. Incident gamma rays pass through walls of the container to interact with inert gas atoms within the chamber. Wavelength-shifting fiber elements are disposed within scintillator bars oriented parallel to and radially spaced from the chamber axis. At least one sensor is interconnected with the fiber elements to receive first signals therefrom in response to the scattered gamma rays. An electrically-charged wire is disposed within the container along the axis thereof. The wire is adapted to attract electrons released from atoms of the inert gas that are ionized from being impacted by an incident gamma ray, and then produce second signals in response to the released electrons. Electronic circuitry collects the first and second signals, and a processor acquires and analyzes the first and second signals to produce an output based thereon.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar Signal optimum processing method and device
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar Signal optimum processing method and device, and it includes: that S1. uses through-wall radar to carry out target detection to region to be measured that the method comprising the steps of, receives the multi-channel back wave signal in corresponding multiple apertures；S2. the aperture numeric field data for obtaining different pore size respectively from multi-channel back wave signal constitutes multiple sub-aperture data groups, compare weighted imaging as a result, obtaining the imaging data signals after optimization processing by similar portion in each weighted imaging result after the corresponding full aperture data of multi-channel back wave signal and each sub-aperture data group are weighted imaging respectively；The device includes radar detected module, Signal optimum processing module；The present invention have many advantages, such as implementation method it is simple, it is at low cost, can be realized real time signal processing simultaneously clutter reduction, and optimize performance it is good, high-efficient.

title_en: For measuring the device and system of life signal
abstract_en: It discloses a kind of for measuring the device and system of life signal.The system includes: the millimetre-wave radar sensor of setting on circuit boards；Mutiple antennas is coupled to millimetre-wave radar sensor and is arranged on circuit boards；And processing circuit, it is coupled to millimetre-wave radar sensor and is arranged on circuit boards.The processing circuit is configured to determine life signal information based on the output from millimetre-wave radar sensor.

title_en: System and method for subject monitoring
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for collecting and analyzing vital sign information to predict the likelihood of a subject having a disease or disorder. In one aspect, a system for monitoring a subject may comprise: a sensor comprising an Electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor configured to acquire health data comprising vital sign measurements of a subject over a period of time; and a mobile electronic device, the mobile electronic device comprising: an electronic display; a wireless transceiver; and one or more computer processors configured to (i) receive health data from a sensor via a wireless transceiver, (ii) process the health data using a trained algorithm to generate an output indicative of the progression or regression of the subject's health condition over the time period with a sensitivity of at least about 80%, and (iii) provide the output on the electronic display for display to the subject.

title_en: Telescopic distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses telescopic distributed radar life detection positioning equipment which comprises more than two radar units, wherein two adjacent radar units are connected through a telescopic mechanism, and the telescopic mechanism is used for enlarging or reducing the distance between the two adjacent radar units. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, simple and convenient operation, wide application range, capability of realizing multi-mode detection and the like.

title_en: Radar-based respiration and heartbeat signal detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting respiration and heartbeat signals based on a radar. The method comprises the following steps: a, judging whether a target exists or not based on a transmitting signal and a receiving signal; b, processing the mixed vital sign signal of the target as follows: b1, carrying out high-pass filtering and FFT (fast Fourier transform) on the mixed vital sign signal to obtain first spectrum data; b2, if the frequency corresponding to the maximum amplitude value point is in the respiratory frequency range and an amplitude maximum value point exists at the Q frequency doubling position and/or near the Q frequency doubling position of the frequency, taking the frequency as the respiratory main frequency; b3, decomposing the mixed vital sign signals of the target based on empirical wavelet transform; and B4, if the maximum frequency of the third component or the fourth component is within the preset heartbeat frequency range, taking the maximum frequency as the heartbeat main frequency. Based on empirical wavelet transform, breath and heartbeat signals are separated in a self-adaptive mode, the frequency of the breath and heartbeat signals is extracted accurately, and the breath and heartbeat frequencies of a plurality of people can be extracted and separated simultaneously for a broadband/ultra-wideband radar.

title_en: Respiration and heartbeat monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar and lightweight neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiratory heartbeat monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar and a lightweight neural network. The radar vital signal extraction module is used for preprocessing the radar echo original signal, filtering clutter interference and accurately extracting a radar vital signal containing the vital sign of the detected human body; the vital sign separation module is used for realizing the quick and effective separation of the vital sign respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal by adopting an LMS self-adaptive algorithm; the breath heartbeat classification module is used for training a lightweight neural network MobileNetV2 network and respectively extracting and classifying the characteristics of the normal/abnormal breath signals and the normal/abnormal heartbeat signals; and the breath heartbeat monitoring module is used for monitoring whether the breath heartbeat of the detected human body is abnormal or not in real time.

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar not only detecting the position of a buried object but also discriminating whether the underground buried object is a metal object or a nonmetal object, when examining a buried state prior to an underground drilling work.  <P>SOLUTION: This underground radar 1 includes an electromagnetic wave transmission part 4 for transmitting an electromagnetic wave toward the underground, and an electromagnetic wave reception part 5 for receiving a reflected electromagnetic wave based on the transmitted electromagnetic wave, and detects a buried object 9 buried underground based on an electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 5. The radar 1 has a constitution including a correlation processing part 22 for performing mutual correlation processing between a reception waveform 19 of the electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 5 and a transmission waveform 12 of the electromagnetic wave transmitted from the electromagnetic wave transmission part 4, and autocorrelation processing of the reception waveform 19; and a discrimination part 7 for calculating the ratio between a mutual correlation value and an autocorrelation value acquired by the correlation processing part 22, and discriminating whether the underground buried object 9 buried underground is a metal object or a nonmetal object based on the calculated ratio.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Insulation Wall-pannel structure for improving hardness and cohesion
title_ko: 내진 성능을 갖춘 열교 차단형 단열 벽 패널 구조체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermal bridge prevention type insulation wall panel structure having earthquake-resistance performance, capable of having an earthquake-resistance performance by enabling a wall panel to offset vibrations and movements caused by an external shock. According to an advisable embodiment of the present invention, the present invention comprises: a wall panel comprising an outer finishing material and an insulator integrated directly with the rear side of the outer finishing material; fixtures buried in the upper and lower parts of the wall panel respectively; a connection plate located and fixed between wall panels stacked vertically; an L-shaped fixing bracket having a side bolted with the connection plate and having the other side fixed to a wall or support structure of a building through anchor bolts; and a fixing joint comprising a horizontal insertion part inserted into a separation part of the connection plate and vertical insertion parts inserted into insertion holes of fixtures in the upper and lower parts and fixed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 벽 패널 설치시 벽 패널의 상부와 하부에 각각 고정구를 매입시키고 고정구에 구조용 브래킷으로 상하 벽 패널 고정시에 "ㅏ" 형상의 연결 고정용 이음부재를 추가로 설치하여 좌/우측으로 이동 설치가 가능하여 수평방향의 오차의 수렴이 용이하면서도 벽면에 설치된 벽패널이 외부 충격에 의한 움직임과 진동을 상쇄할 수 있어 내진 성능을 갖추도록 하는 내진 성능을 갖춘 열교 차단형 단열 벽 패널 구조체에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예는 외부 마감재와, 외부 마감재의 배면에 직접적으로 일체화 된 단열재로 형성되는 벽 패널과; 상부가 개구되어 삽입구가 형성되는 U형 단면으로 이루어져 삽입구가 노출되도록 벽 패널의 상단부와 하단부에 각각 매입되는 고정구와; 일정 길이의 수평 판형상의 조정판과, 조정판의 일측 단부에서 일정 거리 이격되어 이격부가 형성되도록 각각 수평방향으로 연장되는 연장부와, 한 쌍의 연장부의 외측단부에서 상하부로 엇갈려 형성되도록 수직 상방 및 하방으로 연장되는 걸림턱으로 이루어져, 벽 패널의 상하부 적층시 상하부 적층된 벽 패널의 사이에 위치하여 걸림턱이 고정구의 삽입구에 삽입되어 고정되는 연결플레이트와; 일측은 연결플레이트에 볼트 결합되고, 타측은 앵커 볼트를 통해 건축물의 벽체 또는 지지용 구조물에 고정되는 "L" 자 형상의 고정 브라켓과; 일정길이의 수직끼움부와 수직끼움부의 중앙부에서 수평방향으로 일체로 형성되는 수평끼움부로 이루어져, 수평끼움부가 연결플레이트의 이격부에 삽입되며 수직끼움부가 각각 상부와 하부의 고정구의 삽입구에 삽입되어 고정되는 고정용 이음부재;를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: IoT-based wearable devices for the vulnerable group of emergency response and healthcare service
title_ko: 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention can provide an IoT-based wearable device for emergency response and healthcare for a vulnerable group, which measures a health condition including electrocardiogram and a bio-signal of a vulnerable group and monitors the health condition in real time when an emergency occurs to provide a supporter and a caregiver with the health condition and cooperate with a medical institution, thereby providing an immediate and personalized emergency response service within a golden time. The IoT-based wearable device for emergency response and healthcare for a vulnerable group comprises: a strap unit including a conductive wire embedded in an electrocardiogram (ECG) electrode pad to measure electrocardiogram; a data measurement module processing the electrocardiogram measured by the strap unit and including a plurality of sensors for measuring a bio-signal; a server analyzing, transmitting, and receiving information transmitted from the data measurement module; and a user terminal receiving information from the server and providing a user with the information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스에 있어서, ECG(Electrocardiogram, ECG) 전극패드에 전도선이 내장된 형태로 구비되어 심전도를 측정하는 스트랩부, 상기 스트랩부에서 측정된 심전도를 가공하고, 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 복수의 센서를 포함하는 데이터 측정 모듈, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈에서 전송된 정보를 분석하고 송수신하는 서버, 상기 서버로부터 정보를 수신하여 사용자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말을 포함하되, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈은, 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 차동 증폭하여 데이터의 정확도를 향상시키는 계측부, 고역통과필터(High Pass Filter ,HPF) 및 저역통과필터(Low Pass Filter ,LPF)를 포함하여, 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 필터링하여 노이즈를 제거하는 필터부, 상기 서버와 통신하여 상기 스트랩부 및 데이터 측정 모듈에서 가공한 데이터를 송수신 하는 통신부를 포함하되, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈은 실시간 심박수, 분당 심박수, 산소포화도, 맥박 및 체온을 측정하기 위한 센서와 상기 웨어러블 디바이스의 위치 정보를 파악하기 위한 GPS 센서를 더 포함하고, 상기 서버는 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 가공 및 데이터베이스화 함으로써 상기 사용자 단말에 건강상태 데이터 및 응급 상황 데이터를 제공하여, 착용자인 취약계층과 부양자에게 착용자의 심전도 및 생체 신호 데이터를 제공하고, 응급상황 발생 시 부양자에게 응급상황 알림 및 전화연결을 진행하고, 일정시간 동안 연결이 진행되지 않을 시 응급센터로 신고 및 전화연결을 진행하여 불필요한 응급센터와의 연결이 감소되며 응급상황에서의 효과적인 대처를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 하는 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스.

title_en: Mmwave radar-based iot control device and method thereof
title_ko: mmWave 레이더 기반 IoT 제어 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: mmWave 레이더 기반 IoT 제어 장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 mmWave 레이더 기반 IoT 제어 장치는 소정의 영역에 mmWave 전자파를 송신하고, 상기 사용자의 신체 표면에 의해 반사된 반사 전자파를 수신하는 mmWave 레이더 센서부, 상기 반사 전자파를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 호흡수와 심박수를 추정하는 생체 신호 분석부, 상기 반사 전자파를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 자세 정보를 추정하는 3차원 자세 추정부, 상기 호흡수, 심박수 및 자세 정보를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 감정 상태를 추정하는 감정 상태 추정부 및 상기 추정된 감정 상태를 기반으로 IoT 디바이스의 제어 신호를 생성하는 제어 신호 생성부를 포함한다. 이를 통해 사용자의 호흡수, 심박수 및 자세 정보를 정확하게 추정하고, 이에 따른 사용자의 감정 상태를 추정할 수 있다. 그리고, 추정된 사용자의 감정 상태에 따라 IoT 디바이스를 적절히 제어하여 사용자에게 편안하고 안정한 환경을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Apparatus for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: System and method for mitigation of random body movement and interference effects in radar-based vital signs monitoring systems in medical applications
abstract_en: A radar system (10) for vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing and a method for mitigating random body movement and external interference effects in vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing by employing a radar system (10) that is configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external interference affecting vital signs monitoring is at least mitigated by decomposing and filtering a reconstructed displacement signal x(t) using a time and frequency analysis technique such as Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. This decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency basis components containing the random body movement interference. Hence, the filtered signal can be reconstructed after removing the random body movement components, thus enabling reliable and robust vital-signs parameter estimation.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures by means of a ground-penetrating radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a plurality of radar signals for a region of ground, determining, based on the radar signals, a 3D point cloud, each point corresponding to one radar detection and being geolocated in space, searching for at least one set of substantially aligned points in the 3D point cloud by: i. for each straight line among a set of straight lines of the 3D space, determining the number of points of the 3D point cloud that are located at a distance smaller than a predetermined minimum distance from the straight line, ii. determining at least one straight line for which the number of points is higher than a predetermined minimum detection threshold, the points located at a distance from this straight line smaller than said minimum distance characterizing a longitudinal structure.
assignees: COMMISSARIAT A L’ENERGIE ATOMIQUE ET AUX ENERGIES ALTERNATIVES

title_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using ultra wideband
abstract_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using Ultra-Wideband communication. UWB signals are transmitted from one UWB system node (110B) to another UWB system node (110A). Channel impulse responses (CIRs) associated with the UWB signals are determined. Based on the CIRs, in some embodiments velocities associated with the UWB signals are determined, and activities of vehicle occupants are classified based on the CIRs along with vital signs such as breathing rates. In other embodiments, based on the CIRs, phase unwrapping of phase features associated with the CIRs is performed, and principle component analysis (PCA) transforms the CIRs, allowing estimated vital signs such as breathing rates to be determined.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on periodic characteristics and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method, a device and a storage medium based on periodic characteristics, and the vital sign detection method based on the periodic characteristics comprises the following steps: sending radar signals to a region to be detected, and receiving radar echo signals returned by the region to be detected; performing signal preprocessing on the radar echo signal, and determining the state of a human body target in the region to be detected; if a human body target exists in the area to be detected, extracting vital sign data with periodic characteristics from radar echo signals of the area to be detected based on the periodic characteristics of the vital sign data; and carrying out data processing on the vital sign data with the periodic characteristics to obtain a vital sign detection result with the periodic characteristics. The vital sign detection method, the device and the storage medium based on the periodic characteristics, disclosed by the embodiment of the application, improve the detection precision of vital sign data.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring vital sign information, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign information monitoring method and device, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting echo signals of a target object in a sleep state through target monitoring equipment, wherein the target monitoring equipment is radar monitoring equipment which is not required to be worn by the target object; extracting a micro-motion signal from each distance unit in the echo signal; performing spectrum analysis on the micro-motion signal to obtain a chromatographic spectrum of the micro-motion signal; and monitoring vital sign information of the target object by utilizing a chromatographic spectrum of the micro-motion signal, wherein the vital sign information at least comprises the respiration rate, the respiration form and the restless leg phenomenon of the target object. The application solves the problem of poor monitoring effect on vital sign information in the related technology.

title_en: Bio-processor, bio-signal detecting system, and method for operating the same
title_ko: 바이오 프로세서, 생체 신호 감지 시스템, 및 바이오 프로세서의 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이오 프로세서, 생체 신호 감지 시스템, 및 바이오 프로세서의 동작 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 바이오 프로세서는 생체 전기 저항 센서 및 디지털 신호 프로세서를 포함한다. 생체 전기 저항 센서는 정착 시간의 일부를 포함하는 시간 동안 생체 전기 저항을 측정한다. 디지털 신호 프로세서는 측정된 생체 전기 저항의 변화 추이에 기초하여 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값을 추정한다. 디지털 신호 프로세서는 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값에 기초하여 생체 데이터를 생성한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 생체 신호의 측정 시간을 감소시키되, 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값의 정확성을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting wake-up
title_ko: 웨이크-업 감지 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a wake-up detection device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the wake-up detection device comprises: a sensor that detects movements and biosignals of a person; and a control part that analyzes the movements and biosignals recognized by the sensor, and determines whether the person wakes up based on a result of analyzing the movements and biosignals, wherein the control part determines a change in the heart rate of the person when transitioning from a sleeping state to a non-sleeping state, and outputs a first alarm when it is determined that the change in the heart rate and the movement of the person are increased.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 웨이크-업 감지 장치를 제공한다. 웨이크-업 감지 장치는 사람의 움직임 및 사람의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 움직임 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석하고, 상기 움직임 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석한 결과에 기초하여 사람이 잠에서 깨는지 여부를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 수면 상태에서 비수면 상태로 전환될 때의 사람의 심박수의 변화를 판단하고, 상기 제어부는 상기 심박수의 변화 및 사람의 움직임이 증가된 것으로 판단하는 경우 제1 알람을 출력한다.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting sensorcraft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting sensorcraft, including body, it is characterised in that：Body is surrounded by wing, wing end is provided with infrared ray proximity switch, registering weather vane is provided with the top of body, inside is provided with battery, the front side wall and rear wall of body are provided with storage box one, the inner top of storage box one is provided with motor, the output axis connection transmission device of motor, transmission device connects push rod, push rod connection expansion link, expansion link is flexibly connected infrared hemisphere camera, organism bottom center is provided with storage box two, the bottom of storage box two is provided with four pieces of baffle plates, baffle plate side is provided with fire monitor, the inner top of storage box two is provided with lowering or hoisting gear, lowering or hoisting gear lower end connects thermal infrared life-detection instrument by connection component, the bottom of storage box two is biparting two-way vertical hinged door.The utility model advantage：It can predict that the intensity of a fire is moved towards, and the personnel in the condition of a disaster can be detected so that fire-fighting center quickly and accurately carries out fire control and personnel sue and labour.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring infrared output of ABREU brain thermal channel
abstract_en: A medical device for measuring brain temperature data via an ABREU Brain Thermal Tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is an equally key and universal indicator of disease and health, and is the only vital sign that is not artificially altered by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present application describes a device that readily locates the ABREU brain thermal tunnel and is configured to provide non-contact temperature readings of the brain. Various embodiments of the disclosed apparatus enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable a medical professional to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar fine motion object detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar fine motion object detection methods, belong to detections of radar field, through-wall radar detection field, and method and step of the invention is as follows: the echo signal of intermediate frequency of acquisition is carried out process of pulse-compression；A narrow band filter is designed according to the Doppler shift characteristics of fine motion target to inhibit to outer clutter；Coherent accumulation is carried out to clutter recognition treated signal；Treated signal is subjected to CFAR detection；Wherein pulse compression improves signal-to-noise ratio and range accuracy；The strong clutter at barrier rear can be effectively suppressed in clutter recognition；This method targetedly the processing such as is filtered, amplifies, extracts to the faint echo of fine motion target after wall on the basis of the analysis of the micro-doppler characteristic to fine motion target, finally realizes effective detection of fine motion target.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Sleep staging method and device based on radar information and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a sleep staging method, a sleep staging device, a sleep staging terminal and a sleep staging storage medium based on radar information. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring respiratory heartbeat information in a sleep period monitored by a vital sign monitoring radar; calculating a sleep staging index at each moment in a sleep period based on the breathing heartbeat information; calculating a sleep stage characteristic value of each moment in a sleep period based on the sleep stage index; and comparing the sleep stage characteristic value with a preset stage threshold value, and determining the sleep stage corresponding to each moment in the sleep period according to the comparison result. The invention carries out sleep staging based on radar information, acquires information under the conditions of no perception and no influence on normal sleep of a user, has simple and accurate sleep staging processing process and has higher reliability.
assignees: SONISTEK HEBEI SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for rapidly detecting through-wall radar target by frequency modulation continuous wave signal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for rapidly detecting a through-wall radar target by using a frequency modulated continuous wave signal system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving each frame of transmission information transmitted by an FMCW receiver according to a set frequency by adopting a zero intermediate frequency de-frequency modulation mode to obtain a corresponding beat signal; acquiring echo range images corresponding to the beat signals respectively according to the obtained beat signals; carrying out difference on any two adjacent frames of echo range profiles to obtain a sequence of difference range profiles; screening out a differential distance image meeting a first preset condition; performing Fourier transform on the complex scattering value at the corresponding distance of the differential distance image meeting a first preset condition along the sequence direction to obtain a function of the complex scattering value after Fourier transform; and calculating function value points of the complex scattering values after Fourier transform meeting a second preset condition along the sequence direction aiming at the functions of the complex scattering values after Fourier transform, and taking the distance positions corresponding to the function value points meeting the second preset condition as effective targets.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: FMCW radar approaching multi-target vital sign signal separation method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for separating adjacent multi-target vital sign signals of an FMCW radar, which comprises the following steps: acquiring FMCW radar echo intermediate frequency signal data, and determining slow time data containing a life signal according to the FMCW radar echo intermediate frequency signal data; carrying out phase extraction on the slow time data to obtain mixed vital sign data; according to the mixed vital sign signal data, combining a signal decomposition algorithm to obtain virtual multichannel data; and obtaining vital sign signal data close to multiple targets according to the virtual multichannel data. The method can perform applicable reconstruction conversion on the FMCW radar signals, construct a virtual multichannel through the CEEMDAN method, convert the space domain problem into the signal domain problem by using the FastICA method, and finally can effectively extract the vital sign signals of a plurality of targets in the same space unit from the FMCW radar echo signals.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH CHONGQING INNOVATION CENTER;BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital sign monitoring, comprising a method for detecting vital signs using at least one radar sensor mounted to a vehicle. The method includes detecting a plurality of target candidates using at least one radar sensor, analyzing the plurality of target candidates to generate a target list, steering the at least one radar sensor toward the target using an angle of arrival corresponding to the target, and detecting a vital sign signal of the target based on the distance using the at least one radar sensor.

title_en: Pre-buried antidetonation support and pre-buried antidetonation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building earthquake resistance, in particular to an embedded earthquake-resistant bracket and an embedded earthquake-resistant system. The both ends of pre-buried muscle are connected in supporting seat and pre-buried board respectively, and supporting mechanism rotates to be connected in supporting seat and main frame or bottom plate. The backup pad is installed in the top of main frame, butt in the bottom plate. When an earthquake occurs, the first support rod and the second support rod deviate and displace along with the vibration, and the adjusting plate generates acting force on the first elastic piece and the second elastic piece along with the vibration, so that the first elastic piece and the second elastic piece deform. The pressure sensor is used for sensing acting force at two ends on the adjusting plate, the hydraulic rod stretches and contracts according to the acting force on the adjusting plate, the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod are driven by changing the position of the adjusting plate, vibration energy is consumed, the whole supporting mechanism is kept stable, and the vibration-resistant effect of the whole embedded vibration-resistant support is guaranteed.
assignees: MCC COMM CONSTR GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Metal sensing device and system for preventing crime and diasasters using thereof
title_ko: 금속탐지장치 및 이를 이용한 방범방재시스템
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, disclosed are a metal detection device and a crime/disaster prevention system using the same. The metal detection device comprises: a case having a hollow inside and formed in a predetermined size; a cable formed in the case, and carrying a predetermined current; a permanent magnet formed in the case, and generating a magnetic field varied by a reaction to the current of the cable by moving in the case while reacting to an iron component; and a detection sensor sensing the varied magnetic field. Also, the metal detection device is buried to a predetermined depth in the ground. The crime/disaster prevention system comprises: the metal detection device; an analysis device analyzing and determining whether a fence is abnormal and where an abnormality occurs based on a sensed value transmitted from the detection sensor of the metal detection device; a remote reception device (server) receiving the information determined by the analysis device about whether the fence is abnormal; and a power supply part applying operating power to the system. Therefore, the present invention is capable of enabling accurate crime/disaster prevention by increasing usability.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 내부가 중공형태이고 일정한 크기로 형성되는 케이스; 케이스 내부에 구성되고, 일정한 전류가 흐르는 케이블; 케이스 내부에 구성되고, 철 성분과 반응하면서 케이스 내부에서 움직임에 따라 상기 케이블 전류와의 반응에 의해 변화되는 자기장을 발생하는 영구자석; 및 변화되는 자기장을 감지하는 감지센서로 구성되고 지중 일정깊이에 매설되는 금속탐지장치; 및 금속탐지장치의 감지센서로부터 전송된 감지값을 토대로 펜스의 이상여부 및 이상 발생 위치를 분석 판단하는 분석장치; 분석장치에서 판단된 펜스의 이상여부를 전송받는 원격 수신장치(서버); 및 시스템에 동작전원을 인가하는 전원부로 이루어진 금속탐지장치 및 이를 이용한 방범방재시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Emergency Service Notification Necklace
title_ko: 응급 구조 알리미 목걸이
abstract_ko:
고령자, 거동이 불편한 사람 또는 1인 가구의 긴급 상황 발생 시 신속하게 구조 요청을 할 수 있도록 다양한 최신 기술을 통합한 목걸이형 웨어러블 기기입니다. 이 기기는 사용자의 생명과 안전을 보호하기 위해 설계되었으며, 공공기관과의 연계를 통해 사용자 상태에 대한 실시간 모니터링과 정보 전달을 지원하여 신속한 응급 대응이 가능하도록 합니다.
