title_en: A method of localizing objects, explosive mines and unexploded ordnance on or in the ground
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting explosive mines, unexploded ordnance (UXO) or other targeted objects on or buried underground using a combination of metal detectors (2,4) and Ground Penetration Radar (1) with multiple receivers and transmitters and a GPS device.

title_en: Ultra-long tunnel sewage disposing and separation drainage structure suitable for cold regions
abstract_en: An ultra-long tunnel sewage disposing and separation drainage structure suitable for cold regions, comprising a portal segment drainage structure and a trunk segment drainage structure, as well as an outside clean water trench (14), an outside deeply buried water trench (15), an outside sewage trench (16) and a water purification tank (17); the portal segment drainage structure comprises a central water trench (6) and side-type sewage trenches A(7), the central water trench is deeply buried in a main tunnel portal segment (4) at a position lower than a freezing depth, the side-type sewage trenches A are provided on both sides of the main tunnel portal segment, the trunk segment drainage structure comprises side-type clean water trenches (8) and side-type sewage trenches B, and the side-type clean water trenches and the side-type sewage trenches B are provided on both sides of a main tunnel trunk segment (5). The drainage structure achieves the separation drainage disposal of clean water and sewage during tunnel construction and operation, and satisfies high environmental requirements; drainage structures are separately arranged on the portal segment and the trunk segment, meeting the thermal insulation requirements of drainage in cold regions, and being capable of effectively preventing the occurrence of cold disaster caused by the infiltration of underground water into tunnels; and a service tunnel is used to assist in enhancing the drainage capability of the main tunnel, thereby realizing the drainage of a huge amount of water for an ultra-long tunnel.
assignees: CCCC SECOND HIGHWAY CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Portable touchless vital sign acquisition device
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a non-contact MCG is anticipated as one embodiment. Additionally, a non-contact stethoscope, thermal sensor, or MCG could be utilized singly or in combination with each other, or included singly or together in other medical devices such as a fluoroscope, For example, a handheld, portable instrument comprising a non-contact stethoscope without a magnetometer or thermal sensor can provide a measure of acoustic signals without contacting a subject, while a non-contact thermal sensor as a single device can provide a rapid contactless temperature of a subject
assignees: SKIDMORE FRANK M;DAVIDSON MARK;DONDA RUSSELL S

title_en: System and method for monitoring life signs of a person
abstract_en: A system (10) and method for monitoring a person (14) within a defined area by detecting breathing, or the lack thereof. Breathing is detected using radar signals (24), camera signals (22) and/or microphone signals (26). The radar signals (24), camera signals (22) and/or microphone signals (26) are analyzed to determine if the subject person (14) is moving, and if not moving if the person (14) is breathing or not-breathing. An alarm is generated should the reflected radar signals (24), the camera signals (22) and the microphone signals (26) all simultaneously indicate no movement and no movement of the subject person (14) in the defined area for a selected period of time.

title_en: Sensor-fusion-based blood pressure measurement
abstract_en: Various arrangements for measuring blood pressure using sensor fusion are presented herein. Radio frequency (RF) signals are emitted and RF reflection signals are received by a radar sensor of a stationary device. The RF reflection signals are analyzed at a first distance range to identify a first pulse pressure waveform (PPW) at an aortic valve of a user. Vital sign data measured at an extremity of the user by a mobile device are received by the stationary device. The vital sign data is analyzed to identify a second PPW at the extremity of the user. Using the first PPW and the second PPW, a pulse transit time from the aortic valve to the extremity is determined. Using the PTT, a blood pressure (BP) of the user is determined and an indication of the BP is output.

title_en: Detection system and detection method of vital sign
abstract_en: A detection system and a detection method of vital sign are provided. The method includes: transmitting a first radio frequency (RF) signal and receiving a first radar signal corresponding to the first RF signal by a first radar; performing IQ-demodulation on the first radar signal to obtain a first receiving in-phase component and a first receiving quadrature component; performing a first convolution operation to the first receiving in-phase component and a first symbol and performing a multiply accumulate (MAC) operation to a first result of the first convolution operation to obtain a first accumulated value; performing a second convolution operation to the first receiving quadrature component and the first symbol and performing a MAC operation to a second result of the second convolution operation to obtain a second accumulated value; and generating a vital sign according to the first and the second accumulated value.

title_en: Through-wall radar sensors networked together to create 2d and 3d combined views of an area
abstract_en: Systems and methods for networking together through-wall radar sensors to generate a combined image based on signal data from the networked through-wall radar sensors. The system includes a first through-wall radar sensor and a second through-wall radar sensor. The second through-wall radar sensor is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor. The system includes a display of an area, wherein the display of the area is based on data from the first through-wall radar sensor combined with data from the second through- wall radar sensor. The system may include a first communication device connected to the first through-wall radar sensor and a second communication device connected to the second through-wall radar sensor. A controller is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor and the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a plurality of through- wall radar sensors networked together to provide a two-dimensional or a three-dimensional image of an area.

title_en: Ubiquitous network system enabling life-saving and emergency reporting services based on lighting supervisory system
title_ko: 도시조명 관리시스템을 기반으로 인명구조 및 구급 신고가 가능한 유비쿼터스 방식의 네트워크 시스템
abstract_en: The invention is a network system for emergency reporting services that enables remote checking of ON/OFF states in lighting installations, comprising: a terminal with a communication module for transmitting radio frequency signals; a lighting supervisory terminal including a light emitting device; a module for controlling the light emitting device; a module for transmission/receipt of control signals; and a control/supervision server including a transmission/receiving module for receiving lighting information data and signal strength data; a location tracking module for tracking location of the portable terminal by using the lighting information data and the received signal strength data, a lighting supervisory module for controlling/supervising the lighting supervisory terminal, and a lighting location information DB for storing data about lighting locations. In one embodiment, the portable terminal comprises a detecting sensor for measuring and detecting a vital sign of a target person and a control module that combines data about the transmitted vital signal from the detecting sensor with an input ID to the portable terminal, thereby generating result data and sending the result data to the communication module to be sent; and the control and supervisory server further includes a user information DB.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 중앙 관제시스템을 통해 도시조명 시설물의 ON/OFF 및 고장 여부에 대한 확인을 원격에서 제어 관리하는 한편, 구급 및 응급이 요청되는 주민에 대한 신속한 구조와 응급활동을 수행할 수 있도록 효율적인 신고 환경을 구축하는 도시조명 관리시스템을 기반으로 인명구조 및 구급 신고가 가능한 유비쿼터스 방식의 네트워크 시스템에 관한 것으로, 조명등 관리단말기와 통신하는 휴대단말기의 발신 ID를 확인하여 사용자정보DB에서 대상자의 정보를 검색한 후 유관기관의 통신망에 접속 통신하면서 대상자의 추적된 위치와 정보를 전송하도록 된 것이다
assignees: JE CHEON CITY;ROADBANK CO LTD;JANG YONG HAK;AN YOUNG SOOK

title_en: Search and rescue device and method integrating vibration and radar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue device and a method for fusion of vibration and radar detection, wherein the device comprises a host module, a vibration detection module and a radar detection module, wherein the vibration detection module and the radar detection module are respectively connected with the host module, the vibration detection module detects vibration signals in a target area and sends vibration detection results to the host module, and the radar detection module detects vital sign signals of targets to be rescued in the area and sends radar detection results to the host module; the method obtains the final detection result of the target to be saved by fusing the vibration detection result and the radar detection result. The invention has the advantages of simple realization, high search efficiency and precision, strong anti-interference performance and the like.

title_en: Ocean disaster-bearing body evaluation and early warning method based on unmanned plane and geographic grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ocean disaster-bearing body evaluation early warning method based on an unmanned plane and a geographic grid, which belongs to the technical field of ocean disaster-bearing body evaluation and comprises the following steps of S1, determining an evaluation area and establishing a monitoring network, wherein a plurality of first sensors are buried in the disaster-bearing body area, geographic grid division is carried out based on the positions of the first sensors, the first sensors and a preset data processing system are connected to form the monitoring network, real-time acquisition and transmission of data are realized, S2, receiving and monitoring ocean disaster data, and when the ocean disaster data reach a first preset threshold value, the first sensors acquire corresponding data of the disaster-bearing body area according to a preset frequency, and data preprocessing is carried out after the first sensor data are collected. The invention improves the real-time performance and the accuracy of evaluation and enhances the monitoring and early warning capability of ocean disasters.

title_en: Electronic device capable of measuring biological signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정 가능한 전자 장치
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 전도성 부분을 적어도 일부 포함하는 하우징, 상기 하우징의 적어도 일부를 통해 외부로 시각적으로 노출되는 디스플레이, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 통신 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 센서, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 통신 회로 사이에 연결되고, 제1 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제1 차단 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 센서 사이에 연결되고, 제2 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제2 차단 회로, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 통신 회로 및 상기 센서와 동작적으로(operatively) 연결된 프로세서를 포함할 수 있고, 상기 전도성 부분은 상기 통신 회로의 안테나 및 상기 센서의 생체 신호 측정 전극으로 동작하도록 구성될 수 있다.  이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Method for detecting abnormal respiration using a photoplethysmography (PPG) signal
abstract_en: An abnormal respiration detection apparatus includes a sensor for sensing a PPG signal from an optical signal reflected and received from a user's body; a band pass filter for extracting a signal of a required band from the PPG signal; an analog-to-digital converter for performing a digital conversion on the filtered PPG signal; and an abnormal respiration recognition unit deriving a respiration rate signal from the digital-converted PPG signal, deriving a plurality of respiration rate characteristic values through a time axis analysis on the derived respiration rate signal, and detecting an abnormal respiration using the derived plurality of respiration rate characteristic values. The embodiments can be utilized to monitor the survival of elders who live alone, soldiers isolated in a military operation, persons isolated in disaster and accident sites, thereby contributing to public and social safety and building of welfare society and nation.

title_en: through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of through-wall radar, through-wall radar includes shell, display, transmitter, receiver, alarm and controller, the side of shell is arcwall face, shell is equipped with boss, and boss is set to the outside wall surface of shell, and boss has a flat surface, flat surface is the surface far from shell in boss, a mounting hole is arranged in boss, and mounting hole extends to the internal face of shell from flat surface, and earphone socket is inserted in mounting hole and is fixedly arranged on boss.The through-wall radar of the utility model is by being arranged earphone socket, alarm signal is sent to earphone socket by controller, operating personnel are connect with earphone socket using audible device and draw alarm signal, even if under complicated environmental condition, operating personnel can directly receive the sound of audible device, and the sound of alarm will not be masked even if noisy environment.And the setting of the flat surface of shell convex platform, it can make earphone socket is stronger to be connected to shell, improve the performance of through-wall radar.
assignees: SHANGHAI TIANXUN ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of multi-functional full landform fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to fire-fighting robot technical fields, it is a kind of multi-functional full landform fire-fighting robot, including main body, crawler type walking mechanism, connection shaft, crawler type climbing mechanism, central processing unit, rotating device, first support bar, camera, 4G transmit network interface card, loudspeaker, second support bar, life-detection instrument, transmission module, extinguishing device, temperature sensor；The utility model rotates turntable by rotating electric machine and carries out patrol monitoring, the temperature change of temperature sensor real-time monitoring surrounding enviroment, camera records the information detected in real time, the information that 4G transmission network interface card will test in real time is transferred to fire-fighting control platform, without considering the place of monitoring and the complexity of scene of fire rescue environment in use process, it saves in time to fire source, it is existing high to landform environmental requirement to efficiently solve existing fire-fighting robot, it encounters rough terrain use and is restricted the problem of cannot rescuing fire in time, fire excessive loss is avoided to increase.
assignees: URUMQI ZHIYUAN YITONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rotatable distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable distributed radar life detection location is equipped, including solitary radar unit more than two, every be provided with a rotary mechanism on the radar unit, let solitary radar unit rotate with the direction of adjustment antenna polarization round the fixed axle through rotary mechanism. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, easy and simple to handle, application scope are wide, can realize searching for fast on a large scale and full polarization target detection etc.

title_en: Fire safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting equipment technical field, when taking place to the conflagration, smog is to the great literary composition problem of personnel's injury, aims at providing a conflagration safety monitoring system, including installing at indoor smog induction circuit, install the raceway on the indoor ceiling, the intercommunication has a plurality of spray pipes that extend towards the ground direction on the raceway, and pre-buried in the indoor wall has the water tank, has placed the working shaft in the water tank, and the intercommunication has the flow pipe between working shaft and the raceway, and smog induction circuit includes: the device comprises a smoke sensor, a smoke concentration comparison unit and a verification control unit. The water in the water tank is sprayed out from the water spraying pipe through the water conveying pipe under the action of the water supply pump, and the water spraying pipe is arranged around the circumference of the water conveying pipe, so that water sprayed out from the water spraying pipe forms a water curtain indoors, people stand in the water curtain, and smoke is partially contained in the water, so that the people standing in the water curtain are not easy to absorb too much smoke in a short time, and more rescue time is strived for fire fighters.
assignees: GUANGZHOU NEW GOOD CASTLE FIRE ENGINEERING ENTPR CO LTD

title_en: Old person heartbeat detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an old person's heartbeat detection device belongs to breathing, heartbeat frequency detection technical field. The method comprises the following steps: a front cover plate and a rear shell of the heartbeat detection device; the front cover plate is provided with a microwave radar and an infrared detection probe; the rear shell is fixedly provided with a single chip microcomputer MCU, an internal module and an external module; wherein, the external module, the MCU, the internal module, the microwave radar and the infrared detector head form a complete circuit. The utility model uses commercial power supply and wall mounting mode; the self-contained display module displays the measured data in real time, so that historical data can be stored, and the data can be conveniently checked; the device has an infrared detection function, when a user approaches the device, the display screen is on, heartbeat data is displayed in real time, and when the user leaves, the display function is turned off; when the detected heartbeat is abnormal, the sound-light alarm is immediately sent out, meanwhile, the alarm data are sent to a community hospital or an emergency contact through the communication module, and the old people can be rescued in an emergency.
assignees: NANJING OHOSURE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting underground cavity around non-metal pipeline by using in-hole radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting underground cavities around a non-metal pipeline by using an in-hole radar, which is characterized in that the underground cavities around the non-metal pipeline are detected by using ground penetrating radar equipment with an in-hole radar antenna, the in-hole radar antenna enters the non-metal pipeline and moves forwards along the non-metal pipeline through the dragging of a rope from downstream, and transmits and receives electromagnetic wave signals, the in-hole radar antenna is connected with a ground radar receiver through a relay cable, the received radar signals are transmitted to the radar receiver and stored, and the underground cavities around the non-metal pipeline are judged according to radar reflected wave signals and the characteristics of a same phase axis. The invention effectively solves the problems that the pipeline cannot be effectively detected on the ground and personnel cannot detect the pipeline (the pipe diameter is small, the siltation is serious and the like) when the pipeline is deeply buried (the buried depth is more than 5m), has high detection efficiency and good detection effect (equivalent to short-distance detection), and avoids the safety problem caused by the personnel entering the underground pipeline.

title_en: Wall clutter suppression method of through-wall imaging radar based on joint entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall imaging radar wall clutter suppression method based on a joint entropy value, which belongs to the field of through-wall radar imaging. Due to the change of each scanning position of the antenna, the change intensity of a target echo signal is large, the change intensity of a wall clutter is small, so that the information entropy value of the target echo is smaller than that of the wall clutter, and a joint entropy value method is provided according to the fact that the joint entropy value of two groups of echo data is larger than that of any one group. The method can enlarge the adjustable range of the threshold, thereby improving the difference between the input signal-to-clutter ratio and the output signal-to-clutter ratio of the target, eliminating the influence of wall clutter by adaptively selecting the optimal threshold adjusting factor, and obtaining the target image with higher quality by a back projection algorithm.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitor, includes the housing, the monitor still includes millimeter wave biological radar module and display screen, the signal transmission end of millimeter wave biological radar module is located the housing outer wall, waits to detect human thorax position and is located the coverage of signal transmission end, the output and the main control module of millimeter wave biological radar module are connected, the main control module is connected with display module, display module's output is connected with the display screen, the display screen is located on the housing. The invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitor which is convenient to use, simple in structure and rich in functions.

title_en: Non-contact human vital sign measuring device and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact human vital sign measuring device, which comprises a monitoring room, wherein the monitoring room comprises a first wall body and a second wall body which are opposite to each other, the second wall body is provided with an infrared imaging instrument, the first wall body or the second wall body is provided with a moving mechanism, and the moving mechanism is provided with a radar transceiver; the infrared imaging instrument is electrically connected with the processing center, the radar transceiver is electrically connected with the processing center, and the moving mechanism is electrically connected with the processing center. The radar transceiver is used for transmitting signals and receiving reflected signals, the processing center receives the signals, the frequency of the heartbeat and the respiration is obtained according to the Doppler frequency shift of the heartbeat and the respiration, and the moving mechanism is used for changing the position of the radar transceiver, so that the radar transceiver is always aligned to the body of a patient in a monitoring room, and the influence of an interference source on the monitoring result of the radar transceiver is reduced.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection system with privacy protection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact vital sign detection system with privacy protection, which comprises a human body detection radar, at least one signal power connection line and a server, wherein the human body detection radar is used for detecting whether a user enters an environment space, if so, a frequency modulation pulse signal is transmitted to the user to generate vital sign signal data corresponding to the user, and the server is connected to the human body detection radar through the signal power connection line and is used for judging whether the vital sign signal data is in a normal range or not, and if not, an abnormal alarm is issued. The non-contact vital sign detection system with privacy protection can simplify the configuration of wires.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar track deviation estimation method based on image domain self-focusing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of through-wall radars, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar track deviation estimation method based on through-wall imaging image domain self-focusing. Firstly, realizing wall energy integration by utilizing Radon transformation, and realizing track deviation estimation of the sight direction in a transformation domain by an image self-focusing method; and performing maximum contrast self-focusing on a plurality of point target areas distributed behind the wall to realize course along-course track deviation estimation. The invention can reduce the dimension of the optimized variable, improve the estimation efficiency and fully utilize the space-variant pitch error information provided by targets with different distances and azimuth positions.

title_en: Airborne through-wall radar moving target coherent accumulation method based on time domain conjugate inversion transformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for accumulating phase parameters of an airborne through-wall radar moving target based on time domain conjugate inversion transformation, which comprises the step of providing a new method for accumulating the phase parameters by using the time domain conjugate inversion transformation and the key transformation. The invention enables the return waves of the moving target to obtain correct coherent accumulation by removing the second-order range migration and the second-order Doppler expansion items. Compared with the traditional method, the frequency domain cancellation method provided by the invention avoids the high requirements of the traditional multichannel cancellation method on the time domain registration, and is more suitable for practical application requirements. Meanwhile, the invention can image the moving object more accurately under the condition of knowing the type of the moving object. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through numerical simulation.

title_en: Underground excavation deformation monitoring method based on ultra-shallow buried high-flow stratum subway channel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground excavation deformation monitoring of subway channels, and particularly discloses an underground excavation deformation monitoring method based on an ultra-shallow buried high-flow stratum, which generates a geological risk distribution map by carrying out geological radar detection on a construction influence range in the early stage of construction, further carries out differential arrangement of monitoring points by carrying out risk grading on the construction influence region by utilizing the geological risk distribution map, improves the deformation capturing capability of a key region on the premise of ensuring the monitoring effect, the monitoring redundancy of the low-risk area is reduced, the jump modification and stability characteristics of deformation are identified by dynamically analyzing deformation data collected by monitoring points in each sub-area in the construction process, whether a monitoring blind area or a redundant area exists is judged, encryption or migration operation of the monitoring points is triggered according to the jump modification and stability characteristics, the transition from static layout to dynamic evolution of the monitoring system is realized, and the real-time matching performance between the layout of the monitoring points and deformation evolution of the stratum is effectively ensured.
assignees: CHINA TIESIJU CIVIL ENG GROUP CO LTD;NO 6 ENGINEERING COMPANY LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY NO 4 ENGINEERING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type respiratory heartbeat monitoring method and device combining vision auxiliary positioning and millimeter wave radar dynamic tracking
abstract_en: The application provides a non-contact type respiration and heartbeat monitoring method and device combining vision auxiliary positioning and millimeter wave radar dynamic tracking, and belongs to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and millimeter wave radar. The device comprises a depth camera module, an edge calculation module and a millimeter wave radar module, wherein the depth camera module is used for acquiring human body image data, the edge calculation module is used for identifying skeleton key points, positioning chest positions and predicting movement tracks of targets according to the human body image data to obtain prediction information, the millimeter wave radar module is used for dynamically adjusting wave beams according to the prediction information and tracking and acquiring signals of chest areas, and the edge calculation module is used for separating the signals of the chest areas and extracting respiration and heartbeat information to obtain noninductive monitoring data of vital signs of human bodies. The application can realize accurate positioning and dynamic non-contact vital sign monitoring on the chest of the human body, and effectively improve the monitoring accuracy and the anti-interference capability.

title_en: Intelligent wall lamp health monitoring method and system based on radar induction
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of health monitoring, and discloses an intelligent wall lamp health monitoring method and system based on radar induction. The system generates movement characteristics and vital sign data by collecting space echo signals through the radar, realizes multi-mode data fusion analysis by combining an external sensor, judges whether a user triggers an abnormal event, sends alarm information through visible light communication, and realizes self power supply by adopting a photovoltaic film and a radio frequency energy collection technology.
assignees: HAIKAIBAO INTELLIGENT TECH JIAXING CO LTD

title_en: Mobile life detection method, system and device based on migration learning mechanism and UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile life detection method, a system and a device based on a migration learning mechanism and a UWB radar, which relate to the technical field of radar signal processing and emergency rescue, and have the technical key points that the mobile life detection method and the system construct a simulation-migration-real-time reasoning technical system, generate a large amount of diversified training data with labels through high-fidelity physical simulation, and pre-train a deep neural network model by utilizing the data; after the mobile platform enters a real disaster site, the invention adopts a transfer learning technology, and the pre-training model can be quickly fine-tuned by only collecting data of a very small amount of non-living areas on site or simply calibrating the data, so that the model is suitable for the current special environment. In this way, the invention can realize high-precision mobile life detection and provide powerful support for emergency rescue work.

title_en: Measuring apparatus for velocity of rainfall and measuring method using the same
title_ko: 우수 침투속도 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 우수 침투속도 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus (100) for measuring the infiltration velocity of rainwater comprising: a main body (110); a supporting part (120) extended toward the lower side of the main body (110) to be buried under the ground in order to fix the main body (110) to the predetermined position of the ground; a measuring part (130) mounted on the deep part of the main body (110); a first electric wire (11) and a second electric wire (21) whose one end is connected with the measuring part (130), and the other side is extended toward the lower side from the position at a distance toward a lateral side from the measuring part (130); and a first moisture sensor (10) connected with the first electric wire (11), and buried under the ground; and a second moisture sensor (20) connected with the second electric wire (21), and buried under the ground. The length of the first electric wire (11) and the second electric wire (21) is formed to be different from each other. Therefore, the buried depth of the first moisture sensor (10) and the second moisture sensor (20) is formed to be different from each other. The measuring part (130) is capable of measuring the rainwater filtration velocity by the time difference of a measured value of the first moisture sensor (10) and the second moisture sensor (20). Therefore, a landslide is efficiently predicted and prepared.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본체(110); 상기 본체(110)를 지면의 일정 위치에 고정하기 위하여 지중에 매설되도록, 상기 본체(110)의 하측으로 연장형성된 지지부(120); 상기 본체(110)의 심부에 장착된 측정부(130); 일단이 상기 측정부(130)에 연결되고, 타단이 상기 측정부(130)로부터 측방으로 이격한 위치에서 하측으로 연장설치된 제1 전선(11) 및 제2 전선(21); 상기 제1 전선(11)에 연결됨과 아울러, 지중에 매설된 제1 수분센서(10); 상기 제2 전선(21)에 연결됨과 아울러, 지중에 매설된 제2 수분센서(20);를 포함하고, 상기 제1 전선(11)과 제2 전선(21)의 길이가 상호 다르게 형성되고, 이에 따라 상기 제1 수분센서(10)와 제2 수분센서(20)의 매설깊이가 상호 다르게 형성되며, 상기 측정부(130)는 상기 제1 수분센서(10)와 제2 수분센서(20)의 측정값의 시간차에 의해 우수 침투속도를 측정하는 것을 특징으로 하는 우수 침투속도 측정장치(100)를 제시함으로써, 산사태를 효율적으로 예측하고 대비할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Method of manufacturing loess wood
title_ko: 황토목재 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of loess wood, which can be used in an economic manner, by delaying the corrosion phenomena of the wood with antimicrobial activities of the loess. The manufacturing method of loess wood comprises: a first process for manufacturing a loess raw material; a second process for manufacturing a loess crude liquid; a third process for inserting the wood in an impregnation furnace; a fourth process for removing the moisture and impurities inside the wood; a fifth process for supplying the loess crude liquid to a storage tank of the impregnation furnace; a sixth process for permeating the loess crude liquid into the inside of the wood tissue; a seventh process for collecting the excessively absorbed loess crude liquid and the residues on the surface of the wood; an eighth process for drying the loess crude liquid-collected wood; and a ninth process for sanding and treating the surface of the dried wood.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는, 황토목재 제조방법은 황토를 소금과 혼합한 혼합물을 0.1 ~ 5㎚ 크기의 입자로 제조하는 제 1 공정, 상기 제조한 황토 원료, 규소 또는 알루미늄으로 이루어지는 염알루미늄 계열의 무기질 경화제 및 물을 혼합하여 황토원액을 제조하는 제 2 공정, 목재를 함침로에 투입하는 제 3 공정, 상기 함침로에 진공을 가하여 목재 내부의 수분 및 불순물을 제거하는 제 4 공정, 상기 함침로의 저장탱크에 황토원액을 공급하는 제 5 공정, 상기 함침로의 압력을 가하여 상기 황토원액을 목재 조직 내부로 침투시키는 제 6 공정, 상기 가압을 해제하고 진공을 가하여 목재 표면의 잔재물 및 과잉흡수된 황토원액을 회수하는 제 7 공정, 상기 황토원액을 회수한 목재를 8시간 ~ 7일 동안 60 ~ 120℃의 온도에서 건조하는 제 8 공정 및 상기 건조한 목재의 표면을 샌딩처리하는 제 9 공정으로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명에 따라 제조된 황토목재는 산업적인 측면에서 황토의 원가가 저렴하여 원재료인 황토의 구입이 용이하며 취급시 안전하다는 장점이 있으며, 황토의 점성적 성질로 목재 내부의 융착이 용이하다는 장점이 있다. 
또한 환경적인 측면에서 황토를 사용함으로써 친환경적이며 습도조절능력이 뛰어나다는 효과가 있으며,목재와 함께 사용함으로써 통기성 및 축열성이 높으며 원적외선 방사로 인체 건강에 유익하며, 강력한 항균력으로 곰팡이 서식을 억제할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한 목재와 황토무기질 세라믹의 혼합으로 착화온도가 높아 화재 발생을 지연 또는 억제시키는 역할을 하며, 연소시 불꽃이 형성되지 않아 유독가스의 발생을 억제시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Device for providing emotional feedback service
title_ko: 감성 피드백 서비스 제공 장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emotion feedback service providing device can accurately diagnose a current emotion state of a user. The emotion feedback service providing device comprises: a DB unit for storing emotion determining reference information related to multiple types of state information representing an emotion state and multiple types of reference feature information generated by using a bio-signal for each emotion state; a receiving unit for receiving a bio-signal of a user from a sensor module which has a sensor sensing the bio-signal attached thereto and is worn by the user; an extracting unit for extracting feature information from the bio-signal of the user; and an information generating unit for generating current state information of the user by matching the extracted feature information and the emotion determining reference information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 감성 피드백 서비스 제공 장치는 감정 상태별 생체신호를 이용하여 생성된 복수 개 기준특징정보와 해당 감정 상태를 표상하는 복수 개의 상태정보가 연계된 감성판단 기준정보가 저장된 DB부; 생체신호를 감지하는 센서가 부착되며 사용자가 착용하는 센서모듈로부터 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 전송받는 수신부; 상기 사용자의 생체신호로부터 특징정보를 추출하는 추출부; 및 상기 추출된 특징정보와 상기 감성판단 기준정보의 매칭을 통하여 상기 사용자의 현재 상태정보를 생성하는 정보생성부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Electronic device capable of measuring biological signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정 가능한 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, an electronic device comprises: a housing including at least a conductive part; a display visually exposed to the outside through at least a part of the housing; a communication circuit electrically connected to the conductive part; a sensor electrically connected to the conductive part; a first blocking circuit connected between the conductive part and the communication circuit, and blocking a signal in a first frequency range; a second blocking circuit connected between the conductive part and the sensor, and blocking a signal in a second frequency range; and a processor operatively connected with the display, the communication circuit, and the sensor. The conductive part can be operated as an antenna of the communication circuit and a bio-signal measuring electrode of the sensor. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible. Therefore, a communication function and a biometric function of the electronic device can be efficiently provided.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 전도성 부분을 적어도 일부 포함하는 하우징, 상기 하우징의 적어도 일부를 통해 외부로 시각적으로 노출되는 디스플레이, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 통신 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 센서, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 통신 회로 사이에 연결되고, 제1 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제1 차단 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 센서 사이에 연결되고, 제2 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제2 차단 회로, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 통신 회로 및 상기 센서와 동작적으로(operatively) 연결된 프로세서를 포함할 수 있고, 상기 전도성 부분은 상기 통신 회로의 안테나 및 상기 센서의 생체 신호 측정 전극으로 동작하도록 구성될 수 있다.  이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Negative Pressure Clothing having portable negative pressure apparatus
title_ko: 휴대용 음압기가 구비된 음압복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to negative pressure clothing with a portable negative pressure device. The present invention comprises: a sensor unit which detects air pollution and fine dust indoors; a head unit which forms a penetrating unit on a front side and covers a face part; a body unit which is downwardly connected to the head unit, is combined to be separated, and covers a body; an earphone which is combined and provided to be wirelessly connected to a smartphone in the head unit; an oxygen supplying line which receives oxygen by allowing one end to be inserted into an inner space of a lower part of the head unit and allowing the other end to be exposed to the outside; an oxygen generating device which is installed in the other end of the oxygen supplying line and generates the oxygen; and a wearable type portable negative pressure device which discharges indoor contaminated air to the outside by lowering indoor air pressure below outdoor air pressure. The present invention can promote health.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 음압기가 구비된 음압복에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 실내에는 공기 오염도와 미세먼지를 검출하기 위한 센서부와 전면에는 투시부가 형성되며, 얼굴 부분을 감싸도록 하는 머리부와 상기 머리부와 하향으로 연결되며, 분리 가능하게 결합되어 몸을 감싸는 몸통부와 상기 머리부에는 스마트폰과 무선 연결되도록 하기 위해 결합, 구비되는 이어폰과 상기 머리부의 하부의 내부공간에 일단이 삽입되고 외부에 타단이 노출되어 산소가 유입되는 산소공급라인과 상기 산소공급라인의 타단에 설치되어 산소를 발생시키는 산소발생기와 실내의 공기 압력을 실외의 공기 압력보다 낮게 하여 내부의 오염된 공기를 실외로 배출시키는 웨어러블 형태의 휴대용 음압기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
