title_en: Arrangement for monitoring vitality data of a vehicle driver
abstract_en: The invention relates to an arrangement in a vehicle for monitoring vitality data of a vehicle driver (10). The arrangement has a sensor unit (01) which comprises a sensor, with a transmission unit (Tx) which generates a transmission signal and emits it in the direction of the vehicle driver (10) via an antenna (03), and with a receiving unit (Rx) which receives components of the transmission signal reflected by the vehicle driver (10) as reception signal via an antenna (04). A control unit controls the transmission and receiving units and extracts a vital signal, which corresponds to an organ movement representing the vitality of the vehicle driver (10). The control unit sends the vital signal to a vehicle control unit if the sensor unit (01) detects a change to the vitality data of the vehicle driver (10) beyond a predetermined limit value.

title_en: Wireless telemetry sensor system
abstract_en: The presently disclosed technique includes a multi-detector wearable medical sensor that combines biopotential, optical, temperature, acceleration, and acoustic measurement into a single device. It leverages sensor fusion and deep learning algorithms on device which allows it to directly monitor vital signs, physiological waveforms, and early warning of medical complications. One utility is the ability for the sensor to expand and adapt to several use cases. An expansion port and accessory cables allow the biopotential electrodes to step up or down for any combination of continuous 1-12L electrocardiography ("ECG") measurements. It can also measure fetal ECG with a different accessory cable, or electroencephalogram ("EEG") with another cable. The sensor has BLUETOOTH® Low Energy ("BLE"), Wireless Fidelity ("WIFI®"), Fifth Generation mobile network ("5G") Long Term Evolution Machine Type Communication ("LTE-M"), Near Field Communication ("NFC"), and Ultra Wideband ("UWB") radios. The sensor can also charge and communicate over Universal Serial Bus ("USB").

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Algorithmic approach for estimation of respiration and heart rates
abstract_en: One or more aspects of the disclosure relate to monitoring a resting subject's respiration and heart rate through an impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) radar in a noninvasive fashion, in order to infer the corresponding health status including heart rate and respiration rate. Any other reflectance technology may be used. These two cardiopulmonary vital signs are derived based on the processing of recorded waveforms that are collected by the IR-UWB radar or any other reflectance technology system, after getting reflected-off the resting subject's body or relevant body part. A novel algorithm that processes the recorded waveforms is proposed to extract these vitals' signals and, accordingly, estimate their rates. This algorithm includes at least three major stages: i) noise reduction, ii) respiration rate estimation, and iii) heart rate estimation. Furthermore, the algorithm addresses the effects of harmonics and intermodulation between the breathing and heartbeat signals without requiring the implementation of filters.

title_en: Non-contact respiration detection method based on CSI dynamic component rapid alignment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of respiration monitoring, and discloses a non-contact respiration detection method based on rapid alignment of a CSI dynamic component, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting wireless signal data transmitted by a WiFi transmitter in an indoor environment, and extracting CSI original data from the WiFi signal; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a CSI ratio signal by preprocessing original CSI data, removing static components and reducing noise, calculating a covariance matrix of the preprocessed data, obtaining a main direction by using a eigenvalue decomposition method, calculating an included angle between the main direction and the positive direction of an I axis, calculating an angle required to rotate for aligning the CSI ratio signal according to the polarity of a sample sum of the CSI ratio signal, and finally combining all the CSI ratio signal enhancement dynamic components to extract a breathing mode. The method solves the problem that the target is far away from the WiFi equipment, so that the breath cannot be detected, and improves the sensing range of the WiFi signal for detecting the breath.

title_en: Remote controller for measuring bio-signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 원격 제어 장치
abstract_ko: 원격 제어 장치(remote controller)가, 원격 제어 장치 상의 사용자 인식 모듈을 이용하여 사용자를 인식하고, 사용자가 등록된 사용자인지 여부에 대한 판단에 따라, 사용자의 생체 신호를 원격 제어 장치 상의 생체 신호 센서를 이용하여 측정하고, 측정된 생체 신호의 데이터를 표시 장치에게 전송하는, 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: A Life Detection System Using Radar Sensors with Anti-Misdetection Technology
title_ko: 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템은, 오탐지 요인을 제거하여 구조대원이 재난상황에 처한 사람의 위치를 정확히 파악하고 신속히 구조함은 물론 구조요원의 불필요한 위험지역 출동을 차단하여 구조요원의 안전을 도모하는 레이더 센서 기반의 재난구호 시스템을 제공하는데 목적이 있다.  
이에 따라, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템은, 하우징 형태로 시설물 내부의 다수 위치에 설치되고, 재난 발생 시 시설물 내부의 사람을 탐지하며, 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제센터와 구조요원의 스마트기기로 전달하는 다수의 인명탐지모듈; 다수의 인명탐지모듈과 통신망으로 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 취합하고 게이트웨이에 전달하는 다수의 중계기; 중계기와 통신망으로 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제시스템에 제공하는 다수의 게이트웨이; 시설물 내 관제실에 위치하여 재난 발생 시 시설물 내 재난통제시스템을 가동하고 게이트웨이와 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 수신하여 인명이 탐지되면 인명 구호시스템을 가동하는 관제서버; 및 시설물 외부 현장지휘본부에 위치하여 재난 발생 시 시설물 내 인명에 대한 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 수신하여 구호요원의 스마트기기에 전달하고 인명 구호시스템을 제어하는 로컬관제시스템;을 포함하되, 인명탐지모듈은, 레이더 센서로 구성되어 객체의 움직임과 위치를 탐지하고, 탐지데이터를 생성하여 신호처리부에 전달하는 레이더센서부; 탐지데이터를 수집하여 객체의 움직임, 위치, 크기, 속도를 계산하고 인명 여부를 해석한 후 분석데이터를 생성하는 신호처리부; 신호처리부에서 탐지데이터와 분석데이터를 전달받아 중계기로 전송하는 통신모듈부; 및 외부전원이 연결되고 내부 배터리로 구성되며 인명탐지모듈에 전원을 공급하는 전원부;를 하우징 내부에 포함하고, 신호처리부는, 다수의 비교대상 파라미터에 대한 탐지데이터 중 유효데이터로 측정된 파라미터의 종류가 기 설정한 판단기준값을 초과하면, 해당 객체는 사람인 것으로 간주하여 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제시스템에 제공하여 사람만 구호 대상에 포함되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Human presence detector and human presence detection method thereof
abstract_en: A human presence detector includes a microwave generator, a microwave receiver, a frequency mixing wave detector and a signal processor. The microwave generator is configured to emit and transmit a detecting microwave in a detection space. The microwave receiver is configured to receive a corresponding echo of the detecting microwave. The frequency mixing wave detector, linked to the microwave generator and the microwave receiver, is configured to perform a frequency mixing wave detection on the detecting microwave and the corresponding echo of the detecting microwave to output a primary detecting signal. The signal processor linked to the frequency mixing wave detector is configured to select a fluctuation signal at a predetermined frequency range in the primary detecting signal to amplify and output a secondary detecting signal. Accordingly, in response to the detection of the motion at the predetermined frequency range, a human (living) body is detected and determined in the detection space.

title_en: Direct RF signal processing for heart-rate monitoring using UWB impulse radar
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for direct radio frequency (RF) signal processing for heart rate (HR) monitoring using ultra-wide band (UWB) impulse radar are presented. A radar sensor is able to directly sample a received signal at RF which satisfies the Nyquist sampling rate, preserving a subject's vital sign information in the received signal. The vital sign information can be extracted directly from a raw RF signal and thus down conversion to a complex baseband is not required. The HR monitoring performance from the proposed direct RF signal processing technique provides an improvement in continuous HR monitoring as compared against existing methods using a complex baseband signal and/or other measurement techniques.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures by means of a ground-penetrating radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a plurality of radar signals for a region of ground, determining, based on the radar signals, a 3D point cloud, each point corresponding to one radar detection and being geolocated in space, searching for at least one set of substantially aligned points in the 3D point cloud by: i. for each straight line among a set of straight lines of the 3D space, determining the number of points of the 3D point cloud that are located at a distance smaller than a predetermined minimum distance from the straight line, ii. determining at least one straight line for which the number of points is higher than a predetermined minimum detection threshold, the points located at a distance from this straight line smaller than said minimum distance characterizing a longitudinal structure.

title_en: Meteorological service early warning device applied to karst landform scenic spot
abstract_en: A meteorological service early warning device applied to karst landform scenic spots relates to the technical field of meteorological service early warning and is used for improving accuracy of detection results of meteorological disasters caused by rainfall of the karst landform scenic spots. The meteorological service early warning device applied to karst landform scenic spots comprises a monitoring module, a data processing module and an early warning module, wherein the monitoring module comprises a displacement sensor, an inclination sensor, a soil humidity sensor and a pressure type water level sensor, the displacement sensor is arranged on a bedrock or a concrete base, the displacement sensor is used for monitoring displacement changes of the geologic body, the inclination sensor is attached to the surface of the geologic body, the inclination sensor is used for monitoring inclination conditions of the geologic body, the soil humidity sensor is buried in soil, the soil humidity sensor is used for measuring soil water content, the pressure type water level sensor is arranged in a karst cave ponding area, and the pressure type water level sensor is used for monitoring ponding amount of the karst cave ponding area.
assignees: Guanling Buyi and Miao Autonomous County Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Fire-prevention and invasion-prevention synchronous early warning system and signal processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-prevention and invasion-prevention synchronous early warning system based on an FBG (fiber bragg grating) sensing network, comprising such three modules as a sensing optical cable, an optical signal demodulating device and a central processing unit, wherein the sensing optical cable is hung on a perimeter fence or buried underground. By using the characteristics that an FBG sensor is sensitive to both the stress and the temperature and the stress and the temperature result in different wavelength change rules, namely, the FBG reflection wavelength fluctuates rapidly near the static value thereof due to the invasion and the reflection wavelength drifts slowly towards a certain direction due to temperature change, the different characteristics of the temperature and the stress are extracted by using a signal processing method, thus the invasion and the fire disaster are intelligently distinguished, and the corresponding prompting warning is given.

title_en: Human body target and surrounding structure compatibility detecting method based on UWB (Ultra Wideband) bio-radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body target and surrounding structure compatibility detecting method based on a UWB (Ultra Wideband) bio-radar, comprising the following steps: a preprocessing step A, a human body target detecting step B and a structure detecting step C. Since most of survivors pressed and buried in ruins after an earthquake and other disasters are buried in holes formed under the ruins is considered, a certain space is formed between the survivors and the ruins, and the medium in the space is air. The detection and identification are realized on the upper and lower interfaces of the holes according to the limited conditions and the human body target position information, so that more accurate and more comprehensive ruins structure information can be obtained in the follow-up study, and new thinking can be provided for the application and development of a UWB search and rescue bio-radar technology.

title_en: Consider the Ground Penetrating Radar diffraction stack imaging method and system of antenna radiation pattern
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Ground Penetrating Radar diffraction stack imaging method and system for considering antenna radiation pattern, this method includes the following steps: that dual-mode antenna and corresponding survey line are arranged on component to be measured, and dual-mode antenna carries out common offset B-Scan sampling along survey line；Extract received every one of echo-signal；Calculate the emitted antenna transmitting of electromagnetic wave, point scatter scattering and the received stroke of receiving antenna；When extracting the travelling of each imaging point electromagnetic wave of imaging space；The value range of imaging region and the sampling interval of pixel are set, is established when according to travelling and receives signal index；The electric field value of each imaging space point scattering is extracted according to index when travelling；Obtain the directional diagram of antenna in radar system；Diffraction stack migration is corrected, by the imaging space point scattering electric field value superposition calculated per reception data together as the imaging results after offset.The present invention introduces radiation pattern in offset imaging method, improves imaging precision and imaging effect to buried target.

title_en: Fall detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tumble detection method based on a millimeter wave radar, which belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar detection and specifically comprises all the methods described in the right 1-8; according to the invention, the millimeter wave radar is adopted to obtain the three-dimensional geometrical posture data information of the target personnel in the region easy to fall, and the influence of external illumination change and imaging distance is small; and after statistics and analysis learning, the posture of the target person is identified and judged, so that the accuracy of vital sign detection and judgment is continuously improved, meanwhile, the target fall time and the area where the target fall time is located are uploaded to a remote server, and the remote server sends the target fall time and the area where the target fall time is located to a monitoring terminal so that the monitoring person can realize remote fall detection on the target person.
assignees: ZHENJIANG TONGRUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sensor installation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To bury a sensor in the seafloor with high positional accuracy in a manner that ensures measurement accuracy.SOLUTION: A sensor installation method: moves an excavation steel pipe 200, for installing an earthquake measurement device therein, to a predetermined position on the seafloor to bury the earthquake measurement device by using an unmanned submersible capable of moving on the seafloor; excavates the seafloor below the excavation steel pile 200 while pressing the same onto the seafloor and removes excavated surplus soil outside the excavated steel pile 200 through an upper face thereof in a manner that an internal space of the excavation steel pile 200 extends downward in an almost vertical direction using an excavation control function as well as a surplus soil removal function mounted on the unmanned submersible; inserts the earthquake measurement device in the internal space of the excavation steel pile 200 buried in the seafloor using the unmanned submersible; and fills soil in a space between an inner surface of the excavation steel pile 200 and a surface of the earthquake measurement device as well as a space between a bottom surface of a burial hole and the earthquake measurement device using a soil spreading function mounted on the unmanned submersible.

title_en: Contactless sensor circuit
title_ko: 비접촉식 센서 회로
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A contactless sensor circuit is provided to activate bioelectric signal measurement field by performing a contactless measuring operation for signals without an electrolyte electrode. CONSTITUTION: A measuring electrode is capacitevly coupled with a measuring target(102). A coupling electric-condenser(112) is in serial connection with the measuring electrode. A first amplifier(106) includes a first negative inputting terminal(106b) and a first positive inputting terminal(106a). The first positive inputting terminal is in connection with the capacitive electric condenser. The first amplifier includes self-inputted resistance and self-electrostatic capacitance(Ci).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉식 센서 회로를 제공한다. 이 센서 회로는 측정 대상과 전기적, 물리적으로 비접촉하여 측정 대상의 전위를 측정할 수 있다. 이 센서 회로는  측정 대상과 축전 결합하는 측정 전극, 측정 전극과 직렬 연결되는 결합 축전기, 제1 음의 입력단 및 결합 축전기에 연결된 제1 양의 입력단을 포함하고 측정 신호를 제1 양의 입력단으로 입력받아 측정 신호를 증폭하여 제1 출력단으로 출력하는 제1 증폭기, 및 제1 노드와 상기 제1 출력단 사이에 연결되어 입력 임피던스를 증가시키는 임피던스 회로부를 포함하되, 제1 증폭기는 자체 입력 저항(Ri) 및 자체 정전용량(Ci)를 포함하고, 결합 축전기의 결합 정전용량은 측정 대상과 측정 전극에 의하여 형성된 등가 정전 용량보다 작을 수 있다. 
       
     비접촉 센서, 전위 센서, 생체 신호 증폭기, 고입력 임피던스, 저입력 커패시턴스

title_en: Sensor attachable bio signal transmitter
title_ko: 센서의 탈부착이 가능한 생체신호 발신기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-signal transmitter having a detachable sensor is provided to improve accuracy of bio-signal measurement and to replace a detachable sensor unit. CONSTITUTION: A bio-signal transmitter(100) includes a main body(110), a strap(120) and a detachable sensor unit(130). The main body wirelessly transmits a signal. The strap is connected with both sides of the main body and is supported by a user's wrist. The detachable sensor unit measures a user bio-signal, transmits to the main body and is detachably connected with the main body from the inner side of the strap. The main body judges an emergency state through a measured user bio-signal in the detachable sensor unit and transmits a wireless signal notifying an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서의 탈부착이 가능한 생체신호 발신기에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 생체신호 발신기는 무선으로 신호를 송출하는 본체; 상기 본체의 양측에 결합되며 상기 본체를 사용자의 손목에 지지시켜주는 착용줄; 및 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하여 상기 본체로 전달하며 상기 착용줄 내측에서 상기 본체에 착탈 가능하게 결합되는 착탈식 센서부;를 포함하며, 상기 본체는 상기 착탈식 센서부에서 측정된 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 통해 위급상황을 판단하고 위급상황을 알리는 무선 신호를 송출할 수 있다. 이에 따라 생체신호 발신기를 손목에 착용하면 착용줄 내측에 위치한 착탈식 센서부의 센서가 착용줄의 조임에 의해 손목에 완전하게 밀착될 수 있으며, 따라서 더욱 정확하게 생체신호를 측정할 수가 있다. 더불어 착탈식 센서부의 교체가 가능하여 다른 종류의 센서를 적용시킬 수가 있다.
assignees: OHSUNG E R S TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and Method for measuring physiological signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An apparatus for measuring a physiological signal includes a battery cover which covers a region to and from which a battery of a terminal device is attached and detached, a sensor unit which senses the physiological signal included in the battery cover, and a control unit which controls the sensor unit to sense the physiological signal. The apparatus for measuring the physiological signal is attached to and detached from the terminal device by attaching and detaching the battery cover to and from the terminal device.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 생체 신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 단말 장치의 배터리를 탈부착할 수 있는 영역을 커버하기 위한 배터리 커버; 배터리 커버에 포함된 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 센서부가 생체 신호를 감지하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 배터리 커버가 단말 장치와 탈부착됨으로써 단말 장치와 탈부착될 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체 신호 측정 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Mouse having human health monitoring function
title_ko: 지식근로자의 건강상태 모니터링 기능을 가지는 마우스와 이를 포함하는 컴퓨터장치 및 스마트기기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mouse having a knowledge worker health state monitoring function, and a computer device including the same, and a smart device linked thereto to be operated. More specifically, the mouse used as a pointing device of a computer device includes a first sensor capable of measuring blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulses or heartbeats of a user and a second sensor capable of measuring skin conductance (EDA) of a user. A measured biosignal is compared with previously stored data to be shown to monitor the health state of knowledge workers who use a computer device and a mouse for a long time at all times.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지식근로자의 건강상태 모니터링 기능을 가지는 마우스와 이를 포함하는 컴퓨터장치 및 이와 연동되어 작동될 수 있는 스마트기기에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게로는, 컴퓨터장치의 포인팅 장치로 사용되는 마우스에 사용자의 혈중 산소포화도(SpO2)와 맥박 또는 심박을 측정할 수 있는 제1센서 및 사용자의 피부전도도(EDA)를 측정할 수 있는 제2센서를 포함하도록 하고, 측정되는 생체신호를 이전에 저장된 데이터와 비교하여 보여주도록 함으로써, 장시간 동안 컴퓨터장치 및 마우스를 이용하는 지식근로자들의 건강상태를 상시 모니터링할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Non-contact vital-sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A non-contact vital-sign monitoring system having a radar disposed in vicinity of a monitored subject includes a data buffer storing output signals of the radar sampled in sequence during a predetermined period; a status classifier determining status of the monitored subject; and a vital-sign detector determining a vital sign of the monitored subject according to the output signals of stationary status.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Integrated steering wheel sensors for driver safety and health monitoring
abstract_en: A steering wheel system is disclosed for monitoring a driver's vital signs of a driver. The steering wheel system comprises a steering wheel and sensors integrated into the steering wheel. The sensors are configured to detect one or more driver vital signs. The steering wheel system comprises a memory storing computer executable instructions, and a processor configured to execute the computer executable instructions. The processor receives the one or more vital signs from the array of sensors, wherein the one or more vital signs correspond to cortisol levels, alcohol levels, one or more proteins associated with an occurrence stroke, one or more biomarkers associated with myocardial infarctions, temperature, pulse rate, and oxygen levels. The processor determines a health risk of the driver based at least in part on the vital signs and alerts the driver in response to the health risk exceeding a certain health risk level.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to vital sign monitoring systems. The present invention relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system may include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system is capable of operating in one or more modes of operation such as, for example, a capacitance measurement mode, an electrical measurement mode, a piezoelectric measurement mode, a temperature measurement mode, an acceleration measurement mode, an impedance measurement mode, and a standby mode. Based on the measurements, the monitoring system may analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and advice to the user, and/or may adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system is also capable of analyzing the sleep of the user without having to directly contact or attach an uncomfortable probe to the user and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., medical facility).

title_en: Apparatus for mapping buried object and ground cavity through electromagneticwave analysis
title_ko: 전자기파 분석을 통한 지하구조물과 공동형상 맵핑장치 및 그 맵핑방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 지표상의 특정 탐사구간에서 제1방향으로 이동하는 이동부; 상기 탐사구간의 지반으로 지향성 전자기파를 송신하고, 지하구조물로부터 반사되는 반사파를 수신하는 지표투과레이더; 및 상기 특정 탐사구간에서의 상기 지표투과레이더의 제1지점에서 상기 지하구조물의 특정 반사점으로부터 최단경로로 반사되는 제1반사파와, 제2지점에서 상기 동일 특정 반사점으로부터 반사되는 제2반사파를 추출하여, 상기 특정 반사점의 길이와 심도를 연산하여 좌표를 산출하고, 상기 이동부의 이동에 따른 상기 지표투과레이더의 제1 및 제2지점을 특정 탐사진행간격만큼 연속적으로 변경하여 상기 특정 반사점의 분포좌표를 분석하여서, 상기 지하구조물의 길이와 심도와 형상을 맵핑하여 평가하는 제어부;를 포함하여, 상기 지하구조물의 구체적인 형상 및 크기를 평가하는, 전자기파 분석을 통한 지하구조물과 공동형상 맵핑장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Lodging vehicle smog fire protection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model provides lodging vehicle smog fire protection alarm device, including lodging vehicle, feature further include：Signal processor（MCU）Temperature detection scan device I, II, III, infrared temperature detects the condition pickoffs I, II of scanning strip human life detection non-process, phonetic alarm, it is connect by conducting wire with signal processor, audio alert is carried out when being connected to the audio alert signal of signal processor, when nobody is engaged in cooking activity and deck occupant smokes, the two sector scanning signal operation principles are identical with electrical heating region and front and back bed sensor scanning work principle, signal processor alarm（At displays temperature exception electric appliance）And signal audio alert is sent, vehicle occupant handles it to abnormal immediately, can avoid fire in time to lodging vehicle burning things which may cause a fire disaster automatic early-warning on fire, ensure passenger life and property safety.

title_en: Individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with a vital sign monitoring system, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a reinforcing ring is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the equipment main body, a fixing strip is arranged on one side of the equipment main body, a display screen and a buzzer are arranged on the front side of the fixing strip, a water storage tank is embedded in the bottom of the equipment main body, the water storage tank consists of a water diversion mechanism, a water absorption layer and a pull buckle, the water absorption layer is inserted into the bottom of the water storage tank, the water diversion mechanism is arranged on the upper part of the water absorption layer, the pull buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the water absorption layer, an inner cavity is arranged on the inner side of the equipment main body, a sweat detection sensor and a liquid collection rod are arranged on the side surface of the inner cavity, a monitoring system is arranged in the equipment main body, and the individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with the vital sign monitoring system is characterized, Blood pressure detection module and heart rate detection module carry out comprehensive control to temperature, blood pressure and heart rate.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Vital sign detection device based on distributed millimeter wave radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vital sign detection device based on a distributed millimeter wave radar technology, which comprises a first radar module, at least two second radar modules and a motor driving module, wherein the first radar module, the at least two second radar modules and the motor driving module are arranged on a main body, the second radar modules are connected with the first radar module, the first radar module is connected with the motor driving module, the main body is used for monitoring sleep quality of a plurality of users, the second radar module is used for acquiring vital sign data of each user and sending the vital sign data to the first radar module, the first radar module is used for comparing the vital sign data of each user detected and the vital sign data of each user with preset vital sign threshold values, judging sleep quality of each user and controlling the motor driving module according to the sleep quality of each user so as to adjust lifting heights of different positions of the main body through the motor driving module. The scheme improves the detection precision of the multi-user vital sign detection information.
assignees: JINGHUA INTELLIGENT PERCEPTION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensory system for preventing occupational disease in a work environment and method of using the same
abstract_en: The present application relates to a multisensory system for preventing occupational diseases in a work environment, the multisensory system comprising: -a protective mask for application in the front region of a human face, including the nose and mouth regions, and comprising: -temperature and humidity sensors (5, 6) for being driven when the mask is worn and for providing time-dependent data on said driving and temperature and humidity values; -a removable air filter element (3, 4) applied to the front portion of the mask; -an inhalation valve (8) and an exhalation valve (7) applied in the front region of the mask in front of the mouth when the mask is worn; -an element (2, 9, 10, 11, 12) for fixing the mask on the face; -an electronic nose device (3) for providing time-dependent data on the air quality in the working environment when worn by a person; -a respiration detection arrangement for providing time-dependent data on the respiration rate when worn by a person; -data processing and display means for receiving and storing data output by said protective mask, electronic nose device and breath detection device, and for processing and displaying said data in order to determine the state in which said protective mask needs to be worn.

title_en: GNSS and gyroscope fused high-precision geological disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-precision geological disaster monitoring system with a GNSS and a gyroscope integrated, which comprises a plurality of monitoring stations arranged at monitoring points, wherein each monitoring station comprises a positioning monitoring pile and a plurality of sensors buried under the ground, each positioning monitoring pile comprises a positioning assembly, a pile body and a control assembly, each positioning assembly comprises a gyroscope, a GNSS antenna and a circuit board, each circuit board comprises an OEM board and an MEMS accelerometer, each GNSS antenna is connected with the OEM board to receive positioning information of a satellite navigation system, each control assembly comprises a storage battery, a data acquisition front end, a data conversion circuit, an MCU data processing circuit and a communication module, the data acquisition front end acquires the positioning information of the sensors buried under the ground, the gyroscopes, the MEMS accelerometers and the satellite navigation system, data is transmitted to an operation center through the communication module, the operation center calculates monitoring results, and the monitoring large screen displays field monitoring results, and sending the early warning alarm information and the early warning place geographic coordinate information to terminal equipment of related management personnel.

title_en: Multi-feature fusion fatigue monitoring and identifying method for pole climbing operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fatigue monitoring and identifying method for multi-feature fusion of pole climbing operation, which is characterized in that a hardware facility is arranged in a power dispatching center, a human body infrared video is collected, human body infrared video data are sent to a background server in real time, the human body infrared video data are analyzed and divided into single-frame pictures, the single-frame pictures are input into a trained deep learning model, an action prediction result is output, a respiration index and a heart rate index are detected by a vital sign monitoring module based on a UWB radar to obtain the respiration index and heart rate index results, a LVQ-BP artificial neural network is adopted for feature index fusion to form a comprehensive fatigue index, whether a human body is in a fatigue state or not is judged according to the comprehensive fatigue index, the method can monitor the body state of a worker in the power dispatching center in real time, has high accuracy, and guarantees the safety of power operation and the life safety of the worker, thereby reducing the incidence of accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG PROVINCE FENGHUA DISTR POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Breathing abnormity detection method based on frequency domain analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of respiratory signal abnormity identification, and discloses a respiratory abnormity detection method based on frequency domain analysis, which comprises the following steps: sending electromagnetic waves to the chest cavity of the human body by using the radio frequency sensor, receiving echo signals returned by the electromagnetic waves, and processing the echo signals to obtain respiratory signals of the human body; denoising the respiratory signal based on the wavelet entropy; converting the respiratory signal subjected to noise reduction processing into frequency domain representation by using a fast Fourier transform method; and constructing a breathing abnormity detection model based on a random forest algorithm, and inputting the frequency domain representation of the breathing signal into the breathing abnormity detection model to obtain a breathing abnormity detection result. The method realizes the frequency domain representation of the breathing signal based on the wavelet entropy and the fast Fourier transform, realizes the breathing abnormity detection by combining the frequency domain representation result by utilizing the random forest method, and realizes the long-time and continuous breathing detection based on the radio frequency sensor.
assignees: HUNAN WANMAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and computer equipment for recognizing vital signs of multiple human body targets
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and computer equipment for identifying vital signs of multiple human body targets, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a region to be detected by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo matrix corresponding to the region, and filtering static clutter in the radar echo matrix; calculating the arrangement entropy value of each range gate corresponding to the slow time sequence in the radar echo matrix; determining an initial range gate region where the human body target is located according to each arrangement entropy value; determining the number of the human body targets and the positions of the human body targets according to the initial distance gate area where the human body targets are located; and according to the position of each human body target, extracting the body surface vibration signal of each human body target from the radar echo matrix for filtering the static clutter and respectively identifying each human body target. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the KMeans + + clustering algorithm and the HOC algorithm are utilized to identify the vital signs of the multi-human body target, so that the identification efficiency, accuracy and intelligent degree are improved, and further, the guarantee is provided for timely and effective rescue.

title_en: Method and device for inversion of scattering measurement of buried targets in internal and external fields
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for inversion of scattering measurement of buried targets in an inner field and an outer field, wherein the method comprises an operation computer, a vector network analyzer, a power amplifier, a receiving and transmitting antenna and a bracket which are sequentially connected, a box with a low scattering film material is arranged below the receiving and transmitting antenna, a microwave darkroom is arranged at the periphery of the box, and a layer of wedge-shaped wave absorbing material is paved on the inner wall of the microwave darkroom; collecting soil of a target field to be measured and preparing an experimental model; placing the buried target in soil for measurement, calculation and analysis and collecting parameter values; writing an initial neural network, and inverting buried target parameters; substituting the measured experimental data into a neural network to obtain a trained neural network model under the soil; the invention has the characteristics that the FDTD method and the BP neural network are used as core algorithms, and the electromagnetic scattering measurement and the machine learning method are utilized to jointly solve the problem of carrying out scattering measurement on the buried target.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar heart rate detection method based on adaptive clutter filtering
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave radar heart rate detection method based on adaptive clutter filtering. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, a millimeter wave radar life detection system acquires an intermediate frequency signal data matrix containing target human body respiratory heartbeat signals, and the intermediate frequency signal data matrix is preprocessed to obtain unwrapped signals and vital sign phase information; step two, extracting heart beat signals from vital sign phase information; thirdly, training the state of the heartbeat signal in the database, constructing a wavelet scattering-long-short-time memory network, and judging the state of the heartbeat signal in the second step; selecting a reference noise vector corresponding to the state of the heartbeat signal, and constructing a self-adaptive filter of a recursive least square method to filter the reference noise to obtain a pure heartbeat signal; fifthly, performing fast Fourier transform to perform heart rate estimation on the pure heartbeat signals. The application has the advantages of small operand, high measurement precision, strong stability and real-time realization.

title_en: Safety monitoring method, system and terminal for ultra-deep buried high-ground-stress hydraulic tunnel
abstract_en: The application relates to a safety monitoring method, a system and a terminal for a hydraulic tunnel with ultra-deep buried high ground stress, belonging to the technical field of safety monitoring of hydraulic tunnels, wherein the safety monitoring method comprises the following steps: acquiring construction information of a hydraulic tunnel to be monitored, wherein the construction information comprises lining structure information and surrounding rock type information; searching hydraulic tunnel information which is matched with the hydraulic tunnel construction information to be monitored and is monitored in a history; if the information is found, an image set associated with the hydraulic tunnel information is called, wherein the image set comprises a normal image subset, an interference image subset and an abnormal image subset; acquiring a detection image of a geological radar when the hydraulic tunnel to be monitored is detected; comparing the detection images with the images in the image set respectively to generate a comparison result; and classifying the detection images according to the image set according to the comparison result. The application has the beneficial effect of reducing the labor capacity of staff.
assignees: SHANDONG WATER CONSERVANCY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based driver state point cloud detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a driver state point cloud detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radar and comprises the following steps: acquiring a target data matrix, wherein the target data matrix is formed by a target vital sign signal of a target driver dynamically measured by a multi-transmission multi-reception MIMO-FMCW millimeter wave radar based on a preset measurement distance; determining a distance unit by combining the position of the target part and the radar distance resolution, and performing Fourier transform on the target data matrix to obtain a target motion three-dimensional point cloud; analyzing and constructing a target space diagram; carrying out normal estimation on hidden space among continuous frames on the target space diagram to obtain a target continuous frame point cloud; and carrying out state evaluation on the target driver according to the target dense point cloud obtained by carrying out multi-frame fusion processing on the target continuous frame point cloud. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional driver state monitoring method often depends on vision or sensor data, and has the defects of limited vision, large environmental interference, large difficulty in complex scene recognition and the like.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on SVMD and harmonic estimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection and discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on SVMD and harmonic estimation, which comprises the steps of placing a millimeter wave radar at the position right in front of a detected human body, collecting an IF signal, obtaining the distance between the millimeter wave radar and the detected human body in a field of view according to the IF signal, and determining the position of a target human body in an area; selecting candidate distance units adjacent to the target human body according to the phase information of the IF signals, carrying out principal component analysis by combining the distance units of the target human body and the phase information of the IF signals in the candidate distance units, extracting vital sign signals, decomposing the vital sign signals to reconstruct to obtain respiratory signals, heartbeat signals and heartbeat harmonic signals, and carrying out frequency spectrum estimation and correction on the reconstructed signals to obtain final respiratory estimated values and heartbeat estimated values. The invention can effectively strengthen and extract vital sign signals and realize accurate estimation of respiration and heartbeat.

title_en: Crib health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crib health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar and comprises the following steps of starting the millimeter wave radar, entering a detection mode, judging whether an infant is on a crib, performing multi-frame accumulation after entering a crib state, judging whether the heart rate of the current infant is normal, judging whether the breath of the current infant is normal, judging whether the infant moves greatly, starting sleep recording in a time unit after the infant meets a sleep threshold, performing sleep cycle analysis on the infant, evaluating the respiratory health quality and sleep quality of the infant, and transmitting the result to a mobile terminal of a parent. The invention realizes real-time vital sign monitoring of the crib to the baby based on the millimeter wave radar, can detect the breathing and heartbeat data of the baby in the crib, monitor whether the baby moves greatly, can record the sleeping condition of the baby, and can improve the monitoring capacity of the crib in the actual use process.
assignees: FURUI ZHIXING INTELLIGENT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Sleep apnea detection method and system based on microwave radar and microphone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep apnea detection method and system based on a microwave radar and a microphone, wherein the method and the system comprise the following steps of radar data processing, S11, S12, receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching for the position of a human body, S13, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching for a respiration detection area, S13, receiving radar signals returned by respiration detection, extracting and recording respiration waveforms from the radar signals, audio data processing, S21, capturing audio data through the microphone, identifying whether the audio data accords with the characteristics of snore, judging that the audio data comprises snore if the audio data comprises the snore, recording the snore, and judging that the sleep apnea is detected if the sound characteristics corresponding to the sleep apnea exist in the snore and the respiration characteristics corresponding to the sleep apnea exist in the respiration waveforms.

title_en: Lightweight human body behavior recognition method and system based on ultra-wideband radar in complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light human body behavior recognition method and system based on ultra-wideband radar in a complex environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an echo matrix of human body behaviors by collecting through-wall human body behavior experimental data, preprocessing the echo matrix to obtain a processed echo matrix, obtaining a TDM data set based on the processed echo matrix, and inputting the TDM data set into a constructed recognition model to complete human body behavior recognition in the complex environment. The invention can effectively remove wall clutter in echo signals, improve adaptability in complex environments, enhance time-frequency representation capability of human behavior characteristics, and adopt an improved ShuffleNetV feature extraction module. The model can improve the accuracy and the robustness of human behavior recognition, thereby realizing a lighter and efficient radar behavior recognition system.

title_en: High-resolution radar through-wall imaging method based on fusion of various communication signals and spatial frequency spectrum shifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution microwave through-wall imaging method based on multi-system communication signal fusion and spatial spectrum shifting of a cellular base station, which is oriented to a sense-of-general integrated application scene. The method comprehensively utilizes the spectrum resources of a plurality of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) communication signals coexisting in the cellular base station, introduces a spatial spectrum shift imaging method, and combines a wall structure path compensation algorithm to realize high-resolution imaging of a target. The invention is based on the transmission and receiving architecture of the distributed cellular base station, integrates the advantages of various OFDM signals and the resolution of spatial spectrum shifting, effectively overcomes the defects of the existing through-wall imaging technology in the aspects of low resolution, fuzzy target contour and the like, and obviously improves the imaging definition and the target identification accuracy. The method realizes high-resolution through-wall imaging by using the base station communication signals, is suitable for through-wall detection scenes such as security monitoring and anti-terrorism search and rescue in cities, and has important significance for improving the imaging performance of the through-wall radar and the scene capability of the through-wall radar in practical application.

title_en: A detection method of sleepiness
title_ko: 졸음 감지방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A detection method of sleepiness is provided to compensate noises signal due to an action of a body by using a Doppler radar mode and an optical system mode of using the light source / optical detector, so extracting a heartbeat and a respiratory signal accurately. CONSTITUTION: In a detection method of sleepiness, in a Doppler radar and the optical system mode of using the light source / optical detector, each detection signal is applied to a amplifier(2000). Noises are removed from the detection signal and the detection signal is amplified. The output signal is applied to a central processing unit(3000) to perform signal processing of the output signal and mix processed signal. If a value of subtraction of a counted valued before two minutes and a counted valued before one minute is between 2~10 pr -2 ~-10 and this value is detected twice or ten times, an alarm and vibration is outputted through a output unit(4000).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 졸음 감지방법에 관한 것으로, 특히 신체의 움직임 하에서도 심장박동 검출이 가능하도록 도플러 레이더의 원리를 이용한 방식과 광원/광검출기를 이용한 광학계 방식을 혼용하여 사용함으로써 대상 신체에 접촉함이 없이 심장박동 및 호흡의 신호를 검출하는 제1 단계와; 상기 도플러 레이더의 원리를 이용한 방식과 광원/광검출기를 이용한 광학계 방식에서의 각 상기 검출 신호를 각각의 증폭부에 인가하여 신호 잡음을 제거하고 증폭하는 제2 단계와; 상기 제2 단계의 출력 신호를 각각 중앙처리부에 인가하여 신호처리 및 상기 신호처리된 각 신호를 합성하는 제3 단계; 및 상기 제3 단계에서 출력된 출력 값을 카운트하고, 상기 출력 값을 모니터링한 과거 2분전의 상기 카운트 값에 과거 1분전의 상기 카운트 값을 차감한 값이 2 내지 10 범위 또는 -2 내지 -10 범위에 있고, 상기 2 내지 10 범위 또는 -2 내지 -10 범위의 값이 시간이 흐름에 따라 동일 상기 범위 권내를 연속적으로 2번 내지 10번 검출되면, 출력부를 통해 경보음이나 멘트 또는 진동을 출력하는 제4 단계;로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 졸음 감지방법에 관한 것이다. 
      따라서, 본 발명은 사용자가 졸림 현상이 올 때 심박수가 느려지고 호흡수가 느려지는 현상을 상기 심박센서로 감지하고 졸음이 올 때 경보 또는 진동을 발생하여 자각증상을 회복시켜 졸음 운전에 대한 사고 예방하는 이점이 있다.

title_en: System and method for detecting vital signs using imaging-assisted radar
title_ko: 촬영 보조형 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for detecting vital signs using imaging-assisted radar. The system for detecting vital signs according to an embodiment comprises: an imaging part for imaging an object; at least one radar transmission part for transmitting radar signals to the object; at least two radar reception parts for receiving radar signals reflected on different body parts of the object, respectively; and a processing part for detecting vital signs having noise, which is caused by the movement of the object, using weight for each body part of the object and the radar signals reflected on different body parts. According to an embodiment, noise caused by the movement of an object can be actively removed by the assistance of an imaging device, thereby improving the accuracy of detecting vital signs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 촬영 보조형 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 검출 시스템은, 대상을 촬영하기 위한 촬영부; 상기 대상을 향해 레이더 신호를 송신하기 위한 적어도 하나의 레이더 송신부; 상기 대상의 서로 다른 신체부위에서 반사된 레이더 신호를 각각 수신하기 위한 적어도 두 개의 레이더 수신부; 및 대상의 신체부위별 가중치와 서로 다른 신체부위에서 반사된 레이더 신호를 이용하여, 상기 대상의 움직임에 의한 노이즈가 제거된 생체 신호를 검출하는 처리부를 포함한다. 실시예에 따르면 촬영장치의 보조를 통해 대상의 움직임에 의한 노이즈를 능동적으로 제거함으로써 생체 신호의 검출 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Matrix-type three-dimensional-layered landslide monitoring and early-warning system
abstract_en: A matrix-type three-dimensional-layered landslide monitoring and early-warning system characterized in that: the system consists of stand-alone positioning sensors (1), and a relay station (2) and a monitoring center (3) in proximity to the stand-alone positioning sensors. The stand-alone positioning sensors are buried vertically in positions in a mountain requiring monitoring. The stand-alone positioning sensors are each provided with a radio module, a battery (1-7), and a positioning response device. A wireless signal transmitted by the stand-alone positioning sensors (1) is received and retransmitted by the relay station to the monitoring center (3) reception system. The advantages of the early-warning system are: the early-warning system has a long life, allows for automatic remote monitoring, has a simple structure, has accurate early-warning capabilities, and does not consume energy during periods of inactivity. The stand-alone positioning sensors remain hidden from sight and are not easily damaged. The early-warning system minimizes losses caused by natural disasters such as landslides, mudslides, and sand dune movements.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: A body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient featuring a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: System, method and computer program product for remote measurement of vital signs
abstract_en: A system for measuring medical data characterizing a subject to be monitored, the system including radar sensor/s and/or electro-optical sensor/s. The medical data, which may include pulse and/or respiratory rate and/or temperature of the subject to be monitored, are measured remotely, thereby providing standoff detection and reducing risk of infection to medical personnel.

title_en: A system and method for through-wall imaging
abstract_en: An antenna array (100) for through wall imaging includes a plurality of antennas (102) configured to transmit and receive a plurality of signals to and from, respectively, a plurality of targets (90) across an obstruction (95); and a plurality of interference restricting elements (104) interposed between the plurality of antennas (102), wherein the plurality of interference restricting elements (104) are configured to reduce interference of the plurality of signals among the plurality of antennas (102) based upon microwave absorption. An imaging device (106) for through wall imaging includes the antenna array (100); a transceiver unit (108) communicably coupled to the antenna array (100); and a control unit (110) communicably coupled to the antenna array (100) and the transceiver unit (108). The imaging device (106) is communicably coupled to a through wall imaging system (112) configured for reconstructing a scene based upon identification of the targets (90) behind the obstruction (95).

title_en: Intelligent through-obstruction 3d imaging system using uwb electromagnetic sensing for object detection
abstract_en: Herein disclosed a system and method to utilize information from imaging sensor and UWB sensor to perform object recognition, object tracking, activity recognition, vital sign detection, and 3D image reconstruction through any obstruction. This proposed invention uses deep learning algorithm and neural network to perform feature extraction of image data and signal data, identify depth estimation, recognize object and track its activity, and construct a 3D model of the object even though the object is not visible or overlapped with other objects.

title_en: Registered multi-layer underground and surface images in land surveys
abstract_en: A method of land surveying that electronically registers together multi-layer underground and surface images of a surface volume with buried utilities and other infrastructures. Such method further comprises assembling and presenting the combition to a device in the field that visually guides crews in their safe digging of the ground nearby. The orienting, scaling, and registering of a first image layer is to a standardized orientation and scaling on a map of a photograph of a land surface from a zenith point in space above. Then the orienting, scaling, and registering of a second image layer is made to the standardized orientation and scaling on the map. This layer is a result of an ground penetrating radar investigation of buried objects point-by-point in an immediate search area of a corresponding ground surface. Underground buried objects and utilities are thereby located to make safe digging nearby.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Using wifi-signal based, device-free human presence detection technology to identify humans consuming media content
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method includes detecting a presence of a subject in a vicinity of radio transceivers based on radio signal strength variations received at an input of the radio transceivers as a radio signature, so as to recognize the presence of the subject in an indoor environment by analyzing and quantifying irregularities in the radio signature, wherein the detecting the presence does not incorporate sensors for subject detection, and only performs the detecting based on radio irregularity phenomenon, without modifying the indoor environment; and mixing the detected presence of the subject with viewership datasets derived from an audience measurement source, to generate rich result datasets that provide insights on media exposure at a personal and household level, and to assign personal viewership insights to the household audience observation, without sacrificing personal privacy of the subject, and without requiring additional hardware or detection signals.
assignees: FREE STREAM MEDIA CORP DBA SAMBA TV

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluation of a subject's emotional, physiological and/or physical state with the subject's physiological and/or acoustic data
abstract_en: Embodiments of the subject invention relate to a method and apparatus for remote evaluation of a subject's emotive and/or physiological state. Embodiments can utilize a device that can be used to determine the emotional and/or physiological state of a subject through the measurement and analysis of vital signs and/or speech. A specific embodiment relates to a device capable of remotely acquiring a subject's physiological and/or acoustic data, and then correlating and analyzing the data to provide an assessment of a subject's emotional and/or physiological state. In a further specific embodiment, the device can acquire such data, correlate and analyze the data, and provide the assessment of the subject's emotional state and/or physiological in real time.
assignees: UNIV FLORIDA;SHRIVASTAV RAHUL;LIN JENSHAN;ZAWOY KARL;PATEL SONA

title_en: Multi-person positioning and vital sign detection method and system based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person positioning and vital sign detection method and system based on an FMCW radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: correcting the amplitude and the phase of echo signals of each channel; weighting the corrected signals at each search angle by using a guide vector to obtain echo signals of corresponding angles; calculating a distance dimension FFT for each echo signal, and inhibiting interference of a stationary object; performing constant false alarm rate processing to obtain distance and angle information of each human target; solving an optimal direction diagram weight vector for forming main lobes at each expected human body target angle and forming nulls in other human body target angle intervals; weighting each channel signal respectively, and calculating a distance dimension FFT; and extracting respiration and heartbeat signals of each human target according to the phase information of the range gate of the target. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, and can accurately judge the distance and angle information of a plurality of human targets positioned in different or same distance doors and extract corresponding respiration and heartbeat signals.

title_en: Living body detection method, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a life body detection method, a terminal and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method is applied to millimeter wave radar and comprises the following steps: acquiring distance dimension data of a millimeter wave radar; intercepting through preset effective distance range distance dimension data to obtain a target index corresponding to a maximum peak value in intercepted data; according to the target index, N adjacent distance detection units taking a distance detection unit corresponding to the target index as a center are obtained, and amplitude difference data of distance dimension data of the distance detection unit at the kth moment and the kth-1 moment in continuous N moments are sequentially obtained; windowing and fast Fourier transformation are carried out on amplitude difference data corresponding to any distance detection unit, so as to obtain a frequency spectrum corresponding to the distance detection unit; and judging whether a target exists at the nth moment according to the frequency spectrums corresponding to the N distance detection units. The application can improve the life detection precision.

title_en: Method and system for extracting and identifying embedded target based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for extracting and identifying a buried target based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the field of disaster relief and multi-source data fusion and can be used for carrying out horizontal fusion and vertical fusion on multi-source data related to disaster, wherein disaster information is extracted, disaster clues are determined through horizontal fusion, a collapsed building is identified according to basic geographic data to obtain an initial judgment result, and then mobile phone signal data, radar signal data and the like are vertically fused to confirm the buried target. According to the invention, the multi-source data are fused, so that the target to be rescue and buried can be rapidly and accurately identified.

title_en: Radar respiratory heart rate detection method, equipment and storage medium based on multi-unit detection and harmonic fusion statistics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar respiratory heart rate detection method based on multi-unit detection and harmonic fusion statistics, which comprises the following steps of selecting an AOI in a buffer area for subsequent processing; the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase calculation on all distance units in an AOI to obtain an unwrapped phase matrix and a phase difference matrix, respectively screening out distance units suitable for detecting respiration and heart rate according to the phase matrix and the phase difference matrix, respectively storing the distance units in a respiration index array and a heart rate index array, respectively carrying out multi-unit respiration detection on the screened respiration detection distance units and heart rate detection distance units, calculating the confidence coefficient of each respiration detection result and each heart rate detection result, respectively caching the respiration detection results and the heart rate detection results of a plurality of frames and a plurality of units, carrying out statistical analysis on the cached respiration detection results, carrying out harmonic fusion statistical analysis on the cached heart rate detection results, and carrying out result smoothing treatment on the two results.

title_en: Remote emergency monitoring system
title_ko: 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A remote monitoring system for emergency situation is provided to shorten time required for a rescuing process by obtaining the disease history, the address, and the emergency contact number of a target according to the emergency signal of the target. CONSTITUTION: A monitoring server(10) analyzes bio signal data and verifies an emergency situation using a calculator. An user terminal(20) includes a vital sensor and a zigbee module. The vital sensor is worn in the wrist of a user. The bio signal data including the pulse of a user is measured. The zigbee module transfers and receives data through a zigbee communication. A plurality of gateways(30) includes an AP zigbee module, an AP communicator, and an AP controller. The AP zigbee module receives data from the zigbee module. The AP communicator transfers and receives data with the monitoring server. The AP controller transfers an intrinsic terminal ID, the bio signal data, and an intrinsic gateway ID to the monitoring server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 팔목에 착용되어 생체신호정보를 측정할 수 있는 바이탈센서가 구비된 사용자단말기와, 상기 사용자단말기와 지그비 무선 통신을 이용하여 상기 바이탈센서에서 측정된 생체신호정보를 수신받고 수신받은 생체신호정보를 통신망을 이용하여 원격지에 위치된 모니터링 서버에 송신할 수 있는 게이트웨이와, 수신받은 사용자의 생체신호정보를 분석하여 응급상황을 판단할 수 있는 모니터링 서버가 상호 유기적으로 결합된 모니터링 시스템을 구축함으로써 사용자 특히, 독거노인이나 장애인과 같이 거동이 불편한 사람에게 유용하게 활용할 수 있고, 사회구조 서비스로 활용할 수 있으며, 갑작스런 심장마비나 의식불명 등 응급상황 발생시에 신체의 맥박 등 신체신호정보와 IT 기술의 접목으로 응급상황을 모니터링할 수 있도록 한 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템은, 원격지에 위치되고 사용자의 생체신호정보를 분석하여 응급상황을 판단할 수 있는 연산부가 구비된 모니터링 서버와; 사용자의 팔목에 착용되어 사용자의 맥박을 포함한 생체신호정보를 측정할 수 있는 바이탈센서와, 지그비 무선 통신을 이용하여 정보의 송수신이 가능한 사용자지그비모듈과, 사용자의 식별을 위한 고유 단말기ID가 저장되고 고유 단말기ID 및 상기 바이탈센서로부터 측정된 생체신호정보를 외부로 송신하도록 상기 사용자지그비모듈을 제어하는 단말기제어부가 구비된 사용자단말기와; 상기 사용자지그비모듈로부터 송신된 정보를 수신받을 수 있는 AP지그비모듈과, 통신망을 통해 상기 모니터링 서버와 정보의 송수신이 가능한 AP통신부와, 상기 AP지그비모듈을 통해 수신된 고유 단말기ID 및 생체신호정보를 상기 모니터링 서버로 송신하도록 상기 AP통신부를 제어하는 AP제어부가 구비된 게이트웨이를; 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Vehicle and control method for the same
title_ko: 차량 및 그 제어방법
abstract_ko:
차량 내 사용자의 긍정도를 결정하고, 결정된 긍정도가 미리 정해진 값 이상이면 사용자의 긍정 지수를 누적시키는 차량 및 그 제어방법을 제공한다. 
일 실시예에 따른 차량은, 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서, 영상을 표시하는 디스플레이, 및 상기 측정된 생체신호에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 긍정도 및 긍정도의 변화량 중 적어도 하나를 결정하고, 상기 결정된 긍정도 및 긍정도의 변화량 중 적어도 하나가 미리 정해진 값 이상이면 상기 사용자의 긍정 지수를 누적 시키고, 상기 디스플레이가 상기 누적된 긍정 지수를 표시하도록 제어 신호를 송출하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for monitoring life signs of a person
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring a person within a defined area by detecting breathing, or the lack thereof. Breathing is detected using radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals. The radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals are analyzed to determine if the subject person is moving, and if not moving if the person is breathing or not-breathing. An alarm is generated should the reflected radar signals, the camera signals and the microphone signals all simultaneously indicate no movement and no movement of the subject person in the defined area for a selected period of time.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on medical protective clothing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on medical protective clothing, which solves the problems of overlarge detection result error and inconvenient carrying caused by large influence of environment and severe movement of signals in the existing non-contact detection technology, and comprises a signal transmitter, a first signal receiver, a signal processor, an early warning module and an upper computer, wherein the signal transmitter comprises a millimeter wave radar chip set, the first signal receiver comprises an acoustic wave sensor, the signal processor comprises a singlechip, a signal processing chip, a band-pass filter and a triaxial acceleration sensor, and the early warning module comprises a wireless Bluetooth module, a second signal receiver and a vibration motor; compared with contact detection such as ECG and PPG and conventional non-contact detection, the utility model has better signal processing capability and signal stability, and ensures that each basic vital sign of a human body can be accurately detected in real time.
assignees: UNIV XIAN POLYTECHNIC;SHAANXI YUANFENG TEXTILE TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;XIAN CHILDRENS HOSPITAL

title_en: Landslide pre-warning system used for detection of micro-vibration of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide pre-warning system used for detection of micro-vibration of a mountain and belongs to the technical field of geological hazard prevention and control. The landslide pre-warning system comprises a metal tube buried in the mountain, wherein a plurality of vibration probes are mounted in the metal tube in the longitudinal direction at an interval of 0.5-1m; a vibrating sensor is placed on the surface of the mountain and electrically connected with the plurality of vibration probes. Prediction errors can be reduced, the pre-warning accuracy is improved, possible geological disaster can be predicted in advance, and sufficient time is provided for crowd evacuation and disaster elimination.
assignees: HONGDA GUOYUAN WUHU RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT MAN CO LTD

title_en: vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system may include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system may be operable in one or more modes of operation such as, for example: a capacitance measurement mode, an electrical measurement mode, a piezoelectric measurement mode, a temperature measurement mode, an acceleration measurement mode, an impedance measurement mode, and a standby mode. Based on the measurements, the monitoring system may analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and advice to the user, and/or may adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system is also capable of analyzing the sleep of the user without directly contacting or attaching an uncomfortable probe to the user and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: A kind of adaptive through-wall radar static human body object localization method based on EMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of adaptive through-wall radar static human body object localization method based on EMD is related to through-wall radar technology, more particularly to the static target detection of through-wall radar and location technology.The present invention provides the static target location algorithm suitable for MIMO through-wall radars.Fast time dimension Fourier transformation is carried out to the multicycle data of reception and obtains multicycle Range Profile；Multicycle Range Profile is resolved into multiple column vectors by range cell again, with each column vector data of EMD algorithm process；By slow time dimension Fourier transformation, by treated, each Range Profile is transformed into frequency domain, the adaptively selected Range Profile for including target information.Noise and clutter are further suppressed finally by BP imaging algorithm fast imagings, and in conjunction with PCF algorithms.The present invention has positioning accuracy high, can self-adaptive processing data ability, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Water-containing soil buried environment multi-source search and rescue equipment test dummy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test dummy system for multisource search and rescue equipment in a buried environment containing water and soil, which is formed by matching a main dummy body and a dummy vital sign simulation system arranged in the dummy body, wherein the dummy vital sign simulation system comprises a central control unit, a power supply unit, a breathing unit, a whole body temperature unit, an acoustic unit, a vibration unit, a trace gas secretion unit and a breathing thorax movement unit; the scheme provided by the invention has the characteristics of simulating dynamic respiration, typical expiration, gas secretion, sound, vibration, body temperature and the like of a human body under various life states under disaster conditions, has strong environmental adaptability and comprehensive simulation capability, and can meet the requirement of comprehensive efficiency test of water-bearing life search and rescue equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Postoperative atomizing nursing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a postoperative atomization nursing device, which comprises an atomization device, a state monitoring and adjusting module and a control module, wherein the atomization device comprises an induced draft fan, a filtering and sterilizing assembly, a medicament container, a stirring device, a first micro-mesh atomization device, a second micro-mesh atomization device, a gas detection assembly, a heating assembly, an oxygen regulation assembly, a humidity regulation assembly, a gas regulation cavity, an inspiration control valve, an expiration control valve, a one-way valve, a respiration detection assembly, an air pipe and a respiratory mask, and the state monitoring and adjusting module comprises a fixed ring, a brain wave generating assembly, a first electrode, a second electrode, a millimeter wave radar, a blood oxygen detection assembly and a brain wave acquisition assembly. According to the invention, the atomization working process is adjusted according to the breathing state, and the blood pressure, heart rate, blood oxygen and emotion of the user are monitored in an omnibearing manner, so that the comfort of the user is improved by improving the oxygen content, brain wave physiotherapy and other modes.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL ARMY MEDICAL UNIV OF PLA

title_en: Highway engineering mountain landslide safety monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway engineering mountain landslide safety monitoring device, which comprises: the system comprises a plurality of groups of calibration rods, wherein the calibration rods are buried on a mountain to be monitored; the system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data acquisition unit and a data processing unit, wherein the data acquisition unit comprises a laser radar, visual equipment, a gyroscope and a moisture measuring instrument, the moisture measuring instrument acquires moisture data Q of a mountain, and the laser radar acquires a distance M; the gyroscope measures the inclination angle N of the calibration rod and the rock stratum offset direction change quantity w on the horizontal plane; the image analysis unit is used for calculating the mountain change rate X according to the data collected by the data collection unit, and the image analysis unit is used for calculating the final risk grade Y by combining the mountain change rate X through the comparison of the front and rear characteristic point ratios. The risk grade Y provided by the invention is obtained by performing superposition calculation on the mountain deformation coefficient and the mountain change rate, so that the early warning accuracy is improved, and the misjudgment on the landslide risk is reduced.

title_en: Underground radar device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To use a chirp signal as a transmission signal, receive a reflection wave from an underground buried object and reduce unwanted components generating in a correlation signal undergoing correlation processing by a reference signal.SOLUTION: An underground radar device using a chirp signal (S) as a transmission signal transmitting (2) toward an underground, receiving (3) a reflection wave from an underground buried object, and exploring the buried object on the basis of a correlation signal (S) undergoing correlation processing (4) of a reception signal of the radar device (S) with a reference signal (S). As the transmission signal and reference signal (S), the underground radar device uses a plurality of kinds of chirp signals, and explores the buried object by a signal (S) of an average waveform in which an addition averaging (5) of a plurality of kinds of correlation signals obtained by the correlation processing is executed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
