abstract_en: To provide a vital-sign detecting system.SOLUTION: A vital-sign detecting system according to the present invention includes: a plurality of RF tags that are each attached to respective subjects, wherein when one of the RF tags is activated to generate an incident RF signal with a predetermined frequency, the incident RF signal is projected onto the respective subject for generation of a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one RFID radar that is used to activate one of the RF tags, and allows the reflected RF signal to be modulated to obtain a vital sign of the respective subject, and the subject is identified according to the activated RF tag.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A Fire Evacuees' Context- Information Providing Method and A System therefor
title_ko: 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a CCTV; a flame/smoke sensor; a server which includes a person detection module, a context information module, a fire dynamics simulator (FDS), and a building exodus, receives images from the CCTV, and transmits the context information on evacuees in a building to an emergency operation center; a person characteristic information database which has person detection information, such as person patterns; a building information database which has information on the building, such as the drawing of the building; a detection information database which stores the person detection information by areas in the building; and an emergency operation center which receives the context information from the server in a fire and sends a rescue team to the building.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피자의 상황정보를 종합방재 센터의 구조대에게 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, CCTV, 화염/연기 감지 센서,  상기 CCTV의 영상에서 사람을 검출하고 대피자의 수와 위치를 확인하는 사람 검출 모듈, 상기 사람 검출 정보와 상기 센서의 정보를 기반으로 대피자의 상황정보를 생성하는 상황 정보 모듈, 화재의 현상을 가상 모델링하는 시뮬레이션하는 FDS(Fire Dynamics Simulator), 건물 상주 인원들의 대피경로를 계산하는 Building Exodus를 포함하며, 상기 CCTV로부터 영상을 수신 받고 화재시 상기 건축물의 대피자에 대한 상황정보를 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 Server, 상기 사람 패턴과 같은 사람 검출 정보를 가지고 있는 사람 특징 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 건축물의 도면과 같은 건축물의 정보를 가지고 있는 건물 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 사람 검출 모듈에서 검출된 사람 검출 정보를 건축물 내부의 지역별로 저장하는 검출 정보 데이터베이스, 화재시 상기 Server로부터 상황정보를 수신 받고 구조대를 상기 건축물로 보내는 종합방재 센터로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템과,  
상기 CCTV으로부터 영상을 입력받는 영상 입력 단계, 상기 CCTV의 동작여부를 확인하는 CCTV 작동 여부 확인 단계, 상기 CCTV가 동작하지 않을 경우 경보를 제공하는 사람 검출 오류 경보 단계, 사람을 검출하는 사람 검출 단계, 화재가 발생하였는지 확인하는 화재 발생 확인 단계, 평시에 종합 방재 센터로 정보를 전송한 전송 주기를 확인하는 전송 주기 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보를 상기 검출 정보 데이터베이스에 저장하는 사람 검출 정보 갱신 단계, 화재가 발생한 지역을 확인하고 FDS를 통해 화재 현상, 화재 위험 지역 및 인명 사상 지역 정보를 계산하여 화재 상황 정보를 계산하는 화재 상황 정보 확인 단계, Building Exodus를 통해 인명 가상 대피 정보와 잔류 인원에 대한 정보를 계산하는 화재 인명 정보 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보와 화재 상황 정보, 화재 인명 정보들을 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 인명 상황 정보 전송 단계로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법으로, 기존 건축물의 CCTV를 통해 화재시 대피인원 및 잔류 인원에 대한 상황정보를 획득하기 때문에 종래의 시스템들이 시스템 구축을 위해 생체 신호를 수집하는 센서, 위치 정보를 제공하는 센서, 상기 센서들로부터 정보를 수신 받는 PDA와 같은 장치들로 인해 시스템 구축이 어렵고 시스템 사용이 복잡한 종래의 문제점들을 해결할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 상기 건축물의 대피인원 및 잔류인원들에 대한 가상의 대피 정보를 정확하게 시뮬레이션하고 화재 현상 모델링을 기반으로 화재 상황을 정확하게 시뮬레이션하기 때문에 보다 정확한 인명 구조를 위한 정보의 수집이 가능하며, 상기 시뮬레이션정보, 사람 검출 정보를 실시간으로 종합방재 센터로 전송하여 구조대가 인명을 구조하기 위한 구조 시간의 단축과 정확한 구조를 하는데 효과적이다. 
또한, 평시에도 사람 검출정보를 전송하기 때문에 화재시 본 발명에 의한 시스템이 문제가 발생하게 될 경우 평시에 전송되어진 최근 정보를 기반으로 보다 신속하게 상기 건축물의 구조를 수행할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.
assignees: UNIV HANNAM INST IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Bio-processor, bio-signal detecting system, and method for operating the same
title_ko: 바이오 프로세서, 생체 신호 감지 시스템, 및 바이오 프로세서의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio-processor, a bio-signal detecting system, and a method of operating the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-processor includes a bioelectrical impedance sensor and a digital signal processor. The bioelectrical impedance sensor measures the bioelectrical resistance for a period of time including a portion of a settling time. The digital signal processor estimates a stabilized bioelectrical resistance value based on a change in the measured bioelectrical resistance. The digital signal processor generates biometric data based on the stabilized bioelectrical resistance value. According to the embodiment of the present invention, it is possible to reduce the measurement time of a bio-signal, but to ensure the accuracy of the stabilized bioelectric resistance value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이오 프로세서, 생체 신호 감지 시스템, 및 바이오 프로세서의 동작 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 바이오 프로세서는 생체 전기 저항 센서 및 디지털 신호 프로세서를 포함한다. 생체 전기 저항 센서는 정착 시간의 일부를 포함하는 시간 동안 생체 전기 저항을 측정한다. 디지털 신호 프로세서는 측정된 생체 전기 저항의 변화 추이에 기초하여 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값을 추정한다. 디지털 신호 프로세서는 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값에 기초하여 생체 데이터를 생성한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 생체 신호의 측정 시간을 감소시키되, 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값의 정확성을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire security apparatus and method while charging electric vehicle charging station
title_ko: 전기차량 충전소에서의 충전중 화재감시 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for monitoring a fire at an electric vehicle being charged in an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises: a plurality of fire detection modules; a vehicle detection sensor; and a fire monitoring main body unit. The plurality of fire detection modules each comprise: a flame detection sensor which is disposed to be partially buried in a charging parking area of an electric vehicle charging station and detects a fire in a vehicle being charged at an early stage; a smoke and combustible gas detection sensor which is configured to detect a small amount of smoke or combustible gas leaking from a point where fire vehicle occurs; and a suction fan installed to suck in gas so as to quickly guide smoke or combustible gas leaks from the point where the fire vehicle occurs toward the smoke and combustible gas detection sensor. The vehicle detection sensor is disposed in the charging parking area and detects an electric vehicle in charging. The fire monitoring main body unit is wirelessly connected to the plurality of fire detection modules via short-distance wireless communication, checks whether a fire is detected by the fire detection modules depending on vehicle detection at the vehicle detection sensor, verifies a fire outbreak, selectively supplies main power for charging electric vehicles to a vehicle charger, shuts off the main power for charging as the fire outbreak is verified, sends a fire report message to a local firefighting situation room, and provides an evacuation announcement when a human body within the charging station is detected. According to the present invention, it is possible to prevent and manage fire accidents that frequently occur when electric vehicles are charged in a charging station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차량 충전소에서의 충전중 화재감시 장치로서, 전기차량 충전소의 충전주차구역에 일부매립 배치되어 충전중인 차량의 화재를 초기에 검지하기 위해 불꽃감지센서, 차량화재시 소량의 연기나 가연성가스 누출 감지를 위한 연기 및 가연성가스 감지센서, 차량화재 발생지점에서의 연기나 가연성가스 유출분을 연기 및 가연성가스 감지센서쪽 방향으로 신속 유도하기 위해 흡기 작동되게 설치된 흡기팬 등이 개별적으로 포함된 다수개의 화재감지모듈들과, 충전주차구역에 배치되어서 충전중인 전기차량을 감지하는 차량감지센서와, 다수개의 화재감지모듈과 근거리 무선통신을 통해 무선 연결되며, 차량감지센서에서의 차량감지에 따라 화재감지모듈들로부터 화재감지 여부를 체크하고 화재발생을 검증하여서 전기차량 충전용 메인전력을 차량충전기로 선택적으로 공급하고, 화재발생이 검증됨에 따라 충전용 메인전력을 차단하고 화재신고 메시지를 해당 지역 소방상황실로 전송함과 함께 충전소내 인체감지시 대피안내방송을 하는 화재감시용 본체유닛을 구비한 것이다.

title_en: Pet house system enabling companion animal health management through biosignal measurement
title_ko: 생체신호 측정을 통한 반려동물 건강관리가 가능한 펫하우스 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a pet house system that can analyze heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress of a pet, classify sleep state, and analyze body water and body fat; and a pet health management method using the same. Provided is a method for managing pet health through biosignal measurement comprising: a step of obtaining, by a sensor part, a pressure signal of the pet; a step of signal processing, by a processor, a signal measured through the sensor part; and a step of estimating, by the processor, a stress of the pet by analyzing the heart rate variability (HRV) included in the signal processing result, wherein the obtaining step obtains the pressure signal from each of a plurality of channels, and selects an optimal signal among the pressure signals of each channel. According to embodiments of the present invention, the present invention enables to contribute to the health management of pets by providing functions for analyzing heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress of the pet, classifying sleep state, and analyzing body water and body fat.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정을 통해 반려동물 건강관리가 가능한 펫하우스 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정을 통한 반려동물 건강관리 방법은, 센서부가, 반려동물의 압력 신호를 획득하는 단계; 프로세서가, 센서부를 통해 측정된 신호를 신호처리하는 단계; 및 프로세서가, 신호처리 결과에 포함된 심박변이도(HRV)를 분석하여 반려동물의 스트레스를 추정하는 단계;를 포함하고, 획득하는 단계는, 복수의 채널에서 각각 압력 신호를 획득하고, 각 채널의 압력 신호 중 최적 신호를 선택한다. 이에 의해, 반려동물의 심박수, 호흡수 및 스트레스 분석, 수면 상태 분류, 체수분과 체지방 분석 기능을 제공하여, 반려동물의 건강관리에 기여할 수 있다. 또한, 여러 채널의 센서를 활용하여 센서값을 수집하고, 이 중 최적의 센서값을 선택할 수 있어, 다양한 자세에서도 높은 정확도의 생체신호 측정이 가능하며, 반려동물의 심박변이도(HRV)를 측정하여 심박과 호흡의 Peak를 도출하고 심박수와 호흡수를 보정함으로써, 종래의 기술보다 더 높은 정확도로 심박수와 호흡수를 측정할 수 있다.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method based on radar signal and detection radar
abstract_en: Provided is a multi-target life detection method based on radar signals. The method includes: performing time accumulation in a slow time direction on a preprocessed echo signal to obtain a first echo signal; performing an envelope extraction of inflection points on the first echo signal to obtain a second echo signal; calculating an average value of all amplitude signals in the second echo signal other than M marked amplitude signals; and in response to a ratio of a marked amplitude signal to the average value being greater than a threshold, determining that a living target exists at a radar detection distance corresponding to the marked amplitude signal. According to the life detection method of the present disclosure, a normalization method is adopted to normalize signal amplitudes of the radar in a dimension of fast time (distance). In addition, two envelope extractions of inflection points may be performed.

title_en: Radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital monitoring
abstract_en: A radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital monitoring includes a method for detecting vital signs using at least one radar sensor mounted to a vehicle. The method includes detecting a plurality of target candidates using the at least one radar sensor, analyzing the plurality of target candidates to generate a list of targets, steering the at least one radar sensor towards the target using the angle of arrival to the target, and detecting a vital signal of the target based on the range using the at least one radar sensor.

title_en: Rescue system for a collapse
title_ko: 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue system for a collapse, in which a body detection unit is installed in order to detect the presence of people inside a building, and a tilt sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed in order to set changed tilt data and acceleration data as an event trigger signal, when an earthquake or external shock occurs. Moreover, by analyzing a signal measured in the body detection unit at a predetermined time before the event trigger signal occurs, if someone was in the building before a collapse accident, the place where people are buried is announced through a voice or Morse code via an alarm unit in order to perform a rescue operation quickly. As a result, accident mortality from a collapse may be drastically reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체 감지부를 설치하여 건축물 내부 사람의 유무를 감지하고 경사 센서와 가속도 센서를 설치하여 지진 또는 외부의 충격이 발생할 경우 변화되는 경사 데이터와 가속도 데이터를 이벤트 트리거 신호로 설정하여 이벤트 트리거 신호가 발생한 시점의 일정시간 전 인체 감지부에서 계측한 신호를 분석하여 건축물의 붕괴사고 발생 전 사람이 있을 경우 경보 알람부를 통해 사람이 매몰된 장소의 위치를 음성 또는 모스부호를 통해 경보하여 신속하게 구조 작업을 진행할 수 있도록 함으로써 붕괴에 의한 사고 사망률을 현저히 저감할 수 있는 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA MAINTENANCE CO LTD;CHOI JUN SEONG;SONG JEA HWAN;KANG SUNG MIN

title_en: Life detection method and system based on radar signals
abstract_en: The life detection method and system based on the radar signals comprise the steps of detecting an area to be detected by an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo matrix, filtering static clutter in the radar echo matrix, extracting body surface vibration signals of human targets in the area to be detected according to the radar echo matrix after filtering clutter, carrying out modal decomposition on the body surface vibration signals by a modal decomposition method, determining main frequencies of all eigen mode functions by a wavelet analysis method, screening eigen mode functions of the main frequencies in a preset breathing and heartbeat frequency band range, reconstructing breathing and heartbeat signals based on the screened eigen mode functions, and determining vital sign information of the detected human targets based on a stochastic resonance system and the reconstructed breathing and heartbeat signals. The technical scheme provided by the application has strong anti-interference capability, and can accurately and rapidly detect the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the target to be detected.

title_en: Emergency determination device
title_ko: 위급 상황 판단 장치
abstract_en: Provided is an emergency situation determination apparatus. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the emergency situation determination apparatus comprises: a sensor detecting the biosignal of a person and the motion of the hands of the person within a certain range; and a determination part analyzing the biosignal recognized by the sensor and determining whether an emergency situation occurs by additionally analyzing the motion of the hands according to the result of analyzing the biosignal, wherein the determination part determines whether the biosignal is analyzed and the emergency situation occurs after a wake-up behavior is detected by the sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 위급 상황 판단 장치를 제공한다. 위급 상황 판단 장치는 일정 범위 내에서 사람의 생체 신호 및 사람의 손의 동작을 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 생체신호를 분석하고, 상기 생체신호를 분석한 결과에 따라 추가적으로 손의 동작을 분석하여 위급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 판단하는 판단부를 포함하고, 상기 판단부는 상기 센서에 의해 웨이크-업(wake-up) 행위가 감지된 이후에 상기 생체 신호의 분석 및 위급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 판단한다.

title_en: Miner basic vital sign wireless monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wireless monitoring, and particularly relates to a miner basic vital sign wireless monitoring system under a mine. A piezoelectric film sensor is adopted to convert pulses to electric signals, a digital temperature sensor is adopted to directly convert the temperature at the wrist of a miner to digital values, a single chip microcomputer is used for processing the pulse signals to obtain pulse wave information, a value of the temperature sensor is read, the pulse wave information and the temperature value are transmitted to a ground monitoring room through an underground wireless transmission network, and miner basic vital signs can be wirelessly monitored in real time. The miner basic vital sign wireless monitoring system can play an important role in the rescue work of mine disaster accidents, and also can monitor pulses and body temperature of the miner in real time in down-hole operation at ordinate times, and the health conditions of the miner can be conveniently mastered.

title_en: Based on the search and rescue robot system of multi-agent theory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the search and rescue robot system based on multi-agent theory.Apply to search and rescue technology that is extensive, high-level efficiency multiple robots not comprehensive, particularly the group behavior of search and rescue robot group controls deficienter.Arduino Uno R3 single-chip microcomputer, expansion board, circuit for controlling motor, positioning system, Zigbee module, infrared life detection module, the first direct supply and the second direct supply is provided with in car body of the present utility model; Circuit for controlling motor by the second DC power supply, and controls the running of four wheels by four reducing motors; Radio Network System Zigbee module builds autonomous network, and remote control equipment and multiple agent multiple robots are all by Zigbee module access of radio network system.The utility model substantially increases the automatism of search and rescue robot, concertedness and controllability, decreases the search and rescue time, meets extensive requirement of searching and rescuing.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vital sign monitoring radar, which relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and comprises a radar body and a display screen, wherein a key is arranged on one side of the radar body, a connecting port is arranged on one side of the radar body, an MCU module is fixedly connected to one side of the radar body, a loudspeaker module is fixedly connected to the front side of the MCU module, a protection block is arranged at the upper end of the loudspeaker module, one side of the protection block is fixedly connected with the front side of the radar body, and a millimeter wave radar antenna board is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the radar body. According to the utility model, the sliding blocks on two sides slide in the sliding groove by pulling the handle and drive the metal connecting rod, so that the magnetic blocks are separated, the protection plate covers the surface of the speaker module, the problem of blockage caused by dust on the surface of the speaker module when the speaker module is used for a long time is solved, and the effect of protecting the speaker module and preventing the dust from being blocked is achieved.

title_en: Buried pipeline stress strain monitoring system based on LoRa communication and vibrating wire sensing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buried pipeline stress-strain monitoring system based on LoRa communication and vibrating wire sensing, wherein data acquisition units are arranged on a buried pipeline at intervals, each data acquisition unit is respectively provided with a data processing unit, the data processing units concentrate acquired data to a LoRa gateway through a LoRa communication module, and the LoRa gateway uniformly uploads all acquired data to a data center; the data acquisition unit comprises a vibrating wire type sensor stuck to the outer surface of the buried pipeline, and the data processing unit comprises a processor and a LoRa communication module. Each data acquisition unit comprises four vibrating wire sensors for respectively monitoring the axial, radial and oblique stress changes of the buried pipe. The utility model combines the vibrating wire type strain sensing monitoring technology and the LoRa communication technology to solve the engineering technical problem of stress strain monitoring of special pipe sections with frequent natural disasters such as goaf, geological settlement, landslide and the like of long-distance natural gas pipelines.
assignees: HENAN HUIRONG OIL AND GAS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel method for monitoring strain on earth crust shallow layer
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel method for monitoring strain on an earth crust shallow layer. Practice proves that the strain on the earth crust shallow layer is related to an earthquake precursor, so that the method is a novel method for monitoring the earthquake precursor. By the method provided by the invention, the characteristics of particle media are used, a stress sensor is not arranged in a drill hole of a bed rock on an earth crust deep layer but is embedded in sand of the earth crust shallow layer, and water around the stress sensor is displaced into clean water for washing sand in spite of an earth surface soil stratum or an earth surface bed stratum. The stress sensor is buried below a frozen soil layer and above an underground water level.
assignees: BEIJING PREC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;XIAOMING SUN

title_en: System and device based on dynamic gradient clustering and inter-cluster frequency division routing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sensors, and relates to a sensor network system of a motion node based on dynamic gradient clustering and inter-cluster frequency division routing. The system comprises a convergence node (1) and a sensor node (2). A device comprises a sensor node hardware based on a radio frequency baseband, a PA, an LNA, a radio frequency switch and a matching circuit of the aforementioned elements. A method comprises a motion node self-networking method based on the dynamic gradient clustering and inter-cluster frequency division. The system can be applied to a dynamic sensor network with nodes are moving, a sensor network with the nodes are static and occasions of vital signal detection of firefighters in a scene of fire.
assignees: BEIJING YILIN ZHIXIN TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring vital signs of infant
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and system for monitoring vital signs of an infant. The infant monitoring system combines an infant pacifier having a sensor for detecting a position or sucking action of the pacifier and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. Vital signs sensor output is interpreted in view of the sensing of the pacifier. In this way, nipple sucking action may be prevented from being misinterpreted as or otherwise corrupting different vital sign measurements (such as heart rate or breathing rate).

title_en: Non-excavation accurate positioning method and device for deeply buried underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-excavation accurate positioning method and a device for an underground pipeline, comprising the following steps: step one: a movable detection trolley is arranged on the ground; step two: the small detection vehicle is provided with a ground penetrating radar and an adjustable induction coil type accurate positioner for positioning detection; step three: the rotation of the ground penetrating radar is regulated to be close to the ground to be tested, so that the distribution condition of underground metal or nonmetal pipelines is inquired; step four: analyzing the strength of signals between the induction coils to judge the moving direction by adjusting the distance between the induction coils; through the implementation of the invention, the ground penetrating radar mechanism is used for finding out the distribution condition of underground metal or nonmetal pipelines, pitch adjustment can be carried out at the same time, the storage is carried out when the ground penetrating radar mechanism is idle, the positioning accuracy of the single coil mechanism can be improved on the basis of the prior art through the accurate positioning mechanism, compared with the multi-coil mechanism, the cost is reduced, the structural design is scientific and reasonable, and the ground penetrating radar mechanism has certain use value and popularization value.
assignees: HANGZHOU JISI SHIKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave-based non-contact vital sign monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring method and a non-contact vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves, which relate to the technical field of millimeter wave radars and are used for transmitting millimeter wave radar signals to a target human body; receiving echo signals reflected by thoracic cavity vibration of a target human body; mixing an echo signal with a transmitted millimeter wave radar signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal, and extracting the frequency and the phase of the intermediate frequency signal; and constructing a frequency domain signal according to the frequency and the phase of the intermediate frequency signal, and filtering the respiratory signal based on the difference of the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal in the frequency spectrum characteristic to obtain the heartbeat signal.
assignees: KANGLIYUAN TIANJIN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and deep learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, and discloses a vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and deep learning, aiming at solving the problems of high cost, low accuracy and insufficient privacy protection of the existing vital sign monitoring method, and the scheme mainly comprises the following steps: the transmitting antenna transmits the linear continuous frequency modulation electromagnetic wave, the transmitting antenna receives the echo signal reflected by the target human body, and the echo signal is subjected to frequency mixing operation to obtain an intermediate frequency signal; obtaining radar cube data according to the intermediate frequency signals, and constructing a distance-azimuth heat map according to the radar cube data; detecting the distance-azimuth heat map to obtain a distance and azimuth unit where a chest of a target human body is located, and extracting to obtain effective phase data; and inputting the effective phase data into a deep learning model, obtaining the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a target human body in the current time period, and determining whether the state of the target human body is abnormal. According to the method and the device, the vital sign monitoring cost is reduced, and the accuracy and privacy protection are improved.

title_en: Control device for air conditioner, air conditioner including control device, control method for air conditioner and program
abstract_en: To provide a control device for an air conditioner that detects occurrence of a fire disaster early.SOLUTION: A control device 2 for an air conditioner (indoor unit 3 for air conditioning) includes: an acquisition unit for acquiring an output signal from a human presence sensor 4 that detects presence/absence of a person (user 101) in a predetermined range 41 and also detects temperature of each of the division ranges 42 obtained by dividing the range 41 into multiple pieces; and a determination unit for determining whether an abnormal heating source 201 occurs in a space 8 in which an air conditioner is installed on the basis of the temperature detected by the human presence sensor 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: MITSUBISHI HEAVY IND THERMAL SYSTEMS LTD

title_en: Thermochromic pigment-based fiber-optic respiration sensor for respiratory monitoring during clinical procedures using mri system or radiation devices
title_ko: 자기공명영상장치 또는 방사선 장치를 이용한 시술 시 호흡 모니터링을 위한  시온안료 기반의 광섬유 호흡센서와 광섬유 호흡센서 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fiber-optic respiration sensor of the thermochromic microcapsule pigment base and a fiber-optic respiration sensor system are provided to enhance the quality of a radiological image by controlling fine movement due to a respiratory motion of a patient. CONSTITUTION: A respiration sensing film(1) is attached to a plastic pipe(2). The plastic pipe is combined with one end of optical fiber(3). The respiration sensing film mixes thionic pigment powder and transparent optics epoxy. The respiration sensing film compresses and dries a mixture. The respiration sensing film is formed into a thin film type. The respiration sensing film is composed of a light source(4), a Y- coupler(5), a light detector(6), and a display device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자기공명영상(magnetic resonance imaging, MRI) 촬영 또는 방사선 장치(radiation device)를 이용한 진단 및 치료 시 호흡 모니터링을 위해 시온안료(thermochromic microcapsule pigment) 기반의 광섬유 호흡센서와 광섬유 호흡센서 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 호흡 감지부, 광섬유(optical fiber), 광원(light source) 및 광 계측장비(light measuring device)로 구성된 온라인 광섬유 호흡센서(fiber-optic respiration sensor)에 관한 것이다. 
 발명은 광섬유 호흡센서에 있어서 호흡 감지 필름을 플라스틱 관에 부착하고, 상기 플라스틱 관을 광섬유의 끝단에 결합하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and device for sensing buried metal using synchronous detection method
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a method and device for sensing buried metal, whereby it is possible to wirelessly transmit a synchronous signal, and, when the frequency band of the transmission signal is restricted, to perform synchronous detection using a reference signal having a frequency equal to or greater than the frequency band. [Solution] A method for sensing buried metal using synchronous detection, the method provided with a transmission-side device for transmitting a sensing transmission signal (alternating electric current) to buried metal and transmitting a synchronous signal for synchronous detection, and a reception-side device for discovering a magnetic field generated by an alternating electric current flowing in the buried metal through use of a magnetic sensor and performing amplitude and phase signal processing, and ascertaining the position and buried depth of the buried metal, wherein the transmission-side device generates a standard signal having a frequency f, n-divides and converts the standard signal to a transmission signal having a frequency of f/n, transmits the transmission signal to the buried metal, m-divides and converts the standard signal to a synchronous signal having a frequency of f/m, and transmits the synchronous signal wirelessly from the transmission-side device. The synchronous signal is received by the reception-side device, multiplied m times, and converted to a standard signal. The converted standard signal is n-divided and converted to a reference signal having a frequency of f/n. Meanwhile, the magnetic field from the alternating electric current flowing in the buried metal is discovered, and synchronous detection is performed using the reference signal.

title_en: Breathing detection apparatus and method
abstract_en: A device is disclosed for remote monitoring of breathing movements of a patient, comprising a sender transmitting a microwave signal toward the patient, a receiver arranged to receive a signal reflected by the patient, and a processor. The processor mixes the received signal with the transmitted signal and with a signal in quadrature with the transmitted signal to determine a breathing frequency of the patient. In some embodiments, two signals at different frequencies are emitted toward the patient and processed in order to compensate for breathing patterns that are not uniquely resolvable at a single frequency.

title_en: Vehicle mounted metal and mine detector
abstract_en: The invention is related to a vehicle mounted metal and mine detector, which is used in the operations with military or humanitarian purposes regarding the clearance or removal of landmines for detecting mines with high metal content and plastic mines with a minimum content of metal that are near the ground surface or buried underground, as well as any improvised explosive devices, ammunitions and explosives; in the archaeological researches for determining the location of the buried archaeological remains without damaging them; in the geophysical studies for the exploration of mineral deposits, industrial minerals and rock formations; and in the detection of infrastructure elements such as underground pipelines and cables. The system is comprised of a manned or unmanned ground vehicle (8), a lower arm (2) and an upper arm (3) that are connected to the lower shell (7) of the vehicle by means of rotating links, a search head (1) in which electromagnetic interference (EMI) sensor coils and ground penetrating radar (GPR) antennas are arranged to be nested inside one another, fore arms (9) that are fastened directly on the search head (1) or into the ribs (13) placed on the search head and that enable the search head (1) to be connected to the lower arm (2) and to the upper arm (3) by means of the quick-connect rotating connection components, a linear actuator (5) and a lever arm (4) that are connected to either one of the lower arm (2) and the upper arm (3) with rotating links for adjusting the height of the search head (1) from the ground, and an upper shell (6) covering the last-mentioned mechanisms for protecting them against external factors. While adjusting the height of the search head (1) from the ground, at the same time, it is kept parallel to the ground, and these two functions are carried out by using only one linear actuator (3). Through the arrangement of the sensors in the search head such that the sensors are arrayed in pairs nested one another, the dimensions of the search head are kept as small as possible, providing the ease of use in narrow areas where the detection operation is carried out. When the search head is damaged, the connection components are broken off by themselves and the search head is broken off from the vehicle due to the connection of the search head (1) to the lower arm (2) and the upper arm (3) by means of the quick-connect connection components, which prevents the rest of the vehicle from being damaged by protecting it against the damaging effects. Furthermore, the damaged search head can be replaced easily and quickly with a new one on site without the need for any special equipment, therefore the vehicle has the ability to operate for a long time.

title_en: Localized triggering of human activity analysis
abstract_en: A method of determining human activity in an environment in which at least one sensor is configured to measure a parameter relating to human activity. The method includes: receiving an indication of a human presence, and activating the sensor when a human presence is being detected in the environment.

title_en: Sudden stop of respiration detection alarm system
abstract_en: The invention provides a respiratory sudden stop detection alarm system, which comprises a processor and at least one radar sensor which is arranged in a monitoring area and is in communication connection with the processor, wherein the radar sensor is used for transmitting electromagnetic waves and receiving echo signals; the method is suitable for a non-contact non-visual detection mode, does not need to be worn, does not influence normal activities, does not infringe personal privacy, greatly improves the detection practicability, and has high popularization value.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning device which comprises a vertical rod, wherein the top of the vertical rod is fixedly connected with a mounting ball body, a plurality of sensors are assembled on the mounting ball body, the bottom of the vertical rod is fixedly connected with a buried mounting piece, the buried mounting piece comprises a mounting annular plate fixedly connected to the bottom of the vertical rod, a mounting hole is formed in the mounting annular plate, the inner side wall of the mounting hole is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the vertical rod through a plurality of connecting columns, the buried mounting piece further comprises a plurality of buried annular plates which are distributed at intervals up and down, through holes are formed in the buried annular plates, a plurality of buried pieces are fixedly connected to the buried annular plates, each buried piece comprises a buried mounting column penetrating through the buried annular plate, two ends of each buried mounting column are respectively connected with an outer buried ball body and an inner buried ball body, and the mounting annular plates are fixedly connected through a plurality of annular arrays. The invention has the advantages of improving the embedding stability and the early warning reliability.

title_en: Sleep staging method and device based on radar information and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a sleep staging method, a sleep staging device, a sleep staging terminal and a sleep staging storage medium based on radar information. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring respiratory heartbeat information in a sleep period monitored by a vital sign monitoring radar; calculating a sleep staging index at each moment in a sleep period based on the breathing heartbeat information; calculating a sleep stage characteristic value of each moment in a sleep period based on the sleep stage index; and comparing the sleep stage characteristic value with a preset stage threshold value, and determining the sleep stage corresponding to each moment in the sleep period according to the comparison result. The invention carries out sleep staging based on radar information, acquires information under the conditions of no perception and no influence on normal sleep of a user, has simple and accurate sleep staging processing process and has higher reliability.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar life detection algorithm based on SE and SSD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband radar life detection algorithm based on SE and SSD, and belongs to the technical field of radar life detection. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing clutter and noise signals in original radar echo signals by adopting a channel signal subtraction method, a direct subtraction average method, linear trend suppression, automatic gain control, slow time filtering and other methods, and then carrying out echo selection by calculating time delay corresponding to a SE value peak value of radar receiving pulses along the slow time direction so as to position a target. Selecting and recombining the signals on these adjacent range gates based on the SE values may obtain more vital sign information than a single frame signal and may reduce the observation time. And decomposing and reconstructing radar echo signals by using SSD, reconstructing the signals according to the energy percentage of SSCs in the breathing and heartbeat frequency bands obtained by decomposition, and calculating the breathing and heartbeat frequency by using FFT. The radar life detection method provided by the invention can accurately locate the target and extract the life information, effectively improves the signal to noise ratio, and has wide research value and application prospect.

title_en: A alarm for saving a life
title_ko: 개인인명구조용 경보기
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a personal life saving alarm comprises: a case main body, and a main board. And a beacon, which is a wireless communication module, is installed in the personal life saving alarm to enable the personal life saving alarm to track a position of a firefighter, thereby easily recognizing a firefighter buried in a fire scene, and to verify personal information of firefighters entering the fire scene and a maximum entry maintaining time from a firefighting command center away from the fire scene, thereby considering safety of the entering firefighters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 개인인명구조용 경보기는, 배면에 버클이 부착되고 전면에 이머전시 키와 상기 이머전시 키를 둘러싸는 LED 링이 배치된 케이스본체와, 상기 케이스본체의 측면에 인출작동이 가능하게 작동 키가 설치되고, 해제버튼이 설치되고, 상부측면에 LED 표시창이 설치되고 타측면에 모드키 및 접속부가 설치되고 내부에 움직임 감지 센서와 RTD센서가 설치되고, 비콘이 설치되고, 상기 비콘과 접속되며 경보음을 발생하는 부저와 배터리와 연결되며 상기 LED 링과 LCD 표시창과 연결된 메인보드를 포함하여, 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동하는 소방관등의 안전과 출동현장의 현황을 파악하여 현장을 효율적으로 지휘하기 위하여 소방관등이 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동 시에 소방관들이 착용한 소방복상에 걸어서 착용할 수가 있으며 착용이 용이하고, 화재현장에 진입한 소방관의 움직임이 없으면 경보음을 출력하고 LED가 점멸작동되고 화재현장에 설정된 온도이상의 고온의 온도가 감지되게 되면 경보음을 출력하고 LED가 점멸작동되어 위험한 현장을 식별하여 붕괴사고가 발생될 위험한 현장을 알려주며 화재현장의 진입시간과 현재시간이 표시되어 용이하게 착용한 소방관이 진입시간과 현재시간을 파악할 수가 있으며 무선통신모듈인 비콘이 설치되어 소방관의 위치의 추적이 가능하게 되어 화재현장에서 매몰된 소방관을 용이하게 인지하며 화재현장에서 떨어진 소방지휘소에서 화재현장에 진입한 소방관들의 인적사항과 진입시간의 파악이 가능하게 되어 최대진입유지시간의 파악으로 인하여 진입 소방관들의 안전을 고려하는 것이 가능한 우수한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Security protection fire-fighting equipment based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a security protection fire-fighting equipment based on thing networking, including pre-buried box and fishplate bar, pre-buried box bottom surface fixedly connected with fishplate bar, and the fishplate bar underrun articulates the post and rotate and be connected with the rotation piece to rotate the piece surface and seted up tooth, the inside fixedly connected with servo motor of pre-buried box, and the servo motor output passes through universal coupling and is connected with the dwang, and dwang bottom surface fixedly connected with driving gear, driving gear and tooth meshing, rotate the vertical fixedly connected with connecting rod of rotation bottom surface central point position, and the connecting rod underrun first articulated shaft rotates and is connected with the connecting rod. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses a first infrared induction camera, second infrared induction camera, servo motor and telescopic link make the shower nozzle can aim at the burning things which may cause a fire disaster department and put out a fire, improve fire control fire extinguishing efficiency, relative and traditional fire gun, simple structure, the low price is fit for the large tracts of land installation.

title_en: Life detection alarm device in automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a life detection alarm device in an automobile, which comprises a lock control module, a temperature detector, a time delay module, a life body detection sensor, a reminding module, a sound warning module and a control interface module, wherein the temperature detector receives command signals of the lock control module to open/close an automobile door and an automobile window and sends a temperature value and a delay time command; the life body detection sensor sends a life body information detection instruction after receiving the temperature value and the delay time instruction, the reminding module receives the life body information detection instruction to carry out acousto-optic reminding, the sound warning module receives the acousto-optic reminding to carry out reminding alarm or cancel operation outside the vehicle, and the control interface module receives the acousto-optic reminding to turn off the alarm device. When an accident life body appears in the automobile, the automobile gives an alarm, calls a telephone, sends a short message and the like to send a distress to a preset number, and a person receiving the distress carries out remote control operation on the automobile through the short message or the telephone to help the trapped person to escape, can talk with the inside of the automobile and monitor sound, images and the like.

title_en: Weak-breathing-signal enhancement method used for life detection radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a breathing signal enhancement method used for a life detection radar. In the breathing signal enhancement method, an echo signal matrix of an ultra-wide-band life detection radar is modeled into a zero mean stationary random process, and through a background removal method and a linear jitter removal method, a signal matrix which includes weak breathing signals is obtained preliminarily. Different degrees of enhancement processing, fast time FIR band-pass filter and a slow time moving average filter enable the weak breathing signals to be enhanced and more obvious in an output signal matrix so that guarantee is provided to follow-up detection of weak human body characteristics.

title_en: A kind of multidimensional fire-fighting data fusion analysis method neural network based
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multidimensional fire-fighting data fusion analysis methods neural network based, include the following steps: step 1, establish with the state parameter of live cigarette sense, the temperature parameter at scene, the temperature warning threshold parameter at scene and the vital signs parameter at scene as input, it take occurrence index as the neural network model of output, and the neural network model of foundation is trained, according to the implicit layer number of training result and the error transfer factor neural network model of actual alarm result, until accuracy rate is not less than desired value；Step 2, with trained neural network model, the condition of a disaster analysis is carried out to the state parameter of the live cigarette sense obtained in real time, the temperature parameter at scene, the temperature warning threshold parameter at scene and the vital signs parameter at scene.Compared with prior art, the present invention obtains the operating condition of field device in time, carries out data analysis convenient for platform.Field condition is judged in time by the video information that infrared photography provides, and can be remotely operated fire extinguisher and be put out a fire.
assignees: NANJING KEGU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional through-wall radar system, which comprises a frequency source, a transmitter, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a receiver, a signal processing board and a power supply, wherein the frequency source, the transmitter and the receiver are integrated on the same PCB to form a radio frequency integrated board; the signal processing board is connected with the radio frequency integrated board through an inter-board connector; the power supply is fixed on the radio frequency integrated board and is directly connected with the signal processing board through a power supply interface; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are both positioned on the periphery of the radio frequency integrated board. The invention has the advantages of simple and compact structure, light weight, simple, quick and reliable connection and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting adjacent multi-target vital signs of millimeter wave MIMO radar under clutter background
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting adjacent multi-target vital signs of a millimeter wave MIMO radar under a clutter background, which belongs to the field of vital sign detection and comprises the following steps: transmitting a plurality of chirp signals modulated with a space-time block code; receiving end: a. mixing the echo signals of all receiving antennas with a reference modulation signal, and extracting recombination and space-time decoupling to obtain an arrayed signal; carrying out distance and azimuth two-dimensional smoothing and spatial spectrum estimation on the arrayed signals to position adjacent human body targets; b. extracting phase difference value sequences corresponding to the human body target and the clutter scattering point to construct a vital sign signal and a clutter scattering point phase signal corresponding to the human body target; c. and carrying out variation constraint multi-mode decomposition on the detected vital sign signals and the clutter scattering point phase signals to obtain vital sign parameters. The method can separate the adjacent human body targets under the clutter background, and the separated vital sign signals have obvious periodicity, smooth waveforms and high parameter estimation precision.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of radar signal detection, in order to improve detection accuracy, a vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the following steps: 1. acquiring an original signal of respiration and heartbeat overlapping; 2. the denoising method based on phase space reconstruction is adopted to carry out signal separation on the original signal so as to obtain a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: 21. reconstructing the phase space of respiration and heartbeat respectively by adopting different embedding dimensions and time delays to obtain a high-dimensional phase space; 22. a zero subspace in Gao Weixiang space represents noise components, an attractor space represents respiratory signals or heartbeat signal components, the zero subspace is projected to the attractor space continuously to eliminate the noise components, and the projected phase points are corrected; 23. carrying out weighted anti-reconstruction processing on all corrected phase points to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals; 3. the respiration signal and the heartbeat signal are analyzed to obtain a respiration value and a heartbeat value. By adopting the mode, the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Non-contact identity recognition method, system, medium, equipment and terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of identity recognition, and discloses a non-contact type identity recognition method, a non-contact type identity recognition system, a non-contact type identity recognition medium, a non-contact type identity recognition device and a non-contact type identity recognition terminal, wherein a life motion signal of a target individual acquired by AWR1642 is subjected to phase extraction, demodulation and difference; denoising the phase signals after the difference by utilizing sine fitting to obtain heart motion information; the wild dog algorithm optimization support vector machine is improved by using self-adaptive adjustment weights and local disturbance, so that identity recognition is realized; and separating respiratory and heartbeat signals through a Butterworth low-pass filter, comparing the obtained heartbeat frequency with an intelligent bracelet, and verifying the feasibility of the FMCW millimeter wave radar for detecting the vital signals. Experimental results show that the heart beat frequency obtained by the method and the pearson correlation coefficient obtained by the contact method are 0.96, the feasibility of acquiring life signals by the FMCW radar is shown, the accuracy of real individual identification by using the improved wild dog optimization algorithm to optimize the SVM can reach 88%, and the identification accuracy can be effectively improved by the identification method.

title_en: Following type human health state monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to follow-up human health state monitoring equipment which comprises a follow-up base, wherein the follow-up base is provided with a lower mounting cavity, a fixed shell is provided with an upper mounting cavity, a controller is fixed in the lower mounting cavity, a motion control module is in control connection with the controller, a data processing module is arranged in the lower mounting cavity, a data acquisition module is in control connection with the data processing module, a radar sign monitoring module is in control connection with the controller, an output module is in control connection with the controller, the data acquisition module comprises a camera, a first rotating structure capable of swinging left and right in the horizontal direction and a second rotating structure capable of swinging in the vertical direction are arranged in the fixed shell, the camera is arranged on the first rotating structure, the first rotating structure is relatively fixed on the second rotating structure, a first angle sensor is arranged on the first rotating structure, the first angle sensor is in control connection with the controller, the second angle sensor is in control connection with the control, and vital signs of monitored personnel can be continuously acquired.
assignees: SHENYANG YISHENGKANG HEALTH MAN CO LTD

title_en: Ruminant respiration detection method, ruminant respiration detection system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a ruminant respiration detection method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the field of vital sign detection and comprise the steps of collecting radar echo ADC data, carrying out distance dimension fast Fourier transform on the radar echo ADC data to obtain a distance-snapshot matrix, carrying out phase extraction and calculating the difference of phase signals to construct a vital sign time sequence, carrying out fast Fourier transform on the vital sign time sequence to obtain fast Fourier spectrum energy distribution, determining a respiration candidate signal based on a preset respiration frequency band, carrying out empirical mode decomposition on the respiration candidate signal to obtain a plurality of intrinsic mode components, calculating comprehensive scores based on frequency matching degree, energy weight and cycle consistency, determining a respiration main component by the intrinsic mode component with the highest comprehensive score, calculating a power spectrum peak corresponding to the respiration main component, and determining the respiration times by the power spectrum peak. The method enhances the robustness of the animal breath detection method.

title_en: Sensor, system and method for detecting radar biosignal
title_ko: 생체신호 검출을 위한 low-IF 레이더 센서, 시스템 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sensor and system for radar bio-signal detection and a bio-signal detection method using the same. More specifically, the sensor has a simple radar structure without a null detection point while canceling the noise effect caused by a signal source. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the sensor for radar bio-signal detection according to one embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a transmission unit transmitting a signal to a living organism; a reception unit receiving a signal reflected from the living organism; and a switching signal application unit directly connected to the reception unit to apply a switching signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 레이더 생체신호 검출을 위한 센서, 시스템 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 신호원에 의한 잡음 영향을 상세하면서도 널 감지 지점(Null detection point)이 없는 간단한 구조의 레이더 구조를 갖는 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 생체신호 검출 센서는 생명체를 향해 신호를 송신하는 송신부; 상기 생명체로부터 반사되는 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 및 상기 수신부에 직접 연결되어 스위칭 신호를 인가하는 스위칭 신호 인가부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Smart traffic signal lamp
title_ko: 스마트 교통신호봉
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart traffic signal rod. The smart traffic signal rod according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: an LED unit in which an LED light bulb is formed on the top of the smart traffic signal rod; a handle provided at the lower end of the LED unit; a self-generation battery unit provided inside the LED unit to convert kinetic energy to generate power; and a biosignal detection sensor provided on the outside of the handle to sense the biosignal of an operator.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 교통신호봉에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 스마트 교통신호봉은, 스마트 교통신호봉의 상단에 LED전구가 형성되는 LED부; 상기 LED부의 하단으로 마련되는 손잡이부; 상기 LED부의 내측에 마련되어 　 운동에너지를 변환하여 전력을 생산하도록 구비되는 자가발전 배터리부; 및 상기 손잡이부의 외측에 마련되어 작업자의 생체신호를 감지하도록　구비되는 생체신호 감지센서를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: System for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for determining a dangerous situation and managing safety of a user. The system comprises: a wearable device which senses a biometric signal of a user by using at least one sensor every predetermined period, and transmits the sensed information to a server; and the server which monitors a state of the user based on sensor information received from the wearable device, matches a surrounding environment of the user to any one state group among a plurality of state groups classified according to an activity attribute of the user when a change in the biometric signal of the user deviates from a threshold value, determines a risk level for the surrounding environment based on setting information of the matched state group and the biometric signal of the user, and transmits a notification message to a terminal of a guardian according to the determined risk level.
abstract_ko: 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하고, 센싱된 정보를 서버로 전송하는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 상기 웨어러블 디바이스로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하되, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 상기 사용자의 주변 환경을 상기 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하고, 상기 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 상기 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 서버를 포함하는, 위험 상황을 판단하고 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrostatic field sensor and a security system in interior spaces, which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna (1). Said probe is connected to an electronic circuit (2,3,4,31,32) which is able to decode said changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor, and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field, by means of a processor (7), enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding said antenna (1) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Contactless detection and monitoring system of vital signs of vehicle occupants
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and systems for detecting vital signs of occupants in vehicles, for example, the vehicle cabin. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receiving the radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to vibration data of the vehicle, to produce a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine the vital signs of the occupant.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.

title_en: Respiration detection using radar
abstract_en: One or more radar sensors can be used to monitor patients in a variety of different environments and embodiments. In one embodiment, radar sensors can be used to monitor a patient's breathing, including monitoring of tidal volume, chest expansion distance, breathing rate, etc. In another embodiment, a patient position can be monitored in a patient bed, which can be used as feedback for control of bladders of a patient bed. Additional embodiments are described herein.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Detection device for vital signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device (1) for vital signs, comprising a sensor (2) and an energy supply module (3), wherein the sensor (2) has at least one detection means (5, 6, 7, 8), which is designed to detect a vital sign from the group consisting of the oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, and pulse, and furthermore comprises a first (10) communication module, wherein the energy supply module (3) has a second communication module (20) and an energy source (21), and wherein a wireless communication connection (4) exists between the first (10) and second communication module (20), wherein the sensor (2) is configured as an elastically restorably deformable thin-film sensor, and the communication connection (4) is configured for transmitting energy and measured values, or measurement data.

title_en: Oil pipe protection device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil exploitation equipment, and discloses an oil pipe protection device which comprises an oil pipeline, wherein a protective outer pipe sleeve is sleeved outside the oil pipeline, a puncture-resistant layer is embedded and installed on one side inside the protective outer pipe sleeve, a heat-insulating layer is embedded and installed on one side outside the puncture-resistant layer, a flame-retardant rubber ring is embedded and installed on one side outside the heat-insulating layer, a pressure sensor is uniformly clamped and installed at the edge position of the outer wall of the flame-retardant rubber ring, and a fixed inner side ring is fixedly installed on one side outside the flame-retardant rubber ring. According to the invention, through the electronic conducting wire and the puncture-resistant layer inside the protective outer sleeve, the functions of plant puncture prevention, heat preservation and water prevention can be provided when an oil pipeline is pre-buried, meanwhile, when a fire disaster occurs inside the oil pipeline, the flame-retardant rubber ring can be contracted towards the fixed inner side ring side under the action of high temperature, the fire source is closed to block air, the fire source is extinguished, and the function of flame-retardant protection of the oil pipeline is realized.

title_en: Biological sign parameter acquisition method, electronic scale and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data processing, and provides a method for acquiring biological sign parameters, an electronic scale and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an infrared imaging image of a user through an infrared camera module and acquiring a corresponding airflow value when the user measures through an airflow sensor; the method comprises the steps of determining output current parameters corresponding to all electrodes on an electronic scale through an infrared imaging image, determining the acquisition frequency of a pressure sensor on the electronic scale through an airflow value, controlling electronic equipment to acquire at least one group of vital sign data of a user based on the output current parameters and the acquisition frequency, and obtaining a vital sign measurement report corresponding to the user according to a plurality of groups of vital sign data. By adopting the method, the accuracy of measuring the biological sign data can be improved.

title_en: System for rescuing distress of human life by collapse and fire
title_ko: 붕괴 및 화재에 따른 인명 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for rescuing people when a collapse or fire occurs is provided to minimize the number of victims by determining whether a person exists inside a building in which the collapse or fire occurs. CONSTITUTION: An acceleration sensor (110) measures vibrations affected to a building when an earthquake occurs or an external impact is applied. An inclination sensor (120) measures a change in an inclination angle of the building. An analog-to-digital (A/D) converting unit (140) converts analog data filtered in a band-pass filter into digital data. A human body sensing unit (300) detects an infrared ray generated from a human body and senses existence of a person inside the building. A data analyzing unit (400) determines whether a person exists inside the building. [Reference numerals] (100) Collapse detection unit; (110) Acceleration sensor; (120) Inclination sensor; (130) Band pass filter; (140) A/D converting unit; (200) Smoke detection unit; (300) Human body sensing unit; (400) Data analyzing unit; (500) Warning alarm unit; (600) Power supply unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사람들이 내부에서 업무 또는 휴식을 취하는 건축물에 지진, 외부 충격, 화재가 발생할 경우 건축물 내부에 미처 대피하지 못한 사람의 유무를 감지하고 붕괴로 인한 매몰자 및 화재로 인한 질식자를 감지하여 구조대원에게 구조요청을 할 수 있도록 경보 및 구조요청 신호를 전달하는 것으로 상기 건축물에 발생하는 붕괴와 화재를 붕괴 감지부와 화재 감지부를 통해 감지하고, 상기 건축물의 내부에 사람이 존재할 경우 인체 감지부를 통해 사람의 유무를 감지하여 건축물의 붕괴 또는 화재 발생 시 구조대원들이 휴대하고 있는 구조 요청 단말기에 붕괴 또는 화재 발생 신호를 전송하고 인체 감지부를 통해 사람의 유무 감지 시 사람이 있다고 판단할 경우 붕괴로 인해 발생한 매몰자 또는 화재에 따른 연기 질식자가 있음을 구조 요청 단말기에 전송하여 상기 건축물의 붕괴 및 화재 발생 시 구조대원들이 매몰자 또는 질식자를 신속하게 구조할 수 있는 붕괴 및 화재에 따른 인명 조난 구조 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Wall-Touching Gain-Booster and Impedance-Treatment Metamaterial Surface Combined with Patch Antennas for Through-Wall Radars
title_ko: 벽 투과 벽 접촉 레이다용 패치 방사원의 고이득화 및 표면 임피던스 등화기형 메타재질표면 장치
abstract_en: A transmitter for a wall contact type wall penetrating object detection system comprises: a radiation source; and a meta-material planar lens which is arranged to be spaced apart from the radiation source by a predetermined distance and includes a plurality of unit cells using a stacked structure of a metal ring pair patterned on a dielectric as a unit cell. The radiation source includes a microstrip patch array antenna. The microstrip patch array antenna includes: a plurality of microstrip patches for radiating an input signal; and a guard which is spaced apart from the plurality of microstrip patches by a predetermined distance to surround the plurality of microstrip patches in order to alleviate the spread of electromagnetic waves radiated from the plurality of microstrip patches. The present invention can accurately detect a metal body and improve radar performance by transmitting electromagnetic waves through a wall using a wall contact-type meta-material antenna.
abstract_ko: 건물 내 금속체, 사무실 옆 다른 방의 금속체, 복도에서 사무실 안의 금속체, 비파괴 금속체 검출에 사용 가능한 레이다를 만들거나 기존의 동일 목적의 레이다의 성능을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 전자파 방사원인 새로운 안테나와 그에 결합하여 벽 접촉 시 전자파가 벽을 투과할 수 있게 하는 새로운 메타재질표면을 발명하였다. 전자파 방사원은 흔하게 사용되는 혼 안테나의 단점인 구조의 큰 길이는 없애고 장점인 안테나 고이득을 위해 메타재질 렌즈와의 결합에 적합한 마이크로스트립 패치 안테나를 시초점으로, 메타재질구조 표면은 벽 접촉 시 임피던스의 급격한 차이를 줄이는 임피던스 정합을 위해 벽 상의 균일 임피던스 분포에 맞도록 임피던스를 균등화하며 집속하여 이득을 증가시키는 렌즈 기능을 위해 금속패턴의 적층구조의 메타재질 표면을 만들어, 공극을 두고 방사원에 결합한다. 그렇게 하여, 전자파를 만들어 벽을 투과하는 것은 물론 금속체에 닿아 반사되어 오면서 또 한 번 벽을 투과하여 송신기 옆의 수신기에 신호가 도달하게 만들어, 벽 뒤의 도체를 감지하게 하는 신기술이다.
