title_en: Apparatus for suitability assessment and recommendation based on finger pressure and biometric signals
title_ko: 수지압력 및 생체신호 기반 적합성 판단 및 추천 장치
abstract_ko: 수지압력 및 생체신호 기반 적합성 판단 및 추천 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 수지압력 및 생체신호 기반 적합성 판단 및 추천 장치는, 사용자의 수지압력 및 생체적 반응을 기반으로 특정 대상에 대한 적합성을 판단하고, 적합성 판단 결과를 사용자 맞춤형 추천 또는 의사결정 보조로 활용하는 시스템에 있어서, 수지압력 측정장치; 피부 전도도(GSR)와 근전도(EMG) 및 심박수(HR)를 측정하는 센서를 구비한 생체신호 측정장치; 상기 수지압력 측정장치 및 상기 생체신호 측정장치로부터 수집된 데이터를 처리하고 분석하는 프로세서; 상기 데이터를 기반으로 사용자 기본값을 산출하고, 상기 특정 대상에 대한 측정값과 상기 사용자 기본값 간의 비교를 통해 상기 특정 대상에 대한 적합성을 산출하여 점수화하는 적합성 산출 알고리즘 모듈; 적합성 결과를 사용자에게 출력하는 사용자 인터페이스; 및 상기 적합성 결과를 활용하여 상기 특정 대상에 관련된 선택을 보조하고, 상기 특정 대상에 연관된 비즈니스 시스템과 연동하여 추천, 판매, 컨설팅 솔루션 중 적어도 하나를 제공하는 통합 추천 모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Chest-based physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Microwave sensing device for detecting vital signs of paralyzed old people
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microwave sensing device for paralysed old man vital sign detects, including the base, the lower extreme of base is fixed with the universal wheel, is fixed with the barrel on the base, and it is provided with the stand to slide in the barrel, is fixed with the rod cover on the stand, and it has first threaded rod to slide to run through in the rod cover, and the one end of first threaded rod is fixed with the connecting rod, and the lower extreme of connecting rod is fixed with the mounting panel, is provided with the microwave radar module on the mounting panel. Through the height adjustment and the front and back position adjustment to the microwave radar module, can adjust according to the actual position that paralysed old man lies in the bed to make things convenient for family members' use, and the microwave radar module is convenient for assemble, convenient maintenance.

title_en: Fire-fighting smoke-sensing alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire control smoke detector alarm, including pre-buried box, the bottom surface of pre-buried box is provided with the smoke detector cover, the bottom surface intercommunication of smoke detector cover sets firmly the cooperation cover, the bottom surface port intercommunication of cooperation cover sets firmly the collar, a plurality of flashing lamps are evenly installed to the bottom surface of collar, the collar has set firmly the installation section of thick bamboo, the installation section of thick bamboo is located the cooperation cover, the top surface port of installation section of thick bamboo is internal fixed mounting has the mounting bracket, the mid-mounting of mounting bracket has smoke alarm sensor, the fixed mounting has the cross in the bottom surface port of installation section of thick bamboo, the mid-mounting of cross has the smoke detector speaker; an oval connecting plate is fixedly arranged on the inner top surface of the embedded box, and a mounting assembly is arranged between the oval connecting plate and the smoke sensing cover. The utility model discloses a setting of installation component not only is convenient for install and dismantle the alarm is felt to the fire control cigarette, easy operation does benefit to the popularization moreover.
assignees: ANHUI YUNHAI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Area array detection system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an area array detection system based on a through-wall radar, which comprises a radar main control and an antenna area array, wherein the antenna area array comprises four transmitting antennas and six receiving antennas, the four transmitting antennas and the six receiving antennas are respectively and electrically connected with the radar main control, the four transmitting antennas are respectively positioned at four vertexes of a rectangular surface, two receiving antennas are respectively arranged on two long sides of the rectangular surface, one receiving antenna is respectively arranged on two short sides of the rectangular surface, and the distance between each transmitting antenna and each adjacent receiving antenna is equal to the distance between each adjacent receiving antenna. The detection system disclosed by the utility model adopts a stepping frequency system, an area array is formed by arranging spiral antennas in a central symmetry mode, and the distance between each array element is accurately calculated, so that the Nyquist sampling theorem is satisfied, and the interference area is made to be small enough as much as possible, thereby avoiding the influence of grating lobes on the array performance.
assignees: CHINA INSTITUTE OF RADIO WAVE PROPAGATION CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION NO 22 RESEARCH IN

title_en: The calibration method of life signal measuring system and method and correcting filter
abstract_en: Disclose a kind of method for measuring the method and system of life signal using millimetre-wave radar sensing system and being calibrated to the correcting filter for the system.The method of the measurement life signal includes: to execute first group of radar surveying using millimetre-wave radar sensor to generate first group of radar data；First group of range gate measurement is determined according to first group of radar data；High response range gate is determined according to first group of range gate measurement；And life signal information is extracted from height response range gate.

title_en: System with vital sign data sensor
abstract_en: The system with analytical unit 1 and sensor 2,3 that the present invention relates to a kind of, wherein the sensor 2,3 can measure the vital sign parameter of life entity 4 and the analytical unit 1 can be implemented to analyze based on measured vital sign parameter.The analytical unit 1 provides in this way, enables analytical unit 1 to send command signal 8 to external equipment 5,6,7 according to the result of analysis, so that external equipment 5,6,7 executes movement according to command signal 8.The invention further relates to a kind of application, a kind of method and a kind of computer program products.User is it is possible thereby to save the time and realize extra high operating comfort.

title_en: Human health state detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of human body detection of electromagnetic waves, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting human body health states. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signals generated in continuous frames, analyzing to obtain voltage values of the echo signals, and determining a state decision weight corresponding to a signal wave of each frame according to the voltage values of the echo signals and the voltage value of the spatial noise; calculating a state value corresponding to each frame according to the state decision weight and the voltage value of the echo signal, comparing the state value corresponding to each frame with a standard value of a preset human body state, and determining the human body state corresponding to each frame according to a comparison result; and judging the health state of the human body according to the human body state corresponding to the continuous frames in the preset time and a preset decision rule. The invention can realize the recognition of the human body state based on the microwave signal, thereby accurately judging the health state of the human body and improving the application range of the detection of the vital signs of the human body by utilizing the microwave.
assignees: BEIJING ZHUOJIAN ZHIHAN TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI ZHUOHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sleep monitoring method and sleep monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a sleep monitoring method and sleep monitoring equipment. The sleep monitoring method comprises the steps of obtaining continuous multi-frame two-dimensional temperature images obtained by temperature monitoring of a sleeping scene through a two-dimensional temperature sensor, obtaining a spatial perception signal obtained by spatial perception of the sleeping scene through a body perception radar, wherein the body perception radar is a radar capable of perceiving body movement characteristics representing vital signs of an object, carrying out recognition processing on the multi-frame two-dimensional temperature images to obtain a gesture prediction sequence representing body gesture change of the object, carrying out joint recognition processing on the multi-frame two-dimensional temperature images and the spatial perception signal to obtain a sleep state prediction sequence representing sleep characteristic states of the object, and recognizing sleep time of the object based on the gesture prediction sequence and the sleep state prediction sequence. By adopting the scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure, the problem that the time for determining the object to fall asleep is inaccurate through the information representing the vital signs of the user can be found.
assignees: BEIJING GEWU CENTURY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device, system, and method for heartbeat signal detection and processing
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of assuring satisfactory detection of a heartbeat even when there is interference caused by various generation sources.SOLUTION: A heartbeat detection device includes at least one optical reflection sensor (10 or 10a and 10b) to be placed on the skin of a person. A sensor unit is provided with a light emitter (11) and a corresponding light receiver (12) for converting a light reflected by the skin to an electric signal, includes electrically adjustable optical filters (16 and 17) connected to the light emitter or the light receiver, or both of them, for selecting desired light wavelength when operated, and executes processing of the signal thus obtained for reinforcing a heartbeat signal. There are descriptions on the system having this device, and the detection method as well.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sensing Catheter
abstract_en: To provide a vascular access device, and associated system and method.SOLUTION: A catheter system can include a catheter including a catheter lumen having a proximal end, a distal end, a luminal surface, and an outer luminal surface. The catheter can also include first and second electrodes. A blood sensor can communicate with the first and second electrodes. The distal end of the catheter lumen can be inserted into a blood vessel of a patient in the following manner: (1) At least part of the first and second electrodes is buried in the blood vessel of the patient. (2) The first and second electrodes communicate with each other through the blood present in the blood vessel of the patient. (3) The blood sensor detects insertion of the distal end of the catheter lumen into the blood vessel of the patient by sensing at least one characteristic associated with the blood present in the blood vessel of the patient.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: The device which sends the living body signal between living bodies
title_ko: 생체간 생체신호 전달 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A device is provided to transfer the bio-signal of an organism to a different organism through an electrode. CONSTITUTION: An organism signal transfer device comprises a first electrode, a second electrode, an amplifier, and a wire. The first electrode is attached onto the skin of a first organism. A second electrode is attached onto the skin of a second organism. The second electrode is connected to the end of the wire. The amplifier is connected to the first electrode and the wire. The amplifier amplifies a bio-signal which is measured from the first electrode. The amplifier transfers the amplified bio-signal to the second electrode through the wire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 한 생체의 생체신호를 다른 생체에 전달할 수 있는 장치로서 생체신호가 전극을 통하여 전자기유도 현상에 의하여 전선을 따라 이동하거나 마이크로파에 담긴 생체신호가 수신 안테나를 통하여 증폭부에서 증폭된 후 전선을 통하여 다른 생체에 부착되는 전극이나 송신 안테나를 통하여 다른 생체의 신경에 전달되어 다른 생체의 생각이나 의지등을 알 수 있게 되는 생체신호 전달 장치이다.

title_en: System and methods for detection of subjects vitals and physiological symptoms via non-contact methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring which properly detect subject' s vital signs by correcting the measured signals for reflectance and variations in distance between measurements. The present invention provides for adequate sensor numbers and types to properly monitor a subject's vitals and physiological signals. Certain aspects of the invention include the use of signal scoring methods. In such embodiments, acquired data and/or information is used for scoring a signal acquired from non-contact vital monitoring assisting in the accurate measurement of various vitals of a subject, including, without limit, a subjects temperature, cardiovascular and respiratory information. The present invention provides a viable solution for at-a-distance non- contact vital sign monitoring that overcomes the shortcomings of existing solutions known in the art.

title_en: Using wifi-signal based, device-free human presence detection technology to identify humans consuming media content
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method includes detecting a presence of a subject in a vicinity of radio transceivers based on radio signal strength variations received at an input of the radio transceivers as a radio signature, so as to recognize the presence of the subject in an indoor environment by analyzing and quantifying irregularities in the radio signature, wherein the detecting the presence does not incorporate sensors for subject detection, and only performs the detecting based on radio irregularity phenomenon, without modifying the indoor environment; and mixing the detected presence of the subject with viewership datasets derived from an audience measurement source, to generate rich result datasets that provide insights on media exposure at a personal and household level, and to assign personal viewership insights to the household audience observation, without sacrificing personal privacy of the subject, and without requiring additional hardware or detection signals.

title_en: Millimeter wave (mmwave) mapping systems and methods for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs for defining a human psychological state
abstract_en: Millimeter (mmWave) mapping systems and methods are disclosed for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs for defining a human psychological state. A point cloud comprising point cloud data defining a person or an object detected within a physical space is generated based on one or more mmWave waveforms of an mmWave sensor. A posture of the person within the portion of the physical space is determined from the point cloud data. One or more vital signs of the person is determined based on the mmWave waveform(s). An electronic feedback is provided representing a human psychological state of the person as defined by the point cloud data and the one or more vital signs of the person.

title_en: A kind of through-wall detection body of wall suppressing method based on phase locked track loop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall detection body of wall suppressing method based on phase locked track loop, step includes：1) local carrier sin and cos being produced the original echoed signals that reception antenna receives with PLL module is multiplied respectively, is divided into two paths of signals after peeling off carrier wave；2) two paths of signals is sent into together in a DLL module, after calculating delay phase place τ of M sequence, export M sequence, be multiplied with the carrier wave cos of PLL module output, obtain direct-path signal；3) primary signal receiving and direct-path signal are subtracted each other, obtain direct signal；4) pass sequentially through multiple DLL modules, repeat step 1) to step 3) processing mode, finally give target echo information,.The inventive method, is applied in through-wall radar, and signal to noise ratio is suitable, and target acquisition is accurate.

title_en: The one-dimensional radar that system is monitored based on non-contact vital sign is structured the formation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of one-dimensional radars monitoring system based on non-contact vital sign to structure the formation optimization method, and steps are as follows：Under conditions of considering cardiac dimensions, according to radar system carrier frequency, the aperture of array and the number of array element are determined, sliding-model control is carried out to radar one-dimensional array aperture and discrete aperture topology is indicated using the binary vector of Problem with Some Constrained Conditions；MIMO radar directional diagram formula is substituted into obtained binary vector to establish the one-to-one relationship with directional diagram, its corresponding peak sidelobe PSL can be solved by directional diagram, to which PSL to be expressed as to the function of topological structure binary vector, corresponding binary system optimization problem is established；Array topology after optimization is determined using intelligent optimization algorithm, obtains corresponding optimal PSL directional diagrams.The present invention can effectively reduce the PSL that non-contact vital sign monitors radar by intelligent optimization algorithm, structure the formation optimization design to realize that non-contact vital sign monitors the one-dimensional radar of system.

title_en: FMCW broadband life detection radar respiration and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an FMCW broadband life detection radar respiration and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm, compared with the prior art, the FMCW broadband life detection radar respiration and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm has the following beneficial effects: the method can simultaneously acquire respiratory and heartbeat signals of multiple persons, and by using the Coiflets wavelet, compared with the traditional frequency domain filtering, the wavelet can well keep the boundary and energy of a reconstructed respiratory signal, particularly the processing of a short-time signal is obvious, the higher harmonics of the respiratory signal are filtered by adopting a dual-coefficient LMS (least mean square) self-adaptive filtering algorithm, the self-adaptive filtering algorithm does not need an additional reference signal, as a descending search step size factor is adopted in the algorithm, the heartbeat signal can be better kept while the respiratory signal harmonics are filtered, by selecting a proper initial step size factor, the heartbeat signal can be fast converged by the dual-coefficient LMS self-adaptive filtering method, and a small steady state imbalance is kept in a longer time, so that the frequency component of the finally separated heartbeat signal is more accurate in a long time.

title_en: Method for recovering buried history of stratum near normal fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recovering a buried history of a stratum near a normal fault, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out regional stratum division by combining well and earthquake; s2, selecting a virtual well position of the target area and calculating the degradation amount of the virtual well position; s3, calculating the fault activity rate; and S4, recovering the burying history. The method adopts well-seismic combination to divide regional strata, selects a virtual well position in a zone where a fault does not pass near a target well position, calculates the stratum erosion amount by using a trend analysis method, calculates the fault activity rate according to the thickness characteristics of the two strata of a fault rising disc and a fault falling disc, and determines the fault activity period; and recovering the buried history of the research area by integrating the formation degradation data, the lithology data, the ground temperature data and the geological analysis data. The method can accurately recover the burying history and the thermal evolution history of the stratum near the fracture zone, thereby laying a foundation for reservoir evolution and high-quality reservoir diagenesis research; and further, the high-quality reservoir distribution is determined, the drilling efficiency in the exploration and development process is improved, and the production cost is saved.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on phase encoding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign detection and discloses a vital sign detection method based on phase coding, which is characterized in that a vital sign detection signal is coded in a random coding mode, so that a transmitted signal has certain randomness, interference between adjacent carriers can be avoided, after correct decoding, the phase of a false target generated by coherent interference can be randomized, thereby detecting a real target, avoiding the influence of coherent interference, reducing phase noise caused by interference through phase coding and traversal decoding, acquiring vital signs from a signal subjected to serious incoherent interference, enhancing the capability of a radar system in detecting vital signs, judging static clutter and the false target through variance of a phase signal, accurately detecting a human body target, carrying out differential operation on a heartbeat signal, enhancing the component of the heartbeat signal and improving the accuracy of heartbeat frequency detection.

title_en: Fitness monitoring
abstract_en: A mobile system for a user includes a telephone having one or more sensors to capture fitness data or vital sign data, the telephone having a wireless transceiver coupled to the processor to communicate fitness or vital sign data over a personal area network; and a processor coupled to the personal area network to process the fitness or vital sign data.

title_en: Contactless detection and monitoring system of vital signs of vehicle occupants
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and systems for detecting vital signs of occupants in vehicles, for example, the vehicle cabin. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receiving the radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to vibration data of the vehicle, to produce a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine the vital signs of the occupant.

title_en: Systems and methods for mapping manmade objects buried in subterranean surfaces using an unmanned aerial vehicle integrated with radar sensor equipment
abstract_en: An aerial vehicle system for mapping an object buried in a subterranean surface, the aerial vehicle system including an aerial vehicle, an electronic sensor, a processor, and a memory. The memory includes instructions, which when executed by the processor, cause the system to receive a first input data set by the electronic sensor, the first input data set based on an electromagnetic signal and geographic location data, generate a raw image based on the first input data set, and compare the raw image to a calibration data set, the calibration data set based on material calibration data. The material calibration data is based on unique spectral reflection patterns of an object in a controlled environment at predefined heights and subterranean conditions.

title_en: Safety helmet with lifesaving function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety helmet with a lifesaving function, which consists of a safety helmet, a life signal amplifier and a wireless signal sound receiving device, wherein the life signal amplifier consists of a sensor, a lead and a life signal amplifier body, is capable of collecting life signals of human bodies and processing and outputting the life signals, can be used for searching, rescuing and positioning trapped persons in disaster incidents and can be used for monitoring physiological states of people in daily work and life; and the wireless signal sound receiving device can be used for receiving wireless voice signals with a specific frequency, can be used for guiding escape for the people during emergency evacuation and can be used for scheduling and managing the people in daily production and management.

title_en: Radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: A kind of radar life-detection instrument, including：Radar detector main frame and handheld terminal, radar detector main frame wireless connection handheld terminal；Wherein, radar detector main frame includes main case, secondary cell, radar transmitter, signal receiver, signal analyzer, the first Wireless Transmitter and control chip；Handheld terminal includes terminal shell, touch screen, the second Wireless Transmitter, supplying cell and microcontroller chip；Radar transmitter is UWB Impulse radar transmitter.Radar life-detection instrument of the present utility model has the advantages that rational in infrastructure, easy to use, life detection is carried out by using UWB Impulse, it is effectively guaranteed the detection efficient of radar detector, pass through the topology layout inside reasonable Arrangement radar life-detection instrument simultaneously so that the application of radar life-detection instrument more facilitates.
assignees: BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal storage fire control is synthesized and is buried pipe network subassembly directly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field, in particular to a comprehensive directly buried pipe network component for fire control in coal storage. The technical scheme includes that the direct-buried pipe fitting, a communicating pipe, an upper disc and a rotating block are arranged on the direct-buried pipe fitting, a protective shell is fixed on the outer wall of the upper end of the communicating pipe, the upper disc is installed on the top end of the inner wall of the protective shell, the rotating block is rotationally arranged between the upper disc and the communicating pipe, the upper disc and the rotating block are mutually communicated through eccentric detection holes, a pressure relief pipe is arranged at the top end opening of the upper disc, and a flow sensor is installed in the pressure relief pipe. According to the utility model, drainage and pressure measurement are carried out at multiple points in the operation process of the coal storage fire-fighting comprehensive direct-buried pipe network through cooperation between the structures, so that the problematic pipe section can be rapidly inspected, and the pipeline overhaul difficulty is reduced.
assignees: YIJINHUOLUO BANNER MENGTAI COAL CO LTD

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced Maximum Permissible Exposure (MPE) compliance based on vital sign detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing target objects. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflected signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflected signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on these reflected signals, the device may measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g. to obtain a heart rate and/or a breathing rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflected signals are indicative of human vital signs (such as heart rate or respiration). The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether a human vital sign is detected at the target subject and transmit an adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Disaster area personnel rescue method and system based on tilt rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of airplane general technology, in particular to a disaster area personnel rescue method and a disaster area personnel rescue system based on a tilt rotor aircraft, wherein the system comprises the tilt rotor aircraft, an airborne communication base station, a aerial survey CCD camera, a synthetic aperture radar, a photoelectric ball head and a plurality of quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles are loaded on the tilt rotor aircraft, and cameras, life detection instruments, voice communication recognition devices and portable material bags are all assembled on the quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles; the method combines the identification of suspect areas, identification of key search and rescue areas, and targeted rescue of quad-rotor drones. By the aid of the rescue method and the rescue system, the problems of untimely rescue and low efficiency can be effectively solved.
assignees: CHENGDU AIRCRAFT IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium for acquiring vital sign data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium for acquiring vital sign data, wherein the terminal device comprises a radar system, so that raw data can be acquired directly through the radar system, direct contact with a user is not needed, the raw data is processed through a preset network model, the vital sign data is acquired, and the convenience for acquiring the vital sign data of the user is greatly improved. The method of the embodiment of the application is applied to terminal equipment, wherein the terminal equipment comprises a radar system, and the method can comprise the following steps: under the condition that the radar system is in an on state, acquiring first original data through the radar system; under the condition that the radar system is in an on state, acquiring first original data through the radar system; inputting the first original data into a first preset network model, and outputting vital sign data, wherein the first preset network model is an algorithm model obtained by model training according to a first historical original data set and a historical vital sign data set.
assignees: OPPO GUANGDONG MOBILE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Indoor moving object detection method based on Doppler frequency modulation profile and range gating filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting an indoor moving target of an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar, which comprises the steps of providing a moving target detection method based on Doppler frequency modulation profile and distance gating filtering. The imaging result of the moving target is defocused and is easy to be submerged in strong static clutter, so that the detection rate of the moving target is reduced. To solve this problem, the present invention analyzes Doppler frequency characteristics of stationary clutter and moving targets. Then, the range migration of the target echo is corrected in the range-doppler domain by sinc interpolation. Then, the Doppler frequency of each range gate of the echo is estimated by fractional Fourier transform, the estimated value of the frequency modulation is compared with the theoretical value of the frequency modulation of the stationary target, and a range gating filter is designed to inhibit clutter generated by walls and stationary objects based on the difference of the Doppler frequency modulation. And finally, constructing an azimuth compression filter to realize focusing imaging of the moving target. Simulation and actual measurement experiments verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

title_en: System for monitoring leakage piping of underground and buried pipe
title_ko: 지하 매설관의 누수배관 및 누수지반 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A water leak detection monitoring system for an underground buried pipe according to an embodiment comprises: a first sensor for detecting temperature change information generated from an underground buried pipe; a second sensor disposed at predetermined intervals on the buried pipe and detecting an acoustic emission signal; a controller for determining a leakage range around the buried pipe using a temperature distribution and an average value of the temperature around the buried pipe based on the temperature change information around the buried pipe detected by the first sensor, and determining the location of at least one buried pipe leakage based on a change in a vibration frequency and a change in a propagation speed of a leakage sound of a buried pipe fluid detected by the second sensor; and a monitoring module for outputting at least one buried pipe leakage information by converting to a digital signal for a leakage range around a buried pipe and the location of the buried pipe leakage and providing alarm information if the outputted buried pipe leakage information exceeds a preset range. Accordingly, it is possible to accurately determine the location of a leaky pipe of a buried pipe buried underground.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 지하 매설관의 누수 검출 모니터링 시스템은 지하 매설관으로부터 발생하는 온도변화정보를 검출하는 제1 센서; 매설관 상에 소정간격으로 배치되며, 음향방출 신호를 검출하는 제2 센서; 제1 센서에서 감지한 상기 매설관 주변의 온도변화정보에 의존하여 매설관 주변 온도 분포와 평균 값을 이용하여 매설관 주변 누수범위를 결정하며, 제2 센서에서 감지한 매설관 유체 누수음 진동 주파수 변화 및 전파 속도 변화에 의존하여 적어도 하나 이상의 매설관 누수위치를 결정하는 컨트롤러; 매설관 주변 누수범위와, 상기 매설관 누수위치에 대하여 디지털 신호로 변환하여 적어도 하나 이상의 매설관 누수정보를 출력하고, 상기 출력된 매설관 누수정보가 미리 설정된 범위를 초과하는 경우, 알람 정보를 제공하는 모니터링 모듈; 을 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Providing image units for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: According to an example aspect of the present invention, there is provided image units for vital sign monitoring by a multichannel radar scanning a field-of-view and a microwave imaging radiometer sounding the field-of- view. Presence of moving targets within the field-of- view of the radar is determined on the basis of phase and/or amplitude changes of the image units between scans. Thermal information or information determined based on the thermal information obtained by the sounding is combined with the image units of the moving targets. In this way vital signs may be monitored based on movement and thermal information of the image units.

title_en: Joint estimation of respiratory and heart rates using ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: A method for contactless vital sign monitoring includes transmitting, via a transceiver, radar signals for object detection. The method also includes generating a clutter removed channel impulse response from received reflections of the radar signals a portion of which are reflected off of a living object. The method further includes identifying a set of range bins corresponding to a position of the living object. Additionally, the method includes identifying a first set of signal components representing a respiration rate of the living object and a second set of signal components representing a heart rate of the living object.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Device and method for assessing, predicting and operating users health in real time
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards a medical device for assessing, and predicting and operating the user's health by capturing the user's vital signs in real time. The medical device comprises a plurality of electrodes and a plurality of sensors positioned on various finger sheaths, wrist portions, and hand portions. The various finger sheaths, the wrist portions, and the hand portions are configured to allow the plurality of electrodes to detect a plurality of electrical potentials on different surfaces of a user's body parts and the plurality of sensors to collect vital signs on different surfaces of a user's body parts. at least one processing device configured to contact with the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors, the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors configured to transmit the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs from the different surfaces of the user's body parts to the processing device. The processing device configured to store the plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs and process the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs to assess a user's health and an end user device configured to receive the plurality of processed electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs form the processing device through a network.
assignees: ATTN VIHATI TECHNO HEALTH PRIVATE LTD

title_en: Lifting or supporting machine for earthquake rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a lifting or supporting machine for earthquake rescue and relates to the field of rescue, engineering application and the like, in particular to a special lifting or supporting machine needed in natural disasters such as earthquakes and the like. The lifting or supporting machine consists of a spherical body and four telescopic type hydraulic cylinders, wherein the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are mutually connected in the spherical body by pipe joints, and four points where the four telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are contacted with the surface of the spherical body form four apex points of a regular hexahedron inscribed to the spherical body; the supporting palms on the top parts of the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are connected with the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders by sphere pairs; and the top part of each telescopic type hydraulic cylinder is provided with a supporting palm provided with a force sensor. Under a condition of lower load, the lifting or supporting machine is used as a lifting machine to rescue people buried beneath collapsed buildings, and under a condition of bigger load, the lifting or supporting machine is used as a supporting machine to protect trapped persons from the secondary extrusion when the large-scale machinery is used for moving buried objects; and the lifting or supporting machine also has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, easy maintenance, big lifting or supporting force and strong environmental adaptability.

title_en: Identification sensor for deep-buried objects
abstract_en: A transponder for an RFID-type wireless communication and contactless identification system intended to be attached to (or in the vicinity of) an embedded item, the transponder comprising: -a set of antenna sections (200 x) consisting of electrical conductors constituting at least one first antenna element (203-1) and at least one second antenna element (203-2); -a printed circuit comprising an RFID chip and at least one tuning capacitor (202 x); and a connector (281) allowing electrical connection of the antenna sections.

title_en: Vital signal measurement system and method, and calibration method for correction filter
abstract_en: A method and system for measuring vital signals using a millimeter wave radar sensor system and a method for calibrating a correction filter for the system are disclosed. The method for measuring the vital signal comprises the following steps: performing a first set of radar measurements using millimeter wave radar sensors to generate a first set of radar data; determining a first set of range gate measurements from the first set of radar data; determining a high response range gate from the first set of range gate measurements; and extracting vital signal information from the high-response range gate.

title_en: Method, device and system for learning and imaging ultra-wideband through-wall radar and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method, a device and a system for learning and imaging of an ultra-wideband through-wall radar and a readable storage medium, wherein the method is used for acquiring echo scattering data of a hidden target; removing wall echoes and noise of the echo scattering data; constructing a Fourier transform fast operator according to a diffraction tomography algorithm; constructing a compressed sensing sparse reconstruction model based on the echo scattering data and the fast Fourier transform operator; and a sparse reconstruction iterative algorithm is expanded into a multilayer neural network structure, and the hyper-parameters in the network model are trained through a training data set. According to the invention, by randomly down-sampling the echo data, the frequency domain data acquisition amount of the system is greatly reduced, and the data acquisition time of the system is reduced; reducing the memory required by the operation of the algorithm by constructing a fast operator of Fourier transform; by driving the hyper-parameters of the intelligent learning network model through data, the calculation complexity is reduced, the limitation of iteration time consumption of a sparse reconstruction method is avoided, and the imaging quality is improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar antenna device for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar antenna device for vital sign monitoring, which comprises a base, wherein a monitoring equipment main body is rotatably connected to the base, an antenna assembly is arranged at the top end of the monitoring equipment main body, the monitoring equipment main body comprises a bottom plate, a housing and a locking rod, the antenna assembly comprises a casing, a top cover and an antenna plate, and the casing is connected with the housing through a pull plate. According to the invention, the antenna assembly which can be independently extended and the orientation angle can be adjusted on the monitoring equipment main body, so that the orientation of the antenna plate in the antenna assembly can be changed along with the change of the orientation of the antenna assembly, and the orientation angle of the antenna plate can be manually adjusted, so that the direction of sending and receiving signals by the antenna plate can be opposite to a patient needing vital sign monitoring, the monitoring error is reduced, and the accuracy of monitoring data is increased.

title_en: Textile electrode kit, and the motion artifact-minimizing clothing installed with the kit
title_ko: 직물전극 키트 및 이를 장착한 동잡음 최소화 의복
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전도성 직물기반 생체신호 측정 센서 등으로 이루어진 직물전극 키트와, 상기 직물전극 키트가 의류에 장착되어, 무구속적 및 무자각적으로, 피검자의 심전도 등 생체신호를 일상 동작 중에도 동잡음이 최소화하고 안정적으로 검출하도록 하는 의복 구조를 구비한, 직물전극 키트 및 이를 장착한 의복에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에서, 생체신호를 검출하는 전극을 장착하기 위한 의복은, 좌우측 겨드랑이 밑에 각각 위치되며, 탄성재질로 이루어진, 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재; 비신축성 소재를 포함하여 이루어지며, 띠형태를 이루며, 의복 앞판에 위치되되, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되는, 앞판중앙 띠;  앞판중앙 띠의 상단의 중앙에서 앞판의 목둘레선의 중앙까지 수직으로 이루어진 다트(dart)인, 앞판상부 중앙다트; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 띠형태를 이루며, 의복 뒷판에 위치되되, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착되는, 뒷판중앙 띠; 뒷판중앙 띠의 하단의 중앙에서 허리부까지 수직으로 이루어진 다트(dart)인, 뒷판하부 중앙다트;를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
앞판중앙 띠는, 중앙에 위치되며 탄성재질로 이루어진, 가슴중앙 탄성부재; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 가슴중앙 탄성부재의 일단에 장착된, 좌측 앞판중앙 띠; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 가슴중앙 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착된, 우측 앞판중앙 띠;를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: A readout circuit for multi-sensing
title_ko: 멀티 센싱 리드아웃 회로
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, 멀티 센서 시스템에 있어서, TSP로부터 터치를 기반으로 입력되는 다양한 신호 또는 환경 센서로부터 입력되는 다양한 환경 센서 신호를 해당 신호에 대응되는 센싱 정보로 생성할 수 있는 리드아웃 회로를 통합하여 구현하고, 다양한 신호가 입력되는 경우 신호의 특성에 대응되는 리드아웃 회로를 통해 해당 신호가 처리되도록 하여 하나의 TSP를 이용하여 별도의 추가적인 장치 없이 터치 신호를 포함하여 생체 신호 및 환경센서 신호도 센싱할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar with variable dwell time
abstract_en: An object detection system may be capable of sensing a buried object and providing an estimate of the object's depth. The object detection system may comprise a signal generator transmitting one or more signals. At least one of the signals may be directed toward the buried object and reflected off of the object back to the system. At least one of the signals may be transmitted along a variable length path. A correlator may then receive the signals and determine an offset between their arrival times at the correlator. The variable length path may then be adjusted over a range which includes a minimum offset indicating a distance to the object.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar with support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld through-wall radar with a bracket, relating to the technical field of through-wall radars, comprising a shell; two roller grooves which are vertically arranged are formed above the left side and the right side of the back surface of the shell and below the middle part of the back surface of the shell, rollers are connected in the roller grooves in a rolling manner, and a silencing pad is wrapped on the surface of each roller; a transverse groove is formed in the rear side of the bottom of the shell, two ends of the transverse groove are communicated with a containing opening which is formed in the left side and the right side below the rear surface of the shell, a supporting shaft is movably connected in the containing opening, an extending shaft penetrating through the bottom of the supporting shaft is movably embedded in the supporting shaft, and five clamping holes which are vertically and equidistantly distributed are formed in the rear surface of the supporting shaft; the utility model discloses beneficial effect does: when convenient handheld, can give the holding power through the back shaft, physical demands when reducing handheld to the pulley of bottom shaft bottom can also play the effect of supplementary removal through-wall radar, can reduce the noise of gyro wheel when the wall removes through the silence pad simultaneously.

title_en: Vital sign information monitoring method and device, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign information monitoring method and device, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an echo signal of a target object in a sleep state through target monitoring equipment, wherein the target monitoring equipment is radar monitoring equipment which is not needed to be worn by the target object; extracting a micro-motion signal from each distance unit in the echo signal; carrying out spectrum analysis on the inching signal to obtain a chromatogram of the inching signal; monitoring vital sign information of the target object by utilizing a chromatographic spectrum of the micro-motion signal, wherein the vital sign information at least comprises the respiration rate, the respiration form and the restless legs phenomenon of the target object. Through the application, the problem of poor monitoring effect on vital sign information in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Precise rescue method for small earthquake space by utilizing miniature intelligent robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an earthquake narrow space accurate rescue method by utilizing a microminiature intelligent robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data and infrared thermal imager thermal imaging data based on a target area, drawing up a ruin environment three-dimensional model according to the data and generating a passing path map, deploying a self-adaptive networking for the micro-robot cluster, carrying out structural stability assessment and residual vibration risk prediction by combining the map, distributing detection partitions and rescue tasks of the micro-robot cluster in real time based on an assessment result, introducing vital sign information, optimizing balanced distribution of the detection partitions and the tasks, and outputting a parallel scheduling strategy. The application solves the technical problems of low rescue efficiency and low precision in a narrow space caused by complex environment and incomplete perception data, and achieves the technical effects of utilizing a microminiature robot cluster to perform life search and rescue and task allocation in the narrow space and improving the precision and efficiency of earthquake rescue in the narrow space.

title_en: Amphibious search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious search and rescue robot, which comprises a base, wherein a chassis is fixedly connected to the base, travelling mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the chassis and used for moving on land, a floating assembly is arranged on the chassis, the invention can lead the robot to walk on land and in water by arranging the travelling mechanism and the propelling mechanism, can realize land and in-water rescue, is applicable to multi-occasion emergency rescue, and leads the search and rescue to be more reasonable, efficient, accurate, safe and comprehensive; the three-dimensional laser scanning device has the advantages that the three-dimensional laser scanning device is used for carrying out all-dimensional scanning on the search and rescue area, processing laser scanning data, generating a three-dimensional model of the search and rescue area, carrying out path planning and formulation of search and rescue strategies, providing accurate environmental information for search and rescue work, detecting and visually displaying vital sign information in real time through the thermal infrared imager, guiding search and rescue personnel to quickly locate trapped personnel, and improving the efficiency and success rate of the search and rescue work greatly through the combination of the two.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Millimeter wave radar arrhythmia detection method based on particle swarm optimization variation modal decomposition and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar arrhythmia detection method based on particle swarm optimization variation modal decomposition and deep learning, which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring human chest micro-motion signals by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, and carrying out static clutter filtering, phase extraction, unwrapping and trending treatment on radar echo signals to obtain chest displacement signals containing heartbeat and respiratory information; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a variation modal decomposition model aiming at the chest displacement signal, carrying out self-adaptive optimization on the modal number and penalty factors through a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain optimal decomposition parameters and complete signal decomposition, S3, screening modal components located in a heartbeat frequency range according to the center frequency and energy distribution characteristics of each modal component and carrying out reconstruction to obtain a heartbeat characteristic signal representing the mechanical activity of a heart, S4, carrying out time sequence segmentation on the heartbeat characteristic signal, extracting local heartbeat morphological characteristics by utilizing a convolutional neural network, modeling the long-term rhythm dependency relationship of the heartbeat signal by combining a time sequence modeling network based on an attention mechanism to obtain a heart rhythm depth characteristic representation, S5, inputting the heart rhythm depth characteristic into a heart rhythm discrimination model, analyzing the heart rhythm state of a tested person, and outputting a heart rhythm abnormality detection result. According to the invention, the adaptive selection of variation modal decomposition parameters is realized by introducing a particle swarm optimization mechanism, the heartbeat signal, the respiration and motion interference components are effectively separated, and the rhythm characteristics of the heart rhythm are modeled by combining a deep learning model, so that the non-contact detection of arrhythmia is realized. The method does not need to wear electrodes or contact a human body, has the advantages of strong anti-interference capability, good adaptability and high detection precision, and has good application prospects in the fields of heart rhythm health monitoring, disease screening and the like.

title_en: Buried pipe position estimation system
abstract_en: To save labor and improve efficiency in estimation of a position where a buried pipe is buried.SOLUTION: A burying position estimation unit 42 estimates the position and depth of an underground buried structure based on a position measured by a survey position measuring device and an intensity pattern of a radio wave received by a radar survey device. A buried pipe determination unit 44 determines whether the underground buried structure continues linearly based on the position and depth of the underground buried structure estimated by the burying position estimation unit 42, and determines the underground buried structure determined to continue linearly as a buried pipe.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Monitoring system and method for concreteballast
title_ko: 광섬유 브릴루앙 산란 센서를 이용한 철도 콘크리트 도상 변형 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method using an optical fiber brillouin scattering sensor for monitoring the deformation of railway concrete roadbed are provided to sense a position and the size of the deformation generated in an arbitrary position on the railway concrete roadbed of a monitoring target section, thereby measuring the deformation of a track caused by a roadbed loss and subsidence might be generated natural disasters. CONSTITUTION: A system using an optical fiber brillouin scattering sensor for monitoring the deformation of railway concrete roadbed comprises a roadbed monitoring member and an information analyzing member. The roadbed monitoring member acquires brillouin scattering lights according to the length of an optical fiber buried in the concrete roadbed, thereby calculating a brillouin frequency, which is a frequency of the brillouin scattering lights. The information analyzing member converts the brillouin frequency acquired by the roadbed monitoring member, thereby extracting the temperature of the roadbed and deformation data thereof.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 광섬유 브릴루앙 산란 센서를 이용한 철도 콘크리트 도상 변형 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로; 콘크리트 도상에 매립된 광섬유의 길이에 따른 브릴루앙 산란광을 취득하여 이의 중심 주파수인 브릴루앙 주파수를 산출하는 도상감시수단과, 상기 도상감지수단에서 취득한 브릴루앙 주파수를 환산하여 도상의 온도 및 변형 데이터를 추출하는 정보분석수단으로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 광섬유 브릴루앙 산란 센서를 이용한 철도 콘크리트 도상 변형 감시 시스템과, 그 감시 방법을 제공한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 감시 대상 구간에 위치한 콘크리트 도상의 임의의 위치에서 발생한 변형의 위치와 크기를 감지할 수 있게 하므로, 지진 및 폭우 등 자연재해로 인해 발생할 수 있는 노반 유실 및 침하에 의한 궤도 변형을 측정하는데 사용되어 즉각적인 선로 유지보수에 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: A wearable sensing device and a method of monitoring biological signal data/alerting emergencies by using thereof
title_ko: 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 데이터 모니터링/응급 상황 감지 방법
abstract_en: A wearable sensing device may comprise: a bio sensor sheet covering a part of a front chest and back chest around an axillar (armpit) as the center; and a biosensor control unit connected to the biosensor sheet and located at the bottom of the back chest. The bio sensor sheet is configured to measure one or more bio-signals among the electrocardiogram, the heart rate, the body temperature, the pulse, the electromyogram, the blood pressure, and the respiration volume. A wearable sensing device, and a bio-data management and emergency situation detection method using the same, according to the present invention, enable a small number of staffs to rapidly determine whether there is any problem in the health of invalids who are being cared for in a nursing/protective facility and whether an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스는 액와(겨드랑이)를 중심으로 흉부 정면의 일부와 흉부 배면의 일부를 덮는 바이오센서 시트, 및 바이오센서 시트에 접속되고 상기 흉부 배면의 하단에 위치한 바이오센서 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 바이오센서 시트는 심전도, 심박율, 체온, 맥박, 근전도, 혈압, 근전도, 및 호흡량 중 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호를 측정하도록 구성될 수 있다.  본 발명에 따른 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 생체 데이터 관리 및 응급 상황 감지 방법은 요양/보호 시설에 있는 보호대상약자들의 건강 이상 유무 및 응급 상황 발생 여부를 적은 인원으로 빠르게 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Bio signal measurement apparatus and bio signal measurement method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a biosignal measurement apparatus and a method thereof. The biosignal measurement apparatus includes a sensor which detects a signal from at least two reference marks displayed on the surface of an object, and a biosignal measurement position detecting part which uses the signal from the at least two reference marks and outputs information on the biosignal measurement potion. The biosignal measurement apparatus uses information on the biosignal measurement position and measures a biosignal. So, the reliability of the biosignal can be improved.
abstract_ko:
생체 신호 측정장치 및 방법이 제공된다.  
개시된 생체 신호 측정장치는, 피검체의 표면에 표시된 적어도 두 개의 참조마크로부터의 신호를 검출하는 센서와 상기 적어도 두 개의 참조마크로부터의 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호 측정 위치에 대한 정보를 출력하는 생체 신호 측정위치 검출부를 포함한다. 생체 신호 측정장치는 생체 신호 측정위치에 대한 정보를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정한다.

title_en: Blood pressure measurement system and method using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 비접촉식 혈압 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a non-contact blood pressure measurement system using a radar sensor comprises: a sensor unit including a radar sensor that detects a bio signal of a blood pressure measurement target; a signal analyzing unit that analyzes a waveform of the bio signal sensed by the sensor unit; and a blood pressure measurement unit that extracts a blood pressure value of the blood pressure measurement target based on an analysis result of the waveform of the bio signal by the signal analyzing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 비접촉식 혈압 측정 시스템은 혈압 측정 대상의 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 센서를 포함한 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호의 파형을 분석하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의한 상기 생체 신호의 파형의 분석 결과에 기초하여 상기 혈압 측정 대상의 혈압 값을 추출하는 혈압 측정부를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire detection system for predicting fire situation and checking occupancy through supervised learning
title_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire detection system capable of predicting fire situations and confirming occupancy status through supervised learning. The fire detection method according to an embodiment comprises the steps of: obtaining data for fire detection by the fire detection system; applying the obtained data to a recurrent neural network (RNN) model; determining the occurrence of a fire based on the RNN model; and determining occupancy detection based on an ultra-wideband (UWB) sensor. By utilizing machine learning with data from various sensors such as temperature, humidity, and smoke detectors, the system can assess and predict fire risk in advance and improve accuracy through re-learning of the prediction model. Additionally, the UWB radar sensor enables detection of human presence and location at the fire site, thereby minimizing human casualties during fire incidents.
abstract_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 화재감지 방법은, 화재감지 시스템이, 화재 감지를 위한 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, 획득된 데이터를 RNN(Recurrent Neural Network) 모델에 적용하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, RNN 모델을 기반으로 화재 발생 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 화재감지 시스템이, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 센서를 기반으로 재실감지 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 각 센서(온/습도, 연기감지)로부터 데이터를 이용한 기계학습을 통해 화재감지의 위험도를 사전에 판단하고 예측할 수 있으며, 예측 모델의 재학습을 통해 정확도를 개선할 수 있다. 또한, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 레이더 센서를 통하여 화재 발생 장소에 인체가 존재하는지를 판단하고, 위치를 확인할 수 있어, 화재 발생 시 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: System, method, and application using the same to acquire biological/movement signal information using Doppler signals
title_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션
abstract_en: Provided are a system and a method for acquiring bio/movement signal information using a doppler signal, and an application using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for obtaining bio/motion signal information using a doppler signal comprises: a doppler signal obtaining unit which emits a radar signal to a subject to be observed, obtains a doppler signal by obtaining a signal returned by reflecting the radar signal, and obtains a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit which obtains first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a signal information output unit which obtains the first signal information and the second signal information, and obtains bio signal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information using a preset algorithm, respectively.
abstract_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템은 관측 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임 신호 정보를 획득하는 신호 정보 출력부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Radio Frequency Life Detection Radar System
abstract_en: Trapped or confined individuals may be located and rescued by detecting their vital signs (e.g., chest movement or heart beat) using reflected, radio frequency signals over a range of multiple antenna polarities.
assignees: GHAFFARI NIK HOSSEIN;FRASER DESMOND A;PEIXOTO NATHALIA

title_en: Electronic device for determining users vital sign and method for operating the same
abstract_en: An electronic device determining a vital sign while a user is active is provided. The electronic device includes a first sensor for detecting a vital sign of a user, second sensor for detecting an activity of the user, and at least one processor connected to the first sensor and the second sensor. The at least one processor may be configured to identify the vital sign determined through a first signal obtained through the first sensor, normalize the vital sign to correspond to an activity characteristic of the user based on the vital sign determined through the first signal and an activity level of the user determined through a second signal obtained through the second sensor, and determine a merged vital sign by merging the vital sign determined through the first signal and a normalized vital sign.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.

title_en: Device and method for assessing, predicting and operating user's health in real time
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards a medical device for assessing, and predicting and operating the user's health by capturing the user's vital signs in real time. The medical device comprises a plurality of electrodes and a plurality of sensors positioned on various finger sheaths, wrist portions, and hand portions. The various finger sheaths, the wrist portions, and the hand portions are configured to allow the plurality of electrodes to detect a plurality of electrical potentials on different surfaces of a user's body parts and the plurality of sensors to collect vital signs on different surfaces of a user's body parts, at least one processing device configured to contact with the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors, the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors configured to transmit the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs from the different surfaces of the user's body parts to the processing device. The processing device configured to store the plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs and process the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs to assess a user's health and an end user device configured to receive the plurality of processed electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs form the processing device through a network.

title_en: Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on LASSO feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of target tracking and discloses a Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on LASSO feature extraction. Wherein, the LASSO frequency estimation algorithm separates the components of the demodulated echo signals and estimates the frequency characteristics of the interested target components; and the positioning tracking algorithm estimates the position information of the target in real time according to the instantaneous frequency of the target, synthesizes the motion track of the target and realizes the tracking of the target. The invention not only can effectively improve the positioning precision of the target on the basis of ensuring the simplicity (only one transmitter and two receivers) and the detection real-time performance (high operation speed) of the Doppler through-wall radar system, but also can solve the problem of frequency ambiguity and realize the tracking and positioning aiming at multiple targets at the same time. In addition, the method does not need complicated calculation processes such as multi-channel data fusion and the like, has high calculation speed, and has wide application prospect in the field of target tracking of Doppler through-wall radar.

title_en: Drunk driving detection method based on MQ3 sensor and UWB laser radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drunk driving detection system and method based on an MQ3 sensor and a UWB laser radar, and the drunk driving detection system comprises an alcohol detection module (100), a respiration detection module (200), a signal matching module (300) and a drunk driving alarm module (400), wherein all the modules cooperatively operate to complete detection; wherein the alcohol detection module (100) based on MQ3 sensor is used for alcohol signal capture, alcohol sequence processing and drunk driving threshold detection; the UWB lidar-based respiration detection module (200) is used for respiration signal acquisition, respiration signal processing, and passenger separation and localization; the signal matching module (300) is used for periodic signal alignment, sequence feature matching and drinker identity confirmation; the drunk driving alarm module (400) is used for system alarm prompt, data observable interface and drunk driving information uploading. Compared with the prior art, the method can provide efficient and accurate drunk driving detection for a motor vehicle driving scene, and detect the alcohol concentration in the vehicle and the breathing signals of all passengers in real time.

title_en: Large robot burying rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale robot burying rescue method and a system, which relate to the technical field of robots and comprise the following steps: the rescue robot dynamically scans a scene and constructs a three-dimensional model to obtain point cloud data; acquiring a target image to perform target detection; acquiring vital sign data of trapped people through a living body detection radar; evaluating the health state of the trapped person based on the vital sign data of the trapped person; making a rescue decision, planning a local path of the rescue robot by using an artificial potential field method, and simultaneously sending a control instruction according to the rescue decision to enable the rescue robot to carry out rescue operation; the invention can integrate the functions of detecting life signs, positioning the positions of a plurality of trapped persons, researching rescue strategies, automatically planning paths, realizing automatic obstacle avoidance and assisting rescue workers to rescue, thereby making rescue path decisions according to the life strengths and the positions of the trapped persons.

title_en: Sensor for acquiring physiological signals
title_ko: 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 센서
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 특히 센서(1)가 의복(7)에 포함되고 이러한 의복(7)을 착용한 사람이 고 레벨 활동을 하는 경우에, 개선된 실리콘 고무를 가지는, 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 센서(1)에 관한 것이고, 본 발명은 또한 이러한 센서를 포함하는 장치 및 이러한 장치를 포함하는 의복(7)에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Personal air breathing device with safety alarm function
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기
abstract_ko: 공기호흡기에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조)시 소방대원들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서, 고압용기에 저장된 공기량을 측정하는 공기 잔량 감지부, 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 공기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량에 따라 공기 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부, 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하는 공기호흡기; 상기 공기호흡기의 무선 송신기에서 송출된 사용자의 상태신호를 수신하여 저장하고, 관리자의 요청에 따라 사용자의 상태를 화면에 표시해주는 대원관리장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: Safety lighting fitting under a kind of ore deposit
abstract_en: The utility model provides safety lighting fitting under a kind of ore deposit, it is applied on front side of Mine safe cap, including illuminating lamp, the first danger button, the first vibrating sensor, controller and locator, first danger button is connected with the start end of the first vibrating sensor, the output end of first vibrating sensor connects the input of controller, the start end of the output end connecting positioner of controller；First vibrating sensor is used to start detecting when the first danger button is pressed, and the pulse of personnel is strong and weak under detection ore deposit, and pulse strong and weak signals are transferred into controller；Controller is used to control locator to start according to pulse strong and weak signals.By the utility model, positioning signal can be sent when detecting vital signs, so that when occurring mine disaster, rescue group carries out reasonable distribution to rescue resource, is timely and accurately succoured with personnel under the ore deposit to survival.

title_en: A kind of sound insulation shock isolation system of the floor slab pipeline through walls for building construction
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to sound insulation shock isolation system technical field, the sound insulation shock isolation system of specially a kind of floor slab pipeline through walls for building construction, including sound insulation earthquake isolating equipment entirety and acoustic vibration damper plate, the upper end of the sound insulation earthquake isolating equipment entirety is fixedly installed with fixed block, and glass sound insulation lid is installed below fixed block, position of the inner surface of the fixed block among glass sound insulation lid is movably installed with tube seat, one end of the sound insulation earthquake isolating equipment entirety is fixedly installed with card and block, the side of the card and block is fixedly installed with adjusting soundproof plate, the upper end of the acoustic vibration damper plate is fixedly installed with noise reduction shock insulation plate close to the position of glass sound insulation lid lower end, a kind of sound insulation shock isolation system of floor slab pipeline through walls for building construction described in the utility model, equipped with adjusting soundproof plate, acoustic vibration damper plate and noise reduction shock insulation plate, it can mention The flexibility that height uses, and the better sound insulation shock insulation of energy, bring better prospect of the application.
assignees: FOSHAN NANHAI JINYUAN BUILDING MAT CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitor, includes the housing, the monitor still includes millimeter wave biological radar module and display screen, the signal transmission end of millimeter wave biological radar module is located the housing outer wall, waits to detect human thorax position and is located the coverage of signal transmission end, the output and the main control module of millimeter wave biological radar module are connected, the main control module is connected with display module, display module's output is connected with the display screen, the display screen is located on the housing. The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitor which is convenient to use, simple in structure and rich in functions.

title_en: A kind of rescue at sea system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of maritime search and rescue systems, comprising: unmanned plane, unmanned plane obtain the position of itself by navigation satellite in real time, in wrecked sea area flying overhead, acquire image, spectrum and the infrared ray on sea in real time, are sent to control station；Ship is searched and rescued, ship is searched and rescued and is at least arranged 1, for carrying unmanned plane；Control station, control station setting, for being integrated, being sorted out and being analyzed received position, image, spectrum and infrared ray information, identify vital sign parameter signals, and the map of combining position information drafting life body position feeds back to unmanned plane on searching and rescuing ship；Message center: it is communicated to connect for providing unmanned plane and control station, overcomes marine adverse circumstances, realize a wide range of accurate search and rescue of the difficult member of end-on.
assignees: FOSHAN SHENFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave vital sign detection method introducing compressed sensing theory
