abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of millimeter wave vital sign detection, provides a millimeter wave vital sign detection method introducing a compressive sensing theory, and can effectively realize the non-contact real-time monitoring of human respiration and heart rate by a Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar system while greatly reducing the transmission frame rate of a radio frequency front end. The algorithm is used for constructing an underdetermined equation by introducing a compressed sensing theory aiming at the phase information of a human body target, and can accurately capture the position of a spectral peak by directly adopting a small amount of inner product operation under the condition of not calculating a phase signal frequency spectrum, thereby outputting vital sign data. Compared with the existing FMCW radar sign monitoring system, the method has obvious advantages in the aspects of Chirp number required to be transmitted by the radio frequency module, calculation cost of the DSP and the like, and the algorithm can be fused with fast Fourier transform, wavelet transform and various spectrum thinning technologies, and can be used in the fields of nursing monitoring, sleep analysis, family medical treatment, earthquake rescue and the like.

title_en: Multi-mode self-positioning networking radar life detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode self-positioning networking radar life detection method, which relates to the technical field of radar life detection and comprises the following steps of firstly dividing a region to be detected into a plurality of subareas. According to the invention, the area to be detected is divided into a plurality of subareas, and the dynamic change of the signals is analyzed, so that the system can timely identify abnormal signals in complex environments such as debris flow. And generating a signal change coefficient by combining characteristic parameters such as a phase shift index, a frequency spectrum expansion index and the like with a machine learning model, and accurately judging the signal quality. The method effectively avoids missed detection and improves rescue success rate. Meanwhile, the system optimizes resource allocation by comparing the signal change coefficient with a reference threshold value, improves rescue efficiency, ensures that trapped people can be positioned rapidly, and saves more lives.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human body respiration and heartbeat signal estimation method and system based on UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body respiration and heartbeat signal estimation method and system based on UWB radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting channel impulse response signals by using the UWB radar; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing channel impulse response signals, namely filtering random noise of direct current offset and high frequency parts in the signals respectively by means of average filtering and low-pass filtering, selecting a distance gate with the largest autocorrelation value as a distance gate with the most abundant human vital sign information based on the preprocessed response signals by using an autocorrelation function, using a signal sequence corresponding to the distance gate as an input signal for signal processing, decomposing the input signal based on discrete wavelet transformation, extracting characteristic information of the input signal in a time domain and a frequency domain, acquiring frequency point information of a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal based on the characteristic information, and respectively carrying out respiratory frequency estimation and heartbeat frequency estimation based on frequency point extraction in a specific frequency range. The method can realize high-precision respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency estimation.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: Multi-source sensing integrated tree root health intelligent early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a tree root system health intelligent early warning system and method integrating multi-source sensing, comprising a multi-source sensing module, wherein the multi-source sensing module consists of four types of heterogeneous sensors, the four types of heterogeneous sensors form a distributed monitoring network, the system specifically comprises a ground penetrating radar, a dielectric characteristic sensor array, a gas detection unit module and a geomagnetic anomaly detection module, the ground penetrating radar, the gas detection unit module and the geomagnetic anomaly detection module are all arranged in a cylindrical titanium alloy shell, the dielectric characteristic sensor array is connected with the cylindrical titanium alloy shell through cables, and the dielectric characteristic sensor array is vertically buried in a main distribution area of a tree root system.
assignees: QINGDAO AOLIPU QIZHI INTELLIGENT INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Portable non-contact millimeter wave human body breathing and heartbeat monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable non-contact millimeter wave human breath and heartbeat monitoring method and device, the device comprises a millimeter wave lens antenna, a radio frequency front end module, a digital control and intermediate frequency processing module, a digital signal processing module, a shell module and upper computer software. According to the invention, the millimeter wave radar is adopted to realize non-contact respiration and heartbeat measurement, the special millimeter wave lens antenna is utilized to realize narrow wave beam so as to improve signal to noise ratio, the digital signal processing module is used for automatically processing to obtain respiration waveform, respiration frequency, heartbeat waveform and heartbeat frequency vital signs, and the results are synchronously displayed on a shell screen and upper computer software, so that a laser indicator lamp in front of the shell is convenient for observing a measurement position, and the power supply of an adapter and the power supply of a battery are supported. The invention has the characteristics of portability, miniaturization and integration, realizes accurate measurement of respiration and heartbeat in a non-contact scene, is used for emergency diagnosis, intensive care and sleep monitoring, and meets the clinical rapid and accurate respiratory heartbeat detection application requirements.

title_en: Heart rate monitoring method and device, vehicle and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heart rate monitoring method, a heart rate monitoring device, a vehicle and a storage medium thereof, and relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, comprising the steps of acquiring navigation information of the vehicle and determining indication information according to the navigation information, wherein the indication information is information for indicating detection of a user in the vehicle and comprises one or more of traffic signal lamp information, position information of the vehicle or driving information of the vehicle; if the indication information meets the preset condition, responding to the monitoring request, controlling the millimeter wave radar on the vehicle seat to monitor the heart rate of the user on the vehicle seat, and determining heart rate monitoring information of the user according to the electromagnetic wave signal of the millimeter wave radar for monitoring the heart rate of the user. According to the scheme, the heart rate of the user on the vehicle seat is monitored through the non-contact millimeter wave radar, the arrhythmia detection requirements of the driver and the passenger are met, and convenience in heart rate monitoring of the user on the vehicle seat is guaranteed.
assignees: WUHU AUTOMOBILE QIANZHAN TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHERY AUTOMOBILE CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire detection device and forest fire monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 산불발생 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 산불감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forest fire detection device having a power supply structure using a thermoelectric module, and a forest fire monitoring system using the same. In accordance with the present invention, the forest fire detection device includes: a first ceramic substrate forming a high temperature part; a second ceramic substrate forming a low temperature part; a thermoelectric semiconductor provided between the first and second ceramic substrates to sense a temperature difference, and generate an electromotive force based on the temperature difference; a PCB for supplying the electromotive force generated by the thermoelectric semiconductor as direct current power; a control part provided on the PCB to generate a forest fire detection signal with the electromotive force generated when a forest fire occurs; and a communication module connected to the PCT, and wirelessly transmitting the forest fire detection signal generated by the control part to a nearby communication hub, wherein the second ceramic substrate is provided with a heat-conducting ground bracket formed of metal having high thermal conductivity and buried in the ground such that the ground temperature can be conducted to the second ceramic substrate. In accordance with the present invention, the forest fire detection device generates a forest fire occurrence signal with the electromotive force generated by a temperature difference due to the occurrence of a forest fire between a ground part and a heat-conducting support mount buried below the surface of the ground, and transmits the generated signal through the communication module, thereby facilitating installation and enabling more stable forest fire occurrence detection.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 열전모듈을 이용한 전원공급 구조의 산불발생 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 산불감시 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 산불발생 감지장치는 고온부를 형성하는 제1세라믹기판과, 저온부를 형성하는 제2세라믹기판과, 상기 제1,2세라믹기판 사이에 구비되어 온도차를 감지하고, 온도차에 의해 기전력을 생성하는 열전 반도체와, 상기 열전 반도체에 의해 생성된 기전력을 직류전원으로 공급하기 위한 PCB기판과, 상기 PCB 기판에 구비되어 산불 발생시 생성되는 기전력으로 산불 감지 신호를 생성하는 제어부와, 상기 PCT 기판과 연결되며, 상기 제어부에 의해 생성된 산불발생 감지신호를 인근 통신허브에 무선 송출하기 위한 통신모듈을 포함하며, 상기 제2세라믹기판에는 열전도도가 높은 금속으로 형성되며 지중에 매설되는 열전도 지중브라켓이 구비되어 지중 온도가 상기 제2세라믹기판으로 전도되도록 한다. 
이와 같은 본 발명에 따르면 산불 발생으로 인한 지상부의 온도와 지표면 하부에 매설된 열전도 지지마운트의 온도차에 의해 발생되는 기전력을 전원으로 산불발생 신호를 생성하고, 생성된 신호를 통신모듈을 통해 송신 함으로써 설치가 용이하고 보다 안정적인 산불 발생 감지가 가능한 이점을 가진다.

title_en: Vital signal measuring apparatus and method for estimating contact condition
abstract_en: A vital signal measuring apparatus is attached to a living body to measure a vital signal of the living body, which includes an amplifier, an A/D converter, a processing unit, an n-th-order differential signal output unit, and an output unit. The amplifier and the A/D converter constitute a vital signal measuring unit for measuring a vital signal from a vital signal sensor and outputting a first signal corresponding to the vital signal. A time differentiation signal output unit includes the n-th-order differential signal output unit for receiving the first signal and outputting an n-th-order time differentiation signal (where n is an integer of 1 or more) of the first signal. The processing unit functions as a contact condition determination unit for determining contact condition between the vital signal measuring apparatus and the living body based on the n-th-order time differentiation signal.

title_en: Fitness Monitoring
abstract_en: A mobile system for a user includes a telephone having one or more sensors to capture fitness data or vital sign data, the telephone having a wireless transceiver coupled to the processor to communicate fitness or vital sign data over a personal area network; and a processor coupled to the personal area network to process the fitness or vital sign data.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Non-contact vital-sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A non-contact vital-sign monitoring system having a radar disposed in vicinity of a monitored subject includes a data buffer storing output signals of the radar sampled in sequence during a predetermined period; a status classifier determining status of the monitored subject; and a vital-sign detector determining a vital sign of the monitored subject according to the output signals of stationary status.

title_en: Systems and methods for subject monitoring
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for collecting and analyzing vital sign information to predict a likelihood of a subject having a disease or disorder. In an aspect, a system for monitoring a subject may comprise: sensors comprising an electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor, which sensors are configured to acquire health data comprising vital sign measurements of the subject over a period of time; and a mobile electronic device, comprising: an electronic display; a wireless transceiver; and one or more computer processors configured to (i) receive the health data from the sensors through the wireless transceiver, (ii) process the health data using a trained algorithm to generate an output indicative of a progression or regression of a health condition of the subject over the period of time at a sensitivity of at least about 80%, and (iii) provide the output for display to the subject on the electronic display.

title_en: Detection, location, and characterization of buried explosive devices and weapon caches
abstract_en: Embodiments of this invention utilize Fraunhofer diffraction to detect, locate, and characterize buried objects, and, in particular, weapons caches and/or potentially dangerous explosive devices, are to be detected and characterized according to rough size, shape, and reflectivity with respect to the probe energy (ultrasound, microwave, milliwave, etc.). Size is obtained by measuring the spatial pattern and/or width of the Fraunhofer diffraction wave. Reflectivity is obtained by normalizing the reflected energy with respect to the energy reaching the target object and the size of the reflective area of the target object.

title_en: Millimeter wave perception-based multi-human vital sign synchronous monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A multi-human vital sign synchronous monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave perception comprises a millimeter wave radar front-end module, a microcontroller, a processor and a display and recording module, wherein the millimeter wave radar front-end module is used for transmitting linear frequency modulation continuous wave microwaves or millimeter wave signals and receiving reflected echo signals to generate multichannel intermediate frequency baseband signals, the microcontroller is used for setting and controlling waveform parameters, transmitting power, signal gain parameters and monitoring processes, setting and controlling acquisition parameters of a signal acquisition module of the processor, the processor extracts vital sign parameter information of a human body from the multichannel intermediate frequency baseband signals, and the display and recording module is used for displaying and storing information including the multi-human body position information, chest wall micro-motion displacement information and vital sign parameters obtained by the processor. The invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring system and a non-contact vital sign monitoring method which are high in measurement precision, strong in anti-interference capability, reliable and stable for synchronous monitoring of multiple human vital signs.

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar imaging method, system, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar imaging method, a through-wall radar imaging system, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring radar echo data in a preset radar detection scene and discretizing an imaging scene in the preset radar detection scene; constructing a dictionary matrix according to a discretization result of an imaging scene, constructing a low-rank sparse signal model according to the dictionary matrix, determining a low-rank sparse optimization problem in the low-rank sparse signal model, constructing a through-wall radar imaging model according to the determined low-rank sparse optimization problem, performing model training on the through-wall radar imaging model until the through-wall radar imaging model converges, inputting echo data to be imaged into the converged through-wall radar imaging model, and performing imaging analysis to obtain a reconstructed image. According to the invention, the clutter suppression and target image reconstruction problems of the wall are converted into the low-rank sparse optimization problem, the reflection clutter of the wall is effectively suppressed, and the imaging quality of the reconstructed image is improved.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle airborne life detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne life detection radar, which comprises a radar device and a shell for installing the radar device, wherein the radar device comprises an antenna, a power module, a radio frequency module and a baseband module, and is characterized in that a damping device is also arranged on the shell, the damping device comprises a damping shaft, and a damping spring and a damper cover plate which are nested on the damping shaft; the shock absorber shaft extends out of the surface of the shell and is connected with the shell through the shock absorber cover plate. The utility model discloses the device is direct to be carried on the carbon plate of unmanned aerial vehicle bottom, can realize life detection, and can effectively reduce and take the interference problem for life detection device by unmanned aerial vehicle vibrations, and damping device adopts dual shock-absorbing structure, can reach the best shock attenuation effect.

title_en: One-dimensional radar embattling optimization method based on non-contact vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an one-dimensional radar embattling optimization method based on a non-contact vital sign monitoring system. The method comprises the following steps of under the condition that a heart size is considered, according to a radar system carrier frequency, determining the numbers of apertures of an array and array elements, carrying out discretization processing on one-dimensional array apertures of a radar and using a binary system vector with a constraint condition to express the discrete apertures in a topology mode; substituting the acquired binary system vector to a MIMO radar direction diagram formula to determine an one-to-one correspondence relation with the direction diagram, using the direction diagram to solve a corresponding peak sidelobe level PSL so that the PSL expresses a function of a topology-structure binary system vector, and establishing a corresponding binary system optimization problem; and using an intelligent optimization algorithm to determine an optimized array topology structure and obtaining a corresponding optimal PSL direction diagram. In the invention, through the intelligent optimization algorithm, the PSL of the non-contact vital sign monitoring system radar can be effectively reduced so as to realize a one-dimensional radar embattling optimization design of the non-contact vital sign monitoring system.

title_en: Rescue unmanned plane and its regulation and control fire-fighting system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to rescue unmanned plane and its regulation and control fire-fighting system, it is included with unmanned planes more than three axles respectively by corresponding motor driving, the performing module being arranged on unmanned plane, the control terminal by wirelessly controlling unmanned plane and performing module respectively and the battery for providing electric energy to performing module；Performing module includes illuminator, radar life-detection instrument, GPS positioning system and/or high-definition camera.More than rescue a group of planes, including ten the broken unmanned plane of detection, water spray unmanned plane and the fire extinguishing ball unmanned plane of more than ten of more than ten；Reasonable in design, compact conformation of the invention and easy to use.
assignees: RUENTER RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: A kind of search and rescue robot waterborne quickly searches and rescues positioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of search and rescue robots waterborne quickly to search and rescue positioning system, including power module, navigation module, the first control host, the second control host, search module and control station.The present invention coordinates sonar by search and rescue robot, infrared ray, the autonomous search and rescue of the sensors such as the life-detection instrument difficult member of end-on of marine site expansion nearby, after determining persons falling in water approximate location, search device is based on the location information of the starting point of itself and drowning people, the optimal path searched and rescued is calculated based on ant group algorithm, to be succoured in time persons falling in water, overcome the deficiency that previous rescue worker visually searches for, using infrared, radar, the equipments such as life-detection instrument, quickly persons falling in water is scanned for positioning, rescue in time, utmostly reduce the property loss and human life injures and deaths of maritime peril event.

title_en: A kind of object localization method for building penetrating life-detection radar
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of object localization methods for building penetrating life-detection radar, include the following steps：Step A：Original signal is inputted, and original signal is arranged in B-SCAN figures by road number；Step B：For per the static clutter of the removal of original signal all the way and linear trend item；Step C：By doing energy accumulation to life micro-tremor signal in time domain, the peak value in energy spectrum is detected, to determine the distance between target and two reception antennas estimated value；Step D：According to the range estimation that step C is provided, to this apart from upper all slow times to data be FFT, obtain the echo frequency information at the distance, determine the distance between target and reception antenna；Step E：Distance of the target that step D is provided away from two reception antennas is obtained by the revised time lag curve of wall time delay；Step F：The intersection point for seeking time lag curve, the location estimation as target.

title_en: Vital sign signal enhancement method and equipment, and extraction method and equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for enhancing vital sign signals based on a millimeter wave radar, and a method and equipment for extracting the vital sign signals, wherein the enhancing method comprises the following steps: the multi-antenna radar continuously receives N echo signals, wherein the echo signals are echoes of a target to radar transmission signals; carrying out null filtering on the echo signal to remove zero-frequency components; establishing a multi-channel Kalman smoothing model by taking the signals which are received at the same time and subjected to null filtering as observed quantities to obtain enhanced vital sign signals; the extraction method further comprises the steps of: and performing Fourier transformation on the enhanced vital sign signals to a frequency domain, determining the range of the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency according to the comparison of the amplitude and the frequency spectrum data of a preset threshold value in a preset frequency range, and further determining the characteristic value of the life. The method and the equipment can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the radar receiving echo when the life signal is too weak or the interference of the environmental noise is too large.
assignees: NANJING HUIJUN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact intestinal disease diagnostic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact intestinal disease diagnosis device, comprising: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring radar echo signals by using a non-contact vital sign monitoring radar; the preprocessing module is used for processing the radar echo signal by adopting a band-pass filter; the signal separation module is used for processing the preprocessed signals by adopting a signal separation algorithm to separate intestinal motility signals; the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting the characteristics of the separated intestinal motility signals to obtain characteristic parameters which are beneficial to judging different intestinal conditions, and the machine learning module is used for determining a mapping model between the intestinal conditions and the characteristic parameters by utilizing a machine learning algorithm; and the intestinal disease judgment module judges the intestinal diseases according to the mapping model. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, and can accurately judge the intestinal diseases.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of generating training data, wherein the training data comprises two parts of input echo data and output reference data; the convolutional neural network is a multilayer network and comprises two activation functions, namely a convolutional layer activation function is designed on a convolutional layer, and an output layer activation function is designed on an output layer; constructing a loss function according to the output reference data and the activation function; constructing a convolutional neural network structure for through-wall imaging by training data, an activation function and a loss function and combining a convolutional neural network technology; and inputting training data into the convolutional neural network structure, training the convolutional neural network structure, and then inputting echo data to be imaged to perform imaging test. The invention introduces the deep learning network into the imaging process instead of image post-processing, improves the imaging quality and inhibits grating lobes.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: transmitting frequency modulation continuous wave signals to a human body by using a millimeter wave radar, and extracting intermediate frequency signals; estimating the azimuth angle of the human body relative to the radar, and forming by adopting digital beams; generating a range-azimuth heatmap; estimating the elevation angle of the human body relative to the radar, and extracting a distance-azimuth heat map corresponding to the obtained elevation angle; determining detection points of different human bodies, and extracting intermediate frequency signals of the different human bodies according to the distance, the azimuth angle and the elevation angle; heart rate, breathing rate are estimated. The invention realizes non-contact multi-person vital sign monitoring, can effectively separate echo signals of different human bodies in a radar monitoring scene through the joint estimation of distance, azimuth angle and elevation angle, removes interference signals in the monitoring scene, jointly estimates the heart rate and the respiration rate by utilizing various algorithms, improves the monitoring precision and ensures good monitoring effect.

title_en: Intelligent wearable underwear-based vital sign real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign real-time monitoring method and system based on intelligent wearing underwear, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring vital sign data of a user based on a sensor integrated in the intelligent wearing underwear, acquiring a current exercise activity state of the user through an accelerometer and a gyroscope built in the intelligent wearing underwear, acquiring a vital sign data threshold of the user based on the current exercise activity state of the user, vital sign data change of the user in a preset time window and vital sign data of the user in the same time period, sending out early warning when the vital sign data of the user exceeds the threshold, acquiring abnormal vital sign data of the user sending out early warning, training an abnormal prediction model based on the abnormal vital sign data of the user, and predicting abnormal conditions of the vital sign of the user based on the abnormal prediction model. By the method and the corresponding system, the state of the user is considered to customize the vital sign data threshold value for each user, and the monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN FURUIXING HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Household personnel health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a health monitoring system for household personnel, which utilizes millimeter wave radar technology to monitor vital sign changes of human body in real time, and performs data analysis through a medical monitoring module to generate a health report. The system comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a medical monitoring module, an alarm, a GPS positioning module, a wireless transmission module, a controller and a power module. The millimeter wave radar module receives weak millimeter wave signals sent by a human body through a plurality of radar antennas, and identifies potential health risks and provides alarm information through intelligent analysis. The alarm can trigger sound and light signal alarm according to health abnormality and transmit accurate position information by combining with the GPS positioning module. The system also supports wireless transmission, sends alarm information and health data to the receiving terminal, and provides real-time monitoring and remote management functions for users. The system is particularly suitable for health monitoring of solitary old people, and provides a safe, real-time and intelligent solution.
assignees: LIKAI PRECISION TECH KUNSHAN CO LTD

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on propagation compensation and coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on propagation compensation and coherence factors. Aiming at the problems of attenuation weakening of target signals, grating lobe side lobes accompanying imaging and low imaging efficiency, firstly, reconstructing obtained data based on coherent factors, deforming echo data, obtaining reconstructed data, enabling the obtained reconstructed data to be capable of being calculated in parallel with original echo data to obtain incoherent superposition parts of the coherent factors, then reducing the dimension of the echo data of the MIMO array to be single static array echo data based on an equivalent phase center, quantitatively deriving to obtain a specific propagation compensation value based on scalar diffraction theory, compensating fixed free space propagation attenuation under the condition that non-fixed wall attenuation is difficult to obtain, completing wave number domain processing, designing wall compensation factors of the wave number domain, directly correcting extra time delay introduced by wall penetrating refraction in the wave number domain, and finally utilizing incoherent superposition components and coherent superposition components obtained through parallel calculation to complete weighted imaging to obtain a final imaging result.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-person real-time breath heartbeat monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive multi-person real-time breath heartbeat monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the steps of carrying out one-dimensional Fourier transform on radar echoes and removing static clutter, carrying out rough target detection of a self-adaptive threshold value by utilizing global statistical characteristics, dynamically updating the threshold value by utilizing a front-to-back frame noise intensity ratio, carrying out target verification and accurate positioning by utilizing a 2D-CFAR, carrying out angle measurement by adopting a subspace MUSIC algorithm with enhanced micro-motion characteristics, determining target space information by combining specific frequency filtering, carrying out angle compensation on multi-channel data to obtain phase information, carrying out preliminary separation signal by utilizing two-channel heterogeneous wavelet packet transformation, introducing respiratory frequency multiplication harmonic wave removal technology to eliminate interference, reconstructing respiratory and heartbeat signals with high signal to noise ratio, and carrying out characteristic tracking by combining Kalman filtering and short-time Fourier transform. The invention effectively solves the problems of flexibly switching target positioning and interference under different conditions of single person, double person, same distance, multiple persons and the like, and realizes high-precision self-adaptive vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Apparatus and method of trouble shooting for big-signal sensor in vehcile
title_ko: 차량용 생체신호 센서 고장 진단 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for diagnosing trouble of a bio-signal sensor in a vehicle comprises the following steps of: measuring a first bio-signal through a bio-signal sensor in correspondence with a signal inputted from a seating sensor; measuring a second bio-signal through the bio-signal sensor in correspondence with the input through interface in a vehicle; and determining whether the bio-signal sensor is out of order in accordance with existence of a signal left from a critical range which is set as the second bio-signal corresponds to the first bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 차량용 생체 신호 센서의 고장 진단 방법은 착석 센서로부터 입력되는 신호에 대응하여 생체 신호 센서를 통해 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 차량 내 인터페이스를 통한 입력에 대응하여 생체 신호 센서를 통해 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 및 제2 생체 신호가 제1 생체 신호에 대응하여 설정된 임계 범위를 벗어나는 신호를 포함하는 지에 따라 생체 신호 센서의 고장 여부를 판단하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;OMRON AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONICS;OMRON AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONIC KOREA CO LTD

title_en: System and method for customized addiction therapy based on bio signal
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, the present invention relates to a biosignal-based patient-oriented addiction treatment system and a method therefor. To this end, the biosignal-based patient-oriented addiction treatment system comprises: a sensor for measuring a biosignal from a user; a state determination unit for determining user state based on the measured biosignal; a cognitive behavior treatment image determination unit for determining a cognitive behavior treatment image based on the determined user state; and an image providing unit for providing the user with the determined cognitive behavior treatment image.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 사용자로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서, 측정된 생체신호를 기초로 사용자 상태를 결정하는 상태 결정부, 결정된 사용자 상태를 기초로 인지행동치료 영상을 결정하는 인지행동치료 영상 결정부, 및 결정된 인지행동치료 영상을 사용자에게 제공하는 영상 제공부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 그 방법에 관련된다.

title_en: apparatus for ultra-precision high-resolution bio-signal measuring and method using it
title_ko: 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치 및 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ultra-precise, high-resolution bio-signal measurement device having improved energy efficiency while having high measurement precision, and a measurement method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the ultra-precise, high-resolution bio-signal measurement device comprises: a sensor part measuring a bio-signal by measuring a plurality of electrodes through which electricity is conducted and a change in capacitance between the plurality of electrodes; and a driving control part that supplies a variable current to the sensor part, compares output voltage output by the supplied variable current and reference voltage, and when the output voltage is greater than or equal to the reference voltage, fixes the variable current and resupplies the same to the sensor part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 높은 측정 정밀도를 가지며 에너지 효율이 향상된 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치 및 측정방법에 관한 것으로, 
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치는, 
전기가 도통하는 다수의 전극과 상기 다수의 전극 간의 커패시턴스 변화를 측정하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및, 상기 센서부에 가변 전류를 공급하여 공급된 가변 전류에 의해 출력된 출력 전압과 기준 전압을 비교하여 상기 출력 전압이 상기 기준 전압 이상인 경우, 상기 가변 전류를 고정시켜서 상기 센서부로 재공급하는 구동 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Hand Held Bio Signal Measuring Device and Method Using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 핸드 헬드 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for measuring a hand-held bio-signal using radar. The disclosed apparatus comprises: a handle; an IMU sensor coupled to the handle; and a radar device coupled to the handle, receiving speed information for each direction output from the IMU sensor to calculate a moving distance between a previous time point and a current time point, calculating a distance from a subject at the current time point using the calculated moving distance, transmitting a radar signal to the subject, and measuring a bio-signal of the subject by receiving a fast time signal reflected from the subject, wherein the IMU sensor is arranged such that an x-axis coincides with a transmission signal direction of the radar device. According to the disclosed apparatus and method, it is possible to measure a bio-signal in a portable manner, and it is possible to accurately measure a bio-signal of a subject even in an environment in which radar moves.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 핸드 헬드 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 장치는 손잡이; 상기 손잡이와 결합되어 있는 IMU 센서; 상기 손잡이와 결합되며 상기 IMU 센서에서 출력되는 방향별 속도 정보를 제공받아 이전 시점과 현재 시점의 이동 거리를 연산하고, 상기 연산된 이동 거리를 이용하여 현재 시점의 피측정자와의 거리를 연산하며, 상기 피측정자에게 레이더 신호를 송신하고, 상기 피측정자로부터 반사되는 패스트 타임 신호를 수신하여 상기 피측정자의 생체 신호를 측정하는 레이더 장치를 포함하되, 상기 IMU 센서는 x축이 상기 레이더 장치의 송신 신호 방향과 일치하도록 배치된다. 개시된 장치 및 방법에 의하면, 휴대용으로 생체 신호를 측정할 수 있으며, 레이더가 움직이는 환경에서도 피측정자의 생체 신호를 정확히 측정할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using a kalman filter
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving reflected radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating a displacement signal indicative of a displacement of a target based on the reflected radar signals; filtering the displacement signal using a bandpass filter to generate a filtered displacement signal; determining a first rate indicative of a heartbeat rate of the target based on the filtered displacement signal; tracking a second rate indicative of the heartbeat rate of the target with a track using a Kalman filter; updating the track based on the first rate; and updating a setting of the bandpass filter based on the updated track.

title_en: Deterministic method for non-contact vital signs monitoring via multiple radar signals and related monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the estimation of vital signs of living beings, human or animal, through radar signals of different types both in terms of the signals and the devices used for the transmission and reception of such signals. In particular, a new algorithm is developed for the real-time estimation of the heart rate optionally in combination with the respiratory rate and further capable of detecting apnea if desired. It employs a selection combining technique and a filtering method with memory which, in one embodiment, is inspired by the principles of Bayesian filtering applied to radar signals reflected from the body of the monitored living being. The invention also relates to the system and software implementing such method.
assignees: UNIV DEGLI STUDI DI MODENA E REGGIO EMILIA

title_en: Smart Device-Based Radar System Detecting Human Vital Signs Using a Compact Circularly-Polarized Antenna
abstract_en: Techniques and apparatuses are described that implement a smart device-based radar system capable of detecting human vital signs using a compact circularly-polarized antenna. A radar system includes at least one compact circularly-polarized antenna with a patch antenna and a quadrature hybrid coupler. The quadrature hybrid coupler is on a separate plane that is above or below the patch antenna. By vertically stacking the patch antenna with the quadrature hybrid coupler, lateral dimensions of the radar system can be reduced relative to other antenna configurations or designs. The quadrature hybrid coupler can also have a ring-shape design to improve isolation and polarization purity of the compact circularly-polarized antenna relative to a rectangular design. The compact circularly-polarized antenna enables a radar system operating at frequencies between approximately 1 gigahertz (GHz) and 24 GHz to be implemented within a variety of small smart devices.

title_en: Systems and methods for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring using a radar unit centrally positioned within the cabin to obtain image data of the vehicle cabin and a processor to generate detect occupancy of seats within the vehicle cabin, categorize occupants, detect posture, determine seatbelt status and monitor life signs of the occupants. An output unit may execute responses appropriate to the status of occupants of the vehicle cabin.

title_en: Automatic detection system and method suitable for tunnel lining
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic detection system and method suitable for tunnel lining, which comprises a sectional type pre-buried guide rail unit and a radar antenna coupling automatic scanning device, wherein the sectional type pre-buried guide rail unit comprises a plurality of sectional type guide rails and pre-buried brackets, each pre-buried bracket lifts one sectional type guide rail, one end of each pre-buried bracket is pre-buried in a position to be detected, and the sectional type pre-buried guide rails are linearly arranged into a track for the radar antenna coupling automatic scanning device to move; the automatic scanning device for radar antenna coupling comprises a geological radar, an elastic part and a travelling mechanism, wherein the travelling mechanism is parallel to the running direction of the radar antenna, the elastic part is arranged between the travelling mechanism and the radar antenna, and the radar antenna is lifted by the travelling mechanism to perform lining quality detection on a track formed by the sectional type embedded guide rail units.

title_en: Smart home devices using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring contactless human interaction and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. A radar sensor operating in burst mode may output radar chirp. Burst mode radar data flows may be monitored for non-contact human interactions performed by active users. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. The virtual continuous mode radar data stream may be used for health monitoring of inactive users.

title_en: Three-dimensional through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional through-wall radar system, which comprises a frequency source, a transmitter, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a receiver, a signal processing board and a power supply, wherein the frequency source, the transmitter and the receiver are integrated on the same PCB to form a radio frequency integrated board; the signal processing board is connected with the radio frequency integrated board through an inter-board connector; the power supply is fixed on the radio frequency integrated board and is directly connected with the signal processing board through a power supply interface; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are both positioned on the periphery of the radio frequency integrated board. The invention has the advantages of simple and compact structure, light weight, simple, quick and reliable connection and the like.

title_en: Remote monitoring method for converter station based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote monitoring method of a converter station based on image recognition. The method comprises the steps of setting a camera to shoot images of all physical assets in a converter station, marking position information of the physical assets, extracting images shot by the camera from a database to a data center for image recognition of the physical assets needing to be checked, setting vital signs of millimeter wave radar detection personnel, carrying out image recognition to judge whether smoke appears, judging whether the vital signs of the personnel exist in the smoke by using the millimeter wave radar if the smoke appears, constructing an electronic fence for a set working area of the converter station, and then carrying out image recognition to identify personnel and vehicles entering and exiting the set working area. The invention can remotely count the physical assets in the converter station, and improves the efficiency and timeliness of counting.

title_en: Apparatus For Disaster Relief
title_ko: 재난 구조 장치
abstract_ko: 상기 과제를 해결하기 위한 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 재난 구조 장치는 재난 이벤트가 발생한 경우 상기 재난 이벤트가 발생한 재난 현장으로 이동하기 위한 동력을 제공하는 구동부; 상기 이동 과정 중에 상기 재난 현장에 속하는 재난자를 탐색하고, 상기 탐색된 재난자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 감지된 생체 신호를 기초로 상기 탐색된 재난자의 현재 상태를 판단하는 재난자 상태 판단부 및 상기 판단된 현재 상태에 따라 상기 재난자에 대하여 수행할 구호조치를 상이하게 판단하는 동작 판단부를 포함하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 상기 재난자에게 대피 방법을 안내하는 지도를 표시하는 화면부를 포함한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for living thing presence detection using a radar system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the disclosure include a Radar system for detecting presence of a living thing. The radar system includes a transmitter/receiver module configured to emit radio signals to an environment surrounding the Radar system and to detect returned radio signals from the environment, and a large-movement detection sub-module configured to determine a large movement of the living thing based on the returned radio signals. The radar system also includes a micro-movement detection sub-module configured to determine a micro movement of the living thing based on the returned radio signals, and a breath and heartbeat detection sub-module configured to determine a breath or heartbeat of the living thing based on the returned radio signals. The radar system further includes a presence detection sub-module configured to determine the presence of the living thing based on determinations received from the corresponding detection sub-modules.
assignees: AIRTOUCH SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Control system of wireless sensing mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control system of a wireless sensing mine rescue robot, relates to a control system of a robot and solves the problems that the existing rescue robot sensor has a single type and a small number and underground cables are possibly damaged in accidents to cause system breakdown. A first input/output end of a main controller is connected with an input/output end of a wireless communication system based on the zigbee technology; a second input/output end of the main controller is connected with an input/output end of an ultrasonic obstacle avoiding system; a third input/output end of the main controller is connected with an input/output end of a life detection system; an output end of a positioning system is connected with a fourth input end of the main controller; an output end of a vision system is connected with a fifth input end of the main controller; an output end of an underground environment detection system is connected with a sixth input end of the main controller; and an output end of a power module is connected with a seventh input end of the main controller. The control system disclosed by the utility model is mainly used for collecting the complicated environment information underground in the case of mine disasters, and realizes real-time, accurate and comprehensive information collection.

title_en: Rescue system for a collapse
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue system for a collapse, in which a body detection unit is installed in order to detect the presence of people inside a building, and a tilt sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed in order to set changed tilt data and acceleration data as an event trigger signal, when an earthquake or external shock occurs. Moreover, by analyzing a signal measured in the body detection unit at a predetermined time before the event trigger signal occurs, if someone was in the building before a collapse accident, the place where people are buried is announced through a voice or Morse code via an alarm unit in order to perform a rescue operation quickly. As a result, accident mortality from a collapse may be drastically reduced.

title_en: Noninductive vital health sign parameter measuring instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-inductive vital health sign parameter measuring instrument, which comprises a hemispherical shell, wherein an opening at the bottom is fixedly connected with a support, a radar module for collecting vital sign parameters of a human body is arranged in the hemispherical shell, and an information processing module for receiving and processing the vital sign parameters is fixedly arranged on the support below the radar module; the vital sign parameters processed by the information processing module can be uploaded to a cloud server through a wireless WIFI module and then pushed to a user terminal. The invention adopts the non-contact Doppler radar detection technology to detect the vital sign parameters of the human body, thereby being free from the influence of the external environment and avoiding the danger of contact infection; the intelligent home monitoring system has the functions of data checking, data storage, alarming and remote monitoring, detected data are pushed to the user terminal through the cloud server, so that the user can know the health condition of a detected person in time, and medical treatment and intelligent home are combined.

title_en: Multi-target vital sign detection method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of data processing, and discloses a multi-target vital sign detection method, terminal equipment and a storage medium. The multi-target vital sign detection method comprises the steps of controlling a millimeter wave radar to scan a target area to obtain a point cloud sequence, determining the number of target characters in the target area according to the point cloud sequence, generating an independent point cloud sequence of each target character according to the point cloud sequence when the number of the target characters is multiple, and generating vital sign parameters corresponding to each target character according to the independent point cloud sequence of each target character. The invention reduces the complexity and the cost of hardware and also maintains the advantages of non-contact detection of the millimeter wave radar.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIYUAN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Arithmetic processing device for identifying location of buried long object using gpr data from array-type ground-penetrating radar device
abstract_en: To accurately identify a buried position and an extension direction even when an apex position of a hyperbolic reflection image is not located directly below data acquisition points.SOLUTION: GPR data are obtained by an array-type ground-penetrating radar device on the first, second, and third analysis lines, which extend in different directions and consist of data acquisition points. From a first angle between the first analysis line and the second analysis line and a second angle between the second analysis line and the third analysis line, a vertex position of a hyperbola of the GPR data on the first analysis line, and a first virtual propagation velocity, a second virtual propagation velocity, and a third virtual propagation velocity of the radio wave in the material below the first analysis line, the second analysis line, and the third analysis line are calculated, respectively. An oblique angle between a fourth straight line projected onto the ground from a long object and the first analysis line, an inclination angle between the long object and the ground, a buried depth from a first point located directly above the long object on the first analysis line to the long object directly below, and a position of the first point are calculated to identify the buried position and extension direction of the long object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Detection Apparatus of Vital Parameters On the Steering Wheel
title_ko: 스티어링 휠에 장착된 생체 파라미터 검출장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혼스위치와, 차량의 기기를 작동시키는 리모컨 스위치와, 탑승자의 생체 신호를 검출하는 생체신호 감지부가 장착된 스티어링 휠에 장착된 생체 파라미터 검출장치에 있어서, 상기 생체신호 감지부는, 탑승자의 생체 신호를 검출하는 감지센서와, 광센서를 포함하여, 상기 리모컨 스위치에 장착되어, 스티어링 휠을 파지한 상태에서 생체신호 감지부의 파지가 용이하고, 스티어링 휠의 리모컨 스위치에 생체신호 감지부를 일체로 장착함으로써 별도의 조립부가 필요하지 않게 되어 편의성의 향상되고, 생체신호 감지부를 리모콘 스위치에 내장하여 견고한 조립구성을 이루며, 감지센서를 인쇄회로기판에 전기적으로 연결시 볼팅 및 솔더로 인하여 강건하게 고정되는 스티어링 휠에 장착된 생체 파라미터 검출장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;LS AUTOMOTIVE CORP

title_en: System searching based on drone for rescuing mountaineers
title_ko: 산악 조난자 구조를 위한 무인항공용 드론을 이용한 수색 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a search system using an UAV to rescue sufferers at a mountain comprises: an UAV equipped with a life detection ICT integrated module based on a wireless sensor in the scene of a disaster and scanning Wi-Fi signals from mobile phones of sufferers in the air; a ground control device controlling the UAV to fly to a desired place; and a sufferer rescue integrated server collecting position information, signal strength, time, and atmospheric pressure data of mobile phone of each sufferer through LTE network in real time based on the signals scanned by the UAV.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 산악 조난자 구조를 위한 무인항공용 드론을 이용한 수색 시스템은 조난 현장에 무선센서 기반 인명탐지 ICT통합 모듈을 탑재하고, 상공에서 조난자들의 휴대폰 Wi-Fi 신호를 스캔하는 무인항공용 드론; 상기 무인항공용 드론을 원하는 위치로 비행시킬 수 있도록 제어하는 지상통제장치; 및 상기 무인항공용 드론에서 스캔된 신호를 기초로 하여, 실시간으로 LTE 통신망을 통해 조난자의 각 휴대폰의 위치정보와 신호강도, 시간, 기압 데이터를 수집하는 조난자 구조 통합서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Seismic diffraction lens
title_ko: 지진파 굴절 렌즈
abstract_en: The present invention performs control using a combination acoustic lens and refractive index conversion lens. Seismic waves are a type of elastic wave and acoustic wave, and like other waves, when encountering materials with different impedances, show general wave properties such as reflection, refraction and transmission. If a seismic lens with a diameter approximate to the wavelength of a seismic wave is manufactured and buried underground, an area similar to a kind of artificial seismic dark zone, where seismic waves are weakened by being refracted, can be made. For maximal effectiveness, the seismic wave wavelength to be blocked should be between the thickness and the diameter of the cylindrical lens. Therefore, the seismic wave refraction lens is buried underground not to be exposed to the outside, thereby preventing the surrounding environment from being harmed. Even if the lens is destroyed, the lens can be repaired without causing any damage to a building. Since the degree of weakening seismic waves is linearly proportional to the number of lenses, the seismic wave refraction lens is effective against earthquakes of magnitude 6 or higher, which require a lot of costs with current technology.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음향 렌즈이자 굴절률 변환렌즈를 이용하여 제어하는 것이다. 지진파는 탄성파이자 음향파의 일종으로서 다른 파동들과 마찬가지로 임피던스가 다른 물질을 만나면 반사, 굴절, 투과 등 파동이 보이는 일반적 성질을 보인다. 지진파 파장 정도의 직경을 가진 지진파 렌즈를 제작하여 지하에 매설하면 지진파를 굴절시켜 지진파가 약화되는 일종의 인공 지진파 암영대와 유사한 지역을 만들 수 있다. 최대 효과를 위해서는 차단하고자 하는 지진파 파장은 원통형 렌즈의 두께와 직경 사이로 한다.  
따라서 지하에 매설되므로 외부에 노출되지 않아 주위 환경을 해치지 않는다. 설령 렌즈가 파괴되더라도 건물에 전혀 피해를 끼치지 않고 보수가 가능하다. 지진파를 약화시키는 정도가 렌즈의 개수에 선형 비례하므로 현재의 기술로 많은 비용이 소요되는 ‘규모 6’이상의 강진에 효과적이다.

title_en: Accident Prevention System for Elderly Living Alone
title_ko: 독거노인 사고방지 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for detecting an emergency dangerous situation for the elderly living alone including an emergency dangerous situation detection server, a gateway, a radar sensor, a motion detection sensor, and a pressure sensor comprises: an emergency dangerous situation detection server which applies a video image received from the gateway to a pre-generated learning model for detecting a dangerous situation, provides an emergency risk prediction grade for the elderly living alone according to a posture of the elderly living alone with respect to the video image extracted from the learning model for detecting a dangerous situation to an emergency dangerous situation monitoring device through the gateway, and provides an emergency dangerous situation notification message for the elderly living alone to a manager terminal according to the emergency risk prediction grade for the elderly living alone; a radar sensor which is installed in a residence of the elderly living alone, generates an impulse signal, radiates the same through a transmission antenna, generates a bio-signal value according to a reflection signal for the radiated signal, and provides the same to the gateway; a gateway which, when receiving the bio-signal value from the radar sensor, generates a video image at the moment when an emergency dangerous situation occurs according to the bio-signal value, provides the same to the emergency dangerous situation detection server, and determines whether there is an emergency dangerous situation for the elderly living alone according to the emergency risk prediction grade for the elderly living alone received from the emergency dangerous situation detection server; and an emergency dangerous situation monitoring device which receives and stores a monitoring result for the elderly living alone registered in the emergency dangerous situation detection server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 게이트웨이, 레이더 센서, 동작 감지 센서, 압력 센서를 포함하는 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템은 게이트웨이로부터 수신된 영상 이미지를 미리 생성된위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델에 적용한 후 상기 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델로부터 추출된 영상 이미지에 대한 독거노인 자세에 따른 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급을 상기 게이트웨이를 통해 상기 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치에 제공하고, 상기 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 관리자 단말에 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 알림 메시지를 제공하는 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 독거노인의 거주지에 설치되며 임펄스 신호를 생성하여 송신 안테나를 통해 방사하고, 상기 방사된 신호에 대한 반사 신호에 따라 생체 신호 값을 생성하여 상기 게이트웨이에 제공하는 레이더 센서, 상기 레이더 센서로부터 생체 신호 값을 수신하면 상기 생체 신호 값에 따라 응급 위험 상황이 발생한 순간의 영상 이미지를 생성하여 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 제공하고, 상기 응급 위험 상황감지 서버로부터 수신된 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 독거노임 응급 위험 상황 여부를 판단하는 게이트웨이 및 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 등록된 독거노인에 대한 모니터링 결과를 수신하여 저장하는 응급위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Heartbeat and respiration detection device and heartbeat and respiration detection program
abstract_en: The purpose of the present disclosure is to improve fastness, reduce the effect of disturbance, isolate heartbeat and respiration, prevent multiple counts, and expand detection range while also making it possible to reduce the burden on nurses and reduce the risk of infection when heart rate and respiration rate are calculated on the basis of a radar signal (or an ultrasonic signal) that is reflected at a body surface.　According to the present disclosure, heartbeat detection is performed by extracting a frequency component produced by heartbeat micro-vibrations over a prescribed heartbeat observation time window, extracting amplitude peaks from the frequency component produced by the heartbeat micro-vibrations, and extracting one characteristic micro-vibration from a plurality of characteristic micro-vibrations for one heartbeat. According to the present disclosure, respiration detection is performed by extracting positive and negative frequency components produced by heartbeat micro-vibrations, performing complex multiplication on the positive and negative frequency components, and removing a heartbeat phase change produced by the heartbeat micro-vibrations from the positive and negative frequency components on which the complex multiplication was performed to extract a respiration phase change produced by respiration micro-vibrations.

title_en: Method and device for measuring biometric signal by using radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for measuring a biometric signal by using a radar. The disclosed method for measuring multiple biometric signals by using a radar comprises the steps of: (a) receiving an input of multiple biometric signals from a radar; (b) calculating distance information of the input multiple biometric signals, and classifying the multiple biometric signals by distance; (c) selecting a signal having a largest variance over time from among the distance-specific multiple biometric signals classified in step (b); (d) further selecting multiple signals from among signals, each of which is spaced, by a distance smaller than a predetermined distance, from the signal selected in step (c) among the distance-specific multiple biometric signals classified in step (b); (e) converting all signals selected in step (c) and step (d) from a time domain to a frequency domain; (f) calculating a reliability of each biometric signal in the distance-specific signals converted in step (e); and (g) selecting a distance-specific signal having a highest reliability calculated for each biometric signal in step (f), and detecting a corresponding biometric signal. According to the disclosed method, each biometric signal can be accurately detected from multiple biometric signals.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 레이더를 이용하여 다중 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법에 있어서, (a) 상기 레이더로부터 상기 다중 생체 신호를 입력받는 단계; (b) 상기 입력받은 다중 생체 신호의 거리 정보를 계산하고 거리별로 분류하는 단계; (c) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 시간에 따른 분산이 가장 큰 신호를 선택하는 단계; (d) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 상기 (c)단계에서 선택된 신호와의 거리가 임의의 거리보다 작은 신호들 중에서 다수의 신호들을 더 선택하는 단계; (e) 상기 (c)단계 및 (d)단계에서 선택된 모든 신호들을 시간 도메인에서 주파수 도메인으로 변환하는 단계; (f) 상기 (e)단계에서 변환된 거리별 신호들에서 각 생체 신호별로 신뢰도를 산출하는 단계; 및 (g) 각 생체 신호 별로 상기 (f)단계에서 산출된 신뢰도가 가장 높은 거리별 신호를 선택하여 해당 생체 신호를 검출하는 단계를 포함한다. 개시된 방법에 따르면, 다중 생체 신호에서 각 생체 신호를 정확하게 검출해 낼 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Method, system, and computer program product for automatic multi-object localization and/or vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A method for automatic multi-object localization and/or vital sign monitoring is provided. The method comprises the steps of receiving a radar signal in order to form a corresponding observation matrix, reducing noise by applying singular value decomposition to the observation matrix, processing the result of the singular value decomposition by an independent component analysis in order to estimate the corresponding sources, and estimating propagation channels of the estimated sources by minimizing the corresponding residual error based on the observation matrix and the estimated sources.

title_en: Wavelength Division Sensing Method and Apparatus for Doppler Radar Vital Sign Monitoring and Mechanical Vibration Monitoring
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and a radar system incorporating multiple carrier wavelengths. A multi-carrier radar method and system according to the present invention can be used to realize sensing of complex pattern vibrations using a wavelength division sensing technique.

title_en: Device and method for detecting position and orientation of underground elongated bodies
abstract_en: A method for defining a lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50), by means of GPR technique (Ground Penetrating Radar), comprises the steps of moving a first GPR sensor (110) along a first trajectory s consisting of a plurality of points P, and moving a second GPR sensor (110'), integral to the first GPR sensor (110), along a second trajectory s' consisting of a plurality of points P' and parallel to the first trajectory s. The method also comprises the steps of detecting a first and a second plurality of presence signals concerning possible buried objects by the first GPR sensor (110) and the second GPR sensor (120), acquisition of a first and a second set of spatial coordinates for each point P and P' at which a presence signal is detected, and receiving by a control unit (150) the presence signals and the set of spatial coordinates. The method provides then a step of computing the data concerning the presence of possible buried elongated objects (50) and the set of spatial coordinates, in order to determine, among all points P and P' at which a presence signal has been detected, points P 1  and P 1 ' at which the probability of presence of an elongated buried object (50) is higher. Then, a step of determining, at the end of said computing step, the lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50) is carried out responsive to the set of spatial coordinates corresponding to points P 1  and P 1 '.

title_en: HRV signal extraction method and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave radar-based HRV signal extraction method and device, which are used for solving the technical problem that the existing HRV signal extraction method cannot carry out non-contact long-term monitoring on a user. The method comprises the following steps: collecting radar echo data of a human body in a sleep state, and processing the radar echo data to obtain a vital sign signal of the human body; wherein the radar echo data is obtained by acting on the human body through millimeter wave radar; filtering the vital sign signals based on a first preset filter to obtain first filtered signals, and filtering the vital sign signals based on a second preset filter to obtain second filtered signals; performing heartbeat period division on the first filtering signal through a first preset algorithm to obtain a heartbeat period signal; and screening the heartbeat cycle signal by using the second filtering signal through a second preset algorithm to obtain an HRV signal.

title_en: Method And Apparatus for Vital Signal by Using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 바이탈 신호를 감지하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for detecting a vital signal using a radar. An embodiment of the present invention provides a method and a device for detecting a vital signal using a radar, which use a continuous wave (CW) type radar signal to perform band-pass filtering from a received signal to a heartbeat frequency band, a respiration frequency band, and a heart movement frequency band, respectively, thereby accurately measuring a respiration rate, heart rate, and heart movement of a human body from the received signal.
abstract_ko:
레이더를 이용하여 바이탈 신호를 감지하는 방법 및 장치를 개시한다. 
본 실시예는 CW(Continuous Wave) 형태의 레이더 신호를 이용하여 수신된 수신 신호로부터 심박 주파수 대역 및 호흡 주파수 대역, 심장의 움직임 주파수 대역으로 각각 대역 통과 필터링하여 수신 신호로부터 인체의 호흡 수, 심박 수, 심장 움직임을 정확하게 측정할 수 있도록 하는 레이더를 이용하여 바이탈 신호를 감지하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치된 호흡 센서를 통해 사용자의 호흡 상태에 맞게 공기의 유동을 조절할 수 있으며,자동식 호흡 감지 기반 FAN 동작으로써 정압식 방식에 비해 고객의 호흡을 편안하게 해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Earthquake-proof, traffic safety full automatic alarm schoolbag, knapsack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake resistant schoolbag and a dorsal sac which can automatically give an alarm about traffic safety and are used as earthquake resistance and assistance equipment and traffic safety protection equipment, and discloses an earthquake resistance and head protecting rubber plate device fixed on the schoolbag. The device can prevent injuries to students in traffic accidents, and help prevent the heads of the students from being injured or alleviate the injuries in an earthquake, and after the earthquake, the device can help rescuers rescue and the students buried in ruins perform self rescue or passively cry for help by sending a distress signal through the reflection of light and acoustic control, thus reducing the death toll.

title_en: A kind of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization method based on frequency spectrum remnants conspicuousness detection methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization methods based on frequency spectrum remnants conspicuousness detection methods, including（1）, Ground Penetrating Radar B Scan echo datas are filtered；（2）, using frequency spectrum remnants conspicuousnesses detection method find out target region of interest from filtered B Scan images；（3）, to extract target region of interest image carry out edge extracting；（4）, utilize Hough transformation position target hyperbola；（5）, according to target hyperbola realize buried target positioning.This method can efficiently differentiate clutter and target echo, promote the effect of clutter recognition；Target region of interest can be accurately extracted, and more completely remains target information, improves the precision of target positioning；And the algorithm used is succinct, and algorithm operation time is shorter, can quickly complete the positioning of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target.

title_en: Method for detecting life information through non-contact wall
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for detecting life information by non-contact wall penetration, which comprises the following steps: denoising a target signal to be detected; processing the signal in the fast time dimension direction of the denoised target signal to be detected by adopting the EEMD to obtain a first IMFs set; locating characteristic time index sampling points in a first IMFs set; processing the signal in the slow time dimension direction of the denoised target signal by adopting the EEMD to obtain a second IMFs set of characteristic time index sampling points in the slow time dimension direction, and constructing a second IMFs set matrix; and acquiring signals which meet the breathing rate characteristics and the heart rate characteristics in the second IMFs set matrix, and finding out corresponding breathing signals and heart rate signals. The method and the device can remove the fixed background noise in the radar receiving echo signal, can utilize the through-wall detection function of the radar receiving echo signal, and adopt non-contact detection to realize detection of the life information.

title_en: Vital sign detection method, system, equipment and medium based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method, a system, equipment and a medium based on machine learning, which are used for monitoring a target by utilizing a millimeter wave radar to obtain target information; inputting target information into a pre-established monitoring model to obtain vital sign signals, wherein the vital sign signals comprise respiratory signals and heartbeat signals; the process for establishing the monitoring model comprises the following steps: monitoring different targets by utilizing a millimeter wave radar to obtain target information, wherein the target information comprises a target signal and a target echo signal; synthesizing the target signal and the target echo signal into an intermediate frequency signal; performing signal processing on the intermediate frequency signal to obtain a respiration signal corresponding frequency and a heartbeat signal corresponding frequency; constructing a plurality of R-D graphs by taking the corresponding frequency of the respiratory signal and the corresponding frequency of the heartbeat signal as labels; training the learning model through a plurality of R-D graphs to obtain a monitoring model.
assignees: INTERSECT INFORMATION CORE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE XIAN CO LTD;XIAN SHENXIN KECHUANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign measuring device and vital sign measuring method
abstract_en: The vital sign measurement device is provided with a single infrared sensor (1), a single radar sensor (2), and a final vital sign output unit (3), wherein the single infrared sensor (1) acquires an infrared image of a target object, identifies a living body from the acquired infrared image, estimates the body temperature and two-dimensional azimuth of the identified living body, the single radar sensor (2) is arranged in time synchronization with the infrared sensor and in close proximity to the infrared sensor, the single radar sensor (2) is provided with a signal acquisition unit (221) for acquiring a received signal of a reflected wave from an antenna receiving the reflected wave reflected by the target object, a signal separation unit (222) for separating the acquired received signal into a moving object signal and a stationary object signal, a moving object estimation unit (223) for estimating the distance, the speed and the two-dimensional azimuth of the moving object from the moving object signal, and a radar vital sign estimation unit (224) for estimating the position, the respiratory frequency and the heart rate of the living body from the stationary object signal based on the detected detection result of the moving object, and the final vital sign output unit (3) acquires and outputs the position, the respiratory frequency and the heart rate and the body temperature.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The specification relates to the technical field of radar vital sign monitoring, and particularly discloses a vital sign monitoring method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo data; performing 3D-FFT processing on the echo data to determine whether the echo data contains a target; under the condition that the target is contained, target detection is carried out to obtain micro Doppler signals corresponding to vital signs; carrying out phase extraction on the micro Doppler signals to obtain phase information; the phase information is filtered by using a first band-pass filter and a second band-pass filter respectively to obtain first phase data and second phase data; based on an M-Rife interpolation algorithm, respectively carrying out frequency tracking on the first phase data and the second phase data to obtain a first frequency value and a second frequency value; the first frequency value is used to characterize a first vital sign; the second frequency value is used to characterize a second vital sign. The scheme can improve the accuracy and efficiency of vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Multifunctional health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional health monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving echo signals in a space, and calculating point cloud data of a user and phase change data caused by respiration and heartbeat of the user according to the echo signals; calculating the behavior of the user according to the point cloud data; calculating vital signs of the user according to the phase change data, wherein the vital signs comprise respiratory frequency and heart rate; monitoring whether a user triggers a set alarm event according to the behaviors and/or vital signs; if yes, executing corresponding alarm operation according to the triggered alarm event type. The multifunctional health monitoring method based on the millimeter wave radar has the advantages of multifunctional monitoring, low cost, non-contact all-weather monitoring, privacy protection, two-way call and the like.

title_en: UWB vehicle-mounted airtight space detection system with respiratory rate monitoring and SOS linkage
