abstract_en: The UWB vehicle-mounted airtight space detection system with the breathing frequency monitoring and SOS linkage is characterized by comprising an ultra-wideband signal acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a control decision module and a response module which are sequentially connected, wherein the ultra-wideband signal acquisition module is provided with at least 3 array antennas which are used for covering the vehicle-mounted airtight space completely and have no dead angle and continuously transmitting ultra-wideband pulses and receiving echo signals reflected by the breathing motion of a chest of a human body, the preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the echo signals to obtain breathing characteristic data, the control decision module is used for detecting the breathing state of the human body according to the breathing characteristic data, and sending corresponding control signals to the response module when the breathing abnormality of the human body is detected, and the response module is used for completing acousto-optic alarm, window control and emergency call response according to the control signals. The intelligent life sign monitoring system has the advantages that stable and accurate life sign monitoring can be realized and emergency rescue is triggered while low power consumption is guaranteed.
assignees: CHONGQING REBO LIGHTING & ELECTRONICS CO LIMITED

title_en: Bio signal measurement apparatus and method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a biosignal measurement device may comprise: a tissue fluid extraction part for extracting a tissue fluid from the skin of a user; a sensor part for measuring at least one of impedance and optical characteristics of the extracted tissue fluid; and a processor for estimating the concentration of an analyte based on at least one of the impedance and the optical characteristics. Therefore, the accuracy of estimating the concentration of the analyte can be improved.
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 생체 신호 측정 장치는 사용자의 피부로부터 조직액을 추출하는 조직액 추출부와, 상기 추출된 조직액의 임피던스 및 광 특성 중 적어도 하나를 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 임피던스 및 광 특성 중 적어도 하나를 기반으로 분석 물질의 농도를 추정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar device and measurement method
abstract_en: This ground penetrating radar device 1 is moved by human power and has three wheels 11A-11 respectively having axles that are at 120 degree angles from each other and that each have an encoder 12A-12C attached thereto. A control unit 14 calculates a movement direction, movement distance, movement speed vector, and turning vector for the ground penetrating radar device 1 from the rotation amounts measured by the encoders 12A-12C. A measurement unit 15 uses radio waves to locate an object buried underground. A storage unit 17 stores a two-dimensional measurement data set associating the position information and movement direction for the ground penetrating radar device 1 calculated by the control unit 14 with measurement data from the radar measurement unit, and a display unit 18 displays, in a superimposed manner, the measurement data and an installation map that is stored in a database 16 and shows the buried position of the underground structure.

title_en: Patient monitoring and surveillance system, methods, and devices
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods, devices and systems for the remote monitoring and/or surveillance of a patient's location, position, movement, vital signs, biopotentials, or a combination thereof using transmission of stepped-frequency radar signals, detecting reflections of the transmitted signals and processing the frequency and phase shifts.
assignees: BROWN DAVID;NORDIN DAVID;TERAN MANUEL;LIFEFLOW TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Airborne systems and detection methods localisation and production of images of buried objects and characterisation of the composition of the subsurface
abstract_en: Airborne systems and methods for the detection, location and obtaining of images of buried objects and for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. The systems comprise at least one aerial module with a radar unit that emits and/or captures radar signals and a positioning and guidance system with an accuracy equal to or less than 3 cm, and a ground station with a flight control system and a radar signal processing unit where radar signal processing algorithms are applied. The invention also comprises a method for the detection, localization and obtaining of images of buried objects and a method for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. Applicable in sectors where it is necessary to perform the detection of buried objects, as for example in civil applications (detection of antipersonnel mines), pipeline inspection or in archaeology.

title_en: Human body perception detection method based on FMCW millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body perception detection method based on an FMCW millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of acquiring and processing data of an environment by adopting the FMCW millimeter wave radar to obtain a plurality of frames of original intermediate frequency signal data, carrying out frame processing to obtain an adaptive speed amplitude threshold value and a target speed energy amplitude of a corresponding frame, then detecting by using different strategies according to the human body perception detection result of the previous frame, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or a stationary human body target if the human body perception detection result of the previous frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion if the current frame is larger than the adaptive speed amplitude threshold value, otherwise, carrying out human vital sign detection to obtain a target breathing signal and a heartbeat signal, analyzing and judging whether the current frame is a human body target or not, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not if the human body perception detection result of the previous frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not. The invention can detect the static human body target and the human body target with large-amplitude action, and realize more accurate human body perception detection in different scenes.

title_en: Cognitive Workload Estimation System using Driving Performance and Physiological Data
title_ko: 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용한 운전 중 인지부하 평가장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용하여 운전자의 운전중 인지부하를 평가하고, 그 평가에 따른 안전 및 예방 조치를 행하는 지능형 자동차 시스템에 과한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은, 상기 차량의 이미지를 입력받아 차선의 위치를 계산하는 차선 검출부와, 상기 차선 검출부로부터 수신된 상기 차선의 위치 데이터에 대해 일정 시간 동안 누적된 SDLP 값을 구하는 SDLP 연산부와, 상기 차량의 스킨 컨덕턴스 센서로부터 일정시간 동안 입력된 상기 차량의 운전자에 대한 피부전도도의 평균값을 구하는 SCL 연산부와, 상기 SDLP값과 피부전도도 평균값을 통해 상기 운전자의 인지부하 상태를 추정하는 인지부하 판단부를 포함하는 인지부하 평가장치 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Connecting structure of smart garment for measuring biological signal
title_ko: 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connecting structure of a smart garment for measuring biosignals and, more specifically, to a connecting structure of a smart garment for measuring biosignals, the connecting structure comprising: at least one connecting unit which a sensor for sensing biosignals is detachably mounted to; an output unit which outputs, to a biosignal processor, biosignals detected by the sensor attached to the connecting unit; and electrically conductive nanofibers which have one end and the other end connected to the connecting unit and the output unit, respectively and send, to the output unit, the biosignals detected by the sensor, wherein the connecting unit and output unit of the smart garment for measuring biosignals have first magnetic bodies, respectively, of which the surface is coated with a conductive layer, both ends of the nanofibers are connected to the first magnetic bodies, the sensor and the biosignal processor have a polarity opposite to that of the first magnetic bodies respectively provided on the connecting unit and the output unit and have second magnetic bodies, respectively, of which the surface is coated with a conductive layer, and the biosignals are sent by contact between the first and second magnetic bodies. According to the present invention, the sensor for sensing biosignals and the biosignal processor for processing the biosignals are easily attached to or detached from a flexible garment, having magnetism-based electrical conductivity and comprising nanofibers, with less power by using magnetic forces, thereby preventing loss of signal due to the short circuit of the nanofibers provided on the garment.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속구조에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 생체신호를 감지하는 센서가 탈부착 되는 적어도 하나 이상의 접속부와, 접속부에 부착된 센서에 의해 감지되는 생체신호가 생체신호처리장치로 출력되는 것을 가능하게 하는 출력부 및 접속부와 출력부에 일단과 타단이 각각 연결되며, 센서에 의해 감지되는 생체신호를 출력부로 전달하는 전기 전도성 나노섬유를 구비하는 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속부와 출력부는 표면에 전도층이 코팅된 제1 자성체를 각각 구비하며, 제1 자성체에 나노섬유의 양단이 연결되고, 센서와 생체신호처리장치는 접속부와 출력부에 각각 구비된 제1 자성체에 반대되는 극성이며 표면에 전도층이 코팅된 제2 자성체를 각각 구비하며, 제1 자성체와 제2 자성체 간의 접촉을 통해 생체신호가 전달되는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속구조에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 자성 기반의 전기 전도성을 지닌 나노섬유를 구비한 신축성 있는 의복에 생체신호를 감지하는 센서와 이를 처리하는 생체신호처리장치를 자력을 이용해 적은 힘으로 용이하게 탈부착할 수 있어 의복에 구비된 나노섬유의 단락으로 인한 신호손실을 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of indoor fire-fighting UAS
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of indoor fire-fighting UAS, including for obtaining the position data of indoor objects for interior structure mapping laser radar module used, the camera module for obtaining indoor picture and auxiliary positioning, the loudspeaker module for sending sound searching or guide indicator of trapped personnel, the sound detection module for detecting voice, and for detecting the life detection module of sign of life；The laser radar module, camera module, loudspeaker module, sound detection module and life detection module are all connected to the winged control plate of unmanned plane, the control command sent by flying control plate is received, and the data collected are sent to the integrated data processing platform outside scene of fire by the wireless transport module for flying by being connected to control plate.The utility model is easy to rescue personnel more quickly and accurately to understand scene of fire interior structure and trapped personnel situation, and the information of directiveness can be provided for rapid development rescue method, is advantageous to improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Anti-hiding system for vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vehicle anti-system of hiding, include: the vehicle access passage is provided with a first scanning area and a second scanning area; the drive-up passage type vehicle scanning and checking system is arranged in a first scanning area; the vehicle bottom imaging device is arranged in the middle of the first scanning area; radar life check out test set, radar life check out test set includes L type support, the top inner wall of L type support is installed and is prevented escaping perspective life detection radar. Through adopting passageway formula vehicle scanning inspection system and vehicle bottom imaging device of exempting from to detect vehicle inside and vehicle chassis, can understand, accurate, effectively discern the inside article of vehicle and the vehicle chassis condition, improved detection accuracy, both cooperate the use simultaneously, have avoided a single detection technology to receive specific environmental interference to cause the problem of unable normal detection.

title_en: Pipeline carrier radar damage detection process
abstract_en: A radar damage detection process for a pipeline carrier relates to the technical field of damage detection of buried pipelines. The method comprises the following steps: s1, sending radar wave signals to the metal pipeline through the radar station; s2, receiving radar wave signals on the metal pipeline through a plurality of radar receivers arranged along the metal pipeline and sending the received signals to a processor; s3, analyzing and processing the received information through the processor to find out the damage position of the outer anticorrosive layer of the metal pipeline; and S4, detecting and scanning the metal pipeline at the damaged position of the anticorrosive layer through the pipeline damage detector, and confirming the damaged position and type of the metal layer, the damaged degree and the damage detection range. According to the invention, the damage position of the anticorrosive coating outside the pipeline is found through the matching of the radar station and the distributed radar receiver, and then the pipeline at the damage position of the anticorrosive coating of the pipeline damage detector is used for detecting and scanning, so that the damage type, the damage position and the damage degree of the metal pipeline are confirmed, and the purpose of preventing the metal pipeline from being damaged in the bud is achieved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDUN XUNDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Outdoor infrared ray makes a video recording and surveys multi-legged running gear
abstract_en: The invention relates to outdoor detection equipment, in particular to an outdoor infrared ray camera shooting, detecting and observing multi-foot walking device. Comprises a rolling multi-foot walking device, a flat ground walking device, a camera, an infrared sensor and a controller; the rolling multi-foot walking device comprises a rolling motor, a hemispherical shell and a plurality of telescopic stabbing feet, wherein the plurality of telescopic stabbing feet are fixedly connected to the outer part of the hemispherical shell, and the rolling motor is connected with the hemispherical shell; the flat ground walking device comprises an annular shell, supporting legs, walking wheels and a walking motor, wherein the supporting legs are fixedly connected outside the annular shell, the walking wheels are arranged on the supporting legs, and the walking motor is connected with the walking wheels; the two hemispherical shells are arranged on two sides of the annular shell through bearings, the camera, the infrared sensor, the walking motor and the rolling motor are electrically connected with a controller, and the controller is powered by a battery. The camera helps people to take a picture or view in an outdoor complex environment; after disasters such as earthquakes occur, life signs are searched for through infrared detection in a complex and severe environment.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system
abstract_en: A dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system for agricultural meteorological disasters belongs to the technical field of agricultural information intelligent analysis, and comprises a monitoring rod, a high-definition camera, an integrated meteorological five-element monitor, a photovoltaic panel storage battery, a rainfall sensor, a soil temperature and humidity sensor, a weak current box, a 4G router and a hard disk video recorder; the high-definition camera is arranged on the top of the monitoring rod; the integrated meteorological five-element monitor and the rainfall sensor are arranged on the monitoring rod; the weak current box is arranged on the monitoring rod, and the 4G router and the hard disk video recorder are both arranged in the weak current box; the photovoltaic panel is arranged on the monitoring rod, and a photovoltaic panel storage battery is arranged on the photovoltaic panel; the soil temperature and humidity sensor is buried in the soil. The method is used for monitoring meteorological conditions and meteorological disasters by agricultural farmers in the crop growth process, giving early warning to the meteorological disasters in real time, and storing disaster-suffering conditions in a video image mode, so that the farmers can resist disasters in time, save themselves and settle claims in later period conveniently.
assignees: JILIN PROVINCE ZHONGNONG SUNSHINE DATA CO LTD

title_en: Fall alarm detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radio wave measurement, in particular to a fall alarm detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step 1: determining a falling alarm detection area boundary, and deploying a millimeter wave radar in the detection area according to the area boundary; step 2: the method comprises the steps of installing life detection equipment in a detection area, setting the life detection equipment to run in real time, and controlling the millimeter wave radar to be converted into a running state from a standby state when a life characteristic target in the detection area is detected; the method can provide fall detection service for the appointed area, provides two different working modes in the execution process of the steps, is suitable for fall detection service of the appointed user or random fall detection service of the user, adopts the millimeter wave radar to detect dynamic vital sign targets in the appointed area, judges whether the user falls through the dynamic state of the vital sign targets, and has the characteristics of accurate identification and low resource consumption cost.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign sleep monitoring method and device based on UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign sleep monitoring method and device based on UWB radar, and relates to the technical field of UWB radar sleep monitoring, comprising the following steps of (a) switching on a power supply and installing a sleep monitoring device, wherein the front face of the device faces to the angular position of the chest of a human body and the sleep activity range area; and (c) acquiring radar wave signals of the UWB radar module by a signal processing module arranged in the sleep monitoring device, processing the radar echo signals by clutter cancellation, adaptive filtering denoising and a slow time-frequency domain analysis method, and calculating vital sign data. The device has the characteristics of strong penetrating power, high accuracy, good stability and low use complexity, and provides better sleep monitoring experience for users.

title_en: Antenna for underground search radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To rapidly and accurately detect a three dimensional position of an underground buried object.  <P>SOLUTION: Three sets of pairs of transmitting-receiving antenna elements 1a, 1b; 1c1, 1c2; 1d1, 1d2 are arranged in a plurality of partial storage spaces formed in a conductive antenna housing 2. In the antenna elements, pairs of conductors 5a, 5b, 5cl, 5c2, 5d1, 5d2, 6a, 6b, 6c1, 6c2, 6d1, 6d2 are arranged in a straight line, and a dipole antenna is formed. The conductor has a length of λ/2 when a wavelength is λ, and the pair of the antenna elements 1a and 1b is arranged to be shifted by λ/2 in a longitudinal direction of the conductors from the sets of the antenna elements 1cl, 1c2; 1d1, 1d2. A distance of the underground buried object, that is, the position thereof can be detected based on the time difference between a pulse-like transmitting signal applied to the sets of the transmitting antenna elements 1a, 1c1, 1d1 and a receiving signal obtained from the sets of the receiving antenna elements 1b, 1c2, 1d2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Bio complicated sensor
title_ko: 생체복합센서
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio complex sensor is provided to comfortably receive various bio signals by performing an integrated shape. CONSTITUTION: A bio complex sensor includes a glove, a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor, a conductive fiber part(170), and an optical sensor part(180). The glove has a unit for sensing bio information of user, and comprises body part(110), a finger part(150a~150e), and a kerf part(120). The pressure sensor and the temperature sensor are included in the kerf part, and measure blood pressure and body temperature of user. The conductive fiber part measures electrocardiogram and fat of the user. The optical sensor part measures oxygen saturation of the user.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체복합센서에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 생체정보를 측정하는 장치에 있어서, 상기 사용자의 생체정보를 감지하는 수단을 내장한 장갑, 상기 장갑은 몸통부, 손가락부, 커프부로 구성되고, 상기 사용자의 혈압을 측정을 위해 가압 및 감압을 하는 커프부, 상기 커프부에 구비되어 사용자의 혈압 및 체온을 측정하는 압력센서 및 온도센서, 상기 사용자의 심전도 및 체지방을 측정하는 도전성 섬유부, 상기 사용자의 산소 포화도를 측정하는 광센서부로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같은 생체복합센서를 이용하는 것에 의해, 기존의 팔뚝형 혈압계, 심전계, 산소 포화도 측정기와 체지방 측정기를 비롯해 생체신호 측정시 번거롭게 센서를 장착하거나 외부로 배선을 연결할 필요없는 일체형 형태를 가짐으로 보다 편하게 다양한 생체신호를 받을 수 있다. 
       
     장갑, 산소 포화도, 심전도, 혈압, 체온

title_en: Apparatus and method of integratedly processing a plurality of bio signals
title_ko: 통합적인 생체신호 처리장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio signal processing unit and a method thereof are provided to obtain a desired bio signal by processing the bio signal of specific sensor according to a predetermined processing requirement. CONSTITUTION: A sensing module(110) includes a plurality of sensor groups. A plurality of sensor groups measures a bio signal according to a predetermined control signal. A first signal processing module(130) generates a signal for driving the sensing module. A first signal processing module processes the bio-signal provided from a plurality of sensor groups. A second signal processing module(150) processes the bio-signal provided from the first signal processing module according to a predetermined processing requirement. The predetermined processing requirement comprises at least one among a filtering frequency band, an amplifying gain, and a computing algorithm.
abstract_ko: 통합적인 생체신호 처리장치 및 방법을 개시한다.   제1 신호처리모듈은  제어신호에 대응하여 각 센서를 구동하기 위한 신호를 생성하고, 각 센서로부터 제공되는 생체신호를 처리한다.  제2 신호처리모듈은 처리하고자 하는 생체신호에 대응하여 제어신호를 생성하는 한편 처리조건을 자동으로 설정하고, 제1 신호처리모듈로부터 제공되는 생체신호를 설정된 처리조건에 따라서 처리하고, 처리결과를 출력한다.

title_en: System of alarm and leakage detecting for underground hot water pipe
title_ko: 지하 열배관 누수감지 및 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting leakage of an underground heat pipe and issuing an alarm thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a bimetal sensor installed at a junction or a connection part of a heat pipe buried underground and operated when the temperature of the junction exceeds a predetermined critical temperature to control switching; a temperature sensor operated only in a dangerous situation by the operation of the bimetal sensor to detect the temperature of the junction or connection part of the heat pipe; an Arduino unit; and a system server.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 지하 열배관 누수감지 및 경보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지하에 매설된 열배관의 점검인원이 턱없이 부족하여 제대로 점검이 이루어지지 않고 있으며, 사람의 육안으로 점검이 이루어지다보니 오류가 많고 정확한 점검이 어려우며, 점검 및 유지관리에 비용이 많이 소요되는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 것이다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명에 의한 지하 열배관 누수감지 및 경보 시스템은, 지중에 매설된 열배관의 접합부분 또는 접속부분에 설치되며, 상기 접합부의 온도가 소정의 임계 온도를 초과했을 때 작동하여 스위칭을 제어하는 바이메탈 센서; 상기 열배관의 접합부분 또는 접속부분에 배관 둘레를 따라 병렬로 복수로 설치되며, 상기 바이메탈 센서의 작동에 의해 위험 상황에서만 동작하여 상기 열배관의 접합부분 또는 접속부분의 온도를 감지하는 온도 센서; 상기 온도 센서가 설치된 부근의 열배관에 설치되며, 상기 온도 센서의 감지 데이터와 상기 열배관의 위치정보와 일련번호를 묶은 데이터 리스트를 로라(LoRa) 통신을 통해 전송하는 아두이노; 및 상기 아두이노로부터 로라(LoRa) 통신을 통해 상기 데이터 리스트를 수신받고, 상기 데이터 리스트에 포함된 상기 열배관의 감지 데이터를 분석하여 열배관의 파열 조짐을 미리 예측하고, 상기 열배관의 파열로 판단되면 사고내용과 사고위치가 포함된 긴급 재난 문자를 발송하는 시스템 서버;를 포함한다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 열배관 파열에 따른 누수를 실시간으로 감지할 수 있고 감시 인력과 시스템의 운영 비용을 크게 감소시킬 수 있다. 또한, 열배관의 감지 데이터 분석에 의해 파열 조짐을 미리 예측할 수 있고, 파열이 발생한 열배관의 위치정보를 제공함에 따라 위험상황에 대한 정확한 지령을 전달할 수 있다.

title_en: Health monitor device, system and method
abstract_en: A health monitor device (1) for monitoring the health and/or one or more vital signs of a user comprises: an attachment means (2) for attaching the health monitor device (1) to a limb or the neck of the user; a sensing means (3) configured to output raw sensor data, the sensing means (3) comprising at least a plurality of electrodes (31) for applying an alternating current to the skin of the user and measuring a voltage across the skin of the user; a processing means (4) configured to produce processed output data from the raw sensor data; and a communication means for sending or reporting the raw sensor data and/or processed output data to one or more further devices. The processed output data comprises at least a first output signal indicative of the respiration of the user.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection with elimination of signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system (100) that is configured to determine range and velocity information from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior (116) of a vehicle (114) for vital sign detection comprises steps to decompose reflected and received signals into range and velocity information, to measure the movement over time in specified range gates and to evaluate the similarities between them. Based on the characteristics of similar behaving range bins, it can be decided whether any detected movement is related to an internal or external disturbance or by vital signs.

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject. A radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of arrays of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A phase vaue is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing phase changes over time for each voxel is generated. Voxels indicating an oscillating signal are selected and life sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: A method and an arrangement for monitoring
abstract_en: An arrangement and a method for observing presence, location, movement and/or attitude of one or more persons in a monitored area with an arrangement comprising at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501), measuring electronics and a processor configured to process the sensor data. The at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) is a radar-based sensor, such as frequency-modulated continuous-wave MIMO radar-based sensor, and the arrangement measures with the at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) the area to be monitored, and determines the presence, location, movement and/or attitude of the person. The arrangement has a first operating mode and a second operating mode, and in the first operating mode the arrangement detects falling of a person (206, 402, 502) and/or measures vital signs of the person (206, 402, 502), such as heartbeat and/or breathing of the person (206, 402, 502), in the monitored area with the at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) and sends an alarm if the person (206, 402, 502) has been determined as fallen and/or vital signs of the person (206, 402, 502) are not within the predefined limits, and in the second operating mode the sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) and/or the arrangement detects presence and/or location of a person (206, 402, 502) in the monitored 5 area with the at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) and sends an alarm if a person (206, 402, 502) is present in the monitored area when the second operating mode is in use.

title_en: Vital sign detection apparatus and system and data processing method
abstract_en: The vital sign detection device of the present invention includes one or more sensors, which can detect a plurality of vital sign signals of a test subject in a non-contact manner, and output corresponding a plurality of vital sign information, thereby achieving fast and accurate vital sign detection. The invention also relates to a combined multi-functional detection device, which includes a camera, a radar sensor, an infrared sensor and a sensor driving unit, used for measuring vital signs. The invention also provides a non-contact blood pressure measurement method and device. The method includes receiving radar echoes and video signal streams at first and second parts, extracting first and second pulse wave signals therefrom, obtaining a measured pulse wave transit time, matching the measured pulse wave transit time with a reference pulse wave transit time, and obtaining a blood pressure value.
assignees: NAT UNIV SINGAPORE;NATIONAL UNIV OF SINGAPORE SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: System and method for non-contact people localization and vital signs monitoring via fmcw radar
abstract_en: A monitoring system is presented for monitoring vital signs of subject(s). The monitoring system includes a control system configured for signal communication with a frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar to process measured data which is received from a single-channel front end of receiver of said FMCW radar and which is in the form of data matrix indicative of consecutive beat signals. The control system comprises a data processing utility comprising: a localization module configured and operable to process the measured data indicative of said data matrix and provide support recovery data indicative of the received signals originated at localized one or more subjects; and a vital signs monitoring module configured and operable to analyze the support recovery data and monitor vital signs of said localized one or more subjects.

title_en: Airborne system and method for detecting, locating and image acquisition of buried objects, method for characterizing subsoil composition
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an airborne system and method for detection, localization and image acquisition of buried objects and characterization of subsoil composition. The system comprises at least one flight module (1) and a ground station (2), the flight module (1) having a radar unit (11) for emitting and/or capturing radar signals and a positioning and guidance system (13) with an accuracy equal to or less than three centimeters, the ground station (2) having a flight control system (21) and a radar signal processing unit (23) to which a radar signal processing algorithm (25) is applied. The invention also relates to methods for detecting, localizing and image-acquiring buried objects, and methods for characterizing subsoil composition. The invention is applicable in the field where the detection of buried objects is required, for example in civil applications (detection of lethal mines), pipeline detection or archaeology.

title_en: Realtime monitoring system for guard based on bio signal and etc.
title_ko: 생체 신호 등을 기반으로 한 경계 근무 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경계 근무 상황실에서 원격으로 경계 근무자를 모니터링하는 것에 관한 것이며, 특히 경계 근무자의 생존 여부, 생체 상태, 근무 태도 및 이동 경로 등을 모니터링하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명의 경계 근무 실시간 모니터링 시스템은, 경계 근무자의 심전도를 측정하여 심전도 신호를 생성하는 심전도 센서부(21)와, 상기 경계 근무자의 움직임을 측정하여 3축 가속도 신호를 생성하는 3축 가속도 센서부(22)를 포함하는 센서 모듈(20); 상기 센서 모듈(20)로부터 수신한 상기 심전도 신호 및 3축 가속도 신호를 포함하는 경계 근무자 상태 신호를 전송하는 휴대 단말 장치(100); 상기 휴대 단말 장치(100)로부터 상기 경계 근무자 상태 신호를 수신하여 분석하는 경계 근무 모니터링 서버(200)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
     
     경계근무, 보초, 심전도, 가속도, 알람, 근태, 안전, 실시간 모니터링

title_en: Inductive biosignal detection sensor based on conductive textile
title_ko: 전도성 직물기반 유도용량성 생체신호 측정 센서
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A conductive fabric based inductively capacitive biological signal measurement sensor is provided to detect volume change of a biological tissue by preparing a contact prevention unit consisting of an insulator. CONSTITUTION: An inductively capacitive biological signal measurement sensor receives a vibration signal from an oscillation unit, forms an inductor and outputs a vibration signal having a biological signal. A spiral coil confines a magnetic flux in a central part and has a whirlwind form. The spiral coil is formed to be an embroidery using silver thread or conductive thread. A contact prevention unit between coil wire of the spiral coil and coil wire is prepared. The contact prevention unit is prepared by stitching with a thread.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 발진부로부터 진동신호를 수신하면 시변함수의 인덕터가 형성되어, 생체신호가 포함된 진동신호를 출력하는 유도용량성 생체신호 측정 센서에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 발진부로부터 진동신호를 수신하면, 시변함수의 인덕터가 형성되어, 생체신호가 포함된 진동신호를 출력하는 유도용량성 생체신호 측정 센서에 있어서, 중앙부위에 자속을 집속시킬 수 있도록, 직물지 위에 회오리 형태를 가지는 나선형 코일을, 은사 또는 전도사(conductive yarn)를 이용하여 자수(embroidery)로 형성하며, 상기 나선형 코일에서 코일선과 코일선 사이에는 절연체로 이루어진 접촉방지부를 구비하되, 상기 접촉방지부는 실로 스티치를 행하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV KONKUK IND COOP CORP;UNIV YONSEI IACF

title_en: Signal processing method and apparatus for ultra wide band ground penetrating radar based land mine detection
title_ko: 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention is a signal processing method for detecting landmines based on an ultra-wide band ground surface penetration radar, comprising: a training process of generating a background signal model by collecting data of an area in which landmines are not buried and of an area in which landmines are buried in a state in which burial of landmines is recognized; and a probing step of probing landmines by using the background signal model acquired through the training process in a state in which burial of landmines is not recognized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지뢰 매설을 인지한 상태에서 지뢰가 매설되지 않은 영역과 지뢰가 매설된 영역의 데이터를 수집하여 배경 신호 모델을 생성하는 훈련 과정과, 지뢰 매설을 인지하지 못한 상태에서 훈련 과정을 통해 획득한 배경 신호 모델을 이용하여 지뢰를 탐지하는 탐지 과정을 포함하는 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 일 개시에 의하여, 사용자의 생체 신호를 분석한 1차 위험 판단, 주변 환경 정보를 분석한 2차 위험 판단을 통해 사용자의 위험 상황을 판단하고 안전을 관리하는 방법을 제공하며, 본 방법은 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 사용자의 주변 환경을 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하는 단계, 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 정하는 단계 및 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar system and radar signal processing method performed thereby
title_ko: 탑승객 감시 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 레이더 신호처리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a passenger monitoring radar system and a radar signal processing method performed therein. The method comprises the steps of: (a) removing, by a preprocessing unit, a fixed target included in a received signal and preprocessing to detect a biosignal which is a moving target; (b) storing, by a data buffer unit, the data preprocessed by the preprocessing unit and monitoring a power value of the signal; (c) detecting, by a multiple targets detection unit, multiple targets including the presence or absence of living things, 3D location information of the living things, and information on the number of living things through a multiple target detection signal processing process for the preprocessed data; and (d) detecting, by a biosignal detection unit, a biosignal including respiration and heart rate BPM of the living things. The present invention can remove the fixed object existing in a space to be detected, and detect the presence or absence of the living things, the 3D location information of the living things, the number of the living things, and biosignal information for each the living things.
abstract_ko: 탑승객 감시 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 레이더 신호처리방법에 관한 것으로, (a) 전처리부에서 수신신호에 포함된 고정 표적을 제거하고, 이동 표적인 생체신호를 검출하도록 전처리하는 단계, (b) 데이터 버퍼부에서 상기 전처리부에 의해 전처리된 데이터를 저장하고 신호의 파워 값을 모니터링하는 단계, (c) 다중 표적 검출부에서 전처리된 데이터에 대한 다중 표적 검출 신호처리 과정을 거쳐 생명체의 존재 유무, 생명체의 3차원 위치정보 및 생명체의 수 정보를 포함하는 다중 표적을 검출하는 단계 및 (d) 생체신호 검출부에서 생명체의 호흡 및 심박 BPM을 포함하는 생체신호를 검출하는 단계를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 탐지하고자 하는 공간 내에 존재하는 고정 물체를 제거하고, 살아있는 생명체의 존재 유무, 생명체의 3차원 위치정보 및 생명체의 수 및 생명체별 생체신호 정보를 탐지할 수 있다.

title_en: Proactive and preventive health care system using remote monitoring and notifications
abstract_en: A health status monitoring and reporting system comprising a user-wearable armband and a gateway device is disclosed. The armband comprises a power source, a positional sensor and/or a movement sensor, a vital signs measurement device, and a transmitter operated. The vital signs measurement device generates output signals including an indicator of a health condition of the user. The transmitter is configured to receive outputs from the accelerometer and the vital signs measuring device, and transmit signals to an ultra low power network. The gateway device transmits data from the ULP network to a Wide Area Network for processing, data storage, notifications, or the like.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Detection device for vital signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device (1) for detecting vital signs comprising a sensor (2) and a power supply module (3), which sensor (2) has at least one detection means (5, 6, 7, 8) configured to detect a vital sign from the group comprising oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, pulse, and a first (10) communication module, and the power supply module (3) has a second communication module (20) and a power source (21), and a wireless communication link (4) exists between the first (10) and second communication module (20), and the sensor (2) is provided in the form of an elastically deformable, rebounding thin-film sensor, and the communication link (4) is configured for transmitting power and measured values or measurement data.

title_en: Carbon dioxide detector used for ruins life detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a carbon dioxide detection device used for ruins life detection. A sampling rod sleeve is of a hollow structure, a conical head is fixed at the front end of an internal support to form a sampling inner core, and the rear end of a conical sleeve is connected with the front end of the sampling rod sleeve in a sealing manner to form a hollow sampling rod; the sampling inner core is inserted into the sampling rod, the sampling inner core and the sampling rod are arranged in a sliding manner, and a locking device is arranged between the sampling inner core and the sampling rod; a gas sampling pump, a carbon dioxide sensor and a separating plate are respectively fixed on the internal support; the separating plate separates the gas sampling pump from the carbon dioxide sensor, the separating plate and the inner wall of the sampling rod are in sliding hermetic seal, and an output air pipe of the gas sampling pump penetrates through the separating plate to be communicated with the carbon dioxide sensor; and the carbon dioxide sensor is electrically connected with a display control alarm device. The carbon dioxide detection device used for ruins life detection solves the problem that the existing carbon dioxide life detection device is not applicable to detection in debris ruins environment, and the device and the method provided by the utility model are convenient for searching trapped persons in debris ruins in a rescue scene.
assignees: INST OF CRUSTAL DYNAMICS CHINA SEISMOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Flight type radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The application relates to a flight type radar life detection instrument, including the detection instrument body, be provided with the aircraft on the detection instrument body, be provided with connecting device between aircraft and the detection instrument body, connecting device is including connecting the platform and connecting the inserted block, it has two and all sets up at aircraft towards detection instrument body one side to connect the platform, connect the inserted block and insert and establish between two connection platforms, connect the inserted block and set up in detection instrument body towards aircraft one side. This application has and drives the detection instrument body through the aircraft and surveys in the space to avoid the road and the house of collapse, reduce the effect of the road of collapse and the performance of house restriction radar life detection instrument.
assignees: SHENZHEN DASANTI SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nursing respiration detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device, in particular to a nursing respiration detection device. The nursing respiration detection device comprises fixing belts and an elastic belt, wherein the fixing belts are arranged at both ends of the elastic belt and are fixedly connected with the elastic belt through fixing blocks; a slip buckle and an electrode plate are arranged on each fixing belt; the elastic strip is provided with annular grains; a casing is arranged on the fixing blocks; a motor is fixedly arranged on the casing and is connected with a rotary shaft; a bearing is arranged on the rotary shaft and is fixedly connected with a turntable; photoelectric sensors are arranged on the turntable, and are distributed in a cross way; a storage device is arranged on the side wall of the casing. By adopting the technical scheme, the nursing respiration detection device has the advantage that defect of lower detection accuracy in the prior art can be effectively overcome.

title_en: Two-dimensional through-wall object detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional through-wall object detection radar system, and relates to an impulse pulse radar detection field. The two-dimensional through-wall detection object radar system adopts impulse pulses in a range from 0 to 6GHZ, and a single emission antenna is used to emit impulse pulse signals, which can penetrate walls, ruins, and other obstacles, and then are bounced back after being collided with a life entity, and then are reflected back to double time-sharing sharing receiving antennas. Doppler effect of a received impulse pulse sequence can be caused by the moving of the chest wall of the detected life entity, which is used as the basis of the detection of the life entity. The signals acquired by the two receiving antennas are transmitted to an FPGA signal control processing unit, and the two-dimensional plane position of the detected life entity is calculated after being processed and calculated by adopting an algorithm, and then is displayed by a display unit.

title_en: Breathing detection system after calamity based on intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to sensor network, mobile computing and voice processing technology field, a kind of specifically breathing detection system after calamity based on intelligent terminal.System of the invention includes trigger module and detection module；The trigger module is used for the automatic triggering system after calamity and starts to work, and the detection module is used to detect the breath state of the trapped person of terminal surrounding.The present invention provides trapped person's breathing detections after calamity, according to current technology, corresponding signal transmission or detection means can be set according to the type of terminal device, to provide a kind of possible search and rescue reference direction to rescue worker, rather than the search of blindness, the probability that trapped person is rescued can be improved under specific circumstances.

title_en: Pipeline stress monitoring system and monitoring test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline stress monitoring system and a monitoring test method thereof, wherein the pipeline stress monitoring system comprises a bottom plate, a fixed support, a stress loading device and a resistance strain type sensor, wherein the bottom plate is placed on the ground and is constructed with a first area for arranging the fixed support and a second area for arranging the stress loading device; the fixed support is arranged in the first area and can fix two ends of the pipeline so as to simulate the fully-constrained state of the buried pipeline at the soil inlet and outlet points of the landslide section; the stress loading device is arranged in the second area and can apply a vertical downward acting force to a section of pipeline so as to simulate the uniform load action of objects around the pipeline on the pipe body; the resistance strain type sensor is arranged on a stress monitoring point of the pipeline and can monitor and output the stress generation process of the pipeline. The pipeline stress monitoring system can monitor the stress-strain state of the pipeline, can find pipeline damage in time and realize real-time monitoring and scientific early warning of the suspended state of the pipeline.
assignees: NAT OIL & GAS PIPE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;STATE PIPE NETWORK GROUP SOUTHWEST PIPELINE CO LTD

title_en: Life detection equipment with analysis function
abstract_en: The invention provides life detection equipment with an analysis function, which comprises a sensor for detecting a signal emitted by a target source, wherein the sensor comprises a sound sensor and a vibration sensor; a probe body for receiving a signal transmitted from the sensor; the analysis module is used for analyzing at least two received signals and converting the signals into an AI image, and the display module is used for displaying the AI image on the display module, so that a rescuer can intuitively check the relative positions of a target source and each sensor so as to acquire the position information of the target source, the time for manual analysis of the rescuer can be saved, the sensor position does not need to be moved for many times to determine the target source, the rescue efficiency is effectively improved, the probability of occurrence of secondary accidents can be reduced, and the safety of trapped people and rescue workers is ensured; but also can reduce the cooperation of personnel, so that more rescue work can be done by limited manpower.
assignees: GUANGZHOU E DESIGN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heart rate and respiratory rate millimeter wave radar detection method based on CNN fusion characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a heart rate and respiratory rate millimeter wave radar detection method based on CNN fusion characteristics, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time one-dimensional radar signal of a target person, wherein the one-dimensional radar signal is obtained by monitoring vital signs of the target person through a millimeter wave radar sensor; performing time-frequency analysis based on the one-dimensional radar signals to obtain two-dimensional time-frequency signals; based on the one-dimensional radar signal and the two-dimensional time-frequency signal, the heart rate and the respiration rate of the target person are detected, the heart rate and the respiration rate of the target person are obtained, the problems of inconvenience in long-term monitoring, discomfort and limited application to specific people existing in the traditional contact detection method are overcome, comprehensive and accurate detection of the heart rate and the respiration rate of the human body is realized through a non-invasive monitoring means, and the method is particularly beneficial to the old, chronic patients and individuals needing long-term rehabilitation monitoring, and provides support for home medical treatment and remote health monitoring.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection system based on handheld display and control terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of life detection and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection system based on a handheld display control terminal, which comprises a sensor group, a sensor control module and a control module, wherein the sensor group is used for collecting vital sign signals and environmental parameters and comprises a thermal infrared imager, an audio vibration sensor, a radar wave detector and an environmental sensor; the data processing module is connected with the sensor group and is used for carrying out noise filtering and feature extraction on the data acquired by the sensor group. The application adopts the multi-sensor collaborative detection and data fusion technology, and achieves the technical effect of detecting vital signs in real time and accurately in a complex environment. Compared with the detection method of a single sensor in the prior art, the method can be used for carrying out complementation and fusion on the data of a plurality of sensors on a disaster site, so that the reliability and the accuracy of detection are obviously improved, and the problem of detection blind areas of the traditional method under the conditions of environmental noise and interference is solved.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electronic device for measuring biometric data and device for charging the electronic device
title_ko: 생체 정보를 측정하는 전자 장치 및 그를 충전하는 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 다양한 실시예는 생체 정보를 측정할 수 있는 전자 장치 및 그를 충전하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 상기 전자 장치는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 일면에 위치하며, 도전성 재질의 장식물을 이용하여 형성되는 제1전극; 상기 하우징의 타면에 위치하며, 상기 전자 장치의 착용 시 사용자의 신체에 접촉되는 제2전극; 상기 제1전극 및 상기 제2전극과 전기적으로 커플되는 센서 모듈; 상기 센서 모듈과 전기적으로 커플되는 프로세서; 상기 프로세서와 전기적으로 커플되는 디스플레이 모듈; 및 상기 프로세서와 전기적으로 커플되는 메모리를 포함하되, 상기 메모리는 상기 센서 모듈이 상기 제1전극 및 상기 제2전극을 통해 사용자의 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 프로세서가 상기 측정된 생체 신호를 분석하여 사용자의 건강 상태에 대한 정보를 상기 디스플레이 모듈을 통해 사용자에게 제공하도록 하는 명령을 저장할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 기술적 사상에 바탕을 둔 다양한 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Electronic device for determining vital sign of user and operation method thereof
abstract_en: Provided is an electronic device that determines a vital sign while a user is active. The electronic device comprises: a first sensor for sensing a vital sign of a user; a second sensor for sensing activity of the user; and at least one processor connected to the first sensor and the second sensor. The at least one processor may be configured to: identify a vital sign determined through a first signal acquired through the first sensor; normalize the vital sign to correspond to the activity characteristics of a user on the basis of the vital sign determined through the first signal and the activity level of the user determined using a second signal acquired through the second sensor; and merge the vital sign determined through the first signal and the normalized vital sign so as to determine a merged vital sign.

title_en: Method and apparatus for real-time non-invasive optical monitoring of decompression sickness state
abstract_en: Described herein is a device and system and method for the detection of naturally occurring gas bubbles in the bloodstream; in one embodiment, a wireless optical device may be placed on various parts of the body including a finger or earlobe or is coupled with the SCUBA mouthpiece and detects certain vital signs such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and respiration rate by analyzing the photoplethysmogram (PPG) from a miniature sensor. There is also a method and apparatus for real-time non-invasive optical monitoring of actual state of decompression sickness are presented. The method is based on simultaneous measurements of PPG signals in different locations of human body and analysis of such a factor as phase shifts between various locations, change the shape of PPG signal between different locations, existence and modification of slow trends and low frequency modulations and angular distributions of the out-coming light.

title_en: Smart watch
abstract_en: Systems and methods include a cellular, WiFi, and Bluetooth transceiver coupled to a processor; an accelerometer or a motion sensor coupled to the processor; and a sensor coupled to the processor to sense mood or body vital sign.

title_en: Treating pathogenic infections
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range and bacterial or viral infection are targeted for death. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of an antibiotic and an antiviral. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: Radar for through wall detection
abstract_en: Radar apparatus for detecting an object in through wall and related applications, the radar apparatus comprising a transmitter for transmitting radar signals, and a receiver for receiving reflected portions of said transmitted signals from said object. The radar apparatus is configured for operation in any of at least a first and a second selectable mode. The transmitter is configured for transmitting radar signals in accordance with a selected one of the modes of operation, and said receiver is configured for receiving said reflected portions of said signals transmitted in accordance with said selected mode of operation. The radar apparatus is configured for transmission of signals, through an obstacle, to said object when operating in at least one of said modes.
assignees: CAMBRIDGE CONSULTANTS;BURCHETT MICHAEL HUGH;UTSI PER ARNE VINCENT;OSWALD GORON KENNETH ANDREW;CARTER EDWIN CHRISTOPHER;EDGCOMBE JONATHAN PETER;KEMP GARY;CARTER ROBERT JOHN

title_en: Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on extended Bessel model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler through-the-wall radar positioning method based on Hough transform of an extended Bezier model, which belongs to the technical field of target tracking, and is characterized in that a Hough transform frequency estimation algorithm based on the extended Bezier model is used for extracting an interested target component in a received echo and estimating an instantaneous frequency characteristic value of the target component, an extended Bezier curve is constructed by introducing parameters, and further, the parameters are dynamically adjusted, and a value is determined when signal energy can be concentrated to the maximum extent, at the moment, when a fitting result is most approximate to a target instantaneous frequency curve, the estimation of target instantaneous frequency is completed, the precision is improved when compared with the parameters, and the method has innovativeness; and the positioning and tracking algorithm is used for estimating position information of the target in real time according to the instantaneous frequency, synthesizing a target motion track and realizing the tracking of the target.

title_en: Test device for performance evaluation under action of dislocation load of buried pressurizing pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for performance evaluation under the action of a dislocation load of a buried pressurizing pipeline, which comprises a bracket, a separable box body, a pipeline, a loading assembly, an angle adjusting assembly, a pressurizing assembly and a data acquisition assembly, wherein the detachable box body is provided with a loading hole; the separable box body comprises a fixed end box body and a sliding end box body, the lower part of the bracket is fixed on the rigid floor, and the upper part of the bracket is fixedly connected with the fixed end box body of the separable box body; two ends of the pipeline are respectively and fixedly connected with two ends of the separable box body; the end part of the pipeline is connected with a pressurizing assembly, and the loading assembly is connected with a sliding end box body of the separable box body and is used for realizing axial and oblique dislocation loading of the box body; the data acquisition assembly comprises a pressure sensor, a DIC, an electromagnetic flowmeter, a dynamic acquisition instrument, a computer terminal and the like. The invention can realize accurate and convenient measurement of the three-dimensional space behavior of the pipeline under the action of the earthquake.

title_en: Wearable underwater vital sign and environment monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign measurement, in particular to a wearable underwater vital sign and environment monitoring system which comprises a physiological signal acquisition module, a photoelectric volume pulse wave sensor, a bioelectrical impedance electrode, a piezoelectric sensor and a neck piezoelectric signal, wherein the photoelectric volume pulse wave sensor is fixed at a wrist position, the bioelectrical impedance electrode is attached to the chest, the piezoelectric sensor is placed at the neck position, and the photoelectric volume pulse wave signal, the bioelectrical impedance signal and the neck piezoelectric signal of the wrist position are acquired. In the invention, signal reconstruction is carried out based on energy proportion calculation, the position of an electrocardio R wave crest value point and an R-R interval time sequence are extracted, variability indexes are generated through frequency domain decomposition and frequency band energy statistics, time domain and frequency domain index values are calculated, and weight distribution is carried out, so that the overall monitoring of the underwater physical sign state is realized. The signal acquisition precision is improved by means of a multi-source signal acquisition mode, noise interference is eliminated through signal track matrix decomposition operation, and the reconstruction quality of signals is ensured by adopting characteristic vector energy specific gravity calculation.

title_en: Sleep tracking and vital sign monitoring using low power radio waves
abstract_en: Various arrangements for performing radar-based measurement of vital signs. Waveform data may be received then filtered of data indicative of static objects to obtain motion-indicative waveform data. The motion-indicative waveform data may be analyzed to determine one or more frequencies of movement present within the motion-indicative waveform data. A spectral analysis may be performed on the motion-indicative waveform data to determine a spectral-analysis state of a monitored region. The spectral-analysis state of the monitored region may be determined to match a predefined spectral-analysis state during which vital sign monitoring is permitted. One or more vital signs of a monitored user present within the monitored region may be determined and output based on analyzing the motion-indicative waveform data.

title_en: Wireless life search and rescue instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless life search and rescue instrument which comprises a life detection sensing module and a wireless receiving module. The life detection sensing module includes a microcontroller and a vibration sensor and a human body infrared sensor which are connected with the microcontroller, wherein the microcontroller contains an ARM-core-based STM32 single-chip microcomputer; an output end of the microcontroller is connected with a wireless transmitting antenna. The wireless receiving module includes a wireless receiving antenna and a signal processor, wherein the wireless receiving antenna is connected with an input end of the signal processor. According to the wireless life search and rescue instrument, the vibration sensor has high sensitivity and high reliability; the human body infrared sensor is utilized to sense a survivor and the survivor information can be readily and rapidly transmitted wirelessly to the wireless receiving module, and the wireless receiving module gives audio alarms and searches and locates the survivor, and thus the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the death rates in earthquakes or other disasters are substantially reduced.
assignees: ANHUI POPULAR SCIENCE PRODUCT ENG RES CT CO LTD

title_en: Vital signs detecting module for safeguard station
abstract_en: The utility model is a kind of vital signs detecting module for safeguard station, including the Ith road signal conditioning circuit (1), IIth road signal conditioning circuit (2), IIIth road signal conditioning circuit (3), IVth road signal conditioning circuit (4), vital sign parameter signals radiating circuit (5), totally 5 parts, which are combined, forms an one integral piece.For omnidirectional detection human body vital sign, safeguard station uses 4 road radar modules, radar module output signal amplitude is more compared with small and interference signal, 3 grades of filter amplification circuits are devised for this, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters wireless transmitter module ADC, after software algorithm is handled, breathing/beats are transformed into, are launched vital sign information with 121.5MHz/243MHz frequency ranges by safeguard station.The utility model first applies radar module on safeguard station, can send the vital sign of distress personnel to search and rescue center, greatly improve the efficiency and specific aim of search-and-rescue work.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGYUAN MOBILCOM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar which comprises an outer box body and a detector body, wherein one side of the outer box body is connected with a box cover through a hinge, a limiting assembly is arranged on the inner side of the box cover, the detector body is arranged in an inner cavity of the outer box body, and a protection assembly is arranged at a position, close to the bottom end, of the detector body; the protection component is used for protecting the detection end of the detector body, and a butt joint component is arranged between the protection component and the detector body; according to the utility model, the outer protection frame is matched with the mounting groove and the elastic belt layer, so that when a worker grabs the detector body to detect in ruins, the detection end of the detector body can be protected through the outer protection frame, so that external sundries are prevented from being collided with the detector body, and the detector body is effectively protected.

title_en: Emergency SOS device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency SOS device; infrared lights (6) are arranged on a shell (1) in various directions, and a chargeable battery (2) and a radio (9) are arranged inside the shell (1), and an LED bulb (4) is arranged at one end of the shell (1), and a whistle is arranged at the other end thereof; the chargeable battery (2), the radio (9), a switch (7), infrared lights (6) and an external charging port (8) are connected with a control device (3). The utility model provides a small device for overcoming the deficiency that buried people cannot communicate with the outside; after being buried, since the emergency SOS device can illuminate, people can ask for help by blowing the whistle and acquire information from the outside through the radio, thus increasing the probability of being detected by an external life detecting instrument through infrared information and the opportunity of people to be saved; and the emergency SOS device can be used in the earthquake-prone area.

title_en: Time-share rotary scanning detection method for radar vital sign detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for time-share rotary scanning detection method for a radar vital sign detector. The method comprises the following steps of: erecting a radar in the middle of a wall according to a position to be detected and a range to be detected; determining a detection region of the radar according to a wave velocity width phi degree of the radar and a range of the detection region; and after all the regions in the detection range are detected, generating a vital sign distribution planar graph of the whole region on a computer. According to the method, the radar vital sign detector is deflected at a fixed angle by adopting a gradual deflection scanning detection mode, so that the detection direction of the detector can be changed, and vital sign distribution in the whole region or a room can be gradually finished without moving the radar detector. Each deflection angle of the radar is equal to the wave velocity width of the radar, so that problems of region leakage, repeated detection, leakage detection and the like can be solved. The method is simple, reliable and favorable for detection; the result is accurate and reliable; the method is convenient; and furthermore, the vital sign distribution planar graph can be generated.

title_en: Ultra wideband radar multipoint distributed target positioning method based on life detection aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra wideband radar multipoint distributed target positioning method based on a life detection aircraft, which relates to the technical field of life detection aircrafts and radars. Based on powerful maneuvering performance of a search and rescue aircraft, an ultra wideband life detection radar is arranged on the aircraft, and by using the multipoint distributed target positioning method, quick and accurate living thing positioning can be realized. In an experiment, the radar is placed on an aircraft pan-tilt, the aircraft is used for controlling the radar to move at a high altitude, and according to a multipoint distributed target judgment criterion, a three-sphere method is applied to solving target position information. The original distance detection result in a pitch-catch mode is used for solving a ternary quadratic inhomogeneous equation set, the optimal solution is selected according to results of the equation set, and thus the position information of the living thing in three-dimensional space can be obtained. Through applying an adjacent discrimination method to searching a detection point, the radar is closest to the target position and surrounds the target, and effectiveness and reliability of living thing target positioning are enhanced.

title_en: Impulse type through-wall radar antenna ringing suppression method based on deconvolution
abstract_en: the invention discloses a method for suppressing the ringing of a swash pulse type through-wall radar antenna based on deconvolution, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining an antenna impulse response function, converting the antenna impulse response function into a frequency domain form, and pre-storing the antenna impulse response function into a radar processor; step S2: if the radar is a multi-channel radar, channel correction is carried out on errors of all channels in the echo; if the radar is a single-channel radar, the step is omitted; step S3: FFT transforming the echo after channel correction to a frequency domain; step S4: the echo signal in the frequency domain is multiplied by the inverse function of the impulse response function of the antenna to realize the deconvolution ringing suppression; step S5: the signal is converted into the time domain when the ringing effect in the signal has been removed. The invention has the advantages of wide application range, capability of realizing the signal ringing suppression of an antenna end, improvement of radar range resolution and the like.

title_en: Distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed radar life detection positioning device, which comprises: the life detection module comprises more than two radar units to form a network, and each radar unit comprises a transmitting unit and a receiving unit and can work independently; and the GPS positioning time service module is used for receiving GPS communication, positioning the position of each radar unit in real time, and using the GPS signal as a time sequence trigger signal of each radar unit to realize time sequence synchronization of each radar unit. And the WIFI signal transmission module is used for performing wireless transmission of radar detection data and issuing a control instruction. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, larger coverage, wider detection range and the like.

title_en: Shield segment utilizing air-entrapping bag for intelligent vibration isolation and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield segment utilizing intelligent vibration isolation of an air-entrapping bag and a use method thereof, wherein the outer side wall of the segment is provided with a plurality of air cushions; the outer side wall of the duct piece is provided with an air cushion embedded groove corresponding to each air cushion; the bottom of each air cushion pre-buried groove is provided with an air charging and discharging reserved hole communicated with the inner side of the duct piece; one surface of each air cushion, which is close to the corresponding air cushion embedded groove, is provided with a pressure sensor, and the other surface of each air cushion, which faces the outer side of the air cushion embedded groove, is provided with a rubber limit strip, and is fixed in the corresponding air cushion embedded groove through the corresponding rubber limit strip; each air cushion is connected with an air charging and discharging device; each pressure sensor is connected with the control center; the control center controls the inflation and deflation device to inflate or deflate the corresponding air cushion according to the pressure acquired by each pressure sensor. The application of the invention ensures that the shield segment can sense the deformation of the joint of the segment caused by the earthquake and immediately make air leakage reaction, thereby effectively consuming the energy generated by the earthquake and avoiding the damage of the shield tunnel.
assignees: SHANGHAI URBAN CONSTR DESIGN RES INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Early warning method and device for real-time monitoring of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to real-time monitoring of geological disasters, and particularly relates to an early warning method and device for real-time monitoring of geological disasters, which comprise the following steps: install bin and post leg, when the hillside of position department takes place to ftracture or sink between post leg and the pre-buried nail, the pre-buried nail can drive hollow floating frame through spacing post and keep away from the post leg, at this moment, hollow floating frame drives the movable block through second connecting rod and pull pole and glides in the spout, when the movable block touches shift knob, start audible-visual annunciator and report to the police, remind the ground fracture condition serious, in time, the reply is made, first ratchet and second ratchet on transmission assembly are at the pivoted in-process, can drive the pointer and take the inside removal of locating frame that has the scale mark, observe constantly the pointer position through the surveillance camera, thereby can master rivers variation in size in real time, when taking place the debris flow, according to vibrations sensor response shaking force size, judge the serious degree that the hillside produced the debris flow.

title_en: Method and device for identifying human behaviors of rapid multi-scale through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying human body behaviors of a rapid multi-scale through-wall radar, aiming at frequency stepping radar data, a super-resolution Doppler estimation model based on nuclear distance, a lightweight non-anchor single-stage target detection network model and a lightweight classification network model are combined to construct a lightweight deep neural network with multi-scale characteristic information mining capability, translation information of a human body in a complex through-wall environment and generated mu-D characteristics are synchronously extracted, and two scales of information are mixed for judgment and identification, so that a human body motion identification result of the through-wall radar is finally given; the method can realize higher recognition accuracy, and the construction methods of the sub-modules are all based on the lightweight model, so that the calculation cost of the whole algorithm is greatly reduced.

title_en: Contactless vital sign detection and gesture recognition device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection and gesture recognition, and discloses a non-contact vital sign detection and gesture recognition device, which comprises a millimeter wave radar sensor and a controller, wherein the millimeter wave radar sensor acquires radar sequence frame data for detecting vital sign and gesture recognition of a scene and an object in a non-contact mode, and the radar sequence frame data is connected with a first high-speed signal connector and transmitted to the controller through a first serialization deserializer and superimposed with a power supply from the controller; the central computing processor contained in the controller reads radar parameter data and receives radar sequence frame data through the second serializer-deserializer, the radar sequence frame data is continuous data frames for scene and object measurement, the continuous radar data frame data changes are associated with vital signs and/or gesture changes, and vital sign detection and/or gesture recognition is achieved through running a continuous radar sequence frame data processing program and an AI algorithm program.

title_en: Apparatus for predicting disease based on sleep analysis installed in senior house
title_ko: 노인 주택 내 설치되는 수면분석기반의 질병예측장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sleep analysis-based disease prediction device installed in an elderly house. The sleep analysis-based disease prediction device according to an embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a biosignal sensor which can be installed in an elderly house, is installed in a bedroom, and remotely measures the heart rate or respiration of a sleeper to generate biosignal data; and a sleep analysis unit which analyzes the sleep pattern of the sleeper based on the biosignal data, and generates an alarm message when a disease suspicion pattern is determined from the sleep pattern.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 노인 주택 내 설치되는 수면분석기반의 질병예측장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 수면분석기반의 질병예측장치는 노인 주택 내 설치될 수 있으며, 침실 내 설치되어, 원격으로 수면자의 심박 또는 호흡을 측정하여 생체신호 데이터를 생성하는 생체신호 센서; 및 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기반으로 상기 수면자의 수면패턴을 분석하고, 상기 수면패턴으로부터 질병의심패턴이 판별되면, 알람 메시지를 생성하는 수면분석부를 포함할 수 있다.
