title_en: System and method for detecting undergroung object using frequency analysis
title_ko: 주파수 분석을 이용한 지하 매설물 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is an underground buried object detection system comprising: a GPR module for producing reflected wave data; and an analysis module for producing detection information on an underground buried object by using the reflected wave data, wherein the GPR module includes a GPR sensor for producing reflected wave signals by repeating a process of causing an electromagnetic wave to enter the ground and receiving a reflected wave returning in response thereto while moving a predetermined distance on the ground, the reflected wave data includes a plurality of reflected wave signals produced by the GPR sensor, the analysis module includes a frequency analysis unit for producing frequency analysis data by performing frequency analysis on the reflected wave data, a machine learning unit for performing machine learning on learning data, and an underground buried object estimation model generated by the machine learning and configured to detect a target underground buried object, and the learning data includes the frequency analysis data as an input learning factor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의하면, 반사파 데이터를 생산하는 GPR 모듈; 및 상기 반사파 데이터를 이용하여 지하 매설물에 대한 탐지 정보를 생산하는 분석 모듈을 포함하며, 상기 GPR 모듈은 지상에서 일정 거리 이동하는 동안 전자기파를 땅속으로 입사시키고 대응하여 되돌아오는 반사파를 수신하는 과정을 반복하여 반사파 신호를 생산하는 GPR 센서를 구비하며, 상기 반사파 데이터는 상기 GPR 센서에 의해 생산되는 복수 개의 반사파 신호들을 포함하며, 상기 분석 모듈은 상기 반사파 데이터에 대한 주파수 분석을 수행하여 주파수 분석 데이터를 생산하는 주파수 분석부와, 학습데이터에 대한 기계학습을 수행하는 기계학습부와, 상기 기계학습에 의해 생성되어서 탐지 대상 지하 매설물을 탐지하는 매설물 추정 모델을 구비하며, 상기 학습데이터는 입력 학습 인자로서 상기 주파수 분석 데이터를 포함하는 지하 매설물 탐지 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: System for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for determining a dangerous situation and managing safety of a user. The system comprises: a wearable device which senses a biometric signal of a user by using at least one sensor every predetermined period, and transmits the sensed information to a server; and the server which monitors a state of the user based on sensor information received from the wearable device, matches a surrounding environment of the user to any one state group among a plurality of state groups classified according to an activity attribute of the user when a change in the biometric signal of the user deviates from a threshold value, determines a risk level for the surrounding environment based on setting information of the matched state group and the biometric signal of the user, and transmits a notification message to a terminal of a guardian according to the determined risk level.
abstract_ko: 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하고, 센싱된 정보를 서버로 전송하는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 상기 웨어러블 디바이스로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하되, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 상기 사용자의 주변 환경을 상기 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하고, 상기 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 상기 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 서버를 포함하는, 위험 상황을 판단하고 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A home occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event.

title_en: Non-contact phase-locked and self-injection-locked vital sign sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact phase-locked and self-injection-locked vital sign sensor includes a self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element and a phase-locked loop. The self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element is used for transmitting an oscillation signal to an organism and for receiving a corresponding reflected signal from the organism to be posed at a self-injection-locked state, the oscillation signal being tuned by a vital sign of the organism to form a frequency-tuned signal. The phase-locked loop is used for demodulating the frequency-tuned signal to obtain a corresponding vital signal of the organism. By comparing the oscillation signal frequency-eliminated and outputted from the self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element with a reference signal, a corresponding comparison result is used to vary a phase of the frequency-divided oscillation signal for maintaining the same phase of the reference signal. Thereupon, the oscillation frequency can be stabilized, and the measurement sensitivity can be enhanced.

title_en: Vehicle occupant detection
abstract_en: A vehicle occupant detection system and method for using the same. The vehicle occupant detection system includes: a controller; a plurality of life detection sensors, wherein the plurality of life detection sensors are installed within an interior cabin of a mass-transit vehicle and are each associated with a life detection zone; a local warning system having at least one human-machine interface (HMI) output device; and a vehicle interface that communicatively couples the controller to a vehicle electrical system of the mass-transit vehicle. The vehicle occupant detection system is configured to: (i) acquire sensor data by scanning the life detection zone using the plurality of life detection sensors; (ii) determine whether an occupant is present based on the sensor data; and (iii) provide an indication to a user that an occupant is present using the HMI output device when it is determined that an occupant is present.

title_en: Vibrating table test system for tunnel-landslide system and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibrating table test system for a tunnel-landslide system and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the test system comprises a visual model box with an open top surface, which is made of a U-shaped steel plate, an organic glass plate and a steel plate, wherein a polystyrene foam plate is arranged on the right side wall in the box, surrounding rock materials are filled in the box and a slope body is built, the sliding belt is arranged under the slope body, two stereo-crossed tunnel models are buried horizontally in the surrounding rock material, a plurality of acceleration sensors and dynamic strain gauges are arranged around the tunnel models, and a plurality of acceleration sensors and dynamic soil pressure gauges are arranged on the slope surface of the slope body, on the upper side and the lower side of the sliding belt and in the surrounding rock material. The vibration table test system provided by the invention can comprehensively and dynamically monitor the dynamic response conditions and strain response changes of tunnel lining, tunnel integrity and surrounding rocks in a tunnel-landslide system, grasp the dynamic response conditions of the tunnel lining and the surrounding rocks under different working conditions, save cost, and monitor and analyze the dynamic response conditions of the tunnel and the side slope in the same stage.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar human heart rate measurement method and system based on breath harmonic analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave radar human heart rate measurement method and system based on breath harmonic analysis. The method comprises the steps of acquiring phase change information by using an extended DACM algorithm through an I/Q signal acquired by a millimeter wave radar, analyzing time domain waveforms of vital sign information, calculating to obtain an asymmetry parameter of respiration and a pause parameter of a respiration gap, dynamically adjusting the bandwidth of a notch filter through analysis, inhibiting respiration harmonic waves, reducing the influence on a heartbeat frequency spectrum, finally reducing a heart rate estimation range through a time domain number peak mode, and obtaining a heartbeat frequency with higher precision by applying Chirp-Z conversion. Compared with the traditional respiratory harmonic elimination method, the heart rate measurement method is simple and convenient in flow, more effectively analyzes the intensity of respiratory harmonic and inhibits pertinence, and can effectively improve the measurement accuracy when the heart rate is overlapped with the respiratory harmonic frequency.

title_en: Sensor module for biological signal detection using conductive wire
title_ko: 전도성 실을 이용한 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전도성 실을 전극으로 이용하는 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈은, 전도성 실을 이용하여 비전도성 모재의 양면에 걸쳐 형성된 다수의 전극패턴을 포함하는 어레이 전극; 상기 다수의 전극패턴에 각각 대응하는 다수의 접촉단자와 상기 다수의 접촉단자와 각각 연결되는 다수의 배선패턴을 포함하는 기판; 상기 다수의 전극패턴이 상기 다수의 접촉단자에 항상 접촉되도록 상기 기판을 상기 어레이 전극에 대해 고정시키는 고정수단을 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면 전도성 실을 생체신호 감지용 전극으로 활용하므로 사용자에게 부드럽고 편안한 착용감을 줄 수 있고 피부접촉면에 굴곡이 있는 경우에도 충분한 접촉면을 확보함으로써 보다 정확한 생체신호를 검출할 수 있다. 또한 비전도성 모재에 전도성 실을 이용하여 간편하게 어레이 전극을 구성할 수 있고, 전기적 연결 구성이 매우 간단하므로 어레이 전극의 생산성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있다. 또한 전도성 실로 이루어진 전극패턴은 유연한 피부접촉면을 제공하고 전극패턴의 소형화가 가능하므로 센서모듈을 컴팩트하게 제조하는 것이 가능해진다.

title_en: Bury formula fire pump station water tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting water tanks, and discloses a buried fire-fighting pump station water tank, which comprises a main body, the bottom fixedly connected with supporting mechanism of main part, the supporting mechanism includes the base, the supporting mechanism is installed in the bottom of main part, the inside of base has been seted up and has been held the chamber, the inside of main part is installed separating mechanism, the inside fixedly connected with water pressure sensor of main part, the inside of main part is installed pumping mechanism, the top of main part is installed scrubbing mechanism, scrubbing mechanism includes the scrubbing pipe, the end fixedly connected with scrubbing head of scrubbing pipe, scrubbing head is located and holds the inside of chamber, the top of main part is installed into water mechanism; the utility model discloses can get rid of the inside impurity of water tank.

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced Maximum Permissible Exposure (MPE) compliance based on vital sign detection
abstract_en: The present application relates to wireless communication with enhanced Maximum Permissible Exposure (MPE) compliance based on vital sign detection. Aspects of the present disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflected signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflected signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on these reflected signals, the device may measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain heart rate and/or respiration rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflected signals are indicative of a human vital sign (such as heart rate or respiration). The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether a human vital sign is detected at the target object and transmit an adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Apparatus and method for processing bio-signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 처리 장치 및 생체 신호 처리 방법
abstract_en: A bio-signal processing apparatus is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal processing apparatus receives bio-signals having different electric physical quantities from a plurality of sensors, and processes the bio-signal through any one from a voltage input unit and a current input unit.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 처리 장치가 개시된다.  일 실시예는 복수의 센서들로부터 서로 다른 전기적 물리량을 갖는 생체 신호를 수신하고, 생체 신호를 전압 입력부 및 전류 입력부 중 어느 하나를 통해 수신하여 처리한다.

title_en: Apparatus for mapping buried object and ground cavity through electromagneticwave analysis
title_ko: 전자기파 분석을 통한 지하구조물과 공동형상 맵핑장치 및 그 맵핑방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for mapping a buried object and a ground cavity through electromagnetic wave analysis, comprising: a moving unit configured to move in a first direction in a specific exploration section on the ground surface; a ground penetrating radar configured to transmit a directional electromagnetic wave to the ground of the exploration section and receive a reflected wave reflected from a buried object; and a controller configured to extract a first reflected wave reflected through a shortest path from a specific reflection point of the buried object at a first point of the ground penetrating radar in the specific exploration section and a second reflected wave reflected from the same specific reflection point at a second point, calculate coordinates by calculating the length and depth of the specific reflection point, analyze distributed coordinates of the specific reflection point while continuously changing the first and second points of the ground penetrating radar according to the movement of the moving unit at a specific exploration interval, to map and evaluate the length, depth, and shape of the buried object. As described above, the apparatus of the present invention evaluates the specific shape and size of the buried object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 지표상의 특정 탐사구간에서 제1방향으로 이동하는 이동부; 상기 탐사구간의 지반으로 지향성 전자기파를 송신하고, 지하구조물로부터 반사되는 반사파를 수신하는 지표투과레이더; 및 상기 특정 탐사구간에서의 상기 지표투과레이더의 제1지점에서 상기 지하구조물의 특정 반사점으로부터 최단경로로 반사되는 제1반사파와, 제2지점에서 상기 동일 특정 반사점으로부터 반사되는 제2반사파를 추출하여, 상기 특정 반사점의 길이와 심도를 연산하여 좌표를 산출하고, 상기 이동부의 이동에 따른 상기 지표투과레이더의 제1 및 제2지점을 특정 탐사진행간격만큼 연속적으로 변경하여 상기 특정 반사점의 분포좌표를 분석하여서, 상기 지하구조물의 길이와 심도와 형상을 맵핑하여 평가하는 제어부;를 포함하여, 상기 지하구조물의 구체적인 형상 및 크기를 평가하는, 전자기파 분석을 통한 지하구조물과 공동형상 맵핑장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Apparatus for emitting sonic sound for rescuing maritime distress
title_ko: 해상조난 구조용 음파발생장치
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a sound wave generating device for marine distress rescue, which collects a bio-signal of a user to generate bio-information, determines whether the user is flooded without an error by a flooding sensor and a water pressure sensor, and transmits a sound wave signal including the bio-information to the water, thereby enabling rapid marine disaster rescue. The present invention comprises: a band unit wound around and fixed to a specific body of a user; a sound wave generation unit including a housing frame having a watertight structure, a bobbin formed inside a voice coil to which a current corresponding to sound information is conducted to transmit vibration, a vibration plate having a watertight structure to transmit a sound wave signal in an audible frequency range to the water, and a control module to control application of a current to the voice coil; a biometric sensor attached and fixed to an inner surface of a strap to sense a biometric signal of the user; a flooding sensing unit including three or more seawater inlet holes, a soluble blocking film formed at an inlet of the seawater inlet hole, and a flooding sensor to sense seawater introduced into the seawater inlet hole; and a water pressure sensor formed on a side surface of the sound wave generation unit to sense water pressure. According to the present invention, bio-information is generated by collecting a bio-signal of a user, and whether the user is submerged in water is determined by a flooding sensor and a water pressure sensor without an error. Therefore, a sound wave signal including the bio-information is transmitted underwater, thereby enabling a rapid marine disaster rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 사용자의 특정 신체에 감겨 고정되는 밴드부(110), 하우징 프레임(121)과, 진동을 전달하는 보빈(122)과, 보빈(122)의 상단에 결합되어 가청주파수범위의 음파신호를 수중으로 전달하는 수밀구조의 진동판(123)과, 보이스 코일로의 전류 인가를 제어하는 제어모듈(125)로 이루어진, 음파발생부(120), 생체신호를 감지하는 생체 인식 센서(130), 진동판(123)의 테두리 영역에 일정거리 이격 배치되는 3개 이상의 해수유입홀(141)과, 해수유입홀(141)의 입구에 형성된 용해성 차단막(142)과, 차단막(142)의 용해로 노출된 해수유입홀(141)로 유입된 해수를 각각 감지하는 침수 센서(143)로 이루어진, 침수감지부(140), 및 수압을 감지하는 수압 센서(150)를 포함하여, 제어모듈(125)은, 생체신호를 분석하여 사용자의 정상상황과 위급상황을 판단하여 생체정보를 생성하고, 침수 센서(143)의 3개 이상의 해수유입홀(141)로 해수가 유입되어 일정시간이상 지속되고, 수압 센서(150)에 의해 일정 수압이 감지되면, 음파발생부(120)가 침수된 것으로 판단하여, 생체정보를 포함하는 음파신호를 수중으로 송출하도록 하는, 해상조난 구조용 음파발생장치를 개시한다.

title_en: System and method for monitoring vital signals in contactless
title_ko: 비접촉 방식 생체신호 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 비접촉 방식 생체신호 모니터링 시스템은 개시된다. 일 실시예의 비접촉 방식 생체신호 모니터링 시스템은 대상자의 수면 장소로부터 반사된 초광대역의 임펄스 라디오 신호의 임펄스 응답 신호가 담긴 UWB 원시 데이터를 전송하는 IR-UWB 레이더 장치, 대상자의 심장박동 및 호흡 운동에 의한 진동을 감지한 신호가 담긴 피에조 원시 데이터를 전송하는 피에조 센서 장치 및 UWB 원시 데이터 및 피에조 원시 데이터를 각각 전처리하고, 주파수 영역으로 변환한 주파수 스펙트럼의 첨두치를 추적하여 심박수 및 호흡수 중 적어도 하나를 추출하는 멀티모달 디바이스를 포함한다. 이러한 비접촉 방식 생체신호 모니터링 시스템은 수면 중 편안한 생체신호 계측이 가능하여 자연스러운 장시간 생체신호 모니터링을 가능케 한다.

title_en: Method, system, and computer program product for automatic multi object localization and/or vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A method for automatic multi-object localization and/or vital sign monitoring is provided. The method comprises the steps of receiving a radar signal in order to form a corresponding observation matrix, reducing noise by applying singular value decomposition to the observation matrix, processing the result of the singular value decomposition by an independent component analysis in order to estimate the corresponding sources, and estimating propagation channels of the estimated sources by minimizing the corresponding residual error based on the observation matrix and the estimated sources.

title_en: Physiological signal sensor
abstract_en: A physiological signal sensor to measure life signs includes at least one first and one second Doppler detectors, at least one first amplification filter, at least one second amplification filter, a processor, and a transceiver. Data from the physiological signal sensor is sent to the first and second Doppler detectors to detect first and second physiological signals from different locations on a living body. The two physiological signals are sent to the first and second amplification filters and amplified and filtered, and converted to obtain a first and second digital sensed signal. Digital signal processing is carried out on the digital sensed signals to obtain first and second physiological information which are outputted via the transceiver.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Wireless telemetry sensor system
abstract_en: The presently disclosed technique includes a multi-detector wearable medical sensor that combines biopotential, optical, temperature, acceleration, and acoustic measurement into a single device. It leverages sensor fusion and deep learning algorithms on device which allows it to directly monitor vital signs, physiological waveforms, and early warning of medical complications. One utility is the ability for the sensor to expand and adapt to several use cases. An expansion port and accessory cables allow the biopotential electrodes to step up or down for any combination of continuous 1-12L electrocardiography ("ECG") measurements. It can also measure fetal ECG with a different accessory cable, or electroencephalogram ("EEG") with another cable. The sensor has BLUETOOTH® Low Energy ("BLE"), Wireless Fidelity ("WIFI®"), Fifth Generation mobile network ("5G") Long Term Evolution Machine Type Communication ("LTE-M"), Near Field Communication ("NFC"), and Ultra Wideband ("UWB") radios. The sensor can also charge and communicate over Universal Serial Bus ("USB").

title_en: Wearable vital signs monitor with selective signal acquisition
abstract_en: In one example, a wearable vital sign monitor (WVSM) system comprises a support structure configured to be worn by a patient, a plurality of patient physiological sensors configured to be coupled to the patient when the patient is wearing the support structure, each patient physiological sensor configured to output a respective patient physiological signal, a memory, and, a processor communicatively coupled to the plurality of patient physiological sensors and configured to store in the memory measurements of patient physiological signals taken at selected times based on a categorization of the patient physiological signal.

title_en: System and method for the detection, recording and reporting of hazardous materials and illegal activity
abstract_en: A system and method for the detection, recording, and reporting of matter and energy related to hazardous and illegal substances in enclosed and semi-enclosed spaces The system and method relate to the early detection of hazardous materials and illegal actions commonly associated with criminal and terrorist activities This 'around-the-clock' security shield integrates audio, video and sensor detection (passive deterrence) with real-time monitoring, communications, and data recording (active deterrence) The system can function as a stationary or mobile recording-reporting device(2) for the detection of biological agents, toxic chemicals, dirty bombs, electromagnetic radiation, human presence, drugs associated with volatile organic chemicals (VOCs). and occasions of negligent oversight The primary component of the system is a solid-state detection unit(2) housed in a compact case which ma) be mounted for mobile or stationary applications The detection unit(2) includes a variety of detectors( 18,22.24) and sensors(20), power supply(10a I Ob), and communication interfaces

title_en: Patient-worn sensor assembly
abstract_en: A patient-worn sensor assembly for detecting, recording and communicating patient vital signs includes several structural features that can provide improved signal quality, reduced signal noise, improved patient comfort, improved reliability, and improved adhesion to the patient's skin. The patient-worn sensor is capable of tracking vital sign information such as blood pressure, body temperature, respiratory rate, blood oxygen saturation, heart rate (via ECG), heart rate, blood glucose level, and hydration (bio-impedance) level. The sensors are also capable of tracking and recording other information about the patient, including patient motion, activity, and sleep patterns.

title_en: Real-time gesture recognition method and computer equipment for through-wall radar human body image sequence
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radars, and provides a real-time gesture recognition method and computer equipment for a through-wall radar human body image sequence. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a human body image sequence when a hidden human body target moves through a human body image generation algorithm according to the radar echo signal of the target; dividing a human body image sequence when a hidden human body target moves into a training set sample and a test set sample according to a preset proportion, and labeling corresponding action labels at corresponding moments; constructing a human body posture real-time recognition network by combining a 3D convolution layer and a 3D convolution gate control circulation unit, and training the human body posture real-time recognition network through a training set sample; and inputting the test set sample into the trained human body posture real-time recognition network to obtain the posture category of each moment. The invention has the capability of short-time judgment of human behavior types, and effectively solves the problems that the actions are incomplete within fixed time or are difficult to distinguish when two actions exist, and the like.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar vital sign signal denoising algorithm based on PE and TVF-EMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband radar vital sign signal denoising algorithm based on PE and TVF-EMD, and belongs to the technical field of radar vital detection. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing clutter and noise signals in original radar echo signals by adopting methods such as channel signal subtraction, average subtraction, linear trend suppression, automatic gain control, fast time filtering, slow time filtering and the like, and then analyzing statistical characteristics such as kurtosis, standard deviation, variance and the like of data in a slow time direction, and detecting the position of a human body target by adopting a PE algorithm. The optimization algorithm can conveniently and accurately locate the time when the signal is suddenly changed, and can amplify the fine change of the signal. And decomposing the extracted vital sign signals by adopting a TVF-EMD algorithm, calculating the respective energy duty ratio of each IMF component in the respiratory frequency band and the heartbeat frequency band after decomposition, selecting a proper signal for reconstruction, and finally carrying out spectrum analysis on the reconstructed signal by utilizing FFT (fast Fourier transform). The radar vital signal denoising method provided by the invention can accurately locate the target and extract the vital information, and the denoising result is quite considerable.

title_en: Driver health monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning the health of a driver, which belong to the technical field of intelligent cabins of automobiles, wherein the method comprises the steps of calling camera data in a DMS (digital management system) in the intelligent cabin, positioning the chest of the driver and obtaining the three-dimensional coordinates of the chest part of the driver in a cabin space; the method comprises the steps of combining three-dimensional coordinates positioned on a thoracic cavity part, adjusting a millimeter wave radar integrated in a steering wheel to send radar signals, receiving echo signals of the radar signals after interference of movement of a fluctuation cavity of the thoracic cavity part, extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals in real time based on the echo signals to obtain vital sign signals, extracting features of the vital sign signals to obtain vital sign parameters, analyzing the vital sign parameters, and sending an abnormality processing request when the vital sign parameters exceed a threshold value. The method analyzes the cardiopulmonary data of the driver and judges the occurrence of crisis abnormal conditions such as the suppressed respiration and the heart beat pause in advance.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for monitoring a bionic signal based on a wireless network. The method for monitoring a bionic signal based on a wireless network includes the steps of: enabling a bionic sensor to sense the bionic signal generated by a sensing object; enabling a bionic signal monitoring device to monitor the bionic signal; enabling the bionic signal monitoring device to determine whether the bionic signal is in a normal range or an abnormal range based on a preset value; enabling the bionic signal monitoring device to transmit state information of the sensing object to an emergency situation management device if the bionic signal is not in the abnormal range; and enabling the emergency situation management device to transmit the state information to a user device of a protector of the sensing object. Accordingly, the present invention can continuously manage the state of the sensing object by analyzing the bionic signal.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법은 생체 센서가 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 생체 신호를 센싱하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 설정된 값을 기반으로 생체 신호가 정상 범위인지 비정상 범위인지 여부를 판단하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 생체 신호가 상기 비정상 범위인 경우, 응급 상황 관리 장치로 센싱 대상의 상태 정보를 전송하는 단계와 응급 상황 관리 장치가 센싱 대상의 보호자의 사용자 장치로 상태 정보를 전달하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: workers healthcare method using smartphone application
title_ko: 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법

본 발명 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통해 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Indicator light equipement for guideing the escape in the event of fire
title_ko: 안전한 대피를 위한 소방표시기구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire display device for safe evacuation, the fire display device comprising: a case (10) buried to be exposed on a wall body; a guide plate (20) installed to be foldable on the case (10); an LED electronic display (30) which is installed on the guide plate (20) and visually displays characters or a design; a linear actuator (40) which folds the guide plate (20); a fire sensor (50) which senses an emergency situation and outputs the same; a control unit (60) which receives transmission of a signal from the fire sensor (50) and controls operation of the LED electronic display (30) and the linear actuator (40); a speaker (70) which is operated and controlled by the control unit (60) and outputs sounds for evacuation to the outside; and a battery (80) which supplies power to the LED electronic display (30), the linear actuator (40), the fire sensor (50), the control unit (60), and the speaker (70). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fire display device for safe evacuation can guide people to escape from risk of fire in a rapid manner by significantly increasing visibility of displaying the location of an emergency exit as the guide plate and the LED electronic display are folded and protrude from the wall body when a fire occurs. The fire display device for safe evacuation stores evacuation articles (a flashlight, a mask, and so on) easy to be lost (misplaced) therein and enables the evacuation articles to be naturally exposed only in an emergency situation. Accordingly, the fire display device for safe evacuation can reduce the number of lost (misplaced) evacuation articles and can significantly help evacuation activities.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안전한 대피를 위한 소방표시기구에 관한 것으로서, 벽체 노출되게 매설되는 케이스(10); 케이스(10)에 접철가능하게 설치되는 안내판(20); 안내판(20)에 설치되어 문자나 도안을 시각적으로 표시하는 LED전광판(30); 안내판(20)을 절첩하는 리니어액추에이터(40); 비상상황을 감지해 출력하는 화재감지센서(50); 화재감지센서(50)로부터 신호를 전달받아 LED전광판(30) 및 리니어액추에이터(40)를 동작제어하는 제어부(60); 제어부(60)에 의해 동작제어되어 외부로 대피음향을 방출하는 스피커(70); LED전광판(30), 리니어액추에이터(40), 화재감지센서(50), 제어부(60), 스피커(70)로 전원을 공급하는 축전지(80)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면, 화재발생시 안내판과 LED전광판이 접히면서 벽체로부터 돌출됨에 따라 비상구의 위치 표시에 대한 시인성을 획기적으로 높여주어 화재의 위험으로부터 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있고, 분실(망실)되기 쉬운 피난물품(손전등, 마스크 등)을 내부에 수납하여 비상상황 시에만 자연스럽게 노출되도록 함으로서 피난물품의 분실(망실)을 줄일 수 있으면서 대피활동에 큰 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: Wall-Touching Holey Patterned Metamaterial Surface Combinative to the High-Gain SIW-Slot-Array Antenna for Through-Wall Radars
title_ko: 벽 투과 레이다용 기판집적도파관 슬롯배열 고이득 안테나와 결합하는 벽 접촉 메타재질표면 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transmitter for a wall-contact type wall-transmissive object detection system, which comprises: a new antenna which is an electromagnetic wave radiation source capable of making a radar usable for detecting a metal body in a building, a metal body in another room next to an office, a metal body in an office in a corridor, and a non-destructive metal body in the office, or greatly improving the performance of the existing radar for the same purpose; and a new metamaterial surface coupled to the new antenna to allow electromagnetic waves to penetrate a wall when a wall is in contact. A wall-contact type wall-transmissive object detection system includes a signal generator that generates a signal; a wall-contact type transmitter that radiates radio waves by inputting the signal of the signal generator; a receiver that receives a signal in which the radio waves radiated from the transmitter pass through the wall and hit an object behind the wall and reflected waves re-transmit the wall; and an object detection unit for detecting the object based on the signal of the receiver.
abstract_ko: 건물 내 금속체, 사무실 옆 다른 방의 금속체, 복도에서 사무실 안의 금속체, 비파괴 금속체 검출에 사용 가능한 레이다를 만들거나 기존의 동일 목적의 레이다의 성능을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 전자파 방사원인 새로운 안테나와 그에 결합하여 벽 접촉 시 전자파가 벽을 투과할 수 있게 하는 새로운 메타재질 평면렌즈를 발명하였다. 전자파 방사원은 흔하게 사용되는 혼 안테나의 단점인 구조의 큰 길이는 없애고 장점인 안테나 고이득을 위해 기판집적도파관형 슬롯 배열 안테나를, 메타재질구조 표면은 벽 접촉 시 임피던스의 급격한 차이를 줄이는 임피던스 정합을 위해 상대 유전율이 낮은 유전체에 공기구멍을 내고 이득을 증가시키는 렌즈 기능을 위해 공기구멍들의 패턴을 형성한 모습의 메타재질 표면을 공극을 두고 방사원에 결합한다. 그렇게 하여, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 벽 접촉형 벽 투과 물체 감지 시스템은, 전자파를 만들어 벽을 투과하는 것은 물론 금속체에 닿아 반사되어 오면서 또 한 번 벽을 투과하여 송신기 옆의 수신기에 신호가 도달하게 만들어, 벽 뒤의 물체를 감지하게 하는 신기술이다.

title_en: Intelligent protection system for high-dam plunge pool
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an intelligent protection system for a high dam plunge pool. A horizontal pressure sensor is buried in the middle point at the lateral surface of headwaters under an abrasion resistance layer of each board block, a vertical pressure sensor is buried in the middle point at the bottom surface of the tail water of the board blocks, and two vertical vibration sensors are buried at the opposite angles of the two pressure sensors. A signal line is connected to signal collecting equipment via a cable and is connected to a computer. The present invention is suitable for monitoring various operating states of a soleplate of a plunge pool, finds different sick danger and various disasters which impossibly happen on the soleplate in time and quickly finds out the position where the sick danger happen, and thus, various project methods can be adopted to carry out repair and reinforcement. The system has the characteristics of simple form, convenient construction, low construction cost, convenient operation and management.

title_en: A kind of unmanned aerial vehicle group searching rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of unmanned aerial vehicle group searching rescue systems, including form unmanned aerial vehicle group by multi rack search unmanned plane, and described search unmanned plane carries detection source, is scanned for treating region of search, determines suspicious region；Described search unmanned plane also carries ultra-wide life detection radar, for being scanned to target area, obtaining and returning the vital sign status information in the target area；The detection source includes radio-frequency spectrum detection source and/or SAR imaging detection source and/or optical imagery detection source；The target area is to be determined and carrying out data fusion to the suspicious region.The advantages that with searching rescue accurate positioning, precision is high, and flexibility is good, and stability is good, can greatly improve the efficiency of searching rescue.

title_en: Emergency SOS device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency SOS device. Infrared lights (6) are arranged on a shell (1) in various directions, and a chargeable battery (2) and a radio (9) are arranged inside the shell (1), and an LED bulb (4) is arranged at one end of the shell (1), and a whistle is arranged at the other end thereof; the chargeable battery (2), the radio (9), a switch (7), infrared lights (6) and an external charging port (8) are connected with a control device (3). The utility model provides a small device for overcoming the deficiency that buried people cannot communicate with the outside; after being buried, since the emergency SOS device can illuminate, people can ask for help by blowing the whistle and acquire information from the outside through the radio, thus increasing the probability of being detected by an external life detecting instrument through infrared information and the opportunity of people to be saved; and the emergency SOS device can be used in the earthquake-prone area.

title_en: ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR human body respiration signal detecting method through walls based on Faster-RCNN network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR human body respiration signal detecting method through walls based on Faster-RCNN network, first to it is original slow when the m- two-dimentional ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo-signal of distance do denoising and weak signal enhancement pre-processes；Then using Advance Normalisation method, for treated, echo continues signal enhancing and denoising；Echo-signal in preprocessing process is imaged as by gray level image using MATLAB, scheme the wide corresponding echo slow time to, scheme high corresponding echo distance to；Finally obtained gray level image is screened, labeled data collection, training Faster-RCNN network model carries out the identification of human body respiration small-signal.Recognition accuracy of the invention is high, and detection speed is fast, provides superior technique for practical techniques such as radar return target detection, life detections in practical application and supports.

title_en: Vital sign parameter estimation method and performance evaluation based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign parameter estimation method and performance evaluation based on an MIMO radar, relates to the technical field of MIMO radar application, and provides a technical scheme for improving the performance of parameter estimation by further applying the MIMO radar to the vital sign parameter estimation. The method comprises the steps of placing the MIMO radar in an observation area; acquiring MIMO radar position information and observation area position information; acquiring the received acquisition sample information of the MIMO radar, wherein the acquisition sample information is the transmission signal of the MIMO radar transmitting antenna through the observation area; inputting the position information and the sample information to a signal model, outputting an unknown parameter of the input information through maximum likelihood estimation by the signal model, and outputting a Cramer-Rao boundary value of the estimated unknown parameter by the signal model; and outputting the vital sign parameter information and the performance of parameter estimation thereof. The evaluation method and the evaluation device realize that the evaluation value of the heartbeat frequency is obtained by adopting Bayesian estimation through the MIMO radar, and the evaluation performance is evaluated by utilizing the Clarmero bound value of the parameter.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE QUZHOU OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Integrated non-contact millimeter wave radar system for health monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated non-contact millimeter wave radar system for health monitoring, which comprises a vital sign monitoring module, a sleep monitoring module, a falling monitoring module and a Labview visual display module. The system adopts the millimeter wave radar sensor with 60Ghz to realize the non-contact health monitoring of the human body, and avoids the problems of complex operation, limited application range, low user dependency and low integration degree of the existing monitoring system. Compared with the existing monitoring system, the system has the advantages of high resolution, strong sensitivity, high visualization degree and multifunction integration, health characteristic signals of a human body can be monitored, evaluated and judged in real time through the millimeter wave radar, and fed back to a doctor or a guardian in time, and the doctor or the guardian can make emergency treatment according to corresponding prompts. The system plays an important role in special crowds such as children, old people, burn patients, infectious disease patients and the like, and can achieve the purpose of efficient and accurate monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHIJU XINLIAN MICROELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on ultra-wideband radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of measuring vital signs through an ultra-wideband radar to obtain echo signals, wherein the echo signals comprise vital sign signals and clutter signals of stationary objects; clutter filtering processing is carried out on the echo signals to obtain body surface micro-motion signals; after the body surface micro-motion signal is compensated and undersampled, performing modal decomposition by using an improved self-adaptive noise complete set empirical mode decomposition ICEEMDAN algorithm, and reconstructing to obtain a heartbeat respiratory micro-motion signal; and classifying and processing the heartbeat respiratory micro-motion signals through a multiple signal classification MUSIC algorithm to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals. The problem of modal aliasing caused by modal decomposition of the existing EMD algorithm is avoided, and the problem of interference of the respiratory signal to the heartbeat signal during separation of the heartbeat respiratory signal in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Deep learning-based radar non-contact human electrocardiogram monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical health monitoring, and particularly relates to a radar non-contact human electrocardiograph monitoring method based on deep learning. The invention can realize noninvasive vital sign monitoring of the human body target, and solves the limitations of the traditional electrocardiogram in long-term monitoring and special cases. The method transmits signals to a human body in a non-contact mode by using a CW continuous wave radar based on a six-port technology, obtains original radar sensing signals from radar echoes, and simultaneously completes synchronous acquisition of electrocardiographic signals (ECG) of the human body by using reference equipment. The obtained radar signals as well as the ECG signals are processed using a signal processing algorithm and a data set is constructed. Then training a mixed convolution automatic coding and two-way long-short-term memory cyclic network (BiLSTM) with MODWT layers in a data driving mode to finally obtain a reconstruction mapping model from the radar original signal to the ECG signal.

title_en: Through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on phase non-uniform quantization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on phase non-uniform quantization, which comprises the steps of firstly calculating the phase of radar imaging at grating lobe or side lobe positions; then, aiming at radar receiving signals, calculating imaging results of all channels and radar original imaging results by using a back projection algorithm; according to the operation result, the phase of each channel is quantized by the phase of the grating lobe or the side lobe position. And then calculating standard deviation of phase quantization results of different channels at the same pixel point position, thereby forming a weight image. And finally, weighting the radar original imaging result to obtain radar images after grating lobes and side lobe suppression. The effectiveness and the robustness to noise of the disclosed method are proved through a plurality of simulation and actual measurement embodiments. The method is not only suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging detection, but also can be applied to the fields of synthetic aperture radar imaging, microwave imaging and the like, and is a universal image grating lobe and sidelobe suppression method.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: To provide a vital-sign detecting system.SOLUTION: A vital-sign detecting system according to the present invention includes: a plurality of RF tags that are each attached to respective subjects and allow respective incident RF signals with different predetermined frequencies to be generated, the incident RF signals being projected onto respective subjects for generation of respective reflected RF signals; and at least one RF radar that enables the reflected RF signals to be demodulated such that a vital sign of the respective subjects is obtained, and the subjects are identified according to the associated frequency of the reflected RF signals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Mask for clean room
title_ko: 청정실용 무진 마스크
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mask for clean room is provided, which prevents foreign material like saliva from being exhausted to the outside and minimizes generation of dust in the cut out part of the mask. CONSTITUTION: A mask for clean room comprises: a mask body(11) which is formed so that the length become narrow towards both side ends; a cover(14) which is thermally fused in the top end portion of the mask body and in which both side ends are thermally fused in both side ends of the mask body by ultrasonic wave and a metal or plastic wire is buried in the bottom; and a hanging band(12) in which both ends are fused with both side ends of the mask body by ultrasonic wave. The mask body, band, cover and a wrinkle part(13) are integrated by ultrasonic wave welding.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무진 마스크에서 미세 먼지가 발생하는 것을 억제하고 작업자 즉, 작업자의 안면으로부터 이물질이 떨어지지 않도록 하기 위해, 상기 마스크 본체와 상기 걸이 밴드, 상기 덮개 그리고 주름부가 초음파 실링에 의해 컷팅 및 마무리되는 한편 초음파 용착에 의해 일체화된 것으로서, 마스크 본체의 하단부에 필터지가 연장되고, 이 필터지가 접혀져 외주름 또는 맞주름을 가지는 주름부가 형성되며, 이 주름부가 상기 마스크 본체 이면에 닿도록 접혀진 상태에서 초음파에 의해 마스크 본체의 양측 단부에 주름부의 양측 단부가 용착되어, 사용시 주름부의 외주름 또는 맞주름들이 펴지면서 마스크 본체의 후방에 작업자의 턱을 수용할 수 있는 포켓이 형성되도록 한 청정실용 무진 마스크에 관한 것이다.
