title_en: Electronic device including biometric sensor and electrode for acquiring biometric signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 획득을 위한 생체 센서 및 전극을 포함하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. According to an embodiment disclosed in the present document, the electronic device comprises: a housing forming a plurality of through-holes formed on its surface; a wheel member rotatably coupled to the surface of the housing, wherein the wheel member comprises a conductive portion; a printed circuit board disposed inside the housing; and a first bearing structure, at least a portion of which is disposed inside the through-holes, to support rotation of the wheel member, wherein the first bearing structure electrically connects the printed circuit board and the conductive portion. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 문서에 개시되는 일 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 표면에 복수의 관통 홀이 형성되는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 상기 표면에 회전 가능하도록 결합되는 휠 부재, 상기 휠 부재는 도전성 부분을 포함함; 상기 하우징 내부에 배치되는 인쇄 회로 기판; 및 상기 휠 부재의 회전을 지지하기 위해, 적어도 일부가 상기 관통 홀의 내부에 배치되는 제1 베어링 구조, 상기 제1 베어링 구조는 상기 인쇄 회로 기판과 상기 도전성 부분을 전기적으로 연결함; 을 포함할 수 있다. 이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Leakage pipe and ground monitoring system of underground buried pipe
title_ko: 지하 매설관의 누수 관로 및 지반 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A leakage pipe and ground monitoring system of an underground buried pipe according to an embodiment can improve the reliability and efficiency of underground pipe maintenance through inspection and analysis of leaky pipes and leaky ground of underground pipes, including heat transport pressure pipes for district heating. Specifically, in the embodiment, a leakage area of the buried pipe can be identified through analysis of vibration signals including ground penetrating radar (GPR) signals, heat distribution signals, and elastic waves. The leakage pipe and ground monitoring system of an underground buried pipe includes a ground penetrating radar (GPR); a non-contact GPR receiving antenna; a thermal imaging camera; at least one vibration detection sensor; a controller; and vehicles.
abstract_ko:
실시예에 따른 지하 매설관의 누수 관로 및 지반 모니터링 시스템은 지역난방용 열수송 압력 관로를 포함하는 지하 매설관의 누수관 및 누수지반의 탐상 및 분석을 통하여 지하 매설관 유지관리의 신뢰성 및 효율성을 향상시킨다. 
구체적으로, 실시예에서는 지표투과레이더(GPR)신호, 열분포 신호, 탄성파를 포함하는 진동신호 분석을 통해 매설관의 누수영역을 파악할 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Air conditioner and control method thereof
title_ko: 공기조화기 및 이의 제어방법
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 공기조화기는 공기 조화기 하우징, 실내 공간으로 냉기를 공급하기 위한 냉기 공급장치, 상기 실내 공간 내의 사용자의 움직임 또는 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 적어도 둘 이상의 재실 감지 센서 및 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.  상기 프로세서는 상기 적어도 둘 이상의 재실 감지 센서로부터 획득한 센싱 값에 기초하여 상기 실내 공간 내의 사용자의 유무 또는 인원수를 추정하고, 상기 추정된 사용자에 대해 식별자를 부여하고, 상기 식별자에 관한 움직임 정보 또는 생체 신호를 획득하고, 상기 획득한 움직임 정보 또는 생체 신호에 기반하여 상기 식별자의 수면 상태 및/또는 수면 단계를 판단하고, 상기 수면 단계에 기초하여 상기 냉기 공급장치(30)의 동작을 제어하도록 구성될 수 있다.  상기 재실 감지 센서는 레이더 센서 및 마이크를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Signal processing method and device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a signal processing method and device. The method comprises: processing a radar echo signal to obtain a thoracic cavity movement signal, wherein the radar echo signal is an echo signal generated by a target object reflecting an electromagnetic wave emitted from a radar; filtering the thoracic cavity movement signal by using a filter to obtain a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, wherein the respiratory signal corresponds to a respiratory bandpass frequency of the filter, and the heartbeat signal corresponds to a heartbeat bandpass frequency of the filter; and performing joint time-frequency domain processing on the respiratory signal to obtain a respiratory frequency corresponding to the respiratory signal, and performing joint time-frequency domain processing and data statistical analysis on the heartbeat signal to obtain a heartbeat frequency corresponding to the heartbeat signal. The present disclosure solves the technical problem in the related art that in radar-based heartbeat and respiration detection methods, low accuracy of detection is caused by relaying only on a time domain characteristic or a frequency domain characteristic of a radar signal during analysis.

title_en: Electronic device comprising sensor module
title_ko: 센서 모듈을 포함하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may comprise: a housing; a battery disposed in the housing; and a sensor module at least a part of which is disposed in the housing, wherein the sensor module comprises: a substrate; a biometric sensor disposed on the substrate; a sealing member surrounding at least a part of the substrate and the biometric sensor; and a biometric signal sensing electrode surrounding at least a part of the sealing member and electrically connected to the substrate, at least a part of the biometric signal sensing electrode being exposed outside the housing. Various other embodiments may also be possible.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 다양한 실시예들에 따르는 전자 장치는, 하우징, 상기 하우징 내에 배치된 배터리 및 적어도 일부가 상기 하우징 내에 배치된 센서 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 센서 모듈은, 기판, 상기 기판 상에 배치된 생체 인식 센서, 상기 기판 및 상기 생체 인식 센서의 적어도 일부를 둘러싸는 밀봉 부재, 및 상기 밀봉 부재의 적어도 일부를 둘러싸고, 상기 기판과 전기적으로 연결된 생체 신호 감지 전극으로서, 적어도 일부가 상기 하우징의 외부로 노출된 생체 신호 감지 전극을 포함할 수 있다. 그 외에도 다양한 실시예들이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to techniques for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection in analog domain. Proposed methods and apparatus are able to measure an impedance of human body based on sub-Nyquist sampling of signals. The proposed techniques can be particularly beneficial for reducing overall sensor power when an actuation signal generates electrical signals corresponding to vital signs in humans.
assignees: GARUDADRI HARINATH;BAHETI PAWAN K;MAJUMDAR SOMDEB;QUALCOMM INC

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: System and Method for Monitoring Life Signs of a Person
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring a person within a defined area by detecting breathing, or the lack thereof. Breathing is detected using radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals. The radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals are analyzed to determine if the subject person is moving, and if not moving if the person is breathing or not-breathing. An alarm is generated should the reflected radar signals, the camera signals and the microphone signals all simultaneously indicate no movement and no movement of the subject person in the defined area for a selected period of time.

title_en: Time-share rotary scanning detection method for radar vital sign detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for time-share rotary scanning detection method for a radar vital sign detector. The method comprises the following steps of: erecting a radar in the middle of a wall according to a position to be detected and a range to be detected; determining a detection region of the radar according to a wave velocity width phi degree of the radar and a range of the detection region; and after all the regions in the detection range are detected, generating a vital sign distribution planar graph of the whole region on a computer. According to the method, the radar vital sign detector is deflected at a fixed angle by adopting a gradual deflection scanning detection mode, so that the detection direction of the detector can be changed, and vital sign distribution in the whole region or a room can be gradually finished without moving the radar detector. Each deflection angle of the radar is equal to the wave velocity width of the radar, so that problems of region leakage, repeated detection, leakage detection and the like can be solved. The method is simple, reliable and favorable for detection; the result is accurate and reliable; the method is convenient; and furthermore, the vital sign distribution planar graph can be generated.

title_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and rescue method in the cabin of crewman sea
abstract_en: One kind is based on positioning in the cabin of crewman sea, it is positioned in the crewman sea cabin of vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system, vital sign monitors and rescue method, the system comprises command centre's servers, fence transmitter, crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, crewman's Real Time Localizer, carrier-borne personnel positioning processor and persons falling in water locator, this method is by being based on AIS, UWB, the modern information technologies such as big-dipper satellite positioning, develop single crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, carrier-borne and persons falling in water Real Time Localizer and wounded's vital sign are transmitted with location data, realize marine wounded's vital sign monitoring automation, information storage electronization, information transmission network and the wounded give first aid to visualization.

title_en: A kind of life detection robotic equipment based on multi-sensor information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection robotic equipment based on multi-sensor information, the both sides of casing are symmetrically installed with walking mechanism unit, head unit is arranged on casing, with the rotary joint arm for realizing rotary freedom and on rotary joint arm, realize the pitching joint arm of pitch freedom, video load cell is arranged on pitching joint arm, rotated with pitching joint arm pitching and with rotary joint arm, and sound load cell, radar life detection load cell are separately mounted on rotary joint arm, rotated with rotary joint arm；Head unit, video load cell, sound load cell, radar life detection load cell are connected with the control unit in casing respectively, and control unit is connected by the wireless telecommunications on casing with fast leaflet member and rear console.The present invention can replace rescue personnel to enter ruins scene and perform search and rescue task, reduce rescue personnel's injures and deaths, significant to provide survivor's search efficiency.

title_en: A kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration enhancing detection method based on multi-antenna data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respirations based on multi-antenna data fusion to enhance detection method, belongs to bioradar or radar type human life detection field.Technical solution are as follows: firstly, providing the multi-channel information breathed about human body target by multiple antennas ultra-wide spectrum radar system；Secondly, by the original radar return data in each channel by pre-processing and carrying out adaptable Kalman filter fusion after target association；Finally, the human body respiration waveform that output detects.Innovation of the invention is to propose a kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration enhancing detection method, data fusion is carried out by receiving the multi-channel information provided to multiple antennas, it solves feeble respiration caused by human body target orientation and postural change and detects problem, to enhance human body respiration detectivity of the ultra-wide spectrum radar in the application such as detecting through walls, earthquake rescue.

title_en: Two-dimentional through-wall detection target radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses two-dimentional through-wall detection target radar system, impulse radar detection fields；This system uses the impulse of 0-6GHZ, emits impulse signal by single transmitting antenna, penetrates the barriers such as wall, ruins, encounters life entity and is reflected back double time sharing shared receiving antennas again.Tested life entity chest wall movement makes received impulse sequence that Doppler effect occur, as the foundation for judging whether to detect life entity.The collected signal of two receiving antennas is transmitted to FPGA signal control processing unit, calculates through algorithm processing and is detected life entity two-dimensional surface position, then shows on the display unit.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system may include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system may be operable in one or more modes of operation such as, for example: a capacitance measurement mode, an electrical measurement mode, a piezoelectric measurement mode, a temperature measurement mode, an acceleration measurement mode, an impedance measurement mode, and a standby mode. Based on the measurements, the monitoring system may analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and advice to the user, and/or may adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system is also capable of analyzing the sleep of the user without directly contacting or attaching an uncomfortable probe to the user and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional life detector which comprises a control terminal, wherein the control terminal is electrically connected with a detection handle through a connecting wire, the detection handle is fixedly connected with a detector through a flexible wire, the detector comprises a detection shell, a bioelectricity sensor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the detection shell, a vibration sensor is fixedly arranged inside the detection shell and positioned on the right side of the bioelectricity sensor, a lateral optical camera is fixedly arranged inside the detection shell and positioned on the right side of the vibration sensor, a video processor is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the lateral optical camera, and a vertical optical camera extending to the right side of the detection shell is fixedly arranged on the right side of the video processor. According to the multifunctional life detector, the bioelectricity sensor senses an electric field generated by ultralow frequency electric waves emitted by a human body, the vibration sensor identifies sound emitted by trapped persons, the optical camera shoots scenes in the ruins, and the trapped persons in the ruins can be detected to the greatest extent by three detection modes.

title_en: System and method for remotely tracking vital signs with millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring vital signs of a subject. The radar unit includes generating raw data, and the processor unit receives the raw data and identifies an oscillating signal in a series of complex-valued arrays representing radiation reflected from each voxel of the target region during a given time segment. A phase value is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing the phase over time is generated for each voxel. Voxels indicative of the oscillation signal are selected and vital sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: Human vital sign monitoring method oriented to sports scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign monitoring method oriented to a motion scene, which is characterized in that a radar reflected signal reflected by a human body is received, the radar reflected signal and a radar transmitted signal are subjected to frequency mixing treatment to obtain an original intermediate frequency signal, then the original intermediate frequency signal is subjected to Fourier transformation to construct characteristic spectrum data, a sliding window sampling method is adopted for the generated characteristic spectrum map, the characteristic spectrum map is intercepted according to a preset window length and a step length, and the characteristic spectrum map is input into a trained classifier network model to identify a motion state or a non-motion state and a motion type in the motion state. And monitoring the breathing or heartbeat frequency during the exercise time in a non-exercise state. The invention monitors vital sign information of human body by utilizing millimeter wave radar, and has the advantages of low illumination dependency, good privacy protection, high monitoring sensitivity, no contact and the like.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and care system
title_ko: 실시간 모니터링 및 돌봄 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time monitoring and care system. The real-time monitoring and care system includes: a sensor part generating sensing information by sensing the sleep condition and movement of a care target person (an infant, a child, an elderly person, an inpatient or a handicapped person) and whether a door is open; a gateway transmitting the sensing information to a manager terminal connected through an information communication network; and the manager terminal monitoring the sensing information by classifying the same by care target person, while generating relief activity request information when the sensing information is out of a preset reference value. In accordance with the present invention, the system senses one biometric signal among the heart rate, breathing rate, tossing-and-turning, and apnea of the care target person through a sleep tracking pad in real time based on Internet of things (IoT), and senses one motion signal among whether the care target person presses an emergency bell or whether a door is open, while checking an emergency situation, in which the care target person presses the emergency bell, in real time even remotely, and enabling prompt action by situation in an untact manner.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 모니터링 및 돌봄 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 관리대상자(영유아, 어린이, 노약자, 입원환자 또는 장애인)의 수면상태, 움직임 및 도어 개폐 여부를 감지하여 감지정보를 생성하는 센서부; 감지정보들을 정보통신망을 통해 접속된 관리자 단말기로 전송하는 게이트웨이; 및 감지정보를 관리대상자별로 분류하여 모니터링하되, 감지정보가 기 설정된 기준값을 벗어나는 경우 구호활동 요청정보를 생성하는 관리자 단말기를 포함하되, 센서부는 관리대상자의 심박수, 무호흡 여부 및 뒤척임 정도를 계측하여 수치화한 감지정보를 생성하는 수면 추적 패드; 관리대상자의 댁내에 기 설정된 범위마다 설치되어 관리대상자의 움직임을 인식하여 감지정보를 생성하는 모션센서; 및 관리대상자 댁내 문의 손잡이 또는 경첩에 설치되어 도어 개폐 여부에 따른 감지정보를 생성하는 도어센서를 포함한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 사물인터넷(IoT)를 기반으로 실시간으로 수면 추적 패드를 통해 관리대상자의 심박수, 호흡수, 뒤척임 또는 무호흡 중에 어느 하나의 생체신호를 감지하고, 관리대상자의 응급벨 호출 여부 또는 문열림 감지 중에 어느 하나의 모션신호를 감지하되, 감지된 측정 데이터가 비정상이거나, 관리대상자가 응급벨을 호출하는 경우 등 관리대상자의 위급상황을 원격지에서도 실시간 확인이 가능하고, 비대면으로 상황별로 즉각적인 대처가 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Indoor buried-type of ultra-wideband anchor device with downlight function
title_ko: 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 uwb 앵커 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is an indoor embedded ultra-wideband (UWB) anchor device having a downlight lighting function. The present invention comprises: a downlight lighting module installed on a ceiling of a certain space in a building and having an LED radiating downlight lighting light; a UWB anchor module attached to the downlight lighting module and performing UWB communication with a UWB tag; an emergency power supply module for supplying commercial power and emergency power to the downlight lighting module and the UWB anchor module; a fixing plate for fixing and coupling the downlight lighting module and the UWB anchor module in close contact with each other; and a microphone for collecting surrounding voice and sound in real time. According to the indoor embedded UWB anchor device having a downlight lighting function, a ceiling-embedded downlight lighting, and a UWB anchor are attached and installed indoors, and the UWB anchor is configured to perform UWB communication with a UWB tag of a firefighter or a demander, thereby measuring and recognizing a precise position of the firefighter or the demander at a fire scene from the outside.
abstract_ko: 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커 장치가 개시된다. 건물 내 소정 공간의 천정에 설치되며, 다운라이트 조명광을 방사하는 LED를 구비하는 다운라이트 조명 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈에 부착되어 설치되며, UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하는 UWB 앵커 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈 및 상기 UWB 앵커 모듈로 상용 전원 및 비상 전원을 공급하는 비상 전원 공급 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈 및 상기 UWB 앵커 모듈을 서로 밀착하여 고정 결합하는 고정용 플레이트; 주변의 음성 및 소리를 실시간 집음하는 마이크로폰을 구성한다.  상술한 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커 장치에 의하면, 실내에 천장 매립형의 다운라이트 조명과 이에 UWB 앵커를 부착하여 설치하고, UWB앵커가 소방관이나 요구조자의 UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하도록 구성됨으로써, 외부에서도 화재 현장의 소방관이나 요구조자의 정밀한 위치를 측정하여 인지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Node thermal disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a node thermal disaster monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of underground pipeline monitoring, and comprises an underground pipeline, a sensing optical fiber, an electronic marker, a detecting instrument, a temperature measuring host and a display device, wherein the sensing optical fiber is buried underground and fixed on the outer wall of the underground pipeline, the electronic marker is fixed at the right upper end of the underground pipeline, and the detecting instrument is used for detecting the position of the electronic marker on the ground; the sensing optical fiber is connected to the temperature measurement host through the optical cable, and the temperature measurement host is used for demodulating and early warning the temperature signal transmitted by the sensing optical fiber. The utility model discloses a temperature measurement host computer converts the temperature signal of sensing optical fiber into data signal and shows at display device, and the staff utilizes the detection instrument to detect out the concrete position data after the temperature measurement host computer conversion according to data again, then implements the maintenance, in time repairs little leak source, and big incident takes place in effective prevention.
assignees: SHANDONG LAIOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of through-wall radars, in particular to a handheld through-wall radar, which comprises a radar detector, wherein the front surface of the radar detector is provided with a protection groove, the inner side of the protection groove is provided with a handle, the top end of the handle is provided with a side button, the front surface of the handle is provided with a front button, the rear surface of the handle is provided with a supporting leg, the inner wall of the protection groove is provided with a chute, the bottom end of the supporting leg is positioned at the inner side of the chute, the surface of one side of the supporting leg is provided with a clamping groove, the inner side of the clamping groove is provided with a first spring, one side of the first spring is provided with a clamping block, the inner wall of the chute is provided with a limiting groove, and the inner side of the limiting groove is provided with a pushing block; through having set up the handle, with side button and positive button setting at the handle surface, can both hands hold and control radar detector under the state, improve stability and portability greatly, can release the locking to the supporting legs through promoting the ejector pad, make the supporting legs take the handle to take in the protection groove inboard, conveniently accomodate and carry.
assignees: SUZHOU RED POLICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life detection radar system and method based on random code modulated sinusoid signal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection radar system and methods based on random code modulated sinusoid signal, including radar host computer and handheld terminal, the radar host computer includes power module, central processing unit, transmitting unit, receiving unit, transmitting antenna, receiving antenna and communication unit, life detection order is sent from the handheld terminal to radar host computer, system generates random code modulated sinusoid signal after receiving order, emitted after power amplifier amplifies by transmitting antenna, life detection is carried out to target area, the echo-signal that receiving antenna receives is demodulated after low noise amplifier amplifies by quadrature demodulator, data acquisition module is acquired the signal after demodulation, then it exports to central processing unit and carries out the extraction of life-information and location information, and it will analyze and determine that result is transmitted to handheld terminal and shows.Random code signal is introduced into traditional Doppler's life detection radar by this system, is quick on the draw, high resolution, strong antijamming capability.

title_en: Dynamic and static human body target self-adaptive detection method and system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a medium, equipment and a system for adaptively detecting moving and static human body targets based on a through-wall radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first echo data information and second echo data information, and generating a first baseband signal corresponding to the first echo data information and a second baseband signal corresponding to the second echo data information; performing distance-to-Fourier transform and Doppler-to-Fourier transform on each set of first baseband data and each set of second baseband data to generate first frequency domain data and second frequency domain data; judging whether a moving human body target exists according to a first preset self-adaptive threshold value, and calculating the first target distance delay; judging whether a static human body target exists according to a second preset self-adaptive threshold value, and calculating a second target distance delay; calculating the position information of a moving human body target and the position information of a static human body target; the interference of the moving target to the detection of the static target in the detection process can be effectively inhibited, and the accuracy of the detection of the moving and static human targets is improved.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Vehicle-mounted life body monitoring and alarming method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted vital body monitoring and alarming method, a system, a storage medium and equipment, wherein the vehicle-mounted vital body monitoring and alarming method comprises the steps of obtaining a vehicle power-off instruction, detecting according to an echo signal received by a millimeter wave radar when a vehicle is detected to be in a closed state, collecting detection results for multiple times at preset intervals, continuously collecting the detection results in a first time period when the ratio of the detection results with vital sign signals in the preset interval reaches a first preset ratio, wherein the first time period comprises a plurality of preset intervals, and judging whether the ratio of the detection results with vital sign signals reaches the first preset ratio or not in the first time period; if yes, determining that the life exists in the vehicle, and triggering an alarm mode. According to the vehicle-mounted life monitoring and alarming method, system, storage medium and device, the accuracy of life detection in a vehicle is improved by periodically detecting and judging the echo signals received by the millimeter wave radar in a first time period.

title_en: Non-contact type vital signal monitoring millimeter wave radar system with mechanical rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type vital signal monitoring millimeter wave radar system with mechanical rotation, and belongs to the technical field of electronic information. The system comprises a computer, a millimeter wave radar, an antenna module, a two-phase four-wire stepping motor, a control chip, a transformer and a driver, and is based on the FMCW and millimeter wave radar technology at the same time. The system is provided with the mechanical rotating device, so that the automatic detection without dead angles in all directions on a plane can be realized, the detection area is enlarged, the safety and the convenience are greatly improved, vital sign monitoring can be carried out on different people in real time and conveniently, and the waste of human resources is reduced; the method provides an alternative scheme for the construction of vital signal monitoring, traffic, security inspection and monitoring of special crowds.

title_en: Improved method of magneto-electric dipole antenna and application system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improvement method of a magneto-electric dipole antenna and an application system thereof, which relate to the technical field of medical vital sign detection, and comprise the improvement of a medium, the improvement of a patch and the improvement of a magnetic dipole, and the application of non-contact non-line-of-sight internal human health detection. The improved method of the magnetic electric dipole antenna and the application system thereof aim at the traditional magnetic electric dipole antenna, and the cost is greatly reduced by using a multilayer PCB technology; based on three improvements of magnetic dipoles, media and patches, the size of the antenna is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the gain and the higher performance of the directivity pattern are maintained, and meanwhile, the antenna is particularly suitable for a miniaturized radar detection system.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH;TANGSHAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Communication security and protection integrated routing system, method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a communication security protection integration routing system, a method, equipment and a storage medium suitable for under fire scene, comprising the following steps: the fire scene far-end MCU selects a target area to be detected according to the SSID provided by the WiFi routing module carrying the fire scene near-end MCU, and connects the fire scene far-end MCU with the SSID of the selected target area in a 5GHzWiFi frequency band; the WiFi routing module collects the CSI data and uploads the CSI data to the communication cloud module; the Tencel cloud module sends the CSI data to an edge computing power PC end, human existence state judgment is carried out through filtering processing of the edge computing power PC end and by utilizing a sliding window function algorithm, and a judgment result is fed back to the mobile end APP module. According to the method, information feedback is provided for the physical layer characteristics of the disturbance of the WiFi 5GHz electromagnetic wave by utilizing the human body activity, so that the human body existence state monitoring function in the fire scene is realized, and whether the human body vital signs to be rescued exist in the fire scene is rapidly judged by a firefighter.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar-audio frequency identification combined detection underground water supply pipeline and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground penetrating radar-audio frequency identification combined detection underground water supply pipeline and a construction method thereof, mainly relating to a three-dimensional model experimental device for detecting leakage of the ground penetrating radar pipeline, a quick pressing-in anti-floating sinking technology for a sound listening pipe of a high-underground water level deep buried pipeline of a hand propelled geological radar guiding limit running device, a non-excavation side grouting plugging model experimental device for leakage of the underground pipeline, a pressing-in type small steel plate box enclosure excavation technology for a soft soil geological shallow buried pipeline, and mainly comprising a flattening roller, an openable bottom plate, a pipeline support, a geological radar, a sound listening rod, a sound listening instrument, a sensor, a steel plate box and the like. The ground penetrating radar-audio frequency identification combination detection underground water supply pipeline and the construction method thereof improve the safety and efficiency of underground water supply pipeline restoration and reduce adverse effects on the surrounding environment.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIANGRUN TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG SHIRUN JIANCHUANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar multipath ringing suppression imaging method and system based on deconvolution processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for suppressing multipath ringing of a through-wall radar based on deconvolution processing, which relate to the technical field of imaging and comprise the steps of obtaining a single frame echo of the through-wall radar, obtaining the amplitude and the reflection time delay of multiple reflection echoes of a wall, and estimating basic parameters of the wall; filtering direct coupled waves in single-frame echoes, performing distance fast Fourier transform on the processed single-frame echoes to obtain distance frequency domain data, calculating to obtain a frequency domain expression of a kernel function for multipath ringing suppression processing according to estimated basic parameters of a wall body, performing deconvolution operation on the frequency domain expression of the kernel function and the distance frequency domain data to obtain distance frequency domain data for multipath ringing clutter suppression, performing inverse Fourier transform on the distance frequency domain data to obtain single-frame echoes for multipath ringing clutter suppression, and imaging by adopting a plurality of single-frame echoes for multipath ringing clutter suppression to obtain a through-wall radar target image. The invention can improve the overall detection performance of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Heartbeat and respiration detection device and heartbeat and respiration detection program
abstract_en: To improve fastness, reduce an effect of disturbance, isolate heartbeat and respiration, prevent multiple counts, and expand a detection range while also making it possible to reduce a burden on nurses and reduce a risk of infection when the heart rate and the respiration rate are calculated on the basis of a radar signal (optionally including an ultrasonic signal) that is reflected off a body surface.SOLUTION: According to the present disclosure, heartbeat detection is performed by extracting a frequency component produced by heartbeat micro-vibrations over a prescribed heartbeat observation time window, extracting amplitude peaks from the frequency component produced by the heartbeat micro-vibrations, and extracting one characteristic micro-vibration from a plurality of characteristic micro-vibrations for one heartbeat. On the other hand, respiration detection is performed by extracting positive and negative frequency components produced by heartbeat micro-vibrations, performing complex multiplication of the positive and negative frequency components, and removing a heartbeat phase change produced by the heartbeat micro-vibrations from the positive and negative frequency components of which the complex multiplication was performed to extract a respiration phase change produced by respiration micro-vibrations.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Algorithmic Approach for Estimation of Respiration and Heart Rates
abstract_en: One or more aspects of the disclosure relate to monitoring a resting subject's respiration and heart rate through an impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) radar in a noninvasive fashion, in order to infer the corresponding health status including heart rate and respiration rate. Any other reflectance technology may be used. These two cardiopulmonary vital signs are derived based on the processing of recorded waveforms that are collected by the IR-UWB radar or any other reflectance technology system, after getting reflected-off the resting subject's body or relevant body part. A novel algorithm that processes the recorded waveforms is proposed to extract these vitals' signals and, accordingly, estimate their rates. This algorithm includes at least three major stages: i) noise reduction, ii) respiration rate estimation, and iii) heart rate estimation. Furthermore, the algorithm addresses the effects of harmonics and intermodulation between the breathing and heartbeat signals without requiring the implementation of filters.

title_en: Treating pathogenic infections
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range and bacterial or viral infection are targeted for death. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of an antibiotic and an antiviral. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: Radar heartbeat signal detection based on prt model shaping
abstract_en: In radar heartbeat signal detection based on PRT model shaping, a vital-sign signal including a heartbeat component and a respiration component is detected by a radar and sent to a computing device which is electrically connected to the radar, the computing device extracts the heartbeat component from the vital-sign signal to obtain a radar heartbeat signal and segments the radar heartbeat signal into two or more one-cycle radar heartbeat signals, and the computing device multiply each of the one-cycle radar heartbeat signal with a PRT model and connects the one-cycle radar heartbeat signals as a shaped radar heartbeat signal.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted ultra-wideband radar systems and methods
abstract_en: Vehicle-mounted UWB systems and/or methods for detecting mines and other explosive devices are provided. In certain exemplary embodiments, a system for detecting non-buried mines and/or improvised explosive devices is provided. Distance measuring equipment may be configured to track movement of the system. Substantially forward-looking bistatic antenna transceivers may be capable of collecting range-magnitude radar data over two channels. A first transceiver may capture radar data for a first area, and a second transceiver may capture radar data for a second area. A processor may be configured to: derive range resolution data and cross-range resolution data from the range-magnitude radar data; focus the range resolution data and the cross-range resolution data, based at least on the distance data and an antenna beamwidth pattern associated with the antenna transceivers; and, “and” data for portions of the first area and the second area that overlap.

title_en: The collection of disaster field information intelligent is equipped
abstract_en: The invention discloses disaster field information intelligent collection equipment, communication module, temperature and pressure transmitter, jogging sensor, RFID reading apparatus, gyroscope, vital signs detecting device etc. are installed additional by design, it is made also to have individual soldier location, radio communication, motion state detection, air respiratorresuscitator pressure monitoring in building, several large innovative functions such as external environment (temperature, pressure) detection, vital sign monitoring, every detected parameters energy real-time Transmission is to floor manager Succor plain stage.The present invention is rational in infrastructure, improves fire-fighting, rescue efficiency, drops to minimum, sublimation of life security assurance level by life, property loss.

title_en: High-resolution through-wall imaging system and method based on random antenna array and microwave relevance imaging principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high-resolution through-wall imaging system and method based on random antenna array and microwave relevance imaging principle.Use using the equal aerial array of equidistantly arrangement and ranks number as emitting portion, the opening and closing random by each array-element antenna carries out stochastical sampling to single signal source, project and be imaged region, formed to have and be similar to counterfeit thermal light source space-time stochastic volatility and the microwave field of statistical independence, by once detecting acquisition high-resolution imaging result, simplify design and the manufacture difficulty of microwave relevance imaging system, reduce cost, the stability of raising system and interference free performance, the large-scale application for microwave relevance imaging creates condition with universal.Formation method can obtain the high-definition picture of indoor objects and the room area blocked by body of wall, and the signal attenuation effect that brings body of wall is insensitive, there is strong noise robustness, improve disguise and the battlefield survivability of operating personnel of detection device, there is huge using value.

title_en: Wall parameter estimation method of through-wall imaging radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall parameter estimation method of a through-wall imaging radar. The wall parameter estimation method includes steps of (1) estimating the variation range of the relative dielectric constant and the thickness of the wall, and selecting the minimum value as initial parameter value; (2) calculating the distance between the radar and the wall, and setting an imaging area behind the wall; (3) compensating the effect of the wall in imaging by parameters obtained in the step (1) to obtain aperture range data; (4) calculating GCF value of each imaging point along the aperture range data; (5) searching the maximum value of the GCF values of all imaging points as a target GCF value; (6) sequentially increasing the relative dielectric constant and the thickness of the wall sequentially and repeating the above steps to obtain a target GCF value for each pair of wall parameters; (7) searching the maximum value in all the target GCF values and using the corresponding wall parameters as estimation results. The wall parameter estimation method has the advantages that wall parameters are accurately estimated, the effects of the wall in the through-wall imaging can be effectively compensated, and focusing effect of target imaging is improved.

title_en: Sleep sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of firstly presetting acquisition parameters of the millimeter wave radar, transmitting signals by the millimeter wave radar, capturing reflected signals by a receiving antenna, obtaining intermediate frequency digital signals after sampling, and sending sampling results to back-end computing equipment; and identifying the sleeping posture of the user by utilizing the point cloud characteristics and the breathing characteristics obtained after the characteristic extraction. Then, effective reflection points are extracted, and the breathing frequency is accurately estimated by a weighted average method by using the reflection points. The invention aims to realize an accurate and reliable vital sign monitoring system by using low-cost and easy-to-deploy commercial millimeter wave radar equipment, stably identify 6 sleep postures and accurately measure respiratory rate, acquire rich and stable point cloud information, enhance the characterization of the point cloud on the sleep postures and acquire more accurate respiratory rate estimation results.

title_en: Fire extinguisher identification device of a road tunnel using RF communication
title_ko: 알에프 통신을 이용한 도로 터널 소화장치 식별장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher identification device of a road tunnel using RF communication, which is for a road tunnel fire extinguisher including a fire extinguisher box (40) and comprises an installation space recess (33), a smoke and fire sensor (31a), a smoke penetrating LED lighting box (10), a lighting box protection frame (20), and a remote manager terminal (60). According to the present invention, a fire in a tunnel can be easily identified by a plurality of smoke and fire sensors installed on the wall of the tunnel, a nearby fire extinguisher box accommodating a fire extinguisher can be easily found by upper and side smoke penetrating LEDs even if smoke and various noises are generated in the event of a fire in the tunnel, and a door of the fire extinguisher box accommodating the fire extinguisher is automatically opened, so that a user near the fire extinguisher box can easily and quickly take out the fire extinguisher from the fire extinguisher box and quickly extinguish the fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널(30) 내 보행로(32) 상측 벽면(31)에 설치되어 작동시 터널(30) 내 화재를 시청각수단으로 알리는 비상벨스위치(41)와 경광등(42)을 갖고 도어(44)에 의해 개폐되는 내부 공간에는 소화기(43)를 포함하는 소방관련 설비들이 구비되는 소화전함(40)을 포함하는 도로 터널 소화장치에 있어서, 상기 소화전함(40)이 설치된 직하부 보행로(32) 일정길이가 절개되어 분리되면서 도로(50)와 동일평면을 이루게 형성되는 설치공간요부(33); 상기 연기투시엘이디조명박스(10) 투명조명커버(17)의 상면커버(17a) 상측에 수평으로 위치되어 상면이 보행로(32) 상면과 동일 평면을 이루고 우측단은 터널(30) 벽면(31)과 밀착되며 좌우측 일정간격으로 다수개 통공(21aa)이 형성되는 수평지지대(21a)를 갖고 수평지지대(21a) 좌측단에서 도로(50)측으로 연장되어 선단이 도로(50)와 밀착되되 좌측면이 보행로(32) 최측면과 동일 평면을 이루는 외측지지대(21b)를 갖는 횡방향지지프레임(21)이 길이방향으로 일정간격 다수개 형성되고, 다수개 횡방향지지프레임(21) 우측단을 길이방향으로 고정지지하고 일정간격 상부로 수직돌출되어 터널(30) 벽면(31)에 앵커볼트(22c)에 의해 고정되는 볼트공(22b)이 통공형성된 고정바(22a)를 갖는 우측단지지프레임(22)이 형성되며, 다수개 횡방향지지프레임(21) 좌측단을 길이방향으로 고정지지하는 좌측단지지프레임(23)이 형성되며, 다수개 횡방향지지프레임(21) 수평지지대(21a)의 통공(21aa)을 길이방향으로 연결지지하는 봉체인 종방향상단지지봉(24)을 갖는 조명박스보호프레임(20); 상기 소화전함(40)의 도어(44)는, 우측단부 중심에 회동축(44a)이 형성되고, 우측단 외측면은 평면이 원형으로 랙기어부(44b)가 형성되며, 랙기어부(44b)에는 내측에 설치되어 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되고 화재시 도어(44)를 개방시키는 정역회전모터(44c)의 피니언기어부(44ca)가 기어결합되고, 좌측단부 내측면에는 선단부에 상하로 잠금공(44da)이 통공형성된 잠금바(44d)가 돌출형성되며, 소화전함(40) 내측면에는 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되어 잠금바(44d)가 단속장공(45c)을 통해 삽입되고 삽입된 잠금바(44d)의 잠금공(44da)에 솔레노이드(45a)의 단속바(45b)가 삽입되어 화재시 솔레노이드(45a)의 단속바(45b)가 잠금바(44d)의 잠금공(44da)에서 분리되는 솔레노이드도어괘정장치(45)가 형성되고, 소화전함(40) 내부 상면에는 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되어 회재시 점등되는 조명등(46)이 형성되며; 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되는 원격의 관리자단말기(60)를 구비하는 알에프 통신을 이용한 도로 터널 소화장치 식별장치에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은 터널 벽면에 설치된 다수개 연기및화재감지센서에 의해 손쉽게 터널내 화재를 인식할 수 있고 터널 내 화재시 연기와 각종 소음이 발생하더라도 소화기가 수납된 인근의 소화전함을 연기투시상부엘이디와 연기투시측부엘이디에 의해 손쉽게 찾을 수 있으며 이때 자동으로 소화기가 수납된 소화전함의 도어가 자동으로 오픈됨에 따라 소화전함 인근의 사용자가 소화전함에서 손쉽고 신속하게 소화기를 꺼내 신속히 화재를 진압할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Precast concrete steel mesh frame presss from both sides core curtain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a precast concrete steel mesh frame presss from both sides core curtain, the structure is assembled to the adoption slat, the slat includes the window upper plate, board between window hypoplastron and window, the inter -plate sets up the vertical deformation seam under a window board and window upper plate and/or the window, in the slat is equipped with, outside concrete layer and middle heat preservation, be equipped with the plane wire net among the concrete layer separately, through a plurality of obliquely inserted steel wire welded connection between the wire net of plane, the anchor has the pre -buried subassembly of connected node of four rectangular arrays and the pre -buried subassembly of supporting node that two lie in same height among the inboard concrete layer, the edge is equipped with towards the bellied vertical limit rib of heat preservation about inboard concrete layer, the left and right sides two is listed as the pre -buried subassembly of connected node and is arranged in the vertical limit of left and right sides rib respectively, the interval is equipped with the limit rib steel muscle of many vertical extensions in the rib of vertical limit. The utility model discloses a development of steel construction building provides the curtain system of supporting light, heat preservation, thermal -insulated, fire prevention, structure integration, simple to operate, and it is effectual to combat earthquake.
assignees: ARCH DESIGN AND RES INST OF TSINGHUA UNIV CO LTD;BEIJING HUAMEIKEBO TECH DEV CO LTD;ZHONGQINGDA (BEIJING) CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of robot for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of robots for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety, safety detection device and safety device for life-saving including crawler type walking mechanism and for coal mine tunnel, be provided on the crawler type walking mechanism for install safety detection device and safety device for life-saving from steady holder；The safety detection device includes the sensor module for being sealingly disposed in rear in crawler type walking mechanism, and the sensor module includes infrared thermography and gas detector；The safety device for life-saving includes the life-detection instrument of sealed set and is operated in the wireless tranceiver communication system of ultrashort wave frequency band.The working efficiency that robot provided by the utility model for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety improves gas in coal mine tunnel, the security risk of electric wiring is investigated, when solving coal mine tunnel generation cave-in accident, it is excessive because searching and rescuing range to being buried survivor's search-and-rescue work, it searches and rescues team member and searches and rescues that direction is indefinite to cause to search and rescue the problem of being wasted time.

title_en: Deep buried pipe detection device based on ultra wide band radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep hidden pipe detection device based on ultra wide band radar technique, include the frame and fix the detection instrument body on the frame, the one end of frame is equipped with two bracing pieces, the both ends of two bracing pieces fixedly connected with handle and connecting axle respectively. The utility model discloses in, detecting device is provided with the frame, be provided with detection instrument body and bracing piece on the frame, be provided with handle and connecting axle on the bracing piece, be provided with the casing on the connecting axle, the inside of casing is provided with the ratchet, pawl and elastic component, the pawl bottom is provided with the footboard, the ratchet blocks through the pawl during use, make the bracing piece fix on different positions, make things convenient for the height of different users regulation handle, simultaneously through pressing down the footboard, drive the pawl and break away from the ratchet, the contrarotation bracing piece makes its top that is located the detection instrument body again, thereby save device's space, convenient transportation.
assignees: TR GEOPHYSICS TECH WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: Testing device for seepage characteristics of strong-medium silicious slate joint fracture compact zone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a testing arrangement that is used for strong-siliceous slate joint crack intensive district seepage flow characteristic of apoplexy belongs to geological disasters prevention and cure technical field. This testing arrangement includes the test box, strutting arrangement, data acquisition device and rainfall analogue means, the test box passes through strutting arrangement and sets up on the base, the inboard bottom level of test box is provided with the porous disk, the porous disk is the rivers cavity with the cavity of test box diapire, the lateral wall bottom of test box is provided with the outlet, the outlet is located the bottom of rivers cavity, the porous disk is gone up to pack has the soil body, data acquisition device's sensor is evenly buried underground in the soil body, rainfall analogue means's shower nozzle setting is directly over the test box. The utility model discloses a testing arrangement can obtain different strong-siliceous slate joint crack intensive district intensive rainfall conditions, seepage process law under the different inclination of apoplexy.

title_en: A kind of multipaths restraint method of multiple target side wall after through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of multipaths restraint method of multiple target side wall being applicable to through-wall radar imaging, extracts all connected domains first with 4 connected domain detection methods from the original radar image of binary；Then connected domain vector is obtained to all connected domains numbering and according to their the average coordinates Euclidean distance ascending sort from radar array center；Then connected domain vector element is reassembled into two subvectors, according to multi-path transmission paths and the direct echo transmission path to radar, the two subvector is extended respectively；Then similarity function is utilized to calculate the similarity matrix of two subvectors；The method finally using similarity thresholding and decision rule judges all elements of similarity matrix, obtains the connected domain at real goal place and multipath decoy is curbed.Multiple target hidden after wall can be detected by the present invention, can effectively be rejected by multipath while retaining target.

title_en: Testing device for simulating seepage failure of dam with upper part defects and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing device for simulating a seepage failure of a dam with upper part defects and a construction method thereof. The testing device comprises a model tank and a dam model arranged in the model tank. An arch simulative ant channel is formed in the upper part of the dam model. A spherical area is arranged near the position, close to the downstream dam slope, of the simulative ant channel of the dam model, and an artificial sprinkler is arranged above the model tank. A plurality of sets of monitoring sensors are buried near the simulative ant channel in the dam model. The construction method of the testing device comprises the steps that firstly, clay is made into a soil sample, an arch thin pipe is buried on the upper part of the dam model, and tamping is conducted after the soil sample is made higher than the thin pipe through filling; and secondly, the portion, on the periphery of the thin pipe, of the soil sample is excavated to be spherical, the excavated portion of the soil sample is backfilled again to make a clay layer in the spherical area become looser towards the thin pipe, the simulative ant channel is generated by pulling out the pre-buried thin pipe after filling is completed, and the multiple sets of monitoring sensors are arranged along the simulative ant channel. The testing device can be used for studying preferential flow effects of the upper part defects of the homogeneous dam and the disaster-causing mechanism inducing the seepage failure of the homogeneous dam.

title_en: Identity recognition method based on pulse ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an identity identification method based on a pulse ultra-wideband radar, belonging to the field of radar signal processing; after a pulse ultra-wideband radar collects radar echo signals of a person to be detected, preprocessing is sequentially carried out, an energy concentration column and an energy concentration area are selected and slide slices are carried out, and variation modal decomposition is carried out on each slice to obtain heartbeat frequency and respiratory frequency information representing vital signs; and forming energy concentration waveforms by the vital sign feature vectors of all the slices, inputting the energy concentration waveforms into an identity recognition neural network, and respectively passing through the attention modules of the encoder and the decoder, the convolutional layer and the full-connection layer to realize identity recognition of the tested personnel. The invention can realize non-contact identity recognition, has no specific requirements on the behavior and the action of the detected person, uses various characteristics of heartbeat, respiration and posture, and has higher robustness.

title_en: Engineering roadway gas coal dust explosion test system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gas coal dust disaster prevention and control, and discloses an engineering roadway gas coal dust explosion test system, which comprises a simulated roadway, wherein the simulated roadway comprises a main roadway and a secondary roadway which are communicated; the main lane comprises a gallery communicated with the auxiliary lane and an inclined lane communicated with the outside; an explosion-proof door and an explosion chamber are arranged at the joint of the gallery and the auxiliary gallery; a plurality of coal dust frames are axially arranged in the upper space of the gallery along the gallery; the two side walls of the middle part of the gallery are buried with a plurality of test boxes communicated with the pipelines, a plurality of sensors are arranged in the test boxes, and cables of power supplies and sensors are laid in the communication pipelines. According to the scheme, the explosion of a real roadway or the coal dust explosion scene caused after the real explosion is simulated, so that the spreading rule and the disaster-causing mechanism of the gas coal dust explosion of the engineering level are effectively researched, and the explosion suppression performance of the roadway can be researched by using explosion suppression equipment, so that theoretical models and bases are provided for reducing or even avoiding the underground coal mine explosion injury, and the safety of the underground coal mine and the gas mine operation is further improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Monitoring method for breathing and heart rate of multiple persons based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method of breathing and heart rate of multiple persons based on millimeter wave radar, comprising the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target area, determining a distance unit where the target is located according to echo signals, estimating an arrival angle according to signals received by different receiving antennas, and determining the target in the area through Gaussian smoothing filtering; determining the phase of the target according to the distance unit, so as to obtain an original signal of the respiratory heartbeat overlapping of the real human target; separating a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal from the original signals overlapped with respiratory heartbeats through a principal component analysis algorithm, and decomposing the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal through a variation mode to obtain a respiratory signal component and a heartbeat signal component; estimating a respiration value and a heart rate value according to the respiration signal component and the heartbeat signal component; the invention provides some important information during vital sign monitoring or discovery.

title_en: Deformable disaster area rescue detection robot
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of robots, and provides a deformable disaster area rescue detection robot, which comprises a robot body and further comprises: a flight control system, a life detection system, and a ground motion control system, the ground motion control system comprising: the four mechanical arms are sequentially provided with a movable joint, a telescopic joint and a rotary joint from inside to outside; the double-shaft steering engine is used for controlling the rotation of the movable joint; the first steering engine is used for controlling the rotation of the telescopic joint; the second steering engine is used for controlling the rotation of the rotary joint; the control main board is used for controlling the steering engine; an ultrasonic sensor; and the buffer mechanism is used for protecting the rotary joint. The invention can be in different motion states for multi-task scenes, can meet the life detection of various complex environments such as caves, ruins, dangerous buildings and the like, has higher environmental adaptability, and improves rescue efficiency; the whole device has reasonable structure, flexible and direct operation and strong practicability.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion-based high-voltage test hall electric shock prevention early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion-based high-voltage test hall electric shock prevention early warning system and method, wherein an electric field dynamic monitoring module is used for acquiring and calibrating electric field data through a distributed three-axis field intensity sensor array and predicting field intensity distribution by combining an ARIMA-GRU hybrid model; the UWB-IMU co-location module adopts TOF-TDOa-aOA algorithm to fuse inertial data to achieve location of testers, the vital sign abnormality detection module is used for monitoring body surface leakage current and physiological parameters, the three-dimensional live-action modeling module is used for constructing dynamic safety boundaries based on laser SLAM, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation decision module is used for dynamically distributing weights and calculating risk indexes through an LSTM-ATT model, and the multistage emergency linkage control module is used for executing hierarchical power-off response. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and dynamic threshold adjustment, quick power-off response and full scene risk management and control are realized, the false alarm rate is reduced, and the electric shock accident of the high-voltage test is effectively prevented.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Vehicle, early warning control method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vehicle, an early warning control method and a device, which can solve the technical problem of failure of emergency response after power failure of the whole vehicle in the related technology, and relates to the field of intelligent cabins. The vehicle comprises a bus, a micro-motion detection device, an environment sensor, a microcontroller MCU, an actuator and an auxiliary power supply device, wherein the microcontroller MCU is connected with the bus, the micro-motion detection device and the environment sensor are connected with the MCU, the actuator is connected with the bus and used for controlling the starting of external ventilation operation and early warning operation according to vital signs detected by monitoring data of the micro-motion detection device and the environment sensor, the auxiliary power supply device comprises auxiliary electric equipment and power supply switching equipment, and when the power supply switching equipment is switched to the auxiliary power supply equipment to be in a working state, the auxiliary power supply equipment provides power supply for the MCU, the actuator, the micro-motion detection device and the environment sensor. Thus, the early warning capability under the extreme scene (such as the power failure of the whole vehicle) is ensured, and the early warning operation is ensured not to be interrupted.

title_en: Hilbert transform-based millimeter wave radar heart rate estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar heart rate estimation method and device based on Hilbert transform, wherein the method utilizes a millimeter wave radar to collect echo data containing human chest wall tiny displacement information, positions chest wall positions and extracts phase information to obtain vital sign signals; and (3) processing the signals by adopting sliding time windows, solving an instantaneous phase in each window through improved Hilbert transformation, calculating candidate heart rate estimated values through slopes of regression fit straight lines on the basis of corresponding relations between time and phases periodically in the window sliding process, and carrying out time sequence constraint on the candidate heart rate values to inhibit isolated abnormal values and non-physiological jumps. The method uses improved Hilbert transformation, overcomes the problem of easy jump at two ends of a window in the conventional method, and combines a heart rate estimation method based on regression fitting and heart rate time sequence constraint to improve the accuracy and stability of heart rate estimation.

title_en: Cognitive workload estimation system using driving performance and physiological data
title_ko: 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용한 운전 중 인지부하 평가장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A cognitive load estimation system using driving performance and a physiological data and a method thereof are provided to allow a driver to safely and conveniently drive by operating a safe driving support system or by appropriately warning according to a cognitive load state of the driver. CONSTITUTION: A cognitive load estimation system(100) using driving performance and a physiological data comprises a lane detecting unit(140), an SDLP calculation unit(110), an SCL calculation unit(120), and a cognitive load determining unit(130). The lane detecting unit calculates a lane position by inputting an image of vehicle surroundings. The SDLP calculation unit calculates a standard deviation value of the lane position which is accumulated for predetermined time about a lane position data transmitted from the lane detecting unit. The SCL calculation unit calculates an average value of skin conductivity of the driver for the predetermined time from a skin conductance sensor mounted on a handle of a vehicle. The cognitive load determining unit estimates a cognitive load state of a driver through the SDLP value and the average value of the skin conductivity. [Reference numerals] (110) SDLP calculation unit; (120) SCL calculation unit; (130) Cognitive load determining unit; (140) Lane detecting unit; (151) HMI module; (152) Display unit; (153) Audio unit; (AA) Bio signal sensor data; (BB) In the absence of an ADAS; (CC) Image; (DD) Lane position data from an ADAS; (EE) Estimated severity of cognitive loads
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용하여 운전자의 운전중 인지부하를 평가하고, 그 평가에 따른 안전 및 예방 조치를 행하는 지능형 자동차 시스템에 과한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은, 상기 차량의 이미지를 입력받아 차선의 위치를 계산하는 차선 검출부와, 상기 차선 검출부로부터 수신된 상기 차선의 위치 데이터에 대해 일정 시간 동안 누적된 SDLP 값을 구하는 SDLP 연산부와, 상기 차량의 스킨 컨덕턴스 센서로부터 일정시간 동안 입력된 상기 차량의 운전자에 대한 피부전도도의 평균값을 구하는 SCL 연산부와, 상기 SDLP값과 피부전도도 평균값을 통해 상기 운전자의 인지부하 상태를 추정하는 인지부하 판단부를 포함하는 인지부하 평가장치 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Healthcare system reflecting IoT and AI service design using data communication-based village broadcasting device
title_ko: 데이터 통신기반 마을방송장치를 이용한 IoT 및 AI서비스 설계반영의 헬스 케어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a healthcare system based on data communication which transmits and receives data between a village broadcasting device and a data communication server and at least one home IoT linking device based on a binary-CDMA communication network. The home IoT linking device comprises: a sensor module which senses biometric signals of a user, risk signals such as gas and fires, and activity signals for managing dying alone of the user; a B-CDMA module which receives a village broadcasting or disaster broadcasting from the village broadcasting device using the binary-CDMA communication network and transmits a message data of the user or the sensing data sensed through the sensor module; and a broadcasting output module which is provided to output the village broadcasting transmitted from the village broadcasting device. Accordingly, the system understands emergencies and accidents occurring each home in real time to rapidly deal with emergencies and accidents of each home.
abstract_ko: Binary-CDMA 통신망을 기반으로 마을방송 장치 및 데이터 통신 서버와 적어도 하나의 홈 IoT 연동 장치 간에 데이터를 송수신하는 데이터 통신 기반 헬스 케어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 홈 IoT 연동 장치는 사용자의 생체 신호, 가스 및 화재 등의 위험 신호, 사용자의 고독사를 관리하기 위한 활동 신호를 감지하는 센서 모듈, 상기 Binary-CDMA 통신망을 이용하여 마을방송 장치로부터 마을방송 또는 재난방송을 수신하고, 사용자의 메시지 데이터 또는 상기 센서 모듈을 통해 감지된 센싱 데이터를 송신하기 위해 마련된 B-CDMA 모듈, 상기 마을방송 장치로부터 전송된 마을방송을 출력하기 위해 마련된 방송 출력 모듈을 포함하며, 각 가정에서 발생하는 위급 상황 및 사고 내용을 실시간으로 파악하여 각 가정의 위급 상황 및 재난사고에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A method and system for monitoring vital signs of an infant
abstract_en: :An infant monitoring system combines an infant soother having a sensor for detecting the location or sucking motion of the soother and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. The vital signs sensor output is interpreted taking account of the sensing of the soother. In this way, it can be prevented that a soother sucking motion is incorrectly interpreted as a different vital signs measurement (such as heart rate or respiration rate) or otherwise corrupts the vital signs measurement.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrostatic field sensor and a security system in interior spaces, which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna ( 1 ). Said probe is connected to an electronic circuit ( 2, 3, 4, 31, 32 ) which is able to decode said changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor, and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field, by means of a processor ( 7 ), enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding said antenna ( 1 ) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Wifi-based human body detection method, and smart device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a Wi-Fi based human body detection method, which includes selecting a sub-carrier data source device by a smart device, acquiring sub-carrier channel frequency responses, checking and filtering out invalid sub-carrier channel frequency responses, obtaining sub-carrier amplitudes, and grouping to obtain a plurality of datasets. Each data set is divided into multiple sub-datasets according to different parts of the sub-carrier channel frequency responses, and then for each sub-dataset, a correlation coefficient between the sub-carrier amplitudes is calculated, to obtain a human body presence detection value; a Mahalanobis distance or a Euclidean distance between the sub-carrier amplitudes is calculated to obtain a human activity detection value; in conjunction of a human activity threshold and a human presence threshold, a state of a human body sign is determined and reported to a cloud server. The present disclosure also includes a smart device for implementing the above method.

title_en: Algorithm and Method to Calculate Trajectory Lengths of Buried Cables
abstract_en: A method of determining the real length of underground cables in a line location receiver having a spatial array of 6 antennas, wherein the antennas can receive and measure a phase coherent low frequency alternating magnetic field emanating from a buried conductor that is energized by a signal generator, wherein the antennas are arranged in 2 sets each comprising sensors on 3 orthogonal axes, includes computing a relative position of a buried conductor that includes both the cable depth and the transverse offset relative to a magnetic axis of the line location receiver, the transverse offset being vector at 90° to the buried conductor trajectory; and determining the real trajectory length of a buried cable from defined start and end positions from the relative positions.

title_en: Through-wall radar wall parameter estimation method without reference to transmitted waveform
abstract_en: A through-wall radar wall parameter estimation method without reference to transmitted waveforms includes obtaining reflection coefficient sequences and transmitted signals from wall echo time domain sampling data by a sparse blind deconvolution method at the same time, accurately estimating time delay differences of reflected waves on the front surface and the rear surface of a wall, constructing a target function based on time delay difference estimated values and time delay difference theoretical values of multiple observation positions, accurately estimating thickness and relative dielectric constant of the wall by minimizing the target function, and accurately estimating conductivity of the wall by comparing amplitude of the reflected waves on the rear surface and the front surface of the wall with amplitude of the reflected waves on the lower wall in a mode of single-base receiving and transmitting. The estimation method is particularly suitable for estimating the wall parameters under the condition of unknown reference emission waveforms, can avoid the problem that the prior information of the reference emission waveforms is needed in the wall parameter estimation process, and not only improves the efficiency of wall parameter estimation, but also improves the accuracy of wall parameter estimation.

title_en: Small micro-motion object detector, method and biological radar sensor for hiding in cabin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation safety detection, and discloses a small micro-motion object detector, a method and a biological radar sensor for cabin hiding, wherein the small micro-motion object detector for cabin hiding is used for collecting vital sign information of small micro-animals, and the number of JC122 biological radar sensors for cabin hiding small micro-motion object detection is 10; the small micro-motion object detector comprises: JC122 biological radar sensor, signal preprocessing and multipath information synthesis module, signal equalization processing module, little micro-motion object vital sign information extraction module, information enhancement module, wireless data transmission module, PDA software intelligent discrimination equipment, adopt the lithium ion battery to supply power. The invention synchronously detects a plurality of pieces at one time, thereby improving the working efficiency; meanwhile, the method can indicate the region of the small micro-animals in the cabin, realize the horizontal omnibearing detection of the 2X 10 meter long-distance vital sign information, and meet the detection and use requirements of various airplanes.

title_en: Fire trapped person positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and discloses a method and a system for positioning trapped fire personnel, wherein the method for positioning trapped fire personnel comprises the following steps of integrating a heart rate sensor, a body temperature sensor and a respiratory rate sensor into portable equipment, collecting vital sign data, sending the vital sign data to a central processing unit through a wireless transmission mechanism, and monitoring and analyzing the vital sign data to obtain the vital sign monitoring data; according to the invention, by integrating sensor data and carrying out real-time analysis, more accurate vital sign state identification and abnormal early warning are realized, the positioning precision of trapped people is further improved by combining the real-time acquisition of acoustic fluctuation and acoustic feature processing, the allocation of rescue resources is optimized by calculating sound source positioning coordinates, and the efficient and targeted rescue strategy and priority allocation can be formulated, so that the rescue efficiency is remarkably improved, the search time and resource waste are reduced, and the survival probability of the trapped people is improved.

title_en: Hybrid FMCW-interferometry radar for positioning and monitoring and methods of using same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for a hybrid radar system that integrates frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) mode and interferometry mode. The radar works as a time division system that continuously switches between the FMCW mode and interferometry mode. The FMCW mode is responsible for absolute range detection and the interferometry mode takes cares of the weak physiological movement monitoring. The respective accuracies in range detection and displacement measurement complements the advantages of the two radar modes, providing versatile performance. By steering the antenna beam, the proposed radar system becomes an ideal solution for indoor health care, human localization, and human-computer interaction. Objects or human targets with or without stationary clutters can be precisely located. At the same time, the targets' vital signs and gestures can be monitored.

title_en: One kind is for vital signs detection device after calamity
