abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind for vital signs detection device after calamity, including equipment box, side inside equipment box is fixedly installed air pump, air pump is connected by one end of tracheae and connecting tube, the two sides on connecting tube top are symmetrically arranged with into object mouth and object out hole, the other end of connecting tube is fixedly connected with one end of infrared heat survey meter, and the other end of infrared heat survey meter is fixedly installed the second video intercom.The utility model passes through air pump, tracheae and the connecting tube being equipped with, convenient for the life such as food or water requirement is put into from connecting tube, air pump is recycled to inflate tracheae, slide to food near trapped person from connecting tube, to provide food and water etc. for trapped person, and infrared heat survey meter and the second video intercom can be fixed in connecting tube, pass through the first video intercom and the second video intercom being equipped with, convenient for carrying out video communication using the first video intercom and the second video intercom after finding trapped person.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Automatic vital sign interconnection monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic vital sign interconnection monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar, which realizes full coverage monitoring of a monitoring area through interconnection of multiple groups of radar data and replaces a mechanical rotating structure, so that the use cost and noise interference are reduced, and the monitoring efficiency and accuracy are improved. The system comprises a communication unit host and at least two vital sign monitoring devices, wherein the at least two vital sign monitoring devices are installed towards an area to be detected, monitoring scanning areas are not overlapped with each other, the vital sign monitoring devices comprise millimeter wave transceiver modules, vital sign recognition modules and communication modules, the communication unit host is connected with the communication modules in a wireless communication mode, monitoring data of the vital sign monitoring devices are received, the at least two vital sign monitoring devices are divided into a host and a slave, vital sign data exist in the host monitoring areas, and the vital sign data do not exist in the slave monitoring areas. The utility model is suitable for the technical field of clinical nursing.
assignees: ZHUHAI PULSE TIME HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Video search and rescue robot and rescue method based on ZigBee wireless locations
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless locations, including ZigBee telegons, the blind nodes of ZigBee and the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms of more than three, the blind nodes of ZigBee are arranged on search and rescue robot, controller, communication module, infrared monitoring module and video surveillance module are also set up on the search and rescue robot, the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms are arranged on the vertex position for the minimum regular polygon for surrounding search and rescue region.The present invention searches life signal by search and rescue robot using pyroelectric infrared sensor, using cradle head camera intake surrounding ambient image and video and be sent to intelligent terminal using the self-built or outside Wi Fi networks of search and rescue robot, the blind node modules of ZigBee are installed on search and rescue robot, coordinate the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms of disaster field peripheral disposition and ZigBee coordinator modules to calculate the real time position coordinate of search and rescue robot and shown on the electronic map for searching and rescuing intelligent terminal, realize to the wounded's search-and-rescue work in disaster ruins.

title_en: Through-wall imaging radar double-fundamental-frequency three-channel time base control circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a through-wall imaging radar double-fundamental-frequency three-channel time base control circuit, which comprises an FPGA (field programmable gate array) time sequence control circuit, a programmable time sequence control circuit, a system clock circuit, a reference clock circuit and three paths of delay pulse output circuits which are arranged in parallel; the FPGA time sequence control circuit is electrically connected with the system clock circuit and is used for outputting initial pulses, delay data, fine tuning data and channel gating signals; the programmable time sequence control circuit comprises an ECL conditioning circuit, a programmable delay chip and a fine tuning DAC chip. The invention realizes high-precision and large-range time delay control of three channels through the time sequence control circuit; the synchronous design of the two base frequency clocks reduces time jitter errors and improves the stability of the pulse signal generation module; the method can set 16-bit delay configuration control words, is flexible in parameter adjustment, can realize ultrahigh delay precision of 2ps, can realize continuous scanning of a maximum 2000ns time window, can simultaneously send three paths of delay pulses or send the delay pulses in a time-sharing manner, and has controllable time interval of time-sharing sending.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGDIAN ZHONGYI INTELLIGENT TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue method, device and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue method based on a radar, which is applied to a fire rescue system, wherein the fire rescue system comprises the radar and a prompting device, the prompting device is used for outputting or forming a corresponding path, and the fire rescue method comprises the following steps: detecting the detection range by using a radar and acquiring an echo signal; extracting vital sign information and a motion trail of a detection target from the echo signal; acquiring the number of detection targets according to the vital sign information of the detection targets; acquiring position information of a radar; planning a first rescue path according to the motion track and the number of the detection targets and the position information of the radar; and controlling the prompting device to prompt the first rescue path. In addition, the invention also provides a fire rescue device and a fire rescue system. According to the technical scheme, fire rescue can be assisted when a fire disaster occurs.

title_en: Intelligent detection device for physical signs of drivers and passengers based on radar fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transportation, and discloses an intelligent detection device for physical signs of drivers and passengers based on radar fusion; the system comprises a power management part, a core control processing part, a 4G communication module part, a GPS positioning module part, a vital sign detection part, a face recognition part and an emotion analysis part, wherein the system is used for dynamically monitoring emotion analysis and vital signs of drivers and passengers in real time based on radar and video fusion technology, establishing a mental health monitoring long model for individual drivers and passengers, particularly people engaged in the driving industry for a long time, monitoring the physical health state and the mental state of the drivers and passengers for a long time, and timely and pertinently providing psychological counseling and timely intervention or post allocation through individual long model curve data; the body state of the driver is dynamically detected in real time through the millimeter wave radar, so that traffic accidents caused by sudden body diseases of the driver can be effectively prevented.
assignees: ANHUI FUHUANG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for measuring living body signal
title_ko: 생체신호 측정 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio-signal measurement system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal measurement system checks the location of a measurement subject; decides the coordinates of a location where the measurement subject has stopped; makes a sensor unit move to the coordinates; enables the sensor unit to detect a displacement corresponding to a bio-signal from the stopped measurement subject; and determines whether an emergency situation has occurred to the measurement subject based on a variation of the displacement.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일실시예의 시스템은, 측정대상자의 위치를 확인하고, 측정대상자가 정지한 위치의 좌표를 결정하여, 상기 좌표로 센서부를 이동하게 하고, 센서부가 정지한 측정대상자로부터 생체신호에 해당하는 변위를 수신하여, 변위의 변화량에 의해 측정대상자의 응급상황을 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Exercise management system based on wearable device
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 기반의 운동 관리 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a wearable device-based exercise management system. According to the present invention, when an exercise device performs short-range communications with smart glasses worn by a user and exercise-related sensor information measured by the exercise device and user′s exercise video photographed by the exercise device are transmitted to the smart glasses, the smart glasses or an exercise management server uses the sensor information to diagnose a current exercise state of the user, correctness of an exercise posture, and the like and display a diagnosis result on the user′s smart glasses as video, thereby enabling the user to effectively perform exercise. Moreover, a body state of the user is diagnosed by using a biological signal measured by a smart band worn by the user to be displayed through the user′s smart glasses and proper measures are taken in an emergency situation, thereby protecting the user from risk caused by excessive exercise. Moreover, when the exercise devices are photographed through a camera of the smart glasses, the smart glasses sequentially designs the exercise devices to be used in accordance with a preset exercise program and displays unknown usage of the exercise devices through the smart glasses in video, thereby enabling the user to effectively perform exercise. According to the present invention, the system comprises the exercise device, the smart band, and the smart glasses.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 디바이스 기반의 운동 관리 시스템을 공개한다. 본 발명은 운동 기구와 사용자가 착용한 스마트 글래스가 상호 근거리 통신을 수행하고, 운동 기구에서 측정한 운동 관련 센서 정보 및 운동 기구에서 촬영한 사용자의 운동 영상을 스마트 글래스로 전송하면, 스마트 글래스 또는 운동 관리 서버가 센서 정보를 이용하여 현재 사용자의 운동 상태 및 운동 자세의 정확성 등을 진단하고, 진단 결과를 사용자의 스마트 글래스에 영상으로 표시함으로써 보다 효과적인 운동을 가능하게 한다. 또한, 본 발명은 사용자가 착용한 스마트 밴드에서 측정한 생체 신호를 이용하여 사용자의 몸 상태를 진단하여 사용자의 스마트 글래스를 통해서 표시하고, 위급 상황에서 적절한 조치를 취하도록 함으로써, 과도한 운동으로 인한 사용자의 위험을 방지할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 스마트 글래스의 카메라를 통해서 운동 기구들을 촬영하면, 스마트 글래스가 사전에 설정된 운동 프로그램에 따라서 운동을 수행할 운동 기구를 순차적으로 표시하여 줄 뿐만 아니라, 사용자가 숙지하지 못한 운동 기구 사용법을 스마트 글래스를 통해서 영상으로 표시하여 줌으로써, 보다 효과적인 운동을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Pet house system with health care based on pet biometric information
title_ko: 반려동물 생체정보 기반의 건강 관리 펫 하우스 시스템
abstract_en: A pet house system is provided that offers real-time health care functions based on the pet's biometric information. The pet house system for health care based on the pet's biometric information according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit equipped with a piezoelectric sensor and a photosensor embedded in the pet house; a processor that processes biometric signals acquired through the piezoelectric sensor, measures heart rate and respiratory rate based on the signal processing results, and estimates the pet's stress by analyzing heart rate variability (HRV) included in the signal processing results; and a urine component testing device that tests the pet's urine components using the photosensor. By doing so, the pet's heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress analysis, sleep state classification, and body water and body fat analysis can be performed, and real-time body temperature detection can be carried out through urine component testing and epidermal temperature measurement, thereby contributing to the health management of the pet.
abstract_ko: 반려동물 생체정보를 기반으로 실시간 건강 관리(health care) 기능을 제공하는 펫 하우스 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 반려동물 생체정보 기반의 건강 관리 펫 하우스 시스템은, 펫 하우스에 내장되는 압전센서(Piezoelectric Sensor) 및 광센서(Photosensor)가 구비되는 센서부; 압전센서를 통해 획득된 생체 신호를 신호처리하고, 신호처리 결과를 기반으로 심박수(Heart rate) 및 호흡수(respiratory rate)를 측정하고, 신호처리 결과에 포함된 심박변이도(HRV)를 분석하여 반려동물의 스트레스를 추정하는 프로세서; 및 광센서를 활용하여 반려동물의 소변 성분을 검사하는 소변 성분 검사 장치;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 반려동물의 심박수, 호흡수 및 스트레스 분석, 수면 상태 분류, 체수분과 체지방을 분석하고, 반려동물의 소변 검사 성분 검사 및 표피온도 측정을 통한 실시간 체온감지를 수행하여 반려동물의 건강관리에 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring patient risk using vital signals acquired in non-contact manner and method thereof
title_ko: 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 방법에 있어서, 생체신호 자동 수집 장치는 환자를 향하여 레이더를 주기적으로 조사하는 단계, 상기 환자로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 이용하여 상기 환자의 심박수와 호흡수를 측정하는 단계, 적외선 체온 측정 센서를 이용하여 상기 환자의 체온을 측정하는 단계, 상기 심박수를 이용하여 상기 환자의 혈압을 추정하는 단계, 상기 심박수와 혈압 값을 이용하여 상기 환자의 심전도(ECG)와 산소포화도(SpO₂)를 추정하는 단계, 그리고 상기 심박수, 호흡수, 혈압, 체온, 심전도 및 산소포화도를 이용하여 상기 환자의 중증질환에 대한 위험도를 예측하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 예측된 위험도가 기준값보다 크면 외부 단말로 알람 신호를 전달하는 단계를 더 포함할 수 있다. 
이와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 비접촉 방식으로 환자의 생체신호를 획득하므로 환자의 불편감을 해소하고, 환자의 상태를 지속적으로 모니터링함으로써 응급 상황을 조기에 감지하여 외부에 알람 신호를 전달할 수 있다.

title_en: Device, system and method for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: In order to provide means for measuring vital signs such as heart rate, breathing rate, pulse forms, that allow accurate and unobtrusive signal acquisition and that are automatically adjusted to varying positions of an area of interest within a predetermined area, a device, a system and a method for measuring vital signs are provided, wherein electromagnetic signals such as microwave or radar are emitted and reflected electromagnetic signals are sensed with directional sensitivity by a transceiving unit and wherein a direction of interest is determined based on the sensed reflected signals and a primary direction of sensitivity (300) of the transceiving unit is adjusted to the direction of interest by a control unit. Thus, vital signs can be monitored in an unobtrusive and simple way.
assignees: PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, sway cancellation, patient identification, and subject monitoring sensors
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or to provide apnea therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.
assignees: DROITCOUR AMY;VERGARA ALEXANDER;SHING TOMMY;EL HOURANI CHARLES;NAKATA ROBERT;MOSTAFANEZHAD ISAR;MIYASATO SCOTT;KAI MEDICAL INC

title_en: Method of electronically mapping underground utility infrastructures from the surface
abstract_en: A non-invasive method of buried-utility-mapping includes using a long wavelength gradiometric ground penetrating radar to “see” patches of conductive material below ground and buried pipes and electrical conductors that are all constantly radio-illuminated by local AM radio broadcasts. The underground infrastructure of entire cities can be surveyed this way, point-by-point over time. A short wavelength part of the gradiometric ground penetrating radar operates shoulder-to-shoulder with the magnetic part and is able to improve shallow object resolution, map moisture build-ups under roads, and spot contaminated soils. Two gradiometric ground penetrating radar technologies, cameras, and navigation receivers can be mounted on city vehicles and a daily collection of their data batch transformed by digital processing algorithms into detailed and automatically updating false-color maps of the underground utilities of the whole city and other buried infrastructures.
assignees: STOLARCZYK GERALD L;STOLARCZYK LARRY G;BAUSOV IGOR

title_en: Ultra-wideband radios for time-of-flight ranging and network position estimation
abstract_en: This invention provides a novel high-accuracy indoor ranging device that uses ultra-wideband (UWB) RF pulsing with low-power and low- cost electronics. A unique of the present invention is that it exploits multiple measurements in time and space for very accurate ranging. The wideband radio signals utilized herein are particularly suited to ranging in harsh RF environments because they allow signal reconstruction in spite of multipath propagation distortion. Furthermore, the ranging and positioning techniques discussed herein directly address many of the known technical challenges encountered in UWB localization regarding synchronization and sampling. In the method developed, noisy, corrupted signals can be recovered by repeating range measurements across a channel, and the distance measurements are combined from many locations surrounding the target in a way that minimizes the range biases associated to indirect flight paths and through-wall propagation delays.
assignees: UNIV CALIFORNIA;HERTZOG CLAUDIA A;DOWLA FARID U;DALLUM GREGORY E;ROMERO CARLOS E

title_en: Methods, computer programs, radar systems, antenna systems and flying platforms for detecting a horizontally buried linear object
Wireless communication with enhanced Maximum Permissible Exposure (MPE) compliance based on vital sign detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflected signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflected signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on these reflected signals, the device may measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain heart rate and/or respiration rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflected signals are indicative of a human vital sign (such as heart rate or respiration). The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether a human vital sign is detected at the target object and transmit an adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Multi-human-body-target vital sign identification method, system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of detecting a region to be detected by using ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo matrix corresponding to the region, filtering static clutter in the radar echo matrix, calculating arrangement entropy values of slow time sequences corresponding to range gates in the radar echo matrix, determining initial range gate regions where human targets are located according to the arrangement entropy values, determining the number of the human targets and the positions of the human targets according to the initial range gate regions where the human targets are located, extracting body surface vibration signals of the human targets from the radar echo matrix with the static clutter filtered according to the positions of the human targets, and identifying the human targets respectively. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the KMeans ++ clustering algorithm and the HOC algorithm are utilized to identify the vital signs of the multiple human targets, so that the identification efficiency, accuracy and intelligent degree are improved, and further, a guarantee is provided for timely and effective rescue.

title_en: Ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system, which comprises seismic sources, seismic source excitation signal detection instruments and ground gravity measurement instruments, wherein the seismic sources are uniformly or non-uniformly distributed on the ground; the seismic source excitation signal detecting instrument is a wired wave detector and a wired seismic data recording instrument which are arranged on the ground, or a wireless node seismic instrument which is arranged on the ground, or an embedded continuous spirally wound armored optical cable and a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing modulation and demodulation system. And (4) acquiring microgravity data point by point along the ground detector line and the ground seismic source line in a high density manner. The buried depth and the velocity distribution of the whole measuring work area from the earth surface to the bedrock surface are obtained through the joint inversion of the first arrival travel time data, the reflected wave and the refracted wave of the ground seismic data and the ground microgravity data, the buried depth and the velocity distribution are used for carrying out accurate and reliable static correction processing on the ground seismic data, and the data after high-quality static correction processing are provided for the subsequent further processing of the ground seismic data.
assignees: CNPC AOBO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Speech-based fire fighting channel monitoring device for property management
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control passageway monitoring device for property management based on pronunciation relates to fire-fighting equipment technical field. The utility model discloses a pre-buried pole, high definition camera, photovoltaic power generation subassembly, control controller and speaker, pre-buried pole bury underground in one side of outdoor fire control passageway, and cantilever bar is installed to upper portion one side of pre-buried pole, and the one end that pre-buried pole was kept away from to the pole of encorbelmenting installs the high definition camera. The utility model discloses a set up speaker and infrared inductor, the speaker passes through the signal receiving and dispatching antenna and is connected with remote control's monitor, can realize long-range propaganda directed to communicate, avoids the fire control through occupied, and infrared inductor can carry out the auto-induction to vehicle in through the fire control passageway, stops when reaching 2 minutes in the fire control passageway when the vehicle, will trigger alarm program and report to the police to the monitor, has solved current technical function singleness, and the monitoring efficiency is low, the big problem of personnel working strength.

title_en: Ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging method. The ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging can be achieved through an oval envelope line moving object boundary imaging algorithm, and an oval envelope line cluster tangent with the target boundary is constructed through the oval envelope line moving object boundary imaging algorithm according to the geometrical relationships between one transmitting antenna and multiple receiving antennas and a target at each moment. An actual equivalent circle of the target boundary at the moment is constructed by selecting three points of the oval envelope line cluster, and actual equivalent circles at adjacent moments are averaged to obtain an average equivalent circle. The same processing is carried out at all moment, the track of the centers of the obtained average equivalent circles can be regarded as the moving track of the target boundary, the imaging point numbers at all moments are integrated and unified through the locus function, the information of the shape of the target boundary can be obtained, and the imaging process can be finished. The ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging method has the advantages of being high in imaging precision and noise immunity and low in complexity.

title_en: Detection method for deeply-buried high-pressure gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a deeply buried high-pressure gas pipeline, which comprises the following steps: according to the result of the earlier stage on-site gas pipeline investigation, two vertical shafts are firstly constructed right above the pipeline in the approximate direction, the vertical shafts are constructed by adopting an inverted well wall method, and the excavation depth is 13.2 m. After the vertical shaft is seen from the bottom, the position of the pipeline is detected by a radar, and then the specific trend and the elevation of the pipeline are detected in a penetration mode. The method solves the problems that the traditional pipeline detection method has large detection error on the deeply buried metal pipeline and cannot position the non-metal pipeline, has the characteristics of high precision, easy operation, quick response and the like, has strong practical value in the accurate detection of the deeply buried pipeline, has wide application prospect, and is worthy of reference and popularization.
assignees: SUBWAY ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Respiration detection using radar
abstract_en: One or more radar sensors may be used to monitor a patient in a variety of different environments and embodiments. In one embodiment, the radar sensor may be used to monitor the patient's breathing, including monitoring tidal volume, chest expansion distance, breathing rate, and the like. In another embodiment, the position of the patient on the patient bed may be monitored, which may be used as feedback for controlling the bladder of the patient bed. Additional embodiments are described herein.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method, device, equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar imaging method, a device, equipment and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a through-wall radar echo signal set acquired by a transmitting-receiving co-located antenna at a plurality of observation position points; preprocessing the through-wall radar echo signal set to remove echo signals of a fixed wall static background in the through-wall radar echo signal set; inputting the preprocessed through-wall radar echo signal set and preset tuning parameters into a preset low-rank sparse optimization algorithm for solving so as to extract an echo signal of a target to be detected; and constructing an image of the target to be detected according to the echo signal of the target to be detected. The invention effectively removes strong reflection of foreign matters such as pipelines or reinforcing steel bars in the wall body, enhances the through-wall radar image of the target behind the wall and improves the imaging quality of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Human motion, heartbeat and respiration monitoring system based on millimeter waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave-based human body motion, heartbeat and respiration monitoring system, which comprises a vital sign detection mechanism, wherein the vital sign detection mechanism is respectively arranged on an installation support in the human body movement range, the installation support is triangular in shape, shock absorption pads are arranged at the corners of the bottom of the installation support, a circular support plate is arranged in the middle of the top end of the installation support, a circular nut is arranged in the middle of the top end of the disc surface of the circular support plate, and a sleeve is arranged in the middle of the top end of the circular nut in a threaded manner, the millimeter wave-based human body motion, heartbeat and respiration monitoring system comprises a vital sign detection mechanism, wherein the vital sign detection mechanism is arranged on the installation support in the human body movement range, the circular nut is arranged in the middle of the disc surface of the circular support plate, and a sleeve is arranged in the middle of the top end of the circular nut in a threaded manner: the method can be conveniently applied to health and activity monitoring radar data and monitoring maps in private places such as hospitals, offices and families for verification and acquisition respectively, and dual privacy safety is provided from the mechanism. Through millimeter wave sign detection case, conveniently make the access with data, combine the convenient speed that will obtain of vital sign radar still to include all motion components. By performing a doppler FFT to perform spectral analysis on the obtained velocity, various components can be resolved.
assignees: HEFENGCHU VOYAGE SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: LFMCW through-wall radar analog domain distance compensation method based on intermediate frequency filter special design
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analog domain distance compensation method based on special design of an intermediate frequency filter. The method utilizes the strong correlation between the LFMCW radar intermediate frequency signal frequency and the target distance, designs a filter with a specific slope of the transition band amplitude-frequency response characteristic, directly pre-compensates the echo signal energy of targets with different distances in an analog signal processing stage, and inhibits the front wall strong echo signal. Through verification of actual measurement experiments, the special design of the intermediate frequency filter can be realized, and the method can successfully compensate the echo energy of targets with different distances to similar levels while effectively inhibiting the strong echo signals of the front wall, so that the detection distance of the LFMCW through-wall radar system can be effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING INST TECHNOLOGY;BEIJING INST OF TECHNOLOGY YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INST JIAXING

title_en: Underground radar device and buried object survey method therefor
abstract_en: To provide an underground radar device and a buried object survey method therefor capable of estimating the reliability of the relative permittivity used for calculating the depth of a buried object, and issuing a warning about poor depth accuracy to a user when the reliability of the relative permittivity is estimated to be low.SOLUTION: An underground radar device comprises a radar unit 21, an underground survey device 22, and a display device 14, radiates an electromagnetic wave EM from a transmitting antenna 23 into the ground, receives a reflected wave RW reflected at a boundary surface between materials having different relative permittivities by means of a receiving antenna 24, and surveys a buried object BO in the ground. A reliability calculation section 29 estimates the reliability of the relative permittivity used for calculating the depth of the buried object on the basis of changes in the road surface condition and the measurement speed of the measurement path. When the reliability is estimated to be low, a display section 14a issues a warning about poor depth accuracy to a user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: System for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of a user. The system for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of a user comprises: a wearable device to sense a biosignal of a user in every predetermined period by using at least one sensor, and transmit sensed information to a server; and the server to monitor the state of the user based on sensor information received from the wearable device, match the surrounding environment of the user to one state group among a plurality of state groups classified in accordance with activity attributes of the user if the change of the biosignal of the user exceeds a threshold, determine a danger level for the surrounding environment based on setting information of the matched state group and the biosignal of the user, and transmit a notification message to a terminal of a protector in accordance with the determined danger level.
abstract_ko: 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하고, 센싱된 정보를 서버로 전송하는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 상기 웨어러블 디바이스로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하되, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 상기 사용자의 주변 환경을 상기 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하고, 상기 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 상기 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 서버를 포함하는, 위험 상황을 판단하고 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: System for monitoring elderly people living alone and method performing the same
title_ko: 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템 및 이를 실행하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 게이트웨이, 레이더 센서 및 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함하는 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템은 게이트웨이로부터 수신된 영상 이미지를 미리 생성된 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델에 적용한 후 상기 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델로부터 추출된 영상 이미지에 대한 독거노인 자세에 따른 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급을 상기 게이트웨이를 통해 상기 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치에 제공하고, 상기 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 관리자 단말에 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 알림 메시지를 제공하는 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 독거노인의 거주지에 설치되며 임펄스 신호를 생성하여 송신 안테나를 통해 방사하고, 상기 방사된 신호에 대한 반사 신호에 따라 생체 신호 값을 생성하여 상기 게이트웨이에 제공하는 레이더 센서, 상기 레이더 센서로부터 생체 신호 값을 수신하면 상기 생체 신호 값에 따라 응급 위험 상황이 발생한 순간의 영상 이미지를 생성하여 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 제공하고, 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버로부터 수신된 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 독거노임 응급 위험 상황 여부를 판단하는 게이트웨이 및 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 등록된 독거노인에 대한 모니터링 결과를 수신하여 저장하는 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for heartbeat detection using radar
title_ko: 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for extracting a heartbeat signal based on radar. According to an embodiment of the present application, the method for extracting a heartbeat signal based on radar comprises the steps of: obtaining a reception signal in which a transmission signal of radar is reflected by a target person; extracting a unit signal having a preset window size from the reception signal; reconstructing a data set by combining a plurality of the unit signals; and extracting a heartbeat signal of the target person using a result of fourier transform using the data set.
abstract_ko: 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 방법은, 레이더의 송신 신호가 대상자에 의해 반사된 수신 신호를 획득하는 단계, 상기 수신 신호로부터 미리 설정된 윈도우 크기를 갖는 단위 신호를 추출하는 단계, 상기 단위 신호를 복수 개 결합하여 데이터 셋을 재구성하는 단계 및 상기 데이터 셋을 이용한 푸리에 변환의 결과를 이용하여 상기 대상자의 심박신호를 추출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KONKUK UNIV HOLDINGS CO LTD;MILLISIGHT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sensor system for explosive detection and removal
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting one of Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs), landmines or other buried explosives, the sensor system is mounted in place of a standard backhoe digging bucket of a backhoe vehicle. The sensor system includes a mounting portion having arc swing points for hanging the sensor system on a backhoe arm, and a holding pin opening for receiving a holding pin when positioned in a mounting position on the backhoe arm; and an electronic sensor wand arm assembly mounted to the mounting portion.

title_en: User interfaces for utility locators
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to user interfaces for enhanced utility locators. Such enhanced utility locators may include a myriad of sensors and other such technologies for determining information regarding the buried or otherwise inaccessible utility line. Such information may be displayed in a myriad of ways to convey relative characteristics among multiple utilities, or to convey relative characteristics of one or more utilities with respect to a locator.

title_en: Chest-based physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures by means of a ground-penetrating radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a plurality of radar signals for a region of ground, determining, based on the radar signals, a 3D point cloud, each point corresponding to one radar detection and being geolocated in space, selecting, from the 3D point cloud, at least one set of points comprising a number of points higher than or equal to a minimum detection threshold allowing a longitudinal structure to be characterized, the points of the set being substantially aligned with one another.
assignees: COMMISSARIAT A L’ENERGIE ATOMIQUE ET AUX ENERGIES ALTERNATIVES

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for detecting human presence in front of a plurality of sensors, such as speaker sensors, and a device with a processor, such as a television. An example method includes varying, during a collection routine, a respective signal strength of one or more of a plurality of transmitters. The example method further includes receiving results of the collection routine in a form of raw data from a plurality of sensors. The example method further includes determining, by at least one processor, a respective geographical position of one or more humans present within a predetermined geographical range of the at least one processor based on the raw data from the plurality of sensors. Subsequently, the example method includes executing an action based on the respective geographical position of the one or more humans.

title_en: Non-contact type vital signal monitoring millimeter wave radar system with mechanical rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type vital signal monitoring millimeter wave radar system with mechanical rotation, and belongs to the technical field of electronic information. The system comprises a computer, a millimeter wave radar, an antenna module, a two-phase four-wire stepping motor, a control chip, a transformer and a driver, and is based on the FMCW and millimeter wave radar technology at the same time. The system is provided with the mechanical rotating device, can realize the omnibearing automatic detection without dead angles on a plane, enlarges the detection area, greatly improves the safety and convenience, can monitor vital signs of different people in real time and conveniently, reduces the waste of manpower resources, and provides an alternative scheme for the vital signal monitoring and the construction of traffic, security inspection and monitoring of special people.

title_en: FMCW-based radar vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method based on an FMCW radar, and the method can realize the vital sign detection by adopting single-channel data of a single receiving antenna, belonging to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection. Firstly, radar intermediate frequency signals are stored as a two-dimensional data matrix, distance information is obtained through Fourier transformation of fast time dimension, after static target clutter interference is filtered through a static target filtering algorithm, the position of a human body is determined, after phase information is extracted from the position of the human body, a periodic signal multiplication algorithm and a heart rate optimizing equation are carried out, and finally, the solution of physical sign information is successfully obtained through an optimizing algorithm. The invention can effectively reduce the interference of the limb movement of the human body without the need of the test personnel to keep the whole-course static state, and realize the vital sign detection under different body states.

title_en: Wireless passive rfid stress sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless passive RFID stress sensor. On the premise of not damaging the mechanics structure of a wire rope or a steel bar, stress data inside material are obtained through force direction changing measuring. Through an RFID wireless technology, the data are transmitted out in real time, an additional power source does not need to be provided by the adoption of a passive technology, the problem that the power supply of traditional equipment is difficult is solved, and efficient deployment can be convenient to perform. The wireless passive RFID is mainly used for a railway, a highway, a bridge, a viaduct and others. The stress sensor is buried into a large concrete beam body, the load capacity of the beam body can be measured in real time, multiple strut beam bodies can form the internet of things, and the dangerous beam bodies can be predicated. When stress data of the strut beam bodies fluctuate up and down abnormally in one region, it shows that the risk of earthquake occurring possibly exists in the region. Bridge type clamps (1), the wire rope (2), a boss (3), a steel body (4), a stress piece (5), bridge type clamp screws (6), a plastic support (7), a PCB (8) and a plastic cover (9) are arranged as the drawing.

title_en: RF coil with integrated vital signs detector
abstract_en: It is an object of the present invention to provide a Radio Frequency (RF) transmit-receive coil (1) for a Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging system with an integrated vital signs detector (3) for detecting vital signs of a patient within the Magnetic Resonance (MR), wherein a contact sensor directly connected to the body of the patient is replaced by a contactless system for monitoring vital signs, which makes it easier to measure vital signs of the patient. This object is achieved by an RF transmit-receive coil (1) comprising a vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is integrated in the RF transmit-receive coil (1), wherein a pair of electrically conductive coil elements (4) of the RF transmit-receive coil (1) forms the vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is a capacitive vital signs detector (3), the capacitive vital signs detector (3) being adapted to receive a capacitive vital signs signal. The invention further relates to a system for detecting vital signs of a patient within a Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging system, to a method system for operating a system for detecting vital signs of a patient within a Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging system, to a software package for a Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging system and to a software package for upgrading a Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging system.

title_en: Permanent scattering point device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a permanent scattering point device, which is characterized in that: comprises a main body part, a movable part and a corner reflector part; the corner reflector part is fixed at the upper end of the main body part; the movable part is positioned at the lower end of the main body part; the main body part comprises a hollow tube and a sensor module; the sliding part comprises a sliding rod and a fin assembly, and the fin assembly is arranged at the lower end of the sliding rod; the slide rod is slidably inserted into a hollow tube of the main body portion, and the sensor module is disposed in the hollow tube to detect a vertical movement of the slide rod within the hollow tube. The device for settling permanent scattering points is inserted into the ground of a place to be detected and buried. When landslide occurs, the sensor module can send detected signals to an external communication device, so that the measurement precision of the ground-based synthetic aperture radar system is improved as auxiliary data, and false alarm is reduced.
assignees: SICHUAN DIGITAL TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;HAWKEYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life detection radar fire environment operation performance research test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection radar fire environment operation performance research test device, and relates to the technical field of life detection radar operation performance research. The device comprises a flue and a combustion chamber; the first end of the smoke inlet channel is connected with the combustion chamber, the second end of the smoke inlet channel is connected with the flue, and the cavity channel, the storage bin and the smoke inlet channel of the flue are communicated; the radar signal transceiver is positioned outside the first end wall of the flue; the radar signal reflector is connected to the second end wall of the flue; the smoke environment parameter monitoring and adjusting assembly is arranged in the flue and is suitable for adjusting smoke parameters in the cavity so as to accord with a preset value. The life detection radar fire environment operation performance research test device can accurately simulate the smoke environment under the condition of fire, provides a test platform for researching the operation performance of the life detection radar under the fire environment, and ensures the feasibility of quantitative evaluation of the operation efficiency under the fire environment of the life detection radar.

title_en: Sand shallow-buried garbage detection method and system based on intelligent trolley and IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The application provides a sand shallow garbage detection method and system based on an intelligent trolley and an IR-UWB radar, comprising the following steps: step S1: detecting sand by using an IR-UWB radar carried by the intelligent trolley, and collecting radar data which can be used for detecting and positioning garbage; step S2: preprocessing collected radar data which can be used for garbage detection and positioning; step S3: based on the preprocessed radar data, utilizing an improved algorithm based on Canny edge detection to adaptively detect edge features corresponding to a plurality of garbage; step S4: extracting garbage features of the corresponding region and constructing the garbage features as feature vectors; step S5: garbage and noise are distinguished based on the constructed feature vector.

title_en: Detection method, detection equipment and detection system for vital signs of pets
abstract_en: The specification provides a detection method, detection equipment and detection system for vital signs of pets. The method comprises the steps of controlling a millimeter wave radar module to send millimeter wave radar signals to a region to be detected, receiving millimeter wave radar echo signals returned by the region to be detected, enabling a target pet to move in the region to be detected, determining position information of the target pet in a first time window based on the millimeter wave radar echo signals in the first time window, determining activity conditions of the target pet in a second time window based on a plurality of position information of the target pet in the second time window, wherein the activity conditions comprise an activity state and a resting state, the second time window comprises a plurality of first time windows, and determining vital sign parameters of the target pet in the second time window if the target pet is in the resting state in the second time window. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the specification, the automatic detection of vital signs of the pets can be realized under the conditions of no contact and no wearing.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUAYI MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for detecting static human body target based on FMCW through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting a static human body target based on an FMCW through-wall radar, belonging to the technical field of human body target detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an echo signal of an FMCW radar, mixing to obtain an intermediate frequency signal, and sampling the intermediate frequency signal to obtain a two-dimensional signal matrix; performing a row distance dimension FFT on the two-dimensional signal matrix to obtain a distance-slow time image; extracting phase information of all static targets according to the distance-slow time image, and respectively calculating the peak intervals of autocorrelation functions of the phase information; and estimating the signal frequency of each stationary target according to the peak value interval of the autocorrelation function, and eliminating stationary targets with signal frequency not in the human respiratory frequency range to obtain stationary human targets. The invention can distinguish the static human body target and other interference signals by judging whether the signal frequency of the static target is in the frequency range of the human body respiratory signal, thereby effectively reducing the false alarm probability.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign recognition and detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign recognition detection system, which relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and comprises a time-sharing echo acquisition module, a phase processing module, a vital sign separation module, a respiratory event judgment module, a radar dynamic scheduling module and a power compensation module, wherein the time-sharing echo acquisition module acquires echo signals and constructs an original data matrix, the phase processing module performs background subtraction and phase extraction processing on the original data matrix and calculates phase signals, the vital sign separation module processes the phase signals to generate respiratory waveforms, the respiratory event judgment module converts the respiratory waveforms into physical displacement waveforms and judges and generates an apnea early warning signal, the radar dynamic scheduling module generates radar switching instructions according to the calculated target positions, and the power compensation module acquires signal quality parameters and generates power adjustment instructions. According to the invention, through the cooperation of double radars and dynamic scheduling, the continuous monitoring of the whole domain without blind areas is realized, and the advanced signal processing method is utilized, so that the obstacle can be penetrated, the respiration heartbeat can be accurately separated, and the high precision is ensured, and meanwhile, the low power consumption and the high environmental adaptability are realized.
assignees: BAOJI WEIXI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Waistband with health management function
title_ko: 건강관리 기능을 가진 혁대
abstract_en: A belt having the health care function is provided to make the efficient management of the extracted health information possible. A belt having health care function comprises: a health information derivation module drawing the health related information from all kinds of the bio-signals; a buckle(13) performing the housing function of the derivation module; and a band(10) connected to one end of the buckle. The health information derivation module(14) comprises: a sensor module which senses all kinds of the bio-signals; and a processing extracting unit extracting the health related information from the digital signal which is obtained by the digital processing of the sensed bio-signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지능형 혁대에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 건강관리 기능을 구비한 혁대에 관한 것이다. 
     본 명세서에서 개시하는 건강관리 기능을 구비한 지능형 혁대는 각종 생체신호로부터 건강 관련 정보를 도출하는 건강정보 도출 모듈; 상기 도출 모듈의 하우징 기능을 수행하는 버클; 및 상기 버클의 일단에 연결되는 띠를 포함하여 본 발명의 목적 및 기술적 과제를 달성하며, 상기 건강정보 도출 모듈은 상기 각종 생체신호를 감지하는 센서 모듈; 및 상기 감지된 생체신호를 디지털 처리하여 처리된 디지털 신호로부터 상기 건강 관련 정보를 추출하는 처리/추출부를 포함하는 것이 본 발명의 목적 및 기술적 과제를 달성함에 바람직하다. 
       
     건강관리 혁대(waistband for health management), 다이어트(diet), 생체신호(physiological signal), 넘어짐 감지(fall detection), 호흡(respiration), 심전도(electrocardiography), 체지방(body fat), 혈압(blood pressure), 체온(body temperature)
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TELECOMM;CATHOLIC UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Individual safety system using wearable wireless device
title_ko: 웨어러블 무선 장치를 이용한 개인 안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a user safety ensuring system using a wireless wearable device. The user safety ensuring system includes the wireless wearable device and a user terminal. The wireless wearable device includes: a sensing unit which is attached to a specific body part of a user and includes at least two of the pressure sensors, voice sensors, motion sensors, image sensors, and bio-signal sensors; and a wearable control unit which recognizes the presence of a dangerous situation when sensing two or more abnormal signals in the detected signals from a location information receiver, a communication unit, pressure sensors, voice sensors, motion sensors, image sensors, and bio-signal sensors, generates rescue request signals including the location information of the location information receiver as short-range communication signals or wireless signals, and outputs the rescue request signals including the location information of the user to the communication unit. The user terminal receives the rescue request signals transmitted by the wireless wearable device and transmits the rescue request signals including the location information of the user to a rescue request system designated in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 무선 장치를 이용한 사용자 안전 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 특정 부위에 부착되며, 압력센서, 음성센서, 움직임센서, 영상센서 및 생체 신호 센서 중 적어도 둘 이상을 포함하는 감지부, 위치정보 수신기, 통신부, 상기 압력 센서, 음성 센서, 움직임 센서, 생체 신호 센서 및 영상센서로부터 검출된 신호들 중 적어도 둘 이상의 이상 신호가 감지되면 위험상황으로 인식하고, 상기 위치정보 수신기의 위치 정보를 포함하는 구조요청신호를 근거리 통신 신호 또는 무전 신호로 형성하고, 상기 사용자의 위치 정보가 포함된 구조 요청 신호를 상기 통신부로 출력하는 웨어러블 제어부를 포함하는 웨어러블 무선 장치와, 상기 웨어러블 무선 장치가 전송하는 구조 요청 신호를 수신하여, 미리 지정된 구조 요청 시스템으로 상기 사용자의 위치 정보가 포함된 구조 요청 신호를 전송하는 사용자 단말기를 포함한다.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and labeling method thereof
title_ko: 전자 장치 및 그의 레이블링 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic apparatus. According to the present invention, the electronic apparatus comprises: a user input unit including a button; a sensor measuring a brain signal and a vital sign of a user; an audio output unit outputting audio to provide audiogenic stimulation to the user; and a processor outputting the audio through the audio output unit while measuring the brains signal and the vital sign of the user through the sensor, determining a conscious state of the user based on user reaction to the audio inputted/outputted through the button, and classifying the measured brain signal and the measured vital sign for each determined conscious state to label the classified brain signal and the classified vital sign.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 전자 장치는 버튼을 포함하는 사용자 입력부, 사용자의 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 사용자에게 청각 자극을 제공하기 위한 오디오를 출력하는 오디오 출력부 및 센서를 통해 상기 사용자의 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 측정하는 동안 오디오 출력부를 통해 오디오를 출력하고, 버튼을 통해 입력된 출력된 오디오에 대한 사용자의 반응에 기초하여 사용자의 의식 상태를 판단하고, 측정된 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 판단된 의식 상태별로 구분하여 레이블링하는 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for bio-signal detection using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 생체신호 검출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for detecting a bio-signal using a radar sensor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for detecting a bio-signal using a radar sensor comprises: a preprocessing step through filtering for removing a harmonic noise component with respect to a baseband signal reflecting a difference between a transmission signal of a radar and a reception signal reflected by a target and limiting a maximum frequency signal range of the baseband signal; a step of generating a plurality of intrinsic mode functions (imf) by applying empirical mode decomposition (emd) to the preprocessed baseband signal; a step of identifying a first mode function including a target signal component and a removal signal component among the plurality of intrinsic mode functions and a second mode function including the removal signal component; a step of generating a harmonic signal of the removal signal component by using the second mode function; and a step of deriving a target signal including the target signal component by using the first mode function and the harmonic signal.
abstract_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 생체신호 검출 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 생체신호 검출 방법은, 레이더의 송신 신호와 대상자에 의해 반사된 수신 신호의 차이를 반영하는 기저대역 신호에 대하여 고조파 잡음 성분을 제거하고 기저대역 신호의 최대 주파수 신호 범위를 한정하는 필터링을 통한 전처리 단계, 전처리된 기저대역 신호에 경험적 모드 분해(Empirical Mode Decomposition, EMD)를 적용하여 복수의 내재 모드 함수(Intrinsic Mode Function, IMF)를 생성하는 단계, 상기 복수의 내재 모드 함수 중 타겟 신호 성분 및 제거 신호 성분을 포함하는 제1모드 함수와 상기 제거 신호 성분을 포함하는 제2모드 함수를 식별하는 단계, 상기 제2모드 함수를 이용하여 상기 제거 신호 성분의 고조파 신호를 생성하는 단계 및 상기 제1모드 함수 및 상기 고조파 신호를 이용하여 상기 타겟 신호 성분을 포함하는 타겟 신호를 도출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KONKUK IND COOP CORP;MILLISIGHT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The present application discloses a multifunctional health monitoring method and system based on a millimeter wave radar, and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises: receiving an echo signal in a space, and on the basis of the echo signal, calculating point cloud data of a user and phase change data caused by the respiration and heartbeat of the user; calculating behaviors of the user on the basis of the point cloud data; calculating vital signs of the user on the basis of the phase change data, wherein the vital signs comprise respiration rate and heart rate; and on the basis of the behaviors and/or the vital signs, determining that the user triggers a set alarm event, and on the basis of the type of the triggered alarm event, performing a corresponding alarm operation.

title_en: System, method and computer program product for remote measurement of vital signs
abstract_en: A system for measuring medical data characterizing a subject to be monitored, the system including radar sensor/s and/or electro-optical sensor/s. The medical data, which may include pulse and/or respiratory rate and/or temperature of the subject to be monitored, are measured remotely, thereby providing standoff detection and reducing risk of infection to medical personnel.

title_en: Super-regenerative oscillator integrated metamaterial leaky wave antenna for multi-target motion detection and ranging
abstract_en: Various embodiments comprise systems, methods, architectures, mechanisms and apparatus providing a super-regenerative oscillator (SRO) integrated metamaterial (MTM) leaky wave antenna (LWA) architecture suitable for use in radio frequency (RF) detecting, ranging (e.g., RADAR), and sensing systems/applications, such as a noncontact multi-target vital sign detection system.

title_en: Joint remote vital signs sensing communications and pnt based drone swarm
abstract_en: Embodiments of a method of operating a drone swarm system of a swarm of unmanned arial vehicles (UAVs) are disclosed. In some embodiments, a search of a geographic area is performed based on one or more first radar signals from at least one of the UAVs. Additionally, it is determined whether at least one obstruction of the geographic area is found in response to performing the search. A radar operation mode for each of the UAVs is determined based on whether at least one obstruction is detected. One or more living entities are detected in the geographic area based on one or more second radar signals transmitted in accordance with the determined radar operation mode.

title_en: Systems for maintaining, managing and exploring pipe networks
title_ko: 관망의 유지관리탐사 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for maintaining and exploring pipe networks, comprising: a ground penetrating radar (GPR) applying electromagnetic waves to roads to check whether to install pipe networks buried in the ground and the location thereof; a sound wave detecting device receiving sound waves generated from the pipe networks to check whether water has leaked from the pipe networks; and a control device checking whether to install the pipe networks and the location thereof by using information received from the GPR and checking whether water has leaked from the checked pipe networks and the location of the water leakage by using information received from the sound wave detecting device. Therefore, whether to install the pipe networks and the location thereof and whether water has leaked from the checked pipe networks and the location of the water leakage can be identified together.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하에 매설되어 있는 관망의 설치 여부 및 위치를 확인하기 위하여, 도로에 전자기파를 가진하는 지표투과레이더(GPR, Ground Penetrating Radar), 상기 관망의 누수 여부를 확인하기 위하여, 상기 관망에서 발생하는 음파를 수신하는 음파 탐지 장치, 상기 지표투과레이더로부터 수신된 정보를 이용하여 상기 관망의 설치 여부 및 위치를 확인하고, 상기 음파 탐지장치로부터 수신된 정보를 이용하여 상기 확인된 관망에서 유출 여부, 누수 여부 및 누수 위치를 판단하는 제어장치를 포함하는 관망의 유지관리탐사 시스템을 제공한다. 따라서 관망의 설치 여부 및 위치를 확인하고, 확인된 관망에서 유출 및 누수가 있는지와 유출 및 누수가 있다면 위치가 어디인지도 함께 파악이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Method for human only activity detection based on radar signals
abstract_en: A method of detecting human presence includes using a radar sensor to monitor a space, and receiving an output signal from the radar sensor. A Fourier transform is performed on the output signal to produce a signal spectrum. It is decided whether the output signal is indicative of human activity dependent upon at least one acoustic feature of the signal spectrum and at least one spectral feature of the signal spectrum.

title_en: A kind of fire command system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of fire command system based on Internet of Things, it is intended to solves the problems, such as during the disaster relief to lack to fireman's vital signs in real time information monitoring at present.A kind of fire command system based on Internet of Things, including fireman mobile terminal and fire-fighting vehicle-mounted terminal platform.Fireman mobile terminal includes fire-entry suit component, Arduino development boards, sensor cluster and wireless signal transmission module；Arduino development boards, sensor cluster and No.1 wireless transport module are arranged on fire-entry suit component；Sensor cluster and No.1 wireless transport module electrically connect with Arduino development boards；Sensor cluster includes heart rate sensor, 9 axle athletic posture sensors and at least one thermocouple pyrostat；Fire-fighting vehicle-mounted terminal platform includes PC ends, and No. two wireless transport modules with the communication connection of No.1 wireless transport module are electrically connected with PC ends.Solve the problems, such as during the disaster relief to lack to fireman's vital signs in real time information monitoring at present.

title_en: Air breathing pressure and vital sign online monitoring and early warning system for firefighters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure and vital sign on-line monitoring early warning system are exhaled to fireman sky, include: the air-breathing pressure on-line monitoring and early-warning system for the firefighters comprises a PT500-500 gas pressure sensor, a peripheral circuit, a single-chip microcomputer processing and low-power-consumption Bluetooth wireless transceiver, a data relay forwarding platform, a team data server and a mobile command platform. Both systems comprise: the remote monitoring system comprises a remote transmitting and receiving display device, a host transmitting and receiving system and a voice communication device, wherein the remote transmitting and receiving display device is connected with the host transmitting and receiving system through a data line; the individual soldier system in the forecourt includes a plurality of fire scene terminal parts, and it passes through WIFI, 3G or relay transmission part intercommunication with host computer receiving and dispatching system. The vital sign on-line monitoring and early warning system comprises a vital body information acquisition terminal and a monitoring command center.
assignees: RUENTEX RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Fire hydrant freeze-proofing method and device by geothermal energy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire hydrant freeze-proofing method and a device by geothermal energy. According to the method, constant temperature heat from a stratum below the meters of ground surface is adopted and is transferred upwards through a low temperature heat pipe of a fire hydrant geothermal energy device buried underground to heat the fire hydrant, so that the temperature of the fire hydrant body above the ground surface is constantly higher than freezing temperature and the purpose of preventing the fire hydrant from being frozen is achieved. The freeze-proofing device is composed of a heat adsorption fin, a heat release fin, a water supply stand pipe, a low temperature heat pipe, the fire hydrant, a water supply pipe, a stand pipe thermal insulating layer, a hot top and a rapid dismounting clip. The freeze-proofing method of the invention is easy to implement, the freeze-proofing device is easy to be produced and installed, dose not consume energy and is safe, reliable, convenient and effective; and in addition, with the device, the hidden dangers can be eliminated and good guarantee can be provided for fire fighting in the winter.

title_en: A kind of multipath mitigation algorithms based on node degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multipath mitigation algorithms based on node degree, be applied in through-wall radar data processing module.When target location changes, the echo-signal time delay of each propagation path and phase place respective change, thus affect the position of multipath ghost, i.e. target is interrelated with multipath ghost.Therefore the flight path that Target Tracking System produces can describe by a complex network model being made up of node and directed edge, and every flight path is seen as node, and limit is regarded in the association between flight path as.Go out in-degree by calculate each discrete instants flight path, update average out-degree peace all in-degrees of whole flight path node, finally judge whether every flight path constitutes discrete nodes or whether be multipath.Repetition above step, until having processed all track data, completes the multipaths restraint to whole scene.The present invention realizes multipaths restraint based on node degree, it is possible to the real-time of boosting algorithm while improving Studies of Radar Detection performance.
assignees: NANJING YUDA TELECOMMUNICATIONS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system and data acquisition and processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system and a data acquisition and processing method, comprising seismic sources which are uniformly or non-uniformly distributed on the ground, a seismic source excitation signal detection instrument and a ground gravity measurement instrument; the seismic source excitation signal detecting instrument is a wired wave detector and a wired seismic data recording instrument which are arranged on the ground, or a wireless node seismic instrument which is arranged on the ground, or an embedded continuous spirally wound armored optical cable and a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing modulation and demodulation system. And (4) acquiring microgravity data point by point along the ground detector line and the ground seismic source line in a high density manner. The buried depth and the velocity distribution of the whole measuring work area from the earth surface to the bedrock surface are obtained through the joint inversion of the first arrival travel time data, the reflected wave and the refracted wave of the ground seismic data and the ground microgravity data, the buried depth and the velocity distribution are used for carrying out accurate and reliable static correction processing on the ground seismic data, and the data after high-quality static correction processing are provided for the subsequent further processing of the ground seismic data.
assignees: ZHONGYOU AOBO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bistatic MIMO radar life detection method based on propagation operator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bistatic MIMO radar life detection method based on a propagation operator, which comprises the following steps: matching filtering is carried out on echo signals of the radar, an output signal matrix of a virtual array is constructed, a propagation operator is constructed after finite primary row-column transformation is carried out on the matrix, a minimum cost function of the propagation operator is solved, the solution of the propagation operator is obtained, eigenvalue decomposition is carried out on the matrix to obtain a diagonal matrix to realize parameter matching, and the estimation of an azimuth angle is calculated through the diagonal matrix to obtain the life position. The invention has high distance and angle positioning accuracy, can enhance the positioning, tracking and detecting capabilities of the target, has strong anti-interference capability, has fine speed resolution potential and strong detecting capability in a disaster environment.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;NANJING MINZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Use method of induction device for monitoring landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a use method of an induction device for monitoring landslide, which comprises the following steps: the signal inductor is connected to the current release device in a linear arrangement mode through a plurality of flexible wires with different lengths, and the using method comprises the following steps: s1, embedding: embedding the signal sensor into a mountain, and placing the current release device into the mountain; s2, monitoring: before landslide occurs on the mountain, relative displacement occurs on rock masses around the landslide, the shearing force along with the vertical displacement causes the flexible lead to extend, the resistance of the flexible lead is increased, and the current value measured by an ammeter is decreased; s3, data reception: the signal receiver receives data of an ammeter in the signal sensor, the signal sensor is buried in a mountain body when the signal receiver is used, whether the mountain body has landslide or not and the landslide strength are judged according to the current, the monitoring process cannot be influenced by weather and external environment, the monitoring is not assisted by external conditions, and therefore the signal receiver is not limited by geographical environment and is wide in application range.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHIDAFEI TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human motion gesture recognition method based on radar vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention provides a human body action classification method based on radar vital sign signals. Firstly, refining and processing a narrow-band spectrum region of interest in a signal global spectrum by using a linear frequency modulation Z conversion method, and extracting accurate information of a specific frequency band; secondly, extracting characteristic values of respiratory and heartbeat signals subjected to the linear frequency modulation Z transformation to obtain 6 effective characteristic values of absolute value characteristics, variances, amplitudes, zero crossing time, slope transformation and root mean square; then, taking the absolute value characteristics, variance, amplitude, zero crossing time, slope transformation and root mean square as input quantities of a support vector machine classifier, and classifying corresponding human actions; finally, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network combined with the provided characteristic values is designed to classify the human body actions. The invention comprehensively considers the relevant characteristics of the human body actions corresponding to the sign signals, monitors the household human body actions, and has good accuracy and reliability.

title_en: Personnel intelligent monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a personnel intelligent monitoring method and related equipment based on millimeter wave radar, and relates to the technical field of nursing monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting millimeter wave signals and receiving radar original echo data; preprocessing according to the radar original echo data to obtain time domain feature information of a target human body; obtaining monitoring information of a target human body by processing according to the time domain characteristic information and adopting a deep learning method, wherein the monitoring information at least comprises the number, the position, the movement track, vital sign information and gesture recognition information of people; and generating corresponding alarm information and control instructions according to the monitoring information, wherein the alarm information is sent to a set crowd, and the control instructions are sent to set household appliances. The application can acquire various monitoring data of personnel in real time, is non-contact, is simple and convenient, and can realize intelligent monitoring of personnel and intelligent control of household appliances.
assignees: GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC GUANGZHOU;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Method and system for detecting through-wall radar target
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar target detection method, which comprises the steps of detecting by adopting a through-wall radar and acquiring an original echo signal; pulse compression is carried out to obtain compressed echo data; performing clutter suppression; performing coherent imaging to obtain an imaging result; constructing a robust principal component analysis optimization model based on the imaging result; and solving the model to obtain a final target detection result, and finishing the through-wall radar target detection. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the through-wall radar target detection method. The method for analyzing the robust principal component is applied to the target detection of the through-wall radar, and not only realizes the target detection of the through-wall radar through the technical scheme of pulse compression, clutter suppression, coherent imaging and robust principal component analysis, but also is suitable for the simultaneous detection of multiple moving and static targets under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, and has the advantages of higher detection accuracy and reliability, better robustness, higher detection speed and higher efficiency.

title_en: Non-contact sleep monitoring system based on radio frequency sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep monitoring system based on a radio frequency sensor. The system comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module, a signal processing module and a signal processing module, wherein the signal acquisition and acquisition module is used for acquiring vital sign information of a user during sleep by using a biological radar, and performing signal processing on received echo signals containing vital signs to obtain vital sign signals under different distance gates; the multi-distance door fusion module is used for fusing vital sign signals under a plurality of distance doors; the feature extraction module is used for extracting feature parameters reflecting the sleep state from the fused signals; the data transmission module is used for transmitting the characteristic parameters to the cloud service platform; and the cloud analysis and prediction module is used for analyzing the characteristic parameters and evaluating the sleep quality. The method and the device can monitor the vital sign information of the user, and automatically classify the sleep stages through the cloud service platform according to the information, thereby being effective and feasible and having reliable performance.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring heart rate of personnel in vehicle based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-based in-vehicle personnel heart rate monitoring method and a radar-based in-vehicle personnel heart rate monitoring system, which belong to the technical field of vital sign detection, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring radar echo signals of vital signs of personnel in a monitoring vehicle; the method comprises the steps of determining phase signals of a range gate where a human target is located and a range gate nearby the range gate according to acquired radar echo signals, extracting spatial characteristics of the range gate where the human target is located and the range gate nearby the range gate, extracting time sequence characteristics from the extracted spatial characteristics, acquiring heartbeat signals of personnel in a vehicle according to the time sequence characteristics, and acquiring heart rates of the personnel in the vehicle according to the heartbeat signals of the personnel in the vehicle. The accuracy of monitoring the heart rate of the personnel in the car is improved.

title_en: Microwave radar sleep monitoring method and device based on user charging time
