abstract_en: The invention relates to a microwave radar sleep monitoring method and device based on user charging time, which comprises the following steps of S0, S1, searching a human body position by transmitting and receiving a radar signal through a microwave radar when detecting that a terminal is connected with a charger, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate to search a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving the radar signal returned by the vital sign detection area, and extracting vital signs from the radar signal.

title_en: Physiological index monitoring method, device, equipment and medium applied to micro-pressure oxygen cabin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a physiological index monitoring method, device, equipment and medium applied to a micro-pressure oxygen cabin, wherein the method comprises the following steps of carrying a physiological index monitoring system comprising a radar sensing module and a fingerstall module to the micro-pressure oxygen cabin; the method comprises the steps of continuously detecting whether a moving target exists in a set area through a radar sensing module, triggering a system to enter a working state if the moving target exists, detecting whether the target wears a fingerstall through a temperature module of a fingerstall module, monitoring physiological indexes of the target through the radar sensing module, the temperature module and a blood oxygen detection module if the moving target is worn, outputting generated data as physiological index data, sending prompt information if the fingerstall is not worn, setting a duration threshold, and recovering the physiological index monitoring system to a standby state if the time that the target is in the non-moving state exceeds the duration threshold and the target is not worn. Because the proposal realizes the full-automatic vital sign monitoring through the physiological index monitoring system.
assignees: CROSS STRAIT TSINGHUA RES INSTITUTE XIAMEN;SUZHOU YAOZHIKANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Land-air collaborative monitoring and early warning method and system for buried gas pipeline in landslide hidden danger area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a land-air collaborative monitoring and early warning method and a land collaborative monitoring and early warning system for a buried gas pipeline in a landslide hidden danger area, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing distributed optical fiber sensing for ground monitoring, embedding an optical fiber sensor into the outer wall of the buried gas pipeline or paving a concomitant optical fiber pipeline; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-physical quantity data of strain, temperature and vibration of a pipeline, carrying out air inspection by utilizing a multi-sensor platform carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle in air monitoring, fusing the air monitoring data with ground monitoring data to construct a landslide hidden danger area pipeline safety state assessment model, carrying out real-time intelligent analysis on the fused data by utilizing an advanced mixed attention convolution neural network to identify a potential disaster hidden danger area of the pipeline, carrying out early warning classification according to a risk assessment result, and formulating a corresponding emergency plan. The method can realize real-time and accurate monitoring of the pipeline state, discover landslide hidden danger in time and accurately early warn, and can effectively ensure safe operation of the buried gas pipeline in the landslide hidden danger area.
assignees: SUZHOU NANYONG EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact sleep stage classification system and classification method based on visual view
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact sleep stage classification system and a classification method based on visual views. The system comprises a non-contact physiological information acquisition module, a visual network construction module and a sleep stage multi-element classification module. The visual network construction module is used for training network features extracted by the visual network construction module by using a machine learning method, firstly carrying out normalization processing on the extracted network features, then dividing sleep stages into a awake stage and a sleep stage, then carrying out fine classification on the sleep stage, dividing the sleep stage into a rapid eye movement stage, a sleep stage I, a sleep stage II and a sleep stage III, and finally completing the division of five sleep stages. The visual network is applied to the respiration and heartbeat signals extracted by the non-contact vital sign monitoring radar, so that the two branch networks of respiration and heartbeat are built, deep information of the respiration and heartbeat signals is further mined, and the accuracy rate of sleep stage classification is improved.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF NUCLEAR IND;UNIV NANJING SCI & TECH

title_en: Mental load evaluation device and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device capable of estimating a mental load attributed to an operation of on-vehicle information equipment.SOLUTION: A respiration rate is derived based on respiratory data acquired from a respiration detection sensor (S330), and an SCL (skin conductance level) is derived based on skin conductance data acquired from a skin conductance detection sensor (S340). All respiration rates and SCLs associated with the corresponding time are acquired in an operation period (S370), and a representative value of the respiration rates in the period and a representative value of the SCLs in the period are calculated (S380). The sum of the representative value of the respiration rates in the period and the representative value of the SCLs in the period is calculated as an evaluation index (S390), and if the difference between the evaluation index and an evaluation criterion is equal to or greater than a specified value, a mental load attributed to an operation of on-vehicle information equipment is evaluated as being felt by a driver while an automobile is driven (S400).

title_en: Method and device for detecting life
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for detecting life.SOLUTION: A life detection device is provided, comprising: a first data processing unit for removing an average value of a wave motion of a radar signal; a second data processing unit for filtering radar signal data on the basis of the wave motion of the radar signal, and/or intensity of the radar signal, and/or the size of a detection area; and a detection unit for determining the presence or absence of life on the basis of candidate radar signal data obtained after processing by the first data processing unit and the second data processing unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Wearable device for monitoring body water, electronic device, and operation method therefor
title_ko: 체수분 변화를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 장치, 전자 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: A wearable device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise: a communication circuit set to transmit or receive data or signals to or from an external electronic device; an output module; an electrical sensor that measures a first biological signal related to electrical properties; an optical sensor that measures a second biological signal related to optical properties; a temperature sensor that measures the temperature of skin; and at least one processor operatively connected to the communication circuit, the output module, the electrical sensor, the optical sensor, and the temperature sensor. The at least one processor may be configured to: acquire the first biological signal, the second biological signal, and a third biological signal related to the temperature from the electrical sensor, the optical sensor, and the temperature sensor, respectively; transmit first data related to the acquired first biological signal, second data related to the acquired second biological signal, and third data related to the third biological signal to the external electronic device via the communication circuit; receive data related to body water changes in the body from the external electronic device via the communication circuit, the body water changes being calculated on the basis of changes in the first data and the second data respectively corrected using the third data; and output feedback related to the body water changes to the output module on the basis of the received data related to body water changes.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 웨어러블 장치는, 외부 전자 장치와 데이터 또는 신호를 송신하거나 또는 수신하도록 설정된 통신 회로, 출력 모듈, 전기적 특성과 관련한 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 전기 센서, 광학적 특성과 관련한 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 광학 센서, 피부의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서, 및 상기 통신 회로, 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서와 동작적으로 연결된 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서로부터, 상기 제1 생체 신호, 상기 제2 생체 신호, 및 상기 온도와 관련한 제3 생체 신호를 각각 획득하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 획득한 제1 생체 신호와 관련한 제1 데이터, 상기 획득한 제2 생체 신호와 관련한 제2 데이터, 및 상기 제3 생체 신호와 관련한 제3 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로 전송하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 제3 데이터에 의해 각각 보정된 상기 제1 데이터 및 상기 제2 데이터의 변화에 기반하여 산출된 신체의 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로부터 수신하고, 상기 수신한 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터에 기반하여, 상기 출력 모듈에 상기 체수분 변화에 관련한 피드백을 출력하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior spaces and exterior spaces which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna (1). The antenna (1) is connected to an electronic circuit (2, 3, 4, 31, 32) which is able to decode the changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field by means of a processor (7) enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding the antenna (1) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using a kalman filter
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving reflected radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating a displacement signal indicative of a displacement of a target based on the reflected radar signals; filtering the displacement signal using a bandpass filter to generate a filtered displacement signal; determining a first rate indicative of a heartbeat rate of the target based on the filtered displacement signal; tracking a second rate indicative of the heartbeat rate of the target with a track using a Kalman filter; updating the track based on the first rate; and updating a setting of the bandpass filter based on the updated track.

title_en: Near-field coherent sensing methods and systems
abstract_en: Near-field coherent sensing (NCS) methods and systems are described herein. The techniques may be used to monitor vital signs is introduced herein. Multiple-input, multiple output near-field techniques may be used to characterize motion. In some embodiments, the methods and systems are used to measure cardiac motion. In some embodiments, the disclosed system is integrated into a seat, such as, for example, a car seat. The system be configured to monitor the vital signs of a seat occupant with multiple sensing points. The sensor can be integrated into the cushion and hence “invisible” to the user.

title_en: Radar-based single target vital sensing
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: generating a target displacement signal indicative of a movement of a human target based on raw digital data generated by a millimeter-wave radar sensor; and estimating a vital sign of the human target based on the target displacement signal, where generating the target displacement signal includes: generating target in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) (I/Q) data associated with the human target based on the raw digital data, classifying the target I/Q data as high quality data or as low quality data using a first neural network, when the target I/Q data is classified as low quality data, discarding the target I/Q data, when the target I/Q data is classified as high quality data, performing ellipse fitting on the target I/Q data to generate compensated I/Q data, and generating the target displacement signal based on the compensated I/Q data.
assignees: INFINEON TECHNOLOGIES AG;UNIV FRIEDRICH ALEXANDER ER

title_en: Combined infrared displacement sensor network node for monitoring mountain massif coast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a joined infrared displacement sensor network node for monitoring landslide, and relates to a slope displacement sensor for monitoring landslide in real time. The structure of the joined infrared displacement sensor network node combined according to a triangle comprises the following: the joined infrared displacement sensor network node consists of a primary node (10), a first secondary node (20) and a second secondary node (30) which are arranged on vertexes of the locked monitoring triangle respectively. The structure of the joined infrared displacement sensor network node combined according to a quadrangle comprises the following: the joined infrared displacement sensor network node consists of a primary node (10), a first secondary node (20), a second secondary node (30) and a third secondary node (40) which are arranged on vertexes of the locked monitoring quadrangle respectively. The joined infrared displacement sensor network node can reliably monitor lateral displacement, longitudinal displacement, altitude difference three-dimensional displacement and collapse information of a slope. When the sensing nodes are buried by gliding mass, loss information of the buried sensing nodes can also be accurately calculated, so that the aim of objectively identifying and evaluating position, state and level of landslide and collapse is achieved. The joined infrared displacement sensor network node has the advantages of low price, high sensitivity, flexible radio-frequency control and small power consumption, and meets the characteristic requirements of the sensing nodes.

title_en: Vital sign and consciousness condition monitoring system based on active and passive radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign and consciousness condition monitoring system based on an active and passive radar, which is characterized in that on the basis of monitoring vital signs by an existing millimeter wave radar, millimeter wave echo signals and brain wave signals can be received by adopting a low-side lobe high-gain high-sensitivity dual-frequency receiving antenna, meanwhile, an extremely low-frequency (brain wave band signal frequency range: 0-20 MHz) high-sensitivity receiver is added to a high-sensitivity receiver module for receiving and conditioning brain wave radiation signals, then sampling and analyzing are carried out in a signal processing module, the analyzed data result is compared with the analyzed data result of normal personnel stored in a data storage module, and when the difference is larger than a threshold value, the occurrence of abnormality of the vital signs or consciousness conditions of a patient is indicated, and an early warning signal is sent. The invention relates to a non-contact monitoring system based on active and passive radars, which is used for accurately collecting vital sign signals and brain electrical signals, and realizing real-time, continuous and dynamic monitoring of vital signs and consciousness conditions of patients, thereby being beneficial to rapid recovery of the patients under good resting conditions.

title_en: Multi-unit radar cooperative motion state and vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unit radar cooperative motion state and vital sign monitoring system and method. The system comprises an edge sensing node and an upper computer which are in communication connection, wherein the edge sensing node is provided with complete vital sign wireless sensing, signal resolving and communication capability, the upper computer is used for receiving information such as a target ID, a target position, a target vital sign, a target abnormal state and the like sent by the edge sensing node, the edge sensing node is composed of a microcontroller module, a radar sensor module, a DSP module, an FPGA neural network reasoning module, a communication module and a power supply module, the microcontroller module is respectively in communication connection with the radar sensor module, the DSP module and the FPGA neural network reasoning module, the radar sensor module is in communication connection with the DSP module, the DSP module is in communication connection with the FPGA neural network reasoning module, and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the edge sensing node. The method carries out the accurate tracking of the vital signs and the positions of the multiple targets, and realizes the accurate tracking of the health states of the multiple targets.

title_en: Biological signal analysis system and method
title_ko: 탈착 디바이스를 이용한 생체 신호 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탈착 디바이스를 이용한 생체 신호 분석 시스템 및 방법을 제시하고 있다. 본 발명에 따른 탈착 디바이스를 이용한 생체 신호 분석 방법은 사용자의 신체에 탈착이 가능한 탈착 디바이스를 이용한 생체 신호 분석 방법에 있어서, 상기 탈착 디바이스에 구비된 심박 측정 센서, 체온센서, 착용 여부 센서, 가속도 센서, GPS 모듈 및 마이크로폰이 각각 상기 사용자의 심박을 측정하여 상기 사용자의 비정상심박을 감지하고, 상기 사용자의 체온을 측정하여 상기 사용자의 비정상체온을 감지하고, 상기 사용자의 상기 탈착 디바이스 착용상태를 감지하고, 상기 사용자의 움직임, 중력, 평형 및 자유 낙하 중 적어도 어느 하나 이상을 감지하고, 상기 사용자의 위치를 감지하고, 상기 사용자의 비정상음성 감지하여, 상기 사용자의 비정상심박, 비정상체온, 탈착 디바이스 착용상태, 자유 낙하, 위치 및 비정상음성 중 적어도 어느 하나가 포함된 상기 사용자의 상태정보를 서버로 송신하는 사용자 상태정보 센싱 단계와, 상기 서버가 상기 사용자의 상태정보를 이용하여 통계학습을 통한 상기 사용자 상태의 비정상상황 감지 및 기계학습을 통한 상기 사용자 상태의 비정상상황 감지를 실시하여 상기 사용자의 상태가 정상상황인지 비정상상황인지를 판단하는 비정상상황 판단 단계 및 상기 비정상상황 판단 단계에서 상기 사용자 상태가 비정상상황이라고 판단한 경우 상기 서버가 상기 사용자에게 전화 연결을 시도하거나, 119전화 연결을 실시하는 대처 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 각종 센서를 탑재한 탈착 디바이스를 이용하여 사용자의생체 신호를 측정할 수 있고, 측정된 생체 신호 데이터를 분석하여 응급 상황을 감지하여 인명사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Ground-penetrating radar device and method for same
abstract_en: An underground radar device and a method thereof are provided that do not require replacement of antennas for transceiving in conformity with the width of a road, and can achieve exploration of a buried object with a single scan. An underground radar device includes a transmission array antenna and a reception array antenna, and further includes a position variable mechanism capable of changing intervals between antenna elements of the transmission array antenna and the reception array antenna while keeping all the intervals equal. The position variable mechanism includes a drive unit, a plurality of crossbars constituting an expandable link, and a plurality of link sections for coupling so as to change inclination angles of a V-shape and an inverted V-shape of the expandable link.

title_en: Across perspective detection stratum, hole High water cut zone device
abstract_en: Across hole perspective detection stratum High water cut zone device, by transmitting terminal and receiving end counter, tripod, boring, sleeve pipe, antenna, guiding hammers into shape and ground data processing host, computing machine, Transmission Fibers cable, data line form.In institute's probing medium formation volumes, utilizing works rig bores transmitting terminal and receiving end two boring, implants sleeve pipe retaining wall respectively.Fix the tripod of transmitting terminal and receiving end on sleeve pipe top, tripod is installed transmitting and receiving counter.And be connected with data processing host with Transmission Fibers cable one end, the other end is connected with transmitting and receiving antenna, and data processing host is connected with computing machine with data line.Transmitting and receiving antenna is hammered into shape with each self-steering and is connected.The transmitting and receiving antenna assembled is put into respectively transmitting and receiving end borehole casing to carry out across hole perspective detection.The utility model boring interplantation sleeve pipe avoids collapse hole to cause antenna to be buried, and in hole, antenna unobstructed movement under the guiding of guiding hammer, avoids antenna by card, be extremely suitable for radar antenna and repeatedly detect in hole, rational in infrastructure, easy to operate.
assignees: WATER CONSERVANCY & HYDROPOWER SCIENCE RES INST LI

title_en: Ground anchor detection system based on ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to electric power inspection field, concretely relates to ground anchor detecting system based on ground penetrating radar. The system is characterized by comprising a DSP module, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a FLASH memory, a multifunctional display screen, a storage hard disk and a storage battery. The utility model discloses a ground penetrating radar carries out the detection of the earth anchor buried depth underground, through to the earth anchor transmission with receive the electromagnetic wave to handle the echo signal who receives, thereby learn the earth anchor buried depth underground. The ground anchor detection work is more targeted, blind excavation is avoided, and the work efficiency of ground anchor burying depth detection is improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID AC CONSTRUCTION CO

title_en: Geological landslide monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological landslide monitoring device, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, which comprises a monitoring pile buried in the middle and lower part of a mountain slope; the mountain body sensing assembly is provided with a pressure sensor, a vibration sensor and a crack monitoring sensor; the pressure sensor is arranged on the upper slope surface at the lower part of the monitoring pile; the vibration sensor is arranged inside the monitoring pile; the crack monitoring sensor is arranged on the mountain slope; the control box is arranged at the upper part of the monitoring pile and is electrically connected with the pressure sensor, the vibration sensor and the crack monitoring sensor; the signal emitter is arranged at the top of the monitoring pile and is electrically connected with the control box; the signal transmitter is used for transmitting the monitoring signal to the remote control center. The geological landslide monitoring device can be used for carrying out 24-hour all-weather monitoring and early warning on the geological landslide, and the intelligent degree and the use safety of the geological landslide monitoring and early warning are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN SHUDU GEOLOGICAL ENG SURVEY CO LTD

title_en: Intrusion detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides an intrusion detection device and belongs to the technical field of public safety. The intrusion detection device comprises a passive infrared detection unit, a camera, a video image analyzer and an alarm unit, wherein the passive infrared detection unit is used for acquiring the human or animal alarm signals with vital signs; the camera is used for acquiring a video image; the video image analyzer is used for analyzing the video image acquired by the camera and extracting the alarm signals with human signs; and the alarm unit is used for analyzing the alarm signals with the human signs recognized by the video image analyzer in combination with the human or animal alarm signals with the vital signs detected by the passive infrared detection unit, and rejecting the alarm signals with the human sign outline but without the vital signs or the alarm signals with the vital signs but without the human sign outline so as to ensure that the recognition alarm only aims at the intruding human bodies, thereby realizing the functions of advanced alarming and accurate alarming.
assignees: KARASSN SECURITY PROT ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Carrying type small radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of life detectors, and provides a carrying type small radar life detection instrument. A vital sign signal in a ruin gap is detected by a radar detection system; a respiration signal, a heartbeat signal and a monitoring signal are extracted from the vital sign signal, and are transmitted to a detection and analysis control system through a wireless transmission mode; a detection result is obtained by analyzing and judging the respiration signal, the heartbeat signal and the monitoring signal; therefore, the shortcomings of the conventional radar life detection instrument are made up; the carrying type small radar life detection instrument is carried on a carrier and put into the ruin gap for life detection; furthermore, the wireless control mode is adopted, so that a rescuer for detection can perform the detection operation in a safety zone; detection data and a detection result are wirelessly transmitted to the rescuer for detection; the safety of the rescuer for detection is guaranteed; and the injury to the rescuer approaching the ruin is avoided.

title_en: Life detection robot equipment based on multi-sensor information
abstract_en: The invention relates to life detection robot equipment based on multi-sensor information. Walking mechanism units are symmetrically installed on the two sides of a box. A holder unit is installed on the box and provided with a rotating joint arm achieving rotating degrees of freedom and a pitching joint arm achieving pitching degrees of freedom, wherein the pitching joint arm is installed on the rotating joint arm. A video load unit is installed on the pitching joint arm, swings in a pitching mode along with the pitching joint arm and rotates along with the rotating joint arm. A voice load unit and a radar life detection load unit are installed on the rotating joint arm and rotate along with the rotating joint arm. The holder unit, the video load unit, the voice load unit and the radar life detection load unit are connected with a control unit installed in the box. The control unit is connected with a background console through a wireless communication and rapid transmission unit installed on the box. The life detection robot equipment can replace rescue workers to enter a ruined site to execute the search and rescue task, rescue worker casualties are reduced, and the survival search efficiency is significantly improved.

title_en: Method for calibrating ground penetrating radar of urban buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calibrating a ground penetrating radar of an urban buried pipeline, which comprises the following steps of; s1, designing and manufacturing various standard blocks, forming various standard sample blocks by combining different layering models, wherein the standard sample blocks are used for simulating real urban road layering and buried pipelines thereof; s2, continuously sweeping the calibrated ground penetrating radar from left to right above the standard sample block to generate a visual picture; step S3, calculating the thickness of different layers, the buried depth of the pipeline, the distance between pipelines, the trend of the pipeline and the medium property of the pipeline according to the generated pictures; step S4, comparing, calculating the measurement performance error of the calibrated radar, and realizing the calibration of the measurement performance; meanwhile, checking whether the radar to be calibrated is accurate or not; step S5, judging whether the radar performance is qualified according to the result of the step S4; the invention solves the problem that the measurement result is deviated due to factors such as different dielectric constants, different material compositions, noise interference and the like.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion-based high-voltage test hall electric shock prevention early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion-based high-voltage test hall electric shock prevention early warning system and method, wherein an electric field dynamic monitoring module is used for acquiring and calibrating electric field data through a distributed three-axis field intensity sensor array and predicting field intensity distribution by combining an ARIMA-GRU hybrid model; the UWB-IMU co-location module adopts TOF-TDOa-aOA algorithm to fuse inertial data to achieve location of testers, the vital sign abnormality detection module is used for monitoring body surface leakage current and physiological parameters, the three-dimensional live-action modeling module is used for constructing dynamic safety boundaries based on laser SLAM, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation decision module is used for dynamically distributing weights and calculating risk indexes through an LSTM-ATT model, and the multistage emergency linkage control module is used for executing hierarchical power-off response. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and dynamic threshold adjustment, quick power-off response and full scene risk management and control are realized, the false alarm rate is reduced, and the electric shock accident of the high-voltage test is effectively prevented.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Buried object surveying apparatus, target point surveying method, and v-shaped target
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object surveying apparatus that is compatible with a comparatively thick wall and is easily handleable, and surveys the position of a target point provided on the back side being a back plane of a wall or floor, from its near-side surface by using a radar wave.  <P>SOLUTION: The buried object surveying apparatus 1 includes a display 2, an operation switch 3, a handle 4 for holding the buried-object surveying apparatus 1, and wheels 5 having a built-in encoder for detecting the position of movement. Moreover, the buried-object surveying apparatus 1 is operated on the near side of the wall, and a V-shaped target 10 is arranged on the back side of the wall. The V-shaped target 10 is a tapelike metal plate which reflects radar waves, and is stuck to the wall so as to stretch right and left at an angle of θ/2 with respect to a perpendicular axis (direction of gravity) passing a target point (point C).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Processing system for online health care and medical service and method thereof
title_ko: 온라인을 통한 개인 건강관리와 의료서비스 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal health care and medical service system through online capable of efficiently caring health of a patient and a method thereof. The personal health care and medical service system through online comprises: a health sensor device (10) which stores and transmits measured patient data through a near field communication device; a telehealth hub (20) which transmits the patient data through wired and wireless communication network; and a central server (30) which finds condition and location information of the patient and transmits the information to each service through wired and wireless communication network; and a service server (40) which performs treatment according to the patient data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개인 의료센서장치(health sensor device)를 이용하여 온라인 상에서 환자에게 효율적인 건강관리와 의료서비스를 받을 수 있게 하고, 환자에게 위급상황이 발생되었을 때 소방관서 및 응급구조센터 등에 구조요청을 하며, 환자의 건강관리 상태에 따라 헬스케어, 요양시설 등과 연계하여 환자의 건강관리를 효율적으로 관리하도록 한 온라인을 통한 개인 건강관리와 의료서비스 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
전술한, 본 발명의 특징은, 각 환자의 생체신호(심전계, 체온, 혈압, 혈당, 체중 등)를 측정하고, 측정한 환자데이터를 저장하고 이를 근거리 통신장치(블루투스, 와이파이, 지그비 등)를 통하여 전송하는 의료센서장치(health sensor device)(10)와, 근거리 통신장치를 통하여 각 의료센서장치(10)의 각 환자데이터를 전송 받아 저장하고, 각 환자데이터를 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 전송하는 원격의료 허브(telehealth hub)(20)와, 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 원격의료 허브(20)의 각 환자데이터를 전송 받아 저장하고, 각 환자데이터를 분석하고 판별하는 자체 진단 프로그램을 통하여 환자의 이상상태 및 위치정보를 파악하여 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 각 서비스로 전송하는 중앙서버(30)와, 중앙서버(30)와 제휴를 관계를 맺고, 서로 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 각 데이터를 전송하며 중앙서버(30)로부터 전송 받은 각 환자데이터의 상태에 따라 처치하는 서비스서버(40)로 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 온라인을 통한 개인 건강관리와 의료서비스 시스템에 의하여 달성될 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: System and method for estimating vital signs
abstract_en: A system for estimating breathing frequency and heartbeat frequency of a subject, comprises at least one ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver, connected to at least one hardware processor, configured to: receive a plurality of readings from the UWB transceiver, each of the readings having a time and comprising a plurality of intensity values at the time, each of the intensity values having a corresponding distance value representing a distance between the UWB transceiver and the subject; determine a Range-Doppler map from the plurality of readings; analyze the Range-Doppler map to determine a breathing frequency value of the subject; perform null steering of a plurality of Doppler-map frequencies in the Range-Doppler map to nullify the breathing frequency value and integer multiples of the breathing frequency value to obtain a plurality of combined frequencies; and determine a heartbeat frequency value for which a plurality of computed frequencies corresponds with the plurality of combined frequencies.

title_en: Radar apparatus for detecting multiple life - signs of a subject, a method and a computer program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, comprising a transmitter system for emitting a transmission electromagnetic beam to the chest and/or the abdomen of a subject, a receiving system for receiving first reflected electromagnetic beam data from the chest and/or the abdomen, and a processor unit for processing the first received beam data retrieving breath activity information. The transmitter system, the receiving system and the processor are further arranged for performing a radar measurement of a superficial artery structure, such as a wrist artery, an ankle artery, a carotid artery and/or the fontanel artery for retrieving heart activity information. Thereto, the a second transmission electromagnetic beam is directed towards the superficial artery structure, the first and the second transmission electromagnetic beam being transmitted from a single radar unit.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring simulation echo data; carrying out BP imaging on echo data to be used as an input image during neural network training; then, generating a reference picture by simulation training, wherein the reference picture is used as a reference picture during neural network training; building a neural network by using a tensoflow tool to train training data, training the neural network by using an input picture and a reference picture, and generating a network model; and finally, applying the trained network model to the measured data. The method provided by the invention improves the resolution of through-wall radar imaging; and side lobes in the through-wall radar image are reduced.

title_en: Multi-target respiration heart rate monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave radar-based multi-target respiration heart rate monitoring method and system, wherein a millimeter wave radar module is used for detecting a heart rate and a respiration rate in a non-contact manner, so that a complicated contact-type monitoring program is avoided, and the privacy of a detected person cannot be violated. Compared with the non-contact detection technology in the prior art, the invention improves the detection precision and greatly enhances the reliability of measurement. According to the invention, the respiration heart rate data of the monitored object is monitored and analyzed in real time through the vital sign monitoring platform, so that sudden unexpected diseases of the monitored object can be prevented, or timely alarm can be realized when sudden situations occur; medical care personnel can timely master the physical sign data of the monitored object through the vital sign monitoring platform, timely evaluate the physical condition of the monitored object and give professional opinions and suggestions; the family members of the monitoring object can acquire the health report form of the monitoring object through the vital sign monitoring platform and nurse the monitoring object according to the professional guidance suggestions.

title_en: Anti-interference extraction and separation vital sign information method based on millimeter wave biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-interference extraction and separation vital sign information method based on millimeter wave biological radar; the method comprises the following steps: s1: performing time domain interference detection on the signals, and traversing to detect whether all the frequency modulation signals are interfered; s2: detecting the interference position of the interfered signal; s3: interference suppression and signal restoration, which suppresses an interference section in an interfered frequency modulated signal and reconstructs the section; s4: detecting target vital sign information, namely detecting the position of the target and the vital sign information of the target; s5: and extracting and separating vital sign information, and extracting and separating heartbeat and respiratory signals of the target. The invention can accurately find the interference position and accurately repair the interfered signal, reduce the phase noise caused by interference, ensure that the radar system can be used in a multi-interference environment, improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the vital signal and more accurately separate the respiratory heartbeat signal.

title_en: Ultra-wideband UWB life signal data processing method and device based on singular value decomposition
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and a device for processing Ultra Wideband (UWB) vital signal data based on singular value decomposition, the method comprising: transmitting a continuous pulse sequence by using an ultra-wideband radar life detector to detect so as to obtain a plurality of groups of continuous echo signals containing vital sign signals, and preprocessing an echo signal matrix; singular value decomposition is carried out on the echo signal matrix after pretreatment so as to obtain multi-order singular values and singular matrix components; extracting space eigenvectors and time eigenvectors corresponding to the singular values of each order from the singular matrix components; the method and the device have the advantages that compression storage processing is carried out on the singular values, the space feature vectors and the time feature vectors of each order, and through the method and the device, the problems of large clutter and noise interference, space-time feature coupling, overlarge data size, occupation of a large amount of storage space and the like of the echo signals of the ultra-wideband radar life detector can be reduced, meanwhile, the singular values of the signals are processed, and the timeliness of processing the vital sign signals is improved.

title_en: Positioning method for distributed optical fiber sensing system
abstract_en: The method is used for carrying out phase correction on signals acquired by an optical fiber sensor array, so that the influence of the scale of an optical fiber sensing channel is eliminated, and the corrected signals can be directly used for obtaining high-precision target source position information by using an array signal processing method. The method is not dependent on a specially designed optical fiber winding structure, and is suitable for the conventional buried communication optical cable. The invention has the advantages of simple implementation, low cost, large range, high precision and the like, can further improve the positioning capability of the existing sensing system on the target signal in the actual application scene, is suitable for the fields of railway safety, perimeter security, earthquake rapid reporting and the like, and has great significance.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring continuous biomedical signal
title_ko: 연속적인 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 모니터링 하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  본 개시의 예시적 실시예에 따른 센서 시스템은, 생체 신호를 감지함으로써 연속적인 전기적 신호를 출력하는 센서 모듈, 기준 데이터를 저장하는 메모리, 무선 채널을 통해서 출력 데이터를 전송하는 트랜스미터, 및 연속적인 전기적 신호로부터 생성된 입력 데이터 및 기준 데이터에 기초하여, 입력 데이터를 출력 데이터로서 트랜스미터를 통해서 전송할지 여부를 결정하는 데이터 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Ultra wide band radar life detection device used for positioning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra wide band radar life detection device used for positioning comprising a satellite differential positioning base station unit, a detection control and display system, and more than three ultra wide band radar life detection units. The satellite differential positioning base station unit can be cooperated with the ultra wide band radar life detection units to complete the self-positioning. Each of the ultra wide band radar life detection units comprises a WiFi data transceiving module, a satellite positioning module, an ultra wide band radar life detection transceiving and processing module. The ultra wide band radar life detection transceiving and processing module can use the radar to detect life signals, and the satellite positioning module can be cooperated with the satellite differential positioning base station unit. The WiFi data transceiving module can be connected with the detection control and display system, and can be used to transmit the detected data signals. The detection control and display system can be used to complete a WiFi networking and transceiving work, a target positioning resolving work, and a detection result display work. The ultra wide band radar life detection device has advantages of convenient operation, superior performance, high positioning accuracy, and ability of improving efficiency of searching and rescuing affected people.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation
abstract_en: A life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation is disclosed and is characterized by comprising an infrared image acquisition apparatus, a sound wave signal acquisition apparatus and a signal fusion apparatus, wherein the infrared image acquisition apparatus is connected with the signal fusion apparatus, and the sound wave signal acquisition apparatus is connected with the signal fusion apparatus. According to the life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation, infrared image and sound wave information synchronous acquisition and processing are adopted, infrared and sound wave sensors can work in adverse environment conditions such as dark light environment, greasy dirt environment and the like; the life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation is advantaged by simple structure, low cost, strong adaptability, not-easy-to-damage and the like. According to the life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation, images of environment where living entities are positioned can be obtained through the infrared sensor, active and passive type sound wave sensors can be used for detecting weak distress signals emitted by living entities and can be used for accurately positioning the living entities, an accurate decision basis for making a rescue solution can be provided through cooperation of the two kinds of sensors, rescue time can be reduced, and calamity loss can be reduced.

title_en: Mobile device based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile device based on a through-wall radar, which comprises a radar host and a control terminal, wherein the control terminal is a mobile terminal, and the control terminal and the radar host are mutually connected through a spring slot; carry out the plug between control terminal and the radar host computer and be connected the back and lock through the draw-in groove through the magnetic stripe absorption, be provided with compression spring between draw-in groove and the control terminal lower extreme, adsorb the back through the magnetic stripe between control terminal and the radar host computer thereby carry out the draw-in groove of downstream card income radar host computer under compression spring's the effect. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, good portability, easy operation, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Point type temperature-sensing fire detector convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model provides a point type temperature sensing fire detector convenient to installation belongs to fire-fighting equipment technical field, and this point type temperature sensing fire detector convenient to installation includes the protective housing, the lower fixed surface of protective housing is connected with the shell, the gas pocket is seted up to the upper surface of shell, it has the heat conduction post to peg graft in the center of shell upper surface, the one end fixedly connected with thermal-arrest piece of heat conduction post, the other end fixedly connected with hot detector of heat conduction post, the last fixed surface of hot detector is connected with the fixed plate, carry out fixed connection between the both ends of fixed plate and the inner wall of shell. Through the heat collecting sheet, the heat conduction post and the thermal detector that set up, absorb the heat through the heat collection sheet and pass through the heat conduction post heat conduction to the heat sensing detector when the conflagration breaing out to can report to the police the conflagration, through buckle and the draw-in groove that sets up, can be convenient install the pre-buried box to the shell on, thereby solved and installed inconvenient problem among the prior art.
assignees: HUBEI DONGJIU FIRE FIGHTING SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Radar and microseism combined composite life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compound life detection instrument that radar and slight shock combined relates to search for and rescue apparatus technical field, including shell, radar send-receiver portion, slight shock sensing portion, illumination unit, display element and handle unit, send and receive radar signal through setting up radar send-receiver portion, set up slight shock sensing portion and discern the micro-vibration, set up illumination unit and deal with night or the dim environment of light, set up the information that radar send-receiver portion and slight shock sensing portion output is looked over to display element, set up the handle unit and be used for portable handheld. The utility model discloses when possessing the radar detection function, still possess the microseism and survey the function, synthesize the two advantage, realized the accurate location to stranded person.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting footwear carrying out vital signs detecting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting footwear carrying out vital signs detecting, including sole, vital signs detecting device, illuminating lamp and shoulder guard, on described sole, deck is installed, on described deck, roller is installed, described sole is internally provided with described shoulder guard, described sole is provided above with fire-proof and thermal-insulation vamp, it is provided with described shoulder guard inside the toe-cap of described fire-proof and thermal-insulation vamp, described fire-proof and thermal-insulation vamp is provided above with face, described face is provided above described illuminating lamp, described illuminating lamp is provided above belt, described belt is provided below buzzer, described buzzer is provided below function key, described function key is provided below alarm lamp, described alarm lamp side is provided with described vital signs detecting device.Having the beneficial effects that: fireman can be helped to carry out personnel's search and rescue, described illuminating lamp facilitates rescue work at night to carry out, and has fire-proof and thermal-insulation function simultaneously, can prevent scene of fire flame burn consumption person foot.

title_en: A kind of high altitude regions rescue system based on Intelligent bracelet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high altitude regions rescue system based on Intelligent bracelet, comprising: Intelligent bracelet, user mobile phone, Lora communication terminal, monitoring center and search and rescue service station；Intelligent bracelet detects human heart rate, blood pressure, ECG, body temperature, human body posture.There is public network regional, the sign information of field personnel is transmitted to user mobile phone, information is transmitted to by 4G public network by monitoring center；In no public network area, information is transmitted to by Lora technology and searches and rescues service station, 4G public network is recycled to be transmitted to monitoring center.The present invention has the advantages that vital sign information can be obtained by front end condition sensor, there is public network area and the transmission of information can be carried out without public network area, solve the transmission problem of field search and rescue signal, it is not limited by weather, landform and distance, the multidimensional information for the personnel that rescued, the especially warning information of high altitude regions environment lower body status tracking are provided to the search and rescue of complicated highlands.

title_en: A kind of life signal synchronized measurement system and measurement method for bioradar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life signal synchronized measurement systems and measurement method for bioradar detection, belong to bioradar and life signal field of measuring technique.Including being located at multiple touch sensor groups and control display end；Each touch sensor group includes a piezoelectric type respiration transducer and a photosensitive type pulse transducer；Control display end includes computer and bluetooth router, and touch sensor group passes through bluetooth router and computer communication；Computer and bioradar system communication, for monitoring the working condition of bioradar system.Third party software monitor is established using the Hook technology in windows messaging mechanism, start/stop the event message of measurement using hook capture bioradar system software, when monitoring bioradar starts/stops to save the event of data, triggering synchronized measurement system starts/stops to save data immediately, realizes the time synchronization of the acquired data of the two.

title_en: Identification device and method for detecting buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recognition device and a recognition method for detecting a buried pipeline. When the ground penetrating radar protection box is transported or not used, the protection plate is pulled to be in contact with the protection box through the electric telescopic rod, so that the ground penetrating radar enters the protection box, the protection box and the protection plate can be used for protecting the ground penetrating radar, the damage caused by collision of the ground penetrating radar in the transportation process is reduced, the limiting rod is pulled upwards to drive the arc-shaped clamping block to be separated from the gear, the supporting plate is pulled to adjust the angle between the supporting plate and the battery box, and therefore a user can adjust the supporting plate and the connecting rod according to self habits.
assignees: TIANJIN SCIENCE AND TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar under motion disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on an ultra-wideband radar under motion disturbance, which comprises the following steps: carrying out down-conversion processing on original radar echo data; determining an interested area according to the result of the down-conversion treatment; preprocessing the data of the region of interest, and extracting an optimal respiratory signal by using a respiratory signal extraction algorithm based on an R square value; removing the background of the data of the region of interest, and obtaining a start-stop frame of each random body motion through a motion detection algorithm; calculating according to the data of the region of interest obtained after the Butterworth band-pass filtering to obtain the respiration rate and the heart rate, and optimizing the detection of the respiration rate according to the optimal respiration signal; and stopping detection when the random body movement is detected according to the start-stop frame of each random body movement obtained by the movement detection algorithm, and setting the breathing rate and the heart rate of the previous moment as the current detection result. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the vital signs of the human body are continuously monitored under the condition of small random body movement.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle life detection system based on vision SLAM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle life detection system based on a visual SLAM technology, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous life detection platform for detecting human life through an infrared camera sensor and realizing integration of composition, navigation and life detection, wherein the SLAM technology is used as an autonomous navigation mode of an unmanned aerial vehicle, binocular cameras are used for extracting and screening characteristic points, matching and updating key frames, filtering and optimizing rear ends, three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out on the space where the unmanned aerial vehicle is located, and three-dimensional coordinates of the real-time position of the unmanned aerial vehicle are obtained through pose calculation, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can realize the establishment of a surrounding environment map and carry out self positioning according to the established environment map on the basis of no external signals, the autonomous flight function is achieved, meanwhile, the existence of a trapped person is detected in real time in the autonomous navigation flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the position of the trapped person is positioned quickly and efficiently according to the information autonomously detected by the unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby rescue is implemented.

title_en: Sleep quality evaluation method, device, system and medium based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep quality evaluation method, equipment, a system and a medium based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the sleep quality evaluation method comprises the following steps: collecting vital sign data of a measured person through millimeter wave radar monitoring equipment; according to the obtained vital sign data, one or more operations of body movement frequency analysis, breath disorder degree analysis and bed duration determination of the tested person are executed; and performing sleep quality assessment on the tested person based on one or more information of the obtained body movement frequency, the breathing disorder degree and the bed duration. In view of the advantages of non-contact detection of the millimeter wave radar and the detection of the vital signs of the user without wearing the millimeter wave radar, the invention utilizes various representative vital sign data acquired by the millimeter wave radar in the sleeping process of the person to be detected to evaluate the sleeping quality of the person to be detected, obtains detailed and accurate evaluation data on the premise of no sensing detection, and has a wide application prospect.
assignees: BEIJING HUASHENG MEDICAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Anti-disassembly function control method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a prevent tearing open function control method, back lid subassembly includes main control board, plastics lower cover and metal cold rolled sheet back stores pylon, be equipped with hall switch element and radar response function module on the main control board, be equipped with a plurality of fixed pre-buried box holes on the metal cold rolled sheet back stores pylon, be equipped with two neodymium iron boron magnets on the plastics lower cover, hall switch element is fixed on the main control board in the intermediate position of two neodymium iron boron magnets, the plastics lower cover passes through self tapping screw to be fixed on the casing, produces magnetic field induction through two magnets on the left and right sides and metal back stores pylon and acts on hall switch components and parts, can play product installation fixed and prevent tearing open early warning bilayer effect, and in addition radar response and camera face capture function combine, the safety and convenience of protection user can save space and product pleasing to the eye again.
assignees: XIAMEN DNAKE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bio-signals based automatic sleep-stage identification system
title_ko: 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-signal based automatic sleep stage classification system is provided to reduce the number of measurement signals, thereby conveniently estimating a sleep stage. CONSTITUTION: A bio-signal detection part(100) measures various bio-signals from each part of a human body using a 7-channel amplifier. The bio-signal detection part comprises two-channel Electroencephalogram(EEG) sensors(110,120), an electrooculogram(EOG) sensor(130), an electromyogram(EMG) sensor(140), a photoplethysmography(PPG) sensor(150), a galvanic skin response(GSR) sensor(160), and a skin temperature(SKT) sensor(170). A signal process and characteristic extraction part(200) extract a feature point which displays characteristics of each bio-signal by processing various bio-signals. A subset generation part(300) arranges a plurality of subsets required for sleep stage classification by mixing the bio-signals with different conditions based on the feature point with respect to each bio-signal. A performance evaluation part(400) analyzes a performance evaluation result of a subset combination according to each sleep stage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템에 관한 것으로, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용하여 수면 단계를 예측하기 위한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 EEG, EOG, EMG, PPG, SKT, GSR 센서를 이용하여 서로 다른 채널을 통해 다양한 생체 신호를 획득하는 생체신호 검출부, 생체신호 검출부에서 각 채널을 통해 획득된 다양한 생체신호를 각 생체신호의 특징 추출에 적합한 방법으로 신호 처리를 실시하여 각각의 생체신호로부터 각 생체신호의 특징을 나타내는 특징점을 추출하는 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부, 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부의 각 생체신호에 대한 특징점을 기준으로 생체신호 조합을 생성하는 서브셋 발생부, 및 서브셋 발생부에서 조합된 생체신호 조합을 통하여 수면단계(REM,LS,DS)를 분류하고, 각 단계에 따른 조합의 성능 평가를 분석하는 성능 평가부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템을 제공하여, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용한 수면 단계 분석시 측정의 정확도와 편리성을 고려한 최적의 생체신호 조합으로 수면 단계를 정확하고 편리하게 예측할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: User authentication method and system via the skin impedence recognition in the bio-electrical signal measurement environment using wearable sensors
title_ko: 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for authenticating a user via recognition of skin impedance in a bio-electrical signal measurement environment by using wearable sensors. The method for authenticating a user via recognition of skin impedance in a bio-electrical signal measurement environment by using wearable sensors comprises the steps of: (1) measuring, by a skin impedance measurement unit, skin impedance of a user; (2) transmitting, by a communication unit, the skin impedance, measured at step (1), to an authentication unit; and (3) authenticating, by the authentication unit, the user by comparing the skin impedance transmitted at step (2) with previously stored user data. According to the method and system for authenticating a user via recognition of skin impedance in a bio-electrical signal measurement environment by using wearable sensors, which are proposed by the present invention, skin impedance unique to an individual person is measured by using the electrode sensors, and the measured skin impedance is used as a user authentication tool, thereby simply and conveniently authenticating a user, i.e., a bio-electrical signal measurement target, in an environment in which bio-electrical signals are measured by using the wearable sensors.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 (1) 피부 임피던스 측정부가 사용자의 피부 임피던스를 측정하는 단계; (2) 통신부가 상기 단계 (1)에서 측정된 피부 임피던스를 인증부로 전송하는 단계; 및 (3) 인증부가 상기 단계 (2)에서 전송된 피부 임피던스를 미리 저장된 사용자 데이터와 비교하여 사용자를 인증하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템에 따르면, 개인별로 차이가 나는 피부 임피던스를 전극 센서를 이용하여 측정하고, 이를 사용자 인증 도구로 사용함으로써, 웨어러블 센서로 생체 신호를 측정하는 환경에서 생체 신호 측정 대상이 되는 사용자를 간편하고 편리하며 정확하게 인증할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KEIMYUNG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: A battery charging system that can quickly extinguish a fire with an infiltration extinguishing agent
title_ko: 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery charging system for extinguishing a fire occurring during the charging of a battery by spraying an infiltration fire-extinguishing agent when the fire starts.The battery charging system capable of quickly extinguishing a fire by using an infiltration fire-extinguishing agent according to an embodiment of the present invention, which charges an electrically operating device operated by a battery, comprises: a battery charging chamber for accommodating the battery-driven device; and a fire-detecting attachment and detachment jig including a fire detection sensor installed on a portion where the battery is placed in the battery-driven device, to be able to be attached and detached, thereby detecting a fire in the battery. The fire-detecting attachment and detachment jig includes a perforator for perforating the device case of the electrically operating device so that the infiltration fire-extinguishing agent can be infiltrated into the electrically operating device to extinguish a fire in the battery when the fire in the battery is detected by the fire detection sensor. Therefore, a fire in the battery can be extinguished quickly when the fire in the battery starts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배터리의 충전 시 발생하는 화재의 발화 시점에 침윤소화약제를 분사하여 진압하기 위한 배터리충전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템은 배터리에 의해 작동하는 전기작동장치를 충전하는 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템으로서, 상기 배터리구동장치를 수용하는 배터리충전챔버, 상기 배터리구동장치에서 상기 배터리가 위치하는 부분에 탈착 가능하게 설치되어 상기 배터리의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서를 포함하는 화재감지 탈착지그를 포함하고, 상기 화재감지 탈착지그는 상기 화재감지센서에서 상기 배터리의 화재를 감지하는 경우, 상기 전기작동장치의 내부로 상기 침윤소화약제를 침투시켜 화재를 진압하도록 상기 전기작동장치의 장치케이스를 천공하는 천공부를 포함한다. 따라서 배터리의 발화시점에서 신속하게 화재를 진압할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA FLAME PROOF TECH;KIM KYOUNG HO;CHO HEUBG HWAN

title_en: Method and system for operating sleep abnormality detection platform
title_ko: 수면 이상 감지 플랫폼 운영 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예는, 수면 이상 감지 플랫폼 운영 방법을 제공한다. 본 방법은, 복수의 레이더센서로부터 침대에 위치한 사용자의 움직임 및 생체신호를 수신하는 단계, 상기 사용자의 움직임 신호, 생체신호 및 가속도를 이상 탐지 모델 및 분류 모델에 입력함으로써, 상기 사용자의 수면 이상여부를 판단하는 단계, 상기 사용자의 수면 이상 여부에 따라, 사용자 단말, 보호자 단말 및 의료센터 단말 중 적어도 하나로 상기 사용자의 수면 이상을 알리는 메시지를 전달하는 단계 및 기 설정된 시간 이후, 상기 레이더센서로부터 수신한 사용자의 움직임 신호 및 생체신호가 수면 이상 상태로 판단되는 경우, 상기 레이더센서로부터 기 설정된 범위 이내의 IoT 장치를 원격으로 제어하여 후속조치를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring using a radar unit centrally positioned within the cabint to obtain image data of the vehicle cabin and a processor to generate detect occupancy of seats within the vehicle cabin, categorize occupants, detect posture, determine seatbelt status and monitor life signs of the occupants. An output unit may execute responses appropriate to the status of occupants of the vehicle cabin.

title_en: Radar sensing of vehicle occupancy
abstract_en: A method for sensing occupancy status within an automotive vehicle uses a radar sensor system, the radar sensor system comprising an antenna system, at least one sensor ( 10 ) and processing circuitry ( 18 ). The method comprises illuminating, using the antenna system, at least one occupiable position within the vehicle with continuous wave (CW signals), the CW signals being frequency modulated in time. At least one sensor signal (a) reflected as a result of the CW signals, is received using at least one sensor ( 10 ) the at least one sensor ( 10 ) defining a plurality of receive channels (1 . . . i), each channel having a different frequency (f 1  . . . f i ). Processing circuitry ( 18 ) is operable for applying, for each receive channel (1 . . . i), DC offset removal to the corresponding sensor signal (a) to generate a modified signal (b); and generating, based on the modified signals (b) one or more occupancy status signals ( 34, 38 ), the occupancy status signal indicating a property related to said at least one occupiable position. A system for carrying out the method is also disclosed. The techniques provide for in-vehicle occupant detection and classification (airbag suppression), for passenger presence detection and passenger's vital sign monitoring and for seat-belt reminder functionality (SBR). The radar system may consist of one or two (or four) outputs (I/Q) per channel. The received signal may be mixed down with a single channel demodulator or an I/Q demodulator into the baseband. An advanced signal processing including an auto calibration routine and clutter removal may be used to detect occupants and their vital sign (breathing and heart beat) and to determine their distance to the radar system.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-invasive virus symptom detection
abstract_en: Systems for symptom detection include a sensor configured to sense a signal indicative of at least one vital sign of a user, a display, a processor, and a memory. The memory has stored thereon instructions which, when executed by the processor, cause the system to determine at least one vital sign of the user based on the sensed signal, determine a wellness and/or health condition of the user based on the at least one vital sign, and display on the display at least one of information or indicia indicative of the determined wellness or health condition.

title_en: Elliptical cross target positioning method for one-transmitting and double-receiving through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elliptical cross positioning method suitable for a transmitting-receiving platform through-wall radar. The method can effectively eliminate the false points which may occur in the multi-target detection of the one-and-two-receiving platform through-wall radar, and improve the positioning accuracy of the radar system. Compared with the traditional double-ellipse cross positioning algorithm, the method can effectively prevent the problem of false point interference which is easy to occur in the positioning of the first-sending and second-receiving platform through-wall radar, avoids the limitation that more than 3 receivers are needed in the past, saves the actual research and development cost, improves the service performance of the first-sending and second-receiving platform through-wall radar in the actual environment, and is beneficial to the actual application of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Multi-living-body intelligent detection device and method based on CPPWM radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the disaster detection field and discloses a multi-life intelligent detection device and method based on CPPWM-MIMO radar, wherein the device comprises a CPPWM signal generator, a plurality of power amplifiers, an array antenna, a plurality of low-noise amplifiers, a multichannel high-speed mixed sampler and a data processing system; the array antenna comprises a plurality of transmitting antennas and a plurality of receiving antennas, and the CPPWM signal generator simultaneously generates orthogonal multipath CPPWM detection signals and multipath CPPWM reference signals corresponding to the orthogonal multipath CPPWM detection signals; each CPPWM detection signal is connected with a transmitting antenna through a power amplifier, and the output end of each receiving antenna is connected with a multichannel high-speed mixed sampler through a low-noise amplifier; each CPPWM reference signal is respectively connected with the multi-channel high-speed mixed sampler; the multichannel high-speed mixed sampler is connected with the data processing module, and the data processing system is used for calculating and analyzing to obtain a life detection result. The invention has the advantages of being not influenced by environmental temperature, noise, site visibility, external electromagnetic interference and the like.

title_en: Piping structure for firefighting water
title_ko: 건축물의 소방 배관 설치 구조물
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, provided is a firefighting piping installation structure for a building. The firefighting piping installation structure for a building includes: a ceiling formed in the interior of a building; a firefighting water pipe buried in the ceiling, and receiving firefighting water from a first firefighting water supply part placed in the building; a sprinklers connected with the firefighting water pipe, and sprinkling the firefighting water to the interior; a connection pipe connected with the firefighting water pipe, and penetrating a wall forming the interior; a valve provided on the connection pipe; a first position sensor installed in an end part of the connection pipe, and transmitting a position of the end part of the connection pipe to a controller; a second firefighting water supply part placed in the rooftop of the building; a moving part connected with the second firefighting water supply part through a tube having a predetermined length, and moved laterally in the rooftop of the building; a winder provided in the moving part, and winding or unwinding a fire-retardant rope; a pipe connection part installed at an end part of the rope, and connected with an end part of the tube; and a second position sensor installed in the pipe connection part, and transmitting the position of a connector formed in the pipe connection part to the controller. Therefore, the present invention is capable of efficiently suppressing a fire by promptly supplying firefighting water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 소방 배관 설치 구조물을 제공한다. 상기 건축물의 소방 배관 설치 구조물은 건물의 실내에 형성되는 천정; 상기 천정에 매입되며, 건물에 배치된 제 1소방수 공급부로부터 소방수를 공급 받는 소방수 배관; 상기 소방수 배관과 연결되며, 상기 실내에 소방수를 분사하는 스프링 클러들; 상기 소방수 배관과 연결되며, 상기 실내를 이루는 벽체를 관통하는 연결 배관; 상기 연결 배관에 구비되는 밸브; 상기 연결 배관의 단부에 설치되며, 상기 연결 배관 단부의 위치를 제어기로 전송하는 제 1위치 센서; 상기 건물의 옥상에 배치되는 제 2소방수 공급부; 상기 제 2소방수 공급부와 일정 길이를 갖는 튜브를 통해 연결되며, 상기 건물의 옥상에서 좌우를 따라 이동되는 이동부; 상기 이동부에 구비되며, 난연성의 로프를 권취 또는 권출하는 와인더; 상기 로프의 단부에 설치되며, 상기 튜브의 단부와 연결되는 배관 연결부; 상기 배관 연결부에 설치되며, 상기 배관 연결부에 형성되는 커넥터의 위치를 상기 제어기로 전송하는 제 2위치 센서;를 포함한다.

title_en: Mine detection using radar vibrometer
abstract_en: A frequency-stepped radar may be used to detect buried landmines by sequentially inducing vibrations of different frequencies in the landmine. A sensor detects signals associated with the vibrations, and a processor processes the signals to detect the landmine.

title_en: Vehicle interior life signal radar detection apparatus
abstract_en: A kind of vehicle interior life signal radar detection apparatus, including：Radar detedtor and remote control terminal；Radar detedtor includes main case, radar transmitter, signal limitation chip, signal receiver, distance by radar analyzer, life entity analyzer, result of detection transmitter and control chip；Remote control terminal includes terminal shell, touch screen, control signal transmitter, supplying cell and microcontroller chip；Radar detedtor is also connected with vehicle interior control system；Remote control terminal also includes siren.The utility model carries out life detection by using UWB Impulse, it is effectively guaranteed the detection efficient of radar detection apparatus, pass through the limitation to radar detection signal simultaneously, prevent investigative range is excessive from causing to judge by accident, and, vehicle interior life signal radar detection apparatus is attached with vehicle control system, additionally it is possible to after going wrong, more easily remotely vehicle is controlled accordingly.
assignees: YUNNAN PROVINCE JINMA SECURITY EQUIPMENT MFG FACTORY

title_en: Earthquake rescue system based on optical imaging system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the earthquake rescue system based on optical imaging system, belong to Seismic monitoring equipment technical field, signal pickup assembly is optical imaging apparatus, system also includes the gravity sensor of the signal input part connection for Cloud Server, signal output part and the optical imaging apparatus being connected simultaneously with wireless router and terminal device, the imaging sensor that optical imaging apparatus includes master control IC, is connected with master control IC signal input part, gravity sensor is connected with master control IC, and master control IC is connected with wireless router.After house collapse caused by special violent earthquake disaster, the condition information when earthquake that extraction Cloud Server is recorded occurs or before generation refers to for rescue personnel, check the picture occurred in house, it is confirmed whether that someone is buried, as far as possible useful information is provided for rescue, finally formulation is accurate, reasonably excavates scheme, rescues buried person person.

title_en: Vibration table test system for tunnel-landslide system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shaking table test system for tunnel-landslide system, make the open visual model case of top surface including U shaped steel board, organic glass board and steel sheet, the incasement right side wall sets up the polystyrene foam board, and the incasement is filled and is built the country rock material and build the slope body, sets up the tourniquet under the slope body, and two intercrossed tunnel models are buried underground to the inside level of country rock material, lay a plurality of acceleration sensor and dynamic strain gauge around the tunnel model, and the slope body is domatic, on both sides about the tourniquet and arrange if dry acceleration sensor and dynamic soil pressure gauge in the country rock material. The utility model provides a shaking table test system tunnel lining, the whole dynamic response condition and the response change of meeting an emergency of tunnel lining, the whole peripheral country rock of tunnel in can all-round dynamic monitoring tunnel-landslide system, master the dynamic response condition of tunnel lining and peripheral country rock under the different operating mode, not only practice thrift the cost, can carry out with stage monitoring and analysis to the dynamic response condition of tunnel and side slope moreover.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC

title_en: Multi-mode composite life detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multimode composite life detection system, which comprises a mobile terminal and a detection terminal, wherein the mobile terminal is in wireless connection with the detection terminal; the mobile terminal comprises a touch screen, a signal analyzer and first wireless communication equipment; the detection terminal comprises a shell, a main control unit, radar detection equipment, a micro-vibration probe, an audio and video probe, second wireless communication equipment, a radar antenna and a main battery. According to the multimode composite life detection system, the radar detection, the micro-vibration detection and the audio-video detection are combined, so that the life detection can be carried out more efficiently and accurately, and meanwhile, the life detection operation is simpler and more convenient through the improvement of the system structure and the introduction of a wireless communication technology.
assignees: BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Real-time gesture recognition method and computer equipment for through-wall radar human body image sequence
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radars, and provides a real-time gesture recognition method and computer equipment for a through-wall radar human body image sequence. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a human body image sequence for hiding the motion of the human body target through a human body image generation algorithm according to the radar echo signal of the target; dividing a human body image sequence when a hidden human body target moves into a training set sample and a test set sample according to a preset proportion, and labeling corresponding action labels at corresponding moments; constructing a human body posture real-time recognition network by combining a 3D convolution layer and a 3D convolution gate control circulation unit, and training the human body posture real-time recognition network through a training set sample; and inputting the test set sample into the trained human body posture real-time recognition network to obtain the posture category of each moment. The invention has the capability of short-time judgment of human behavior types, and effectively solves the problems that the actions are incomplete within fixed time or are difficult to distinguish when two actions exist, and the like.

title_en: Portable local mine earthquake monitoring, early warning and alarming device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable local mine earthquake monitoring early warning device and a portable local mine earthquake monitoring early warning method, wherein the device comprises an equipment protection shell, the equipment protection shell comprises a feedback part, a connecting part and a buried part which are connected from top to bottom, and the buried part is internally provided with a plurality of sensors which are electrically connected from bottom to top in sequence: the system comprises a P-L-S energy receiver, a seismic wave memory, an electric energy memory and an ARM program programming module; the feedback part is provided with the components which are electrically connected from bottom to top in sequence: an electron emitter, a buzzer, and a vibration display for displaying frequency and energy; an electric wire is arranged in the connecting part which is communicated with the feedback part and the embedded part, and the ARM program programming module is electrically connected with the electronic emitter through the electric wire; the embedded part is sleeved with a steel pipe, and a seismic wave expansion space is formed between the steel pipe and the embedded part.
