Aiming at rock burst disasters, the invention can monitor the vibration energy level induced by the fracture of the coal seam and realize early warning and alarming, thereby providing a scientific solution for the early warning and alarming of the occurrence of rock burst.

title_en: Configurable distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of life detection, and discloses a configurable distributed radar life detector which comprises a display and control terminal and more than two radar detection units, and aims to solve the technical problems of poor detection performance and low detection efficiency of the life detector at the present stage; each radar detection unit can be flexibly arranged in a disaster-stricken scene, and each radar detection unit is wirelessly connected to form a distributed detection networking to detect a target object; the display and control terminal positions the radar node positions of the radar detection units through a UWB positioning technology, establishes a three-dimensional reference coordinate system, and calculates the three-dimensional coordinates of the target object by combining the one-dimensional distance between the target object and the radar node positions detected by the corresponding radar detection units through a least square positioning method; meanwhile, by combining the MIMO array imaging technology, the signal-to-noise ratio of the target object can be improved, the three-dimensional information of the target can be more accurately obtained, and the purposes of improving the detection performance and the detection efficiency of the life detector are achieved.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar respiratory frequency detection method and system based on broadband frequency spectrum weighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar respiratory rate detection method and a system based on broadband frequency spectrum weighting, wherein the millimeter wave radar respiratory rate detection method based on the broadband frequency spectrum weighting comprises the following steps: s1, performing distance dimension FFT on an ADC signal to obtain a distance dimension FFT result; s2, carrying out dynamic and static separation on the distance dimension FFT result, and extracting a life signal from the static part; s3, dynamic and static separation among multiple frames is performed, and static objects and micro-moving targets are distinguished; s4, selecting a distance unit from dynamic and static separation results among multiple frames, and extracting phases in the distance unit; s5, phase unwrapping and filtering are carried out on the phase to obtain a breathing signal; s6, FFT (fast Fourier transform) calculation is carried out on the respiratory signal to obtain a frequency spectrum of the respiratory signal; s7, calculating the respiratory frequency according to the frequency spectrum. The invention can improve the accuracy of respiratory rate detection.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUAJIE ZHITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on WOA-SVMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on WOA-SVMD, which comprises the steps of carrying out self-adaptive optimization on balance parameters of Successive Variation Modal Decomposition (SVMD) by using a Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), decomposing a signal into a series of eigen modal functions by using the successive variation modal decomposition based on the optimal balance parameters, carrying out twice screening on the eigen modal functions through energy ratio and correlation coefficient, and finally determining the eigen modal function with the largest correlation coefficient to reconstruct a heartbeat signal. The vital sign detection method based on WOA-SVMD can realize accurate estimation of heart rate, the separated heart beat signal is closer to the actual signal, and the problem that noise interference and respiratory harmonics in radar vital sign detection easily interfere with the heart beat signal can be effectively solved.

title_en: Connecting structure between sheath tube for communication cable and side wall of handhole
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a connecting structure between a sheath tube and a side wall of a handhole that prevents a sheath tube from protruding into a handhole together with a fixing plate or prevents a sheath tube from being detached from a sleeve while allowing axial thermal-expansion/contraction of a sheath tube and allowing movement of a sheath tube when an earthquake occurs, and a joint used for the connection.  <P>SOLUTION: The connecting structure is a connecting structure between a sheath tube 2 inserted with a communication cable and a side wall 4a of a handhole 4 buried in the ground. A sleeve 13 is fixed onto the side wall 4a of the handhole 4 while the end of the sheath tube 2 is connected to the sleeve 13 via a joint 1. The joint 1 has a first tube 11 and a second tube 12 axially movably fitted to the first tube 11. A coil spring 10 is externally fitted to the first tube 11 and the second tube 12. One end of the coil spring 10 is fixed to the first tube 11 while the other end of the coil spring 10 is fixed to the second tube 12.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Underground radar survey device
abstract_en: To provide an underground radar survey device capable of surely and easily teaching an operator of an excavator, an underground buried object in an object region.SOLUTION: There is provided an underground radar survey device which is provided on an excavator 1 comprising: an operation device 2 operated by an operator; an excavator body 3 which can travel in response to an operation of the operation device 2; and a bucket 4 which is provided on the excavator body 3 and is movable in response to an operation of the operation device 2. The underground radar survey device comprises: an antenna 6 which is provided on the bucket 4, radiates an electromagnetic wave for survey to a direction separated from the bucket 4, and receives a reflection wave of the electromagnetic wave for survey by the object buried in the underground; a signal processing part 7 which is mounted on the excavator body 3 and generates a three-dimensional image signal on the basis of a reception signal of the reflection wave received by the antenna 4; and an image display part 8 which is provided on the excavator body 3 and displays the three-dimensional image signal generated by the signal processing part 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System and method for sensing high-resolution distance, and application thereof
abstract_en: To conduct a non-contact and non-invasive type sending of a vital sign or other health signal using radar or other high-resolution distance sensing.SOLUTION: A sensing system 11 includes a first radar sensing assembly and an analysis system 18. The first radar sensing assembly uses a radar to measure a plurality of distances to a first target position 16 at different times. The analysis system 18 receives the plurality of distances from the first radar sensing assembly and calculates a difference of the plurality of distances measured by the first radar sensing assembly, thereby quantifying a movement of a target 14 at the first target position 16 at different times. The sensing system 11 uses the calculated difference of the plurality of distances to generate one or more first quantitative action level value that represents the movement of the target 14 at the first target position 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Bio-signal measurement system unified toilet stool
title_ko: 원격 건강관리를 위한 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치
abstract_en: A toilet stool unified type bio-signal measurement system is provided to measure and manage an individual bio-signal by using a personal identification card for identifying a user. A toilet stool unified type bio-signal measurement system includes a foothold(100), a toilet stool unit(200), and a brachium support unit(300). The foothold detects a weight by mounting at least four weight measuring sensors on a bottom surface. The toilet stool unit detects a weight by mounting at least four weight measuring sensors on a bottom surface and mounts thigh electrocardiogram electrodes(220) and thigh bio-electrical impedance measuring electrodes(260) on a top surface where both thighs are in contact with each other. The brachium support unit mounts a finger insertion type measuring device(305) on an upper end and wrist electrocardiogram electrodes(370) and wrist bio-electrical impedance measuring electrodes(380) on a top portion in contact with a wrist.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 건강관리를 위한 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는 변기와 발판에 장착되어 체중, 혈압, 심전도, 체임피던스, 혈중산소포화도를 측정하며 이 측정된 데이터들을 사용자별로 관리가능하며 원격전송할 수 있는 생체신호획득 장치에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명의 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치는 그 밑면에 4개이상의 체중 측정 센서가 장착되어 발판측정 체중을 검출하는 발판부(100); 그 아랫면에 4개 이상의 체중측정센서가 장착되어 변좌측정 체중을 검출하며, 그 윗면에 양쪽 허벅지 닿는 부분에 허벅지 심전도 전극들 및 허벅지 체임피던스 측정전극들이 장착되어 있는 변좌부; 그 상면 일단부에 손가락 삽입형측정기(305)가 장착되어 있으며. 그 상면의 팔목이 닿는 부분에 팔목 심전도 전극 및 팔목 체임피던스 측정전극이 장착되어 있는 상완거치부;를 구비한다. 
     또한 본 발명은 개인 식별자카드를 읽어들여 인식하는 카드 인식부(390)를 더 구비하며, 상기 허벅지 심전도 전극들과 상기 팔목 심전도 전극을 이용하여 심전도를 측정하며, 상기 허벅지 체임피던스 측정전극들과 상기 팔목 체임피던스 측정전극를 이용하여 체임피던스(체지방)을 측정한다. 
       
      심전도, 체임피던스, 체지방, 혈압, 산소포화도, 개인 식별자카드, 무선전송

title_en: Bio-signal measurement device of mouse type
title_ko: 마우스형 다중 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mouse type multiple bio-signal measuring apparatus is provided to measure a multiple bio-signal at the same time by using a ring-shaped measuring part, an electrocardiogram electrode, and an impedance electrode. CONSTITUTION: A palm holding part(100) has a cupola-shape. A ring-shaped measuring part(200) is arranged in one side of the palm holding part. The ring-shaped measuring part measures the blood pressure from an inserted finger. The ring-shaped measuring part comprises a cuff pressure measurement part and an oxygen saturation measurement sensor part. The cuff surrounds the inserted finger. The oxygen saturation measurement sensor part has a lighting-emitting part and a light receiving unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 보다 정확한 심전도, 혈압을 측정하며, 사용하기 간편한 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는 상기 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 일측에 장착된 링형 측정부에서 커프압 및 산소포화도에 의해 정확한 혈압을 측정하며, 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 손바닥 접촉부에 위치된 심전도 전극 및 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 밑면에 위치된 가슴 심전도 전극을 통해 정확한 심전도를 측정하며, 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 손바닥 접촉부에 위치된 체임피던스 전극을 통해 체임피던스를 측정하는 마우스형 다중 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은, 반구(半球)형으로 이루어지며 손바닥을 거치(据置)하도록 이루어진 손바닥 거치부를 구비한 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치에 있어서, 상기 손바닥 거치부(100) 상의 일측에 위치되며, 손가락이 삽입되도록 이루어지고, 삽입된 손가락에서 혈압 및 산소포화도를 측정하는 링형 측정부; 를 적어도 구비하며, 상기 링형 측정부는, 내측에 삽입된 손가락을 감싸도록 이루어진 커프를 구비하며, 상기 커프에 공기를 가압한 후, 커프에서의 압력 변화로 부터 혈압신호를 검출하도록 이루어진 커프압력 측정부; 내측에 발광부와 수광부를 구비하여, 산소포화도를 검출하도록 이루어진 산소포화도 측정센서부;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명은, 손바닥 거치부 상에 위치되되, 손바닥이 닿는 부분에 장착되어지는 심전도 전극을 구비하는 손바닥 심전도 전극부; 상기 마우스형 생체신호  측정장치의 밑면의 일측에 심전도 전극이 구비되며, 상기 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치의 밑면을 가슴부위에 위치(부착)시킴에 의해 가슴 심전도를 측정하도록 이루어진 가슴 심전도 전극부; 손바닥 거치부(100) 상에 위치되되, 손바닥이 닿는 부분에 체임피던스 전극이 장착되는 손바닥 체임피던스 전극부;를 더 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_ko: 생체 신호들의 판독에 기초한 전자기 치료 프로토콜을 생성하기 위한 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로토콜 생성 및 치료 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 프로토콜 생성 및 치료 시스템은: 메인 데이터베이스; 머신 러닝 소프트웨어, 전자기장들을 생성하도록 구성되는 전자기장 발생기를 포함하는 휴대용 장치(100); 생물리학적 신호들을 측정하도록 구성되는 일련의 센서들(500) 및 전자기장들을 전달하도록 구성되는 일련의 이미터들(400); 전자기장 발생기를 제어하도록, 일련의 센서들(500) 각각으로부터 실시간으로 측정되는 생물리학적 신호들을 기록하기 위하여, 측정된 생물리학적 신호들을 기준 전자기장 또는 신호 범위와 비교하기 위하여, 일련의 이미터들(400)을 통해 복수의 상이한 전자기장들을 전달하도록 구성되는 컴퓨팅 장치(104); 그리고 휴대용 장치(100)의 구성요소들을 위한 전원 공급장치; 그리고 휴대용 장치(100)를 보정하도록, 일련의 센서들(500) 및 이미터들(400)의 정확성을 테스트하도록, 환자가 사용하기 전에 기본 치료 프로토콜과 기준 센서들(500) 및 이미터들(400) 포지셔닝 맵을 메인 데이터베이스와 휴대용 장치(100)의 저장 공간에 저장하도록 구성되는 고정 장치(200);를 포함한다. 컴퓨팅 유닛(104)이 일련의 센서들(500) 각각으로부터의 생물리학적 신호의 측정과 동시에 일련의 이미터들(400) 각각을 통해 전달되는 전자기장을 보정하도록 더 구성되고, 서로 근접하게 위치되는 각 특정 이미터(400) 및 각 특정 센서(500)는 쌍으로 작동한다. 각 이미터(400)를 통해 전달되는 전자기장은 측정된 생물리학적 신호가 기준 전자기장 또는 신호 범위 내에 있다는 것이 달성될 때까지 계속해서 보정된다. 컴퓨팅 유닛(104)은, 신호가 기준 전자기장 범위 내에 있을 때 복수의 센서들(500)로부터의 하나 이상의 센서(500)에 의해 측정되는 생물리학적 신호에 기초하여, 전자기장 전달을 제외하기 위해 복수의 이미터들(400)로부터 하나 이상의 이미터(400)를 선택하도록 추가로 구성된다.

title_en: Radar detection system and method for detecting permanence of slow targets
abstract_en: A method and a system for radar detection system include, after cyclically generating a detection profile representing signal intensity as a function of position, cyclically analyzing the detection profile by alternating two modes of analysis. The first mode is suitable to detect a target entering the field of view, but may have poor sensitivity to targets that move at a low speed for a long time, such as a person entering a hazardous area and stopping. When this mode detects a target, a second mode is entered, which is more sensitive and suitable to detect the permanence of the target in the field of view, and in particular small movements connected to the vital signs of the target. The second mode may be based, for example, on complex signal deviations for each position with respect to a long-term complex mean value for that position. Only if the second mode does not detect any target for a certain restart time, the field of view is deemed to be clear and the first mode is used again.

title_en: Portable non-contact vital signal detection device, driver monitoring device, visitor screening system, and home healthcare system
abstract_en: A vital signal detection device includes: an antenna unit provided with a planar antenna of a MIMO radar on a front surface; and a display unit including a display panel on the front surface. The antenna unit is combined with the display unit or the display unit is combined with the antenna unit in a rotatable manner so that, from a state where the planar antenna and the display panel face in a direction ahead of the front surface, the planar antenna is turned to be directed to a direction of a back surface of the display unit opposite from the display panel. The portable non-contact vital signal detection device detects a vital signal on a side ahead of the front surface and a vital signal on a side in the direction of the back surface opposite from the front surface.

title_en: Radar apparatus with natural convection
abstract_en: An apparatus detects and measures vital signs of each human target by a continuous, non-intrusive method. In an example, the vital signs of interest include a heart rate and a respiratory rate, which can provide valuable information about the human’s wellness. Additionally, the heart rate and respiratory rate can also be used to identify a particular person, if more than two target humans are living in a home. The apparatus has a natural convection spatial flow path that draws heat from at least one processor, one fan-less radar and a heat sink.

title_en: Detection Device For Vital Signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device ( 1 ) for detecting vital signs comprising a sensor ( 2 ) and a power supply module ( 3 ), which sensor ( 2 ) has at least one detection means ( 5, 6, 7, 8 ) configured to detect a vital sign from the group comprising oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, pulse, and a first ( 10 ) communication module, and the power supply module ( 3 ) has a second communication module ( 20 ) and a power source ( 21 ), and a wireless communication link ( 4 ) exists between the first ( 10 ) and second communication module ( 20 ), and the sensor ( 2 ) is provided in the form of an elastically deformable, rebounding thin-film sensor, and the communication link ( 4 ) is configured for transmitting power and measured values or measurement data.

title_en: Portable touchless vital sign acquisition device
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a non-contact MCG is anticipated as one embodiment. Additionally, a non-contact stethoscope, thermal sensor, or MCG could be utilized singly or in combination with each other, or included singly or together in other medical devices such as a fluoroscope, For example, a handheld, portable instrument comprising a non- contact stethoscope without a magnetometer or thermal sensor can provide a measure of acoustic signals without contacting a subject, while a non-contact thermal sensor as a single device can provide a rapid contactless temperature of a subject
assignees: UNIV FLORIDA;SKIDMORE FRANK M;DAVIDSON MARK;DONDA RUSSELL S

title_en: Vital sign monitoring action removing method based on deep learning and radio frequency sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring action removing method based on deep learning and radio frequency sensing. By applying the method, the influence of motion on non-contact vital sign monitoring can be eliminated, fine-granularity vital sign waveforms can be recovered correctly, the robustness of vital sign monitoring on motion is improved, and the defect that the waveform separation technology at the present stage is limited to linear signals is overcome. In addition, the method samples the sensing data captured by the radar on the fast and slow time scales, converts the data captured by various radars into a unified format, and is convenient for subsequent signal processing, so that the vital sign monitoring method provided by the invention is independent of the bottom hardware.

title_en: Rader module for detecting and measuring vital sign
title_ko: 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는 전자 부품의 실장 영역과 안테나 영역이 하나의 인쇄회로기판에 구비되며, 안테나 영역에 유발되는 사이드 로브에 의한 간섭 효과가 완화된 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈은 전면에 전자 부품들을 실장하기 위한 실장 영역과 상기 실장 영역의 좌측 및 우측에 각각 구비된 제1 안테나 영역 및 제2 안테나 영역; 구비된 기판을 포함하되, 상기 실장 영역과 상기 제1 안테나 영역 사이 및 상기 실장 영역과 상기 제2 안테나 영역 사이에 상기 기판을 수직 방향으로 관통하는 관통구를 포함하며, 상기 관통구는 상기 실장 영역을 수평 방향으로 가로지르는 안테나 패턴과 맞닿으며, 상기 관통구에는 RF 부싱 커넥터가 삽입된 구조를 취할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting abnormal respiration
title_ko: 이상호흡 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 사용자 신체로부터 반사되어 수신되는 광신호로부터 광용적맥파를 센싱하는 센서, 상기 센서로부터 수신된 광용적맥파로부터 필요 대역의 신호를 추출하는 대역통과 필터, 상기 필터링된 신호에 대해 디지털 변환을 수행하는 아날로그-디지털 변환기, 및 디지털 변환된 광용적맥파 신호로부터 호흡률 신호를 추출하고, 추출된 호흡률 신호에 대해 시간 축 분석을 통해 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 도출하고, 도출된 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 이용해 이상 호흡을 감지하는 이상호흡 인지부를 포함하는 이상호흡 감지 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 이상호흡 감지 장치는 독거노인 및 군사 작전시 고립된 병사들, 재난/사고 현장에 고립된 사람들의 생존 여부 모니터링, 수면 질 진단 및 모니터링 등에 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Terminal for carrying out far-distance monitoring on life information of wounded persons in disaster environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a terminal for carrying out far-distance monitoring on the life information of wounded persons in a disaster environment. The terminal comprises a man-machine interface module, a communication module, a CPU (central processing unit) control module, a positioning module, a vital sign detection sensor and a power supply module, wherein the communication module is respectively connected with a rescue command center module and the CPU control module, the man-machine interface module is connected with the CPU control module, the positioning module is connected with the CPU control module, the vital sign detection sensor is connected with the CPU control module, and the power supply module is connected with all the modules above so as to supply power for the modules. The terminal disclosed by the utility model comprehensively integrate the functions of satellite positioning, vital sign monitoring and information transmission, thereby achieving an integration effect; the location positioning of an individual soldier is performed by using a Beidou-2 satellite navigation system and GPS (global positioning system) compatible chips; the short message transmission is performed by using a BD1 (Beidou-1) satellite navigation system, thereby ensuring the demands of communication in the disaster environment; a plurality of vital sign monitoring modules are integrated, and an effect of expert diagnosis can be achieved; and a low-power-consumption and lightweight miniaturization design is adopted.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE SCIENCE & INDUSTRY CENTURY SATELLITE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Pre-buried building fire-fighting information collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pre-buried building fire-fighting information collecting device which comprises a solar power supply buried in a building body and used for supplying power, fire-fighting data sensors for collecting data, a data black box for storing the data, and a photoelectric electrode plate disposed outside the building body. The photoelectric electrode plate is electrically connected with the solar power supply and charges the solar power supply. The solar power supply supplies power to the fire-fighting data sensors and the data black box. The fire-fighting sensors are connected with the data black box and store fire-fighting data in the data black box. The beneficial effects are that because the pre-buried building fire-fighting information collecting device is buried in a core position of the building when the building is being constructed, in the case of a fire disaster, performance changes of construction material during the period of the fire disaster can be completely preserved, and the collected data is valid and reliable.
assignees: SUZHOU SIDI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Marine vital signs detecting module based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The utility model is a kind of marine vital signs detecting module based on Bluetooth technology, include water-proof sensor (1), low frequency filtering and amplifying circuit (2), Bluetooth transmission circuit (3), totally 3 parts, which are combined, constitutes an one integral piece.The analog signal that water-proof sensor is exported, after 2 grades of amplification filtering, the gain of 1Hz low frequency respiratory rate signals can be made to reach 10dB, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters bluetooth module ADC, after being handled through bluetooth module kernel algorithm, respiration rate is converted into, by Bluetooth transmission to closely lifesaving appliance.In a word, water-proof sensor and bluetooth module are combined together by the utility model, can emit the vital sign of maritime peril personnel by bluetooth wireless mode, greatly improve the efficiency and specific aim of maritime search and rescue work.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGYUAN MOBILCOM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Early recognition device for slope geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope geological disaster early-stage identification device, which comprises a main telescopic rod, wherein a plurality of telescopic connecting rods are fixedly connected to the main telescopic rod in the height direction, a clamp is fixedly connected to the telescopic connecting rods, a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the main telescopic rod, a mounting plate is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, a monitoring pipeline is arranged below the bottom plate, a plurality of strain sensors are respectively and fixedly connected to the mounting plate and the monitoring pipeline, the mounting plate can rotate so as to adjust the height of the strain sensors on the mounting plate, the main telescopic rod can adjust the required height according to the environment, the clamp can be fixedly connected with trunks with different heights so as to fix the device, the strain sensors can detect stratum deformation and landslide surface deformation and upload detection data, and by arranging the clamp, the clamp can be fixed by using forest trees, so that the device has good stability and is suitable for long-term use; through setting up the monitoring pipeline and the mounting panel that can angle regulation under the buried stratum, can adapt to the forest area that deep trench, stratum show few, topography are complicated.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUADONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Early warning device for disaster prevention and reduction monitoring
abstract_en: An early warning device for disaster prevention and reduction monitoring relates to the field of meteorological early warning, and solves the problems that an existing early warning device is complex and has large limit on terrains. The early warning device comprises a mounting column, a bearing part, a water cup and a rainfall sensor, wherein the mounting column is partially buried in a preset area, the bearing part is arranged on a part where the mounting column is not buried, the bearing part is provided with a bearing cavity, the water cup is arranged in the bearing cavity and is provided with a water receiving port, a water leakage port and a water containing cavity, the rainfall sensor is arranged on the bearing part and comprises a sensor body, a probe and a first communication module, the probe is connected with the sensor body, and the probe penetrates through the side wall of the water cup and stretches into the water containing cavity. The real-time rainfall in the preset area is detected by the water cup and the rainfall sensor so as to judge the natural disaster degree and early warn, and the scheme has the advantages of simple structure, convenient installation and low cost, has no limitation on the terrain, and is suitable for areas with larger rainfall and frequent natural disasters.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radar life detection instrument, which comprises a wireless detector and PDA (1); the wireless detector comprises a receiving part and a transmitting part; the receivingpart comprises a plurality of receiving antennae (2); the receiving antennae (2) respectively passes through a filtering circuit, a low-noise amplifying circuit and a down-conversion module (3) and then is connected with a signal input end of a baseband signal processor (4), an output end I of the baseband signal processor (4) is connected with a system main control part, the signal input end of the baseband signal processor (4) is connected with the input end of a baseband module coder in the baseband signal processor (4); and the output end of the baseband module coder is respectively connected with the filtering circuit, a modulation module, an up-conversion module (5), a power amplifier and a transmitting antenna (6), the transmitting antenna (6) is wirelessly connected with the PDA (1). The radar life detection instrument not only conveniently and quickly detects the trapped person, but also has high accuracy of detecting.

title_en: Service robot with visual system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service robot with a visual system. The service robot comprises a robot vehicle body and a mechanical hand mounted above the robot vehicle body, wherein the robot vehicle body is internally provided with a control system for controlling the robot control vehicle body to move and controlling the mechanical hand to move; the robot control vehicle body is internally provided with an embedded type visual tracking system and a WIFI (Wireless Fidelity) communication module; a camera of the visual tracking system is mounted on the mechanical hand by a cloud deck; the WIFI communication module realizes wireless transmission of data and instructions of the control system, the visual tracking system and an upper computer. According to the service robot with the visual system, the service robot adopts the embedded type visual tracking system; the camera is used for carrying out visual tracking and the WIFI communication module and the upper computer are used for realizing visual transmission; a WIFI wireless network is used as a data transmission carrier to realize an intelligent system with the functions of real-time control, audio/video transmission, image acquisition and the like. The service robot disclosed by the invention can be used for civil and military fields including anti-terrorist investigation, battlefield C4ISR systems, fire protection and disaster relief, life detection and the like.

title_en: Smart life radar detection method matching heartbeat features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart life radar detection method matching heartbeat features. The method comprises the following steps of sending an emission instruction, and emitting electromagnetic waves; receiving echo signals reflected from a life body; processing the echo signals to obtain detection signals; preprocessing the detection signals to obtain life signals including heartbeat signals; calculating position data and distance data of the life body according to the life signals; smartly analyzing and recognizing the heartbeat signals to obtain feature data of the life body; sending the position data and distance data of the life body and the feature data to a client terminal, and displaying the data to a user by the client terminal. The method can automatically analyze feature information of a detected life body, effectively sort life bodies, and more visually display features and states of life bodies behind a barrier block, so as to quickly sort rescue targets to provide reference to rescuers so the rescuers can firstly rescue targets in danger or special targets, valuable time can be saved for rescue.

title_en: A kind of strong reflection clutter removing method based on double source IR UWB bioradar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of strong reflection clutter removing method based on double source IR UWB bioradar, the antenna utilizing two kinds of different center frequency detects simultaneously, first pretreatment in the radar echo signal to two kinds of different frequencies carries out passage respectively, it is included in the accumulation of spatial domain enterprising row distance, be normalized in time domain, linear trend eliminates and low-pass filtering, realizes the enhancing of the faint life signal of human body；The most pretreated two kinds of different frequency radar echo signals are carried out interchannel process, uses the strong reflection noise jamming in self-adapting clutter technology for eliminating suppression radar return, thus improve the accuracy rate of radar detection.

title_en: UWB radar human motion micro-Doppler feature extracting method based on multichannel HHT
abstract_en: The invention discloses the UWB radar human motion micro-doppler extracting method based on multichannel HHT, comprise the following steps：Step 1, UWB radar signal is obtained；Step 2, the UWB radar signal that pretreatment is obtained；Step 3, effective channel selecting；Step 4, multichannel time-frequency spectrum is merged；The present invention puies forward micro-doppler Time-Frequency Analysis Method with higher time frequency resolution, and different part correspondence micro-Doppler feature compositions distinguish more obvious, can more embody the temporal characteristics and variations in detail of human motion；The present invention remains to capture obvious micro-Doppler feature in the case of carrying Time-Frequency Analysis Method strong antijamming capability, more remote through-wall detection, signal sharp-decay.The present invention, which puies forward Time-Frequency Analysis Method, has more preferable noise removal capability, and gained time-frequency spectrum signal to noise ratio is higher, and micro-Doppler feature composition is more obvious.

title_en: A kind of sparse imaging method of structure and device of MIMO through-wall radars
abstract_en: The present invention is suitable for through-wall radar imaging field, provides a kind of sparse imaging method of structure and device of MIMO through-wall radars.The method includes：Sparse transformation is carried out to the echo-signal of the extension target of MIMO through-wall radar array acquisitions, and builds the pseudorandom calculation matrix based on pseudorandom m-sequence and carries out compression sampling, and then builds perception matrix；It is expanded target scattering coefficient initial value according to rear orientation projection's imaging algorithm, and estimates the indexed set for orthogonal matching pursuit compressed sensing algorithm；According to Markov random field first order neighbors, transmittance process fully considers the structure sparse prior information between pixel one by one, obtains new indexed set；Then extension target scattering coefficient is recalculated, until meeting the condition of convergence, extension target scattering coefficient at this time is used for two-dimensional imaging.Piecemeal parameter need not be manually arranged in the present invention, and required memory space is small, reduces operand and system complexity, is easy to hardware realization.

title_en: The method for carrying out human body target positioning based on comentropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods for carrying out human body target positioning based on comentropy, firstly, radar sends electromagnetic wave signal, and receive the echo-signal reflected through human body；Then, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is done by the time signal to different distance point respectively, obtains the frequency spectrum of time signal in each range points；Comentropy mass spectrum database method is used again, is sought logarithm the bottom of by of e, is calculated the information entropy of different distance point signal spectrum signal；Finally, target exact position is positioned by choosing the smallest distance unit of information entropy, the echo-signal of distance unit where obtaining vital sign target.Compared with prior art, stronger to noise filtering ability, and constituents extraction precision is higher, have convenient for operation, the advantages of stability is good and high reliablity.
assignees: HUNAN SHUNHONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;CHANGSHA JUNMIN ADVANCED TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Health monitoring system and method for gymnasium bracelet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring and control, and discloses a health monitoring system and a method for a gymnasium bracelet, the system comprises a control center and a bracelet information acquisition end which are in signal connection with each other through a communication module, the bracelet information acquisition end consists of a sensor and a processor, the sensor is connected with the processor, the sensor detects vital sign information of a sporter during sports, the processor receives the vital sign information of the sporter during sports detected by the sensor, compares, analyzes and processes the sports vital sign data of the sporter stored in the control center, judges whether the sporter exceeds a sports vital sign data safety threshold value, judges whether the sporter continues to move and gives an alarm, the alarm information is output by the processor, and the control center receives the alarm information sent by the processor, the invention comprehensively monitors the vital sign information of the sporter during sports in the gymnasium, and the monitoring center can be informed to process abnormal conditions in time when abnormal conditions occur in the vital sign information of the sporter, so that accidents are prevented.
assignees: SICHUAN HUAYOU ENTERPRISE MAN SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring and controlling system and method based on microwave radar
abstract_en: A vital sign intelligent monitoring control system and method based on microwave radar is characterized in that: the system comprises a Doppler human body life detection radar front end, an intelligent control end, a local control end and a remote end; the local control end comprises a controller and local hardware equipment, and the local hardware equipment comprises an intelligent home and a medical emergency system; and the intelligent control end identifies the original data acquired by the front end of the Doppler human body life detection radar and then generates human body life characteristic parameters and gesture commands. The invention carries out gesture command and human body respiration and heart rate detection based on the continuous wave radar, the front end of the Doppler radar has simple structure, the all-weather monitoring of the physiological state of the target human body is realized under the condition of no contact, and the radar electromagnetic wave technology is not influenced by the environment; the intelligent household appliance can realize the control switch and emergency help seeking of the intelligent household appliance, and can carry out voice or manual remote control.

title_en: Life detection radar system based on multi-domain multi-feature and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection radar system based on multi-domain multi-feature and deep learning, wherein the signal output end of a transceiving channel is respectively connected with the signal input end of a pre-pulse-pressure life body identification module and the signal input end of a pulse pressure preprocessing module, the signal output end of the pulse pressure preprocessing module is respectively connected with the signal input end of a post-pulse-pressure life body identification module and the signal input end of an imaging-based life body detection and positioning identification module, and the pre-pulse-pressure life body identification module, the post-pulse-pressure life body identification module and the imaging-based life body detection and positioning identification module are all connected with a sparse self-coding network and a logistic regression classifier. The invention is used for radar life detection, overcomes the outstanding problems of low identification efficiency and low accuracy rate caused by adopting a manually designed feature extraction method and only using a time-frequency joint domain as a feature extraction domain in the existing life detection radar target identification technology, and meets the practical requirements of rapid search and rescue of trapped people in disaster ruins such as earthquakes, landslides and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RES INST MEM;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Non-contact type accurate heart rate detection method based on 77GHz millimeter radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact type accurate heartbeat detection method based on a 77GHz millimeter wave radar. Firstly, the frequency shift caused by weak chest displacement caused by the beating of the heart of a human body is captured by adopting the principle of continuous wave Doppler radar sign detection, namely, the radar transmits T (t) to a subject through a transmitting terminal. Then the phase of the signal T (t) is modulated by the chest wall movement x (t) of the subject, and the reflected signal is captured by a radar receiving end; secondly, after the reflected signal passes through a low noise amplifier at the front end, a baseband signal is obtained, a quadrature mixer is adopted to demodulate the baseband signal, and after the baseband signal passes through a gain amplifier, a chest wall signal can be obtained through arc tangent demodulation and joint winding calculation; and finally, obtaining a digital signal x (t) by the chest wall analog signal through an analog-to-digital converter, and obtaining a heartbeat frequency spectrum result after the digital signal is processed and is subjected to a heartbeat signal extraction algorithm VMD and a heartbeat frequency spectrum estimation algorithm CZT at the PC end.

title_en: Top-mounted millimeter wave radar heartbeat and respiration detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a top-mounted millimeter wave radar heartbeat and respiration detection device which comprises a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a control circuit connected with the transmitting antenna and a base provided with the control circuit, wherein the base is arranged on a roof, the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna of the base face a detection target respectively.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN BAWEIJIUZHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sleep physiological information monitoring system based on sleep monitoring platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sleep monitoring, and discloses a sleep physiological information monitoring system based on a sleep monitoring platform, which comprises an electroencephalogram detector, a sleep mattress, a radar respiration detection device, a visualization device and a monitoring center; the electroencephalogram detector comprises an electroencephalogram acquisition module, a blood oxygen acquisition module, a forehead temperature acquisition module, a main control chip and a Bluetooth module. The beneficial effects are as follows: the invention provides a sleep physiological information monitoring system based on a sleep monitoring platform, which utilizes an electroencephalogram detector to collect electroencephalogram signals, blood oxygen concentration signals and forehead temperature signals, and utilizes a sleep mattress and a radar respiration detection device to synchronously monitor respiration heart rate signals. Compared with the prior art, the physiological data monitored in the invention is more comprehensive and more accurate, and more accurate data support is provided for subsequent treatment of sleep monitoring.
assignees: CHONGQING THE SEVENTH PEOPLES HOSPITAL;UNIV CHONGQING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for monitoring vital signs of an ultra-wideband biological radar, which relate to the technical field of monitoring vital signs of drivers and comprise the following steps of monitoring the drivers by transmitting short pulse signals by using the ultra-wideband biological radar; the method comprises the steps of filtering a monitoring signal to obtain a sign signal, extracting signal characteristics of the sign signal, grouping the signal characteristics based on different signal characteristics to obtain different characteristic groups, analyzing the relation between the signal characteristics and vital signs based on the different characteristic groups, and monitoring the vital signs of a driver based on the relation between the signal characteristics and the vital signs.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Training method of breath detection model, and breath detection method and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a breath detection model training method, a breath detection method and a breath detection device, which can be applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of sample echo signals of a sample object, wherein the sample echo signals are reflection signals of sample radar signals, the sample radar signals are used for detecting a target detection area of the sample object, the plurality of sample echo signals correspond to a plurality of detection positions in the target detection area, fusing signal attributes of the plurality of sample echo signals based on the detection positions corresponding to the sample echo signals to obtain sample attribute signals, and training an initial respiration detection model by utilizing the sample attribute signals to obtain a target respiration detection model.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Intelligent child vital sign acquisition system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical health monitoring, and discloses an intelligent child vital sign acquisition system, an intelligent child vital sign acquisition method and a storage medium, wherein the intelligent child vital sign acquisition system comprises a wearable patch device and a data processing system; the wearable patch device comprises a biocompatible adhesive layer, a multi-mode sensor integrated layer and a medical TPU packaging layer, and the data processing system comprises a micro control unit, an energy and communication unit, a hospital cloud server and a user mobile terminal. The method and the storage medium correspond to the system. The invention solves the technical problems of poor multi-parameter fusion capability, serious motion artifact interference and lack of skin safety monitoring and personalized early warning mechanisms of the existing child monitoring equipment, and realizes the integrated management of accurate acquisition of physiological parameters, real-time risk early warning and remote collaborative monitoring.
assignees: WOMEN AND CHILDRENS MEDICAL CENTER OF GUANGZHOU MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Method for controlling an wearable device and the wearable device thereof
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_en: Provided is a method for controlling a wearable device and a wearable device thereof. The method for controlling the wearable device includes the following steps: determining whether a sensor installed in the wearable device is activated or not; controlling an adherency control unit which enables to control the adherency between the sensor and a human body of a wearer based on an activation states of the sensor; and sensing a biological signal through the sensor.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스(wearable device)를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스가 제공된다. 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법은, 웨어러블 디바이스에 구비된 센서의 활성화 여부를 판단하는 단계와, 센서의 활성화 여부에 기초하여 센서와 착용자의 신체 간의 밀착도를 조절할 수 있는 밀착도 조절부를 제어하는 단계 및 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Determining penetrability of a barrier
abstract_en: A through-wall radar system includes a transceiver configured to receive and transmit multiple radar signals, each radar signal associated with a frequency that nominally passes through a barrier. The system includes a processor coupled to an electronic storage, the processor configured to sense a portion of a signal transmitted by the transceiver and analyze the sensed portion of the signal to determine a penetrability of a barrier. The system also includes an output configured to present a perceivable indicator related to the determined penetrability of the barrier.
assignees: CYTERRA CORP L 3 COMM;L3 COMMUNICATIONS CYTERRA CORP

title_en: Portable Penetrating Radar
abstract_en: Method and apparatus is a handheld ground penetrating radar which transmits radar pulses and acquires and processes received data for presentation on a display allowing a user to identify buried targets. Novel low cost approach to portable high-resolution light weight penetrating imaging. Method and apparatus for a portable penetrating radar incorporating a display depicting permittivity variation versus distance and time as the medium is scanned.

title_en: Sleep tracking and vital sign monitoring using low power radio waves
abstract_en: Various arrangements for performing radar-based measurement of vital signs. Waveform data may be received then filtered of data indicative of static objects to obtain motion-indicative waveform data. The motion-indicative waveform data may be analyzed to determine one or more frequencies of movement present within the motion-indicative waveform data. A spectral analysis may be performed on the motion-indicative waveform data to determine a spectral-analysis state of a monitored region. The spectral-analysis state of the monitored region may be determined to match a predefined spectral-analysis state during which vital sign monitoring is permitted. One or more vital signs of a monitored user present within the monitored region may be determined and output based on analyzing the motion-indicative waveform data.

title_en: Systems and methods for mapping manmade objects buried in subterranean surfaces using an unmanned aerial vehicle integrated with radar sensor equipment
abstract_en: An aerial vehicle system for mapping an object buried in a subterranean surface, the aerial vehicle system including an aerial vehicle, an electronic sensor, a processor, and a memory. The memory includes instructions, which when executed by the processor, cause the system to receive a first input data set by the electronic sensor, the first input data set based on an electromagnetic signal and geographic location data, generate a raw image based on the first input data set, and compare the raw image to a calibration data set, the calibration data set based on material calibration data. The material calibration data is based on unique spectral reflection patterns of an object in a controlled environment at predefined heights and subterranean conditions.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Terahertz Doppler radar-based long-distance life micro-motion signal detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a long-distance life micro-motion signal based on a terahertz Doppler radar, and particularly relates to the technical field of life micro-motion signal detection. The method comprises the steps of receiving four paths of life body reflected echo signals in real time through a terahertz Doppler radar, and digitizing the four paths of life body reflected echo signals through a multichannel digitizer; static clutter in the four-path living body reflection echo signals is restrained; inhibiting linear trend items in the four paths of life body reflection echo signals for filtering static clutter; the four paths of signals after static clutter filtering and linear trend restraining are respectively processed through complex signal demodulation and the like, and the result is processed through ensemble empirical mode decomposition to obtain a reconstructed vital sign signal; performing Fourier transform on the reconstructed vital sign signals to obtain signal spectrums; and suppressing harmonic components, and taking peaks in the frequency spectrum after in-band harmonic suppression as estimated values of respiratory frequency and heart rate respectively.

title_en: Life detection method and system based on radar signal processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection method and a system based on radar signal processing, which relate to the technical field of radar signal processing and comprise the steps of collecting radar echo signals of a target area, controlling a phased array radar transmitting antenna array to transmit orthogonal frequency division multiplexing double-frequency continuous wave radar signals, and inputting the processed radar echo signals into an orthogonal demodulation module for synchronous coherent demodulation to obtain baseband signals; the method comprises the steps of inputting feature vectors into a multi-task deep learning network integrating an attention mechanism to perform feature fusion and target recognition to obtain a second processing signal, obtaining a target feature frequency spectrum by calculating time-frequency distribution of the second processing signal, judging whether a living body exists in a target area according to time-varying characteristics and amplitude fluctuation rules of respiratory frequency components and heartbeat frequency components, calculating three-dimensional space coordinates of the living body by a multi-base station cooperative positioning algorithm if the living body exists in the target area, and outputting detection results containing the three-dimensional space coordinates and living body feature information.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using ground penetrating radar
Method and apparatus for image processing in ground penetratiang radar
title_ko: 지표면 투과영상 시스템 및 그 이미지 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground penetrating radar system (GPR) and a method of processing an image therefrom, more particularly, to a ground penetrating radar system and a method of processing an image therefrom for improving a performance of detecting a nearby object by compensating for a strength of a reflected signal according to an angle of the reflected signal when image-processing the signal reflected from an object near a surface. The ground penetrating radar system of the present invention includes a controller to generate a pulse; a transmitting antenna to receive and transmit the pulse generated from the controller; a receiving antenna to receive the signal reflected from a buried object after the transmitted pulse passes through a medium; an image signal processing unit to compensate for a strength of the reflected signal according to an incident angle of the reflected signal of the receiving antenna and generating a 2-dimensional image or a 3-dimensional image when image-processing the reflected signal received from the receiving antenna; and a display unit to display the generated 2-dimensional image or the 3-dimensional image on a display screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지표면 투과영상 시스템(GPR) 및 그 이미지 처리 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 표면에 근접한 물체에서 반사된 신호를 이미지 처리함에 있어서 각도에 따라 반사 신호의 강도를 보정함으로써 근접 물체의 감지 능력을 향상시키는 지표면 투과영상 시스템 및 그 이미지 처리 방법에 관한 것이다. 
  본 발명의 지표면 투과영상 시스템은 펄스를 발생시키는 제어장치; 제어장치에서 발생한 펄스를 수신하여 방사시키는 송신안테나; 방사된 펄스가 매질을 통과한 후 매설 물체에서 반사되어 들어오는 신호를 받아들이는 수신안테나; 수신 안테나로부터 수신된 반사 신호를 이미지 처리함에 있어서 수신 안테나의 반사 신호 수신 각도에 따라 반사 신호의 강도를 보정하여 2영상 또는 3차원 영상을 생성하는 이미지 신호 처리부; 및 생성된 2영상 또는 3차원 영상을 디스플레이 화면에 표시하는 표시부를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for monitoring vital signs of animal in shelter
title_ko: 보호시설 내 동물의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 보호시설 내 동물의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템은 보호시설 내에 설치되고, 상기 보호시설 내에 수용된 동물들 각각의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 생체 신호의 변화 추이 정보를 생성하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의해 생성된 상기 변화 추이 정보를 이용하여 수의사 단말기 및 동물 주인 단말기 중 적어도 하나에 상기 동물의 건강 상태와 관련한 위험성을 알람으로 경보하는 알람 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: Eco-friendly an ant nest device using seawater
title_ko: 해수를 이용한 친환경 개미집 침수장치
abstract_en: Provided is an eco-friendly ant nest flooding apparatus using seawater, which comprises: a boundary object having a predetermined height on the ground and disposed to surround a hole connected to an ant nest; a seawater storage device connected to an upper end of the boundary object and supplying seawater to an area set by the boundary object through an opening and closing hole; a control device controlling opening and closing of the opening and closing hole; a camera transmitting photographing data obtained by photographing the area to the control device; and a ground-penetrating radar (GPR) device irradiating electromagnetic waves to the ground and analyzing the received electromagnetic waves to determine characteristics of the ant nest below the ground, wherein the control device includes at least one processor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for analyzing the structure of an ant nest using ground-penetrating radar may be provided.
abstract_ko:
본원 발명의 지반 투시를 이용한 개미집 침수 장치는 지면 상에서 일정 높이를 가지며 개미집과 연결된 구멍을 둘러싸도록 배치되는 경계물; 상기 경계물의 상단과 연결되고, 개폐홀을 통해 상기 경계물에 의해 설정된 일 영역에 해수를 공급하는 해수 저장 장치; 상기 개폐홀의 개폐를 제어하는 제어 장치; 상기 일 영역을 촬영한 촬영 데이터를 상기 제어 장치에 전송하는 카메라; 및 상기 지면에 전자기파를 조사하고, 수신된 전자기파를 분석하여 상기 지면 아래의 상기 개미집의 특성을 결정하는 지반 투시 레이더(GPR) 장치를 포함하고, 상기 제어 장치는 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 상기 촬영 데이터를 제1 인공지능 모델에 입력하고, 상기 제1 인공지능 모델로부터 획득한 판단 결과에 기초하여 상기 카메라가 촬영한 개미가 외래종인지 여부를 판단할 수 있다. 
본원 발명의 실시로, 살충제에 포함된 유해 화학 물질의 사용을 줄여 토양 생태계를 보전할 수 있다. 
또한, 유해 외래종 개미를 해수로 제거하는 방법을 실용화하여 환경 및 토양 생태계의 파괴를 방지할 수 있다.
assignees: SHINIL ENG & CONSULTANT CO LTD;SHINIL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Implantable cardioverter defibrillator designed for use in a magnetic resonance imaging environment
abstract_en: An implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) includes a communication interface operable to receive a communication signal from an external programmer. With the ICD not being in the presence of an MRI field generated by an MRI scanner, a communication signal is sent precharging a high energy storage capacitor before the patient undergoes the MRI scan. The signal also switches the ICD into an MRI mode which turns off the ICD's sensing functions detecting a dangerous ventricular arrhythmia. An operator monitors the patient's vital signs with sensors connected to the patient. If the patient does require the defibrillation shock, the operator sends a second communication signal delivering the defibrillation shock from the precharged high energy storage capacitor of the ICD. The patient can then be removed from the MRI scanner and the RF and gradient fields of the MRI scanner turned off.

title_en: First responder dispatch system and methods of operation thereof
abstract_en: A first responder dispatch system is disclosed comprising a sensing wearable configured to be worn by a first responder. The sensing wearable can comprise a wrist-worn electronic device. The sensing wearable can comprise a plurality of biometric sensors configured to measure a plurality of vital signs of the first responder. The system can comprise a server programmed to receive biometric data concerning a plurality of vital signs of the first responder measured by the sensing wearable. The server can also transmit alerts to a plurality of dispatch client devices over a plurality of secured real-time bidirectional connections concerning a status of the first responder. At least one dispatch client device can transmit a response to the server and the server can, in turn, transmit additional biometric data concerning the first responder to the dispatch client device.

title_en: A kind of life detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of life detection and rescue robot, including pedestal, electric machine stand and storing bin, the impact faces end set has the electric machine stand, servomotor is provided with the electric machine stand, the servomotor end set has rotating shaft, the roller end is provided with transmission belt wheel set, and the transmission belt wheel set end set has drive shaft.Beneficial effect is：The present apparatus carries out infrared imaging to rescue environment by infrared induction camera and infrared imaging device and finds captive to detect life, and captive is moved to carry out trajectory calculation rear drive equipment to image-forming information by cascade algorithm processor, and the accurate location information of captive is received by gps signal receivers and sent by wireless signal to external device to be rescued, the relief supplies that captive can be taken off in storage bin are simply saved oneself, it instead of traditional artificial search and rescue mode, search efficiency is improved, has ensured the promptness of rescue.

title_en: A kind of radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of radar life-detection instrument, it comprises wireless detector and PDA (1), wireless detector comprises receiving unit and radiating portion, receiving unit comprises the receiving antenna (2) of several, receiving antenna (2) passes through filtering circuit successively, the low noise amplifying circuit is connected with the signal input part of baseband signal processor (4) with down conversion module (3) back, baseband signal processor (4) output terminal I is connected with the system master part, baseband module scrambler input end in the signal input part of baseband signal processor (4) and the baseband signal processor (4) is connected, baseband module scrambler output terminal is connected with filtering circuit in turn, modulation module, up-conversion module (5), power amplifier is connected with emitting antenna (6), and emitting antenna (6) is wireless connections with PDA (1).The present invention not only can detect trapped personnel quickly and easily, and the accuracy height of surveying.

title_en: Laying method of long distance coal conveying pipeline at debris flow gully section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline laying method and particularly relates to a laying method of a long distance coal conveying pipeline at a debris flow gully section. The laying method includes the following steps: 1) a pipe ditch on a coal paste laying line is dug to the bed rock, and width of the pipe ditch is two times of that of a designed pipe ditch; 2) a pipe ditch is dug on the bed rock, and depth and width of the pipe ditch meet requirements of pipeline laying; and 3) when the pipeline is laid well, prevention measures of flood drainage and flow guidance are performed on the section so as to reduce damage of debris flow on the coal conveying pipeline. Due to the fact that the pipeline is buried deeply, the pipeline is arranged in the bed rock with underlaying stability, the risk that the pipeline is damaged by the debris flow in a debris flow season is reduced, the top of the pipeline is buried under the frost line, and thermal insulation performance of the pipeline is improved.
assignees: WUHAN DESIGN & RES INST CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP

title_en: Method for distinguishing position of rockburst risk on deep buried tunnel section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing the position of a rockburst risk on a deep buried tunnel section. The method comprises the following steps: A, performing numerical simulation analysis according to the shape of a section, engineering geology, conditions of initial ground stress and an excavation method before tunnel excavation, to be specific, a, performing indoor rock mechanics experiments and parametric inversion; b, confirming a three-dimensional initial ground stress field; c, constructing a geometrical model for three-dimensional numerical calculation according to stratigraphic distribution, geologic construction and the size of the tunnel section; d, implementing numerical calculation and analysis of a tunnel excavation process for the geometrical model; e, analyzing the distributed situation of the local energy release rate on the tunnel section; B, monitoring slight shock in a real-time mode in the tunnel excavation process, to be specific, 1, mounting a sensor at the rear part of a tunnel face; 2, collecting slight shock signals in the process of the micro fracture of rock mass to invert the occurrence position of the micro fracture of surrounding rocks; 3, analyzing the projection distribution of micro fracture events on the tunnel section; C, performing comprehensive evaluation on the distinguished occurrence positions of the rockburst risk. Through the adoption of the method, the occurrence of rockburst disasters is reduced or avoided, and the construction safety and the construction progress are ensured.
assignees: INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Fire detection rescue mode and system based on millimetre-wave radar technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire rescue fields, disclose a kind of method and system based on the fire detection of millimeter microwave Radar Technology and emergency management and rescue, this method provides a kind of based on millimetre-wave radar personnel statistical method, human body target vital signs detection method, millimetre-wave radar Detection Techniques, computer storage medium, smoke alarm and its fire rescue system, end control centre, which is waken up, by smog warning system sends warning information to background data center, or timing wake-up terminal control center, signal emission module by controlling millimeter microwave emits millimeter microwave signal, then obtain reflection echo signal, millimeter microwave area of coverage human body target quantity and track are determined according to echo information, the corresponding data of each human body target is transmitted to background data center, to fire occur when can be accurately positioned out rescue target position and its Vital signs provides fast and accurately rescue scenario for rescue, reduces human loss, reduce the danger coefficient of rescue.

title_en: Trapped person position calculation method based on CFD (computational fluid dynamics) adjoint probability method
abstract_en: A trapped person position calculation method based on a CFD adjoint probability method comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a loose porous medium type ruin simplified physical model; step 2, obtaining a steady-state flow field through CFD forward simulation; step 3, collecting monitoring information of monitoring points of the sensor; step 4, solving a CFD-based adjoint equation for each monitoring alarm position to obtain a standard reverse position probability; step 5, solving a joint position probability equation to obtain a joint reverse position probability; step 6, solving a conditional reverse position probability equation and a multiple conditional reverse position probability equation to obtain a conditional reverse position probability; step 7 identifies the source location from the reverse location probability distribution. According to the method, the vital sign representative gas collected along the path of the monitoring point of the sensor by the instantaneous time sequence is combined, the collected data is analyzed by the cascaded large-scale monitoring point of the sensor, and the search and rescue workers track and trace the source by the gas inversion theory to judge the condition and the approximate position of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method and system, terminal device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar imaging method, a through-wall radar imaging system, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring radar echo data in a preset radar detection scene, and discretizing an imaging scene in the preset radar detection scene; constructing a dictionary matrix according to the discretization result of the imaging scene, and constructing a low-rank sparse signal model according to the dictionary matrix; determining a low-rank sparse optimization problem in a low-rank sparse signal model, and constructing a through-wall radar imaging model according to the determined low-rank sparse optimization problem; and performing model training on the through-wall radar imaging model until the through-wall radar imaging model converges, and inputting the echo data to be imaged into the converged through-wall radar imaging model for imaging analysis to obtain a reconstructed image. The method converts the problems of clutter suppression and target image reconstruction of the wall body into the problem of solving low-rank sparse optimization, effectively suppresses the reflection clutter of the wall body, and improves the imaging quality of the reconstructed image.

title_en: Earthquake monitor
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a seismic monitor. This earthquake monitor includes that the earthquake monitor includes power DC, computer control computer display terminal and a plurality of position sensing subassembly, and a plurality of position sensing subassembly are placed respectively in different positions, and sensing subassembly is connected and power DC connects with computer control computer display terminal, and sensing subassembly includes: receiving sensor LMIC, resistor R1, resistor R2, integrated chip IC1, capacitor C2. The implementation mode adopts the infrasound and electromagnetic synchronous receiving principle and the chip processing technology to monitor the earthquake infrasound and electromagnetic wave signals, so that the seismograph is not required to be buried underground, is not limited by high floors, does not need to set points for scanning and receiving the earthquake waves in any direction, reduces the waste of manpower, material resources and resources, is a comprehensive instrument, monitors the earthquake display technology in advance in the whole world, solves the unpredictable problem of earthquake, predicts and monitors the earthquake in advance, and achieves the aims of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction.
assignees: BEIJING WEIDIAN YUNXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Maritime disaster prevention system
title_ko: 해상 조난사고 예방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing maritime distress, and more specifically, to a system for preventing maritime distress, which automatically stops the screw of a ship in emergency and at the same time, sends an emergency rescue request signal through an inter-ship communication network and a control center communication network when a marine accident (death due to loss of footing) occurs, thereby maximizing the probability of survival of crew on board during navigation. To achieve the purpose, the present invention provides the system for preventing maritime distress comprising: a biometric sensor device mounted on essential equipment of the crew and including a biometric signal measuring unit measuring biometric signals of the crew and a first transmitting unit transmitting, to a remote control server unit, a biometric signal measured by the biometric signal measuring unit through wireless communications; and the remote control server unit provided in the ship and including a biometric signal receiving unit receiving a signal transmitted from the biometric sensor device, a screw control unit emergently stopping the screw being driven, and a second transmitting unit transmitting an urgent rescue request signal to a neighboring ship and a control center through wireless communications. When the biometric sensor device and the remote control server unit are out of a predetermined section, a contact signal is lost, and the communication is terminated for a predetermined period of time, the system considers the termination as an accident due to loss of footing such that the screw control unit automatically and emergently stops the screw being driven, and simultaneously, the second transmitting unit transmits the urgent rescue request signal through the inter-ship communication network and the control center communication network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해상 조난사고 예방 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 해상에서 사고발생(실족사)시 자동으로 선박의 스크류를 비상정지시킴과 동시에 긴급구조요청 신호를 선박 간 통신망 및 관제센터 통신망으로 송신하므로 선박에 승선한 선원들이 항해 중 생존확률을 극대화할 수 있는 해상 조난사고 예방 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 목적 달성을 위한 본 발명은 선원의 필수장비에 장착되며, 상기 선원의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 측정부와, 상기 생체신호 측정부에서 측정된 생체신호를 무선통신을 통해 원격 관제 서버부로 송신하는 제1 송신부를 포함하는 생체인식센서장치; 및 선박에 구비되며, 상기 생체인식센서장치로부터 송신되는 신호를 수신하는 생체신호 수신부와, 구동 중인 스크류를 비상정지시키는 스크류 제어부와, 인근 선박 및 관제센터에 무선통신을 통해 긴급구조요청 신호를 송신하는 제2 송신부를 포함하는 원격 관제 서버부;를 포함하되, 상기 생체인식센서장치와 원격 관제 서버부가 일정구간을 벗어나 접점신호가 상실되어 기설정된 일정기간 동안 통신이 두절되면 실족사고로 간주하여 자동으로 스크류 제어부가 구동되고 있는 스크류를 비상정지시킴과 동시에 제2 송신부가 긴급구조요청 신호를 선박 간 통신망 및 관제센터 통신망으로 송신하는 해상 조난사고 예방시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling smart health care mattress
title_ko: 환자 특정이 가능한 스마트 병실용 침대 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart hospital bed monitoring system capable of specifying a patient. The bed monitoring system comprises: a hospital bed; an RFID tag storing preset unique tag identification information; a plurality of RFID readers mounted on one side of the hospital bed; at least one radar sensor device mounted on one side of the hospital bed; a radar control device; and a patient management server connected to the radar control device through a communication network. Therefore, the bed monitoring system can efficiently collect and monitor only bio-signal data of a corresponding patient by specifying the patient.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환자 특정이 가능한 스마트 병실용 침대 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 환자가 누울 수 있도록 구비되는 병실용 침대와, 해당 환자가 소지할 수 있도록 구비되며, 기 설정된 고유한 태그식별정보를 저장하는 RFID 태그와, 병실용 침대의 일측에 장착되며, RFID 태그의 정보를 RFID 방식으로 인식하고, 인식된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보를 전송하는 복수개의 RFID 리더기들과, 병실용 침대의 일측에 장착되며, 적어도 하나의 레이더를 이용하여 병실용 침대 상에 존재하는 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 비접촉식으로 검출하는 적어도 하나의 레이더 센서장치와, 복수개의 RFID 리더기들 중 전파가 수신되고 있는 RFID 리더기의 방향으로 빔포밍 방식을 이용하여 레이더 신호가 송출되도록 레이더 센서장치의 동작을 제어하고, 전파가 수신되고 있는 RFID 리더기로부터 인식된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보와 함께 레이더 센서장치로부터 검출된 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 수집 및 전송하는 레이더 제어장치와, 레이더 제어장치와 통신망을 통해 연결되며, 레이더 제어장치로부터 전송된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보와 함께 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 해당 환자의 재실/부재, 수면, 체위, 호흡, 심박, 움직임, 또는 거리 상태 중 적어도 하나의 환자 상태정보를 실시간 분석 및 환자 상태 통합 모니터링을 수행하는 환자 관리서버를 포함함으로써, 불필요한 생체신호 데이터가 섞이는 경우를 최소화할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 환자를 특정하여 해당 환자의 생체신호 데이터만을 효율적으로 수집 및 모니터링 할 수 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Mitigation of Random Body Movement and Interference Effects in Radar-Based Vital Signs Monitoring Systems in Medical Applications
abstract_en: A radar system for vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing and a method for mitigating random body movement and external interference effects in vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing by employing a radar system that is configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external interference affecting vital signs monitoring is at least mitigated by decomposing and filtering a reconstructed displacement signal using a time and frequency analysis technique such as Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. This decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency basis components containing the random body movement interference. Hence, the filtered signal can be reconstructed after removing the random body movement components, thus enabling reliable and robust vital-signs parameter estimation.

title_en: Through-wall radar sensors networked together to create 2d and 3d combined views of an area
abstract_en: Systems and methods for networking together through-wall radar sensors to generate a combined image based on signal data from the networked through-wall radar sensors. The system includes a first through-wall radar sensor and a second through-wall radar sensor. The second through-wall radar sensor is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor. The system includes a display of an area, wherein the display of the area is based on data from the first through-wall radar sensor combined with data from the second through- wall radar sensor. The system may include a first communication device connected to the first through-wall radar sensor and a second communication device connected to the second through-wall radar sensor. A controller is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor and the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a plurality of through- wall radar sensors networked together to provide a two-dimensional or a three-dimensional image of an area.

title_en: Dynamic millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign dynamic detection method based on a minimum mean square error criterion. The method comprises the steps of firstly, preprocessing intermediate frequency signals of human body information detected by a radar, and reducing background noise and radar emission leakage interference; then, carrying out speed priori detection on the target, determining that the human body belongs to a resting state or a motion state, and verifying and compensating a distance unit occupied by the human body through the obtained speed value after the motion state is obtained; after obtaining an accurate distance unit, positioning human random motion through continuous wavelet transformation and restraining the random motion through moving average filter attenuation to obtain an original chest waveform; finally, an optimized filter based on a mean square error criterion is adopted to extract the human respiration and heartbeat signals. The invention can accurately measure the resting or moving human vital signs in a single detection, and ensure that the radar can accurately acquire vital sign information while the human body freely moves in a non-contact state.

title_en: Radar high-precision heart rate detection method based on fitting matched filtering and Double-CZT
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar high-precision heart rate detection method based on fitting matched filtering and Double-CZT. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an intermediate frequency signal data matrix containing target human body respiratory heartbeat signals by adopting a millimeter wave radar life detection system, secondly preprocessing the intermediate frequency signal data matrix to obtain unwrapped signals and preprocessed signals, thirdly, fitting the unwrapped signals by using smooth splines to obtain template signals, then convolving the template signals with the preprocessed signals, wherein convolution results are output results of matched filtering, fourthly, extracting variation of the output results of the matched filtering to obtain heartbeat signals, and fifthly, performing heart rate estimation on the obtained heartbeat signals by using bilinear frequency modulation Z conversion (Double-CZT). The invention has high measurement accuracy and high stability, and is easy for real-time detection of heart rate and engineering realization.

title_en: Outlet box
title_ko: 공동주택의 실내벽면에 매설되는 전기콘센트박스
abstract_en: An outlet box buried in an inner wall surface of an apartment is provided to employ a housing, an outlet, an opening part, a pinion gear, the first motor, a screw axis, the second motor, a switch, the first load sensor, the second load sensor, and a controller, thereby preventing a conductor or impurities from being inserted into the outlet or piled into the outlet.
