A housing has an opening part at a front surface and an internal space. An outlet is mounted in the housing movably forward and backward. The outlet includes a body provided with a protrusion protruding forward through the opening part of the housing, in which the protrusion includes a plug connection recess having a leg insertion hole in the lower portion of the body. The outlet includes an electrode installed in the body, is connected to an external power source, and is stuck to a leg inserted into the leg insertion hole(21a2) to apply power to the leg. An opening panel has an embossed part having a rack shape, and is vertically slid inside the housing to open the opening part. A pinion gear vertically moves the opening panel in the engagement with the embossed part of the opening panel. A guide guides the left and right movement of the opening panel. The first motor rotates the pinion gear. A screw axis passes through the outlet. The second motor is coupled to the screw axis. A switch is installed at the front side of the housing. The first load sensor detects the load of the first motor. The second load sensor detects the load of the second motor. A controller controls the operation of the first and second motors according to signals of the first and second load sensors and the switch.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 실내벽면에 매설되는 전기콘센트박스에 관한 것으로, 레그가 구비된 플러그를 꽂아 전원을 공급할 수 있도록 된 벽체매설형 전기배전단자함에 있어서, 전면일측에 개구부(11)가 구비되고, 내부에 공간이 형성된 하우징(10) ; 하우징의 내부에 전후진가능하게 장착되고 전면에는 전진시 상기 개구부를 통해 전방으로 돌출되는 돌부(P)가 구비되며 돌부(P)에는 내부 저면에 레그삽입홀(21a2)을 갖는 플러그연결홈(21a)이 형성된 본체(21)와, 본체(21)에 내설되어 외부전원에 연결되며 레그삽입홀(21a2)에 삽입된 레그와 밀착되어 전원을 인가하는 전극을 포함하는 콘센트(20) ; 상부에 랙 형상의 요철부(31)가 형성되며, 하우징(10)의 내부에 측방향으로 슬라이드되어 개구부(11)를 개폐하도록 장착된 개폐부재(30) ; 개폐부재(30)의 요철부(31)와 연동하여 개폐부재(30)를 측방향으로 이동시키는 피니언기어(40) ; 피니언기어(40)를 회전시키는 제1모터(50) ; 콘센트(20)를 전후방으로 관통하도록 나사결합된 나사축(60) ; 나사축(70)에 연결된 제2모터(70) ; 하우징(10)의 전면에 설치되는 스위치(80) ; 제1모터(50)의 부하를 감지하는 제1부하감지센서(90) ; 제2모터(70)의 부하를 감지하는 제2부하감지센서(100) ; 스위치(80)와 제1 및 제2부하감지센서(90,100)의 신호에 따라 제1모터(50)와 제2모터(70)를 작동제어하는 제어부(110)를 갖추고서 벽체에 매설되어, 콘센트(20)의 플러그연결홈(21a)로의 전도체 삽입으로 인한 감전사고 및, 이물질이 플러그연결홈(21a)에 쌓여 발생할 수 있는 화재사고를 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: workers healthcare monitoring method using biological signals based safety menagement woking clothes
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 모니터링 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 모니터링 방법은 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)에 구비된 생체신호용 센서(130)를 통해 감지된 신호를 서버(200)의 웹 서비스(210)에 전송하는 단계; 상기 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 삽입 또는 삭제를 서버(200)의 데이터베이스(220)에 요청하거나, 또는 알고리즘 저장을 서버의 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)(HDFS, Hadoop Distributed File System)에 요청하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 알고리즘 저장 요청시 알고리즘을 저장하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 저장된 알고리즘을 실행하기 위해 알고리즘을 웹 서비스(210)로 전송하는 단계; 상기 알고리즘을 수신한 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 검색 및 적용한 후, 적용된 데이터를 검색하여 SOAP(Simple Object Access Protocol) 메시지를 출력장치에 보내는 단계; 상기 출력장치를 통해 화면을 출력하는 단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 모니터링 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting body component
title_ko: 체내 성분 검출 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 체내성분 검출장치의 일 실시예는 피검체와 접촉되어 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 생체신호에서, AC성분의 진폭이 최대가 되는 시점 또는 DC성분의 기울기가 최대가 되는 시점을 포함하는, 국부혈압의 영향이 최소가 되는 시점을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 시점을 기초로 체내성분을 검출하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, device, and system for detecting an occupant
title_ko: 승객 탐지 방법, 승객 탐지 장치, 및 승객 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a passenger detecting method, a passenger detecting apparatus, and a passenger detecting system. The passenger detecting method according to one embodiment of the present application comprises the following steps of: acquiring sensor data; obtaining class information related to a status of a seat of a vehicle from the sensor data through a learned classification model; sensing a biosignal by analyzing the sensor data; sensing movement by analyzing the sensor data; and determining whether to board a passenger based on the class information, a sensing result of the biosignal, and a sensing result of the movement.
abstract_ko: 본 출원의 일 실시예에 따른 승객 탐지 방법은, 센서 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 학습이 완료된 분류 모델(classification model)을 통하여, 상기 센서 데이터로부터 상기 차량의 좌석의 상태(status)와 관련된 클래스 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 센서 데이터를 분석하여 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계; 상기 센서 데이터를 분석하여 움직임을 감지하는 단계; 및 상기 클래스 정보, 생체 신호의 감지 결과, 및 움직임의 감지 결과에 기초하여 승객 탑승 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire engine operation place of ascending a height
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire fighting truck ascending operation site, which comprises a turf, planting soil, grass planting grids, a plain soil layer, a gravel cushion layer and a base layer which are arranged from top to bottom in sequence; planting soil is paved in the grass planting grids, the thickness of the planting soil is higher than that of the grass planting grids, an anti-seepage film is paved on the base layer, the gravel cushion layer is positioned on the anti-seepage film, a drainage blind pipe is buried at the bottom end of the gravel cushion layer, and the drainage blind pipe is communicated with a water tank positioned in the gravel cushion layer; the inside soil moisture sensor that is equipped with of planting soil, be equipped with in the water tank and pierce through the turf, planting soil, plant the grass check, plain soil layer, be equipped with the water pump on the spray pipe and the spray pipe of rubble bed course, the outside cover of water pump has the protective housing, through being equipped with drainage blind pipe and water tank, be equipped with the prevention of seepage membrane in the basic unit, can retrieve the water of rubble bed course, when needs irrigate the turf, utilize the water pump to draw water from the water tank, irrigate the turf, realize the reuse to water, save the water resource.

title_en: Opening and closing mechanism based on display unit in fire mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opening and closing mechanism based on a display unit in a fire mask, which belongs to the technical field of fire masks. The opening and closing mechanism can control the display device to be far away from or close to the front of the eyes of the firefighter, and when the display device is not needed in front of the eyes of the firefighter, the normal sight of the firefighter is prevented from being disturbed; when the display device is needed in front of the fire fighter, the infrared image, vital signs of the fire fighter, position information, temperature information and the like can be displayed on the fire scene.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGHANG DISPLAY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried type ground disaster monitoring device capable of guaranteeing timely reaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried type ground disaster monitoring device capable of guaranteeing timely reaction, which comprises a mounting plate, a storage battery body, a data receiving and sending device, a central processing unit and a double-shaft driving device, wherein a buried pipe is welded on the lower side of an opening in the middle of the mounting plate, a supporting pipe is mounted on the upper side of the opening in the middle of the mounting plate through a bolt, a photovoltaic plate body is mounted on the inner side of the mounting frame, the storage battery body is arranged on the inner side wall of the lower end of the supporting pipe, a microseismic sensor is arranged below the central processing unit, the double-shaft driving device is mounted inside the upper end of the mounting frame through a bolt, and a movable frame is. This can guarantee to react bury formula ground disaster monitoring device in time has solved the photovoltaic board clearance problem, guarantees the cleanliness factor of photovoltaic board, makes the photovoltaic board be in good operating condition, guarantees battery power storage, ensures that equipment is in charged state all the time, can real-time supervision.
assignees: SURVEY INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY OF CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Wall clutter suppression method based on SVD iteration entropy value
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wall clutter suppression method based on SVD iteration entropy, belonging to the technical field of microwave imaging; the method comprises the following steps of firstly, carrying out singular value decomposition on an echo received by a through-wall radar, and estimating a first singular value as a singular value set representing a wall subspace; then removing wall echo signals by a subspace projection method, calculating and storing an entropy value at the moment; adding one to the singular value set representing the wall subspace, and repeating the steps until the iteration of all the singular value intervals is finished; finding the minimum entropy value in the entropy value set, wherein the singular value set under the entropy value represents a wall subspace; and finally, filtering the wall subspace and the estimated noise subspace, and obtaining the through-wall radar image through a BP imaging algorithm. The algorithm provided by the invention has a good wall clutter suppression effect aiming at different wall thicknesses and wall relative dielectric constants, and can effectively improve the quality of images.

title_en: Management control system based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, which comprises the following steps: step one: building a rescue mechanical group comprising a high-altitude search and rescue unmanned plane and a ground search and rescue crawler; step two: the unmanned aerial vehicle for high-altitude search and rescue utilizes multiple sensors to collect regional data and search vital signs in geological disasters; step three: the ground search and rescue crawler judges and selects a overcoming mode or a avoidance mode based on the detected obstacle; step four: the unmanned aerial vehicle for high-altitude search and rescue contacts with the ground search and rescue crawler by using the intelligent sensing system to perform combined search and rescue management control through the butt joint of the two search and rescue modes of flight and crawling; the invention discloses a rescue mechanical group comprising a high-altitude rescue unmanned plane and a ground rescue crawler, which is characterized in that the rescue mechanical group is butted with multiple rescue modes by using an intelligent sensing system to contact the ground rescue crawler to quickly reach a rescue place through the butt joint of two rescue modes, namely flying and crawling.

title_en: Continuous identity recognition system based on millimeter wave perception heart characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous identity recognition system based on millimeter wave radar sensing heart characteristics, which comprises a control module, a millimeter wave radar sensing module, a heart motion signal extraction module and an identity recognition module. The system avoids the problems of privacy invasiveness, easiness in forging, low availability and the like faced by the existing biological characteristic-based identity recognition system to a certain extent; the continuous identity recognition mechanism is used, so that the system safety is enhanced; the non-contact vital sign sensing method based on the millimeter wave radar can collect heart motion signals which are not easy to forge or steal under the condition of protecting the privacy of users, and improves the usability of the recognition system. The invention has a certain novelty and can be used as an identity recognition solution in an intelligent interconnection scene.

title_en: Human body existence induction detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body existence induction detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar, comprising the following steps: modeling human body vital signs; the monitoring radar transmits a transmission signal of the linear frequency modulation continuous wave into the monitoring area, and simultaneously continuously captures an echo signal reflected by a human body; analyzing a transmitting signal, an echo signal and a beating signal of the radar, and extracting human body vital sign data; checking vital sign information in real time; and separating the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal, and respectively carrying out frequency calculation on the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal. According to the invention, the human body vital sign signal is measured by measuring the relative frequency relation between the received signal and the transmitted signal, so that the real-time performance and accuracy of human body vital sign signal detection are improved; the data of the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal are extracted through confidence parameters based on FFT, autocorrelation and spectrum estimation of peak intervals, so that the accuracy of sensing detection of human existence is greatly improved.

title_en: Breathing and heartbeat detection method based on ultra-wideband radar CIR
abstract_en: The invention provides a respiration and heartbeat detection method based on an ultra-wideband radar CIR, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original signal of respiration and heartbeat signals, wherein the original signal is a first signal, and preprocessing the first signal to obtain a second signal; performing fast fourier transform on real and imaginary signals on a range gate within a buffer window of the first signal, respectively; when the signal-to-noise ratio of the real part or the imaginary part of the continuous 3 distance gates in the frequency domain is higher than a first threshold, the frequency domain judgment is passed, and when the frequency domain judgment is continuously passed for 3 times, the time domain judgment is carried out; when the value obtained by dividing the number of effective half periods by the number of half periods exceeds a preset threshold value, the time domain detection is considered to pass, and a respiratory signal is detected; when the respiration signal is detected, the second signal is time-domain detected to detect a heartbeat signal. According to the respiration and heartbeat detection method based on the ultra-wideband radar CIR, which is provided by the invention, the respiration and heartbeat signals can be accurately detected based on the fast Fourier transform and time signal characteristic statistics.
assignees: CHANGSHA CHIXIN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for enhancing through-wall radar signal of human body movement
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for enhancing a through-wall radar signal of human body movement, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a through-wall spectrogram to be enhanced; and inputting the through-wall spectrogram to be enhanced into a generator in a spectrogram processing-based network model to obtain an enhanced through-wall spectrogram so as to monitor human body movement. The training method of the network model comprises the steps of training a pre-training model through a free space spectrogram and a corresponding free space turning spectrogram in a data set, inputting a through-wall spectrogram into a generator to obtain a corresponding enhanced through-wall spectrogram, inputting the enhanced through-wall spectrogram and a non-paired free space spectrogram into the trained pre-training model to respectively obtain a corresponding channel dimension autocorrelation matrix, inputting the enhanced through-wall spectrogram and the non-paired free space spectrogram into a discriminator to obtain a discrimination result, constructing a loss function to optimize the generator and the discriminator, enabling the generator to carry out signal enhancement, and improving the accuracy of downstream semantic recognition.

title_en: A method and system for monitoring vital signs of an infant
abstract_en: An infant monitoring system combines an infant soother having a sensor for detecting the location or sucking motion of the soother and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. The vital signs sensor output is interpreted taking account of the sensing of the soother. In this way, it can be prevented that a soother sucking motion is incorrectly interpreted as a different vital signs measurement (such as heart rate or respiration rate) or otherwise corrupts the vital signs measurement.

title_en: Non-contact fatigue detection method and system
abstract_en: Disclosed are a non-contact fatigue detection method and system. The method comprises: sending a millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar signal to a person being detected, receiving an echo signal reflected from the person, and determining a time-frequency domain feature, a non-linear feature and a time-series feature of a vital sign signal; acquiring a facial video image of the person, and performing facial detection and alignment on the basis of the facial video image, for extracting a time domain feature and a spatial domain feature of the person's face; fusing the determined vital sign signal with the time domain feature and the spatial domain feature of the person's face, for obtaining a fused feature; and determining whether the person is in a fatigued state by the fused feature. By fusing the two detection techniques, the method effectively suppressing the interference of subjective and objective factors, and improving the accuracy of fatigue detection.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to techniques for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection in analog domain. Proposed methods and apparatus are able to measure an impedance of human body based on sub-Nyquist sampling of signals. The proposed techniques can be particularly beneficial for reducing overall sensor power when an actuation signal generates electrical signals corresponding to vital signs in humans.
assignees: QUALCOMM INC;GARUDADRI HARINATH;BAHETI PAWAN KUMAR;MAJUMDAR SOMDEB

title_en: Imaging method and system based on through-wall radar clutter suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to an imaging method and system based on through-the-wall radar clutter suppression, comprising the following steps: acquiring an original echo signal received by a through-wall radar; imaging the original echo signal to determine an original image; determining discrete coefficients of pixel vectors of the original image according to the original image; sorting the pixel vectors of the original image according to the discrete coefficients to obtain the sorted pixel vectors; determining a stepping length according to the original image; determining a pixel elimination proportion according to the stepping length; determining a first elimination ratio by using the sorted pixel vectors and the pixel elimination ratio; determining a second elimination proportion according to the first elimination proportion and the pixel elimination proportion; and reproducing according to the pixel value corresponding to the second elimination proportion to obtain an imaging result. The method and the system provided by the invention improve the imaging quality by improving the inhibition effect of clutter and background pixel vectors.

title_en: Disaster area personnel rescue method and system based on tilt rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of airplane general technology, in particular to a disaster area personnel rescue method and a disaster area personnel rescue system based on a tilt rotor aircraft, wherein the system comprises the tilt rotor aircraft, an airborne communication base station, a aerial survey CCD camera, a synthetic aperture radar, a photoelectric ball head and a plurality of quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles are loaded on the tilt rotor aircraft, and cameras, life detection instruments, voice communication recognition devices and portable material bags are all assembled on the quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles; the method combines the identification of suspect areas, identification of key search and rescue areas, and targeted rescue of quad-rotor drones. By the aid of the rescue method and the rescue system, the problems of untimely rescue and low efficiency can be effectively solved.

title_en: Full-flow management method and system for non-contact microwave monitoring physiological parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-flow management method and a full-flow management system for non-contact microwave monitoring physiological parameters, which are characterized in that microwave signals of physiological parameters of a user are collected, and the microwave signals are preprocessed and subjected to feature extraction processing to obtain vital sign parameters of a human body; the method comprises the steps of wirelessly transmitting human vital sign parameters to a terminal of a user or a nurse station to evaluate the human vital sign parameters, comparing an evaluation result with a health rule base to generate corresponding health suggestions and pushing the health suggestions to the user terminal, analyzing the human vital sign parameters in the terminal through a pre-training model when the user is in a night sleep state, judging whether the user is in an abnormal breathing state according to an analysis result, if so, sending a control instruction to a sickbed corresponding to the user to control the sickbed to execute angle adjustment operation, and particularly, realizing real-time response and intervention on the health state of the patient through a complete flow management method of collecting the vital sign, judging the state and performing linkage intervention.

title_en: Method and device for determining a kind of land mind based on various characteristics
title_ko: 다특성 기반의 지뢰 분류 결정 방법 및 이를 적용한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mine classification apparatus capable of accurately classifying mines regardless of mine type and condition of soil in which mines are buried. Provided is a mine classification method based on multi-characteristic including: a buried mine recognition step (S21) for receiving a mine refection signal from at least one buried mine buried under the ground through ground penetrating radar; a buried mine analysis step (S22) for analyzing the mine reflection signal by a main component analysis method and discrete frequency conversion and obtaining eigenvalue for each buried mine and mine characteristic data with frequency coefficient; and a buried mine detection step (S23) for presenting the eigenvalue and the frequency coefficient on a graph with respect to each X-axis and Y-axis on a basis of the mine characteristic data and obtaining mine classification data recognizing the buried mine by applying a likelihood ratio test method. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S31) Input data detected by a ground penetrating radar; (S32) Equalization for removing effect of ground; (S33) Extracting feature through a main component analysis method; (S34) Extracting feature through a discrete frequency transformation method; (S35) Recognization and classification through likelihood ratio testing method; (S36) Determining type of inputted mine
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지뢰의 종류와, 지뢰가 매설된 토양의 상태에 관계없이 정확하게 지뢰의 분류를 결정해 낼 수 있도록 하는 지뢰의 분류 결정 장치가 구현되고, 
이를 위해 본 발명은 지표 투과 레이더를 통해 지표면 아래에 매설된 적어도 1개 이상의 매몰지뢰로부터 지뢰 반사신호가 수집되는 매몰지뢰인식단계(S21)와, 상기 지뢰 반사신호가 주성분 분석법과, 이산 주파수 변환을 통해 분석되고, 상기 매몰지뢰 별로 각각 고유치와, 주파수 계수를 갖는 지뢰특성데이터가 획득되는 매몰지뢰분석단계(S22) 및 상기 지뢰특성데이터로부터 상기 고유치 및 상기 주파수 계수를 각각 X축과 Y축에 대한 그래프로 표현하고, 우도 비율 검정법이 적용되어 상기 매몰지뢰가 인식될 수 있는 지뢰분류데이터가 획득되는 매몰지뢰검출단계(S23)를 포함하는 다특성 기반의 지뢰 분류 결정 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Driving Prediction and Safety Driving System Based on Judgment of Driver Emergency Situation of Autonomous Driving Vehicle
title_ko: 자율주행차량의 운전자 응급상황발생판단에 기반한 주행예측 및 안전주행시스템
abstract_ko: 자율주행차량의 주행예측시스템을 개시한다. 실시예에 따른 주행예측시스템은 자율주행차량의 주행예측시스템에 있어서, 주행하는 차량에 인접한 차량을 감지하고, 인접 차량들과의 거리에 따라 속도 및 속도 변화량을 조정하는 가속제어모듈; 주행중인 차량이 위치한 지역의 도로상황과 위치 정보에 따라 충돌 예측정보 및 사고위험정보를 생성하는 안전주행모듈; 주행차량의 현재 위치와 목적지 입력정보, 지역별 교통 정보를 기반으로 주행경로를 생성하는 경로생성모듈; 및 전방차량, 후방차량 및 인접한 차선을 주행하는 주변객체를 인식하고, 주변객체에서 전송하는 운전신호와 주행경로정보를 수신하고 주변객체의 속도를 감지하여 주변객체들의 주행을 예측하고, 예측된 주행정보에 따라 차량의 자율주행을 조정하는 주행예측모듈; 을 포함하고, 주행예측모듈은 차량 내부에 설치된 생체신호 감지 센서로부터 운전자의 호흡주기를 포함하는 운전자생체 신호를 파악하여 응급상황 발생여부를 판단하고, 응급상황이 발생된 것으로 파악한 경우, 안전주행모드로 자동전환 한다.

title_en: Buried object locating device with a plurality of spherical sensor balls that include a plurality of orthogonal antennae
abstract_en: A buried object locator which may include at least one antenna array including three mutually orthogonal antennas each sharing a common center point senses electromagnetic signals emitted by two or more buried objects such as utility lines, pipes or sondes. A circuit at least partially mounted in a housing of the locator may be connected to the array and used to determine location information of the buried objects by measuring signal strength and field angles in three dimensions.

title_en: Non-contact sensing of vital signs
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed for non-contact sensing of vital signs. An example electronic device to measure vital signs includes a camera to capture an image; a radar antenna to transmit and receive radar signals; and processing circuitry to: identify a subject in the image; identify a location of the subject in an environment; control the radar antenna to steer the radar signals toward the location; and determine a vital sign of the subject based on a reflected radar signal.

title_en: PCR radar sensor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vital sign recognition sensors and discloses a PCR radar sensor which comprises a sensor body, wherein a connecting table is arranged on the back surface of the sensor body, connecting shafts are fixedly arranged on two sides of the connecting table, connecting rods are rotatably connected to the connecting shafts, screws are arranged at the ends of the connecting rods and used for limiting the relative positions of the connecting shafts and the connecting rods, mounting plates are arranged at the tops of the connecting rods and used for fixing the PCR radar sensor at a use position. The PCR radar sensor utilizes the wavelet with different emission lengths of the sensor body to accurately control pulse repetition frequency, center frequency and pulse duration, realizes high precision with low power consumption, is more beneficial to micro feature observation, feature extraction and motion feature detection of targets, and improves the precision of detecting various vital signs in various fields such as expressway toll stations.

title_en: Fiber bragg grating soil monitoring device
abstract_en: The application relates to a fiber grating soil monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of soil monitoring and comprises a demodulator, a plurality of strain fiber grating detection chains and a plurality of installation pieces, wherein the plurality of fiber grating detection chains respectively comprise multi-core optical cables which are pre-buried under the slope surface of a slope body to be monitored, the multi-core optical cables are respectively connected with a plurality of strain fiber grating sensors in series, the plurality of strain fiber grating sensors are respectively detachably installed on the plurality of installation pieces, the plurality of installation pieces are inserted under the slope surface of the slope body to be monitored, the plurality of installation pieces are arranged in a linear array, the output ends of the multi-core optical cables are connected with the demodulator, the signal output ends of the demodulator are connected with a signal processor, the signal processor receives a plurality of stress induction signals and generates a slope body monitoring array, the signal output ends of the signal processor are connected with a display in a control room, and the signal output ends of the demodulator are also connected with a fire alarm host. The application can monitor the landslide in real time and reduce the loss caused by landslide disaster.

title_en: Indoor LED fire emergency lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to fire emergency lamps, in particular to an indoor LED fire emergency lamp, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein a storage battery is fixedly connected to one side of the fixed plate, a display structure is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, an induction mechanism is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, in the use process, the indoor LED fire emergency lamp can be buried in advance at a floor, a first bolt can be loosened, a direction indicator can rotate through loosening of the first bolt, so that the effect of adjusting the indication direction of the direction indicator is achieved, when a sudden fire disaster occurs, a temperature sensor senses abnormal indoor temperature, a loudspeaker and an illumination lamp are triggered, the loudspeaker can broadcast preset voice to help a person in the presence to escape in order, the illumination lamp can provide a certain illumination condition for the person in the presence, clear and correct escape direction is provided for the person in the presence, and the safety level of the whole fire fighting is greatly improved.
assignees: TIANJIN DINGYU CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mounting structure for vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting structure for a vital sign detection radar, which comprises a fixing mechanism, a supporting rod, an adjusting mechanism and the vital sign detection radar, wherein the fixing mechanism is used for being detachably connected with a side plate of a bedstead, the lower end of the supporting rod is connected with the fixing mechanism, the upper end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with the adjusting mechanism, the vital sign detection radar is connected with the adjusting mechanism, the adjusting mechanism has two degrees of freedom, the adjusting mechanism can adjust the vital sign detection radar to rotate around the axis of the supporting rod and pitch and swing up and down, and a sleeping area on the bedstead can be covered by radio waves emitted by the vital sign detection radar. The problem of among the prior art through drilling on the wall body, adopt the inflation screw to install sign detection radar, the installation is inconvenient, and inconvenient installation angle to sign detection radar adjusts is solved.

title_en: A buried object locating and tracing method and system employing principal components analysis for blind signal detection
abstract_en: A blind locating system for finding and tracing buried objects such as utility lines, conductive pipes and sondes. A sensor array is coupled to a signal processor, which determines a field vector for one or more buried objects by producing a data signal representing a covariance matrix corresponding to the covariances of the time-varying sensor array signals over a selected frequency band and accumulation interval. The covariance matrix is characterized by eigenvalues and associated eigenvectors and a user interface (UI) indicates the field vector associated with the eigenvector having the largest eigenvalue. Using several different frequency bands, a plurality of underground objects may be simultaneously detected and indicated in the UI without foreknowledge of their existence or characteristics.

title_en: System and method for detecting, recording and reporting hazardous materials and illegal activities
abstract_en: A system and method for detecting, recording and reporting items and energy associated with hazardous and illegal substances in enclosed and semi-enclosed spaces. The system and method relate to early detection of hazardous materials and illegal activities commonly associated with criminal and terrorist activities. This successive-night security protection integrates audio, video and sensor detection (passive deterrence) with real-time monitoring, communication, and data recording (active deterrence) technologies. The system can provide the functionality of a fixed or mobile recording-reporting device to detect biological agents, toxic chemicals, dirty bombs, electromagnetic radiation, human presence, drugs associated with volatile organic chemicals, and inadvertent negligent accidents. The main component of the system is a solid state detection unit located within a small housing that is mounted to accommodate mobile or stationary applications. The detection unit contains various detectors and sensors, a power supply, and a plurality of communication interfaces. The central monitoring center continuously monitors the detection units where a controller can observe the data from each detection unit and respond to events triggered by the detection units.

title_en: Automatic alarm system for vehicle casualties and traffic accidents
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic alarm system for vehicle casualties and traffic accidents. The automatic alarm system is characterized in that an infrared life detection instrument is installed on a vehicle and respectively acquires the life information below a vehicle chassis and the life information within a vehicle peripheral setting range; the life information below the vehicle chassis is obtained through covering an area right below the vehicle chassis via the infrared light which is sent out by the infrared life detection instrument, and the life information within the setting range is collected in real time, so that life images are generated and are transmitted to an alarm information control center via a public wireless communication network through utilizing global system for mobile communication (GSM); and the life information within the vehicle peripheral setting range is obtained in the way that for a traveling vehicle, when the infrared life detection instrument detects the vehicle body peripheral life information, and the vehicle is judge to hit pedestrians during brake acceleration, as a result, the image information is instantly sent to the alarm information control center. The automatic alarm system can be used for effectively solving the problems of runaway drivers or delayed and inaccurate alarming and difficult control when traffic accidents are happened, so that patients can be rescued in time.

title_en: Multi-channel integrated non-contact vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel integrated non-contact vital sign monitoring system which comprises a vision part, an ultra-wideband radar part and an infrared temperature measurement part. The invention displays the vital sign information of each target in real time by wireless monitoring of multiple target vital signs (including heart rate, respiration and body temperature), realizes the real-time monitoring function of the target, and timely gives a warning when the target vital signs are abnormal.

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, an environment sensing unit, a through-wall radar, a holder and a control unit; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the environment sensing unit, the through-wall radar and the holder are all connected with the control unit; the through-wall radar is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for detecting the external structure, the internal structure and the internal personnel of the building to be detected; the environment sensing unit is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for sensing the flight environment information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the flight environment information to the control unit; the control unit controls the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the flight environment information so as to keep the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the outer wall body within a certain range; the cloud platform is located unmanned aerial vehicle, and the receiving and dispatching antenna of through-wall radar is located the cloud platform, and the control unit is according to flight environment information control cloud platform's action so that the array face of receiving and dispatching antenna keeps parallel with outer wall body. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, good detection performance and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar target identification method, equipment and medium based on vortex electromagnetic waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a medium for identifying a through-wall radar target based on vortex electromagnetic waves, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively executing corresponding multi-mode signal transceiving processes based on each transmitting mode in the transmitting mode range to obtain each echo signal of the target; acquiring characteristic information of the target object based on each echo signal of the target object; wherein the multi-modal signaling process, when executed, comprises: determining a wall echo mode corresponding to a current emission mode based on the current emission mode; executing a current multi-mode echo signal acquisition process based on the current emission mode, the wall echo mode and the receiving mode range; updating the emission modality to re-execute the multi-modality signal transceiving process based on the new emission modality until exiting; the invention realizes clutter suppression on the echo signal of the partition wall target object and improves the radar identification efficiency of the through-wall target object.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST MICROSYSTEM & INFORMATION TECH CAS

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based vital sign monitoring method and a radar-based vital sign monitoring system, wherein the radar-based vital sign monitoring method comprises the following steps: generating a frequency modulation continuous wave signal based on a radar, wherein one path of the generated signal is sent towards a monitoring target, and the other path of the generated signal is mixed with the obtained echo signal, and filtering and digital-to-analog conversion are sequentially carried out to obtain a digital signal; according to the distance between the monitoring target and the radar, the digital signals are subjected to phase expansion to obtain phase difference, the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals are separated according to a band-pass filter of a set frequency band, and the respiration rate and the heart rate of the monitoring target are obtained through post-processing. The method comprises the steps of sending radar signals to a subject by using a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, modulating the signals by using the radar signals, mixing the captured echo signals with the emission signals, and processing to obtain the required heartbeat and respiration data, so that vital sign monitoring is realized in a non-contact mode.

title_en: Human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming. The human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming comprises the following steps: extracting a distance-angle unit of the measured object; acquiring Doppler frequency spectrum; and estimating the heart rate value and the respiration value of the tested object, and detecting the vital signs of the human body of the tested object. According to the invention, each distance-angle unit of a measured object is extracted through preprocessing the received initial echo signals, then the corresponding phase signals are extracted, the Doppler frequency spectrum is obtained through unwrapping and differential processing, then the Doppler frequency spectrum is analyzed, a respiratory pseudo spectrum is constructed in a preset respiratory frequency range to obtain the respiratory value of the measured object, finally a heart rate pseudo spectrum is constructed in a preset heart rate range, and the heart rate value of the measured object is obtained by combining the heart rate harmonic product spectrum, so that the improvement of the detection accuracy of the vital signs of the human body is achieved, and the problem of low detection accuracy of the vital signs of the human body in the prior art is solved.
assignees: CHANGSHA MICROBRAIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system and method for health and accidental injury of old people at home
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for intelligently monitoring health and accidental injury of a household old person, comprising a non-contact monitoring module, a sensor module and an integrated signal module, wherein the non-contact monitoring module and the sensor module are respectively in communication connection with the integrated signal module, the non-contact monitoring module is used for monitoring the behavior state of the old person and sending monitoring data to the integrated signal module, the sensor module integrates various sensing functions and is used for collecting specific physiological information of the old person to form a physiological data pool facing the specific individual and sending the physiological data pool to the integrated signal module, and the integrated signal module carries out vital sign recognition and human body falling body position recognition based on the physiological data pool of the specific individual collected by the sensor module and the behavior state parameters of the old person collected by the non-contact monitoring module and forms an analysis report. The invention can monitor and timely find the state of the old people at home in real time, and reduce the risk possibly caused by accidental injury to the maximum extent.

title_en: Non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring method, device, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring method, a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring device, a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring system, equipment, media and products, and relates to the technical field of emotion recognition. The method comprises the steps of starting a human-computer interaction program to conduct interview with target personnel, receiving human vital sign signals and audio-video signals collected by a millimeter wave biological radar module and an audio-video collection module for the target personnel in the interview process, then sequentially carrying out pretreatment, signal separation treatment and frequency estimation treatment on the human vital sign signals to obtain respiratory rate and heartbeat frequency, carrying out feature extraction treatment on the audio-video signals to obtain audio features and video features, and finally comprehensively analyzing the audio features and the video features to obtain the emotion state of the target personnel according to the respiratory rate, the heartbeat frequency, the audio features and the video features, thereby providing high-quality data support for the establishment of a follow-up artificial intelligent emotion early warning and assessment model and realizing emotion state analysis with higher accuracy and higher reliability.

title_en: Prevention System for Safety Accident of Driver Using Analysis of Individual Sleeping Pattern and Bio Rhythm and Method of Operating the Same
title_ko: 개인별 수면 패턴 및 생체 리듬 분석을 이용하는 운전자 안전 사고 예방 시스템 및 그 작동 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a system for preventing a driver from being injured. The system comprises: a first radio frequency mode radar for detecting a biological signal of a driver in a sleeping area of the driver; a second radio frequency mode radar for detecting a biological signal of the driver in a driving area of the driver; and a network storage apparatus wirelessly linked with the first and second radio frequency mode radars and analyzing the biological signal of the driver detected by the first and second radio frequency mode radars to periodically calculate biological rhythm of the driver.
abstract_ko: 운전자 안전 사고 예방 시스템이 제공된다. 운전자 안전 사고 예방 시스템은 대상자의 수면 공간에서 대상자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 제 1 무선 주파수 방식 레이더, 대상자의 운전 공간에서 대상자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 제 2 무선 주파수 방식 레이더, 및 제 1 및 제 2 무선 주파수 방식 레이더들과 무선으로 연동하되, 제 1 및 제 2 무선 주파수 방식 레이더들에 의해 감지된 대상자의 생체 신호를 분석하여 대상자의 생체 리듬을 주기적으로 계산하는 네트워크 저장 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Washing machine and control method thereof
title_ko: 세탁기 및 세탁기의 제어 방법
abstract_en: A washing machine and a control method for the washing machine are provided. The washing machine may comprise: a cabinet which forms the appearance of the washing machine; a tub formed inside the cabinet; a life detection sensor which detects life inside the washing machine through millimeter wave radar; and at least one processor. The at least one processor may receive a request for activating a remote control mode of the washing machine from an external device through a communication interface. The at least one processor may, upon the request, activate the life detection sensor. The at least one processor may receive a detection signal regarding the presence or absence of life inside the washing machine from the life detection sensor. The at least one processor may transmit information about whether life exists inside the washing machine to the external device through the communication interface, based on the received detection signal.
abstract_ko: 세탁기 및 세탁기의 제어 방법이 제공된다. 세탁기는 세탁기의 외관을 형성하는 캐비닛, 캐비닛 내부에 형성된 터브, 밀리미터파 레이더를 통해 세탁기 내부의 생명체를 감지하는 생명체 감지 센서, 및 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 외부 장치로부터 세탁기의 원격 제어 모드를 활성화하기 위한 요청을 수신할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 요청에 따라, 생명체 감지 센서를 활성화할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 생명체 감지 센서로부터 세탁기 내부의 생명체의 존재 여부에 관한 감지 신호를 수신할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 수신한 감지 신호에 기초하여, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 세탁기 내부에 생명체가 존재하는지에 관한 정보를 외부 장치로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Non-contact fatigue detection method and system
abstract_en: A non-contact fatigue detection method and system. The method mainly comprises: sending a millimeter-wave radar signal to a person to be subjected to detection, receiving an echo signal reflected from said person, and determining a time-frequency domain feature, a non-linear feature and a timing feature of a vital sign signal (S101); acquiring a facial video image of said person, and performing facial detection and alignment on the basis of the facial video image, so as to extract a time domain feature and a space domain feature of the face of said person (S102); fusing the time-frequency domain feature, the non-linear feature and the timing feature of the vital sign signal with the time domain feature and the space domain feature of the face of said person, so as to obtain a fused feature (S103); and inputting the fused feature into a classifier to perform fatigue state recognition of said person, and determining whether said person is in a fatigued state (S104). By means of the method, two detection techniques are fused, thereby effectively suppressing the interference of subjective and objective factors, and improving the accuracy of fatigue detection.

title_en: Fitness monitoring
abstract_en: A mobile system for a user includes a telephone having one or more sensors to capture fitness data or vital sign data, the telephone having a wireless transceiver coupled to the processor to communicate fitness or vital sign data over a personal area network; and a processor coupled to the personal area network to process the fitness or vital sign data.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A method of measuring vital signals using a millimeter-wave radar sensor system includes performing a first set of radar measurements using a millimeter-wave radar sensor to produce a first set of radar data; determining a first set of range gate measurements from the first set of radar data; determining high response range gates from the first set of range gate measurements; and extracting vital signal information from the high response range gates.

title_en: Tunnel engineering safety construction excavation method
abstract_en: A tunnel engineering safe construction excavation method is characterized in that the excavation process of two opposite tunneling working faces of a deep-buried tunnel is continuously monitored through a micro-seismic sensor, the fault condition in front of the working faces is detected in real time, and when a plurality of faults exist in front of the working faces at two sides, the excavation sequence of the working faces at two sides of the tunnel is determined according to the rock mass property between each fault and the working face, so that the rockburst disasters caused when the working faces of the tunnel pass through the faults can be effectively reduced, and the tunnel construction safety is ensured.

title_en: Vital sign information extraction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a vital sign information extraction method, a vital sign information extraction device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo signal; determining signal energy corresponding to each slice signal in the slow time direction in the radar echo signal; extracting human body sign signals from the radar echo signals based on an energy window with a preset width and signal energy corresponding to each slice signal; and carrying out coherent accumulation processing on the human body sign signals, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals from the processed human body sign signals. Therefore, the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal can be accurately extracted from the radar echo signal according to the signal energy corresponding to each slice signal in the slow time direction in the radar echo signal and the energy window with the preset width.

title_en: Pipeline signal identification and trend calculation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water supply and drainage pipeline detection, and provides a pipeline signal identification and trend calculation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional radar data of a buried pipeline; determining the size and the movement overlapping rate of the three-dimensional radar data array block, carrying out array processing on the three-dimensional radar data to form an array block data set, and manually marking the array block data set; performing signal enhancement and data enhancement on the array block data set; inputting the array block data set subjected to signal enhancement and data enhancement into a pipeline identification model trained on three-dimensional radar data; and (3) according to the pipeline recognition result of the pipeline recognition model, dyeing the array block data set and calculating the pipeline trend by using the dyed array block. The pipeline with various materials can be accurately identified, the interference of noise characteristics of the underground environment is reduced, the trend of a hidden pipeline is automatically and accurately calculated, and construction excavation is facilitated; and the processing efficiency is higher, so that reliable technical support is provided for urban infrastructure construction and management.

title_en: Alarm devices of biological signals detection for fireman
title_ko: 소방관용 생체신호감지 경보장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for alarming biological signal detection for a fireman. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device for alarming the biological signal detection for the fireman comprises: a lower body (100) which is attached to a shirt or underwear; and an upper body (200) which is combined with the lower body (100) to be detached. The device for alarming the biological signal detection for the fireman easily detects biological signals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방복의 일측에 부착함으로써 설정 값 이상의 생체신호가 감지되면 경보신호를 발생할 수 있도록 무선신호를 송출하는 경보장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 동시에 감지할 수 있으며 휴대가 더욱 용이한 소방관용 생체신호감지 경보장치에 관한 것으로, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착되는 하측몸체와, 상기 하측몸체에 착탈할 수 있도록 결합되는 상측몸체로 구성되고, 상기 상측몸체의 내측에 설치된 피씨비에는 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하여 수치가 설정범위를 벗어나면 소정의 전기적 신호를 발생하는 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서와, 상기 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서에서 발생된 전기적 신호를 제어하는 엠씨유와, 상기 엠씨유의 제어신호에 따라 엘이디 점등, 부저경보음 발생, 진동발생을 위해 무선신호를 송수신하는 블루투스모듈이 설치되되, 상기 하측몸체는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착되는 하측커버와, 상기 하측커버의 내측에 결합되며 복수의 접속단자가 형성된 단자고정부재와, 상기 단자고정부재의 외측에 결합되는 패킹링을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 상측몸체는 전원버튼 및 표시부가 구비된 상측커버와, 상기 상측커버의 하측에 결합되는 설치부재와, 상기 설치부재의 상측에 결합되는 피씨비를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서가 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하고, 설정범위를 벗어나면 엘이디 점등과 진동 및 경보음을 발생할 수 있는 무선신호를 송출함으로써 사용자가 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 하여 긴박한 상황에서 더욱 안전하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써 생체신호의 감지가 더욱 용이하고, 휴대 및 사용이 더욱 편리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Electronic device generating health information based on a plurality of biometric signal and method of operating the same
title_ko: 복수의 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 생성하는 전자 장치 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 배터리, 디스플레이, 적어도 하나의 센서, 인터페이스, 적어도 하나의 메모리, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서, 상기 인터페이스, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 메모리와 전기적으로 연결되는 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자가 상기 전자 장치를 착용하였는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 사용자가 전자 장치를 착용한 동안에, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 제1 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 전자 장치가 상기 인터페이스를 통해 RF 센서를 포함하는 충전 장치와 연결된 동안에, 상기 충전 장치에 포함된 상기 RF 센서를 구동시켜 상기 RF 센서로부터 발진되는 RF 신호에 의하여 발생되는 상기 사용자의 제2 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 인터페이스를 통해 상기 충전 장치로부터 상기 배터리를 충전하기 위한 전력 및 상기 제2 생체 신호 중 적어도 하나를 수신하고, 상기 제1 생체 신호 및 상기 제2 생체 신호에 적어도 기반하여 상기 사용자의 건강 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 상기 건강 정보를 상기 디스플레이에 표시할 수 있다. 그 밖의 다양한 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Water valve control system
title_ko: 제수밸브 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water valve control system that can accurately grasp the open/close state of a manual type or automatic type water valve by installing a sensor module on an instruction plate that displays the rotation amount of the water valve buried in a manhole, and collecting the rotation amount of the instruction plate in a collection device outside the manhole and notifying the rotation amount of the instruction plate to a remote location. In addition, the water valve control system that can ascertain the buried state of the water valve from the remote location as the sensor module is completely waterproof so that no malfunction occurs, and the sensor module detects an earthquake or shock. To this end, the water valve control system is provided with the instruction plate indicating the rotation amount of the valve in a scale on a gearbox of a valve body built in the manhole, and mounts the sensor module on the instruction plate so that the rotation amount of the instruction plate can be checked by the collection device on the ground, wherein the sensor module is composed of a 3-axis acceleration sensor, a 3-axis gyro sensor, and a geomagnetic sensor, when the instruction plate is installed vertically, the sensor module is fixed to the instruction plate so that a Y axis of the 3-axis acceleration sensor is parallel to the instruction plate, and the rotation amount of the instruction plate is detected according to the gravity vector of the Y axis, when the instruction plate is installed horizontally, the sensor module is fixed to the instruction plate so that the Y axis of the 3-axis gyro sensor faces south, and the rotation amount of the instruction plate is detected according to the quaternion value output from the 3-axis acceleration sensor, 3-axis gyro sensor, and geomagnetic sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 맨홀에 묻힌 제수밸브의 회전량을 표시하는 지침판에 센서모듈을 장착하여 상기 지침판의 회전량을 맨홀 외부의 수집장비에서 집계한 뒤 원격지에 통보 함으로써, 수동식 또는 자동식 제수밸브의 개폐상태를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 또한 센서모듈이 완전방수되어 오작동이 발생되지 않고, 상기 센서모듈이 지진이나 충격을 감지하므로 상기 제수밸브의 매립상태를 원격지에서 파악할 수 있는 제수밸브 제어시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 맨홀에 내장된 밸브몸체의 기어박스에 밸브의 회전량을 눈금으로 표시하는 지침판이 구비되고, 상기 지침판에 센서모듈을 장착하여 지상의 수집장비에서 상기 지침판의 회전량을 확인할 수 있도록 한 제수밸브 제어시스템에 있어서, 상기 센서모듈은 3축가속도센서, 3축자이로센서 및 지자기센서로 구성되고; 상기 지침판이 수직으로 설치될 경우 상기 3축가속도센서의 Y축이 상기 지침판의 지침과 나란하도록 상기 센서모듈을 지침판에 고정하고, Y축의 중력 벡터에 따라 상기 지침판의 회전량이 감지되도록 하며; 상기 지침판이 수평으로 설치될 경우 상기 3축자이로센서의 Y축이 남쪽을 향하도록 상기 센서모듈을 지침판에 고정하고, 상기 3축가속도센서, 3축자이로센서 및 지자기센서에서 출력되는 쿼터니언값에 따라 상기 지침판의 회전량이 감지되도록 한 특징이 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring vital sign based on spatial phase coherency
title_ko: 공간적 위상 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공간적 위상 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 방법에 있어서, 레이더를 통해 반사된 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 반사된 신호에 기초하여 위상 신호를 결정하는 단계; 복수의 거리 별 결정된 위상 신호를 이용하여 상기 복수의 거리 중에서 선택된 거리 쌍인 제1 거리 및 제2 거리에 대한 위상 신호 사이의 코히어런시를 결정하는 단계; 및 상기 코히어런시에 기초하여 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 한 쌍의 서로 다른 범위 빈에서의 위상 간 코히어런시를 정량화하는 공간적 위상 코히어런시 지수를 활용하여, 가장 높은 지수 값을 가지는 한 쌍의 범위 빈을 활력 징후 탐지를 위한 거리로 선택함으로써, 종래의 방법들에 비하여 더욱 정확한 활력 징후가 측정될 수 있다.

title_en: Wearable vital signs monitor with selective signal acquisition
abstract_en: In one example, a wearable vital sign monitor (WVSM) system comprises a support structure configured to be worn by a patient, a plurality of patient physiological sensors configured to be coupled to the patient when the patient is wearing the support structure, each patient physiological sensor configured to output a respective patient physiological signal, a memory, and, a processor communicatively coupled to the plurality of patient physiological sensors and configured to store in the memory measurements of patient physiological signals taken at selected times based on a categorization of the patient physiological signal.

title_en: A kind of directing self-extinguishing module
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of directing self-extinguishing module, including vision sensor, foamite container, extinguishing chemical jet module, head, extinguishing chemical flexible pipe and processor, vision sensor is integrated in same head with extinguishing chemical jet module, vision sensor includes visible image capturing module and infrared thermal imaging module, it is seen that the light photographing module and camera lens of infrared thermal imaging module is identical with the nozzle direction of extinguishing chemical jet module and centerline parallel.Fire suppression module of the present utility model has the characteristics that operating efficiency is high, fire extinguishing accuracy rate is high, and fire suppression module of the present utility model is equipped in mobile robot or other platforms, it is possible to increase the fire disaster emergency processing rapidity and accuracy in buried cable tunnel.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Narrow-beam microstrip Doppler radar organism motion detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a narrow-beam micro-strip Doppler radar organism motion detector, which comprises a metal lining plate, a micro-strip Doppler radar module and a wave-absorbing plate, wherein the micro-strip Doppler radar module is fixed in the middle of the metal lining plate, and the wave-absorbing plate is arranged around the micro-strip Doppler radar module; the microstrip Doppler radar module comprises a circuit board and a bottom cavity, a microstrip antenna is arranged on the front side of the circuit board, a high-frequency circuit is arranged on the back side of the circuit board, the bottom cavity surrounds the high-frequency circuit and is fixed on the back side of the circuit board, and the bottom of the bottom cavity is fixed in the middle of the metal lining plate. The utility model discloses a set up the wave absorption plate on current microstrip Doppler radar module, narrow the microwave detection wave beam, can promote the directive property of microwave in the detection process, avoid interfering mutually between the detector of neighbouring setting, can be applicable to the application scene that many beds surveyed respectively, avoid the adjacent bed to interfere; meanwhile, the narrow beam reduces background noise, can distinguish slight body movement, and lays a foundation for vital sign detection.

title_en: Portable thunder Life detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable radar life detection appearance belongs to detection appearance technical field, and its structure includes portable package, and the vertical detection pole cover that is provided with in portable package left surface takes the seat group, and portable package intracavity is equipped with the detection appearance subassembly, the activity suit is taken in to detection pole cover opposite side extension, through the combination design of taking the seat group to portable package and the detection pole cover that detects host computer room, the opening, the portable room of detection head, the winding displacement is deposited room, the inclusion constitutes one and is used for carrying the knapsack of detection instrument subassembly, when the detection instrument subassembly does not use, the detection pole subassembly is retracted and is reduced the length volume and take in the detection pole cover and take the seat group, and the folding storage is taken in the portable room of detection head fast to the detection head group, makes the detection instrument subassembly take in the seat group in portable package and detection pole cover, also takes the detection host computer through portable package back, and the user holds the detection pole subassembly and just can carry out portable search and rescue use, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Contactless method for sensing on treadmill and treadmill
abstract_en: Disclose the contactless method for sensing on a kind of treadmill and treadmill.The treadmill includes: treadbelt；Display；First sensor has the first transmit circuit for emitting the first radar beam above treadbelt and for detect the first reception circuit for being used as the first radar beam to reflect signal from the first of the reflection of the user in treadbelt；Processor is connected to first sensor, treadbelt and display；And non-transient computer readable storage medium, the program that storage will be executed by processor.The program includes the instruction for operating as follows: showing vital sign over the display to determine the first data associated with the vital sign of user, and according to the first data according to the first reflection signal.

title_en: Human body static target acceleration detection method for impulse type through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body static target acceleration detection method for impulse type through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: eliminating background clutter, namely eliminating the background clutter generated by a completely static target in an echo; step S2: adaptive compensation, namely compensating the influence generated by medium mutation in the electromagnetic wave propagation path; step S3: compensating the energy attenuation of the electromagnetic wave along with the change of the propagation distance so as to meet the requirement of constant false alarm during target detection; step S4: selecting a proper window in the fast and slow time directions, and performing sliding window point taking operation along the fast time direction; step S5: and (6) performing Fourier transform on the data obtained by the sliding window in the step (S4), detecting a respiratory thoracic cavity movement frequency signal of the human body in a frequency domain, judging whether a human body target exists in a detection area and accurately positioning. The invention has the advantages of simple principle, easy realization, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Method for extracting vital sign signals based on full-phase fast Fourier transform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting vital sign signals based on full-phase fast Fourier transform, which solves the technical problem that the existing fast Fourier transform is difficult to obtain correct respiration heartbeat waveform, and comprises the following steps: the radar transmits and receives signals, and intermediate frequency digital signal data obtained by analog-to-digital conversion after echo frequency mixing is extracted; reconstructing the data to distinguish the speed time; carrying out full-phase data preprocessing on the data to obtain processed data; performing fast Fourier transform on the data after full-phase preprocessing, and selecting a frequency point corresponding to a target distance to perform phase solving; and extracting and connecting each snapshot phase to obtain the respiration heartbeat waveform. The invention can be widely applied to the non-contact radar monitoring of the vital signs of people.
assignees: BEIJING PHOSENSE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-powered displacement sensor, landslide monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a self-powered displacement sensor, a landslide monitoring system and a landslide monitoring method. The self-powered displacement sensor is used for being buried in a mountain to be monitored so as to monitor whether landslide occurs in the mountain to be monitored, when landslide occurs in the mountain to be monitored, the self-powered displacement sensor generates corresponding electric signals, the principle that the self-powered displacement sensor generates corresponding electric signals when landslide occurs in the mountain to be monitored is consistent with that of the friction nano generator, and the working mode of the friction nano generator at least comprises a vertical contact-separation mode, a horizontal sliding mode, a single electrode mode and an independent layer mode. According to the application, an external power supply is not needed, and corresponding electric signals can be generated when landslide occurs on the mountain to be monitored based on the principle of the friction nano generator, so that the reliability of the sensor is improved, and the research, development and manufacturing costs of the sensor are reduced.

title_en: Radar high-precision heart rate detection method based on fitting matched filtering and Double-CZT
abstract_en: The application discloses a radar high-precision heart rate detection method based on fitting matched filtering and Double-CZT. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an intermediate frequency signal data matrix containing target human body respiratory heartbeat signals by adopting a millimeter wave radar life detection system; step two: preprocessing the intermediate frequency signal data matrix to obtain an unwrapped signal and a preprocessed signal; step three: fitting the unwrapped signal by using a smooth spline to obtain a template signal; then convoluting the template signal and the preprocessing signal, wherein the convolution result is the output result of matched filtering; step four: extracting variation of the matched filtering output result to obtain a heartbeat signal; step five: heart rate estimation is performed on the resulting heartbeat signal using a bilinear frequency modulated Z transform (Double-CZT). The application has high measurement accuracy and high stability, and is easy for real-time detection of heart rate and engineering realization.

title_en: Pipeline buried depth precision detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline buried depth precision detection device, which comprises a bottom frame, wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom frame, the wheels are connected to the bottom frame through lifting components, a supporting frame is arranged on the upper end face of the bottom frame, a spherical hinge connecting piece is arranged above the inside of the bottom frame and fixedly arranged on the supporting frame, a ball head is arranged in the spherical hinge connecting piece in a universal rotation mode, a straight rod is connected below the ball head, a locking component for limiting the ball head to rotate in the spherical hinge connecting piece is further arranged on the spherical hinge connecting piece, a push rod is further connected above the rear end of the bottom frame, a holding rod is further arranged behind the upper end of the push rod, a control component for controlling the locking component is further arranged on the holding rod, a mounting plate for loading a ground penetrating radar is further arranged at the bottom of the straight rod, and a plurality of counterweight components are further arranged at the non-center position of the mounting plate. The device has high trafficability and high stability, and effectively reduces the collision risk of the ground penetrating radar and improves the stability of the ground penetrating radar when detecting on a complex road surface.

title_en: Non-contact human body heartbeat waveform extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact human body heartbeat waveform extraction method, which belongs to the technical field of human body perception and heartbeat detection, and comprises the steps of obtaining a reflected signal of a heartbeat of a target person by utilizing IR-UWB equipment, constructing an autocorrelation matrix characteristic of the reflected signal, carrying out characteristic mapping with an autocorrelation matrix of a heartbeat waveform extracted by real heartbeat acquisition equipment, obtaining a value of a heartbeat rate by utilizing a period similarity characteristic of a heartbeat period signal, and constructing the heartbeat waveform. The invention solves the problem that the high-precision human heartbeat waveform is difficult to obtain under the conditions of real stability and motion state and is limited by the interference of different indoor environments, the postures of personnel, the surface coverings and other factors.

title_en: Mental health monitoring and nursing robot with body-multidimensional intelligent cooperation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical-multidimensional intelligent cooperative mental health monitoring and nursing robot which comprises a mobile robot platform provided with a differential driving chassis, a laser SLAM navigation module and the like, a multi-modal sensing network integrated with an RGB-D depth camera, a thermal imager and the like, wherein the multi-modal sensing network processes data in real time through an edge computing unit, an intelligent decision engine based on a micro-service architecture covers modules such as patrol recognition, vital sign monitoring non-mental support transducer dialogue model and multi-modal emotion recognition and the like, and a man-machine interaction interface is connected through an end-to-end encryption 5G network. The medicine compliance management module is also provided with a privacy protection scheme of RFID medicine box, medicine taking action recognition, federal learning and differential privacy. The intelligent nursing system has the beneficial effects that the nursing efficiency is improved by more than 40%, the occurrence rate of adverse events is reduced by 35%, the psychological intervention coverage rate is improved, the medicine taking compliance is improved, the sublingual medicine hiding detection rate is improved to more than 95%, the data privacy is safe and controllable, and the intelligent upgrading of mental health care is promoted.
assignees: THE 7TH PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF HANGZHOU HANGZHOU MENTAL HAZARD RES AND PREVENTION CENTER

title_en: Methods circuits assemblies devices systems facets and associated machine executable code for detecting vital signs
abstract_en: Disclosed are a composite bio-parameter sensor assembly and a wearable device including same, for detecting vital signs of a subject person. The sensor assembly includes one or more sensors, mounted on an outer contact surface of the assembly, having a sensing surface to optically detect one or more parameters of a pulse of the subject. The sensor assembly further includes an additional sensor, facing an inner cavity of the assembly, for optically detecting displacement of the one or more outer sensors. The one or more sensors and the additional sensor are positioned on the opposite sides of a printed circuit board (PCB).

title_en: Multi-target vital sign detection method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of data processing, and discloses a multi-target vital sign detection method, terminal equipment and a storage medium. The multi-target vital sign detection method comprises the steps of controlling a millimeter wave radar to scan a target area to obtain a point cloud sequence, determining the number of target characters in the target area according to the point cloud sequence, generating an independent point cloud sequence of each target character according to the point cloud sequence when the number of the target characters is multiple, and generating vital sign parameters corresponding to each target character according to the independent point cloud sequence of each target character. The invention reduces the complexity and the cost of hardware and also maintains the advantages of non-contact detection of the millimeter wave radar.

title_en: Buried pipeline settlement detection and evaluation method and system based on ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a buried pipeline settlement detection and evaluation method based on a ground penetrating radar and a system thereof, wherein the detection method acquires a B-Scan mask image of a shallow buried pipeline, extracts the integral and local characteristics of target hyperbolic reflection signal characteristic points in the image, removes singular points in the characteristic points, performs curve fitting on all effective target hyperbolic reflection signal characteristic points, calculates and screens a score on depth values and wave velocity values corresponding to the target characteristic points, and obtains the pipeline buried depth; the evaluation method is based on a pipeline sedimentation detection result, an angle is formed through the height change between two points on the pipeline, the position of the maximum sedimentation deformation is identified, the position where the fracture risk of a detection section is possibly generated is predicted, the detection system implements the detection method, and the evaluation system implements the evaluation method. The application solves the problem that the hyperbolic reflection signal with characteristics damaged due to the attenuation and coupling problems of electromagnetic waves in engineering actual measurement cannot be effectively calculated, and remarkably improves the processibility and the analyzability of data.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method based on radar signal and detection radar
abstract_en: Provided is a multi-target life detection method based on radar signals. The method includes: performing time accumulation in a slow time direction on a preprocessed echo signal to obtain a first echo signal; performing an envelope extraction of inflection points on the first echo signal to obtain a second echo signal; calculating an average value of all amplitude signals in the second echo signal other than M marked amplitude signals; and in response to a ratio of a marked amplitude signal to the average value being greater than a threshold, determining that a living target exists at a radar detection distance corresponding to the marked amplitude signal. According to the life detection method of the present disclosure, a normalization method is adopted to normalize signal amplitudes of the radar in a dimension of fast time (distance). In addition, two envelope extractions of inflection points may be performed.

title_en: An earthquake rescue positioning watch
abstract_en: Provided is an earthquake rescue positioning watch which comprises a watchband, a watchcase, and a watch surface which are connected successively. A time display and a liquid crystal screen are disposed on the watch surface. A cell and an integrated circuit board are installed inside the watch surface. A GPS positioner is installed on the top of the watchcase. A loudspeaker and a switch are installed on the bottom of the watchcase. A remote control receiving switch and a time adjusting button are installed on the right side of the watchcase. A microphone is installed on the upper right side of the watchcase.
