An LED calling glittering lamp is installed on the upper left side of the watchcase. An infrared probe is installed on the left side of the watchcase. A microwave emitter is installed on the lower left side of the watchcase. An LED floodlight and a light switch are installed on the lower right side of the watchcase. Usually, the earthquake rescue positioning watch is worn on a hand and does not leave a body. After an earthquake, if a user is  buried or forgets to turn on the switch while being sacred, a rescuer may use a unified specially-produced remote controller to remotely switch on the remote control receiving switch of the earthquake rescue positioning watch. At this time, the GPS positioner, the microwave emitter, the LED calling glittering lamp, and the loudspeaker give a distress signal such that the rescuer is easy to find out the user needing for help in order to perform rescue in time.
assignees: KUNSHAN YUSHAN TOWN SHILONG DESIGN WORK STUDIO

title_en: Control system based on quadrotor auxiliary search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of control system based on quadrotor auxiliary search and rescue device, including flight module and search and rescue module, the flight module include master control set, communication unit, remote control signal receiver, remote control；The search and rescue module includes MCU, infrared life-detection instrument, earth station, GPS.The master control set is arranged on inside quadrotor, master control set and MCU wireless connections；Remote control signal receiver communicates connection with master control set；The remote control and remote control signal receiver wireless connection；The infrared life-detection instrument and GPS communicate connection with MCU；The utility model is by the way that auxiliary search and rescue device is be combined with each other with aircraft so that control search can be realized by aircraft in the place that some are with a varied topography or are searched and rescued by the bad realization in ground so as to reach the purpose of auxiliary rescue.Pass through the setting of infrared life-detection instrument so that rescue worker easier can have found to treat the position of rescue worker.
assignees: ANHUI LANGBA SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Build long-distance intelligent life detection fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses building long-distance intelligent life detection fire extinguishing systems, wireless smoke sensor device, radio temperature sensor, wireless heart rate detection sensor, radar detection sensor, full-view camera, several first spray heads, the second spray head and pressure dry powder extinguisher and central signal including being mounted on architecture indoor receive control machine；The central signal receives control machine and is configured as receiving the signal that wireless smoke sensor device, radio temperature sensor, radar detection sensor, full-view camera and wireless heart rate detection sensor issue, the triggering of the start and stop of full-view camera and the trigger mechanism of pressure dry powder extinguisher is controlled, and carries out both-way communication and connect to be controlled by it with fire-fighting central platform.The utility model carries out fire behavior control in first time, while informing fighting condition of afflicted personnel information and trapped person's situation, reduces rescue difficulty and fighting personnel probability in danger, while increasing the chance for survival of trapped person.
assignees: SICHUAN JIANAN CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and an operating method thereof. The search and rescue robot consists of three parts, namely a head part, a body part and a tail part, wherein the three parts are connected together through a connecting mechanism; the head part is provided with a life detection device, a driving device, a control device, a power device, a communication device, a camera and an infrared device; the body part and the tail part are provided with a driving device, a control device and a power device; each part consists of a plurality of joints; a deformation mechanism is a structure which is used for supporting in the joints; the joints are connected together through the driving device; and the outer surface of the entire robot is covered by a flexible fabric skin layer. The robot is suitable for executing detection tasks of living bodies under ruin environments of earthquake, coal mine disasters and the like; the robot can also enter a narrow space in ruins through deformation of the robot to detect life information; and thus, the search and rescue range of the robot is expanded, the rescue efficiency is increased, and valuable time is brought for rescuing more lives.

title_en: Post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system. The post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle system body, a control station system and a communication link system. The unmanned aerial vehicle system body comprises at least one unmanned aerial vehicle which obtains the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time through a navigational satellite and flies in the sky above a post-disaster search-rescue region to collect an image, the spectrum and infrared rays of the ground in real time. In addition, the position, the image, the spectrum and the infrared rays are sent to a control station after being integrated, classified and analyzed. The control station system comprises at least one control station which is used for recognizing a vital sign signal according to the image, the spectrum and the infrared rays collected through the unmanned aerial vehicle and drawing a map presenting a life position in combination with the position. The communication link system is used for providing communication links between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the navigational satellite, between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the control station, and between the control station and a disaster relief command center. The post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system can overcome the influence of severe environment and collect data continuously, and has the advantages of being high in search-rescue efficiency and accurate in life locating.

title_en: The vital sign monitoring of mine servant a kind of and positioning search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of monitoring of the vital sign of mine servant and positioning search and rescue systems, and the system comprises wireless sensings to position network, external alert device, server end；The wireless sensing positions network, including：User terminal, coordinator and multiple beaconing nodes, user terminal are wearable devices, and beaconing nodes are sensor node known to different location but position of the regular arrangement under mine；The valid data of each node feeding back of the user terminal received are transferred to server end and handled by the coordinator；The external alert device, for receiving the warning message issued by the processor module；The server end carries out processing storage to data information, and show in the form of picture and text when needed for receiving the data information that coordinator transmits；The vital sign real-time monitoring to mine servant can be achieved in the present invention, and carries out timely positioning to the miner that emergency situations occur and search and rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN WANFA CHUANGXIN IMP AND EXPORT TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method, wherein the detection system comprises a visual detection unit and an ultra-wideband radar, the visual detection unit is used for acquiring target information of a visual area, and the target information comprises wall information; the ultra-wideband radar is connected with the visual detection unit and used for filtering target information in front of the wall according to the wall information and detecting a target in a rear area of the wall to obtain a detection result. The invention has the advantages of long-distance omnibearing detection, high detection speed, high detection precision, flexibility and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal detection method for FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal detection method for an FMCW radar, which comprises the following steps: constructing a matrix R (m, n) for the radar intermediate frequency signals according to a frame period, and performing FFT (fast Fourier transform) on each frame of data in the matrix R (m, n) respectively to obtain a time distance matrix D (p, n); detecting the front N1 column data of D (p, N) by using a constant false alarm rate to obtain potential distances of a plurality of targets; clustering the potential distances of the multiple targets in the N1 column by using a K-means algorithm to obtain rough distances of the K targets, and determining distance ranges of the K targets; searching peak values in K distance ranges for each line of data in D (p, n) to obtain K target distance values, and calculating phases of K target positions; and performing unwrapping and difference on K target phases in the N lines of data, and performing filtering separation to obtain respiratory and heartbeat signals of K targets. The invention can overcome clutter influence and quickly obtain rough positions of a plurality of targets; the method improves the detection precision of respiration and heartbeat signals, and is suitable for detecting multi-target vital signs in a complex environment.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on millimeter wave vital radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on millimeter wave vital radars, wherein the method adopts six millimeter wave radars which are respectively placed at six positions of front, back, left, right, upper and lower of a tested person, uses continuous wave radars to emit electromagnetic waves and analyze echo signals, carries out MEEMD decomposition on phase signals, carries out full-phase spectrum analysis on modal components obtained after decomposition, carries out respiration and heartbeat reconstruction according to the energy proportion of frequency-amplitude peak response on the IMF components and peaks after classification, processes to obtain a cardiogram and a pulmonary map, and realizes high-efficiency and accurate non-contact vital sign monitoring. The method is used for three-dimensional measurement of the lung and the heart aiming at six directions with different angles, so that high sensitivity and high accuracy of the test are ensured, and accurate detection of the lung and the heart is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle human vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote detection, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle human body vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar, which comprises the following steps of planning a flight path of an unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of acquiring reflected signals received by an ultra-wideband radar, position information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and image data of a thermal imager in real time, acquiring and preprocessing the reflected signals received by the ultra-wideband radar in real time, processing the reflected signals based on a signal processing algorithm and extracting human vital sign characteristic parameters, wherein the human vital sign characteristic parameters comprise respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency, and judging the existence condition of human life according to the normal range of the human vital sign characteristic parameters and preset human vital sign characteristic parameters and the image data of the thermal imager. The invention can remotely detect vital signs, and quickly and accurately detect human vital sign signals under ruins in a large range by utilizing the high maneuverability of the unmanned aerial vehicle.
assignees: NANJING NINGYING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Living body information executive system that ubiquitous sensor network
title_ko: 무선센서네트워크를 이용한 생체정보 관리시스템
abstract_en: A living body information management system by using wireless sensor network is provided to grasp a location of a target person in an occurrence of an emergency situation to take an immediate action to the emergency situation. A portable living body information terminal(101) is adhered to a body of a person, measures bio-information in a constant time interval, and transmits the bio-information with identification code through a wireless sensor network(102). A router(103) wirelessly receives the bio-information obtained in the portable living body information terminal. A web server(104) manages the router location information, and manages the bio-information transmitted from the router. An information server(105) stores the router location information and bio-information. A client transmits a data to a monitoring system which displays a collected bio-information and location information. An information transmitting server(108) converts the set up designated time interval bio- information into the HL7 standard among the bio-information stored in the information server. The converted information is transmitted to an external system(109).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선센서네트워크를 이용한 생체정보 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 대상자의 몸에 부착하여 생체정보를 일정 시간 간격으로 계측하고, 상기 생체정보를 대상자별 식별코드와 연계하여 무선센서네트워크 통신을 이용하여 전송하는 휴대형 무선센서네트워크 생체정보 단말기; 소정 공간별 설치되고, 상기휴대형 무선센서네트워크 생체정보 단말기에서 취득된 생체정보를 무선 수신하는 라우터; 상기 식별코드별 대상자 정보 및 상기 라우터별 위치정보가 저장되고, 상기 라우터에서 전송된 생체정보를 수집 및 저장하는 정보서버; 상기 정보서버에 수집된 생체정보 및 상기 대상자별 위치정보를 표시하는 모니터링 시스템부; 상기 정보서버에 저장된 생체정보 중 설정된 소정 시간 간격별 생체정보를 HL7 표준으로 변환하여 외부 시스템(전자의무기록 시스템 또는 처방전달시스템 등)으로 전송하는 정보 전송 서버로 구성된 무선센서네트워크를 이용한 생체정보 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명은 대상자의 현재 생체정보를 일상생활 중에 불편함 없이 계측 제공함에 따라 대상자의 건강상태를 실시간으로 파악할 수 있고 대상자의 응급상황 발생시 대상자의 위치를 빠른 시간 내에 확인하여 초기에 효과적으로 대처할 수 있다.

title_en: Privacy-preserved User Context Prediction Method and System for Healthcare Services with Radar-based Contactless Biometric Monitoring System
title_ko: 레이더 기반 비접촉식 생체정보 모니터링 기반 1인가구용 헬스케어 서비스를 위한 프라이버시 보호형 사용자 상황 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A privacy-protection-type method of predicting a user situation for single-person household healthcare services using radar-based contactless biometric information monitoring, and a system therefor are suggested. The privacy-protection-type system of predicting a user situation for single-person household healthcare services using radar-based contactless biometric information monitoring, suggested in the present invention, comprises: a biometric signal collection unit which collects time-series biometric information of a user using a radar-based contactless biometric information measurement method; a privacy-protection-type data processing module which generates a plurality of pieces of characteristic data without additional privacy infringement on the user by performing a pre-processing process to extract feature points with respect to the collected time-series biometric information; and a radar-based biometric information monitoring system analysis module which selects characteristic data types to predict a situation of the user among the plurality of pieces of generated characteristic data and performs learning to predict the situation of the user using the pieces of selected characteristic data. According to the present invention, the method and system can efficiently analyze biometric information of users without privacy infringement.
abstract_ko: 레이더 기반 비접촉식 생체정보 모니터링 기반 1인가구용 헬스케어 서비스를 위한 프라이버시 보호형 사용자 상황 예측 방법 및 시스템이 제시된다. 본 발명에서 제안하는 레이더 기반 비접촉식 생체정보 모니터링 기반 1인가구용 헬스케어 서비스를 위한 프라이버시 보호형 사용자 상황 예측 시스템은 레이더 기반 비접촉 생체정보 측정 방식을 이용하여 사용자의 시계열 생체정보를 수집하는 생체 신호 수집부, 수집된 시계열 생체정보에 대하여 특징점 추출을 위한 전처리 과정의 수행을 통해 사용자에 대한 추가적인 프라이버시 침해가 없는 형태로 복수의 특징 데이터를 생성하는 프라이버시 보호형 데이터 처리 모듈 및 생성된 복수의 특징 데이터 중 사용자의 상황을 예측하기 위한 특징 데이터 종류들을 선정하고, 선정된 특징 데이터들을 이용하여 사용자의 상황을 예측하기 위한 학습을 수행하는 레이더 기반 생체 정보 모니터링 시스템 분석 모듈을 포함한다.

title_ko: 비닐하우스, 축사에서 실내보온용 지열흡수보강장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a structure that maintains stable temperature and humidity by supplying thermal air, which has absorbed geothermal heat, into an indoor space through a long heating pipe and a drainage pipe buried underground. In addition, by linking a sensor and a pump, it prevents cold damage in vinyl greenhouses and storage warehouses and improves energy efficiency. In a geothermal heat absorption reinforcement device comprising a drainage pipe buried underground with an inner space and a reinforcing member formed with ribs on its outer surface, a penetration hole is formed in the upper section of the drainage pipe and a first suction pipe is connected thereto, and an inlet is formed in the lower section of the first suction pipe to supply air into the indoor space through a pump. In addition, air is supplied by a pump through a second hose fixed to the injection section of the reinforcing member to provide indoor thermal insulation for vinyl greenhouses or livestock barns.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비닐하우스, 축사에서 실내보온용 지열흡수보강장치에 대한 발명으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 비닐하우스의 실내에서 습설로 붕괴되는 손실을 예방에 필요한 보온을 지열의 공급과, 아울러 지붕이나 실내에 실용적인 지열을 공급으로, 냉해, 폭염, 습설에 의한 자연재해의 피해방지를 제공하기 위한 발명이다.  
일반적으로 기후변화에 의한 실매보온을 위하여 보일러 또는 태양광과 같은 신재생에너지를 활용하고 있으나, 이는 실내안전을 위한 에너지 제공을 위하여 요구되는 비용의 증가함이며, 특히 기후변화에 의한 급격한 한파, 폭염에 대한 대비를 위한 비용에 대한 절약을 위한 신제생에너지, 지열 등의 보온장치에 대한 관심이 높아가는 현실이다 
그러나 가온변화에 따른 실내의 온도변화에 따라 냉해, 폭염에 의한 부패 등의 문제가 발생하고 있는 현실이다.  
   따라서 조립식 작업장에서 혹한, 폭염기에 냉해, 열사병, 고온에 의한 식재료의 변질에 대한 공기온도를 조절시켜 주도록 친환경적이면서 경제성이 양호한 지열을 공급을 제공함이며, 이는 산업발전에 따른 AI기술의 도입에 따른 감지장치와 펌프의 구동을 자동화로서, 영농지역에 구축된 농업시설에 대한 공기조화를 위하도록 지하수의 순환적인 활용으로 안정적인 실내공간에 대한 실용성 재고를 위한 발명이다.  
 따라서 상기 비닐로 감싸주는 내측공간에  분출구가 천공된 공급 및 배출용 파이프을 교호상으로 고정시켜 주되, 상기 파이프에는 호오스로 연결된 펌프을 구비로서, 기온 변화에 따른 모니터링 감응장치의 구동에 따라, 창고, 작업장의 실내공간에 대한 쾌적의 온도유지용 체크밸브로 제공하는 발명이다.

title_en: Plurisensorial system adapted for the prevention of professional diseases in the working environment, and method for the use of the system
abstract_en: A multi-sense system adapted for prevention of occupational diseases in a working environment is described, which comprises: - a protective facial mask, adapted for application in the front zone of a person's face, comprising nose and mouth areas, and comprising: - a temperature and humidity sensor (5, 6) adapted to be activated when the mask is worn, and adapted to provide time-related data concerning said activation as well as temperature and humidity values; - removable air filter elements (3, 4) applied to the front side parts of the mask; - inhalation (8) and exhalation (7) valves applied to the front zone of the mask, in front of the mouth, when the mask is worn; - elements for securing the mask to the face (2, 9, 10, 11, 12); - an electronic nose device (3) adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the quality of the air in said working environment; - a breathing detection device, adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the respiratory rate; - a data processing and displaying device, adapted to receive and store the data outputted by said protective facial mask, electronic nose device and breathing detection device, also adapted to process and display said data in order to determine a condition wherein said rotective facial mask needs to be worn.

title_en: Method and apparatus for matching vital sign information to a concurrently recorded data set
abstract_en: An approach is provided for matching vital sign information to a concurrently recorded data set (119) according to a time domain. The approach involves determining sensor information collected from one or more sensors configured to monitor one or more vital signs of one or more objects (111a, 111b) within a monitored area (107). The approach also involves processing and/or facilitating a processing of the sensor information to detect the one or more objects and to track the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects (111a, 111b) over a time domain. The approach further involves matching the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects (111a, 111b) to a concurrently recorded data set (119) based on the time domain. The approach further involves storing at least one record of the one or more vital signs matched to the concurrently recorded data set (119).

title_en: Electronic apparatus capable of measuring biosignals
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정 가능한 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic apparatus according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise: a housing at least partially including a conductive portion; a display visually exposed to the outside through at least a portion of the housing; a communication circuit electrically connected to the conductive portion; a sensor electrically connected to the conductive portion; a first cut-off circuit connected between the conductive portion and the communication circuit and configured to cut off signals in a first frequency range; a second cut-off circuit connected between the conductive portion and the sensor and configured to cut off signals in a second frequency range; and a processor operatively connected to the display, the communication circuit, and the sensor. The conductive portion may be configured to operate as an antenna of the communication circuit and as a biosignal measurement electrode of the sensor. Various other embodiments that can be understood through the specification are also possible.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 전도성 부분을 적어도 일부 포함하는 하우징, 상기 하우징의 적어도 일부를 통해 외부로 시각적으로 노출되는 디스플레이, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 통신 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 센서, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 통신 회로 사이에 연결되고, 제1 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제1 차단 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 센서 사이에 연결되고, 제2 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제2 차단 회로, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 통신 회로 및 상기 센서와 동작적으로(operatively) 연결된 프로세서를 포함할 수 있고, 상기 전도성 부분은 상기 통신 회로의 안테나 및 상기 센서의 생체 신호 측정 전극으로 동작하도록 구성될 수 있다. 이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Air conditioner and control method therefor
title_ko: 공기조화기 및 이의 제어방법
abstract_en: An air conditioner according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise: an air conditioner housing; a cold air supply apparatus for supplying cold air to an indoor space; at least two occupancy detection sensors for detecting movement or biosignals of a user in the indoor space; and a processor. The processor may be configured to: estimate the presence or absence of a user or the number of users in the indoor space, on the basis of sensing values acquired from the at least two occupancy detection sensors; assign an identifier to the estimated user; acquire movement information or biosignals related to the identifier; determine a sleep state and/or a sleep stage of the identifier on the basis of the acquired movement information or biosignals; and control the operation of the cold air supply apparatus on the basis of the sleep stage. The occupancy detection sensors may include a radar sensor and a microphone.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 공기조화기는 공기 조화기 하우징, 실내 공간으로 냉기를 공급하기 위한 냉기 공급장치, 상기 실내 공간 내의 사용자의 움직임 또는 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 적어도 둘 이상의 재실 감지 센서 및 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 프로세서는 상기 적어도 둘 이상의 재실 감지 센서로부터 획득한 센싱 값에 기초하여 상기 실내 공간 내의 사용자의 유무 또는 인원수를 추정하고, 상기 추정된 사용자에 대해 식별자를 부여하고, 상기 식별자에 관한 움직임 정보 또는 생체 신호를 획득하고, 상기 획득한 움직임 정보 또는 생체 신호에 기반하여 상기 식별자의 수면 상태 및/또는 수면 단계를 판단하고, 상기 수면 단계에 기초하여 상기 냉기 공급장치의 동작을 제어하도록 구성될 수 있다. 상기 재실 감지 센서는 레이더 센서 및 마이크를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Near field subwavelength focusing synthetic aperture radar with chemical detection mode
abstract_en: Detection of objects such as a buried explosive device while operating from a moving platform using a radio frequency emission system having two modes. An electromagnetic wave emission and detection system operates in a first mode to locate objects of interest and in a second mode to determine if an object contains explosive materials. In the first mode, the emission and detection system preferably operates as a subwavelength focusing, wideband, superlens using a near field super gain synthetic aperture continuous wave (CW) swept radar. In the second mode the system preferably enabled after detection of an object in the first mode, uses chemical detection methods such as Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance (NQR).
assignees: AMI RES & DEV LLC;AMI RES & DEV LLC

title_en: System and Method for Contactless Sensing on a Treadmill
abstract_en: A treadmill includes a belt, a display, a first sensor having first transmission circuitry for transmitting a first radar beam over the belt and first reception circuitry for detecting a first reflected signal that is a reflection of the first radar beam from a user on the belt, a processor connected to the first sensor, the belt and the display, and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program to be executed by the processor. The program includes instructions for determining, according to the first reflected signal, first data associated with a vital sign of the user and displaying, according to the first data, the vital sign on the display.

title_en: Earthquake alarm method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster reduction, and relates to a new detection method for updating an earthquake detection concept, which comprises the following steps: the earthquake omnibearing signal is detected by the linkage mechanism and the magnetic sensor, and the earthquake alarm method solves the problems of signal loss and error and prevents the missed alarm. And a plurality of detection modes can be singly selected or selected to form a plurality of measuring and reporting devices with function difference, so that manufacturers can select or regulate and control measuring and reporting modes according to different regional requirements, and the like, thereby breaking the old mode that longitudinal waves and transverse waves of the traditional alarm are respectively singly measured and reported. The earthquake-proof lifesaving box is integrated with functions of recording messages, sending distress signals and the like, wherein a solid conduction sound sensor is designed for blocking sound conduction, all sound and information can be recorded or stored in a storage device at any time in advance, earthquake process data can be recorded, infrared ray sending and infrared life detection instruments are adopted to correspond, and the earthquake-proof lifesaving box is a quakeproof lifesaving project invention with the theme of improving lifesaving effect and is called as an earthquake lifesaving black box for short.

title_en: A kind of multipath based on Bayes's compressed sensing utilizes through-wall radar imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multipaths based on Bayes's compressed sensing to utilize through-wall radar imaging method.The present invention is being parallel to the multiple position transmitting trains of pulse of metope and is being obtained echo-signal using Dan Zhandan dual-mode antenna Millimeter Wave Stepped-Frequency High Resolution Radar system, the measuring signal that compression sampling obtains relatively small amount is carried out to echo-signal by random measurement matrix, then joint constructs compressed sensing model according to the designed dictionary of wall multipath reflection characteristic, scene information after wall is reconstructed to come from measuring signal using Bayes's compression sensing method, finally completes through-wall radar imaging using the information reconstructed.Present invention reduces cost, reduce the record time, at the same Bayes's compressed sensing technology use so that calculating speed faster, required observation data volume it is less, the precision of images obtained using method in conjunction with multipath is higher and restrained effectively the appearance of diplopia.

title_en: Soil body flowing model test system for large-scale vibration table experiment platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soil mass flow model test system for a large-scale vibration table test platform, which comprises: and (4) modeling a box: the device is used for simulating the motion conditions of soil bodies under the action of earthquake loads on mountain surfaces with different slopes and under different friction strengths; a data acquisition device: the device comprises a computer, a high-speed camera arranged on the front surface of a model box and connected with the computer, a three-dimensional laser scanner arranged on one side of the model box, a sensor which is connected with a data acquisition device of the existing large-scale vibrating table through a data line and is buried in the soil body of the model box, and monitoring cameras arranged on the side surface and the bottom of the model box. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of convenience and automation, convenient and adjustable door opening, avoidance of impact and swing, accurate data capture and the like.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar heart rate detection method based on multi-sequence WOA-VMD algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wideband radar, and relates to an ultra wideband radar heart rate detection method based on a multi-sequence WOA-VMD algorithm, which is used for acquiring multi-sequence vital sign vectors by utilizing vital sign information carried by reflected echoes of the ultra wideband radar, inhibiting respiratory interference and accurately separating heartbeat signals to obtain heart rate values, and comprises the following steps: the radar transmits pulses in a certain pulse repetition period, and the receiving end samples and records data in a certain time interval; performing clutter suppression, linear trend suppression and signal-to-noise ratio improvement preprocessing on radar echo signals, and calculating a slow time direction data variance to obtain a target position so as to obtain a multi-sequence vital sign vector; and (5) integrating a whale algorithm WOA and a variation modal decomposition algorithm to obtain the heart rate value. The method is mainly applied to occasions for acquiring vital sign information by using ultra-wideband radar.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring heart rate of personnel in vehicle based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-based in-vehicle personnel heart rate monitoring method and a radar-based in-vehicle personnel heart rate monitoring system, which belong to the technical field of vital sign detection, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring radar echo signals of vital signs of personnel in a monitoring vehicle; the method comprises the steps of determining phase signals of a range gate where a human target is located and a range gate nearby the range gate according to acquired radar echo signals, extracting spatial characteristics of the range gate where the human target is located and the range gate nearby the range gate, extracting time sequence characteristics from the extracted spatial characteristics, acquiring heartbeat signals of personnel in a vehicle according to the time sequence characteristics, and acquiring heart rates of the personnel in the vehicle according to the heartbeat signals of the personnel in the vehicle. The accuracy of monitoring the heart rate of the personnel in the car is improved.

title_en: Leak detection sensor
title_ko: 누액 감지 센서
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a leak detection sensor capable of selectively detecting hazardous materials. To this end, the present invention comprises: a base seat portion composed of a resin or a fluorine resin; a plurality of detection portions formed with conductive materials in a certain pattern on the base seat portion; and a protection portion installed in the base seat portion to prevent the detection portion from being exposed to moisture, and configured to electrically disconnect or have electrical short on the detection portion by inputting a fluid to be detected to the detection portion by being reacted with the fluid to be detected. Thus, the present invention is advantageous in that malfunctions due to raining, snowing, water cleaning, and the like are prevented and selective detection of hazardous materials can be performed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유해 물질의 선별적인 검출이 가능한 누액 감지 센서를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은 수지 또는 불소계 수지로 이루어진 베이스 시트부; 상기 베이스 시트부에 도전성 재료가 일정 패턴으로 형성된 복수의 검지부; 및 상기 베이스 시트부에 설치되어 상기 검지부가 수분에 노출되는 것을 방지하고, 검출 대상 유체와 반응하여 상기 검출 대상 유체를 검지부 측으로 침투시켜 상기 검지부가 전기적으로 단선 또는 단락(쇼트)되도록 하는 보호부를 포함한다. 따라서 본 발명은 강우, 강설, 물청소 등에 의한 오동작을 방지하여 유해 물질의 선별적인 검출이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for calibrating bio-information estimation model and, apparatus for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 장치 및 방법과, 생체정보 추정 장치
abstract_ko: 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 장치가 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면, 캘리브레이션 장치는 피검체로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서부와, 생체신호의 복수 지점 각각에서 제1 특징 및 제2 특징을 추출하고, 기준 지점의 제1 특징 대비 각 지점의 제1 특징의 변화 정도 및 상기 기준 지점의 제2 특징 대비 각 지점의 제2 특징의 변화 정도를 기초로 복수 지점 중에서 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 지점을 결정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: What radar life-detection instrument can be adjusted flexibly thickness penetrates medium mobile test platform
abstract_en: What the utility model provided that a kind of radar life-detection instrument can be adjusted flexibly thickness penetrates medium mobile test platform, including fixed frame, movable frame, wheel, several baffle plates and several separate plates；Wherein, fixed frame is cube structure, including under(-)chassis, forward frame, rear frame, left part framework, right part framework and top frame；Under(-)chassis be arranged in parallel several lower fixed card slots, and top frame is symmetrical arranged fixed card slot on several corresponding with lower fixed card slot.Advantage is：What the radar life-detection instrument provided using the utility model can be adjusted flexibly thickness penetrates medium mobile test platform, in radar life-detection instrument test process is carried out, conveniently replaced a variety of tested medias, the thickness of tested media and the combination of variety classes tested media can be adjusted flexibly, funds have been saved, measuring accuracy have more been improved, simultaneously, the test platform can shift position freely, greatly improve testing efficiency.

title_en: Infrared life detection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot which detects life based on infrared temperature induction. The robot is capable of performing infrared life detection in a severe environment and alarming through radio waves. At the same time, the robot has a motion function of robots and is capable of carrying out search and rescue work for wounded people efficiently under a condition that personnel use is reduced and reducing personnel casualty in a highly risky environment at the same time.

title_en: A kind of method of estimation of underground metalliferous pipe radius and buried depth based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses the method for estimation of a kind of underground metalliferous pipe radius based on BP neural network and buried depth, the metal circular tube that different radii and buried depth are obtained using GPR forward simulation is embedded in radar return data in different medium；The backward energy value in A Scan echo-peaks, peak value arrival time and preset time period directly over extraction metal circular tube, with this 3 parameter construction feature vectors, composition characteristic vector matrix, the data set as training sample importation.The data set of training sample output par, c is made up of the relative dielectric constant of the radius of known metal pipe, buried depth and background media.The structure of BP neural network is designed, BP neural network is trained with training sample data, inputted the characteristic parameter of GPR echo data to be measured to the BP neural network after training, the radius and buried depth of underground metal circular tube are estimated.The present invention can fast, accurately estimate the radius and buried depth of underground metalliferous pipe.

title_en: High-precision radar sign detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision radar sign detector. The system comprises a physical sign detector and an information processing terminal; the physical sign detector comprises a radar baseband processing module, at least one set of radar transmitting link and at least two sets of radar receiving links, wherein a plurality of sets of receiving and transmitting links are synchronous and are connected in a rigid body, the radar baseband processing module pretreats echo signals received by the radar receiving links, transmits the echo signals to the information processing terminal for further processing, and outputs heartbeat breathing signals. The invention is provided with a plurality of sets of radar receiving and transmitting systems, and eliminates the micro-motion interference of the trunk of the human body by specially processing complex signals uploaded by the plurality of sets of systems, thereby obtaining more accurate vital signs.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses millimeter wave radar vital sign detection equipment and a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system, wherein the equipment comprises a mobile robot main body, a height angle adjusting unit, a camera and a millimeter wave radar, and the camera and the millimeter wave radar are arranged on the mobile robot main body through the height angle adjusting unit. The system comprises a server and one or more millimeter wave radar vital sign detection devices connected with the server through a network. The invention adjusts the pitch angle and the height of the millimeter wave radar in real time, so that the pitch angle and the height can be adjusted in real time when the position of a subject changes, the possibility of data loss is reduced, and the accuracy of vital sign information is improved. And can realize comprehensive nursing in a large range, greatly improve the utilization rate of equipment.
assignees: CHINA NANHU ACAD OF ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION

title_en: Human sleeping posture identification and vital sign monitoring method based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a human sleeping posture identification and vital sign monitoring method based on an FMCW radar, which comprises the following steps: obtaining gray level images corresponding to the distance time matrix after the two radars are spliced under each sleeping posture of the human body; training a sleep posture recognition model by using the gray map data; performing sleep gesture recognition and classification on the human body to be monitored by using the trained sleep gesture recognition model; according to the recognized sleeping gesture result, correspondingly selecting one from the two distance time matrixes; accurately positioning a plurality of continuous range gates where the chest of a human body is positioned by using a chest displacement signal correlation algorithm; the chest displacement signals of a plurality of continuous range gates occupied by a human body are jointly decomposed by a GA-MVMD method to obtain a plurality of IMF components; the respiration signal and the heartbeat signal are reconstructed from each IMF component. The method improves the accuracy of sleep posture recognition and can realize accurate measurement of vital signs of human bodies under different sleep postures.

title_en: Object detection flying apparatus for detection of object entombed on lower part of ground surface and object detection method
title_ko: 지표면의 하부에 매장된 오브젝트를 탐지하는 오브젝트 탐지 비행 장치 및 오브젝트 탐지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an object detection flying device and an object detection method. The object detection flying device receives a radar signal reflected by an object buried in a lower portion of a ground surface to detect the object by using the received radar signal.
abstract_ko:
오브젝트 탐지 비행 장치 및 오브젝트 탐지 방법에 관한 것이다. 
오브젝트 탐지 비행 장치는 지표면의 하부에 매장된 오브젝트에 의해 반사된 레이더 신호를 수신하여 수신한 레이더 신호를 이용하여 상기 오브젝트를 탐지할 수 있다.

title_en: Drowsy-driving prevention method and drowsy-driving prevention system
title_ko: 운전자 졸음 방지 방법 및 운전자 졸음 방지 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a drowsy-driving prevention method and a drowsy-driving prevention system to control a stimulation unit and a measurement unit by performing an artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm in a 5G environment connected for Internet of things. According to the present invention, the drowsy-driving prevention method comprises a stimulating step, a measuring step and a determining step. The stimulation unit outputs stimulation to stimulate sensory organs of a driver, and then, the measurement unit measures a biosignal of the driver from the time to output the stimulation. When the biosignal of the driver is determined not to be a response to the stimulation, the stimulation unit can output stimulation again.
abstract_ko: 사물 인터넷을 위해 연결된 5G 환경에서 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI) 알고리즘 및/또는 기계학습(machine learning) 알고리즘을 실행하여 자극부와 측정부를 제어하는 운전자 졸음 방지 방법 및 운전자 졸음 방지 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 운전자 졸음 방지 방법은, 자극하는 단계, 측정하는 단계 및 판단하는 단계를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다. 자극부가 자극을 출력하여 운전자의 감각기관을 자극하고 나서, 측정부가 자극의 출력시점부터 운전자의 생체신호를 측정한다. 운전자의 생체신호가 자극에 대한 반응이 아니라고 판단되면, 자극부가 자극을 재출력할 수 있다.

title_en: System for vital sign monitoring and analysis for emergency with wireless radar sensor
title_ko: 비접촉 센서를 이용한 활력 징후 모니터링 및 위급 상황 분석 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a system for monitoring vital signs and analyzing an emergency situation using a non-contact sensor, which comprises: a main unit measuring vital signs, transmitting and receiving the measured data, and outputting the measured data through a sound and a display; a stretch arm unit provided to stretch an arm on one side of a robot-type body unit provided to be movable and adjustable; and a display unit displaying medical information of stored data. The present invention can provide the system capable of checking and predicting a health condition by measuring a cumulative state of a patient by proposing a sensing device located on the upper or upper end of a lying human body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가려지거나 시야 확보가 어려운 공간에서 사용자의 바이탈 사인을 확인하고, 활력징후 센싱과 정보제공용 모니터링을 위해 스트레치 암 끝단에 비접촉센서를 장착하여 활력징후 정보의 실시간 표시 및 위급 상황 분석 시스템에 관한 것으로, 스마트 헬스케어 시스템에 도입되어 위급 상황에서 다양한 정보와 대응 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
본 발명에 따른 비접촉 센서를 이용한 활력 징후 모니터링 및 위급 상황 분석 시스템은,  활력 징후를 측정하고, 상기 측정된 데이터를 송수신하며, 소리 및 디스플레이로 출력하는 메인부; 이동이 가능하도록 마련된 로봇형의 바디부 일측에 암(arm)을 뻗을 수 있도록 마련된 스트레치암부; 및 저장된 데이터의 의료 정보를 표시하는 디스플레이부;로 구성하되, 상기 메인부는 활력 징후를 측정하는 센서부; 상기 측정된 활력 징후의 데이터를 송수신하는 통신부; 상기 측정된 활력 징후 데이터에서 기설정된 값을 벗어나는 경우 위급상황으로 인지하여 알림 소리로 출력하는 알림부; 상기 측정된 활력 징후 데이터에서 기설정된 값을 벗어나는 경우 위급상황으로 인지하여 디스플레이로 출력하는 표시부; 및 상기 메인부를 컨트롤하는 컨트롤부;로 구성되고, 상기 메인부가 스트레치암부의 말단에 장착되어 상기 활력 징후를 측정하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SILLA UNIV INDUSTRY UNIV COOPERATION FOUNDATION;FUTURE ICT CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant operator's workload evaluation system and method using biosignal
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 원자력발전소 운전원의 직무부하 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for evaluating a job load of a nuclear power plant operator using a bio-signal. The system comprises: a bio-signal detection device including a heart rate measurement sensor and a skin electric resistance measurement sensor; and a server communicating with the bio-signal detection device, wherein a data receiving unit of the server receives bio-activity information from the bio-activity detection device; a preprocessing unit classifies the received bio-activity information into a mental element and a physical element, and compares the classified mental and physical elements with pre-stored mental and physical elements in a normal state to derive a first result value of the mental element and a second result value of the physical element, respectively; a priority setting unit sets a priority of each of the mental element and the physical element by applying a preset weight to each of the derived first result value and the derived second result value; and an evaluation result report creation unit creates an individual job load evaluation result report according to the set priority. Therefore, the present invention can improve the accuracy and reliability of job load evaluation, and can reduce manpower and time required for evaluation work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호를 이용한 원자력발전소 운전원의 직무부하 평가 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 심박수 측정 센서 및 피부전기저항 측정 센서를 구비하는 생체신호 감지장치; 및 생체신호 감지장치와 통신하는 서버를 포함하고, 서버의 데이터 수신부가 생체활동 감지장치로부터 생체활동 정보를 수신하고, 전처리부가 수신된 생체활동 정보를 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소로 분류하고 분류된 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소와 기 저장된 정상상태의 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소를 비교하여 정신적 요소의 제1 결과값 및 육체적 요소의 제2 결과값을 각각 도출하고, 우선순위 설정부가 도출된 제1 결과값 및 도출된 제2 결과값 각각에 기 설정된 가중치를 적용하여 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소 각각의 우선순위를 설정하고, 평가결과보고서 작성부가 설정된 우선순위에 따라 개인별 직무부하 평가결과보고서를 작성하는 구성으로 직무부하 평가의 정확성 및 신뢰성이 향상되며, 평가업무에 소요되는 인력과 시간을 절감할 수 있다.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for health and safety of infants or elderly
title_ko: 유아 또는 노약자의 건강과 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are monitoring system and method for the health and safety of infants or the elderly. The monitoring system for the health and safety of infants or the elderly according to the present invention includes: a sensor unit for sensing the health and indoor environment of infants or the elderly; a monitoring unit for monitoring the health status and sleep environment of infants or the elderly by analyzing sensing data on the health and indoor environment sensed through the sensor unit; and a communication unit for transmitting monitoring information on the health status and sleep environment to a guardian terminal. The sensor unit includes a real-time sensor for capturing general images, a thermal image sensor for sensing body temperature, and a radar sensor for sensing breathing.
abstract_ko: 유아 또는 노약자의 건강과 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 유아 또는 노약자의 건강과 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템은 유아나 노약자의 건강 및 실내 환경을 감지하는 센서부, 상기 센서부를 통해 감지된 건강 및 실내 환경에 관한 센싱 데이터를 분석하여 유아나 노약자의 건강 상태 및 수면 환경을 모니터링하는 모니터링부, 및 상기 건강 상태 및 수면 환경에 관한 모니터링 정보를 보호자 단말기에 전송하는 통신부를 포함하고, 상기 센서부는 일반 영상을 촬영하는 실화상 센서, 체온 감지를 위한 열화상 센서 및 호흡 감지를 위한 레이다 센서를 포함한다.

title_en: Life sign detection system, apparatus, and method
abstract_en: A Life Sign Detection system (LDS) monitors one or more environments using radar. The radar signals are processed to generate one or more point clouds, each associated with an organism in the environment(s). Life signs for the organisms(s) are inferred based on the radar point clouds. For example, the coordinates of the point cloud may be tracked to determine if the organism is moving about the environment, frequency domain components of the points of the point cloud may be used to determine involuntary movements, or combinations thereof. The LDS may determine a status of the organism(s) based on the inferred life signs. For example, if the organism is moving or has involuntary movement, the organism may be determined to be alive. In some embodiments, the life signs may be compared to normal ranges to determine a status of the organism(s).

title_en: Recuperation monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nursing monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar, which relate to the technical field of nursing monitoring and solve the technical problem that in the prior art, a patient in real time cannot be analyzed in time according to vital sign parameters of a nursing process in a nursing period; and monitoring and analyzing vital sign parameters of the rehabilitation process of the analysis object, judging whether the rehabilitation state of the analysis object in the rehabilitation period is qualified or not, and accordingly monitoring the rehabilitation of the analysis object in the rehabilitation period.

title_en: Intelligent robot for fire-extinguishing
title_ko: 소화용 지능형 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent robot for fire-extinguishing purposes to wirelessly inform a user or a fire station of a fire and to travel to a relevant indoor position on its own to promptly extinguish a fire in the initial stages. To achieve this, the intelligent robot for fire-extinguishing purposes includes: a body part (10) wherein a main wheel (11) is mounted on both sides and an auxiliary wheel (12) is mounted at the center on the front and rear sides; an insertion space part (16) arranged above the body part (10); a fire hydrant (40) inserted into the insertion space part (16) of the body part (10); a proximity sensor bar (20) joined to the front side of the body part (10) to avoid obstacles; an infrared sensor bar (30) joined to the front side of the body part (10) to sense a fire; and a control part (50) buried in the body part (10).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화용 지능형 로봇에 관한 것으로, 특히 화재시 소방소 또는 사용자에게 무선으로 화재 사실을 알리고, 실내에서 자체적으로 해당 위치까지 자율 주행하여 화재를 신속하게 초기 진압할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Building repair method
title_ko: 신속하고 스마트한 구조물 인상 공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rapid and smart method of lifting a structure, which uses an apparatus for correcting cracks and abnormal displacement of the structure generated by aging of the structure or constant natural disasters so as to remove the ground around the structure with the abnormal displacement, select a position by considering the leaning direction of the structure and the position of cracks, and bury a lathe connection pipe and a plurality of connection pipes by a hydraulic pressure through a rotary cylinder at the selected position of the structure. When the front end connection pipe is buried down to a firm ground layer, the structure is supported by a beam, and a hydraulic apparatus is installed on an upper surface of the connection pipe engaged with a connection pipe mounting plate to be operated so as to lift the structure by raising the beam along a bracket formed on one side of the beam. At the same time, the cracks of the structure are matched. In addition, the present invention is able to frequently check the displacement of a building through a vibration detection sensor and at the same time, automatically block electricity in the structure when a natural disaster occurs, thereby preventing accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조물의 노후화 또는 잇따른 자연재해로인해 발생하는 구조물의 균열과 이상변위를 바로잡는 장치로써, 상기 이상변위가 생긴 구조물 주위에 지반을 걷어낸 후 상기 구조물의 기울어진 방향과 균열의 위치를 고려하여 위치선정을 하고, 상기 선정된 구조물 위치에 회전식실린더를 통해 선반연결관과 다수의 연결관을 유압으로 매설한다.  상기 선단연결관이 단단한 지반층까지 매설되면 대들보를 통해 구조물을 받치도록 하고 연결관탑재판에 결합된 연결관 상면에 유압장치를 설치하여 가동하므로 대들보 일측에 형성된 브라켓을 따라 대들보가 상승하도록 하여 구조물을 들어올리고 그 동시에 구조물의 균열을 맞출 수 있도록 한다.    또한, 진동감지센서를 통해 건물의 변위를 수시로 체크하는 동시에 자연재해가 발생할 시 구조물 내의 전력을 자동차단하여 안전사고를 예방을 할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 신속하고 스마트한 구조물 인상 공법 장치에 관한것이다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for heartbeat detection using radar
title_ko: 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 방법은, 레이더의 송신 신호가 대상자에 의해 반사된 수신 신호를 획득하는 단계, 상기 수신 신호로부터 미리 설정된 윈도우 크기를 갖는 단위 신호를 추출하는 단계, 상기 단위 신호를 복수 개 결합하여 데이터 셋을 재구성하는 단계 및 상기 데이터 셋을 이용한 푸리에 변환의 결과를 이용하여 상기 대상자의 심박신호를 추출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for detecting buried objects
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method for detecting buried objects includes receiving ground penetrating radar (GPR) signals captured at discrete locations along a surface of a medium in which an object may be buried, computing parameters based on the received GPR signals that are indicative of the proximity of a buried object, plotting the computed parameters as a function of location, determining an apex of a hyperbola that results from the plotting of the computed parameters, and designating a location at which the apex occurs as an estimated location of the buried object.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH FLORIDA;UNIV OF THE SCIENCES IN PHILADELPHIA

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in front of a plurality of sensors such as those of speakers and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from the plurality of sensors may be analyzed by the processor to determine if one or more humans are present proximate to the device. Based on the determined presence or absence of one or more humans, further actions including, inter alia, customizing a home theatre experience for the one or more humans, making content recommendations, or activating parental controls can be taken by the device.

title_en: Circular plastic tarpaulin room
abstract_en: The circular plastic tarpaulin room comprises a roof and a room body, wherein the roof is arranged at the top end of the room body, a working cavity is arranged in the room body, a sliding door is arranged on the side wall of the front end of the working cavity, shutters and observation windows are arranged on the side walls of the left side and the right side of the working cavity, a pre-buried layer is arranged at the bottom end of the room body, a driving motor is arranged at the top end of the working cavity, a driving gear is arranged at the top end of the working cavity, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the driving gear, the room body is arranged above the working cavity and provided with an annular conduction cavity, and through the arrangement of the driving gear, the conduction gear, the convex block, the fire sprinkler and a dry powder storage tank, when a fire disaster happens, a smoke sensor drives a control valve to be opened, and simultaneously controls the driving motor to work, so as to drive the conduction gear and the fire sprinkler to carry out circular motion, and spray dry powder outwards through the fire sprinkler, thereby spraying of dry powder is more comprehensive even to promote fire extinguishing effect.
assignees: TIANJIN LONGISU SEA CRYSTAL GROUP LTD COMPANY;DRY FARMLAND INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH BALANCED WATER LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: A kind of multipaths restraint method of wall after multiple target after through-wall radar three-dimensional imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses multipaths restraint method of wall after multiple target after a kind of through-wall radar three-dimensional imaging, all objects in images are extracted from the original radar three-dimensional image after binaryzation first；Then all objects barycentric coodinates, and the Euclidean distance progress ascending sort according to their barycentric coodinates from radar array center are extracted；Next calculates all objects to the directapath propagation distance and multiple paths propagation distance of each bay；Then relevant matches coefficient is defined, and calculates the relevant matches coefficient of the direct directapath propagation distance of object and multiple paths propagation distance two-by-two；Decision threshold and rule are finally defined, and whether they have Target multipath relation according to the relevant matches coefficient decision of two objects, find out in image and them are rejected after all multipaths.The present invention effectively can reject multipath of rear wall in through-wall radar 3-D view.

title_en: Method for detecting object through wall by radar, radar detection equipment and electronic device
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for detecting an object through a wall by a radar, a radar detection device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein a stationary object on one side of the wall is detected on the other side of the wall by using radar detectors at different positions on the other side of the wall, and a detection result corresponding to each position is obtained; establishing a first relationship at each position for representing the length of the different propagation paths, the propagation time of the electromagnetic wave and the propagation speed of the electromagnetic wave, and establishing a second relationship for representing the received electromagnetic wave strength, the propagation time and the propagation speed obtained on the different propagation paths; according to the first relation and the second relation, the position of the static object is determined, the problem of low accuracy when the radar is adopted to detect the target object blocked by the wall body in the fire scene is solved, and the accuracy of radar detection is improved.

title_en: Gesture recognition method of wireless through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gesture recognition method of a wireless through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: A. collecting source data; a1, collecting source domain data in an obstacle-free environment: the human body targets put out different postures, the radar collects and receives signals, and the signals are collected and a source data set is manufactured. According to the invention, the human body echo data of the through-wall radar is collected firstly, so that the effect of automatically comparing the gesture recognition is facilitated in the later period, the through-wall radar can be applied to actual tasks such as safety detection, disaster rescue and the like, the human body gesture is conveniently and automatically recognized by adopting the cooperation of the discriminator and the memory, the condition that the manual recognition is time-consuming and labor-consuming is avoided, and the problem that the gesture of a human body target is distinguished manually according to the statistical characteristics is solved; the method relies on the statistical characteristics of manual design, so that judgment is needed manually, and the method not only consumes time and energy, but also has the problem of low recognition accuracy.
assignees: WUXI XINCHENGHUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Sleep tracking and vital sign monitoring using low power radio waves
abstract_en: Various arrangements for performing radar-based measurement of vital signs. Waveform data may be received then filtered of data indicative of static objects to obtain motion-indicative waveform data. The motion-indicative waveform data may be analyzed to determine one or more frequencies of movement present within the motion-indicative waveform data. A spectral analysis may be performed on the motion-indicative waveform data to determine a spectral-analysis state of a monitored region. The spectral-analysis state of the monitored region may be determined to match a predefined spectral-analysis state during which vital sign monitoring is permitted. One or more vital signs of a monitored user present within the monitored region may be determined and output based on analyzing the motion-indicative waveform data.

title_en: Multifunctional telemetry alert safety system (MTASS)
abstract_en: A personnel accountability and situational awareness monitoring communications system for emergency personnel that comprises wireless network-adaptable monitoring devices, peripherals and base station console software for telemetry monitoring of real-time information at a plurality of personnel accountability and situational awareness parameters of critical data about the safety, health and whereabouts of first responders deployed in typically hazardous environments. Exterior incident command, including fire, rescue, safety and other emergency agencies achieve real-time command view and control over a variety of personnel accountability and safety parameters during emergency response activities of personnel wearing the system of the present invention portable device while operating within the wireless network of an emergency incident scene. Configured to be carried by emergency services personnel while deployed on scene, the portable device is a multi-functional sensing and communicating integration of accountability and situational awareness technologies consolidated into one portable, telemetry device. The portable device's multifunctional integrated technology includes the monitoring, telemetry and alert notification of accountability identification, location, assignment notification, vital signs, ambient vicinity temperature, SCBA status, combustible gas sensing, video streaming, “evacuation” recall signaling, signal tracking and multi-alarm signaling if the wearer has either low remaining air pressure/time, impending thermal breakthrough, low battery power, exceeds the safety threshold for safe heart rate or external body temperature readings, or becomes motionless for a predetermined time period.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring vital body signs of a seated person
abstract_en: A method comprising the step of using a plurality of doppler radars disposed on the seat belt or integrated into the seat belt for monitoring vital body signs of a person seated in a seat of a motor vehicle is disclosed. The disclosed method unobtrusively monitors vital body signs like heart rate and respiration of the person seated in the motor vehicle. A number of safety applications as well as wellness applications can be enabled. Examples are detection of momentary sleep of the driver, vital sign monitoring in case of an accident as well as relaxation exercise using biofeedback to reduce stress for drivers.
assignees: KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV;PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;THIJS JEROEN ADRIANUS JOHANNES;MUEHLSTEFF JENS;PINTER ROBERT

title_en: Non-contact identity recognition method, system, medium, equipment and terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of identity recognition, and discloses a non-contact type identity recognition method, a non-contact type identity recognition system, a non-contact type identity recognition medium, a non-contact type identity recognition device and a non-contact type identity recognition terminal, wherein a life motion signal of a target individual acquired by AWR1642 is subjected to phase extraction, demodulation and difference; the method comprises the steps of carrying out denoising treatment on differential phase signals by utilizing sine fitting to obtain heart motion information, carrying out improvement on a wild dog algorithm optimization support vector machine by utilizing self-adaptive adjustment weight and local disturbance to realize identity recognition, separating respiratory and heartbeat signals by using a Butterworth low-pass filter, comparing the obtained heartbeat frequency with an intelligent bracelet, and verifying the feasibility of the FMCW millimeter wave radar for detecting life signals. Experimental results show that the heart beat frequency obtained by the method and the pearson correlation coefficient obtained by the contact method are 0.96, the feasibility of acquiring life signals by the FMCW radar is shown, the accuracy of real individual identification by using the improved wild dog optimization algorithm to optimize the SVM can reach 88%, and the identification accuracy can be effectively improved by the identification method.

title_en: Life detection method and device based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection method and device based on radar, and the method comprises the steps of detecting a target by the radar, determining distance information and angle information of the target, preprocessing signals in a target distance unit, outputting target signals, obtaining phase information of the target signals, performing phase unwrapping on the target signals to obtain life signals, separating the life signals to obtain breathing signals and heartbeat signals, obtaining the frequency of the heartbeat signals and the frequency of the breathing signals by a time domain method and a frequency method, respectively determining a breathing frequency weighting coefficient and a heartbeat frequency weighting coefficient according to the numerical value difference of the breathing frequency and the numerical value difference of the heartbeat frequency under the time domain method and the frequency method, and obtaining a breathing frequency detection value and a heartbeat frequency detection value. The method effectively eliminates the defects of the time domain method and the frequency method, and improves the accuracy of vital sign data detection.

title_en: Method and system for non-contact vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system (1), the radar sensor system (1) comprising a transmitter (2), a receiver (3) and a processing device (5), wherein the transmitter (2) irradiates (100) at least one body region (21) of a person (20) with radar radiation (30), the receiver (3) generates (110) a receiver signal from reflected radiation (11) from the at least one body region, the processing device (5) generates a displacement signal for each of a plurality of processing windows based on the receiver signal, and calculates an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillatory motion, the displacement signal characterizing the body motion, the body motion comprising respiratory motion and cardiac motion as oscillatory motions. In order to provide a reliable and efficient means for vital sign monitoring, the present invention provides that the processing device (5) applies an adaptive non-linear least squares method to calculate (250) a plurality of frequency estimates (f  r1 、f r2 、f r3 ) based on the displacement signal, each of the plurality of frequency estimates corresponding to one of a plurality of harmonics of the first oscillatory motion, wherein the processing device (5) uses a separate search area (a  h1 、A h2 、A h3 ) for each frequency estimate (f  r1 、f r2 、f r3 ), adapts at least one search area (a  h1 、A h2 、A h3 ) for at least one processing window, and calculates (300) a first estimated fundamental frequency (f  h ) for the first oscillatory motion based on the frequency estimates (f  r1 、f r2 、f r3 ).

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Direct-buried laying steam pipeline structure and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-buried laying steam pipeline structure, which relates to the technical field of thermal pipelines and comprises a core pipe, wherein the core pipe comprises a left pipe section and a right pipe section, a disposable compensator is connected between the left pipe section and the right pipe section, sleeves are sleeved on the left pipe section and the right pipe section, and heat-insulating layers are filled between the sleeves and the left pipe section and between the sleeves and the right pipe section. Aiming at the problem that the corrugated pipe is frequently stretched and easily damaged in the prior art, the invention lays the steam pipe network in a non-compensation laying mode, simplifies the installation project of the heat supply network, reduces the manufacturing cost and eliminates the risk of disasters caused by damage of the compensator.
assignees: SHANGHAI KEHUA THERMAL PIPE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar, monitoring method and emotion judging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar, a monitoring method and an emotion judging method, which belong to the technical field of health monitoring, and particularly comprise an MCU module, a loudspeaker module, a millimeter wave radar antenna board, a power supply module and a display screen, wherein the MCU module, the loudspeaker module, the millimeter wave radar antenna board and the power supply module are arranged in a shell, and the display screen is arranged on the shell; the invention adopts non-contact monitoring, has wide application range and simple and quick monitoring.

title_en: Radar type life detection method, system and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrying
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a radar type life detection method, a system and a medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrying; the method can comprise the following steps: receiving radar echo signals in a detection area by a biological radar carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform; the radar echo signals comprise a plurality of channel signals; eliminating motion interference about a platform in radar echo signals by using platform motion information sensed by a sensor carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and obtaining a first radar signal after preliminary interference suppression; after all channel signals in the first radar signal are subjected to cross-correlation processing, restraining environmental motion interference in a detection area by adopting a self-adaptive spectral line enhancement mode, and obtaining a second radar signal which is subjected to interference suppression processing; extracting the breathing detail characteristics of the human target from the second radar signal; and determining whether a human body target exists in the detection area based on a human body motion recognition strategy of the two-dimensional CA-CFAR and the breathing detail characteristics of the human body target.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION AIR FORCE AND MILITARY UNIV

title_en: Ductile segment suitable for fracture zone and simulation experiment device and experiment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ductile segment suitable for a fracture zone, a simulation experiment device and an experiment method thereof, wherein the ductile segment comprises an arc segment main body, a shearing joint is arranged in the middle of the segment main body, a shearing force sensor is arranged at the shearing joint, and segment main bodies at two opposite sides in the shearing joint are connected through elastic members; the steel plate member and the water-swelling water stop strip are buried in the duct piece main body; the upper side and the lower side of the duct piece main body are provided with bolt holes for connecting with adjacent duct piece main bodies; the steel plate member comprises fixed steel plates positioned at the upper side and the lower side, the left side and the right side of the steel plate member are movable steel plates capable of moving left and right, and the duct piece main body is connected with the movable steel plates through double-acting jacks. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the toughness of the whole structure is improved, the safety is higher, and the influence of dislocation of the fracture zone on the tunnel structure under the action of an earthquake can be effectively reduced.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN;CCCC TUNNEL ENGINEERING COMPANY LTD

title_en: Fine detection system and method for dam formic nest ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a dam newly-buried nest ground penetrating radar refined detection system and method, which relate to the technical field of dam newly-buried nest geophysical detection, and aim at the current short plates such as shallow detection depth, difficult sketching of space characteristics of newly-buried nest in detection section, incapability of reflecting expansion degree of newly-buried nest on a dam cross section and the like of the current ground penetrating radar.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GUANGCHUAN ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar human body behavior identification method based on micro Doppler angular point characteristics and dynamic graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar indoor human body behavior identification technology based on micro Doppler angular point characteristics and a Dynamic Graph Convolution Neural Network (DGCNN). The method firstly utilizes the DoG-mu D-CornerDet to extract the radar distance and the angular point characteristics on the Doppler image. And secondly, maximizing the distance between behavior classes under the constraint of a kinematic model by using a micro Doppler angular point screening method based on polynomial fitting smoothing. And thirdly, fusing micro-Doppler angular point features on the distance and Doppler images by using a non-maximum suppression algorithm, and establishing a three-dimensional angular point Yun Te collection. And finally, utilizing DGCNN identification models to realize the mapping from the point cloud characteristic data to the behavior label. Simulation and actual measurement results show that the method has high identification accuracy and strong generalization capability on radar data acquired by different subjects.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection system and method based on millimeter wave radar. The detection system comprises: a transmit antenna, a receive antenna, a mixer, and a signal processor, the transmit antenna configured to transmit a signal from a signal source; the receiving antenna receives the echo signals reflected after the transmitting antenna transmits to the object to be detected, and transmits the echo signals to the mixer; and the signals mixed by the mixer are transmitted to a signal processor after being subjected to signal processing so as to extract characteristic signals. And transmitting FMCW electromagnetic waves to radiate the object to be detected by using the radar system to receive electromagnetic wave signals reflected by the object to be detected. Further extracting phase change information and Doppler frequency shift information in the reflected signals, thereby extracting vital sign information such as heartbeats.

title_en: Inspection of passengers device based on distributed dual-polarized millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a inspection of passengers device based on a distributed dual-polarized millimeter wave radar, which relates to the inspection of passengers device and the radar imaging detection field, and comprises a detection device body and upper computer equipment, wherein the detection device body comprises an electromagnetic wave shielding box and a wave absorbing material conveying belt, an inlet and an outlet are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the electromagnetic wave shielding box to form a transmission channel, the wave absorbing material conveying belt penetrates through the transmission channel and is fixed at the bottom of the electromagnetic wave shielding box through a transmission bracket, electromagnetic shielding curtains are arranged at the inlet and the outlet of the electromagnetic wave shielding box, vertical polarization detection radars and horizontal polarization detection radars are symmetrically arranged on the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the electromagnetic wave shielding box, and the dual-polarized MIMO imaging radar is arranged in the central area of the inner wall of the top of the electromagnetic wave shielding box. The device utilizes the distributed dual-polarized millimeter wave radar to cooperatively detect and integrate multi-mode information, solves the contradiction between coverage and identification precision in inspection of passengers and the difficulty in vital sign detection, and improves the security inspection efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
title_ko: 초광대역 모니터링 시스템 및 안테나
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station. ® KIPO & WIPO 2009
abstract_ko: 하나 이상의 살아있는 대상의 활력 징후를 모니터링하는 장치는 모니터링 스테이션 및 상기 모니터링 스테이션과 통신하는 적어도 하나의 센서를 포함한다. 상기 센서는 안테나 시스템, 상기 안테나 시스템에 커플된 초광대역 레이더 시스템, 신호 프로세서 및 통신 시스템을 포함한다. 상기 신호 프로세서는 상기 초광대역 레이더 시스템으로부터 신호를 수신하도록 연결되고 상기 안테나 시스템에 대응하는 감지 공간 내에서 사람 또는 동물의 하나 이상의 활력 징후에 대해 상기 신호 정보로부터 추출되도록 구성된다. 상기 통신 시스템은 상기 모니터링 스테이션으로 상기 정보를 전송하도록 구성된다.

title_en: All in one survival kit for fire escape and evacation leading LED line system connected to thereof
title_ko: 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 led라인 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated survival kit for fire evacuation and an evacuation guidance LED line system linked therewith and, more specifically, to an integrated survival kit for fire evacuation, which is always carried by a user to wear goggles and an oxygen mask in case of a fire or disaster so that the user quickly responds to suffocation accidents caused by fire and evacuates safely from the fire scene, and an evacuation guidance LED line system linked therewith.
