According to the present invention, a thermal sensor, a controller, and a beacon sensor are buried in an existing winker hose LED guidance lamp, are configured to be connected to an emergency exit, and are linked with a beacon sensor installed in the integrated survival kit for fire evacuation, so that an emergency exit in a direction away from the place where a fire occurred, and thus prompt evacuation is guided.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 LED라인 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 화재나 재난 상황에서 항시 고글 및 산소마스크를 착용할 수 있게 휴대하여 화재로 인한 질식사고에 신속하게 대응함과 동시에 화재 현장으로부터 안전하게 대피하는 것이 가능한 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 LED라인 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
특히, 본 발명의 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 LED라인 시스템은 기존 윙카호스LED 유도등 내에 열감지센서 및 콘트롤러와 비콘센서를 매립하고, 비상구와 연결되도록 구성되며, 상기 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트에 설치된 비콘센서와 연동하게 하여 화재발생장소로부터 이격되는 방향의 비상구로 안내하도록 구성하여 신속한 피난을 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Grenade Training Simulation System
title_ko: 수류탄 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 훈련병이 가상 현실(VR), 증강 현실(AR), 혼합 현실(MR) 기술을 활용하여 실제 수류탄 투척 훈련을 가상으로 경험할 수 있는 수류탄 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이 시스템은 센서 기반 시뮬레이션을 통해 훈련병의 투척 궤적과 속도를 실시간으로 감지 및 분석하여 훈련 효과를 극대화하며, 훈련 관리, 데이터 분석, 비상 대피, 신체 상태 모니터링 등의 기능을 포함한다. VR 시스템은 VR 헤드셋을 통해 가상 환경에서 훈련을 진행하게 하며, AR 시스템은 실제 훈련 환경에 가상 정보를 추가하여 실감 나는 훈련을 가능하게 한다. MR 시스템은 가상과 실제 환경이 결합된 훈련 환경을 제공하여 현실감 있는 훈련을 지원한다. 센서 기반 시뮬레이션 시스템은 센서수류탄, 센서플레이트, 콘솔박스로 구성되어 훈련 데이터를 실시간으로 감지하고 분석한다. 대형 스크린은 투척 결과를 시각적으로 제공하여 몰입감을 높이며, 훈련 관리 시스템은 훈련 상황을 모니터링하고 제어할 수 있게 한다. 데이터 분석 시스템은 훈련 성과를 평가하고 피드백을 제공하여 훈련 효과를 극대화하고, 비상 대피 시스템은 비상 상황 시 훈련병을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있다. 신체 상태 모니터링 시스템은 훈련병의 생체 신호를 감지하여 이상 징후가 발생하면 경고하는 기능을 포함한다. 이를 통해 훈련병이 안전하고 효과적으로 수류탄 훈련을 받을 수 있도록 하며, 훈련의 질과 효과를 향상시킨다.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Vital signs beacon system
abstract_en: Monitoring and action related to an end user's sleep activity may be provided by a system, device, and associated methods to monitor an end user's heart activity. A ballistocardiograph (BCG) signal may be detected by a physiological sensor that is not in contact with the end user. The BCG signal may be used to determine one of a plurality of sleep related statuses and health. Reports, alerts, and control of local electronic devices may be performed by a remote computer server and analysis engine that process the BCG signal.

title_en: Practical landslide early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a practical landslide early warning system. Comprises a main control unit and a plurality of landslide sensors. The main control unit is composed of a wireless receiving module, a microprocessor, a short message module, a storage module, an audible and visual alarm, a state indicating module and a receiving antenna. The landslide sensor is composed of a mechanical double-shaft inclination angle detection module, a wireless transmitting module, an antenna and a battery. The landslide sensors are buried in different positions of a scene where landslide is likely to occur perpendicularly to the horizontal plane, and each landslide sensor can be set with different inclination angle thresholds and is in a power-off state at ordinary times. The main control unit is arranged in the home of personnel near the landslide point or in enterprises and public institutions or other places where uninterrupted power supply is possible. The invention has the advantages that the difficult problem of power supply of the landslide sensor is solved; the landslide sensor has the advantages of simple internal structure, power supply by a dry battery, small volume, low cost and capability of being used in a large amount; landslide sensors can be embedded in a plurality of positions at the same place, so that the landslide monitoring range is enlarged, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system of moving target
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system of a moving target, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting chirp signals with different slope frequencies based on MIMO technology to obtain multiple groups of signal data with different distance resolutions; acquiring target distance information and extracting a target phase signal; and decomposing the target phase signal based on a modal decomposition algorithm to obtain a heartbeat signal and a respiratory signal of the target, and estimating the target heart rate and respiratory frequency. According to the invention, non-contact millimeter wave radar detection is used, so that the detection of the respiration rate and the heart rate of a moving target is realized, and compared with wearable and contact equipment, the privacy is ensured, and meanwhile, pleasant experience is brought to a user; compared with other traditional non-contact vital sign monitoring methods, the method does not need to enable the monitored personnel to sit on a chair or lie on a bed to enable the chest to face the radar equipment, supports the target to conduct normal activities in the monitoring area, and achieves vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Millimeter wave mapping system and method for generating point cloud and determining vital signs to define human mental state
abstract_en: Millimeter wave (mmWave) mapping systems and methods are disclosed for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs to define a human mental state. A point cloud is generated that includes point cloud data defining a person or object detected within a physical space based on one or more mmWave waveforms of the mmWave sensor. A pose of the person within the portion of the physical space is determined from the point cloud data. One or more vital signs of the person are determined based on the mmWave waveform. Electronic feedback is provided that represents a human mental state of the person defined by the point cloud data and the one or more vital signs of the person.

title_en: Radar apparatus with natural convection
abstract_en: An apparatus detects and measures vital signs of each human target by a continuous, non-intrusive method. In an example, the vital signs of interest include a heart rate and a respiratory rate, which can provide valuable information about the human's wellness. Additionally, the heart rate and respiratory rate can also be used to identify a particular person, if more than two target humans are living in a home. The apparatus has a natural convection spatial flow path that draws heat from at least one processor, one fan-less radar and a heat sink.

title_en: After-calamity detecting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an after-calamity detecting rescue robot, which is formed by a robot body, a remote control terminal and a signal transmission module, wherein the robot body comprises more than two reflection photoelectric switches, a temperature sensor, a life signal detector, a humidity sensor and a front-positioned CCD (charge-coupled device) camera, a wireless module and a voice module, which are connected with a control circuit and are respectively fixed on a vehicle body; the robot body also comprises wheels driven by a driving circuit and speed reducing motors; the reflection photoelectric switches, the temperature sensor, the life signal detector and the humidity sensor are mounted at the front end of the robot body; the front-positioned CCD camera is mounted above the front end of the robot. The after-calamity detecting rescue robot overcomes the after-calamity severe rescue environment and avoids the potential dangers of a dangerous area to the rescue staff, so the rescue and survival probability of trapped people in the disaster area is improved, functions such as finding and detecting lives, position determining and performing multiple rescue are achieved, the stability is good, the operation is simple and the after-calamity detecting rescue robot has a well application prospect.

title_en: Underground buried pipe detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides an underground pipe detector, belongs to detection equipment technical field, includes the base and installs in four wheels of base both sides wall, and the standing groove has been seted up on the base top, and geological radar has been placed to the standing groove inner chamber, and geological radar passes through stop gear detachable setting in the inner chamber of standing groove, and stop gear includes drive part and spacing part, drives spacing part through drive part and carries out spacingly to geological radar position. The geological radar is arranged at the base in a detachable mode, so that the geological radar can be flexibly detached or installed, the geological radar is convenient and quick to detach, the subsequent independent maintenance and overhaul of the geological radar are facilitated, the phenomenon that the screen display device slides left and right and falls down can be effectively prevented by limiting the rear side and the left and right sides of the screen display device respectively, and the screen display device can keep stable positions in the geological detection process.
assignees: LIAONING JUWEI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting concealed target life trace and concealed target detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the radar technology, in particular to the hidden target detection and recognition technology. The invention discloses a method for detecting a hidden living target by utilizing the radar technology and a detection device. The hidden target detection device of the invention is composed of a microwave radar, and is characterized in that the microwave radar has two different modes: a moving target detection mode and a life sign detection mode. The method and the detection device have the advantages that the detection and the positioning of the hidden target are carried out by utilizing the penetrability of the microwave. The accurate detection of the motion state of the hidden target can be carried out, the detection and the recognition of the life signs of a static target can also be carried out, thereby being able to be widely applied in fight against terrorism, disaster relief and other fields.

title_en: Intelligent information collecting device on disaster site
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent information collecting device on a disaster site. A communication module, a temperature and pressure sensor, a micro sensor, an RFID reading instrument, a gyroscope, a vital sign detector and the like are designed to be additionally arranged. The several innovative functions of man positioning, telecommunication, motion state detection, air respirator pressure monitoring, external environment (temperature and pressure) detection, vital sign monitoring and the like inside a building are further achieved, and all detecting parameters can be transmitted to a field managing rescue platform in real time. The intelligent information collecting device on the disaster site is reasonable in structure, improves the fire protection and rescue efficiency, lowers the life and property loss to the minimum degree, and improves the life safety guarantee level.
assignees: XINJIANG ZHONGJU ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrostatic field sensor and a security system in interior spaces, which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna (1). Said probe is connected to an electronic circuit (2,3,4,31,32) which is able to decode said changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor, and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field, by means of a processor (7), enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding said antenna (1) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidance method, computer program product and system
abstract_en: A hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) coaching method (40) for a system comprising a head-mountable computing device (100) is disclosed, the hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation coaching method (40) allowing a rescuer to receive CPR coaching without losing sight of the victim, the head-mountable computing device (100) comprising a processor (110) and at least one display module (106, 106') arranged to be viewed by a wearer (20) of the head-mountable computing device when the wearer wears the device. The method comprises the following steps: receiving (420), on the processor, a first signal conveying vital sign information from at least one sensor (200, 210) for monitoring vital signs of a patient (10), wherein a sensor (210) of the at least one sensor is integrated in the head-mountable computing device (100); processing the first signal on the processor to extract the vital sign information; and displaying (422) CPR guidance on the at least one display module in response to the processed vital sign information. A computer program product and a CPR coaching system are also disclosed. The system can be created using ubiquitous devices (e.g., smart devices including available sensors), thereby facilitating a fast response to SCA events, which improves the chances of survival of SCA patients.

title_en: Life detection and environmental data collecting search and rescue car after the calamity of controlled in wireless
abstract_en: Car is searched and rescued the invention discloses life detection after a kind of calamity of controlled in wireless and environmental data collecting.The present invention includes main control chip, power module, automatic obstacle-avoiding and range finder module, motor drive module, IMAQ and face detection module, smog and Carbon Monoxide Detection module, flame detection modules, ambient light detection module, lighting module, Temperature and Humidity module, pyroelectricity life detection module, wifi communication modules, environment scene feature drafting module.Small volume of the present invention, the unapproachable dangerous narrow space of people can be entered and carry out detection and rescue, employ the automatic obstacle-avoiding solution of autonomous Design, realize the avoidance in complicated landform, meanwhile, under the scene that obstacle avoidance system can not be handled, mode of operation can be switched to manually operated, it can continue effectively to be searched and rescued, casualties is reduced to greatest extent.

title_en: Two-band vital signs detecting radar system based on superhet and low intermediate frequency structure
abstract_en: The two-band vital signs detecting radar system based on superhet and low intermediate frequency structure that the invention discloses a kind of, including receiving antenna and transmitting antenna, receiving antenna series connection low-noise amplifier, No.1 frequency mixer and bandpass filter, the No.1 frequency mixer is connected with No.1 low-pass filter, No.1 low-pass filter connects No.1 analog-digital converter, No. two frequency mixers of bandpass filter series connection, No. two low-pass filters and No. two analog-digital converters；Transmitting antenna connects power amplifier, and power amplifier connects power combining structures, and power combining structures input terminal connects No. two phase-locked loop chips being connected with No. two mixer inputs all the way, and another way connects power splitter；Power splitter input terminal connects No.1 phase-locked loop chip, and output end is connected to power combining structures input terminal all the way, and another way is connected to No.1 mixer input.The present invention can solve the problems, such as that direct current biasing and mirror image inhibit simultaneously, realize the Effect on Detecting of the vital sign parameter signals of higher precision.

title_en: A kind of object detection apparatus suitable for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to object detection apparatus fields, especially a kind of object detection apparatus suitable for through-wall radar, for the problem that existing object detection apparatus volume is big, portability is poor, now propose following scheme comprising the first mounting shell, the second mounting shell, the first rotating turret, the second rotating turret, erecting bed, through-wall radar and control ECU；Through-wall radar, control ECU and display screen are arranged on the second mounting shell；Second rotating turret is arranged on the second mounting shell, and is rotatablely connected with the first rotating turret；First rotating turret is rotatably arranged on the first mounting shell；Erecting bed be arranged on the first mounting shell, and along the vertical direction be arranged side by side there are two；Thread gluing subband and thread gluing master tape are respectively arranged on two erecting beds；The accommodating groove that can store the second mounting shell is provided on first mounting shell；Accommodating groove and thread gluing subband and thread gluing master tape are located at the first mounting shell longitudinal direction two sides.The present invention is small in size, can be worn on user's arm, use good portability.
assignees: JIANGSU WEIHANG JINGYI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-radar signal fusion tracking algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an algorithm for fusion tracking of multiple radar signals, which comprises the following steps: A. the method comprises the steps that a through-wall detection radar partition wall is used for collecting echo signals of a through-wall radar, the radar continuously transmits step frequency signals outwards, and meanwhile target echo signals are received; B. and eliminating direct waves from each piece of scanning data in the acquired through-wall radar echo signals, wherein the implementation mode is that two adjacent pieces of scanning data are subtracted in sequence. The invention is suitable for the positioning operation of the portable through-wall detection radar on a moving human body in a partition wall environment by matching with the detection and display device of the through-wall radar on the basis of the echo signal correlation, thereby more rapidly realizing the detection, positioning and tracking of the moving target by utilizing the through-wall detection radar, and solving the problem that the target information can be extracted only by processing multi-frame periodic data due to lower detection data utilization rate when the conventional wireless through-wall radar is used.
assignees: NANJING MIAOMI SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-stability vital sign signal judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars, and particularly discloses a high-stability vital sign signal judging method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring distance dimension FFT data of all targets; judging whether moving targets exist in all targets according to the distance dimension FFT data of all targets; when a moving target exists, extracting a phase to be selected of the moving target in a current time window; calculating the current respiratory rate and the current heart rate of the moving target according to the time domain information and the frequency domain information of the phase to be selected; judging the current mode of the moving target; and outputting the current respiratory rate and the current heart rate of the moving target according to the current mode of the moving target. The invention also discloses a high-stability vital sign signal judging system. According to the invention, the current state of the target is judged through the millimeter wave radar, and the decision of the vital sign signal is carried out, so that the occurrence of misjudgment is avoided to a certain extent, and the stability and accuracy of the calculation of the respiratory rate and the heart rate are improved.
assignees: WEIFU HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Patient vital sign monitoring method and system for ward environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a patient vital sign monitoring method and system for ward environments. The invention relates to the technical field of medical monitoring, and the system consists of a millimeter wave radar radio frequency front end, a radar data high-speed acquisition board and an upper computer. The target signal extraction processing is carried out in the radar high-speed acquisition board, and a light-weight self-stabilizing target distance unit selection method is adopted, so that the stability and accuracy of the target distance unit extraction are improved under the multipath interference and signal sparseness conditions of a ward. The upper computer performs vital sign signal separation and enhancement processing, and provides a multi-strategy fusion MTOC-VMD decomposition method and a spectrum weighted heartbeat enhancement method, which decompose target phase signals, construct weighting coefficients, effectively inhibit respiratory harmonic interference and enhance the spectrum characteristics of heartbeat signals. The invention can realize real-time monitoring of vital signs of patients in a non-contact manner in a ward environment, is beneficial to early detection of abnormal trends of the patients and reduces the manpower burden of hospital monitoring.

title_en: Buried object prospecting method and buried object prospecting apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object prospecting method capable of prospecting a buried part with higher accuracy.SOLUTION: A buried object prospecting method according to an embodiment, comprises a first setting step, a first analysis step, a first display step, a second setting step, a second scanning step, a second analysis step, and a second display step. In the first setting step, a first scanning range of a high frequency electromagnetic radar prospecting machine is set. In the first analysis step, first position information on a first buried object at a first to-be-prospected depth is obtained on the basis of an analysis of result data obtained in the first scanning step. In the first display step, a position of the first buried object is displayed. In the second setting step, a second scanning position of a low frequency electromagnetic radar prospecting machine is set. In the second analysis step, second position information on a second buried object at a second to-be-prospected depth is obtained on the basis of an analysis of result data obtained in the second scanning step. In the second display step, a position of the second buried object is displayed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13

title_en: Function Operating Method based on Biological Signals and Electronic Device supporting the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 기반 기능 운용 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio-signal-based function. The present invention may provide: a method for operating a bio-signal-based function; and configuration of an electronic device supporting the same. The method includes: a step of a first electronic device arranged on a wrist for collecting bio-signals according to a condition of bio-tissue by using an electromyogram sensor and a subsidiary sensor; and a step of outputting information, related to the collected bio-signals, on a first display module of the first electronic device. The present invention is not limited to the configuration described above but should be understood with various embodiments described in the detained description.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 신호 기반 기능에 관한 것으로, 손목에 배치된 제1 전자 장치가 생체 조직의 상태에 따른 생체 신호를 근전도 센서 및 보조 센서를 이용하여 수집하는 과정, 수집된 생체 신호와 관련된 정보를 상기 제1 전자 장치의 제1 표시 모듈에 출력하는 과정을 포함하는 생체 신호 기반 전자 장치의 기능 운용 방법과 이를 지원하는 전자 장치의 구성을 개시할 수 있다. 여기서 본 발명이 상술한 구성에 한정되는 것은 아니며, 발명의 상세한 설명에 기재된 다양한 실시 예들로서 이해되어야 할 것이다.

title_en: workers healthcare system using biological signals based safety menagement woking clothes
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a worker healthcare system using safety management work clothes based on a biological signal. According to the present invention, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal comprises: safety management work clothes (100) based on a biological signal including a sensor for a biological signal and a module; a server (200) receiving and analyzing the biological signal of a user from the safety management work clothes (100) based on the biological signal, wherein the server (200) changes the biological signal to data capable of determining a user′s pattern; and an output device outputting the user′s health state on a screen to enable the user to monitor the health state using the data provided by the server (200). According to the present invention, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can prevent an accident in an industrial field by obtaining the health state based on the biological signal of the worker wearing the safety management work clothes measuring the biological signal. Also, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can prevent an accident by analyzing the state of the worker such as the level of stress, exercise strength, a motion, an action pattern and the like in the server based on big data by using the biological signal such as electrocardiogram, acceleration, and body temperature, which are sensed by the sensor for a biological signal of the safety management work clothes. The worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can provide a continuous personalized healthcare service to the worker. Therefore, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can remarkably increase productivity, promote health, and prevent a disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템은 생체신호용 센서 및 모듈이 내장된 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)과; 상기 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)으로부터 사용자의 생체신호를 전달받아 분석하여 사용자의 패턴을 판단할 수 있는 데이터로 변환하는 서버(200)와; 상기 서버(200)에서 제공받은 데이터를 통해 건강상태를 모니터링 할 수 있도록 화면에 출력하는 출력장치; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Wireless Telemetry Sensor System
abstract_en: The presently disclosed technique includes a multi-detector wearable medical sensor that combines biopotential, optical, temperature, acceleration, and acoustic measurement into a single device. It leverages sensor fusion and deep learning algorithms on device which allows it to directly monitor vital signs, physiological waveforms, and early warning of medical complications. One utility is the ability for the sensor to expand and adapt to several use cases. An expansion port and accessory cables allow the biopotential electrodes to step up or down for any combination of continuous 1-12 L electrocardiogrameasurements. It can also measure fetal ECG with a different accessory cable, or electroencephalogram (“EEG”) with another cable. The sensor has BLUETOOTH® Low Energy (“BLE”), Wireless Fidelity (“WIFI®)”), Fifth Generation mobile network (“5G”) Long Term Evolution Machine Type Communication (“LTE-M”), Near Field Communication (“NFC”), and Ultra Wideband (“UWB”) radios. The sensor can also charge and communicate over Universal Serial Bus (“USB”).

title_en: A kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection radar device, especially a kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device having both detection human life characteristic information and range information, can be used for disaster assistance.A kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device includes the first signal generator, the first power splitter, frequency mixer, power amplifier, ultra broadband transmitting antenna, ultra-wideband receiver antenna, low noise amplifier, i/q demodulator, secondary signal generator, the second power splitter, voltage-controlled phase shifter, adjustable attenuator, solid state microwave sensor, the 3rd signal generator, lock-in amplifier, signal acquisition process module, can quickly and accurately detect vital signss information and the positional information of trapped personnel.

title_en: Method for real-time tracking of multiple moving targets by through-wall radar in complex environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for tracking multiple moving targets in real time by a through-wall radar in a complex environment. Firstly, predicting the positions and the energies of all tracks at the current moment by using a Kalman filter, respectively constructing two neighborhoods with the positions and the energy predicted values as centers, and associating all targets in the two neighborhoods with the corresponding tracks; then, an improved nearest neighbor method based on position and energy information and a bipartite graph maximum weight matching algorithm are utilized to find out targets which are respectively matched with each motion track to realize the best matching from the related targets; then, judging the current states of the tracks according to the track quality based on the log-likelihood ratio so as to decide track maintenance, new track generation or track deletion; and finally, smoothing the existing track by using a Kalman filter. The method is simple, high in execution efficiency and suitable for the portable through-wall radar partition wall to track the multiple moving human body targets, and the working efficiency of the through-wall radar can be effectively improved.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content
abstract_en: A microwave stethoscope measurement method and sensor design employ a microwave transmission sensor and a microwave reception sensor placed on a patient's chest in spaced-apart side-by-side configuration for monitoring patient vital signs, lung water content and other critical measurements. The side-by-side sensors are spaced apart a separation distance of about 1-3 cm in lateral chest orientation. The sensors may be formed with a textile fabric for wearer comfort and to improve contact with the patient's skin. The microwave sensor measurements are digitally processed using a modified short time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrum windowed-averaged algorithm. Output data extracted from the microwave sensor measurements may be transmitted wirelessly to a mobile device such as a smartphone for remote monitoring of the patient's medical condition.
assignees: ISKANDER MAGDY F;CELIK NURI;GAGARIN RUTHSENNE;HUANG GUI CHAO;BIBB DARCY ALAN;UNIV HAWAII

title_en: A kind of forest fire protection monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of forest fire protection monitoring devices, including inner cavity, the outside of the inner cavity has shell, the bottom of inner cavity is fixedly installed with pre-buried pedestal, the inner bottom of inner cavity is equipped with battery group, the inside of battery group is equipped with reserve battery, the outer middle side part of shell is equipped with monitoring camera, the outside of monitoring camera is equipped with computer camera protective cover, the lower part left end of inner cavity has temperature sensor, the top of temperature sensor has control device, the lower part right end of inner cavity has smoke sensor device, the top of smoke sensor device has Beidou module, the top of inner cavity is equipped with two pieces of solar panels.The forest fire protection monitoring device, reasonable in design, monitoring effect is stablized, and is hardly damaged, can satisfy people to the requirement of forest fire protection monitoring device.

title_en: Earthquake trapped personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field provides an earthquake stranded personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle, include the main part and locate first wing in the main part, be equipped with first radar life detection instrument in the main part, there is the cabin in the main part, be equipped with mini unmanned aerial vehicle in the cabin, be equipped with second radar life detection instrument on the mini unmanned aerial vehicle. The utility model discloses an earthquake trapped personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle, through adopting unmanned aerial vehicle to cooperate with radar life detection instrument to search for and rescue work, more flexible and convenient than depending on manpower or searching for and rescuing dogs; the mini unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged in the cabin of the main body, so that the mini unmanned aerial vehicle can enter a narrow space to perform search and rescue work, and more places can be searched and rescued conveniently; the switching of four wings and six wings is realized through the bracket group; the main body can not contact the ground when the unmanned aerial vehicle lands on the ground by adopting the support frame; the main body is provided with the heat dissipation holes, so that heat dissipation of electronic components in the main body can be facilitated; the current environment condition can be transmitted in real time by arranging the infrared camera.

title_en: Wisdom fire control is with having life to detect alarm function's intelligence smoke detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent smoke detector with a life detection and alarm function for intelligent fire fighting, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a sucker component is mounted at the top of the mounting plate, and a shell is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate. According to the utility model, the suction cup is placed on the ceiling through the mutual matching of the mounting plate, the suction cup assembly, the suction cup, the exhaust pipe, the exhaust valve, the exhaust pump, the exhaust pipe, the shell, the sealing cover, the smoke detector body, the fixing mechanism, the driving motor, the lead screw, the moving groove, the bearing, the threaded sleeve, the sliding groove, the sliding block, the fixing frame, the supporting plate, the guide rod and the infrared imaging probe, so that the suction cup is firmly fixed on the ceiling along with the exhaust of the exhaust pump, when the suction cup needs to be disassembled, the exhaust valve exhausts the air in the suction cup, the suction cup can be taken down, nails do not need to be nailed for fixation, the attractiveness of the roof is improved, the installation and the disassembly of the smoke detector are very convenient, and great convenience is brought to users.

title_en: Multi-source disaster situation data online fusion processing method and hollow unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for multi-source disaster data online fusion processing and a hollow unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method is applied to the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle, mobile phone signals are acquired at a plurality of specified sampling points in a target damaged area according to a search instruction issued by a ground command system, and preliminary mobile phone signal data are acquired; correcting the preliminary mobile phone signal data according to the offset vector sequence of each screened target sampling object; generating a primary judgment result of the buried point according to each corrected position and the position of each building target in the target damaged area; guiding the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicle to perform radar scanning in a multi-point observation mode based on the positions of the building buried points in the buried point initial judgment result; the target positioning result uploaded by the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicle is received, the target positioning result and the primary judgment result of the buried point are fused to form a buried point search result, and the buried point search result is transmitted back to the ground command system, so that disaster area emergency rescue can be efficiently and accurately carried out.
assignees: NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE;UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Wall rear hidden target tracking method suitable for low signal-to-noise ratio environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for tracking a hidden target behind a wall in a low signal-to-noise ratio environment, which is applied to the technical field of radar tracking. The method aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, clutter and noise in echoes are large, imaging quality is poor, and a target is difficult to track. Firstly, reconstructing a scene by adopting a back projection method, then establishing a target template by extracting target region characteristics and based on a ridge regression idea, establishing a scale pool with small distance to scale change and large azimuth to scale change based on a through-wall radar target imaging mechanism and the characteristics of the imaged target, then tracking the next frame of target based on a related filtering idea, updating the target template for each frame adapting to the change of the through-wall radar target characteristics, and finally dynamically estimating a target region and obtaining a tracking track; the method can realize the accurate tracking of the hidden target behind the wall in the scene with low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine pulse condition detection method based on vital sign radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine pulse condition detection method based on vital sign radar data, and relates to the technical field of medical detection; the method comprises the following steps: the first step: and (3) data acquisition: collecting human breath and heartbeat data through a vital sign detection radar; and a second step of: data screening: extracting effective data segments of respiratory heartbeats; and a third step of: and (3) data processing: generating a respiration peak value screened frequency table and a heartbeat peak value screened frequency table; fourth step: outputting a result: judging pulse conditions according to the correspondence of the RB_ratio and the traditional Chinese medicine pulse condition table and outputting a result; the invention is suitable for the medical field.

title_en: Slope landslide early warning device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of slope early warning, in particular to a slope landslide early warning device which comprises a detection assembly, wherein the detection assembly comprises a plurality of detection rods, the detection rods are connected in sequence, two adjacent detection rods are movably connected through a ball connector, a plurality of tension sensors are arranged between the two adjacent detection rods, the tension sensors are arranged around the ball connector, one end of each tension sensor is fixed on one detection rod, the other end of each tension sensor is connected with a tension spring, one end of each tension spring, which is far away from the tension sensor, is connected to the other detection rod, one end of each detection assembly is used for being buried in a slope, the other end of each detection assembly is provided with a slope detector for detecting a surface, and the slope detector and the tension sensors are connected with batteries for supplying power. The application has the effect of early warning when landslide occurs in the side slope.
assignees: HENAN KEDA WATER CONSERVANCY SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Sleep quality assessment method and system based on non-contact UWB radar vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep quality assessment method and a sleep quality assessment system based on a non-contact UWB radar vital sign signal, and relates to the technical field of sleep quality assessment, and the method specifically comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring vital sign data; the method comprises the steps of acquiring vital sign data in the sleeping process of a human body through a non-contact UWB radar, wherein the vital sign data comprise heart rate, respiratory rate, distance, body movement and body energy, S2, processing the vital sign data in S1, and performing clustering analysis and feature processing on the vital sign data in each T time from a starting point of a specified monitoring time interval through setting a time judging window T to obtain a sleeping state sequence in each T time and a time-sharing sequence of the sleeping state. The sleep mode is monitored uninterruptedly for a long time in a non-contact way, the sleep is not affected, privacy invasion is avoided, a personalized sleep health file is established for the user, the user can detect the related problems of sleep disorder in advance, and the effective reference basis is provided for treatment by a follow-up doctor.

title_en: Wall penetrating radar system for life detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar system for life detection, which belongs to the technical field of radar detection, and comprises an antenna module, a P440 ultra-wideband transceiver module, a signal processing module, a communication module and a control terminal, wherein an antenna array formed by sail-shaped antenna units is constructed, and the P440 ultra-wideband transceiver module is combined to realize accurate detection of a human body target after a dry brick wall with the thickness of more than or equal to 22cm, and the system is modularized integrated under the condition of ensuring the detection distance and the angle range, so that portability is ensured, and the system stability is ensured through a power module and a temperature sensing supplementing unit, so that the system can be widely applied to the scenes of anti-terrorism detection, post-disaster search and rescue and the like. The invention solves the problem of insufficient reliability of life detection of the radar in a complex wall environment.

title_en: An old or feeble person care system
title_ko: 노약자 구호 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A care system for the old and the infirm is provided to rapidly save the old and the infirm of an emergency condition by monitoring a health condition of the old and the infirm without leak of personal information of the old and the infirm on a real time. CONSTITUTION: A care system for the old and the infirm includes a detecting device(100), an alarm device(200), and a phone(300). The detecting device is attached to a body of the old and the infirm, detects bio signals like pulse or body temperature, and transmits an emergency signal which indicates an abnormal state of the bio signals to the alarm device. The alarm device is adjacently installed to the phone, and sends an emergency message transmission command to the phone. The phone includes an auto-message transmission function or an auto-dialing function.
abstract_ko:
노약자 구호 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명은 노약자의 생체신호를 감지하여 생체신호의 이상에 따라 응급신호를 발생시키는 감지장치, 및 감지장치로부터 응급신호를 수신하며, 자동 메시지 전송 기능 및 자동 다이얼링 기능 중 적어도 하나를 구비하는 전화기에 설치되어 전화기가 미리 정해진 전화번호로 응급 메시지를 전송하도록 하는 알림장치를 구비한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 노약자의 개인 정보 유출의 문제점 없이 노약자의 건강상태를 실시간으로 감시하여 노약자의 응급상태의 경우에 신속한 구조가 가능하게 된다.  
       
     노약자, 센서, RFID, 전화기

title_en: Apparatus and method of wearable detection for underground objects
title_ko: 지하 매설물 착용형 탐지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wearing type underground objects detecting apparatus and a method for the same are provided to prevent the occurrence of accidents in an operational field and improve operational efficiency by detecting the buried positions of underground objects in real time. CONSTITUTION: A wireless transmitting unit(111) transmits a transmission detecting sensor(112) by generating a signal for detecting underground objects. A reception detecting sensor(124) receives reflected wave corresponding to the signal from the transmission detecting sensor and transmits the reflected wave to a wireless reception unit(123). The wireless receiving unit transmits the reflected wave from the reception detecting sensor to a recognition signal processing unit(121). The recognition signal processing unit generates detecting information related to underground objects and transmits the detecting information to an indicating and displaying unit(130).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하 매설물 탐지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로 특히 착용이 가능한 지하 매설물 탐지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에서는 휴대성이 용이하고, 실시간으로 정보를 수신할 수 있으며, 구현이 용이한 지하 매설물 착용형 탐지 장치 및 방법을 제공한다. 
     본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 탐지 장치는, 착용형 지하 매설물 탐지 장치에 있어서, 미리 결정된 신호를 미리 결정된 방향으로 송신하는 신호 송신 장치와, 상기 송신된 신호에 대응하는 반사파를 수신하는 수신 탐지 센서와, 상기 수신된 반사파를 수신 신호로 복원하는 무선 수신 장치와, 상기 복원된 수신 신호를 기준으로 상기 매설물의 유/무를 분석하여 상기 매설물의 유/무에 따라 제1인지 신호 및 제2인지 신호를 발생하는 인지 신호 처리 장치를 포함한다. 
       
     착용형, 매설물 탐지, 지하 매설물

title_en: Biosignal interface device and method of operation of biosignal interface device
title_ko: 생체신호 인터페이스 장치 및 생체신호 인터페이스 장치의 동작 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a bio-signal interface device and a method for operating the bio-signal interface device. The bio-signal interface device according to an embodiment is provided to generally use the thickness of a forearm and an elbow and approximately predict the position of a sensor unit, thereby changing a mode such as the number of recognized gestures or the like. The bio-signal interface device comprises a sensor unit which is touched to a measured object and senses the measured object; a position identifying unit which identifies the position of the sensor unit in the measured object; and an adjusting unit which adjusts the mode of the sensor unit according to the identified position.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 인터페이스 장치 및 생체신호 인터페이스 장치의 동작 방법을 제공한다.  일실시예에 따른 생체신호 인터페이스 장치는, 일반적으로 손목보다 팔뚝/팔꿈치쪽으로, 아래팔의 두께가 두꺼워지는 것을 이용하여, 센서부가 아래팔의 어떤 부위에 위치해 있는지 대략적으로 예측 함으로써, 인식할 수 있는 제스처의 개수 등의 모드를 변환하고 있다.

title_en: Electronic device for measuring biometric signal and method of opearating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 전자 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic device including a sensor module, a communication circuit, and at least one processor. The at least one processor may be configured to check a mounting state of the electronic device based on sensor data received from the sensor module, select at least one antenna combination including at least one transmission antenna and at least one reception antenna among the one or more antennas according to the mounting state, obtain a radar signal for a measurement target from the communication circuit using the at least one antenna combination, obtain a bio-signal from the obtained radar signal, evaluate a signal quality of the bio-signal, and adjust control parameters for the selected antenna combination among the at least one antenna combination according to the sensor data, the radar signal, and the signal quality of the bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 센서 모듈, 통신 회로, 및 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하는 전자 장치를 개시한다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 상기 센서 모듈로부터 수신된 센서 데이터를 기반으로 전자 장치의 거치 상태를 확인하고, 상기 거치 상태에 따라, 상기 하나 이상의 안테나들 중 적어도 하나의 송신 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신 안테나를 포함하는 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합을 선택하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합을 통해 상기 통신 회로로부터 측정 대상에 대한 레이더 신호를 획득하고, 상기 획득된 레이더 신호로부터 생체 신호를 획득하고, 상기 생체 신호의 신호 품질을 평가하고, 상기 센서 데이터, 상기 레이더 신호, 및 상기 생체 신호의 신호 품질에 따라 상기 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합 중 선택된 안테나 조합에 대한 제어 파라미터들을 조정하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Contactless biosignal detection methods for multiple targets
title_ko: 다중 타겟용 비접촉식 생체신호 검출 방법
abstract_en: The objective that the present invention aims to solve is to provide a non-contact biometric signal detection method for multiple targets using a radar sensor, which is designed to overcome the limitations of conventional non-contact biometric signal detection devices for a single target. The method comprises the steps of: extracting, by a control unit, the phase from each frame of a reflected signal and detecting the phase difference between two consecutive frames; determining, by the control unit, a frequency change based on the detected phase difference, determining the frequency change as a change in the body caused by a subjects respiration if the frequency change is in the range of 0.1 to 0.5 Hz, and performing a fast Fourier transform to determine the respiratory rate; and determining, by the control unit, the frequency change as a change in the body due to the subject's heartbeat if the frequency change is in the range of 0.8 to 4.0 Hz and performing a fast Fourier transform to determine the heart rate.
abstract_ko: 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 방법이 개시된다. 이러한 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 방법은, 방위각, 거리 고도에 관한 정보를 검출하기 위한 송신 안테나들, 반사 신호를 수신하는 수신 안테나들, 제어부의 제어하에 처프 신호를 생성하기 위한 처프 신호 발생부, 중간 주파수 신호 생성부, 아날로그 디지털 컨버터, 디지털 프론트 엔드, ADC 버퍼, 복수의 대상자들의 심박수 및 호습수를 결정하기 위한 처리를 수행하는 제어부와, 제어부에 의해 결정된 심박수 호흡수를 포함하는 데이터를 통신망을 통해 관리자 측으로 전송하기 위한 통신부를 포함하는 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 장치를 이용하는 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 방법으로서, 상기 반사 신호의 각 프레임에서 위상(Phase)을 추출한 다음 연속적인 두 프레임 사이의 위상차를 상기 제어부에서 검출하는 단계와, 상기 검출된 위상차에 따라 주파수 변화를 상기 제어부에서 판단하여, 상기 주파수 변화가 0.1Hz ~ 0.5Hz 범위에 있으면 대상자의 호흡에 의한 신체의 변화로 판단하여 이에 대해 고속 퓨리에 변환을 수행한 후 호흡수를 결정하는 단계와, 상기 주파수 변화가 0.8Hz ~ 4.0Hz 범위에 있으면 대상자의 심장박동에 의한 신체의 변화로 상기 제어부에서 판단하여 이에 대해 고속 퓨리에 변환을 수행한 후 심박수를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Imaging system using infrared light
abstract_en: An imaging system is disclosed for imaging buried structure, typically vasculature, below the surface of an object which can be skin, fat deposits, or other material and for projecting an image of the buried structure onto the surface of the object. Scanning lasers are used both to illuminate the object and to project an image onto it. One or more photodiodes measure the intensity of scattered and reflected light to create an image in conjunction with one or more of the scanning lasers.

title_en: Assembly for the generation of a two or three-dimensional map of obstacles in a surrounding area through walls, system comprising it and associated method and use
abstract_en:
The present invention is in the area of the identification of obstacles - particularly objects or living beings - through walls, based on electromagnetic signals, such as radiofrequency or microwave signals. 
     The invention refers to a method for the generation of a two- or three-dimensional map of obstacles in a surrounding area through walls characterised in that it comprises the following steps: 
- emission of a first electromagnetic signal from a first position and an at least one subsequent electromagnetic signal emitted from at least one subsequent position, 
- reception of the first electromagnetic signal and of each subsequent electromagnetic signal in a plurality of antennas (2), 
- detection of the power level of the received signal in each of the antennas (2), and 
- generate a map of obstacles in a surrounding area of the receiving device, based on: 
i) said pluralities of power level values corresponding to each emitted electromagnetic signal, and 
ii) the positions corresponding to the emitted electromagnetic signals.

title_en: A radar apparatus for detecting multiple life - signs of a subject, a method and a computer program product
abstract_en: A radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, a method and a computer program product. The invention relates to a radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, comprising a transmitter system for emitting a transmission electromagnetic beam to the chest and/or the abdomen of a subject, a receiving system for receiving first reflected electromagnetic beam data from the chest and/or the abdomen, and a processor unit for processing the first received beam data retrieving breath activity information. The transmitter system, the receiving system and the processor are further arranged for performing a radar measurement of a superficial artery structure, such as a wrist artery, an ankle artery, a carotid artery and/or the fontanel artery for retrieving heart activity information. Thereto, a second transmission electromagnetic beam is directed towards the superficial artery structure, the first and the second transmission electromagnetic beam being transmitted from a single radar unit, the second transmission beam being redirected by a redirector after emission by the radar unit.

title_en: Automatic pet door with prey detection and method for its use
abstract_en: A method and a system for detecting the proximity of a pet (10) attempting to pass through a pet door and preventing access if the pet is carrying another live animal (12). Upon determining that the input signal (308) from the proximity sensor is indicative of the presence of the pet (10), a received UWB return signal (310) is analyzed for vital signs (20, 22). If the analysis of the UWB return signal (310) results in detection of vital signs from more than one animal, an opening mechanism for the pet door is disabled (306). If, on the other hand, the analysis of the UWB return signal results in detection of vital signs from no more than one animal, the opening mechanism for the pet door is activated.

title_en: Ground-Penetrating Radar Device and Method for Same
abstract_en: An underground radar device and a method thereof are provided that do not require replacement of antennas for transceiving in conformity with the width of a road, and can achieve exploration of a buried object with a single scan. An underground radar device includes a transmission array antenna and a reception array antenna, and further includes a position variable mechanism capable of changing intervals between antenna elements of the transmission array antenna and the reception array antenna while keeping all the intervals equal. The position variable mechanism includes a drive unit, a plurality of crossbars constituting an expandable link, and a plurality of link sections for coupling so as to change inclination angles of a V-shape and an inverted V-shape of the expandable link.

title_en: Joint estimation of respiratory and heart rates using ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: A method for contactless vital sign monitoring includes transmitting, via a transceiver, radar signals for object detection. The method also includes generating a clutter removed channel impulse response from received reflections of the radar signals a portion of which are reflected off of a living object. The method further includes identifying a set of range bins corresponding to a position of the living object. Additionally, the method includes identifying a first set of signal components representing a respiration rate of the living object and a second set of signal components representing a heart rate of the living object.

title_en: Through-wall radar sensors networked together to create 2d and 3d combined views of an area
abstract_en: Systems and methods for networking together through-wall radar sensors to generate a combined image based on signal data from the networked through-wall radar sensors. The system includes a first through-wall radar sensor and a second through-wall radar sensor. The second through-wall radar sensor is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor. The system includes a display of an area, wherein the display of the area is based on data from the first through-wall radar sensor combined with data from the second through- wall radar sensor. The system may include a first communication device connected to the first through-wall radar sensor and a second communication device connected to the second through-wall radar sensor. A controller is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor and the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a plurality of through- wall radar sensors networked together to provide a two-dimensional or a three-dimensional image of an area.

title_en: Based on the expansion moving-target through-wall imaging method of array radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of expansion moving-target through-wall imaging method based on array radar.Technical scheme comprises the steps: the first step: adopt change detecting method to differ from process to eliminate clutter impact to adjacent two frames of echo data; Second step: successively imaging is carried out to each frame echo data; 3rd step: adopt the CFAR detecting device of Gaussian distribution to complete the detection of target; 4th step: the locus coordinate extracting target in image; 5th step: false target judge with eliminate, obtain each frame echo data eliminate false target after expansion pre-filter method result.The present invention can solve the suppression problem of false target in extension movement target imaging, and the present invention is simultaneously easy to realize, and can be used for actual engineering design and signal transacting.

title_en: A kind of stage excavation buried hard rock tunnel microseismic monitoring sensor method for arranging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of stage excavation buried hard rock tunnel microseismic monitoring sensor method for arranging, when the tunnel second layer to last layer excavates, first group/second group microseismic sensors is installed in the tunnel inner wall rock mass in face rear/front, currently excavate layer base plate center line with tunnel and offset downward the straight line at 1m as rotation centerline, first group of microseismic sensors and second group of microseismic sensors axle centered by rotation centerline are distributed in tunnel inner wall rock mass, continuous propelling along with face, rearrange first group/second group microseismic sensors, until tunnel excavation completes.The present invention utilizes tunnel to excavate the space that layer provides, microseismic sensors is arranged at excavation front of tunnel heading and rear, face higher for risk and near zone thereof are contained in all the time and are arranged in before and after face in two groups of microseismic sensors arrays, be conducive to the collection to micro rupture signal, ensure that microseism positioning precision, the Accurate Prediction forecast for disaster lays the foundation.

title_en: Scale-adaptive through-wall imaging radar target tracking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scale self-adaptive through-wall imaging radar target tracking method, relates to through-wall radar technology, and particularly relates to target tracking technology of through-wall radar. The method adopts a time domain back projection imaging method to quickly obtain a radar image with higher quality; the image enhancement algorithm based on CF weighting processing can inhibit side lobes and noise and improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the image; after a target area is acquired by adopting a biaxial projection algorithm, a tracking algorithm based on mean shift can effectively cope with human body target tracking with stronger randomness; the target scale and angle estimation method based on the image moment can accurately calculate the target image scale and angle, and can improve tracking precision and robustness. The method has the advantages of good instantaneity, strong adaptability and high tracking robustness.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar human vital sign monitoring method and system based on diversity mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar human vital sign monitoring method and system based on a diversity mechanism, comprising a millimeter wave radar, a signal processing module and a dynamic component acquisition module, wherein the millimeter wave radar is provided with a plurality of transmitting antennas for transmitting millimeter wave signals to the environment and a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving signals reflected by human bodies and objects, the signal processing module is used for mixing the reflected signals received by the receiving antennas, utilizing the position of the human bodies to implement space diversity to acquire reflected components of the positions of the human bodies, carrying out dynamic signal extraction by estimating echo static components to acquire the dynamic components, carrying out time diversity by utilizing echo dynamic components at a plurality of moments to improve the signal to noise ratio, carrying out phase extraction and deconvolution on the signals after the time diversity, and carrying out band-pass filtering and period estimation on the time domain to acquire the respiration rate and the heart rate of a target. The invention utilizes a diversity method to improve the accuracy of monitoring the vital signs of the human body in a complex environment and a long distance by integrating multi-antenna and multi-pulse data.

title_ko: 유량제어가 가능한 하천 배수 댐 구조물
abstract_en: A river dam structure for flow control is provided to secure the enough time for evacuation and to inform the lower reaches of a river of flood occurrence if the river rises rapidly by a localized torrential downpour. The river dam structure for flow control comprises a reservoir panel(10) composed of a support frame and a support case and installed to make the base hinged on the bottom of the river to be close by the lower reaches of an underwater barrier(2) and the front end placed closely to the bottom(1) of a river toward the upper reaches of a river to block up a waterway of a river, a support(20) installed to the lower reaches of the reservoir panel and supporting the rear of the reservoir panel when the reservoir panel ascends to keep the reservoir panel vertically, a fixture(30) composed of a bracket(32), a fixing hook(34), a spring(36) and a wire(38) and installed on the bottom of the river to fix the reservoir panel adhered closely to the bottom of the river not to be ascent, a pressure detector(40) composed of a housing(42) provided with an opening(41) and buried under the underwater barrier to make the opening face the upper reaches of the river, a piston(43) fixed to the housing, a spring(44) placed on the rear of the piston to pressurize the piston toward the upper reaches of the river, a push rod(45) extended to the rear of the piston and a movable arm(46) hinged on the rear of the housing and connected with the push rod and the wire and installed on the upper reaches of the underwater barrier to be operated by the pressure of water flowing along the river to release the fixture, and an alarm composed of a sensor switch(62) placed on the rear of the housing of the pressure detector and switched on when the movable arm moves, a controller connected to the sensor switch, a voice alarm connected to the controller to generate alarm sounds according to the signals of the controller and a signal flare projector connected to the sensor switch to project signal flares and to let people know the flooded location.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 유량제어가 가능한 하천 배수 댐 구조물은 하천의 물이 불어나면 저수패널(10)이 자동으로 입설되어 하천의 물을 가둠과 동시에, 경보를 출력하도록 구성되어, 집중호우에 의해 하천의 수량이 급격하게 증가되면 대피시간을 벌 뿐 아니라, 하류쪽에 홍수발생 사실을 알릴 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting status of vehicle occupant
title_ko: 차량 탑승자 상태 감지방법 및 차량 탑승자 상태 감지장치
abstract_ko: 탑재된 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI) 알고리즘 및/또는 기계학습(machine learning) 알고리즘을 실행하여 차량에 탑승한 탑승자의 생체신호를 취득하고, 취득한 탑승자 생체신호에서 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호 및 심박수 신호를 통해 탑승자의 신체 변화를 측정한 뒤, 5G 통신 환경에서 차량 내부 기기와 통신하여 추정된 탑승자의 신체 변화에 대응할 수 있도록 차량 내부 기기의 구동을 제어하거나 차량 운행을 제어할 수 있는 차량 탑승자 상태 감지방법 및 차량 탑승자 상태 감지장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 의하여 차량 내 탑재된 RF 센서를 통해 차량에 탑승한 탑승자의 움직임, 호흡, 심박수 신호를 추출한 뒤, 추출된 탑승자의 생체신호를 기초로 탑승자의 신체 상태를 추정하여 신체 상태가 정상상태를 벗어난 생체신호로 추정되면, 이를 탑승자에 알릴 수 있다.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection with vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system and a method for detecting an occupancy in an interior of a vehicle and with vital sign monitoring. The radar sensor system includes a radar transmitting unit, a radar receiving unit and a signal processing and control unit. The method includes: transmitting a radar wave towards a scene within the vehicle interior, receiving at least one radar wave that has been generated by reflection of the transmitted radar wave, decomposing the received radar wave into range, Doppler and angular information, quantifying and tracking a movement in each region of interest by angular gating and range gating, detecting and monitoring vital signs of occupants in each region of interest, and determining whether quantified and tracked movements in the scene are related to an occupant or to external or internal disturbances, based on a fulfillment of at least one predefined condition concerning the and/or the detected vital signs.

title_en: Joint estimation of respiratory and heart rates using ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: A method for contactless vital sign monitoring includes transmitting, via a transceiver, radar signals for object detection. The method also includes generating a clutter removed channel impulse response from received reflections of the radar signals a portion of which are reflected off of a living object. The method further includes identifying a set of range bins corresponding to a position of the living object. Additionally, the method includes identifying a first set of signal components representing a respiration rate of the living object and a second set of signal components representing a heart rate of the living object.

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument, including control terminal to and with control terminal data interchange's life detection device, but and for control terminal, life detection device carry out the charge -discharge pond and the power supply circuit that supply power, the life detection device includes the host system who carries out data interchange with control terminal to and being connected the electric magnetic detection ware of the UWB who forms the data interaction, shake detector and audio frequency and video detector a little with host system respectively, control terminal controls UWB electricity magnetic detection ware, shake switching between three kinds of detection modes of detector and audio frequency and video detector a little. The utility model discloses realize the high accuracy, can adapt to the life rescue under the various condition, for first -aid staff after the calamity provides the powerful guarantee, technical merit and the equipment level of effectual promotion china at earthquake relief, in the aspect of salvaging life.

title_en: A kind of through-wall detection radar installations and Through-Wall Radar System
abstract_en: Through-wall detection radar installations provided by the utility model, including range finder module, wireless network module, signal emission module, signal receiving module, time synchronization module and signal processing module, it can be while guaranteeing portable, largely improve the azimuth resolution of the Through-Wall Radar System, the utility model also provides Through-Wall Radar System, higher azimuth resolution may be implemented using more portable through-wall detection radar installations, improving Effect on Detecting.

title_en: Buried fire-fighting water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bury formula fire water tank, including the fire water tank body, the inner wall fixedly connected with level sensor of fire water tank body, the surface of fire water tank body is provided with the protective housing, the inner wall of protective housing is provided with the protection and fills up, the equal fixedly connected with a plurality of extension board of both sides wall of protective housing, the upper end fixedly connected with mounting panel of fire water tank body, the upper end fixedly connected with alarm of mounting panel, the upper end fixedly connected with mounting box of fire water tank body, the inside of mounting box is provided with the controller, the high-pressure water pump of upper end fixedly connected with of fire water tank body. The utility model discloses in, through setting up level sensor and feeling, alarm, controller, when not having water in the water tank, through the level sensor response, the alarm reports to the police, informs fire fighter in time to add water, because of anhydrous loss that causes in the water tank when avoiding appearing emergency, improves the availability factor.
