title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device, including mounting bracket and radar life detection instrument, the side symmetry of mounting bracket is provided with two drive mechanism, and the week side of radar life detection instrument is equipped with the electric putter who corresponds the setting with drive mechanism, and electric putter's top is connected with drive mechanism, and electric putter's bottom is equipped with the gesture regulating part of control radar life detection instrument gesture, and the gesture regulating part is including installing the base in the electric putter bottom, and the both ends of base are all rotated and are provided with the landing leg. This unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device can carry radar life detection instrument through unmanned aerial vehicle to can adjust the height of radar life detection instrument and the gesture of falling to the ground, can also monitor and buffer protection when radar life detection instrument falls to the ground, make radar life detection instrument can normally carry out the life and detect, can carry out the life to the center of suffering from a disaster fast and survey, convenient rescue, easy operation, convenient to use.

title_en: Direct-buried fire-fighting pipe antifreezing device on outdoor local freezing line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antifreezing device for directly buried fire pipes on an outdoor local freezing line, which comprises a fire pipe pre-buried outdoors and underground, wherein the top of the fire pipe is provided with a U-shaped structure, the U-shaped structure of the fire pipe is sleeved with a heat insulation layer, the central part of the U-shaped structure of the fire pipe is welded with a rigid sleeve pipe with both ends being of plugging structures, the rigid sleeve pipe is positioned in the heat insulation layer, the heat insulation layer is matched with the rigid sleeve pipe to insulate and freeze the U-shaped pipe, the top and the bottom of the rigid sleeve pipe are communicated and fixed with first connecting pipes, one sides of the two first connecting pipes far away from each other extend out of the heat insulation layer, and the right side of the heat insulation layer is provided with a thermal valve inspection well. According to the utility model, through a series of structures, the fire-fighting pipe can be insulated in a mode of hot water circulation and heat insulation by matching with the heat insulation layer, so that the water temperature in the local fire-fighting pipe is ensured to be higher than 5 ℃, and the anti-freezing effect is achieved.
assignees: HEBEI SONGYUN ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake-proof insulated energy-saving house for countryside
abstract_en: A rural shock-proof thermal-insulation energy-saving house relates to movable rural shock-proof energy-saving house. The utility model solves failures for current houses such as poor function for land source and disaster-proof, bad thermal insulation, wasting resource and high cost. A thread post of the utility model is arranged on a reinforced concrete base (1) whose four corners are provided with movable hole (9); bottom of a metal frame (2) and a pre-buried thread (6) on the reinforced concrete base (1) are fixed joint through nut; a decoration plate (4) for outer and inner wall is fixed on the metal frame (2); the outer and inner wall decoration plate (4) is provided with thermal insulation material layer (3); a solar heating device (5) is arranged at inclined face for A-shape beam for house top and is provided with anti-rain layer (7). Compared to current houses, the utility model has saved percent 40 to percent 50 in energy and saved percent 10 to percent 20 in cost, and also has the advantages of saving large quantity of land source; good shock-proof function; good thermal insulation.

title_en: Combined infrared displacement sensor network node for monitoring mountain massif coast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a joined infrared displacement sensor network node for monitoring landslide, and relates to a slope displacement sensor for monitoring landslide in real time. The structure of the joined infrared displacement sensor network node combined according to a triangle comprises the following: the joined infrared displacement sensor network node consists of a primary node (10), a first secondary node (20) and a second secondary node (30) which are arranged on vertexes of the locked monitoring triangle respectively. The structure of the joined infrared displacement sensor network node combined according to a quadrangle comprises the following: the joined infrared displacement sensor network node consists of a primary node (10), a first secondary node (20), a second secondary node (30) and a third secondary node (40) which are arranged on vertexes of the locked monitoring quadrangle respectively. The joined infrared displacement sensor network node can reliably monitor lateral displacement, longitudinal displacement, altitude difference three-dimensional displacement and collapse information of a slope. When the sensing nodes are buried by gliding mass, loss information of the buried sensing nodes can also be accurately calculated, so that the aim of objectively identifying and evaluating position, state and level of landslide and collapse is achieved. The joined infrared displacement sensor network node has the advantages of low price, high sensitivity, flexible radio-frequency control and small power consumption, and meets the characteristic requirements of the sensing nodes.

title_en: Method for detecting vital signs in non-contact mode by terahertz waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting vital signs in a non-contact mode by terahertz waves. The method comprises the steps that a system for detecting the vital signs in the non-contact mode by the terahertz waves is arranged, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna of the system are arranged at the equidistant positions of a detected life body, and the detection signals of the detected life body are sampled; after time-frequency transformation is conducted on the sampled detection signals twice, the movement frequency signals, the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals of the detected life body are extracted after time weighting is conducted. According to the method for detecting the vital signs in the non-contact mode by the terahertz waves, the detection sensitivity is higher than that of microwave detection in the prior art, and meanwhile the vital sign data obtained by detection through the method are more precise and accurate. The method can be widely applied to the fields of medicine, rescuing, security and the like, for example, non-contact heartbeat monitoring, automatic personal health detection, chronic health condition diagnosis and even personnel searching in earthquakes or snow crashes can be achieved.

title_en: Intelligent control method for mine rescue detection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent control method for a mine rescue detection robot, and the method comprises the steps: employing a gas concentration sensor, a carbon monoxide sensor and a temperature sensor to detect the environment parameters of a roadway; enabling the mine rescue detection robot to carry out the obstacle avoiding according to the information of a visual sensor, a supersonic sensor and an infrared sensor; carrying out the positioning and life detection of underground trapped persons through a GPS positioning module and a life detector; outputting decision making control information through an intelligent control algorithm and a central controller, carrying out the real-time monitoring of an underground environment, and carrying out the control of the mine rescue detection robot. According to the technical effect, the method carries out the coupling of an Elman neural network through employing a fruit fly optimization method, carries out the modeling of a mine rescue detection robot detection control system, carries out the information fusion of a plurality of sensors, and achieves the intelligent control of the sensors. The method is high in convergence speed, is high in precision, is better in stability and reliability, ad provides a new idea for the mine safety research.

title_en: A kind of earthquake calamity audio life detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake calamity audio life detection equipment, mainly include：Detection device and main control device, detection device between wireless network and main control device by being transmitted；Using special microelectronics processor, the small vibrations propagated in air or solid can be recognized, main control device is placed on behind safety zone, detection device is controlled to enter rescue region by direction controlling touch screen, camera captured in real-time transmits terrain graph, micro- vibration sensor probe and speech transducer probe transfer information to microseismic signals display screen and sound wave display screen, micro- vibration sensor probe perceives the faint seismic signal that surface layer is transmitted, and speech transducer probe can carry out voice call with rescuer；Voice signal is directly passed to detection personnel by main control device；According to signal intensity infinite approach rescuer, the then detailed rescue plan of rapid development.

title_en: Through-wall radar diffraction tomography method based on compressed sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar Diffraction tomography method based on compressed sensing, carried imaging method uses compression sampling to the frequency domain scattering field data of concealed target after wall in frequency domain, then field data is all scattered in frequency band using openness resume work using sparse algorithm for reconstructing of reception signal in each observation position, imaging reconstruction is finally carried out to concealed target after wall using conventional diffractive chromatography imaging method.The present invention can still ensure the quality of target imaging reconstructed results, substantially increase systematic survey speed in the case where system frequency domain data collection capacity substantially reduces.

title_en: Life detection method and system based on radar signal processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection method and a system based on radar signal processing, which relate to the technical field of radar signal processing and comprise the steps of collecting radar echo signals of a target area, controlling a phased array radar transmitting antenna array to transmit orthogonal frequency division multiplexing double-frequency continuous wave radar signals, and inputting the processed radar echo signals into an orthogonal demodulation module for synchronous coherent demodulation to obtain baseband signals; the method comprises the steps of inputting feature vectors into a multi-task deep learning network integrating an attention mechanism to perform feature fusion and target recognition to obtain a second processing signal, obtaining a target feature frequency spectrum by calculating time-frequency distribution of the second processing signal, judging whether a living body exists in a target area according to time-varying characteristics and amplitude fluctuation rules of respiratory frequency components and heartbeat frequency components, calculating three-dimensional space coordinates of the living body by a multi-base station cooperative positioning algorithm if the living body exists in the target area, and outputting detection results containing the three-dimensional space coordinates and living body feature information.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar multipath ghost suppression method based on array virtual rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall penetrating radar multipath ghost suppression method based on array virtual rotation. Aiming at the problems of unknown scene layout, difficult acquisition of multiple view angles and unstable azimuth dependence, echo data of multiple rotation angles are acquired through virtual rotation of an array, then multipath paths are divided into areas outside the main lobes by utilizing different main lobe orientations under different rotation angles, so that multipath ghost phase mismatch is caused, and a target keeps a certain focus on the basis of approximate compensation. Then, the cross-correlation back projection algorithm is utilized to complete imaging at each virtual rotation angle, and simultaneously, non-target components are restrained. And finally, carrying out incoherent multiplication fusion on the plurality of angle echo data, and finally realizing the suppression of multipath ghost. The method is applied to multipath ghost suppression of the through-wall radar, and can effectively utilize the azimuth dependence of multipath ghost through single array based on signal processing under the condition of no prior information of a layout structure, so as to obtain better multipath ghost suppression performance.

title_en: Non-contact type vital sign monitoring system and method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a non-contact type vital sign monitoring system and a method.SOLUTION: A non-contact type vital sign monitoring system and a method of the present invention include a radar installed in the vicinity of a monitoring target. The non-contact type vital sign monitoring system comprises: a data buffer in which a plurality of output signals of the radar sampled in order in a prescribed period are saved; a status classifier that determines a state of the monitoring target on the basis of these output signals; and a vital sign detector that acquires a vital sign of the monitoring target on the basis of these output signals when the monitoring target is in a quiescent state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Biosignal Measurement Patch Structure and Its Use Method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조 및 그 사용 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a biosignal measurement patch structure capable of maintaining a contact force by bringing sensors for biosignal measurement into close contact with the skin. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a biosignal measurement patch structure comprises: a substrate made of a flexible material; a housing disposed in a first region of the substrate; and a biosignal measurement sensing electrode disposed in a second region of the substrate. The substrate is formed with a slit that penetrates in a direction dividing the first region and the second region.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Fall Risk Detection Solution Based on Two or More Vital Measurement Sensors
title_ko: 2개 이상의 바이탈 측정 센서 기반 낙상 위험 상태 감지 솔루션
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 목적은 2개의 생체신호 감지 센서를 이용하여 보호자가 있어도 환자의 침대로부터의 낙상 여부를 오감지 없이 높은 신뢰도로 감지할 수 있는 바이탈 측정 센서 기반 낙상 방지 솔루션을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: System and method for estimating vital signs
abstract_en: A system for estimating breathing frequency and heartbeat frequency of a subject, comprises at least one ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver, connected to at least one hardware processor, configured to: receive a plurality of readings from the UWB transceiver, each of the readings having a time and comprising a plurality of intensity values at the time, each of the intensity values having a corresponding distance value representing a distance between the UWB transceiver and the subject; determine a Range-Doppler map from the plurality of readings; analyze the Range-Doppler map to determine a breathing frequency value of the subject; perform null steering of a plurality of Doppler-map frequencies in the Range-Doppler map to nullify the breathing frequency value and integer multiples of the breathing frequency value to obtain a plurality of combined frequencies; and determine a heartbeat frequency value for which a plurality of computed frequencies corresponds with the plurality of combined frequencies.

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in front of a plurality of sensors such as those of speakers and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from the plurality of sensors may be analyzed by the processor to determine if one or more humans are present proximate to the device. Based on the determined presence or absence of one or more humans, further actions including, inter alia, customizing a home theatre experience for the one or more humans, making content recommendations, or activating parental controls can be taken by the device.

title_en: Method and system for validating optimal body sensor placement
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system comprising a monitoring patch configured to be adhesively attached to skin of an associated patient, the monitoring patch including at least one vital sign sensor arranged to measure vital sign data of the associated patient when the monitoring patch is adhesively attached to the skin of the associated patient. The monitoring patch includes a wireless transceiver or transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit the vital sign data, a monitoring device configured to receive the wirelessly transmitted vital sign data and to store, retransmit, or both store and retransmit the vital sign data, a skin condition sensor configured to measure skin measurement data on the skin of the associated patient, and at least one hardware processor configured to analyze the skin measurement data to determine advice on adhesive attachment of the monitoring patch to the skin and output the advice on the monitoring patch or the monitoring device.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Contactless sensor-driven device, system, and method enabling ambient health monitoring and predictive assessment
abstract_en: An ambient monitoring device includes a housing, contactless sensors coupled to the housing, and a processing device disposed in the housing. The processing device is coupled to the contactless sensors. The processing device is to receive, from one or more contactless sensors of the plurality of contactless sensors, historical sensor data. The processing device is further to determine baseline vital signs based on the historical sensor data. The processing device is further to receive, from the one or more contactless sensors, current sensor data associated with a user that is within a threshold distance of the ambient monitoring device without contacting the ambient monitoring device. The processing device is further to determine, based on the current sensor data, current vital signs of the user. Responsive to determining the current vital signs do not meet the baseline vital signs, the processing device is to provide an alert.

title_en: Based on human body target and the surrounding environment structure compatible detection method of UWB bioradar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of human body target based on UWB bioradar and surrounding environment structure compatible detection method, comprise the following steps: A pre-treatment step; B human body target detection steps; C-structure detection steps; Consider the hole formed under pressing the survivor be embedded in ruins to be mostly buried in ruins after the disasters such as earthquake occur, therefore there is certain space between survivor and ruins, and the medium in this space is air.Utilize this qualifications and human body target positional information, the detecting and identifying to hole upper and lower interface can be realized, to for obtaining in follow-up study more accurately, comprehensively ruins structural information explore, and the application and development of searching and rescuing bioradar technology for UWB provides new thinking.

title_en: Service robot with visual system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service robot with a visual system. The service robot comprises a robot vehicle body and a mechanical hand mounted above the robot vehicle body, wherein the robot vehicle body is internally provided with a control system for controlling the robot control vehicle body to move and controlling the mechanical hand to move; the robot control vehicle body is internally provided with an embedded type visual tracking system and a WIFI (Wireless Fidelity) communication module; a camera of the visual tracking system is mounted on the mechanical hand by a cloud deck; the WIFI communication module realizes wireless transmission of data and instructions of the control system, the visual tracking system and an upper computer. According to the service robot with the visual system, the service robot adopts the embedded type visual tracking system; the camera is used for carrying out visual tracking and the WIFI communication module and the upper computer are used for realizing visual transmission; a WIFI wireless network is used as a data transmission carrier to realize an intelligent system with the functions of real-time control, audio/video transmission, image acquisition and the like. The service robot disclosed by the invention can be used for civil and military fields including anti-terrorist investigation, battlefield C4ISR systems, fire protection and disaster relief, life detection and the like.

title_en: Human presence detector and human presence detection method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a human body presence detector, comprising a microwave generator, a microwave receiver, a mixing detector and a signal processor, wherein the microwave generator is configured to emit detection microwaves propagating in a detection space, wherein the microwave receiver is configured to receive corresponding echoes of the detection microwaves, wherein the detector is connected to the microwave generator and the microwave receiver and configured to perform mixing detection on the detection microwaves and the corresponding echoes to output corresponding primary detection wave signals, wherein the signal processor is connected to the mixing detector and configured to select and amplify the primary detection wave signals output from the mixing detector to output secondary detection wave signals in a specific fluctuation frequency range, and the human body detector amplifies response signals to actions having an action frequency in the specific frequency range, thereby, the presence of a human (living) body can be judged in response to the motion in the specific frequency range.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using a Kalman filter
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to radar vital signal tracking using a kalman filter. In an embodiment, a method includes receiving a reflected radar signal with a millimeter wave radar, generating a displacement signal indicative of a displacement of a target based on the reflected radar signal, filtering the displacement signal using a bandpass filter to generate a filtered displacement signal, determining a first rate indicative of a heart rate of the target based on the filtered displacement signal, tracking a second rate indicative of a heart rate of the target having a trajectory using a Kalman filter, updating the trajectory based on the first rate, and updating a setting of the bandpass filter based on the updated trajectory.

title_en: Life detection radar weak target detection method based on state prediction accumulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection radar weak target detection method based on state prediction accumulation, which comprises the following steps: discretizing the received multi-frame echo signals; detecting each frame of discrete echo signals according to a first detection threshold; constructing a target motion model and a target measurement model; constructing a target accumulation function according to the target motion model and the target measurement model; updating the state transition set of each frame of echo detection signal according to the speed constraint threshold and the prediction constraint threshold; calculating a target accumulation function value for each frame of echo detection signals according to the updated state transition set and the target accumulation function; judging a target according to a second detection threshold and a target accumulation function value; and backtracking the target estimation track according to the target accumulation function value. The invention sets the first detection threshold to filter noise interference, and sets the speed constraint threshold and the forecast constraint threshold to filter state information with high conformity with the target state, thereby reducing the arithmetic operation amount and improving the target detection performance.

title_en: A kind of automation deviational survey warning device and foundation pit tilt monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automation deviational survey warning devices, by in the pre-buried inclinometer pipe of pit foundation side wall to be measured, inclination sensor is set in inclinometer pipe, it is connect using detection module with inclination sensor, pass through inclination sensor and the deformation situation of inclinometer pipe synchro measure pit foundation to be measured in the construction process, the change shape in pit foundation work progress is obtained using detection module, and the data and preset threshold obtained by detection module by inclination sensor compare, so as to quickly see if fall out slant range, early warning can be carried out in time, the present apparatus can carry out real-time monitoring to the case where foundation pit side-wall horizontal displacement, it is again easy to use, save manpower, the problem of overcoming cumbersome traditional measurement method and serious lag, accurate data can be provided for guiding construction, early warning can be carried out to foundation pit disaster, to improve Foundation Pit Construction Mechanization, the level of IT application.

title_en: Method and system for processing sign data based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a sign data processing method and a system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly adopting the frequency modulation continuous wave radar to transmit electromagnetic wave signals to a human body to be detected so as to detect the mechanical motion signals of the chest wall of the human body to be detected and receive returned echo signals; then sampling the echo signals, processing the sampled echo signals by using a multiple signal classification algorithm to obtain a high-resolution range profile, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals according to the high-resolution range profile; finally, physical sign data of the human body to be detected are determined according to the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals, wherein the physical sign data comprise respiration rate, real-time respiration rate variability, heart rate and real-time heart rate variability; the invention can detect the vital signs of the human body to be detected more conveniently and more efficiently, realizes the high-precision real-time extraction of the respiration rate, the heart rate, the variability of the respiration rate and the variability of the heart rate, and provides accurate and clear sign data.

title_en: Smart home devices using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring contactless human interaction and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. A radar sensor operating in burst mode may output radar chirp. Burst mode radar data flows may be monitored for non-contact human interactions performed by active users. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. The virtual continuous mode radar data stream may be used for health monitoring of inactive users.

title_en: Coal mine goaf surface subsidence data acquisition system based on microseismic monitoring technology
abstract_en: The application provides a surface subsidence data acquisition system based on microseism monitoring technology, including earthquake wave sensor, data acquisition station and data processing host computer, this system adopts the mode that earth's surface and deep hole were buried underground, has realized that the noise is low, the fast characteristics of response. The earth surface grid and the deep hole are close to the bottom layer, and the characteristics of micro-seismic wave high-low frequency propagation are matched, so that the characteristics of long distance, large area, three-dimensional, real-time monitoring and time continuity are realized. The data can accurately obtain the three-dimensional space position and magnitude of the occurrence of the microseismic event through specialized data processing software, so that the rock mass damage condition and the filling treatment effect are evaluated. By means of microseism monitoring, long-time and wide-area bottom layer monitoring is achieved, and the method is well applied to aspects of reducing enterprise cost risks, providing effective goaf treatment schemes, treatment positions, evaluating treatment effects and the like.
assignees: CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;CCTEG BEIJING LAND CONSOLIDATION AND ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Shaft rescue communication probe
abstract_en: A shaft rescue communication probe is used for underground rescue. The rescue communication probe is connected with the aboveground computer through an optical fiber; an external power supply supplies power to the photoelectric transceiver and the main control circuit board through a lithium battery; the optical fiber is connected to the photoelectric transceiver, the photoelectric transceiver is connected with the main control circuit board through a network cable, the photoelectric transceiver converts optical signals received from an aboveground computer into electric signals, the signals are input to the main control circuit board through the network cable, the electric signals sent from the main control circuit board are converted into optical signals, and the optical signals are sent back to the computer; the main control circuit board is connected with the sound equipment, the microphone, the camera and the infrared thermal imaging sensor through a USB serial bus, and is connected with the environmental sensor module through an I2C serial bus. The invention supports long-distance communication, has multiple functions of life detection, video, two-way talkback, environment sensing and the like, can judge the position of the trapped person, know the field condition of the trapped person, acquire underground environment information and quickly and accurately make and execute a rescue plan.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHANNENG INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: WiFi signal-based respiration detection method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a breath detection method based on WiFi signals and related equipment, which are used for capturing the breath change of personnel by utilizing the WiFi signals of the equipment so as to improve the monitoring accuracy and the real-time performance as much as possible. The method of the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: acquiring a reflected wireless broadcast signal sent by WiFi equipment; extracting Channel State Information (CSI) signals from the wireless broadcast signals, and analyzing amplitude variation values and phase variation values corresponding to respiration signals in the CSI signals; calculating a respiratory rate value and a respiratory depth value in the respiratory signal according to the amplitude variation value and the phase variation value; and determining a corresponding breathing state identifier according to the breathing frequency value and the breathing depth value, so as to output prompt information according to the breathing state identifier.

title_en: Heartbeat signal processor and heartbeat signal processing method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable acquisition of proper heartbeat detection characteristics by removing a noise from a heartbeat signal.SOLUTION: A heartbeat signal processor includes: a means for acquiring a heartbeat signal associated with a subject's heartbeat from a heartbeat sensor; a low-pass filter for allowing the passage of the signal with a first predetermined frequency or lower, among the heartbeat signals; a harmonic noise acquiring means for acquiring a harmonic signal with a low-frequency noise by applying high-pass complementation to the signal output from the low-pass filter means; a high-pass filter for allowing the passage of the signal with a second predetermined frequency or higher, among the heartbeat signals; and a harmonic noise removing means for removing the harmonic signal with the low-frequency noise from the signal output from the high-pass filter.
assignees: TOYOTA INFOTECH CT CO LTD;TOYOTA MOTOR CORP

title_en: Mobile terminal under disaster
abstract_en: To enable a mobile device buried in a debris flow or an avalanche to oscillate a specified frequency.SOLUTION: A mobile terminal such as a smartphone is equipped with a sensor for detecting a disaster. When a person using a mobile terminal encounters a disaster such as a mudslide or an avalanche that suddenly occurs, the mobile terminal involved in the disaster detects the disaster at the same time, and detects a sudden change in radio wave condition, for example, in a case that the radio wave condition from a base station suddenly gets out of range because the mobile terminal is buried, whereby it is possible to find a buried location in a short period of time by transmitting a specified frequency by an oscillator incorporated in the mobile terminal even when the mobile terminal is broken.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Emergency rescue assisting devices and the method
title_ko: 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 응급구호방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 구성은, 흉부압박 센서부(10); 생체신호 센서부(20)와 호흡신호 센서부와 일체형의 흉부압박 조율 장치부(30)로 구성된다. 
이러한 구성의 본 발명은, 급성 심정지 등의 응급구호 상황이 발생했을 때 환자의 흉부압박 부위에 흉부압박 조율장치를  올려놓고 압박을 실시하여 압박의 강도와 주기를 조율해주는 장치이며, 환자의 압박이 이루어지면서 압박의 강도를 정확하게 측정하여 압박의 강도와 주기를 조율할 수 있도록 압박의 측정에 로드셀(Loadcell) 센서를 사용하고, 압박의 주기를 리드하는 리듬 재생청음 스피커를 사용하고, 압박을 인가하는 가압부에 시술자가 동일한 압력을 유지하되, 보다 부드러운 느낌으로 과도한 긴장없이 압박을 인가할 수 있도록 압박의 주기와 강도를 눈과 귀로 확인할 수 있도록 표시 장치부와 소리 재생 장치부를 포함한 것을 특징으로 하는 흉부압박 조율장치부와 이와 동시에 환자의 구강호흡 확인을 위해 양 입술에 끼워 압박 중간 중간 환자의 호흡이 돌아오고 있는지 실시간으로 감지하는 호흡신호 센서부와 또한 동시에 손가락에 일반적으로 검지 손가락 끝마디에  
착용하여 혈중산소농도와 맥박수를 측정하여 흉부 압박중에 생체에서 발생하는 생체신호 역시 회복되고 있는지를 감지하는 생체신호 센서부를 통해 응급구호를 실시하는 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Micropile and micropile molding method for earthquake-proof and strengthening ground
title_ko: 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법 및 상기 방법에 의하여 시공된 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forming method of a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement and a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement constructed by the same and, more specifically, to a forming method of a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement and a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement constructed by the same which allow ground reinforcing work regardless of all ground regardless of strength and weakness of bearing power of the ground, facilitate forming work of a micropile for ground reinforcement to increase a work progress speed to shorten a construction period, and easily insert a steel bar vertically to a center of a bottom surface of a bore to fix the steel bar to guarantee design strength to property provide strength and easily absorb an S wave of an earthquake by the vertically buried steel bar even when being shaken by the S wave of the earthquake to minimize destruction of the micropile to be used as an earthquake resistant structure. The forming method of a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement comprises: a step of drilling the ground by a bit; a step of embedding a steel bar on a center of a bore through a center hole in the bit in the drilled ground; and a step of lifting the bit while spraying air supplied from an air supply pipe installed on the bit through an air spray hole and spraying mortar supplied through a mortar supply pipe installed on the bit through a mortar spray nozzle in a state where the steel bar is embedded on the center of the bore to form a grout bulb.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법 및 상기 방법에 의하여 시공된 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일에 관한 것으로, 지반의 지지력의 강약을 불문하고 모든 지반에 관계없이 지반의 보강작업이 가능하게 되며 지반을 보강하기 위한 마이크로파일의 성형작업이 용이하게 되어 작업의 진척속도가 빨라 시공기간이 단축되며 천공의 저면의 중앙에 수직으로 강봉을 용이하게 삽입시켜 고정시킬 수가 있게 되므로 설계강도까지 보장되어 강도가 제대로 발현되고 지진의 횡파로 인한 요동시에도 이러한 지진의 횡파를 용이하게 수직으로 매립된 강봉에서 흡수하게 되어 마이크로파일의 파괴를 최소한으로 하는 것이 가능하게 되어 내진용 구조로도 사용이 가능한 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법 및 상기 방법에 의하여 시공된 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일을 포함하고, 
지반을 비트로 천공하는 단계와, 천공된 지반에 비트내의 중앙공을 통하여 강봉을 천공의 중앙에 근입시키는 단계와, 천공의 중앙에 강봉이 근입된 상태에서 비트에 설치된 에어공급관에서 공급된 에어를 에어분사공을 통하여 분사함과 동시에 비트에 설치된 몰탈공급관을 통하여 공급된 몰탈을 몰탈분사노즐을 통하여 분사하면서 비트를 상승시켜서 그라우트구근을 형성시키는 단계를 포함하는 본 발명에 따른 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법에 의하여 그 목적이 달성된다.

title_en: Management system for elderly people living alone based on ultra-wideband impluse-radio
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a UWB-based contactless impulse radar-type system for managing living-alone senior citizens. According to the present invention, the UWB-based contactless impulse radar-type system for managing living-alone senior citizens comprises: a bio-signal detection unit for detecting a reflection signal; a bio-signal calculation unit; a bio-signal comparison unit; an emergency power supply unit for supplying emergency power to a bio-signal recognition terminal; and a control unit. According to the present invention, the reliability of measurement of bio-signals can be increased.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 건물 실내의 벽면에 생체신호 인식 단말이 설치되어, 비접촉식으로 실내에 거주하는 모니터링 대상자의 생체신호를 측정하여, 측정된 생체신호 데이터를 인터넷망을 통해 관리서버로 전송하고, 상기 관리서버에서는 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기초로 하여 관리 단말로 제어신호를 전송하도록 하는 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템에 있어서, 실내 특정장소에 누워있는 모니터링 대상자의 가슴 방향으로 무선 주파수(radio frequency) 전파를 송신하고, 상기 대상자의 가슴으로부터 운전자의 심장 및 폐의 운동 변위에 따른 반사 신호를 검출하기 위한 생체신호검출부, 상기 생체신호검출부로부터 검출된 모니터링 대상자의 심장 및 폐의 운동 변위에 따른 반사 신호를 토대로 실시간으로 모니터링 대상자의 심박수 및 호흡수를 계산하는 생체신호계산부, 상기 생체신호계산부으로 계산된 실시간으로 모니터링 대상자의 심박수 및 호흡수와 기 저장된 기준 심박수 및 호흡수를 비교하는 생체신호비교부, 상기 생체신호 인식 단말로 건물내의 전원공급이 중단될 경우, 비상용 충전 배터리를 통해 상기 생체신호 인식 단말로 비상전원이 공급되도록 하는 비상전원공급부 및 상기 생체신호비교부로부터 실시간으로 운전자의 심박수 및 호흡수가 기준 심박수 및 호흡수로부터 벗어나 신체 이상 상태인 것으로 판단되는 경우, 상기 관리자 단말 또는 상기 생체 신호 인식 단말로 운전자에게 경고명령 신호를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 제공된다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 신체의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 센싱수단을 신체에 부착하거나 파지하는 등의 번거로움을 덜고, UWB를 기반으로 한 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식을 이용하여 독거노인의 생체정보를 외부로 전송 및 경고할 수 있도록 하여, 모니터링 대상자의 불편함없이 관리가 이루어 질 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 지진 등의 자연재해나 화재 또는 건물내 정전으로 생체신호 인식 단말로 전원이 공급되지 않을 경우, 비상용 배터리를 통해 모니터링 대상자의 생체신호 측정이 연속적으로 이루어지도록 하여, 위급상황에서 안정적으로 관리가 이루어질 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 건물내 천정에 설치되는 생체신호 인식 단말이 탄성줄에 의해 천정에 매달리는 형태로 설치되도록 하여, 지진이나 건물 주변 열차 통행에 의해 건물의 천정으로 전달되는 진동이 생체신호 인식 단말로 전달되지 않아 위급상황에서도 생체신호 측정의 오류없이 신뢰도가 높은 관리가 이루어질 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and device for searching through collapsed ground
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for determining whether a living person has been buried in collapsed ground. The device consists of a rod provided with a receiver unit and a signal processing unit. The receiver unit is intended to receive reflected radar signals transmitted form a radar transmitting antenna and transfer these signals to the signal processing unit. The signal processing unit which is provided with specific detection units determines whether the received signal have been Doppler shifted. By determining that the device can decide whether the Doppler shift depends on the moving chest of a breathing person buried alive.

title_en: Gripping-detection device
abstract_en: A gripping-detection device includes a first electrode and a second electrode provided on a steering wheel of a vehicle; a heartbeat detection unit that detects the heartbeat of a driver that is in contact with the first electrode and the second electrode based on a voltage pattern obtained from the first electrode and the second electrode; a first sensor and a second sensor that detect an electrostatic capacitance in the steering wheel; and a gripping state determination unit that determines a gripping state of the steering wheel of the driver based on the electrostatic capacitance detected by the electrostatic capacitance detection unit and a voltage pattern of the first electrode and the second electrode detected by the heartbeat detection unit.

title_en: Plurisensorial System Adapted for the Prevention of Professional Diseases in the Working Environment, and Method for the Use of the System
abstract_en: A multi-sense system adapted for prevention of occupational diseases in a working environment includes a protective facial mask adapted for application in the front zone of a person's face, having nose and mouth areas, and including: —a temperature and humidity sensor adapted to be activated when the mask is worn, and adapted to provide time-related data concerning the activation as well as temperature and humidity values; —removable air filter elements applied to the front side parts of the mask; —inhalation and exhalation valves applied to the front zone of the mask, in front of the mouth, when the mask is worn; —elements for securing the mask to the face; —an electronic nose device adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the quality of the air in the working environment; —a breathing detection device, adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the respiratory rate; —a data processing and displaying device, adapted to receive and store the data outputted by the protective facial mask, electronic nose device and breathing detection device, also adapted to process and display the data in order to determine a condition wherein the protective facial mask needs to be worn.

title_en: Non-contact exercise vital sign detection method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A non-contact exercise vital sign detection method is provided. At least one candidate position having an energy intensity exceeding an energy threshold is pre-selected from a vibration frequency map, and a position having a vibration frequency meeting a vital sign parameter range is then selected as a target position from the at least one candidate position. Accordingly, phase data obtained according to the target position facilitates accurate detection of a vital sign parameter of a subject.

title_en: Ultra wideband ai-enhanced imu tracking system for first responder use with smart glasses
abstract_en: A tracking system that works through walls, below grade, and at long range is provided, which may be utilized as a first responder tracking system. The system combines UWB (Ultrawideband) with AI-enhanced IMU motion tracking with use on, e.g., android-based smart glasses, phones and tablets. The UWB tracking provides a stable reference point in GPS denied environments, offering 3D tracking under the most challenging conditions. When walls or distance make UWB untenable, disclosed tags stream back IMU data processed by machine learning algorithms which remove, e.g., the effect of drift, noise, and error common to motion-based tracking. The system may process the UWB and IMU input data and produce a platform and language agnostic serialized message stream with position data. This published stream allows any visualization platform to subscribe and consume 3D position data, be it a local graph for engineering debug, cloud-based first responder software, or a third-party solution.

title_en: Radar type life detection method, system and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrying
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a radar type life detection method, a radar type life detection system and a radar type life detection medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrying; the method may include: receiving radar echo signals in a detection area by a biological radar mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle platform; wherein the radar echo signal comprises a plurality of channel signals; the method comprises the steps of eliminating motion interference about a platform in radar echo signals by using platform motion information sensed by a sensor mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and obtaining a first radar signal after primary interference suppression; after all channel signals in the first radar signals are subjected to cross-correlation processing, suppressing environmental motion interference in a detection area by adopting a self-adaptive spectral line enhancement mode, and obtaining a second radar signal subjected to interference suppression processing; extracting human target respiration detail characteristics from the second radar signal; and determining whether a human body target exists in the detection area based on a human body movement identification strategy of the two-dimensional CA-CFAR and the human body target breathing detail characteristics.

title_en: Tube for distribution position adjustment
title_ko: 배선위치 조정용 전선관
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A conduit for the control of a wire position is provided to enable people to rapidly extinguish fires by arranging a fire sensor and a fire hydrant in a wire installation stand and a distribution panel. CONSTITUTION: A one end of a main body member(10) is buried to the underground. The other end of the main body member is communicated with the support plate of a distribution panel. A wire installation stand(20) is arranged in the other end of the main body by passing through the support plate of the distribution panel. A buffer spring is arranged between the support plate of the panel and the wire installation stand in order to elastically support the wire installation stand. A fire sensor(60) is arranged in the bottom surface of the wire installation stand. A controller(70) outputs an opening and closing signal to a fire hydrant according to the fire monitoring signal of the fire sensor. The fire hydrant sprays a fire extinguishing material onto the wire protection member according to the opening and closing signal of the controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 일단부가 지중에 매립되고, 타단부가 배전반(1)의 지지플레이트(1-1)와 상호 연통되며, 양단에는 플랜지(11a)가 형성된 원통형상의 전선보호부재(11)와; 전선보호부재(11)의 둘레면에 설치되며, 내주면과 전선보호부재(11)의 외주면 사이에 공기층이 마련되는 럭비공형상의 탄성재질을 갖는 보호튜브(12)와; 플랜지(11a)를 감싸 고정 및 연결하는 탄성재질의 연결고무링(13)과; 반원형을 이루고, 외면에는 다수개의 볼트가 형성되며, 연결고무링(13)의 외면을 감싸 고정하는 한 쌍의 체결링(14)과; 체결링(14)의 볼트에 결합되어 너트를 매개로 고정되는 고정판(15)으로 구성된 본체부(10)와: 일측으로 개구되되, 개구된 내측에는 공간부(21a)가 형성되고, 상면에는 등 간격을 이루며 공간부(21a)와 연통되는 적어도 3개 이상의 장착공(21b)이 구비되며, 지지플레이트(1-1)를 관통하여 본체부(10)의 타단부에 삽탑가능하게 설치되는 도넛형상의 장착대바디(21)와; 공간부(21a)에 형성되되, 장착공(21b)을 기준으로 상호 대향되게 배치되어 한 쌍을 이루는 탄성재질의 가압링억류부재(22)와; 가압링억류부재(22)에 의해 고정되는 탄성재질의 가압링(23)과; 장착대바디(21)의 개구부를 밀폐하고, 전체적으로 원형관 형상을 이루는 가요성 및 탄성 재질의 팽창부재(24)와; 일측이 장착공(21b)에 설치되고, 타측이 컴프레셔(80)에 설치되는 연결부재(25)로 구성된 전선장착대(20)와: 지지플레이트(1-1)와 전선장착대(20) 사이에 설치되어 전선장착대(20)를 탄발지지하는 완충부재(30)와: 상부와 하부에는 돌부(41a)가 형성되며, 지중전선(L)의 둘레면에 고정되는 제1전선고정부(41)와, 외면에는 환형홈(42a)이 형성되고, 내면에는 돌부(41a)에 대응되는 삽입홈(42b)이 마련되어, 제1전선고정부(41)의 둘레면에 상하이동가능하게 설치되는 제2전선고정부(42)를 갖추고서, 전선장착대(20)의 가압링(23) 및 팽창부재(24)에 의해 위치가 고정되는 전선연결부(40)와: 전선장착대(20)의 상면에 설치되며 지중전선(L)에 의해 동작되어 제어부(70)로 감지신호를 출력하는 스위치부(50)와: 전선장착대(20)의 저면에 설치되어 화재시 발생되는 열을 감지하여 제어부(70)로 화재감지신호를 출력하는 화재감지센서(60)와: 스위치부(50)에 인접하게 배치되어 스위치부(50)로부터 감지신호를 입력받아 컴프레셔(80)에 동작신호를 출력하고, 화재감지센서(60)로부터 화재감지신호를 입력받아 소화전(90)의 개폐밸브(93)에 개폐신호를 출력하는 제어부(70)와: 제어부(70)로부터 동작신호를 입력받아 전선장착대(20)의 연결부재(25)에 에어를 공급하는 컴프레셔(80)와: 소화액이 저장되는 저장통(91)과; 장착대바디(21)의 공간부(21a)를 수직관통하는 다수개의 노즐(92a)과, 저장통(91)과 연결되는 연결호스(92b)를 갖추고서, 장착대바디(21)의 상면에 설치되어 저장통(91)으로부터 유입된 소화액을 전선보호부재(11)의 내부로 분사하는 분사관(92)과; 연결호스(92b)에 설치되며 제어부(70)의 개폐신호에 의해 작동제어되는 개폐밸브(93)를 갖춘 소화전(90)을 포함하여 된 것으로서, 전선장착대의 저면에 화재감지센서를 설치하고, 배전반의 내부에 소화전을 마련하여 줌으로서, 지중전선의 손상으로 인한 전기화재시 이를 신속하게 진압할 수 있어 지중전선을 타고 불길이 번지는 것을 방지 및 최소화할 수 있으며, 전선보호부재에 보호튜브를 설치하여 줌으로서, 전선보호부재에 외부요인 작용시 이를 보호튜브 및 보호튜브의 내부에 마련되는 공기층(미도시)이 충격을 흡수하여 전선보호부재가 파손되는 것을 최소화시켜줄 수 있다.

title_en: Gesture-based disaster response device and method
title_ko: 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 사용자의 신체에 부착되어 동작하는 복수의 센서들을 포함하는 웨어러블 단말로부터 재난 대응을 위한 동작 신호 및 생체 신호를 수신하는 상황 정보 수집부, 상기 사용자의 위치에 따른 장소 특성을 기초로 상기 동작 신호의 변화 패턴에 따라 상기 사용자의 제스처를 인식하는 제스처 인식부, 상기 제스처에 따른 생체 신호의 이상 유무를 모니터링하여 상기 사용자에 관한 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부 및 상기 재난 발생이 검출된 경우 상기 사용자의 위치를 포함하는 재난 정보를 전파하고 관제 서버에 긴급 구조의 진행을 요청하는 재난 대응 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: System for be used for interior vital signs of probe vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a system for be used for interior vital signs of probe vehicle, including radar formula life detector, gas composition sensor, temperature sensor, controller and alarm device, wherein, the radar formula life detector set up in engine compartment for vital signs in the response car, gas composition sensor settings is in the up end of car operation panel for gaseous information in the measuring car, temperature sensor sets up in the top in carriage for response in -car temperature, the controller sets up in the inside of car operation panel, is connected with radar formula life detector, gas composition sensor and temperature sensor electricity for receive and the process information, alarm device sets up in vehicle chassis for send alarm information. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the driver can effectively avoid owing to neglecting the interior safety problem of the car that arouses, if in forgeing the car with child, smoke in vehicle drives when intoxicated, the vital signs run -down arouses in the extreme condition is got off serious consequence is with safe taking precautions againt calamity in the car.

title_en: High-precision camera detector based on loop antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision camera detector based on a loop antenna. Including the main part, main part one end is annular head, and the other end is handheld portion, and the main part is fixed mounting has the light filter in the interior ring chamber of annular head, and annular head inside is provided with annular installation cavity, has buried annular antenna in the annular installation cavity, and handheld portion is external to have infrared LED lamp and built-in circuit board and battery. The loop design of the loop antenna can enlarge the detection area, so that the loop antenna is more sensitive to detection than a single vertical antenna, and the signal detected by the antenna is processed by a designed signal processing circuit, so that the signal is subjected to secondary signal transportation and amplification, and the voltage follower is combined to achieve the effects of buffering and improving the load capacity, thereby further improving the detection accuracy in circuit signal processing.

title_en: Mud-rock flow gabion prevention and control structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a debris flow gabion control structure, which comprises a gabion, wherein broken stones stacked together are wrapped on the inner side of the gabion, steel wires penetrate between grid-like meshes of the gabion, two ends of each steel wire are led out outwards and wound on a wood rod, two ends of each steel wire penetrate through holes in the bottoms of bolts, the bottoms of the bolts are propped against the outer side of the grid-like meshes of the gabion, the outer ends of the bolts are arranged on the surface of a stress plate through nuts, a gasket strip is arranged at the contact position of the stress plate and the gabion, a concave pressing plate is arranged at the rear end of the stress plate, a digital display pressure sensor is fixed on the inner side surface of a concave area in the middle of the concave pressing plate, and protruding areas on two sides of the concave pressing plate are fixed on the side surface of a wall through wall-in bolts. The gabion control structure is provided with a visual tensioning reference structure, so that constructors can be helped to accurately judge whether the tensioning degree of the binge gabion meets the standard or not, and the construction quality of debris flow gabion control is improved.

title_en: Portable through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses portable through-wall radar which comprises a radar shell. The portable through-wall radar further comprises a power supply module, a display control module, a digital module, a transceiving module and an antenna array, wherein the power supply module, the display control module, the digital module, the transceiving module and the antenna array are arranged in the radar shell; the output end of the power supply module is connected with the display control module, the digital module and the transceiving module; the display control module is connected with the digital module, the transceiving module and the antenna array in sequence. Various aspect factors such as penetrating power, areas and external disturbance are considered during optimized frequency band selection; light and ultra-broadband antennae are adopted; the requirements for broadband, impedance matching, lightweight and low profiles are met at the same time, transceiving leakage is controlled, and the dynamic range of a reception channel is guaranteed; the array topological structure is optimized, the requirement for high angular resolution is met, and angular grating lobes are avoided as much as possible; multi-airspace freedom degree is adopted to guarantee target fuzzy calculating; propagation speed changes and direction deviations are reduced; multiple false targets caused by the multipath effect are suppressed.

title_en: A kind of estimating two-dimensional direction-of-arrival method applied to S-band through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of estimating two-dimensional direction-of-arrival methods applied to S-band through-wall radar, specifically includes the following steps: first, the rectangular array layout being made of asymmetrically distributed five bay is set, first antenna array element is placed in coordinate origin, other four bays are centered on first antenna array element, four quadrants are respectively placed in, and each bay and first antenna array element spacing are unequal；Then, using the incoherent signal Subspace algorithm of processing broadband signal, radar emission/received broadband signal is divided into multiple sub-bands on frequency domain, arrival direction estimation is done by the method for narrow band signal to the signal of each sub-band, then the DOA estimated result of each sub-band is done into weighting processing, obtains estimated result to the end；Estimating two-dimensional direction-of-arrival method applied to S-band through-wall radar of the invention eliminates the influence of false peak spectrum, and be applicable in narrowband and broadband signal while improving angular resolution.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign detection method based on improved robust adaptive beam forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign detection method based on improved steady adaptive beam forming, which comprises the following steps: acquiring radar receiving signals, and estimating angles of all human bodies and angle intervals occupied by all human bodies by adopting a direction of arrival estimation algorithm; enabling one of the human body echoes to be an expected signal and other human bodies to be interference signals, and reconstructing a covariance matrix by adopting an improved method based on an epsilon constraint value; reconstructing a guide vector of a desired signal direction by adopting an improved xi constraint value-based method; obtaining a weight value by utilizing a self-adaptive beam forming algorithm; adopting the method of maximum signal-to-noise ratio search to obtain ideal weight and breathing signal; repeating the steps to obtain all the human breathing signals. The method of the invention starts from the scene of vital sign detection, and improves the robust beam forming algorithm, and the improved robust self-adaptive beam forming method of the invention is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, and can accurately extract the vital sign signals of each human body.

title_en: Pilot distress call device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pilot distress device, which comprises: the device comprises a shell, wherein keys, an air pressure sensor, an ambient temperature sensor, a display screen, a charging interface, a heart rate blood oxygen sensor and a body surface temperature sensor are arranged on the shell; the shell is internally provided with a controller, a clock module, a communication positioning module, a power module, a memory and a motion sensor; the controller is used for controlling the working mode switching, the state information acquisition, the activity state judgment and the vital sign state classification of the device, and realizing manual and automatic distress alarm after the pilot is in danger. According to the invention, under the complex condition, the influence of human body activity states and environmental factors on vital sign states can be comprehensively considered, the classification of the vital sign states can be comprehensively and accurately identified, help calling can be actively or automatically carried out, warning information of pilots can be sent to a management center, timely and accurate information can be provided for pilot search and rescue, and search and rescue progress can be accelerated.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY AIR FORCE CHARACTERISTIC MEDICAL CENTER

title_en: Vital sign and sleep monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign and sleep monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method utilizes the millimeter wave radar to realize non-contact sleep monitoring, firstly, the millimeter wave radar is used for collecting radar echo signals obtained by chest wall vibration in a sleep state, the position of a monitored object is determined, vital sign signals of the object are extracted, then, first amplitude body movements and second amplitude body movements of the object are accurately detected, whether an apnea event occurs in the object or not is detected in real time, alarm information is prompted under the condition that the event occurrence time is long, three sleeping positions of supine, lateral lying and prone lying are detected, finally, sleep state monitoring is formed, a user sleep quality analysis report is formed by combining the monitored information, and health advice is given. The method is simple, accurate, economical and efficient, is suitable for various application scenes such as families, hospitals, nursing homes and the like, and provides all-weather health monitoring services for users.

title_en: Vital sign detector based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of criminal escort monitoring, in particular to a vital sign detector based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises a detector shell, a rotor craft and a machine base, wherein a base plate is fixedly connected to the top of the machine base, a hanging structure is arranged at the top of the base plate, a mounting assembly is fixedly connected to the bottom of the rotor craft, and the detector shell is arranged at the bottom of the mounting assembly. The invention provides a vital sign detector based on millimeter wave radar, which has the advantages that millimeter wave detection components are arranged through arranging a detector shell to detect vital signs and activities of escorted personnel, an arranged base is used for arranging a fixed structure in a carrier or being worn in front of escorted personnel in cooperation with a hanging structure, the external features of the escorted personnel, which are input in advance through a rotor craft when the carrier walks outside to move for escort, are tracked, and a certain distance is kept to avoid the escorted personnel from damaging equipment.

title_en: Lightweight millimeter wave vital sign measurement method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a lightweight millimeter wave vital sign measurement method, a system, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of millimeter wave radar application, and the method generates a human body reflection energy factor by fusing a echo energy characteristic and a micro-motion energy characteristic, and inputs the human body reflection energy factor into a lightweight deep learning network, so that high-precision joint discrimination of the existence state of personnel and the human body distance is realized; after confirming personnel existence, carrying out multistage filtering and unwrapping processing by combining phase signals of corresponding range gates to obtain smooth continuous phase signals so as to effectively support stable extraction of follow-up vital sign parameters, further, constructing self-adaptive harmonic spectrum based on instantaneous respiratory frequency and human body distance, precisely removing interference caused by respiratory higher harmonic from heartbeat components, remarkably improving accuracy of heart rate estimation, avoiding invalid calculation in an unmanned state, and considering measurement accuracy and system efficiency.

title_en: Electric signal system and method for converting respiration
title_ko: 호흡을 이용한 신호 처리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for processing a signal by using respiration, which include: a respiration sensor for sensing respiration and converting the respiration into a respiration electrical signal; a respiration processing processor for processing the respiration electrical signal to generate digital data; and an output device for outputting the digital data. According to the present invention, the communication with a disabled person is possible, such that needs of the disabled person can be treated quickly in an emergency situation. In addition, it can be used for military purposes because it can be applied to cryptographic techniques such as Morse code, and it can be used as an input scheme for substituting a touch when using a smart phone or the like because the signal can be processed without using a hand.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 호흡을 이용한 신호 처리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 호흡을 감지하여 호흡 전기 신호로 변환하는 호흡 감지 센서와, 호흡 전기 신호를 처리하여 디지털 데이터를 생성하는 호흡 처리 프로세서와, 디지털 데이터를 출력하는 출력 장치를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 장애인과의 대화가 가능하므로 긴급한 상황에서 장애인의 요구사항을 신속하게 처리할 수 있을 것이다. 또한, 모르스 부호와 같은 암호전달기법에도 적용할 수 있으므로 군사적인 목적으로도 활용이 가능할 것이며, 손을 이용하지 않고 신호 처리가 가능하므로 스마폰 등의 이용에 있어 터치를 대신할 수 있는 입력방법으로 이용될 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV SOONCHUNHYANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: The device which sends the living body signal between living bodies
title_ko: 생체간 생체신호 전달 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device capable of transmitting a bio-signal of one living body to another living body. The device may know thought or will of another living body when a bio-signal is transmitted to nerves of another living body through an electrode or transmission antenna attached to another living body through a wire after the bio-signal moves along the wire by an electromagnetic phenomenon through the electrode or the bio-signal in microwave is amplified in an amplification unit through a reception antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 한 생체의 생체신호를 다른 생체에 전달할 수 있는 장치로서 생체신호가 전극을 통하여 전자기유도 현상에 의하여 전선을 따라 이동하거나 마이크로파에 담긴 생체신호가 수신 안테나를 통하여 증폭부에서 증폭된 후 전선을 통하여 다른 생체에 부착되는 전극이나 송신 안테나를 통하여 다른 생체의 신경에 전달되어 다른 생체의 생각이나 의지등을 알 수 있게 되는 생체신호 전달 장치이다.

title_en: Module for measuring bio information
title_ko: 생체정보 측정모듈
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio information measuring module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio information measuring module may include a finger contact interface, a bio sensor, a force sensor, and a support. The finger contact interface is operated by contact force applied by coming in contact with a finger of a user. The bio sensor measures a bio signal in a state where the finger comes in contact with the finger contact interface. The force sensor measures the contact force of the finger applied to the finger contact interface. The support guides an operation of the finger contact interface for the force sensor to support the finger contact interface.
abstract_ko: 생체정보 측정모듈이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체정보 측정모듈은 핑거 접촉 인터페이스와, 생체센서와, 힘 센서, 및 서포트를 포함할 수 있다. 핑거 접촉 인터페이스는 사용자의 손가락이 접촉되어 가해지는 접촉력에 의해 동작한다. 생체센서는 핑거 접촉 인터페이스에 손가락이 접촉된 상태에서 사용자의 생체신호를 측정한다. 힘 센서는 핑거 접촉 인터페이스에 가해지는 손가락의 접촉력을 측정한다. 서포트는 힘 센서를 핑거 접촉 인터페이스에 대해 지지한 상태로 핑거 접촉 인터페이스의 동작을 가이드한다.

title_en: Methods, computer programs, radar systems, antenna systems and flying platforms for detecting a horizontally buried linear object
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for detecting a horizontally buried linear object, the horizontally buried linear object having a longitudinal extension. The method comprises moving(S10), with a flying platform comprising a radar for synthetic aperture radar, SAR, vertical imaging, along a trajectory corresponding to a synthetic aperture. The method further comprises transmitting (S20) and receiving radar signals while moving along the trajectory corresponding to the synthetic aperture. The method also comprises forming (S30) a SAR image based on collected data representing radar signal reflections received from the ground. The method additionally comprises detecting (S40) one or more features in the formed SAR image relating to the horizontally buried linear object. Said trajectory is oriented in a direction substantially perpendicular to an expected orientation of the longitudinal extension of the horizontally buried object and traversing the horizontally buried object. The present disclosure further relates to corresponding computer programs, radar systems, flying platforms and antenna systems.

title_en: Noncontact self-injection-locked sensor
abstract_en: In a noncontact self-injection-locked sensor, a self-injection-locked oscillating integrated antenna is designed to radiate a signal to a subject and be injection-locked by a reflect signal reflected from the subject. Owing to the reflect signal is phase-modulated by vital signs of the subject, a demodulator is provided to demodulate an injection-locked signal of the self-injection-locked oscillating integrated antenna to obtain a vital signal of the subject.
assignees: SIL RADAR TECH INC;UNIV NAT TAIWAN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Human Presence Detector and Human Presence Detection Method Thereof
abstract_en: A human presence detector includes a microwave generator, a microwave receiver, a frequency mixing wave detector and a signal processor. The microwave generator is configured to emit and transmit a detecting microwave in a detection space. The microwave receiver is configured to receive a corresponding echo of the detecting microwave. The frequency mixing wave detector, linked to the microwave generator and the microwave receiver, is configured to perform a frequency mixing wave detection on the detecting microwave and the corresponding echo of the detecting microwave to output a primary detecting signal. The signal processor linked to the frequency mixing wave detector is configured to select a fluctuation signal at a predetermined frequency range in the primary detecting signal to amplify and output a secondary detecting signal. Accordingly, in response to the detection of the motion at the predetermined frequency range, a human (living) body is detected and determined in the detection space.

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection with vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system and a method for detecting an occupancy in an interior of a vehicle and with vital sign monitoring. The radar sensor system includes a radar transmitting unit, a radar receiving unit and a signal processing and control unit. The method includes: transmitting a radar wave towards a scene within the vehicle interior, receiving at least one radar wave that has been generated by reflection of the transmitted radar wave, decomposing the received radar wave into range, Doppler and angular information, quantifying and tracking a movement in each region of interest by angular gating and range gating, detecting and monitoring vital signs of occupants in each region of interest, and determining whether quantified and tracked movements in the scene are related to an occupant or to external or internal disturbances, based on a fulfillment of at least one predefined condition concerning the and/or the detected vital signs.

title_en: Multifunctional telemetry alert safety system (MTASS)
abstract_en: A Continuation-in-Part (CIP) of application Ser. No. 12/286,210 for the system of the present invention “Multifunctional Telemetry Alert Safety System” or “MTASS”, which comprises a personnel accountability and situational awareness monitoring communications system for hazardous work personnel that comprises wireless network-adaptable sensoring-monitoring devices, peripherals and base station dashboard software for telemetry monitoring of real-time information at a plurality of personnel accountability and situational awareness parameters of critical data about the safety, health and whereabouts of hazardous workers deployed in typically dangerous environments. Exterior worker management for urban/wildland firefighting, paramedics, search & rescue, hazmat, coal mines, oil platforms, law enforcement, and other hazardous work, achieve real-time command view and control over a variety, of personnel accountability and safety parameters during work activities of personnel wearing the system of the present invention portable device while operating within the mobile ad hoc wireless network. The portable device is a multi-functional sensing and communicating integration of technologies consolidated into one portable, telemetry device. The portable device's multifunctional integrated technology includes the monitoring, telemetry and alert notification of accountability identification, location, assignment notification, vital signs, ambient vicinity temperature, breathing apparatus status, combustible gas sensing, video streaming, “evacuation” recall signaling, signal tracking and multi-alarm signaling if the wearer has either low remaining air pressure/time, impending thermal breakthrough, low battery power, exceed the safety threshold for safe heart rate or external body temperature readings, or becomes motionless for a predetermined time period, or manually signals for help.

title_en: A kind of multiaspect body of wall fast-compensation method being applicable to through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of multiaspect body of wall fast-compensation method being applicable to through-wall radar imaging, based on body of wall parameter that is known or that estimate, consider that antenna pastes concealed target imaging problem in wall, the parallel wall body building structure of multiaspect, suppose that this multiaspect body of wall has identical relative dielectric constant and different-thickness, first, according to refraction law, move on to first surface body of wall edge by parallel for multiaspect body of wall, multiaspect body of wall, in conjunction with the equivalent one side body of wall of formation one, ensures that imaging and focusing postpones constant simultaneously.By above-mentioned equivalent process, by many refraction problems that multiaspect body of wall electromagnetic propagation relates to, be equivalent to traditional one side body of wall single refraction problem, simplify problem difficulty.Then, search for refraction point position on equivalent body of wall based on shortest time method, calculate propagation path delay.Finally, utilize rear orientation projection's imaging algorithm to obtain multiaspect body of wall and compensate rear target focusedimage, the advantage of accurate compensation Target Location Error, has very strong practicality.

title_en: Rescue and relief method based on unmanned aerial vehicle system and unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue and relief method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle system and the unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof, comprising the following steps of; the first step, dispatching corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle quantity according to the serious disaster situation; secondly, distributing an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue range through an unmanned aerial vehicle formation host according to disaster types, terrains and damage conditions; a third step of detecting the sign of life by a thermal imaging camera and throwing a marker at a corresponding position; and fourthly, expanding the search and rescue activities by the search and rescue personnel in the marked position range. The invention can cope with post-disaster rescue and relief activities of various natural disasters such as debris flow, flood, earthquake and the like, can detect the life signs from the air through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and can enable the search and rescue pair to find the search and rescue targets more easily through throwing the marker, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Body State Recognition using Various Bio-Signal Parameter
title_ko: 다양한 생체 신호의 파라미터를 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 다양한 생체 신호의 파라미터를 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치가 제공된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체 상황 인지장치는, ECG 센서, ECG 신호처리부 및 신호처리된 ECG의 피크 개수와 최대 피크를 참조하여 생체 상황을 판단하는 프로세서를 포함한다.  이에 의해, ECG의 피크 개수와 최대 피크를 모두 고려하여 생체 상황을 판단하므로, 그 정확도를 높일 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Biosignal Measurement Patch Structure and Its Use Method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조 및 그 사용 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피부에 생체 신호 측정을 위한 센서들을 밀착시켜 접촉력을 유지할 수 있는 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조는, 플렉서블한 소재의 기판; 상기 기판의 제1영역에 배치되는 하우징; 및 상기 기판의 제2영역에 배치되는 생체 신호 측정 센싱전극; 을 포함하고, 상기 기판은 상기 제1영역 및 상기 제2영역을 구획하는 방향으로 형성되는 슬릿이 관통 형성된다.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for battery-free measuring vital signs of a user from a single position near the user influenced by an alternating electric field provided by an electronic device. The apparatus includes a first electronic circuitry, a second electronic circuitry stacked to the first electronic circuitry, an instrumentation amplifier for amplifying the signals, an analog/digital converting logic circuit for generating digitized information, and a communication unit for communicating the digitized information. The first electronic circuitry includes a first electrode for receiving vital signals (acoustic, mechanical, electrical signals) from the user's body, a first shield unit for shielding the first electrode from electrical influences and influenced by the alternating electric field provided by the electronic device, a first rectifier for harvesting and rectifying the received alternating electric field from the first shield unit, further the first rectifier provides DC energy, a first buffer stores the DC energy and provides differential voltages, a first programmable operational amplifier amplifies the amplitude of the received vital signs powered by the received differential voltage from the first buffer.

title_en: Metal ore body detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a metal ore body detection instrument, wherein this instrument includes: the device comprises a sensor, an electromagnetic signal processing circuit, a laser sensor and an upper computer. The utility model discloses an whether near utilizing laser data preliminary judgement geologic body contains the metal, then use the sensor to come the perception to detect the natural electromagnetic wave signal of geologic body reflection, and obtain the frequency-selecting signal after enlargiing and screening processing natural electromagnetic wave signal, thereby can carry out the analysis to the characteristic of geologic body and reachs the kind of this near geologic body metal ore body, the buried depth, thickness and the appearance of producing, the efficiency of surveying of metal ore body has been improved greatly, and do not receive conventional electrical equipment basically, the influence that steamship iron material or sea were strikeed, it is big to have the detection degree of depth, the advantage that the detection precision is high.

title_en: A kind of synthetic aperture imaging optimized treatment method, device for through-wall radar
