abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of synthetic aperture imaging optimized treatment method, device for through-wall radar, and this method step includes: that S1. detects destination region using through-wall radar, acquires multi-channel back wave signal；S2. channel echo domain each in multi-channel back wave signal signal is imaged respectively and is carried out coherent superposition, obtain image domain data；S3. the image domain data output for processing being focused the energy of mesh target area is carried out primary energy focusing, after obtaining optimization processing to image domain data；The device includes that echo-signal obtains module, multichannel coherent imaging module and image area focus optimization module.The present invention has many advantages, such as that implementation method is simple, can inhibit clutter in through-wall radar synthetic aperture image in real time, reduces false alarm rate and does not lose target energy.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact fatigue detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact fatigue detection method and a non-contact fatigue detection system, which comprise the following steps: sending a millimeter wave radar signal to a person to be detected, and receiving an echo signal reflected from the person to be detected; to determine time-frequency domain characteristics, nonlinear characteristics and timing characteristics of the vital sign signals; acquiring a face video image of a person to be detected, and performing face detection and alignment based on the face video image to extract time domain characteristics and space domain characteristics of the face of the person to be detected; fusing the time-frequency domain characteristics, the nonlinear characteristics and the time sequence characteristics of the vital sign signals with the time domain characteristics and the space domain characteristics of the face of the person to be detected to obtain fused characteristics; and inputting the fused features into a classifier, identifying the fatigue state of the person to be detected, and judging whether the person to be detected is in the fatigue state. The invention combines the two technologies, thereby effectively inhibiting the interference of subjective and objective factors and improving the precision of fatigue detection.

title_en: Information detection method and device for indoor object, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses an indoor object information detection method and device, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data information of an indoor target object through target detection equipment, wherein the target data information at least comprises vital sign information and behavior information of the target object, and the target detection equipment comprises radar monitoring equipment which is not required to be worn by the target object and vital sign monitoring equipment worn on the target object; analyzing the behavior state information of the target object based on the target data information; and displaying the behavior state information of the target object on a display interface. Through this application, solved among the correlation technique to the not good problem of indoor personnel's information detection effect.

title_en: Prediction method for surface type rock burst of deep-buried tunnel structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method of a surface type rock burst of a deep-buried tunnel structure, and relates to the technical field of deep-buried tunnel construction; comprising the following steps: in the area needing to evaluate the rock burst tendency, determining the ground stress information by a hydraulic fracturing method, and determining the maximum main stress and direction; collecting field rock blocks and preparing samples required by rock tests in areas needing to evaluate rock burst tendency; carrying out a uniaxial compression test on the rock sample to obtain the elastic modulus, the uniaxial compressive strength and the strain corresponding to the uniaxial compressive strength of the rock sample; obtaining geological information of a construction area through geological sketch, advanced geological radar and other methods; establishing a corresponding numerical calculation model according to the ground stress information of the construction area, the geological information obtained by on-site geological investigation and the rock mechanical parameters; and predicting the position and strength of the rock burst through numerical simulation of the tunnel excavation process.

title_en: Underground garage fire-fighting fire-extinguishing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire extinguishing and fire extinguishing, in particular to a buried underground garage fire extinguishing and fire extinguishing system, which comprises a cover plate arranged on the surface of a parking space, an infrared temperature sensor embedded in the ground surface, a smoke sensor arranged on a wall surface and a groove arranged below the surface of the parking space, wherein a fire extinguishing mechanism is arranged on the upper layer in the groove and comprises a first pipeline, two ends of the first pipeline are respectively connected with a second pipeline through a rotating shaft, one of the second pipelines is sleeved with a first turbine, the second pipeline is respectively connected with a third pipeline through a first telescopic steel pipe, one end of the third pipeline is respectively connected with a cooling spray head, the rotating shaft at the other end of the third pipeline is respectively connected with a water curtain spray head, the end of the third pipeline, which is provided with the water curtain spray head, is respectively sleeved with a second turbine, one side of the second pipeline is connected with a fourth pipeline through a first connecting rod, and two ends of the fourth pipeline are respectively provided with a dry powder spray head.
assignees: ZHONGWAI JIANHUACHENG ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Personal air breathing device with safety alarm function and worker management system
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal air respirator having a safe alarming function, which is mounted on an air respirator to enable a user to easily confirm survival, disorder, and position of fire fighters during fire fighting (life saving), and to a worker management system using the same. The worker management system comprises: an air respirator including a respiration sensor for sensing respiration of a user, an air residual amount sensing unit for measuring the air amount stored in a high pressure container, a control unit for determining a state of a user according to a respiration sensed signal sensed through the respiration sensor, controlling display of the air residual amount according to the air residual amount sensed through the air residual amount sensing unit, and controlling a user state signal to be transmitted, and a wireless transmitter for transmitting the user state signal as a wireless signal according to control of the control unit; and a worker management device which receives and stores the user state signal transmitted from the wireless transmitter of the air respirator and displays the state of the user on a screen according to a request of an administrator.
abstract_ko: 공기호흡기에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조)시 소방대원들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서, 고압용기에 저장된 공기량을 측정하는 공기 잔량 감지부, 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 공기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량에 따라 공기 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부, 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하는 공기호흡기; 상기 공기호흡기의 무선 송신기에서 송출된 사용자의 상태신호를 수신하여 저장하고, 관리자의 요청에 따라 사용자의 상태를 화면에 표시해주는 대원관리장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Method of manufacturing loess wood
title_ko: 황토목재 제조방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는, 황토목재 제조방법은 황토를 소금과 혼합한 혼합물을 0.1 ~ 5㎚ 크기의 입자로 제조하는 제 1 공정, 상기 제조한 황토 원료, 규소 또는 알루미늄으로 이루어지는 염알루미늄 계열의 무기질 경화제 및 물을 혼합하여 황토원액을 제조하는 제 2 공정, 목재를 함침로에 투입하는 제 3 공정, 상기 함침로에 진공을 가하여 목재 내부의 수분 및 불순물을 제거하는 제 4 공정, 상기 함침로의 저장탱크에 황토원액을 공급하는 제 5 공정, 상기 함침로의 압력을 가하여 상기 황토원액을 목재 조직 내부로 침투시키는 제 6 공정, 상기 가압을 해제하고 진공을 가하여 목재 표면의 잔재물 및 과잉흡수된 황토원액을 회수하는 제 7 공정, 상기 황토원액을 회수한 목재를 8시간 ~ 7일 동안 60 ~ 120℃의 온도에서 건조하는 제 8 공정 및 상기 건조한 목재의 표면을 샌딩처리하는 제 9 공정으로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명에 따라 제조된 황토목재는 산업적인 측면에서 황토의 원가가 저렴하여 원재료인 황토의 구입이 용이하며 취급시 안전하다는 장점이 있으며, 황토의 점성적 성질로 목재 내부의 융착이 용이하다는 장점이 있다. 
또한 환경적인 측면에서 황토를 사용함으로써 친환경적이며 습도조절능력이 뛰어나다는 효과가 있으며,목재와 함께 사용함으로써 통기성 및 축열성이 높으며 원적외선 방사로 인체 건강에 유익하며, 강력한 항균력으로 곰팡이 서식을 억제할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한 목재와 황토무기질 세라믹의 혼합으로 착화온도가 높아 화재 발생을 지연 또는 억제시키는 역할을 하며, 연소시 불꽃이 형성되지 않아 유독가스의 발생을 억제시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Device, system and method for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: In order to provide means for measuring vital signs such as heart rate, breathing rate, pulse forms, that allow accurate and unobtrusive signal acquisition and that are automatically adjusted to varying positions of an area of interest within a pre-determined area, a device, a system and a method for measuring vital signs are provided, wherein electromagnetic signals such as microwave or radar are emitted and reflected electromagnetic signals are sensed with directional sensitivity by a transceiving unit and wherein a direction of interest is determined based on the sensed reflected signals and a primary direction of sensitivity (300) of the transceiving unit is adjusted to the direction of interest by a control unit. Thus, vital signs can be monitored in an unobtrusive and simple way.
assignees: MULDER BERNARDO ARNOLDUS;ANGELIS GEORGO ZORZ;DILLEN PAULUS HENRICUS ANTONIUS;VAN DALFSEN AGE;SEVO ALEKSANDAR;PINTER ROBERT;IGNEY CLAUDIA HANNELORE;GODLIEB ROBERT;VAN DEN BOOGAARD MAARTEN;KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Health management
abstract_en: A method includes capturing continuously vital signs and motion data from one or more sensors adapted to be coupled to a user; capturing food consumption of the user; predicting a predetermined health condition of the user based on the vital signs; generating a plan for the predetermined health condition; and prompting the user to execute the plan with a closed-loop feedback based on sensor data.

title_en: Sepsis risk assessment and treatment
abstract_en: A patient support apparatus includes a controller, a sensor capable of detecting vital signs, and a point of care (PoC) device for assessing risk of developing sepsis and for providing local and/or remote indications to caregivers. The controller is coupled to the sensor and the point of care device, and the controller can analyze signals from the sensor and the point of care device to determine data indicative of sepsis.

title_en: System and method for through-wall detection
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a through-wall detection system and a through-wall detection method. The through-wall detection system includes a synthetic aperture radar (SAR), configured to scan an area of interest behind a wall to obtain SAR scanning data, where the SAR includes a linear frequency-modulated continuous-wave (LFMCW) time-division multiple access (TDMA) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) SAR; a laser range finder, configured to estimate a distance between the SAR and the wall; and further include a mobile device. A data processor is configured to pre-process SAR scanning data of all Tx-Rx antenna pairs and transfer pre-processed SAR scanning data of all Tx-Rx antenna pairs to the mobile device; and the mobile device is configured to process the pre-processed SAR scanning data of all Tx-Rx antenna pairs to generate a 2-dimensional SAR image and determine presence or absence of a target in the area of interest behind the wall.

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
Safety guarantee system for high-risk places of digital wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital wireless sensing network high-risk place safety guarantee system which is used for carrying out safety guarantee on firefighters, disaster relief personnel and the like in high-risk places such as fire scenes, mine accident sites and the like. The multifunctional remote control device comprises a wristwatch module, a helmet module, an air calling module, a control center module and a handheld PDA module. The system and the method monitor vital signs and field environment of high-risk personnel in real time by using the technology of Internet of things, realize real-time tracking and positioning of the high-risk personnel, complete field commanding and dispatching in the high-risk place and ensure the life safety of the personnel.
assignees: JIANGSU RIFETUNE SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of method for through-wall radar multi-target detection
abstract_en: The present invention is necessarily more than the echo of target own apart from this principle based on the multipath echo distance corresponding to a target, a kind of multipath mirage suppressing method being applicable to close space multi-target detection is provided, first pass through Threshold detection by original image binaryzation, obtain one group of connected domain based on 4 communicating method mark binary images, all connected domains are formed connected domain sequence according to the distance of its coordinate average to radar center point is ascending according to ascending sort；Then according to ascending analyze respectively successively according to ascending order of the distance of radar center point, its coordinate average judges that each connected domain is target or multipath mirage region, finally retain the connected domain being judged as target, and being judged as the connected domain zero setting in multipath mirage region, thus realize can guarantee that again the target image being in multipath mirage region will not be lost while suppression multipath mirage.

title_en: Synthetic aperture through-wall radar multipath false target removing method based on multiple imaging dictionaries
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-path false target removing method for a synthetic aperture through-wall radar based on multiple imaging dictionaries, which is applied to the technical field of primary multi-path suppression of the synthetic aperture through-wall radar, and comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a target direct echo dictionary and a multi-path false target dictionary according to the structural characteristics of a building, the position of the through-wall radar away from a front wall and echoes of each reflection path; secondly, respectively using a target direct echo dictionary and a multipath false target dictionary to perform back projection imaging processing on the echo data to obtain a target space image and a multipath false target space image; finally, carrying out incoherent fusion on the target space image and the multipath false target space image to realize the suppression of the primary multipath false target in the building; compared with the prior art, the method has lower complexity and better multipath suppression effect.

title_en: Outdoor infrared shooting and detecting and observing multi-foot walking device
abstract_en: The invention relates to outdoor detection equipment, in particular to an outdoor infrared shooting and detecting and observing multi-foot walking device. The device comprises a rolling multi-foot walking device, a flat ground walking device, a camera, an infrared sensor and a controller; the rolling multi-foot walking device comprises a rolling motor, a hemispherical shell and a plurality of telescopic thorns, wherein the telescopic thorns are fixedly connected to the outside of the hemispherical shell, and the rolling motor is connected with the hemispherical shell; the flat ground traveling device comprises an annular shell, supporting legs, traveling wheels and a traveling motor, wherein the supporting legs are fixedly connected to the outside of the annular shell, the traveling wheels are arranged on the supporting legs, and the traveling motor is connected with the traveling wheels; the two hemispherical shells are arranged on two sides of the annular shell through bearings, the camera, the infrared sensor, the walking motor and the rolling motor are electrically connected with the controller, and the controller is powered by the battery. The camera shooting or framing of people in an outdoor complex environment is facilitated; after disasters such as earthquake occur, the life signs are searched in a complex and severe environment through infrared detection.

title_en: In-vehicle life detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of intelligent automobiles, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting life in an automobile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an x-th radar frame signal acquired by a preset millimeter wave radar in the vehicle; performing demodulation sampling and time-frequency conversion on the xth radar frame signal to obtain a first distance dimension signal array; filtering the first distance dimension signal array to obtain a second distance dimension signal array; extracting the phase and the confidence coefficient of a preset detection point in the second distance dimension signal array; performing iterative filtering on the phase and the confidence coefficient of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal according to the phase and the confidence coefficient of the preset detection point of the pre-extracted xth-1 radar frame signal to obtain a filtering result of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal; and determining that the preset detection point has life under the condition that the filtering result is greater than a preset threshold value. The invention can be suitable for life detection in vehicles in various scenes and has better detection effect.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar respiratory frequency detection method and system based on broadband frequency spectrum weighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar respiratory rate detection method and system based on broadband frequency spectrum weighting, wherein the millimeter wave radar respiratory rate detection method based on the broadband frequency spectrum weighting comprises the steps of S1, conducting distance dimension FFT on ADC signals to obtain a distance dimension FFT result, S2, conducting dynamic and static separation on the distance dimension FFT result to extract life signals from static parts, S3, conducting dynamic and static separation among multiple frames to distinguish static objects and jogging targets, S4, selecting distance units from the dynamic and static separation results among the multiple frames to extract phases in the distance units, S5, conducting phase unwrapping and filtering on the phases to obtain a respiratory signal, S6, conducting FFT calculation on the respiratory signal to obtain a frequency spectrum of the respiratory signal, and S7, calculating the respiratory rate according to the frequency spectrum. The invention can improve the accuracy of respiratory rate detection.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Railway line geological disaster monitoring and forecasting system
abstract_en: A railway along-line geological disaster monitoring and forecasting system relates to the field of railway safety and is used for guaranteeing railway traffic safety. The railway line geological disaster monitoring and forecasting system comprises an upper computer and disaster monitoring components, wherein the upper computer is provided with a plurality of alarms, the disaster monitoring components are arranged on one side of the railway and are distributed at intervals along the extending direction of the railway, the disaster monitoring components further comprise embedded parts, sensors and communicators, the embedded parts are buried underground on one side of the railway, the sensors are arranged on one side of the embedded parts and are in contact with the embedded parts, the communicators are fixedly connected with the embedded parts, the communicators are electrically connected with the sensors, and the communicators are in communication connection with the upper computer. The disaster monitoring assembly is buried at the railway side, and can detect whether the topography and the topography of the railway side are greatly changed, so that whether geological disasters occur in the area where the disaster monitoring assembly is located is monitored, and the railway traffic safety is ensured.
assignees: TIBET PLATEAU ATMOSPHERIC ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INST

title_en: Ultra-wideband monitoring system and antenna
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects includes a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor includes: an antenna system; an ultra-wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system; a signal processor; and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive signals from the ultra-wideband radar system and is configured to extract information from the signals relating to one or more vital signs of a person or animal within a sensing range corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to send the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: A kind of electromagnetic wave three-dimensional reverse-time migration imaging method under higher-Order Time-Domain algorithm
abstract_en: A kind of electromagnetic wave three-dimensional reverse-time migration imaging method under higher-Order Time-Domain algorithm, it is related to Computational electromagnetics and wideband radar detection.It is applicable not only to the buried target of ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR and hidden media area is reconnoitred and data acquisition imaging, is further widely applied to the particular problems such as geological prospecting, road prospecting and through-wall imaging.The experimental signal detected using three-dimensional high-order time-domain finite difference and ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR, obtains the positive field distribution for the time domain excitation signal that ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR receives and the reverse field distribution of time domain observation signal that ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR receives.In the case where meeting the requirement of reverse-time migration image-forming condition, overcome inclination angle to limit in theory, and accurately image can be realized.The numerical simulation of reverse-time migration Imaging Simulation is carried out to target area using radar signal, the dynamic information of target to be measured can effectively be obtained, there is higher imaging resolution advantage compared to traditional magnetography algorithm, taken a firm foundation to obtain the identification of target to be measured and parametric inversion.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: A non-contact vital sign detection system and method, the non-contact vital sign detection system has radar that locates near person under test, the non-contact vital sign detection system includes the data buffer, store a plurality of output signals of radar sampled sequentially in the predetermined period; the state classifier determines the state of the person to be tested according to the output signal; and the vital sign detector is used for obtaining the vital signs of the person to be detected according to the output signal when the person to be detected is in a static state.

title_en: Building layout tomography method based on direct wave time delay estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building layout tomography method based on direct wave time delay estimation, which is characterized by accurately extracting a direct wave from a sampling signal with complex components, establishing a tomography projection model according to the relation between the propagation time delay of the direct wave and the relative dielectric constant of a medium on a path, reconstructing the building layout by using a minimum total variation augmented Lagrange alternating direction algorithm, realizing high-precision reconstruction of a conventional building only containing horizontal and vertical walls, accurately estimating the direct wave time delay, solving the problems of more artifacts, fuzzy walls and the like in an imaging result, being suitable for reconstruction of the conventional building layout, being beneficial to optimizing the reconstruction quality of the partial unconventional building layout, having the advantages of simple processing flow and low cost, and being directly applied to through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring sensor, and relates to the technical field of medical equipment. This ultra wide band biological radar vital sign monitoring sensor, including biological radar sensor host computer, biological radar sensor host computer's lower fixed surface is connected with the fixed plate, the inside threaded connection of fixed plate has the screw rod, the output of screw rod rotates and is connected with first splint and second splint, biological radar sensor host computer's surface is provided with places the cover shell, place the surface fixedly connected with buffer and the solar panel of cover shell, place the lower fixed surface of cover shell and be connected with mobile device, place the top of cover shell and be provided with the upper cover, the upper fixed surface of upper cover is connected with first elastic plate and second elastic plate, place the bottom fixedly connected with battery of cover shell internal surface, cooperation between through each structure, make equipment can be used for different places, the practicality of equipment has been improved greatly, not only easy operation, but also the square portable outdoor use of taking.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fatigue detection method for millimeter wave radar and vision fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fatigue detection method by fusing millimeter wave radar and vision, which relates to the field of safe driving and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining head videos and vital sign signals of a driver through a camera and a millimeter wave radar, preprocessing the head videos and the vital sign signals, calculating facial fatigue parameters and respiratory frequency through a software algorithm, and judging the fatigue state of the driver according to the facial fatigue parameters and the respiratory frequency. The invention improves the accuracy of fatigue detection by using a double detection mode, and avoids the single aspect characteristic and the possible false detection phenomenon during single fatigue detection.

title_en: Multi-mode health monitoring method and device, radar, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a multi-mode health monitoring method, a multi-mode health monitoring device, a multi-mode health monitoring radar, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of transmitting a linear frequency modulation signal through a frequency modulation continuous wave radar and receiving a return wave signal, carrying out cluster analysis on the return wave signal, dynamically judging the relevant behavior state of the bed according to a clustering result, switching among a plurality of monitoring modes according to the behavior state and a switching condition of a finite state machine, wherein the monitoring modes comprise a bed occupation monitoring mode, a vital sign monitoring mode and a falling monitoring mode, the switching condition of the finite state machine comprises a vital sign monitoring mode when the behavior state is the stable bed occupation, a falling monitoring mode when the behavior state is the object movement, and a bed occupation monitoring mode when the behavior state is the continuous empty bed, so as to meet the multi-mode dynamic monitoring requirement under a complex scene.
assignees: HANGZHOU SHENGDEWEI INTEGRATED CIRCUIT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire site handling support system and fire site handling support method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fire site handling support system and a fire site handling support method capable of effective supporting fire fighting, prevention of fire spread, and evacuation guidance of survivors.SOLUTION: A fire site handling support system comprises: a fire situation determination device which detects whether a fire has occurred from sensing information of fire detection sensors; a fire prevention zone creation state determination device which determines an opened/closed state of fire doors from sensing information of the fire door sensors located near the fire doors; a remaining survivor state detection device which determines whether there is any remaining survivor from sensing information of remaining survivor detection sensors; a determination processing device which generates disaster activity information on which disaster prevention staff acts from a combination of the fire situation determined by the fire situation determination device, the opened/closed state of the fire doors determined by the fire prevention zone creation state determination device, the remaining survivor information determined by the remaining survivor state detection device and each installation location of the fire detection sensors, the fire door sensors, the remaining survivor detection sensors; an information transmission device which transmits the disaster activity information from the determination processing device.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Body State Recognition using the Impedance Charateristic Enhanced Electorde
title_ko: 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus to recognize biological conditions using an electrode having improved impedance. The biological condition recognizing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes an EEG sensor, an ECG sensor, an EEG signal processing unit, an ECG signal processing unit, and a processor which determines biological conditions based on EEG and ECG, wherein the electrode of the EEG sensor and the electrode of the ECG sensor are textile electrodes using conductive thread. Thereby an accurate biological signal can be sensed by overcoming high skin impedance using an electrode having improved impedance.
abstract_ko: 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치가 제공된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체 상황 인지장치는, EEG 센서, ECG 센서, EEG 신호처리부, ECG 신호처리부 및 신호처리된 EEG와 ECG를 기반으로 생체 상황을 판단하는 프로세서를 포함하고, EEG 센서의 전극과 ECG 센서의 전극은 전도사를 이용한 직물 전극이다.  이에 의해, 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용하여 높은 피부 임피던스를 극복하여 정확한 생체 신호 센싱이 가능해진다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for monitoring a biosignal based on a wireless network. A method for preventing solitary death based on an embedded biosignal collector installed in a lamp in a room comprises: a step of collecting a biosignal based on an embedded biosignal collector in a room lamp; a step of performing digital signal processing (DSP) to suppress a clutter signal in the biosignal and extract only a biosignal of a solitary death prevention subject; a step of performing signal processing to extract only an important signal from the biosignal on which DSP is performed; a step of extracting a feature parameter from the biosignal on which signal processing is performed; and a step of transmitting the biosignal and the feature parameter to a biosignal processing collection server. The biosignal includes a heart beat signal, a motion signal, and a respiration signal. The embedded biosignal collector is a super-sensitivity microwave sensor. The biosignal processing collection server collects the feature parameter and the biosignal of the solitary death prevention subject to extract biosignal property information. The biosignal collection server extracts a signal of the solitary death prevention subject in a plurality of biosignals generated by a plurality of solitary death prevention subjects in an identical place based on the biosignal property information.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 방 내부의 등에 설치된 내장형 생체 신호 수집기 기반 고독사 방지 방법에 있어서, 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기를 기반으로 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 상기 생체 신호에서 클러터(Clutter) 신호를 억제하고 고독사 방지 대상자의 생체 신호만을 추출하는 DSP(digital signal processing) 처리를 수행하는 단계; 상기 DSP 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 중요 신호만 추출하는 신호 처리를 수행하는 단계; 상기 신호 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 특징 파라미터를 추출하는 단계; 상기 생체 신호 및 상기 특징 파라미터를 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버로 전송하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버는 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 상기 생체 신호 및 특징 파라미터를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하고,  상기 생체 신호 수집 서버는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 고독사 방지 대상자에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 신호를 추출한다.

title_en: Smart diffuser with non-contact bio-signal measurement function
title_ko: 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function, and more specifically, to a smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function, wherein air quality management customized for the indoor position of a resident, the living pattern of the resident by the measurement of bio-signals, and each space can be performed in a non-contact manner using an RF radar. The smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function according to the present invention can track, in real time, the position of a resident in a non-contact manner using an RF radar and can analyze the amount of activity, thereby enabling air quality management customized for each living space. In addition, the smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function according to the present invention measures the respiration rate and the heart rate of a resident in real time in a non-contact manner using an RF radar to check whether an emergency situation occurs and to enable prompt follow-up measures, and can recognize an intruder by analyzing the activity pattern and bio-signals of the resident.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 RF레이더를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 실내 위치, 생체신호 측정을 통한 거주자의 생활패턴 및 공간별 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져는 RF레이더를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 위치를 실시간으로 추적 및 활동량을 분석하고, 이에 따른 주거 공간별로 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 장점이 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에 따른 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져는 RF레이더를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 호흡수 및 심박수를 실시간 측정함으로써 응급상황 발생 여부를 확인 및 신속한 후속조치가 가능하고, 거주자의 활동패턴 및 생체신호 분석을 통해 침입자 인식이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Machine learning-based non-contact user health anomaly detection method and system
title_ko: 머신 러닝 기반 비접촉식 사용자 건강 이상 상태 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a machine learning-based non-contact user health anomaly detection system. The present invention includes: a data acquisition unit that acquires user biometric detection data from an image captured by a non-contact biometric signal sensor; a data conversion unit that converts the biometric detection data acquired through the data acquisition unit into biometric signal data; and a user risk detection unit that detects a user's health risk state by using the user's biometric signal data converted through the data conversion unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 머신 러닝 기반 비접촉식 사용자 건강 이상 상태 탐지 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 비접촉 생체 신호 센서를 통해 촬영되는 영상에서 사용자의 생체 검출 데이터를 획득하는 데이터 취득부; 상기 데이터 취득부를 통해 획득한 상기 생체 검출 데이터를 생체 신호 데이터로 변환하는 데이터 변환부; 및 상기 데이터 변환부를 통해 변환된 사용자의 생체 신호 데이터를 이용하여 사용자의 건상 위험 상태를 감지하는 사용자 위험 감지부를 포함한다.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, one of the RF tags being turned on and generating an incident RF signal with a predetermined frequency, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one radio-frequency identification (RFID) radar that turns on one of the RF tags, demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital signal of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to the turned-on RF tag.

title_en: A kind of strong reflection clutter removing method based on double source IR-UWB bioradars
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of strong reflection clutter removing method based on double source IR UWB bioradars, detection is carried out at the same time using the antenna of two kinds of different center frequencies, first to the radar echo signals of two kinds of different frequencies respectively into pre-processing in row of channels, it is included in the enterprising row distance accumulation of spatial domain, be normalized in time-domain, linear trend eliminate and low-pass filtering, to realize the enhancing of the faint life signal of human body；Then interchannel processing is carried out to pretreated two kinds of different frequency radar echo signals again, the strong reflection noise jamming in radar return is suppressed using self-adapting clutter technology for eliminating, so as to improve the accuracy rate of radar detection.

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent real-time monitoring, and provides an intelligent vital sign monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: modeling human body vital signs; the monitoring radar transmits a transmission signal of the linear frequency modulation continuous wave into the monitoring area, and simultaneously continuously captures an echo signal reflected by a human body; analyzing a transmitting signal, an echo signal and a beating signal of the radar, and extracting human body vital sign data; checking vital sign information in real time; and separating the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal, and respectively carrying out frequency calculation on the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal. According to the invention, the human body vital sign signal is measured by measuring the relative frequency relation between the received signal and the transmitted signal, so that the real-time performance and accuracy of human body vital sign signal detection are improved; the calculation accuracy of separating the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal is greatly improved by extracting the data of the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal based on the confidence parameters of the spectrum estimation of FFT, autocorrelation and peak interval.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement effect, which comprises the steps of extracting phase data containing vital sign information from radar signals, carrying out multichannel average processing, extracting heartbeat signals by using a high-pass filter, detecting body movement of the heartbeat signals by using a double-energy threshold detection method, judging a body movement mode, selecting initial distribution parameters of a maximum expected algorithm, filtering movement artifacts by using the maximum expected algorithm, and obtaining heart rate of a detected target by using a fast Fourier transform spectrum analysis method. The non-contact heart rate detection framework of the MCA processing method, the APSEM method and the FFT spectrum analysis method provided by the invention realizes the inhibition of strong interference caused by body movement in the detection process, and is beneficial to obtaining accurate heart rate measurement results in the detection environment of the body movement of a detected person.

title_en: Contactless sensor circuit
title_ko: 비접촉식 센서 회로
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉식 센서 회로를 제공한다. 이 센서 회로는 측정 대상과 전기적, 물리적으로 비접촉하여 측정 대상의 전위를 측정할 수 있다. 이 센서 회로는  측정 대상과 축전 결합하는 측정 전극, 측정 전극과 직렬 연결되는 결합 축전기, 제1 음의 입력단 및 결합 축전기에 연결된 제1 양의 입력단을 포함하고 측정 신호를 제1 양의 입력단으로 입력받아 측정 신호를 증폭하여 제1 출력단으로 출력하는 제1 증폭기, 및 제1 증폭기의 제1 양의 입력단과 결합 축전기 사이에 위치한 제1 노드와 제1 증폭기의 상기 제1 출력단 사이에 연결되어 제1 증폭기의 안정적 동작을 제공하는 바이어스 회로부를 포함할 수 있다. 제1 증폭기는 자체 입력 저항(Ri) 및 자체 정전용량(Ci)를 포함하고, 결합 축전기의 결합 정전용량은 측정 대상과  측정 전극에 의하여 형성된 등가 정전 용량보다 작을 수 있다. 
       
     비접촉 센서, 전위 센서, 생체 신호 증폭기, 고입력 임피던스, 저입력 커패시턴스

title_en: Method for controlling an wearable device and the wearable device thereof
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스(wearable device)를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스가 제공된다. 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법은, 웨어러블 디바이스에 구비된 센서의 활성화 여부를 판단하는 단계와, 센서의 활성화 여부에 기초하여 센서와 착용자의 신체 간의 밀착도를 조절할 수 있는 밀착도 조절부를 제어하는 단계 및 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Vehicle occupant detection
abstract_en: A vehicle occupant detection system and method for using the same. The vehicle occupant detection system includes: a controller; a plurality of life detection sensors, wherein the plurality of life detection sensors are installed within an interior cabin of a mass-transit vehicle and are each associated with a life detection zone; a local warning system having at least one human-machine interface (HMI) output device; and a vehicle interface that communicatively couples the controller to a vehicle electrical system of the mass-transit vehicle. The vehicle occupant detection system is configured to: (i) acquire sensor data by scanning the life detection zone using the plurality of life detection sensors; (ii) determine whether an occupant is present based on the sensor data; and (iii) provide an indication to a user that an occupant is present using the HMI output device when it is determined that an occupant is present.
assignees: IEE SA;LEE INT ELECTRONICS & ENGINEERING S A

title_en: Protective clothing based on flexible sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective clothing based on flexible sensor, which comprises a coat for upper body protection, trousers for leg protection and a head cover for head and neck protection, wherein the coat, the trousers and the head cover are arranged in an integrated manner, the coat comprises two groups of sleeves for arm protection and a coat main body for chest and back protection, and the two groups of sleeves are integrally connected with the coat main body; still include the data acquisition subassembly, the data acquisition subassembly is including the flexible gas sensor that is used for gaseous composition to gather, the flexible humidity transducer that is used for air humidity to gather, the flexible temperature sensor that is used for the collection of regional interior temperature and the flexible inductance formula sensor that is used for vital sign to gather. The utility model discloses can realize carrying out data acquisition with the form of wearing to the condition of surrounding environment to can detect fire fighter's vital sign, with the condition in the fire fighter place region is known to the command center of being convenient for, the command center of being convenient for formulates the rescue scheme.

title_en: Through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar. The through-wall radar is characterized by comprising a housing, one surface of the housing is an operation surface, and the operation surface is provided with a display screen and holding portions disposed at the two sides of the display screen; and the other surface of the housing is an attachment surface attached to a wall surface, a cross-shaped groove is formed in the attachment surface, and a radar emission surface is formed at the central portion of the cross-shaped groove. The through-wall radar provided by the invention is a high-tech reconnaissance device applying an ultra-wideband radar technology, can perform accurate detection and display on position information and a movement locus of personnel existing in a certain scope in front of the radar, and is applied to the military, anti-terrorism, rescue and special forces as a special tactical tool.
assignees: SHANGHAI LIANGXIANG INTELLIGENCE ENGINEERING CO LTD;SHANGHAI ZHILIANG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD;SHANGHAI LIANGXIANG ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of low complex degree entropy extension through-wall radar imaging method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of through-wall radar imaging methods, belong to through-wall radar imaging algorithm field, this method first carries out dimension-reduction treatment to the received echo-signal matrix of bay institute, obtain the submatrix of low dimensional, then according to discrete memoryless source entropy principle, submatrix is extended respectively, utilizes the entropy thresholding different to each arranged in matrix, the influence of wall clutter is eliminated, realizes target imaging.Computation complexity can be greatly reduced in this method, reduce the memory that data occupy in algorithm.

title_en: Life detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection method and a device thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo; receiving pulses for radar in a radar echo along a slow time direction, and determining a permutation entropy PE value; determining the position of the human body object according to the PE value; vital sign signals are extracted from the radar echoes according to the position of the human subject. Therefore, the position of the human body object can be determined according to the PE value of the radar receiving pulse in the radar echo along the slow time direction, and the vital sign signal can be effectively extracted from the radar echo according to the position of the human body object.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Underwater emergency rescue navigation command system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater emergency rescue navigation command system and a method, wherein the system comprises a water area high-speed remote control mobile equipment component, a water area rapid search detection and positioning component, a water area rescue worker high-speed auxiliary power component, a water area rescue heat preservation suit, an underwater high-precision search component, an underwater search and rescue worker monitoring positioner, an underwater communication and positioning base station, an aerial video and information relay component and a water surface or ground emergency command controller; carry on waters fast search through waters high speed remote control mobile equipment subassembly and survey and locating component etc. carry out quick detection and location under water, gather the vital sign information of rescue workers and environmental information under water through waters high-speed auxiliary power subassembly of rescue workers, waters rescue thermal-insulation suit, search for and rescue personnel monitoring locator etc. under water to transmit for the controller end, rescue the condition under water through controller real time monitoring, in time adjust the rescue strategy when emergency appears and carry out high-efficient, safe rescue work of developing.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for monitoring driving state of driver
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring the driving state of a driver, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a millimeter wave radar field of view, and identifying a distance range corresponding to a detected human body target in the radar field of view; correcting direct current offset in a distance range corresponding to a human body, unlocking an arc tangent demodulation phase and extracting a differential phase signal; separating the heartbeat and the respiration of the differential phase signal and reconstructing heartbeat and respiration signals; based on the reconstructed heartbeat and respiratory signals, estimating and calculating the heartbeat and respiratory frequency by using a frequency domain FFT algorithm and a time domain autocorrelation algorithm, and further estimating the vital signs. The method is suitable for human body vital sign detection, measures vital signs to determine the health level of a person, and can be used as early warning information of potential health problems of drivers.
assignees: INTERSECT INFORMATION CORE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE XIAN CO LTD

title_en: Underground PE pipeline detection device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground PE pipeline detection device and method. The device comprises: the system comprises a main control unit and a glass fiber board, wherein a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are integrated on the glass fiber board; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna respectively comprise a pair of plane dipoles which are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the glass fiber plate; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna comprise: an antenna pole, a microstrip feed line; the external outline of the antenna pole is of an arc structure; one end of the microstrip feeder is electrically connected to the tail of the antenna pole. According to the PE pipeline detection device provided by the invention, the outer contours of the antenna poles of the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are designed into arc structures, so that the detection precision of the buried depth of an underground PE pipeline is improved; and the radar wave velocity is estimated through the radar data image, and the burial depth of the PE pipeline is calculated according to the radar wave velocity, so that the accurate measurement of the burial depth of the PE pipeline is realized.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign data monitoring method, a system and a computer readable storage medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving echo signals in a radar detection space, and screening static detected personnel from the radar detection space according to the echo signals to serve as target objects; calculating the space position information of the target object in the radar detection space according to the echo signal of the target object; judging the number of target objects equidistant to the radar according to the space position information; if at least two target objects equidistant to the radar exist in the radar detection space, calculating phase information according to azimuth angle information and pitch angle information of the target objects; and calculating vital sign data of the target object according to the phase information. The non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on the millimeter wave radar has the advantages of non-contact monitoring, strong monitoring reliability, low cost and the like.

title_en: Life-saving robot prepared for avalanches and snow storms
title_ko: 눈사태와 폭설에 대비한 재난 방제 및 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow is provided to identify the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, to send a signal to rescue workers, and then to rescue people buried in snow. CONSTITUTION: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow inhales snow through a snow sucking unit (10) and converts snow into water by a heating plate (20). The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow converts the water into vapor by an ultrasonic generator (50) for removing snow. The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow identifies the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, sends a signal to rescue workers and then rescues people buried in snow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 눈사태와 폭설 시 재난 방제 및 인명을 구조하는 로봇에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 눈을 수증기로 바꿈으로써 눈을 제거하고, 눈에 갇힌 사람의 위치를 파악함과 더불어, 구조 신호를 보내 구조대원들이 조난자를 구조할 수 있도록 메커니즘을 제공할 수 있는 눈 제거 및 인명 구조에 관한 로봇이다.

title_en: Healthcare system of vehicle and method thereof
title_ko: 차량용 헬스케어 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a healthcare device for a vehicle, through which a driver can frequently check a health condition of the driver through self-diagnosis, and to a method thereof. The healthcare device comprises: a biosignal sensing unit sensing a biosignal of a driver by using multiple bio-information sensors installed in a driver seat of a vehicle and a device operated by the driver; and an audio/video device analyzing the biosignal of the driver, obtained from the biosignal sensing unit, with a pre-installed diagnosis application to diagnose a health condition of the driver, and audiovisually expressing a diagnosis result so that the driver recognizes the result. Therefore, the driver is able to conveniently confirm the health condition of the driver in real time.
abstract_ko: 차량에 설치된 헬스케어 장비를 통해서 운전자가 수시로 자가 진단을 통해 본인의 건강 상태를 확인할 수 있도록 한 차량용 헬스케어 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 차량의 운전석 및 운전자가 운전 시 조작하는 장비에 장착된 복수의 생체정보센서를 이용하여 운전자의 생체신호를 감지하는 생체신호 감지수단; 및 상기 생체신호 감지수단에서 획득한 운전자의 생체신호를 미리 내장된 진단 애플리케이션으로 분석하여 운전자의 건강 상태를 진단하고, 그 진단 결과를 운전자가 인지할 수 있도록 시청각으로 표출해주는 오디오/비디오 장치로 차량용 헬스케어 장치를 구현함으로써, 운전자가 편리하게 실시간으로 자신의 건강 상태를 확인할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Integrated terahertz sensor
title_ko: 통합 테라헤르츠 센서
abstract_ko: 시스템 및 방법은 전자기 스펙트럼의 테라헤르츠 영역에서 동작하는 통합 소형 센서를 제공할 수 있다.  통합 소형 센서는 원격 표적을 검출하고, 비접촉, 비외과적 방식으로 동작할 수 있다.  통합 소형 센서가 생체 신호의 장기간 기록이 필요한 생명 의학, 생리학 및 기타 환경에서 사용될 때, 도플러 레이더 기술, 흡수 분광학 등과 같은 다양한 신호 분석 기술이 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic device for acquiring biosignals and operation method therefor
title_ko: 생체 신호를 획득하는 전자 장치와 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present invention comprises: a sensor module; a first electrode unit connected to a first channel of the sensor module; and a second electrode unit connected to a second channel of the sensor module, and may be configured to: measure, through the sensor module, a first impedance between the first electrode unit and a first portion of a user's body contacting the first electrode unit, and a second impedance between the second electrode unit and a second portion of the user's body contacting the second electrode unit; adjust, through the sensor module, an impedance corresponding to each of the first channel and the second channel on the basis of the first impedance and the second impedance so that a difference between the first impedance and the second impedance is within a specified range; and obtain the user's biosignals through the sensor module while the impedance of the first channel and the second channel are adjusted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 센서 모듈, 상기 센서 모듈의 제1채널과 연결된 제1전극부, 상기 센서 모듈의 제2채널과 연결된 제2전극부, 및 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1전극부와 상기 제1전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제1부분 사이의 제1임피던스와, 상기 제2전극부와 상기 제2전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제2부분 사이의 제2임피던스를 측정하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1임피던스와 상기 제2임피던스에 기초하여 상기 제1임피던스 및 상기 제2임피던스의 차이가 지정된 범위를 만족하도록 상기 제1채널과 상기 제2채널 각각에 대응하는 임피던스를 조절하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1채널 및 상기 제2채널의 임피던스가 조절된 상태에서, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 획득하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: System for detecting and preventing school accidents using radar for biometric signal analysis and operating method thereof
title_ko: 생체신호 분석용 레이더를 이용한 학교내 사고 감지 및 예방 시스템 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system for detecting and preventing school accidents, and the system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise: a first radar unit that extracts and detects a biometric signal from a surrounding area by using a radar signal and transmits the biometric signal and first location information associated with the biometric signal; a school safety server that receives and analyzes the biometric signal, determines, on the basis of the analysis, whether an abnormal situation has occurred, when the abnormal situation has occurred, determines an incident type of the abnormal situation, and generates, on the basis of the determination, an incident occurrence signal including the first location information and transmits same; and an imaging unit that is movably installed, upon receiving the incident occurrence signal, moves to a first location corresponding to the first location information, and generates image data in which the abnormal situation is recorded and transmits same to the school safety server.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 학교내 사고 감지 및 예방 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 시스템은, 레이더 신호를 이용하여 주변 영역에서 생체신호를 추출하여 감지하고, 상기 생체신호와 연관된 제1 위치정보 및 상기 생체신호를 전송하는 제1 레이더부, 상기 생체신호를 수신하여 분석하고, 이에 기초하여 이상사태의 발생여부를 판단하고, 이상사태가 발생한 경우, 상기 이상사태의 사건유형을 판단하고, 이에 기초하여 상기 제1 위치정보를 포함하는 사건발생신호를 생성하고 전송하는 교내안전서버, 및 이동 가능하도록 설치되고, 상기 사건발생신호를 수신하면 상기 제1 위치정보에 해당하는 제1 위치로 이동하고, 상기 이상사태를 기록한 화상데이터를 생성하여 상기 교내안전서버로 전송하는 촬영부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Robotic sense-through-wall sensor with simplified control interface
abstract_en: A system includes a self-propelled robotic vehicle carrying an UWB sensor. The UWB sensor responds to binary transitions of a mode control signal to select for its modes of operation.

title_en: Smart home device using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring for contactless human interactions and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. Radar chirps may be output by a radar sensor operating in a burst mode. The burst mode radar data stream may be monitored for a contactless human interaction performed by an active user. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. Health monitoring of an inactive user may be performed using the virtual continuous mode radar data stream.

title_en: Multi-feature fusion fatigue monitoring and identifying method for pole climbing operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fatigue monitoring and identifying method for multi-feature fusion of pole climbing operation, which comprises the steps of arranging hardware facilities in a power dispatching center, collecting human body infrared videos, sending human body infrared video data to a background server in real time, analyzing and cutting the human body infrared video data into single-frame pictures, inputting the single-frame pictures into a trained deep learning model, outputting an action prediction result, detecting a respiration index and a heart rate index through a vital sign monitoring module based on a UWB radar to obtain the respiration index and heart rate index results, performing feature index fusion by adopting an LVQ-BP artificial neural network to form a comprehensive fatigue index, and judging whether a human body is in a fatigue state or not according to the comprehensive fatigue index.

title_en: Processing method of ultra wideband UWB life signal
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method and device of an ultra-wideband UWB life signal, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Collecting a plurality of echo signals corresponding to an ultra wideband UWB life signal to obtain a first echo signal matrix composed of the echo signals, obtaining a second echo signal matrix after clutter pretreatment of the first echo signal matrix, performing singular value decomposition to obtain a plurality of singular values corresponding to the second echo signal matrix, screening the singular values and important terms to obtain a plurality of main singular values, generating a third echo signal matrix corresponding to the main singular values, performing signal decomposition to obtain an inherent mode component matrix corresponding to the third echo signal matrix, and reconstructing a target ultra wideband UWB life signal according to the inherent mode component matrix, thereby accurately determining the target ultra wideband UWB life signal based on decomposition reconstruction processing of the ultra wideband UWB life signal, and improving the processing precision of the ultra wideband UWB life signal.

title_en: Intelligent super-surface-assisted non-line-of-sight human vital sign sensing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent super-surface-assisted non-line-of-sight human vital sign sensing system and method, which are characterized in that a deep learning model Yolo-v7 is combined to position a human body target, and the propagation path of a sensing signal is changed through intelligent super-surface coding optimization, so that human vital sign sensing under a non-line-of-sight scene is realized. Aiming at the limitation of the traditional variational modal decomposition algorithm in human vital sign perception, the invention further provides an improved variational modal decomposition algorithm based on filtering, which is used for extracting human respiration and heartbeat echo signals and realizing accurate estimation of respiration rate and heart rate. The invention is different from the human body sensing technology based on the through-wall radar, and utilizes the flexible regulation and control capability of the electromagnetic wave of the super surface to change the propagation path of the sensing signal, thereby customizing the sensing environment between the wireless signal transceivers, opening up a new application environment and scene for the non-contact vital sign sensing based on the wireless signal, thereby improving the universality of the vital sign wireless sensing technology and promoting the further development and landing of the vital sign wireless sensing technology.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar and camera fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and provides a vital sign detection method based on fusion of a millimeter wave radar and a camera, which comprises the steps of detecting the gesture based on a human body image of a target person to obtain a chest area of the target person, and performing frequency analysis on a millimeter wave radar signal to obtain a distance angle heat map; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a chest area, carrying out human body positioning based on the chest area and a distance angle heat map to obtain a human body position, carrying out phase extraction on millimeter wave radar signals based on the human body position to obtain vital sign signals of target personnel, carrying out variation modal decomposition on the vital sign signals to obtain vital sign parameters of the target personnel, overcoming the defects that the current detection is easily influenced by the skin state of the human body, the detection result is inaccurate, and limitations exist on special crowd, continuous monitoring and remote monitoring, realizing non-invasive detection, ensuring that the detection result is more accurate and reliable, being more beneficial to the special crowd, and providing support for home medical treatment and remote health monitoring.

title_en: Bio-signal measurement system unified toilet stool
title_ko: 원격 건강관리를 위한 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 건강관리를 위한 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는 변기와 발판에 장착되어 체중, 혈압, 심전도, 체임피던스, 혈중산소포화도를 측정하며 이 측정된 데이터들을 사용자별로 관리가능하며 원격전송할 수 있는 생체신호획득 장치에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명의 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치는 그 밑면에 4개이상의 체중 측정 센서가 장착되어 발판측정 체중을 검출하는 발판부(100); 그 아랫면에 4개 이상의 체중측정센서가 장착되어 변좌측정 체중을 검출하며, 그 윗면에 양쪽 허벅지 닿는 부분에 허벅지 심전도 전극들 및 허벅지 체임피던스 측정전극들이 장착되어 있는 변좌부; 그 상면 일단부에 손가락 삽입형측정기(305)가 장착되어 있으며. 그 상면의 팔목이 닿는 부분에 팔목 심전도 전극 및 팔목 체임피던스 측정전극이 장착되어 있는 상완거치부;를 구비한다. 
     또한 본 발명은 개인 식별자카드를 읽어들여 인식하는 카드 인식부(390)를 더 구비하며, 상기 허벅지 심전도 전극들과 상기 팔목 심전도 전극을 이용하여 심전도를 측정하며, 상기 허벅지 체임피던스 측정전극들과 상기 팔목 체임피던스 측정전극를 이용하여 체임피던스(체지방)을 측정한다. 
       
      심전도, 체임피던스, 체지방, 혈압, 산소포화도, 개인 식별자카드, 무선전송

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치된 호흡 센서를 통해 사용자의 호흡 상태에 맞게 공기의 유동을 조절할 수 있으며,자동식 호흡 감지 기반 FAN 동작으로써 정압식 방식에 비해 고객의 호흡을 편안하게 해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, the RF tags respectively generating incident RF signals with different predetermined frequencies, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one RF radar that demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital sign of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to associated frequency of the reflected RF signal.

title_en: Concurrent monitoring of indoor oxygen concentration levels and human vital signs with mmWave radar sensors
abstract_en: Technologies directed to are monitoring human vital signs with mmWave radars are described. One method sends a first signal having a first chirp that is a triangular-type chirp that increases in frequency for a first period and decreases in frequency for a second period and a second chirp that is a ramp-type chirp that increases in frequency for a third period. The method receives a second signal corresponding to the first signal. The method generates, using the first chirp and a first portion of the second signal, a third signal indicative of a human vital sign, such as a heart rate or a respiratory rate. The method measures a received signal strength indicator (RSSI) value of a second portion of the second signal at approximately 60 GHz. The method determines, using the RSSI value, a value indicative of oxygen-concentration in an ambient environment of the monitoring device.

Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: System and method for ground penetrating radar communication using antenna crosstalk
abstract_en: An object detection system ( 24 ) is disclosed having a transducer ( 40, 40 ′) for detecting buried objects ( 26 ). The transducer is encapsulated within a robust, electromagnetically transparent construction ( 42 ).
assignees: SIMICEVIC NEVEN;JAGANATHAN ARUN;MONTGOMERY JAMES L;OLSON JAY H;DEERE & CO;LOUISIANA TECH UNIV RES FOUND A DIV OF LOUISIANA TECH UNIV FOUND INC

title_en: Near-field coherent sensing methods and systems
abstract_en: Near-field coherent sensing (NCS) methods and systems are described herein. The techniques may be used to monitor vital signs is introduced herein. Multiple-input, multiple output near-field techniques may be used to characterize motion. In some embodiments, the methods and systems are used to measure cardiac motion. In some embodiments, the disclosed system is integrated into a seat, such as, for example, a car seat. The system be configured to monitor the vital signs of a seat occupant with multiple sensing points. The sensor can be integrated into the cushion and hence “invisible” to the user.

title_en: Beidou system-based transmission line geological disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: Provided in the utility model is a Beidou system-based transmission line geological disaster monitoring system comprising a sensor, a collection box, a camera, and an elevated tower. To be specific, the sensor buried under the ground monitors data of geological changes in real time; the collector box installed at the elevated tower receives the data collected by the sensor; and the camera arranged at the elevated tower can rotate automatically in a 360-degree range and is provided with a video sensor. According to the technical scheme, all-weather, full-automatic, high-precision, real-time monitoring of geological disasters like a regional transmission line corridor debris flow source and surface displacement and the like as well as secure and reliable collection and transmission of monitoring data can be realized; and a fault spot can be determined based on the analysis on the collected data.
assignees: XI AN TONGKAI ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of new life detection intercom
abstract_en: Connect and put device, main frame the utility model discloses a kind of new life detection intercom, including azimuth indicator, connection handle, holding pad, radarscope, regulation turn-button, indicator lamp, radar detedtor, control panel, audio；The main frame top is provided with regulation turn-button, and main frame surface connection control panel, the upper right side connection indicator lamp of control panel is equipped with radarscope in the middle of control panel.The utility model be provided with hold pad can mitigate when user uses the intercommunication machine equipment firmly, enhance frictional force, allow what it can more consolidate to catch, and more comfortable.

title_en: Physical test device for simulating sandy soil debris flow
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a physical test device for simulating sandy soil mud-rock flow relates to geological experiment technical field, and its technical scheme main points are: the rainfall simulation system comprises a transparent model box, a rainfall simulation device and a data acquisition system; a sandy soil model is laid in the transparent model box; a plurality of sensor devices are buried in the sandy soil model; the rainfall simulation device comprises a water inlet tank, a water guide pipe and a nozzle; the data acquisition system consists of a high-definition camera, a three-dimensional microscopic device, a dynamic strain acquisition system connected with the sensor device and a computer device; the high-definition camera, the stereo microscope and the dynamic strain acquisition system are connected with the computer equipment. The test device can be used for finely and visually acquiring the occurrence and development processes of the sand-soil debris flow, and obtaining the debris flow starting characteristics, the displacement field evolution process and the damage form through analysis, so that the complicated inducing mechanism of the debris flow can be conveniently and deeply explored, and technical support and theoretical basis can be provided for effective prevention and treatment engineering measures.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses non-contact vital sign detection equipment, relates to the technical field of vital sign detection equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the non-contact radar vital sign detection equipment in the prior art is inconvenient to carry due to the use scene problem. The fixing base is installed to radar life detection instrument's below, and fixing base and radar life detection instrument fixed connection, be provided with the shrink seat on the preceding terminal surface of fixing base, and shrink seat and fixing base sliding connection, the hand pull is installed to one side of shrink seat, and hand pull and shrink seat fixed connection, install the wheel seat on radar life detection instrument's the rear end face, and wheel seat and radar life detection instrument fixed connection, the inboard of wheel seat is provided with the wheel, the top of fixing base is provided with the interlock leg, and fixing base and interlock leg set up structure as an organic whole, the interlock leg is connected with radar life detection instrument interlock.
assignees: NANJING JINGYI SECURITY SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-driven landslide pore water pressure sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-driven landslide pore water pressure sensor, which relates to the technical field of mechanical instruments and comprises a shell and at least one detection probe arranged in the shell, wherein the detection probe comprises a tray, a slide bar, a plurality of nano friction rings, metal friction rings and an elastic piece, the tray is slidably arranged on the surface of the shell, one end of the slide bar is connected with the tray, the other end of the slide bar is connected with the elastic piece, the other end of the elastic piece is fixedly arranged, each nano friction ring is sleeved on the slide bar at intervals, and the metal friction ring is fixedly arranged on the periphery of one nano friction ring. The utility model has the advantages that the nano friction rings can be directly buried in soil, when pore water pressure acts on the detection probe, the tray is extruded to slide towards the inside of the shell to drive the slide bars to slide so as to enable the nano friction rings to move, and then the nano friction rings are contacted with the metal friction rings and are rubbed to generate electricity, and the change of charges can be used as a detection signal of the pore water pressure, so that the pore water pressure can be accurately calculated.
assignees: HUBEI PROVINCIAL COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Wall parameter estimation method of through-wall imaging radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall parameter estimation method of a through-wall imaging radar. The wall parameter estimation method includes steps of (1) estimating the variation range of the relative dielectric constant and the thickness of the wall, and selecting the minimum value as initial parameter value; (2) calculating the distance between the radar and the wall, and setting an imaging area behind the wall; (3) compensating the effect of the wall in imaging by parameters obtained in the step (1) to obtain aperture range data; (4) calculating GCF value of each imaging point along the aperture range data; (5) searching the maximum value of the GCF values of all imaging points as a target GCF value; (6) sequentially increasing the relative dielectric constant and the thickness of the wall sequentially and repeating the above steps to obtain a target GCF value for each pair of wall parameters; (7) searching the maximum value in all the target GCF values and using the corresponding wall parameters as estimation results. The wall parameter estimation method has the advantages that wall parameters are accurately estimated, the effects of the wall in the through-wall imaging can be effectively compensated, and focusing effect of target imaging is improved.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic portable clinometer
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic portable clinometer. The automatic portable clinometer is characterized by comprising a sensor probe, a cable, a positioning hole cover, a wire spool and an equipment terminal, wherein the sensor probe is connected with one end of the cable and the other end of the cable is connected with the wire spool; the positioning hole cover is arranged at the upper end part of the clinometer and is used for positioning the cable; the clinometer adopts a brand-new data acquisition manner and measurement software so that the function is more intelligent and complete, and automatic measurement of inclined deformation of a pre-buried clinometer pipe is realized; and meanwhile, the novel cable and the positioning hole cover are introduced so that the labor intensity of workers is alleviated, the measurement precision is improved and the automatic portable clinometer can be widely applied to monitoring of deformation of a slippage surface in a soil body of landslides, embanks, water dams and deep pits and at the periphery of a tunnel.
assignees: NANJING NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: A kind of life-detection system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to unmanned plane applied technical field; specifically provide by radar life-detection instrument of the carry on unmanned plane to detect life-information after calamity, be made up of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, GPS module, protective cradle, radar life-detection instrument, antenna, unmanned controller, posture display, Minitype hand-held computer controller.Solve the problems, such as in rescue and relief work that artificial detection efficient is low, danger zone rescue personnel is unable to reach, there is the advantages of convenient, efficient, accurate.
