assignees: MENGCHENG COUNTY YONGTENG HUIHANGZHANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact detection and monitoring system for vital signs of vehicle occupants
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detecting vital signs of an occupant in a vehicle, such as a vehicle cabin, are disclosed. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receives a radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to the vibration data of the vehicle to generate a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine a vital sign of the occupant.

title_en: Self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method for intelligent cabin of automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method for an intelligent cabin of an automobile, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: detecting a human body target in the vehicle by the vehicle-mounted millimeter wave radar; detecting the position of a human body target; extracting the phase of the echo of the human body target; separating heartbeat signals and respiration signals in the echo of the human target; directly performing frequency estimation on the separated respiratory signals; and for the heartbeat signals, after eliminating interference by using a self-adaptive cancellation method, carrying out frequency estimation. Under the vehicle-mounted environment, the invention can realize the non-contact monitoring of the health state of the driver, including the measurement of the breathing and heartbeat frequency. The invention can eliminate the interference caused by the vibration of the vehicle body and the environmental noise and reduce the measurement error of the breathing and heartbeat frequency by the thought of self-adaptive filtering facing the application background of the intelligent cabin.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIHE HUOBAN INTELLIGENT DRIVING CO LTD

title_en: Human vital sign monitoring method oriented to sports scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a human vital sign monitoring method oriented to a motion scene, which is characterized in that a radar reflected signal reflected by a human body is received, the radar reflected signal and a radar transmitted signal are subjected to frequency mixing treatment to obtain an original intermediate frequency signal, then the original intermediate frequency signal is subjected to Fourier transformation to construct characteristic spectrum data, a sliding window sampling method is adopted for the generated characteristic spectrum map, the characteristic spectrum map is intercepted according to a preset window length and a step length, and the characteristic spectrum map is input into a trained classifier network model to identify a motion state or a non-motion state and a motion type in the motion state. And monitoring the breathing or heartbeat frequency during the exercise time in a non-exercise state. The application monitors vital sign information of human body by utilizing millimeter wave radar, and has the advantages of low illumination dependency, good privacy protection, high monitoring sensitivity, no contact and the like.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning calling integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses mountain torrent disaster early warning and calling integrated equipment, which comprises a monitoring station point arranged beside a river course, wherein the monitoring station point comprises a mounting frame which is pre-buried and arranged beside the river course, a rain gauge arranged on the mounting frame and a plurality of ultrasonic velocimeters for measuring water flow rate, the side surface of the rain gauge is fixedly connected with an ultrasonic water level gauge for measuring water level height, the side surface of the ultrasonic water level gauge is fixedly connected with a monitoring device, and the top of the ultrasonic water level gauge is fixedly connected with a water drop sensor. This mountain torrent calamity early warning calls integration equipment through set up the edulcoration cover at the rain gauge top, and its partly comprises fixed rack, and partly comprises a plurality of rotatable edulcoration poles to a plurality of edulcoration poles can link to rotate, can directly outwards release impurity such as the leaf that falls on the edulcoration cover in the rotation in-process, has realized automatic clearance, can avoid the leaf to cover the problem that influences the collection rain and cause the jam.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCIAL ACADEMY OF WATER RESOURCES JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER R

title_en: Vital sign data acquisition and processing management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign data acquisition and processing management system, which belongs to the technical field of vital sign data management and monitoring, and particularly relates to a vital sign data acquisition and processing management system, comprising a cloud end unit, wherein a millimeter wave radar sensing unit is connected with the cloud end unit, a multi-band millimeter wave radar array and an adaptive beam forming technology are adopted to realize vital sign monitoring with high precision, long distance and dynamic tracking, a signal processing unit is connected with the cloud end unit, adaptive noise filtering, anomaly detection and data enhancement are carried out on first data information, the edge computing unit is connected with the millimeter wave radar sensing unit, the vital sign monitoring of high-precision, long-distance and dynamic tracking is realized by adopting the multi-band millimeter wave radar array and the self-adaptive beam forming technology, and based on the edge computing technology, the data acquired by the radar are processed in real time, which is equivalent to the built-in microprocessor of each node, the data are automatically judged after being processed and integrated, and then the data information is uploaded, so that the delay is reduced and the real-time response capability is enhanced.
assignees: JIANGXI UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Blood Pressure Meter And Method For Measuring Blood Pressure Using The Same
title_ko: 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a blood pressure measurement system which calculates a blood pressure value by using biological signals measured at two different parts, and a blood pressure measurement method using the same. According to the present invention, the blood pressure measurement system comprises: a first sensor unit detecting a blood flow parameter in one part of a body; a second sensor unit detecting a blood flow parameter and arterial pressure in the other part of the body; and a control unit having a blood pressure calculation unit for calculating a blood pressure value of a part in which a first blood flow parameter is detected from the first blood flow parameter detected by the first sensor unit, a second blood flow parameter detected by the second sensor unit, and the arterial pressure. The blood pressure measurement system measures blood pressure using changes in vascular resistivity and blood pressure parameters. More specifically, the blood pressure measurement system is a sphygmomanometer which calculates the blood pressure by using the blood flow parameter detected in one part of the body, the arterial pressure detected in other part of the body, and the vascular resistivity by the blood flow parameter, thereby more accurately measuring the blood pressure of a part desired to obtain the blood pressure based on an amount of changes in the blood flow parameter and the vascular resistivity, and greatly improving reliability of the sphygmomanometer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서로 다른 2 부위에서 측정되는 생체 신호를 이용해서 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 혈압 측정 시스템은: 신체의 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터의 검출을 위한 제1센서부; 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터와 동맥압 측정의 검출을 위한 제2센서부; 그리고 상기 제1센서부에 의해 검출되는 제1 혈류 파라미터와 상기 제2센서부에 의해 검출되는 제2 혈류 파라미터 및 동맥압으로부터, 상기 제1 혈류 파라미터가 검출되는 부위의 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 산출부를 갖는 제어유닛을 포함한다. 
본 발명은 혈관 저항률과 혈압 파라미터의 변화를 이용해서 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정 시스템, 보다 구체적으로 신체의 일 부위에서 검출되는 혈류 파라미터와 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 검출되는 동맥압과 혈류 파라미터에 의한 혈관 저항률을 이용해서 혈압을 계산하는 혈압계이므로, 혈류 파라미터 변화량과 혈관 저항률을 기반으로 혈압 획득을 원하는 부위의 혈압을 보다 정확하게 측정할 수 있고, 혈압계의 신뢰도가 크게 향상될 수 있다.

title_en: Sleep capsule
title_ko: 수면 캡슐
abstract_en: A sleep capsule according to one aspect of the present disclosure comprises: a mattress; a base supporting the mattress; a cover coupled with the base to form an internal space; a mattress air pressure control unit which adjusts the air pressure of an air area formed inside the mattress; and a sensor unit including one or more sensors that detect biometric signals of a user lying on the mattress, wherein the mattress air pressure control unit adjusts the air pressure of the air area based on the biometric signals detected by the sensor unit. According to the present invention, the comfortable sensation can be increased by utilizing a plurality of cooling and heating means.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 측면에 따른 수면 캡슐은, 매트리스, 상기 매트리스를 지지하는 베이스(base), 상기 베이스와 결합되어 내부 공간을 형성하는 커버(cover), 상기 매트리스의 내부에 형성된 에어(air) 영역의 공기압을 조절하는 매트리스 공기압조절부, 및, 상기 매트리스에 누워 있는 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 하나 이상의 센서를 포함하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 매트리스 공기압조절부는, 상기 센서부에서 감지되는 생체신호에 기초하여, 상기 에어 영역의 공기압을 조절한다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Earthquake underground fluid inspection well and system and method used earthquake underground fluid inspection well to detect seismic precursor abnormal information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake underground fluid inspection well and a system and a method used the earthquake underground fluid inspection well to detect seismic precursor abnormal information of gap pressure diffusion coefficients, which relate to earth physics and quakeproof disaster reduction technology. The earthquake underground fluid inspection well is arranged vertical to the direction of strata, a corrosion resisting seal stainless steel sleeve is installed in the center of the inspection well in the middle, cement is used at the bottom and the top of the inspection well for fixing a sleeve, a stainless steel clamp is adopted to fix the sleeve at the position of the axial center of the stainless steel sleeve additionally, multimode fibers are buried in a gap between the sleeve and the well wall, ore particles are filled in the gap between the sleeve and the well wall, so that an even gap medium layer is formed. A special high-resolution-ratio fiber sensor collects gas pressure dynamic response signals stimulated by earthquake cutting waves, a data analyzing system is integrated through a maximum likelihood deconvolution space-time conservation method and a weight integral method chips, characteristic scale of the dynamic gap pressure diffusion coefficients related to the cutting waves is obtained through calculation, an earthquake source generated the earthquake cutting waves is  carried out high-precision earthquake location, scientific decision-making data with earthquake source physical significances are provided to seismic prediction. The obtaining method of the characteristic scale of the dynamic gap pressure diffusion coefficients can be used for well wall fracture monitor of oil exploitation wells and carbon dioxide geology seal injection wells.
assignees: INST CRUSTAL DYNAMICS CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Treadmill and non-contact sensing method on treadmill
abstract_en: A treadmill and a method of non-contact sensing on a treadmill are disclosed. This treadmill includes: running the belt; a display; a first sensor having first transmit circuitry for transmitting a first radar beam over the treadmill and first receive circuitry for detecting a first reflected signal as a reflection of the first radar beam from a user on the treadmill; a processor connected to the first sensor, the treadbelt, and the display; and a non-transitory computer readable storage medium storing a program to be executed by the processor. The program includes instructions for: first data associated with a vital sign of the user is determined from the first reflected signal, and the vital sign is displayed on the display according to the first data.

title_en: Intelligent alarm method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent alarm method and an intelligent alarm device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining target vital sign data of a target object, determining a body state of the target object based on the target vital sign data, determining alarm parameters based on the body state of the target object, determining the position of the target object through the UWB module when the body state of the target object is in an abnormal state, sending alarm information to target equipment when the duration of the abnormal state of the body state of the target object is longer than or equal to a preset duration, and controlling an alarm module to alarm based on the alarm parameters, wherein the alarm information carries the target vital sign data and the position. The method can realize the positioning and alarming of the target object when the body state of the target object is abnormal, thereby reducing the loss and casualties caused by accidents.

title_en: Underground pipeline buried depth estimation method based on ground penetrating radar and three-dimensional velocity spectrum
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground pipeline buried depth estimation method based on a ground penetrating radar and a three-dimensional velocity spectrum, which adopts the ground penetrating radar and the three-dimensional velocity spectrum to estimate the buried depth of an underground pipeline, can automatically and accurately obtain the propagation speed of electromagnetic waves of the ground penetrating radar in a soil medium above the underground pipeline, and is further applied to back propagation offset imaging to realize accurate estimation of buried depths of various underground pipelines. The invention solves the problem that the detection of the urban underground pipeline by adopting the traditional special pipeline detection instrument can only detect the metal pipeline.

title_en: Walking state vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring vital signs in a walking state, and relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of determining an anchor distance gate according to the first K frames in N frames of FMCW radar echo signals, and respectively executing processing steps on each frame of FMCW radar echo signals after the K frames to obtain a plurality of third signals and a plurality of target distance gates, further determining a plurality of second signals, further determining respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency, and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to an upper computer to monitor vital signs of a human body. The processing steps comprise updating the anchor range gate according to the target range gate corresponding to the last frame of the FMCW radar echo signal of the current frame, determining the target range gate according to the plurality of first signals and the anchor range gate, and determining the third signal according to the plurality of first signals and the target range gate. The method and the device can solve the problem that vital signs of a human body in a walking state are difficult to accurately monitor, enlarge the applicable scene of vital sign monitoring, and improve the accuracy of vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Connection structure of the electric cable
title_ko: 지중배전용 전선보호관 이음구조
abstract_en: A connection structure of a wire protection tube for an underground distribution line is provided to prevent the fire from spreading along an underground pipe by cutting off electrical connection of a switchboard when the firs occurs in the switchboard or a switchboard case due to an electric leakage or arson. A switchboard case(10) is installed on the ground. A switchboard(20) is installed in the switchboard case. An underground pipe(30) made of an insulation material is buried under the ground and is connected to the bottom of the switchboard. A switchboard power supply line(40) is composed of an active wire and a neutral wire and is arranged inside the underground pipe. An external power supply line(50) is composed of the active wire and the neutral wire and is installed in the underground pipe. A connection unit(60) electrically interconnects the active wires of the switchboard power supply line and the external power supply line or the neutral wires of the switchboard power supply line and the external power supply line. A disconnection unit(70) includes a striking part of the fire retarding material which seals the underground pipe and is installed in a piston. A fire sensor(80) is installed at the switchboard case and senses the fire of the switchboard. A control unit(90) receives the fire signal from the fire sensor and controls the drive motor of the disconnection unit. An alarm unit(100) is controlled by the control unit and outputs the fire state to the outside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중배전용 전선보호관 이음구조에 관한 것으로, 지면에 설치되는 배전반케이스(10)와; 배전반케이스(10)에 내설되는 배전반(20)과; 지중에 매설되어, 배전반케이스(10)의 저면에 연통되는 절연재질의 지중배관(30)과; 활선(41)과 중성선(42)으로 구성되어, 지중배관(30) 내부에 배치되는 배전반전력공급선(40)과; 활선(51)과 중성선(52)으로 구성되어, 지중배관(30)에 내설되는 외부전력공급선(50)과; 중심부에 절개홈(61)을 갖추고서, 배전반전력공급선(40)을 구성하는 활선(41)과 외부전력공급선을 구성하는 활선(51)을 전기적으로 상호연결하거나, 배전반전력공급선(40)을 구성하는 중성선(42)과 외부전력공급선을 구성하는 중성선(42)을 전기적으로 상호연결하는 "一" 자 형태의 연결대(60)와; 지중배관(30)의 외면에 설치되어, 지중에 매설되는 케이스(71)와, 지중배관(30)의 축 방향과 90도로 교차하는 방향으로 직선왕복이동가능하게 내설되는 피스톤(72)과, 피스톤(72)에 설치되어 연결대(60)를 절단하면서 지중배관(30)을 밀폐하는 난연재의 타격부(73)와, 케이스(71)에 내설되어 피스톤(72)을 일방향으로 탄발지지하는 스프링(74)과, 와이어(W)를 매개로 피스톤(72)에 연결되는 권취드럼(75a)과 권취드럼(75a)을 구동하는 구동모터(75b)를 갖추고서 케이스(71)에 설치되어 피스톤(72)의 동작을 제어하는 권취기구(75)를 포함하는 차단기구(70)와; 배전반케이스(10)에 설치되어, 배전반(20)의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서(80)와; 화재감지센서(80)로부터의 화재신호를 입력받아 차단기구(70)의 구동모터(75b)를 작동제어하는 제어유닛(90)과; 제어유닛(90)에 의해 작동제어되어 화재상태를 외부로 출력하는 경보장치(100)로 이루어져, 지중배관을 따라 불길이 번져가지 않으며, 화재의 발생을 관리자가 즉각 알 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A bicycle generating electric power using piezoelectric element
title_ko: 압전소자를 이용하여 전력을 생산하는 자전거
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bicycle, comprising: a chain ring connected to a crank fastened to a pedal, and having a piezoelectric element at a portion engaged with a chain; a battery for storing electric power produced from the piezoelectric element; a handle having a biometric signal sensor for measuring electrical conductivity and a heart rate; a biometric signal information transmission device for transmitting the biometric signal information collected from the biometric signal sensor to a user terminal; a lighting device; an illuminance detecting device for detecting an external illuminance; and an electric power supply control device preferentially supplying the electric power stored in the battery to the lighting device in accordance with the external illuminance detected by the illuminance detecting device.
abstract_ko: 페달이 체결되는 크랭크와 연결되고, 체인과 맞물리는 부분에 압전소자를 구비한 체인링; 상기 압전소자로부터 생산된 전력을 저장하는 축전지; 전기전도도 및 심박수를 측정하는 생체신호 센서가 구비된 손잡이; 상기 생체신호 센서로부터 수집된 생체신호 정보를 사용자 단말로 전송하는 생체신호 정보 전송 장치; 조명 장치; 외부의 조도를 감지하는 조도 감지 장치; 상기 축전지에 저장된 전력을 상기 조도 감지 장치에 의해 감지된 외부 조도에 따라 상기 조명 장치에 우선적으로 제공하는 전력공급 제어장치를 포함하는 자전거가 개시된다.

title_en: Underground facilities detection system using gpr
title_ko: 지피알 시스템을 이용한 지하시설물 탐지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility detection system, and more specifically, to an underground facility detection system using a ground penetrating radar (GPR) system, which is characterized by comprising: a control device generating a transceiving pulse and storing a received signal; a transmitting antenna radiating the pulse generated in the control device; a receiving antenna receiving the signal which is returned after the radiated pulse is reflected by a buried object after passing through a medium; a display unit embodying the signal acquired from the control device as an image; and a cart on which the control device, the transmitting antenna, the receiving antenna and the display unit are mounted. Therefore, an underground facility detection method is established to improve performance. Furthermore, the present invention is miniaturized and integrated to improve work efficiency and reduce fabrication costs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 탐지시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 송수신 펄스를 발생시키고 수신된 신호를 저장하는 제어장치, 상기 제어장치에서 발생한 펄스를 방사시키는 송신 안테나, 방사된 펄스가 매질을 통과한 후 매설물체에서 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 수신하는 수신 안테나, 상기 제어장치에서 획득한 신호를 영상으로 구현하는 디스플레이부 및 상기 제어장치, 송신 안테나, 수신 안테나 및 디스플레이부가 탑재되는 카트를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 지하시설물 탐측기법을 확립하여 성능을 향상시키고, 소형 일체화를 통해 작업 효율을 향상시킴과 동시에 원가를 절감할 수 있는 지피알 시스템을 이용한 지하시설물 탐지시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Buffer type ground transformer with electric power equipment installed
title_ko: 전력설비가 부설된 완충형 지상변압기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a buffer type ground transformer with electric power equipment installed therein. The buffer type ground transformer comprises: a body for accommodating a transformer unit connected to a high-voltage cable and a low-voltage cable buried in the ground; a plurality of support springs for distancing the body from the ground and absorbing shocks applied thereto from the outside; a power supply built in the body, connected to the transformer unit, and for providing power; an optical sensor disposed on the body to detect ambient brightness; a rain sensor disposed on the body to detect rainwater when it rains; a controller for receiving detection information from the optical sensor and the rain sensor and outputting a control signal; and a retractable streetlight waiting in a concealed state inside the body and operating under the control of the controller to output light while being exposed to an upper part of the body. Therefore, the buffer type ground transformer can perform the basic functions and have a self-operating streetlight or an emergency charging means, thereby serving as a facility that is useful in real life, not an inconvenient facility that hinders traffic. In addition, the buffer type ground transformer can have a buffering capacity to prevent damage caused by external shocks such as vehicle collisions or earthquakes, thereby being stably used.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전력설비가 부설된 완충형 지상변압기에 관한 것이다. 이는, 지중에 매설된 고압케이블 및 저압케이블과 각각 접속된 변압유니트를 수용하는 본체와; 상기 본체를 지면으로부터 이격시키고, 외부로부터 가해지는 충격을 흡수하는 다수의 받침스프링과; 상기 본체에 내장된 상태로 변압유니트에 접속되고 전력을 제공하는 전원과; 본체의 상부에 배치되며 주변 밝기를 감지하는 광센서와; 본체의 상부에 배치되고 강우 시 빗물을 감지하는 레인센서와; 상기 광센서 및 레인센서로부터 감지정보를 전달받아 제어신호를 출력하는 제어기와; 상기 본체의 내부에 은폐된 상태로 대기하며, 제어기의 제어에 의해 동작하여 본체 상부로 노출된 상태로 조명을 출력하는 출몰형가로등을 구비한다. 
상기와 같이 이루어지는 본 발명의 전력설비가 부설된 완충형 지상변압기는, 변압기의 기본 기능을 수행함은 물론, 스스로 작동하는 가로등이나 비상용 충전수단을 가져, 통행에 방해를 주는 불편 시설물이 아닌 실생활에 도움을 시설물의 역할을 한다. 또한, 완충능력을 가져 차량의 충돌이나 지진과 같은 외부 충격에 의한 손상이 없어 안정적인 사용이 가능하다.

title_en: Health management
abstract_en: A method includes capturing continuously vital signs and motion data from one or more sensors adapted to be coupled to a user; capturing food consumption of the user; predicting a predetermined health condition of the user based on the vital signs; generating a plan for the predetermined health condition; and prompting the user to execute the plan with a closed-loop feedback based on sensor data.

title_en: Multichannel UWB-based radar life detector and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: A multichannel UWB-based radar life detector includes a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas for forming three radar echo signal channels. A 2-dimensional positioning method thereof includes: a1) amplifying weak life signals of stationary human by the channels, providing an 8-point integration method with an interval of 4 points to radar echo signals by distance; then breaking the integrated signals for decomposition and reconstruction in such a manner that target echo signals and three distance signals are formed; providing digital filtering and differential to the target echo signals for amplifying the weak but useful life signals; a2) 1-dimensionally distinguishing the signals by distance, analyzing spatial frequency according to the filtered and differentiated target echo signals as well as the distance signals for obtaining three target projection signals in the three channels; and a3) identifying the 2-dimensional position information of the targets according to the projection signals, forming an image.
assignees: WANG JIANQI;JING XIJING;ZHANG YANG;LU HAO;LI YANFENG;LI ZHAO;JIAO TENG;YU XIAO;CHINESE PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY AIR FORCE MILITARY MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Non-contact phase-locked and self-injection-locked vital sign sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact phase-locked and self-injection-locked vital sign sensor includes a self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element and a phase-locked loop. The self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element is used for transmitting an oscillation signal to an organism and for receiving a corresponding reflected signal from the organism to be posed at a self-injection-locked state, the oscillation signal being tuned by a vital sign of the organism to form a frequency-tuned signal. The phase-locked loop is used for demodulating the frequency-tuned signal to obtain a corresponding vital signal of the organism. By comparing the oscillation signal frequency-eliminated and outputted from the self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element with a reference signal, a corresponding comparison result is used to vary a phase of the frequency-divided oscillation signal for maintaining the same phase of the reference signal. Thereupon, the oscillation frequency can be stabilized, and the measurement sensitivity can be enhanced.

title_en: A kind of automatic Fast measurement system of emissive source ground penetrating radar multiple offset distance data altogether
abstract_en: A kind of automatic Fast measurement system of emissive source ground penetrating radar multiple offset distance data altogether, relates to ground penetrating radar.Be provided with the automatic rapid measurement device of common emissive source Coherent Noise in GPR Record, computing machine, radar host computer, measurement mechanism is provided with screw rod, clip, transmission nut, ground penetrating radar emitting antenna, ground penetrating radar receiving antenna and step motor; Emitting antenna and step motor are fixed on screw rod two ends; Receiving antenna is fixed on screw rod; Computing machine is connected with step motor and radar host computer by data line, and step motor controls the position of ground penetrating radar receiving antenna by drving sprial bar; Radar host computer controls emitting antenna to underground medium radiated electromagnetic wave, and by receiving antenna record reflection echo; Transmission nut is used for the position of transmission receiving antenna; Screw rod is for carrying the movement of receiving antenna; Fixed emitting antenna is used for underground medium radiate high frequency electromagnetic impulse signal; Receiving antenna is for receiving and gather the echoed signal from buried target.

title_en: A kind of radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of radar life-detection instruments, are related to radar detector technical field.The utility model includes survey meter ontology, and one opposite flank of survey meter ontology is respectively and fixedly provided with both heights and adjusts component；Both heights, which adjust component and are rotatably assorted, limit assembly；Height adjustment assembly includes rectangle connection guide post；Rectangle connection one end face of guide post is provided with the first guiding circular hole；First guiding one inner wall of circular hole is hinged with electric telescopic rod by the first free bearing；The electric telescopic rod other end is hinged with end cap by the second free bearing；End cap one end week side is threaded with levelling column guide cylinder；Levelling column guide cylinder week side is provided with the first notch.The height adjustment assembly that the utility model passes through design, it is primary to place the first levelling and progress detection angle adjustment for being able to carry out radar life-detection instrument on ruins, supplement detection is carried out to horizontality detection blind area, solving existing radar life-detection instrument does not have the problem of detection angle regulating device, the time is searched and rescued in waste.
assignees: ANXIN KEGONG BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Wall-mounted induction fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fire control, and discloses a wall-mounted induction fire extinguishing device which comprises a suspension frame arranged on a wall, wherein an adjusting member, a spray head and a containing member are arranged on the suspension frame, the input end of the spray head is provided with a connecting pipe, the tail end of the connecting pipe is provided with a booster pump, the input end of the booster pump is communicated with a fire extinguishing medium supply source, the adjusting member is used for pulling the spray head to be close to a fire source and pulling the spray head to swing when a fire disaster occurs, and the containing member is used for keeping the connecting pipe in an ordered state; according to the utility model, the fire disaster is sensed through the temperature sensor pre-buried at the position where the fire disaster easily occurs, and when the fire disaster occurs, the temperature sensor sends out signals to enable the first motor, the second motor and the third motor to operate, the former drives the spray head to be close to the fire source, so that accurate fire extinguishment is realized, the fire extinguishment effect is improved, the latter two motors cooperate to drive the spray head to swing, the spraying range of the spray head is improved, and the fire extinguishment effect is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGBA FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar life-detection instrument, which comprises a main body of the instrument and a bluetooth device (1), wherein the main body comprises a transmitting antenna (2), a receiving antenna (3), a low noise amplifier (4), a power amplifier (5), a modem (6) and a signal processor (7); the transmitting antenna (2) is arranged on the power amplifier (5), and the receiving antenna (3) is arranged on the low noise amplifier (4); and the low noise amplifier (4) and the power amplifier (5) are respectively connected with the signal processor (7) through the modem (6). The radar life-detection instrument can conveniently and quickly detect the trapped person, and has the advantages of high detection accuracy and simple structure.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar is under complex environment to the method for multiple mobile object real-time tracking
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of through-wall radar under complex environment to the method for multiple mobile object real-time tracking.Go out all tracks in the position at current time and energy first with Kalman filter prediction, and construct two neighborhoods centered on position and energy predicting value respectively, all targets in two neighborhoods and corresponding track simultaneously are associated；Improvement nearest-neighbor method and bipartite graph maximum weight matching algorithm based on position and energy information are recycled, the target for realizing best match with each movement locus respectively is found out in the target above associated；Then according to the current state of track these tracks of Quality estimation based on log-likelihood ratio, so as to determine that track is maintained, new track is produced or track is deleted；Finally existing smooth trajectory is handled using Kalman filter.The inventive method is simple, execution efficiency is high, suitable for tracking of the portable through-wall radar partition wall to human body target of doing more physical exercises, can effectively improve the operating efficiency of through-wall radar.

title_en: A kind of intelligent fire breathing mask glasses that Multi-information acquisition is shown
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of intelligent fire breathing mask glasses that Multi-information acquisition is shown, it is characterised in that：Including frame mirror holder, image-forming module and battery module, the frame mirror holder is installed on breathing mask, and image-forming module is set at the top of frame mirror holder and is integrated in frame mirror holder end side close to eyes side, battery module；Frame mirror holder is integrated with circuit sheet processor and control module.The present invention is mounted in fire-fighting breathing mask, it can access the imaging picture of display air respiratorresuscitator oxygen cylinder pressure value, the gas concentration of gas detecting instrument, the physical sign parameters of vital sign bracelet and thermal imaging system, it is compact-sized, light weight, it is convenient using interaction, normal line of sight is not influenced, fireman's both hands are really liberated, promotes fireman's rescue and self-protection ability.
assignees: 28TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Life detection method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: at a certain distance from the earth's surface, the airborne life detection radar transmits detection signals and receives echoes, such as echoes of subsurface life signals, the earth's surface and other interference signals; preprocessing an echo signal received by an airborne radar; carrying out Fourier transform on the preprocessed signals and constructing a neural network data set; preprocessing the constructed neural network data set; a neural network is built and a test neural network model is trained, so that vital signals, strong echoes of the earth surface and other interference signals are effectively distinguished, and whether life signs exist below the earth surface or not is detected. The method provided by the invention can be used for detecting the vital signals more effectively and has stronger environmental adaptability.
assignees: Wolfman fire fighting equipment co ltd

title_en: Miniature non-contact radar system for human body monitoring
abstract_en: A miniaturized non-contact radar system for human body monitoring, comprising: the invention adopts a radio frequency-baseband fusion cancellation full duplex radio frequency system architecture to construct a stray signal cancellation network for a received signal at a radio frequency end and a baseband end respectively, interference is reduced in two steps, thus the signal-to-noise ratio of the received signal is greatly improved, and non-contact accurate real-time perception of human vital signs and body subtle actions is realized.

title_en: Multifunctional composite net material for building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety protection, in particular to a multifunctional composite net material for building, which comprises a top layer and a bottom layer, wherein the top layer and the bottom layer are formed by alternately weaving polyester fibers, glass fibers and carbon fibers; the structure of the connecting layer is consistent with that of the top layer and the bottom layer. The wave-shaped fiber is arranged between the top layer and the bottom layer, the wave-shaped fiber comprises cavities, and the cavities are gaps of the wave-shaped fiber. The beneficial effects are that: the electric heating wires are pre-buried in the composite net material and used for paving the tunnel portal or the side ditch in the tunnel, and the electric heating wires are electrified and heated when the electric heating wires encounter icing in winter, so that the icing is melted, the water flow is normal, and the water in the tunnel is prevented from being frozen in the tunnel or when the water flows out of the tunnel portal, so that the water level is continuously increased, and the railway track bed is flooded. The displacement sensor, the acceleration sensor and the sensor for monitoring vibration for measuring landslide and falling stones and rolling stones are buried in the net material, so that the movement of the landslide body and the rolling stones and falling stones can be monitored, and the safety of railway and highways is ensured.
assignees: SHAANXI YONGGUBANG ENGINEERING MATERIALS TECH CO LTD;TAIZHOU MENGNENGDA ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blood pressure measurement based on sensor fusion
abstract_en: Various arrangements for measuring blood pressure using sensor fusion are presented herein. A Radio Frequency (RF) signal is transmitted and a radar sensor of the fixture receives the RF reflected signal. The RF reflected signal at the first distance range is analyzed to identify a first Pulse Pressure Waveform (PPW) at the aortic valve of the user. The stationary device receives vital sign data measured by the mobile device at a limb of the user. The vital sign data is analyzed to identify a second PPW at the limb of the user. Using the first PPW and the second PPW, a pulse transit time from the aortic valve to the limb is determined. Using PTT, the user's Blood Pressure (BP) is determined and an indication of BP is output.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar baseband module and system for multi-target vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar baseband module and a system for multi-target vital sign monitoring, wherein the radar baseband module comprises a time domain processing submodule, a frequency domain processing submodule and an FFT submodule, the time domain processing submodule is used for filtering and preprocessing digital intermediate frequency signals of echo signals reflected by targets to obtain time domain sampling point sequences, the FFT submodule is used for carrying out FFT conversion on the time domain sampling point sequences output by the time domain processing submodule to obtain one-dimensional frequency domain signals, the frequency domain processing submodule is used for extracting phase characteristics of a plurality of targets from the one-dimensional frequency domain signals, and the FFT submodule is also used for carrying out FFT conversion on the phase characteristics of the targets to obtain two-dimensional frequency domain signals so as to extract vital sign information of each target; the frequency domain processing submodule comprises a distance extraction unit, a phase extraction unit, a plurality of parallel unwrapping units, a parallel-serial conversion unit and a null-notch filter. The invention has high integration, low power consumption, low cost and low time delay.

title_en: Multimode compound life detection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and discloses a multimode composite life detection system which comprises a radar detection module, an infrared sensor module, an acoustic detection module, a central processing unit and a data processing and signal fusion module, wherein the radar detection module is used for detecting surrounding environment through radar signals and identifying the position and existence of a target, the infrared sensor module is used for detecting the body temperature change of a life body through temperature difference, the acoustic detection module is used for detecting weak sound signals of the life body through sound collection and analysis, the central processing unit is used for coordinating the work of each module, receiving and processing signals from different detection modules and carrying out signal fusion and judging the existence of the life body, and the data processing and signal fusion module is used for receiving the signals of each detection module. According to the invention, through multi-mode composite detection, environment adaptability modeling, wireless communication optimization and intelligent man-machine interaction interface, high-precision life detection, stable data transmission and high-efficiency operation response in a complex environment are realized, and rescue efficiency and accuracy are greatly improved.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion human body target recognition method based on automatic control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-modal data fusion target recognition, in particular to a multi-modal data fusion human body target recognition method based on automatic control, which is characterized in that the existing life detection system is difficult to effectively distinguish the spatial distribution of a human body target and a thermal pseudo target, real-time synchronous analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data cannot be realized, the target positioning reliability in an extreme environment is severely restricted, the cross-modal data of infrared thermal imaging and visible light imaging are fused, A characteristic complementation and interference suppression model based on a deep neural network is constructed, a multi-scale anti-interference network based on wavelet graph rolling and attention mechanisms is adopted, the broadband interference of environmental noise is suppressed through time-frequency localization characteristics, high robustness recognition of human targets in severe environments such as dense smoke shielding and thermal radiation interference is realized, and accurate distinction of human bodies and thermal pseudo targets in complex fire scene environments is realized.
assignees: SHANXI UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: A low power biological signal measuring instrument and a amplification rate control method of measured signal
title_ko: 저전력 생체신호 측정기 및 측정 신호 증폭율 제어 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a low power biological measuring device and a method of controlling a measuring signal amplification factor. The low power biological measuring device comprises: a sensor unit detecting a biological signal; a filter unit receiving the detected biological signal and filtering the biological signal; an amplification factor control unit outputting an amplification factor control signal by comparing DC baselines of the detected biological signal; an amplification unit receiving the filtered biological signal and amplifying the biological signal to correspond to the amplification factor control signal; a signal processing unit receiving the amplified biological signal and processing the biological signal using a diagnosis algorithm; and a power unit supplying power or blocking power in accordance with whether a pair of first and second contact terminals in the sensor unit are in contact with each other or submerged in the water. According to the present invention, the low power biological measuring device and the method of controlling a measuring signal amplification factor can remarkably increase the use time of a biological signal measuring device by remarkably reducing a duty cycle in a measured biological signal waveform and remarkably reducing the whole power to be consumed when the biological signal is measured, also can prevent power from being continuously consumed when the biological signal is not measured, and prevent a malfunction when the biological signal measuring device is submerged in the water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 저전력 생체신호 측정기 및 측정 신호 증폭율 제어 방법을 공개한다. 이 장치는 생체신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 감지된 생체신호를 인가받아 필터링하는 필터부; 상기 감지된 생체신호의 직류 기저선(DC baseline)을 비교하여 증폭율 제어 신호를 출력하는 증폭율 제어부; 상기 필터링된 생체신호를 인가받아 상기 증폭율 제어 신호에 응답하여 증폭하는 증폭부; 상기 증폭된 생체신호를 인가받아 진단 알고리즘을 이용하여 생체신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 센서부 내 제1 및 제2 접촉단자 쌍의 접촉여부 또는 침수 여부에 따라 측정기에 전원을 공급 또는 차단하는 전원부;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의할 경우, 측정되는 생체신호 파형의 듀티 싸이클을 현격하게 감소시키고, 생체신호 측정시 전체의 소모되는 전력을 현저하게 절감시킴으로써, 생체신호 측정기의 사용 시간을 획기적으로 증가시킬 수 있게 된다. 또한, 생체신호 비측정시에도 지속되는 전력소모를 방지하고, 생체신호 측정기 침수시 고장을 미연에 예방할 수 있다.
assignees: FOUNDATION RES & BUSINESS SEOUL NAT UNIV SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Airborne systems and detection methods localisation and production of images of buried objects and characterisation of the composition of the subsurface
abstract_en: The invention relates to airborne systems and methods for the detection, localisation and production of images of buried objects and for the characterisation of the composition of the subsurface. The systems comprise at least one aerial module (1) with a radar unit (11) that emits and/or captures radar signals, a positioning and guidance system (13), the accuracy of which is equal to or less than 3 cm, and a ground station (2) with a flight control system (21) and a unit for processing radar signals (23) where radar signal processing algorithms (25) are applied. The invention also relates to a method for the detection, localisation and production of images of buried objects, and to a method for characterising the composition of the sub-surface. The invention is applicable in sectors where the detection of buried objects is required, for example in civil applications (detection of anti-personnel mines), inspection of tubing or in archeology.

title_en: An iot-enabled smart garment for location-based detection of bulletproof vest penetration using a liquid-conductivity-based sensor technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel loT-enabled smart garment system designed to be worn beneath a bulletproof vest, to perform location-based determination of a body region penetrated by a projectile after penetration of the vest, to detect multiple projectile impacts, and to differentiate impacts to vital organs, thereby enabling advance planning of medical intervention and casualty evacuation, wherein the loT-enabled smart garment comprises liquid-conductivity-based sensor nodes positioned in a 3x3 matrix arrangement on both the front and rear sides of the body so as to define a total of 18 independent regions, wherein each sensor node includes an IV fluid bag disposed between two opposing conductive metal plates in the sensor and containing silver nitrate or a similar conductive liquid, wherein the loT-enabled smart garment incorporates a liquid-conductivity-based switching mechanism which operates on the principle that, when a projectile impacts the body, rupture of the IV fluid bag causes the conductive liquid to flow between the metal plates, thereby forming a short-circuit condition, wherein, by means of said mechanism, a microcontroller determines which of the 18 sensor nodes corresponds to a closed switch state, thereby providing a point-specific identification of the body region through which the projectile has penetrated, wherein the loT-enabled smart garment further includes a GPS module for determining a location information of the injured person, an IMU sensor for monitoring the motion state of the injured person, biometric sensors for tracking vital signs such as a heart rate and a body temperature, and a GSM module for transmitting real-time notifications to medical response teams and relevant security units so as to accelerate the intervention process, and wherein the loT-enabled smart garment system thereby enables life-saving medical intervention in projectile-related injuries by means of all these features.
assignees: ATATURK UNIV FIKRI MULKIYET HAKLARI KOORDINATORLUGU DONER SERMAYE ISLETMESI

title_en: Systems and methods for vehicle occupant vital sign detection
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detection and/or estimation of a rate of an occupant vital sign from within a cabin of a vehicle. In some implementations, the method may comprise identifying a repeating pattern of Doppler spectrum peaks in RADAR signal using a plurality of different range bins. An estimated frequency distance between adjacent peaks of the repeating pattern may then be identified using the signal data. An estimated rate of a repeating vital sign of an occupant within the cabin of the vehicle may then be calculated using the estimated frequency distance.

title_en: Radar apparatus with natural convection
abstract_en: An apparatus detects and measures vital signs of each human target by a continuous, non-intrusive method. In an example, the vital signs of interest include a heart rate and a respiratory rate, which can provide valuable information about the human's wellness. Additionally, the heart rate and respiratory rate can also be used to identify a particular person, if more than two target humans are living in a home. The apparatus has a natural convection spatial flow path that draws heat from at least one processor, one fan-less radar and a heat sink.

title_en: wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system. The system comprises a comprehensive processing server, a communication base station, an intelligent watch node, a positioning and monitoring node, a wind speed sensor node and a pressure sensor node. The comprehensive processing server can be in communication with the communication base station through connection of a cable. The communication base station is wirelessly connected with the intelligent watch node, the positioning and monitoring node, the wind speed sensor node and the pressure sensor node, and wireless mesh network communication is formed. According to the wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system, the positions of an underground miner can be positioned accurately, the vital signs of the miner and the safety information of the construction area environment of the miner can also be monitored, monitoring information can be transmitted to a ground monitoring center and the intelligent watch node on the hand of the underground miner in real time, operation and use are convenient, when the monitoring parameter exceeds the safety threshold value, the system can send out alarming information in time automatically, the positions of survived people can be determined after a mine disaster happens, the rescue efficiency can be improved, and the casualty loss can be reduced.

title_en: Precise electromagnetic calibration method for ultra-deep underground pipeline azimuth
abstract_en: An accurate electromagnetic calibration method for the azimuth of an ultra-deep underground pipeline. The invention uses a measuring sensor formed by three-component orthogonal coil groups, a built-in circuit board and a plane electron Luo Panan to be arranged in a non-metallic probe, thereby realizing electromagnetic calibration of the orientation of the ultra-deep underground pipeline relative to the probe. The probe for electromagnetic calibration method measurement is connected by a cable, is lowered into a well drilled in advance, is connected with a detection host on the ground through serial communication, and is used for completing measurement parameter setting, process control and measurement result display. In the detection process, the probe descends by self gravity, when approaching to a pipeline, a plurality of groups of data are collected, and the data of the probe azimuth measured by the electronic compass are collected and uploaded to the detection host, and the detection host calculates and displays the position of the target pipeline relative to the exploratory well. The method is matched with the ultra-deep pipeline buried depth measuring device, and can be widely applied to high-precision measuring occasions of ultra-deep underground pipelines and cable positions.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring waveform recovery method based on deep learning and radio frequency sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering vital sign monitoring waveforms based on deep learning and radio frequency perception, which is based on radio frequency sensing and deep contrast learning technology, recovers vital sign monitoring waveforms in a contactless manner, builds a neural network by applying an encoder-decoder model, avoids loss of waveform details compared with a traditional comparison model, can recover vital sign waveforms with fine granularity more accurately in a motion state, and further improves the robustness of vital sign monitoring to motion; in addition, the vital sign waveform recovery method provided by the invention adopts a unified data format, so that the method can be almost deployed on any type of commercial grade radar in the prior art, can adapt to different application requirements, and is independent of bottom hardware.

title_en: Multi-target regional rapid through-wall imaging method under polar coordinate system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-target regional rapid through-wall imaging method under a polar coordinate system, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and comprises the following steps: preprocessing a target echo signal to remove wall echo and background clutter; carrying out one-dimensional constant false alarm detection on the central channel, and extracting the number of targets and the electric length corresponding to the positions of the targets; step 2, measuring that the electric length of the target position is larger than the real distance of the target due to the existence of the wall, and obtaining the relation between the real distance of the target and the electric length according to detailed mathematical deduction; calculating the difference between the electric length corresponding to the target position and the real distance and the width of the main echo lobe, and determining the width of the local imaging strip; the true distance at which each target is located is striped. The method shortens the time consumption of the algorithm, avoids the condition that strong targets mask weak targets due to energy attenuation, and corrects the deviation of the imaging positions of the targets due to the existence of the wall body by deducing the wall body compensation formula under the polar coordinate system.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The application relates to a vital sign detection method and equipment based on a microwave radar, which comprises the following steps of S1, transmitting and receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching the position of a human body, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving the radar signals returned by the vital sign detection area, and extracting vital signs from the radar signals. The application can control the rotation and/or translation of the microwave radar to find the vital sign detection area, so that the microwave radar for detecting vital signs can be placed at a plurality of indoor positions, manual adjustment of a scanning area of the microwave radar is not needed before the microwave radar is used, and the microwave radar can automatically find the vital sign detection area and detect the vital signs.

title_en: Hand-held landmine detector with image display
title_ko: 영상 전시 핸드 헬드 지뢰 탐지 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A hand-held mine detection device having an image displaying function is provided to provide a user with the image information of the ground in real time. CONSTITUTION: A hand-held mine detection device having an image displaying function comprises a detector(100), a controller(400), a detected signal transmitter-receiver(300), and a detection grip body. The detector senses materials buried in the ground and generates detected signals. The controller comprises a wired and wireless communication unit, a signal processing unit, a detection position/motion sensing unit, a detected image synchronizing unit, and a display unit. The detected signal transmitter-receiver transmits the detected signals from the detector to the controller. The detector and the controller are attached on the detection grip body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영상 전시 핸드 헬드(Hend-held)형 지뢰 탐지 장치에 관한 것으로서, 지중에 매설된 지뢰를 탐지(detection)하여 인지(recognition)할 수 있는 영상 전시 핸드 헬드 지뢰 탐지 장치이다. 본 발명의 실시 형태는 지중에 매설된 매설물을 감지하여 탐지 신호를 발생하는 탐지체;와,  상기 탐지 신호 송수신기로부터의 탐지 신호를 수신하는 통제기 유무선 통신부와, 탐지 방향에서의 탐지가 완료되면 탐지 시작점에서부터 탐지 완료점까지의 탐지 신호를 필터링하여 탐지 영상으로 생성하는 신호 처리부와, 탐지가 이루어지는 탐지체의 위치정보 및 움직임정보를 감지하는 탐지위치 및 움직임 센싱부와, 상기 탐지 영상에 탐지체의 위치정보 및 움직임정보를 동기화하는 탐지 영상 동기화부와, 상기 탐지 영상, 탐지체의 위치정보 및 움직임정보를 함께 하나의 화면에 디스플레이하는 표시부를 포함하는 통제기;와, 상기 탐지체에 탐지 구동 신호를 인가하여 상기 탐지체로부터 탐지 신호를 상기 통제기로 중계하는 탐지 신호 송수신기;와, 상기 탐지체 및 통제기가 부착된 탐지 파지체;를 포함하며, 상기 신호 처리부는, 탐지 영상 생성 조건에 충족할 경우에만 탐지 방향에서의 탐지가 완료되었다고 판단하여 탐지 영상을 생성하며, 이때, 상기 탐지 영상 생성 조건은, 탐지 방향에서의 작업 방위각, 작업 시간, 지표 투과 레이더의 측정값 및 금속 탐지기의 측정값 갯수인 처리정보갯수를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart infant stethoscope toy and infant health condition minotoring system including the same
title_ko: 스마트 영유아 청진기 장난감 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 영유아 청진기 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 외부에 고무 캡이 결합되어 귀에 삽입되는 삽입부; 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 접촉되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 삽입부 및 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도 및 피부전도도를 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: A battery charging system that can quickly extinguish a fire with an infiltration extinguishing agent
title_ko: 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배터리의 충전 시 발생하는 화재의 발화 시점에 침윤소화약제를 분사하여 진압하기 위한 배터리충전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템은 배터리에 의해 작동하는 전기작동장치를 충전하는 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템으로서, 상기 전기작동장치를 수용하는 배터리충전챔버, 상기 전기작동장치에서 상기 배터리가 위치하는 부분에 탈착 가능하게 설치되어 상기 배터리의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서를 포함하는 화재감지 탈착지그를 포함하고, 상기 화재감지 탈착지그는 상기 화재감지센서에서 상기 배터리의 화재를 감지하는 경우, 상기 전기작동장치의 내부로 상기 침윤소화약제를 침투시켜 화재를 진압하도록 상기 전기작동장치의 장치케이스를 천공하는 천공부를 포함한다. 따라서 배터리의 발화시점에서 신속하게 화재를 진압할 수 있다.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring camera system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vital sign monitoring camera system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises: the device comprises a millimeter wave radar module, an optical camera module, a main control board, an audio module, a storage module, a rotating assembly, a communication module and a power module; the millimeter wave radar module is used for transmitting electromagnetic waves and receiving echo signals, and judging the motion amplitude, the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the human body according to the echo signals; the optical camera module is used for acquiring image information through optical imaging; the main control board is used for processing echo signals and image information; the audio module is used for outputting and inputting audio signals; the storage module is used for storing the echo signal, the image information and the audio signal; the rotating assembly is used for driving the millimeter wave radar module and the optical camera module to rotate, and the rotation of the millimeter wave radar module and the optical camera module realizes omnibearing monitoring. The utility model adopts non-contact vital sign monitoring, can carry out all-round monitoring and has better monitoring effect.
assignees: SHENZHEN WANJIAAN INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Radar and infrared combined composite life detector packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar and infrared combined composite life detection instrument packaging structure, which comprises a base, a first cover body, a second cover body, a radar unit and an infrared unit; the first cover body is hollow, a first opening is formed in one side face of the first cover body, and the side face is connected with the base in a sealing mode through the first opening; a second opening is arranged on one end face of the first cover body; the end part of the second cover body is connected with the first cover body in a sealing way, and the non-end part position of the second cover body and the first cover body is arranged in a clearance way; the radar unit is arranged on the end face of one side, close to the first cover body, of the base; the infrared unit is embedded in the first cover body at the second opening; through optimizing the inner structure of first lid and base for at the inside rational overall arrangement radar detection device and the infrared detection device of hand-held apparatus, satisfied the requirement of miniaturization, the portability of equipment, single use of specially adapted calamity or accident rescue scene.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Prevent outdoor high-voltage board of automatic rising that wades
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-water-wading automatic lifting outdoor high-voltage cabinet, which comprises a concrete prefabricated base, sliding cylinders are fixed at four corners of the top of the concrete prefabricated base, sliding rods are inserted into the sliding cylinders, high-voltage cabinet bases are fixedly arranged at the tops of the four sliding rods, the concrete prefabricated base at the bottom of the high-voltage cabinet is buried underground for fixation, when a water-logging disaster occurs, the water level rises, when the water level reaches a water-wading sensor, the water-wading sensor detects a water-wading signal at the moment, the water-wading signal is transmitted to a controller, the controller controls a speed-reducing motor to start, the speed-reducing motor drives a threaded rod to rotate in a threaded cylinder so as to enable the threaded rod to axially move in the vertical direction, the speed-reducing motor moves upwards through the upward movement of the threaded rod, and when a limit disc in the sliding cylinder slides to the top of the threaded cylinder, the limit disc presses a pressing switch at the moment, the speed-reducing motor is closed, the rising operation of the high-voltage cabinet is completed, and severe weather can be coped with, and water-wading of the high-voltage cabinet is prevented by the water-wading disaster.
assignees: HUBEI TAIAN SIYUAN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional detection and positioning method for dental implant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional detection and positioning method of a dental implant, which is used for detecting the implant in a gingival. The tooth implant detection device comprises a detection sensor, a software and hardware control device and the like, wherein the detection sensor consists of a spiral coil at the front end and an electrode at the tail end, and when the detection sensor senses a metal implant buried in gum, the inductance of the coil is changed, and the frequency of an oscillation circuit is changed along with the change of the inductance, so that the detection and positioning effects are achieved. Can bury three dimensions such as the outside of gum, the inboard of gum through top, the planting body to wearing the planting body and survey to can fix a position the inside accurate position whether have planting body and planting body of gum fast, not only can make things convenient for the planting body in accurate location patient oral cavity of doctor, also can reduce patient's economic burden and reduce the injury to the human body.
assignees: CHANGSHA WEIXIAO MEICHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-band millimeter radar detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-band millimeter radar detection system which comprises a multi-band reconstruction radar module, an MIMO antenna array, an FPGA preprocessing module, an edge computing unit and a power management module, wherein the multi-band reconstruction radar module supports 24GHz/77GHz dynamic switching, intelligent adaptation of a penetration mode and a positioning mode is achieved through a radio frequency switch, the MIMO antenna array is used for receiving signals transmitted by the multi-band reconstruction radar module, the FPGA preprocessing module is used for preprocessing radar echo signals received by the MIMO antenna array, the edge computing unit is used for computing and analyzing the preprocessed radar echo signals to determine detection results, and the power management module is used for providing electric quantity. The invention breaks through the technical bottlenecks of weak penetrability, difficult multi-target separation and high response delay of the traditional detection equipment, fills the blank of life detection technology in a complex environment, and promotes the remarkable improvement of emergency rescue efficiency and success rate.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Full aviation life intelligent detection and emergency rescue decision-making method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full aviation life intelligent detection and emergency rescue decision-making method and system, the method comprises the steps of dividing an emergency rescue scene into gridding subareas, identifying disaster degree and number of people affected, combining identification results with the gridding subareas to form a red, yellow, blue and green post-disaster gridding subarea map, sequentially adopting a full aviation transient electromagnetic method life detector, optical personnel detection equipment and microwave radar life detection equipment to detect a potential disaster area step by step to form a final replacement result of a red, yellow, blue and green four-color gridding target mark, determining the priority level of ground rescue entering search and rescue according to the gridding subarea map and the final replacement result, collecting rescue result information entering the ground rescue entering search and rescue to form box count statistics of gridding information, automatically generating rescue decision-making advice according to the box count statistics result, and forming high-efficiency cooperation with a ground team, and effectively overcoming the limitation of a single detection method under complex terrain and extreme environments.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;WUHAN ZHONGKE KECHUANG ENG DETECTION CO LTD;JILIN JINDUN FIRE SAFETY DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: Building interior and exterior wall reconstruction system and method based on through-wall radar and laser radar fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building interior and exterior wall reconstruction system and a method based on fusion of a through-wall radar and a laser radar. According to the invention, the high-precision reconstruction is carried out on the building outer wall through the SLAM technology of the laser radar and the optical camera, the surface contour is extracted by utilizing the obtained outer wall point cloud, and the time delay optimization is carried out on the wall compensation part in the imaging process of the wall inside the through-wall radar by utilizing the contour information, so that the imaging accuracy of the wall inside the building in the BP result of the through-wall imaging is improved. And finally, high-precision reconstruction of the building outer wall and the inner wall is realized at the same time. The invention builds a corresponding data acquisition and processing system to verify the technical scheme.

title_en: Medical treatment device for search and rescue type aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical treatment device for a search and rescue type aircraft, which comprises a rewarming device, a vital sign monitoring device, an emergency treatment device and an onboard power supply, wherein the rewarming device comprises a thermal blanket and a far infrared rewarming bag and is used for rewarming a user, the vital sign monitoring device is respectively connected with the rewarming device and the emergency treatment device and comprises a sphygmomanometer, a heart rate measuring module, a body temperature measuring module, an oxygen saturation measuring module, a carbon dioxide sensor, an electrocardiograph and a vital sign evaluation module and is used for carrying out vital sign monitoring on the user, and the emergency treatment device comprises an automatic external defibrillator, a cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument, a simple breathing machine, an airborne oxygen supply device, an injection pump and a quantitative infusion pump and is used for carrying out emergency treatment on the user.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF LOGISTICS SCIENCE AND TECH INSTITUTE OF SYSTEMS ENGINEERING ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCE

title_en: The apparatus of human body antenna in mine detection
title_ko: 지뢰탐지용 휴먼바디 안테나장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a human body antenna device (1) to detect a mine using an ultrahigh frequency RF beam by being installed in a human body to be detached, to solve a problem wherein many human resources and much time are wasted as an existing mine detecting device cannot distinguish a spot where mine detection was performed or a spot where the mine detection is not performed; to solve a problem in which a mine is not accurately detected when a user quickly moves a sensor head unit or moves the sensor head unit in an irregular speed; and to solve a problem of a mine detection error solved using a one-way ultrasonic waves sensing signal. The human body antenna device can be worn on a human body as a detachable type while the human wears a combat uniform such that the human body antenna device has excellent compatibility with an existing combat uniform. The human body antenna device distinguishes an ignition of the mine which is not a metal and a base metal of the mine and detects the mine. Also, the human antenna device detects the mine buried underground and on the ground in all directions (360°). The human body antenna device transmits ignition detection data to a combat command server in a remote place to share the data, and radiates a plurality of ultrahigh frequency RF beams to a front ground and a side ground in an antenna structure. The human body antenna device also performs pretreatment by an ignition pretreatment unit and detects a signal of a mine to which it is of high possibility, and an explosive based on the strength of a response signal of the ultrahigh frequency RF beam in accordance with a delay time by applying a property in which the strength of the signal received to the ultrahigh frequency RF beam through a nonlinear regressive model algorithm engine unit nonlinearly damps in accordance with the delay time. As such, the human body antenna device improves a mine detection accuracy by 90% or more than an existing invention.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래의 지뢰탐지 장치가 지뢰탐지를 실시한 곳과 탐지를 실시하지 않은 지역을 구분할 수 없으므로, 많은 인력 및 시간이 낭비되는 문제점과, 사용자가 센서 헤드부를 일정한 속도로 움직이지 않거나 너무 빨리 움직이는 경우, 지뢰를 정확히 탐지하지 못하는 문제점, 단방향 초음파 센싱신호를 통한 지뢰탐지오류 문제점을 개선하고자, 신체에 탈부착식으로 설치되어 초고주파 RF빔을 통해 지뢰를 탐지하는 휴먼바디안테나장치(1)가 구성됨으로서, 전투복을 입은 상태에서 신체에 탈부착식으로 장착할 수 있어, 기존의 전투복과 호환성이 우수하고, 지뢰의 금속과 비금속이 아닌 지뢰의 기폭제를 식별하면서 지뢰를 탐지할 수 있으며, 지상 및 지하에 매설된 지뢰를 전방위(360°)로 탐지할 수 있고, 기폭제탐지데이터를 원격지 전투지휘서버로 전송시켜 데이터를 공유할 수 있으며, 플렉시블 루프방사형 안테나구조로 초고주파 RF 방사빔을 전방지면, 측방지면으로 복수개로 방사시키고, 기폭제전처리부를 통해 전처리시키며, 비선형 회귀모델알고리즘엔진부를 통해 초고주파 RF 방사빔에 수신되는 신호의 세기가 지연 시간에 따라 비선형적으로 감쇄하는 특성을 반영하여, 지연 시간에 따른 초고주파 RF 방사빔 응답신호의 세기를 기반으로 지뢰 및 폭약일 가능성이 높은 신호를 검출할 수 있어, 기존보다 지뢰탐지 정확률을 90% 향상시킬 수 있는 지뢰탐지용 휴먼바디안테나장치을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Method for fallen detection using radar sensors
title_ko: 레이더센서를 활용한 낙상 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a fall using a radar sensor, which is performed by a server. The method for detecting a fall using a radar sensor comprises: (a) a step in which a plurality of radar sensors installed in a lower portion of a bed detect a movement and a bio-signal of a user located in the bed; (b) a step of receiving a movement signal and a bio-signal of the user from the radar sensor and inputting the movement signal and the bio-signal to a fall detection model to determine whether the user is present and falls; (c) a step of transmitting a message notifying the fall of the user to at least one of a user terminal, a guardian terminal, and a medical center terminal according to whether the user is present and falls; and (d) a step of remotely controlling an IoT device within a preset range from the radar sensor to perform follow-up measures when the movement signal and the bio-signal of the user received from the radar sensor are determined to fall after a preset time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 서버에 의해 수행되는, 레이더센서를 활용한 낙상 감지 방법에 관한 것으로서, (a) 침대의 하부에 설치된 복수의 레이더센서가 상기 침대에 위치한 사용자의 움직임 및 생체신호를 감지하는 단계; (b) 상기 레이더센서로부터 사용자의 움직임 신호 및 생체신호를 수신하여 낙상감지모델에 입력함으로써, 상기 사용자의 재실 여부 및 낙상여부를 판단하는 단계; (c) 상기 사용자의 재실 여부 및 낙상여부에 따라, 사용자 단말, 보호자 단말 및 의료센터 단말 중 적어도 하나로 상기 사용자의 낙상을 알리는 메시지를 전달하는 단계; 및 (d) 기 설정된 시간 이후, 상기 레이더센서로부터 수신한 사용자의 움직임 신호 및 생체신호가 낙상 상태로 판단되는 경우, 상기 레이더센서로부터 기 설정된 범위 이내의 IoT 장치를 원격으로 제어하여 후속조치를 수행하는 단계;를 포함하는, 레이더센서를 활용한 낙상 감지 방법에 관한 기술이다.

title_en: Radar system for locating pipes buried in the ground and for detecting underground leaks of liquid, in particular water, with a square waveguide antenna for emitting orthogonally polarised signals of the same frequency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar system for locating pipes buried in the ground and for detecting underground leaks of liquid, in particular water, with a square waveguide antenna for emitting orthogonally polarised signals of the same frequency. The invention essentially consists of a radar system (1) with an antenna (4) that can emit waves at a nominal frequency towards the ground in two polarisations that are distinct and orthogonal to one another, and that incorporates a measuring element (5) configured to measure the polarimetric ratio of the signals received in the two polarisations, in order to deduce from the imbalance between the two received signals the presence of a pipe buried in the ground, and, where appropriate, the presence of leaks of liquid, in particular water.

title_en: Data pre-processing method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A data pre-processing method is provided. By using an energy distribution parameter set obtained through beamforming scanning, a signal-to-noise ratio of a signal can be improved and a detection range region can be automatically generated, thereby improving an object tracking effect. An exercise vital sign detection radar (10) is also provided.

title_en: Autonomous mobility for detecting buried object and method for detecting buried object using same
title_ko: 매설물 탐지를 위한 자율 주행 모빌리티 및 이를 이용한 매설물 탐지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous mobility for detecting a buried object and a method for detecting a buried object using same. The autonomous mobility comprises: a driving control unit for, when a magnetic field signal is detected by a magnetic field sensor while the mobility is traveling in a designated range in an autonomous driving mode, switching the autonomous driving mode to a tracking driving mode, and controlling the mobility to travel along the position in which the magnetic field signal is detected; a data collection unit for collecting reception position data, intensity data, and time data required for signal transmission and reception of a magnetic field signal received while the mobility is traveling in the tracking driving mode; an information analysis unit for analyzing buried object information including a position, a type, and a depth of the buried object by using the collected data; and a map generation unit for storing a driving route on which the mobility travels in the tracking driving mode and generating a buried object map in which the buried object information is reflected in the stored driving route.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매설물 탐지를 위한 자율 주행 모빌리티 및 이를 이용한 매설물 탐지 방법에 관한 것으로, 자율 주행 모드로 지정 범위를 주행하는 도중 자기장 센서에 의해 자기장 신호가 감지되면, 추적 주행 모드로 전환시켜 자기장 신호가 감지되는 위치를 따라 주행하도록 제어하는 주행 제어부; 추적 주행 모드로 주행하면서 수신되는 자기장 신호의 수신 위치 데이터, 세기 데이터 및 신호 송수신 시 소요되는 시간 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 수집한 데이터를 이용하여 매설물의 위치, 종류 및 깊이를 포함하는 매설물 정보를 분석하는 정보 분석부; 및 추적 주행 모드로 주행한 주행 경로를 저장하고, 저장된 주행 경로에 매설물 정보가 반영된 매설물 지도를 생성하는 지도 생성부를 포함한다. [대표도] 도 1
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms.
