Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Wearable Vital Signs Monitor With Selective Signal Acquisition
abstract_en: In one example, a wearable vital sign monitor (WVSM) system comprises a support structure configured to be worn by a patient, a plurality of patient physiological sensors configured to be coupled to the patient when the patient is wearing the support structure, each patient physiological sensor configured to output a respective patient physiological signal, a memory, and, a processor communicatively coupled to the plurality of patient physiological sensors and configured to store in the memory measurements of patient physiological signals taken at selected times based on a categorization of the patient physiological signal.

title_en: Vital sign sensing method and system using a communication device
abstract_en: Vital sign sensing method and system using a communication device are disclosed in the present invention. An EVM algorithm is performed on a demodulated in-phase signal and a demodulated quadrature-phase signal output from an IQ demodulator for extracting a vital-sign signal of a subject. Any communication device can still preserve communication function while being used as a vital sign sensor, no other hardware architecture is required. The vital sign sensing method and system can overcome the shortcoming of signal interference between the conventional active sensing system and the communication device and also can reduce the construction costs of noncontact vital sign sensing system significantly.

title_en: Rfid based proximity sensor and alert system for fugitives, sex offenders, missing soldiers and the like
abstract_en: A robust, wireless sensor system providing a low cost method of tracking people such as sex offenders, child molesters, etc., after their release from prison or other confinement, which protects society from such individuals and lessens their ability to repeat such offenses. The system and method of the invention can also be used to locate kidnapped persons, people buried in snow avalanches, missing or dead soldiers, etc. The system utilizes RFID tags placed on people or in specified locations and RFID transmitters that can resonate with the tagged people or objects. Such a trigger recognition arrangement combined with communication of information from the triggering can be used to obtain a signal alerting the transmitter carrier that the tagged object or person is nearby. The triggering action can also initiate a sequence of information transfers in which the transmitter broadcasts to a central command that a particular transmitter is or was in proximity to a specific object or person, and allows the command center to order the dispatch of authorized personnel, such as policemen, military personnel, emergency rescue workers, etc. to the triggering location.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A method of measuring vital signals using a millimeter-wave radar sensor system includes performing a first set of radar measurements using a millimeter-wave radar sensor to produce a first set of radar data; determining a first set of range gate measurements from the first set of radar data; determining high response range gates from the first set of range gate measurements; and extracting vital signal information from the high response range gates.

title_en: Processing method of through-wall radar echo data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing through-wall radar echo data, which comprises the steps of obtaining a radar receiving signal sequence; carrying out row-by-row difference to obtain a difference sequence; calculating energy in a direction dimension to obtain an energy sequence; normalizing the difference sequence line by line to obtain a normalized difference sequence; accumulating and summing in the direction dimension to obtain a sequence; acquiring points larger than a differential threshold value, and determining a target interval, a protection interval and a reference interval; judging whether a target appears in the target interval or not and determining the initial position of the target; filtering the sequence to obtain preprocessed data; and acquiring the target position and displaying the target track to finish the processing of the through-wall radar echo data. The method has the advantages of no need of extra hardware requirement, high applicability, high calculation speed and good clutter suppression effect, and can be applied to real-time positioning of moving targets of through-wall radar and data preprocessing of moving target detection radar systems such as unmanned aerial vehicles and the like.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method and device, which are characterized in that a radar sensor is used for collecting data of a vital sign region to be detected, after the data is processed, a distance-energy mapping relation of a moving target is obtained after a static target in the vital sign region to be detected is removed, a distance-phase mapping relation of the moving target is obtained, and then at least one specified parameter corresponding to the distance is determined according to the two mapping relations. Wherein the specified parameter includes at least a high frequency signal duty cycle. And inputting the specified parameter corresponding to the at least one distance into a pre-constructed support vector machine model to obtain a vital sign detection result output by the support vector machine model. By determining the specified parameter corresponding to the at least one distance and further using the determined specified parameter as the input of the support vector machine model, whether vital signs exist in the vital sign region to be detected can be accurately determined according to the specified parameter at least comprising the high-frequency signal duty ratio.

title_en: Thermochromic pigment-based fiber-optic respiration sensor for respiratory monitoring during clinical procedures using MRI system or radiation devices
title_ko: 자기공명영상장치 또는 방사선 장치를 이용한 시술 시 호흡 모니터링을 위한  시온안료 기반의 광섬유 호흡센서와 광섬유 호흡센서 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자기공명영상(magnetic resonance imaging, MRI) 촬영 또는 방사선 장치(radiation device)를 이용한 진단 및 치료 시 호흡 모니터링을 위해 시온안료(thermochromic microcapsule pigment) 기반의 광섬유 호흡센서와 광섬유 호흡센서 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 호흡 감지부, 광섬유(optical fiber), 광원(light source) 및 광 계측장비(light measuring device)로 구성된 온라인 광섬유 호흡센서(fiber-optic respiration sensor)에 관한 것이다. 
 발명은 광섬유 호흡센서에 있어서 호흡 감지 필름을 플라스틱 관에 부착하고, 상기 플라스틱 관을 광섬유의 끝단에 결합하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for acquiring bio-signal, and apparatus for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 생체신호 획득 장치 및 방법과, 생체정보 추정 장치
abstract_ko: 생체신호 획득 장치가 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면 생체신호 획득 장치는 대상체의 접촉에 따라 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서, 대상체의 접촉 하중을 검출하는 하중 센서 및 대상체의 접촉 하중 분포를 검출하는 초음파 센서 어레이를 포함하는 센서부와, 접촉 하중 및 접촉 하중 분포를 기초로 관심영역의 실제 접촉 하중을 획득하고, 관심영역의 실제 접촉 하중 및 생체신호를 출력하는 신호 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Air cleaning headphone system with rotating guide capable of collecting fine dust information
title_ko: 미세먼지정보 수집이 가능하며 회전식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air cleaning headphone system with a rotary guide capable of collecting fine dust information, comprising: a headphone main body including two earplugs emitting sound and cleaned air, a headband connecting the two earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a rotary guide rotatably engaged with each earplug to be fixed at a specific position; a fine dust measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring the fine dust concentration around a user and transmitting the information of the fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a bio signal measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring bio signals of the user and transmitting the information of the measured bio signals to the mobile device of the user; and a central server wirelessly communicating with the mobile device of the user and receiving the information of the fine dust concentration and the information of the bio signals. The present invention aims to provide an air cleaning headphone system with a rotary guide capable of collecting fine dust information, which is capable of allowing a user to breathe clean air anywhere.

title_en: Integration energy-conserving system for solar construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar building integrated energy-saving system, comprising a solar photovoltaic generation and energy storage system, an intelligent power control system, energy-saving lighting and various electrical devices, a solar photo-thermal water heating system, a geothermal heat exchange system, a heat pump unit, a fresh air conditioning system, a fire-fighting and industrial and domestic water storage system, a hot water tank, various water-consuming devices, a floor radiation heating system, a membrane separation water treatment and reuse system, a rainwater and waste water collection system and a sewage flushing and discharging system. The solar photovoltaic generation and energy storage system supplies all the power needed by the building; the solar photo-thermal water heating system is arranged on the top layer of the building or on the solar-oriented wall surface; the geothermal heat exchange system is buried underground; a rainwater and waste water collection tank is arranged on the ground or in the subterranean layer of the building to collect rain water and waste water; and the collected water is treated through the membrane separation water treatment and reuse system and supplied for the building to use. The remaining systems and various water-consuming or electrical devices as well as the electric cables are arranged inside the building and integrated with the building.

title_en: A kind of vital sign remote monitoring device based on Kalman filtering and target following
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of vital sign remote monitoring devices based on Kalman filtering and target following, the vital sign observation circuit uses contactless radar detection circuit, its governor circuit has been also connected with human body tracking circuit, so that monitoring objective is still fallen in the coverage of radar detection antenna main lobe direction.Device can independent suspension in indoor open position, also can be arranged at as component in the household electrical appliances such as home computer or television set, set-top box, telephone set, home-services robot, in scope separated by a distance, the vital sign parameters such as contactless automatic tracking, monitoring solitary indoor old age, the heart rate of weakling, breathing, and pass through communication network, internet to remote monitoring equipment, transtelephonic real-time parameter and alarm signal, realize care facilities and relatives to old, weakling long distance monitoring.People under the guardianship can be freely movable indoors, has broken away from traditional monitor device and the action such as the sensor wearing of people under the guardianship and cable winds are limited.

title_en: Human life signal high precision measuring method based on Terahertz radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to Radar Signal Processing Technology and life medical science/tele-medicine field, it is related to a kind of human life signal high precision measuring method based on Terahertz radar, step is：(S1) radar system emission measurement signal；(S2) radar echo signal is obtained, range Imaging is carried out according to echo-signal, and select the coverage unit related to human body target；(S3) phase ranging processing is carried out, the phase changing capacity of human body target is obtained, by phase unwrapping and the displacement variable of human body target is converted to；(S4) displacement variable of human body target is decomposed using empirical mode decomposition method, filters out the displacement component related with heartbeat to human body respiration, additive combination obtains displacement signal；(S5) displacement signal is carried out being fourier transformed into frequency domain, selects the parameter of the peak value in frequency domain, as human body respiration and heartbeat signal.The present invention is applicable special human body and environment, with higher Doppler sensitivity and measurement capability.

title_en: Respiration detection and mode classification method based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: A breathing detection and mode classification method based on FMCW radar relates to the technical field of vital sign detection. The invention aims to solve the problem that the results cannot be classified by measuring vital signs in the existing radar mode. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring data through an FMCW radar system, and separating and extracting respiration and heartbeat signals through data calculation to realize non-contact measurement of vital signs; secondly, calculating an energy spectrum and a threshold value of respiration at each time interval by using a rectangular window, and comparing the two values to realize accurate judgment of apnea; finally, extracting a peak value, a valley value and a difference value of the peak value and the valley value by respectively using a VPD peak searching algorithm; calculating the average value and standard deviation of the normalized short-time energy; and extracting the average value, the standard deviation and the minimum value of the instantaneous frequency by using HHT, and finally classifying the extracted characteristic values by using an SVM (support vector machine) and a K-proximity algorithm, thereby realizing the effective identification of various respiratory modes.

title_en: Portable optical cable buries degree of depth intellectual detection system appearance
abstract_en: The invention provides a portable optical cable burial depth intelligent detector, which belongs to the technical field of underground pipeline detection and comprises a shell, a multi-mode sensing unit, a main control and data processing unit, a man-machine interaction unit and a power supply unit, wherein the multi-mode sensing unit, the main control and data processing unit, the man-machine interaction unit and the power supply unit are integrated in the shell. The multi-mode sensing unit comprises an electromagnetic induction sensor, a ground penetrating radar sensor and an inertial measurement unit IMU. The main control and data processing unit runs a data fusion algorithm, fusion processing is carried out on the multi-source sensing data, and parameters of the electromagnetic induction model are dynamically corrected according to the dielectric constant of soil detected by the radar through the self-adaptive calibration module. The invention effectively overcomes the defects that a single detection principle is easy to be interfered and depends on experience through multi-mode sensing complementation and intelligent information fusion, obviously improves the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of measuring the buried depth of the metal and nonmetal optical cables under different soil conditions, and realizes continuous acquisition, intelligent interpretation and informationized management of buried depth data.
assignees: GUANGDONG CLP GREEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gripping detecting device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately detect whether or not a hand of a driver contacts steering wheel.SOLUTION: A gripping detecting device 10 comprises: a first electrode (L)13L and a second electrode (R)13R provided for a steering wheel of a vehicle; a heartbeat detection part 14 which detects heartbeats of a driver contacting the first electrode (L)13L and the second electrode (R)13R based on voltage patterns obtained from the first electrode (L)13L and the second electrode (R)13R; a first sensor (L)11L and a second sensor (R)11R which detect electrostatic capacitance on the steering wheel; and a gripping state determination part 15 which determines a gripping state of the driver to the steering wheel based on electrostatic capacitance detected by an electrostatic capacitance detection part 12 and voltage patterns of the first electrode (L)13L and the second electrode (R)13R detected by the heartbeat detection part 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and system for monitoring vital body signs of a seated person
title_ko: 사람의 생체 사인들을 모니터링하기 위한 디바이스
abstract_en: A method comprising the step of using a plurality of doppler radars disposed on the seat belt or integrated into the seat belt for monitoring vital body signs of a person seated in a seat of a motor vehicle is disclosed. The disclosed method unobtrusively monitors vital body signs like heart rate and respiration of the person seated in the motor vehicle. A number of safety applications as well as wellness applications can be enabled. Examples are detection of momentary sleep of the driver, vital sign monitoring in case of an accident as well as relaxation exercise using biofeedback to reduce stress for drivers.
abstract_ko: 좌석 벨트 상에 배치되거나 좌석 벨트 내에 통합된 복수의 도플러 레이더들을 사용하여 자동차의 좌석에 착석한 사람의 생체 사인들을 모니터링하기 위한 단계를 포함하는 방법이 개시되어 있다. 개시된 방법은 자동차에 착석한 사람의 심박수 및 호흡과 같은 생체 사인들을 거슬리지 않게 모니터링한다. 다수의 안전 애플리케이션들 뿐만 아니라, 건강관리 애플리케이션(wellness application)들이 가능해질 수 있다. 예들은 운전자의 순간적인 졸음의 검출, 사고의 경우에 생체 사인 모니터링 뿐만 아니라, 운전자들에 대한 스트레스를 감소시키기 위한 바이오피드백을 사용하는 이완 운동이다.

title_en: Robot for life-saving
title_ko: 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A lifesaving robot is provided to freely move debris of a collapsed building in a random direction and to detect a person who is buried in the debris of the collapsed building. CONSTITUTION: A lifesaving robot comprises a movement unit(100), a sensing sensor unit(200), a human sensing signal generator(300), and a transmitting and receiving unit(400). The movement unit comprises a mobile unit(110) and a movement control unit(120). The mobile unit moves the lifesaving robot inside a collapsed building. The movement control unit controls the mobile unit. The sensing sensor unit senses a person who is positioned in a movement route of the lifesaving robot. The human sensing signal generator generates a human sensing signal including a count identifier when receiving the human sensing signal. The transmitting and receiving unit transmits the human sensing signal to a surrounding lifesaving robot through a local area wireless network. [Reference numerals] (110) Moving unit; (120) Movement control unit; (200) Sensor unit; (300) Human sensing signal generator; (400) Transmitting and receiving unit; (500) Display unit; (600) Distance control signal generator
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 소형으로 제작되어 자연 피해나 인공 피해로 인해 붕괴된 건축물 잔해를 자유롭게 이동하여 붕괴된 건축물 잔해에 매몰되어 있는 사람을 감지하며, 사람을 감지하는 순간 이동을 멈추고 사람 감지 신호를 생성하여 주변 인명 구조 로봇으로 송신하며 사람 감지 신호를 수신하는 인명 구조 로봇은 사람 감지 신호의 카운트 식별자를 증가시켜 카운트 식별자가 감소하는 방향에 위치하는 인명 구조 로봇을 따라가며 붕괴된 건축물에서 매몰된 사람을 용이하게 구조할 수 있는 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KYUNG HEE UNIV IND COOP GROUP

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Body State Recognition using Various Bio-Signal Parameter
title_ko: 다양한 생체 신호의 파라미터를 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus to recognize biological conditions using parameters of various biological signals. The biological condition recognizing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes an ECG sensor, an ECG signal processing unit, and a processor which determines biological conditions by referring to the number of peaks of a signal-processed ECG and the maximum peak. Thereby the present invention is able to increase accuracy by determining biological conditions by considering both the peak number of an ECG and the maximum peak.
abstract_ko: 다양한 생체 신호의 파라미터를 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치가 제공된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체 상황 인지장치는, ECG 센서, ECG 신호처리부 및 신호처리된 ECG의 피크 개수와 최대 피크를 참조하여 생체 상황을 판단하는 프로세서를 포함한다.  이에 의해, ECG의 피크 개수와 최대 피크를 모두 고려하여 생체 상황을 판단하므로, 그 정확도를 높일 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Apparatus for determining the emergency situation of the old and the infirm
title_ko: 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm. The apparatus according to the present invention is installed in a residential space of the elderly and infirm and detects whether the elderly and infirm enter a specific space and a biological signal of the elderly and infirm in a contactless manner so as to determine whether the elderly and inform has an emergency situation through the biological signal detection. The apparatus comprises a bio radar; a wireless communication part; and a control part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 노약자의 주거 공간 내에 배치되어 노약자의 특정 공간 진입 여부와 노약자의 생체신호를 비접촉 방식으로 감지하고, 노약자의 생체신호 감지를 통해 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Information Complex Alert
title_ko: 사물인터넷을 기반으로 한 환경, 응급상황, 정보복합알리미
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an Internet-of-Things (IoT)-based user management system that enables a user to check a variety of information and measure and transmit bio-signals to monitor and manage the environmental status of the user with a complex information notifier. An IoT-based user management complex service of the present invention comprises: a device that can be installed in a living space such as a living room, a room, a kitchen, etc., and includes an activity detection sensor capable of detecting the amount of activity; an information notification window that enables a user to check various information such as time, fine dust, and temperature; and a disaster broadcast speaker that can receive various disaster broadcasts, wherein the device is capable of transmitting designated content to a predetermined location by using an SOS button, an activity signal sent from the device is periodically received and stored, and a manager server is configured to receive information about the activity signal stored in a designated terminal.
abstract_ko:
-본 발명은 정보복합 알리미 장비를 이용해 사용자가 각종정보를 확인할 수 있고 생체신호를 측정 및 전송함으로써 사용자의 환경상태를 모니터링 관리할 수 있는 사물인터넷 기반 사용자 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명 은 사물인터넷 기반 사용자 관리 복합서비스는 거주 공간 거실, 방, 부엌 등에 설치할 수 있으며, 활동량을 감지 할 수 있는 활동 감지 센서가 포함하는 기기와, 시간, 미세먼지, 온존수치 등 각종정보를 확인할 수 있는 정보알림창과, 각종 재난 방송을 수신할 수 있는 재난방송 스피커를 포함하며, SOS 버튼을 활용하여 미리 지정한 위치에 지정된 내용을 전송할 수 있는 기기이며, 상기 기기에서 송출된 활동신호를 주기적으로 수신하여 저장하며, 상기 관리자 서버는 지정한 단말기로 저장된 활동신호를 정보를 수신하도록 형성된다.

title_en: Asymmetric high geo-stress tunnel rock burst micro-seismic sensor arrangement method
abstract_en: An asymmetric high stress tunnel rock burst micro-seismic sensor arrangement method, relating to the technical field of tunnel engineering. On the basis of tunnel surrounding rock geological data, three-dimensional numerical simulation is carried out for asymmetric high stress tunnel stability on the basis of asymmetric in-situ rock geo-stress distribution and tunnel section geometric characteristics, and asymmetric high stress tunnel energy is calculated; the location of a rock burst risk area is determined; micro-seismic sensors are arranged in front of and behind a stress concentration area; the area at a high risk and nearby areas thereof are always incorporated in two micro-seismic sensor arrays arranged in front of and behind a tunnel face. The micro-seismic sensors work cooperatively and are staggered in space, the mounting and arrangement of the micro-seismic sensors changes forwards and backwards along with the stress concentration area, and the micro-seismic sensors always keep a certain distance range with the stress area. The tunnel stress concentration area and more nearby effective micro-crack source signals can be captured by the micro-seismic sensors, thereby improving the precision of locating a micro-seismic source and laying a foundation for accurate prediction and forecast of deep-buried hard rock tunnel disasters.

title_en: Gravity elevator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gravity elevator that can be used in a nuclear power plant with safety system with fuse element , the buildings of the power plant subjected to contamination being buried below sea level and under borated water basins, and having a safety system free of electrical and electronic components to act in the event of possible accidents comprising, among others, means for flooding the buildings of the power plant with thermal fuses and gravity elevators for operator evacuation in the event of an emergency.
assignees: SERBEX TECNOLOGÍA Y VALORES S L

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: A body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient featuring a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Direction-sensitive radiation detector and radiation detection method
abstract_en: A radiation detection system and method suitable for use by a first responder to detect a radiological source. The system includes a container that encloses a chamber containing a pressurized inert gas. Incident gamma rays pass through walls of the container to interact with inert gas atoms within the chamber. Wavelength-shifting fiber elements are disposed within scintillator bars oriented parallel to and radially spaced from the chamber axis. At least one sensor is interconnected with the fiber elements to receive first signals therefrom in response to the scattered gamma rays. An electrically-charged wire is disposed within the container along the axis thereof. The wire is adapted to attract electrons released from atoms of the inert gas that are ionized from being impacted by an incident gamma ray, and then produce second signals in response to the released electrons. Electronic circuitry collects the first and second signals, and a processor acquires and analyzes the first and second signals to produce an output based thereon.

title_en: UWB radar human motion micro-Doppler feature extracting method based on multichannel HHT
abstract_en: The invention discloses the UWB radar human motion micro-doppler extracting methods based on multichannel HHT, comprising the following steps: step 1, obtains UWB radar signal；Step 2, the UWB radar signal of acquisition is pre-processed；Step 3, effective channel selecting；Step 4, multichannel time-frequency spectrum merges；The mentioned micro-doppler Time-Frequency Analysis Method of the present invention has a higher time frequency resolution, and it is more obvious that different components correspond to the differentiation of micro-Doppler feature ingredient, can more embody the temporal characteristics and variations in detail of human motion；The mentioned Time-Frequency Analysis Method strong antijamming capability of the present invention remains to capture apparent micro-Doppler feature in the case of more remote through-wall detection, signal sharp-decay.The mentioned Time-Frequency Analysis Method of the present invention has better noise removal capability, and gained time-frequency spectrum signal-to-noise ratio is higher, and micro-Doppler feature ingredient is more obvious.

title_en: Patient vital sign change trend detection method and system based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting the change trend of vital signs of a patient based on a microwave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a patient based on a microwave radar; performing trend analysis based on the patient vital sign data, the trend analysis including a lifting trend analysis and a variability trend analysis; and judging whether the result of the trend analysis meets a first preset condition, and if so, sending out an alarm. The invention allows medical staff to pay attention to the change trend of vital signs of patients in time, evaluates the conditions of the patients, gives corresponding intervention measures as early as possible, and avoids serious bad results caused by delayed discovery of the changes of the conditions.

title_en: Radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital monitoring
abstract_en: A radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital monitoring includes a method for detecting vital signs using at least one radar sensor mounted to a vehicle. The method includes detecting a plurality of target candidates using the at least one radar sensor, analyzing the plurality of target candidates to generate a list of targets, steering the at least one radar sensor towards the target using the angle of arrival to the target, and detecting a vital signal of the target based on the range using the at least one radar sensor.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional air respirator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multi-functional air respirators, including gas cylinder, magnetic leakage detecting probe, recorder, vibrator, respirator and life-detection instrument, the top of the gas cylinder is provided with magnetic leakage detecting probe, the front surface of the harness is provided with life-detection instrument close to the other end of gas cylinder, the outside of medium pressure pipe is provided with pressure sensor close to one end of supply valve, the top of the respirator is provided with vibrator, and the outside of the high-voltage tube is provided with overbottom pressure alarm close to the bottom end of pressure gauge.The utility model the utility model is scientific and reasonable for structure, it is safe and reliable, it is provided with magnetic leakage detecting probe, the corrosion condition that can detecte gas cylinder internal, is provided with vibrator, reminds user when can have the gases did escape in bottle, it is provided with recorder, external staff can be allowed to participate in that user is instructed to sue and labour, life-detection instrument is provided with, the living body life being buried can be found.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar ground vehicle adapter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ground penetrating radar, and provides a ground penetrating radar adapter, which aims to solve the problems of easy damage, less information amount and large error of the existing pavement detection mark, and comprises a main body which is buried on the ground, wherein the main body is T-shaped, the upper surface of the top end of the T-shaped is provided with a two-dimensional code, and the T-shaped top ends on two sides of the two-dimensional code are provided with positioning holes for fixing the main body and the ground; the bottom end of the main body T-shaped vertical section is provided with a cavity, a plastic package capsule is arranged in the cavity, and an identification chip is packaged in the plastic package capsule.
assignees: JIANGSU LIANJIAN TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: After-calamity search-and-rescue cluster locating method based on assist of air pressure and height measurement
abstract_en: The invention disclose an after-calamity search-and-rescue cluster locating method based on assist of air pressure and height measurement, and relates to the technology of locating. According to the method, a mobile phone and a plurality of life detection instruments are included. The mobile phone and the life detection instruments are respectively provided a temperature and air pressure sensor, and the position of each life detection instrument is accurately measured firstly. Under the after-calamity condition, a trapped person decodes and modulates information such as the air pressure, temperature and life and then sends a distress signal through the mobile phone, and the life detection instruments receive the distress signal at the same time and process the distress signal to obtain measurement information such as the distance from the mobile phone to the life detection instruments. Information of distance measurement and the height of the mobile phone of each subsidiary life detect instrument is transmitted to a main life detection instrument through a communication link. Measurement data of the main life detection instrument and the subsidiary life detection instruments are combined with measurement data of the air pressure and the height of the mobile phone, weighting processing is carried out on the measurement data, absolute elevation of a user is obtained, the absolute elevation of the user serves as an auxiliary equation, the auxiliary equation is processed by the main life detection instrument and then the three-dimension position of the mobile phone is obtained. The method is simple and easy to implement, the obtained three-dimension position of the trapped person is accurate, and the search-and-rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Fixed-point whole-plane full-automatic deflection scanning detection device for radar life-detection instruments
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed-point whole-plane full-automatic deflection scanning detection device for radar life-detection instruments. A constant-angle horizontal-deflection bearing platform is fixed at the top of a camera tripod; a detection radar is fixed on the constant-angle horizontal-deflection bearing platform; and a computer is connected with the constant-angle horizontal-deflection bearing platform through a data transmission line or in a wireless transmission mode. According to the detection device provided by the invention, through adopting a horizontal time-sharing deflection scanning detection mode and an automatic constant-angle deflection radar life-detection instrument, the detection direction of the detection instrument is changed so as to successively complete the detection on the distribution of life entities in a whole area or a room without moving the radar detection instrument. Because each deflection angle of a radar is equal to the beam width of the radar, no detection-leakage area is produced, and a repeated detection problem is also not produced. The detection device disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high degree of automation, rapid detection speed, accurate time-sharing detection area, no produced detection-leakage leakage and repeated detection, and capability of producing planar graphs of life entity distribution, and the like.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method for bedridden patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring method for a bedridden patient, and aims to solve the problem that the bedridden patient needs to monitor vital signs but is inconvenient to wear contact equipment. The invention utilizes the advantage that the millimeter wave radar does not need to be in direct contact with the measured object, utilizes the Popler effect, obtains the vibration information of the chest surface of the patient through a series of processing on the received millimeter wave radar, and further calculates the heart rate and the respiratory rate. The accuracy of the calculation result is improved by the cooperation of a plurality of spectrum estimation methods and the design of a respiratory harmonic filter. Therefore, the method for monitoring the vital signs of the bedridden patient is convenient to use, high in measurement precision and non-contact.

title_en: Non-contact intestinal motility signal feature extraction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact intestinal motility signal feature extraction method and a non-contact intestinal motility signal feature extraction system, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring radar echo signals by using a non-contact vital sign monitoring radar; the preprocessing module is used for processing the radar echo signal by adopting a band-pass filter; the signal separation module is used for processing the preprocessed signals by adopting a signal separation algorithm to separate gastric motility signals, intestinal motility signals, respiration signals and heartbeat signals; and the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting the characteristics of the separated intestinal motility signals to obtain characteristic parameters which are beneficial to judging different intestinal conditions.

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body characteristic detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring children target
abstract_en: The invention provides a target object for monitoring vital signs of children, which comprises: the children model comprises a children model body, a children model skin and a motion mechanism, wherein the children model skin is attached to the children model body and is formed by multiple layers of cloth and used for generating the same millimeter wave radar RCS radar scattering sectional area, the same micro Doppler effect and the same laser radar attribute as those of real children; motion is located the abdominal cavity of children's model body, includes: the device comprises a moving motor, an eccentric wheel, a jacking sliding plate and a fixed shell, wherein vertical slideways are arranged on two walls of the inner side of the fixed shell, the jacking sliding plate is erected on the vertical slideways, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a central shaft of the eccentric wheel, an eccentric shaft of the eccentric wheel is rotatably connected with a driving end of the jacking sliding plate so as to drive the eccentric wheel to rotate by the moving motor, and therefore the eccentric wheel drags the jacking sliding plate to reciprocate up and down to simulate the fluctuation of the thoracic cavity during respiration.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar heart rate detection method based on multi-sequence WOA-VMD algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wideband radar, and relates to an ultra wideband radar heart rate detection method based on a multi-sequence WOA-VMD algorithm, which is used for acquiring multi-sequence vital sign vectors by utilizing vital sign information carried by reflected echoes of the ultra wideband radar, inhibiting respiratory interference and accurately separating heartbeat signals to obtain heart rate values, and comprises the following steps: the radar transmits pulses in a certain pulse repetition period, and the receiving end samples and records data in a certain time interval; performing clutter suppression, linear trend suppression and signal-to-noise ratio improvement preprocessing on radar echo signals, and calculating a slow time direction data variance to obtain a target position so as to obtain a multi-sequence vital sign vector; and (5) integrating a whale algorithm WOA and a variation modal decomposition algorithm to obtain the heart rate value. The method is mainly applied to occasions for acquiring vital sign information by using ultra-wideband radar.

title_en: Human behavior recognition and vital sign measurement method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human behavior recognition and vital sign measurement method and device, and belongs to the field of deep learning and signal processing. The method comprises the following steps: collecting radar signals and corresponding visual images of human behavior actions; 3DFFT preprocessing is carried out on the radar signals, and a human behavior data set of the radar fusion is constructed; determining a radar data enhancement algorithm to enhance the data set; constructing an end-to-end thunder-vision fused human body behavior recognition model, and training the human body behavior recognition model by adopting an enhanced data set; acquiring the position and behavior action of a human body target according to the trained human body behavior recognition model; and separating the sign parameters according to the position of the human body target, and acquiring and displaying the current action and vital sign analysis result of the human body. According to the invention, the position and the behavior action of the human body target are obtained through the human body behavior recognition model, the vital sign information of each human body is obtained, and a comprehensive health monitoring analysis result is effectively provided for a user.

title_en: Vital sign detection signal denoising method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for denoising vital sign detection signals, which relate to the technical field of physiological perception and signal processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring an original phase signal containing a physiological signal based on a Doppler technology of a millimeter wave radar; performing variational mode decomposition on the original phase signal based on a variational mode decomposition super-parameter search algorithm optimized by a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain vibration mode function information corresponding to the original phase signal; the particle swarm optimization algorithm uses a displacement entropy and a fuzzy entropy as fitness functions; after denoising the vibration mode function, recombining the denoising vibration mode function to obtain a high-precision denoising physiological signal; and extracting respiratory and heartbeat physiological signals from the physiological signals subjected to the high-precision denoising treatment.

title_en: Intermediate frequency signal phase demodulation method under low signal-to-noise ratio condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intermediate frequency signal phase demodulation method under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, which belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar non-contact vital sign detection, and the method reserves key information of a phase signal and provides rich characteristic representation through gram transformation, so that noise components without fixed modes are restrained; the phase demodulation network adopts an asymmetric U-Net structure, so that the complexity of the network is reduced, the signal demodulation precision is not reduced while the low calculation amount is realized, and the introduced SwinTransformer module and dynamic convolution attention module enhance the noise suppression capability and the signal detail capturing capability of the network. The invention has stronger anti-noise performance and accurate phase demodulation effect under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, remarkably reduces the estimated deviation of heart rate in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection, and has wide application prospect in the research of non-contact vital sign detection.

title_en: Emergency management method and system for the elderly using smart band
title_ko: 스마트 밴드를 이용한 노인 대상 응급상황 관리 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Provided are a method and a system for managing an emergency situation for the elderly using a smart band. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: monitoring, by a smart band worn by the elderly, a biosignal and motion information on the elderly; randomly transmitting an emergency call to an adjacent smart device using UWB short-range wireless communication when the smart band determines that a situation is an emergency on the basis of the biometric signal and the motion information; transmitting, by a smart device, a response signal to the emergency call to the smart band using the UWB short-range wireless communication; and transmitting, by the smart band, location information on the smart band to the smart device using the UWB short-range wireless communication. Therefore, a serious accident and a fatal accident of a senior citizen who lives alone can be remarkably reduced.
abstract_ko: 스마트 밴드를 이용한 노인 대상 응급상황 관리 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 이 노인 대상 응급상황 관리 방법은, 노인에게 착용된 스마트 밴드가 노인의 생체신호 및 운동정보를 모니터링하는 단계; 스마트 밴드가 생체신호 및 운동정보를 기반으로 응급상황이라 판단하는 경우, UWB 근거리 무선통신을 사용하여 인접한 스마트 기기에 무작위로 비상호출을 전송하는 단계; 스마트 기기가 UWB 근거리 무선통신을 사용하여 비상호출에 대한 응답신호를 스마트 밴드에 전송하는 단계; 및 스마트 밴드가 UWB 근거리 무선통신을 사용하여 스마트 밴드의 위치정보를 스마트 기기에 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for subject monitoring
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for collecting and analyzing vital sign information to predict a likelihood of a subject having a disease or disorder. In an aspect, a system for monitoring a subject may comprise: sensors comprising an electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor, which sensors are configured to acquire health data comprising vital sign measurements of the subject over a period of time; and a mobile electronic device, comprising: an electronic display; a wireless transceiver; and one or more computer processors configured to (i) receive the health data from the sensors through the wireless transceiver, (ii) process the health data using a trained algorithm to generate an output indicative of a progression or regression of a health condition of the subject over the period of time at a sensitivity of at least about 80%, and (iii) provide the output for display to the subject on the electronic display.

title_en: Contactless biosignal measurement system and method
title_ko: 비접촉식 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a MIMO antenna which transmits or receives an FMCW-type radar signal; a raw data collection unit which stores raw data obtained by sampling, at a rate of N signals per chirp, a plurality of chirp signals that are received by a plurality of reception antennas in response to reflection of radar signals transmitted from a plurality of transmission antennas of the MIMO antenna; a cube generation unit which generates two-dimensional data including data corresponding to an ADC sampling index and a reception antenna (Rx) index from the raw data stored in the raw data collection unit, accumulates the two-dimensional data on a time axis in a chirp period, and converts same into a 3D radar cube; a location measurement unit which obtains angle and distance information by performing range-fast Fourier transformation (RFFT) and digital beamforming on data of the 3D radar cube, and specifies a location of a person by using the angle and distance information; and a biosignal detection unit which obtains a respiratory waveform on the basis of a distance between the person at the location specified by the location measurement unit and the MIMO antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, FMCW 형태의 레이다 신호를 송수신하는 MIMO 안테나; 상기 MIMO 안테나의 복수개의 송신 안테나에서 송신한 레이다 신호가 반사되어 복수개의 수신 안테나에 수신되는 복수개의 첩 신호(chirp signal)를 하나의 첩 당 N개로 샘플링하여 획득한 로데이터(raw data)를 저장하는 로데이터 수집부; 상기 로데이터 수집부에 저장된 로데이터로 ADC 샘플링 인덱스(ADC sample index) 및 수신 안테나 인덱스(Rx index)에 해당하는 데이터로 구성되는 2차원 데이터를 생성하고 첩 주기의 시간 축 상에서 누적하여 3D 레이다 큐브로 변환하는 큐브 생성부; 상기 3D 레이다 큐브의 데이터를 RFFT(Range-Fast Fourier Transform)와 디지털 빔포밍을 수행하여 각도와 거리정보를 획득하고, 각도와 거리정보로 사람의 위치를 특정하는 위치 측정부; 및 상기 위치 측정부에서 특정한 위치의 사람과 상기 MIMO 안테나 사이의 거리를 기반으로 호흡 파형을 획득하는 생체신호 검출부;를 포함하는 것을 일 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Waistband monitoring analysis for a user
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and computer readable mediums for waistband monitoring analysis for a user are provided. In a particular embodiment, a waistband monitoring device is configured to generate a motion pattern based on motion data from a motion sensor coupled to the waistband monitoring device; receive physiological data generated by a physiological sensor coupled to the waistband monitoring device, wherein the physiological data indicates at least one vital sign of the user; identify an activity of the user that corresponds to the motion data and the physiological data; and generate an analysis of the user's performance of the identified activity based on the motion data and the physiological data.

title_en: Targeting abnormal cell populations for apoptosis
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range abnormal cells including senescent and cancerous cells are targeted for apoptosis. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of a senolytic and chemotherapeutic. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: Rescue scene intelligent detection system
abstract_en: The application provides a rescue scene intelligent detection system, which comprises a wireless communication module and an intelligent detection module, wherein the wireless communication module is used for receiving and sending voice, data and video information, and the intelligent detection module comprises an environment sensor, a vital sign detector, a data processing unit and a camera device; the base station equipment is used for receiving and processing voice, data and video signals from the firefighter terminal and comprises fixed base station equipment and mobile base station equipment, wherein the fixed base station equipment is positioned in a command part, and the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the mobile base station equipment, the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the appointed area can be rapidly deployed in a short time through the mobility and the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the communication requirements of different scenes are met, and the high-efficiency communication quality of the fire disaster and the command part is ensured.

title_en: System and method for estimating vital signs
abstract_en: A system for estimating breathing frequency and heartbeat frequency of a subject, comprises at least one ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver, connected to at least one hardware processor, configured to: receive a plurality of readings from the UWB transceiver, each of the readings having a time and comprising a plurality of intensity values at the time, each of the intensity values having a corresponding distance value representing a distance between the UWB transceiver and the subject; determine a Range-Doppler map from the plurality of readings; analyze the Range-Doppler map to determine a breathing frequency value of the subject; perform null steering of a plurality of Doppler-map frequencies in the Range-Doppler map to nullify the breathing frequency value and integer multiples of the breathing frequency value to obtain a plurality of combined frequencies; and determine a heartbeat frequency value for which a plurality of computed frequencies corresponds with the plurality of combined frequencies.

title_en: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for radio-frequency imaging sensors for advanced fingerprint biometrics and medical imaging
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, systems, and implementations of an ultra-compact RF (30 GHz-10 THz) imaging sensor topology that provides a new insight into the human skin are disclosed. The skin tissue is the largest organ in the body—both in weight and surface area—and stores valuable information that can revolutionize security biometrics and mobile health monitoring. The proposed compact sensor enables, for the first time, portable and wearable devices to perform superior biometric authentication compared to current fingerprint methods. Additionally, these devices could probe into the skin to monitor vital signs in real-time and enable mobile health monitoring.

title_en: Handheld live pig vital sign detection equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hand-held type live pig vital sign check out test set based on millimeter wave radar, include: the detector is a main body structure of the device, anti-slip layers for increasing friction force are arranged on the side faces of the detector at equal intervals, and an operation switch is arranged below the right end of the detector and is L-shaped; the base is arranged at the lower end of the detector, and the base is embedded in the limiting frame. This hand-held type live pig vital sign check out test set based on millimeter wave radar stretches into the inside of mount with the hand, tightening band can contract this moment, thereby fix user's hand and device, the user can drive the gasbag with the grip of hand and contract this moment, thereby make the gaseous outflow in the gasbag, will drive turbine blade this moment and rotate, thereby start operating switch, because this moment the device removes along with the arm, and then make user's wrist rest.
assignees: QINGDAO BUCHOUWANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring facilities based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring facilities based on millimeter wave radar, including millimeter wave radar chip, ADC data collection card, RAM random access memory, SD card, DSP chip, MCU, LCD display screen and Zigbee module. The utility model has the advantages that: the data line does not need to be laid, the upper computer does not need to be used, the processing speed is high, and the cost for detecting the vital signs is greatly reduced. The scheme is a circuit structure integrating acquisition, processing and display, realizes high integration of equipment, and is convenient and quick to use; meanwhile, the problem that the data volume is too large and cannot be processed timely can be solved, the privacy leakage problem of the posture monitored by the camera is solved, and the problem that the breathing and the heartbeat are inconvenient to monitor by the wearable device is solved. The result of vital sign monitoring is directly displayed in the integrated circuit instead of the upper computer, so that the monitoring result can be viewed in real time and space.

title_en: Implementation method of wireless sensor network emergency communication system for earthquake disasters
abstract_en: Provided is an implementation method of a wireless sensor network emergency communication system for earthquake disasters. The system is composed of a multifunctional sensing node, a wireless sensor network gateway, system software and terminal software. The multifunctional sensing node is used for collecting human body specific information such as blood oxygen information, pulse information and body temperature information through various probes like a blood oxygen probe, a pulse probe and a body temperature probe and collecting relative geographical location information, then, data are transmitted to a wireless sensor network gateway device through a wireless sensing module, the gateway device transmits the specific data to a terminal device through an infrastructure network in a manner that the gateway device achieves seamless switching between a wireless sensing network and the Ethernet and between the wireless sensing network and the WLAN, and a monitor center can use relative mobile equipment like a PDA and an intelligent cell phone conveniently to monitor vital signs and geographical location information of a trapped person. The system can be applied to earthquake disaster environment actually, reduce life and property losses caused by the earthquake disasters from the perspectives of human, material and financial resources and the like, and provide a real-time monitoring platform for earthquake disaster management and outburst environment monitoring.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearable equipment for firefighter emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearing equipment for firefighter emergency rescue, which comprises a fire fighting AR intelligent helmet and a multifunctional firefighter tactical vest; the implementation method is that the gas concentration detector, the thermal imaging module, the Beidou positioning module, the AR display module, the wireless networking module, the multi-information real-time communication transmission module, the brain wave information monitoring module and the vital sign monitoring module are integrated in the fire-fighting AR intelligent helmet and the multifunctional tactical vest, so that support is provided for the command center to judge the on-site rescue condition and develop scientific command decision. The intelligent sensing and judging system can intelligently sense and judge the environmental temperature, environmental position information, site suffocation, explosion, poisoning accident risk, personnel search and rescue and other information of a disaster accident site before a fireman enters an unknown disaster accident site, can also monitor the psychological, physiological and other vital sign information of the fireman at the same time, and provides site real-time information and rescue command decision basis for rescue command of the accident site.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU DINGJIE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Providing an image unit for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: According to an exemplary aspect of the invention, an imaging unit is provided for life monitoring by a multi-channel radar scanning field of view and a microwave imaging radiometer probing the field of view. The presence of a moving object within the field of view is determined based on the change in phase and/or amplitude of the image elements between scans. The thermal information obtained by the detection or the information determined on the basis of the thermal information is combined with the image unit of the moving object. Thereby, vital signs can be monitored based on the motion and thermal information of the image unit.

title_en: Method and system for detecting change trend of vital signs of patient based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting the change trend of vital signs of a patient based on a microwave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a patient based on a microwave radar; performing trend analysis based on the patient vital sign data, the trend analysis including trend analysis of ascending and descending and trend analysis of variability; and judging whether the result of the trend analysis meets a first preset condition, and if so, giving an alarm. The invention enables medical care personnel to pay attention to the change trend of the vital signs of the patient in time, evaluates the illness state of the patient, and gives corresponding intervention measures as early as possible, thereby avoiding serious adverse outcome caused by delayed discovery of the change of the illness state.

title_en: Vital sign signal monitoring method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign signal monitoring method and a related device, and belongs to the field of intelligent driving. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase expansion on a phase corresponding to each sample frequency point in a plurality of sample frequency points to obtain a plurality of target phases, subtracting every two adjacent target phases in the plurality of target phases according to the time sequence corresponding to the plurality of sample frequency points to obtain a plurality of phase differences, determining radar vital signals based on the plurality of phase differences, and determining vital sign signals based on the radar vital signals. Because the heart fluctuation corresponding to the adjacent time in the heartbeat waveform or the thoracic cavity fluctuation corresponding to the adjacent time in the respiration waveform are related to the phase difference between the two phases corresponding to the adjacent time. Therefore, the radar vital signals determined based on the plurality of phase differences are accurate, so that the vital sign signals can be accurately determined based on the radar vital signals, and the safety of vehicle driving is guaranteed.

title_en: Vital sign detection device, system and data processing method
abstract_en: The vital sign detection device comprises one or more sensors, can detect a plurality of vital sign signals of a person to be detected in a non-contact mode, and outputs a plurality of corresponding vital sign information, so that quick and accurate vital sign detection can be realized. The invention also relates to a multifunctional fusion detection device which comprises a camera, a radar sensor, an infrared sensor and a sensor driver and is used for vital sign measurement. The invention also provides a non-contact blood pressure measurement method and a non-contact blood pressure measurement device. The method comprises the steps of receiving radar echo and video signal streams from a first part and a second part, extracting a first pulse wave signal and a second pulse wave signal from the radar echo and video signal streams to obtain actual measurement pulse wave transmission time, and matching the actual measurement pulse wave transmission time with reference pulse wave transmission time to obtain a blood pressure value.
assignees: NAT UNIV SINGAPORE;NUS SUZHOU RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Ground penetrating radar inversion method, device, equipment and medium based on semantic segmentation
abstract_en: The application discloses a ground penetrating radar inversion method, device, equipment and medium based on semantic segmentation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial simulation image data of forward modeling of a ground penetrating radar scatterer, and preprocessing the initial simulation image data to obtain optimized simulation image data; constructing a ground penetrating radar scatterer inversion model based on semantic segmentation; inputting the optimized simulation image data into a ground penetrating radar scatterer inversion model based on semantic segmentation to obtain a predicted scatterer dielectric constant and a predicted scatterer mask; and obtaining the dielectric constant of the real scatterer and the real scatterer mask, calculating the difference between the dielectric constant of the predicted scatterer and the dielectric constant of the real scatterer and the difference between the predicted scatterer mask and the real scatterer mask through a preset loss function and a preset evaluation index, and training a ground penetrating radar scatterer inversion model based on semantic segmentation. According to the application, the interpretation precision and efficiency of the underground buried scatterer are improved by constructing the inversion model of the ground penetrating radar scatterer based on semantic segmentation.
assignees: XINJIANG HUIER ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD;UNIV XINJIANG AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Training method of heartbeat detection model and heartbeat interval detection method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a training method of a heartbeat detection model and a heartbeat interval detection method, which can be applied to the technical field of radar signal processing. The method comprises the steps of determining signal quality of a plurality of sample echo signals based on signal characteristics of the plurality of sample echo signals, wherein the plurality of sample echo signals are obtained by detecting a plurality of positions to be detected of a sample object by using a sample radar signal, determining a target echo signal from the plurality of sample echo signals based on the signal quality of the sample echo signals, detecting a heartbeat interval of the target echo signal by using a preset heartbeat detection algorithm to obtain a tag signal, and training an initial heartbeat detection model by using the tag signal and the plurality of sample echo signals to obtain a target heartbeat detection model.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Ground subsidence measuring apparatus and system using for the same
title_ko: 침하량 계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 침하량 계측시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A ground subsidence measuring apparatus and a system with the same are provided to reduce a responding time to the abnormal occurrence. CONSTITUTION: A ground subsidence measuring apparatus comprises a main body(60), a hinge binding site(70), a connecting member(72) and a tilt sensor. The main body is equipped in a pile among several piles buried under the ground. The hinge binding site is hinge-coupled in the main body and is circulated around the main body. The connecting member connects the hinge binding site to the piles. The tilt sensor measures the slope variation of the hinge binding site using the swinging of the hinge binding site around the pile.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중의 침하량을 계측하여 지중의 침하로 인한 재해를 예방하기 위한 침하량 계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 침하량 계측시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히 본 발명은 지중에 매설된 복수의 파일 중 어느 하나의 파일에 장착되는 본체; 상기 본체에 대하여 회동될 수 있도록 상기 본체에 힌지 결합되는 힌지결합부; 상기 힌지결합부를 상기 복수의 파일 중 또 다른 파일에 연결하는 연결부재; 상기 파일에 대한 상기 힌지결합부의 회동에 의한 상기 힌지결합부의 기울기 변화를 계측하는 기울기 센서;를 포함하는 침하량 계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 침하량 계측시스템에 관한 것으로서, 지중의 침하 이상징후 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
       
     침하, 침하량 계측, 기울기 변화, 기울기 센서

title_en: Breath measurement system based on x-band doppler radar
title_ko: 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A respiration measurement system capable of using an X-band Doppler radar is provided to use a DFD(Dual Frequency Differential) method, thereby facilitating the measurement. CONSTITUTION: A transceiver process unit(120) obtains a bio-signal from a patient. An antenna unit propagates a frequency to the patient. An amplifier(130) amplifies the size of the bio-signal. A TCP IP transmission unit(140) transmits bio-signal to a respiration analysis equipment. A noise elimination filter unit removes the noise of the bio-signal. [Reference numerals] (110) X-Band antenna unit; (120) Transceiver process unit; (130) Amplifier; (140) TCP/IP transmission unit
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 사람의 심장부에 RF 신호를 방사하여 생체 신호를 검출하여 원격으로 호흡을 측정하는 바이오 레이더 시스템으로 신체에 부착하지 않은 상태에서 호흡을 측정하며, 측정된 호흡 정보를 관제모니터링수단에서 실시간으로 저장하고 관리하여 미리 설정된 경고/위험수준에 도달하면 알람을 발생시키고, 해당 호흡값 정보를 환자이력관리부에 저장 관리하는 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통해 사람의 심장부에 RF 신호를 방사하여 생체 신호를 검출하여 원격으로 호흡을 측정하는 바이오 레이더 시스템으로 신체에 부착하지 않은 상태에서 호흡을 측정할 수 있게 되어 중환자 혹은 상시 호흡 측정이나 모니터링이 필요한 환자를 대상으로 실시간 호흡수 측정이 가능한 효과를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Rader module for detecting and measuring vital sign
title_ko: 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar module for detection and measurement of biological signals, and more specifically, to a radar module for detection and measurement of biological signals, where an electronic component mount area and an antenna area are arranged on a single printed circuit board and the interference of a side robe on the antenna area is reduced. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the radar module includes a board including a mount area for mounting electronic components on the front surface and first and second antenna areas arranged on the left and right sides of the mount area. The board includes through-holes penetrating in a vertical direction between the mount area and the first antenna area and between the mount area and the second antenna area. The through-holes contact an antenna pattern crossing the mount area in a horizontal direction. A radio frequency (RF) bushing connector is inserted into the through-holes.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈에 관한 것이며, 보다 상세하게는 전자 부품의 실장 영역과 안테나 영역이 하나의 인쇄회로기판에 구비되며, 안테나 영역에 유발되는 사이드 로브에 의한 간섭 효과가 완화된 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈은 전면에 전자 부품들을 실장하기 위한 실장 영역과 상기 실장 영역의 좌측 및 우측에 각각 구비된 제1 안테나 영역 및 제2 안테나 영역; 구비된 기판을 포함하되, 상기 실장 영역과 상기 제1 안테나 영역 사이 및 상기 실장 영역과 상기 제2 안테나 영역 사이에 상기 기판을 수직 방향으로 관통하는 관통구를 포함하며, 상기 관통구는 상기 실장 영역을 수평 방향으로 가로지르는 안테나 패턴과 맞닿으며, 상기 관통구에는 RF 부싱 커넥터가 삽입된 구조를 취할 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic device for obtaining biometric signal and method of operating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호를 획득하는 전자 장치와 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device comprises: a sensor module; a first electrode unit connected to a first channel of the sensor module; a second electrode unit connected to a second channel of the sensor module; and a processor. The processor measures first impedance between the first electrode unit and a first part of a body of a user in contact with the first electrode unit and second impedance between the second electrode unit and a second part of the body of the user in contact with the second electrode unit through the sensor module, adjusts the impedance corresponding to each of the first channel and the second channel to satisfy a range in which a difference between the first impedance and the second impedance is predetermined based on the first impedance and the second impedance through the sensor module, and is set to obtain a biometric signal of the user in a state in which the impedance of the first channel and the second channel is adjusted through the sensor module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 센서 모듈, 상기 센서 모듈의 제1채널과 연결된 제1전극부, 상기 센서 모듈의 제2채널과 연결된 제2전극부, 및 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1전극부와 상기 제1전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제1부분 사이의 제1임피던스와, 상기 제2전극부와 상기 제2전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제2부분 사이의 제2임피던스를 측정하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1임피던스와 상기 제2임피던스에 기초하여 상기 제1임피던스 및 상기 제2임피던스의 차이가 지정된 범위를 만족하도록 상기 제1채널과 상기 제2채널 각각에 대응하는 임피던스를 조절하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1채널 및 상기 제2채널의 임피던스가 조절된 상태에서, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 획득하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Motion sickness reduction method and system
title_ko: 멀미 저감 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 이동 장치에 탑승한 탑승자의 멀미 저감 방법에 있어서, 생체센서를 통해 상기 탑승자의 생체 신호를 측정하고; 상기 이동 장치의 센서로부터 상기 이동 장치의 거동 신호를 획득하며; 상기 측정한 생체 신호 및 상기 획득한 거동 신호를 딥러닝 모델을 포함하는 프로세서에 입력하고; 상기 프로세서를 통해, 상기 입력된 거동 신호를 구간 단위로 분할(Epoching)하며, 상기 입력된 생체 신호를 레이블링(Labeling)하고; 상기 분할된 거동 신호 및 상기 레이블링된 생체 신호를 융합하여 특성값을 추출하며; 상기 추출된 특성값을 기초로 상기 탑승자의 멀미 상태를 예측하여 상기 이동 장치를 제어하는 멀미 저감 방법은, 이동 장치에 탑승한 탑승자의 멀미 상태를 딥러닝 모델에 기반하여 예측의 신뢰도를 높이면서 보다 효과적으로 이동 장치를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Search system and method for searching for a buried person
abstract_en: The system (10) has a radio device (R) comprising a receiving device with a receiving antenna (12) for receiving field of a transmitter antenna. The radio device determines direction of a field vector of the transmitter antenna relative to the receiving antenna. A user interface device (UI) interfaces with the radio device and has an output device (16) for outputting search information. The radio and interface devices are formed as separate units and accommodated by respective housings. Position sensors (18a, 18b) determine relative orientation of the interface device to the radio device. An independent claim is also included for a method for searching buried persons.

title_en: Ground-penetrating radar device and method for same
abstract_en: Provided are a ground-penetrating radar device and a method for the same, capable of surveying a buried object with a single scan, and without the need to exchange a transmission and reception antenna in accordance with the width of a road. A ground-penetrating radar device 100 provided with a transmission array antenna 30 and a reception array antenna 40 is provided with a position varying mechanism 20 capable of varying spacings between antenna elements in each of the transmission array antenna 30 and the reception array antenna 40 while making all of said spacings equal, wherein the position varying mechanism 20 is provided with a drive unit, a plurality of crossbars forming bellows, and a plurality of linking portions linking troughs and peaks of the bellows in such a way that angles of inclination thereof can be varied.

title_en: Bio-monitoring and care system for care service for elderly person living alone
title_ko: 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 위한 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio-monitoring and care system for providing a care service for an elderly person living alone. The disclosed bio-monitoring and care system comprises: a bio-signal measurement device which measures a movement path according to a dynamic state of an elderly person living alone in a predetermined space by using an FMCW radar, and measures a bio-signal in a static state of the elderly person living alone, so as to analyze the bio-signal measured in the static state of the elderly person living alone, and then transmits a resulting signal according to the analysis of the bio-signal through a communication network; a server which stores a bio-signal and a signal related to the movement path measured by the bio-signal measurement device and provides the signal related to the movement path to the side of a management unit according to a request of the management unit; and the management unit which selectively provides a care service for the elderly person living alone as the resulting signal is received from the bio-signal measurement device through the communication network.
abstract_ko: 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 제공하기 위한 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템이 개시된다. 개시되는 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템은, FMCW 레이더를 이용하여 소정의 공간 내에서의 독거 노인의 동적 상태에 따른 동선을 측정하고 상기 독거 노인의 정적 상태에서의 생체 신호를 측정하여 상기 독거 노인의 정적 상태에서 측정된 생체 신호를 분석한 후, 상기 생체 신호의 분석에 따른 결과 신호를 통신 네트워크를 통해 전송하기 위한, 생체 신호 측정 장치와, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치에 의해 측정된 동선에 관한 신호 및 생체 신호를 저장하고 상기 관리부의 요청에 따라 상기 동선에 관한 신호를 상기 관리부 측으로 제공하는 서버와, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치로부터 상기 결과 신호를 상기 통신 네트워크를 통해 수신함에 따라 선택적으로 상기 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 제공하는 관리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Bio-signal detection apparatus, operating method of bio-signal detection apparatus, and user terminal comprising bio-signal detection apparatus
title_ko: 생체 신호 감지 장치, 생체 신호 감지 장치의 동작 방법 및 이를 포함하는 사용자 단말
abstract_en: A bio-signal detection apparatus according to disclosed embodiments may comprise: a sensor unit including a plurality of electrodes that obtain bio-signals; a memory including one or more instructions; and one or more processors. The one or more processors according to an embodiment may execute the one or more instructions to determine the time at which arbitrary electrodes of the plurality of electrodes obtain bio-signals. The one or more processors according to an embodiment may determine the variability of the bio-signals obtained by the arbitrary electrodes. The one or more processors according to an embodiment may determine an arrangement of the arbitrary electrodes when the time at which the arbitrary electrodes obtain the bio-signals and the variability of the obtained bio-signals meet predetermined criteria, and may learn the determined arrangement of the electrodes.
abstract_ko: 개시된 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 감지 장치는 생체 신호를 획득하는 복수의 전극들을 포함하는 센서부, 하나 이상의 인스트럭션을 포함하는 메모리 및 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 일 실시예에 따른 하나 이상의 프로세서는 하나 이상의 인스트럭션을 실행하여, 복수의 전극들을 중 임의의 전극들이 생체 신호를 획득하는 시간을 판단할 수 있다. 일 실시예에 따른 하나 이상의 프로세서는 임의의 전극들이 획득한 생체 신호의 변동성을 판단할 수 있다. 일 실시예에 따른 하나 이상의 프로세서는 임의의 전극들이 생체 신호를 획득하는 시간 및 획득된 생체 신호의 변동성이 미리 정해진 기준을 만족하면, 임의의 전극들의 배치를 결정하고, 결정된 전극들의 배치를 학습할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: Systems and methods for mapping manmade objects buried in subterranean surfaces using an unmanned aerial vehicle integrated with radar sensor equipment
abstract_en: A method for mapping an object buried in a subterranean surface includes receiving a first input data set. The first input data set is based on a GNSS signal, a SAR signal, and a GPR signal. The method further includes generating a raw image based on the first input data set, comparing the raw image to a calibration data set, identifying an object based on the raw image compared to the calibration data set, transmitting object data to a ground-based post-processing unit, and displaying the object data to a graphic user interface. The calibration data set may be based on material calibration data. The object data may be based on the object identified.

title_en: EMD-based adaptive through-wall radar static human body target positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an EMD-based adaptive through-wall radar static human body target positioning method, relates to a through-wall radar technology, and particularly relates to a through-wall radar static target detection and positioning technology. The invention provides a static target positioning algorithm suitable for an MIMO through-the-wall radar. Carrying out fast time dimension Fourier transform on the received multi-period data to obtain a multi-period range profile; decomposing the multi-period distance image into a plurality of column vectors according to the distance units, and processing the data of each column vector by using an EMD algorithm; and transforming each processed range image into a frequency domain through slow time dimension Fourier transform, and adaptively selecting the range image containing target information. And finally, rapidly imaging by using a BP imaging algorithm, and further inhibiting noise and clutter by combining a PCF algorithm.
