The invention has high positioning precision and the capability of self-adaptively processing data, and can be directly applied to through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Smart home device using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring for contactless human interactions and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. Radar chirps may be output by a radar sensor operating in a burst mode. The burst mode radar data stream may be monitored for a contactless human interaction performed by an active user. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. Health monitoring of an inactive user may be performed using the virtual continuous mode radar data stream.

title_en: Portable non-contact vital signal detection device, driver monitoring device, visitor screening system, and home healthcare system
abstract_en: A vital signal detection device includes: an antenna unit provided with a planar antenna of a MIMO radar on a front surface; and a display unit including a display panel on the front surface. The antenna unit is combined with the display unit or the display unit is combined with the antenna unit in a rotatable manner so that, from a state where the planar antenna and the display panel face in a direction ahead of the front surface, the planar antenna is turned to be directed to a direction of a back surface of the display unit opposite from the display panel. The portable non-contact vital signal detection device detects a vital signal on a side ahead of the front surface and a vital signal on a side in the direction of the back surface opposite from the front surface.

title_en: Method for determining the position and vital parameters of an occupant of a transportation vehicle and transportation vehicle
abstract_en: A method for determining the position and vital signs of an occupant of a transportation vehicle and a transportation vehicle having a radio system and a control unit connected to the radio system. The method is based on channel impulse response (CIR) measurements and is performed using at least two UWB antennas during the operation of the transportation vehicle to determine a position and a vital sign of one or more occupants of the transportation vehicle.

title_en: Fire-fighting search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fire-fighting search and rescue robot, it comprises base, hose reel, controller and search and rescue main body, is provided with road wheel at base bottom, is provided with controller, rotates the search and rescue main body of hose reel and the split setting arranged in base top; Temperature sensor and life-detection instrument is provided with in search and rescue body front end; Search and rescue main body wall is provided with water cannon; Searching and rescuing, body top is provided with The Cloud Terrace, the electric-controlled mechanical arm of lower the temperature shower nozzle and rotation setting.Advantage: structure is simple, and cost is low; Search and rescue body volume is little, and action is convenient; Fire-fighting robot obtains water source by fire hose and carries out high-pressure extinction to different burning things which may cause a fire disaster from the scene of a fire, and fire-fighting efficiency is high; Controller is connected with search and rescue main body by flexible cable, and stable signal transmission, can manipulate search and rescue main body accurately; Robot body carries apparatus of oxygen supply, provides oxygen can to dyspneic trapped personnel; In addition, robot also carries extinguishing device, contributes to trapped personnel and carries out saving oneself or waiting for rescue.

title_en: A kind of implementation method of the ultra-broadband wall-through radar imagery algorithm based on FPGA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of implementation method of the ultra-broadband wall-through radar imagery algorithm based on FPGA, through-wall radar aerial array is placed at a certain distance from wall, analysis through-wall radar electromagnetic wave imaging path, time delay is solved according to approximate through-wall radar electromagnetic wave imaging path, and time delay is compensated for, simplify time delay solving complexity；The substantial amounts of quadratic sum extracting operation in Delay is realized using cordic algorithm, image taking speed is significantly improved；By realizing through-wall radar back-projection algorithm on FPGA, the practicality of algorithm is improve.The method of the present invention reduces the complexity of through-wall imaging radar calculating, improves image taking speed.

title_en: Image biological physiological signal pairing method and physiological signal pairing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physiological signal matching method of an image organism, which can correctly match a plurality of vital signs contained in a physiological signal measured by a radar to each organism in an image by matching the image auxiliary physiological signal captured by an image capturing device, thereby continuously tracking the vital signs of the plurality of organisms.

title_en: Sewage pipe positioning device based on buoy signal enhancement and dynamic detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage pipe positioning device based on buoy signal enhancement and dynamic detection. Comprises a measuring rod (3), a buoy roll (12) for placing a buoy (5), and a geological radar (6) placed on the ground (7). This device can fix a position the outer sewage pipe of well room, surveys reinforcing sewage pipe signal through metal buoy and developments, improves the detection ability of geological radar to the target body, improves the detection degree of depth, can realize the accurate positioning to ageing sewage pipe and big buried depth sewage pipe, fills the blank field of an underground pipeline detection trade, surveys the technical regulation "CJJ 61" for city underground pipeline and becomes more meticulous underground pipeline and surveys or complicated underground pipeline and provide the trade standard.
assignees: XUZHOU SURVEY AND MAPPING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Portable vital sign monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable vital sign monitoring device, which comprises a radar sign detection module, a camera auxiliary positioning module, a cardio-pulmonary health evaluation and display early warning module and an operation environment monitoring module, wherein the radar sign detection module is used for transmitting electromagnetic waves and receiving echo signals and judging the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of a person according to the echo signals, the camera auxiliary positioning module realizes target positioning operation, the cardio-pulmonary health evaluation and display early warning module further processes and analyzes the heartbeat and respiratory information separated by the radar sign detection module to provide reference for judging the health of cardio-pulmonary functions, and the operation environment monitoring module is used for judging the air quality of an operation environment and early warning and displaying dangerous conditions. The device can be used for monitoring vital signs of soldiers, disaster relief personnel and injured people in the scenes of battlefields, disaster areas and the like, can be used for monitoring the vital signs of the soldiers, the disaster relief personnel and the injured people, can also be used for monitoring the vital signs of surrounding people, has a sign abnormal alarm signal and guides rescue work.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar self-adaptive transmitting power optimization method for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave radar self-adaptive transmitting power optimization method for vital sign monitoring, which comprises the steps of adopting an FMCW-MIMO radar to monitor vital signs of a human body, processing echo signals reflected by the human body of each frame corresponding to each frame of transmitting signals to obtain discrete echo signals, preprocessing the discrete echo signals, estimating target distance, speed and arrival angle by adopting CFAR detection, carrying out receiving end beam forming on the received signals according to the target arrival angle, carrying out phase extraction according to a range gate where the target distance is located, carrying out band-pass filtering on the extracted phase, extracting vital sign signals including respiration and heart rate, estimating signal power in an arrival angle area according to the arrival angle of the data of the previous frame, and carrying out self-adaptive adjustment on the transmitting power of the radar of the next frame so that the power of the echo signals reflected by the human body corresponding to the frame meets the power requirement of CFAR detection. The invention realizes low-radiation and high-precision human vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement interference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement interference, which comprises the steps of firstly positioning a human body target, obtaining a recovered human body vital sign signal through a SARIMA model, finally carrying out first-order difference on the recovered human body vital sign signal to remove phase drift, and decomposing the signal into a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal through different band-pass filters after removing impulse noise and moving average filtering, wherein the heartbeat signal is required to pass through a band-stop filter to remove respiratory harmonics; finally, respectively carrying out fast Fourier transform on the respiration signal and the heartbeat signal, extracting peak frequency and converting the peak frequency into corresponding respiration rate and heart rate; according to the invention, non-contact detection is realized by utilizing the millimeter wave radar, so that the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a human body are obtained, meanwhile, the position of the human body is dynamically detected, and the SARIMA model is used for recovering vital sign signals interfered by the movement of the human body, so that the measurement error is reduced.

title_en: Lightweight millimeter wave radar child age classification method based on feature engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight millimeter wave radar child age classification method based on feature engineering, which comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave radar vital sign data sets containing a plurality of children with different ages, extracting respiratory signals, calculating a plurality of candidate features from the respiratory signals, constructing a candidate feature set, screening key feature subsets for child age classification from the candidate feature set, training a lightweight machine learning model to obtain a child age classification model, processing input millimeter wave radar signals, and outputting child age classification results. The invention has the beneficial effects that the calculation complexity and the storage cost of the model are obviously reduced, so that the high-precision child age classification model can be efficiently operated on an embedded platform with limited resources.

title_en: Management and control method and system for vital sign monitoring sickbed
abstract_en: The invention relates to a management and control method and a management and control system for a vital sign monitoring sickbed. The utility model provides a vital sign monitoring sick bed's management and control system includes millimeter radar wave module, body temperature detection module, blood pressure monitoring module, data processing module, wireless communication module and alarm module, millimeter radar wave module's data transmission end is connected with data processing module first input, body temperature detection module's output is connected with data processing module second input, blood pressure monitoring module is connected with data processing module's third input, data processing module's output is connected with wireless communication module's input, alarm module is connected with data processing module's output. The invention has the effect of improving the medical response efficiency.
assignees: XIAMEN SHITUO MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electronic apparatus and method for monitoring sleep
title_ko: 전자 장치 및 전자 장치에서 수면 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device includes: a motion sensor sensing the movement of the electronic device; a bio sensor sensing bio signals; and a processor calculating an intensity of the movement of the electronic device, determining whether a user wears the electronic device or not by activating the bio sensor if a change in the intensity of the movement during at least two sections corresponds to a preset pattern, and controlling to the electronic device to monitor a sleep when it is determined that the user wears the electronic device. Above and beyond these, various other embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시 예들에 따르면 전자 장치에 있어서, 상기 전자 장치의 움직임을 감지하는 움직임 센서; 생체 신호를 감지하는 생체 센서; 및 미리 설정된 구간 별로 상기 움직임 센서 출력값과 미리 설정된 값을 비교하여 상기 전자 장치의 움직임 강도를 계산하고, 적어도 두 개 이상의 구간들 간의 움직임 강도의 변화가 미리 설정된 패턴에 대응되는 경우, 상기 생체 센서를 활성화시켜 상기 전자 장치의 착용 여부를 판단하여, 착용 상태이면 수면 모니터링을 수행하도록 제어하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있으며, 이외에도 다양한 다른 실시 예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Driving Prediction and Safety Driving System Based on Judgment of Driver Emergency Situation of Autonomous Driving Vehicle
title_ko: 자율주행차량의 운전자 응급상황발생판단에 기반한 주행예측 및 안전주행시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a driving prediction system of an autonomous vehicle. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the driving prediction system of an autonomous vehicle comprises: an acceleration control module to sense a vehicle adjacent to a driving vehicle, and adjust a speed and a speed change rate in accordance with a distance from adjacent vehicles; a safe driving module to generate accident risk information and collision prediction information in accordance with location information and a road situation of a region where the driving vehicle is located; a route generation module to generate a driving route based on traffic information for each region and input information of a destination and a current location of the driving vehicle; and a driving prediction module to recognize a front vehicle, a rear vehicle, and a surrounding object driving on an adjacent lane, receive a driving signal and driving route information transmitted from the surrounding object and sense the speed of the surrounding object to predict driving of surrounding objects, and adjust autonomous driving of the vehicle in accordance with predicted driving information. The driving prediction module identifies a driver biosignal including a breathing cycle of a driver from a biosignal sensor installed in the vehicle to determine an occurrence of an emergency situation, and automatically switches to a safe driving mode if the emergency situation is determined to have occurred.
abstract_ko: 자율주행차량의 주행예측시스템을 개시한다. 실시예에 따른 주행예측시스템은 자율주행차량의 주행예측시스템에 있어서, 주행하는 차량에 인접한 차량을 감지하고, 인접 차량들과의 거리에 따라 속도 및 속도 변화량을 조정하는 가속제어모듈; 주행중인 차량이 위치한 지역의 도로상황과 위치 정보에 따라 충돌 예측정보 및 사고위험정보를 생성하는 안전주행모듈; 주행차량의 현재 위치와 목적지 입력정보, 지역별 교통 정보를 기반으로 주행경로를 생성하는 경로생성모듈; 및 전방차량, 후방차량 및 인접한 차선을 주행하는 주변객체를 인식하고, 주변객체에서 전송하는 운전신호와 주행경로정보를 수신하고 주변객체의 속도를 감지하여 주변객체들의 주행을 예측하고, 예측된 주행정보에 따라 차량의 자율주행을 조정하는 주행예측모듈; 을 포함하고, 주행예측모듈은 차량 내부에 설치된 생체신호 감지 센서로부터 운전자의 호흡주기를 포함하는 운전자생체 신호를 파악하여 응급상황 발생여부를 판단하고, 응급상황이 발생된 것으로 파악한 경우, 안전주행모드로 자동전환 한다.

title_en: Intelligent detection of buried ieds
abstract_en: A surveillance system includes a multi-propeller aircraft having a main propeller and a plurality of wing unit propellers; a housing that houses the main propeller and the wing unit propellers; an optical video camera; an ultra-wideband (UWB) radar imaging system; a control system for controlling flight of the multi-propeller aircraft from a remote location; and a telemetry system for providing information from the optical camera and the ultra-wideband (UWB) radar imaging system to a remote location.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting abnormal respiration
abstract_en: An abnormal respiration detection apparatus includes a sensor for sensing a PPG signal from an optical signal reflected and received from a user's body; a band pass filter for extracting a signal of a required band from the PPG signal; an analog-to-digital converter for performing a digital conversion on the filtered PPG signal; and an abnormal respiration recognition unit deriving a respiration rate signal from the digital-converted PPG signal, deriving a plurality of respiration rate characteristic values through a time axis analysis on the derived respiration rate signal, and detecting an abnormal respiration using the derived plurality of respiration rate characteristic values. The embodiments can be utilized to monitor the survival of elders who live alone, soldiers isolated in a military operation, persons isolated in disaster and accident sites, thereby contributing to public and social safety and building of welfare society and nation.

title_en: Precise infrastructure mapping using full-waveform inversion of ground penetrating radar signals
abstract_en: A new system and method for FWI of common-offset GPR data, particularly targeting the dimensions and infilling material of buried objects. The method is useful in situations where clear isolated diffraction hyperbolas indicate the presence of an underground object, but the object's dimensions and filling may be unknown. The present invention acquires GPR data and applies advanced numerical methods to get the depth and size of the underground object in a very accurate manner. An embodiment of the invention includes five main steps: GPR data processing, ray-based analysis to set a good initial model, 3D to 2D transformation of data, effective SW estimation, and FWI.

title_en: A kind of detection method that the two-dimentional CA-CFAR human bodies based on omnidirectional's bioradar are moved with body
abstract_en: The detection method that the invention discloses a kind of two-dimentional CA CFAR human bodies based on omnidirectional's bioradar are moved with body, the human body in stronger moving-target interference environment is detected using bioradar to move to realize the detection and identification of survival target with body, and new approaches are provided for radar detection survival target；Two Dimensional Thresholding using channel internal reference background and context with reference to background as two dimension CA CFAR technologies carries out comprehensive analysis and judgement to omnidirectional's four-way bioradar signal, realizing to be alarmed by the rustling of leaves to open air waits the human body under moving-targets disturbed condition with body is dynamic accurately detect and identify, requirement of the life detection radar to search and rescue environment is effectively reduced, search efficiency is improved.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A non-contact vital sign detection system and method, the non-contact vital sign detection system has radar that locates near person under test, the non-contact vital sign detection system includes the data buffer, store a plurality of output signals of radar sampled sequentially in the predetermined period; the state classifier determines the state of the person to be tested according to the output signal; and the vital sign detector is used for obtaining the vital signs of the person to be detected according to the output signal when the person to be detected is in a static state.

title_en: Human body static target acceleration detection method for impulse type through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body static target acceleration detection method for impulse type through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: eliminating background clutter, namely eliminating the background clutter generated by a completely static target in an echo; step S2: adaptive compensation, namely compensating the influence generated by medium mutation in the electromagnetic wave propagation path; step S3: compensating the energy attenuation of the electromagnetic wave along with the change of the propagation distance so as to meet the requirement of constant false alarm during target detection; step S4: selecting a proper window in the fast and slow time directions, and performing sliding window point taking operation along the fast time direction; step S5: and (6) performing Fourier transform on the data obtained by the sliding window in the step (S4), detecting a respiratory thoracic cavity movement frequency signal of the human body in a frequency domain, judging whether a human body target exists in a detection area and accurately positioning. The invention has the advantages of simple principle, easy realization, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body feature detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: Method and system for rapidly detecting through-wall radar target by frequency modulation continuous wave signal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for quickly detecting a through-wall radar target by using a frequency modulation continuous wave signal system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving each frame of transmission information transmitted by an FMCW receiver according to a set frequency by adopting a zero intermediate frequency de-frequency modulation mode to obtain a corresponding beat signal; acquiring echo range images corresponding to the beat signals respectively according to the obtained beat signals; carrying out difference on any two adjacent frames of echo range images to obtain a sequence of differential range images; screening out a differential distance image meeting a first preset condition; performing Fourier transform on the complex scattering value at the corresponding distance of the differential distance image meeting a first preset condition along the sequence direction to obtain a function of the complex scattering value after Fourier transform; and calculating function value points of the complex scattering values after Fourier transform meeting a second preset condition along the sequence direction aiming at the functions of the complex scattering values after Fourier transform, and taking the distance positions corresponding to the function value points meeting the second preset condition as effective targets.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection system based on handheld display and control terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of life detection and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection system based on a handheld display control terminal, which comprises a sensor group, a sensor control module and a control module, wherein the sensor group is used for collecting vital sign signals and environmental parameters and comprises a thermal infrared imager, an audio vibration sensor, a radar wave detector and an environmental sensor; the data processing module is connected with the sensor group and is used for carrying out noise filtering and feature extraction on the data acquired by the sensor group. The application adopts the multi-sensor collaborative detection and data fusion technology, and achieves the technical effect of detecting vital signs in real time and accurately in a complex environment. Compared with the detection method of a single sensor in the prior art, the method can be used for carrying out complementation and fusion on the data of a plurality of sensors on a disaster site, so that the reliability and the accuracy of detection are obviously improved, and the problem of detection blind areas of the traditional method under the conditions of environmental noise and interference is solved.

title_en: Bio-metric signal measuring apparatus using sensors and method of performing there of
title_ko: 복수의 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 복수의 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 장치는 생체 신호 측정 대상의 모션을 센싱하고, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치가 상기 생체 신호 측정 대상의 피부에 접촉되었는지 여부를 센싱하는 복수의 센서, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서의 센싱 값을 피부 접촉 신호로 변환하여 제1 접촉 상태를 감지한 후 제1 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 생성하는 제1 ADC, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서의 센싱 값을 피부 접촉 신호로 변환하여 제2 접촉 상태를 감지한 후 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 생성하는 제2 ADC, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제1 센서의 센싱 값을 이용하여 특정 패턴이 감지되었는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 판단 결과에 따라 상기 제1 ADC의 상태를 활성화 상태로 변경하기 위한 활성화 명령을 제1 ADC에 제공하고, 상기 제1 ADC로부터 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 수신하면 상기 제1 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 기초로 상기 제2 ADC 상태를 활성화 상태로 변경하기 위한 활성화 명령을 상기 제2 ADC에 제공하는 제1 제어부 및 상기 제2 ADC로부터 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 수신하면 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과에 따라 상기 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서를 통해 생체 전위차를 측정하는 제2 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart diffuser with directional antenna-based non-contact bio-signal measurement function
title_ko: 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 실내 위치, 생체신호 측정을 통한 거주자의 생활패턴 및 공간별 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능하고, 지향성을 가지도록 하여 정확도 높은 센서데이터의 취득이 가능한 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 위치를 실시간으로 추적 및 활동량을 분석하고, 이에 따른 주거 공간별로 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 장점이 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에 따른 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 호흡수 및 심박수를 실시간 측정함으로써 응급상황 발생 여부를 확인 및 신속한 후속조치가 가능하고, 거주자의 활동패턴 및 생체신호 분석을 통해 침입자 인식이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Respiration and heartbeat detection method, system and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a breath and heartbeat detection method, a system and a device based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a radar echo signal, and acquiring object distance and phase information based on the mixture of the radar echo signal and a transmitting signal; enhancing the phase information to obtain enhanced phase information; wavelet packet decomposition is carried out on the enhanced phase information, a respiratory signal is reconstructed based on the decomposed low-frequency component, and a heartbeat signal is reconstructed based on the decomposed high-frequency component; performing physiological rate reconstruction on the reconstructed respiration signal and the reconstructed heartbeat signal; constructing a loss function based on the reconstructed respiration signal, the reconstructed heartbeat signal and the sensing matrix, and introducing a sparse penalty item and a self-adaptive factor into the loss function to realize the reconstruction of the physiological rate. The scheme can effectively eliminate the influence caused by multipath effect in the environment, improves the signal to noise ratio, overcomes the interference caused by movement with different intensities, and realizes accurate detection of the respiratory heartbeat.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring system based on optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring system based on optical fiber sensing, which comprises an optical fiber sensor and a plurality of optical transmitters which are in communication connection with the optical fiber sensor, wherein the optical transmitters are communicated with each other through communication optical fibers and form a monitoring network, and the optical transmitters are respectively connected to a monitoring center; the optical fiber sensor is buried in the area to be monitored in an M shape, and a plurality of acquisition ends are connected along the extending direction of the sensor optical fiber; the optical transmitter receives the electric signal of the optical fiber sensor and outputs an optical signal; the monitoring center receives the multipath optical signals sent by the plurality of optical transmitters and performs data processing.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY

title_en: Sign measurement system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave radar-based sign measurement system which can accurately extract and measure vital sign signals of human bodies in different directions. The invention carries out human vital sign measurement based on the linear frequency modulation continuous millimeter wave radar, provides a dynamic circle center tracking algorithm aiming at the DC offset existing in the I/Q two paths of signals, determines the existing DC offset, further corrects the I/Q two paths, removes the DC component and reduces the phase estimation error caused by the DC offset; the multi-channel signal is realized by using the MIMO virtual aperture technology, the distance-azimuth image is constructed, and the interference in other directions is further suppressed by using the self-adaptive beam forming technology, so that the existence azimuth of the human body is determined, and the accurate extraction and measurement of the vital sign signals of the human body in different azimuth are realized.
assignees: BIT RACO ELECTRONIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heartbeat breath detection method based on radar signal and related device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of signal detection, and discloses a heartbeat and respiration detection method based on radar signals and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an echo signal of a radar, and generating an echo sequence phase; according to a preset phase unwrapping algorithm, unwrapping the echo sequence phase to generate an unwrapped sequence phase; performing median filtering processing on the unwrapped sequence phase based on the average value of the unwrapped sequence phase to generate a filtered sequence phase; according to a preset FFT conversion algorithm, carrying out conversion processing on the phase of the filtering sequence to obtain a frequency domain phase signal; and carrying out peak extraction processing on the frequency domain phase signal according to a preset peak analysis algorithm to generate a heartbeat frequency or a respiratory frequency. The invention solves the technical problem that the current heartbeat breath detection still needs to be fit with a human body to bring inconvenience to the user's use experience.

title_en: Millimeter wave vital sign monitoring method based on Narx neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave vital sign monitoring method based on Narx neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, initializing monitoring system parameters, configuring the working frequency of a millimeter wave radar sensor to be 77GHz, setting the sampling frequency to be 100MHz, 2, executing signal acquisition, transmitting and receiving millimeter wave signals to a monitoring area through a millimeter wave radar sensor component, 3, judging whether abnormal conditions exist after acquisition is completed, and executing 4 if no abnormal conditions exist, and 4, executing signal processing and analysis. The intelligent monitoring system has the advantages of realizing real-time and accurate monitoring and deep analysis of respiration and heartbeat signals and meeting the comprehensive monitoring requirements of multiple fields such as medical monitoring, intelligent home furnishing, security protection and the like.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar system and image signal processing method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a ground penetrating radar system, and an image signal process method capable of simplifying operation formula for specifying a body though the detection precision of the body buried under the ground is improved to show a high reliability.  <P>SOLUTION: The 3D-data acquisition step of obtaining each element of the 3D-matrix data composed of the ground surface as a reference of horizontal surface direction and depth direction from the ground surface to the underground direction; the moving average calculation step of obtaining the moving average in the ground surface as reference of the horizontal surface; the imaging step of making 3D-images from the 3D-data acquisition step and the moving average calculation step; the peak sharpness calculation step of calculating by the correlation between adjacent images;the mine image specification step of specifying the mine image from the condition of peak sharpness is at maximum; and the mine coordinate specification step of specifying the mine coordinate from the point of mine image maximum value.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Mobile device for physiological sensing
title_ko: 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치
abstract_en: A mobile device for measuring a bio-signal is provided to improve convenience of bio-signal measurement by measuring a bio-signal of one hand or both hands according to necessary. A mobile device for measuring a bio-signal includes a sensing part(20), a power supply part(60), an operation display lamp(70), and a wireless communication part. The sensing part has a grip groove for gripping a thumb. The sensing part measures a bio-signal. The sensing part includes a first sensor(30), a second sensor(40), and a third sensor(50). The first sensor is contacted with an end part of a thumb in order to measure a heart rate. The second sensor is contacted with a palm in order to measure a skin conductance. The third sensor measures a body temperature. The power supply part is formed with a button type. The operation display lamp displays an operation state of the sensing part. The wireless communication part transmits a measured result of the bio-signal to outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 착용하지 않고 필요시에 취부 하여 생체 신호를 계측하는 것이 가능한 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 엄지의 그립(grip)을 위해 표면에 비스듬하게 형성된 취부홈을 구비하며, 심박수와 피부 전도도 및 체온을 포함한 생체 신호를 계측하기 위한 센서를 포함하는 센싱부; 한 손으로 취부한 상태에서 검지로 누를 수 있도록 일측 상단부에 버튼식으로 구비된 전원부; 및 상기 센싱부의 동작 상태를 표시하도록 상기 센싱부의 상부에 구비된 동작 표시등을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치를 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면 상시 착용하지 않고 필요시에 사용자가 취부하여 왼손 혹은 양손의 생체 신호를 측정하는 것이 가능하므로 생체 신호 계측에 따른 불편함이나 이물감이 발생하지 않는 효과를 가진다. 
       
     생체 신호, 계측, 휴대용

title_en: Combined low and high frequency band multiple ground-penetrating radar system, and control method thereof
title_ko: 저주파/고주파 복합형 지하 탐사 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A low and high frequency combined underground exploration radar system and a control method of the same are provided to use both a low frequency radar system and a high frequency radar system, thereby detecting all targets buried in a shallow or deep depth using a single system. CONSTITUTION: A low frequency radar module generates and transmits a low frequency band pulse signal and obtains a reflected signal of a generated low frequency band pulse signal from an underground buried target. A high frequency radar module generates and transmits a high frequency band pulse signal. The high frequency radar module obtains a reflected signal of a generated high frequency band pulse signal from the underground buried target. An image processing device displays signals obtained in the low frequency radar module and the high frequency radar module. [Reference numerals] (AA) Bent trace; (BB) Drainpipe
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 저주파/고주파 복합형 지하 탐사 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 시스템은 저주파 대역 펄스 신호를 생성하여 방사하고, 상기 생성된 저주파 대역 펄스 신호가 지하 매설 표적으로부터 반사되는 신호를 획득하는 저주파 레이더 모듈, 고주파 대역 펄스 신호를 생성하여 방사하고, 상기 생성된 고주파 대역 펄스 신호가 지하 매설 표적으로부터 반사되는 신호를 획득하는 고주파 레이더 모듈, 그리고 상기 저주파 레이더 모듈에서 획득된 신호와 상기 고주파 레이더 모듈에서 획득된 신호를 합성하여 표시하는 영상 처리 장치를 포함한다.  본 발명에 의하면 지하의 얕은 곳에 매설되어 있는 작은 표적과 깊은 곳에 매설되어 있는 큰 표적을 하나의 시스템으로 하나의 화면 상에서 동시에 인식할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Emergency rescue assisting devices and the method
title_ko: 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 응급구호방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An auxiliary device for emergency relief and an emergency relief method using the same are provided to safely and accurately implement emergency relief by properly assists the relief operation of an operator. CONSTITUTION: A first bio-signal sensor part senses the bio-signal of the state of the respiratory organ of a patient. A second bio-signal sensor part senses the bio-signal of the state of the circulatory system of the patient. A chest pressure tuning sensor part comprises a dynamometer sensor sensing the intensity of chest pressure and a nine shaft displacement sensor sensing the accuracy of pressure. A wireless data transceiver wirelessly transmits data to an external personal computer or a server. A memory storage part stores chest pressure data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것이다. 
급성 심정지 환자와 같은 응급 구호상황이 발생했을 때, 본 발명에 의하면 먼저 환자의 생체 호흡기 신호를 감지하는 제 1 생체신호 센서부; 환자의 순환기 생체 상태를 감지하는 제 2 생체신호 센서부; 환자의 흉골을 압박하여 흉부 압박의 힘의 강도를 감지하는 검력계 센서와 흉부압박의 정확성을 감지하는 9축 변위센서를 사용하는 흉부압박 조율 센서부; 와 상기 센서부로 부터 신호 값을 유선전송 받거나 혹은 무선 전송받는 무선데이터 송수신부;와 모니터링하여 이를 표시하는 표시부;와 압박 속도 및 안내콘텐츠를 버저와 스피커로 재생해주는 음량발생부;와 9축 변위 센서의 기준값을 저장하고 흉부압박 전과정의 데이터를 저장하는 메모리 저장부;와 데이터 필요시 또는 실시간으로 데이터를 출력해주는 프린터부;를 포함하며,필요한 전원을 공급해주는 전원부;를 포함하고, 전체 를 제어 통제하는 중앙연산 장치부를 포함 구성하는 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method for obtaining bio signal and electronic device implementing the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 취득 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining a bio signal and an electronic device supporting the same. A wearable electronic device according to any one among various embodiments of the present invention includes a housing, a battery mounted inside the housing, a coupling member configured to detachably couple the electronic device to a portion of a body of a user, a conductive member which is electrically connected to the battery and is exposed to the outside, at least one sensor electrically connected to the conductive member, and a circuit which is electrically connected to the battery, the conductive member, and the at least one sensor. The method for obtaining a bio signal of the electronic device according to the present invention includes the operations of: applying a current transmitted from an external material to a switch; electrically connecting at least one or more terminals to the battery; and charging the battery with the current transmitted from the external material. Therefore, the present invention can accurately measure a skin temperature through an external device connection unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 다양한 실시예 중 어느 하나에 따른 웨어러블 전자 장치는, 하우징, 상기 하우징 내에 장착된 배터리, 상기 하우징의 일부에 연결되고, 상기 전자장치를 사용자의 신체의 일부에 탈착가능하게(detachably) 결착하도록 구성된 결착 부재(coupling member), 상기 하우징의 일면 또는 상기 결착 부재의 일면에 배치되고, 상기 배터리와 전기적으로 연결된, 외부에 노출된 도전성 부재, 상기 도전성 부재와 전기적으로 연결된 적어도 하나의 센서 및 상기 배터리, 상기 도전성 부재, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 센서와 전기적으로 연결된 회로를 포함하고, 상기 도전성 부재는, 제 1 컨택 및 제 2 컨택을 포함하고, 상기 회로는, 상기 도전성 부재의 제 1 컨택 또는 제 2 컨택을 통하여 수신되는 전류의 세기 또는 전압을 모니터링 하고, 상기 모니터링된 값에 적어도 일부 기초하여, 상기 전류를 이용하여 상기 배터리를 충전하거나, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 동작시키도록 구성될 수 있다. 
본 발명의 다양한 실시예 중 어느 하나에 따른 전자 장치는, 하우징, 상기 하우징 내에 장착된 배터리, 상기 하우징의 일부에 연결되고, 상기 전자 장치를 상기 사용자의 신체의 일부에 탈착가능하게(detachably) 결합시키는 결합 부재(coupling member), 상기 하우징의 일면 또는 상기 결합 부재의 일면 중 적어도 하나에 노출된 적어도 하나 이상의 단자, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 단자를 통해 생체 신호를 취득하거나 배터리를 충전하도록 스위치를 제어하고, 상기 생체 신호를 처리하는 제어부, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 단자를 생체 센서 또는 상기 배터리 중 적어도 하나와 전기적으로 연결하는 상기 스위치 및 상기 배터리, 상기 단자, 상기 제어부, 상기 생체 센서 및 상기 스위치를 포함한 회로를 포함하고, 상기 회로는, 상기 제어부로부터 수신된 생체 신호 취득 명령에 따라, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 단자와 상기 생체 센서를 전기적으로 연결 하고, 외부 물질로부터 전달되는 전류를 수신하고, 상기 수신된 전류에 기초하여, 상기 생체 센서로 상기 외부 물질의 생체 신호를 취득하도록 제어하도록 구성될 수 있다. 
본 발명의 다양한 실시예 중 어느 하나에 따른 전자 장치의 생체 신호 취득 방법은, 생체 신호 취득 요청을 인식하고 상기 요청에 따라, 적어도 하나 이상의 단자와 상기 생체 센서를 전기적으로 연결하고 외부 물질로부터 전달되는 전류를 수신하고 상기 수신된 전류에 기초하여, 상기 생체 센서로 상기 외부 물질의 생체 신호를 취득하는 동작을 포함할 수 있다. 
본 발명의 다양한 실시예 중 어느 하나에 따른 전자 장치는, 하우징, 상기 하우징 내에 장착된 배터리, 상기 하우징의 일부에 연결되고, 상기 전자 장치를 상기 사용자의 신체의 일부에 탈착가능하게(detachably) 결합하도록 구성된 결합 부재(coupling member), 상기 하우징의 일면 또는 상기 결합 부재의 일면 중 적어도 하나에 노출된 적어도 하나 이상의 단자, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 단자를 통해 생체 신호를 취득하거나 배터리를 충전하도록 스위치를 제어하고, 상기 생체 신호를 처리하는 제어부, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 단자를 생체 센서 또는 배터리 중 적어도 하나와 전기적으로 연결하는 상기 스위치 및 상기 배터리, 상기 단자, 상기 제어부, 상기 생체 센서 및 상기 스위치를 포함한 회로를 포함하고, 상기 회로는, 상기 전자 장치가 방전 상태인 경우, 외부 물질로부터 전달되는 전류를 상기 스위치에 인가하고 상기 전류가 인가된 상기 스위치를 조정하여 적어도 하나 이상의 단자와 상기 배터리를 전기적으로 연결하고 상기 외부 물질로부터 전달되는 전류로 상기 배터리를 충전하도록 구성될 수 있다. 
본 발명의 다양한 실시예 중 어느 하나에 따른 전자 장치의 생체 신호 취득 방법은 상기 전자 장치가 방전 상태인 경우, 외부 물질로부터 전달되는 전류를 스위치에 인가하고 상기 전류가 인가된 상기 스위치를 조정하여 적어도 하나 이상의 단자와 상기 배터리를 전기적으로 연결하고 상기 외부 물질로부터 전달되는 전류로 상기 배터리를 충전하는 동작을 포함할 수 있다. 다른 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Fine dust information collection system using air cleaning headphone with rotating guide
title_ko: 회전식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰을 이용한 미세먼지정보 수집 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a headphone body which includes two ear plugs emitting sound and purified air, a headband connecting the two earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a rotary guide coupled to the ear plugs to be rotatable and fixed to a specific position; a charging station in which the headphone body is mounted and which can discharge purified air; a fine dust measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body, measures a concentration of fine dust around a user, and transmits information on the measured concentration of fine dust to the user's mobile device; a bio-signal measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body, measures the user's bio-signal, and transmits information on the measured bio-signal to the user's mobile device; and a central server which wirelessly communicates with the user's mobile device and receives the information on the concentration of fine dust and the information on the bio-signal. According to the present invention, a concentration of fine dust in a place where a user is located can be identified in real time, and the user can breathe clean air anywhere through an air cleaning mode of the headphone body.

title_en: Low power device for monitoring a vital sign
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for monitoring a vital sign of a subject (14) when attached to the subject's body. The device (12, 12', 12", 12" ') comprises an optical sensor arrangement (18) including a light source (20) for emitting light into tissue of the subject, a light sensor (22) for receiving at least part of the emitted light after an interaction of the emitted light with the tissue and an evaluation unit (24) for deriving an optical monitoring signal from the received light being indicative of the vital sign of the subject (14). The device (12, 12', 12", 12' ") further comprises an auxiliary sensor arrangement (26) different from the optical sensor arrangement (18) for obtaining an auxiliary monitoring signal being indicative of the vital sign of the subject (14). Still further, the device (12, 12', 12", 12" ') comprises a fusion unit (28) for determining an output signal based on the optical monitoring signal and the auxiliary monitoring signal, said output signal being representative of the vital sign of the subject (14); and a control unit (30) for controlling the optical sensor arrangement (18), the auxiliary sensor arrangement (26) and the fusion unit (28). The optical monitoring signal and the auxiliary monitoring signal are indicative of the same vital sign of the subject. The present invention further relates to a corresponding method as well as to a monitoring apparatus (10) including a device as described above.

title_en: Ultrasonic treatment device and driving method thereof
title_ko: 초음파 치료 장치 및 이의 구동 방법
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides an ultrasonic treatment device, comprising: a respiratory sensor unit for sensing one respiratory period of an object, and generating a respiratory sensing signal; an information processing unit for extracting a synchronization signal corresponding to any one time interval in the one respiratory period by using the respiratory sensing signal; a magnetic resonance image generating unit including a hollow cavity to which a magnetic field for magnetic resonance imaging is applied, and generating a magnetic resonance image of a region of interest of the object according to the synchronization signal; an ultrasonic image generating unit including an ultrasonic probe that radiates, to the region of interest of the object, ultrasonic waves for capturing an image, and being disposed on one side of the magnetic resonance image generating unit so as to generate an ultrasonic image of the region of interest; and an ultrasonic treatment unit being disposed on one side of the magnetic resonance image generating unit, and radiating focused ultrasonic waves to the region of interest by using the ultrasonic image and the magnetic resonance image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 대상체의 일 호흡주기를 감지하여 호흡감지신호를 생성하는 호흡센서부; 상기 호흡감지신호를 이용하여 상기 일 호흡주기 중 어느 하나의 시구간에 대응되는 동기화 신호를 추출하는 정보처리부; 자기공명영상 촬영을 위한 자기장이 인가되는 중공을 포함하고, 상기 동기화 신호에 따라 상기 대상체의 관심영역의 자기공명영상을 생성하는 자기공명영상 생성부; 상기 대상체의 관심영역에 촬상용 초음파를 조사시키는 초음파 프로브(probe)를 포함하며, 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되어 상기 관심영역의 초음파 영상을 생성하는 초음파영상 생성부; 및 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되며, 상기 초음파영상 및 상기 자기공명영상을 이용하여 상기 관심영역에 집속(focused) 초음파를 조사하는 초음파 치료부;를 포함하는, 초음파 치료 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A method of measuring vital signals using a millimeter-wave radar sensor system includes performing a first set of radar measurements using a millimeter-wave radar sensor to produce a first set of radar data; determining a first set of range gate measurements from the first set of radar data; determining high response range gates from the first set of range gate measurements; and extracting vital signal information from the high response range gates.

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in front of a plurality of sensors such as those of speakers and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from the plurality of sensors may be analyzed by the processor to determine if one or more humans are present proximate to the device. Based on the determined presence or absence of one or more humans, further actions including, inter alia, customizing a home theatre experience for the one or more humans, making content recommendations, or activating parental controls can be taken by the device.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection with elimination of signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system that is configured to determine range and velocity information from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior of a vehicle for vital sign detection. The method includes steps to decompose reflected and received signals into range and velocity information, to measure the movement over time in specified range gates and to evaluate the similarities between them. Based on the characteristics of similar behaving range bins, it can be decided whether any detected movement is related to an internal or external disturbance or by vital signs.

title_en: Two-dimensional direction of arrival estimation method applied to S-band through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional direction of arrival estimation method applied to an S-band through-wall radar, which specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, setting a rectangular array layout consisting of five antenna elements, placing a first antenna element at a coordinate origin, and placing other four antenna elements in four quadrants respectively by taking the first antenna element as a center, wherein the distance between each antenna element and the first antenna element is unequal; then, a non-coherent signal subspace algorithm for processing broadband signals is adopted, the broadband signals transmitted/received by a radar are divided into a plurality of sub-bands on a frequency domain, two-dimensional DOA estimation is carried out on the signals of each sub-band according to a method of narrowband signals, and then weighting processing is carried out on the DOA estimation result of each sub-band, so that a final estimation result is obtained; the two-dimensional direction of arrival estimation method applied to the S-band through-wall radar provided by the invention has the advantages that the angle resolution is improved, the influence of a virtual false peak spectrum is eliminated, and the method is applicable to both narrowband and broadband signals.

title_en: Non-contact detection and monitoring system for vital signs of vehicle occupants
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detecting vital signs of an occupant in a vehicle, such as a vehicle cabin, are disclosed. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receives the radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to vibration data of the vehicle to generate a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine vital signs of the occupant.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
An earthquake detection and user status check system using the smart devices
title_ko: 스마트기기를 이용한 지진감지 및 사용자 상태 확인시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진발생시 지진 알람을 통해 대피를 이룰 수 있음과 더불어, 가족 구성원간의 상태를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 스마트기기를 이용한 지진감지 및 사용자 상태 확인시스템에 관한 것으로, 지진감지센서가 구비되어 세대에 배치되는 지진감지기; 상기 지진감지기와 블루투스로 연결되어 지진감지센서로부터 전달받은 지진발생 정보를 진동신호를 통해 착용자에게 전달하며, 온도센서와 동작센서와 심박센서 및 GPS가 구비되어 착용자의 정보를 감지하는 웨어러블기기; 어플을 통해 각각의 웨어러블기기에 연결되어 상기 웨어러블기기를 착용하고 있는 착용자들의 정보를 수신하는 각각의 스마트기기;를 이용함으로써, 지진발생시, 각 방에 위치한 착용자들이 웨어러블기기에서 발생하는 진동신호를 통해 지진을 감지하여 대피할 수 있음과 더불어, 온도센서와 동작센서와 심박센서와 GPS를 통해 착용자들의 생체신호 및 위치를 스마트기기로 수신함으로써 각각의 착용자들의 안전 상태를 서로 확인할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for providing health information based on bio-signal measured by non-contact manner
title_ko: 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 상기 방법은 피검자와 이격되어 위치하는 비접촉 생체 센서를 통해, 비접촉 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 기 학습된 변환 모델을 이용하여, 상기 수집된 비접촉 생체 신호를 접촉 방식의 생체 신호에 상응하도록 변환하여 가상의 생체 신호를 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 생성된 가상의 생체 신호를 기반으로 건강 상태를 분석하여 상기 피검자에 대한 건강 정보를 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 이러한 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호를 접촉 방식으로 측정되는 생체 신호에 상응하는 가상의 생체 신호로 변환하여 건강 상태를 진단할 수 있다. 이로 인하여, 본 발명은 비접촉 방식의 생체 신호를 분석하기 위한 별도의 진단 기법(또는 진단 방법 또는 진단 알고리즘)을 개발하지 않고도, 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호를 기반으로 건강 상태(예: 심혈관 질환)를 용이하게 진단하여 건강 정보를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior spaces and exterior spaces which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna ( 1 ). The antenna ( 1 ) is connected to an electronic circuit ( 2, 3, 4, 31, 32 ) which is able to decode the changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field by means of a processor ( 7 ) enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding the antenna ( 1 ) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Vital sign sensor capable of resisting clutter
abstract_en: In a vital sign sensor of the present invention, an antenna assembly radiates an oscillation signal generated by a SIL oscillator to an object in a form of a wireless signal and receives a reflected signal from the object, and the reflected signal can have the SIL oscillator injection-locked. The wireless signal radiated from the antenna assembly is transmitted to a demodulator for demodulation such that the vital signs of the object can be obtained. Additionally, an isolator of the antenna assembly is provided to prevent the SIL oscillator from receiving a clutter reflected from the demodulator and an environment where the demodulator is placed. As a result, the clutter can't influence the vital sign detection of the object.

title_en: A kind of Combined through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to Radar Technology fields, more particularly to apply the Combined through-wall radar in individual soldier's partition wall detection radar field.The Combined through-wall radar includes one-dimensional through-wall radar, and the one-dimensional through-wall radar includes: transmitter, receiver, wideband signal source, signal-processing board and display screen；The transmitter, receiver, display screen and wideband signal source are all connected with signal-processing board, and the transmitter connects transmitting antenna, and receiver connects receiving antenna, and the output end of the wideband signal source connects receiver；The transmitter will emit the emitted antenna of signal and launch, and the echo-signal of the transmitting signal is received by the receiving antenna of the one-dimensional through-wall radar and is transferred to its receiver；The wideband signal source generates reference signal, and by the reference signal transmission to receiver；Reference signal is mixed and is amplified with echo-signal received in receiver, and signal-processing board is then forwarded to, and display screen shows the result of the signal-processing board processing.
assignees: North general electronics group co ltd

title_en: Through-wall detection radar device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a through-wall detection radar device, which comprises a frame, the through-wall radar host computer is installed to the upper end of frame, and the lower extreme is connected with the link, be provided with the round pin axle on the link, epaxial clipboard A and the clipboard B that is connected with the cross setting of round pin, the other end is provided with the through-hole, it has the bolt to embolia in the through-hole, the nut is installed to the bolt, through-wall radar host computer includes receiver, transmitter and battery, the receiver is connected with the schottky diode, the schottky diode is connected with the base of triode, the collecting electrode and the projecting pole of triode are connected with the positive pole and the negative pole of power respectively, the projecting pole of triode is connected with signal processor, signal processor is connected with the. The through-wall radar host can be fixed on the wall, so that the image is clearer, the strength of weak signals can be increased, and the power of target signals is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU IANKE HUIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radar life detection instrument, including the detection instrument body, the bottom of detection instrument body is equipped with the box, be equipped with the guide post group on the detection instrument body, the guide post group includes two interval arrangement's first guide post and second guide post, the box is worn out along upper and lower direction to the assembly that slides in the guide post direction on the detection instrument body, be equipped with the lead screw in the box, the one end of lead screw rotates the assembly with the inner wall of box, the box is worn out to the other end of lead screw, the screw thread assembly has the nut on the lead screw, it is equipped with first rotation stopping piece and second rotation stopping piece to rotate on the inner wall of box, the relative both sides of nut articulate has first connecting rod and second connecting rod, first connecting rod links to each other with first rotation stopping piece, the second connecting rod links to each other with the second rotation stopping piece, still include the bracing piece, the middle part in the outer bottom surface of box is just established to the orientation about the bracing piece extends. The utility model discloses a radar life detection instrument has made things convenient for the level of radar life detection instrument to adapt, has improved and has placed efficiency.
assignees: HENAN XITUO FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitor for remotely and centrally monitoring vital signs of patient
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitor for remotely and centrally monitoring vital signs of patients, which comprises a shell, wherein a display screen is arranged outside the shell, a microwave radar is arranged inside the shell, the shell is rotatably connected with a driving screw rod, the external thread of the driving screw rod is connected with a thread block, the external of the thread block is movably connected with a first connecting rod, and the inside of the shell is fixedly connected with a fixed frame; this monitor of long-range central authorities guardianship patient vital sign passes through the drive wheel and meshes with the pinion rack when rotating, thereby make the drive wheel remove, the drive wheel removes and drives the ejector pin removal, the ejector pin removes and drives the monitor and carry out altitude mixture control, and can carry out individualized setting to every patient's vital sign baseline threshold value through the display screen on the monitor, can be higher than or be less than the automatic triggering warning when the threshold value at patient's real-time reading, the nursing staff can in time master the unusual that patient vital sign appears, take measures.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GREEN CATTLE HEALTH SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Multifunctional composite net material for building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of safety protection, in particular to a multifunctional composite net material for building, which comprises a top layer and a bottom layer, wherein the top layer and the bottom layer are formed by alternately weaving polyester fibers, glass fibers and carbon fibers; the structure of the connecting layer is consistent with that of the top layer and the bottom layer. The wave-shaped fiber is arranged between the top layer and the bottom layer, the wave-shaped fiber comprises cavities, and the cavities are gaps of the wave-shaped fiber. The beneficial effects are that: the electric heating wires are pre-buried in the composite net material and used for paving the tunnel portal or the side ditch in the tunnel, and the electric heating wires are electrified and heated when the electric heating wires encounter icing in winter, so that the icing is melted, the water flow is normal, and the water in the tunnel is prevented from being frozen in the tunnel or when the water flows out of the tunnel portal, so that the water level is continuously increased, and the railway track bed is flooded. The displacement sensor, the acceleration sensor and the sensor for monitoring vibration for measuring landslide and falling stones and rolling stones are buried in the net material, so that the movement of the landslide body and the rolling stones and falling stones can be monitored, and the safety of railway and highways is ensured.
assignees: SHAANXI YONGGUBANG ENGINEERING MATERIALS TECH CO LTD;TAIZHOU MENGNENGDA ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Body detects vice driver's seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a body detection auxiliary driving seat, which comprises a seat plate and a pedal, wherein a backrest is arranged on one side of the seat plate, rotating arms are arranged on two sides of the backrest, first electrode plates are arranged on the two rotating arms, a weighing mechanism is arranged on the seat plate, and a detection mechanism is arranged on the pedal; the weighing mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a weighing sensor and a plurality of reset springs are arranged on the bottom plate, and the other ends of the reset springs are connected with a supporting plate; the utility model discloses a detection mechanism, including keeping off the lid, keep off to cover the lock and be in set up the standing groove upper end on the footboard, be equipped with a plurality of second electrode slices in the standing groove, body composition and vital sign that the body detected the vice driver seat to take personnel can be measured by oneself, weigh and measurement data and observe through display screen or cell-phone connection transmission on the vehicle, increase device multifunctionality, through weighing the setting of mechanism, can measure the weight of taking personnel.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF NANJING MEDICAL UNIV;NANJING HAIWANG AUTO PARTS CO LTD

title_en: Clutter suppression method for holographic penetration imaging radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a clutter suppression method for a holographic penetration imaging radar. The technical scheme is as follows: firstly, carrying out singular value decomposition on received holographic penetration imaging radar echo data; then, solving a reconstruction coefficient matrix by taking the maximum Target Clutter Ratio (TCR) as a criterion; and finally, calculating echo data after clutter suppression by using the solved reconstruction coefficient matrix. The method can effectively inhibit clutter components in the echo data of the holographic penetration imaging radar, simultaneously reserve target information, and realize the enhanced imaging of the buried weak target in the medium.

title_en: Walking state vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring vital signs in a walking state, and relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of determining an anchor distance gate according to the first K frames in N frames of FMCW radar echo signals, and respectively executing processing steps on each frame of FMCW radar echo signals after the K frames to obtain a plurality of third signals and a plurality of target distance gates, further determining a plurality of second signals, further determining respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency, and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to an upper computer to monitor vital signs of a human body. The processing steps comprise updating the anchor range gate according to the target range gate corresponding to the last frame of the FMCW radar echo signal of the current frame, determining the target range gate according to the plurality of first signals and the anchor range gate, and determining the third signal according to the plurality of first signals and the target range gate. The method and the device can solve the problem that vital signs of a human body in a walking state are difficult to accurately monitor, enlarge the applicable scene of vital sign monitoring, and improve the accuracy of vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Feature extraction method of vital sign signals based on multichannel fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature extraction method of vital sign signals based on multichannel fusion, which comprises the steps of modeling vital sign signals caused by chest cavity movement, carrying out mixing processing on multichannel radar human body target echo signals to obtain multichannel sampling intermediate frequency signals to obtain one-dimensional distance images of the echo signals, carrying out moving target display processing to realize static clutter background cancellation and extract target distance unit multichannel complex signals, obtaining a decomposition form of a track matrix based on multidimensional singular spectrum analysis, dividing the decomposition sub-matrix into disjoint groups, overlapping sub-sequences with the same signals to obtain main component reconstruction complex signals of each channel, carrying out time-frequency analysis and weighted fusion on the reconstruction complex signals of each channel to obtain a fusion time spectrum, tracking the ridge line of the fusion time spectrum to obtain a phase signal containing chest cavity movement features, and extracting vital sign parameters. The invention can improve the estimation precision of the non-contact human target respiration and heartbeat frequency parameters under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for inverting and reconstructing water content of soil layer
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for inverting the water content of a reconstructed soil layer, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting the structure of the reconstructed soil layer by using a ground penetrating radar system to obtain electromagnetic wave propagation data of each layer of the reconstructed soil layer; the method comprises the steps of detecting a reconstructed soil layer provided with a reflector based on a ground penetrating radar system, obtaining double-pass time-of-flight data, obtaining the relative dielectric constant of a medium layer based on the double-pass time-of-flight data and the buried depth of the reflector, obtaining an empirical formula based on the relative dielectric constant, correcting the empirical formula based on the actual water content of the reconstructed soil layer, obtaining a water content model, and inverting based on the water content model to obtain the water content of the reconstructed soil layer. The method can obviously improve the accuracy of inversion of the water content of the soil layer by combining a ground penetrating radar system and a corrected empirical formula, and is particularly suitable for land reclamation and ecological restoration engineering of arid and semiarid open-air mining areas.

title_en: Respiratory heartbeat detection method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiratory heartbeat detection method and a respiratory heartbeat detection system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a reflected echo signal obtained by detecting a target object by a continuous wave signal sent by an FMCW millimeter wave radar; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing echo signals, separating respiratory signals from heartbeat signals on the basis of an EPH multistage cooperative signal processing algorithm, and carrying out anomaly correction on separated instantaneous frequency anomaly data on the basis of a local weighted regression algorithm. Therefore, the method can improve the accuracy of radar detection of vital signs under the interference conditions of background noise, signal harmonic waves and the like.
assignees: SUZHOU LEIJIADA HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring method, system and device based on migration learning mechanism and UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent vital sign monitoring method, system and device based on a migration learning mechanism and UWB radar, and relates to the technical field of radar signal processing and medical health monitoring, and the technical key points are that the monitoring method and system of the invention pre-trains a deep neural network model on simulation radar data by generating the simulation radar data so as to enable the simulation radar data to learn the basic characteristics of vital sign signals; and then, the pre-training model is finely adjusted by using a small amount of acquired real UWB radar data, so that knowledge of the pre-training model is migrated and adapted to the current specific scene and individuals, and the effect of training a large amount of data is achieved by using a small amount of real data. The invention uses the simulation data to complement the deficiency of the real data, and enables the model to be rapidly adapted to the new monitoring environment and the target individual through the migration learning mechanism, thereby finally achieving the non-contact vital sign monitoring with high accuracy, high stability and high practicability.

title_en: Spherical surface contact type rotation slip support and underground buried pile method in support body pile head
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a pile head base-isolated structure capable of supporting a big building weight without being influenced by a periodic characteristic of earthquake wave.  <P>SOLUTION: A supporting part is a spherical structure similar to a bearing support and a slip support equivalent to a ball bearing which Coulomb friction coefficient is η=0.01-0.001 by a combination of a sphere 7 and a spherical surface saucer, and the supporting part bears a bit axial force. In order to reduce a frictional force, a coating rim in which a zinc galvanized steel plate or a stainless steel plate or the like are thermally pressed with an electroresistive welding and a hot metal on the surface of both end rotate and slip support of a column 8 is provided, and a polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFT) which is a tribology technology to support the axial force and to reduce a stress concentration and a creaking sound on a slideway between the sphere and a casing.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Air-coupled type ground penetrating radar antenna
title_ko: 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 안테나
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air-coupled type bistatic ground penetrating radar (GPR) antenna and, more specifically, to an air-coupled type ground penetrating radar (GPR) antenna which reduces reception of a direct wave, which is a factor limiting imaging performance of a system when being received at a receiving side of the GPR antenna, by placing a loop antenna at a receiver point so as to be vertical to an antenna plane with respect to a polarization direction of a transmitting antenna and configuring a feeding direction to be orthogonal to a feeding direction of a transmitter and the ground surface. The air-coupled type GPR antenna, which is spaced apart from the ground, comprises: the transmitting antenna directed towards the ground and penetrating a radio wave into the ground; and a receiving antenna receiving a radio wave, which is radiated from the transmitting antenna and reflected from the ground, and fed in a direction perpendicular to the ground surface and the feeding direction of the transmitting antenna. The transmitting antenna uses an antenna, such as a horn antenna, having directivity and the receiving antenna uses a loop antenna in which a physical plane of the antenna is positioned to be perpendicular to the ground surface with respect to the polarization direction, thereby resulting in the effect of improving radar detection performance of an air-coupled type GPR system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지면 이격형 바이스태틱 지표투과레이다 안테나에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 수신기 지점에 루프 안테나를 송신안테나의 편파방향을 축으로 안테나 평면에 수직이 되게 놓고 급전방향을 송신기의 급전방향 및 지표면과 직교가 되게 구성하여 지표투과레이다 안테나(Ground Penetrating Radar, 이하 GPR이라 칭함)의 수신측에서 수신하는 경우 시스템의 영상화 성능을 제한하는 요소인 직접파의 수신을 감소시킨 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 안테나에 관한 것으로서, 지면에서 이격하여 구성된 지면 이격형 GPR 안테나에 있어서, 지면으로 지향시키고 내부로 전파를 침투시키도록 구성되는 송신안테나; 상기 송신안테나로부터 방사되어 상기 지중으로부터 반사되어 돌아오는 전파를 수신하고 상기 송신안테나의 급전 방향 및 지표면과 각각 직각이 되는 방향으로 급전되는 수신안테나;를 포함하고, 상기 송신안테나는 혼 안테나 등 지향성을 갖는 안테나를, 상기 수신안테나는 안테나의 물리적 평면이 송신안테나의 편파방향을 축으로 지표면과 수직을 이루도록 위치시킨 루프 안테나를 사용하도록 구성되어 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 시스템의 레이다 탐지 성능을 향상시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Electronic device for determining vital sign of user and operation method thereof
title_ko: 사용자의 생체 사인을 결정하는 전자 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an electronic device that determines a vital sign while a user is active. The electronic device comprises: a first sensor for sensing a vital sign of a user; a second sensor for sensing activity of the user; and at least one processor connected to the first sensor and the second sensor. The at least one processor may be configured to: identify a vital sign determined through a first signal acquired through the first sensor; normalize the vital sign to correspond to the activity characteristics of a user on the basis of the vital sign determined through the first signal and the activity level of the user determined using a second signal acquired through the second sensor; and merge the vital sign determined through the first signal and the normalized vital sign so as to determine a merged vital sign.
abstract_ko: 사용자가 활동하는 동안 생체 사인 (vital sign)을 결정하는 전자 장치가 제공된다. 상기 전자 장치는, 사용자의 생체 사인을 감지하기 위한 제 1 센서, 상기 사용자의 활동을 감지하기 위한 제 2 센서, 및 상기 제 1 센서 및 상기 제 2 센서에 연결된 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함한다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 상기 제 1 센서를 통해 획득한 제 1 신호를 통해 결정되는 생체 사인을 확인하고, 상기 제 1 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 생체 사인 및 상기 제 2 센서를 통해 획득한 제 2 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 사용자의 활동 레벨에 기반하여 상기 사용자의 활동 특성에 상응하도록 생체 사인을 정규화 (normalization)하고, 상기 제 1 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 생체 사인 및 정규화된 생체 사인을 머징 (merging)하여 머지된 생체 사인을 결정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Array-type underwater apparatus and method for monitoring deformation of reservoir landslide
abstract_en: In an array-type underwater apparatus for monitoring deformation of a reservoir landslide, an anchor is buried at an underwater monitoring point in a landslide mass, and a floating shell is configured to float on a water surface. A GPS sensor is configured to transmit and receive a GPS signal to obtain a real-time position of the floating shell, a water temperature sensor is used to obtain a water temperature-time relationship, and a gravity wave gauge is used to obtain a wave height-time relationship. An upper end of a pull cord is securely connected to the floating shell via a displacement compensation mechanism, and a lower end of the pull cord is securely connected to the anchor. The displacement compensation mechanism compensates for a displacement after the floating shell floats with a wave. An encoder-type displacement meter measures a real-time distance between the encoder-type displacement meter and the anchor.

title_en: Physiological sign sensor capable of resisting clutter
abstract_en: A physiological symptom sensor capable of resisting clutter generates an oscillation signal by virtue of a SIL oscillator, the oscillation signal is transmitted to an object in a wireless signal mode through an antenna group, the antenna group receives a reflection signal reflected by the object, the SIL oscillator is injected and locked by the reflection signal, the wireless signal transmitted by the antenna group is transmitted to a demodulation unit for demodulation, so that a vital sign of the organism is obtained, wherein a separation part of the antenna group can prevent the clutter signal reflected by the demodulation unit and the environment where the demodulation unit is located from being transmitted to the SIL oscillator, so that the clutter signal is prevented from interfering the detection of the vital sign of the object.

title_en: Smart Respirator Protective Equipment
title_ko: 스마트 호흡기 보호구
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트 호흡기 보호구에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 미세입자 및 유해가스를 차단하는 필터 모듈, 착용자의 식별성을 증대시키는 광원 모듈, 착용자 상태 및 공기의 질을 측정하는 모듈, 착용자의 생체정보 및 위치정보를 파악하는 모듈이 구비되는 고신뢰성의 스마트 호흡기 보호구를 구현하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 
	본 발명에 따른 스마트 호흡기 보호구는 미세입자 및 유해가스가 착용자의 입과 코를 통해 인체 내부로 유입되는 것을 방지하기 위한 필터모듈; 상기 착용자의 생체신호를 감지하고 획득하는 생체신호 센서모듈; 상기 착용자의 이동상태 또는 낙상을 감지하는 가속도 센서모듈; 상기 착용자의 이동 위치정보를 획득하는 위치추적모듈; 상기 스마트 호흡기 보호구 전면부의 일측에 구비되며 다발 형태의 고휘도 발광 다이오드로 구성되어 원거리에서 상기 착용자를 식별하기 위한 광원모듈; 상기 스마트 호흡기 보호구 측면부의 일측에 구비되며, 긴급 경고음을 발생시키는 스피커모듈; 상기 스마트 호흡기 보호구 측면부의 일측에 구비되며, 상기 착용자의 생체신호와 위치변화 및 위치이동신호를 전송하기 위해서 상용 이동 통신망에 접속하는 무선이동통신모듈; 상기 생체신호 센서모듈, 상기 가속도 센서모듈, 위치추적모듈, 상기 광원모듈, 상기 스피커모듈 및 상기 무선이동통신모듈에 전원을 공급하기 위한 착탈식 충전 배터리모듈;로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Situation monitoring system based on activity sensor
title_ko: 활동센서 기반의 상황 감시 시스템
