abstract_ko: 본 발명은 활동센서 기반의 상황 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 실내 환경에서 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 측정기; 상기 레이더 측정기에 의해 수집된 생체 신호를 수신하여 상기 실내 환경 하에서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 측정기 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 가정, 사무실 등의 실내 환경에서 생체 신호를 감지하여 사용자의 위급상황 발생을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: Respirator with end-of-service-life detection
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and apparatus for detecting when respiratory cartridges of a respirator have reached their end-of-service-life. In some instances, two or more respiratory cartridges are removably connectable to a respirator housing, where each of the two or more respiratory cartridges receives ambient air and deliver cleaned air to the respirator housing. One of the respiratory cartridges may be configured to have a lower adsorption capacity than the remaining respirator cartridges. A gas sensor may be situated downstream of the reduced capacity respirator cartridge, and may detect an increased concentration of the targeted gas in the cleaned air delivered by the reduced capacity respiratory cartridge. When detected, an end-of-service-life indication may be provided to the user.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of search and rescue instruments, in particular to a search and rescue robot for coal mines, which comprises a device main body, a mobile device and a search and rescue device, wherein the mobile device comprises a driving wheel, a driven wheel, a supporting wheel, a crawler belt, a supporting column, a left driving motor and a right driving motor, the search and rescue device comprises a lighting lamp, a thermal imaging camera, a sound wave life detection instrument, a communication module, a signal receiver and a traction ring, the climbing capability of the device is stronger and the device is adaptive to various terrains by additionally arranging the supporting wheel obliquely above the driving wheel, trapped persons can see the light to find the search and rescue device by installing the lighting lamp at the forefront, the trapped persons can also find the trapped persons in the unclear environment by installing the thermal imaging camera on a rotatable telescopic rod, the trapped persons can hear search and rescue voice and can communicate with the search and rescue persons to relieve tension to a certain degree by installing the communication module, the device can be remotely controlled by installing the controller and the signal receiver.
assignees: ANHUI DERUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: UVB based multi-channel radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UVB based multi-channel radar life detection instrument for multi-target detection, which comprises a front end of a UWB biologic radar and a computing unit. The front end of the UWB biologic radar comprises a transmitting antenna, three receiving antennas, an impulse oscillator, an electromagnetic pulse generator and a sampling integrator. The transmitting antenna and each receiving antenna form a channel and therefore three channels are formed. The computing unit analyses and processes the collected three radar echo signals and finally extracts life information of multiple human body targets and the two dimensional position information of each target.

title_en: Side slope geologic hazard pre-warning method and device based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side slope geologic hazard pre-warning method and device based on a wireless sensor network. The wireless sensor network is buried inside a side slope body; a wireless sensor network cluster head is used for acquiring a sound transmission signal at the initial catastrophe stage of a side slope, and transmitting the signal to a data transmitter arranged at a safety position in a wireless way through a multi-hop path; the data transmitter is used for transmitting assembled information to an indoor receiving and analyzing system in a customized data format through a backbone network, and transmitting a received signal to a computer of the receiving and analyzing system; the computer is used for analyzing and processing the received signal, and taking a pre-warning measure of a corresponding level according to a processing result; and the pre-warning information is transmitted to a pre-warning display screen at a section where a disaster occurs through a communication cable to prompt passing vehicles, pedestrians or residential areas and the like of taking corresponding disaster reduction and prevention measures.

title_en: Buried depth detecting device and method of communication pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a buried depth detecting device and method of a communication pipeline. The detecting device comprises a control unit, and ground penetrating radar system GPR, a GPS device, a display unit and a storage battery connected with the control unit; the storage battery supplies power to the whole device; the control unit sets parameters including time, the buried soil type of a detecting pipeline and the arched shape of the detecting pipeline, and displays detection data via the display unit; the control unit is also connected with a resource management server to upload the detection data; the ground penetrating radar system GPR emits high-frequency electromagnetic waves in 3D conical distribution to the underground via a radar technology, and a radar reception antenna of the ground penetrating radar system GPR can receive electromagnetic waves reflected from the channel pipeline, so that the buried depth of the underground communication pipeline is detected and transmitted to the control unit to generate a visual image; and the GPS device can position the latitude and longitude of the present position of the detecting pipeline, and back feeds the latitude and longitude to the control unit. Thus, the buried depth of the underground communication pipeline can be identified.

title_en: GPR buried target localization method and system based on box spline wavelets frameworks
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of GPR buried target localization method based on box spline wavelets frameworks and system.The present invention obtains the echo image data of GPR first, and removes the direct wave image in the image, obtains pretreated Gpr Signal；Then pretreated Gpr Signal is decomposed using box spline wavelets, and to carrying out edge positioning to decomposition result；The boundary curve of fitted figure picture, choose curve derivative be zero point as radar image summit；Buried target curvilinear equation is finally set up, two points in the Liang Ge branches on the radar image summit on asymmetric selection edge are fitted buried target curve, so as to realize the positioning of buried target using 3 fitting process.The localization method of the present invention improves the precision of target positioning, for metal pipe line and nonmetal pipe line shallow-layer detection all that may be present, is not likely to produce false-alarm；And algorithm is simple, run time is short, improves the efficiency of target positioning.

title_en: Underground cable position determining and imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining and imaging the position of an underground cable, which comprises a ground penetrating radar and a position determining system, wherein the position determining system comprises a data processing module, an electromagnetic signal analysis module, a signal receiving module and display equipment, the ground penetrating radar is electrically connected with the signal receiving module through a wire, the signal receiving module is electrically connected with the data processing module through the electromagnetic signal analysis module, and the data processing module is electrically connected with the display equipment; the invention utilizes the penetrating electromagnetic wave to detect the buried cable, realizes the reconstruction and imaging of the shape and the space position of the direct current cable by collecting and analyzing the reflected echo signal of the electromagnetic wave and combining the three-dimensional imaging technology, simplifies the direct current cable into line current, can obtain the space coordinate and the shape of the direct current cable, and can visually display through the reconstructed image.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHANDONG ANLAN POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human presence detection device and method
abstract_en: A human presence detection apparatus and method are disclosed. The human body presence detection device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a radar sensor unit configured to transmit a radar signal, receive a reflected radar signal generated by an obstacle reflecting the radar signal, and generate an analog electronic signal based on the reflected radar signal; and a signal processor unit configured to generate a digital electronic signal by analog-to-digital conversion of the analog electronic signal, and determine the presence of a human body within the sensing range of the radar sensor unit based on the amplitude variation condition of the digital electronic signal.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ON BRIGHT ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional distributed multi-vital sign non-contact detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional distributed multi-vital sign non-contact detection radar system which comprises a central processing module, a line distribution module and a front-end detection module. The front-end detection module is composed of a plurality of vital sign sensing access modules, transmits optical signals or microwave signals to a detection area and receives echoes to obtain original detection signals. The central processing module comprises a signal generation and processing unit, a pulse condition extraction unit, a blood pressure estimation unit and a dynamic tracking and fall-preventing early warning unit, and realizes the functions of generating and processing detection signals, pulse condition extraction, blood pressure estimation, fall-preventing monitoring and early warning processing based on range profile and micro Doppler analysis and the like. The circuit distribution module is connected with the sensing access module and the central processing module, adds delay in each link and consists of a plurality of optical splitters and optical delays. The invention realizes the continuous measurement functions of non-contact, respiration and pulse detection, acquisition of human body pulse condition information, rapid estimation of human body systolic pressure, falling prevention and dynamic tracking.
assignees: AIR FORCE EARLY WARNING ACAD;UNIV HUBEI CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Mri magnetic field generator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an MRI magnetic field generator, enhancing a heat efficiency by reducing variations in temperature without impairing uniformity of a magnetic field, and controlling the temperature of a permanent magnet with high accuracy.  <P>SOLUTION: In this MRI magnetic field generator, temperature controlling heaters 10, 11 are embedded and incorporated in base yokes 3, 3 which form magnetic path forming members. In this configuration, when the temperature controlling heaters 10, 11 are heated by a temperature controller according to the temperatures detected by a temperature sensor 12, permanent magnets 5, 5 disposed in the vicinities of the base yokes are heated efficiently to thereby provide an excellent control follow-up and the temperature controlling heaters are buried in the base yoke and heat from the heaters is conducted through the base yokes to directly reach the permanent magnets to thereby permit very efficient heat control without heat loss due to heat dissipation to the outside.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Biological signal matching method of biological image and biological signal matching system
abstract_en: To provide a biological signal matching method of a biological image and biological signal matching system.SOLUTION: A biological signal matching method 10 of a biological image according to the present invention, utilizes an image captured by an image capture device to assist biological signal matching. An operational device matches a plurality of vital signs in the biological signal detected by a radar, with respective living bodies in the image one on one accurately to realize continuous tracking of vital signs of the plurality of living bodies. This configuration can resolve such a conventional technical problem that it is not possible to match a plurality of vital signs, and thereby capable of contactlessly detecting the vital signs of the plurality of living bodies.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: An earthquake detection and user status check system using the smart devices
title_ko: 스마트기기를 이용한 지진감지 및 사용자 상태 확인시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart device-based earthquake detection and user status confirmation system. With the present invention, earthquake alarm-based evacuation can be carried out during an earthquake and the status of family members can be confirmed. The present invention uses a household earthquake detector provided with an earthquake detection sensor; a wearable device Bluetooth-connected to the earthquake detector, transmitting earthquake occurrence information from the earthquake detection sensor to a wearer by means of a vibration signal, and provided with a temperature sensor, a motion sensor, a heart rate sensor, and a GPS to detect wearer information; and smart devices respectively connected to the wearable devices via an application and receiving information on the wearers wearing the wearable devices. As a result, during an earthquake, the wearer in each room can evacuate the room by detecting the earthquake via the vibration signal from the wearable device and the safety status of each wearer can be mutually confirmed by the smart devices receiving the wearers′ biosignals and positions via the temperature sensor, the motion sensor, the heart rate sensor, and the GPS.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진발생시 지진 알람을 통해 대피를 이룰 수 있음과 더불어, 가족 구성원간의 상태를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 스마트기기를 이용한 지진감지 및 사용자 상태 확인시스템에 관한 것으로, 지진감지센서가 구비되어 세대에 배치되는 지진감지기; 상기 지진감지기와 블루투스로 연결되어 지진감지센서로부터 전달받은 지진발생 정보를 진동신호를 통해 착용자에게 전달하며, 온도센서와 동작센서와 심박센서 및 GPS가 구비되어 착용자의 정보를 감지하는 웨어러블기기; 어플을 통해 각각의 웨어러블기기에 연결되어 상기 웨이러블기기를 착용하고 있는 착용자들의 정보를 수신하는 각각의 스마트기기;를 이용함으로써, 지진발생시, 각 방에 위치한 착용자들이 웨어러블기기에서 발생하는 진동신호를 통해 지진을 감지하여 대피할 수 있음과 더불어, 온도센서와 동작센서와 심박센서와 GPS를 통해 착용자들의 생체신호 및 위치를 스마트기기로 수신함으로써 각각의 착용자들의 안전 상태를 서로 확인할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Personalized alarm provision system using biometric information and motion information on basis of doppler signal
title_ko: 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personalized alarm provision system using biometric information and motion information on the basis of a Doppler signal, comprising: an acquisition device that emits a radar signal to a subject and analyzes a Doppler signal generated through a reflected wave acquired by reflecting the emitted radar signal to acquire bio-signal or motion signal information of the subject from the Doppler signal; a server; and a guardian terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 방출된 레이더 신호가 반사되어 획득되는 반사파를 통해 생성되는 도플러 신호를 분석하여 도플러 신호로부터 대상자의 생체 신호 또는 움직임신호 정보를 획득하는 획득 장치, 서버 및 보호자 단말을 포함하는 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템이다.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.
assignees: KAI MEDICAL INC;NAKATA ROBERT;MOSTAFANEZHAD ISAR;MIYASATO SCOTT

title_en: Underground utility location and damage prevention
abstract_en: A method of underground utility location and damage prevention that electronically registers together multi-layer underground and surface images of a surface volume with buried utilities and other infrastructures. Such method further comprises assembling and presenting the combination to a device in the field that visually guides crews in their safe digging of the ground nearby. The orienting, scaling, and registering of a first image layer is to a standardized orientation and scaling on a map of a photograph of a land surface from a zenith point in space above. Then the orienting, scaling, and registering of a second image layer is made to the standardized orientation and scaling on the map. This layer is a result of an ground penetrating radar investigation of buried objects point-by-point in an immediate search area of a corresponding ground surface. Underground buried objects and utilities are thereby located to make safe digging nearby.

title_en: Method and system of attachment and detection of attachment of a wearable sensor to clothing material
abstract_en: A method and system of universal, secure attachment with attachment detection mechanism, of a wearable sensor-unit to any article of clothing worn around the body in order to measure vital signals of a person, such as motion, movements and activity levels. The method and system permits: reliable attachment to any article of clothing; an attachment in any position to clothing or fabric worn by a person; and detection for the wearable sensor attachment to an article of clothing to minimize false alarms.

title_en: For the faint breath signal detection method of life detection radar
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of faint breath signal detection method for life detection radar. This faint breath signal detection method comprises: by radar echo signal, set up M �� N dimension distance slow time signal matrix S (m, n); For each range unit, when S (m, n) slow, direction carries out auto-correlation processing, obtain signal matrix R x (m, ��); Respectively to R x Each row vector of (m, ��) carries out FFT, obtains frequency of distance matrix   Range direction on carry out weighted accumulation, obtain breath signal frequency spectrum And traversal Each position, find energy than the position being greater than pre-determined threshold, if when the number of this position is greater than 0, judge that underground exists life entity. Present invention achieves the enhancing of faint breath signal, detection and extract, the needs of the faint vital signs detection of the personnel that bury under meeting the occasions such as disaster rescue.

title_en: High-precision radar sign detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision radar sign detector. The system comprises a physical sign detector and an information processing terminal; the physical sign detector comprises a radar baseband processing module, at least one set of radar transmitting link and at least two sets of radar receiving links, wherein a plurality of sets of receiving and transmitting links are synchronous and are connected in a rigid body, the radar baseband processing module pretreats echo signals received by the radar receiving links, transmits the echo signals to the information processing terminal for further processing, and outputs heartbeat breathing signals. The invention is provided with a plurality of sets of radar receiving and transmitting systems, and eliminates the micro-motion interference of the trunk of the human body by specially processing complex signals uploaded by the plurality of sets of systems, thereby obtaining more accurate vital signs.

title_en: Millimeter wave-based non-contact vital sign monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring method and a non-contact vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves, which relate to the technical field of millimeter wave radars and are used for transmitting millimeter wave radar signals to a target human body; receiving echo signals reflected by thoracic cavity vibration of a target human body; mixing an echo signal with a transmitted millimeter wave radar signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal, and extracting the frequency and the phase of the intermediate frequency signal; and constructing a frequency domain signal according to the frequency and the phase of the intermediate frequency signal, and filtering the respiratory signal based on the difference of the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal in the frequency spectrum characteristic to obtain the heartbeat signal.

title_en: Blood pressure detection method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood pressure detection method and a system based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the blood pressure detection method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the following steps: s1, designing a data acquisition system, and acquiring original data from a millimeter wave radar sensor through the data acquisition system; step S2, formulating a signal processing algorithm, and converting the original data into vital sign parameters related to blood pressure; and S3, correcting the individual difference through a personalized correction algorithm according to the physiological difference of each individual. The invention provides a blood pressure detection method and a blood pressure detection system based on millimeter wave radar, which are used for continuously measuring blood pressure without interruption and improving the accuracy of blood pressure measurement.

title_en: Method for repositioning moving targets in building based on unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted double-channel through-wall radar interference phase
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repositioning a moving target in a building based on an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted double-channel through-wall radar interference phase, which comprises the step of providing a novel method for repositioning the azimuth of the moving target based on the double-channel interference phase. The method firstly extracts the two-channel interference phase of the moving target in a distance compression domain. And secondly, establishing an interference phase polynomial model, and calculating coefficients of each order by using a least square method. Finally, the obtained polynomial coefficients are used for constructing and solving an optimization problem about the azimuth position of the moving target. In contrast to conventional methods, the present invention does not require imaging and multi-channel registration operations. In addition, the method provided by the invention can directly obtain the azimuth position of the moving target without estimating the radial speed and calculating the offset, thereby avoiding the problem of space Doppler ambiguity of the radial speed estimation faced by the traditional synthetic aperture radar moving target positioning technology. The validity of the proposed method is verified through simulation.

title_en: Termite detection method and termite detection system based on microwave radar through-wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a termite detection method and system based on microwave radar through-wall detection, and belongs to the technical field of microwave radar through-wall detection. The detection method comprises the steps of scanning a region to be detected by using a multi-output microwave radar detection device to obtain radar echo signals, performing signal receiving processing on the radar echo signals to obtain discrete time domain intermediate frequency signals, removing background clutter by band-pass filtering, reconstructing the signals to achieve DOA estimation of an information source, screening white ant targets in amplitude and measuring target distances, and sending termite detection results comprising the target distances and the DOA estimation to target users. The detection system comprises a microwave radar detection device and a user terminal, wherein the microwave radar detection device is used for scanning an area to be detected, performing signal processing and analysis on radar echo signals to obtain termite detection results, and sending the termite detection results to the user terminal. The invention adopts a non-invasive detection mode to realize rapid, convenient and low-cost accurate termite self-detection so as to obviously reduce the hazard of termite disasters.

title_en: Underground wire connect pipe laid underground
title_ko: 지하에 매설되는 지중배전선 연결관
abstract_en: An underground wire connection pipe is provided to accelerate an underground wire repairing process by instantly monitoring a damage state of the underground wire. A support unit(100) is buried under an underground pipe. An external case(200) is buried on a ground to be located over the underground pipe. A first measuring unit(300) and a second measuring unit are symmetrically embedded in the external case. First ends of a first wire(400) and a second wire are connected to the support unit, while second ends thereof are connected to the first and second measuring units. First and second support wires are connected to the measuring units. First and second winders wind the support wires. A control unit is connected to the measuring units. A light emitting unit(800) is connected to the control unit. A pipe is connected to an exterior of the underground pipe. Liquid is filled inside the pipe. A fire detector detects a fire inside the underground pipe.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring pulse wave and skinresistance of human body and respiration

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for measuring a pulse wave, skin resistance, and respiration. The device comprises: a grip-skin current measurement piece (80) configured to measure skin resistance of a person to be measured; a probe-skin current measurement piece (90) having a rod shape; a wrist pulse wave detecting sensor (100) having a clip shape; an index finger pulse wave detecting sensor (110) including a light emitting element and a light receiving element; a respiration detecting pad (120) including an air pressure pad; a main body (1) including a control unit (130), a capacitance touch input unit (30), a display unit (20), and a USB interface (140); and a personal computer (150) including an integrated control unit (160). Therefore, the device enables a user to simply obtain basic medical information.

title_en: Buried object detection in GPR images
abstract_en: A method and system for detecting the presence of subsurface objects within a medium is provided. In some embodiments, the imaging and detection system operates in a multistatic mode to collect radar return signals generated by an array of transceiver antenna pairs that is positioned across the surface and that travels down the surface. The imaging and detection system pre-processes the return signal to suppress certain undesirable effects. The imaging and detection system then generates synthetic aperture radar images from real aperture radar images generated from the pre-processed return signal. The imaging and detection system then post-processes the synthetic aperture radar images to improve detection of subsurface objects. The imaging and detection system identifies peaks in the energy levels of the post-processed image frame, which indicates the presence of a subsurface object.
