title_en: Noise filtering out method based on kurtosis coefficient
abstract_en: The invention relates to microwave imaging and ultra-wide-band wireless detection, in particular to a noise filtering out method based on a kurtosis coefficient. By the noise filtering out method based on the kurtosis coefficient, a buried object can be detected effectively, an objective response signal can be directly extracted from a signal containing objective information, and the shortcoming that an object cannot be detected due to over large noises in the objective signal is overcome. According to the noise filtering out method based on the kurtosis coefficient in the technical scheme, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are arranged on the periphery of an organization to be measured, the transmitting antenna transmits signals, and the receiving antenna receives the signals. The noise filtering out method based on the kurtosis coefficient comprises the following steps of (1) performing ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) on signals obtained by the receiving antenna; (2) guiding in a coefficient of association; (3) finding out a plurality of maximum intrinsic mode functions of the coefficient of association; (4) calculating a kurtosis coefficient of the maximum intrinsic mode functions of the coefficient of association by using the kurtosis coefficient; and (5) obtaining an objective information image. The noise filtering out method is mainly used for microwave imaging.

title_en: It is a kind of that detection method is strengthened based on the ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration that multi-antenna data merges
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of strengthen detection method based on the ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration that multi-antenna data merges, belong to bioradar or radar type human life detection field.Technical scheme is：First, the multi-channel information with regard to human body target breathing is provided by multiple antennas ultra-wide spectrum radar system；Secondly, the original radar return data of each passage are carried out into adaptable Kalman filter fusion after pretreatment and target association；Finally, export the human body respiration waveform for detecting.The innovation of the present invention is to propose a kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration to strengthen detection method, by the multi-channel information for providing being received to multiple antennas carry out data fusion, a feeble respiration detection difficult problem caused by human body target orientation and postural change is solved, so as to strengthen human body respiration detectivity of the ultra-wide spectrum radar in the application such as detecting through walls, earthquake rescue.

title_en: A kind of inspection device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of inspection device, including engineering truck, array Ground Penetrating Radar and trailer pole, and engineering truck is connected with array Ground Penetrating Radar by trailer pole；It will test equipment to be placed on engineering truck；The array Ground Penetrating Radar includes main structure group, steering structure group, driven structure group；Main structure group main function realizes support, connection, fixed effect；Steering structure group and driven structure group realize complete machine steering, lifting and vibration-damping function.The present invention can low cruise, collect the position RTK record, coal gas detection, visit the multifunctional alls such as ground, it realizes the detection of road foundation disaster, road quality examination, Urban Buried Pipeline Network detection, the functions such as underground utilities periphery Defect inspection, achievees the purpose that efficient, continuous probe, easy to use.
assignees: BEIJING HUAHANG RADIO MEASUREMENT RES INST

title_en: Highway soft soil foundation prefabricated friction type pile and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a friction type pile and a method for prefabricating a soft soil foundation on a highway, which comprises the following steps: the pile body, dynamometer and spacing pipe connected with the pile body; the limiting pipe is internally used for placing a limiting sheet, the dynamometer passes through the limiting pipe to enable a force measuring point to be in a region to be measured, and the dynamometer is limited or opened by adjusting the position of the limiting sheet; piles need to be buried in an danger zone, but whether the piles provide required stress cannot be determined, the precast piles can be monitored and repaired in time, and the safety factor of a foundation pit is greatly improved; compared with the traditional method for measuring the pile body stress, the method has the advantages that the measuring depth can be greatly deepened by arranging the sensor inside, and the installation is convenient without the guidance of technicians on workers; the problems of breakage and the like of the pile body can be analyzed in advance through data so as to prevent engineering disasters.

title_en: Non-contact human vital sign sensing method and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based non-contact human vital sign sensing method and a radar-based non-contact human vital sign sensing system, which comprise the following steps: collecting radar echo signals comprising targets, processing intermediate frequency signals obtained by a low-pass filter to obtain signal spectrums, and selecting a distance domain with the largest dynamic energy as a distance domain for sensing the targets; determining the dynamic and static states of a measured target according to the signal spectrum, if the dynamic state is the dynamic state, re-acquiring the signal, and if the static state is the static state, performing distance beam forming on the signal in the distance domain of the perceived target, so as to enhance the signal to noise ratio of the target signal; performing fast Fourier transform on the target signal to obtain a frequency spectrum of a complex signal, and calculating to obtain the respiration rate; and sequentially performing first-order difference and fast Fourier transform on the target signal to obtain a frequency spectrum of a differential complex signal, and calculating to obtain the heart rate of the target according to the frequency spectrum and the respiration rate of the differential complex signal. The invention can expand the range of breath and heartbeat detection and improve the accuracy of heartbeat detection; can be widely applied to the field of non-contact human vital sign sensing.

title_en: Ultra-wideband through-wall radar wall parameter measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring ultra-wideband through-wall radar wall parameters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, data acquisition and input of a hardware part; S2, clutter and noise suppression, S3, data imaging, S4, parameter identification and output. The method optimizes the characteristic enhancement technology and the high-precision recognition technology of the aiming through-wall radar human body activity recognition, obtains parameters more quickly, calculates more accurately, and has better excellent performance.
assignees: SUZHOU RED POLICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sleep respiration screening method integrating blood oxygen and radio frequency sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep respiration screening method by fusing blood oxygen and a radio frequency sensor. The method comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module, a blood oxygen signal acquisition unit and a radar signal acquisition unit, wherein the blood oxygen signal acquisition unit is used for acquiring blood oxygen signals by utilizing a blood oxygen finger ring, and the radar signal acquisition unit is used for acquiring vital sign signals of a user by utilizing a biological radar; the signal preprocessing module is used for realizing the synchronization of a radar signal and a blood oxygen signal and extracting a respiratory signal from the radar signal; a respiratory event detection module for detecting an apneic event and a possible hypopneas event for the preprocessed radar signal; and the radar blood oxygen fusion module is used for fusing possible low-ventilation events and blood oxygen states to obtain detection results of the low-ventilation events. The sleep respiration monitoring system can monitor sleep respiration information of a user, screen whether apnea/hypopnea occurs in the sleep process, and is effective, feasible and reliable in performance.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pipe diameter estimation method in underground survey radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To precisely find an aperture of a buried pipe based on a reception signal level, using an underground survey radar.  <P>SOLUTION: This pipe diameter estimation method stores a correspondence table of a pipe diameter in a reference depth to the reception signal level (S1), conducts usual survey (S2), and finds a buried depth and a dielectric constant of a soil, based on different propagation times from two lines of reception systems (S3). A reception signal is inverse-TC-processed (S4) to find the reception signal level for estimation. The correspondence table in a reference signal is corrected based on the depth and the dielectric constant (S5), and the corrected table is compared with the reception signal level to estimate the pipe diameter (S6).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
assignees: JAPAN RADIO CO LTD;TOKYO GAS CO LTD;OSAKA GAS CO LTD;TOHO GAS KK;SEIBU GAS CO LTD

title_en: Physiological signal measuring equipment using socks
title_ko: 양말을 활용한 생체정보 측정 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-information measuring system utilizing socks is provided to simultaneously measure various bio-signals through a patch composed of biometric sensors. CONSTITUTION: A bio-information measuring system utilizing socks comprises a bio-sensor module(110) and a control unit. The bio-sensor module contacts wearer's foot, particularly the instep(20a), the sole(20b), or the heel(20c). The bio-sensor module is composed of an electrocardiogram sensor, a skin conductivity sensor, or a body temperature sensor. The control unit converts bio-information data into the digital bio-signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 양말 내에서 하나 또는 복수개가 부착되며, 상기 양말을 착용하는 착용자의 생체정보를 감지하는 생체센서모듈 및 상기 생체정보의 데이터를 무선으로 전달받는 제어부를 포함하는 양말을 활용한 생체정보 측정 장치가 제공된다.  
따라서 양말의 발등 부분과 발바닥 장심 부분에 생체신호 측정 장치를 부착하여 오차 및 노이즈가 감소되어 정확한 데이터를 측정할 수 있다. 또한 기존의 장갑이나 의류가 아닌, 일반적으로 착용하는 양말에 부착하므로, 주의력 분산이 감소되어 사용자는 장시간 편안하게 착용이 가능한 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Water shelter apparatus of underpass
title_ko: 지하도 출입구의 물막이 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A water barrier device for the entrance of an underpass is provided to position a water barrier cover in a vertical direction using a cylinder actuating device or magnetic actuating device installed inside a case. CONSTITUTION: A water barrier device for the entrance of an underpass is buried in the bottom surface of the entrance of an underpass and comprises a case unit and an air inflating and discharging unit. The case unit is composed of a case(10), a hinge(12), and a cover(11). The case is buried in a groove formed on the bottom surface of the entrance. The hinge is coupled to the case. The cover is connected to the hinge and covers the case. The air inflating and discharging unit is composed of an air compressor, an air injecting fan, an airbag(20), and an air outlet. The air compressor powers the air injecting fan. The air injecting fan supplies air into the airbag. The airbag is inflated by the supplied air. The air outlet discharges the air to the outside. [Reference numerals] (AA) Inside; (BB) Outside
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하도 출입구의 물막이 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 지하도로 내려가는 출입구 바닥에 형성된 홈에 케이스를 설치하여 평상시에는 사람들이 밟고 지나도록 해주고, 집중호우로 침수가 우려될 경우에는 케이스 내부에 장착되어 있는 에어 컴프레셔에 의해 공기주입 팬을 구동시켜 에어백이 수직으로 부풀어 오르거나, 케이스 내부에 장착되어 있는 실린더 작동장치 또는 마그네틱 작동장치에 의해 물막이 커버를 수직으로 직립되게 하며, 매립된 힌지에 의해 결합된 케이스용 커버가 자동으로 에어백의 외측부분에 수직으로 세워짐으로써, 도로에 넘쳐나는 빗물이 지하도로 흘러내리는 것을 완전히 차단되도록 하여 지하 시설물을 보호할 수 있고, 집중호우로 인하여 침수가 우려되는 비가 그쳐 평상시로 되는 경우에는 에어백의 상부 일측에 형성되어 있는 공기 배출구에 의해 공기가 모두 빠져나간 다음 케이스용 커버가 닫쳐지게 함으로써, 사람들이 밟고 지나도록 할 수 있으며, 물막이장치의 후면 일측에 공기압력 조절센서가 설치됨으로써, 에어백의 공기압력을 주변 상황에 맞게 조절을 할 수 있고, 물막이장치의 후면 일측에 유입수 배출구를 형성하여 줌으로써, 물막이 장치 내에 남아있는 유입수를 자연적으로 배출시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HAN A TECH CO LTD;JANG SEONG JUN

title_en: Garment for measuring vital signals
title_ko: 생체신호측정용 의복
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A garment for biological signal measurement is provided to accurately measure a biological signal by increasing the adhesion between a biological signal measurement unit and the body of a patient and to take prompt emergency measures by informing an emergency situation to the outside when the emergency situation occurs. CONSTITUTION: A garment(10) for biological signal measurement comprises a main body(100), a biological signal measurement unit, and a biological signal measurement sensor(300). The biological signal measurement unit is detachable from the main body. The biological signal measurement unit is in contact with the body of a patient to measure a biological signal of the patient. The biological signal measurement sensor is connected to the biological signal measurement unit to send the biological signal transmitted from the biological signal measurement unit to a terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호측정용 의복은 의복 본체와 분리 가능하게 결합되는 생체신호측정 유닛을 구비하여, 의복 본체의 관리 편의성을 향상시킬 뿐만 아니라 생체신호측정 유닛과 신체와의 밀착력을 증대시켜 정확한 생체신호 측정을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection
title_ko: 생체 신호 감지를 위한 fmcw 레이다 목표물 탐지 측정 방법
abstract_en: An FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection is provided. A vital signal detection method using radar according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: using the correlation between the phase change profile of an IF signal due to fine movement and a target signal intensity change profile to select a range bin where an accurate vital signal exists. Thus, it is possible to increase the estimation accuracy of biological signals through accurate tracking of people (targets), and to accurately remove clutter by utilizing the phase unwrapping technology that is adaptive to a change in upper body movement compared to the 180-degree fixed phase unwrapping technology.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 감지를 위한 FMCW 레이다 목표물 탐지 측정 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 레이다를 이용한 생체 신호 감지 방법은, 미세 움직임으로 인한 IF 신호의 위상 변화 프로파일과 표적 신호 세기 변화 프로파일 간의 상관관계를 이용하여 정확한 생체 신호가 존재하는 거리 빈을 선택함으로써, 사람(표적)에 대한 정확한 추적을 통해 생체 신호의 추정 정확성을 높이고, 180도 고정형 위상 언래핑 기술 대비 상체 움직임 변화량에 적응형인 위상 언래핑 기술을 활용하여 클러터를 정확하게 제거할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for monitoring human posture in a closed space using radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 폐쇄 공간 내 사람의 자세 모니터링 장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, the posture monitoring device monitors a posture of an occupant in a closed space by using radar, detects a bio-signal for each of a plurality of sectors dividing the closed space in a height direction, and determines the posture of the occupant based on a distribution pattern of the sectors in which the bio-signal is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 자세 모니터링 장치는 레이더를 이용하여 폐쇄 공간 내의 재실자의 자세를 모니터링 하는 장치로 폐쇄 공간을 높이 방향으로 구분한 복수의 섹터 별로 생체 신호를 검출하고 생체 신호가 검출된 섹터들의 분포 패턴에 기초하여 재실자의 자세를 판단한다.

title_en: Locked structure emergency access systems and methods
abstract_en: A locked structure emergency access method involves a vital signs sensor (20) (e.g. a wearable smartwatch) communicating an emergency alert to a rescue professional server (60) (e.g., a 911 server), a rescue volunteer device (80) (e.g., a smartphone or a table), and/or a defibrillator (e.g., an automated external defibrillator or a semi-automated external defibrillator). Based on the communication(s) of the emergency alert by the vital signs sensor (20), a virtual key (92) (e.g., a NFS, QR-code or a bar code) may be communicated to the rescue volunteer device (80) whereby a rescue volunteer via the volunteer key may obtain a physical key (91) to gain access to a locked structure (e.g. a home or an office). Additionally, a rescue professional via the volunteer key may obtain an additional physical key (91) to gain access to the locked structure.

title_en: Physiological parameter monitoring system and method, storage medium
abstract_en: Provided are a physiological parameter monitoring system and method, and as well as a storage medium. The monitoring system includes a first measurement unit, a second measurement unit and a processor. On the one hand, one measurement unit is used to mainly measure vital signs and another one measurement unit is used to mainly measure movements, so that interference can be comprehensively determined through information correction to avoid inaccurate measurement of vital signs caused by a single measurement unit. On the other hand, adding a second measurement unit can overcome the problem of poor anti-interference performance when using radar device alone for non-contact vital sign measurement. By selecting, fusing, or correcting the information measured by different measurement units and participating in the processing process of vital sign information, the reliability of the system can be enhanced, such that more accurate vital sign measurement results can be obtained.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINDRAY BIOMEDICAL ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for using radio frequency signals and sensors to monitor environments
abstract_en: Systems and methods for using radio frequency signals and sensors to monitor environments (e.g., indoor building, industrial environments) are disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a system for providing a wireless asymmetric network comprises a hub having one or more processing units and at least one antenna for transmitting and receiving radio frequency (RF) communications in the wireless asymmetric network and a plurality of sensor nodes each having a wireless device with a transmitter and a receiver to enable bi-directional RF communications with the hub in the wireless asymmetric network. The one or more processing units of the hub are configured to determine localization of the plurality of sensor nodes within the wireless asymmetric network, to monitor regions within an environment for human presence and location of at least one robot, to determine human presence information to indicate whether a human is present within the monitored regions, and to determine a location for the human based on the human presence information when a human is present within the monitored regions.

title_en: Mine Detection Using Radar Vibrometer
abstract_en: A frequency-stepped radar may be used to detect buried landmines by sequentially inducing vibrations of different frequencies in the landmine. A sensor detects signals associated with the vibrations, and a processor processes the signals to detect the landmine.

title_en: Human body respiration signal detection method based on fast-RCNN through-wall ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a human body respiration signal of a through-wall ultra-wideband radar based on a Faster-RCNN network, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out denoising and weak signal enhancement pretreatment on an original slow time-distance two-dimensional ultra-wideband radar echo signal; then, adopting an Advance normalization method to continuously perform signal enhancement and denoising on the processed echo; imaging the echo signals in the preprocessing process into a gray image by adopting MATLAB, wherein the width of the image corresponds to the slow time direction of the echo, and the height of the image corresponds to the distance direction of the echo; and finally, screening the obtained gray level image, labeling a data set, and training a Faster-RCNN network model to recognize the human body respiratory weak signal. The invention has high identification accuracy and high detection speed, and provides better technical support for practical technologies such as radar echo target detection, life detection and the like in practical application.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument of portability rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar life detection instrument capable of carrying rescue equipment, and relates to the technical field of radar life detection instruments. According to the radar life detection instrument, the detection instrument body, the lifting handle, the storage bin, the placing drawer, the pull handle, the limiting block, the limiting plate, the fixing block, the cushion block, the sleeve, the loop bar, the clamping plate, the spring and the clamping block are arranged, so that the function of placing rescue equipment inside the radar life detection instrument is achieved, occupied space is reduced by placing the rescue equipment inside the radar life detection instrument, influence on normal actions of search and rescue personnel is prevented, rescue time of the rescue personnel is avoided, meanwhile, the rescue equipment is prevented from being lost, influence on normal operation of the rescue actions is avoided, meanwhile, the rescue equipment is fixed and buffered, and damage to the rescue equipment due to impact force generated by bumping and shaking of the radar life detection instrument is prevented.
assignees: JIANGSU FLAME BLUE FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Stress and fatigue analysis and diagnosis instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to an analysis and diagnosis device (1) for detecting stress and/or fatigue syndrome on a test subject. The analysis and diagnosis device is provided with at least one sensor (2) which detects the vital signals of the person to be examined and supplies them to a memory unit, a power supply and an evaluation unit which is connected to the memory unit. The evaluation unit can evaluate a time-resolved curve of the vital signals detected by the at least one sensor (2), and a comparator is provided in the evaluation unit for diagnosing stress and/or fatigue syndrome by means of the adjustment of the time-resolved curve of the detected vital signals using the time-resolved stress and fatigue vital samples stored in the database.

title_en: Monitoring method and device capable of preventing asphyxia
abstract_en: A monitoring method and device capable of preventing suffocation, carry on IQ quadrature mixing to the transmitting wave and echo of the millimeter wave radar, output the target distance, speed, direction and phase information; performing correlation analysis through the modulus of the corresponding frequency point and amplitude transformation caused by respiratory vibration, and selecting the optimal vital sign point of the monitored object; selecting the frequency of the maximum module value as the frequency of the current breath and the heartbeat respectively; comprehensively judging the respiration and heartbeat, analyzing whether the frequency of the current respiration and heartbeat is in a preset normal range, and if not, analyzing the duration and the trend quantity of increasing or decreasing; and according to the data of comprehensive judgment, if the duration of the breath which is not in the normal range exceeds a preset time value and the heartbeat exceeds the normal range, judging that the asphyxia occurs, and reporting the judgment result to perform local and remote alarm. The baby asphyxia detection device can actively find baby asphyxia in time and reduce baby risk; the application range is wide, and the life safety of the monitored object is effectively guaranteed.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINGHUA XIANGKONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: In-vehicle vital sign detection and early warning method, system, storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-vehicle vital sign detection and early warning method, a system, a storage medium and a vehicle; the vital sign detection and early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current vehicle state, acquiring vital sign data of personnel in the vehicle through a millimeter wave radar, and processing the vital sign data through a digital signal processing technology to obtain heart rate and respiratory rate of the personnel in the vehicle; and then, carrying out anomaly detection on the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the personnel in the vehicle, and making an early warning sound according to an anomaly detection result. The invention adopts the millimeter wave radar, and realizes the detection and reporting of vital sign data during running and after parking by judging the heart rate and the respiratory rate of personnel in the vehicle, thereby ensuring that the personnel in the vehicle can be timely rescued when danger occurs.
assignees: HUIZHOU DESAY SV AUTOMOTIVE CO LTD

title_en: Well detection method for buried pipeline valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried pipeline valve well detection method, which comprises the following steps: determining a presumed location of a buried valve well to be probed and determining a type of pipe connected to the valve well; selecting a detection mode according to the pipeline type, detecting the position and the trend of the pipeline at the estimated position, and determining the crossing position of the pipeline; and detecting and excavating verification by using a ground penetrating radar according to the crossing position, and determining the accurate position of the valve well. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, accurate data information can be provided for gas enterprises, the management of pipelines is convenient, and powerful guarantee is provided for the datamation and informatization of cities.

title_en: Three-dimensional imaging method and device for through-wall radar based on priori information
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional imaging method and device of a through-wall radar based on priori information, which belong to the technical field of radars, consider three-dimensional characteristics of a wall structure, characterize local similarity of images through 3D-TV constraint, inhibit influence of wall artifacts and random half-points by using group sparse constraint, and can keep global coherence of the wall structure under the influence of noise by combining tensor Tucker decomposition constraint, so that perspective three-dimensional imaging quality is improved. According to the invention, the three-dimensional characteristics of the wall structure are considered in the solving process, so that the solving result is more consistent with the real wall structure.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Earthquake detection system and method and application thereof in seismic surface survey
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic detection system, a method and application thereof in seismic surface investigation, relating to the technical field of seismic exploration, comprising a detection well; the system comprises an optical fiber sensor, an optical fiber data acquisition module, an excitation device and a seismic source, wherein the optical fiber sensor is arranged in a detection well and/or buried on the ground, the optical fiber data acquisition module is connected with one end of the optical fiber sensor and used for providing a light source and acquiring detection data, the excitation device is arranged in the detection well and/or on the ground close to a wellhead of the detection well and used for forming the seismic source, and the problems in the seismic surface investigation technology in at least one prior art are solved.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC GEOPHYSICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: FMCW-based radar vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method based on an FMCW radar, and the method can realize the vital sign detection by adopting single-channel data of a single receiving antenna, belonging to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection. Firstly, radar intermediate frequency signals are stored as a two-dimensional data matrix, distance information is obtained through Fourier transformation of fast time dimension, after static target clutter interference is filtered through a static target filtering algorithm, the position of a human body is determined, after phase information is extracted from the position of the human body, a periodic signal multiplication algorithm and a heart rate optimizing equation are carried out, and finally, the solution of physical sign information is successfully obtained through an optimizing algorithm. The invention can effectively reduce the interference of the limb movement of the human body without the need of the test personnel to keep the whole-course static state, and realize the vital sign detection under different body states.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on MIMO rotary radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on MIMO rotary radar, which relates to the technical field of radar, and comprises the steps of detecting all targets in an omnidirectional range based on the MIMO rotary radar to obtain an original radar data matrix, dividing the original radar data matrix into a plurality of pieces of virtual radar data, and carrying out multidimensional processing on the plurality of pieces of virtual radar data to obtain position information of all dynamic targets and angles of static references, wherein the position information comprises distances and angles; correcting the angles of all the dynamic targets by utilizing the angles of the static reference objects to obtain corrected angles of all the dynamic targets; and (3) selecting a detection target at will from the dynamic targets, and detecting vital signs of the detection target under the same-distance and non-same-distance conditions based on the distances and correction angles of all the dynamic targets. The invention can realize the omnidirectional detection around the radar, acquire the absolute position of the dynamic target in the omnidirectional range and improve the accuracy of the detection of the life signal.

title_en: Intelligent teaching lectern system based on multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent teaching lectern system based on a multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of education equipment. The intelligent inspection system comprises a lectern body integrating a hidden unmanned cabin, a folding unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a multispectral sensor and an edge computing center, three functions are innovatively realized, namely, firstly, intelligent inspection, namely, unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation (drawing precision + -3 cm) through laser SLAM, millimeter wave radar vital sign detection (respiratory frequency precision + -0.5 times/min) and thermal imaging abnormal positioning are fused, manual inspection is replaced, secondly, teaching enhancement is supported, AR knowledge point projection (brightness 500 nit) is supported, a multi-mode question answering system (dialect recognition rate is more than or equal to 95%) is realized, air touch interaction is realized through an ultrasonic array, thirdly, five-stage emergency response is realized, namely, an escape channel is opened from abnormal sign early warning to autonomous, and response delay is less than or equal to 2.5 seconds due to linkage of a spraying system and AED equipment.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact electrophysiological monitoring method based on acoustic wave reflection and AI analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact electrophysiological monitoring method based on sound wave reflection and AI analysis, which comprises the steps of multiplexing consumer-level Bluetooth sound box hardware, transforming a loudspeaker and a microphone of a Bluetooth sound box into a biological radar and a vital sign sensor, detecting the vital sign information through sound wave modulation, processing echo signals based on a TDOA positioning algorithm and an MVDR beam forming algorithm, improving the signal to noise ratio of the echo signals, establishing a time-frequency domain joint feature matrix, processing the time-frequency domain joint feature matrix based on a dual-channel AI model, respectively processing a respiratory frequency band and a blood oxygen band through an LSTM network and an SVM classifier, and finally outputting the vital sign information such as respiratory frequency, heart rate value, blood oxygen saturation and the like.

title_en: Eemergency shelter apparatus a hatch type
title_ko: 해치형 비상 피난장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A hatch type emergency sheltering device is provided to enable residents, the old, and children to rapidly escape in an emergency. CONSTITUTION: A hatch type emergency sheltering device comprises: a frame(10) which is buried in a square form in the veranda floor of an apartment house and is vertically penetrated in a size that a user can come in and out; a hatch cover(20) which is hinge-coupled with the top of the frame and is installed to be able to be opened and closed; a hatch cover opening and closing part(60) which opens and close the hatch cover; a supporting plate elevating unit which is installed in the lower part of the frame; a load sensor installed in one side of the frame; a heat/smoke sensor which senses indoor heat or smoke; and a controller(90) which elevates the supporting plate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재와 같이 비상시에 화재가 발생한 아래층으로 노약자, 어린이들이 안전하고 빠르게 대피할 수 있도록 함과 동시에 홈오토메이션과 연동하여 외부와 커뮤니케이션을 통해 타인에게 피해를 최소한으로 줄이고, 또한 피난장치에 의해 층간 소음이 전달되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 한 해치형 비상 피난장치에 관한 것으로, 다수의 가구가 공동으로 거주하는 공동주택의 베란다 바닥에 사각형의 형태로 매립 설치되어 사람이 출입할 수 있는 크기의 상하로 관통된 프레임; 프레임의 상부에 힌지 결합되어 개폐 가능하게 설치되는 해치덮개; 해치덮개를 개폐시키는 해치덮개 해치덮개 개폐부; 프레임의 하부에 승강 가능하게 설치되어지되 그 상부로 인원의 탑승이 이루어지는 받침판; 받침판을 지지하여 전원의 인가에 의해 승강시키는 받침판 승강수단; 프레임의 일측에 설치되어지되 받침판의 하중을 감지하여 설정된 하중을 기준으로 이상의 하중일 경우에는 받침판 승강수단을 통해 하강시키는 한편 이하의 하중일 경우에는 받침판 승강수단을 통해 상승시키는 하중감지센서; 공동주택의 내부에 설치되어 화재로 인한 열 또는 연기의 발생시 실내 내부의 열 또는 연기를 감지하는 열/연기 감지기; 및 열/연기 감지기로부터 감지된 신호에 따라 해치덮개 개폐부를 제어하여 해치덮개를 개폐시키는 한편 하중감지센서에 의한 하중 감지를 통해 받침판 승강수단을 제어하여 받침판을 승강시키는 컨트롤러를 포함한 구성으로 이루어진다.
assignees: DAEMYUNG MACHINE IND CO LTD;SEOHAN F & AMP C CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for monitoring a biosignal based on a wireless network. According to an aspect of the present invention, a system for preventing solitary death based on an embedded biosignal collector installed in a lamp in a room comprises an embedded biosignal collector in a room lamp. The embedded biosignal collector in the room lamp collects a biosignal, performs digital signal processing (DSP) to suppress a clutter signal in the biosignal and extract only a biosignal of a solitary death prevention subject, performs signal processing to extract only an important signal from the biosignal on which DSP is performed, extracts a feature parameter from the biosignal on which signal processing is performed, and transmits the biosignal and the feature parameter to a biosignal processing collection server. The biosignal includes a heart beat signal, a motion signal, and a respiration signal. The embedded biosignal collector is a super-sensitivity microwave sensor. The biosignal processing collection server collects the feature parameter and the biosignal of the solitary death prevention subject to extract biosignal property information. The biosignal collection server extracts a signal of the solitary death prevention subject in a plurality of biosignals generated by a plurality of solitary death prevention subjects in an identical place based on the biosignal property information.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 또 다른 측면에 따른 방 내부의 등에 설치된 내장형 생체 신호 수집기 기반 고독사 방지 시스템은 상기 고독사 방지 시스템은 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기를 포함하고, 상기 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 생체 신호를 수집하고, 상기 생체 신호에서 클러터(Clutter) 신호를 억제하고 고독사 방지 대상자의 생체 신호만을 추출하는 DSP(digital signal processing) 처리를 수행하고, 상기 DSP 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 중요 신호만 추출하는 신호 처리를 수행하고, 상기 신호 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 특징 파라미터를 추출하고, 상기 생체 신호 및 상기 특징 파라미터를 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버로 전송하도록 구현되고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버는 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 상기 생체 신호 및 특징 파라미터를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하도록 구현되고,  상기 생체 신호 수집 서버는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 고독사 방지 대상자에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 신호를 추출하도록 구현된다.

title_en: ESS data protection system in case in fire
title_ko: 화재 발생 시 배터리 데이터 보호 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery data protection system. More specifically, the present invention relates to a battery data protection system, comprising: an ESS container (100) including a fire detection sensor unit (110), a control unit (120), a data central processing unit (130), a data storage unit (150), and a separation unit (140) therein; a storage unit (300) located outside the container; and an opening/closing unit (200) located between the container and the storage unit, wherein a fire occurrence signal is received from the fire detection sensor unit (110), the opening/closing unit (200) is opened by the control unit (120), and the data storage unit (150) is moved to the storage unit (300) and buried. According to the present invention, the data storage unit can be safely protected.
abstract_ko: 본원발명은 배터리 데이터 보호 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 내부에 화재 감지 센서부(110), 제어부(120), 데이터 중앙처리부(130), 데이터 저장부(150) 및 분리부(140)를 포함하는 상기 ESS 컨테이너(100), 상기 컨테이너 외부에 위치하는 보관부(300), 및 상기 컨테이너와 상기 보관부 사이에 위치하는 개폐부(200)를 포함하고, 상기 화재 감지 센서부(110)로부터 화재발생신호를 전송받고, 상기 제어부(120)에 의해 상기 개폐부가(200)가 열리며, 상기 데이터 저장부(150)가 보관부(300)로 이동되어 매설되는 것을 특징으로 하는 배터리 데이터 보호 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Biological monitoring and care system for care services for the elderly living alone
title_ko: 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 위한 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio-monitoring and care system for providing a care service for an elderly person living alone. The disclosed bio-monitoring and care system includes: a bio-signal measurement device which measures a movement path according to a dynamic state of an elderly person living alone in a predetermined space by using an FMCW radar, and measures a bio-signal in a static state of the elderly person living alone to analyze the bio-signal measured in the static state of the elderly person living alone, and then transmits a resulting signal according to the analysis of the bio-signal through a communication network; a server which stores a bio-signal and a signal related to the movement path measured by the bio-signal measurement device and provides the signal related to the movement path to a management unit according to a request of the management unit; and the management unit which selectively provides a care service for the elderly person living alone as the resulting signal is received from the bio-signal measurement device through the communication network. Therefore, the care service for elderly person living alone can be provided efficiently and stably.
abstract_ko: 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 제공하기 위한 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템이 개시된다. 개시되는 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템은, FMCW 레이더를 이용하여 소정의 공간 내에서의 독거 노인의 동적 상태에 따른 동선을 측정하고 상기 독거 노인의 정적 상태에서의 생체 신호를 측정하여 상기 독거 노인의 정적 상태에서 측정된 생체 신호를 분석한 후, 상기 생체 신호의 분석에 따른 결과 신호를 통신 네트워크를 통해 전송하기 위한, 생체 신호 측정 장치와, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치에 의해 측정된 동선에 관한 신호 및 생체 신호를 저장하고 상기 관리부의 요청에 따라 상기 동선에 관한 신호를 상기 관리부 측으로 제공하는 서버와, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치로부터 상기 결과 신호를 상기 통신 네트워크를 통해 수신함에 따라 선택적으로 상기 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 제공하는 관리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Identification sensor for works buried at great depth
abstract_en: A transponder for a wireless communication and contactless identification system, of RFID type, intended to be affixed on (or in proximity) to buried works, said transponder comprising: - a set of antenna segments (200x) consisting of electrical conductors constituting at least one first and one second antenna element (203-1, 203-2), - a printed circuit comprising an RFID chip and at least one tuning capacitor (202x) as well as a connector (281) allowing electrical connecting of said antenna segments.
assignees: ELIOT INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS S A S

title_en: Wearable device with ambient-light seal with integrated dry electrodes for electrical vital signs measurements
abstract_en: A wearable device (10) for individual health assessment measurement of vital signs comprises a housing (16), an optical sensor/emitter assembly (18), a controller (20), and a light seal (12). The optical sensor/emitter assembly emits optical signals from a bottom surface (22) of the housing through skin of a subject and receives reflected optical signals. The controller (20) controls a physiological measurement modality of the wearable device in the measurement of the vital signs and is coupled to the optical sensor/ emitter assembly (18) for controlling the optical sensor/emitter assembly. The light seal (12) is configured to be removably coupled with the skin of the subject and to prevent ambient light interference with the optical sensor/emitter assembly when coupled. The light seal (12) comprises multiple integrated dry electrodes (14a, 14b) for transmitting and/or receiving electrical signals to/from the skin of the subject. Each integrated dry electrode is electrically coupled to the controller (20) for obtaining electrical measurements according to the physiological measurement modality.

title_en: Nuclear power plant, safety system with fuse element and gravity elevator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nuclear power plant and safety system with fuse element and gravity elevator, the buildings of the power plant subjected to contamination being buried below sea level and under borated water basins, and having a safety system free of electrical and electronic components to act in the event of possible accidents comprising, among others, means for flooding the buildings of the power plant with thermal fuses and gravity elevators for operator evacuation in the event of an emergency.
assignees: LARRION JAVIER;SERBEX TECNOLOGIA Y VALORES S L

title_en: System and Method for Monitoring Life Signs of a Person
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring a person within a defined area by detecting breathing, or the lack thereof. Breathing is detected using radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals. The radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals are analyzed to determine if the subject person is moving, and if not moving if the person is breathing or not-breathing. An alarm is generated should the reflected radar signals, the camera signals and the microphone signals all simultaneously indicate no movement and no movement of the subject person in the defined area for a selected period of time.

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in front of a plurality of sensors such as those of speakers and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from the plurality of sensors may be analyzed by the processor to determine if one or more humans are present proximate to the device. Based on the determined presence or absence of one or more humans, further actions including, inter alia, customizing a home theatre experience for the one or more humans, making content recommendations, or activating parental controls can be taken by the device.

title_en: Life tracking UAS after a kind of calamity
abstract_en: The present invention, which discloses life tracking UAS after life tracking UAS after a kind of calamity, the calamity, to be included：UAS：Including at least 1 frame unmanned plane, the unmanned plane obtains the position of itself by aeronautical satellite in real time, image, spectrum and the infrared ray of flying overhead in post-disaster search and rescue region, in real time collection ground, and control station is sent to after position, image, spectrum and infrared ray are integrated, sorted out and analyzed；Control station system：Including at least one control station, image, spectrum and the infrared ray that the control station is used to be gathered according to unmanned plane identify vital sign parameter signals, and the map for drawing statement life body position is combined with position；Communication link system：For providing unmanned plane and aeronautical satellite, unmanned plane and control station and control station and the communication link of disaster relief command centre.The present invention can overcome the influence of adverse circumstances, continuous acquisition data, and have the advantages that search efficiency height, life entity accurate positioning.

title_en: Forward direction mixing match tracing method and system towards multipolarization through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of forward direction mixing match tracing method and system towards multipolarization through-wall radar imaging, this method include：Obtain the radar return under multiple POLARIZATION CHANNELs；Vectorization processing is carried out to multiple radar returns, calculate base signal matrix, and degree of rarefication K is set according to multiple radar returns of vectorization；The local solution that multiple POLARIZATION CHANNELs are solved using orthogonal matching pursuit method is merged all local solutions, finds out the position corresponding to K maximum value in fusion results, initialize Ji Xinhaoji, and the signal for calculating multiple POLARIZATION CHANNELs is remaining；Calculating is iterated to the local solution of multiple POLARIZATION CHANNELs, whether iteration is stopped according to preset iteration stopping condition judgment；It is calculated according to the iteration result for meeting iteration stopping condition and merges to obtain and be ultimately imaged result.The invention has the advantages that：In forward direction mixing matching pursuit algorithm, evaluated selected base signal and selected optimal base signal, image quality to be better than other greedy algorithms.

title_en: Life detection radar system and method based on random code modulation sine wave signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a life detection radar system and a method based on random code modulation sine wave signals, wherein the life detection radar system comprises a radar host and a handheld terminal, the radar host comprises a power module, a central processing unit, a transmitting unit, a receiving unit, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna and a communication unit, a life detection command is sent to the radar host by the handheld terminal, the random code modulation sine wave signals are generated after the system receives the command, the random code modulation sine wave signals are amplified by a power amplifier and transmitted by the transmitting antenna, life detection is carried out on a target area, echo signals received by the receiving antenna are demodulated by a quadrature demodulator after being amplified by a low-noise amplifier, a data acquisition module acquires the demodulated signals, then the signals are output to the central processing unit to extract life information and position information, and analysis and judgment results are transmitted to the handheld terminal to be displayed. The system introduces the random code signal into the traditional Doppler life detection radar, and has the advantages of sensitive response, high resolution and strong anti-interference capability.

title_en: Old man's robot system of accompanying and attending to based on interaction of multidimension degree intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional intelligent interaction-based elderly accompanying robot accompanying system, which relates to the technical field of accompanying robots, wherein heart rate, respiratory rate and body temperature can be monitored in real time by utilizing a vital sign radar without contacting a user, the health state of the user is comprehensively estimated by combining the monitoring of the heart rate, the respiratory rate and the body temperature, the multi-dimensional health monitoring and the evaluation are beneficial to finding potential health problems as soon as possible, in addition, the user can interact with the robot through voice instructions to carry out video call, inquire calendar and weather information, the user experience of the elderly is improved, the technical use threshold is reduced, the system is internally provided with an image processing unit, dangerous situations such as falling or abnormal behaviors can be identified, medical staff and family contacts are automatically contacted, timely emergency rescue is provided, daily chatting and psychological guiding with the elderly are realized by utilizing a large language model, and possible autism and depression symptoms are relieved.

title_en: Physiological index monitoring method, device, equipment and medium applied to micro-pressure oxygen cabin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a physiological index monitoring method, device, equipment and medium applied to a micro-pressure oxygen cabin, wherein the method comprises the following steps of carrying a physiological index monitoring system comprising a radar sensing module and a fingerstall module to the micro-pressure oxygen cabin; the method comprises the steps of continuously detecting whether a moving target exists in a set area through a radar sensing module, triggering a system to enter a working state if the moving target exists, detecting whether the target wears a fingerstall through a temperature module of a fingerstall module, monitoring physiological indexes of the target through the radar sensing module, the temperature module and a blood oxygen detection module if the moving target is worn, outputting generated data as physiological index data, sending prompt information if the fingerstall is not worn, setting a duration threshold, and recovering the physiological index monitoring system to a standby state if the time that the target is in the non-moving state exceeds the duration threshold and the target is not worn. Because the proposal realizes the full-automatic vital sign monitoring through the physiological index monitoring system.

title_en: Reservoir engineering safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a reservoir engineering safety management system and method, comprising the steps of acquiring a crack chromatographic image of a drainage gallery wall body through a through-wall type ground penetrating radar, and synchronously acquiring infiltration linear displacement dynamic data of a distributed optical fiber sensor; the method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on the two types of data, constructing a fracture space topological relation and a seepage conduction path model, generating a defect-seepage coupling map, utilizing a coupling map analysis module and a space-time convolution neural network module to identify the abrupt change trend of the displacement rate of a seepage line, triggering a gallery structure failure early warning signal, automatically generating a reinforcement work order after early warning, calling an unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out high-definition image rechecking task, and feeding back a rechecking result to correct the seepage conduction path model to realize dynamic self-correction. The invention has the capabilities of accurate modeling, intelligent early warning and real-time closed-loop regulation and control, and can remarkably improve the structural safety management level of reservoir engineering.

title_en: Garment for measuring physiological signals and method of fabricating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정용 의복 및 그 제조 방법
abstract_en: A garment for measuring physiological signals and a method for manufacturing the same are provided to reduce distortion and noise of the measured physiological signals due to wrinkle and stretch thereof even in wearer's intensive exercise. A garment(10) for measuring physiological signals includes an electrode sensor, a signal connection line(300), a snap structure, and a measuring device. The electrode sensor is coupled with an inner surface of the garment as one body to contact the skin and senses the physiological signals. The signal connection line is connected to the electrode sensor. The snap structure is electrically connected to the snap structure. The measuring device is mounted on the snap structure to measure the physiological signals. The signal connection line has elasticity.
abstract_ko:
생체 신호 측정용 의복을 제공한다. 이 의복은 피부 표면과 접촉되도록 의복의 내부면에 일체로 결합되어 생체 신호를 감지하는 적어도 하나의 전극 센서, 전극 센서로부터 감지된 생체 신호를 전송하되 의복의 내부면에 마감 처리된 신호 연결선, 신호 연결선과 전기적으로 연결되되 전극 센서와 중첩되지 않는 의복의 부위에 일체로 결합되는 스냅 구조물 및 스냅 구조물에 장착되어 생체 신호를 측정하는 측정기를 포함한다. 신호 연결선은 신축성을 갖는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     의복, 생체 신호, 전극 센서, 전도성 실, 연결 스냅

title_en: A detection method of sleepiness
title_ko: 졸음 감지방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 졸음 감지방법에 관한 것으로, 특히 신체의 움직임 하에서도 심장박동 검출이 가능하도록 도플러 레이더의 원리를 이용한 방식과 광원/광검출기를 이용한 광학계 방식을 혼용하여 사용함으로써 대상 신체에 접촉함이 없이 심장박동 및 호흡의 신호를 검출하는 제1 단계와; 상기 도플러 레이더의 원리를 이용한 방식과 광원/광검출기를 이용한 광학계 방식에서의 각 상기 검출 신호를 각각의 증폭부에 인가하여 신호 잡음을 제거하고 증폭하는 제2 단계와; 상기 제2 단계의 출력 신호를 각각 중앙처리부에 인가하여 신호처리 및 상기 신호처리된 각 신호를 합성하는 제3 단계; 및 상기 제3 단계에서 출력된 출력 값을 카운트하고, 상기 출력 값을 모니터링한 과거 2분전의 상기 카운트 값에 과거 1분전의 상기 카운트 값을 차감한 값이 2 내지 10 범위 또는 -2 내지 -10 범위에 있고, 상기 2 내지 10 범위 또는 -2 내지 -10 범위의 값이 시간이 흐름에 따라 동일 상기 범위 권내를 연속적으로 2번 내지 10번 검출되면, 출력부를 통해 경보음이나 멘트 또는 진동을 출력하는 제4 단계;로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 졸음 감지방법에 관한 것이다. 
      따라서, 본 발명은 사용자가 졸림 현상이 올 때 심박수가 느려지고 호흡수가 느려지는 현상을 상기 심박센서로 감지하고 졸음이 올 때 경보 또는 진동을 발생하여 자각증상을 회복시켜 졸음 운전에 대한 사고 예방하는 이점이 있다.  
       
     	심박, 생체신호, 도플러, 광학계

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Body State Recognition using the Impedance Charateristic Enhanced Electorde
title_ko: 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치가 제공된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체 상황 인지장치는, EEG 센서, ECG 센서, EEG 신호처리부, ECG 신호처리부 및 신호처리된 EEG와 ECG를 기반으로 생체 상황을 판단하는 프로세서를 포함하고, EEG 센서의 전극과 ECG 센서의 전극은 전도사를 이용한 직물 전극이다.  이에 의해, 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용하여 높은 피부 임피던스를 극복하여 정확한 생체 신호 센싱이 가능해진다.

title_en: Apparatus for monitoring position of underground power distribution line
title_ko: 특고압 지중 배전선로의 위치 감시 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a position monitoring apparatus for an extra-high voltage underground distribution line. A light receiving part of a flooding monitoring sensor is stored and installed in a waterproof floodlighting casing buried in the floor of an underground power tunnel to promptly start monitoring on flooding when flooding actually starts to occur in the underground power tunnel, thereby enabling real time flooding monitoring, and certainly preventing damage caused by flooding. Also, the quantity of polarized light received by a light receiving part through first and second linear polarization discs is controlled in accordance with characteristics of a light emitting part and the light receiving part, thereby effectively inspecting a flooding monitoring sensor. Also, a motor constituting a flooding monitoring sensor inspection part is installed on an installation position of the flooding monitoring sensor spaced upward apart from the floor of the underground power tunnel to prevent the malfunction of the motor caused by flooding. Also, since a low-priced general motor can be used without the use of a high-priced waterproof motor, costs for installation can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 특고압 지중 배전선로의 위치 감시 장치에 관한 것으로, 침수감시센서의 수광부는 전력구 바닥에 매설된 방수투광케이싱 내에 수납 설치하여 실제 전력구에 침수가 시작되면 곧바로 침수에 대한 감시가 이루어지게 하여 침수감시가 실시간으로 이루어지며, 침수로 인한 피해를 확실하게 방지할 수 있고, 발광부와 수광부의 특성에 따라 제1 선편광원판과 제2 선편광원판을 통과하여 수광부에 수광되는 편광 빛의 광량을 조절함으로써 침수감시센서를 효과적으로 점검할 수 있으며, 침수감시센서 점검부를 구성하는 모터를 전력구 바닥에서 상부로 이격된 침수감시센서의 설치 위치에 설치하여 침수로 인한 모터의 고장을 방지할 수 있게 되며, 고가의 방수모터를 사용하지 않고 저렴한 일반모터를 사용할 수 있으므로 설치비용이 절감될 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Underground buried seismic station using pipe and method of constructing same
title_ko: 관을 이용한 지하 매설형 지진관측소 및 이의 시공방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 지하 매설형 지진관측소는, 지표면 하부에 일정한 깊이를 가지며 매립된 플라스틱 재질의 관; 및 매립된 상기 관의 하단부에 외삽되어 상기 관을 지지하는 가이드부;를 포함하고, 상기 관의 하부면은 콘크리트 타설을 통해 기반암 상에 고정 설치된 것이고, 상기 관의 상부는 지표면 상부에 일정한 높이를 가지고 돌출 형성되되, 상기 관의 상부면에는 보호덮개가 설치되어 있는 것이고, 상기 관의 내부에는 지진계 센서, 지진 기록계 및 부대장비가 설치되어 있을 수 있다.

title_en: Method and device for searching through collapsed ground
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for determining whether a living person has been buried in collapsed ground. The device consists of a rod provided with a receiver unit and a signal processing unit. The receiver unit is intended to receive reflected radar signals transmitted from a radar transmitting antenna and transfer these signals to the signal processing unit. The signal processing unit which is provided with specific detection units determines whether the received signal have been Doppler shifted. By determining that the device can decide whether the Doppler shift depends on the moving chest of a breathing person buried alive.

title_en: Reducing motion-related artifacts in optical measurements for vital signs monitoring
abstract_en: Vital sign monitors are plagued by noisy photoplethysmography (PPG) data, making it difficult for the monitors to output consistently accurate readings. Noise in PPG signals is often caused by motion. The present disclosure provides improved techniques for reducing motion-related artifacts in optical/PPG measurements for vital signs monitoring. In general, techniques described herein are based on using measurements of reference sensors that include sensors other than optical sensors used for the optical measurements, e.g., biopotential sensors, bioimpedance sensors, and/or capacitive sensors. In particular, techniques described herein aim to filter PPG signals using substantially only the noise components of signals generated by reference sensors, by attenuating or altogether eliminating components of the signals generated by reference sensors which are indicative of the parameter the reference sensors are designed to measure. Implementing the techniques described herein may lead to more accurate vital sign evaluation using optical/PPG measurements.

title_en: Human condition detecting device
abstract_en: A human condition detection device comprises a depth image-taking module for taking a depth image of a target area. A millimeter-wave radar module detects breaths or heartbeats in the target area to provide a signal. A thermal image-taking module takes a thermal image of the target area. A processor module determines whether a person is in the target area based on the depth image. The processor module determines whether there is any breath or heartbeat based on the signal if a person is in the target area. The processor module determines whether there is any abnormal vital sign of the person in the target area based on the signal and the thermal image if there is a breath or heartbeat in the target area. The processor module actuates the warning module to provide a warning if there is an abnormal vital sign of the person in the target area.

title_en: Method, system, and computer program product for automatic multi-object localization and/or vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A method for automatic multi-object localization and/or vital sign monitoring is provided. The method comprises the steps of receiving a radar signal in order to form a corresponding observation matrix, reducing noise by applying singular value decomposition to the observation matrix, processing the result of the singular value decomposition by an independent component analysis in order to estimate the corresponding sources, and estimating propagation channels of the estimated sources by minimizing the corresponding residual error based on the observation matrix and the estimated sources.

title_en: Wifi-based human body detection method, and smart device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a Wi-Fi based human body detection method, which includes selecting a sub-carrier data source device by a smart device, acquiring sub-carrier channel frequency responses, checking and filtering out invalid sub-carrier channel frequency responses, obtaining sub-carrier amplitudes, and grouping to obtain a plurality of datasets. Each data set is divided into multiple sub-datasets according to different parts of the sub-carrier channel frequency responses, and then for each sub-dataset, a correlation coefficient between the sub-carrier amplitudes is calculated, to obtain a human body presence detection value; a Mahalanobis distance or a Euclidean distance between the sub-carrier amplitudes is calculated to obtain a human activity detection value; in conjunction of a human activity threshold and a human presence threshold, a state of a human body sign is determined and reported to a cloud server. The present disclosure also includes a smart device for implementing the above method.

title_en: Test device for simulating landslide erosion-collapse-reviving evolution process
abstract_en: The test device for simulating the landslide 'erosion-landslide-reviving' evolution process comprises a landslide model arranged in a test box, wherein a wave making device and a wave absorbing device are respectively arranged at two ends of the model, the wave making device is arranged at the front end of the landslide model, the wave absorbing device is arranged at the rear end of the model, shooting devices are arranged at the top and two sides of the outside of the test box, the shooting devices at the top are arranged at the front end of the landslide model, a water body monitoring device is arranged side by side, the landslide model comprises a multistage bedrock plate and a bedrock plate lifting device, during test, bedrock, a sliding belt and a sliding body material are sequentially paved on the bedrock plate, a sensor is buried in the sliding body material, the test box is a transparent box with an opening at the top, double-layer glass is arranged in the box of a wave making device area, water injection and drainage devices are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the box on the sides of the wave making device and the wave absorbing device, and a sponge is arranged at the wave absorbing device end in the box; the device realizes the simulation of the erosion-collapse-reviving linkage process.

title_en: Explosion-proof device and system that spouts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel slag treatment equipment, in particular to an anti-blowout device and an anti-blowout system. The explosion-proof spraying device comprises a silo, a cut-off valve group and a sensor, wherein the silo is provided with a containing cavity and an opening, the containing cavity is used for containing materials, the opening is opposite to an automobile trunk, the cut-off valve group is in movable fit with the silo and is used for closing or opening the opening, the sensor is arranged at the opening, and/or the sensor is arranged below the opening, the sensor is electrically connected with the cut-off valve group, and the sensor is used for detecting the moving speed of the materials. The explosion-proof spraying device can prevent materials from suddenly collapsing or spraying, and avoid safety accidents such as buried vehicles, casualties and the like.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUAXIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device, system and method for detection and processing of heartbeat signals
abstract_en: A heartbeat detection device includes at least one optical reflection sensor (10 or 10a and 10b) to be positioned on a person's skin. The sensor unit is provided with a light emitter (11) and a corresponding light receiver (12) which converts light reflected by the skin into an electrical signal, and comprises an electrically tunable optical filter (16, 17) connected to the emitter, the receiver or both, in order to select, in operation, the desired light wavelength, and to perform processing of the signal thus obtained in order to enhance the heartbeat signal. Systems having the apparatus and detection methods are also described.

title_en: Continuous wave radar through-wall detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous wave radar through-wall detection system comprising a radar head device and a plurality of display devices. The system is characterized in that a millimeter-wave transceiver module, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are arranged on the radar head device. The millimeter-wave transceiver module includes a transmitting part and a receiving part; the transmitting part contains a sweeping frequency source, a coupler, and a power amplifier, wherein the sweeping frequency source, the coupler, and the power amplifier are successively connected; and the receiving part includes a low-noise amplifier, an image rejection mixer, a band rejection filter, an intermediate-frequency matching filter and a hand-operated gain control circuit. And the display devices receive images and data from the radar head device by a wireless transmission module. According to the invention, because of multiple display devices, a target can be detected by the user at different positions. The detection radar with the millimeter-wave frequency-modulation continuous wave system can meet requirements of high-resolution imaging and target identification of through-wall detection; and a saturated phenomenon during short-distance target detection by the radar can be avoided.
assignees: WUHU HANGFEI SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Life detection rescue equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses life detection rescue equipment, which comprises a machine body and a nutrient solution cavity arranged in the machine body, wherein nutrient solution is stored in the nutrient solution cavity, the right end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a gear box, a transmission cavity is arranged in the gear box, a disinfectant cavity is arranged below the nutrient solution cavity and is arranged in the machine body, medical disinfectant is stored in the disinfectant cavity, two pairs of travelling shaft seats are fixedly connected at the bottom end of the machine body in a bilateral symmetry manner, a slide block valve is arranged at the left end of the machine body at the left side of the nutrient solution cavity in a vertically sliding manner, a magnet is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the slide block valve and is elastically connected at the top end of an electromagnet through a magnet spring, the life detection rescue equipment provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure and convenient operation, the life detection through infrared thermal induction is realized when a disaster, when the life is detected, the life can be supplied through the obstacle ruins, so that the safety of the life can be ensured to the maximum extent.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU MIAOXIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Battlefield search and rescue method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a battlefield search and rescue method. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, receiving signals from a vital sign signal sensor arranged on a warrior; step 2, generating the vital sign signal of the warrior according to the signal acquired by the vital sign signal of the warrior; step 3, judging whether the warrior is in an injured state or not according to the vital sign signal of the warrior; and 4, positioning the position of the warrior when the warrior is in an injured state.
assignees: THE 305 HOSPITAL OF PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Intelligent nursing home monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and provides an intelligent monitoring device of an aged people house based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein a vital sign signal acquisition module is used for sending a radar signal to a target to be detected and receiving a returned echo signal, a signal processing module is used for processing the echo signal to obtain a distance-speed spectrogram and a distance-angle spectrogram, judging whether the target to be detected is a target human body or not based on the distance-speed spectrogram and the distance-angle spectrogram, if so, calculating distance information of the surface fluctuation of the chest cavity of the target human body in unit time according to the echo signal, and extracting vital sign data of the target human body according to a phase difference signal in the distance information; the signal processing module is used for judging whether a set threshold value is exceeded or not according to the target human body vital sign data, if so, sending an early warning signal to the cloud early warning module, and sending a notice or timely warning to a related contact person or a caregiver through the cloud early warning module.

title_en: Pipeline signal identification and trend calculation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water supply and drainage pipeline detection, and provides a pipeline signal identification and trend calculation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional radar data of a buried pipeline; determining the size and the movement overlapping rate of the three-dimensional radar data array block, carrying out array processing on the three-dimensional radar data to form an array block data set, and manually marking the array block data set; performing signal enhancement and data enhancement on the array block data set; inputting the array block data set subjected to signal reinforcement and data reinforcement into a pipeline recognition model R3D trained on three-dimensional radar data; and (3) according to the pipeline recognition result of the pipeline recognition model R3D, dyeing the array block data set and calculating the pipeline trend by using the dyed array block. The pipeline with various materials can be accurately identified, the interference of noise characteristics of the underground environment is reduced, the trend of a hidden pipeline is automatically and accurately calculated, and construction excavation is facilitated; and the processing efficiency is higher, so that reliable technical support is provided for urban infrastructure construction and management.

title_en: Far infrared vital sign monitoring method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sign monitoring, in particular to a far infrared vital sign monitoring method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining thermal imaging data of a monitoring area, generating a thermal diagram to obtain the thermal diagram of the monitoring area, integrating physical sign characteristics of the thermal diagram of the monitoring area to obtain vital sign data of a user of the monitoring area, detecting unbalance of the center of gravity of the user based on the vital sign data of the user of the monitoring area to obtain unbalance behavior data of the center of gravity of the user, obtaining millimeter wave signal sets of the monitoring area, analyzing gesture change behavior to obtain quick gesture change behavior data of the user, performing risk assessment according to the unbalance behavior data of the center of gravity of the user and the quick gesture change behavior data of the user to obtain falling risk data of the user of the monitoring area, and performing falling risk early warning strategy analysis according to the falling risk data of the user of the monitoring area to obtain a falling risk early warning strategy of the user. The method can improve the accuracy and efficiency of physical sign monitoring.
assignees: SHENZHEN DAYIN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave and thermal imaging fusion face shielding detection method and system for bedridden personnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave and thermal imaging fusion face shielding detection method and system for bedridden personnel, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting a target based on ADC (analog-to-digital converter) original data so as to detect the position of the target and extracting vital signs of the target; extracting the temperature of a face area of a target based on temperature matrix data, carrying out temperature distribution entropy calculation on the temperature of the face area to obtain a distribution entropy calculation result, carrying out sign abnormality judgment on the target based on vital signs to obtain a judgment result, carrying out distribution abnormality judgment on the target through the distribution entropy calculation result to obtain a judgment result, carrying out weighted probability fusion on the judgment result and the judgment result to obtain the shielding probability of the target, judging whether the shielding probability exceeds a preset value, and if so, triggering an alarm. The invention can effectively monitor the sign of the target and whether the face is blocked under different conditions, and can also monitor the target under the premise of not invading the privacy of the target.

title_en: Buried object detector
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object detector capable of reducing a burden of a worker carrying the detector.  <P>SOLUTION: This buried object detector 10 is attached with a sensor part 30 for detecting an underground buried object, in one end of a rod 20, and a signal processor 40 for inputting a detection value of the sensor part 30, in the other end of the rod 20. The buried object detector 10 is constituted to make a gravity center of the sensor part 30 and the signal processor 40 on the rod serve as a suspension support point. The suspension support point is coupled to a waist belt of a searching person via a joint part 60, so as to be supported in a waist of the searching person and to serve as the scanning center of the sensor part 30 for circular arc shaped scan.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Vital sensor
abstract_en: To provide a vital sensor suitable for, especially, a use in an MRI examination.SOLUTION: A cable 4 allows a probe which can be mounted on a body of a subject and outputs a signal corresponding to a vital sign of the subject to be connected to a signal processing section for processing the signal. The cable 4 includes a conductor wire 40, a first heat insulation layer 41, and a second heat insulation layer 42. The conductor wire 40 transmits a signal output from the probe to the signal processing section. The first heat insulation layer 41 covers the conductor wire 40 from a radially outer side of the cable 4.
