title_en: Individual a lie detector
title_ko: 휴대용 거짓말 탐지기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A portable lie detector is provided to remove a sense of incongruity while miniaturizing by measuring a bio-signal through a small PPG sensor. CONSTITUTION: A portable lie detector includes a sensor unit(110), a signal processing unit(120), and a lie signal generator(130). The sensor unit comprises a skin reflection sensor(111) and a PPG sensor(112). The signal processing unit comprises a signal processing circuit(140), a calculation module(150), a storage(160), and a determination unit(170). Pulse, respiration, electricity reflection from the skin, and a blood pressure signal are measured through a bio-signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피험자가 평온한 상태에서 피험자의 맥박 ,혈압, 피부전기반사, 호흡 등 일정시간 동안 생체신호를 PPG 센서, 피부전기반사로 측정한 뒤에 이 측정치를 기준으로 삼고 이후에 측정된 생체신호와 비교하여 기존의 측정 기준 범위를 벗어났을때 거짓말이라고 탐지할 수 있는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     기존의 거짓말 탐지기의 생체신호 측정 기계가 대형이었으며 장비 이동의 대한 제 약이 있었다. 본 발명은 생체신호를 소형 PPG 센서를 이용해 측정하고 기록장치인 폴리그래프를 사용하지 않고 기록용지를 사람이 확인하는 대신에 생체신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하여 저장하여 측정된 생체신호 값이 기준 범위를 벗어나면 외부신호를 통해 거짓말임을 알 수 있게 거짓말탐지기의 휴대성을 극대화하였다. 
       
     거짓말 탐지기, 피부 전기반사, 맥박, 호흡, 혈류량, PPG센서, 혈압

title_en: Sleep state determination system, method, and application using the same using Doppler signals
title_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션
abstract_en: A system for determining a sleep state using a doppler signal comprises: a doppler signal acquisition unit which emits a radar signal to a subject to be observed, acquires a doppler signal by acquiring a signal returned by reflecting the radar signal, and acquires a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit which acquires first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a sleep state determination unit which acquires the first signal information and the second signal information, acquires biosignal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information using a preset algorithm, respectively, and determines a sleep state of the subject to be observed using the biosignal and the motion information. A bio-signal and motion information may be obtained by analyzing the doppler signal. Sleep is not obstructed to the contactless radar method. The sleep state can be decided accurately by using respiration and heart rate information.
abstract_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템은 관측 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임 신호 정보를 획득하고, 상기 생체 신호 및 움직임 정보를 이용하여 상기 관측 대상자의 수면 상태를 판단하는 수면 상태 판단부;를 포함하며, 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호를 통해 획득되는 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보는 제1-1 신호 정보 및 제1-2 신호 정보이며, 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 통해 획득되는 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보는 제2-1 신호 정보 및 제2-2 신호 정보를 포함한다.

title_en: Device and Method for Imaging Structures Positioned Behind or Within a Surface
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a surface scanning and imaging device. The surface scanning and imaging device is designed for viewing through walls, ceilings, and other surfaces in a building to view structural components by positioning the device in proximity to the desired surface. The device includes one or more sensors for transmitting surface penetrating signals, a transceiver for receiving signals reflected from one or more structures positioned behind the surface, and an image processor to process the received signals to create a 2D or 3D image of the structural component that reflected the transmitted signals. The device displays the image of the structural component located behind the surface, allowing a user to determine where a repair or modification can be made. The structural components can be one or more of wires, circuits, studs, pipes, taps and other construction components.

title_en: Radar detection device and method
abstract_en: A radar detection device is provided. The radar detection device may include a radar device and a signal processing device. The radar device may include a plurality of antennas to transmit and receive radar signals. The signal processing device is coupled to the radar device, and the signal processing device determines that a target object is in a first area of a detection area or in a second area of the detection area according to the radar signals received by the radar device to determine to perform an activity detection or a vital-sign detection on the target object.

title_en: Protection device and method for X80 buried pipeline to pass through earthquake fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of petrochemical industry and natural gas, and particularly relates to a protection device and a protection method for an X80 buried pipeline to pass through an earthquake fracture zone; the protection device comprises an X80 buried pipeline, a protection pipeline, an end cone pipeline, a flange structure, a displacement sensor, an air pressure sensor, a pneumatic booster pump, an air storage tank, an air inlet pipe, an air outlet pipe, a signal transmission and reception device, a micro controller and an electromagnetic valve. When the X80 buried pipeline passes through the earthquake fracture zone, the fault displacement can cause buckling deformation and even damage of the X80 buried pipeline. The invention can determine the area of the X80 buried pipeline affected by fault displacement, and additionally arrange a protection pipeline in the area, and the nitrogen is filled in the cavity between the protection pipelines, and the air pressure between the pipelines can be regulated according to the strain of the X80 buried pipeline so as to protect the buried pipeline. The invention can effectively lighten the influence of fault displacement on the X80 buried pipeline, prevent the further increase of the strain of the pipeline and give a warning in time under the condition of pipeline danger.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring movement behavior of patient in magnetic resonance operation
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for monitoring patient movement behavior in magnetic resonance surgery, relating to the technical field of human body detection, comprising acquiring vital sign information of a patient based on a plurality of monitoring devices worn on the patient in magnetic resonance surgery; the method comprises the steps of judging a first movement grade corresponding to a patient according to vital sign information and corresponding reference information, obtaining a first image of the patient in the operation process, comparing the first image with a preset reference image to judge a movement range corresponding to the patient, determining a second movement grade corresponding to the movement range based on a preset mapping relation, judging a third movement grade corresponding to the patient based on measurement information measured by an inertial sensor arranged on the patient, and judging whether the movement behavior of the patient has hidden danger or not according to the first movement grade, the second movement grade and the third movement grade. Therefore, the movement behavior of the patient can be timely, reliably and accurately detected, and whether hidden danger exists or not can be judged.

title_en: Multimode fusion living body vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of living body vital sign detection, and provides a multimode-fused living body vital sign detection system and method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises a signal acquisition module, a data alignment module, a position acquisition module and a vital sign calculation module. According to the invention, the signal detection device provided with the infrared imaging unit and the millimeter wave radar detection unit is arranged in the target scene, the primary position of the human body is positioned through the infrared detection image acquired by the infrared imaging unit, then the millimeter wave radar is driven to rotate to point to the direction corresponding to the primary position of the human body to execute accurate detection, and finally the accurate position and vital sign of the human body are generated based on the millimeter wave radar detection data acquired by the accurate detection, so that the problem that the traditional vital sign detection system cannot acquire the accurate position of the human body is solved.

title_en: Apparatus and method of trouble shooting for big-signal sensor in vehcile
title_ko: 차량용 생체신호 센서 고장 진단 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 차량용 생체 신호 센서의 고장 진단 방법은 착석 센서로부터 입력되는 신호에 대응하여 생체 신호 센서를 통해 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 차량 내 인터페이스를 통한 입력에 대응하여 생체 신호 센서를 통해 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 및 제2 생체 신호가 제1 생체 신호에 대응하여 설정된 임계 범위를 벗어나는 신호를 포함하는 지에 따라 생체 신호 센서의 고장 여부를 판단하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Portable automatic ventilating assistant device
title_ko: 휴대용 자동 인공호흡 보조기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable automatic artificial respiration assistant device. In detail, the present invention relates to a portable automatic artificial respiration assistant device which automatically pumps an air bag which supplies air or gas required for respiration to patients to enable artificial respiration adjustment, and comprises a sensor part, an auxiliary battery, and others to measure conditions of the patients, that are vital signs, in real time so that an optimal amount of respiration can be provided according to the conditions of the patients and a structure thereof is simple to be simply portable, thereby being used in emergency situation outdoors.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 자동 인공호흡 보조기에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 환자들에게 호흡에 필요한 공기나 기체를 공급하도록 하는 공기주머니를 자동으로 펌핑하여 인공적인 호흡 조절이 가능하도록 하면서도, 환자의 상태, 즉 바이탈 사인을 실시간으로 측정하기 위한 센서부 및 보조배터리 등을 포함하여 환자의 상태에 따라 최적의 호흡량을 제공할 수 있음은 물론 단순한 구성으로 휴대가 간편하여 실외에서의 위급 상황시에도 사용이 가능한 휴대용 자동 인공호흡 보조기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Fire-fighting robot with life detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting robot with life detection function, which comprises a movable base, wherein a driving box is fixedly arranged on the surface of the top end of the movable base, bearings are fixedly arranged in the middle parts of the upper end and the lower end of the driving box in a penetrating manner, two bearing inner hole walls are fixedly arranged in a penetrating manner and are provided with rotating rods, a follower gear is embedded and arranged on the surface of the middle end of each rotating rod, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the bottom end of the right side in the driving box, and a rotating plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the; the utility model discloses owing to remove the base top and install the drive box to install the dwang through the bearing in drive box inside, can rotate along with the rotor plate at its top of rotation drive of bearing through the dwang, be convenient for adjust the position of the detection box of rotor plate top, and then change the detection position of vital sign sensor, guarantee to carry out quick detection to the different positions in conflagration scene, improve the efficiency of rescue.

title_en: Portable multifunctional monitor for ICU
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable multi-functional monitor for ICU, including the electrocardio sensor who is used for gathering human electrocardiosignal, a blood oxygen sensor for gathering human blood oxygen signal, a blood pressure sensor for gathering human blood pressure signal, a respiratory sensor for gathering the skin resistance sensor of the arbitrary resistance between two points of hand and be used for gathering human respiratory signal, electrocardio sensor links to each other with electrocardio filtering and amplifier circuit, blood oxygen sensor links to each other with blood oxygen filtering and amplifier circuit, blood pressure sensor links to each other with blood pressure filtering and amplifier circuit, skin resistance sensor links to each other with skin resistance filtering and amplifier circuit, respiratory sensor links to each other with respiratory filtering and amplifier circuit, above-mentioned each filtering and amplifier circuit all links to each other with analog-to-digital conversion circuit, analog-digital conversion circuit links to each other with central processing unit, central processing unit respectively with pilot lamp unit, the central processing unit, The display unit is connected with the loudspeaker unit. title_en: Three-dimensional detection and positioning device for dental implant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional detection and positioning device for a dental implant, which is used for detecting the implant in a gingival. The tooth implant detection device comprises a detection sensor, a software and hardware control device and the like, wherein the detection sensor consists of a spiral coil at the front end and an electrode at the tail end, and when the detection sensor senses a metal implant buried in gum, the inductance of the coil is changed, and the frequency of an oscillation circuit is changed along with the change of the inductance, so that the detection and positioning effects are achieved. Can bury three dimensions such as the outside of gum, the inboard of gum through top, the planting body to wearing the planting body and survey to can fix a position the inside accurate position whether have planting body and planting body of gum fast, not only can make things convenient for the planting body in accurate location patient oral cavity of doctor, also can reduce patient's economic burden and reduce the injury to the human body.

title_en: Disaster early warning radar convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the radar technique and specifically relates to calamity early warning radar that can be easy to assemble, including the radar, the stand is installed to the lower extreme of radar, the lower extreme of stand is equipped with two sets of first installation mechanisms, and is two sets of be equipped with second installation mechanism between the first installation mechanism, first installation mechanism is including base plate, first fixed establishment, second fixed establishment, the equal symmetry in upper end of base plate is equipped with the jack, the inner chamber of jack is all pegged graft and is had first fixed establishment, first fixed establishment is including the buried pipe of pegging graft mutually with the jack, the equal equidistance in buried pipe both sides is equipped with the through-hole, the inner chamber of through-hole all is connected with the rubber sack, the utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, and convenient installation dismantlement to the radar, its installation effectiveness of effectual improvement, the labour saving and time saving, the effectual fixed stay that can dismantle the radar, and be convenient for play the supported effect of shock attenuation buffering, the effectual fixed effect that improves it.

title_en: It is a kind of can long-range monitoring human vital sign unmanned plane device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to it is a kind of can long-range monitoring human vital sign unmanned plane device, including unmanned plane detection device and ground intelligent terminal；By ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR device carry below unmanned plane, be equipped with transmitting antenna and receiving antenna, the direction of the transmitting antenna and receiving antenna vertically downward, towards ruins direction；The unmanned plane is equipped with airborne computer, can determine whether human life according to radar antenna signal；The judging result of airborne computer is sent to ground intelligent terminal by the unmanned plane detection device；The ground intelligent terminal has terminal interface, shows the position where unmanned plane on terminal interface on map, and the regional scope that unmanned plane detection device is searched and rescued may be selected, and control unmanned plane detection device is back and forth flown in selected region.Personnel search and rescue after the present invention can be widely applied to calamity, can use the high maneuverability of unmanned plane, the human life signal under a wide range of quick detection ruins.

title_en: A kind of high-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on space structure relevance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high-resolution through-wall radar imaging imaging method based on space structure relevance, includes the following steps: in N-dimensional concentrating rate, obtains the echo-signal that n-th of array element receives observation scene；To N number of array element, M frequency point receives echo-signal vectorization；Cause electro-magnetic wave multi path to be propagated by interior wall reflection, obtains the echo-signal under N-dimensional array received to multipath transmisstion；It is down-sampled to measuring signal progress, obtain the observation vector of sparse reconstruction；To the group sparsity structure of direct wave and the K-1 multipath reflection coefficient vector addition group sparse prior distribution simulation vector；Each parameter is iteratively solved out using parameter Estimation formula, obtains high-resolution through-wall radar imaging result.This method takes full advantage of the spatial distribution structure for organizing sparsity structure and goal succession of multipath transmisstion during through-wall radar imaging, obtains high-resolution radar image.
