title_en: Multi-human body vital sign synchronous monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave sensing
abstract_en: A multi-human body vital sign synchronous monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave perception comprises the following steps: millimeter wave radar front end module, microcontroller, treater and display and record module, wherein: millimeter wave radar front end module is used for transmitting linear frequency modulation continuous wave microwave or millimeter wave signal, and receives the echo signal of reflection, produces multichannel intermediate frequency baseband signal, microcontroller sets up and controls waveform parameter, transmission power and signal gain parameter and monitoring process, sets up and controls the acquisition parameter of the signal acquisition module of treater, the treater draws human vital sign parameter information from multichannel intermediate frequency baseband signal, show and record module demonstration and save that the treater obtains including: multi-human body position information, chest wall micro-motion displacement information and vital sign parameters. The invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring system and method with high measurement precision, strong anti-interference capability, reliability and stability for multi-human body vital sign synchronous monitoring.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on radar, radar and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vital sign detection method and device based on radar, the radar and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: extracting vital signs of a user based on echo signals obtained by detecting the surface area of the bed body by the radar when the user is in the bed; if the vital sign of the current vital sign monitoring period is smaller than a preset vital sign threshold value, acquiring a distance unit and a corresponding signal amplitude value of a user in echo signals of N continuous calculation periods before the current vital sign monitoring period; if the distance unit where the user is located in the echo signals of N continuous calculation periods before the current vital sign monitoring period is continuously increased and the corresponding signal amplitude is continuously reduced, judging that the user has the bed leaving action, otherwise, judging that the user does not have the bed leaving action, and generating an alarm signal with weak vital signs of the current frame. By the method, the two conditions of bed separation and weak heartbeat of the person can be accurately distinguished, the false alarm rate is reduced, and the accuracy of vital sign detection is ensured.

title_en: Method and system for non-contact vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system (1), the radar sensor system (1) comprising a transmitter (2), a receiver (3) and a processing device (5), wherein the transmitter (2) irradiates (100) at least one body region (21) of a person (20) with radar radiation (30), the receiver (3) generates (110) a receiver signal from reflected radiation (11) from the at least one body region, the processing device (5) generates a displacement signal for each of a plurality of processing windows based on the receiver signal, and calculates an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillatory motion, the displacement signal characterizing the body motion, the body motion comprising respiratory motion and cardiac motion as oscillatory motions. In order to provide a reliable and efficient means for vital sign monitoring, the present invention provides that the processing device (5) applies an adaptive non-linear least squares method to calculate (250) a plurality of frequency estimates (f  r1 、f r2 、f r3 ) based on the displacement signal, each of the plurality of frequency estimates corresponding to one of a plurality of harmonics of the first oscillatory motion, wherein the processing device (5) uses a separate search area (a  h1 、A h2 、A h3 ) for each frequency estimate (f  r1 、f r2 、f r3 ), adapts at least one search area (a  h1 、A h2 、A h3 ) for at least one processing window, and calculates (300) a first estimated fundamental frequency (f  h ) for the first oscillatory motion based on the frequency estimates (f  r1 、f r2 、f r3 ).

title_en: Non-contact sleeping posture detection and vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleeping posture detection and vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which uses the millimeter wave radar with multiple transmission and multiple reception, adopts innovative signal processing algorithm and data processing algorithm, the sleep monitoring is carried out by comprehensively considering the frequency spectrum information and the point cloud information, and comprises the steps of extracting vital sign data such as breathing and heartbeat and judging the states of the bed, the body movement and the sleeping posture. The respiratory heartbeat component is effectively extracted through cross-correlation entropy operation, so that the signal to noise ratio is increased, and then the cross-correlation entropy is subjected to fast Fourier transform, and the respiratory heartbeat frequency is proved to be effectively extracted.
assignees: CHENGDU DUOPU DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Karst vacuum corrosion simulation experiment device under dynamic and static load coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physical simulation of geotechnical engineering geological disasters, and discloses a karst vacuum corrosion simulation experiment device under the action of dynamic and static load coupling, which comprises a test box, a vacuum corrosion simulation system, a dynamic and static load loading system, a comprehensive monitoring system and a central control system; A covering layer for simulating karst is filled in layers in the test box, a plurality of karst cavities are arranged in the covering layer, the top of the test box is connected with a moving platform in a sliding mode, a dynamic and static load loading system is arranged on the moving platform, a comprehensive monitoring system comprises a mechanical sensor array, a negative pressure sensor and a visual monitoring unit, the mechanical sensor array is buried in the covering layer, and the negative pressure sensor is arranged in the karst cavities. The invention can simulate vacuum corrosion, apply independent or coupled static and dynamic load with adjustable size and position to the karst covering layer, accurately simulate the formation, development and dissipation process of vacuum negative pressure in the karst cavity, and improve the reality and accuracy of simulation.

title_en: Sleep capsule
title_ko: 수면 캡슐
abstract_en: A sleep capsule according to one aspect of the present disclosure comprises: a mattress; a base supporting the mattress; a cover coupled with the base to form an internal space; an air conditioning unit which discharges air at a predetermined temperature into the internal space formed by the base and the cover; and a sensor unit including one or more sensors that detect biometric signals of a user lying on the mattress, wherein the air conditioning unit changes an angle of the vane, which adjusts the wind direction of air discharged into the internal space, based on the biometric signals detected by the sensor unit. According to the present invention, the comfortable sensation can be increased by utilizing a plurality of cooling and heating means.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 측면에 따른 수면 캡슐은, 매트리스, 상기 매트리스를 지지하는 베이스(base), 상기 베이스와 결합되어 내부 공간을 형성하는 커버(cover), 상기 베이스와 상기 커버가 형성하는 내부 공간으로 소정 온도의 공기를 토출하는 공조부, 및, 상기 매트리스에 누워 있는 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 하나 이상의 센서를 포함하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 공조부는, 상기 센서부에서 감지되는 생체신호에 기초하여, 상기 내부 공간으로 토출되는 공기의 풍향을 조절하는 베인의 각도를 변경한다.

title_en: A radar apparatus for detecting multiple life - signs of a subject, a method and a computer program product
abstract_en: A radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, a method and a computer program product. The invention relates to a radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, comprising a transmitter system for emitting a transmission electromagnetic beam to the chest and/or the abdomen of a subject, a receiving system for receiving first reflected electromagnetic beam data from the chest and/or the abdomen, and a processor unit for processing the first received beam data retrieving breath activity information. The transmitter system, the receiving system and the processor are further arranged for performing a radar measurement of a superficial artery structure, such as a wrist artery, an ankle artery, a carotid artery and/or the fontanel artery for retrieving heart activity information. Thereto, a second transmission electromagnetic beam is directed towards the superficial artery structure, the first and the second transmission electromagnetic beam being transmitted from a single radar unit, the second transmission beam being redirected by a redirector after emission by the radar unit.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, the RF tags respectively generating incident RF signals with different predetermined frequencies, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one RF radar that demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital sign of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to associated frequency of the reflected RF signal.

title_en: Ellipse-hyperbola combined through-wall radar target positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a target positioning algorithm suitable for through-wall radar imaging, which comprises the following steps of firstly, detecting a target area behind a wall by adopting a linear array antenna array with more than two channels; then, utilizing adjacent periodic pulse cancellation to extract a movable hidden target behind a wall and utilizing the characteristics of a step frequency system radar to obtain the distance between the target and a transmitting-receiving array element; determining the target position by a traditional elliptical cross positioning method, and determining the target coordinate by a hyperbolic cross positioning method; and finally, determining the position of the target by respectively selecting coordinates with low error sensitivity in the two methods. The method can accurately position the rear hidden target of the wall body, and has higher positioning accuracy compared with the traditional positioning method.

title_en: Life saving instrument and saving method based on mobile phone
abstract_en: The application relates to a life saving instrument and a saving method based on a mobile phone. The application is based on a smart phone, the smart phone is used as a carrier, the triaxial acceleration sensor is used for acquiring triaxial acceleration of a human body at any moment to judge whether the human body is in a buried state due to earthquake, if the human body is judged to be in the buried state, the smart phone enters a power saving mode, and a power supply of the smart phone is closed except for an electromagnetic wave transmitting module, an audio analyzing module and a high-frequency sound wave module. According to the application, no extra complex equipment is needed, the mobile phone with very high correlation with human space is used as a help signal transmitting device, and the accurate and rapid positioning of combining the help signal transmission and self-help rescue is realized by combining the help mode and the audio mode of transmitting electromagnetic wave signals, so that the success rate of rescue is greatly improved; the application overcomes the defects of long time consumption, low efficiency, complex operation and the like of the traditional search and rescue method, has popularization value and significance of important people, and saves more innocent lives.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on an ultra-wideband radar, which relate to the technical field of vital sign detection and are used for acquiring an echo signal of the ultra-wideband radar; filtering processing operations such as linear migration removal, time domain sliding average difference filtering, fast Fourier transform, frequency domain sliding average difference filtering, overall frequency domain sliding average filtering and the like are carried out on the ultra-wideband radar echo signals; carrying out harmonic multiple cycle detection on the filtered frequency domain signal to obtain a vital sign signal, wherein the vital sign signal comprises information such as position information, respiratory rate and heart rate of a person to be detected; the invention improves the judgment standard of respiration and heartbeat frequency, can accurately detect the position of a vital body from a radar and the respiration and heartbeat rate, can detect and display the vital sign information in real time, and has wide application prospect in the aspects of medical care, disaster search and rescue and the vital sign detection of special people.

title_en: Vital sign radar sensor using wireless network signals
abstract_en: The present invention is a vital sign radar sensor using wireless network signals. The vital sign radar sensor detects vital signs by using wireless network signals, and comprises a first demodulation unit and a second demodulation unit which respectively demodulate the direct and reflected path wireless network signals from two different receiving channels to obtain a first demodulation signal and a second demodulation signal, and the first demodulation signal and the second demodulation signal are combined to eliminate the influence of communication modulation on the process of extracting the vital signs.

title_en: Information detection method and device for indoor object, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses an information detection method and device for indoor objects, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data information of an indoor target object through target detection equipment, wherein the target data information at least comprises vital sign information and behavior information of the target object, and the target detection equipment comprises radar monitoring equipment which is not required to be worn by the target object and vital sign monitoring equipment which is worn on the target object; analyzing behavior state information of the target object based on the target data information; and displaying the behavior state information of the target object on a display interface. The application solves the problem of poor information detection effect on indoor personnel in the related technology.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on radar, radar and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vital sign detection method and device based on radar, the radar and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of extracting vital signs of a user based on echo signals obtained by detecting a bed surface area when the user is in bed, acquiring distance units and corresponding signal amplitudes of the user in echo signals of N continuous calculation periods before the current vital sign monitoring period if the vital signs of the current vital sign monitoring period are smaller than a preset vital sign threshold value, judging that the user has a bed leaving action if the distance units of the user in the echo signals of N continuous calculation periods before the current vital sign monitoring period are continuously increased and the corresponding signal amplitudes are continuously reduced, otherwise judging that the user does not have the bed leaving action, and generating weak vital sign alarm signals of the current frame. By the method, the two conditions of bed separation and weak heartbeat of the person can be accurately distinguished, the false alarm rate is reduced, and the accuracy of vital sign detection is ensured.

title_en: Air cleaning headphone system with sliding guide capable of collecting fine dust information
title_ko: 미세먼지정보 수집이 가능하며 슬라이딩식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰 시스템
abstract_en: An air purifying headphone system of the present invention comprises: a headphone body which includes two earplugs discharging sound and purified air, a headband connecting the earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a sliding guide for collecting the purified air discharged from the earplugs around a mouth and a nose; a fine dust measuring sensor mounted on the headphone body to measure a fine dust concentration around a user and transmitting the measured fine dust concentration information to a mobile device of the user; a bio-signal measuring sensor mounted on the headphone body to measure a bio-signal of the user and transmitting the measured bio-signal information to the mobile device of the user; and a central server for communicating with the mobile device of the user and receiving the fine dust concentration information and the bio-signal information.

title_en: A kind of human life feature detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of human life feature detection device, and the device includes: doppler sensor, is used for human-body emitting microwave signal, and receive the feedback signal of human body；Filter amplifier module, including multi-stage filter circuit, input terminal are connect with doppler sensor, are obtained feedback signal and are filtered and amplify；Control module is connect with the output end of filter amplifier module.The design utilizes the microwave signal of doppler sensor, and the vital sign signals frequency of human body is acquired in the case where not contacting human body.

title_en: Fire-fighting helmet with life detection thermal imager
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take life to survey helmet for fire control of thermal imaging system, including helmet shell body, face guard and life detection thermal imaging system, the outside of helmet shell body is provided with the reflector panel, and the lower extreme of helmet shell body is connected with and separates the shelves cloth, separate the outside of shelves cloth and install the elastic cord, the protecting crust is installed to the outside front end of helmet shell body, and the inboard of protecting crust installs life detection thermal imaging system, the front side of helmet shell body is provided with the face guard, and the inboard of face guard is connected with the display, the second installation piece is installed to the right side lower extreme of helmet shell body, and the outside fixedly connected with connection pad of second installation piece. This take helmet for fire control of life detection thermal imager improves the helmet functional problem, installs life detection thermal imager, is convenient for implement rescue work fast, improves rescue and fire extinguishing efficiency greatly, can avoid danger simultaneously, reduces the injures and deaths, has improved the head safeguard measure to the fire fighter simultaneously.
assignees: HUNAN HANGHUA INNOVATION SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Collapsible loess area road intelligent monitoring early warning system that sinks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent monitoring early warning system that collapsible loess area road sinks belongs to collapsible loess area road monitoring early warning technical field, has solved that current detection technique is difficult to comprehensively, directly perceivedly to the road in time monitoring and the problem of early warning of sinking. The utility model discloses an information acquisition device, official working management facility and communication facility, communication facility includes 3S integrated system, commercial satellite and ground radar system, official working management facility includes the internet, computer and display device, the computer links to each other with display device, 3S integrated system and ground radar system link to each other with the computer through the internet respectively, commercial satellite links to each other with 3S integrated system, ground radar system and internet respectively, information acquisition device is pre-buried underground at the road, information acquisition device links to each other with 3S integrated system. The utility model discloses a two accuses of 3S integrated system and ground radar detecting system, it is more accurate, directly perceived to the prejudgement of collapsing.

title_en: Forest fire disaster resistance control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides forest fire disaster resistance and control equipment which comprises a water collecting assembly and a detection resistance and control mechanism, wherein the water collecting assembly comprises a pre-buried water tank, a rain collecting cover and a central pipe; the detection resistance control mechanism comprises a spray head, an electric control box, a plurality of flame sensors, a small submersible pump, a plurality of water collecting needles and a plurality of diversion trenches; the rain collecting cover is communicated with the top of the embedded water tank; according to the utility model, the high-temperature heat source around the equipment is detected by the flame sensor, when the flame sensor detects the high-temperature heat source, the water in the embedded water tank is injected into the central pipe by the small submerged pump, and then the water in the central pipe is sprayed to the periphery of the equipment by the spray head under the action of water pressure, so that the fire source in a forest or a grassland is extinguished before the fire is formed, the cost of extinguishing the forest and grass fire is further reduced, and the continuous sprayed water can be utilized to inhibit the spreading speed of the fire so as to provide sufficient time for large-scale fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Vital sign extraction method based on dual-source IR-UWB (infrared-ultra wide band) biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign extraction method based on a dual-source IR-UWB (infrared-ultra wide band) biological radar, which separates a broadband signal and a narrowband signal in radar echo by a dual-channel cross-correlation signal enhancement technology of the dual-source UWB biological radar and combining an adaptive spectral line enhancement algorithm to realize the extraction of a human respiratory signal in an unnatural state. The invention establishes a model for simulating an unnatural human body by binding the human body with an air pressure type tourniquet, and the model can be quantitatively controlled and simulate human body targets buried at different parts.

title_en: Method for improving detection precision of soil moisture content based on buried depth of soil sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the detection precision of soil moisture content based on the buried depth of a soil sensor, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing or selecting a soil sensor; s2, detecting a soil capacitance factor W; s3, measuring a buried depth factor H of the soil sensor; and S4, measuring data of different depth positions in the soil sample with the same water content, and selecting a binary linear polynomial equation model to fit the water content, the soil capacitance factor and the depth factor to obtain the final soil water content. The influence of the buried depth of the soil sensor on the water content of the soil is fully considered, the depth factor buried by the soil sensor is measured through the ranging radar module, the corresponding relation between the soil capacitance factor generated through the algorithm of reverse fitting and the water content of the soil is finally obtained, and the precision of the water content detection of the soil under the conditions of different depths of the soil is greatly improved.

title_en: Remote medical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote medical system which utilizes a microwave human body sensing technology to realize the analysis of human body vital signs and data processing; the application is mainly applied to medical monitoring items such as detection of human body care/medical health monitoring and the like, and timely and effectively solves the problem of care health by analyzing the real-time health state of the human body in the room through a large amount of data analysis and a large amount of data analysis; the indoor space is periodically scanned, an indoor organism distribution diagram is obtained according to scanning reflection signals, microwave radar signals are used as induction media, radar signals are transmitted to a living body, radar echo signals reflected by the living body are received, original echo data are formed, and the original echo data are processed through a processing module, so that on one hand, non-contact measurement is achieved, and the comfort of the living body is improved; on the other hand, the respiration rate, the heart rate and the body movement of the living body can be effectively extracted, and the purposes of real-time monitoring and early warning are achieved.
assignees: NINGBO YINGXIN MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar detection device and a radar detection method. The radar detection apparatus may include a radar apparatus and a signal processing apparatus. The radar apparatus includes a plurality of antennas to transmit or receive radar signals. The signal processing device is coupled to the radar device and determines whether a target object is in a first area of a detection area or in a second area of the detection area according to the radar signal received by the radar device, so as to determine whether to perform an activity detection or a vital sign detection on the target object.

title_en: Electrode displacement self-correction grid array device of resistivity imaging system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrode displacement self-correcting grid array device of a resistivity imaging system, which is used for realizing real-time monitoring of the position of a monitoring point by a self-monitoring remote positioning system and timely finding out the distortion condition of an electrode grid; meanwhile, the electrode monitoring points are monitored in real time by the conical threaded electrode monitoring equipment. According to the self-monitoring remote positioning system, on one hand, the positions of electrodes in an electrode grid are uploaded in real time, electrode displacement data recording and self-correction are realized, so that accuracy of device coefficients in the apparent resistivity calculation process is improved, on the other hand, angular acceleration and acceleration sensors can intuitively monitor position changes of two transverse and longitudinal dimensions of the device in a period of time, a data transmission monitoring line and a total cable are respectively led out from the lower part of a disaster intelligent monitoring shell, and are buried in 20-30 cm underground, so that influences of human and animal factors and natural factors are reduced, and mistaken touching and breaking of the cable in the long-term monitoring process are avoided, so that effectiveness of monitoring data is guaranteed.

title_en: Multi-person same-distance vital signal detection method based on OMP super-resolution algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and particularly discloses a multi-person same-distance vital signal detection method based on an OMP super-resolution algorithm, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a distance information matrix containing a plurality of target human body vital signals; performing OMP super-resolution reconstruction on distance information containing a plurality of target human body vital signals to obtain a reconstructed distance information matrix, processing the reconstructed distance information matrix to respectively obtain vital signal phase information, and respectively decomposing the vital signal phase information through a fully self-adaptive noise set empirical mode decomposition algorithm to obtain a reconstructed respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal. According to the invention, the distance information matrix is decomposed and OMP reconstruction is carried out, so that the multi-person life signals which are originally overlapped on the traditional distance-time spectrum are clearly separated after reconstruction, and the signal resolution capability of the millimeter wave radar in a multi-person same-distance scene is obviously improved.

title_en: Through-wall radar respiratory signal detection method based on PCA and VMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar respiratory signal detection method based on PCA and VMD, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out characteristic decomposition on an ultra-wideband radar echo data matrix after direct current component removal, then carrying out modal decomposition on a dynamic signal matrix after impurity removal in a slow time dimension, screening relevant modal components in a respiratory frequency range, reconstructing the screened modal components, carrying out Fourier transformation in the slow time dimension to construct a distance-frequency spectrogram, finally constructing a two-dimensional Gaussian template which accords with human respiratory spectrum characteristics and matching, and calculating the distance and frequency estimated value of human respiratory signals. The invention solves the problems of weak anti-interference capability and high false alarm probability of a single clutter suppression method, thereby realizing accurate respiratory signal detection in a strong clutter environment.

title_en: Smart infant stethoscope toy and infant health condition minotoring system including the same
title_ko: 스마트 영유아 청진기 장난감 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart infant stethoscope and an infant health condition monitoring system including the same which comprise: an insertion unit having a rubber cap attached to the outside thereof, wherein the insertion unit is inserted into an ear; a head unit having a gripping unit formed on one surface, wherein the gripping unit is gripped by a hand, and having a contact unit formed on the other surface, wherein the contact unit contacts a human body; a sensor unit prepared in the insertion unit and the head unit to measure vital signs of an infant who is playing; and a control unit that determines a health condition of the infant based on the measured vital signs. Accordingly, the health condition of the infant is determined through multi-channels including a body temperature, a pulse wave, oxygen saturation, and skin conductance and the health condition of the infant is transmitted to an external device to be monitored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 영유아 청진기 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 외부에 고무 캡이 결합되어 귀에 삽입되는 삽입부; 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 접촉되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 삽입부 및 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도 및 피부전도도를 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-Sensor Fusion-Based Safety Seat System for Autonomous Vehicles
title_ko: 자율주행 차량용 다중 센서 융합 기반 안전 좌석 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자율주행 차량 내 사용자의 생체 신호를 실시간으로 감지하는 다중 센서 융합 기반 안전 좌석 시스템에 관한 것이다. 심박수, 호흡, 압력, 온도 센서를 통해 사용자의 상태를 분석하고, 비상 상황 시 좌석 자동 조정 및 외부 의료기관과의 통신 기능을 통해 안전을 보장한다.

title_en: Smart home device using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring for contactless human interactions and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. Radar chirps may be output by a radar sensor operating in a burst mode. The burst mode radar data stream may be monitored for a contactless human interaction performed by an active user. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. Health monitoring of an inactive user may be performed using the virtual continuous mode radar data stream.

title_en: Method for determining the position and vital parameters of an occupant of a transportation vehicle and transportation vehicle
abstract_en: A method for determining the position and vital signs of an occupant of a transportation vehicle and a transportation vehicle having a radio system and a control unit connected to the radio system. The method is based on channel impulse response (CIR) measurements and is performed using at least two UWB antennas during the operation of the transportation vehicle to determine a position and a vital sign of one or more occupants of the transportation vehicle.

title_en: Vital sign signal enhancement method and equipment, and extraction method and equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for enhancing vital sign signals based on a millimeter wave radar, and a method and equipment for extracting the vital sign signals, wherein the enhancing method comprises the following steps: the multi-antenna radar continuously receives N echo signals, wherein the echo signals are echoes of a target to radar transmission signals; carrying out null filtering on the echo signal to remove zero-frequency components; establishing a multi-channel Kalman smoothing model by taking the signals which are received at the same time and subjected to null filtering as observed quantities to obtain enhanced vital sign signals; the extraction method further comprises the steps of: and performing Fourier transformation on the enhanced vital sign signals to a frequency domain, determining the range of the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency according to the comparison of the amplitude and the frequency spectrum data of a preset threshold value in a preset frequency range, and further determining the characteristic value of the life. The method and the equipment can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the radar receiving echo when the life signal is too weak or the interference of the environmental noise is too large.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physiological information monitoring, in particular to a non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and a non-contact vital sign data monitoring system, which comprise the following contents: the device comprises a chest cavity micro-motion data acquisition module, a heartbeat data analysis module, a body temperature measurement module, a threshold parameter adjustment module and a health index calculation module. According to the invention, the millimeter wave radar sensor and the infrared sensor are utilized to collect and analyze the chest micro-motion and infrared radiation data of a target individual in real time, so that the vital sign is accurately monitored, the physiological state of the individual is combined, the abnormal detection threshold value is adjusted, the monitoring result is attached to the actual health condition of the individual, the comprehensive evaluation of the health state is realized through the combined analysis of a plurality of vital signs, the data support is provided for preventive health management and early disease diagnosis by combining the health trend prediction, the practicability of a monitoring system is improved, and the application range of the non-contact monitoring technology under a complex environment is expanded.

title_en: System and method for contactless sensing on a treadmill
abstract_en: A treadmill includes a belt, a display, a first sensor having first transmission circuitry for transmitting a first radar beam over the belt and first reception circuitry for detecting a first reflected signal that is a reflection of the first radar beam from a user on the belt, a processor connected to the first sensor, the belt and the display, and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program to be executed by the processor. The program includes instructions for determining, according to the first reflected signal, first data associated with a vital sign of the user and displaying, according to the first data, the vital sign on the display.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: The automatic Fast measurement system of a kind of common midpoint Coherent Noise in GPR Record
abstract_en: The automatic Fast measurement system of a kind of common midpoint Coherent Noise in GPR Record, relates to ground penetrating radar.Be provided with common midpoint Coherent Noise in GPR Record self-operated measuring unit, computing machine, radar host computer; Measurement mechanism is provided with transmission nut, left-and-right spiral bar, pipe collar, ground penetrating radar emitting antenna, ground penetrating radar receiving antenna and step motor; One end of left-hand screw bar is located at by step motor, and left-and-right spiral bar is connected by pipe collar; Emitting antenna and receiving antenna are fixed on left-and-right spiral bar by transmission nut; Computing machine is connected with step motor and radar host computer by data line, the position that step motor and radar host computer are used for synchro control emitting antenna and receiving antenna is respectively moved and radar data acquisition, and step motor controls the position of emitting antenna and receiving antenna by transmission left-and-right spiral bar and makes the equidistantly movement round about of emitting antenna and receiving antenna; Radar host computer controls emitting antenna to underground medium radiated electromagnetic wave, and by the reflection echo of receiving antenna record from buried target.
assignees: UNIV XIAMEN;UNIV GUANGZHOU;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Convenient-to-use life detection device for searching earthquake disaster victims
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a convenient life detection device for searching earthquake disaster victims, which comprises a main body, a controller and a display screen, the main body is cuboid, the controller is arranged on the main body, the display screen is arranged on the controller, the main body is internally provided with a radar search and rescue system, the main body is provided with four auxiliary mechanisms which are respectively arranged at four corners of the bottom of the main body, the auxiliary mechanism comprises a connecting block, a connecting pipe, a supporting rod, a screw rod, a buckle and a buffer component, the connecting block is connected with the main body through the buffer component, the buckle is fixed on the main body, the connecting pipe is parallel to the plane of the bottom of the main body, this a convenient to use's life detection equipment for searching earthquake disaster person who suffers from a difficult need not the user through complementary unit and seeks the suitable work area of this equipment, has improved the convenience of use.

title_en: Device, system and method for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: In order to provide means for measuring vital signs such as heart rate, breathing rate, pulse forms, that allow accurate and unobtrusive signal acquisition and that are automatically adjusted to varying positions of an area of interest within a predetermined area, a device, a system and a method for measuring vital signs are provided, wherein electromagnetic signals such as microwave or radar are emitted and reflected electromagnetic signals are sensed with directional sensitivity by a transceiving unit and wherein a direction of interest is determined based on the sensed reflected signals and a primary direction of sensitivity (300) of the transceiving unit is adjusted to the direction of interest by a control unit. Thus, vital signs can be monitored in an unobtrusive and simple way.

title_en: Array-radar-based extending moving-target through-wall imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides an array-radar-based extending moving-target through-wall imaging method. According to the technical scheme, the method includes the following steps that first, difference treatment is performed on every two adjacent frames of echo data with a change detection method to eliminate clutter influences; second, the echo data of all the frames are imaged sequentially; third, targets are detected with a Gaussian distribution CFAR detector; fourth, coordinates of spatial positions of the targets in the image are extracted; fifth, false targets are judged and eliminated, so that the extending moving-target imaging result of all the frames of echo data with the false targets eliminated is obtained. The method can solve the suppression problem of the false targets in the extending moving-target imaging process, meanwhile the method is easy to achieve, and the method can be used for actual engineering design and signal processing.

title_en: Imaging method suitable for through-wall radar multipath phantom inhibition
abstract_en: The invention provides an imaging method suitable for through-wall radar multipath phantom inhibition. The imaging method comprises a subaperture imaging step, wherein a full aperture is divided into N subapertures having no intersection, and for each subaperture, a back projection imaging algorithm is used to obtain N independent sub-images; and a sub-image fusing step, wherein normalization is carried out on the N independent sub-images respectively, N normalized sub-images I'i are obtained, united multiplying is carried out on the N normalized sub-images to obtain a fused iamge If, and finally, threshold detection and binary processing are carried out on the fused image If to obtain a final radar image I. According to the invention, the multipath phantom interference is effectively inhibited, and the signal to clutter ratio of the image and the detection performance of a hidden target behind a wall are improved.

title_en: A kind of multipath based on Bayes's compressed sensing utilizes through-wall radar imaging method
abstract_en: Through-wall radar imaging method is utilized the invention discloses a kind of multipath based on Bayes's compressed sensing.The present invention is launched train of pulse and obtains echo-signal using Dan Zhandan dual-mode antenna Millimeter Wave Stepped-Frequency High Resolution Radar systems parallel to metope multiple position, the measurement signal that sampling obtains relatively small amount is compressed to echo-signal by random measurement matrix, then joint builds compressed sensing model according to the good dictionary of wall multipath reflection characteristics design, scene information after wall is reconstructed from measurement signal to come using Bayes's compression sensing method, finally through-wall radar imaging is completed using the information for reconstructing.Present invention reduces cost, reduce the record time, at the same Bayes's compressed sensing technology use so that calculating speed faster, required observation data volume it is less, the precision of images obtained with reference to multipath Application way is higher and restrained effectively the appearance of diplopia.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar construction wall location acquiring method utilized based on multipath
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar construction wall location acquiring method utilized based on multipath, is averaged CFAR detection method to original radar image progress binaryzation first with two-dimensional cell；Secondly, by clustering method multiple cluster regions will be divided into the image-region of high pixel density in binaryzation radar image, by point cluster region zero setting that pixel is less in cluster process；Again, coordinate value of the geometric center of each image-region after taking clustering processing as each cluster region；Then, by the change in location feature of each cluster areas in analysis multiframe radar image, successively each cluster areas attribute in each frame image is determined；Finally, the ordinate on surface within the walls after being obtained using the geometrical relationship between real goal and the secondary multipath decoy of rear wall, the ordinate of front wall inner surface is acquired according to the geometrical relationship that real goal and front-back wall vibrate a multipath.

title_en: Method for acquiring water level information of aquifer by using ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water level detection devices, in particular to a method for acquiring water level information of an aquifer by using a ground penetrating radar, which comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out topographic measurement on a section selected in a working area to obtain topographic data of the section; detecting the aquifer of the section to obtain a time section of the ground penetrating radar; and processing the time profile of the ground penetrating radar by combining the topographic data of the section, and obtaining water level buried depth data after time-depth conversion. The invention can realize that the underground water level is not exposed in areas with few wells or no wells by digging, the water level information of the underground aquifer can be rapidly and accurately measured by utilizing the ground penetrating radar, and meanwhile, the detection error can be reduced by combining with the terrain data.
assignees: XI'AN CENTER OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CGS

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting and a system thereof, comprising: the unmanned aerial vehicle body, be equipped with battery, radar life detection instrument, GPS positioner, extinguishing device, temperature-sensing ware, wireless transceiver and controller etc. on the unmanned aerial vehicle body. The unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting and the system thereof provided by the invention can monitor the occurrence of forest fire in time, and can carry out emergency fire fighting at the first time and transmit the fire situation to the terminal, thereby reminding people to pay attention to and reducing the loss caused by forest fire.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGTONGJIE SAFETY PREVENTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building interaction system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building interaction systems, and discloses a building interaction system based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises: a target building and a virtual reality terminal device, the target building being configured with a plurality of entrance ends and a first sensing unit; the virtual reality terminal equipment is provided with a live-action display unit and a virtual reality display unit, and is provided with a second sensing unit, an information storage unit, a positioning unit, a thermal sensing unit, a radar life detection unit and a local processor; the local processor is configured with a path guiding module, when a firefighter wearing the virtual reality terminal device enters the interior of the target building from the entrance end, the information storage unit retrieves three-dimensional model information of the corresponding target building, and the path guiding module generates path guiding information according to the three-dimensional model information, the positioning information, the heat source information in the interior of the target building and the life body information and outputs the path guiding information to the virtual reality display unit.

title_en: Intelligent medical and nutritional noninductive comprehensive detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive intelligent medical-care noninductive detection system, which relates to the medical-care detection field, and comprises the following components: the system comprises an edge control platform, a radar, an infrared temperature sensor, a wireless network card and a camera; the edge control platform is provided with an SDIO and high-speed SPI, UART, RMII, HDMI, USB physical interface; the radar and the infrared temperature sensor are connected with the edge control platform through a high-speed SPI interface; the wireless network card is connected with the edge control platform through an SDIO interface; the RMII interface signals are physically connected with a network cable through an RJ45 connector; the camera is connected with the edge control platform through a USB or UART interface; based on the detection system provided by the invention, vital signs, actions, falling and other emergency conditions of a patient can be monitored in real time through millimeter wave radar, infrared and optical lenses and by combining technical means such as AI, and the life quality of the patient is improved.
assignees: SICHUAN JIZHUANZHENGXIN SMART MEDICAL CARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physiological information monitoring, in particular to a non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and a non-contact vital sign data monitoring system, which comprise the following steps: based on the millimeter wave radar sensor, the chest micro-motion data of the target individual is acquired in real time, chest motion signals caused by heartbeat and respiration are separated, and the frequency and the change of the respiration are identified, so that respiration mode data is obtained. According to the invention, the millimeter wave radar sensor and the infrared sensor are utilized to collect and analyze the chest micro-motion and infrared radiation data of a target individual in real time, so that the vital sign is accurately monitored, the physiological state of the individual is combined, the abnormal detection threshold value is adjusted, the monitoring result is attached to the actual health condition of the individual, the comprehensive evaluation of the health state is realized through the combined analysis of a plurality of vital signs, the data support is provided for preventive health management and early disease diagnosis by combining the health trend prediction, the practicability of a monitoring system is improved, and the application range of the non-contact monitoring technology under a complex environment is expanded.
assignees: The 8th Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method and system based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method and system based on an FMCW radar. Firstly, receiving radar echo signals, generating a three-dimensional data matrix, extracting amplitude signals and phase signals, then adopting a self-adaptive distance unit locking technology to respectively determine an optimal breathing distance unit and an optimal heartbeat distance unit, extracting phase signals from the screened optimal breathing distance unit, extracting breathing signals by a band-pass filter, extracting phase signals from the selected optimal heartbeat distance unit, differentiating the phase signals, and carrying out joint denoising through a dynamic double filter to obtain heartbeat signals. And finally, carrying out error correction on the physiological parameters obtained by spectrum analysis through sliding window statistical constraint. The invention solves the problems of mutual interference of respiratory and heartbeat signals, difficult extraction of weak heartbeat signals, insufficient suppression of environmental noise and the like in the existing radar monitoring, and can be widely applied to medical monitoring, intelligent home and health management scenes.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing vital signal characteristics based on radar acquisition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital signal analysis and discloses a vital signal characteristic analysis method and a device based on radar acquisition, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a signal analysis model matched with thoracic cavity displacement parameters according to the thoracic cavity displacement parameters of a tested person acquired by radar, wherein the signal analysis model comprises a target signal analysis function, and the target signal analysis function comprises a vital signal analysis function and a non-vital signal analysis function; the characteristic analysis module is used for carrying out characteristic analysis on the target signal analysis function to obtain the target period characteristic parameter and the space-time characteristic parameter of the target signal analysis function as the signal characteristic analysis result of the tested person, so that the characteristic analysis can be carried out on the life and non-life signal analysis functions through the characteristic analysis module to obtain the target period characteristic and the space-time characteristic of the collected signals of the tested person, the signal characteristic analysis comprehensiveness of the tested person is improved, and the accuracy and the high efficiency of the life signal characteristic analysis of the tested person are improved.
assignees: FOSHAN YUNMI ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive scene classification and interference suppression method based on TCN module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TCN module-based self-adaptive scene classification and interference suppression method, which comprises the steps of acquiring sensor data in different scenes by using a wearable device, including radar signal data of human body vital signals detected by a millimeter wave radar and triaxial acceleration data acquired by a triaxial accelerometer, constructing a random forest model, training the random forest model, inputting the sensor data set, outputting a dynamic scene discrimination result, acquiring the dynamic scene discrimination result of current sensor data by using the trained random forest model, and enhancing radar signals by using the TCN module aiming at the dynamic scene discrimination result. According to the method, scene classification and interference suppression are combined, the indoor and outdoor subnetworks are dynamically invoked based on random forest judgment results, and model threshold parameters and targeted enhancement weak signals are dynamically adjusted according to different energy duty ratios, so that an interference suppression strategy and a scene are synchronized in real time.

title_en: Smart diffuser with directional antenna-based non-contact bio-signal measurement function
title_ko: 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smart diffuser having a non-contact bio-signal measurement function based on a directional antenna capable of acquiring more precise data. The smart diffuser having a non-contact bio-signal measurement function based on a directional antenna comprises: a main body including a cylindrical body, an expansion flange, and a support; a coupling nut having screw-joining holes formed in the upper and lower directions; an elevating drive shaft coupled to the screw-joining holes of the coupling nut; a cover part for opening and closing an exhaust port of the main body; an elevating drive motor for rotating the elevating drive shaft; an elevating guide for blocking rotation of the cover part when the cover part is elevated; a bio-signal detection sensor part for detecting the presence and location of a resident based on a reflected signal by outputting an ultra-wideband frequency signal and detecting a resident's bio-signal; an environmental information detection sensor part for detecting indoor environmental information; and a controller for controlling the bio-signal sensor part, receiving bio-information and environmental information, and controlling the elevating drive motor accordingly.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 실내 위치, 생체신호 측정을 통한 거주자의 생활패턴 및 공간별 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능하고, 지향성을 가지도록 하여 정확도 높은 센서데이터의 취득이 가능한 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 위치를 실시간으로 추적 및 활동량을 분석하고, 이에 따른 주거 공간별로 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 장점이 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에 따른 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 호흡수 및 심박수를 실시간 측정함으로써 응급상황 발생 여부를 확인 및 신속한 후속조치가 가능하고, 거주자의 활동패턴 및 생체신호 분석을 통해 침입자 인식이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: System for Safety Management using EEG-Based Complex Signal
title_ko: 뇌파를 기반으로 하는 복합 신호 활용 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology related to a system for determining whether a user is abnormal by using a complex bio-signal based on a brain wave and determining an emergency situation and an abnormal symptom based on the same. In a process of determining the state of the user by using the complex signal together with the brain wave, the emergency situation of the user can be immediately determined, so that it is possible to immediately cope with an accident. In addition, in that it is possible to determine fatigue and thermal diseases by using the complex signal together with the brain wave, there is an effect of preventing the possibility of an accident that may occur in the future by diagnosing an abnormal symptom in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 뇌파를 기반한 복합 생체신호를 활용하여 사용자의 이상 여부를 판단하고, 이를 기반으로 긴급상황 및 이상 징후을 판단하는 시스템에 관한 기술로, 뇌파와 함께 복합 신호를 활용하여 사용자의 상태를 판단하는 과정에서, 사용자의 긴급상황을 즉각적으로 판단할 수 있는 점에서, 사고 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있을 뿐만 아니라, 뇌파와 함께 복합 신호를 활용하여 피로도 및 온열 질환 등을 판단할 수 있는 점에서, 이상 징후를 사전에 진단하여 향후 발생할 수 있는 사고 가능성을 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
