title_en: Health monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The health monitoring system (100) includes an appliance of stand-alone device equipped with a vital-sign sensor module, a processor in communication with the sensor module; an alert mechanism; and a user interface for communicating alerts to users, providing real-time monitoring, and allowing user interaction. The system represents a integration of radar technology and artificial intelligence within a common household fixture. Comprising a seamlessly integrated radar module and an ornamental radome, this system transforms the common household fixture into a discreet and unobtrusive health-monitoring device. The radar module remotely emits signals towards a monitored area, capturing reflections from the body and providing continuous real-time data on vital signs such as heartbeat rate and breath rate. Processed by an AI processor, this information enables the system to detect abnormalities, triggering alerts communicated to users via a user interface.
assignees: AI SPARK INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A radar apparatus for detecting multiple life-signs of a subject, a method and a computer program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, comprising a transmitter system for emitting a transmission electromagnetic beam to the chest and/or the abdomen of a subject, a receiving system for receiving first reflected electromagnetic beam data from the chest and/or the abdomen, and a processor unit for processing the first received beam data retrieving breath activity information. The transmitter system, the receiving system and the processor are further arranged for performing a radar measurement of a superficial artery structure, such as a wrist artery, an ankle artery, a carotid artery and/or the fontanel artery for retrieving heart activity information.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Vehicle occupant detection
abstract_en: A vehicle occupant detection system and method for using the same.The vehicle occupant detection system includes: a controller; a plurality of life detection sensors, wherein the plurality of life detection sensors are installed within an interior cabin of a mass-transit vehicle and are each associated with a life detection zone; a local warning system having at least one human-machine interface (HMI) output device; and a vehicle interface that communicatively couples the controller to a vehicle electrical system of the mass-transit vehicle.The vehicle occupant detection system is configured to: (i) acquire sensor data by scanning the life detection zone using the plurality of life detection sensors; (ii) determine whether an occupant is present based on the sensor data; and (iii) provide an indication to a user that an occupant is present using the HMI output device when it is determined that an occupant is present.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using ground penetrating radar
A radar based ranging system for positioning and vital sign detection
abstract_en: A radar interferometry based phase detection for ranging of a target object is provided. The method of ranging or positioning is based on a phase of a carrier frequency and a plurality of phases of beats among all frequencies. After ranging, positioning may be determined by multi-station trilateration or mono-station cooperating with direction of arrival detection. The method may be also suitable for vital sign detection because of its high sensitivity to distance changes, and in one example, detect the respiration rate of a moving object.

title_en: Cross-bore detection during horizontal directional drilling
abstract_en: An electromagnetic sensor is configured for deployment at or near a cutting tool connected to a drill string and moveable by a horizontal directional drilling machine. The sensor comprises a housing having an exterior surface which is exposed to soil when the drill string and cutting tool move through the soil. An antenna arrangement and a power source are supported by the housing. Circuitry is disposed in the housing and coupled to the power source and the antenna arrangement. The circuitry is configured to generate a signal for transmission by the antenna arrangement, measure a performance characteristic of the antenna arrangement using a power detector coupled to at least a transmit antenna of the antenna arrangement, and detect a change in the antenna performance characteristic relative to a threshold indicative of contact between the cutting tool and a buried utility.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-invasive virus symptom detection
abstract_en: Systems for symptom detection include a sensor configured to sense a signal indicative of at least one vital sign of a user, a display, a processor, and a memory. The memory has stored thereon instructions which, when executed by the processor, cause the system to determine at least one vital sign of the user based on the sensed signal, determine a wellness and/or health condition of the user based on the at least one vital sign, and display on the display at least one of information or indicia indicative of the determined wellness or health condition.
assignees: SYMPTOMSENSE LLC;Peterson Derek;ELBADRY MOHAMMED;ANDERSON LENWORTH;MUHAMMAD BILAL;HUSSAIN ASHEIK

title_en: Device for measuring or stimulating vital signs of a user
abstract_en: Disclosed is a novel hybrid of a device combined with independent integrated multi sensing automats that measures up to 64 different vital signs simultaneously and battery free(!). This device includes a glue-free suction patch, easy to attach to a patient's neck, wrists, temples (or selected body parts, if required). A base station contains electronic parts that provide a weak alternating electric field (AeF), which propagates over the patient's skin with no harm, to power and communicate with the suction patch. The electric field is bi-directionally data-modulated (proprietary phase-duplex) while remotely powering the chip at the same time. The suction patch gets a sequence from the base station to create desired vital signs sensors temporarily on-the-fly and sends the digitized sensing values radiation-free(!) continuously to the base station, which wirelessly connects to networks, computers, SmartDevices and applications.

title_en: Through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signals. The through-wall imaging method provided by the invention has extremely low hardware equipment cost, WiFi signals generated by a general wireless router can be used as transmitting signals of the imaging system, and the wireless router is widely distributed in places such as families, banks, markets, office buildings, hotels and the like at present, has large quantity, and provides rich signal sources for the through-wall imaging system; WiFi signals generated by the wireless router have wide bandwidth, and imaging high resolution is guaranteed theoretically; the WiFi signal frequency band generated by the wireless router meets the IEEE standard and is universal all over the world, and the frequency band is a free frequency band without paying the frequency band use fee; the required hardware equipment is small in size, and only a reference receiving antenna and a detection receiving antenna are required to be configured compared with the traditional through-wall radar; the method is suitable for any through-wall radar imaging method; the through-wall imaging method based on the WiFi signals can realize through-wall imaging with low cost and high efficiency, and lays a foundation for effectively and quickly solving indoor emergencies.

title_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on group structure and correlation learning
abstract_en: A high-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on group structure and correlation learning relates to the technical field of radar imaging. The invention comprises the following steps: assuming a uniform linear array of N array elements, and simulating a direct echo signal of the nth array element; at the same timeVectorizing M frequency point echo signals of N array elements; simulating N array element multipath echo signals; obtaining compressed observation data; constructing a layered Bayesian generation model; optimizing variables gamma, x and c; initializing gamma, x and c; calculating an upper bound for the reduction of the objective function after changing a non-zero element of gamma to a zero element Calculating an upper bound for a reduction of the objective function after changing a zero element of gamma to a non-zero element Converging gamma to an optimal value; the parameter c is the learned intra-group element correlation. The invention fully utilizes the group sparse structure in the signal and the correlation between the elements in the group, can effectively improve the sparse reconstruction mean square error of the signal, reduces the observation number required by reconstructing the original signal, and has stronger anti-noise capability.

title_en: Telescopic forest fire prevention warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fireproof warning devices, and discloses a telescopic forest fireproof warning device which comprises a rack, a telescopic device and a hydraulic system, wherein the telescopic device is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the rack, the hydraulic system is fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the rack, the rack is made of stainless steel, all frames are welded and connected, and the rack is integrally buried in soil. When the pedestrian passes through, the sensor receives pulse signal, make hydraulic system and telescoping device work, the warning sign rises and exceeds ground, the pedestrian just can see forest fire prevention warning sign, and disappear as pulse signal, under the effect of gravity, the warning sign can slowly descend back to the original position, can avoid the bad weather of strong wind and rainy, reduce the personal safety accident that probably takes place, the overall process does not need artifical the participation, can make the reaction fast when someone gets into the forest zone time, thereby time saving and labor saving, safe and reliable's effect has been reached.

title_en: System and method for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for monitoring a vehicle cabin. Vehicle cabin monitoring uses a radar unit positioned in the center of the cabin to acquire image data of the vehicle cabin and uses a processor to generate detection of occupancy of seats within the vehicle cabin, classification of occupants, detection of gestures, determination of seat belt status, and monitoring of vital signs of the occupants. The output unit may perform a response adapted to the status of the occupant of the vehicle cabin.

title_en: Method for inverting dielectric characteristics of surrounding rock of deep-buried tunnel and identifying loose coil range
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dielectric property inversion and loose coil range identification method of surrounding rock of a deep buried tunnel, which comprises the steps of carrying out forward modeling after preliminary in-situ detection by adopting a geological radar before excavation of the deep buried tunnel, determining the dielectric constant epsilon   Front part  , the conductivity sigma   Front part   and the magnetic permeability mu   Front part   of a region, obtaining a scanning image of a concerned region, and obtaining the radar wave velocity v   Front part   by an excavation wave velocity model; after the deep tunnel is excavated, outputting a high-precision dielectric constant epsilon and a high-precision conductivity sigma through dielectric property inversion, and solving a wave velocity v after the deep tunnel is excavated through an excavated wave velocity model; calculating the thickness of the loose coil according to the wave velocity v; and obtaining the level of the loose ring of the surrounding rock according to the rock integrity index dividing condition table by taking the square of the ratio of the wave speed v to the radar wave speed v   Front part   as the quantitative evaluation of the integrity degree of the loose ring of the surrounding rock. The invention solves the problems of low measurement precision, unreliable measurement data, complex operation and the like in the conventional method for measuring the loose coil range after the deep tunnel blasting.

title_en: Blood pressure measurement system using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 비접촉식 혈압 측정 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 비접촉식 혈압 측정 시스템은 혈압 측정 대상의 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 센서를 포함한 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호의 파형을 분석하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의한 상기 생체 신호의 파형의 분석 결과에 기초하여 상기 혈압 측정 대상의 혈압 값을 추출하는 혈압 측정부를 포함한다.

title_en: A sensor apparatus of pile-type and sensor fixing-type this is able to amplify sensing signal for diagnosing integrity of facilities
title_ko: 센싱 신호 증폭이 가능한 센서 고정형 시설물 건전성 진단용 파일형 센서장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing a health of a sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying a sensing signal. According to the present invention, the pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing the health of the sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying the sensing signal of the present invention is installed to a certain depth inside facilities such as slopes, buried pipes, dams and buildings to detect waves generated by structural displacement inside the facility. In addition, the pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing the health of the sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying the sensing signal amplifies an electrical waveform signal and provides a detection signal to the outside so that the health of the facility can be evaluated. Therefore, the structural displacement of the facility can be detected in advance before a serious structural displacement or collapse accident of the facility occurs, so that casualties and accidents can be prevented in advance. The pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing the health of the sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying the sensing signal comprises: an iron-type pile unit (100); a sensing unit (200); and an amplification unit (300).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비탈 경사면, 지중 매립 관, 댐, 건물과 같은 시설물 내부에 일정 깊이로 삽입 설치되어 시설물 내부의 구조 변위에 따라 발생하는 파동을 감지하고, 전기적 파형 신호를 증폭하여 외부로 감지 신호를 제공하여 시설물의 건전성 평가를 할 수 있도록 하여, 시설물의 심각한 구조 변위나 붕괴 사고가 발생하기 전에 시설물 구조 변위를 사전에 파악할 수 있어 인명피해와 사고 발생을 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과를 제공 발명으로, 철재형 파일부(100), 센싱부(200), 증폭부(300)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-contact fast vital sign acquisition based on radar signal
abstract_en: Various examples are provided for non-contact vital sign acquisition. Information can be provided regarding vibrations of a target using a radar signal such as, e.g., non-contact vital sign measurement. Examples include estimation of heart rate, change in heart rate, respiration rate, and/or change in respiration rate, for a human or other animal. Implementations can produce one or both rates of vibration and/or change in one or both rates of vibration for a target other than an animal or human experiencing two vibrations at the same time, such as a motor, a vehicle incorporating a motor, or another physical object. Some implementations can estimate the respiration movement in the radar baseband output signal. The estimated respiration signal can then be subtracted from radar signals in the time domain and, optionally, can be further enhanced using digital signal processing techniques, to produce an estimate of the heartbeat pulses.

title_en: A kind of life detection and fire-fighting and rescue intelligent firefighting truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of life detection and fire-fighting and rescue intelligent firefighting trucks, belong to mechanical manufacturing field.The utility model includes with there are four the vehicle frame of wheel, and both sides respectively independently drive, and trolley is provided with Intelligent fire-fighting water injection system, and the life detection and fire-fighting and rescue intelligent firefighting truck include：Control centre is arranged above vehicle frame, can be controlled with remote-control handle；Rhombus expansion brackets are fixed on above vehicle frame；Push-rod electric machine is connect with the top of the rhombus expansion brackets by an axis, is fixed on frame interior；Hydraulic giant is connect with water pipe；Steering engine, steering engine above are connect with the hydraulic giant, and steering engine below is connect with steering engine above, and are fixed on above rhombus expansion brackets；Water tank is fixed on vehicle frame rear；Plunger pump is fixed on frame interior；Drive module is fixed on frame interior；Wifi cameras are fixed on front on vehicle frame；Pump motor is driven, is connect by belt with the plunger pump, is fixed on frame interior；Direct current generator is connect with wheel, is fixed below vehicle frame.The utility model is simple in structure, ingenious in design, at low cost, stability is high, fire-fighting efficiency is high.

title_en: Buried radar early warning sensor
abstract_en: A buried radar early warning sensor relates to the monitoring field and comprises a bidirectional probe, wherein the bidirectional probe comprises a sealed probe shell and two chips, a partition plate is connected in the probe shell and divides the probe shell into two cavities, the two chips are respectively arranged in the corresponding cavities, and each chip is connected with a stress sensor, a vibration source sensor, a sound wave conduction module and a sound wave conduction module; a magnet is connected in the probe shell; buried formula radar early warning sensor is still including moulding the type shell, sets up sealed inner cover in moulding the type shell, sets up battery and integrated circuit board in sealed inner cover, and integrated circuit board is connected to the battery, and two chips all are connected with integrated circuit board through the chip signal line, and integrated circuit board still connects the terminal signal line, and the terminal signal line stretches out sealed inner cover and moulds the type shell after connect intelligent terminal. The utility model can effectively detect artificial damage, natural damage and sudden accidents of the pipeline and can be conveniently fixed on the oil and gas pipeline.
assignees: ZHONGHONG MONITORING TECH YANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Radar and microseism composite life detection circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar and micro-seismic composite life detection circuit, which comprises a comprehensive processing module, a radar detection module, a micro-seismic detection module, a camera module and a display module; the radar detection module comprises a first power supply unit and a radar detection unit which are independently arranged; the first power supply unit and the radar detection unit are respectively electrically connected with the comprehensive processing module, and the first power supply unit is used for providing working voltage for the radar detection unit; the microseismic detection module comprises a second power supply unit and a first acceleration sensor which are independently arranged, and the second power supply unit is used as a current source of the first acceleration sensor; the camera module and the display module are both in communication connection with the comprehensive processing module; the comprehensive processing module sequentially enables the first power supply unit and the radar detection unit to be conducted, or sequentially enables the second power supply unit and the first acceleration sensor to enter a working state.

title_en: A kind of small sensible weight wide range tipping bucket rain gauge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of small sensible weight wide range tipping bucket rain gauge, including water outlet is let slip a remark, there are the bypass channel and a pair of tipping bucket components of delivery port in both ends；Bypass channel be located in water outlet let slip a remark bottom center line on, center line that tipping bucket component is let slip a remark according to water outlet is symmetrically arranged on bypass channel bottom.The 0.1mm sensibility reciprocal rain sensors of the present invention, respectively form branch part with accurate counterweight by two pairs of single tipping buckets, with tipping bucket e axle supporting, back-to-back in rack-mount jewel bearing branch, can delicately rotate.Its is simple in construction, small volume, is joined together with rain containing bin part, is supported and installed with only bar, designs firm base, buried underground.Surrounding is tensed with steel wire rope, under 8 grades of typhoons can normal work, use, dimensional expansion, repair convenient, dripping, calibrating is simple and convenient, precision is high；It can not only be used for the hydrology, meteorological department's routine rainfall basic document, it can also be used to 0.2,0.5mm, and remote measurement, Pan, wide application are reported in real time.

title_en: A kind of disaster relief system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster relief system, method and storage mediums, including radar detector, image capture device, monitoring server and maneuvering platform；Radar detector acquires the vital sign information and location information of life entity, and is sent to image capture device；Image and the vital sign information received are sent to monitoring server by image capture device；The image received and vital sign information are sent to maneuvering platform by monitoring server, so that salvor formulates rescue plan according to the vital sign information in maneuvering platform and the environmental information in image and notifies that the disaster relief is live.Due in embodiments of the present invention, salvor can formulate rescue plan according to the vital sign information in maneuvering platform and the environmental information in image and be notified at the first time to scene, therefore life entity after can not only being shaken with quick lock in, the help and guidance that disaster relief expert can also be got in first time after shake greatly improve disaster relief efficiency after shake.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar wall method for parameter estimation
abstract_en: A kind of through-wall radar wall method for parameter estimation mainly solves the problems, such as that existing method time delay precision of estimation result is poor and causes wall parameter estimation result deviation big.The delay inequality of wall front surface and rear surface back wave is estimated using the sparse algorithm for reconstructing of orthogonal matching pursuit by seven steps, the time delay estimation value of M observation position and delay inequality theoretical value are configured to objective function, the thickness and relative dielectric constant of wall are accurately estimated by minimizing objective function, single base transceiver is being combined accurately to be estimated with the conductivity for setting lower wall rear surface and front surface reflection wave amplitude comparison wall.The round trip transmission time delay difference of wall front surface and rear surface is estimated using orthogonal matching pursuit sparse algorithm for reconstructing in wall parameter estimation procedure, the resolution ratio and accuracy of time delay estimation result under low signal-to-noise ratio are improved, to ensure that the accuracy of wall parameter Estimation.The present invention is especially suitable in the case of low signal-to-noise ratio to the parameter Estimation of thin layer wall.

title_en: Imaging method and system based on through-wall radar clutter suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to an imaging method and system based on through-wall radar clutter suppression, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original echo signal received by a through-wall radar; imaging the original echo signal to determine an original image; determining discrete coefficients of pixel vectors of the original image according to the original image; sorting the pixel vectors of the original image according to the discrete coefficients to obtain sorted pixel vectors; determining a stepping length according to the original image; determining a pixel elimination ratio according to the stepping length; determining a first elimination ratio by using the sorted pixel vectors and the pixel elimination ratio; determining a second elimination proportion according to the first elimination proportion and the pixel elimination proportion; and reproducing according to the pixel value corresponding to the second elimination proportion to obtain an imaging result. The method and the system provided by the invention improve the imaging quality by improving the inhibition effect of clutter and background pixel vectors.

title_en: Portable toxin filtering box service life detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a portable toxin filtering box service life detection device, which comprises a box body, a gas detection module, a power supply module and an electric control device; gaseous detection module includes the air duct, gaseous detection sensor, aspiration pump and tail gas adsorber, the inlet end of air duct is located outside the box body, the end of giving vent to anger of air duct is connected with the inlet end of aspiration pump in the box body, gaseous detection sensor locates in the box body, and the sense terminal of gaseous detection sensor stretches into in the air duct in order to detect the gas through the air duct, the end of giving vent to anger of aspiration pump is connected with the tail gas adsorber, power module provides the electric energy for gaseous detection module, electrically controlled device is used for receiving external user's control command, and control the operation of gaseous detection module and with the data output that gaseous detection module detected. The detection device can help a respirator using unit to evaluate the service life of the poison filtering box according to the shift or the daily period, and remind a user of timely replacing the poison filtering box with the expired service life.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUXIANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode space-time fusion-based radar point cloud target detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring equipment, in particular to a radar point cloud target detection system and method based on multi-mode space-time fusion. The method comprises the following steps of synchronously collecting echo signals of targets by at least two radar transceivers at different visual angles, establishing a three-dimensional coordinate system, clustering target points of each time slice based on the three-dimensional coordinate system of the target points, acquiring a coordinate set of point cloud clustering, judging whether the center of gravity of the point cloud of each detection target is displaced, if the detection target is displaced, capturing a space track of the target point based on the center of gravity coordinate, performing gait analysis on the detection target, and if the detection target is not displaced, judging the body posture of the detection target. The invention has the advantage of low cost, can realize reliable radar point cloud, breaks through the defects of multiple antenna MIMO and high cost required by the traditional point cloud, realizes body point cloud modeling in the walking process, simultaneously jointly verifies pose point cloud and vital sign data, and enhances the reliability.
assignees: SHANDONG HAIKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-person detection, positioning and vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person detection, positioning and vital sign monitoring method and system, wherein the system comprises a 77G radar module, a signal preprocessing module, a target separation and people counting module, a positioning module, a vital sign extraction module, a gesture monitoring module and a data output module, and the method comprises the steps of radar signal transmission and reception, signal preprocessing, target separation and people counting, multi-person positioning, vital sign extraction, gesture monitoring and data output. The invention adopts 77G frequency modulation continuous wave radar combined with M X N phased array antenna, which improves distance resolution and angle resolution obviously, effectively separates multi-target superimposed signals through a signal separation algorithm based on sparse representation, realizes accurate people counting, realizes non-perception and high-precision multi-person comprehensive monitoring, has strong illumination resistance, shielding and environmental noise resistance and good privacy protection, and can be widely applied to multiple scenes such as intelligent security, intelligent home, medical monitoring, care and the like.

title_en: Automatic control system for unmanned screen golf facilities using visual sensors and artificial intelligence technology and the use method
title_ko: 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템 및 그 이용 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템 및 그 이용 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템으로서, 무인 스크린 골프시설에 입실을 원하는 고객의 인증을위한 고객 비주얼 데이터를 측정하는 비주얼 센서 모듈; 상기 비주얼 센서 모듈로부터 고객 비주얼 데이터를 받아 고객의 신원 및 행동 패턴을 분석하여 고객의 입실을 승인 처리하고, 고객의 퇴실 시 필요한 퇴실 정보를 자동으로 처리하는 인공지능 분석 모듈; 상기 인공지능 분석 모듈을 통해 고객의 입실이 승인되어 고객이 입실하면, 스크린 골프 사용을 위해 무인 스크린 골프시설에 설치되는 시설 장비를 자동으로 조정하는 시설 제어 모듈; 및 고객이 입실하여 퇴실하기 전까지 무인 스크린 골프시설 내에서 골프를 하는 고객에게 부가 서비스를 제공하는 부가 서비스 모듈을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명의 특징에 따른 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템의 이용 방법은, 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템의 이용 방법으로서, (1) 비주얼 센서 모듈이 무인 스크린 골프시설에 입실을 원하는 고객의 인증을 위한 고객 비주얼 데이터를 측정하는 단계; (2) 인공지능 분석 모듈이 상기 비주얼 센서 모듈로부터 고객 비주얼 데이터를 받아 고객의 신원 및 행동 패턴을 분석하여 고객의 입실을 승인 처리하고, 고객의 퇴실 시 필요한 퇴실 정보를 자동으로 처리하는 단계; (3) 시설 제어 모듈이 상기 인공지능 분석 모듈을 통해 고객의 입실이 승인되어 고객이 입실하면, 스크린 골프 사용을 위해 무인 스크린 골프시설에 설치되는 시설 장비를 자동으로 조정하는 단계; 및 (4) 부가 서비스 모듈이 고객이 입실하여 퇴실하기 전까지 무인 스크린 골프시설 내에서 골프를 하는 고객에게 부가 서비스를 제공하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템 및 그 이용 방법에 따르면, 무인 스크린 골프시설에 입실을 원하는 고객의 인증을 위한 고객 비주얼 데이터를 측정하는 비주얼 센서 모듈과, 상기 비주얼 센서 모듈로부터 고객 비주얼 데이터를 받아 고객의 신원 및 행동 패턴을 분석하여 고객의 입실을 승인 처리하고, 고객의 퇴실 시 필요한 퇴실 정보를 자동으로 처리하는 인공지능 분석 모듈과, 상기 인공지능 분석 모듈을 통해 고객의 입실이 승인되어 고객이 입실하면, 스크린 골프 사용을 위해 무인 스크린 골프시설에 설치되는 시설 장비를 자동으로 조정하는 시설 제어 모듈, 및 고객이 입실하여 퇴실하기 전까지 무인 스크린 골프시설 내에서 골프를 하는 고객에게 부가 서비스를 제공하는 부가 서비스 모듈을 포함하여 구성함으로써, 무인 스크린 골프시설의 고객 입실과 퇴실을 포함한 시설 내 서비스 제공과 공조 시스템의 자동 제어가 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템 및 그 이용 방법에 따르면, 무인 스크린 골프시설의 고객 입실과 퇴실을 포함한 시설 내 서비스 제공과 공조 시스템의 자동 제어가 가능하도록 함으로써, 스크린 골프시설의 무인 운영을 통한 인건비 절감과, 운영 효율성을 높이고, 비주얼 센서 및 인공지능(AI) 기술을 이용한 고객 인증 및 자동 제어를 통해 고객 편의성을 극대화할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명의 비주얼 센서와 인공지능 기술을 활용한 무인 스크린 골프시설 자동 제어 시스템 및 그 이용 방법에 따르면, 부가 서비스 모듈의 구성으로 식음료 주문 및 서비스 호출 모듈과 생체신호 모니터링 모듈과 응급상황 대처 모듈과 고객 맞춤형 서비스 모듈 중 어느 하나 또는 둘 이상을 포함하여 구성함으로써, 생체신호 모니터링을 통해 고객의 안전을 보장하고, 심각한 건강 문제 발생 시 즉각적인 대처가 가능하며, 화재와 같은 응급상황에서도 자동화된 대처를 통해 시설 및 고객 안전 보호가 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method based on radar signal and detection radar
abstract_en: A multi-target life detection method based on a radar signal and a detection radar. The method comprises: perform time accumulation in a slow time direction on a pre-processed echo signal to obtain a first echo signal; perform inflection point envelope extraction on the first echo signal to obtain a second echo signal; obtain an average value of all amplitude signals other than M mark amplitude signals in the second echo signal; and if the ratio of the mark amplitude signals to the average value is greater than a threshold value, a life target is at the radar detection distance corresponding to the mark amplitude signals. According to the life detection method, a normalization method is used for normalizing the radar signal amplitude in the fast time (distance) dimension; the problem of energy attenuation caused by the increase of the radar signal with distance in the process of transmission is solved; the missed rate of a far-end target is effectively reduced; and the method of two inflection point envelope extraction is used for improving the multi-target axial recognition accuracy.

title_en: Vital sign signal enhancement method and device, and extraction method and device based on millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Provided are a vital sign signal enhancement method and device, and extraction method and device based on a millimeter-wave radar. The enhancement method comprises the steps that: a multi-antenna radar continuously receives N echo signals, the echo signals being echoes of a target for a radar transmitting signal; perform null filtering on the echo signals to remove a zero-frequency component; and establish a multi-channel Kalman smoothing model by using the signals which are received at the same moment and are subjected to null filtering as an observed quantity to obtain enhanced vital sign signals. The extraction method further comprises the steps of: performing Fourier transform on the enhanced vital sign signals to a frequency domain; determining, within a preset frequency range, a range where respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency are located according to frequency spectrum data comparison between amplitude and a preset threshold, and then determining a vital characteristic value. The methods and devices can improve a signal-to-noise ratio of the radar receiving echoes when a vital signal is too weak or the interference of the environmental noise is too large.

title_en: Radar-based single target vital sensing
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: generating a target displacement signal indicative of a movement of a human target based on raw digital data generated by a millimeter-wave radar sensor; and estimating a vital sign of the human target based on the target displacement signal, where generating the target displacement signal includes: generating target in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) (I/Q) data associated with the human target based on the raw digital data, classifying the target I/Q data as high quality data or as low quality data using a first neural network, when the target I/Q data is classified as low quality data, discarding the target I/Q data, when the target I/Q data is classified as high quality data, performing ellipse fitting on the target I/Q data to generate compensated I/Q data, and generating the target displacement signal based on the compensated I/Q data.
assignees: INFINEON TECHNOLOGIES AG;UNIV FRIEDRICH ALEXANDER ER

title_en: Vital sensor
abstract_en: A probe is adapted to be attached to a body of a subject, and configured to output a signal corresponding to a vital sign of the subject. A signal processor is configured to process the signal. A cable (4) is connecting the probe and the signal processor. The cable (4) includes a conductive wire (40), a first heat-insulating layer (41), and a second heat-insulating layer (42). The conductive wire (40) is configured to transmit the signal to the signal processor. The first heat-insulating layer (41) is covering the cable from a radially outer side of the cable (4). The second heat-insulating layer is formed between the conductive wire (40) and the first heat-insulating layer (41).

title_en: Reducing motion-related artifacts in optical measurements for vital signs monitoring
abstract_en: Vital sign monitors are plagued by noisy photoplethysmography (PPG) data, making it difficult for the monitors to output consistently accurate readings. Noise in PPG signals is often caused by motion. The present disclosure provides improved techniques for reducing motion-related artifacts in optical/PPG measurements for vital signs monitoring. In general, techniques described herein are based on using measurements of reference sensors that include sensors other than optical sensors used for the optical measurements, e.g., biopotential sensors, bioimpedance sensors, and/or capacitive sensors. In particular, techniques described herein aim to filter PPG signals using substantially only the noise components of signals generated by reference sensors, by attenuating or altogether eliminating components of the signals generated by reference sensors which are indicative of the parameter the reference sensors are designed to measure. Implementing the techniques described herein may lead to more accurate vital sign evaluation using optical/PPG measurements.

title_en: Radar for through wall detection
abstract_en: Radar apparatus for detecting an object in through wall and related applications, the radar apparatus comprising a transmitter for transmitting radar signals, and a receiver for receiving reflected portions of said transmitted signals from said object. The radar apparatus is configured for operation in any of at least a first and a second selectable mode. The transmitter is configured for transmitting radar signals in accordance with a selected one of the modes of operation, and said receiver is configured for receiving said reflected portions of said signals transmitted in accordance with said selected mode of operation. The radar apparatus is configured for transmission of signals, through an obstacle, to said object when operating in at least one of said modes.
assignees: CAMBRIDGE CONSULTANTS;BURCHETT MICHAEL HUGH;UTSI PER ARNE VINCENT;OSWALD GORON KENNETH ANDREW;CARTER EDWIN CHRISTOPHER;EDGCOMBE JONATHAN PETER;KEMP GARY;CARTER ROBERT JOHN

title_en: Ingestible devices and methods for physiological status monitoring
abstract_en: Reliable, real-time heart and respiratory rates are key vital signs used in evaluating the physiological status in many clinical and non-clinical settings. Measuring these vital signs generally requires superficial attachment of physically or logistically obtrusive sensors to subjects that may result in skin irritation or adversely influence subject performance. Given the broad acceptance of ingestible electronics, the approach disclosed here enables vital sign monitoring internally from the gastrointestinal tract. The large animal (porcine) experiments and a robust processing disclosed herein demonstrate the feasibility of this approach. Implementing vital sign monitoring as a stand-alone technology or in conjunction with other ingestible devices has the capacity to significantly aid telemedicine, optimize performance monitoring of athletes, military service members, and first-responders, as well as provide a facile method for rapid clinical evaluation and triage.

title_en: Vital sign extraction method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars, and particularly discloses a vital sign extraction method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of acquiring an echo signal of the millimeter wave radar for a target human body and extracting distance information in the echo signal; the method comprises the steps of selecting an index corresponding to a strongest power point for phase analysis according to distance information in echo signals to obtain an analysis phase, judging whether a target human body is in a motion state or not and judging whether a respiratory signal of the target human body is weak or not according to the analysis phase, expanding an alternative distance gate to determine a vital sign value of the target human body when the target human body is in a non-motion state and the respiratory signal of the target human body is weak, and calculating the vital sign value of the target human body when the target human body is in the non-motion state and the respiratory signal of the target human body is not weak. The vital sign extraction method based on the millimeter wave radar can improve the extraction accuracy of vital sign signals.
