title_ko: 모바일 센서 플랫폼
abstract_ko: 모바일 센서 플랫폼 내의 다양한 탑승자들의 센싱 동작을 수행하기 위한 다양한 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어를 포함하는 모바일 센서 플랫폼이 개시된다. 개시된 일 실시 예에 따른 방법은 차량 내의 하나 이상의 센서를 사용하여 차량 내의 탑승자의 생체 신호를 지속적으로 모니터링하는 단계, 차량 내의 하나 이상의 제1전자 장치, 및 차량 외부의 하나 이상의 제2전자 장치 중 하나 이상으로부터 수신된 다른 센서 신호들과 생체 신호의 데이터 융합으로부터 데이터 결과를 생성하는 단계, 데이터 결과를 사용하여, 탑승자와 독립적으로 탑승자를 대신하여 수행할 하나 이상의 동작을 결정하는 단계, 및	차량이 탑승자와 독립적으로 하나 이상의 동작을 수행하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: A kind of wireless transmission multifunctional life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless transmission multifunctional life-detection instruments, include mainly shell, ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR life detecting device, wireless audio and video probe apparatus, wireless audio probe apparatus, control device and supporting rack；The wireless audio and video probe apparatus is movably arranged in probe placement case one；The wireless audio probe apparatus is movably arranged on probe placement case two；The control device includes master control system, touch screen and battery pack；Support frame as described above includes micro- rotation connector, supporting rod and balancing pole；The present invention takes the mode of wireless transmission, enhances the portability and mobility of equipment, improves the operating distance of Multifunction life survey meter；Meanwhile the present invention is detected using three kinds of detection means, detecting structure have the characteristics that it is high-precision, and can adapt to it is various in the case of life rescue equipment.

title_en: Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on extended Bessel model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler through-the-wall radar positioning method based on Hough transform of an extended Bezier model, which belongs to the technical field of target tracking, and is characterized in that a Hough transform frequency estimation algorithm based on the extended Bezier model is used for extracting an interested target component in a received echo and estimating an instantaneous frequency characteristic value of the target component, an extended Bezier curve is constructed by introducing parameters, and further, the parameters are dynamically adjusted, and a value is determined when signal energy can be concentrated to the maximum extent, at the moment, when a fitting result is most approximate to a target instantaneous frequency curve, the estimation of target instantaneous frequency is completed, the precision is improved when compared with the parameters, and the method has innovativeness; and the positioning and tracking algorithm is used for estimating position information of the target in real time according to the instantaneous frequency, synthesizing a target motion track and realizing the tracking of the target.

title_en: Through-wall radar target near-wall maneuvering tracking method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of through-wall radars, in particular to a through-wall radar target near-wall maneuvering tracking method, and provides a new motion inertia model, namely a covariance prediction formula which is not only related to historical information, but also related to steering degree, namely: the smaller the steering angle is, the closer the prediction mode is to the linear Kalman filtering mode; the larger the steering angle is, the smaller the influence of the history information is; by adopting the prediction strategy, the probability of tracking failure during rapid steering is effectively reduced.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: User monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and computer equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a user monitoring method and computer equipment based on millimeter wave radar, wherein, computer equipment includes: a millimeter wave radar module configured to detect vital sign signals of a user, wherein the vital sign signals include a heart rate and/or a respiration rate; circuitry connected with the millimeter wave radar module and configured to: determining whether the user is abnormal or not according to the vital sign signals; and prompting the user when the user has an abnormality. Adopt this openly, can realize non-contact monitoring through millimeter wave radar module to automatically, carry out whole monitoring in the user use, need not the user and wear relevant equipment, avoided forgetting to wear and lead to unable monitoring. Under the condition that the user is determined to have abnormity according to the vital sign signals, the user is prompted, so that the user can know that the vital signs of the user are abnormal, and the user can have a rest in time.
assignees: SHENZHEN KONKA ELECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar, which belongs to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, wherein echo data is processed into a radar three-dimensional data matrix, FFT is executed on each line of channel data along a fast time dimension, and MVDR processing is carried out on data corresponding to a Range-FFT point to obtain a data matrix containing distance angle information and a distance-angle graph; after preprocessing the distance-angle diagram, extracting connected domains by a connected domain analysis method, wherein the mass center of each connected domain is each target position, further extracting a corresponding phase sequence from a data matrix, separating a respiration signal from a heartbeat signal after phase unwrapping processing, first-order phase difference and band-pass filtering, and obtaining a final monitoring result after FFT processing and estimation are respectively carried out. According to the method, the number of the detected multi-person targets does not need to be known, multiple targets at the same distance or the same angle can be distinguished, and vital sign estimation under the scene of the same distance is achieved.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method and device, wherein a radar sensor is used for collecting data of a vital sign region to be detected, after the data are processed, a distance-energy mapping relation of a moving target is obtained after a static target in the vital sign region to be detected is removed, a distance-phase mapping relation of the moving target is obtained, and then at least one specified parameter corresponding to the distance is determined according to the two mapping relations. Wherein the specified parameter includes at least a high frequency signal duty cycle. And inputting the specified parameter corresponding to the at least one distance into a pre-constructed support vector machine model to obtain a vital sign detection result output by the support vector machine model. By determining the specified parameter corresponding to the at least one distance and further using the determined specified parameter as the input of the support vector machine model, whether vital signs exist in the vital sign region to be detected can be accurately determined according to the specified parameter at least comprising the high-frequency signal duty ratio.

title_en: Vital sign detection method, device and storage medium based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-based vital sign detection method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the detection method comprises the steps of carrying out target detection on radar echo to obtain a real target, a range gate where the real target is positioned and respiratory frequency; the heart rate of the target is obtained by carrying out Chrip-Z expansion and maximum peak frequency search on the heart beat frequency band of the vital sign signal. The method carries out normalization fusion on the phase signals of the multi-range gate, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of respiration and heartbeat signals, fully utilizes vital sign information carried by radar echo, realizes high-resolution spectrum analysis in a heartbeat frequency band through Chrip-Z expansion, refines the frequency spectrum of the heartbeat signals, and improves the detection precision of vital sign parameters.

title_en: System and method of monitoring elderly people living alone using lighting device based on IoT
title_ko: 사물인터넷 기반의 조명장치를 이용한 독거노인 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring a senior citizen who lives along using an IoT lighting device. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: an IoT lighting device including a lighting lamp, a motion detecting unit, a CO2 sensor, and a biosignal detecting unit; and a monitoring device including a health condition analysis unit for analyzing a health condition of a user using operation data, CO2 concentration data, and biosignal data acquired by the IoT lighting device, an alarm generating unit for generating an alarm command when the health condition analysis unit determines a situation as emergency, and a feedback providing unit for generating a feedback command corresponding to the health condition determined by the health condition analysis unit to transmit the same to the IoT lighting device. According to the present invention, a health condition can be checked in real-time using a biosignal and CO2 concentration of a senior citizen, such that rapid respond can be performed when an emergency situation occurs. In addition, real-time check and rapid response can be performed even when an emergency situation occurs during sleeping of the senior citizen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IoT조명장치를 이용한 독거노인 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 모니터링 시스템은, 조명등과, 동작검출부와, CO2센서와, 생체신호검출부를 구비하는 IoT조명장치; 상기 IoT조명장치에서 획득한 동작데이터, CO2농도데이터 및 생체신호데이터를 이용하여 사용자의 건강상태를 분석하는 건강상태분석부와, 상기 건강상태분석부에서 응급상황으로 판단하면 경보지령을 생성하는 경보발생부와, 상기 건강상태분석부에서 판단한 건강상태에 대응하는 피드백 지령을 생성하여 상기 IoT조명장치로 전송하는 피드백제공부를 구비하는 모니터링장치를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 독거노인의 생체신호와 CO2농도를 이용하여 건강상태를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있으므로 긴급상황이 발생하였을 때 신속하게 대처하는 것이 가능하게 된다. 또한 독거노인이 취침 중에 긴급상황이 발생하더라도 실시간으로 확인하여 신속하게 대처할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Occupants sensing device based on ir-uwb rader sensor and disaster response system using the same
title_ko: Ir-uwb 레이더 센서 기반 재실자 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 재난 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an occupant detection device based on an IR-UWB radar sensor, which comprises: an IR-UWB radar sensor which is installed in at least one indoor location and periodically transmits IR-UWB impulse signals to a predetermined surveillance area to detect vital signs of occupants including breathing and a heart rate; a motor unit which is connected to the IR-UWB radar sensor and rotates the IR-UWB radar sensor left and right with respect to the ground within a predetermined angular range; a signal processing unit which, whenever a reflected signal corresponding to each of the IR-UWB impulse signals is received, converts the reflected signal into a frequency domain signal for the same designated time period; a frequency analysis unit which analyzes the frequency domain signal and classifies the same into a breathing section and a heart-rate section; a peak extraction unit which extracts a peak signal above a predetermined level for the breathing section; and an occupant counting unit which counts the peak signal extracted by the peak extraction unit to derive the number of occupants. According to the present invention, the detection ability can be equally exerted even when there are partitions, walls, and obstacles.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실내의 적어도 하나 이상의 개소에 설치되고, 미리 정해진 감시영역으로 IR-UWB 임펄스 신호들을 주기적으로 송신하여 재실자의 호흡 및 심박을 포함하는 생체 신호를 탐지하는 IR-UWB 레이더 센서; 상기 IR-UWB 레이더 센서에 연결되어 미리 정해진 각도 범위 내에서 상기 IR-UWB 레이더 센서를 지면에 대해 좌우로 왕복회전시키는 모터부; 각각의 IR-UWB 임펄스 신호에 대응하는 반사 신호가 수신될 때마다 지정된 동일 시간 구간에 대해 주파수 도메인 신호로 변환하는 신호 처리부; 상기 주파수 도메인 신호를 분석하여 호흡 구간과 심박 구간을 구분하는 주파수 분석부; 상기 호흡 구간에 대하여 정해진 레벨 이상의 피크 신호를 추출하는 피크 추출부; 및 상기 피크 추출부에 의해 추출된 피크 신호를 카운트하여 재실자의 수를 도출하는 재실자 카운트부;를 포함하는 IR-UWB 레이더 센서 기반 재실자 감지장치를 개시한다.

title_en: A Life Detection System Using Radar Sensors with Anti-Misdetection Technology
title_ko: 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a human detection system using a radar sensor applied with a false detection preventing technology, which promotes the safety of a rescue worker, comprising: a plurality of human detection modules; a plurality of repeaters connected to the human detection modules via a communication network; a plurality of gateways connected to the repeaters via the communication network; a control server for operating a life rescue system; and a local control system for controlling the life rescue system.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템은, 오탐지 요인을 제거하여 구조대원이 재난상황에 처한 사람의 위치를 정확히 파악하고 신속히 구조함은 물론 구조요원의 불필요한 위험지역 출동을 차단하여 구조요원의 안전을 도모하는 레이더 센서 기반의 재난구호 시스템을 제공하는데 목적이 있다.  
이에 따라, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템은, 하우징 형태로 시설물 내부의 다수 위치에 설치되고, 재난 발생 시 시설물 내부의 사람을 탐지하며, 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제센터와 구조요원의 스마트기기로 전달하는 다수의 인명탐지모듈; 다수의 인명탐지모듈과 통신망으로 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 취합하고 게이트웨이에 전달하는 다수의 중계기; 중계기와 통신망으로 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제시스템에 제공하는 다수의 게이트웨이; 시설물 내 관제실에 위치하여 재난 발생 시 시설물 내 재난통제시스템을 가동하고 게이트웨이와 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 수신하여 인명이 탐지되면 인명 구호시스템을 가동하는 관제서버; 및 시설물 외부 현장지휘본부에 위치하여 재난 발생 시 시설물 내 인명에 대한 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 수신하여 구호요원의 스마트기기에 전달하고 인명 구호시스템을 제어하는 로컬관제시스템;을 포함하되, 인명탐지모듈은, 레이더 센서로 구성되어 객체의 움직임과 위치를 탐지하고, 탐지데이터를 생성하여 신호처리부에 전달하는 레이더센서부; 탐지데이터를 수집하여 객체의 움직임, 위치, 크기, 속도를 계산하고 인명 여부를 해석한 후 분석데이터를 생성하는 신호처리부; 신호처리부에서 탐지데이터와 분석데이터를 전달받아 중계기로 전송하는 통신모듈부; 및 외부전원이 연결되고 내부 배터리로 구성되며 인명탐지모듈에 전원을 공급하는 전원부;를 하우징 내부에 포함하고, 신호처리부는, 다수의 비교대상 파라미터에 대한 탐지데이터 중 유효데이터로 측정된 파라미터의 종류가 기 설정한 판단기준값을 초과하면, 해당 객체는 사람인 것으로 간주하여 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제시스템에 제공하여 사람만 구호 대상에 포함되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A buried object locating and tracing method and system employing principal components analysis for blind signal detection
abstract_en: A blind locating system for finding and tracing buried objects such as utility lines, conductive pipes and sondes. A sensor array is coupled to a signal processor, which determines a field vector for one or more buried objects by producing a data signal representing a covariance matrix corresponding to the covariances of the time-varying sensor array signals over a selected frequency band and accumulation interval. The covariance matrix is characterized by eigenvalues and associated eigenvectors and a user interface (UI) indicates the field vector associated with the eigenvector having the largest eigenvalue. Using several different frequency bands, a plurality of underground objects may be simultaneously detected and indicated in the UI without foreknowledge of their existence or characteristics.
assignees: SEEK TECH INC;MAIER CHRISTOPH H;MEREWETHER RAY;OLSSON MARK S

title_en: Patient monitoring and surveillance system, methods, and devices
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods, devices and systems for the remote monitoring and/or surveillance of a patient's location, position, movement, vital signs, biopotentials, or a combination thereof using transmission of stepped-frequency radar signals, detecting reflections of the transmitted signals and processing the frequency and phase shifts.
assignees: LIFEFLOW TECHNOLOGIES INC;BROWN DAVID;NORDIN DAVID;TERAN MANUEL

title_en: Through-wall radar sensors networked together to create 2d and 3d combined views of an area
Device, system and method for detection and processing of heartbeat signals
abstract_en: A heartbeat detection device includes at least one optical reflection sensor (10 or 10a and 10b) to be positioned on a person's skin. The sensor unit is provided with a light emitter (11) and a corresponding light receiver (12) which converts light reflected by the skin into an electrical signal, and comprises an electrically tunable optical filter (16, 17) connected to the emitter, the receiver or both, in order to select, in operation, the desired light wavelength, and to perform processing of the signal thus obtained in order to enhance the heartbeat signal. Systems having the apparatus and detection methods are also described.

title_en: Rapid wall body compensation method suitable for MIMO through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid wall body compensation method suitable for MIMO through-wall radar imaging, which comprises the following steps: setting a radar to establish a coordinate system and appointing a pixel point; the MIMO through-wall radar performs multi-transmission multi-reception real-aperture front-view detection to obtain echo signals; searching the upper end and the lower end corresponding to the first pixel point to calculate the abscissa, calculating the propagation delay values of all the transceiving channels corresponding to the first pixel point, and finally obtaining the propagation delay values of all the transceiving channels corresponding to all the pixel points; and combining the echo signals and the propagation delay values to form a final image according to back projection imaging. The method avoids the problem of overlarge operation amount caused by iteration and traversal in the traditional wall body compensation method, has the good characteristics of good effect of correcting the position offset of the target image and large focusing imaging area, can be used for positioning, identifying and extracting the target from the finally obtained output image, and has good application prospect in the MIMO through-the-wall radar imaging application needing real-time processing.

title_en: Multi-target image domain steady tracking method for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target image domain steady tracking method for a through-wall radar, relates to a through-wall radar technology, and particularly relates to a multi-target detection tracking technology for the through-wall radar. The invention provides an image domain tracking algorithm suitable for multiple targets after through-wall radar imaging. Imaging rapidly within a certain allowable error to obtain a high-quality imaging result; the image enhancement algorithm based on PCF weighting processing can effectively inhibit the influence of grating lobes and enhance the target; the target template creating algorithm based on the biaxial projection can effectively extract the characteristic information of the target and prepare for tracking; the image domain tracking algorithm based on the mean shift and the Kalman filtering can effectively deal with the problems of target image expansion and deformation, can also easily deal with the problem of target shielding, and has high tracking precision. Therefore, the method has the advantages of good real-time performance and high tracking precision, and can be directly applied to through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Device and system for measuring vital signals
abstract_en: An apparatus and system for measuring vital signals is disclosed. The system comprises: a millimeter wave radar sensor disposed on the circuit board; a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board; and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on an output from the millimeter wave radar sensor.

title_en: Vibration-sinking in-situ power test bed for foundation soil and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation soil vibration sinking in-situ power test bed and a test method thereof. And applying horizontal vibration load to the foundation soil below through a vibrating table at an in-situ test site, and measuring the dynamic response of the foundation soil by using sensors buried at different positions to reflect the earthquake subsidence deformation of the soil. At present, the soil vibration and subsidence test comprises an indoor test method of dynamic single shear, dynamic triaxial and dynamic torsional shear, but the foundation soil in-situ vibration and subsidence test has not yet been completed. The method for testing foundation soil dynamic response and vibration sinking deformation is provided through the vibration action of the vibrator on the site in-situ soil column, and the soil dynamics test method is filled. The method for measuring the acceleration response and the earthquake subsidence deformation of the foundation soil under the in-situ condition has good practical significance for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses geological disaster monitoring equipment, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and improves the problem that the equipment is easy to be impacted or buried by stones, and comprises a bracket, a rainfall sensor and a collection box, wherein the rainfall sensor and the collection box are arranged on the bracket; the base is characterized in that an accommodating groove is formed in the upper end face of the base, the supporting plate is located right above the accommodating groove, a supporting block is connected to the groove wall of one end, far away from the baffle, of the accommodating groove in a sliding mode, an inserting port for inserting the supporting block is formed in one side, close to the supporting block, of the supporting plate, and the inserting port penetrates through the supporting plate and the baffle along the direction perpendicular to the baffle. When the monitoring device is impacted from the upper part of the slope, the monitoring device can be timely received into the accommodating groove for protection.

title_en: Contactless blood pressure monitoring method based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact blood pressure monitoring method based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, which belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, an echo signal from the chest of a human body to be detected is collected by a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, then heart rate values of a human body target are detected through variation modal decomposition, repositioning is carried out in a section by a pulse wave extraction method based on heart rate guidance, pulse wave signals with smaller interference are obtained, different modalities are screened by taking heart rate as a standard through VMD decomposition, interference on the pulse wave signals caused by respiration and slight body movement is removed, purer effective pulse wave signal waveforms are obtained based on heart rate recovery, time characteristics related to blood pressure are extracted from the waveforms, a blood pressure estimation model is constructed, and cycles of heart contraction and expansion are extracted for blood pressure prediction. The contactless continuous blood pressure monitoring algorithm provided by the invention can accurately and robustly realize blood pressure estimation, and provides possibility for realizing long-term real-time contactless blood pressure monitoring.

title_en: Appratus for controlling integrated supervisory of pilots status and method for guiding task performance ability of pilots using the same
title_ko: 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치 및 이를 이용한 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치 및 이를 이용한 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법은 조종사의 상태 정보에 기반하여 조종 대상체의 조정에 필요한 임무 수행 능력을 평가하는 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치에 의해 수행되는 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법에 있어서, 상기 조종 대상체의 제어 장치와 연계하여 주변 환경 정보를 측정하고, 조종사에 장착되는 센서 장치를 통해 뇌파 신호, 안구 움직임 신호, 피부 전기활동 신호, 호흡 측정 신호를 포함한 적어도 하나 이상의 생체신호를 측정하는 신호 측정 단계; 상기 주변 환경 정보를 조종사의 상태 평가를 위한 각성 상태 평가 모델에 실시간 반영하고, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호를 분석하여 개별 특징 정보를 추출한 후 상기 추출된 개별 특징 정보를 상기 각성 상태 평가 모델에 입력하여 조종사의 각성 상태와의 상관 관계 분석을 통해 융합 특징 정보를 산출하는 정보 산출 단계; 및 상기 융합 특징 정보를 이용하여 실시간 조종사의 각성 상태 수준을 평가하고, 상기 평가된 각성 상태 수준에 따라 각성 유도 피드백 신호를 제공하는 각성 상태 평가 및 피드백 제공 단계를 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus and Method of radar for life signal detection of human trapped in subsurface
title_ko: 매몰자 생명신호 감지를 위한 레이다 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매몰자 생명신호 감지를 위한 레이다 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 레이더 장치는, 미리 정해진 주파수 범위에서 연속파 신호를 발생시키는 연속파 발생기, 연속파 신호를 제1 경로와 제2 경로로 분배하는 분배기, 제1 경로의 신호를 증폭하여 지하로 방사하는 전력증폭기 및 송신안테나, 제2 경로의 신호를 0°위상신호와 180°위상신호로 분리하는 하이브리드 커플러, 180°위상신호의 위상을 조정하여 직접전달파 제거신호를 생성하는 위상변환기, 송신안테나로부터 직접 전달되는 직접전달파와 지하의 요구조자로부터 반사된 반사신호를 수신하는 수신안테나, 수신안테나에서 수신된 수신신호를 증폭하는 저잡음 증폭기, 저잡음 증폭기에서 증폭된 수신신호와 위상변환기에서 생성된 직접전달파 제거신호를 합성하여, 수신신호에서 직접전달파가 제거된 요구조자 생명신호를 출력하는 합성기 및 합성기에서 출력된 요구조자 생명신호와 0°위상신호 간의 이득비 및 위상차를 검출하는 이득/위상 검출기를 포함한다.

title_en: Buried object locator system employing automated virtual depth event detection and signaling
abstract_en: A human-portable utility locator system for locating and tracing a buried utility line characterized by an electromagnetic field emission. The locator may include a horizontal spaced sensor pair for detecting the horizontal field asymmetry of the emitted field in one or more independent frequency bands, which is employed to assist in determining an accurate “virtual depth” measurement for producing detection events. An event detector may be disposed to detect events corresponding to extremum in the B-field gradient with respect to time and a user interface (UI) coupled to the event detector signals the detected event to a user. In a preferred embodiment, one pair of spaced-apart 3D magnetic sensor arrays is disposed substantially orthogonal to another intermediate spaced-apart pair of sensors.
assignees: OLSSON MARK S;MARTIN MICHAEL J;STUART PAUL G;SEEKTECH INC

title_en: Distributed power supply protection device for life detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributed power supply protection device for life detection radar, comprising a base plate, a control box is arranged on the base plate, an air cooler and an installation box are arranged at the bottom of the outer end of the control box, a motor is arranged in the installation box, a slider is arranged on a threaded rod, a spray head is arranged on the installation plate, an exhaust fan is arranged at one side of the upper end outside the control box, a controller and a temperature sensor are arranged at the top of the inner side of the control box, signal receiving plates are arranged at one sides of two groups of moving columns which are close to each other, and a switch signal receiving block is arranged between the two groups of signal receiving plates; the utility model discloses a be provided with air-cooler and air exhauster, change the steam of controller incasement, and be provided with temperature sensor, if the high temperature, two sets of signal receiver boards will break off by oneself, have avoided because the high temperature leads to the emergence of electronic component burnout phenomenon.

title_en: Safe efficient energy storage container
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a container technical field, concretely relates to safe efficient energy storage container has the battery compartment, and the battery compartment array is equipped with a plurality of battery clusters, and the side is equipped with the side door corresponding to a plurality of battery clusters around the battery compartment, and the left side of battery compartment is connected with the explosion vent, and the right side separate connection of battery compartment has fire control cabinet and distribution to converge the cabinet. The utility model discloses cut apart and be equipped with battery cabin and electric cabin, both all adopt non-step-in layout design, separate electric cabin as safe operation district, do benefit to the fire control and put out a fire, cool down, exhaust, let out and explode for the system is safer, and energy density is higher. The fireproof partition wall is a double-layer steel plate clamped with fireproof rock wool, and the fire resistance limit is not less than 2h. The fire-fighting pipeline and the through-wall hole of the cable on the partition wall are blocked by steel plates and fire-proof mud, so that combustible gas generated by thermal runaway of the left battery compartment is prevented from spreading to the right electric compartment, and the electric equipment is prevented from arcing, lighting and igniting to explode.
assignees: Jiangsu tianhe energy storage co ltd

title_en: Vital sign radar sensor using wireless network signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign radar sensor using wireless network signals. The vital sign radar sensor detects vital signs by utilizing wireless network signals and comprises a first demodulation unit and a second demodulation unit, wherein the first demodulation unit and the second demodulation unit are used for respectively demodulating the wireless network signals of direct paths and reflected paths from two different receiving channels to obtain a first demodulation signal and a second demodulation signal, and the first demodulation signal and the second demodulation signal are combined to eliminate the influence of communication modulation on the process of extracting the vital signs.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and system based on terahertz radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring vital signs based on a terahertz radar, which comprise a radar subsystem, a power supply subsystem, a monitoring subsystem and a transportation subsystem, wherein the radar subsystem comprises a flight module, an installation module, a radar module and a positioning module, the transportation subsystem transports the radar subsystem and the monitoring subsystem to a disaster area place, the flight module drives the radar module to automatically carry out multidirectional detection on the disaster area place, so that life bodies under ruins are detected, radar signals are obtained, and the positioning module carries out positioning marking on an area with the life bodies to obtain a marked area; the monitoring subsystem receives the radar signal, converts the radar signal into detection image display to based on the regional command rescue personnel of mark and go to the rescue, the radar module of this system need not the rescue personnel and carries, and it is more convenient than traditional detection device that attaches on the back to rescue.
assignees: CHENGDU WUWEI JICHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for detecting radar system living body penetrating through obstacle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar system living body detection method penetrating through an obstacle, which comprises an FMCW radar system, and the detection method comprises the following steps: determining the response of the potential barrier through FFT calculation, detecting the position of the obstacle and determining a hot spot area; and carrying out second-stage FFT on the phase value of the first-stage FFT sequence recorded on the hot spot area, searching the FFT sequence with the maximum peak spectrum, and designating the FFT sequence with the maximum peak spectrum as target respiratory vital sign data. The obstacle response is identified, the result is used for eliminating beat frequency generated by the obstacle structure, so that the signal-to-noise ratio is improved, the obstacle response is identified by combining the obstacle response with a phase detection method, and Doppler response related to the vital sign of target respiration is extracted. Clutter from other objects reflected under debris is minimized by detailed cross-correlation weighting to effectively eliminate respiratory wall effects, improving detection accuracy.

title_en: Method for arranging asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides an asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor arrangement method, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering. Based on tunnel surrounding rock geological data, carrying out three-dimensional numerical simulation on the stability of an asymmetric high-stress tunnel according to the ground stress distribution of an asymmetric original rock and the geometric characteristics of a tunnel section, calculating the energy of the asymmetric high-stress tunnel, determining the position of a rock burst risk area, distributing microseismic sensors in the front and rear of the stress concentration area, and always including an area with higher risk and an area nearby the area in two groups of microseismic sensor arrays arranged in the front and rear of a tunnel face; the microseismic sensors are mutually cooperated and are arranged in a staggered mode in space, and the installation arrangement of the microseismic sensors immediately moves forwards and backwards in the stress concentration area and always keeps a certain distance range with the stress area. The invention ensures that more effective micro-fracture source signals in and near the tunnel stress concentration area can be captured by the micro-seismic sensor, improves the positioning precision of the micro-seismic source, and lays a foundation for accurately predicting and forecasting the tunnel disasters of the deep buried hard rock.

title_en: Doppler radar positioning method based on complex convolution neural network and time-frequency analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler radar positioning method based on complex convolution neural network and time-frequency analysis, which comprises the steps of constructing echo signals after multi-user mobile Doppler through-wall demodulation, constructing a corresponding ideal time-frequency spectrogram by adopting the constructed echo signals, and constructing a training data set; constructing a preliminary time-frequency spectrogram prediction model by taking a deep learning network as a basic framework, and training the model by adopting a training data set to obtain a final time-frequency spectrogram prediction model; predicting the radar echo signals acquired in real time by adopting the obtained model to acquire a predicted time-frequency spectrogram; adopting the obtained prediction time-frequency spectrogram to predict the track of the target in the wall so as to realize radar positioning; the method combines deep learning with time-frequency analysis to solve the problem of frequency ambiguity; the time-frequency resolution is further improved by introducing a network with a jump residual error structure; the method has the advantages of improved precision, reduced offset, enhanced robustness and improved noise immunity.

title_en: System and method for vehicle occupant vital sign detection
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detecting and/or estimating a rate of vital signs from an occupant within a cabin of a vehicle. In some implementations, the method can include identifying a repeating pattern of doppler spectrum peaks in the RADAR signal using a plurality of different range bins. The signal data may then be used to identify an estimated frequency distance between adjacent peaks of the repeating pattern. The estimated frequency distance may then be used to calculate an estimated rate of repeated vital signs of an occupant within the cabin of the vehicle.

title_en: Non-contact heart rate detection system integrating millimeter wave radar and neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar signal processing and heartbeat detection, in particular to a non-contact heart rate detection system integrating a millimeter wave radar and a neural network. According to the invention, the average value cancellation technology in the radar and processing module is used for overcoming static clutter interference in the environment to improve the signal quality, the heart rate detection module fully utilizes the time sequence of the heart beat waveform, the introduction of a multi-head attention mechanism can more comprehensively understand the relation between phase signals to improve the accuracy of heart rate prediction, and meanwhile, the mixed neural network can be used for more effectively exploring local features and global features, so that the heart rate prediction system has better adaptability and higher robustness.

title_en: Intelligent super-surface-assisted non-line-of-sight human vital sign sensing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent super-surface-assisted non-line-of-sight human vital sign sensing system and method, which are characterized in that a deep learning model Yolo-v7 is combined to position a human body target, and the propagation path of a sensing signal is changed through intelligent super-surface coding optimization, so that human vital sign sensing under a non-line-of-sight scene is realized. Aiming at the limitation of the traditional variational modal decomposition algorithm in human vital sign perception, the invention further provides an improved variational modal decomposition algorithm based on filtering, which is used for extracting human respiration and heartbeat echo signals and realizing accurate estimation of respiration rate and heart rate. The invention is different from the human body sensing technology based on the through-wall radar, and utilizes the flexible regulation and control capability of the electromagnetic wave of the super surface to change the propagation path of the sensing signal, thereby customizing the sensing environment between the wireless signal transceivers, opening up a new application environment and scene for the non-contact vital sign sensing based on the wireless signal, thereby improving the universality of the vital sign wireless sensing technology and promoting the further development and landing of the vital sign wireless sensing technology.

title_en: Underground radar device and construction machine
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To ensure that the performance of detecting a buried object hardly decreases for even irregular ground surfaces such as uneven grounds. 
     SOLUTION: An underground radar device 400 comprises a drum-shaped casing 410, a drum shaft 420 capable of rotating relatively to the casing 410, and a radar 430 suspended from the drum shaft 420 inside the casing 410. The radar 430 is disposed by being spaced apart from the inner surface of the casing 410 by a prescribed interval so that it can be displaced relatively to the inner surface of the casing 410. This ensures that the interval between the radar 430 and a ground surface is maintained almost constant as the casing 410 proceeds on an irregular ground surface while rolling thereupon, and it is possible to suppress a decrease in the performance of detecting a buried object.

title_en: Method for specifying coherent noise and method for detecting position of buried pipe
abstract_en: To specify coherent noise included in a reflected wave in an underground radar.SOLUTION: A background component is obtained by a moving average of a plurality of cross-sectional images obtained while an underground exploration radar is moved. A background-removed component is obtained by removing the background component from the cross-sectional image. With an intermediate frequency between a peak frequency of a frequency spectrum of the background component and a peak frequency of the frequency spectrum of the background-removed component as a boundary, coherent noise is specified based on a magnitude relation of power before and after the intermediate frequency in the frequency spectrum of the cross-sectional image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for measuring bio-signal and wearable electronic device
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정을 위한 방법 및 이를 위한 착용형 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to a variety of embodiments of the present invention, a wearable electronic device comprises: a first sensor configured to sense movement of the electronic device; a second sensor configured to sense a biological signal for a user wearing the electronic device; and a processor configured to compute a movement value of the electronic device by using the first sensor, configured to detect a resting state when the movement value lasts within a predetermined first threshold range during a first time period, and configured to form biological information of the user based on a biological signal measured after detection of the resting state. Other various embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예들에 따른 착용형 전자 장치에 있어서, 상기 전자 장치의 움직임을 감지하기 위한 제1 센서와, 상기 전자 장치의 착용자에 대한 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 제2 센서와, 상기 제1 센서를 이용하여 상기 전자 장치의 움직임값을 산출하고, 상기 움직임값이 미리 정해진 제1임계 범위 이내로 제1 시간 구간 유지되는 안정화 시점을 결정하여, 상기 안정화 시점 이후에 측정되는 생체 신호에 근거하여 상기 착용자의 생체 정보를 구성하도록 제어하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있으며, 이외에도 다양한 다른 실시예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Safety management work clothes based on biological signals
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to safety management work clothes based on a biological signal. According to the present invention, the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal comprises: work clothes (110); a band (120) attached to the inner side of the work clothes and manufactured of a synthetic elastic resin fabric to minimize bending the human body by a sensor for a biological signal and a module; the sensor (130) for a biological signal, attached to the band; the module (140) processing the signal by receiving the signal from the sensor for a biological signal; a battery (150); and a digital chamber (160) capable of transmitting the signal between the sensor for a biological signal and the module or between the module and the battery. According to the present invention, the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal prevents an accident in an industrial field by detecting a health state based on the biological signal of a worker wearing safety management work clothes based on the biological signal. The safety management work clothes based on the biological signal also prevent accidents due to carelessness by analyzing the state of the worker, such as level of stress, exercise strength, and motion and action pattern, in a server based on big data by using the biological signal such as electrocardiogram, acceleration, and body temperature, which are sensed by the sensor for a biological signal of the safety management work clothes. The safety management work clothes based on the biological signal provide a continuous personalized healthcare service for the worker, and therefore, can prevent disease, improve productivity and promote health.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 작업복(110)과; 상기 작업복의 내부면에 부착되되 신체신호용 센서 및 모듈의 인체 접지 최소화를 위해 신축성 있는 합성수지 원단으로 제조된 밴드(120)와; 상기 밴드에 부착되는 신체신호용 센서(130)와; 상기 생체신호용 센서로부터 신호를 전달받아 처리하는 모듈(140)과; 배터리(150)와; 상기 생체신호용 센서와 모듈 또는 모듈과 배터리 간에 신호를 전달할 수 있는 디지털실(160); 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복은 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Method for infrared detection of buried unexploded objects in humanitarian demining operations
abstract_en: A method for the infrared detection of buried unexploded objects in the sub-surface layer of soils at small or moderate depths, in humanitarian demining operations, characterized by the fact that the target soil is locally heated by means of a microwave apparatus, in order to increase the thermal discontinuity between the unexploded objects and the materials surrounding them. Such a thermal discontinuity allows the individuation of the detonator and thus of the UXO. The unexploded objects can be localized at sub-soil depths ranging from some millimeters up to about 150 cm. The frequencies involved in the microwave apparatuses range from 2.45 Ghz up to 10 GHz depending on soil composition and the depth of at which the unexploded objects are buried, and the heating times of the soil range from 2 to 20 minutes, and preferably from 5 to 10 minutes. The apparatus for performing the above method comprises at least one infrared camera and at least one microwave antenna (1).

title_en: Method and system for contactless vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system that includes a transmitter, a receiver, and processing device. The transmitter irradiates a body region of a person with radar radiation, the receiver generates a receiver signal from reflected radiation from the body region, and the processing device generates, for each of a plurality of processing windows, a displacement signal based on the receiver signal. The displacement signal characterizes a body motion having, as oscillating motions, a breathing motion and a heartbeat motion, and calculates an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillating motion. The processing device applies an adaptive Nonlinear Least Squares method to calculate a plurality of frequency estimates, each of which corresponds to one of a plurality of harmonics of a first oscillating motion, wherein the processing device calculates a first estimated fundamental frequency for the first oscillating motion based on the frequency estimates.

title_en: Long-distance tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring method for TBM (tunnel boring machine) under soft-hard interbed geological condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-distance TBM tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring method under soft-hard interbed geological conditions, which is characterized in that a hard rock area and a soft rock area in a tunnel are distinguished through geological exploration, hard rock drill holes in the hard rock area are subjected to drill hole shooting, and a microseismic sensor is arranged in the hard rock drill holes of a complete hard rock section in the hard rock area; and installing the micro-seismic monitoring system on the TBM, and communicating the wireless network bridge group with the rock burst micro-seismic monitoring center outside the tunnel. The method better solves the problems of installation and recovery of the microseismic sensor under the soft-hard interbed geological condition, avoids the influence of a soft rock area on receiving the microseismic monitoring signal, overcomes the difficulty that a transmission line of a long-distance tunnel signal is easy to damage, ensures the quality and continuity of microseismic monitoring of the rock burst, and lays a foundation for accurate early warning of the rock burst disaster. The method can be used for the safe excavation of the deep-buried long-distance TBM tunnel engineering under the complex geological condition.

title_en: Vital sign detection method, device and storage medium based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-based vital sign detection method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the detection method comprises the steps of carrying out target detection on radar echo to obtain a real target, a range gate where the real target is positioned and respiratory frequency; the heart rate of the target is obtained by carrying out Chrip-Z expansion and maximum peak frequency search on the heart beat frequency band of the vital sign signal. The method carries out normalization fusion on the phase signals of the multi-range gate, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of respiration and heartbeat signals, fully utilizes vital sign information carried by radar echo, realizes high-resolution spectrum analysis in a heartbeat frequency band through Chrip-Z expansion, refines the frequency spectrum of the heartbeat signals, and improves the detection precision of vital sign parameters.

title_en: A portable medical equipment for measuring physiological signal
title_ko: 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급처치를 요하는 환자의 현재 신체상태를 측정하기 위한 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비를 제공한다. 이와 같은 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비는 신체의 각종 생체신호를 측정하는 측정기구와, 이를 모니터링하는 디스플레이기구들이 휴대용으로 이루어져 구급차량이나 휴대용 가방 등에 간편하게 탈부착될 수 있도록 함으로써 긴급한 상황이나 일반적인 의료장비의 설치 및 사용이 어려운 장소에서도 신속하게 생체신호를 측정하여 효과적인 의료 조치를 행할 수 있게 된다. 본 발명에 따른 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비는 신체의 생체신호가 측정되는 센서로 이루어진 측정모듈과, 상기 측정모듈로부터 생체신호를 전달받아 이를 송신하는 통신모듈이 케이싱에 설치되어 이루어지는 측정기구와; 측정기구의 통신모듈 및 원격지의 의료기관과 유무선으로 연결되어 생체신호 정보 및 의료정보를 송수신하는 통신모듈과, 통신모듈과 연결되어 생체신호 정보 및 의료정보를 표시하게 되는 모니터가 케이싱에 설치되어 이루어지는 디스플레이기구 및; 일측이 개방된 공간부가 측정기구의 케이싱과 디스플레이기구의 케이싱에 대응되게 각각 형성되어  측정기구 및 상기 디스플레이기구가 각각 탈부착이 가능하게 장착되는 장착기구를; 포함하여 이루어진다. 이와 같은 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비에서 장착기구의 공간부 측면을 이루는 고정면과, 장착기구의 고정면에 대응되는 측정기구의 케이싱 외측면 및 디스플레이기구의 케이싱 외측면에는 서로 요철관계를 이루며 착탈되는 고정구가 각 각 설치되어 고정구에 의해 측정기구와 디스플레이기구가 장착기구에 고정되게 된다. 
       
     의료장비, 생체신호, 측정기구, 모니터, 구급차량, 휴대용 가방

title_en: Mobile device for physiological sensing
title_ko: 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 착용하지 않고 필요시에 취부 하여 생체 신호를 계측하는 것이 가능한 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 엄지의 그립(grip)을 위해 표면에 비스듬하게 형성된 취부홈을 구비하며, 심박수와 피부 전도도 및 체온을 포함한 생체 신호를 계측하기 위한 센서를 포함하는 센싱부; 한 손으로 취부한 상태에서 검지로 누를 수 있도록 일측 상단부에 버튼식으로 구비된 전원부; 및 상기 센싱부의 동작 상태를 표시하도록 상기 센싱부의 상부에 구비된 동작 표시등을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치를 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면 상시 착용하지 않고 필요시에 사용자가 취부하여 왼손 혹은 양손의 생체 신호를 측정하는 것이 가능하므로 생체 신호 계측에 따른 불편함이나 이물감이 발생하지 않는 효과를 가진다. 
       
     생체 신호, 계측, 휴대용

title_en: Floor buried type evacuation guidance light and control system for evacuation guidance lamp using the same
title_ko: 바닥매립형 피난유도등 및 이를 이용한 피난유도등 제어시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재발생과 같은 비상상황시 탈출 경로를 안내하기 위한 피난유도등이 바닥에 매립된 상태로 설치되며, 탈출경로가 다수일 경우 탈출인원이 일방향으로 집중되지 않고 분산되어 원활한 탈출이 이루어질 수 있도록 유도할 수 있는 바닥매립형 피난유도등 및 이를 이용한 피난유도등 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 바닥매립형 피난유도등은 화재감지센서의 감지정보에 따라 탈출경로를 안내하도록 바닥에 매립 설치되는 것으로, 바닥에 매립되도록 설치되는 하우징, 상기 하우징에 설치되는 배터리, 상기 하우징에 설치되며 상기 배터리 또는 외부 전원에 의해 발광하는 발광모듈부, 상기 하우징의 상부에 설치되는 커버부를 포함하고, 상기 발광모듈부 또는 커버부는 탈출인원의 탈출경로를 가이드할 수 있도록 설정된 탈출 방향을 표시할 수 있게 형성된다.

title_en: Emotion sensor system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mm-wave radar sensor to be deployed as emotion sensor, being inherently small size, and being able to be produced in low cost manner. The key system relevant components are utilization of mm-wave integrated radar, specific planar high-gain antenna radiation patterns, and analyzing the vital signs of objects by the same apparatus. The objects are human beings with vital signs vibrations, and animals with vital sign vibrations, where the system calculates and detects the frequency of vital sign rates: heartbeats and respiration frequencies. The values of vital signs rates as well as the changes of vital sign rates are used together with objects vital signs profile to calculate the emotion value. Emotion value may be additionally enhanced by specific movement pattern events added additionally in the emotion status evaluation. Emotion value can be information about object mood or simple alert of the excitements or calmness, as well as information of the increased or decreased excitement. Preferably, the proposed apparatus is using 60 GHz ISM Band integrated radar front, working in Doppler mode. Physical size of proposed apparatus in range: 4×2×1 cm or smaller.

title_en: Method of electronically mapping underground utility infrastructures from the surface
abstract_en: A non-invasive method of buried-utility-mapping includes using a long wavelength gradiometric ground penetrating radar to “see” patches of conductive material below ground and buried pipes and electrical conductors that are all constantly radio-illuminated by local AM radio broadcasts. The underground infrastructure of entire cities can be surveyed this way, point-by-point over time. A short wavelength part of the gradiometric ground penetrating radar operates shoulder-to-shoulder with the magnetic part and is able to improve shallow object resolution, map moisture build-ups under roads, and spot contaminated soils. Two gradiometric ground penetrating radar technologies, cameras, and navigation receivers can be mounted on city vehicles and a daily collection of their data batch transformed by digital processing algorithms into detailed and automatically updating false-color maps of the underground utilities of the whole city and other buried infrastructures.
assignees: STOLARCZYK GERALD L;STOLARCZYK LARRY G;BAUSOV IGOR;STOLAR INC

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The neck-worn sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one four
abstract_en: Receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one four relates to life detection radar and rotor craft technical field. The whole mechanical structure of flight radar lift -launch ultra wide band life detection radar constitution on by the rotor craft. Be fixed with GPS positioner on the rotor craft, fixed mounting has a radar transmitter on the rotor craft, this kind of new -type receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one four who do not is equipped with a screw and this utility model of radar acceptor and provides at the tip of four wings can rely on the efficiency at the high mobility nature improvement life detection of sky flight, also can rely on one four to receive ultra wide band radar array and increase and survey the accuracy to let and buried the life entity by being rescued sooner, it is of far -reaching significance to the disaster relief.

title_en: A kind of intelligent fire scene auxiliary whippet tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of intelligent fire scenes to assist whippet tank, characterized by further comprising 51 single-chip computer control systems, ultrasonic sensor, flame sensor, gray-scale sensor, Raman spectrum analysis instrument, ultra-wide spectrum radar life-detection instrument, left motor drive module, right motor drive modules, the beneficial effects of the utility model are: be programmed using c language, 51 single-chip microcontrollers, it is fairly simple；Flame sensor module seeks fire distance far, strong antijamming capability；Using the direction of MPU6050 gyroscope control turning, direction controlling precision is high, without motion dead angle, and rotation is flexible；Strong using ultrasonic sensor obstacle avoidance ability, anti-interference ability is good；Raman spectrum analysis technology has been used, can analyze the corresponding chemical substance of fire source, has been had great significance to correct fire fighting；Ultra-wide spectrum radar life-detection instrument has been used, the presence of people's life entity can be detected；It is mounted with hawkeye camera, the firsthand information at scene can be obtained, the function of thering are data to transmit.

title_ko: 다기능 연기투시 랜턴
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 다기능 연기투시 랜턴에 관한 것으로서, 헤드부와, 본체부와, 바닥부를 가지며, 상기 본체부는 내측에 배터리를 수용하는 배터리부와, 상기 반사판측으로 삽입되는 LED램프와, 상기 배터리부의 배터리에 접속되는 마이콤과, 상기 마이콤에 전기적으로 접속되는 스위치부와, 상기 마이콤에 전기적으로 접속되는 위치센서와, 상기 마이콤으로부터 인가된 전압신호에 따라 배터리의 잔량을 표시하는 배터리잔량표시부와, 상기 마이콤에 연결되는 레이저포인터를 구비하며, 상기 바닥부는 상기 마이콤에 전기적으로 접속되는 경고음 발생부과 상기 바닥부의 저면을 관통하여 형성된 복수의 관통홀을 구비하며, 상기 랜턴은 충전용 거치대를 더욱 구비하여, 랜턴 사용자가 안전사고를 당하여 일정시간 움직임이 없을 경우 비상 경고음을 발생시켜 다른 소방대원으로부터 구조를 받을 수 있는 비상경고음 발생기능을 구비함과 동시에, 짙은 연무가 발생한 경우에도 사물의 식별이 용이하고, 배터리 잔량을 인식할 수 있도록 하여 예상치 못한 배터리의 방전으로 인한 위험을 배제할 수 있고, 랜턴을 올려놓는 것만으로도 충전이 가능한 충전용 거치대를 구비하여 비상시에 신속하고 용이하게 파지할 수 있으며, 랜턴의 밝기를 여러 단계로 조절함과 동시에 밝기의 조절이 간편하게 할 수 있으며, 하나의 랜턴에 상술한 여러 가지 기능을 구비하여 보다 편리하고 유용하게 사용할 수 있다.

title_en: Feeble respiration signal detection method used for life detection radar
abstract_en:
The present invention provides a kind of feeble respiration signal detecting methods for life detection radar. The feeble respiration signal detecting method include: by radar echo signal, establish M × N-dimensional distance it is slow when signal matrix S (m, n); For each distance unit, S (m, n) it is slow when direction on carry out auto-correlation processing, obtain signal matrix Rx (m, τ); FFT transform is carried out to each row vector of Rx (m, τ) respectively, obtains frequency of distance matrix

   Range direction on carry out weighted accumulation, obtain the frequency spectrum of breath signal

 And traversal

 Each position, find energy ratio be greater than pre-determined threshold position, if the number of the position be greater than 0, judge that there are life entities for underground. The present invention realizes the enhancing, detection and extraction of feeble respiration signal, meets the needs that the faint vital signs detection of personnel is buried under the occasions such as disaster assistance.

title_en: Meteorological monitoring system and monitoring system for early warning of rock slope landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological monitoring system and a meteorological monitoring system for the early warning of rock slope landslide, and belongs to the field of an environment monitoring technology. The meteorological monitoring system comprises a water pressure gage buried on a sliding surface, and a water level indicator arranged at the top of a trailing edge pulling crack; the meteorological monitoring system further comprises a wireless remote system which is connected with the water pressure gauge and the water level indicator through data wires, and an operating system which receives the water pressure monitoring data and water level monitoring data of the wireless remote system. Field monitoring data is transmitted to the operating system through wireless signal transmission, and an early warning value and a field valve can be given simultaneously by a monitoring software in the operating system, therefore the subjectivity of the a man-made set prewarning value can be prevented, and the automatic remote monitoring and landslide forecasting and early warning can be realized. The monitoring system provided by the invention does not need to install a drilling clinometers and a stress sensor based on water level monitoring, therefore the construction difficulty and monitoring cost can be reduced.
assignees: HONG DA GUO YUAN WUHU RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT MAN CO LTD

title_en: A kind of underground criminal case material evidence detection system and method based on geological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underground criminal case material evidence detection system and method based on geological radar, the radar detection apparatus of system include controller, radar transmitter, transmitting antenna, reception antenna, radar receiver and power module；Controller works for control radar detection device；Radar transmitter is connected with controller, for producing radar wave；Transmitting antenna is connected with radar transmitter, for launching the radar wave for producing；Reception antenna is used to receive reflected radar wave；Radar receiver is connected with reception antenna, for processing the radar wave that reception antenna is received, and the radar wave after treatment is sent into controller；Controller is connected by wireless communication mode with background master system；Power module is used to provide working power for radar detection apparatus.The present invention can not only quick detection to the hidden material evidence for being buried in underground, and the hidden material evidence for being buried in underground can be accurately positioned, contribute to criminal offense investigation.

title_en: Across the hole radar detection device of diaphram wall internal flaw and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to underground engineering detection fields, disclose across the hole radar detection device and method of a kind of diaphram wall internal flaw.The invention vertically pre-buried test tube in diaphram wall, across hole radar method is used during detection, transmitting antenna and reception antenna are respectively placed in adjacent test tube, different location transmitting and reception frequency electromagnetic waves in test tube, since the dielectric constant and conductivity of rejected region are apparently higher than complete concrete structure, when electromagnetic wave is by the defects of diaphram wall region, its velocity of wave, amplitude and waveform can all change, therefore can be judged in diaphram wall with the presence or absence of the position of defect and defect by analyzing the form of electromagnetic wave, the information such as size and shape.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI;SHANGHAI ROAD AND BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of buried pipeline detection device and method based on sound wave reflection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of buried pipeline detection devices based on sound wave reflection, including：Surface-based signal generator, power amplifier, vibrator, rake shake table, several three axis geophones, and the signal processor on host computer；Wherein, several three axis geophones constitute detector array, and the vibrator constitutes line direction with detector array line；The signal generator is used to generate two kinds of modulated signals using waveform modulated；The power amplifier is used to carry out power amplification to the modulated signal that signal generator generates；The signal that the vibrator is used to receive the power amplifier generates seismic wave；The rake shake table is used for the earthquake wave coupling that generates vibrator into soil；The three axis geophone is used to receive the reflected sonic signals in three directions；The signal processor is used to handle the acoustic signals of three axis geophones reception and is imaged, and the position of buried pipeline is obtained by image.

title_en: Automatic fire extinguishing system for parking lot
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic fire extinguishing system for a parking lot, which comprises a lifting module, a fireproof and waterproof soft fence, a water spraying system, a drainage system, a control system and a temperature sensor, wherein the fireproof and waterproof soft fence is pre-buried in a parking area, the fireproof and waterproof soft fence is positioned around the parking area and extends towards the upper part of the parking area to form a cuboid fence type structure, positioning mounting points are arranged at four corners of the parking area along the upper edge after the fence type structure is erected, the lifting module is also arranged at the four corners of the parking area, the positioning mounting points are connected with the lifting module, storage grooves are formed in the periphery of the parking area, and the lifting module can drive the fireproof and waterproof soft fence to be lifted to form the cuboid fence type structure or be folded and stored in the storage grooves. The intelligent car fire-fighting water-saving system can automatically control the temperature to sense whether the car is on fire or not, isolate the car from the outside through the fireproof and waterproof soft fence, and can automatically spray water to extinguish fire and drain water, so that the intelligent degree is higher, and the safety is stronger.
assignees: SHENZHEN QIANHAI XIANGBOBO INTELLIGENT DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-wideband UWB (ultra-wideband) vital signal data processing method and device based on singular value decomposition
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and a device for processing Ultra Wide Band (UWB) vital signal data based on singular value decomposition, the method comprising: the method comprises the steps that an ultra-wideband radar life detector is used for emitting continuous pulse sequences to detect, so that multiple groups of continuous echo signals containing vital sign signals are obtained, and an echo signal matrix is preprocessed; singular value decomposition is carried out on the preprocessed echo signal matrix to obtain multi-order singular values and singular matrix components; extracting a space eigenvector and a time eigenvector corresponding to each order of singular value from the singular matrix component; the singular values, the spatial feature vectors and the time feature vectors of all orders are compressed and stored, the problems of a large amount of noise waves and noise interference of echo signals of the ultra-wideband radar life detector, space-time feature coupling, overlarge data volume, occupation of a large amount of storage space and the like can be solved, meanwhile, the singular values of the signals are processed, and the timeliness of vital sign signal processing is improved.
assignees: COAL SCIENT RESEARCH GENERAL INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent monitoring product and health management platform for medical care patients
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring product and health management platform for medical care and patient integration, which solves the technical problems by adopting the following technical scheme: the method comprises the steps of constructing desktop-end child monitoring equipment, namely a monitoring terminal, wherein the monitoring terminal comprises a development board, and a sleep breathing sensor, a microphone and a screen which are respectively in communication connection with the development board; and the USB camera module is externally connected. According to the invention, a service system comprising the child monitoring equipment is designed, the child condition is concerned at any time through real-time data feedback, and the platform is alarmed when vital signs are abnormal. In addition, the desktop end equipment can not lead to the skin to be scalded by the electrode slice and other phenomena because of long wearing time. And the active health platform provides the functions of data management, data acquisition, health management, risk early warning, remote diagnosis and data analysis.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHILDRENS MEDICAL CENTER AFFILIATED TO SHANGHAI JIAOTONG UNIV SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

title_en: Lightweight through-wall radar human body posture recognition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying indoor human body gestures by a through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: acquiring radar signals of the human body posture target behind the wall to obtain motion information of the human body target behind the wall; background cancellation and clutter suppression are carried out on the radar signals; processing the radar data by time-frequency transformation to generate a micro Doppler image; and inputting the generated micro Doppler images into a trained lightweight model for classification. By adopting the invention, the actions of the human body behind the wall can be rapidly and accurately identified.

title_en: Device for monitoring slope stability under rainfall simulation condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for monitoring slope stability under a simulated rainfall condition, which relates to the technical field of slope simulation devices and comprises a simulated landslide body, a stable base, a simulated rainfall system, a monitoring system, an angle adjusting device, a soil moisture detecting device, an optical fiber sensor and a controller, wherein one end of the simulated landslide body is rotationally connected to the upper surface of the stable base, the angle adjusting device is arranged between the other end of the simulated landslide body and the upper surface of the stable base and is used for adjusting the inclination angle of the simulated landslide body, the simulated rainfall system is positioned above the simulated landslide body, the monitoring system is arranged above the simulated landslide body, the soil moisture detecting device is inserted into soil on the simulated landslide body, the optical fiber sensor is buried in the soil on the simulated landslide body, and the simulated rainfall system, the monitoring system, the angle adjusting device, the soil moisture detecting device and the optical fiber sensor are all electrically connected with the controller. The invention can simulate the slope scene under the rainfall condition.

title_en: In-pipe robot positioning method and system suitable for non-excavation deep buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-pipe robot positioning method and system suitable for non-excavation deep buried pipelines, relates to the technical field of robot positioning, can be applied to the field of pipeline detection, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the existing in-pipe robot endurance and signal detection strength cannot be balanced, so that the applicability to different pipeline detection scenes is low. The method mainly comprises the steps that an in-pipe robot synchronously receives electromagnetic signals sent by an out-pipe auxiliary inspection robot through a transmitter array through a plurality of carried receivers, relative position coordinates of the in-pipe robot and the out-pipe auxiliary inspection robot are calculated according to receiving time of all the electromagnetic signals received by each receiver to obtain target relative position coordinates, in-pipe positioning coordinates are calculated according to each group of relative position coordinates, and weighted average calculation is conducted according to the in-pipe positioning coordinates and in-pipe positioning coordinates of a positioning sensor to obtain target in-pipe positioning coordinates. The method is mainly used for positioning the robot in the pipe.

title_en: Small sample injury identification and first-aid decision-making auxiliary system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep learning, and particularly relates to a small sample injury identification and first-aid decision-making auxiliary system based on deep learning. The intelligent diagnosis and decision-making system comprises a vital sign acquisition module, an edge calculation platform module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the vital sign acquisition module is used for acquiring physiological parameters of a sensor, the man-machine interaction module is used for acquiring injury image data and human body posture data, the edge calculation platform module comprises an injury image data processing model, an injury characteristic fusion model and a decision-making model, and intelligent injury diagnosis and decision-making are carried out through an expert system based on a knowledge graph and a multi-sensor fused neural network model by combining the biological characteristic data and the image characteristics, so that scientific and reliable support is provided for injury identification and emergency decision-making under a complex environment. The invention solves the technical problems of difficult acquisition of medical data, difficult fusion of heterogeneous data, complex emergency decision and the like, can be applied to various scenes such as disaster site emergency training and the like, and has important application value.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method, device, equipment, medium and product based on integration of video and millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a heartbeat detection method, device, equipment, medium and product based on integration of video and millimeter wave radar, and relates to the field of heartbeat detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode sensor data, extracting video mode heartbeat features according to a face video data stream based on a spatial attention mechanism to obtain video heartbeat feature embedded vectors, then extracting heartbeat features, carrying out weighted fusion processing based on a video-guided attention mechanism to obtain radar heartbeat feature embedded vectors, carrying out dimension normalization processing on the video heartbeat feature embedded vectors and the radar heartbeat feature embedded vectors, obtaining environment feature vectors through global average pooling, carrying out scene division based on a scene classifier to obtain scene classification results, and carrying out heartbeat signal reconstruction after determining multi-mode fusion weights according to the environment feature vectors and the scene classification results to obtain a heartbeat signal sequence. The application aims to improve robustness and detection accuracy.

title_en: Transmitting and receiving equipment of bio signal using zigbee
title_ko: 지그비를 이용한 생체신호 송수신장치
abstract_en: A device for transceiving a bio signal using ZigBee is provided to enable a user to receive emergency treatment quickly by transmitting an emergency signal to an external medical institution or an emergency rescue center through ZigBee when the bio signal exceeds a dangerous value while recognizing the bio signal of the user. A bio signal receiver(21) receives a bio signal value measured through a bio sensor(10). A signal amplifier(22) amplifies the received bio signal to a level for an ADC(Analog/Digital Converter)(23). The ADC converts an analog bio signal value into a digital bio signal value. A controller(24) determines whether the bio signal value exceeds a dangerous value, and generates a control signal for issuing an emergency call through various communication paths through the ZigBee. A memory(25) stores application software and the dangerous value. A ZigBee communicator(26) communicates with a bio signal receiving device(30) through the ZigBee. The bio signal receiving device includes a ZigBee receiver(31), a communication path selector(32), and a communication unit(33) comprising various communication paths connecting to the medical institution or the emergency rescue center.

title_en: A interpolation method for vital signs using doppler radar sensing
title_ko: 도플러 레이더를 이용한 심박데이터에 대한 ｈｒｖ 보간법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An HRV interpolation method about heart rate data is provided to receive a heart rate signal of a human without the contact with the human. CONSTITUTION: An interval between the maximum and the minimum of a level of an respiratory signal is divided into a plurality of parts(21-1,21-2,21-3,21-4) in a dividing step. In a setting step, a time of a respiratory signal is set up. In a measuring step, the period of a Doppler heart rate signal is measured in the set time. An average period of the Doppler hear rate signal is measured in the respiratory time. The corresponding value is calculated from the value obtained in the dividing step at each period of the Doppler heart rate signal. The average is calculated by summing the Doppler heart rate signal periods(25-1 to 25-8) by searching for the same value for the period of the Doppler heart rate signal. An error value is obtained using the average and the difference value between the Doppler average periods. The interpolation is performed by adding or subtracting the error value to or from the Doppler heart rate signal period.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마이크로파를 인체를 통해서 송수신하여 인체의 호흡, 심박신호를 도플러 효과를 이용하여 얻어진 심박신호에서 호흡의 영향을 제거하고 신체의 건강상태, 스트레스 지수 등의 인체의 순환계상태를 분석하는 도플러 레이더를 이용한 심박데이터에 대한 HRV(에이치알브이) 보간방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 마이크로파의 도플러 신호를 이용하여 비 접촉으로 인체의 심박신호와 호흡신호를 측정하되, 심장박동의 도플러 심박신호가 호흡신호에 의하여 변화하는 것을 보간하기 위한 것으로,  ECG를 이용한 표준 심박신호의 최대점에 대하여 도플러 심박신호가 호흡신호에 의하여 빠르거나 늦어지는 것을 보간하기 위하여 호흡신호 주기에 대해 일정구간을 설정하고, 호흡신호의 레벨을 다수개로 구분하며, 설정된 호흡주기 동안에 발생하는 도플러 심박신호사이의 주기를 각각 측정하고, 설정된 호흡주기 동안 호흡 신호의 레벨에 상관없이 전체의 주기를 합하여  도플러 평균 주기를  측정하고, 설정된 호흡주기 동안에 도플러 심박신호의 주기를 상기 다수개로 구분한 호흡신호의 레벨이 동일한 값을 가진 심박신호로 각각 구성하여 측정한 호흡 크기 구간별 심박주기와  상기의 도플러 평균 주기와 발생한 오차를 보간하도록 구성되어 있다. 
     본 발명은 마이크로파 도플러 심박신호와 ECG 표준 심박신호 주기를 대비하되, 다수개로 구분한 호흡신호의 레벨이 동일한 값을 갖는 심박신호를 사용하여 호흡신호에 의하여 발생한 오차를 보간 하므로 정확하고 신뢰성이 높은 HRV분석 결과 를 제공하는 작용효과가 있다.
