title_en: Context-Awareness System Using Dynamic Object Detection based on Breathing Signal
title_ko: 호흡 신호 기반 동적 객체 탐지를 이용한 상황 인지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio signal sensing sensor installed in a vehicle to use breathing signal-based dynamic object detection. An antenna for an impulse radio ultra-wide band (IR-UWB), which is a chip type surface mount device (SMD), includes: a bio signal sensing sensor providing a sensing result by receiving a radio signal reflected from a random object in a detection area; a context determination part determining a context in the detection area in accordance with whether there is a dynamic object in the detection area based on the sensing result, a classification of the dynamic object, and the situation in the detection area based on the classification of the dynamic object, and providing the determination result as a context determination result; and an alarm part actuating a warning device or providing an alarm to a registered personal communication device based on the context determination result. The present invention can prevent an accident in which an infant is left alone in a vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동차 내부에 설치되어 호흡 신호 기반 동적 객체 탐지를 이용한 생체 신호 감지 센서로 IR-UWB(Impulse Radio Ultra-Wide Band) 레이더용 안테나는 칩형 SMD(Surface Mount Device) 형태로, 탐지 영역 내에 임의의 객체에서 반사된 전파 신호를 수신하여 센싱 결과를 제공하는 생체 신호 감지 센서, 상기 센싱 결과를 기초로 하여 상기 탐지 영역 내에 동적 객체의 존재 유무, 동적 객체의 구분 및 동적 객체 구분에 따라 탐지 영역 내에 상황을 판단하고, 판단 결과를 상황 판단 결과로서 제공하는 상황 판단부, 및 상기 상황 판단 결과에 기초하여 경보 장치를 작동시키거나 등록된 개인용 통신기기에 알람을 제공하는 알람부를 포함한다.

title_en: Health care system and method for driver
title_ko: 차량 운전자를 위한 헬스 케어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, provided are a smart device that includes at least one of a location data generating unit, an acceleration sensor, a camera, a radar, a microphone, and an optical sensor and collects information related to health care of a user and a health care system for a vehicle driver that analyzes a health condition including at least one of an activity level of the user, a sleep condition, and a biological signal by using the information related to health care collected from the smart device and activates a vehicle start lock function according to a health condition.

title_en: Method and apparatus for extracting biological signals from radar signals
title_ko: 레이더 신호에서 생체 신호를 추출하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레이더 신호에서 생체 신호를 추출하는 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 신호에서 생체 신호를 추출하는 방법은 레이더 신호에서 생체 신호를 추출하는 장치가 생체 신호를 추출하는 방법에 있어서, 대상으로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 수신하는 단계, 레이더 신호가 가장 큰 지점을 기준으로 기 설정된 특정 구역을 선택하는 단계, 기 설정된 특정 구역에서 기 설정된 특정 개수 복소 신호를 추출하는 단계, 기 설정된 특정 개수 복소 신호의 공분산 행렬을 수행하여 복소 신호 공분산 행렬을 산출하는 단계, 복소 신호 공분산 행렬을 고유값 분해를 수행하여 복소 신호 고유값 벡터를 산출하는 단계, 기 설정된 특정 개수 복소 신호와 복소 신호 고유값 벡터를 곱하여 복소 신호 벡터를 산출하는 단계, 기 설정된 특정 위치의   복소 신호 벡터를 이용하여 제1복소 신호 위상을 산출하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Vehicle mounted metal and mine detector
abstract_en: The invention is related to a vehicle mounted metal and mine detector, which is used in the operations with military or humanitarian purposes regarding the clearance or removal of landmines for detecting mines with high metal content and plastic mines with a minimum content of metal that are near the ground surface or buried underground, as well as any improvised explosive devices, ammunitions and explosives; in the archaeological researches for determining the location of the buried archaeological remains without damaging them; in the geophysical studies for the exploration of mineral deposits, industrial minerals and rock formations; and in the detection of infrastructure elements such as underground pipelines and cables. The system is comprised of a manned or unmanned ground vehicle (8), a lower arm (2) and an upper arm (3) that are connected to the lower shell (7) of the vehicle by means of rotating links, a search head (1) in which electromagnetic interference (EMI) sensor coils and ground penetrating radar (GPR) antennas are arranged to be nested inside one another, fore arms (9) that are fastened directly on the search head (1) or into the ribs (13) placed on the search head and that enable the search head (1) to be connected to the lower arm (2) and to the upper arm (3) by means of the quick-connect rotating connection components, a linear actuator (5) and a lever arm (4) that are connected to either one of the lower arm (2) and the upper arm (3) with rotating links for adjusting the height of the search head (1) from the ground, and an upper shell (6) covering the last-mentioned mechanisms for protecting them against external factors. While adjusting the height of the search head (1) from the ground, at the same time, it is kept parallel to the ground, and these two functions are carried out by using only one linear actuator (3). Through the arrangement of the sensors in the search head such that the sensors are arrayed in pairs nested one another, the dimensions of the search head are kept as small as possible, providing the ease of use in narrow areas where the detection operation is carried out. When the search head is damaged, the connection components are broken off by themselves and the search head is broken off from the vehicle due to the connection of the search head (1) to the lower arm (2) and the upper arm (3) by means of the quick-connect connection components, which prevents the rest of the vehicle from being damaged by protecting it against the damaging effects. Furthermore, the damaged search head can be replaced easily and quickly with a new one on site without the need for any special equipment, therefore the vehicle has the ability to operate for a long time.

title_en: Method and system for contactless vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system (1), the radar sensor system (1) comprising a transmitter (2), a receiver (3) and processing device (5), wherein: the transmitter (2) irradiates (100) at least one body region (21) of a person (20) with radar radiation (30); the receiver (3) generates (110) a receiver signal from reflected radiation (11) from the at least one body region; the processing device (5) generates, for each of a plurality of processing windows, a displacement signal based on the receiver signal, which displacement signal characterizes a body motion comprising as oscillating motions a breathing motion and a heartbeat motion, and calculating an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillating motion. In order provide reliable and efficient means for life sign monitoring, the invention provides that the processing device (5), based on the displacement signal, applies an adaptive Nonlinear Least Squares method to calculate (250) a plurality of frequency estimates (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ), each of which corresponds to one of a plurality of harmonics of a first oscillating motion, wherein the processing device (5) uses an individual search region (A h1 , A h2 , A h3 ) for each frequency estimate (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ), adapts at least one search region (A h1 , A h2 , A h3 ) for at least one processing window, and calculates (300) a first estimated fundamental frequency (f h ) for the first oscillating motion based on the frequency estimates (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ).

title_en: Ingestible devices and methods for physiological status monitoring
abstract_en: Reliable, real-time heart and respiratory rates are key vital signs used in evaluating the physiological status in many clinical and non-clinical settings. Measuring these vital signs generally requires superficial attachment of physically or logistically obtrusive sensors to subjects that may result in skin irritation or adversely influence subject performance. Given the broad acceptance of ingestible electronics, the approach disclosed here enables vital sign monitoring internally from the gastrointestinal tract. The large animal (porcine) experiments and a robust processing disclosed herein demonstrate the feasibility of this approach. Implementing vital sign monitoring as a stand-alone technology or in conjunction with other ingestible devices has the capacity to significantly aid telemedicine, optimize performance monitoring of athletes, military service members, and first-responders, as well as provide a facile method for rapid clinical evaluation and triage.

title_en: The dykes and dams seepage failure simulation test device of defect containing top and its construction method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of dykes and dams seepage failure simulation test device of defect containing top and its construction method, which includes model slot and the dam model to set within it, and the top of dam model is equipped with the simulation ant road of arch；Simulation ant road of the dam model at the dam slope of downstream is nearby set there are one spheric region, and the top of model slot is equipped with sprinkler；Simulation ant road is nearby embedded with multigroup monitoring sensor in dam model.The construction method of the device is：Soil sample is made in clay first, the tubule of arch is buried on dam model top, fill soil sample it is supreme go out tubule after tamp, then tubule periphery soil sample is excavated for spherical shape, again backfilling the soil sample excavated makes the argillic horizon of spheric region more loose closer to the tubule, pre-buried tubule generation simulation ant road is extracted after the completion of filling, multigroup monitoring sensor is set along journey in simulation ant road.The present invention can be used for research homogeneous dykes and dams top defect predominant current effect and its induce seepage failure cause calamity mechanism.

title_en: Method of manufacturing loess wood
title_ko: 황토목재 제조방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는, 황토목재 제조방법은 황토를 소금과 혼합한 혼합물을 0.1 ~ 5㎚ 크기의 입자로 제조하는 제 1 공정, 상기 제조한 황토 원료, 규소 또는 알루미늄으로 이루어지는 염알루미늄 계열의 무기질 경화제 및 물을 혼합하여 황토원액을 제조하는 제 2 공정, 목재를 함침로에 투입하는 제 3 공정, 상기 함침로에 진공을 가하여 목재 내부의 수분 및 불순물을 제거하는 제 4 공정, 상기 함침로의 저장탱크에 황토원액을 공급하는 제 5 공정, 상기 함침로의 압력을 가하여 상기 황토원액을 목재 조직 내부로 침투시키는 제 6 공정, 상기 가압을 해제하고 진공을 가하여 목재 표면의 잔재물 및 과잉흡수된 황토원액을 회수하는 제 7 공정, 상기 황토원액을 회수한 목재를 8시간 ~ 7일 동안 60 ~ 120℃의 온도에서 건조하는 제 8 공정 및 상기 건조한 목재의 표면을 샌딩처리하는 제 9 공정으로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명에 따라 제조된 황토목재는 산업적인 측면에서 황토의 원가가 저렴하여 원재료인 황토의 구입이 용이하며 취급시 안전하다는 장점이 있으며, 황토의 점성적 성질로 목재 내부의 융착이 용이하다는 장점이 있다. 
또한 환경적인 측면에서 황토를 사용함으로써 친환경적이며 습도조절능력이 뛰어나다는 효과가 있으며,목재와 함께 사용함으로써 통기성 및 축열성이 높으며 원적외선 방사로 인체 건강에 유익하며, 강력한 항균력으로 곰팡이 서식을 억제할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한 목재와 황토무기질 세라믹의 혼합으로 착화온도가 높아 화재 발생을 지연 또는 억제시키는 역할을 하며, 연소시 불꽃이 형성되지 않아 유독가스의 발생을 억제시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Smart valve chamber
title_ko: 스마트 밸브실
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart valve chamber. More specifically, various kinds of preset sensors are installed in multiple valve chambers locally installed in a pipe buried underground. Accordingly, various kinds of data caused by a natural disaster accident, such as an earthquake, a sinkhole, and the like are collected and stored as sensing data so that various kinds of diagnosis, such as detecting leakage and damage to the pipe are possible. Moreover, when a pipe problem occurs between valve chambers, a pipe leak point can be checked by using the sensing data. Also, the valve chamber has an open structure in which the upper part is completely open. Therefore, the smart valve chamber has a structure easy to maintain an inner pipe or a device. The smart valve chamber includes the multiple valve chambers (10), multiple sensors (30), and a system unit (40).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 밸브실에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 지하에 매설된 배관에 국부적으로 설치된 다수의 밸브실 내부에, 사전설정한 다양한 종류의 감지센서를 설치함으로써, 이를 통해 지진, 싱크홀 등의 자연재해 사고에 의한 각종 데이터를 감지데이터로 취합 및 저장하여, 배관의 누수탐지, 파손 등 각종 진단이 가능토록 하며, 밸브실과 밸브실 사이에서의 배관 문제 발생시, 배관리크지점을 이러한 감지데이터를 통해 확인할 수 있도록 하며, 밸브실도 상부가 완전히 개방되는 개방구조를 가지도록 함으로써, 내부 배관이나 장비의 유지보수 또한 용이한 구조를 가지도록 하는 스마트 밸브실에 관한 것이다.

title_en: IoT-based wearable devices for the vulnerable group of emergency response and healthcare service
title_ko: 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스에 있어서, ECG(Electrocardiogram, ECG) 전극패드에 전도선이 내장된 형태로 구비되어 심전도를 측정하는 스트랩부, 상기 스트랩부에서 측정된 심전도를 가공하고, 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 복수의 센서를 포함하는 데이터 측정 모듈, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈에서 전송된 정보를 분석하고 송수신하는 서버, 상기 서버로부터 정보를 수신하여 사용자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말을 포함하되, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈은, 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 차동 증폭하여 데이터의 정확도를 향상시키는 계측부, 고역통과필터(High Pass Filter ,HPF) 및 저역통과필터(Low Pass Filter ,LPF)를 포함하여, 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 필터링하여 노이즈를 제거하는 필터부, 상기 서버와 통신하여 상기 스트랩부 및 데이터 측정 모듈에서 가공한 데이터를 송수신 하는 통신부를 포함하되, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈은 실시간 심박수, 분당 심박수, 산소포화도, 맥박 및 체온을 측정하기 위한 센서와 상기 웨어러블 디바이스의 위치 정보를 파악하기 위한 GPS 센서를 더 포함하고, 상기 서버는 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 가공 및 데이터베이스화 함으로써 상기 사용자 단말에 건강상태 데이터 및 응급 상황 데이터를 제공하여, 착용자인 취약계층과 부양자에게 착용자의 심전도 및 생체 신호 데이터를 제공하고, 응급상황 발생 시 부양자에게 응급상황 알림 및 전화연결을 진행하고, 일정시간 동안 연결이 진행되지 않을 시 응급센터로 신고 및 전화연결을 진행하여 불필요한 응급센터와의 연결이 감소되며 응급상황에서의 효과적인 대처를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 하는 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스.

title_en: System, method, and application using the same to acquire biological/movement signal information using Doppler signals
title_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션
abstract_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템은 관측 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임 신호 정보를 획득하는 신호 정보 출력부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Rotating device applied to distributed type full-polarization radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating device applied to a distributed full-polarization radar life detection instrument in the field of radar life detection instruments. Under the action of the pressure spring, the utility model can provide an upward acting force for the ball, and further, under the matching of the ball and the clamping hole on the sliding block, the rotation self-locking operation of the rotating device is tried, and then, when the radar unit I and the radar unit II on the base are rotated forcibly, the radar unit I and the radar unit II are locked in the matching position of the clamping hole and the ball in a matching way, so that the self-fixing operation of the radar unit I and the radar unit II in each rotation adjusting position is realized, the trouble of adopting screw fixation is saved, the rotation operation is extremely convenient and fast, and the rotation operation is extremely practical.

title_en: Flight type radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the electron equipment technical field, and discloses a flight type radar life detector comprising a control box, an operation page, a display, aircraft direction control handles, a human life information screen, an equipment cabin, an antenna, a rotor, a motor and an undercarriage; a flight type radar life detector control system comprises an LED light source, a power supply portion, a camera, a radar detection wave, a microphone, a noise reduction unit, a loudspeaker, a signal amplifier1, a signal acquisition portion, a filter signal sensor, a signal amplifier 2, a video reception end, a voice reception end and life characteristic information; the top of the control box is provided with the human life information screen; two sides of the control box are respectively provided with the aircraft direction control handle; one end of the control box is provided with the operation page and the display arranged on the top of the operation page; the bottom of the equipment cabin is provided with the undercarriage; the flight type radar life detector is strong in function, wide in life detection scope, thus greatly improving rescue strength.

title_en: A kind of double frequency circuit structure for realizing vital signs detecting and short distance positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of double frequency circuit structures for realizing vital signs detecting and short distance positioning, receiving antenna connects No. four power splitters, No. four power splitter output ends are connected No. three bandpass filters, No.1 low-noise amplifier and No.1 orthogonal mixer all the way, and another way is connected No. four bandpass filters, No. two low-noise amplifiers and No. two orthogonal mixers；Transmitting antenna Series power amplifier, No. three power splitters, No. three power splitter connection No.1 power splitters and No. two power splitters；No.1 power splitter output end connects No. three power splitters all the way, and another way connects No.1 orthogonal mixer through No.1 bandpass filter；No. two power splitter output ends connect No. three power splitters all the way, and another way connects No. two orthogonal mixers through No. two bandpass filters.This invention simplifies the Doppler radar circuit structure for realizing vital signs detecting and short distance positioning, the Doppler radar circuit cost for realizing this two functions is reduced.

title_en: A kind of vital sign detection method and system based on ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of vital sign detection method and system based on ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR is related to vital sign detection technique field, obtains ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo-signal；The filtering processings operations such as the sliding mean difference filtering of linear deflection, time domain, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), the sliding mean difference filtering of frequency domain and whole frequency domain moving average filter are carried out to ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo-signal；Harmonic multiples cycle detection is carried out to filtered frequency-region signal, vital sign parameter signals are obtained, including information such as the location information of person under test, respiratory rate and hearts rate；Finally in the current vital sign information of real-time display interface display and its past change curve, the present invention improves the discrimination standard of breathing and palmic rate, it being capable of position of the accurate detection life entity apart from radar and breathing HR Heart Rate, and it real-time detection and can show vital sign information, be searched and rescued in health care, disaster and the vital sign context of detection of special population has broad application prospects.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar wall method for parameter estimation without necessarily referring to transmitted waveform
abstract_en: A kind of through-wall radar wall method for parameter estimation without necessarily referring to transmitted waveform, reflection coefficient sequence and transmitting signal are obtained simultaneously from wall echo time domain sampled data first with sparse blind deconvolution method, to accurately estimate the delay inequality of wall front surface and rear surface back wave, it is then based on the time delay estimation value and delay inequality theoretical value construction objective function of multiple observation positions, the thickness and relative dielectric constant of wall are accurately estimated by minimizing objective function realization, finally single base transceiver is being combined accurately to be estimated with the conductivity for setting lower wall rear surface and front surface reflection wave amplitude comparison wall.The estimation method is especially suitable for the unknown estimation with reference in the case of transmitted waveform to wall parameter, it can be avoided the problem of wall parameter estimation procedure needs to refer to transmitted waveform prior information, the efficiency of wall parameter Estimation is not only increased, and improves the accuracy of wall parameter Estimation.

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection through vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system (10) and a method of operating a radar sensor system (10) for detecting occupancy of an interior (34) of a vehicle (32) and with vital signs monitoring are provided. The radar sensor system (10) comprises a radar transmitting unit (12), a radar receiving unit (18) and a signal processing and control unit (26). The method at least comprises the following steps: transmitting (60) radar waves to a scene within a vehicle interior (34), receiving (62) at least one radar wave generated by reflection of the transmitted radar waves (16), decomposing (64) the received at least one radar wave (22) into range, doppler and angle information, quantifying and tracking (68) movement in each region of interest (38, 40, 42) by angle gating and range gating, detecting (78) and monitoring vital signs of an occupant (28, 30) in each region of interest (38, 40, 42), and determining (84) whether the quantified and tracked movement in the scene relates to the occupant (28, 30) or to external or internal disturbances based on satisfaction of at least one predefined condition relating to the quantified and tracked movement and/or the detected and monitored vital signs.

title_en: Device and method for detecting respiration and heart rate based on biological radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for detecting respiration and heart rate based on a biological radar. The device comprises a vital signs detection sensor 102, a WiFi module 103, a Bluetooth module 104, a power supply module 107, a display module 106, a real-time alarm module 105 and a single-chip microcomputer minimum system module 101. The vital signs sensor 102 is an IR-UWB biometric radar sensor. The method comprises the steps of utilizing a vital sign detection sensor to emit nanosecond or picosecond narrow pulse signals for detection, utilizing a single chip microcomputer to process IR-UWB echo signals I and Q, and extracting respiratory signals and heart rate signals by methods of a specially designed low-pass filter and the like. The invention can detect the breath and the heart rate of the person 108 to be detected under the condition of non-contact, and can give an alarm immediately once the abnormality occurs, if the terminal device 109 is connected, the data can be transmitted to the terminal device 109 through communication modes such as WiFi or Bluetooth, and alarm information can be displayed on the terminal device.
assignees: GUILIN ELECTRONICS SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Life detection method and system based on radar signals
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection method and system based on radar signals, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a region to be detected by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo matrix, and filtering static clutter in the radar echo matrix; extracting a body surface vibration signal of a human body target in the area to be detected according to the radar echo matrix after filtering and removing impurities; carrying out modal decomposition on the body surface vibration signal by using a modal decomposition method; determining the main frequency of each intrinsic mode function by using a wavelet analysis method, and screening out the intrinsic mode functions of the main frequency in the preset respiratory and heartbeat frequency band range; reconstructing respiration and heartbeat signals based on the screened intrinsic mode functions; and determining the vital sign information of the detected human target based on the stochastic resonance system and the reconstructed respiration and heartbeat signals. The technical scheme provided by the invention has strong anti-interference capability and can accurately and quickly detect the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the target to be detected.

title_en: Motion compensation method, device and system of unmanned aerial vehicle through-wall radar detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motion compensation method, a device and a system of an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar detection system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar detection system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and a through-wall radar, the through-wall radar is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and the motion compensation method comprises the following steps: acquiring radar echo data received by an unmanned aerial vehicle through-wall radar detection system, and acquiring the position of an immobilized structure in a detection environment according to the radar echo data; acquiring data point information corresponding to the position of the stationary structure; and calibrating the radar echo data of each frame by using the data point information corresponding to the position of the stationary structure obtained by the radar echo data of each frame. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, low cost, high compensation efficiency and precision, capability of realizing an efficient and flexible through-wall radar detection system based on unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system based on data transmission
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire prevention monitoring system based on data transmission, which belongs to the technical field of data monitoring, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data transmission module, a warning module and a real environment assessment monitoring effect, wherein the data acquisition module is used for configuring a sensor to a target forest monitoring area and carrying out real-time monitoring to acquire original forest parameter data, the data processing module is used for preprocessing the original forest parameter data and then storing the preprocessed original forest parameter data into a first database, the data transmission module is used for detecting whether the edge equipment is connected with a receiver of a data transmission terminal on line or not by adopting a heartbeat detection mechanism and regularly transmitting the data, if yes, the first parameter data of the first database received by the receiver are standardized to acquire standard parameter data, and the warning module is used for predicting fire risk of the target forest monitoring area according to the historical parameter data and the standard parameter data and configuring the fire risk to the real environment assessment monitoring effect. The system improves monitoring, early warning and response efficiency, optimizes resource allocation and efficiently processes disaster conditions.
assignees: SEVEN STAR COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway foundation pit construction pipeline subsides monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline settlement monitoring, and discloses a subway foundation pit construction pipeline settlement monitoring device which comprises a base, wherein the base is provided with a guide rail hoisting assembly and a guide rail overturning assembly, the guide rail hoisting assembly is provided with a guide rail formed by butt joint combination of multiple sections, the guide rail is parallel to the side wall of a subway foundation pit and extends downwards, the tail end of the guide rail is provided with a vertically-displaced lift car, and one side of the lift car facing the subway foundation pit is provided with a ground penetrating radar. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the device is not contacted with the pipeline, the pipeline is not damaged, a plurality of pipelines with different depths can be scanned in the vertical movement process of the ground penetrating radar, the guide rail can be butted and prolonged, the pipeline with larger buried depth can be monitored, the laser target and the laser range finder are adopted to realize accurate perception of elevation, the vertical position of the laser target is maintained by the liquid level in the static level, a stable measuring reference surface can be provided, and the accuracy of settlement monitoring is ensured.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC;NANCHANG RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD METRO PROJECT MAN BRANCH;BEIJING URBAN CONSTR ENG CONSULT CO LTD

title_en: Self-powered multi-parameter wearable health monitoring system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wearable equipment, and discloses a self-powered multi-parameter wearable health monitoring system and a working method thereof, wherein the self-powered multi-parameter wearable health monitoring system comprises a dual-mode self-powered module, a DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip and a power supply module, wherein the dual-mode self-powered module is used for generating and outputting electric energy to the DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip; the intelligent health monitoring system comprises a multi-mode sensor array, an edge AI processing unit, a dynamic power consumption management module, a power consumption scheduling instruction generation and transmission device, wherein the multi-mode sensor array is used for acquiring a plurality of preset vital sign index information and environment data, the edge AI processing unit is used for carrying out AI reasoning according to the plurality of vital sign index information and the environment data to generate and output health risk assessment results, the dynamic power consumption management module is used for acquiring the input power of a DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip and the current power consumption of a system and generating and transmitting a power consumption scheduling instruction to the multi-mode sensor array and the edge AI processing unit according to the input power of the DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip and the current power consumption of the system.

title_en: Method for checking underground-buried pipeline
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make a check as far as a deeper position than in the past when checking the position of a buried pipe by using a ground penetrating radar.  <P>SOLUTION: A bore hole 14 is formed along a pipe 11 buried in the ground. An electromagnetic wave 16 is transmitted/received between the bore hole 14 and a ground surface 2, thereby detecting a position where the pipe 11 is buried.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Non-contact biosignal measurement system and method capable of removing motion noise
title_ko: 움직임 노이즈 제거가 가능한 비접촉식 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact biosignal measurement system capable of removing motion noise, which comprises: a plurality of MIMO antennas for transmitting and receiving FMCW type radar signals; a location specifying unit for specifying a location of a person using signals received by the plurality of MIMO antennas; a biosignal detection unit for measuring a biosignal based on a distance between a location of a person specified by the location specifying unit and the plurality of MIMO antennas; and a noise removing unit for detecting a change in the biosignal caused by movement of the person and canceling out a signal change detected by each MIMO antenna to remove noise caused by movement of the person from the biosignal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, FMCW 형태의 레이다 신호를 송수신하는 복수개의 MIMO 안테나; 상기 복수개의 MIMO 안테나가 수신한 신호를 이용하여 사람의 위치를 특정하는 위치 특정부; 상기 위치 특정부에서 특정한 사람의 위치와 상기 복수개의 MIMO 안테나 사이의 거리를 기반으로 생체 신호를 측정하는 생체신호 검출부; 및 사람의 움직임에 의해 발생한 상기 생체 신호의 변화를 검출하고, 각각의 MIMO 안테나에서 검출된 신호 변화를 상쇄하여 상기 생체 신호에서 사람의 움직임에 의한 노이즈를 제거하는 노이즈 제거부;를 포함하는 것을 일 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Underground buried seismic station using pipe and method of constructing same
title_ko: 관을 이용한 지하 매설형 지진관측소 및 이의 시공방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an underground buried seismic observation station comprises: a plastic pipe buried at a predetermined depth in a lower portion of the ground surface; and a guide unit inserted into a lower end portion of the buried pipe to support the pipe. a lower surface of the pipe is fixedly installed on a bedrock through concrete placement. an upper portion of the pipe protrudes from an upper portion of the ground surface at a predetermined height. a protective cover is installed on an upper surface of the pipe. a seismometer sensor, a seismic recorder, and auxiliary equipment may be installed inside the pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 지하 매설형 지진관측소는, 지표면 하부에 일정한 깊이를 가지며 매립된 플라스틱 재질의 관; 및 매립된 상기 관의 하단부에 외삽되어 상기 관을 지지다는 가이드부;를 포함하고, 상기 관의 하부면은 콘크리트 타설을 통해 기반암 상에 고정 설치된 것이고, 상기 관의 상부는 지표면 상부에 일정한 높이를 가지고 돌출 형성되되, 상기 관의 상부면에는 보호덮개가 설치되어 있는 것이고, 상기 관의 내부에는 지진계 센서, 지진 기록계 및 부대장비가 설치되어 있을 수 있다.
assignees: DOIT CO LTD;KEPCO ENG & CONSTR CO INC

title_en: Method for controlling wearable device and wearable device
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_en: A method for controlling a wearable device and the wearable device are provided. The method for controlling a wearable device comprises the steps of: determining whether a sensor included in the wearable device has been activated; controlling a contact degree control unit, which can adjust the degree of contact between the sensor and the body of a wearer, on the basis of whether the sensor has been activated; and sensing a bio-signal through the sensor.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스(wearable device)를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스가 제공된다. 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법은, 웨어러블 디바이스에 구비된 센서의 활성화 여부를 판단하는 단계와, 센서의 활성화 여부에 기초하여 센서와 착용자의 신체 간의 밀착도를 조절할 수 있는 밀착도 조절부를 제어하는 단계 및 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Direct rf signal processing for heart-rate monitoring using uwb impulse radar
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for direct radio frequency (RF) signal processing for heart rate (HR) monitoring using ultra-wide band (UWB) impulse radar are presented. A radar sensor is able to directly sample a received signal at RF which satisfies the Nyquist sampling rate, preserving a subject's vital sign information in the received signal. The vital sign information can be extracted directly from a raw RF signal and thus down conversion to a complex baseband is not required. The HR monitoring performance from the proposed direct RF signal processing technique provides an improvement in continuous HR monitoring as compared against existing methods using a complex baseband signal and/or other measurement techniques.

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluation of a subject's emotional, physiological and/or physical state with the subject's physiological and/or acoustic data
abstract_en: Embodiments of the subject invention relate to a method and apparatus for remote evaluation of a subject's emotive and/or physiological state. Embodiments can utilize a device that can be used to determine the emotional and/or physiological state of a subject through the measurement and analysis of vital signs and/or speech. A specific embodiment relates to a device capable of remotely acquiring a subject's physiological and/or acoustic data, and then correlating and analyzing the data to provide an assessment of a subject's emotional and/or physiological state. In a further specific embodiment, the device can acquire such data, correlate and analyze the data, and provide the assessment of the subject's emotional state and/or physiological in real time.
assignees: UNIV FLORIDA;SHRIVASTAV RAHUL;LIN JENSHAN;ZAWOY KARL;PATEL SONA

title_en: End of service life indicator for organic vapor respirator cartridges
abstract_en: Embodiments are generally directed to detection of end of service life of a respirator cartridge for one or more organic vapors. In general, end-of-life detection may use a competitive UV light absorption-fluorescence method. Thus, a sensor that emits light when UV is applied may be placed within the cartridge with the UV lamp and photodetector directed at the sensor. In some embodiments, multiple corresponding sensors and UV lamps and light detectors may be used. Generally, the light level emitted by one or more sensors can be used to estimate the effective end of life.

title_en: Method for simultaneously positioning multiple targets of life detection radar array
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for simultaneously positioning multiple targets of a life detection radar array, which comprises the following steps: arranging at least 4 radar detection units for life detection into an area array, and determining the position coordinates of the radar detection units; acquiring a signal of each radar detection unit; extracting the number of detected life bodies and corresponding distance information from the life bodies; performing mathematical random combination on all radar detection units, matching and combining distance information in each radar combination to calculate a possible target position, and allocating a reliability index to each position to determine whether the position is reserved; and clustering reserved positions, distributing a probability according to the proportion of the number of elements in each class to all possible position points, selecting m classes with the highest probability as the class where the real position of the target body is located, carrying out weighted average on the classes, and obtaining the specific positions of the multi-life body. The method effectively removes the false solution and the false solution, and realizes the simultaneous positioning of multiple targets.

title_en: Intelligent image type vital sign detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent image type vital sign detector, which comprises a main control end with a main power supply and a display, a telescopic probe rod with a signal transmission line, a camera probe arranged at the front end of the probe rod, a front-end light source and a front-end signal processing unit, wherein the main control end is connected with the main power supply and the display; the camera probe adopts a dual-mode camera with an infrared camera and a color camera, a CCD image sensor in the camera probe receives a reflected light signal on the surface of an object, converts the reflected light signal into an image signal, and a front-end signal processing unit processes the image signal to obtain vital sign parameters of a trapped person, such as heart rate and respiratory rate; the image signal is also transmitted back to the main control end by the cable in the probe rod; the front-end light source is used for providing illumination for the color camera. The invention can effectively improve the reliability and accuracy of the traditional optical vital sign detection.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring the physiological signal, method for providing emergency rescue service and system for emergency rescue using the same
title_ko: 생체신호 측정단말기, 이를 이용한 응급구호 서비스 제공방법 및 응급구호 시스템
abstract_ko:
생체신호 측정단말기, 이를 이용한 응급구호 서비스 제공방법 및 응급구호 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 생체신호 측정기는 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 측정센서와 생체신호를 측정하도록 상기 생체신호 측정센서로 제어신호를 출력하는 제어부와 상기 측정된 생체신호 측정값을 이동통신망으로 전송하는 근거리통신부와 상기 사용자별 건강기준값 및 상기 건강기준값에 대응하는 위급단계 정보를 주의단계와 응급단계로 설정하여 저장하는 데이터베이스 및 상기 생체신호 측정값과 상기 데이터베이스에 저장된 위급단계정보를 이용하여 사용자의 위급단계를 주의단계와 응급단계로 구분하여 판단하는 응급상황 판독부를 포함한다.
