title_en: Connection structure of underground distribution line
title_ko: 지중매설형 지중전선의 인입출선 연결구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connection structure for lead-in and lead-out lines of a buried underground line. More particularly, the present invention relates to a connection structure of lead-in and lead-out lines of a buried underground line which can quickly seal an underground pipe by smoothly spraying extinguishing powder from a case by sensing a fire by a fire sensor so as to smoothly extract a hitting unit from the case as well as extinguishing the fire while simultaneously notify a manager immediately and preventing the fire from spreading when the fire occurs in a distribution board.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중매설형 지중전선의 인입출선 연결구조에 관한 것으로써, 더욱 상세하게는 배전반에 화재가 발생할 시 관리자에게 즉각적으로 알 수 있도록 하는 동시에 지중배관으로 불길이 번지지 않도록 하는 한편, 화재감지센서의 화재감지에 따라 케이스로부터 소화분말의 분사가 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 하여 화재진압과 함께 케이스로부터 타격부의 인출이 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 하여 지중배관의 밀폐가 신속히 이루어질 수 있도록 하기 위한 지중매설형 지중전선의 인입출선 연결구조에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Wearable signal generating apparaus and an underwater missing person search system including the same
title_ko: 착용형 신호 발생 장치 및 이를 포함하는 수중 실종자 탐색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a wearable signal generating apparatus worn on the wrist or ankle of a user, which includes a cylindrical body, a signal control module disposed on one side of the inner peripheral surface of the body, and an expansion unit disposed on the other side opposite to one of the inner circumferential surfaces of the body. The signal generating module includes a flooding sensor determining the flooding and generating flooding information, a biometric signal detection sensor detecting a biometric signal of a user and generating biometric signal information, a power supply unit supplying power, a sound wave generation unit generating and transmitting a sound wave signal, and a control unit controlling the flooding sensor, the biometric signal detection sensor, the power supply unit, and the sound wave generation unit. Disclosed are the wearable signal generating apparatus in which the volume expands when moisture is absorbed, and an underwater missing person search system including the same.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자의 손목 또는 발목에 착용되는 착용형 신호 발생 장치에 있어서, 원통형의 몸체; 상기 몸체의 내주면 중 일측에 배치된 신호 제어 모듈; 및 상기 몸체의 내주면 중 일측에 대향하는 타측에 배치된 팽창부; 를 포함하고, 상기 신호 제어 모듈은 침수를 판단하고, 침수 정보를 생성하는 침수 센서, 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하고, 생체 신호 정보를 생성하는 생체 신호 감지 센서, 전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부, 음파 신호를 생성하여 송출하는 음파 발생부 및 상기 침수 센서, 생체 신호 감지 센서, 전원 공급부 및 음파 발생부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 팽창부는 흡습(吸濕) 시 부피가 팽창하는 착용형 신호 발생 장치 및 이를 포함하는 수중 실종자 탐색 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Signal processing method and apparatus for ultra wide band ground penetrating radar based land mine detection
title_ko: 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for detecting a landmine based on ultra-wideband ground penetrating radar, which comprises: a training process for generating a background signal model by collecting data in an area where landmines are not buried and in an area where landmines are buried while recognizing the landmines; and a detecting process that detects the landmines by using the background signal model acquired through the training process without recognizing the landmines.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지뢰 매설을 인지한 상태에서 지뢰가 매설되지 않은 영역과 지뢰가 매설된 영역의 데이터를 수집하여 배경 신호 모델을 생성하는 훈련 과정과, 지뢰 매설을 인지하지 못한 상태에서 훈련 과정을 통해 획득한 배경 신호 모델을 이용하여 지뢰를 탐지하는 탐지 과정을 포함하는 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: Device and method for generating user-customized multi-angle highlights using biosignal analysis
title_ko: 생체신호 분석을 이용한 사용자 맞춤형 멀티앵글 하이라이트 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 생체신호 분석을 이용한 사용자 맞춤형 멀티앵글 하이라이트 생성 장치 및 방법을 제공한다. 실시예에 따른 장치는, 사용자를 촬영하도록 설치되는 복수의 카메라를 포함하는 촬영 시스템; 사용자의 생체신호를 포함하는 센싱데이터를 수집하는 센서 장치; 및 상기 촬영 시스템으로부터 원본영상데이터를 수신하고 상기 센서 장치로부터 상기 센싱데이터를 수신하여 개인맞춤형 하이라이트 최종영상을 생성하는 전자장치;를 포함하되, 상기 센서 장치는 심박센서, 피부전도도센서, 가속도센서, 자이로센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함하고, 상기 전자장치는, 상기 센싱데이터를 기설정된 임계값과 비교하여 사용자의 감정상태를 인식하고, 상기 인식된 감정상태를 기초로 감정가중치를 산출하는 영상 전처리부; 상기 원본영상데이터를 복수의 시간 구간으로 분할하고, 각 시간 구간에 상기 감정가중치를 매핑하되, 상기 감정가중치가 기설정된 임계치 이상인 시간 구간의 프레임들을 하이라이트 후보 프레임으로 선정하고 상기 감정가중치가 높은 순서대로 시간 구간을 정렬하여 상위 기설정된 비율의 구간을 선택하여 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 생성하는 영상 관리부; 및 상기 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 기초로 하이라이트 최종영상을 생성하여 사용자 단말로 전송하는 통신부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Non-contact respiration monitoring method based on Doppler radar
abstract_en: A non-contact respiration monitoring method based on a Doppler radar comprises the steps of preprocessing radar echo signals, extracting the position of the thorax of a monitored object from the radar echo signals, extracting motion information of the position of the thorax of the monitored object, extracting a respiration waveform component from the motion information of the thorax of the monitored object, and estimating the respiration frequency of the monitored object based on the corresponding frequency spectrum of the respiration waveform. The method for monitoring the thorax of the object has higher positioning precision and is the basis for accurately extracting the thorax movement signal. The improved CEEMD algorithm is used for separating respiratory signals and heartbeat signals, so that the method has a good separation effect on body movement interference, background noise and vital sign signals, effectively improves the problem of end effect in the original CEEMD algorithm through improvement, and improves the decomposition speed.
assignees: NANJING ZHELI INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Buried pipeline settlement detection and evaluation method and system based on ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a buried pipeline settlement detection and evaluation method based on a ground penetrating radar and a system thereof, wherein the detection method acquires a B-Scan mask image of a shallow buried pipeline, extracts the integral and local characteristics of target hyperbolic reflection signal characteristic points in the image, removes singular points in the characteristic points, performs curve fitting on all effective target hyperbolic reflection signal characteristic points, calculates and screens a score on depth values and wave velocity values corresponding to the target characteristic points, and obtains the pipeline buried depth; the evaluation method is based on a pipeline sedimentation detection result, an angle is formed through the height change between two points on the pipeline, the position of the maximum sedimentation deformation is identified, the position where the fracture risk of a detection section is possibly generated is predicted, the detection system implements the detection method, and the evaluation system implements the evaluation method. The application solves the problem that the hyperbolic reflection signal with characteristics damaged due to the attenuation and coupling problems of electromagnetic waves in engineering actual measurement cannot be effectively calculated, and remarkably improves the processibility and the analyzability of data.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD;CNNC NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Combined type buried object surveying apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a compact and convenient surveying apparatus by reducing mutual effect between both sensors without increasing the distance between a coil sensor and an antenna sensor.  <P>SOLUTION: This combined type buried object surveying apparatus 6 has both the coil sensors 141 through 147 by an electromagnetic induction method and antenna sensors 441 and 442 by an electromagnetic wave method. The operating frequency band of the coil sensors is separated from the operating frequency band of the antenna sensors, and the coil sensors are covered with electric wave absorber effectively acting in the operating frequency band of the antenna sensors.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method and device for monitoring bio-signal on basis of wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for monitoring a bio-signal on the basis of a wireless network. The method for monitoring a bio-signal on the basis of a wireless network can comprise the steps of: sensing, by a biosensor, a bio-signal generated by a person to be sensed; monitoring the bio-signal by a bio-signal monitoring device; determining, by the bio-signal monitoring device, whether the bio-signal is in a normal range or an abnormal range on the basis of a set value; transmitting, by the bio-signal monitoring device, state information of the person, to be sensed, to an emergency management device if the bio-signal is in the abnormal range; and transmitting, by the emergency management device, the state information to a user device of a guardian of the person to be sensed.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법은 생체 센서가 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 생체 신호를 센싱하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 설정된 값을 기반으로 생체 신호가 정상 범위인지 비정상 범위인지 여부를 판단하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 생체 신호가 상기 비정상 범위인 경우, 응급 상황 관리 장치로 센싱 대상의 상태 정보를 전송하는 단계와 응급 상황 관리 장치가 센싱 대상의 보호자의 사용자 장치로 상태 정보를 전달하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Life body double-station cooperative detection method based on single-channel ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life body double-station cooperative detection method based on a single-channel ultra-wideband radar. The method can effectively detect a plurality of different strong and weak life body targets, can extract the distance information of each life body target relative to two radars at one time, can solve the position information of the life body target without pairing processing, can effectively reduce the false alarm and false alarm leakage probability under the condition of multiple targets, improves the accuracy and robustness of human body target detection, and can meet the requirement of detecting weak vital signs of a plurality of trapped persons under the occasions of disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Synthetic aperture imaging optimization processing method and device for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synthetic aperture imaging optimization processing method and a synthetic aperture imaging optimization processing device for a through-wall radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, detecting a target area by using a through-wall radar to obtain a multi-channel echo signal; s2, imaging each channel echo domain signal in the multi-channel echo signals respectively and performing coherent superposition to obtain image domain data; s3, carrying out focusing processing on the image domain data to carry out primary energy focusing on the energy of the target area to obtain optimized image domain data and output the optimized image domain data; the device comprises an echo signal acquisition module, a multi-channel coherent imaging module and an image domain focusing optimization module. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, capability of inhibiting clutter in the through-wall radar synthetic aperture image in real time, reduction of false alarm rate, no target energy loss and the like.

title_en: Air supply amount detecting device for air supplied respirator
title_ko: 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air supply amount sensor for an air supplied respirator, and more specifically, to an air supply amount sensor for an air supplied respirator, which is displayed to a sight glass of a respirator due to a change in air pressure when the amount of air supplied into the respirator is smaller than a predetermined standard amount. Accordingly, a worker is allowed to quickly recognize the shortage of air supply amount so great and small safety accidents caused by the shortage of air supply amount can be effectively prevented. According to the present invention, the air supply respirator consists of the respirator with the sight glass and a muffler which is mounted on the upper side of the respirator and has multiple air supply holes, and allows air received from the outside to be supplied into the respirator through the air supply holes. The air supply amount sensor for the air supplied respirator comprises: an air inflow pipe connected to one air supply hole among the multiple air supply holes and receiving air; and a movable member which is mounted on the inner side of the respirator to be connected to the air inflow pipe, senses the amount of air supplied through the air inflow pipe, and is displayed to the sight glass while moving due to a change in air pressure when the amount of supplied air is smaller than a predetermined supply amount, thereby visually notifying abnormal air supply.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 마스크의 내부로 공급되는 공기의 공급량이 기설정된 기준량보다 적을 때 공기의 압력변화에 의해 마스크의 투시창으로 표출됨에 따라 공기의 공급량이 부족한 상황을 작업자가 신속하게 인지하도록 함으로써 공기의 공급량 부족으로 인한 크고 작은 안전사고를 효과적으로 예방할 수 있는 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치에 관한 것이다.  
이러한 본 발명은 투시창이 구비된 마스크와, 상기 마스크의 상측에 장착되고 복수 개의 송기공이 천공된 소음기로 구성되어 외부에서 제공되는 공기가 상기 송기공을 통해 상기 마스크의 내부로 공급되는 송기 마스크에 있어서, 상기 복수 개의 송기공 중 하나의 송기공에 연결되어 상기 공기가 유입되는 공기유입관; 및 상기 마스크의 내측에 설치되고 상기 공기유입관과 연결되어 상기 공기유입관을 통해 유입되는 공기의 공급량을 감지하여 기설정 공급량보다 적을 때 공기의 압력변화에 의해 유동하면서 상기 투시창으로 표출되어 공기의 공급이 원활하지 않은 상황을 시각적으로 알리는 유동부재;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치를 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Radio frequency life detection radar system
abstract_en: Trapped or confined individuals may be located and rescued by detecting their movement using reflected, radio frequency signals over a range of multiple antenna polarities.

title_en: Strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor and an early warning system. The strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor is characterized by comprising a soil pore water pressure sensor full-bridge circuit and an amplifying circuit. According to the utility model, a method of monitoring the pore water pressure through the sensor adopting bridge type resistance principles is adopted, thereby enabling the size of the sensor to be small, being high in interference resisting capacity and suitable for being buried under a starting condition that the debris flow is monitored. The strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor can realize early warning for a debris flow disaster through monitoring variations in water content in shallow soil layer and predicates and gives out early warning on occurrence of the debris flow disaster through analyzing water content data when rains.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Vital sign detection circuit and device
abstract_en: The circuit comprises a power supply unit, a Doppler sensor unit, a primary filtering unit, a signal processing unit, an input and output unit, a communication unit and a display unit, wherein the power supply unit is used for providing three direct current voltages of 5V, 3.3V and 1.65V for the whole circuit, the Doppler sensor unit is used for acquiring vital sign original signals and generating I signals and Q signals, the primary filtering unit comprises an I signal primary filtering amplifying circuit and a Q signal primary filtering amplifying circuit which respectively conduct primary filtering amplification on the I signals and the Q signals, the signal processing unit is used for processing the signals after filtering amplification and transmitting the signals to a control end and receiving control instructions of the control end, the input and output unit is used for providing general input and output ports, the communication unit is used for providing an external communication channel for the signal processing unit, and the display unit is used for providing indication lamp display. The device comprises a PCB provided with the vital sign detection circuit. The application solves the problem of poor signal filtering effect in the prior art, and obtains the signal with higher gain and smaller noise.
assignees: SHANDONG WORLD BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD;SHANDONG HANFU HEFENG BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Array radar life detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and provides an array radar life detector which comprises a plurality of radar detection units and a display control terminal, wherein the radar detection units are electrically connected with the display control terminal, each radar detection unit comprises a transmitting antenna, a transmitter, a receiving antenna, a mixer, a low-noise amplifier, a radar signal processing subunit, a comprehensive processing subunit, an acousto-optic alarm subunit and a WIFI subunit, wherein the comprehensive processing subunit is electrically connected with the acousto-optic alarm subunit and the WIFI subunit respectively, the radar signal processing subunit is electrically connected with the comprehensive processing subunit, the low-noise amplifier is electrically connected with the radar signal processing subunit, the mixer is electrically connected with the low-noise amplifier, the transmitter and the receiving antenna are electrically connected with the mixer, and the transmitter is electrically connected with the transmitting antenna. The utility model reduces false alarm rate and false missing rate in complex environment and improves detection sensitivity to weak life signals.

title_en: Remote fire extinguisher
abstract_en: Disclosed is a long-distance fire extinguisher, pertaining to the technical field of fire-extinguishing device. The utility model is designed for the fire extinguisher deeply entering the fire center by long-distance. The utility model comprises a shell, a closed sending ring, a tail wing and a gas generator. The back part of the shell 1 is cylindrical and the front part of the shell 1 is cone-shaped to reduce the flying resistance; the closed sending ring 2 are arranged at the back of the cone-shaped part of the shell 1 in the way of surrounding the shell 1 to be favorable for the good sealing of the sending device; the tail wing 3 is arranged at the back part of the shell 1 to control the flying direction; the fire-extinguishing agent 5 is filled inside the shell 1; the gas generator 4 is arranged at the axis part; a gas generating agent 7 is wrapped by a shell 6 into cylinder shape; one end of a fuse 8 is buried inside the gas generating agent 7; the other end of the fuse 8 is connected with a thermal-sensitive head 9 with fuse powder arranged at the top of the cone-shaped part. When in fire extinguishing, the fire extinguisher enters the fire scene, the thermal-sensitive head 9 is ignited to ignite the fuse 8 to heat the gas generating agent 7 and then the gas generating agent 7 is gasified and expanded to expand the fire extinguisher to put out the fire. The utility model is applicable for the being used in the fire scene where the fire fighters can not get close to.

title_en: Radar type remote vital sign monitoring system based on self-rotating microwave detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to vital sign monitoring systems in the fields of medical diagnosis and health supervision, in particular to a radar type remote vital sign monitoring system based on a self-rotating microwave detector. The radar type remote vital sign monitoring system solves the problems that an existing vital sign monitoring system is restricted in application range, can not achieve remote monitoring and is low in monitoring sensitivity. The radar type remote vital sign monitoring system based on the self-rotating microwave detector comprises a life detection instrument, a network communicating device and a monitoring device. The life detection instrument comprises a first signal generator, a power divider, a transmitting antenna, the self-rotating microwave detector, a voltage control phase shifter, a second signal generator, a bias device, a lock phase amplifier and a data acquisition card. The monitoring device comprises a single-chip microcomputer, an audible and visual alarm and an LED display screen. The system is applicable to the fields of medical diagnosis and health supervision.

title_en: A kind of manned unmanned plane of composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of manned unmanned planes of composite material, comprising: with respectively by unmanned planes more than three axis of corresponding motor driving, the execution module, the controlling terminal by wirelessly controlling unmanned plane and execution module respectively and for providing the battery of electric energy to execution module that are arranged on unmanned plane；Execution module includes: lighting system, radar life-detection instrument, GPS positioning system and/or high-definition camera；Further include: the fire extinguishing ball unmanned plane of ten or more the broken unmanned planes of detection, ten or more water spray unmanned planes and ten or more.Illumination rescue investigation composite material unmanned aerial vehicle group disclosed by the invention, six rotors can provide the angle for looking down the world for people, the image in disaster area can be transmitted in real time and be come out, rescue personnel is set to have the understanding of an entirety to disaster-stricken situation, radar life-detection instrument can detect the life entity in disaster area simultaneously, can rescue life entity.
assignees: FOSHAN SHENFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small and micro animal detector and method for hiding in engine room and biological radar sensor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation safety detection, and discloses a small and tiny animal detector, a method and a biological radar sensor for hiding in an aircraft cabin, wherein the small and tiny animal detector for hiding in the aircraft cabin is used for collecting vital sign information of small and tiny animals, and 10 JC122 biological radar sensors for detecting the small and tiny animals hidden in the aircraft cabin are provided; the small micro-animal detector comprises: JC122 biological radar sensor, a signal preprocessing and multi-channel information synthesis module, a signal equalization processing module, a small and micro animal vital sign information extraction module, an information enhancement module, a wireless data transmission module and PDA software intelligent discrimination equipment, wherein a lithium ion battery is adopted for power supply. The invention has the advantages that a plurality of devices can be synchronously detected at one time, so that the working efficiency is improved; meanwhile, the device can indicate the area of the small animals in the cabin, realize the omnibearing detection of vital sign information level at a distance of 2 multiplied by 10 meters, and meet the detection use requirements of various airplanes.
assignees: XIAN BAORUIDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI INT TRAVEL HEALTHCARE CENTER

title_en: Graphene-based life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene-based life detector which comprises an infrared sensor, a telescopic mechanical arm, a signal processing unit and an alarm, wherein the infrared sensor is fixed at the front end of the telescopic mechanical arm, and the infrared sensor and the alarm are respectively connected with the signal processing unit. The infrared sensor is a regular icosahedron structure consisting of triangles, the surface of the regular icosahedron structure is a photoelectric device consisting of a semiconductor, a plurality of graphene films and an infrared filter layer, the semiconductor is used as a substrate, the graphene films are laid on the semiconductor, and finally the infrared filter layer is plated. By the regular icosahedron substrate structure, life signs in the ruins after a natural disaster are searched for with as large a specific surface area as possible exposed to the environment. The response distance of the life detector is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the sensitivity and the use convenience of infrared response are also improved.

title_en: Tailing body safety monitoring system and monitoring method based on InSAR and optical fiber sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a tailing body safety monitoring system and a monitoring method based on InSAR and optical fiber sensing technology, comprising mine and satellite InSAR and unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR data around the tailing body, safety monitoring wells distributed in a grid shape on the tailing body, three-component distributed acoustic wave sensing optical fibers fixed outside a monitoring well sleeve, distributed strain or displacement sensing optical fibers, distributed temperature sensing optical fibers and a composite modem instrument. Real-time displacement investigation of a local displacement area is carried out on a mining area and a tailing stacking body by depending on satellite InSAR and unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR data, and meanwhile, parameters such as temperature, strain or deformation, displacement, microseism events, change of groundwater level and the like of the tailing body are monitored in real time according to a grid armor monitoring optical cable which is arranged on the tailing body and is buried outside a downhole casing of a safety monitoring well and at the front end face of the tailing body, so that land areas where tailing body landslide or dam break are likely to occur are reinforced and early warning information is issued in time, and geological disasters such as dam break and the like are timely avoided.
assignees: CNPC AOBO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for repositioning moving targets in building based on unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted double-channel through-wall radar interference phase
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repositioning moving targets in a building based on unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted double-channel through-wall radar interference phase, which comprises the following steps: a new method for repositioning the azimuth of a moving target based on a dual-channel interference phase is provided. The method firstly extracts the two-channel interference phase of the moving target in a distance compression domain. And secondly, establishing an interference phase polynomial model, and calculating coefficients of each order by using a least square method. Finally, the obtained polynomial coefficients are used for constructing and solving an optimization problem about the azimuth position of the moving target. In contrast to conventional methods, the present invention does not require imaging and multi-channel registration operations. In addition, the method provided by the invention can directly obtain the azimuth position of the moving target without estimating the radial speed and calculating the offset, thereby avoiding the problem of space Doppler ambiguity of the radial speed estimation faced by the traditional synthetic aperture radar moving target positioning technology. The validity of the proposed method is verified through simulation.

title_en: Miniaturized card type human vital sign monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent health monitoring, in particular to miniaturized card type human vital sign monitoring equipment which comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a flexible substrate, an ADC (analog to digital converter) conversion unit and a signal processing unit, wherein the millimeter wave radar module comprises an antenna array unit and an antenna substrate, the antenna array unit is etched on the antenna substrate through a folding antenna technology, the flexible substrate is bonded with the antenna substrate, the ADC conversion unit is connected with the millimeter wave radar module, and the signal processing unit is connected with the ADC conversion unit and is used for extracting human vital sign signals and calculating medical parameters. The application adopts the flexible substrate and the folding antenna array technology, greatly reduces the area of a core module of the monitoring equipment, can reach the size and the dimension of a credit card, can adapt to various application scenes, is manufactured into the shape of a mobile phone shell, is coupled with the mobile phone, realizes monitoring closed loop, is simple to use and convenient to carry, does not need to be worn on the surface of a human body, and can realize non-contact medical grade health monitoring.

title_en: Nuclear power plant operator's stress measurement system and method
title_ko: 원자력발전소 운전원의 스트레스 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for measuring stress of a nuclear power plant operator. The system comprises a biosignal detection device having a heart rate measurement sensor and a skin electric resistance measurement sensor, and a server communicating with the biosignal detection device. A stress index calculation unit of the server calculates a stress index by comparing biometric information received from the biosignal detection device with pre-stored biometric information in a normal state. A determination unit derives state information of an operator as any one of a normal state, an attention observation state, and a dangerous state according to whether the calculated stress index exceeds a preset threshold value. A control unit generates alarm notification information when the derived state information is in a dangerous state. Therefore, the system can improve stress management efficiency of a nuclear power plant operator and can improve work satisfaction by adjusting a work load according to stress.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력발전소 운전원의 스트레스 측정 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 심박수 측정 센서 및 피부전기저항 측정 센서를 구비하는 생체신호 감지장치; 및 상기 생체신호 감지장치와 통신하는 서버를 포함하고, 서버의 스트레스 지수 산출부가 생체신호 감지장치로부터 수신된 생체정보를 기 저장된 정상상태의 생체정보와 비교하여 스트레스 지수를 산출하고, 판단부가 상기 산출된 스트레스 지수의 기 설정된 임계값 초과여부에 따라 운전원의 상태정보를 정상상태, 주의관찰상태, 및 위험상태 중 어느 하나로 도출하고, 제어부가 상기 도출된 상태정보가 위험상태이면 경보알림정보를 생성하는 구성으로 원전 운전원의 스트레스 관리 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있고, 스트레스에 따른 업무 부하를 조절하여 업무 만족도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Augmented reality system for electromagnetic buried asset location
abstract_en: A system for calculating and visualizing a position of buried assets during a buried asset locate procedure in a target area includes an electromagnetic locate device (ELD) including electromagnetic antennas configured for sensing an electromagnetic (EM) field emanating from a buried asset at a target area, and an augmented reality system comprising a camera, a display, inertial sensors for measuring motion and distance moved, and processors configured for reading camera data and sensor data, calculating motion and distance moved, generating a 3D model representing the target area, generating a 3D vector field representing the EM field emanating from the buried asset, calculating a position of the buried asset based on the 3D vector field and the 3D model, creating an object in the 3D model that represents the buried asset, and rendering video of the target area including a graphic representation of the position of the buried asset.

title_en: Patient head-mountable device having a vital sign camera for use in a medical scanning modality
abstract_en: A patient head-mountable device for use in a medical scanning modality, comprising a frame member adapted to the shape of a patient's head, at least one optical sensor that is temporarily fixedly attachable to the frame member; wherein the optical sensor is a vital sign camera configured for providing an output signal that is indicative of at least a first type of physiological parameter of the patient and serves as a basis for determining the at least first type of physiological parameter of the patient; wherein the patient head-mountable device includes a data acquisition and analysis unit that is configured to acquire output signals of the optical sensors temporarily fixedly attachable to the frame member and to analyze the acquired output signals by applying pre-determined criteria related to the output signals, and to provide a trigger output signal if one of the pre-determined criteria is fulfilled.

title_en: Method and system for validating optimal body sensor placement
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system comprising a monitoring patch configured to be adhesively attached to skin of an associated patient, the monitoring patch including at least one vital sign sensor arranged to measure vital sign data of the associated patient when the monitoring patch is adhesively attached to the skin of the associated patient. The monitoring patch includes a wireless transceiver or transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit the vital sign data, a monitoring device configured to receive the wirelessly transmitted vital sign data and to store, retransmit, or both store and retransmit the vital sign data, a skin condition sensor configured to measure skin measurement data on the skin of the associated patient, and at least one hardware processor configured to analyze the skin measurement data to determine advice on adhesive attachment of the monitoring patch to the skin and output the advice on the monitoring patch or the monitoring device.

title_en: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for radio-frequency imaging sensors for advanced fingerprint biometrics and medical imaging
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, systems, and implementations of an ultra-compact RF (30 GHz - 10 THz) imaging sensor topology that provides a new insight into the human skin are disclosed. The skin tissue is the largest organ in the body - both in weight and surface area - and stores valuable information that can revolutionize security biometrics and mobile health monitoring. The proposed compact sensor enables, for the first time, portable and wearable devices to perform superior biometric authentication compared to current fingerprint methods. Additionally, these devices could probe into the skin to monitor vital signs in real-time and enable mobile health monitoring.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Ingestible devices and methods for physiological status monitoring
abstract_en: Reliable, real-time heart and respiratory rates are key vital signs used in evaluating the physiological status in many clinical and non-clinical settings. Measuring these vital signs generally requires superficial attachment of physically or logistically obtrusive sensors to subjects that may result in skin irritation or adversely influence subject performance. Given the broad acceptance of ingestible electronics, the approach disclosed here enables vital sign monitoring internally from the gastrointestinal tract. The large animal (porcine) experiments and a robust processing disclosed herein demonstrate the feasibility of this approach. Implementing vital sign monitoring as a stand-alone technology or in conjunction with other ingestible devices has the capacity to significantly aid telemedicine, optimize performance monitoring of athletes, military service members, and first-responders, as well as provide a facile method for rapid clinical evaluation and triage.
assignees: SWISTON ALBERT JOSEPH;LANGER ROBERT S;HUGHES TADD BERNARD;JOHNSON KERRY;TRAVERSO CARLO GIOVANNI

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidance method, computer program product and system
abstract_en: A hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) guidance method ( 40 ) for a system including a head-mountable computing device ( 100 ) comprising a processor ( 110 ) and at least one display module ( 106, 106′ ) arranged to be viewed by the wearer ( 20 ) of the head-mountable computing device when wearing the device is disclosed that allows a rescuer to receive CPR guidance without losing sight of the victim. The method comprises receiving ( 420 ), on said processor, a first signal conveying vital signs information from at least one sensor ( 200, 210 ) for monitoring vital signs of a patient ( 10 ), wherein a sensor ( 210 ) of the at least one sensor is integrated in the head-mountable computing device ( 100 ); processing said first signal on said processor to obtain the vital signs information; and displaying ( 422 ) CPR guidance on said at least one display module in response to the processed vital signs information. A computer program product and a CPR guidance system are also disclosed. The system may be created in situ using ubiquitous devices, e.g. smart devices including usable sensors, thus facilitating rapid response to an SCA event, which improves the chances of survival of a SCA victim.

title_en: Direct rf signal processing for heart-rate monitoring using uwb impulse radar
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for direct radio frequency (RF) signal processing for heart rate (HR) monitoring using ultra-wide band (UWB) impulse radar are presented. A radar sensor is able to directly sample a received signal at RF which satisfies the Nyquist sampling rate, preserving a subject's vital sign information in the received signal. The vital sign information can be extracted directly from a raw RF signal and thus down conversion to a complex baseband is not required. The HR monitoring performance from the proposed direct RF signal processing technique provides an improvement in continuous HR monitoring as compared against existing methods using a complex baseband signal and/or other measurement techniques.

title_en: Near-field coherent sensing methods and systems
abstract_en: Near-field coherent sensing (NCS) methods and systems are described herein. The techniques may be used to monitor vital signs is introduced herein. Multiple-input, multiple output near-field techniques may be used to characterize motion. In some embodiments, the methods and systems are used to measure cardiac motion. In some embodiments, the disclosed system is integrated into a seat, such as, for example, a car seat. The system be configured to monitor the vital signs of a seat occupant with multiple sensing points. The sensor can be integrated into the cushion and hence "invisible" to the user.

title_en: Patient monitoring and surveillance system, methods, and devices
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods, devices and systems for the remote monitoring and/or surveillance of a patient's location, position, movement, vital signs, biopotentials, or a combination thereof using transmission of stepped-frequency radar signals, detecting reflections of the transmitted signals and processing the frequency and phase shifts.

title_en: Memory-based, real time feedback system using the processing of several pieces of bio-information into unified communication frames
title_ko: 메모리 기반 다중 생체정보의 통신 프레임 단일화 처리를 통한 실시간 피드백시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a memory-based, real time feedback system using the processing of several pieces of bio-information into unified communication frames, wherein the system is installed in a home or public facility, for detecting bio-signals emitted by a user, analyzing the bio-signals and providing various information to enable the user to autonomously manage the user's health, checking the condition of the user's body in real time so as to determine whether an emergency situation arises and allow a course of action to be taken that is required for said emergency situation. The real time feedback system comprises a bio-signal measuring terminal and a health management apparatus. The bio-signal measuring terminal comprises: a plurality of bio-signal detection sensors for detecting bio-signals of a user; and frame generating means for consolidating information on the bio-signals into one data frame, generating body information data from the data frame, and transmitting the body information data. The health management apparatus comprises: a receiving unit for receiving body information data from the bio-signal measuring terminal; data categorizing means for categorizing body information from the body information data received by the receiving unit; storage means for storing the body information; data analysis means for analyzing the body information stored in the storage means, when input or set analysis conditions for a user analysis request signal are satisfied; and a control unit including control means for receiving an input signal from an input unit and controlling the operation of the data analysis means, and for receiving the analysis results of the data analysis means and transmitting the analysis results via an output unit to an output terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일반 가정 또는 공공장소 등에 설치되어 사용자가 발산하는 생체신호를 감지하고 이를 분석해서 상기 사용자가 자발적으로 건강관리를 하기 위한 다양한 정보를 제공하고, 사용자의 몸 상태를 실시간으로 확인해서 응급상황 여부까지 판단해 처리할 수 있도록 한 메모리 기반 다중 생체정보의 통신 프레임 단일화 처리를 통한 실시간 피드백시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 다수의 셍체신호 감지센서와; 상기 생체신호에 대한 정보를 하나의 데이터 프레임으로 통합해 신체정보데이터로 생성해서 발신하는 프레임생성수단;이 구비된 생체신호 측정단말기, 생체신호 측정단말기로부터 신체정보데이터를 수신하는 수신부와; 수신부의 신체정보데이터로부터 신체정보를 분류하는 데이터분류수단과, 상기 신체정보를 저장하는 저장수단과, 사용자분석요청신호의 입력 또는 설정된 분석조건이 만족되면 저장수단에 저장된 신체정보를 분석하는 데이터분석수단과, 입력부의 입력신호를 수신해서 데이터분석수단의 동작을 제어하고 데이터분석수단의 분석결과를 받아 출력부를 통해 출력단말기로 전송하는 제어수단이 구비된 제어부;가 구비된 건강관리장치를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY;SON JAE GI;PARK CHANG WON;CHUNG HA JOONG;JEON KI MAN;KIM YOUNG HWAN;KIM HYUN WOO

title_en: Ultra-wideband monitoring system and antenna
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects includes a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor includes: an antenna system; an ultra-wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system; a signal processor; and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive signals from the ultra-wideband radar system and is configured to extract information from the signals relating to one or more vital signs of a person or animal within a sensing range corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to send the information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Clutter suppression method for holographic penetration imaging radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a clutter suppression method for a holographic penetration imaging radar. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, carrying out singular value decomposition on received holographic penetration imaging radar echo data; then, solving a reconstruction coefficient matrix by taking the maximum of a Target Clutter Ratio (TCR) as a criterion; and finally, calculating echo data after clutter suppression by using the solved reconstruction coefficient matrix. The method can effectively inhibit clutter components in holographic penetration imaging radar echo data, retain target information, and realize buried weak target enhancement imaging in a medium.

title_en: Postoperative atomizing nursing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a postoperative atomization nursing device, which comprises an atomization device, a state monitoring and adjusting module and a control module, wherein the atomization device comprises an induced draft fan, a filtering and sterilizing assembly, a medicament container, a stirring device, a first micro-mesh atomization device, a second micro-mesh atomization device, a gas detection assembly, a heating assembly, an oxygen regulation assembly, a humidity regulation assembly, a gas regulation cavity, an inspiration control valve, an expiration control valve, a one-way valve, a respiration detection assembly, an air pipe and a respiratory mask, and the state monitoring and adjusting module comprises a fixed ring, a brain wave generating assembly, a first electrode, a second electrode, a millimeter wave radar, a blood oxygen detection assembly and a brain wave acquisition assembly. According to the invention, the atomization working process is adjusted according to the breathing state, and the blood pressure, heart rate, blood oxygen and emotion of the user are monitored in an omnibearing manner, so that the comfort of the user is improved by improving the oxygen content, brain wave physiotherapy and other modes.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring bio-signal by using impulse radar signal
title_ko: 임펄스 레이더 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 임펄스 레이더 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 장치 및 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일실시 예에 따른 임펄스(impulse) 레이더(radar) 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 전자 장치는 상기 생체 신호와 관련된 적어도 하나 이상의 임펄스 레이더 신호를 송수신하는 레이더부; 및 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 임펄스 레이더 신호 중 일부 신호들에서 기준 신호와 상기 기준 신호를 제외한 나머지 신호들을 결정하고, 상기 기준 신호와 상기 나머지 신호들에 대하여 상호 상관(cross correlation) 연산을 수행하고, 상기 상호 상관 연산에 따른 최대값을 획득하고, 상기 최대값을 주파수 성분의 스펙트럼으로 변환하고, 상기 주파수 성분을 분석함으로써 상기 생체 신호를 측정하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Noncontact vital sign detection apparatus of two adjacent targets using signal decomposition and method thereof
title_ko: 신호 분리를 이용한 근접한 두 표적의 비접촉식 생체 신호 탐지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a noncontact vital sign detection apparatus for two adjacent targets using signal decomposition and a method thereof. According to the present invention, a vital sign detection method using a vital sign detection apparatus comprises the following steps: transmitting a radar transmission signal toward first and second targets close to each other and obtaining a radar reception signal in which signals reflected from each target are mixed; extracting an I-channel component and a Q-channel component from the radar reception signal; inputting the I-channel component and the Q-channel component to a preset signal separation function model to separate and extract a first phase component by the first target and a second phase component by the second target, which are mixed in the radar reception signal; and individually detecting a vital sign of the first target and a vital sign of the second target from results of processing the first phase component and the second phase component by fast Fourier transform (FFT), respectively. Accordingly, a mixed radar reception signal due to two targets disposed close to each other on the same distance is separated, thereby efficiently detecting a vital sign of each target.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 신호 분리를 이용한 근접한 두 표적의 비접촉식 생체 신호 탐지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 생체 신호 탐지 장치를 이용한 생체 신호 탐지 방법에 있어서, 서로 근접한 제1 및 제2 표적을 향하여 송출 후 각 표적에서 반사되어 혼합 수신되는 레이다 수신 신호를 획득하는 단계와, 상기 레이다 수신 신호에서 I 채널 성분과 Q 채널 성분을 추출하는 단계와, 상기 I 채널 성분과 Q 채널 성분을 기 설정된 신호분리 함수 모델에 입력하여, 상기 레이다 수신 신호에 혼재된 제1 표적에 의한 제1 위상 성분과 제2 표적에 의한 제2 위상 성분을 분리 도출하는 단계, 및 상기 제1 위상 성분과 상기 제2 위상 성분을 각각 FFT(Fast Fourier Transform) 처리한 결과로부터 상기 제1 표적의 생체 신호와 제2 표적의 생체 신호를 개별 탐지하는 단계를 포함하는 생체 신호 탐지 방법을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 동일 거리 상에 서로 근접하게 위치한 두 표적들로 인하여 혼합된 레이다 수신 신호를 분리하여 각 표적의 생체 신호를 보다 효율적으로 탐지할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar system and bio-signal detection method performed thereby
title_ko: 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 생체 신호 탐지방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar system and a bio-signal detection method performed thereby, the method comprising the steps of: (a) a radar signal processing part removing a fixed target included in a received signal, detecting a peak power distance index of a bio-target using a bio-signal, which is a moving target, and selecting a preset number of neighbor distance indices based on the detected peak power distance index; (b) performing autocorrelation on multi-chirp data corresponding to the selected neighbor distance index to detect the periodicity characteristics of the bio-signal; (c) selecting a plurality of multi-chirp data of the neighbor distance index exceeding a preset reference value from among power values on which the autocorrelation has been performed; (d) summing the multi-chirp data of the selected neighbor distance index to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the signal, thereby detecting a Doppler frequency signal; (e) performing power correlation on the detected Doppler frequency signal; and (f) detecting a maximal peak from the result of the power correlation and calculating the BPM of the bio-signal using a frequency corresponding to the detected maximal peak. The detection rate and accuracy of a bio-signal including the respiration rate or the heart rate of a human being can be improved using the periodic characteristics of the bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 생체 신호 탐지방법에 관한 것으로, (a) 레이더 신호처리부에서 수신신호에 포함된 고정 표적을 제거하고, 이동 표적인 생체 신호를 이용하여 생체 표적의 피크 파워 거리 인덱스를 검출하며, 검출된 피크 파워 거리 인덱스를 중심으로 미리 설정된 개수의 이웃 거리 인덱스를 선택하는 단계, (b) 선택된 이웃 거리 인덱스에 해당하는 다중 첩 데이터에 대해 각각 자기 상관을 수행해서 생체 신호의 주기성 특징을 검출하는 단계, (c) 상기 자기 상관을 수행한 파워 값 중에서 미리 설정된 기준치를 초과하는 이웃 거리 인덱스의 다중 첩 데이터를 복수 개 선택해서 생체 신호를 선별하는 단계, (d) 선택된 이웃 거리 인덱스의 다중 첩 데이터를 합산해서 신호의 신호 대 잡음비를 향상시켜 도플러 주파수 신호를 검출하는 단계, (e) 검출된 도플러 주파수 신호에 대해 파워 상관을 수행하는 단계 및 (f) 상기 파워 상관을 수행한 결과에서 최대 피크를 검출하고, 검출된 최대 피크에 해당하는 주파수를 이용해서 생체 신호의 BPM을 계산하는 단계를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 생체 신호의 주기적인 특성을 이용해서 사람의 호흡수나 심박수를 포함하는 생체 신호의 탐지율 및 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Buried object detection sensor
abstract_en: A combined type buried object detection sensor is provided, in which a MD and a GPR are integrated to improve a detectivity. A buried object detection sensor  10  has a constitution in which plural antenna elements composing a GPR  14  are disposed on a circumference, an inner coil  16  of a MD  12  is arranged at a center portion of the GPR  14  and an outer coil  18  of the MD  12  is arranged at a periphery of the GPR  14 , the GPR  14  has slits  20  separating the respective antenna elements, and the slits  20  between adjacent antenna elements are connected by a metal leaf  36.

title_en: Ingestible devices and methods for physiological status monitoring
abstract_en: Reliable, real-time heart and respiratory rates are key vital signs used in evaluating the physiological status in many clinical and non-clinical settings. Measuring these vital signs generally requires superficial attachment of physically or logistically obtrusive sensors to subjects that may result in skin irritation or adversely influence subject performance. Given the broad acceptance of ingestible electronics, the approach disclosed here enables vital sign monitoring internally from the gastrointestinal tract. The large animal (porcine) experiments and a robust processing disclosed herein demonstrate the feasibility of this approach. Implementing vital sign monitoring as a stand-alone technology or in conjunction with other ingestible devices has the capacity to significantly aid telemedicine, optimize performance monitoring of athletes, military service members, and first-responders, as well as provide a facile method for rapid clinical evaluation and triage.

title_en: Non-contact exercise vital sign detection method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A non-contact exercise vital sign detection method is provided. At least one candidate position having an energy intensity exceeding an energy threshold is pre-selected from a vibration frequency map, and a position having a vibration frequency meeting a vital sign parameter range is then selected as a target position from the at least one candidate position. Accordingly, phase data obtained according to the target position facilitates accurate detection of a vital sign parameter of a subject.

title_en: Fire emergency system capable of achieving life detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire emergency system capable of achieving life detection. The fire emergency system comprises a master controller, the master controller is in communication connection with at least one sub-controller, the sub-controllers are electrically connected with a fire emergency lamp, and the fire emergency lamp is provided with a life detection sensor. The fire emergency system capable of achieving life detection can be managed in a centralized manner, the maintenance difficulty is small, the fire emergency system can be used normally in case of emergency, and can carry out life sign detection, the fire emergency system is beneficial to rescue operation, lives can be rescued quickly, the life saving probability can be increased, and the disaster relief efficiency can be improved, in addition, loss, injuries and deaths can be effectively reduced.

title_en: earth sound sensing probe and earthquake detection system
abstract_en: the invention discloses a ground sound sensing probe and a seismic detection system, wherein the ground sound sensing probe comprises: a test sensor assembly for measuring vibration data; an external processing device, the external processing device comprising: the main control board is electrically connected with the test sensing assembly; the power supply assembly comprises a photoelectric conversion component, a power supply manager and an energy storage component, wherein the photoelectric conversion component and the energy storage component are both electrically connected with the power supply manager, and the power supply manager is electrically connected with the main control board; and the transmission cable is used for electrically connecting the test sensor assembly which is arranged in a split manner with a main control board of the external processing device. The invention aims to ensure that the function of continuous use can be ensured even if the earth sound sensing probe is deeply buried underground and the installation environment is complex, and the stability of the earth sound sensing probe is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN VALLEY VENTURES TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar device for sensing vital signs
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar device for sensing vital signs comprises a microprocessor, a millimeter wave radar and an electrocardiogram machine; the millimeter wave radar is configured to sense a human body to obtain a plurality of wireless vital sign signals; the microprocessor is configured to receive the plurality of wireless vital sign signals; the electrocardiograph is configured to sense the human body to obtain a plurality of wired vital sign signals; the microprocessor is configured to receive the plurality of wired vital sign signals; after the microprocessor receives the plurality of wireless vital sign signals and the plurality of wired vital sign signals, the microprocessor is configured to output the plurality of wireless vital sign signals and the plurality of wired vital sign signals.

title_en: Intelligent system for detecting human heart rate and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system for detecting human heart rate and a detection method thereof, belonging to the technical field of health management; the method comprises a detection stage, a position identification stage, a judgment stage, an information transmission stage, a reminding stage and a rescue information sending stage: s1, the detection stage comprises: arranging an infrared or direct microwave radar sensor in the toilet, and judging whether the current state of the vital sign target is entering a detection area or not through a microwave radar signal; s2: the location identification phase comprises: detecting personnel position identification, area water stain identification and area dehumidification control; s3: the judging stage comprises: the method comprises the steps of judging the inclination angle of a detector and judging the acceleration of the detector. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the reminding module started by the processor can be released through the key module, so that unnecessary panic of family members of the wearer is avoided; the time delay alarm is adopted, the false alarm is reduced, meanwhile, the innovative radar algorithm is adopted to obtain the vital sign signals of the human body, and the accuracy of the falling alarm can be improved.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring waveform recovery method based on deep learning and radio frequency perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for restoring vital sign monitoring waveforms based on deep learning and radio frequency sensing, which is based on radio frequency sensing and deep comparison learning technologies, restores the vital sign monitoring waveforms in a non-contact mode, and applies an encoder-decoder model to construct a neural network, so that compared with a traditional comparison model, loss of waveform details is avoided, fine-grained vital sign waveforms can be restored more accurately in a motion state, and the robustness of vital sign monitoring on motion is further improved; in addition, the vital sign waveform recovery method provided by the invention adopts a uniform data format, so that the method can be almost deployed on any type of conventional commercial grade radar and can adapt to different application requirements, and the method for recovering the waveform provided by the invention is independent of bottom hardware.
assignees: CHINESE AND NEW INTERNATIONAL UNITED RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Vital sign state identification method and system based on Transformer network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying vital sign states based on a Transformer network, relates to a vital body detection technology, and provides a scheme aiming at the problem of ignoring the front-back relation of time sequence data in the prior art. The attention layer performs the following processing on any data block: respectively mapping the data block into a query vector, an index vector and an information vector by using three different randomly initialized matrixes; and then calculating the fractional value of the attention relationship between the current data block and other data blocks, and introducing asymmetric chi-square distribution as an additive bias of the attention layer during calculation. The method has the advantages that the method adopts a Transformer network to carry out feature extraction and state recognition on the vital sign signals collected by the continuous wave Doppler radar, supplements the relative position information of the continuous wave Doppler radar sequence captured by the position code by adding chi-square bias in the attention layer, and has better detection real-time performance and accuracy.

title_en: Intelligent blood pressure measuring system and method based on single vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blood pressure measurement, and particularly discloses an intelligent blood pressure measurement system based on a single vital sign monitoring radar. An intelligent blood pressure measuring method based on a single vital sign monitoring radar comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring an aortic pulse waveform signal of a subject at intervals by using a single vital sign monitoring radar, and acquiring an environmental signal around the subject by using the radar; s2: the pulse data of the hand of the testee is collected in a contact mode, and meanwhile the vibration sensor detects whether the hand of the testee vibrates or not. The scheme solves the problem of inaccurate blood pressure measurement caused by the change of the radar waves when the radar waves are used for measuring the blood pressure.

title_en: Animal vital sign measurement method based on millimeter wave radar, applied device and pet collar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an animal vital sign measurement method based on millimeter wave radar, an applied device and a pet collar, wherein the method comprises the steps of adopting the millimeter wave radar to collect radar data of a pet target area, dynamically locking an echo zone of the target area according to the body type of the pet in the collection process, and separating the target area from the millimeter wave radar by a certain distance; the method comprises the steps of eliminating environmental noise and motion artifacts in radar data by adopting a band-pass filter, retaining effective signals in the range of 0.2-5Hz, then carrying out sliding window segmentation on the radar data, extracting heart rate signals and respiratory signals from the segmented radar data, inputting the extracted heart rate signals and respiratory signals into a trained measuring model, and outputting predicted values of heart rate and respiratory frequency in real time. The invention collects signals and removes environmental noise and motion artifacts in the signals through the millimeter wave radar, solves the problems of low measurement precision and the like caused by the length Mao Zhedang of the pet and the high-frequency circadian rhythm, and can accurately measure the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the pet in real time.

title_en: Apparatus and method for searching buried long object
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To propose an apparatus and a method for searching a long object, such as a synthetic resin pipe buried in a searched region.  <P>SOLUTION: The searching apparatus (1) is provided with an evaluation unit (6), having a calculation means (7) and a display means (8), and a portable search head (9) moving along a searched face (F) and having a transmit/receive unit (11a) with a search path sensor (10) and an antenna (12a). title_en: Vital sign detection device and method
abstract_en: To provide a vital sign detection device and method.SOLUTION: A method comprises: acquiring a radar multi-antenna zero speed distance FFT signal; selecting a first radar signal from the radar multi-antenna zero speed distance FFT signal and generating an amplitude feature and a phase feature of the first radar signal; using a detection model based on a deep neural network to generate candidate physiological signals for multiple segments on the basis of the amplitude feature and the phase feature; selecting a target physiological signal from the candidate physiological signals of the multiple segments, the candidate physiological signal and the target physiological signal being respiratory signals or heartbeat signals; and detecting a vital sign parameter on the basis of the target physiological signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Device and method for non-contact detection of galvanic skin response based on imaging
title_ko: 영상 기반 갈바닉 피부 반응 비접촉 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology for detecting a non-contact biological signal and more specifically, relates to a device and method for an image-based galvanic skin response non-contact detection that extract a galvanic skin response (GSR) as a brightness value of a skin from a non-contact infrared image. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the biological signal can be alternatively detected in a non-contact method using a correlation of a brightness value of the infrared skin image and a galvanic skin response value. The device comprises: an acquisition part; a calculation part; and an analysis part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 생체 신호를 검출하는 기술에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 갈바닉 피부 반응(GSR, Galvanic Skin Response)을 비접촉식 적외선 영상에서 피부의 밝기 값으로  추출하는 영상 기반 갈바닉 피부 반응 비접촉 감지 장치 및 방법에 대한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따르면, 적외선 피부 영상의 밝기 값과 갈바닉 피부 반응 값의 상관 관계를 이용해 비 접촉식으로 생체 신호를 대체 감지할 수 있다.

title_ko: 골프채를 이용하여 근감소증을 진단하는 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 실시예는 골프채를 이용하여 근감소증을 진단하는 장치 및 그 방법을 개시한다. 
본 실시예의 일 측면에 의하면, 골프채의 그립에 배치되어, 사용자의 손바닥 또는 손가락에 접촉되어 악력과 근육량을 포함한 생체신호를 감지하고, 사용자의 보행 속도, 이동 거리를 포함한 보행 정보를 측정하는 적어도 하나 이상의 센서를 포함하는 센서 디바이스를 포함하되, 상기 센서 디바이스는, 일측면이 개방되어 내부에 수용 공간을 포함하는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 개방된 일측면에 배치되어, 상기 하우징의 수용 공간을 밀폐쇄시키는 커버; 및 상기 하우징의 개방된 일측면의 반대 방향에 위치한 타측면에 배치되어, 상기 골프채의 그립의 상단에 나사 결합, 푸시-풀(push-pull) 방식의 결합, 베이요넷(Bayonet) 방식의 결합, 스크류 결합 중 어느 하나의 결합 방식으로 결합되는 결합 부재를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Vital signs monitoring system
abstract_en: This relates to a monitoring system capable of measuring a plurality of vital signs. The monitoring system can include a plurality of sensors including, but not limited to, electrodes, piezoelectric sensors, temperature sensors, and accelerometers. The monitoring system can be capable of operating in one or more operation modes such as, for example: capacitance measurement mode, electrical measurement mode, piezoelectric measurement mode, temperature measurement mode, acceleration measurement mode, impedance measurement mode, and standby mode. Based on the measured values, the monitoring system can analyze the user's sleep, provide feedback and suggestions to the user, and/or can adjust or control the environmental conditions to improve the user's sleep. The monitoring system can further be capable of analyzing the sleep of the user(s) without directly contacting or attaching uncomfortable probes to the user(s) and without having to analyze the sleep in an unknown environment (e.g., a medical facility).

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a body worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring Blood Pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO 2) and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The patch sensor is characterized by a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely over the patient's chest and encloses all sensing and electronic components of the battery, wireless transmitter, and the sensor. The patch sensor measures an Electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform, an Impedance Plethysmogram (IPG) waveform, a vascular plethysmogram (PPG) waveform, and a Phonocardiogram (PCG) waveform, and processes these waveforms centrally to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor measuring PPG waveforms further comprises a heating element for increasing the perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Portable poison filtering box service life detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a portable poison filtering box service life detection device which comprises a box body, a gas detection module, a power supply module and an electric control device, wherein the box body is provided with a gas detection module; the gas detection module comprises a gas guide tube, a gas detection sensor, a suction pump and a tail gas adsorber, wherein the gas inlet end of the gas guide tube is positioned outside the box body, the gas outlet end of the gas guide tube is connected with the gas inlet end of the suction pump in the box body, the gas detection sensor is arranged in the box body, the detection end of the gas detection sensor stretches into the gas guide tube to detect gas passing through the gas guide tube, the gas outlet end of the suction pump is connected with the tail gas adsorber, the power supply module provides electric energy for the gas detection module, and the electric control device is used for receiving control instructions of external users and controlling the operation of the gas detection module and outputting data detected by the gas detection module. The detection device can help respirator use units to evaluate the service life of the toxin filtering box regularly according to shifts or days, and remind users to replace the toxin filtering box with the expired service life in time.

title_en: Brain function composite monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of brain function monitoring, in particular to a brain function compound monitoring system, which comprises an infrared and radar common-caliber antenna, a receiving module, a signal processing module and an alarm module, wherein the receiving module is connected with the infrared and radar common-caliber antenna and comprises a high-sensitivity extremely-low frequency receiver and an infrared detector, the signal processing module comprises an AD plate, a signal processing plate, a data processing plate and a data exchange plate, the data storage module is used for storing vital sign and brain wave characteristic data of a monitored object, and the alarm module is used for sending out early warning signals when detecting that the vital sign or consciousness state of the monitored object is abnormal. The system is suitable for hospitalization, home rehabilitation and elderly patient monitoring, and provides important support for emergency treatment and accurate medical treatment.

title_ko: 사용자의 생체정보 분석을 통한 감정상태 분석장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자의 생체정보 분석을 통한 감정상태 분석장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 신체로부터 수집한 맥파(PPG), 피부전기저항(GSR), 피부온도(SKT) 및 외부온도 등의 생체신호를 추출하고, 생체신호를 연산하여 사용자의 감정상태를 분석 및 판단하도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 본 발명의 목적은 사용자의 생체정보 분석을 통한 감정상태 분석장치는 사용자의 신체에 접촉되어 생체정보를 추출하는 맥파센서, 피부온도센서 및 피부전기저항센서를 포함한 바이오센서부; 바이오센서부로부터 추출된 각 생체정보를 디지털신호로 변환하는 아날로그/디지털변환부; 아날로그/디지털변환부를 통해 입력된 바이오센서부의 맥파(PPG), 피부온도(SKT), 피부전기저항(GSR)값을 입력받아 연산과정을 통해 분당평균심박수(HR)의 비(GSR/HR), 자율신경균형도(LF/HF) 파라미터를 산출하고, 산출된 각 파라미터(PPG, SKT, GSR/HR, LF/HF)로부터 해당 표준지표(T SKT , T SDNN , T LF/HF , T GSR/HR )를 산출하고, 산출된 표준지표 값에 의해 사용자의 감정상태를 판단하는 메인프로세서; 메인프로세서에 의해 판단된 감정상태를 저장하는 메모리; 및 메인프로세서에 의해 판단된 감정상태를 표시하는 LCD표시부;를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, good portability, easy operation, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Through-wall detection radar for enhancing signal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a through-wall detection radar of reinforcing signal, including through-wall radar host computer, through-wall radar host computer includes receiver, transmitter and battery, the receiver is connected with the schottky diode, the schottky diode is connected with the base of triode, the collecting electrode and the projecting pole of triode are connected with the positive pole and the negative pole of power respectively, the projecting pole of triode is connected with signal processor, signal processor is connected with the controller, the controller is connected with the display, the battery passes through the wire and connects receiver, transmitter, signal processor, controller and display respectively. The receiver receives electromagnetic waves through the Schottky diode and converts the electromagnetic waves into current signals, the signals are enhanced through the triode, and the signals entering the signal processor are enhanced, so that the effect of amplifying the signals is achieved, and the enhancement of weak signals is guaranteed.
assignees: CHENGDU IANKE HUIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Respiration detector for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a respiratory detector is used in fire control. The utility model discloses in: the upper end surface and the lower end surface of the detector body are respectively provided with a lower buckle and an upper buckle; the respiratory sensor detects respiratory signals of a fireman and transmits the respiratory signals to the pre-amplification circuit, and the pre-amplification circuit amplifies the signals transmitted by the respiratory sensor and transmits the amplified signals to the signal conditioning circuit; the signal conditioning circuit processes the signal and transmits the processed signal to the main controller through the A/D conversion circuit; the main controller processes the received signal and controls the state indicator lamp; the main controller transmits the signal data to the law enforcement recorder. The utility model discloses an install respiratory sensor in the fire control full face guard and carry out real-time detection to the respiratory state of fire fighter, the signal that respiratory sensor gathered is transmitted to main control unit after preamplification circuit, signal conditioning circuit are handled, main control unit passes through communication module and law enforcement record appearance and monitoring center are connected; thereby ensuring the monitoring and protection of firemen in the fire-fighting and disaster-relief site.

title_en: Fire scene high-precision infrared camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene high accuracy infrared camera, which comprises a mounting seat, a cover body, a camera, an alarm, a storage battery, a mainboard, a fire prevention detection device and a main controller, wherein the camera is fixed on the upper part of the mounting seat, the cover body is arranged on the outer side of the camera and the mounting seat, a temperature sensor and a lighting lamp are arranged in the cover body, the temperature sensor is arranged for sensing the state of the environment in the range and controlling the switch of the camera, the effect of saving energy is achieved, a life detection module is arranged in the camera and comprises an infrared sensor, the infrared sensor and the temperature sensor are connected with the main controller, the camera is provided with an independent power switch, the main controller is connected with the storage battery, the main controller is connected with a wireless transmission module, and the life signs can be distinguished by infrared sensing under the environment with larger smoke after the fire occurs by the arrangement of the infrared sensor, thereby facilitating rescue and making the device more practical.

title_en: Handheld through-the-wall radar with support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld through-wall radar with a bracket, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall radars and aims at the problems that the through-wall radars are easy to wear during use and the loss is caused when the through-wall radars are contacted with a wall; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the mounting assembly, the disassembly and assembly work of the through-wall radar body can be completed in a short time, the disassembly and assembly work efficiency of the through-wall radar body is greatly improved, the disassembly and assembly of the through-wall radar body can be completed without using tools for workers, and the practicability is high.
