title_en: High-resolution through-wall imaging system and method based on random antenna arrays and microwave correlated imaging principles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution through-wall imaging system and method based on random antenna arrays and the microwave correlated imaging principles. The antenna arrays which are arranged at equal distance and identical in rows are used as transmitting parts, one signal source is randomly sampled through random on and off of each array element antenna, the sampled signal source is projected to an imaging area to form a microwave field with time-space random undulatory property and statistical independence similar to a fake thermal light source, a high-resolution imaging result is acquired through one-step detection, design and manufacturing difficulty of a microwave correlated imaging system is reduced, cost is lowered, system stability and interference resistance are increased, and conditions are created for large-scale application and popularization of microwave correlated imaging. The imaging method has the advantages that the high-resolution images of indoor targets and areas blocked by a wall can be acquired, the method is insensitive to signal attenuation brought by the wall, high in noise resistance and worthy of application, and disguising performance of a detecting device and battlefield survivability of an operator are increased.

title_en: A kind of six crawler belt autonomous formula coalmine rescue devices
abstract_en: The invention belongs to colliery emergency rescue technology field, be related to a kind of six crawler belt autonomous formula coalmine rescue devices, its small volume, be easy to carry, simple operation, manufacturing cost it is low.Include the car body of square；360 degree of rotary units, walking unit and scalable mechanical arm unit are provided with the car body；Controller, walking unit, hoofing part unit, GPS positioning unit, infrared ray vital signs detector, night vision cam, voice transfer unit, scalable mechanical arm unit, mechanical arm driver element, sensor integration unit, power module, data storage element, wireless communication unit, Digiplex and emergency light are additionally provided with the car body；The controller receives the control signal that the Digiplex sends by wireless communication unit；The hoofing part unit is connected with walking unit, and the mechanical arm driver element is connected with scalable mechanical arm unit.

title_en: Method and system for removing static background and trend item of life detection radar echo signal and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and electronic equipment for removing static background and trend items of a life detection radar echo signal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting life detection radar echo data to obtain an original echo matrix; taking the maximum value position of each column in the obtained original echo matrix as a segmented marking point; segmenting each row of the original echo matrix; then, fitting by using a polynomial to obtain a static background and a trend term estimation; and subtracting the static background and the trend term estimation from the original echo matrix to obtain an enhanced signal matrix. The method can accurately estimate the signal trend item caused by the instability of radar hardware, and can effectively reduce the influence of non-stationary interference on the target signal.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar life detection algorithm based on SE and SSD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband radar life detection algorithm based on SE and SSD, and belongs to the technical field of radar life detection. Firstly, preprocessing clutter and noise signals in original radar echo signals by adopting methods such as channel signal subtraction, direct average subtraction, linear trend suppression, automatic gain control, slow time filtering and the like; then, echo selection is performed by calculating the time delay corresponding to the SE value peak value of the radar receiving pulse along the slow time direction so as to position the target. Selecting and recombining the signals on these adjacent range gates based on the SE values may obtain more vital sign information than a single frame signal and may reduce the observation time. And decomposing and reconstructing radar echo signals by using SSD, reconstructing the signals according to the energy percentage of SSCs in the breathing and heartbeat frequency bands obtained by decomposition, and calculating the breathing and heartbeat frequency by using FFT. The radar life detection method provided by the invention can accurately locate the target and extract the life information, effectively improves the signal to noise ratio, and has wide research value and application prospect.

title_en: Radar respiration detection method, device and system adopting infrared camera shooting assistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of human health monitoring, in particular to a radar respiration detection method, device and system adopting infrared camera shooting assistance. According to the radar respiration detection method adopting infrared camera shooting assistance, provided by the invention, the infrared camera is used for assisting the millimeter wave radar as a non-contact monitoring means, the position information of a subject can be positioned through an infrared image, and the phase deviation generated by a large-amplitude body movement is corrected, so that more accurate respiration data can be obtained. According to the invention, the body temperature value is measured through infrared, so that whether the monitored object is in a human or non-human state can be judged, thereby realizing the screening of effective respiration data, avoiding the misjudgment of an autocorrelation link and being capable of monitoring the respiration rate of the human body more accurately.

title_en: Vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distance angle energy array based on a radar data frame of a region to be detected received by a radar receiving antenna and a guiding vector of the radar receiving antenna; the method comprises the steps of acquiring an accumulated radar frame set corresponding to a radar receiving antenna, wherein a plurality of radar data frames which are accumulated and received by the radar receiving antenna are stored in the accumulated radar frame set; performing peak characteristic analysis on the distance angle energy array to obtain a micro-motion analysis result corresponding to the region to be detected; trend analysis is carried out on the accumulated radar frame set to obtain a trend analysis result corresponding to the region to be detected; and determining a vital sign detection result corresponding to the region to be detected by combining the micro-motion analysis result and the trend analysis result. The method can effectively save storage resources and computing resources, and simultaneously accurately sense vital sign information in the region to be detected by combining micro analysis and trend analysis.

title_en: Radar data processing method and radar data acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar data processing method and a radar data acquisition system. The method is applied to the field of medical radars. The method comprises the following steps: initializing radar parameters of a configuration radar data transceiver and acquiring radar echo signals; extracting vital sign information and body movement information according to the radar echo signals, and judging whether vital signs exist in a monitoring scene or not; continuously acquiring a judging result of whether vital signs exist or not, if the vital signs exist continuously and the time exceeds the preset time, adjusting radar parameters to a low-power mode, and acquiring a bed Zhou Leida echo signal in the low-power mode; according to the radar echo signals around the bed, body movement detection and body target integration are carried out, and whether vital signs exist around the bed is judged; and continuously acquiring a judging result of whether vital signs exist at the bed periphery, and if the vital signs exist continuously and the time exceeds the preset time, adjusting radar parameters to an initialization state. The invention reduces the power consumption and optimizes the battery endurance, storage and data processing efficiency of the system.
assignees: BEIJING QINGLEI TECH CO LTD;CHANGSHA QINGLEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for monitoring buried cable external damage
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power equipment monitoring, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for monitoring the external damage of an underground cable, which are used for acquiring radar signals of the surrounding environment in real time based on a millimeter wave radar unit, detecting whether engineering mechanical equipment exists in the surrounding environment through a trained engineering mechanical equipment identification model, calculating the relative position between an intelligent ground nail and the engineering mechanical equipment if the engineering mechanical equipment exists in the surrounding environment, acquiring voiceprint signals of the surrounding environment based on a voiceprint acquisition unit, acquiring the category of the engineering mechanical equipment through an engineering mechanical equipment category identification model library, and calculating the distance between a vibration source and the underground cable based on a triaxial vibration unit. Therefore, based on the combination of the artificial intelligence algorithm and the multiple characteristics, the type of the engineering machinery equipment and the vibration source position of the external breaking behavior are accurately identified, and the monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: LINZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU XINGONG INTELLIGENT SYSTEM CO LTD

The system is suitable for hospitalization, home rehabilitation and elderly patient monitoring, and provides important support for emergency treatment and accurate medical treatment.

title_en: Intelligent sleep detection and follow-up adjustment system and method and intelligent bedding
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent sleep detection and follow-up adjustment system, an intelligent sleep detection and follow-up adjustment method and an intelligent bedding, comprising an electromagnetic wave vital sign sensing module, an infrared thermopile array sensing module, a multimode fusion processing unit, a follow-up control unit and an intelligent follow-up mechanism, wherein the electromagnetic wave vital sign sensing module is used for acquiring point cloud data and micro Doppler frequency spectrum information of a user in a non-contact mode, the infrared thermopile array sensing module is used for acquiring body surface temperature distribution information of the user in a non-contact mode and generating a heat map matrix, the heat map matrix comprises a user body surface heat source outline and local thermal fluctuation information caused by physiological activities of the user, the multimode fusion processing unit is used for carrying out fusion processing on the point cloud data, the micro Doppler frequency spectrum information, the user body surface heat source outline and the local thermal fluctuation information, outputting a physiological parameter set representing sleep quality of the user, the follow-up control unit is used for generating deformation control parameters of a sleep support according to the physiological parameter set, and the intelligent follow-up mechanism is used for executing deformation adjustment operation of the sleep support according to the deformation control parameters.
assignees: BEIJING GEWU CENTURY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for prevention of infectious disease
title_ko: 지능형 방역 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An intelligent monitoring system for the prevention of infectious disease is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, the intelligent monitoring system for the prevention of infectious disease includes: a user identification part; a radar sensor part; a radar signal analysis part; a data storage part; a receiving part; a virus confirmation user extraction part; a close contact user extraction part; and a transmitting part. Therefore, it is possible to monitor users of multi-use facilities in a non-contact manner.
abstract_ko: 지능형 방역 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 특정시설에 대한 모니터링의 개시 시각과 종료 시각을 입력 받아 이벤트 기간을 설정하는 이벤트기간설정부; 상기 특정시설에 입장하는 이용자의 신원 정보를 입력 받는 이용자신원확인부; 상기 특정시설 내에 초광대역 레이다 신호를 송출하고, 상기 특정시설 내에 있는 이용자에 의해 반사되어 돌아오는 초광대역 레이다 신호를 수신하는 레이다센서부; 상기 레이다센서부에 수신된 초광대역 레이다 신호를 분석하여 이용자의 위치 정보 및 생체 신호 정보를 생성하는 레이다신호분석부; 상기 레이다신호분석부에 의해 생성된 이용자의 위치 정보 및 생체 신호 정보를 상기 이용자신원확인부를 통해 입력 받은 이용자의 신원 정보와 매칭시켜 상기 이벤트기간설정부에 의해 설정된 이벤트 기간 별로 구분하여 저장하는 데이터저장부; 외부 서버로부터 바이러스 확진자의 신원 정보 및 전염 추정 시각을 수신하는 수신부; 상기 수신부에 수신된 정보와 상기 데이터저장부에 저장된 정보를 기초로 전염 추정 시각 이후의 이벤트 기간 중에 바이러스 확진자의 입장 여부를 확인하여 바이러스 확진 이용자를 추출하는 바이러스확진이용자추출부; 상기 데이터저장부에 저장된 정보를 기초로 바이러스 확진 이용자에게 기 설정된 거리 이내로 접근한 이력이 있는 밀접 접촉 이용자를 추출하는 밀접접촉이용자추출부; 및 상기 밀접접촉이용자추출부에 의해 추출된 밀접 접촉 이용자의 휴대용 단말기로 밀접 접촉 사실을 안내하는 메시지를 전송하는 송신부를 포함하고, 상기 데이터저장부는 바이러스 확진 정보를 이용자의 신원 정보와 매칭시켜 저장하고, 상기 바이러스확진이용자추출부는, 상기 데이터저장부에 저장된 이용자의 생체 신호 정보와 바이러스 확진 정보를 기초로 바이러스 확진 이용자의 생체 신호 특성을 머신러닝에 의해 학습하고, 상기 레이다신호분석부에 의해 생성된 이용자의 생체 신호 정보가 바이러스 확진 이용자의 생체 신호 특성을 나타내면 해당 이용자를 바이러스 확진 의심 이용자로 추출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 지능형 방역 모니터링 시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic device for generating health information on basis of plurality of biosignals and operation method therefor
title_ko: 복수의 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 생성하는 전자 장치 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present invention comprises: a battery; a display; at least one sensor; an interface; at least one memory; and at least one processor electrically connected to the display, the at least one sensor, the interface, and the at least one memory, wherein the at least one processor may determine whether a user wears the electronic device by means of the at least one sensor; measure a first bio-signal of the user by means of the at least one sensor while the user wears the electronic device; drive an RF sensor included in a charging device while the electronic device is connected to the charging device including the RF sensor through the interface, thereby measuring a second bio-signal of the user that is generated by the RF signal oscillated from the RF sensor; receive at least one of electric power for charging the battery from the charging device and the second bio-signal through the interface; generate health information of the user on the basis of at least the first bio-signal and the second bio-signal; and display the generated health information on the display. Other various embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 배터리, 디스플레이, 적어도 하나의 센서, 인터페이스, 적어도 하나의 메모리, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서, 상기 인터페이스, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 메모리와 전기적으로 연결되는 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자가 상기 전자 장치를 착용하였는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 사용자가 전자 장치를 착용한 동안에, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 제1 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 전자 장치가 상기 인터페이스를 통해 RF 센서를 포함하는 충전 장치와 연결된 동안에, 상기 충전 장치에 포함된 상기 RF 센서를 구동시켜 상기 RF 센서로부터 발진되는 RF 신호에 의하여 발생되는 상기 사용자의 제2 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 인터페이스를 통해 상기 충전 장치로부터 상기 배터리를 충전하기 위한 전력 및 상기 제2 생체 신호 중 적어도 하나를 수신하고, 상기 제1 생체 신호 및 상기 제2 생체 신호에 적어도 기반하여 상기 사용자의 건강 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 상기 건강 정보를 상기 디스플레이에 표시할 수 있다. 그 밖의 다양한 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Joint remote vital signs sensing communications and pnt based drone swarm
abstract_en: Embodiments of a method of operating a drone swarm system of a swarm of unmanned arial vehicles (UAVs) are disclosed. In some embodiments, a search of a geographic area is performed based on one or more first radar signals from at least one of the UAVs. Additionally, it is determined whether at least one obstruction of the geographic area is found in response to performing the search. A radar operation mode for each of the UAVs is determined based on whether at least one obstruction is detected. One or more living entities are detected in the geographic area based on one or more second radar signals transmitted in accordance with the determined radar operation mode.

title_en: Through-wall radar rapid imaging method based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar rapid imaging method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform. The invention adopts a receiving-transmitting split-setting mode, and the coordinates of a transmitter and a receiver are different, so that the signal models are different, and therefore, the green functions of the layered media from the transmitting antenna to the target and the green functions of the layered media from the target to the receiving antenna are different; the unmanned aerial vehicle platform is used for data acquisition, the sampling position of the unmanned aerial vehicle platform in the azimuth direction is not straight and uniform, and therefore the imaging result is obtained by utilizing the conjugate linear process of which the imaging result is equivalent to the echo generation process.

title_en: Ultra-wideband MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wide band radar signal processing, and discloses an ultra wide band MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method. The invention mainly comprises the following steps: (1) rearranging the echo data of a plurality of channels of the MIMO radar; (2) performing sequential inertial coherent imaging and compensation on the target area; (3) band-pass filtering along a time dimension; (4) calculating the position of the surface of the thorax of the living body; (5) removing clutter and direct current bias; (6) taking phases to obtain vital sign signals; (7) the respiratory and heartbeat signals are separated. (8) Detecting the peak values of the respiration and heartbeat signals, and calculating the instantaneous respiration rate and the heart rate; (9) sliding time window dynamic measurements. The invention can be used for carrying out three-dimensional positioning and vital sign measurement on trapped people in ruins and buildings, has high signal processing gain, high positioning precision and good real-time performance, and can realize instantaneous respiration rate and heart rate measurement.

title_en: Subway foundation pit construction pipeline subsides monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline settlement monitoring, and discloses a subway foundation pit construction pipeline settlement monitoring device which comprises a base, wherein the base is provided with a guide rail hoisting assembly and a guide rail overturning assembly, the guide rail hoisting assembly is provided with a guide rail formed by butt joint combination of multiple sections, the guide rail is parallel to the side wall of a subway foundation pit and extends downwards, the tail end of the guide rail is provided with a vertically-displaced lift car, and one side of the lift car facing the subway foundation pit is provided with a ground penetrating radar. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the device is not contacted with the pipeline, the pipeline is not damaged, a plurality of pipelines with different depths can be scanned in the vertical movement process of the ground penetrating radar, the guide rail can be butted and prolonged, the pipeline with larger buried depth can be monitored, the laser target and the laser range finder are adopted to realize accurate perception of elevation, the vertical position of the laser target is maintained by the liquid level in the static level, a stable measuring reference surface can be provided, and the accuracy of settlement monitoring is ensured.

title_en: Millimeter wave and thermal imaging fusion face shielding detection method and system for bedridden personnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave and thermal imaging fusion face shielding detection method and system for bedridden personnel, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting a target based on ADC (analog-to-digital converter) original data so as to detect the position of the target and extracting vital signs of the target; extracting the temperature of a face area of a target based on temperature matrix data, carrying out temperature distribution entropy calculation on the temperature of the face area to obtain a distribution entropy calculation result, carrying out sign abnormality judgment on the target based on vital signs to obtain a judgment result, carrying out distribution abnormality judgment on the target through the distribution entropy calculation result to obtain a judgment result, carrying out weighted probability fusion on the judgment result and the judgment result to obtain the shielding probability of the target, judging whether the shielding probability exceeds a preset value, and if so, triggering an alarm. The invention can effectively monitor the sign of the target and whether the face is blocked under different conditions, and can also monitor the target under the premise of not invading the privacy of the target.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using a kalman filter
Physiological signal analysis system, and method using the same
title_ko: 생체신호 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-signal analysis system and method are provided to measure a bio-signal of examinee more accurately by providing the bio-signal analysis system that consists of a bio-signal sensor and a terminal expressed the bio-signal measured at from the bio-signal sensor. CONSTITUTION: A bio-signal sensor(100) senses and transmits the bio-signal of examinee. The bio-signal sensor comprises a power supply unit(110) supplying the power, an A/D converter(130) and a sensor unit(120) sensing the bio-signal of examinee. The A/D converter changes an analog bio-signal sensed in the sensor unit to a digital bio-signal. The terminal(200) receives the bio-signal sensed from the bio-signal sensor and stores, analyzes and indicates it.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호분석시스템 및 이를 이용한 거짓말 탐지방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로 피검자의 신체에 부착되어 피검자의 생체신호를 감지 및 전송하는 생체신호감지기 및 상기 생체신호감지기로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신, 저장 및 분석하여 표시하는 단말기로 이루어진 생체신호분석시스템, 및 이를 이용한 거짓말 탐지방법을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 피검자의 신체에 부착되어 피검자의 생체신호를 감지 및 전송하는 생체신호감지기, 및 상기 생체신호감지기로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신, 저장 및 분석하여 표시하는 단말기로 이루어진 생체신호분석시스템을 제공함으로써 피검자의 생체신호를 더욱 정확하게 측정할 수 있고, 피검자 이외의 다수의 제3자가 피검자의 생체신호에 접근하는 것이 가능하며, 나아가 피검자의 생체신호를 사용자의 니즈에 부합하도록 다양하게 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A method of measuring vital signals using a millimeter-wave radar sensor system includes performing a first set of radar measurements using a millimeter-wave radar sensor to produce a first set of radar data; determining a first set of range gate measurements from the first set of radar data; determining high response range gates from the first set of range gate measurements; and extracting vital signal information from the high response range gates.

title_en: Efflux fan anti -drop early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an efflux fan anti -drop early warning device, including typhoon machine, the fan is fixed on the tunnel roof through a plurality of lifting ropes, it leads the chain still to be equipped with a safety between fan and the tunnel roof, lead safely that the chain is parallelly connected to have a force sensor, force sensor and control center signal connection. The upper end of leading safely the chain is connected with pre -buried iron or the anchor assembly on the tunnel roof, the lower extreme of leading safely the chain is connected with the rings at fan top, lead the focus of the extension line of chain through the fan safely. Adopted the utility model discloses an efflux fan anti -drop early warning device, through leading chain and force sensor with establishing a safety, when arbitrary lifting rope fracture, it can play the supplementary function to lead the chain safely, and the pulling force inductor is sent alarm signal by the pull back(PB) and gives control center simultaneously, and the messenger maintenance personal can judge rapidly that which typhoon machine has had the trouble to the on -call maintenance, the emergence of to prevent accidental accident.

title_en: Portable multifunctional rescue instrument for firefighters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue instruments, in particular to a portable multifunctional rescue instrument for firemen, which comprises a shell, wherein an infrared life detection instrument is arranged inside the shell, a gas detection instrument is arranged on the right side of the shell, a handle is arranged below the shell, and an outer sleeve is arranged outside the handle; the portable multifunctional rescue instrument for the firefighter is provided with the infrared life detection instrument, the gas detection instrument, the outer sleeve and the like, namely, the rescue instrument is fixed on an arm through the outer sleeve during fire rescue, when the life characteristics are detected, the infrared life detection instrument vibrates and sends out a prompt sound, and when harmful gas is detected, the gas detection instrument vibrates and sends out the prompt sound; the design changes the condition that the traditional infrared life detection instrument and the gas detection instrument occupy more space to affect rescue, the rescue is conveniently fixed on the arm according to actual conditions, and the fire fighter can conveniently carry out rescue work.

title_en: Communication optical cable line damage emergency alarm induction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication optical cable line damage emergency warning induction device, which comprises an optical cable line main body buried under the ground and a protection line arranged above the optical cable line main body, wherein the optical cable line main body and the protection line are axially parallel to each other, a plurality of fastener structures which are uniformly distributed are arranged on the optical cable line main body, a first supporting rod and a second supporting rod are respectively and fixedly connected on the upper sides of two adjacent fastener structures, a through hole for passing the protection line is arranged at the top end of the first supporting rod, a tension sensor which is mutually connected with the protection line is arranged at the upper end of the second supporting rod, a vertical rod which penetrates out of the ground is fixedly connected at the top end of the second supporting rod, the communication optical cable line can be prevented from being damaged and emergency warning through the cooperation of a wireless transmitter, an alarm, the protection line and the tension sensor, and the like, and can effectively prevent and protect the communication optical cable line, the solar cell panel can collect solar energy and convert the solar energy into electric energy, and is energy-saving and environment-friendly.

title_en: Microwave life detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microwave life detection instrument relates to life detection technical field, including detection instrument display screen and microwave detection head body, the bottom fixed mounting of detection instrument display screen has the fixed plate, the left side of fixed plate is provided with probe adjustment mechanism, the right side of fixed plate is provided with hand heating mechanism, probe adjustment mechanism includes electric telescopic handle, electric telescopic handle fixed mounting is in the left side of fixed plate. The utility model discloses a work that control electric telescopic handle extends or contracts can be adjusted the stretching out position of microwave detecting head body, and control step motor work drives the ring rotation through the link, and it is rotatory to drive the microwave detecting head body simultaneously, lasts the detection angle who changes the microwave detecting head body, realizes the function that the automation was adjusted the microwave detecting head body promptly, reduces operator's physical demands, promotes the efficiency that the life was surveyed, increases the convenience of this device.

title_en: High safe type radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the radar detection instrument technique and specifically relates to a high safe type radar life detection instrument, including the mounting bracket main part, the inboard fixedly connected with dead lever of mounting bracket main part, the top of mounting bracket main part is equipped with the battery, the inboard swing joint of dead lever has the telescopic link, the top fixedly connected with installation piece of telescopic link, the top fixedly connected with locking ring of dead lever, the external thread groove has been seted up in the outside of locking ring, the one end of installation piece is connected with the universal joint, the one end of universal joint is connected with the platform, the bumper shock absorber is installed to the bottom of dead lever, the base is installed to the bottom of bumper shock absorber, the utility model discloses in, through setting up telescopic link, external thread groove, universal joint, tong-jaw, a section of thick bamboo and platform soon to the realization supports the adjustment that different height carries out radar detection angle to four angles of detection instrument, shortens search and rescue time, improves search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: LVCHUANG WUHAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor biological sensing equipment based on UWB radar
abstract_en: The application discloses indoor biological sensing equipment based on UWB radar, which comprises a shell, a main control board, a UWB radar sensing module (used for transmitting pulse signals and receiving reflected signals, detecting vital signs of a human body such as respiration/heartbeat waveforms and motion tracks, with accuracy reaching centimeter level), a camera (triggering video recording according to need only when abnormality occurs to acquire visual data), and a wireless communication module (transmitting data and receiving instructions). The intelligent algorithm suppresses metal reflection and multipath interference, and improves the falling recognition rate to more than 92%. The wireless communication pushes the alarm in real time, realizes non-contact sensing, solves the problems that privacy of traditional monitoring is revealed, the wearable equipment depends on user cooperation and the millimeter wave radar false alarm rate is high, and obviously enhances the solitary safety of the old.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINGTONGMING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expansive soil slope seepage instability prediction method and system and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method, a system and terminal equipment for predicting the seepage instability of an expansive soil side slope, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a key factor of the seepage instability of the expansive soil side slope; establishing an expansive soil slope instability model based on the key factors; calculating to obtain a critical state value of the instability of the expansive soil slope based on the instability model of the expansive soil slope; obtaining the displacement change rate of the expansive soil through a sensor pre-buried in the expansive soil; judging a target instability risk interval and a target expansion displacement grade of the expansive soil slope according to the expansive soil displacement change rate and the critical state value; and obtaining a prediction result of the seepage instability of the expansive soil slope according to the target instability risk interval and the target expansion displacement grade. The target risk interval and the target expansion displacement grade are combined, the stability of the expansive soil slope is judged, and the judgment result is more accurate.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;CHINA WATER RESOURCES BEIFANG INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Fine-granularity respiration waveform reconstruction method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and discloses a fine-granularity respiration waveform reconstruction method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: setting radar parameters and collecting data, processing the data by utilizing a two-dimensional Fourier transform to obtain a time-distance-azimuth radar matrix, removing reflected signals of static objects in the time-distance-azimuth radar matrix by utilizing a loop filter, positioning a human body region by utilizing a 2D-CFAR algorithm, performing rotation processing on I/Q components in the human body region, performing label normalization processing and data set division, constructing an IQ-transducer model, inputting radar data to be predicted into a trained network model, and realizing fine-granularity respiration monitoring. The invention is responsible for extracting and encoding the breath-related hidden features from the I/Q component of the radar data by designing an IQ-transducer model, and finally recovering the fine-granularity respiration waveform from the hidden features.

title_en: Animal vital sign monitoring devices under different states
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an animal vital sign monitoring device under different states, belongs to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. This animal vital sign monitoring device under different states includes: the biological radar module is used for acquiring physical sign data of the target animal based on radar signals; the state identification module is used for identifying the target state of the target animal according to the sign data; the data processing module is used for obtaining the sign information of the target animal based on the sign data and the target state; and the environmental parameter adjusting module is used for adjusting the environmental parameters of the target animal based on the sign information. The problem that traditional animal vital sign monitoring accuracy is poor can be solved to this disclosure.

title_en: Non-contact respiration state monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact respiration state monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, and belongs to the technical field of non-contact human vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting radar echo signals of a human body target by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, obtaining a phase sequence through frequency mixing, filtering and phase demodulation, extracting respiratory signals through phase unwrapping and displacement conversion, carrying out Fourier transformation on the respiratory signals, calculating respiratory frequency and amplitude, adopting various slope extraction algorithms to derive the respiratory signals in inspiration and expiration phases to obtain respiratory slopes, and finally integrating the respiratory frequency, the amplitude and the slope, setting a threshold value and a scoring system, and realizing rapid and accurate assessment of respiratory distress degree. The method does not need to contact with human body, can penetrate clothes, is suitable for various scenes such as clinical monitoring, emergency diagnosis and the like, and has the advantages of simplicity and convenience in operation, strong instantaneity and high reliability.

title_en: Appratus for Biological Signals Measurement of Textile base
title_ko: 텍스타일 기반의 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile. By attaching a sensor formed with textile to gloves and the like worn by an inspection target, the apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile is to measure biological signals in which the inspection target is unaware that the sensor is attached thereonto, when the inspection target wears the gloves and the like. Also, by providing with a GSR measuring sensor in a textile form to gloves worn by winter sports athletes, the apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile is to analyze GSR signals measured in a state that the inspection target is unrestricted and unconscious, thereby monitoring a psychological state. To this end, the apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile comprises: a textile electrode for measuring electrical signals by coming into contact with skin of an inspection target; a signal processing unit for extracting properties of corresponding biological signals by receiving input of electrical signals measured by the textile electrode and for processing signals; and a wireless transmission unit for storing or wirelessly transmitting the extracted and signal-processed biological signals from the signal processing unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 본 발명은 텍스타일 기반의 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것으로, 센서를 텍스타일로 구성하여 피검자의 장갑 등에 부착하고, 피검자가 착용시 이를 자각하지 못하는 상태에서 생체신호를 측정할 수 있도록 하며, 동계스포츠 운동선수의 장갑에 텍스타일 형태의 GSR측정센서를 구비하여, 피검자가 무구속 무자각 상태에서 측정된 GSR신호를 분석하여 피검자의 심리상태를 모니터링 하도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다.  
상기 목적은 피검자의 피부에 접촉하여 전기신호를 측정하는 직물전극; 상기 직물전극으로부터 측정된 전기신호를 입력받아 해당 생체신호의 특징을 추출 및 신호처리하는 신호처리부; 및 상기 신호처리부로부터 추출 및 신호처리된 생체신호를 저장 또는 무선으로 전송하는 무선송신부;를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire spread prevention and fire suppression apparatus for electric vehicle parking facility
title_ko: 전기차 주차시설 화재 확산방지 및 진압 장치
abstract_en: An object to be achieved by the present invention is to provide a fire spread prevention and suppression device for an electric vehicle parking facility, which is specialized for an electric vehicle to quickly suppress a fire. The fire spread prevention and suppression device for an electric vehicle parking facility comprises: a sensor unit for detecting whether a fire has occurred in a vehicle being charged through an electric charging facility for a vehicle; a control unit for generating a control signal for controlling the installation of a flame retardant fabric, a driving signal for controlling the driving of a water barrier, and a turn-on signal for controlling the on/off of a fire extinguishing water supply nozzle; the flame retardant fabric descending from a ceiling to a floor in response to the control signal to block the inflow of air into a surrounding space of the vehicle when a fire occurring in the vehicle is detected; the water barrier protruding from the buried floor toward the ceiling by a predetermined height in response to the driving signal to seal the surrounding space under the vehicle; and the fire extinguishing water supply nozzle for supplying fire extinguishing water to the surrounding space under the vehicle sealed by the water barrier in response to the turn-on signal to submerge a battery installed in the vehicle. According to the present invention, the fire spread prevention and suppression device for an electric vehicle parking facility can prevent the spread of a fire to people, other parked vehicles and charging facilities around a vehicle in which a fire has occurred by quickly installing a flame retardant fabric around the vehicle when the fire occurrence in the vehicle being charged through an electric charging facility is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 전기차 주차시설 화재 확산방지 및 진압 장치는 차량용 전기 충전 설비가 설치된 공간의 천장에 설치되어, 상기 차량용 전기 충전 설비를 통해 충전중인 차량에 대한 화재 발생 여부를 감지하고, 감지 결과를 제어부로 전송하는 센서부, 상기 센서부로부터 상기 차량에 대한 화재 발생 감지 여부를 나타내는 적어도 하나의 센싱신호를 수신하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 센싱신호에 응답하여 난연포의 설치를 제어하는 제어신호, 차수벽의 구동을 제어하는 구동신호 및 소화수 공급노즐의 온오프를 제어하는 턴온신호를 각각 생성하는 제어부, 상기 센서부가 상기 차량에 대한 화재 발생 감지 시, 상기 제어신호에 응답하여 상기 천장으로부터 바닥으로 하강하여 상기 차량의 주변 공간 내 공기 유입을 차단시키는 난연포, 상기 차량의 주변을 둘러싸도록 바닥에 매립되고, 상기 차량에 대한 화재 발생 감지 시, 상기 구동신호에 응답하여 매립된 바닥으로부터 천장 방향으로 소정 높이 돌출하여 상기 차량의 하부 주변 공간을 밀폐시키는 차수벽 및 상기 바닥 상에 설치되고, 상기 턴온신호에 응답하여 상기 차수벽에 의해 밀폐된 상기 차량의 하부 주변 공간으로 소화수를 공급하여, 상기 차량 내 설치된 배터리를 침수시키는 소화수 공급노즐을 포함한다.

title_en: Contactless sensor-driven device, system, and method enabling ambient health monitoring and predictive assessment
abstract_en: An ambient monitoring device includes a housing, contactless sensors coupled to the housing, and a processing device disposed in the housing. The processing device is coupled to the contactless sensors. The processing device is to receive, from one or more contactless sensors of the plurality of contactless sensors, historical sensor data. The processing device is further to determine baseline vital signs based on the historical sensor data. The processing device is further to receive, from the one or more contactless sensors, current sensor data associated with a user that is within a threshold distance of the ambient monitoring device without contacting the ambient monitoring device. The processing device is further to determine, based on the current sensor data, current vital signs of the user. Responsive to determining the current vital signs do not meet the baseline vital signs, the processing device is to provide an alert.

title_en: Sensor head
abstract_en: Detection systems for scanning regions are disclosed. The detection systems may be used to detect various objects that are, for example, buried in the ground or obscured by being hidden on the body of a person. The detection systems include a sensor head having a continuous wave metal detector (CWMD) coil, radar antennas, and a transceiver electrically connected to a radar. The radar includes a transmit antenna configured to transmit electromagnetic radiation, and a receive antenna configured to sense electromagnetic radiation.

title_en: Underground Radar Device and Measuring Method
abstract_en: A ground penetrating radar device of the present embodiment is a manually operable device, in which encoders are attached to axles of three wheels that are mutually displaced by 120 degrees. A control unit calculates, from rotation amounts measured by the encoders, the moving direction, moving distance, moving speed vector, and turning vector of the ground penetrating radar device. A measurement unit searches for an underground buried object with radio wave. A storage unit stores a two-dimensional measurement data set, in which positional information and moving direction of the ground penetrating radar device calculated by the control unit is associated with measurement data obtained by a radar measurement unit. A display unit displays a facility map indicating the position where an underground structure is present, which is stored in a database, together with the measurement data while superimposing the facility map and the measurement data one on the other.

title_en: Biological information acquisition device and biological information acquisition method
abstract_en: A biological information acquisition device includes a detection-value acquisition unit to acquire a detection value from a non-contact biometric sensor, a vital measurement unit to measure a vital sign of a target person (TP) using the detection value, an image-data acquisition unit to acquire image data indicating an image captured by a camera, an image processing unit to perform at least one of a state estimation process of estimating a state of the target person, an attribute estimation process of estimating an attribute of the target person, or a personal identification process of identifying the target person by performing image processing on the image captured including the target person, and a parameter setting unit to set a parameter in measuring the vital sign in accordance with a result of the image processing.

title_en: Data pre-processing method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A data pre-processing method is provided. By using an energy distribution parameter set obtained through beamforming scanning, a signal-to-noise ratio of a signal can be improved and a detection range region can be automatically generated, thereby improving an object tracking effect. An exercise vital sign detection radar is also provided.

title_en: Method for human only activity detection based on radar signals
abstract_en: A method of detecting human presence includes using a radar sensor to monitor a space, and receiving an output signal from the radar sensor. A Fourier transform is performed on the output signal to produce a signal spectrum. It is decided whether the output signal is indicative of human activity dependent upon at least one acoustic feature of the signal spectrum and at least one spectral feature of the signal spectrum.

title_en: Post-earthquake life sign detection search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-earthquake life sign detection, search and rescue system, which comprises: the system comprises a Zigbee node detection device, a Zigbee router, a Zigbee coordinator, a server and a mobile terminal; the Zigbee nodes build a network by themselves; the Zigbee node is provided with a node detection device, the node detection device transmits the acquired data to a local server, and the local server identifies the geographical position of the Zigbee node detection device on a map; the mobile terminal accesses the server, and the mobile terminal acquires the Zigbee node displaying the life signs and detects the geographical position of the Zigbee node. The post-earthquake life sign detection, search and rescue system takes a ZigBee ad hoc network as a core, detects whether life signs exist or not by an infrared heat release human body detection sensor and an audio signal detection sensor on the nodes by broadcasting the ZigBee nodes in the air, and has the advantages of small investment, high detection efficiency and precious rescue time.

title_en: Wall penetrating radar remote assistance system and method based on WiFi (wireless fidelity) safety communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar remote assistance system and a through-wall radar remote assistance method based on WiFi (wireless fidelity) secure communication, comprising the following steps: the transmitting antenna of the through-wall radar device can transmit ultra-wideband electromagnetic waves, penetrate through the wall body and shoot on a personnel target after the wall body, and the receiving antenna receives the reflected ultra-wideband electromagnetic waves to extract personnel target information; the system comprises at least one wireless network module, a remote assistance system center and a remote assistance system center, wherein the wireless network module is connected with the through-wall radar device, and the through-wall radar device uploads detected personnel target information to the remote assistance system center through the wireless network module; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the remote assistance system solves the problem that the through-wall radar device needs to remotely assist in judging under the complex combat environment, and the wireless network communication based on the WPA is adopted between the remote assistance system and the through-wall radar device, so that the safety is high, the transmission distance is long, and the universality is high.

title_en: Multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal detection method for FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal detection method for an FMCW radar, which comprises the following steps: constructing a matrix R (m, n) according to a frame period for the radar intermediate frequency signal, and respectively performing FFT on each frame of data in the R (m, n) to obtain a time distance matrix D (p, n); detecting the front N1 row data of D (p, N) by utilizing a constant false alarm rate to obtain potential distances of a plurality of targets; clustering potential distances of a plurality of targets in the N1 columns by using a K-means algorithm to obtain rough distances of K targets, and determining the distance ranges of the K targets; for each column of data in D (p, n), searching peak values in K distance ranges to obtain K target distance values, and calculating phases of K target positions; and (3) carrying out unwrapping and difference on K target phases in the N columns of data, and carrying out filtering separation to obtain respiration and heartbeat signals of the K targets. The method can overcome clutter influence and quickly obtain rough positions of a plurality of targets; the detection accuracy of respiratory and heartbeat signals is improved, and the method is suitable for detecting multi-target vital signs in a complex environment.

title_en: Error correction method for random body movement of target in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an error correction method for random body movement of targets in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection, which comprises the steps of separating signals of each target from radar echo signals; tracking echo signals in each target detection time; correcting respiratory heartbeat detection errors caused by random body movement of the target during detection based on a distance alignment and phase compensation algorithm; extracting a phase signal of a target, and decomposing the phase signal into N modes by using a successive variation mode decomposition algorithm; and identifying K modules corresponding to the vital signs, and reconstructing respiratory signals and heartbeat signals according to the K modules. The method can realize the simultaneous detection of the vital signs of a plurality of targets in the radar visual field range; the detection error caused by random movement of the target body in the radar detection process is corrected; the respiratory heartbeat signal of the target is extracted by adopting the successive variation modal decomposition algorithm, the number of modalities is not required to be set in advance, and the convergence speed is higher compared with that of the variation modal decomposition algorithm.

title_en: Human vital sign radar signal processing method and device based on sliding singular spectrum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, and provides a human vital sign radar signal processing method and device based on a sliding singular spectrum, wherein the human vital sign radar signal processing method based on the sliding singular spectrum comprises the following steps: acquiring a physical sign vibration signal, and dividing the physical sign vibration signal into a plurality of signal segments based on a sliding window; carrying out singular spectrum analysis on each signal segment to obtain a reconstruction subsequence corresponding to each signal segment; and determining target sub-fragments of the signal fragments, and combining the reconstructed sub-sequences corresponding to the target sub-fragments to obtain the target sign vibration signal. The invention improves the efficiency of signal processing by reconstructing after segmentation, ensures the accuracy and reliability of analysis results, and is suitable for analyzing long-time sign monitoring data.

title_en: Driver Personalized Negative Emotion Discrimination System using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 운전자 개인 맞춤형 부정적 감정 판별 시스템
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 운전자 개인 맞춤형 부정적 감정 판별 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 운전자 감정 판별 시스템은, 운전석에 설치되어 생체신호를 비접촉식으로 획득하는 레이더 및 레이더에서 획득된 생체신호를 분석하여, 운전자의 부정적 감정을 판별하는 단말을 포함한다. 이에 의해, 부정적 감정으로 판별시 높은 상관관계를 갖는 난폭운전과 법규위반 등의 확률을 줄이는 서비스를 제공함으로써 사용자의 만족도를 향상시킬 수 있게 된다.

title_en: A kind of intelligent safety and defence system and its control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent safety and defence systems, including the master control panel for laying and withdrawing a garrison for security system, access control module, fire alarm module, burglar alarm module, natural gas alarm module and server terminal, the master control panel, access control module, fire alarm module, burglar alarm module, natural gas alarm module is communicated to connect with server terminal, it is characterized by also including intelligent fire fighting modules, escape truck module and natural gas leaking processing module, radar life-detection instrument is additionally provided in the burglar alarm module, the intelligent fire fighting module, escape truck module and natural gas leaking processing module are communicated to connect with server terminal.Beneficial effects of the present invention: the ability of intelligent safety and defence system emergency processing is imparted, mitigation processing can be carried out to scene first before human intervention, security performance is effectively promoted, while the phenomenon that burglar alarm is reported by mistake is greatly reduced, and intelligence degree is high.
assignees: NINGBO JIAKAI ZERO POINT ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life searching method and system based on Multi-sensor Fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life searching method and system based on Multi-sensor Fusion obtain the sensing data sequence group acquired by each sensor module method includes the following steps: several sensor modules are arranged with setpoint frequency；Pretreatment neural network based is carried out to the sensing data sequence group, the life for forming respective sensor mould group detects preliminary probability output；Using each preliminary probability output as the input all the way of deep neural network, is spliced and merged via several preliminary probability outputs of the deep neural network to several sensor modules, and export final probability value existing for life.Signals filtering method and system of the invention is based on multiple sensor modules and acquires a variety of environmental informations, and using the life detection data under deep neural network anastomosing and splicing varying environment information, the robustness and accuracy rate for detecting life have an interim raising.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: False alarm eliminating method for handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: A false alarm eliminating method for a handheld through-wall radar comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring strong reflection point distance information; detecting the internal area of the building through a handheld one-dimensional through-wall radar detection system, acquiring a strong reflection point signal in the building, and solving the distance information of the strong reflection point; step S2: acquiring target point distance information; simultaneously acquiring target signals of an internal area of a building through a through-wall radar, and solving target point distance information; step S3: matching the characteristics; matching the obtained distance information of the target point signal of the internal area of the building with the obtained distance information of the strong reflection point of the internal area of the building to obtain a target signal with matched characteristics, filtering false alarms and counting; step S4: matching results; and matching the real-time target detection result with the false alarm statistical result to further eliminate the false alarm. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, good real-time performance and high efficiency, and can effectively inhibit false alarms caused by the distribution of the internal structure of the building.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Elliptical cross target positioning method for one-transmitting and double-receiving through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ellipse cross positioning method suitable for a transmitting-receiving platform through-wall radar. The method can effectively eliminate the false points which may occur in the multi-target detection of the one-and-two-receiving platform through-wall radar, and improve the positioning accuracy of the radar system. Compared with the traditional double-ellipse cross positioning algorithm, the method can effectively prevent the problem of false point interference which is easy to occur in the positioning of the first-sending and second-receiving platform through-wall radar, avoids the limitation that more than 3 receivers are needed in the past, saves the actual research and development cost, improves the service performance of the first-sending and second-receiving platform through-wall radar in the actual environment, and is beneficial to the actual application of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method based on wall low-rank sparse constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on wall low-rank sparse constraint, which utilizes two important characteristics of signals in through-wall radar imaging: the invention converts the problems of wall clutter suppression and target reconstruction into a regularized least square optimization problem, wherein the target function comprises a data fidelity (least square) term, a nuclear norm regularization term and a sum of l 1 Norm punishment item, realizes the integrated processing of wall clutter suppression and target imaging, separates out wall clutter in iterative cycle, and simultaneously carries out the pairThe target signal is subjected to reconstruction imaging, and the imaging quality is improved.

title_en: Respiration detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a respiration detection method and a respiration detection device, relates to the technical field of radar detection, and is used for improving the accuracy of respiration detection. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target space and acquiring echo signals of M channels; processing the echo signals of the M channels to obtain breathing characteristic signals of the target human body of the M channels; processing the breathing characteristic signals of the target human body of the M channels to obtain cross-correlation entropies corresponding to the target human body; performing Fourier transform on the cross-correlation entropy to obtain a cross-power spectrum; and determining the respiratory frequency of the target human body according to the cross-power spectrum.
assignees: QINGDAO HISENSE HITACHI AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted life detection method, related device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a vehicle-mounted life detection method, a related device and a storage medium. Under the condition of vehicle state change, switching the working mode of the vehicle-mounted radar, transmitting radar signals into the vehicle based on the vehicle-mounted radar and receiving echo signals thereof, and performing signal processing on the echo signals to obtain moving state parameters of the targets, wherein the moving state parameters comprise at least one of the distance from the targets to radar signal transmitting points, the distance change rate, the azimuth, the height and the phase, a life detection algorithm module corresponding to the working mode of the vehicle-mounted radar is called, and the moving state parameters are input into the life detection algorithm module to perform life detection on the targets so as to trigger corresponding auxiliary functions of the vehicle according to life detection results, thereby reducing hardware integration difficulty and cost, improving detection precision and reliability and reducing privacy leakage.
assignees: HANGZHOU SHENGDEWEI INTEGRATED CIRCUIT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground radar system achieving three-dimensional display
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar system capable of accurately detecting a position and a direction of an underground radar apparatus and capable of acquiring accurate investigation data corresponding to the position of the underground radar apparatus.SOLUTION: An underground radar system includes: an underground radar apparatus 1 allowed to be moved along a ground surface to investigate an underground buried object; a marker member 13 including at least three light-emitting elements 14 attached to the underground radar apparatus 1; a camera 17 for photographing an investigation area of the underground radar apparatus 1; a position measuring apparatus 2 for detecting a position of the underground radar apparatus 1 on the basis of an image of the marker member 13 photographed by the camera 17; a database 24 for storing position information of the underground radar apparatus 1 detected by the position measuring apparatus 2 and investigation data acquired by the underground radar apparatus in association with each other; and an image display part 21 for displaying an investigation image on the basis of the investigation data and the position information stored in the database 24.
assignees: TOHOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO;DITECT KK;NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for nondestructive survey at recessed corner of concrete structure using electromagnetic wave radar
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for nondestructive survey at a recessed corner of a concrete structure using an electromagnetic wave radar, with which it is possible to nondestructively survey a buried object or a space arranged at a recessed corner of the concrete structure that has hitherto been a blind spot.SOLUTION: At a recessed corner 2 of a concrete structure 1 is arranged a wedge-shaped electromagnetic wave propagating substance 20 having a dielectric constant of 6-9, having a slope 21 ascending toward the recessed corner 2 and having no reflecting element inside, and an electromagnetic wave radar device 10 is run along the slope 21 of the wedge-shaped electromagnetic wave propagating substance 20, whereby a buried object 4 or a vacant space 3 located at the recessed corner 2 of the concrete structure 1 is surveyed by radiating an electromagnetic wave to the concrete structure 1 in such a way that an electromagnetic wave propagating axis 14 is diagonal to a surface 6 of the concrete structure 1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Portable mri apparatus
title_ko: 포터블 ｍｒｉ 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A portable MRI apparatus is provided to supply a spatial selection saturation without influencing an integral value of a gradient magnetic field in 1TR(repetition time). CONSTITUTION: A main magnetic field coil unit(102) forms a magnetic field in an inner space of a magnet system(100). A gradient coil unit(106) generates three gradient magnetic fields. A signal obtaining device obtains a magnetic resonance signal by supplying a gradient magnetic pulse and an RF pulse to an object. An image reconstructing device(170) reconstructs an image based on the obtained magnetic resonance signal. A controller device(160) controls the signal obtaining device and the image reconstructing device. [Reference numerals] (1) Object; (100) Magnet system; (102) Parking lot coil unit; (106) Gradient coil unit; (108) RF coil unit; (110) Heartbeat detector unit; (112) Heartbeat sensor; (130) Gradient driver unit; (140) RF driver unit; (150) Data collector unit; (160) Sequence controller unit; (170) Data processing unit; (180) Display unit; (190) Operation console unit; (500) Cradle
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 1TR내의 구배 자장의 적분값에 영향을 미치지 않고서 선택 포화를 행하는 포토블 MRI 장치를 제공한다. 포터블 MRI 장치는 정자장, 구배 자장 펄스 및 RF 펄스를 대상에 인가하여 자기 공명 신호를 획득하는 신호 획득 장치와, 획득된 자기 공명 신호에 근거하여 화상을 재구성하는 화상 재구성 장치(170)와, 그러한 두 개의 장치를 제어하는 제어기 장치(160)를 포함한다. 제어기 장치(160)는 신호 획득 장치에게, 선택 포화를 위한 구배 자장 펄스 및 RF 펄스를 복수회 인가한 후, 신호 획득을 위한 구배 자장 펄스 및 RF 펄스를 인가하도록 지시한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting emergency with wearable devices
title_ko: 웨어러블 기기를 이용한 응급 상황 감지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for detecting an emergency situation using a wearable device, and a device therefor. The method for detecting an emergency situation comprises the steps of: allowing a wearable device to collect a user′s biometric signal through a sensor; determining whether the user′s biometric signal satisfies a predetermined normal criterion; transmitting, when the user′s biometric does not satisfy the predetermined criterion, a first notification signal to inform the user terminal of an emergency situation; outputting, when the user terminal receives the first notification signal, a screen for requesting a user confirmation input for an emergency situation in response to the first notification signal; allowing the user terminal to transmit a second notification signal for informing the emergency situation to a predetermined target when it is determined that the emergency situation has occurred based on the request result. According to the present invention, it is possible to monitor and determine an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 기기를 이용한 응급 상황 감지 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  응급 상황 감지 방법은 웨어러블 기기가 센서를 통해 사용자의 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호가 미리 정해진 정상 기준을 만족시키는지 여부를 판단하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호가 미리 정해진 기준을 만족시키지 않는 경우, 사용자 단말에 응급 상황을 알리기 위한 제1 알림 신호를 전송하는 단계, 사용자 단말이  제1 알림 신호를 수신하는 경우, 제1 알림 신호에 응답하여 응급 상황에 대한 사용자 확인 입력을 요청하는 화면을 출력하는 단계 및 요청 결과에 기초하여 응급 상황이 발생한 것으로 결정된 경우, 사용자 단말이 응급 상황을 알리기 위한 제2 알림 신호를 미리 설정된 대상에게 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA POLYTECHNIC UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: System and method for detection of buried objects
abstract_en: A system for detecting buried objects or threats is described. Radiation is detected from a target area by at least two wavelength radiation band sensors. The radiation emitted by the target area is detected by suitable detectors and processed using suitable signal processing means together with statistical data processing methods such that an image of the target area is produced capable of showing buried objects in the target area.
assignees: SELEX GALILEO LTD;LEPLEY JASON;BRAY MARK EDGAR;AVERILL MICHAEL

title_en: Detection system and detection method of vital sign
abstract_en: A detection system (10) and a detection method of vital sign are provided. The method includes: transmitting a first radio frequency (RF) signal and receiving a first radar signal corresponding to the first RF signal by a first radar (210, 220, 230, or 240); performing IQ-demodulation on the first radar signal to obtain a first receiving in-phase component and a first receiving quadrature component; performing a first convolution operation to the first receiving in-phase component and a first symbol and performing a multiply accumulate (MAC) operation to a first result of the first convolution operation to obtain a first accumulated value; performing a second convolution operation to the first receiving quadrature component and the first symbol and performing a MAC operation to a second result of the second convolution operation to obtain a second accumulated value; and generating a vital sign according to the first and the second accumulated value.

title_en: Wearable device having an attachable and detachable sensor for detecting a biological signal and method of controlling wearable device
title_ko: 생체 신호를 검출하는 센서를 착탈할 수 있는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 검출하는 센서를 쉽게 착탈할 수 있는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Emergency situation detection system in private space based on lidar sensor
title_ko: 라이더 센서 기반 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 라이더 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 라이더 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 라이더 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 라이더 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for contactless vital sign monitoring via calculating displacement signal by applying adaptive nonlinear least squares method
abstract_en: A method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system that includes a transmitter, a receiver, and processing device. The transmitter irradiates a body region of a person with radar radiation, the receiver generates a receiver signal from reflected radiation from the body region, and the processing device generates, for each of a plurality of processing windows, a displacement signal based on the receiver signal. The displacement signal characterizes a body motion having, as oscillating motions, a breathing motion and a heartbeat motion, and calculates an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillating motion. The processing device applies an adaptive Nonlinear Least Squares method to calculate a plurality of frequency estimates, each of which corresponds to one of a plurality of harmonics of a first oscillating motion, wherein the processing device calculates a first estimated fundamental frequency for the first oscillating motion based on the frequency estimates.

title_en: Firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device
abstract_en: The invention provides a firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device which comprises portable terminals, visual terminals and a server. Heart rate, respiration rate, temperature, gesture and acceleration sensors and Bluetooth modules are integrated with the portable terminals, and important physiological data of firefighters can be monitored by the sign sensors in real time. The visual terminals are provided with portable display screens of Android systems and can be in data connection with the portable terminals, information of signs, positions and the like can be displayed in real time, and position and state information of the firefighters and teammates can be queried in real time. The server is provided with interface programs and B/S (browser/server) architecture browser programs. Data transmitted by the visual terminals can be parsed by the interface programs and can be stored in local databases according to fixed formats. Interactive interfaces which can be updated in real time can be remotely provided by the B/S architecture browser programs for command staffs, and the sign and position information of the firefighters can be queried in real time. The firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device has the advantages that the multiple firefighters in fire scenes can be monitored in real time, and accordingly the safety can be effectively guaranteed.

title_en: A kind of multiple target life detection method and detection radar based on radar signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multiple target life detection method and detection radar based on radar signal carry out the accumulated time on slow time orientation to pretreated echo-signal, obtain first echo signal；Inflection point envelope extraction is carried out to the first echo signal, obtains second echo signal；Seek the average value of all amplitude signals in the second echo signal in addition to the M label amplitude signal；If the ratio of the label amplitude signal and the average value is greater than threshold value, marking has inanimate object at the corresponding radar range of amplitude signal；Life detection method provided by the invention is normalized radar signal amplitude using method for normalizing in fast time (distance) dimension, it solves the problems, such as the energy attenuation that increase of the radar signal in transmission process with distance generates, effectively reduces the misdetection rate of remote target；Using the method for inflection point envelope extraction twice, multiple target axial direction recognition accuracy is improved.

title_en: Multi-target respiration heart rate monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave radar-based multi-target respiration heart rate monitoring method and system, wherein a millimeter wave radar module is used for detecting the heart rate and the respiration rate in a non-contact manner, so that a complicated contact type monitoring program is avoided, and the privacy of a detected person cannot be violated. Compared with the non-contact detection technology in the prior art, the invention improves the detection precision and greatly enhances the reliability of measurement. According to the invention, the respiration heart rate data of the monitored object is monitored and analyzed in real time through the vital sign monitoring platform, so that sudden unexpected diseases of the monitored object can be prevented, or timely alarm can be realized when sudden situations occur; medical care personnel can timely master the physical sign data of the monitored object through the vital sign monitoring platform, timely evaluate the physical condition of the monitored object and give professional opinions and suggestions; the family members of the monitoring object can acquire the health report form of the monitoring object through the vital sign monitoring platform and nurse the monitoring object according to the professional guidance suggestions.

title_en: Rotatable distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses rotatable distributed radar life detection positioning equipment which comprises more than two independent radar units, wherein each radar unit is provided with a rotating mechanism, and the independent radar units rotate around a fixed shaft through the rotating mechanisms so as to adjust the polarization direction of an antenna. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, simple and convenient operation, wide application range, capability of realizing large-range rapid search and full-polarization target detection and the like.

title_en: In-bed human body respiration and heart rate monitoring equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of physiological signal detection, and particularly relates to equipment and a method for monitoring breathing and heart rate of an in-bed human body. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Detecting a target through a radar sensor, and preprocessing a radar signal to obtain a vital sign signal of the target; 2) The method comprises the steps of carrying out weighted accumulation on sweep frequency signal echoes of a plurality of periods in a frame to locate a target unit; 3) The vital sign signals of the target units are subjected to phase unwrapping through an arctangent method; 4) Separating a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal in the vital sign signal through a band-pass filter; 5) Real-time monitoring of the human body is realized based on the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal. Aiming at the breathing behavior of the user in the bed, the invention provides a non-contact multi-mode connection mode, and provides a convenient method for the communication of the sleep detection equipment.
assignees: NEUSOFT HANFENG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical and medical detection system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical detection system based on millimeter wave radar, which relates to the field of medical detection and specifically comprises an antenna end, a radio frequency front end and a digital part, wherein the antenna end comprises a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna, the radio frequency front end comprises a transmitting unit and a receiving unit, the digital part comprises a direct digital frequency synthesizer, a data processing module and a network communication interface, the direct digital frequency synthesizer is respectively connected with the data processing module and the transmitting unit, the transmitting unit is respectively connected with the transmitting antenna and the receiving unit, the receiving unit is also connected with the receiving antenna and the data processing module, and the network communication interface is connected with the data processing module. The invention explores the instantaneity, the accuracy and the full timeliness of the non-induced vital sign detection and ensures the large-scale application of the non-induced detection technology in the medical and nutritional fields.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on multi-layer variational modal decomposition reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring method based on multi-layer variation modal decomposition reconstruction, which comprises the steps of sending radar microwave signals to a target human body, receiving a return path of radar microwave reflection signals, extracting frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave reflection signals, judging whether the current human body is in a resting state according to the radar microwave reflection signals, extracting radar microwave reflection signals in the resting state, carrying out separation reconstruction on respiratory signals and heart rate signals of the radar microwave reflection signals in the resting state to obtain reconstructed respiratory signals and heart rate signals, respectively extracting phase data of the reconstructed respiratory signals and heart rate signals, respectively carrying out wavelet transformation on the phase data of the respiratory signals and heart rate signals to obtain respiratory phase characteristics and heart rate phase characteristics, and calculating respiratory frequency and heart rate according to the respiratory phase characteristics and the heart rate phase characteristics.

title_en: Escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape guiding scheme design, in particular to an escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment.
