Aiming at the defects of path planning, survivor positioning and cutting, dynamic risk response lag and the like in the traditional rescue, vital signs are detected through multi-source sensor fusion, and an optimal rescue path is generated in millisecond-level time by combining real-time coupling simulation of a stress field, a toxic gas diffusion field and a fire disaster thermal flow field of a building structure. The system automatically classifies priorities after detecting the vital body signals, supports the through-wall mode to quickly approach to high-risk survivors, and synchronously optimizes the multi-objective traversal sequence. The guiding path is dynamically projected to a visual field interface of the rescue personnel through the AR equipment, and the heartbeat frequency domain visualization and the risk chromaticity warning are fused. The scheme breaks through the bottleneck of artificial experience decision making, realizes closed loop intelligent response from physical sign perception to path execution, and greatly improves rescue timeliness, target hit rate and action safety in complex disaster environments.
assignees: QINGDAO JUNHAI IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Movement detector for detecting the movement of a breathing activity
abstract_en: To enhance a movement detector for detecting the movement of a body breathing or heartbeat activity comprising a Doppler sensor (11) with a microwave oscillator (2) and at least one mixer (14) in such a manner, that the detector is on the one hand efficient and save with respect to a baby breathing or heartbeat detection and on the other hand a low cost solution, the sensor (11) is performed as sensor unit (13) with a volume less than 100 cm3 and a sending energy lower than 10 mW.

title_en: Rf coil with integrated vital signs detector
abstract_en: It is an object of the invention to provide a radio frequency (RF) transmit- receive coil (1) for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system with an integrated vital signs detector (3) for the detection of vital signs of a patient within the magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, whereby contact sensors directly attached to the body of the patient, are replaced by a contactless system for monitoring vital signs, which makes it much easier to measure vital signs of the patient. The object is achieved by a RF transmit-receive coil (1) comprising a vital signs detector (3) wherein the vital signs detector (3) is integrated in the RF transmit-receive coil (1), wherein a pair of electrically conducting coil elements (4) of the RF transmit-receive coil (1) forms the vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is a capacitive vital signs detector (3), the capacitive vital signs detector (3) being adapted for receiving capacitive vital signs signals. The present invention also concerns a system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a method for operating the system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a software package for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system and a software package for upgrading a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system.

title_en: Buried object identification device, buried object identification method, and exploration device
abstract_en: This buried object identification unit (3) comprises: a synthetic aperture processing unit (13) that when electromagnetic waves are emitted from a plurality of points toward a dielectric material (5) and then electromagnetic waves scattered by the dielectric material (5) or electromagnetic waves scattered by a buried object (6) existing in the dielectric material (5) are received , generates synthetic aperture radar images from wave data representing the respective electromagnetic waves that have been received; a position detection unit (14) that detects a position, at which the buried object (6) exists, on the basis of the intensity of a plurality of pixels constituting the synthetic aperture radar images generated by the synthetic aperture processing unit (13); and a buried object identification unit (15) that extracts a feature amount of a synthetic aperture radar image at the position detected by the position detection unit (14), among the synthetic aperture radar images generated by the synthetic aperture processing unit (13), and identifies, on the basis of the feature amount, whether or not the buried object (6) is a pipeline.

title_en: Passenger detecting method, passenger detecting device, and passenger detecting system
title_ko: 승객 탐지 방법, 승객 탐지 장치, 및 승객 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: A passenger detecting method according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises the steps of: acquiring sensor data resulting from an electromagnetic wave which has been emitted through a radar sensor mounted inside a vehicle, and which is reflected by an object inside the vehicle; acquiring class information related to the status of a seat of the vehicle from the sensor data through a classification model which has finished learning; sensing a biometric signal by analyzing the sensor data; sensing a movement by analyzing the sensor data; and determining whether a passenger is aboard on the basis of the class information, the biometric signal sensing result, and the movement sensing result. The step of acquiring class information related to the status of a seat of the vehicle comprises the steps of: acquiring first initial class information of a first position of the seat of the vehicle through the classification model; acquiring second initial class information of a second position of the seat of the vehicle through the classification model; and operating the class information on the basis of the first initial class information and the second initial class information by using a tree-based classification algorithm.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 승객 탐지 방법은, 차량의 내부에 장착된 레이더 센서(radar sensor)를 통하여 송출된 전자기파가 상기 차량의 내부의 물체에 의해 반사된 센서 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 학습이 완료된 분류 모델(classification model)을 통하여, 상기 센서 데이터로부터 상기 차량의 좌석의 상태(status)와 관련된 클래스 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 센서 데이터를 분석하여 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계; 상기 센서 데이터를 분석하여 움직임을 감지하는 단계; 및 상기 클래스 정보, 생체 신호의 감지 결과, 및 움직임의 감지 결과에 기초하여 승객 탑승 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함하되, 상기 차량의 좌석의 상태(status)와 관련된 클래스 정보를 획득하는 단계는, 상기 분류 모델을 통하여 상기 차량의 좌석의 제1 위치의 제1 초기 클래스 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 분류 모델을 통하여 상기 차량의 좌석의 제2 위치의 제2 초기 클래스 정보를 획득하는 단계; 및 트리 기반 분류 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 초기 클래스 정보 및 상기 제2 초기 클래스 정보에 기초하여 상기 클래스 정보를 연산하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Distributed detection of living beings through walls while in motion
abstract_en: A system comprises: first through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s) configured to sense living being(s) within area at first current location; second through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s) configured to sense living being(s) within area at second current location; first and second inertial navigation systems corresponding to first and second through-wall sensing radar transceivers, wherein first and second inertial navigation systems compute position data relating to first and second current locations; and circuitry configured to: receive first ranging data pertaining to current location of living being(s) relative to first current location from first through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s); receive second ranging data pertaining to current location of living being(s) relative to second current location from second through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s); receive position data relating to first and second current locations from first and/or second inertial navigation systems; and determine current location of living being(s) based on first ranging data, second ranging data, and position data.

title_en: Device and method for assessing, predicting and operating user's health in real time
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards a medical device for assessing, and predicting and operating the user's health by capturing the user's vital signs in real time. The medical device comprises a plurality of electrodes and a plurality of sensors positioned on various finger sheaths, wrist portions, and hand portions. The various finger sheaths, the wrist portions, and the hand portions are configured to allow the plurality of electrodes to detect a plurality of electrical potentials on different surfaces of a user's body parts and the plurality of sensors to collect vital signs on different surfaces of a user's body parts, at least one processing device configured to contact with the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors, the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors configured to transmit the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs from the different surfaces of the user's body parts to the processing device. The processing device configured to store the plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs and process the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs to assess a user's health and an end user device configured to receive the plurality of processed electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs form the processing device through a network.

title_en: A kind of electromagnetic wave three-dimensional reverse-time migration imaging method under higher-Order Time-Domain algorithm
abstract_en: A kind of electromagnetic wave three-dimensional reverse-time migration imaging method under higher-Order Time-Domain algorithm is related to Computational electromagnetics and wideband radar detection.It is applicable not only to the buried target of ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR and hidden media area is reconnoitred and data acquisition imaging, be further widely applied to the particular problems such as geological prospecting, road prospecting and through-wall imaging.The experimental signal detected using three-dimensional high-order time-domain finite difference and ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR, the reverse field distribution for the time domain observation signal that the positive field distribution and ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR for obtaining the time domain excitation signal that ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR receives receive.Under the requirement for meeting reverse-time migration image-forming condition, theoretically inclination angle is overcome to limit, and can realize accurately image.The numerical simulation of reverse-time migration Imaging Simulation is carried out to target area using radar signal, the dynamic information of object to be measured can effectively be obtained, compared to traditional magnetography algorithm imaging resolution advantage with higher, take a firm foundation to obtain identification and the parametric inversion of object to be measured.

title_en: Method and system for detecting static human body target based on FMCW through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting a static human body target based on an FMCW through-wall radar, which belong to the technical field of human body target detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining echo signals of the FMCW radar, mixing to obtain intermediate frequency signals, and sampling the intermediate frequency signals to obtain a two-dimensional signal matrix; the method comprises the steps of carrying out line distance dimension FFT on the two-dimensional signal matrix to obtain a distance-slow time image, extracting phase information of all stationary targets according to the distance-slow time image, respectively calculating the peak intervals of autocorrelation functions of the phase information, respectively estimating signal frequencies of the stationary targets according to the peak intervals of the autocorrelation functions, and eliminating the stationary targets with the signal frequencies not in the human respiratory frequency range to obtain the stationary human targets. The invention can distinguish the static human body target and other interference signals by judging whether the signal frequency of the static target is in the frequency range of the human body respiratory signal, thereby effectively reducing the false alarm probability.

title_en: Management system for elderly people living alone based on ultra-wideband impluse-radio
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 건물 실내의 벽면에 생체신호 인식 단말이 설치되어, 비접촉식으로 실내에 거주하는 모니터링 대상자의 생체신호를 측정하여, 측정된 생체신호 데이터를 인터넷망을 통해 관리서버로 전송하고, 상기 관리서버에서는 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기초로 하여 관리 단말로 제어신호를 전송하도록 하는 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템에 있어서, 실내 특정장소에 누워있는 모니터링 대상자의 가슴 방향으로 무선 주파수(radio frequency) 전파를 송신하고, 상기 대상자의 가슴으로부터 운전자의 심장 및 폐의 운동 변위에 따른 반사 신호를 검출하기 위한 생체신호검출부, 상기 생체신호검출부로부터 검출된 모니터링 대상자의 심장 및 폐의 운동 변위에 따른 반사 신호를 토대로 실시간으로 모니터링 대상자의 심박수 및 호흡수를 계산하는 생체신호계산부, 상기 생체신호계산부로부터 계산된 실시간으로 모니터링 대상자의 심박수 및 호흡수와 기 저장된 기준 심박수 및 호흡수를 비교하는 생체신호비교부, 상기 생체신호 인식 단말로 건물내의 전원공급이 중단될 경우, 비상용 충전 배터리를 통해 상기 생체신호 인식 단말로 비상전원이 공급되도록 하는 비상전원공급부 및 상기 생체신호비교부로부터 실시간으로 운전자의 심박수 및 호흡수가 기준 심박수 및 호흡수로부터 벗어나 신체 이상 상태인 것으로 판단되는 경우, 상기 관리 단말 또는 상기 생체 신호 인식 단말로 운전자에게 경고명령 신호를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 제공된다. 상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 신체의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 센싱수단을 신체에 부착하거나 파지하는 등의 번거로움을 덜고, UWB를 기반으로 한 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식을 이용하여 독거노인의 생체정보를 외부로 전송 및 경고할 수 있도록 하여, 모니터링 대상자의 불편함없이 관리가 이루어 질 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다. 또한, 지진 등의 자연재해나 화재 또는 건물내 정전으로 생체신호 인식 단말로 전원이 공급되지 않을 경우, 비상용 배터리를 통해 모니터링 대상자의 생체신호 측정이 연속적으로 이루어지도록 하여, 위급상황에서 안정적으로 관리가 이루어질 수 있는 효과가 있다. 또한, 건물내 천정에 설치되는 생체신호 인식 단말이 탄성줄에 의해 천정에 매달리는 형태로 설치되도록 하여, 지진이나 건물 주변 열차 통행에 의해 건물의 천정으로 전달되는 진동이 생체신호 인식 단말로 전달되지 않아 위급상황에서도 생체신호 측정의 오류없이 신뢰도가 높은 관리가 이루어질 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Methods for improving the accuracy of vital radar heart rate based on heart rate analysis algorithms
title_ko: 심박 유형 분석 알고리즘을 통한 바이탈 레이더 심박수의 정확도 개선 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for improving the accuracy of a vital radar heart rate through a heart rate type analysis algorithm, which classifies the heart rate waveform of the first heart rate for a heart rate signal detected based on a biosignal into a plurality of types according to the interval spacing. By recalculating the heart rate using the weights assigned to each type, errors occurring in the primary heart rate calculation process can be further reduced, and the accuracy can be dramatically increased.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 신호에 기초하여 검출된 심박 신호에 대한 1차 심박수의 심박 파형을 인터벌 간격에 따라 다수의 유형으로 분류하고, 각 유형 별로 부여되는 가중치를 이용하여 심박수를 재산출함으로써 1차 심박수 산출 과정에서 발생되는 오차를 더욱 줄이고 정확도를 획기적으로 높일 수 있는 심박 유형 분석 알고리즘을 통한 바이탈 레이더 심박수의 정확도 개선 방법에 대한 것이다.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A home occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event.

title_en: Flying type radar life detection appearance
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment and a flying type radar life detection appearance is disclosed, including control box, the operation page, display screen, aircraft directional control handle, human life information screen, equipment compartment, antenna, rotor, motor and undercarriage, flying type radar life detection appearance control system includes LED light source, power supply unit, camera, radar detection ripples, microphone, falls the unit of making an uproar, megaphone, signal amplifier, signal acquisition portion, filtering signal transducer, signal amplifier, video reception end, speech perception end and life diagnostic information, the control box top is equipped with human life information screen, the control box both sides all are equipped with aircraft directional control handle, control box one end is equipped with the operation page and sets up the display screen at operation page top, the equipment compartment bottom is equipped with the undercarriage, this flying type radar life detection appearance, and functional strong, the life detection wide range has improved the rescue dynamics greatly.

title_en: Crab apartment device with monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crab apartment device with monitor function, includes crab apartment, automatic monitoring device, track, support, power cord, coaster device, backup pad, controller, first servo motor, has first belt pulley device, first assembly pulley, second belt assembly pulley, second servo motor, shell, automatic telescoping device, third servo motor, screw rod, nut, telescopic link, camera device, radar life detection appearance, alarm and infrared induction remote controller. The utility model has the advantages that the occupied space is small, and the occupied area of every hundred swimming crabs is less than 1 square meter on average, thereby saving resources; the camera captures the picture of each swimming crab in the crab apartment, so that the workload of managers is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor is saved; the life state of the portunids is detected in real time through a radar life detector, so that the death of the portunids is avoided, and the accurate positioning treatment is realized; the operation of the monitoring device can be controlled by the infrared of the remote controller, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Health monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a health monitoring system comprising an indoor device equipped with a sensor module, a processor in communication with the sensor module, and an alarm system. The embodiment of the utility model discloses breakthrough integration of radar technology and artificial intelligence in common household equipment (ceiling fans). The system consists of a seamlessly integrated radar module and decorative radome, turning the fan into a discreet and unobtrusive health-monitoring device. The radar module remotely transmits signals to the monitoring area, captures signals reflected from the individual's body, and provides continuous real-time data regarding vital signs such as heart rate and respiratory rate. Such information, when processed by the artificial intelligence processor, enables the system to detect abnormal conditions, triggering an alert communicated to the user through the user interface. The novel system can adapt to different living environments and has deployment flexibility, and a new era of comprehensive, continuous and user-friendly health monitoring is created.
assignees: AIHUI INTELLIGENT TECH ZHONGSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on periodic characteristics and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for detecting vital signs based on periodic characteristics, and the method for detecting the vital signs based on the periodic characteristics comprises the following steps: sending a radar signal to a to-be-detected area, and receiving a radar echo signal returned by the to-be-detected area; performing signal preprocessing on the radar echo signal, and determining the state of a human body target in a region to be detected; if the human body target exists in the region to be detected, extracting the vital sign data with the periodic characteristics from the radar echo signal of the region to be detected based on the periodic characteristics of the vital sign data; and carrying out data processing on the vital sign data with the periodic characteristics to obtain a vital sign detection result with the periodic characteristics. The method, the device and the storage medium for detecting the vital sign based on the periodic characteristics disclosed by the embodiment of the invention improve the detection precision of the vital sign data.

title_en: Multi-person heartbeat detection and positioning method and system based on SIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person heartbeat detection and positioning method and system based on SIMO radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: correcting amplitude and phase of echo signals of all channels of the radar; weighting the corrected signals to obtain echo signals corresponding to the search angles; calculating a two-dimensional FFT of the distance Doppler for the echo signals, and reconstructing; imaging to obtain distance and angle information of a human body target; calculating an optimal directional diagram weight vector according to a DBF principle, and then calculating a distance dimension FFT; acquiring a vital sign signal of each human body target; and estimating heart rate by using PCA and ZASLMS algorithms, decomposing and extracting vital sign signals according to the estimated heart rate by using tensor decomposition theoretical algorithm to obtain target heart beat signals and recovering corresponding time domain waveforms. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, can accurately judge the distance and angle information of a plurality of human targets positioned in different or same distance doors, inhibit the interference of moving and static objects and extract the heartbeat signals of the corresponding targets.

title_en: Life detection method and device based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection method and device based on radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a target by a radar, and determining distance information and angle information of the target; preprocessing signals in the target distance unit, and outputting target signals; acquiring phase information of a target signal, and performing phase unwrapping on the target signal to acquire a life signal; separating the vital signals to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals; acquiring the frequency of a heartbeat signal and the frequency of a respiratory signal by a time domain method and a frequency method; and respectively determining a respiratory frequency weighting coefficient and a heartbeat frequency weighting coefficient according to the numerical difference of the respiratory frequency and the numerical difference of the heartbeat frequency under the time domain method and the frequency method to obtain a respiratory frequency detection value and a heartbeat frequency detection value. The method effectively eliminates the defects of the time domain method and the frequency method, and improves the accuracy of vital sign data detection.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUAJIE ZHITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground penetrating radar detection and disease treatment method for deep-buried high-voltage tunnel
abstract_en: The application relates to a ground penetrating radar detection and disease treatment method for a deep buried high-voltage tunnel, wherein on-site survey lines are of a two-to-longitudinal net structure, a radar transmitting antenna continuously transmits pulse high-frequency electromagnetic waves to the underground, a receiving antenna receives reflected waves and transmitted waves generated by interfaces with electrical differences or target bodies, and the properties of the target bodies are judged and forecast are formed according to the form, strength and change of radar spectrum reflected waves; the forecasting content comprises four aspects of forecasting whether broken rock stratum exists in front of the face, forecasting whether water-rich rock stratum exists in front of the face, forecasting whether water or mud burst possibility exists in front of the face, forecasting a fault broken zone in front of the face and water content of the fault broken zone; and summarizing, surveying and constructing design files and construction specifications according to forecast contents in combination with engineering profiles to formulate treatment schemes.
assignees: SHANXI COMMUNICATION SCIENCE AND TECH R & D CO LTD;SHANXI TRANSP SCIENCE HIGHWAY SURVEY & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle cluster nursing system and deployment platform thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene unmanned aerial vehicle nursing system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent health care. The system comprises a modularized duty workstation, a multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a central dispatching platform, and is innovatively provided with three main core functions, namely, firstly, elastic deployment, namely, dynamically adjusting the ratio of unmanned aerial vehicles (1:4-1:8) based on the number of beds, adopting a tidal charging strategy to ensure the continuous voyage of a high-risk area, enabling a single machine to cover 8 beds, greatly reducing equipment cost, secondly, non-contact monitoring, namely, integrating a 60GHz millimeter wave radar and a thermal imaging technology, realizing 2-meter vital sign monitoring, identifying 9 types of abnormal sounds such as pain and groan by voiceprint analysis, and thirdly, a five-stage emergency system, namely, automatically rechecking to opening an autonomous emergency channel, and obviously improving response speed compared with the traditional scheme. The intelligent monitoring system is suitable for places needing continuous monitoring such as nursing homes, hospitals, kindergartens, pet nursing centers and the like, and realizes the organic integration of intelligent patrol, health early warning and emergency response.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Complex procedure apparatus using galvanic and plasma
title_ko: 갈바닉 및 플라즈마를 이용한 복합 시술 장치
abstract_en: A complex procedure apparatus is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is a complex procedure apparatus, comprising: a main body where a grip portion, capable of being gripped by a user, is formed; a plasma generating portion installed on one side of the main body to generate plasma; a galvanic current generating portion installed on one side of the main body to generate a galvanic current; a biosignal measuring sensor installed on the other side of the main body to measure a user′s biosignal by the user′s grip; and a control portion for controlling the operation of the plasma generating portion and the galvanic current generating portion.
abstract_ko: 복합 시술 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 사용자가 파지 가능한 파지부가 형성되는 본체,본체의 일측에 설치되어 플라즈마를 발생시키는 플라즈마 발생부, 본체의 일측에 설치되어 갈바닉 전류를 발생시키는 갈바닉 발생부, 본체의 타측에 설치되어 사용자의 파지에 의해 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 측정 센서, 및 플라즈마 발생부 및 갈바닉 발생부의 작동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 복합 시술 장치가 제공된다.

title_en: Fine dust information collection system using air cleaning headphone with sliding guide
title_ko: 슬라이딩식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰을 이용한 미세먼지정보 수집 시스템
abstract_en: A fine dust information collection system using an air cleaning headphone with a sliding guide of the present invention comprises: a headphone body which includes two earplugs emitting sound and purified air, a headband connecting the two earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a sliding guide concentrating the purified air emitted from the earplugs around a mouth and a nose; a charging station on which the headphone body is held and which can emit purified air; a fine dust measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure fine dust concentration around a user and transmits information on the measured fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a biosignal measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure a biosignal of the user and transmits information on the measured biosignal to the mobile device of the user; and a central server which wirelessly communicates with the mobile device of the user and receives information on the fine dust concentration and information on the biosignal. Accordingly, the present invention enables users to breathe in fresh air outdoors and even indoors.

title_en: Target detection method for ground-penetrating radar and associated radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for detecting at least one target buried in an area of the ground, using ground-penetrating radar, the method comprising the steps of: - acquiring (201) a measurement of a signal transmitted by each transmission antenna and reflected in the area of the ground; - determining (202) an estimate, in the frequency domain, of the propagation channel for each pair consisting of a transmission antenna and a reception antenna; - defining a first hypothesis H0 corresponding to the absence of a target in the area of the ground; - defining a second hypothesis H1 corresponding to the presence of at least one target in the area of the ground; - performing (203) a test of the likelihood ratio between the likelihood of the channel matrix under the second hypothesis H1 and the likelihood of the channel matrix under the first hypothesis H0, in order to conclude that a target is present at a given position in the area of the ground.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring bio-signal using radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a method and apparatus for measuring a bio-signal using a radar. An apparatus for measuring a bio-signal using a radar according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first signal acquisition unit for acquiring, from a first radar, a first signal including a first bio-signal measured from a measurement subject; a second signal acquisition unit for acquiring, from a second radar, a second signal including both a second bio-signal and the first bio-signal measured from the measurement subject; a signal synchronization unit for synchronizing the first signal and the second signal; and a bio-signal detection unit for calculating the difference between the synchronized first and second signals so as to eliminate the first bio-signal and detect the second bio-signal from the second signal, wherein the distance at which the first radar is placed from the measurement subject is set such that the first bio-signal is measured, and the distance at which the second radar is placed from the measurement subject is set such that both the first bio-signal and the second bio-signal are measured.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 장치는 제1 레이더로부터 측정 대상자의 제1 생체 신호가 측정된 제1 신호를 획득하는 제1 신호 획득부, 제2 레이더로부터 상기 측정 대상자의 제2 생체 신호와 상기 제1 생체 신호가 모두 측정된 제2 신호를 획득하는 제2 신호 획득부, 상기 제1 신호와 제2 신호를 동기화하는 신호 동기화부 및 상기 동기화된 제1 신호와 제2 신호의 차이를 계산하여 상기 제2 신호에서 상기 제1 생체 신호를 제거하고 상기 제2 생체 신호를 검출하는 생체 신호 검출부를 포함하되, 상기 제1 레이더는 상기 측정 대상자로부터 상기 제1 생체 신호가 측정되도록 설정된 거리에 배치되고, 상기 제2 레이더는 상기 측정 대상자로부터 상기 제1 생체 신호 및 제2 생체 신호가 모두 측정되도록 설정된 거리에 배치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for sensing with millimeter waves for sleep position detection, vital signs monitoring and/or driver detection
abstract_en: A sensor and method for sleep position detection including: a transmitter configured to transmit electromagnetic waves between 30 GHz and 300 GHz; a receiver configured to receive the electromagnetic waves from the transmitter, wherein the transmitter and receiver are positioned in relation to person sleeping such that the receiver receives reflected electromagnetic waves; and a control station configured to analyze the transmitted and received electromagnetic waves to determine a position of the person sleeping. In some cases, the method may include: forming a radar cube of results; performing a fast fourier transform (FFT) on the radar cube; applying a constant false alarm rate (CFAR) processor to the FFT data; determining a capon gradient; forming a 5-dimensional feature space based on the capon gradient; and conducting an optimization of SVM.
assignees: SHAKER GEORGE;ALIZADEH Mostafa;SAFAVI NAEINI SAFIEDDIN;ABEDI HAJAR;CHIA XUJIE XAVIER

title_en: Systems and methods for living thing presence detection using a radar system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the disclosure include a Radar system for detecting presence of a living thing. The radar system includes a transmitter/receiver module configured to emit radio signals to an environment surrounding the Radar system and to detect returned radio signals from the environment, and a large-movement detection sub-module configured to determine a large movement of the living thing based on the returned radio signals. The radar system also includes a micro-movement detection sub-module configured to determine a micro movement of the living thing based on the returned radio signals, and a breath and heartbeat detection sub-module configured to determine a breath or heartbeat of the living thing based on the returned radio signals. The radar system further includes a presence detection sub-module configured to determine the presence of the living thing based on determinations received from the corresponding detection sub-modules.
assignees: AIRTOUCH SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Physical test device and test method for simulating sandy soil debris flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical test device and a physical test method for simulating sandy soil debris flow, which relate to the technical field of geological experiments and have the technical scheme that: the rainfall simulation device comprises a transparent model box, a rainfall simulation device and a data acquisition system; a sand model is paved in the transparent model box; a sensor device is buried in the sand model; the rainfall simulation device comprises a water inlet tank, a water guide pipe and a nozzle; the data acquisition system consists of a high-definition camera, stereo microscope equipment, a dynamic strain data acquisition system connected with the sensor device and computer equipment; the high-definition camera, the stereo microscope device and the dynamic strain data acquisition system are connected with the computer device. The method has the advantages that the development process of the debris flow can be finely and visually obtained, the debris flow starting characteristics, the displacement field evolution process and the destruction form are obtained through analysis, the deep exploration of the complex induction mechanism of the debris flow is facilitated, and technical support and theoretical basis are provided for effective prevention and treatment engineering measures.

title_en: Method for arranging asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides an asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor arrangement method, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering. Based on tunnel surrounding rock geological data, according to the ground stress distribution of asymmetric raw rock and the geometric characteristics of tunnel sections, three-dimensional numerical simulation is carried out on the stability of an asymmetric high-stress tunnel, the energy of the asymmetric high-stress tunnel is calculated, the position of a rock burst risk area is determined, microseismic sensors are distributed at the front and rear sides of the stress concentration area, areas with higher risks and areas nearby the areas are always contained in two groups of microseismic sensor arrays arranged at the front and rear sides of a tunnel face, the microseismic sensors work cooperatively and are arranged in a staggered mode in space, and the installation arrangement of the microseismic sensors immediately moves forwards and backwards in the stress concentration area and keeps a certain distance range with the stress area all the time. The invention ensures that more effective micro-fracture source signals in and near the tunnel stress concentration area can be captured by the micro-seismic sensor, improves the positioning precision of the micro-seismic source, and lays a foundation for accurately predicting and forecasting the tunnel disasters of the deep buried hard rock.

title_en: Far infrared vital sign monitoring method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sign monitoring, in particular to a far infrared vital sign monitoring method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining thermal imaging data of a monitoring area, generating a thermal diagram to obtain the thermal diagram of the monitoring area, integrating physical sign characteristics of the thermal diagram of the monitoring area to obtain vital sign data of a user of the monitoring area, detecting unbalance of the center of gravity of the user based on the vital sign data of the user of the monitoring area to obtain unbalance behavior data of the center of gravity of the user, obtaining millimeter wave signal sets of the monitoring area, analyzing gesture change behavior to obtain quick gesture change behavior data of the user, performing risk assessment according to the unbalance behavior data of the center of gravity of the user and the quick gesture change behavior data of the user to obtain falling risk data of the user of the monitoring area, and performing falling risk early warning strategy analysis according to the falling risk data of the user of the monitoring area to obtain a falling risk early warning strategy of the user. The method can improve the accuracy and efficiency of physical sign monitoring.

title_en: Concurrent monitoring of indoor oxygen concentration levels and human vital signs with mmWave radar sensors
abstract_en: Technologies directed to are concurrent monitoring indoor oxygen-deficiency and human vital signs with mmWave radars described. One method sends a first signal having a first chirp having a triangular shape and a second chirp having a ramp shape. A frequency of the first signal is in a millimeter wave (mmWave) frequency range. The method receives a second signal corresponding to the first signal, the second signal comprising a first portion corresponding to the first chirp and a second portion corresponding to the second chirp. The method generates a third signal indicative of a human vital sign using the first chirp and the first portion. The method measures a value indicative of oxygen-deficiency in air using the second chirp and the second portion.

title_en: Through wall sensing system using WiFi/cellular radar
abstract_en: A handheld through-wall sensing system comprising a transmitter/receiving operating at wireless data or cellular transmission frequencies. The system is operated in a monostatic radar mode with transmission occurring on frequency f o  and reception on a predetermined bandwidth centered on f o . The system may be operated on a pulsed or pseudo “half duplex” mode and have a transmit/receive pattern that is a function of the desired minimum stand-off distance.

title_en: Case having individual a lie detector
title_ko: 거짓말 탐지기를 갖는 케이스
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 측정된 인간의 생체신호의 전류 변화량을 기반으로 거짓말 여부를 판별하는 거짓말 탐지기를 갖는 케이스에를 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 휴대폰이 장착되어 외부 충격으로부터 휴대폰을 보호하는 몸체부와, 센서부에 사용자의 손가락이 접촉되면, 생체신호를 감지하고 기존 생체신호와 비교하여 거짓말 여부를 판단하여 표시부에 거짓여부를 표시하는 거짓말 탐지부를 포함하여 구성되는데 있다.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue command information generation and transmission system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine emergency rescue command information generation and transmission system and a method, wherein the mine emergency rescue command information generation and transmission system comprises a rescue scene subsystem, an underground command base subsystem, a ground command center, a remote command center subsystem and a mobile command center subsystem, and is characterized in that: in the rescue scene subsystem, a first wireless camera, a first wireless mobile phone, a first wireless environmental parameter sensor and a first wireless vital sign detector are in wireless communication with a wireless/wired converter through a first wireless base station, a second wireless base station, … or an nth wireless base station respectively; in the underground command base subsystem, a second wireless camera, a second wireless mobile phone, a second wireless environment parameter sensor and a second wireless vital sign detector are in wireless communication with the mining intrinsic safety computer respectively; the third wireless camera and the third wireless mobile phone are in wireless communication with the ground base station respectively; can be widely applied to the fields of coal mines, non-coal mines and the like.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Vital signs detecting module for safeguard station
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of vital signs detecting module for safeguard station, including the Ith road signal conditioning circuit (1), IIth road signal conditioning circuit (2), IIIth road signal conditioning circuit (3), IVth road signal conditioning circuit (4), vital sign parameter signals radiating circuit (5), totally 5 parts combine and constitute an one integral piece.For omnidirectional detection human body vital sign, safeguard station uses 4 road radar modules, radar module output signal amplitude compared with little and interference signal many, 3 grades of filter amplification circuit are devised for this, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters wireless transmitter module ADC, after software algorithm processes, it is transformed into breathing/beats, by safeguard station, vital sign information is launched with 121.5MHz/243MHz frequency range.Radar module is applied on safeguard station by the present invention first, can send the vital sign of distress personnel to search and rescue center, greatly improve efficiency and the specific aim of search-and-rescue work.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGYUAN MOBILCOM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rear interference suppression method for handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for suppressing rear interference of a handheld through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining the distance of a human body target behind the through-wall radar and the echo intensity; step S2: obtaining the distance of a human body target in front of the through-wall radar and the echo intensity; step S3: comparing the echo intensities corresponding to the human body target obtained in the steps S1 and S2, forming a preset threshold value by the difference between the two echo intensities, and using the threshold value as a basis for eliminating the rear interference. Step S4: when an object is detected within a certain distance, the object is feature-matched with the threshold T obtained in step S3. If the echo intensity is larger than the threshold value T, the target is judged, otherwise, the false alarm is judged and filtered. The method has the advantages of simple principle, easy realization, effective suppression of rear interference, guarantee of the optimal detection performance of the radar and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional continuous power supply life detection platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional continuous power supply life detection platform which comprises a parking shelter, wherein a power supply system and an emergency communication system are arranged in the parking shelter, the power supply system consists of an energy storage module and a power generation module, the emergency communication system consists of a satellite communication system, a mobile G communication system short wave and ultrashort wave radio station, a power generator is connected to the power supply system, and the power generator is installed in the parking shelter. The capacity of the radar life detection instrument for continuous work is greatly improved, the box body can still depend on the power supply of the generator after leaving the chassis, and the emergency communication system can well communicate with field personnel or command personnel at all levels in time and effectively when an emergency occurs.
assignees: XINXING HEAVY IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Atrial fibrillation detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign detection technology and discloses an atrial fibrillation detection device, which transmits radar detection signals to a human body object to be detected, receives echo signals reflected by the human body object, processes and analyzes baseband signals obtained after the echo signals are mixed with the radar detection signals serving as local oscillation signals to obtain the heart rate of the human body object to be detected, judges whether atrial fibrillation occurs or not according to the heart rate of the human body object to be detected, and sends an alarm through an alarm unit when the atrial fibrillation occurs to the human body object to be detected, so that real-time monitoring of the atrial fibrillation of the human body object to be detected is realized. According to the atrial fibrillation detection device, atrial fibrillation does not need to be detected through electrocardiogram detection equipment, and the real-time non-contact atrial fibrillation monitoring can be performed on the human body object to be detected only by installing the atrial fibrillation detection device in the living environment of the human body object to be detected, so that the atrial fibrillation detection device is beneficial to timely finding when the human body object to be detected suffers from atrial fibrillation, does not influence the life of the human body object to be detected, and is particularly suitable for being used at home by old patients with irregular atrial fibrillation.

title_en: Transceiver module for detection radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of life detection, in particular to a transceiver module for a detection radar, which aims at solving the problem that the mbgc space is small, namely the relative space of large steel structure cabins such as a refrigeration house is limited, and radiated electromagnetic wave signals are completely reflected by a steel cabin metal structure body, so that the generated power is less than 1 mg, and the target of a life cannot be detected in the prior art. The invention can effectively solve the problem that the detection radar in the prior art cannot detect the target of the living body because the generated power is less than 1 mg because the radiation electromagnetic wave signal is completely reflected by the metal structure body of the steel cabin in a large steel structure cabin such as a refrigeration house with limited relative space.

title_en: Fall detection method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fall detection, and particularly discloses a fall detection method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: acquiring intermediate frequency ADC data through a millimeter wave radar; performing signal preprocessing operation on the intermediate frequency ADC data to obtain moving target point cloud data; identifying the current posture of a target human body according to the moving target point cloud data; and judging the falling state of the target human body according to the current posture recognition result of the target human body. The invention also discloses a fall detection system based on the millimeter wave radar. The method for detecting the falling of the millimeter wave radar based on the invention can select the millimeter wave radar with better environmental adaptability, does not relate to the privacy problem, not only judges the falling state through the information of the radar, but also adds means such as behavior logic judgment, vital sign detection and the like, and improves the falling accuracy of the millimeter wave radar.
assignees: WEIFU HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion-based buried target extraction and identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for extracting and identifying a buried target based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the field of disaster relief and multi-source data fusion, and can perform horizontal fusion and vertical fusion on multi-source data related to disaster situations, wherein disaster situation clues are determined by extracting disaster situation information and performing horizontal fusion, collapsed buildings are identified according to basic geographic data to obtain initial judgment results, and mobile phone signal data, radar signal data and the like are vertically fused to confirm the buried target. The method can quickly and accurately identify the buried target to be rescued by fusing multi-source data.

title_en: FMCW radar-based method for collecting skin superficial pulse wave signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pulse wave signal acquisition, and discloses a method for acquiring skin superficial pulse wave signals based on an FMCW radar, which comprises a pulse wave extraction method based on an FMCW radar signal acquisition module and an FMCW radar signal; the FMCW-based radar signal acquisition module comprises a shell, an FMCW radar and a transmission wire, wherein the human body surface based on the action of the FMCW radar signal acquisition module is a pulse wave body surface conduction position, including but not limited to a wrist, an upper arm, a neck and the like; the surface of the shell, which is contacted with the skin, is hollow. The invention can be applied to the monitoring of human vital signs of wearable equipment and the like by expanding the FMCW radar, and particularly relates to the estimation of vital sign parameters such as human blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate and the like under the condition of limiting exercise.
assignees: HEBEI XIONGAN HUIYI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System based on photoelectric sensor vital sign signal acquisition and analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of health detection, and provides a system based on photoelectric sensor vital sign signal acquisition and analysis, which comprises the following modules, namely an FP430 control module; an FPGA processing module; an expansion module; a cloud platform end; an APP end; a PPG detection module; an ECG detection module; a body fat detection module; according to the invention, physiological signal characteristics of a human body are analyzed by combining the PPG signal and the ECG signal to obtain various human body parameters such as blood pressure, blood oxygen saturation, heart rate, pulse condition, respiratory rate, pulse wave conduction speed, arteriosclerosis index, anxiety index signal, body fat and body water ratio, health management of a whole family can be realized through face recognition, whole-process voice health detection and guidance are realized, timing voice reminding is realized, convenience is brought to personnel, measurement data can be uploaded to a cloud platform and APP through BLE, 4G and WIFI modes, and various communication modes improve convenient data transmission and use experience.
assignees: SHANDONG SHANKE ZHIXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-sample through-wall radar high-resolution imaging method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radar signal processing, and particularly relates to a high-resolution imaging method of a few-sample through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring through-wall radar images of different targets with different rotation angles and optical images serving as optical labels, and constructing a source domain data set and a target domain data set; the method comprises the steps of (1) training a source domain high-resolution imaging network by using a source domain data set, (3) initializing a target domain network by using a trained source domain high-resolution imaging countermeasure network, and training the target domain network by using a target domain data set to obtain a migrated target domain high-resolution imaging network, wherein the structure of the target domain high-resolution imaging network is the same as that of the source domain high-resolution imaging network, and (4) inputting a radar image into a generator of the target domain high-resolution imaging network to obtain a high-resolution imaging result containing shape and contour information.

title_en: Underwater buried metal detection method using distributed MIMO ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater buried metal detection method by using a distributed MIMO ground penetrating radar, which is characterized by comprising two pairs of transceiving antenna arrays, wherein a first transceiving antenna and a second transceiving antenna are arranged in water and fixed at different positions, the underwater transceiving antenna arrays are respectively fixed on different floating bodies through fixing rods, the two groups of transceiving antennas are mutually far away, the first transceiving antenna and the second transceiving antenna are connected with transceiving devices positioned on the water surface through cables, the two groups of transceiving devices are respectively fixed on different floating bodies on the water surface, the floating bodies float above preset detection positions, the distance between the floating bodies on the water surface is adjusted according to the emission inclination angles of the different antennas, a water surface transceiver is connected with an upper computer through the cables, and the upper computer judges the position of the underwater buried metal according to data transmitted by the two pairs of the transceiving antenna arrays.

title_en: Situation monitoring system based on activity sensor
title_ko: 활동센서 기반의 상황 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a situation monitoring system based on an activity sensor, which comprises: a radar measuring device which senses a user's biological signal in an indoor environment; a monitoring server which receives the biological signal collected by the radar measuring device to detect the occurrence of an emergency situation for a user in the indoor environment; and a user terminal which interworks with each of the radar measuring device and the monitoring server through a dedicated application. Accordingly, the present invention can effectively detect the occurrence of the user's emergency situation by sensing a biological signal in an indoor environment such as a home or an office.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 활동센서 기반의 상황 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 실내 환경에서 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 측정기; 상기 레이더 측정기에 의해 수집된 생체 신호를 수신하여 상기 실내 환경 하에서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 측정기 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 가정, 사무실 등의 실내 환경에서 생체 신호를 감지하여 사용자의 위급상황 발생을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidance method, computer program product and system
abstract_en: A hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) guidance method (40) for a system including a head-mountable computing device (100) comprising a processor (110) and at least one display module (106, 106') arranged to be viewed by the wearer (20) of the head-mountable computing device when wearing the device is disclosed that allows a rescuer to receive CPR guidance without losing sight of the victim. The method comprises receiving (420), on said processor, a first signal conveying vital signs information from at least one sensor (200, 210) for monitoring vital signs of a patient (10), wherein a sensor (210) of the at least one sensor is integrated in the head-mountable computing device (100); processing said first signal on said processor to obtain the vital signs information; and displaying (422) CPR guidance on said at least one display module in response to the processed vital signs information. A computer program product and a CPR guidance system are also disclosed. The system may be created in situ using ubiquitous devices, e.g. smart devices including usable sensors, thus facilitating rapid response to an SCA event, which improves the chances of survival of a SCA victim.

title_en: Systems and methods for vehicle occupant vital sign detection
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detection and/or estimation of a rate of an occupant vital sign from within a cabin of a vehicle. In some implementations, the method may comprise identifying a repeating pattern of Doppler spectrum peaks in RADAR signal using a plurality of different range bins. An estimated frequency distance between adjacent peaks of the repeating pattern may then be identified using the signal data. An estimated rate of a repeating vital sign of an occupant within the cabin of the vehicle may then be calculated using the estimated frequency distance.

title_en: Worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: A worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear, according to the present invention, comprises the steps in which: a signal detected by a biosignal sensor (130) provided to biosignal-based safety management workwear (100) is transmitted to a web service (210) of a server (200); the web service (210) sends an algorithm insertion or deletion request to a database (220) of the server (200), or an algorithm storage request to a Hadoop distributed file system (HDFS) (230) of the server (200); the HDFS (230) stores the algorithm when the algorithm storage request is received; the HDFS (230) transmits the algorithm to the web service (210) in order for the execution of the stored algorithm; the web service (210) that received the algorithm retrieves and applies the algorithm, and then retrieves data having the algorithm applied thereto and sends a simple object access protocol (SOAP) message to an output device; and a screen is outputted via the output device. The worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear, according to the present invention, enables the prevention of work accidents on an industrial site by enabling the identification of the biosignal-based health status of a worker wearing safety management workwear for measuring a biosignal, and enables the prevention of safety-related accidents by having a big data-based server analyze the state of a worker, such as the state of stress, movement intensity, motion and behavior patterns, etc., by using a biosignal, such as an electrocardiogram record, acceleration, body temperature, etc., detected by the biosignal sensor provided to the safety management workwear, and a notable effect of promoting accident prevention, production increase and health improvement is achieved by providing a continuous personalized health management service to workers.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법은 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)에 구비된 생체신호용 센서(130)를 통해 감지된 신호를 서버(200)의 웹 서비스(210)에 전송하는 단계; 상기 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 삽입 또는 삭제를 서버(200)의 데이터베이스(220)에 요청하거나, 또는 알고리즘 저장을 서버의 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)(HDFS, Hadoop Distributed File System)에 요청하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 알고리즘 저장 요청시 알고리즘을 저장하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 저장된 알고리즘을 실행하기 위해 알고리즘을 웹 서비스(210)로 전송하는 단계; 상기 알고리즘을 수신한 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 검색 및 적용한 후, 적용된 데이터를 검색하여 SOAP(Simple Object Access Protocol) 메시지를 출력장치에 보내는 단계; 상기 출력장치를 통해 화면을 출력하는 단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: UNIV INJE IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Multichannel UWB-based radar life detector and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: A multichannel UWB-based radar life detector includes a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas for forming three radar echo signal channels. A 2-dimensional positioning method thereof includes: a1) amplifying weak life signals of stationary human by the channels, providing an 8-point integration method with an interval of 4 points to radar echo signals by distance; then breaking the integrated signals for decomposition and reconstruction in such a manner that target echo signals and three distance signals are formed; providing digital filtering and differential to the target echo signals for amplifying the weak but useful life signals; a2) 1-dimensionally distinguishing the signals by distance, analyzing spatial frequency according to the filtered and differentiated target echo signals as well as the distance signals for obtaining three target projection signals in the three channels; and a3) identifying the 2-dimensional position information of the targets according to the projection signals, forming an image.
assignees: WANG JIANQI;JING XIJING;ZHANG YANG;LU HAO;LI YANFENG;LI ZHAO;JIAO TENG;YU XIAO

title_en: Ai-based living sensor-linked care service provision system
abstract_en: An AI-based system for providing care services, includes a radar sensor installed in a specific space, obtains, in the specific space, life signals, and obtains information about the user's body temperature; an artificial intelligence speaker that is linked to the radar sensor, outputs a voice message to the user based on the information obtained by the radar sensor to determine whether an emergency has occurred to the user, and outputs a voice message to encourage the user to measure his/her body temperature at a specified time to allow the user to get into the habit of measuring his/her body temperature; a monitoring server that receives the life signals and analyzes the received life signals, senses an emergency that has occurred to the user and checks whether the emergency has actually occurred through the artificial intelligence speaker, and then provides an alarm about the emergency; and a user terminal.

title_en: Printing solvent storage room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing solvent storage room which is divided into a storage area and a filling area by a fire-fighting shutter, wherein an electromagnetic explosion-proof valve is arranged on a solvent taking platform of the filling area, a solvent storage tank of the storage area supplies solvent to the electromagnetic explosion-proof valve through a buried conduit and a solvent pump, a lifting fire-fighting cover is arranged above the solvent taking platform, sealing grooves corresponding to bottom cover openings of the nested fire-fighting cover are arranged on the periphery of the solvent taking platform, a cover body of the fire-fighting cover is of a hollow sandwich structure, an automatic dry powder fire extinguisher and a temperature sensor are hung at the top of an inner cavity of the fire-fighting cover, a combustible gas concentration detection alarm device and a fire automatic alarm system are arranged in the filling area, a fire alarm controller is in communication connection with a lifting mechanism of the fire-fighting cover, and the explosion-proof ventilation mechanism is in communication connection with the combustible gas concentration detection alarm device. The safety of printing solvent storage and distribution is effectively improved, the occurrence of casualties is thoroughly eradicated, and the accident loss is effectively reduced.

title_en: Distributed biological radar system and monitoring system for home care
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed biological radar system and a monitoring system for home-based aged people, wherein the radar system comprises a first radar and a second radar which are arranged at a certain height of a monitoring area, the first radar detects the distance measurement and/or the angle measurement of a moving target and vital sign signals, the second radar detects the distance measurement and/or the angle measurement of the moving target when in a first detection mode, moves up and down when in a second detection mode and detects the monitoring area to obtain point cloud data, if the distance measurement and/or the angle measurement signals detected by the two radars are unchanged and the vital sign signals are detected by the first radar, the second radar moves up and down, a calculation module divides the point cloud data detected by the second radar into a plurality of layered spaces and determines a ground base line, and judges whether the point cloud data which accords with human body characteristics is in a preset height range above the ground base line, if the point cloud data which accords with human body characteristics is found, the point cloud data is processed abnormally. The invention can realize fall alarm monitoring in a larger range and more accurately.

title_en: Bio signal measurement apparatus and bio signal measurement method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
생체 신호 측정장치 및 방법이 제공된다.  
개시된 생체 신호 측정장치는, 피검체의 표면에 표시된 적어도 두 개의 참조마크로부터의 신호를 검출하는 센서와 상기 적어도 두 개의 참조마크로부터의 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호 측정 위치에 대한 정보를 출력하는 생체 신호 측정위치 검출부를 포함한다. 생체 신호 측정장치는 생체 신호 측정위치에 대한 정보를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정한다.

title_en: Multifunctional air cleaning headphone system capable of collecting fine dust information
title_ko: 미세먼지정보 수집이 가능한 다기능 공기정청 헤드폰 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multifunctional air cleaning headphone system capable of collecting fine dust information, comprising: a headphone main body including two earplugs emitting sound and cleaned air, a mask connected to the part between the two earplugs, a headband rotatably engaged with the two earplugs, and an eye cover rotatably engaged with the part between the two earplugs and the headband; a fine dust measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring the fine dust concentration around a user and transmitting the information of the fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a bio signal measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring bio signals of the user and transmitting the information of the measured bio signals to the mobile device of the user; and a central server wirelessly communicating with the mobile device of the user and receiving the information of the fine dust concentration and the information of the bio signals. The present invention aims to provide a multifunctional air cleaning headphone system which is capable of allowing a user to breathe clean air anywhere.

title_en: Foldable fire self-rescue cabin
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a conflagration life saving equipment technical field specifically discloses folding conflagration cabin of saving oneself, including pre-buried frame, the folding cabin of fire prevention and decoration fixed plate, be equipped with the holding tank that is used for accomodating the folding cabin of fire prevention on the pre-buried frame, the opening of holding tank is forward, decorate the opening part that fixed plate detachably lid closed at the holding tank, make the folding cabin of fire prevention accomodate to the holding tank in, the folding cabin of fire prevention can expand forward and fold backward, the folding cabin of fire prevention after the expansion is formed and is used for holding personnel's of fleing the thermal-insulated inner chamber of fire prevention, and leave the thermal-insulated inner chamber of fire prevention and switch on in the side in the folding cabin of fire prevention, and be used for the fire prevention hatch. The utility model discloses simple structure, convenient to use, space occupancy is little, can enter and dodge when the conflagration breaing out, waits for the rescue, guarantees life safety.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster early warning device, which comprises a vertical post rod; the top of the upright post rod is fixedly connected with a mounting sphere, and a plurality of sensors are assembled on the mounting sphere; the bottom of the upright post rod is fixedly connected with an embedded mounting part; the embedded mounting part comprises a mounting ring plate fixedly connected to the bottom of the upright post rod, a mounting hole is formed in the mounting ring plate, and the inner side wall of the mounting hole is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the upright post rod through a plurality of connecting posts; the embedded installation part also comprises a plurality of embedded ring plates which are distributed at intervals from top to bottom, through holes are formed in the embedded ring plates, a plurality of embedded parts are fixedly connected to the embedded ring plates, each embedded part comprises an embedded installation column penetrating through the embedded ring plates, and two ends of each embedded installation column are respectively connected with an outer embedded ball body and an inner embedded ball body; the installation ring plates are fixedly connected with the embedded ring plates through a plurality of installation pieces distributed in an annular array mode. The utility model has the advantages of improved buried stability, improved the reliability of early warning.

title_en: Anti-seismic bracket for natural gas long-distance pipeline separate-transportation station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of natural gas engineering, and particularly discloses an anti-seismic bracket for a natural gas long-distance pipeline sub-transmission station, which comprises two shock buffers with two ends respectively installed. The support comprises a first bearing part and a second bearing part, the second bearing part is pre-buried in the installation position, and the two shock-absorbing buffers are respectively connected with the first bearing part and the second bearing part. One side of the first bearing part is provided with a pipeline installation part which is fixedly connected with the first bearing part. The shock absorber is mounted on the bearing part through a universal hinged support. The second receiving part is fixed on the structure. Under normal working conditions, the thermal displacement of the pipeline is not limited by the bracket. When an earthquake occurs, the support limits the vibration of the pipeline and prevents resonance damage. The support improves the stability and reliability of the pipeline, the earthquake force is dispersed through the double shock buffers, the universal hinged support allows multidirectional displacement, the maintenance is convenient, and the safety and stability of the natural gas conveying system are guaranteed.
assignees: SICHUAN GUORUI ENG DESIGN CO LTD
